djk_text: Disi na a lo avo gaansama fu Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi, a bakaten manpikin fu Kownu Dafeti paansu. Dafeti seefi na wan baka bakaten pikin fu Abalaham paansu, a moo gaandi avo gaansama fu ala Dyusama.
eng_text: The book of the genealogy of Jesus Christ , the son of David, the son of Abraham.

djk_text: Ne Abalaham meke Isaki. Ne Isaki meke Jakopu. Ne Jakopu meke Juda anga den taa elufu baala fi en.
eng_text: Abraham became the father of Isaac. Isaac became the father of Jacob. Jacob became the father of Judah and his brothers.

djk_text: Juda dati sete a lo fu den Dyusama den e kai Juda. Bika en anga a uman di den e kai Tamal meke Pelesi anga Seila. Ne Pelesi meke Sesilon. Bakadati, ne Sesilon meke Alan.
eng_text: Judah became the father of Perez and Zerah by Tamar. Perez became the father of Hezron. Hezron became the father of Ram.

djk_text: Ne Alan meke Amenadabu. Ne Amenadabu meke Nakson. Ne Nakson meke Salmon.
eng_text: Ram became the father of Amminadab. Amminadab became the father of Nahshon. Nahshon became the father of Salmon.

djk_text: We, ne Salmon anga a uman den e kai Laakabu meke Bowasi. Ne Bowasi anga a uman den e kai Lotu meke Obeti. Bakadati, ne Obeti meke Isai.
eng_text: Salmon became the father of Boaz by Rahab. Boaz became the father of Obed by Ruth. Obed became the father of Jesse.

djk_text: Ne Isai meke Dafeti, a kownu. Namo, ne Kownu Dafeti anga a uman fu Uliya meke Salomo.
eng_text: Jesse became the father of King David. David became the father of Solomon by her who had been the wife of Uriah.

djk_text: Ne Salomo meke Lekabeyamu. Ne Lekabeyamu meke Abiya. Namo, ne Abiya, meke Asa.
eng_text: Solomon became the father of Rehoboam. Rehoboam became the father of Abijah. Abijah became the father of Asa.

djk_text: Ne Asa meke Jowsafati. Ne Jowsafati meke Yoolam. Ne Yoolam meke Usiya.
eng_text: Asa became the father of Jehoshaphat. Jehoshaphat became the father of Joram. Joram became the father of Uzziah.

djk_text: Ne Usiya meke Yowtam. Ne Yowtam meke Akasi. Namo, ne Akasi meke Heskiya.
eng_text: Uzziah became the father of Jotham. Jotham became the father of Ahaz. Ahaz became the father of Hezekiah.

djk_text: Ne Heskiya meke Manase. Ne Manase dati meke Amon. Bakadati, ne Amon meke Yowsiya.
eng_text: Hezekiah became the father of Manasseh. Manasseh became the father of Amon. Amon became the father of Josiah.

djk_text: Ne Yowsiya meke Yekoniya anga den taa baala fu Yekoniya. Da na a ten de, ne den sama fu Babilon Kondee be kon meke oloku anga den Dyusama. Ne den kisi den Dyusama puu a Dyu Kondee tyai go poti a Babilon.
eng_text: Josiah became the father of Jechoniah and his brothers, at the time of the exile to Babylon.

djk_text: We, baka di den kisi den Dyusama so, ne Yekoniya meke Seyaltiyeli. Namo, ne Seyaltiyeli meke Selubabeli.
eng_text: After the exile to Babylon, Jechoniah became the father of Shealtiel. Shealtiel became the father of Zerubbabel.

djk_text: Ne Selubabeli meke Abihutu. Ne Abihutu meke Eliyaken. Ne Eliyaken meke Asolu.
eng_text: Zerubbabel became the father of Abiud. Abiud became the father of Eliakim. Eliakim became the father of Azor.

djk_text: Ne Asolu meke Saadoki. Ne Saadoki dati meke Akin. Namo, ne Akin dati meke Eliyutu.
eng_text: Azor became the father of Sadoc. Sadoc became the father of Achim. Achim became the father of Eliud.

djk_text: Namo, ne Eliyutu meke Eliyasa. Ne Eliyasa dati meke Matan. Da Matan dati meke Jakopu.
eng_text: Eliud became the father of Eleazar. Eleazar became the father of Matthan. Matthan became the father of Jacob.

djk_text: Te fu kaba, na a Jakopu ya meke Jowsef, a man fu Maliya. Maliya na a mma fu Jesesi di den e kai a Kelestesi.
eng_text: Jacob became the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary, from whom was born Jesus , who is called Christ.

djk_text: We, te u teli komoto na a fosi gaansama Abalaham go miti Kownu Dafeti, da na tin na fo dada meke pikin. Da fu komoto a Kownu Dafeti go doo a yuu di den Babilon sama kon kisi den Dyusama tyai gwe, da na tin na fo dada meke pikin tu. Soseefi fu teli komoto na a yuu di den Dyusama go a Babilon Kondee, go miti a ten di a Kelestesi meke, da na soseefi tin na fo dada meke pikin tu.
eng_text: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; from David to the exile to Babylon fourteen generations; and from the carrying away to Babylon to the Christ, fourteen generations.

djk_text: Ma namo, da a de so taki, Maliya na be a poti mofu uman fu Jowsef. Den be de fu libi, ma Maliya kon de anga bee, sondee fu Jowsef sabi en, uman fasi. A Jeje fu Masaa Gadu meke Maliya de anga a bee.
eng_text: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was like this; for after his mother, Mary, was engaged to Joseph, before they came together, she was found pregnant by the Holy Spirit.

djk_text: Ma namo, Jowsef na be wan sama di e pakisei fu du san fiti Masaa Gadu. Ne a denki namo fu paati anga Maliya saafi bakabaka, sondee fu bolotyasi a taki. Bika a á wani gi Maliya sen.
eng_text: Joseph, her husband, being a righteous man, and not willing to make her a public example, intended to put her away secretly.

djk_text: Ne di a pakisei de kon ne en, ne wan Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee kon ne en a ini wan deen. Ne a taigi en taki: “Jowsef! Manpikin fu Kownu Dafeti paansu! Yu á mu feele fu teke Maliya toon yu uman! Bika, a ná sama gi en a bee de, ma na a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu seefi wooko so.
eng_text: But when he thought about these things, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream, saying, "Joseph, son of David, don't be afraid to take to yourself Mary, your wife, for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Spirit.

djk_text: A o meke wan manpikin. Da i mu kai en Jesesi. Bika ne en o tyai yeepi gi a foluku fi en, fu puu den a takuudu anga ogii.”
eng_text: She shall bring forth a son. You shall call his name Jesus, for it is he who shall save his people from their sins."

djk_text: We! A hii toli ya waka enke fa Masaa Gadu be piki wan fositen apaiti takiman fi en, fu sikiifi taki, dati musu pasa bakaten. Bika a takiman be sikiifi taki:
eng_text: Now all this has happened, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying,

djk_text: “Wan ten e kon! Yu o si taki wan yonkuu uman, di á go a man wan dei o de anga bee. Da a o meke wan manpikin. Da den o kai en Imanuweli. A nen ya wani taki, Masaa Gadu seefi kon fu de anga wi.”
eng_text: Behold, the virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son. They shall call his name Immanuel; which is, being interpreted, "God with us."

djk_text: We, di Jowsef weki na a siibi, ne a du leti enke fa a Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee be taigi en, ne a teke Maliya poti a osu enke uman.
eng_text: Joseph arose from his sleep, and did as the angel of the Lord commanded him, and took his wife to himself;

djk_text: Ma a á siibi anga en uman fasi, fosi a meke a manpikin. Ne di Maliya meke a pikin, ne Jowsef taki, den mu kai en Jesesi.
eng_text: and didn't know her sexually until she had brought forth her firstborn son. He named him Jesus.

djk_text: Ma namo, da Masaa Jesesi meke na a pisiwataa fu Judeja, na a foto den kai Betelehem. A pisiten de, da na Kownu Helowdesi be e taki fu a hii pisiwataa anda. Ma wan duupu koniman komoto a doose kondee go a Jelusalem Foto. Den komoto na a se pe san e opo. Den koniman ya na sama di e sabi san o pasa, te den luku den sitali a tapu.
eng_text: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea in the days of King Herod, behold, wise men from the east came to Jerusalem, saying,

djk_text: Di den go doo Jelusalem Foto, ne den e akisi den sama ape taki: “Pe a kownu fu den Dyu di meke ya de? Bika wi si wan sitali a tapu, di e soi wi taki wan nyun kownu fu Dyusama meke dise. Ne i si u kon ya, fu kon gi en gaandi. We, gaantangi! U soi wi pe a meke, baa.”
eng_text: Where is he who is born King of the Jews? For we saw his star in the east, and have come to worship him.

djk_text: Namo, di Kownu Helowdesi yee taki, den e taki wan taa kownu meke, ne en anga a hii Jelusalem foluku buuya, te ná sipowtu.
eng_text: When King Herod heard it, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.

djk_text: Namo a sende kai ala den moo hei begiman a Jelusalem Foto fu den kon ne en. Soseefi a kai ala den leliman fu Dyuweiti tu. Ne a taigi den taki: “We! Masaa Gadu á be paamisi fu sende wan yeepiman kon a goontapu, no? We, u suku gi mi a ini Masaa Gadu Buku pe a Kelestesi be o meke.”
eng_text: Gathering together all the chief priests and scribes of the people, he asked them where the Christ would be born.

djk_text: We namo, ne den piki en taki: “Na Betelehem Foto, na a pisiwataa fu Judeja! Bika a sikiifi taki:
eng_text: They said to him, "In Bethlehem of Judea, for this is written through the prophet,

djk_text: ‘Betelehem Foto! A ná yu de na a pisiwataa fu Judeja, sondee balinen, no? We toku so, yu o toon wan balinen foto. Bika na yu a gaan edeman, di o de wan soluguman fu mi sikapu, mi Dyu foluku, o meke.’ ”
eng_text: 'You Bethlehem, land of Judah, are in no way least among the princes of Judah: for out of you shall come forth a governor, who shall shepherd my people, Israel.'"

djk_text: We, Kownu Helowdesi aliki, te a kaba. Namo a sende kai den koniman di be komoto na a se pe san e opo kibii kibii kon ne en. Ne a akisi den, meke den taigi en, on ten pilisisi den be si a sitali a tapu.
eng_text: Then Herod secretly called the wise men, and learned from them exactly what time the star appeared.

djk_text: Bakadati, ne a gi den pasi den go a Betelehem Foto go suku a pikin. Ma fosi den gwe, ne a taigi den taki: “U go suku fini fini pe a pikin meke. Te u fende en, da u kon piki mi baka. Bika mi seefi wani go gi en gaandi tu.”
eng_text: He sent them to Bethlehem, and said, "Go and search diligently for the young child. When you have found him, bring me word, so that I also may come and worship him."

djk_text: We, di den anga Kownu Helowdesi taki so kaba, ne den gwe. Namo den si a seefi sitali di den be si a tapu baka. We, ne den piisii gaan piisii. Bika den e waka, da a sitali e waka a tapu a den fesi, fu tii den go doo na a pikin. Na di den si a sitali taampu pii a wan peesi, ne den sabi kaba taki, den doo a peesi pe a pikin meke.
eng_text: They, having heard the king, went their way; and behold, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them, until it came and stood over where the young child was.

djk_text: Ne den go a ini a osu. Ne den si a pikin anga en mma, Maliya de. Ne wanten wanten den sutu kini a doti, gi a pikin gaandi. Soseefi den puu den sowtu a sowtu dii kado di den be tyai, fu gi a pikin a ini sani. Den be tyai gowtu sani, wan sowtu kandaa fu boon switi sumee anga mile oli fu lobi a sikin.
eng_text: They came into the house and saw the young child with Mary, his mother, and they fell down and worshiped him. Opening their treasures, they offered to him gifts: gold, frankincense, and myrrh.

djk_text: Na so ala sani be waka. Ma namo de, Masaa Gadu wasikoi den koniman a ini deen taki, den á mu daai go a Kownu Helowdesi moo. Ne den teke wan hii taa pasi waka gwe a den kondee baka.
eng_text: Being warned in a dream that they shouldn't return to Herod, they went back to their own country another way.

djk_text: Da di den koniman gwe kaba, ne namo, ne Masaa Gadu sende wan Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee kon a Jowsef, a ini wan deen. Ne a taigi en taki: “Opo teke a pikin anga en mma, da i lowe gwe a Egepte Kondee. Da tan anda fu te enke mi taigi yu, fi i daai kon baka. Bika luku! Helowdesi o meke ala moiti fu kii a pikin ya!”
eng_text: Now when they had departed, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream, saying, "Arise and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and stay there until I tell you, for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him."

djk_text: We, ne Jowsef opo, ne a teke a pikin anga en mma na a neti, ne a gwe a Egepte Kondee.
eng_text: He arose and took the young child and his mother by night, and departed into Egypt,

djk_text: Ne a tan anda fu te Helowdesi dede. Na so a be mu pasa fu san Masaa Gadu be meke wan apaiti takiman fi en be taki mu kon pasa tuu. Bika a be taki: “Mi o kai mi manpikin puu a Egepte Kondee.”
eng_text: and was there until the death of Herod; that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying, "Out of Egypt I called my son."

djk_text: Ma namo, di Kownu Helowdesi si taki, den koniman á kon piki en moo enke fa den be taki, ne en ati boon, te ná sipowtu. Ne a sende suudati waka kii ala manpikin, fu tu yali go a ondoo, a Betelehem anga a hii pisiwataa de. Bika den koniman be taigi en taki, na tu yali pasa kaba di den be si a sitali a tapu.
eng_text: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked by the wise men, was exceedingly angry, and sent out, and killed all the male children who were in Bethlehem and in all the surrounding countryside, from two years old and under, according to the exact time which he had learned from the wise men.

djk_text: Da na so a sani kon pasa tuu enke fa a Jelemija, a apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu be taki.
eng_text: Then that which was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled, saying,

djk_text: Bika a be taki: “U o yee fa sama e bali gaan adyumadye na a pisi kondee fu Laama. U o yee kusumi anga soso balibali anda. Na den baka bakaten pikin fu a uman den e kai Laakeli di e tan anda o kusumi so. Den ná o wani sama koo den ati. Bika den pikin fu den á de a libi moo.”
eng_text: A voice was heard in Ramah, lamentation, weeping and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children; she wouldn't be comforted, because they are no more.

djk_text: We, ne baka di Kownu Helowdesi dede, ne na wan Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee kon a Jowsef, a ini wan deen a Egepte Kondee anda.
eng_text: But when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt, saying,

djk_text: Ne a taigi en taki: “Jowsef, opo! Teke a pikin anga en mma, da u gwe a Islayeli Kondee baka! Bika a sama di be wani kii a pikin anda dede kaba.”
eng_text: Arise and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel, for those who sought the young child's life are dead.

djk_text: We, ne Jowsef opo wanten, enke fa Masaa Gadu taigi en a ini a deen. Ne a teke a pikin anga en mma, ne den gwe a Islayeli Kondee baka.
eng_text: He arose and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Israel.

djk_text: Ma di a yee taki na a Alikalawsu, a manpikin fu Kownu Helowdesi toon kownu fu Juda ne en dda peesi, ne a feele fu go na a pisi kondee anda. We, ne Masaa Gadu soi en a ini wan deen taki, meke a go tan na a pisiwataa fu Galileya.
eng_text: But when he heard that Archelaus was reigning over Judea in the place of his father, Herod, he was afraid to go there. Being warned in a dream, he withdrew into the region of Galilee,

djk_text: We, ne a go tan a wan foto fu Galileya den e kai Nasaleti. Na so san den apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu be taki, kon pasa tuu. Bika den be taki: “Den o kai en wan sama fu Nasaleti Foto.”
eng_text: and came and lived in a city called Nazareth; that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophets: "He will be called a Nazarene."

djk_text: Na a seefi pisiten de Johanisi a Dopuman be de a ini a gaan sabana fu Judeja Kondee e bali a bosikopu fu Masaa Gadu
eng_text: In those days, John the Baptizer came, preaching in the wilderness of Judea, saying,

djk_text: taki: “Daai libi! Bika a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu de koosube tuutuu.”
eng_text: Repent, for the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!

djk_text: A sani ya waka leti enke fa Masaa Gadu be piki Jesaja enke wan apaiti takiman fu taki, fi en: “A tongo fu wan bosikopuman o bali a ini a gaan sabana taki: ‘U seeka pasi gi a Masaa, meke a pasi sa kon taampu letiopu tollo.’ ”
eng_text: For this is he who was spoken of by Isaiah the prophet, saying, "The voice of one crying in the wilderness, make ready the way of the Lord. Make his paths straight."

djk_text: We, den koosi fu Johanisi di a be e wei be meke anga a uwii fu wan meti den e kai kameili. Da a be e banti en mindii anga wan leli buba. Da na makonkon anga busi oniki a be e nyan.
eng_text: Now John himself wore clothing made of camel's hair, with a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.

djk_text: Namo den sama fu Jelusalem Foto anga a pisiwataa fu Judeja yee a bosikopu fu Masaa Gadu di ai bali. Soseefi sama di e tan na a pisi fu Joodani Liba seefi yee tu. Ne ala den booko kon aliki san ai taki.
eng_text: Then people from Jerusalem, all of Judea, and all the region around the Jordan went out to him.

djk_text: Namo Johanisi dopu somen fu den sama a ini Joodani Liba. Ma fosi a dopu den, da den be mu puu ala ogii, di den be du taki fosi.
eng_text: They were baptized by him in the Jordan, confessing their sins.

djk_text: Ma Johanisi kon si taki, somen Faliseiman anga Saduseiman de a ini den sama di kon fu teke dopu de. Namo a bali kosi den taki: “U takuu tetei sineki! Fa u du sabi taki, u mu lon kibii gi a gaan atiboon fu Masaa Gadu di de a pasi e kon?”
eng_text: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming for his baptism, he said to them, "You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

djk_text: Soseefi a taki go doo taki: “Ma u sabi san? Daai libi sowan fasi taki, u libi e puu bun, di e soi taki, u libi daai tuu.
eng_text: Therefore bring forth fruit worthy of repentance!

djk_text: Ma u á mu pakisei taki, di u na baka bakaten pikin fu Abalaham paansu, da u anga Masaa Gadu de mati. Kweti kweti! Bika mi e taigi u taki, Masaa Gadu abi makiti fu meke den siton di u e si ya kon toon libisama fu de enke pikin fu Abalaham.
eng_text: Don't think to yourselves, 'We have Abraham for our father,' for I tell you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones.

djk_text: Bika luku ya, a akisi de na a lutu fu a bon kaba. Da iniiwan bon di nái meke bun nyanyan, den sa faa en towe, iti go boon a ini faya.”
eng_text:
Even now the axe lies at the root of the trees. Therefore every tree that doesn't bring forth good fruit is cut down, and cast into the fire.
58	Soseefi Johanisi taki go doo taki: “U si! Mi e dopu u anga wataa, fu u daai libi. Ma u luku Awan di makiti bigi moo mi, a o kon a mi baka! Ma mi á dyendee sai fu bendi sibi en susu gi en seefi. En dati o dopu sama anga a Apaiti Jeje anga faya.	58	I indeed baptize you in water for repentance, but he who comes after me is mightier than I, whose shoes I am not worthy to carry. He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit.
59	“We, Masaa Gadu o wai den bun ati sama poti a wanse. Da a wai den takuu ati wan poti na a taase. A de leti enke fa den e wai alisi puu buba. Da den e teke a alisi seefi tyai go kibii a magisin. Ma a buba dati de, e towe a dyiko fu boon a ini gaan ati faya. We da, na letiso den takuu ati sama o pina fu tego a ini a gaan ati faya. Bika sama ná o de fu kii a faya de noiti wan ten.”	59	His winnowing fork is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor. He will gather his wheat into the barn, but the chaff he will burn up with unquenchable fire.

djk_text: Masaa Jesesi seefi be komoto na a pisiwataa fu Galileya kon a Joodani Liba, fu meke Johanisi dopu enseefi tu.
eng_text: Then Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan to John, to be baptized by him.

djk_text: Ma, di Johanisi si en, ne a á wani dopu en. A taigi Masaa Jesesi taki: “Mi ná o dopu yu! Bika na yu mu dopu mi.”
eng_text: But John would have hindered him, saying, "I need to be baptized by you, and you come to me?"

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Nono! I mu dopu mi. Bika wi ya seefi mu du ala letiopu sani di fiti du.” We, di a taki so, ne Johanisi dopu en.
eng_text: But Jesus, answering, said to him, "Allow it now, for this is the fitting way for us to fulfill all righteousness." Then he allowed him.

djk_text: Ma namo, fa i si Masaa Jesesi dopu komoto a ini a wataa go a soo, ne tapu anda piiti opo waa. Ne a Apaiti Jeje fu Masaa Gadu saka komoto a tapu anda wanten, kon enke wan doifi a Masaa Jesesi tapu.
eng_text: Jesus, when he was baptized, went up directly from the water: and behold, the heavens were opened to him. He saw the Spirit of God descending as a dove, and coming on him.

djk_text: Ne wan Tongo taki a tapu anda taki: “Disi na mi Manpikin di mi lobi. Mi hii ati e piisii anga en.”
eng_text: Behold, a voice out of the heavens said, "This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased."

djk_text: We ne, wanten wanten de, ne a Apaiti Jeje fu Masaa Gadu tyai Masaa Jesesi waka gwe a ini a gaan sabana. Namo, ne a didibii de ape e tesi Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: Then Jesus was led up by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi poti nyanyan a wanse, fu begi, fotenti dei anga fotenti neti langa. Namo, ne angii moo en.
eng_text: When he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was hungry afterward.

djk_text: We, ne a tesiman, a didibii kon doo. Ne a taigi Masaa Jesesi taki: “Di i na a Manpikin fu Masaa Gadu tuu, da taigi den siton ya, meke den toon beele, osi?”
eng_text: The tempter came and said to him, "If you are the Son of God, command that these stones become bread."

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Masaa Gadu Buku sikiifi taki: ‘A ná nyanyan namo e oli wan sama a libi. Ma na te wan sama e du san Masaa Gadu taki.’ ”
eng_text: But he answered, "It is written, 'Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds out of the mouth of God.'"

djk_text: We bakadati, ne a didibii teke Masaa Jesesi tyai go a tapu na a Mama Keliki fu den Dyu, a Jelusalem, a apaiti foto fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Then the devil took him into the holy city. He set him on the pinnacle of the temple,

djk_text: Ne a taigi en taki: “We, di i na a Manpikin fu Masaa Gadu tuu, da fee saka go a doti anda, no? Bika Masaa Gadu Buku sikiifi taki: ‘Masaa Gadu o sende den Basiya fi en a Masaa Gadu Kondee kon a yu, fu den tyai yu na a ana, meke yu á sa naki i futu a wan siton.’ ”
eng_text: and said to him, "If you are the Son of God, throw yourself down, for it is written, 'He will put his angels in charge of you.' and, 'On their hands they will bear you up, so that you don't dash your foot against a stone.'"

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Masaa Gadu Buku sikiifi tu taki: ‘Ná tesi Masaa Gadu, di de u Gadu.’ ”
eng_text: Jesus said to him, "Again, it is written, 'You shall not test the Lord, your God.'"

djk_text: We, bakadati, ne a didibii tyai Masaa Jesesi gwe a wan gaan hei mongo ede. Ne te fi i pingi ain opo, ne a soi Masaa Jesesi ala den gudu anga den dyendee fu den kondee kondee fu goontapu.
eng_text: Again, the devil took him to an exceedingly high mountain, and showed him all the kingdoms of the world, and their glory.

djk_text: Ne a taigi Masaa Jesesi taki: “I si fa goontapu dyendee? Mi sa gi yu ala den dyendee de. Ma, da i mu sutu kini a doti begi mi.”
eng_text: He said to him, "I will give you all of these things, if you will fall down and worship me."

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi bali en taki: “Tumalisi komoto a mi fesi ya! Yu didibii, saatan yu! Bika Masaa Gadu Buku sikiifi taki: ‘Na Masaa Gadu wawan u mu begi, soseefi dini!’ ”
eng_text: Then Jesus said to him, "Get behind me, Satan! For it is written, 'You shall worship the Lord your God, and you shall serve him only.'"

djk_text: We, ne a didibii fika Masaa Jesesi saafi, ne a gwe. Ne den Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee kon, ne den dini Masaa Jesesi, gi en ala san a abi fanowdu.
eng_text: Then the devil left him, and behold, angels came and served him.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi yee taki, den kisi Johanisi sooto. Ne a komoto ape go tan a Nasaleti Foto, pe a be kiya. Nasaleti Foto de na a pisiwataa fu Galileya.
eng_text: Now when Jesus heard that John was delivered up, he withdrew into Galilee.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi á tan langa a Nasaleti de moo. Bika a komoto de go tan a Kafalnayemu Foto. Kafalnayemu Foto meke na a sikin wataa fu a ze den e kai ze fu Galileya. Dati na a pisi pe Sebulon anga Naftali kondee de.
eng_text: Leaving Nazareth, he came and lived in Capernaum, which is by the sea, in the region of Zebulun and Naphtali,

djk_text: Da fa Masaa Jesesi go tan ya, meke a sani di wan apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu den e kai Jesaja be taki kon pasa tuu. Bika Jesaja be taki:
eng_text: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,

djk_text: “Luku den kondee den kai Sebulon anga Naftali. Den de leti na a pasi fu waka pasa kai na a ze, na a taase fu Joodani Liba. Na tu kondee fu taa foluku di á de Dyusama. Galileya seefi na kondee fu sama di á de Dyu.
eng_text:
The land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, toward the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles,
80	Da den be o tan faawe fu Masaa Gadu, te den boo be o koti. Bika den gei sama di de a ini dunguu. Ma den ain o kon kiin, enke fa peesi e kiin fu si. Bika den o kon sabi Masaa Gadu, da den o toon sama di abi pasi fu tan a Masaa Gadu se.”	80	the people who sat in darkness saw a great light, to those who sat in the region and shadow of death, to them light has dawned.

djk_text: We, ne fanafu di Masaa Jesesi go tan anda, ne ai bali den sama taki: “U daai libi! Bika a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu de koosube tuutuu.”
eng_text: From that time, Jesus began to preach, and to say, "Repent! For the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand."

djk_text: We wan dei, da Masaa Jesesi be e waka na a lampeesi pe a gaan ze fu Galileya kon sutu mofu a soo. Ne a si tu baala. Wan fu den na Simon di abi a taa nen fu Peitilisi. A taawan na Andeleyasi. Den tu baala ya be de fisiman, di e towe seepi fu kisi fisi a ini a ze.
eng_text: Walking by the sea of Galilee, he saw two brothers: Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew, his brother, casting a net into the sea; for they were fishermen.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi waka go a den. Ne a taigi den taki: “U kon waka a mi baka! U kon go anga mi na ala pe mi e go. Da mi o leli u onti taa fasi, bika u ná o onti fisi moo. Ma u o kon toon ontiman fu kisi libisama tyai kon biibi a mi.”
eng_text: He said to them, "Come after me, and I will make you fishers for men."

djk_text: We, ne den tu baala á du taa fa, ne den wai den seepi wanten poti a wanse. Ne den bigin waka a Masaa Jesesi baka.
eng_text: They immediately left their nets and followed him.

djk_text: A di den waka go moo pikinso, ne den si tu taa baala anga den dda, Da Sebedi a ini wan boto. Wan fu den baala na Jakowbesi, a taawan na Johanisi. Den be e seeka den seepi, fu go sete. Ne Masaa Jesesi kai den tu baala ya tu.
eng_text: Going on from there, he saw two other brothers, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in the boat with Zebedee their father, mending their nets. He called them.

djk_text: Ne den tu baala ya seefi fika den dda anga ala den seepi anga ala a boto a baka wanten. Ne den go waka a Masaa Jesesi baka tu.
eng_text: They immediately left the boat and their father, and followed him.

djk_text: Namo, Masaa Jesesi e waka e lontu a hii pisiwataa fu Galileya e leli den sama a ini den keliki osu fu den Dyu. Soseefi ai bali a Bun Nyunsu di e taki, fu a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu. Da ai deesi ala siki anga ala sowtu takuu takuu siki anga nowtu di den sama be abi.
eng_text: Jesus went about in all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi nen bali lontu na a hii pisiwataa de, te go doo Siliya. Den sama anda seefi tyai ala sowtu sikiman kon ne en. Sama di be abi sikin ati. Sama di takuu jeje be e bali a den tapu. Soseefi, den be tyai lawman anga lanman. Ne Masaa Jesesi deesi ala den fiya.
eng_text: The report about him went out into all Syria. They brought to him all who were sick, afflicted with various diseases and torments, possessed with demons, epileptics, and paralytics; and he healed them.

djk_text: Ma namo, da somen sama fu a pisiwataa fu Galileya, anga a pisiwataa fu den tin foto, di den e kai Dekapolisi, anga Jelusalem Foto, anga sama di be e tan na a pisiwataa fu Judeja, anga abaase fu a Joodani Liba, booko kon e waka a Masaa Jesesi baka.
eng_text: Great multitudes from Galilee, Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea and from beyond the Jordan followed him.

djk_text: We, ne di Masaa Jesesi si fa somen sama e waka ne en baka, ne a subi go a wan pikin mongo. Ne di a sidon, ne den bakaman fi en kon ne en anda.
eng_text: Seeing the multitudes, he went up onto the mountain. When he had sat down, his disciples came to him.

djk_text: Ne a bigin leli den taki:
eng_text: He opened his mouth and taught them, saying,

djk_text: “Seigi fu saka fasi sama di sabi taki, den abi Masaa Gadu fanowdu. Bika fu di a abi a saka fasi ya, da a sa de a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text:
Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.

97	Seigi fu sama di ati kiin a Masaa Gadu fesi. Bika dati o meke den go doo Masaa Gadu Kondee, te go si Masaa Gadu seefi anga ain.	97	Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God.

djk_text: Dyombo piisii seefi fu dati. Bika na letiso den be pina den fositen apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu a fesi. Da u paiman fu kisi bigi a Masaa Gadu Kondee.”
eng_text: Rejoice, and be exceedingly glad, for great is your reward in heaven. For that is how they persecuted the prophets who were before you.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi taki baka taki: “U na a sawtu fu goontapu. Da efu sawtu lasi en tesi, da anga san den o sawtu en fu a kisi tesi baka? Nono! A á bun fu du wan enkii sani moo enke na fu fiingi towe a dyiko namo, da a kaba, fu sama waka ne en tapu. Bika taa sani á de, fu poti gi en moo, fu a kisi tesi, baka.
eng_text:
You are the salt of the earth, but if the salt has lost its flavor, with what will it be salted? It is then good for nothing, but to be cast out and trodden under the feet of men.
103	“Soseefi, u na a leti kiin fu goontapu. Wan foto di meke a wan mongo ede, á poi de kibii kibii. Bika te sama e pasa, den ain musu kai ne en.	103	You are the light of the world. A city located on a hill can't be hidden.

eng_text: For most certainly, I tell you, until heaven and earth pass away, not even one smallest letter or one tiny pen stroke shall in any way pass away from the law, until all things are accomplished.

djk_text: Ma son sama e si son fu den weiti ya enke wan soso sani. Da den e leli taawan fu si den weiti ya enke soso sani tu. Da den sowtu sama de o de den moo lagiwan a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu. Ma den sama di e libi leti enke fa den weiti taki, da den e leli taawan fu libi sowan fasi, o hei a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Whoever, therefore, shall break one of these least commandments, and teach others to do so, shall be called least in the Kingdom of Heaven; but whoever shall do and teach them shall be called great in the Kingdom of Heaven.

djk_text: Soseefi, u mu sabi tu taki, sama di wani de a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu, mu waka letiopu fasi moo den Faliseiman anga den leliman fu Dyuweiti seefi.
eng_text: For I tell you that unless your righteousness exceeds that of the scribes and Pharisees, there is no way you will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.

djk_text: “Bika u yee ya! Weiti be leli u taki: ‘U á mu kii sama ofuso u sa go a kuutu, fu kisi sitaafu.’

You have heard that it was said to the ancient ones, 'You shall not murder;' and 'Whoever shall murder shall be in danger of the judgment.'

eng_text: Most certainly I tell you, you shall by no means get out of there, until you have paid the last penny.

You have heard that it was said, 'You shall not commit adultery;'

djk_text: Soseefi, efu wan sama e dwengi yu, fu waka wan yuu langa anga en, da waka tu yuu langa anga en.
eng_text: Whoever compels you to go one mile, go with him two.

djk_text: Te wan sama begi yu wan sani di yu abi, da yu á mu mombii en. Efu na wan sani fi yu, wan sama wani leni, da yu á mu fika en gwe anga soso ana.”
eng_text: Give to him who asks you, and don't turn away him who desires to borrow from you.

djk_text: Namo, Masaa Jesesi taki baka taki: “Da den be taigi u tu taki: ‘U mu lobi den sama, di e libi bun anga u. Ma u mu buuse den feyanti fu u.’

You have heard that it was said, 'You shall love your neighbor, and hate your enemy. '

149	Gi wi paadon fu ogii di wi e du a yu fesi, leti enke fa wiseefi e gi taawan di e du ogii anga wi paadon.	149	Forgive us our debts, as we also forgive our debtors.
150	Wi e begi yu fu kibii wi, meke wi á kai a ini tesi. Meke a didibii á sa poi tyai u go ini takuudu anga ogii tu.’ ”	150	Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one. For yours is the Kingdom, the power, and the glory forever. Amen. '
151	Namo a taki go doo taki: “Te u sa gi taawan paadon, da u Tata, Masaa Gadu a tapu seefi sa gi u paadon, fu ogii di u e du tu.	151	For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.

djk_text: Ma te u nái gi taawan paadon, da Masaa Gadu, u Tata, a tapu seefi, ná o gi u paadon tu.”
eng_text: But if you don't forgive men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “Te u de sondee nyan, fu begi, da u á mu de enke den gaan bidiigiman. Bika te den e de sondee nyan fu begi, da den e poti gaan tyali buduufu fesi, fu sama mu si taki, den de sondee nyan fu begi. Da na so den e suku nen a sama. Ma u aliki mi! Den sama de fende den paiman kaba anga a gafa di sama gafa den de.

Ma na feti u mu e feti e libi bun gi Masaa Gadu! Bika Masaa Gadu paamisi den sama di e libi sowan fasi gaan gudu, di noiti noiti o poli. A o dyunta dati poti a Masaa Gadu Kondee gi den. Soseefi, fufuuman á poi fende pasi go fufuu den puu anda.
eng_text: but lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust consume, and where thieves don't break through and steal;

djk_text: We, u yee ya! Na pe yu gudu de, na ape yu ati o de tu.
eng_text: for where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.

djk_text: “We, a lampu fu wan libisama sikin, na den ain fi en. Da efu yu ain kiin, da i hii sikin o kiin tu.
eng_text:
The lamp of the body is the eye. If therefore your eye is sound, your whole body will be full of light.
160	Ma sama di ain á kiin, da i hii sikin o de dunguu dunguu. Na letiso, efu wan sama ati á kiin, a sa waka a dunguu. Bika na den sama di ati kiin sa waka a leti pasi.”	160	But if your eye is evil, your whole body will be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in you is darkness, how great is the darkness!
161	Namo Masaa Jesesi taki baka taki: “Ná wan sama di o poi dini tu masaa, sondee fu lobi awan moo enke a taawan. Bika a o lobi awan e teke en taki, moo enke a taawan. Soseefi wan sama á poi dini Masaa Gadu efu moni de wan basi fi en tu.	161	No one can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one and love the other; or else he will be devoted to one and despise the other. You can't serve both God and Mammon.

djk_text: Ma efu Masaa Gadu na u basi, da u ná abi fu kusumi. U ná abi fu taki: ‘Oho! San mi o nyan? Oho, san mi o wei a sikin?’ Bika pakisei taki, Masaa Gadu du moo gaan sani gi wi enke libisama. A gi wi sikin anga libi, di bigi moo nyanyan anga koosi. Da efu a gi wi den sani de, da i denki taki, a ná o gi wi sani fu nyan anga sani fu wei?
eng_text: Therefore I tell you, don't be anxious for your life: what you will eat, or what you will drink; nor yet for your body, what you will wear. Isn't life more than food, and the body more than clothing?

djk_text: We, luku den foo a tapu anda! Peesi fu paandi sani, den ná abi. Magisin fu kibii nyanyan sani, den ná abi tu. Ma toku, den e nyan, e diingi ibii dei. We, wi enke libisama waiti moo foo!
eng_text: See the birds of the sky, that they don't sow, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns. Your heavenly Father feeds them. Aren't you of much more value than they?

djk_text: I denki taki, libisama sa kusumi fu sani te, da a fende moo langa libi?
eng_text:
Which of you, by being anxious, can add one moment to his lifespan?
165	“Teke yu ain luku den moi boomiki di e goo a goontapu! We, u be yee fu a fositen kownu di den kai Salomo. Na be wan tuutuu poolo man, di be e wei en koosi moi, moo ala sani. Ma toku anga ala a moi dyendee fasi fi en de, toku a á be doo a moi fu den boomiki ya.	165	Why are you anxious about clothing? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow. They don't toil, neither do they spin,
166	Ma na Masaa Gadu meke den moi so. Ma toku den ná abi langa libi seefi. Bika na tide den de ete, ma kande den á doo tamaa. Libisama e koti den go boon a ini faya enke soso sani. Ma u ya dati waiti moo boomiki! Da fa u pakisei taki Masaa Gadu ná o poi solugu u anga koosi? Ma na fu di u nái biibi Gadu sai, na dati e tyai a denki de.	166	But if God so clothes the grass of the field, which today exists, and tomorrow is thrown into the oven, won't he much more clothe you, you of little faith?
167	“We, u á mu kusumi moo, pakisei taki: ‘Oho! San u o nyan anga san u o wei a sikin tu?’	167	Therefore don't be anxious, saying, 'What will we eat?', 'What will we drink?' or, 'With what will we be clothed?'

djk_text: Bika na sama di nái waka a Masaa Gadu pasi e kusumi den fasi de. Ma u Tata a tapu, sabi ala san u abi fanowdu.
eng_text: For the Gentiles seek after all these things; for your heavenly Father knows that you need all these things.

djk_text: Da suku fu de a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu. Soseefi fu waka letiopu fasi fiti en. Da a o gi u ala san u fanowdu.
eng_text: But seek first God's Kingdom, and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.

djk_text: Ma u á mu feti e kusumi fu a dei fu tamaa. Bika ibii dei abi en eigi booko anga en nowtu.”
eng_text: Therefore don't be anxious for tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Each day's own evil is sufficient.

djk_text: “Ná kuutu, kaagi taawan, da taawan ná o kuutu, kaagi yu tu.
eng_text:
Don't judge, so that you won't be judged.
172	Bika na a fasi fa yu e kuutu, kaagi taawan, na so taawan o kuutu, kaagi yu baka. Anga a seefi maiki di yu e teke maiki taawan, anga en den o teke maiki yu baka.	172	For with whatever judgment you judge, you will be judged; and with whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you.
173	Bika saide meke, u e si a pikin mbalububa a ini a ain fu wan taawan, ma a gaan gobo di de a ini iseefi ain, dati i nái si?	173	Why do you see the speck that is in your brother's eye, but don't consider the beam that is in your own eye?
174	Da fa i sa taigi i baala taki: ‘Baala! Kon mi puu a pikin mbalu a ini yu ain gi yu.’ Ma wan gaan gobo de a ini iseefi ain?	174	Or how will you tell your brother, 'Let me remove the speck from your eye;' and behold, the beam is in your own eye?
175	U bidiigiman u! Puu a gaan gobo a ini iseefi ain fosi, da i sa si kiin fu puu a pikin mbalu di de a ini i baala ain gi en!”	175	You hypocrite! First remove the beam out of your own eye, and then you can see clearly to remove the speck out of your brother's eye.
176	Namo Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “U á teke a apaiti sani fu Masaa Gadu, iti gi den dagu anga den agu. Bika te u iti den gi dagu anga den agu, da den ná o si en fu wan sani. Da kande den o teke en, da den waka ne en tapu, masimasi en enke lawlaw sani. Da te fu kaba, da den daai kon nyan yu seefi pisipisi kii.”	176	Don't give that which is holy to the dogs, neither throw your pearls before the pigs, lest perhaps they trample them under their feet, and turn and tear you to pieces.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “U begi, da u o kisi. U suku, da u o fende. U koko, da doo o opo gi u.
eng_text:
Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you.
178	Bika sama di e begi, e kisi. Da sama di e suku, e fende. Soseefi sama di e koko, da doo e opo gi den.	178	For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.
179	We, sama di de ya, te i manpikin begi yu wan beele, yu o teke wan siton gi en?	179	Or who is there among you, who, if his son asks him for bread, will give him a stone?
180	Te a akisi yu wan fisi, yu o teke wan sineki langa gi en? Nono!	180	Or if he asks for a fish, who will give him a serpent?
181	We, efu u, anga ala fa u abi takuu ati seefi, toku u sabi gi u pikin bun sani so, da fa u pakisei, fu u Tata a tapu? A ná o gi sama di e begi en sani, bun sani, no?	181	If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father who is in heaven give good things to those who ask him!
182	“We, a fasi fa i wani meke sama libi anga yu, na letiso i mu libi anga sama tu. Disi na a hii mama fu den weiti di Mosesi, anga ala taa taa fositen apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu be sikiifi.”	182	Therefore whatever you desire for men to do to you, you shall also do to them; for this is the law and the prophets.
183	Soseefi a taki go doo taki: “U doo pasa, go a ini, na a sumaa doo mofu! Bika a baala doo mofu na fu pasa go miti a baala pasi di e go kai a didibii faya. Somen sama de, di e waka na a baala pasi ya, pasa go a ini.	183	Enter in by the narrow gate; for wide is the gate and broad is the way that leads to destruction, and many are those who enter in by it.

djk_text: Ma a doo di e tyai sama go na a libi fu tego sumaa. Da a pasi fu waka go miti a doo de nyoni, da a taanga fu waka. Somen sama á de di e waka ne en.”
eng_text: How narrow is the gate, and restricted is the way that leads to life! Few are those who find it.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi wasikoi den sama taki: “U mu koni anga leiman di e lei taki, den na apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu. Den sa koli yu kisi. Bika den e kon a yu tapu enke bunbun saka manii sama. Ma luku bun anga den! Den abi takuu ati enke takuu meti di e kisi taa meti nyan kii.
eng_text:
Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep's clothing, but inwardly are ravening wolves.
186	A takuu libi fu den e puu a takuu ati di den abi kon a doo, fu si. Bika i si pe bunbun sii fu nyan komoto a maka bon kaba?	186	By their fruits you will know them. Do you gather grapes from thorns, or figs from thistles?
187	Kweti! Na bun ati bon namo sa poi meke bunbun sii fu nyan. Ma takuu ati bon na sii di á bun fu nyan a o meke.	187	Even so, every good tree produces good fruit; but the corrupt tree produces evil fruit.
188	Takuu ati bon dati á poi meke bunbun sii fu nyan. Da a kon, bun ati bon á poi meke sii di á bun fu nyan tu.	188	A good tree can't produce evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree produce good fruit.
189	Da di takuu ati bon nái meke bun sii kaba, da na fu koti go iti a ini faya, fu boon.	189	Every tree that doesn't grow good fruit is cut down, and thrown into the fire.
190	Ala san mi taki de e soi, fa fu luku sama libi, meke u sa sabi den falisi takiman.”	190	Therefore by their fruits you will know them.
191	Namo Masaa Jesesi taki go doo taki: “U denki taki na ala sama di e kai mi, ‘Masaa! Masaa!’ o go doo a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu Kondee a tapu anda. Kweti! A ná ala sama di e kai mi, ‘Masaa! Masaa!’ o doo anda. Ma na sama di e libi enke fa mi Tata wani, o doo a tapu anda.	191	Not everyone who says to me, 'Lord, Lord,' will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven; but he who does the will of my Father who is in heaven.
192	Na a dei di Masaa Gadu o kai ala sama kon a kuutu, da u o yee bali. Taawan o go e bali taki: ‘Oho! Masaa! A ná wi be teke yu nen e tyai a bosikopu fu Masaa Gadu go taigi sama, no? Masaa! A ná wi be e yaki takuu jeje puu a sama tapu anga yu nen, no? Oho! Masaa, a ná wi be e du somen foondoo sani anga yu nen, no?’	192	Many will tell me in that day, 'Lord, Lord, didn't we prophesy in your name, in your name cast out demons, and in your name do many mighty works?'
193	Ma, da mi o piki den taki: ‘U gwe komoto a mi fesi ya! U takuu ati sama u! Bika mi á sabi u enke sama di be e libi enke fa mi wani.’ ”	193	Then I will tell them, 'I never knew you. Depart from me, you who work iniquity.'
194	Soseefi Masaa Jesesi taki go doo taki: “Sama di e teke mi taki de enke wan gaan koniman. Bika a koni, da a sabi luku bunbun peesi fu sete en osu.	194	Everyone therefore who hears these words of mine, and does them, I will liken him to a wise man, who built his house on a rock.

djk_text: A sete a fondamenti fi en osu kinkin, fasi a ini wan bunbun taanga doti. Namo gaan alen kai dyullu, ne wataa fuu kon doo na a osu. Soseefi, gaan winta wai huu kon naki a osu. Ma anga ala dati, toku a osu á bunduka kai. Ma a taampu kinkin ete. Bika a fondamenti be sete a ini taanga doti.
eng_text: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat on that house; and it didn't fall, for it was founded on the rock.

djk_text: Ma sama di á wani teke mi taki dati tan enke gaan donman di don. Bika a gei sama di don, fu sabi luku bunbun peesi, fu sete en osu. A gaan donman ya go sete a fondamenti fi en osu wisiwasi fasi a ini fukufuku doti.
eng_text: Everyone who hears these words of mine, and doesn't do them will be like a foolish man, who built his house on the sand.

djk_text: Namo gaan alen kai dyullu, ne wataa fuu kon doo na a osu. Soseefi gaan winta wai huu kon naki a osu. Ne a osu bunduka guwaa dyulu a wataa. Bika a be sete a fukufuku doti ini.”
eng_text: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat on that house; and it fell--and great was its fall."

djk_text: Da a hii fasi fa Masaa Jesesi e gi a leli fu Masaa Gadu ya be foondoo den sama, te ná sipowtu.
eng_text: It happened, when Jesus had finished saying these things, that the multitudes were astonished at his teaching,

djk_text: Bika den leliman fu Dyuweiti be e leli den sani wan hii taa fasi. Ma Masaa Jesesi dati be e leli den, enke wan sama di sa sidon taki a Masaa Gadu peesi.
eng_text: for he taught them with authority, and not like the scribes.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi saka a pikin mongo kon a ondoo baka. Da tyaipi sama be de ne en baka e waka.
eng_text: When he came down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.

djk_text: Wan gwasiman dati be de a ini den sama. Ne a lon kon sutu kini a doti gi Masaa Jesesi. Da ai begi taki: “Masaa! Yu sa wani deesi mi? We, da gaantangi deesi mi, no baa?”
eng_text: Behold, a leper came to him and worshiped him, saying, "Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean."

djk_text: Ne wanten wanten, ne Masaa Jesesi langa ana oli en, taki: “Eeye! Mi wani i kon bun.” Da Masaa Jesesi á kaba taki seefi, a gwasi fu a man gwe kaba. A kon bun kele kele.
eng_text: Jesus stretched out his hand, and touched him, saying, "I want to. Be made clean." Immediately his leprosy was cleansed.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi taigi en taki: “Yee ya! Yu á mu go taigi sama fa i du kon bun so! San i mu du, da go a den apaiti begiman na a Mama Keliki a Jelusalem Foto, meke den si fa i kon bun. Soseefi tyai a paiman go pai de, enke fa Mosesi weiti taki, gwasiman mu pai, te den kon bun. Da na dati o meke den sama de si taki, i kon bun tuutuu.”
eng_text: Jesus said to him, "See that you tell nobody, but go, show yourself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, as a testimony to them."

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi o komoto go a wan foto, den e kai Kafalnayemu Foto. Na ape a de, wan ofisii fu den suudati fu Loma Foto, lon kon begi en wan sani.
eng_text: When he came into Capernaum, a centurion came to him, asking him,

djk_text: A taki: “Masaa! Wan fu den futuboi fu mi lan didon a osu. Ai dede anga sikin ati.”
eng_text: and saying, "Lord, my servant lies in the house paralyzed, grievously tormented."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en wanten taki: “Mi o kon anda, fu kon deesi en gi yu.”
eng_text: Jesus said to him, "I will come and heal him."

djk_text: A ofisii piki en baka taki: “Nono Masaa! Bika mi á waiti sai taki, i sa poti i futu a ini mi osu. Na wan wowtu namo mi wani i taki. Da mi futuboi musu kon bun.”
eng_text: The centurion answered, "Lord, I'm not worthy for you to come under my roof. Just say the word, and my servant will be healed.

djk_text: Soseefi a ofisii taki go doo taki: “Bika mi seefi abi basi a mi tapu. Den e sende mi sani, da mi musu fu du, san den e sende mi. Mi abi suudati a mi ondoo. Den musu fu du, ala san mi e sende den. Efu mi sende wan go a wan peesi, a musu fu go. Mi taigi wan taki, kon! A musu fu kon. Mi taigi wan taki, du so! A musu fu du so.”
eng_text: For I am also a man under authority, having under myself soldiers. I tell this one, 'Go,' and he goes; and tell another, 'Come,' and he comes; and tell my servant, 'Do this,' and he does it."

djk_text: Masaa Jesesi aliki, fa a ofisii fu suudati ya taki, te a kaba. Ne a sani foondoo en te, a daai wanten luku ala sama di taampu ape taki: “Oho! A man di biibi mi a biibi ya! A ná Dyusama, seefi! Ma Dyusama seefi á de di biibi mi a fasi ya wanten. Senten mi e waka lontu a Dyu Kondee, mi á si Dyusama di biibi mi so wanten.”
eng_text: When Jesus heard it, he marveled, and said to those who followed, "Most certainly I tell you, I haven't found so great a faith, not even in Israel.

djk_text: Soseefi a taki go doo taki: “Fu tuu! I si fa a man ya biibi mi tide ya? Na letiso somen taa foluku, di á de Dyusama o de na ala uku fu goontapu di o kon sabi fa Masaa Gadu abi makiti. Na den dati o de a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu Kondee a tapu anda, makandii anga den moo gaandi avo gaansama fu wi Dyusama ya, Abalaham, Isaki anga Jakopu. Da na den o sidon makandii anda na a seefi tafaa, fu meke piisii makandii.
eng_text: I tell you that many will come from the east and the west, and will sit down with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the Kingdom of Heaven,

djk_text: Ma a ná Dyusama Masaa Gadu o tyai go a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu Kondee a tapu anda, no? Weeno! Ma toku, somen fu den o kai gwe a ini a sitaafu peesi pe soso kee anga tyali de, fu di den nái biibi mi.”
eng_text: but the children of the Kingdom will be thrown out into the outer darkness. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth."

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi daai go taigi a ofisii taki: “Go a osu fi i! Ala sani musu waka enke fa yu biibi taki mi o du.” Ne a seefi yuu di Masaa Jesesi taki so, ne a futuboi fu a ofisii, kon bun kelle.
eng_text: Jesus said to the centurion, "Go your way. Let it be done for you as you have believed." His servant was healed in that hour.

djk_text: Moo lati, ne Masaa Jesesi go a Peitilisi osu. Ne a go si a main fu Peitilisi didon anga feba a kama tapu anda.
eng_text: When Jesus came into Peter's house, he saw his wife's mother lying sick with a fever.

djk_text: Namo a oli a uman de wan ana namo, ne a feba saka wanten. Ne a main fu Peitilisi ya opo go seeka sani fu nyan gi Masaa Jesesi anga den taawan wanten.
eng_text: He touched her hand, and the fever left her. She got up and served him.

djk_text: Fa i si neti e doo, sama fu a kondee de seefi tyai somen sama di abi takuu jeje a den tapu kon a Masaa Jesesi. Da Masaa Jesesi e bali den takuu jeje wan kodo mofu namo. Da ala den e komoto wanten wanten a den sama tapu gwe. Soseefi Masaa Jesesi be e deesi ala sama di be abi taanga siki de tu. Ala sikiman be kon betee so moimoi.
eng_text: When evening came, they brought to him many possessed with demons. He cast out the spirits with a word, and healed all who were sick;

djk_text: A hii sani ya e waka enke fa Masaa Gadu be piki Jesaja, a fositen apaiti takiman fi en, fu sikiifi taki, dati o kon pasa bakaten. Bika a be sikiifi taki: “A teke ala u takuu siki puu a u tapu. Da enseefi tyai wi siki anga wi nowtu gi wi.”
eng_text: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying: "He took our infirmities, and bore our diseases."

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi si taki, somen sama kon lontu en. We, ne ai go fu abaa go na abaase fu a ze, anga den bakaman fi en.
eng_text: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes around him, he gave the order to depart to the other side.

djk_text: Namo wan leliman fu Dyuweiti lon kon akisi en taki: “Mesiti! Mi wani kon waka a i baka. Mi wani go na ala pe yu e go.”
eng_text: A scribe came, and said to him, "Teacher, I will follow you wherever you go."

djk_text: Masaa Jesesi piki en wanten taki: “I sabi san i akisi mi de? I sabi taki, boo peesi á de ya gi mi, enke fa foo abi nesi fu boo? I sabi taki, olo seefi á de ya gi mi fu go didon boo, enke fa busi dagu abi olo fu go didon boo? Bika a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya, da osu á de ya gi en, fu go sidon teke boo.”
eng_text: Jesus said to him, "The foxes have holes, and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay his head."

djk_text: Namo wan fu den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi dati kon taigi Masaa Jesesi taki: “Masaa! Fosi mi kon waka a yu baka, i sa gi mi pasi fu go beli mi dda fosi, baa?”
eng_text: Another of his disciples said to him, "Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en dati taki: “Man! Waka a mi baka. Fika den dede, meke den beli den dede.”
eng_text: But Jesus said to him, "Follow me, and leave the dead to bury their own dead."

djk_text: Namo, ne Masaa Jesesi go a ini a boto. Ne den bakaman fi en seefi teke ne en baka.
eng_text: When he got into a boat, his disciples followed him.

djk_text: A yuu di den e gwe, a wataa e seke te! Den gaan paana e naki kon a ini a boto ogii ogii. Ma Masaa Jesesi didon pii e siibi.
eng_text: Behold, a violent storm came up on the sea, so much that the boat was covered with the waves, but he was asleep.

djk_text: Na den bakaman fi en e feele te, ne den go weki en. Da den e bali taki: “Oho, oho, oho! Masaa yeepi, no? I nái si taki, wi o dede, no?”
eng_text: They came to him, and woke him up, saying, "Save us, Lord! We are dying!"

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Den sama ya! U nái biibi mi sai! Saide u e feele so?” Namo a opo, bali a winta anga a seke wataa taki: “Seke wataa anga winta! U tan pii!” Bakadati, ala sani koo pii tuu.
eng_text: He said to them, "Why are you fearful, O you of little faith?" Then he got up, rebuked the wind and the sea, and there was a great calm.

djk_text: Den sama di be de ape foondoo, te a ná sipowtu. Da den e taki: “Sama na a sama ya seefi? A abi makiti te, winta anga seke wataa seefi mu e teke en taki.”
eng_text: The men marveled, saying, "What kind of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?"

djk_text: Ne di den doo na a pisi fu den Gadaleini sama, na abaase fu Galileya ze, ne tu man waka kon ne en. Da takuu jeje be de a den tu man ya tapu. Den komoto a den siton olo pe den e beli dedesama e kon. Da ná wan sama be poi fu waka na a pisi pasi ya, bika den tu man ya be ogii seefi seefi.
eng_text: When he came to the other side, into the country of the Gergesenes, two people possessed by demons met him there, coming out of the tombs, exceedingly fierce, so that nobody could pass that way.

djk_text: Ma di den si Masaa Jesesi, ne den bali wanten taki: “Pikin fu Masaa Gadu! San wi anga yu abi, meke i kon ya? Na kon i kon poti wi a sitaafu, fosi a yuu fu kisi sitaafu seefi doo?”
eng_text: Behold, they cried out, saying, "What do we have to do with you, Jesus, Son of God? Have you come here to torment us before the time?"

djk_text: Da wan duupu agu be de na a pisi kondee de. Bika sama be e kweki agu ape.
eng_text: Now there was a herd of many pigs feeding far away from them.

djk_text: Namo den takuu jeje, di de a den tu sama tapu begi Masaa Jesesi taki: “Gaantangi, baa! Te i puu wi a den tu sama ya tapu, gi wi pasi fu go a ini den agu anda, baa?”
eng_text: The demons begged him, saying, "If you cast us out, permit us to go away into the herd of pigs."

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi sende den taki: “Pasa go anda wanten!” Ne wanten wanten, ne den komoto go a ini den agu anda ini. Bakadati, ne ala den agu lon komoto a wan mongo ede, kai go dede a ini a ze.
eng_text: He said to them, "Go!" They came out, and went into the herd of pigs: and behold, the whole herd of pigs rushed down the cliff into the sea, and died in the water.

djk_text: Ne den sama di be luku den agu lon go a foto, go taki san pasa ya.
eng_text: Those who fed them fled, and went away into the city, and told everything, including what happened to those who were possessed with demons.

djk_text: Namo den sama fu a foto aliki a hii toli, te a kaba. Ne den booko go miti Masaa Jesesi. Ne den begi en gaantangi tangi, fu a gwe komoto na a pisi kondee pe den e tan de.
eng_text: Behold, all the city came out to meet Jesus. When they saw him, they begged that he would depart from their borders.

djk_text: Ne bakadati, ne Masaa Jesesi go a boto, ne a abaa go na abaase, na a foto pe a be e tan.
eng_text: He entered into a boat, and crossed over, and came into his own city.

djk_text: Fa i si a doo, ne wan duupu sama tyai wan lanman a daagi tapu kon ne en, fu a deesi en. Ma namo, di Masaa Jesesi si fa den sama di tyai a man kon de e biibi en taanga, ne a taigi a man taki: “Man, ná feele! I kisi paadon fi i takuudu anga ogii kaba.”
eng_text: Behold, they brought to him a man who was paralyzed, lying on a bed. Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, "Son, cheer up! Your sins are forgiven you."

djk_text: Ma wan duupu leliman fu Dyuweiti de ape, yee san Masaa Jesesi taki. Ne den kuutu a ini den ati taki: “Ai sipowtu e kosi Masaa Gadu! We, moo so poli fu poli Gadu nen á de!”
eng_text: Behold, some of the scribes said to themselves, "This man blasphemes."

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi sabi ala san den e pakisei. Ne a piki den taki: “Fu saide u e pakisei ogii fu mi a ini u ati ini so du?
eng_text: Jesus, knowing their thoughts, said, "Why do you think evil in your hearts?

djk_text: Meke mi akisi u. Fu taigi wan sama taki, a kisi paadon fi en takuudu anga ogii, efu fu taigi en taki, ‘Opo taampu waka!’ on di moo taanga?
eng_text: For which is easier, to say, 'Your sins are forgiven;' or to say, 'Get up, and walk?'

djk_text: Ma u mu sabi taki, a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya abi makiti a goontapu, fu gi sama paadon fu takuudu anga ogii.” Ne a daai, ne a taigi a lanman taki: “Opo taampu! Teke i daagi waka go a osu!”
eng_text: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins..." (then he said to the paralytic), "Get up, and take up your mat, and go up to your house."

djk_text: We, ne a lanman opo, ne a go a osu.
eng_text: He arose and departed to his house.

djk_text: Den somen sama di be de ape foondoo te, a fika feele gi den. Den gafa Masaa Gadu fu di a gi libisama a gaan makiti ya.
eng_text: But when the multitudes saw it, they marveled and glorified God, who had given such authority to men.

djk_text: Namo, ne Masaa Jesesi komoto de e waka e gwe. Di a waka te wan pisi, ne a si Mateyesi sidon ne en kantoo e piki lantimoni. Ne a kai en taki: “Man, waka a mi baka!” Ne wanten, ne Mateyesi opo waka ne en baka.
eng_text: As Jesus passed by from there, he saw a man called Matthew sitting at the tax collection office. He said to him, "Follow me." He got up and followed him.

djk_text: Ne moo lati, ne Mateyesi kai Masaa Jesesi anga den taa bakaman fi en, fu den go nyan ne en osu. Da fa i si den go de, da wanlo taa sama di e piki lantimoni enke Mateyesi seefi anga sama di be e tyai polinen a kondee, be de ape tu.
eng_text: It happened as he sat in the house, behold, many tax collectors and sinners came and sat down with Jesus and his disciples.

djk_text: Namo di den Faliseiman si Masaa Jesesi sidon anga den sama ya, ne den akisi den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi taki: “Fa a waka a mesiti fu u e mosoo enseefi so anga den man di e piki lantimoni anga den taa polinen man de, te a mu sidon a tafaa anga den e nyan seefi?”
eng_text: When the Pharisees saw it, they said to his disciples, "Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?"

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi yee san den e akisi den bakaman fi en. Ne a taigi den taki: “Meke mi akisi u wan sani. San u pakisei dataa de fu du? Na fu deesi sikiman ofu fu deesi sama di de gusontu?”
eng_text: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, "Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.

djk_text: Ne a taigi den taki: “Faliseiman! U mu go leli san wan fositen apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu be sikiifi. Bika a be sikiifi taki: ‘U á mu denki taki, na te u kii meti boon begi mi, da u e dini mi kaba. Nono! Mi wani u abi tyali ati fu libisama, e fii anga den.’ Bika mi á kon a goontapu fu kai den bunbun sama, ma mi kon fu kai den sama di sabi taki, den libi á bun.”
eng_text: But you go and learn what this means: 'I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,' for I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance. "

djk_text: We, wan taa dei, ne den bakaman fu Johanisi a Dopuman kon a Masaa Jesesi. Ne den taki: “Wi enke bakaman fu Johanisi, wi anga den Faliseiman lobi de sondee nyan, fu begi Masaa Gadu. Ma saide den bakaman fi yu seefi nái de sondee nyan fu begi Masaa Gadu tu?”
eng_text: Then John's disciples came to him, saying, "Why do we and the Pharisees fast often, but your disciples don't fast?"

djk_text: Namo, Masaa Jesesi piki den anga wan ageisi toli. A taki: “I sabi te wan man e toow, da ai oli wan toow osu. Da ai kai en mati fu kon nyan piisii anga en. We, i denki den mati sa sidon de sondee nyan? Nono! Ma, i sabi on ten den mati fi en o de sondee nyan? Na te sama kon puu a man di e toow a den mindii tyai gwe fosi.”
eng_text: Jesus said to them, "Can the friends of the bridegroom mourn, as long as the bridegroom is with them? But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taki baka taki: “I sa nai nyun pisi koosi anga gaandi wan mokisa? Nono! Bika a nyun pisi o ali a gaandi pisi piiti. Da a piiti o bigi moo di be de kaba.
eng_text: No one puts a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment; for the patch would tear away from the garment, and a worse hole is made.

djk_text: Soseefi, den nái teke nyunyun meke win lai a ini wan gaandi metibuba saka. Bika a nyunyun win o soopu, da a saka ná o poi soopu moo, fu di a gaandi kaba. Da te den lai a win go a ini, da a o basi towe ala. Da a kon taki, i lasi a saka, i lasi a win. Ma te i poti nyunyun meke win a ini nyunyun saka, da te a win o soopu, da a saka seefi o soopu tu. Da ná wan fu den di o lasi.”
eng_text: Neither do people put new wine into old wineskins, or else the skins would burst, and the wine be spilled, and the skins ruined. No, they put new wine into fresh wineskins, and both are preserved."

djk_text: Namo wan edeman fu wan Dyu keliki kon sutu kini a Masaa Jesesi fesi e kee taki: “Masaa! Wan pikin umanpikin fu mi dede dyonson dyonson ya a osu. Ma mi e biibi taki, yu poi weki en baka.”
eng_text: While he told these things to them, behold, a ruler came and worshiped him, saying, "My daughter has just died, but come and lay your hand on her, and she will live."

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi komoto anga den bakaman fi en, ne den e go makandii anga a edeman fu a keliki, na a edeman ya osu.
eng_text: Jesus got up and followed him, as did his disciples.

djk_text: Na pasi den de, ne wan uman lon kon a Masaa Jesesi baka. A uman ya be abi wan lasi buulu siki, fu twalufu yali langa kaba. Namo a bendi go oli a koosi mofu fu Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: Behold, a woman who had an issue of blood for twelve years came behind him, and touched the fringe of his garment;

djk_text: Da ai pakisei taki: “Efu mi fende Masaa Jesesi koosi oli pikinso namo, mi o kon bun.”
eng_text: for she said within herself, "If I just touch his garment, I will be made well."

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi daai luku wanten, ne a si a uman. Ne a taigi en taki: “Uman! Ná feele! Fu di i biibi mi so taanga, da i kon bun kaba.” Fa i si Masaa Jesesi taki so, a uman betee kaba.
eng_text: But Jesus, turning around and seeing her, said, "Daughter, cheer up! Your faith has made you well." And the woman was made well from that hour.

djk_text: We, den waka pikinso moo. Ne den go doo a osu fu a edeman fu a Dyu keliki. Ne Masaa Jesesi si somen sama e pee wan pee enke tuka anda. Da na so den e kee wan gaan kee de tu.
eng_text: When Jesus came into the ruler's house, and saw the flute players, and the crowd in noisy disorder,

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi go taigi den taki: “U pasa gwe a doo anga u sani di u e meke! Bika a pikin á dede, na siibi ai siibi.” We, di Masaa Jesesi taki so, ne den sama kii en anga lafu.
eng_text: he said to them, "Make room, because the girl isn't dead, but sleeping." They were ridiculing him.

djk_text: Ma di ala sama komoto a doo, ne Masaa Jesesi go a ini a kambaa pe a dede pikin didon. Ne a oli a dede pikin ana, paa. Fa i si a kaba oli en, a pikin opo sidon wanten. Na weki a pikin weki kon a libi baka de so.
eng_text: But when the crowd was put out, he entered in, took her by the hand, and the girl arose.

djk_text: We, a nyunsu fu a gaan foondoo toli ya paati esi esi na a hii pisiwataa anda.
eng_text: The report of this went out into all that land.

djk_text: Namo, ne Masaa Jesesi daai e gwe. Ma tu beendiman lon kon ne en baka. Da den e bali taki: “Yu Bakaten Manpikin fu Kownu Dafeti paansu! Gaantangi! Yeepi wi anga a tyali ati di yu abi fu wi!”
eng_text: As Jesus passed by from there, two blind men followed him, calling out and saying, "Have mercy on us, son of David!"

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi waka go doo a osu, pe a be e tan. Ma soseefi den beendiman seefi de ne en baka go doo, te a ini a osu. Namo Masaa Jesesi akisi den taki: “U e biibi taki, mi poi deesi u tuu?” Namo den piki en taki: “Masaa! Wi e biibi dati tuutuu!”
eng_text: When he had come into the house, the blind men came to him. Jesus said to them, "Do you believe that I am able to do this?" They told him, "Yes, Lord."

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi lobi ana a den ain, saa. Ne a taki: “Da na san u biibi taki mi o du, sa pasa.”
eng_text: Then he touched their eyes, saying, "According to your faith be it done to you."

djk_text: Fa i si Masaa Jesesi kaba taki so, den beendiman ain opo waa, den kon e si. Ma Masaa Jesesi wasikoi den taki: “U á mu go taigi ná wan sama.”
eng_text: Their eyes were opened. Jesus strictly commanded them, saying, "See that no one knows about this."

djk_text: Ma anga ala fa a bali den de seefi, toku den paati a mofu na a hii pisiwataa, te ala sama kon sabi.
eng_text: But they went out and spread abroad his fame in all that land.

djk_text: We, ne di den tu sama gwe, ne den tyai wan babawman kon a Masaa Jesesi, fu a deesi en tu. Bika wan takuu jeje be de na a sama ya tapu, e tapu en mofu fu a á poi taki.
eng_text: As they went out, behold, a mute man who was demon possessed was brought to him.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi yaki a takuu jeje puu ne en tapu. Ne a kon bun wanten baka, te ai taki. Ne den sama kon e foondoo te, den e taki: “Fu senten di Islayeli Kondee de, noiti so wan sani be pasa ya so wanten.”
eng_text: When the demon was cast out, the mute man spoke. The multitudes marveled, saying, "Nothing like this has ever been seen in Israel!"

djk_text: Ma den Faliseiman taki: “Wi Faliseiman dati sabi fa ai du puu takuu jeje a sama tapu. Na saatan, a basi fu didibii e yeepi en, fu puu den takuu jeje.”
eng_text: But the Pharisees said, "By the prince of the demons, he casts out demons."

djk_text: Namo, Masaa Jesesi dati e waka e lontu a den foto foto anga den kondee kondee fu a hii pisiwataa anda. Da ai leli den sama a ini den Dyu keliki, a Bun Nyunsu di e taki, fu a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu. Soseefi, da ala pe a doo, da ai deesi sikiman anga sama di be abi nowtu de.
eng_text: Jesus went about all the cities and the villages, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.

djk_text: Ma fa a si den somen sama e kon ne en, ne tyali fu den sama kisi en te, ná sipowtu. Bika a si taki, den sama tan enke fa i sabi sikapu e waka buuya buuya sondee wan soluguman, fu solugu den.
eng_text: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion for them, because they were harassed and scattered, like sheep without a shepherd.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den bakaman fi en taki: “Somen sama de, di abi yeepi fanowdu. Den de enke wan gaan goon nyanyan di de lepi lepi fu koti poti a baakoto. Ma wookoman á de ipi sai.
eng_text: Then he said to his disciples, "The harvest indeed is plentiful, but the laborers are few.

djk_text: We, u mu begi a Masaa fu a wooko, meke a sende wookoman go na a wooko fi en.”
eng_text: Pray therefore that the Lord of the harvest will send out laborers into his harvest."

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi kai den twalufu bakaman fi en kon, ne a taigi den taki: “U aliki ya! Mi gi u makiti fu u yaki takuu jeje puu a sama tapu. Soseefi mi e gi u makiti fu u deesi ala sowtu sikiman.”
eng_text: He called to himself his twelve disciples, and gave them authority over unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal every disease and every sickness.

djk_text: We, da den nen fu den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi di a be teke puu a den taawan mindii, fu de enke apaiti bosikopuman fi en, di den e kai aposteli na be: Simon, a fosiwan fu den aposteli di den be e kai Peitilisi tu Andeleyasi, en baala Jakowbesi, anga en baala Johanisi, den manpikin fu Da Sebedi
eng_text: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these. The first, Simon, who is called Peter; Andrew, his brother; James the son of Zebedee; John, his brother;

djk_text: Filipi Baatomeyosi Towmasi Mateyesi di be e piki lantimoni Jakowbesi a manpikin fu Alefeyosi Tadeyesi
eng_text: Philip; Bartholomew; Thomas; Matthew the tax collector; James the son of Alphaeus; Lebbaeus, whose surname was Thaddaeus;

djk_text: Simon Selotu Judasi Iskaliyotu, di seli Masaa Jesesi, meke den kii en.
eng_text: Simon the Canaanite; and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.

djk_text: Da na den twalufu bakaman fi en ya, a sende na a wooko. A taigi den taki: “Fa i si u o go de, u á mu go a ná wan taa sowtu sama moo enke den Dyusama. Ná den sama fu Samaliya Kondee seefi u mu go.
eng_text: Jesus sent these twelve out, and commanded them, saying, "Don't go among the Gentiles, and don't enter into any city of the Samaritans.

djk_text: Ma na den Dyusama fu u, di den enke lasi sikapu e waka sondee wan soluguman. Na den u mu go.
eng_text: Rather, go to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.

djk_text: Te u go, da u taigi den taki, a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu de koosube.
eng_text: As you go, preach, saying, 'The Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!'

djk_text: Soseefi, fa i si u o go de, u mu deesi ala sowtu sikiman kon bun. Efu wan sama dede, u weki en baka, puu a dede. U deesi ala den gwasiman fiya. U yaki ala den takuu jeje puu a den sama tapu. A apaiti taanga, di mi gi u ya, a ná bai u bai en. Da u á mu meke sama pai u fi en tu.
eng_text: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers , and cast out demons. Freely you received, so freely give.

djk_text: “Da te u o go, ná wan kopoo sensi seefi di u mu tyai go anga u.
eng_text: Don't take any gold, nor silver, nor brass in your money belts.

djk_text: U á mu lai nyanyan a saka tyai. U á mu tyai tu dyakiti ofu tu susu tyai go anga u. U á mu tyai moo enke wan waka tiki go anga u tu. Bika a fiti fu wan wookoman nyan, fu a wooko di ai du.
eng_text: Take no bag for your journey, neither two coats, nor shoes, nor staff: for the laborer is worthy of his food.

djk_text: Ma, te u go doo wan foto efu wan kondee, da u suku wan waiti bun manii sama, da u tan ne en osu. Da na ape u mu tan te enke u komoto de fu gwe a wan taa peesi.
eng_text: Into whatever city or village you enter, find out who in it is worthy; and stay there until you go on.

djk_text: Ma, te u doo a ini a osu de, da u mu gi den sama de odi taki: ‘Meke Masaa Gadu gi u koo ati fu libi, ye!’
eng_text: As you enter into the household, greet it.

djk_text: Da efu den sama fu a osu de, waiti fu fende a bun de, da Masaa Gadu o gi den koo ati fu libi tuu. Ma efu den á waiti fu fende en, da den ná o fende en. Da a bun de o daai kon a u baka.
eng_text: If the household is worthy, let your peace come on it, but if it isn't worthy, let your peace return to you.

djk_text: Ma efu u go a wan kondee ofu wan osu, ne den sama á wani oli u, den á wani yee a bun fu Masaa Gadu, da u mu komoto de gwe. Ma, te u o gwe, da u mu naki u futu puu a doti di be de ne en towe fika de. Dati o soi taki, te Masaa Gadu o gi den sitaafu, da u dati ná abi fowtu a ini. Ma na denseefi fowtu, meke Masaa Gadu o sitaafu den so.
eng_text: Whoever doesn't receive you, nor hear your words, as you go out of that house or that city, shake off the dust from your feet.

djk_text: “Bika fu tuutuu mi e taki, a dei di Masaa Gadu o kai ala sama kon a kuutu, da a o gi den sitaafu! A o bigi moo a sitaafu fu Sowdom anga Gomola, den tu ogii foto, di Masaa Gadu be gi faya a fositen.
eng_text: Most certainly I tell you, it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city.

djk_text: “Ma u aliki! Fa mi e sende u go ya, da a de enke te mi be o sende sikapu go a mindii fu takuu meti. Da, u mu de na ain e wooko anga ala fusutan. U mu waka anga saka fasi anda.
eng_text:
Behold, I send you out as sheep in the midst of wolves. Therefore be wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.
288	U mu luku bun anga den sama! Bika den sa kisi u tyai go a kuutu. Den o wipi u a ini den keliki osu fu den tu.	288	But beware of men: for they will deliver you up to councils, and in their synagogues they will scourge you.
289	Soseefi den o kisi u tyai go a den edeman fu kondee, fu mi ede. Ma ala dati o pasa, fu di u mu fende pasi fu kotoigi fu mi gi ala Dyusama, te go miti taa foluku di á sabi Masaa Gadu du.	289	Yes, and you will be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony to them and to the nations.
290	Te den kisi u tyai go a den kuutu fu den, da u á mu pantan anga booko ede taki san u o taki. Nono! Bika a yuu de, da Masaa Gadu o gi u san fu u taki.	290	But when they deliver you up, don't be anxious how or what you will say, for it will be given you in that hour what you will say.
291	Bika a ná u o sabi taki so, ma a Apaiti Jeje fu mi Tata di de a u ini, ne en o taki komoto a ini u, kon a doo.	291	For it is not you who speak, but the Spirit of your Father who speaks in you.

Soseefi pikin seefi o seli dda anga mma gi sama fu kii.	292	Brother will deliver up brother to death, and the father his child. Children will rise up against parents, and cause them to be put to death.

djk_text: Meke u taki, ná wan sama o lobi u, fu di u e biibi mi ede. Ma a sama di o tei ati oli fu oli doo, te na a kaba, da a sa fende a yeepi fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: You will be hated by all men for my name's sake, but he who endures to the end will be saved.

djk_text: We, u yee ya! Te u go a wan foto, ne sama e suku toobi anga u de, da u lon komoto de, go a wan taa foto. Bika fu tuu, mi e taigi u taki, u ná o poi kaba a wooko na ala den foto fu Islayeli Kondee ya, fosi a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya daai kon baka a goontapu.
eng_text: But when they persecute you in this city, flee into the next, for most certainly I tell you, you will not have gone through the cities of Israel, until the Son of Man has come.

djk_text: “Da fa i si den e du anga u de, na letiso den e du anga mi ya kaba. Bika a sama di e teke leli a wan basi, noiti hei moo a basi. Soseefi wan futuboi á hei moo en masaa.
eng_text:
A disciple is not above his teacher, nor a servant above his lord.

Bika mi anga u na awan.	296	It is enough for the disciple that he be like his teacher, and the servant like his lord. Da ná wan sani o pasa te, da sama á sabi.	297	Therefore don't be afraid of them, for there is nothing covered that will not be revealed; and hidden that will not be known.
