djk_text: Bika sama ná o poi fu pasa, go teke wan taanga man sani a ini en osu puu a doo. Fosi a sa du dati, da a musu tei a taanga man di abi a osu de fosi.
eng_text: Or how can one enter into the house of the strong man, and plunder his goods, unless he first bind the strong man? Then he will plunder his house.

djk_text: “We, ibii sama di á wani teke a se fu mi, dati o de a didibii ondoo. Bika den sama di nái wooko makandii anga mi, dati e suku fu poli mi wooko.
eng_text:
He who is not with me is against me, and he who doesn't gather with me, scatters.
374	Ma fu tuu, Masaa Gadu sa gi wan sama paadon, fu ala ogii di a sa du. Soseefi a sa gi en paadon tu, fu ala taa kosi, winsi ai taki ogii fu a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya. Ma a wan sani di noiti Masaa Gadu e gi sama paadon, na te a sama e taki ogii fu a Apaiti Jeje fu Masaa Gadu.	374	Therefore I tell you, every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men, but the blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven men.
375	“We, na a sii di wan bon e meke yu o luku, da yu sa sabi fa fu kai a bon seefi. Wan bun ati bon e meke bun sii. Ma na wan takuu ati bon e meke sii di á bun.	375	Either make the tree good, and its fruit good, or make the tree corrupt, and its fruit corrupt; for the tree is known by its fruit.

djk_text: “Na yu enke ogii ati sama, enke takuu tetei di taampu de, á sa poi puu bunbun taki kon a doo. Bika na san fuu a takuu ati fu u, e kon komoto a doo.
eng_text: You offspring of vipers, how can you, being evil, speak good things? For out of the abundance of the heart, the mouth speaks.

djk_text: Ma wan bun ati sama, na bun manii ai puu kon a doo. Ma wan ogii ati sama dati na takuu manii, ai puu kon a doo.
eng_text: The good man out of his good treasure brings out good things, and the evil man out of his evil treasure brings out evil things.

djk_text: Ma fu tuu, mi e taigi u! Wan dei e kon, da Masaa Gadu o kai ala sama kon a kuutu. Da ibii sama o gi faantiwowtu, fu ala soso taki seefi di a be taki ya.
eng_text: I tell you that every idle word that men speak, they will give account of it in the day of judgment.

djk_text: Ma sama di be abi bunbun sani e taki, da dati o tyai bun gi a sama de a Masaa Gadu. Ma efu na poli taki i be abi, da dati o tyai sitaafu gi yu a Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: For by your words you will be justified, and by your words you will be condemned."

djk_text: We, ne wan duupu leliman fu Dyuweiti o waka kon a Masaa Jesesi. Soseefi, Faliseiman be de a ini kon tu. Namo den sende Masaa Jesesi taki: “Mesiti! Du wan gaan wonduu a tapu anda, osi, meke u si fa yu abi a makiti fu Masaa Gadu tuutuu?”
eng_text: Then certain of the scribes and Pharisees answered, "Teacher, we want to see a sign from you."

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “U takuu ati sama, di á de fu fitoow! Bika na a sowtu sama enke u de wani si wonduu, enke maiki fosi den sa biibi. Ma mi ya dati ná o soi u wan enkii maiki, moo enke a foondoo toli fu Jowna.
eng_text: But he answered them, "An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, but no sign will be given it but the sign of Jonah the prophet.

djk_text: Bika u sabi taki, Jowna be beli dii dei anga neti a ini a gaan fisi bee. We, na so den o beli a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya, dii dei anga neti a ondoo doti tu.
eng_text: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the whale, so will the Son of Man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.

djk_text: Ma wan dei e kon, da den sama fu Ninifei o opo, da den o kuutu den sama fu a ten ya. Bika den sama fu Ninifei be yee a wowtu fu Masaa Gadu di Jowna be gi den. Ne den teke en, ne den daai libi wanten. Ma wan Sama de a u mindii ya, di hei moo Jowna, ma toku, u nái teke en taki.
eng_text: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation, and will condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, someone greater than Jonah is here.

djk_text: Soseefi a uman kownu fu a kondee na a se fu san dongo, o opo na a gaan kuutu dei, di Masaa Gadu o kuutu sama, fu kuutu den sama fu a ten ya. Bika en dati be komoto langa langa te na a taase fu goontapu fu kon a Salomo, fu kon yee den koni fi en. Ma wan Sama de a u mindii ya, di hei moo Salomo seefi, ma toku, u nái teke en taki.”
eng_text: The queen of the south will rise up in the judgment with this generation, and will condemn it, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, someone greater than Solomon is here.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi wasikoi den sama go doo taki: “Te wan takuu jeje e komoto na wan sama tapu, da a gwe moimoi, go waka lontu, suku taa tanpeesi a ini gaan sabana. Ma, da a nái poi fende tanpeesi anda.
eng_text: But the unclean spirit, when he is gone out of the man, passes through waterless places, seeking rest, and doesn't find it.

djk_text: Da ai pakisei taki: ‘Meke mi daai go tan na a peesi pe mi be komoto baka.’ Da te a daai kon baka, a osu pe a be komoto de leigi leigi. A de kiinkiin sibisibi moi silli.
eng_text: Then he says, 'I will return into my house from which I came out,' and when he has come back, he finds it empty, swept, and put in order.

djk_text: Ma fosi a go baka, da ai go kai ete seibin taa takuu jeje ogii moo enseefi. Da ala den e go tan a ini a sama makandii. Da a kon, sowan sama libi e kon moo ogii, moo fosi den be puu a takuu jeje gi en. Na letiso sa pasa anga den sama di nái yee mi taki ya tu.”
eng_text: Then he goes, and takes with himself seven other spirits more evil than he is, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first. Even so will it be also to this evil generation."

djk_text: Da di Masaa Jesesi de ape e taki den sani ya, ne en mma anga den baala fi en kon luku en. Den be wani taki anga en. Ma a osu pe Masaa Jesesi be de fuu te, ne den á poi doo Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: While he was yet speaking to the multitudes, behold, his mother and his brothers stood outside, seeking to speak to him.

djk_text: We, ne wan sama lon kon piki Masaa Jesesi a ini a osu taki, en mma anga den baala fi en de a doose e luku en.
eng_text: One said to him, "Behold, your mother and your brothers stand outside, seeking to speak to you."

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi akisi taki: “Sama u e kai mi mma anga mi baala?”
eng_text: But he answered him who spoke to him, "Who is my mother? Who are my brothers?"

djk_text: Ne a daai sii soi finga a den bakaman fi en. Ne a taki: “U luku den sama ya! Na den na mi mma anga mi baala, mi tuutuu tyuku tyuku famii.
eng_text: He stretched out his hand towards his disciples, and said, "Behold, my mother and my brothers!

djk_text: Bika na ala sama, di e du enke fa mi Tata, Masaa Gadu a tapu wani, na mi baala anga mi sisa anga mi mma.”
eng_text: For whoever does the will of my Father who is in heaven, he is my brother, and sister, and mother."

djk_text: Ne a seefi dei de, ne Masaa Jesesi komoto a ini a osu, ne a go sidon a wataa mofu anda.
eng_text: On that day Jesus went out of the house, and sat by the seaside.

djk_text: Ma somen sama booko kon lontu en te, ná sipowtu. Ne a go a ini wan boto fika den sama a soo. Da na anda a tan e taki anga den sama. Da den sama taampu a sikin liba e aliki.
eng_text: Great multitudes gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat, and sat, and all the multitude stood on the beach.

djk_text: Ne a leli den somen sani anga ageisi toli taki: “Wan sama be go a goon, go tyatya wan sii fi en, fu goo.
eng_text: He spoke to them many things in parables, saying, "Behold, a farmer went out to sow.

djk_text: We, di a tyatya a sii, ne afu kai a sikin pasi. Ne pikin foo kon, ne den nyan den.
eng_text: As he sowed, some seeds fell by the roadside, and the birds came and devoured them.

djk_text: Soseefi wan duupu sii kai a siton ini, di ná abi tyaipi doti. Ne den disi goo kon wanten. Bika a doti de á be dipi gi den.
eng_text: Others fell on rocky ground, where they didn't have much soil, and immediately they sprang up, because they had no depth of earth.

djk_text: Ma fa i si a san pii, ne a boon den. Da fu di den á be abi lutu, ne den dede.
eng_text: When the sun had risen, they were scorched. Because they had no root, they withered away.

djk_text: Da taa sii kai a ini maka, ne den goo. Soseefi, den maka seefi goo tu. Da fu di den goo makandii, meke den maka pasuma den sii kii.
eng_text: Others fell among thorns. The thorns grew up and choked them.

djk_text: Ma soseefi, wan duupu sii kai a bun doti. Den disi goo bunbun, meke nyanyan, te ná sipowtu. Son fu den meke wan ondoo toon, moo enke san di a be paandi. Taawan meke sigisitenti toon, moo enke san di den be paandi. Taawan baka, meke diitenti toon, moo enke san di den be paandi tu.”
eng_text: Others fell on good soil, and yielded fruit: some one hundred times as much, some sixty, and some thirty.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “Sama di abi yesi fu yee, da meke a yee san mi taki de.”
eng_text: He who has ears to hear, let him hear."

djk_text: We, ne den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi kon ne en, ne den akisi en taki: “We, Masaa! Saide meke yu e leli sama anga ageisi toli?”
eng_text: The disciples came, and said to him, "Why do you speak to them in parables?"

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “U enke bakaman fu mi, u naki bun ede, fu kon sabi den dipi toli fu Masaa Gadu. Bika u dati sa kon fusutan a Nyun Tii fi en. Ma den sama anda á fende a gaan bun de, fu di den á wani aliki mi.
eng_text: He answered them, "To you it is given to know the mysteries of the Kingdom of Heaven, but it is not given to them.

djk_text: Bika sama di abi, da a sa fende tyaipi moo, te a pasa maiki. Ma sama di ná abi, da a pikinso di a abi seefi, den o teke puu ne en.
eng_text: For whoever has, to him will be given, and he will have abundance, but whoever doesn't have, from him will be taken away even that which he has.

djk_text: Da na fu dati ede meke, mi e taki anga ageisi toli. ‘Bika anga opo opo ain den á wani si. Anga opo opo yesi, den á wani yee. Soseefi den á wani fusutan tu.’
eng_text: Therefore I speak to them in parables, because seeing they don't see, and hearing, they don't hear, neither do they understand.

djk_text: Da fa den de ape, da ai waka anga den enke fa Jesaja a apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu be sikiifi a Masaa Gadu Buku. A be sikiifi taki: ‘U yesi e yee sani fu mi, ma u ná o fusutan dati. U ain e kai a sani fu mi, ma u ná o si dati.
eng_text: In them the prophecy of Isaiah is fulfilled, which says, 'By hearing you will hear, and will in no way understand; Seeing you will see, and will in no way perceive:

djk_text: Bika den sama ya taanga den ati. Den yesi á poi yee sani. Den ain tapu tu. Da den á poi daai den libi kon, fu mi kon deesi den.’
eng_text: for this people's heart has grown callous, their ears are dull of hearing, they have closed their eyes; or else perhaps they might perceive with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and should turn again; and I would heal them.'

djk_text: Ma seigi fu sama di ain kiin fu si sani. Soseefi seigi fu sama di yesi opo fu yee sani.
eng_text:
But blessed are your eyes, for they see; and your ears, for they hear.
409	Bika somen fositen apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu anga somen taa fositen letiopu sama, be angii seefi seefi, fu si den sani di u e si anga den sani di u e yee a goontapu fosi den dede. Ma toku, den á be si den.”	409	For most certainly I tell you that many prophets and righteous men desired to see the things which you see, and didn't see them; and to hear the things which you hear, and didn't hear them.
410	Namo Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “We, mi o puu a toli, fu a sama di e tyatya sii paandi a ini a goon.”	410	Hear, then, the parable of the farmer.

djk_text: A taigi den taki: “Te wan sama yee a toli fu a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu, da efu a á fusutan a toli kiinkiin, da a ogii ati didibii e kon fufuu a bosikopu puu ne en ati ini. Da sowan sama ati de enke a sikin pasi, pe a sii be kai.
eng_text: When anyone hears the word of the Kingdom, and doesn't understand it, the evil one comes, and snatches away that which has been sown in his heart. This is what was sown by the roadside.

djk_text: Ma a siton doti pe a sii kai, na sama di yee a wowtu, ne a teke en anga gaan piisii na ati.
eng_text: What was sown on the rocky places, this is he who hears the word, and immediately with joy receives it;

djk_text: Ma fa i si wan sani miti en fu a wowtu ede, da a nái oli go doo. Wanten ai fika a biibi, daai baka gi Masaa Gadu. Bika a wowtu fu Masaa Gadu á be doo na a dipi fu den ati.
eng_text: yet he has no root in himself, but endures for a while. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, immediately he stumbles.

djk_text: Da, a peesi pe a sii be kai na a maka ini, dati na a sama di yee a wowtu. Ma a abi booko fu dyendee libi anga pina a goontapu ya e meke a wowtu nái puu a wini di a be mu puu.
eng_text: What was sown among the thorns, this is he who hears the word, but the cares of this age and the deceitfulness of riches choke the word, and he becomes unfruitful.

djk_text: Ma a bun doti pe a sii be kai, dati na wan sama di yee a wowtu, da a fusutan en kiinkiin. Ne a teke en kibii a ini en ati. Da son meke diitenti, taawan meke sigisitenti. Taawan baka libi e puu wan ondoo, toon fu san di be de.”
eng_text: What was sown on the good ground, this is he who hears the word, and understands it, who most certainly bears fruit, and brings forth, some one hundred times as much, some sixty, and some thirty."

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi gi den ete wan taa ageisi toli fu soi fa a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu de. A taki: “A de leti enke wan basi di be teke wan sii fi en, go tyatya ne en goon.
eng_text: He set another parable before them, saying, "The Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field,

djk_text: Namo di neti kon doo, ne wan takuu ati feyantiman fi en go saafi saafi a baka, ne enseefi tyatya wan takuu paansu sii a ini a goon fu a basi.
eng_text: but while people slept, his enemy came and sowed darnel weeds also among the wheat, and went away.

djk_text: Ne den de te, a sii goo kon bigi meke nyanyan. Soseefi a takuu paansu sii seefi goo kon tu.
eng_text: But when the blade sprang up and brought forth fruit, then the darnel weeds appeared also.

djk_text: Ne den wookoman fu a basi go na a basi fu a goon, ne den akisi en taki: ‘Basi! A ná bunbun sii namo i be paandi na a goon, no? We, ne pe den tyaipi takuu sii de komoto, kon goo a den bunbun wan mindii so?’
eng_text: The servants of the householder came and said to him, 'Sir, didn't you sow good seed in your field? Where did this darnel come from?'

djk_text: “We, ne a basi piki den taki: ‘Oho! Na wan feyantiman fu mi namo i si du anga mi so.’ “Ne den man akisi en taki: ‘We, i wani meke u go puu den takuu uwii a den bun wan mindii?’
eng_text: He said to them, 'An enemy has done this.' The servants asked him, 'Do you want us to go and gather them up?'

djk_text: “Ma a basi piki den taki: ‘Nono! U á mu du dati! Bika fu u suku fu puu den nownow, u o misi puu den bun paansu wan a ini tu!
eng_text:
But he said, 'No, lest perhaps while you gather up the darnel weeds, you root up the wheat with them.
422	Meke ala den goo kon makandii. Te den lepi fu koti, da mi sa meke den wookoman di e koti lepi sii, go koti den takuu paansu puu a ini den bun wan. Da den o tei den a bosu go gi faya. Ma den sa tyai den bun wan go kibii a magisin.’ ”	422	Let both grow together until the harvest, and in the harvest time I will tell the reapers, First, gather up the darnel weeds, and bind them in bundles to burn them; but gather the wheat into my barn."'"

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi daai gi den ete wan toli, fu soi fa a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu de. A taki: “A de leti enke a sii di den e kai mosite, di wan sama teke paandi ne en goon.
eng_text: He set another parable before them, saying, "The Kingdom of Heaven is like a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and sowed in his field;

djk_text: Da enke fa u sabi, da mosite sii nyoni moo ala sii di i sa paandi a goon. Ma te a goo kon kaba, da ai bigi moo ala taa sowtu sani a ini a goon. Da ai toon wan bon di foo fu ondoo goontapu e kon meke nesi a den taka fi en, fu tan.”
eng_text: which indeed is smaller than all seeds. But when it is grown, it is greater than the herbs, and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in its branches."

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi gi den ete wan ageisi toli baka taki: “A fasi fa a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu de, da na leti enke wan uman di e masi bolon. A teke wan pikin sowda towe ne en. Da dati a pikin sowda ya e soopu a hii bolon te, a kon bigi bufuu.”
eng_text: He spoke another parable to them. "The Kingdom of Heaven is like yeast, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, until it was all leavened."

djk_text: Da na so Masaa Jesesi be gi den sama ala den ageisi toli ya. Da a á be e gi den ná wan toli, sondee fu wooko anga ageisi toli.
eng_text: Jesus spoke all these things in parables to the multitudes; and without a parable, he didn't speak to them,

djk_text: Na so a sani di a apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu be sikiifi fositen a Masaa Gadu Buku be kon pasa tuu. A be sikiifi taki: “Mi o taki anga den anga ageisi toli. Da sani di be kibii senten di Masaa Gadu be meke tapu anga goontapu, mi soi den, fu ala sama si.”
eng_text: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying, "I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things hidden from the foundation of the world."

djk_text: Namo, di Masaa Jesesi kaba leli den sama den sani ya, ne a enseefi go a osu. Namo, ne den bakaman fi en kon ne en, ne den akisi en taki: “Masaa! Puu a ageisi toli, fu a takuu uwii a den bunbun wan mindii gi u, baa?”
eng_text: Then Jesus sent the multitudes away, and went into the house. His disciples came to him, saying, "Explain to us the parable of the darnel weeds of the field."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “A bun! Mi sa puu en gi u. A sama di be e tyatya a sii, dati na a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya.
eng_text: He answered them, "He who sows the good seed is the Son of Man,

djk_text: Ma a goon seefi dati na a hii goontapu pe u de ya. Da a bunbun sii na den sama di de a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu. Da den takuu sii dati na den sama di didibii e tii.
eng_text: the field is the world; and the good seed, these are the children of the Kingdom; and the darnel weeds are the children of the evil one.

djk_text: Da a gaan feyantiman di i si tyatya den sii de, na a didibii seefi. Da a ten fu koti, dati na a kaba ten fu goontapu. Da den sama di o koti a nyanyan kibii a magisin, dati na den Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee .
eng_text: The enemy who sowed them is the devil. The harvest is the end of the age, and the reapers are angels.

djk_text: “We, enke fa i si den sama be e koti den uwii tei a bosu fu gi faya de, na letiso sani a o waka, na a kaba yuu fu goontapu.
eng_text: As therefore the darnel weeds are gathered up and burned with fire; so will it be at the end of this age.

djk_text: Bika a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya, o sende den Basiya fi en a Masaa Gadu Kondee, go a goontapu, go piki ala sama di e du ogii, anga den di e leli taa sama fu du ogii. Da na so a o puu den a mindii fu den di de a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu, fu towe go a ini a sitaafu peesi pe soso kee anga tyali de.
eng_text: The Son of Man will send out his angels, and they will gather out of his Kingdom all things that cause stumbling, and those who do iniquity,

djk_text: Ma den sama di be libi letiopu gi Masaa Gadu, sa beenki kiin kelle, a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu Kondee a tapu anda, enke fa ala sama e si a san te a opo. Da sama di abi yesi fu yee, meke a yee san mi taki de.”
eng_text: Then the righteous will shine forth like the sun in the Kingdom of their Father. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.

djk_text: Namo, ne Masaa Jesesi teke ete wan toli leli den fu fa a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu o de. A taki: “A de enke wan gaan gudu di de kibii kibii a wan ini pisi doti. Ne wan sama go si en. Ne a kibii en baka, ma a á piki ná wan sama. Ne a gwe anga gaan piisii ne en ati, ne a seli ala san a be abi a osu, ne a bai a pisi doti de, toon fi enseefi.
eng_text:
Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a treasure hidden in the field, which a man found, and hid. In his joy, he goes and sells all that he has, and buys that field.
436	“Da soseefi a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu de enke wan wenkiiman di e suku gaan dii dyamanti siton, fu bai seli baka. Ne ai waka e suku, te a go fende wan di waiti moo ala taawan.	436	Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a merchant seeking fine pearls,

djk_text: Ne a go a osu, ne a seli ala san a be abi fiya, ne a teke ala a moni, ne a go bai a gaan dii dyamanti siton de.”
eng_text: who having found one pearl of great price, he went and sold all that he had, and bought it.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi gi den ete wan toli. A taki: “A Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu de enke wan seepi di wan sama towe. Ne a kisi ala sowtu fisi. Den di bun fu nyan anga den di á bun fu nyan.
eng_text:
Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a dragnet, that was cast into the sea, and gathered some fish of every kind,

Bika Masaa Gadu o sende den Basiya fi en a Masaa Gadu Kondee go piki den takuu ati sama, puu a mindii fu den bun ati wan di e libi letiopu fasi gi Masaa Gadu.	440	So will it be in the end of the world. The angels will come forth, and separate the wicked from among the righteous,
441	Da den sa iti den takuu ati sama ya go ini a gaanbigi faya, pe den o de, e bali e kee gaan kee, e kaw tifi, fu tego.”	441	and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be the weeping and the gnashing of teeth.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi akisi den taki: “Fa mi e taki anga u ya, u e fusutan mi?” Ne den piki taki: “Iya Masaa! U e fusutan yu!”
eng_text: Jesus said to them, "Have you understood all these things?" They answered him, "Yes, Lord."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den baka taki: “Da a bun, te wan sama e fusutan a toli di e taki, fu a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu. Soseefi, efu makandii anga dati, da a sama sabi den weiti fu Mosesi bun tu, da a moo bun baka. Bika, da na tu koni fu Masaa Gadu kon miti na awan. Da na dobuu koni a sama de abi.”
eng_text: He said to them, "Therefore every scribe who has been made a disciple in the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a householder, who brings out of his treasure new and old things."

djk_text: We, di Masaa Jesesi gi den ala den toli ya, te a kaba, ne a komoto de.
eng_text: It happened that when Jesus had finished these parables, he departed from there.

djk_text: Ne a gwe a Nasaleti, a foto pe a be kiya. Ne a go a den keliki anda, go leli sama sani fu Masaa Gadu. Ma ai foondoo den, fu si a fasi fa Masaa Jesesi e leli den. Ne den taki: “Ma, pe a fende a gaan koni anga a gaan kaakiti fu du den foondoo wooko de?
eng_text: Coming into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, so that they were astonished, and said, "Where did this man get this wisdom, and these mighty works?

djk_text: Bika, a ná a boi fu Jowsef, a tembeeman de ya, no? Na Maliya ne en mma. Den baala fi en na Jakopu anga Judasi anga Jowsef anga Simon.
eng_text: Isn't this the carpenter's son? Isn't his mother called Mary, and his brothers, James, Joses, Simon, and Judas ?

djk_text: Den sisa fi en na wi anga den de ya. Da pe a go fende ala den sani de?”
eng_text: Aren't all of his sisters with us? Where then did this man get all of these things?"

djk_text: We, na so den teke en fu ogii. Ma Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Na so a de tuu. Wan apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu sa fende lesipeki anga gafa na ala taa peesi fu goontapu, boiti en eigi kondee.”
eng_text: They were offended by him. But Jesus said to them, "A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country, and in his own house."

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi á du somen foondoo wooko a Nasaleti de. Bika den á be poti biibi ne en.
eng_text: He didn't do many mighty works there because of their unbelief.

djk_text: We, da a yuu ten de, da Kownu Helowdesi yee fu den gaan foondoo sani di Masaa Jesesi e du.
eng_text: At that time, Herod the tetrarch heard the report concerning Jesus,

djk_text: Ne a taigi den futuboi fi en taki: “Na Johanisi a Dopuman ne en e du den sani de. A opo komoto a dede kon a libi ya baka! A dati meke a abi a gaan kaakiti de, fu du ala den foondoo sani de.”
eng_text: and said to his servants, "This is John the Baptizer. He is risen from the dead. That is why these powers work in him."

djk_text: We, Helowdesi be teke a uman fu wan baala fi en, den e kai Filipi, enke uman. Na a uman den e kai Helowdiya. We, ne Johanisi be go bali en taki, a sani di a du de á bun. A poli Masaa Gadu weiti anga a uman fi en baala di a teke de. Na fu a sani ya meke, a sende sama go kisi Johanisi. Ne a meke den bwui en, ne den poti en a dunguu osu.
eng_text: For Herod had laid hold of John, and bound him, and put him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip's wife.

djk_text: Kownu Helowdesi ati be boon te, a be sa kii Johanisi seefi. Ma toku, a be e feele fu du dati. Bika ala sama be e si Johanisi taki, en na wan apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: When he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.

djk_text: Ma di den de te, ne Kownu Helowdesi fuuyali. Ma namo, da a uman di a be teke, be abi wan umanpikin. Ne a umanpikin fu Helowdiya ya dansi na a fuuyali, a fesi fu ala den bigi bigiman. We, a dansi ya switi gi Kownu Helowdesi te, ná sipowtu.
eng_text: But when Herod's birthday came, the daughter of Herodias danced among them and pleased Herod.

djk_text: Namo Helowdesi kai a umanpikin ya kon. Ne a sweli gi a pikin, a fesi fu ala den bigiman di de ape taki: “Pikin! Wansi san yu akisi mi, mi sa gi yu en.”
eng_text: Whereupon he promised with an oath to give her whatever she should ask.

djk_text: We, di kownu taki so, ne a pikin umanpikin lon go, ne en mma. Ne a taigi en taki, na so anga so, kownu paamisi en. Da san a mu du. We, ne a mma taigi en taki: “Go taigi kownu taki, i wani a ede fu Johanisi a Dopuman a wan teepala tapu.” Na so a pikin umanpikin lon go, ne a taigi kownu taki: “Kownu! Gi mi a ede fu Johanisi a Dopuman a wan teepala tapu.”
eng_text: She, being prompted by her mother, said, "Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptizer."

djk_text: We, di Kownu Helowdesi yee so, ne a buduufu en te, a á sabi pe fu poti enseefi. Ma a gaan sweli di a be sweli a lanti fesi meke a á be poi kengi mofu moo. Ne wanten, ne a sende sama go a dunguu osu go doo Johanisi ede felen.
eng_text: The king was grieved, but for the sake of his oaths, and of those who sat at the table with him, he commanded it to be given,

djk_text: Ne den poti a koti ede a wan teepala tapu, tyai kon gi a pikin. Ne a pikin ya teke en, ne a tyai go gi en mma, Helowdiya.
eng_text: His head was brought on a platter, and given to the young lady: and she brought it to her mother.

djk_text: Ne den bakaman fu Johanisi kon teke a dede sikin, ne den beli. Bakadati, ne den go piki Masaa Jesesi taki, na so wan sani pasa.
eng_text: His disciples came, and took the body, and buried it; and they went and told Jesus.

djk_text: We, di Masaa Jesesi yee san pasa, ne a komoto de. Ne a teke boto koti abaa go a wan peesi, en wawan kodo. Ma di den sama fu kondee anda yee pe a go, ne den booko gwullu waka lontu a soo go ne en baka.
eng_text: Now when Jesus heard this, he withdrew from there in a boat, to a deserted place apart. When the multitudes heard it, they followed him on foot from the cities.

djk_text: Fa i si Masaa Jesesi saka komoto a soo, tyaipi sama de a soo anda kaba, e luku en. Namo, tyali kisi Masaa Jesesi fu den somen sama. Ne a deesi ala den sikiman, kon bun de baka silli.
eng_text: Jesus went out, and he saw a great multitude. He had compassion on them, and healed their sick.

djk_text: Da di bakadina, neti mofu, ne den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi kon ne en. Ne den taigi en taki: “Masaa! Ai lati kaba! A ini wan sabana ini u de. Da sende den sama gwe, meke den go a den pikin kondee, go suku sani bai fu nyan.”
eng_text: When evening had come, his disciples came to him, saying, "This place is deserted, and the hour is already late. Send the multitudes away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves food."

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Nono! A á de fu den gwe! U gi den sani fu den nyan.”
eng_text: But Jesus said to them, "They don't need to go away. You give them something to eat."

djk_text: We, ne den bakaman piki taki: “Da fa u o du? Bika na feifi beele anga tu losi fisi namo wi abi ya.”
eng_text: They told him, "We only have here five loaves and two fish."

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “U tyai den kon gi mi ya.”
eng_text: He said, "Bring them here to me."

djk_text: Ne a sende ala den sama go sidon a gaasi tapu. Ne a teke den feifi beele anga den tu fisi, ne a opo ede luku tapu, ne a gi Masaa Gadu daa, te a kaba. Ne a booko den feifi beele anga den tu fisi pisipisi gi den bakaman, fu den go paati. Ne den bakaman gi den sama.
eng_text: He commanded the multitudes to sit down on the grass; and he took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, broke and gave the loaves to the disciples, and the disciples gave to the multitudes.

djk_text: Ne ala den sama nyan, te den bee fuu. Ma toku beele anga fisi fika ete. Ne di den bakaman piki den pisi beele anga fisi di fika, ne a fuu twalufu bakisi ete.
eng_text: They all ate, and were filled. They took up twelve baskets full of that which remained left over from the broken pieces.

djk_text: Da fu den sama di be nyan a beele, a be sa de wan sani fu feifi dunsu manengee, boiti den uman anga den pikinengee di be nyan.
eng_text: Those who ate were about five thousand men, besides women and children.

djk_text: Ne wanten bakadati, ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den bakaman fi en, fu go a boto abaa gwe na abaase. Ma en o fika de, fu sende den sama gwe a den osu.
eng_text: Immediately Jesus made the disciples get into the boat, and to go ahead of him to the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.

djk_text: Ne di a sende ala den sama gwe kaba, ne a subi go a wan mongo tapu, go e begi, en wawan kodo. A yuu ten de, da peesi be kon e dunguu kaba.
eng_text: After he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into the mountain by himself to pray. When evening had come, he was there alone.

djk_text: Ma, den bakaman fi en be de, te a mindii wataa kaba anga a boto. Di den go te wan pisi, ne wan gaan winta anga seke wataa e baasi a boto fu den.
eng_text: But the boat was now in the middle of the sea, distressed by the waves, for the wind was contrary.

djk_text: Namo di musude, ne Masaa Jesesi waka anga futu na a wataa tapu kon a den.
eng_text: In the fourth watch of the night, Jesus came to them, walking on the sea.

djk_text: Ma namo, di den si Masaa Jesesi e waka na a wataa tapu e kon, ne den dyombo te, den taki, na wan yooka e kon a den. Ne den feele te, den bali gaan bali.
eng_text: When the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, "It's a ghost!" and they cried out for fear.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi bali piki den wanten taki: “U á feele! Na mi de ya! U oli deki ati!”
eng_text: But immediately Jesus spoke to them, saying "Cheer up! It is I! Don't be afraid."

djk_text: Namo Peitilisi piki taki: “Masaa! Na yu de ape tuu? We, efu na yu de ape tuu, da kai mi, meke mi waka na a wataa tapu kon a yu, osi?”
eng_text: Peter answered him and said, "Lord, if it is you, command me to come to you on the waters."

djk_text: Namo ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Kon!” Ne Peitilisi komoto a ini a boto, ne ai waka na a tapu wataa go a Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: He said, "Come!" Peter stepped down from the boat, and walked on the waters to come to Jesus.

djk_text: Ma di a si fa a winta e wai taanga, ne a feele. Ne ai bigin saka seefi go a ondoo wataa. Ne a bali taki: “Masaa! Yeepi mi oo!”
eng_text: But when he saw that the wind was strong, he was afraid, and beginning to sink, he cried out, saying, "Lord, save me!"

djk_text: Ne wanten, ne Masaa Jesesi langa ana oli en. Ne a taigi en taki: “Saide meke i pantan so? Saide meke yu á tan poti biibi a mi doo?”
eng_text: Immediately Jesus stretched out his hand, took hold of him, and said to him, "You of little faith, why did you doubt?"

djk_text: Ne di den subi go a ini a sipi, ne wanten a gaan winta koo pii.
eng_text: When they got up into the boat, the wind ceased.

djk_text: Ne den sama di be de a ini a boto saka kini a doti ne en fesi de. Ne den taki: “Fu tuu! Yu na a Pikin fu Masaa Gadu tuu.”
eng_text: Those who were in the boat came and worshiped him, saying, "You are truly the Son of God!"

djk_text: Ne den go doo Genesaleti, a kondee di den e go.
eng_text: When they had crossed over, they came to the land of Gennesaret.

djk_text: We, ne den sama fu a kondee be sabi wanten taki, na Masaa Jesesi doo de. Ne den sende bosikopu lontu a hii kondee taki, Masaa Jesesi kon a den de. Ne den tyai ala sowtu siki man kon ne en.
eng_text: When the people of that place recognized him, they sent into all that surrounding region, and brought to him all who were sick,

djk_text: Ne den begi en taki: “Gaantangi! Meke den sikiman fu wi lobi ana a yu koosi namo, baa?” Ne Masaa Jesesi gi den fu den du dati. Namo, ala sikiman di lobi ana ne en koosi mofu, kon bun kele kele fu ibii sowtu siki di den be abi.
eng_text: and they begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his garment. As many as touched it were made whole.

djk_text: We ne, a seefi yuu de, ne wan duupu Faliseiman sama anga wan duupu leliman fu Dyuweiti komoto te a Jelusalem Foto, kon a Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: Then Pharisees and scribes came to Jesus from Jerusalem, saying,

djk_text: Ne den akisi en taki: “Saide den bakaman fi yu mu e du sani di wi avo á be gwenti? Bika den e nyan sondee wasi ana enke fa avo fu u be poti gi.”
eng_text: Why do your disciples disobey the tradition of the elders? For they don't wash their hands when they eat bread.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “U dati e feti fu wai a leli fu Masaa Gadu poti a wanse, soso fu oli den avo gwenti. Saide?
eng_text: He answered them, "Why do you also disobey the commandment of God because of your tradition?

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu weiti taki: ‘I mu lesipeki i mma anga i dda.’ Da ‘ibiiwan sama di saanti en dda ofu en mma mu dede.’
eng_text: For God commanded, 'Honor your father and your mother,' and, 'He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him be put to death.'

djk_text: Ma u dati taki, wan sama sa taigi en mma anga en dda taki: ‘A sani di a be mu teke fu yeepi den, da a moo betee a gi Masaa Gadu dati enke paiman.’
eng_text: But you say, 'Whoever may tell his father or his mother, "Whatever help you might otherwise have gotten from me is a gift devoted to God,"

djk_text: Da a sa fika en mma anga en dda a wanse, sondee fu solugu. Da anga ala den gwenti di den gaansama fika gi u, u e wai Masaa Gadu weiti poti a wanse.
eng_text: he shall not honor his father or mother.' You have made the commandment of God void because of your tradition.

djk_text: U bidiigiman! Na fu sama enke u ede meke Masaa Gadu be gi a apaiti takiman fi en, den e kai Jesaja, fu sikiifi wan sani a fositen.
eng_text: You hypocrites! Well did Isaiah prophesy of you, saying,

djk_text: Bika a be sikiifi taki: ‘Den sama ya e gafa mi anga den buba mofu, ma den ati de faawe fu mi!
eng_text: 'These people draw near to me with their mouth, and honor me with their lips; but their heart is far from me.

djk_text: Da fa den e meke enke den e begi mi de, ma, na soso sani den e du. Bika den nái leli sama Masaa Gadu weiti, ma na libisama sani den e leli sama.’ ”
eng_text: And in vain do they worship me, teaching as doctrine rules made by men.'"

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi kai ala den sama di be de ape kon ne en. Ne a taigi den taki: “U aliki! U mu fusutan mi bun.
eng_text: He summoned the multitude, and said to them, "Hear, and understand.

djk_text: Ná den sani di yu e nyan e meke i tyobo a Masaa Gadu ain. Ma na den sani di i e taki anga i mofu. Na den e meke i tyobo a Masaa Gadu ain.”
eng_text: That which enters into the mouth doesn't defile the man; but that which proceeds out of the mouth, this defiles the man."

djk_text: We, di Masaa Jesesi taki so, ne den bakaman fi en kon taigi en taki: “Masaa! Fa i si i taki de, ná sipowtu boon den Faliseiman ati boon a yu moo.”
eng_text: Then the disciples came, and said to him, "Do you know that the Pharisees were offended, when they heard this saying?"

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “U fika den! Bika den á de fu Masaa Gadu. Da ibiiwan sani di á de san mi Tata paandi, da na fu hali puu.
eng_text: But he answered, "Every plant which my heavenly Father didn't plant will be uprooted.

djk_text: U fika den! Bika den sowtu sama de beendi. Da efu wan beendiman e suku fu tyai beendiman abaa gotoo, da na ala den fiya o kai a ini a gotoo?”
eng_text: Leave them alone. They are blind guides of the blind. If the blind guide the blind, both will fall into a pit."

djk_text: Namo Peitilisi akisi en taki: “Masaa! San na a mama fu a toli di i taki dyonson fu den Faliseiman sama de? I sa puu en fini fini gi wi?”
eng_text: Peter answered him, "Explain the parable to us."

djk_text: Ne a piki den taki: “Oho! Useefi nái fusutan mi kiinkiin ete, no?
eng_text: So Jesus said, "Do you also still not understand?

djk_text: Useefi á sabi ete taki, a sani di wan sama e nyan, e go ne en bee. Da te wan pisi, da a kon komoto baka, no? We, kweti! Dati á poi meke i tyobo a Masaa Gadu ain.
eng_text: Don't you understand that whatever goes into the mouth passes into the belly, and then out of the body?

djk_text: Ma na den sani di yu e puu a ini i mofu. Bika, na te a ini ati den sani ape de. Da, den e kon komoto a doo, da den e meke i tyobo a Masaa Gadu ain.
eng_text: But the things which proceed out of the mouth come out of the heart, and they defile the man.

djk_text: Bika a ini wan sama ati ini ala ogii e komoto. Sani enke kii sama. Waka anga taa uman ofu man. Soseefi motyo libi anga lei. Fufuu seefi tu. Taki ogii fu Masaa Gadu anga poli taawan nen seefi.
eng_text: For out of the heart come forth evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, sexual sins, thefts, false testimony, and blasphemies.

djk_text: Da na den sowtu sani ya e kon komoto a doo, fu meke a sama tyobo a Masaa Gadu ain. Ma fu nyan sondee wasi ana enke fa weiti taki, dati á poi meke wan sama tyobo a Masaa Gadu ain.”
eng_text: These are the things which defile the man; but to eat with unwashed hands doesn't defile the man."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en komoto na a kondee de, ne den go na a pisiwataa fu Tilosi anga Sidon.
eng_text: Jesus went out from there, and withdrew into the region of Tyre and Sidon.

djk_text: We, ne fa i si den go doo de, ne wan uman lon kon a Masaa Jesesi. A uman ya na be fu a kondee den kai Kaana. A ná be Dyusama. Namo ai bali taki: “Masaa! Na yu na a Bakaten Manpikin fu Kownu Dafeti paansu. Gaantangi abi tyali ati fu mi, baa? Bika wan takuu jeje de na a umanpikin fu mi tapu, e pina en, e tyotyo en.”
eng_text: Behold, a Canaanite woman came out from those borders, and cried, saying, "Have mercy on me, Lord, you son of David! My daughter is severely demonized!"

djk_text: Ma anga ala fa a uman e begi de, toku Masaa Jesesi á piki en seefi seefi. Namo den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi taigi en taki: “Masaa! Gaantangi, bali a uman de, meke a kaba a u baka. Senten, ne ai waka a u baka e muliki wi.”
eng_text: But he answered her not a word. His disciples came and begged him, saying, "Send her away; for she cries after us."

djk_text: We, ne na nowfosi Masaa Jesesi o piki a uman taki: “Uman! Masaa Gadu á sende mi, fu mi go a taa foluku, moo enke den lasi sikapu fu Islayeli Kondee.”
eng_text: But he answered, "I wasn't sent to anyone but the lost sheep of the house of Israel."

djk_text: Ma toku, a uman kon kai ne en fesi, sutu kini a doti, e begi taki: “Masaa! Gaantangi, ma yeepi mi.”
eng_text: But she came and worshiped him, saying, "Lord, help me."

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi piki a uman taki: “A á fiti fu mi puu beele a den pikin ana towe gi den dagu.”
eng_text: But he answered, "It is not appropriate to take the children's bread and throw it to the dogs."

djk_text: Namo a uman piki taki: “Masaa! Na so a de tuu! Ma wan pikin dagu seefi á sa abi pasi, fu kon piki den sakasaka di e kai komoto na a tafaa kon a doti, no?”
eng_text: But she said, "Yes, Lord, but even the dogs eat the crumbs which fall from their masters' table."

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Uman! Yu e biibi mi taanga! Da a sani di i si yu e suku de, i fende en kaba.” Masaa Jesesi á kaba taki seefi, namo a umanpikin fu a uman kon bun kelle.
eng_text: Then Jesus answered her, "Woman, great is your faith! Be it done to you even as you desire." And her daughter was healed from that hour.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi komoto de. Ne a go koosube fu a ze fu Galileya. Ne a go a wan mongo tapu go sidon.
eng_text: Jesus departed there, and came near to the sea of Galilee; and he went up into the mountain, and sat there.

djk_text: Ne tyaipi sama kon ape ne en. Den tyai lanman, beendiman, masimasi wan, babawman kon ne en. Ne den poti den ne en futu. Namo a deesi ala den fiya.
eng_text: Great multitudes came to him, having with them the lame, blind, mute, maimed, and many others, and they put them down at his feet. He healed them,

djk_text: Ma, da den sama foondoo seefi, di den si fa den babawman e taki. Den lanman e waka. Den masimasi wan kon bun. Den beendiman e si. Da den sama foondoo tuutuu. Ne den gafa Masaa Gadu, a Gadu fu Islayeli Kondee.
eng_text: so that the multitude wondered when they saw the mute speaking, injured whole, lame walking, and blind seeing--and they glorified the God of Israel.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi kai den bakaman fi en, ne a taigi den taki: “Tyali e kisi mi fu den tyaipi sama ya! Bika tide, na di fu dii dei di den de anga mi ya, sondee nyan. Da mi á wani sende den gwe a osu anga angii bee so. Bika falan falan sa kisi den a pasi.”
eng_text: Jesus summoned his disciples and said, "I have compassion on the multitude, because they continue with me now three days and have nothing to eat. I don't want to send them away fasting, or they might faint on the way."

djk_text: Namo den bakaman piki taki: “Masaa! Pe wi o poi fende sani gi den somen sama ya, fu den nyan? Bika luku ya! Nyanyan á de na a sabana ini pe u de ya, fu gi den.”
eng_text: The disciples said to him, "Where should we get so many loaves in a deserted place as to satisfy so great a multitude?"

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi akisi den taki: “Onmen beele u abi de?” Namo den piki en taki: “Na seibin beele anga wantu losi fisi namo u abi ya.”
eng_text: Jesus said to them, "How many loaves do you have?" They said, "Seven, and a few small fish."

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi sende ala den sama go sidon a doti.
eng_text: He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground;

djk_text: Ne a teke den seibin beele anga den fisi. Ne a gi Masaa Gadu daa, te a kaba. Ne a booko den beele anga den fisi pisipisi, gi den bakaman, fu go paati gi den somen sama.
eng_text: and he took the seven loaves and the fish. He gave thanks and broke them, and gave to the disciples, and the disciples to the multitudes.

djk_text: Ne den bakaman fi en teke, ne den paati gi den somen sama te doo. Ne ala den sama nyan te den bee fuu. Ne den bakaman fi en piki den pisipisi beele di fika, te seibin gaan bakisi fuu kwaa.
eng_text: They all ate, and were filled. They took up seven baskets full of the broken pieces that were left over.

djk_text: Da ala den sama di be nyan, da a be sa de wan sani fu fo dunsu manengee, boiti den uman anga den pikinengee di be nyan.
eng_text: Those who ate were four thousand men, besides women and children.

djk_text: We, ne di Masaa Jesesi sende ala den sama gwe, ne a go a ini wan boto, ne a abaa go na a pisiwataa fu Magadan.
eng_text: Then he sent away the multitudes, got into the boat, and came into the borders of Magdala.

djk_text: We, ne wan dei, ne den Faliseiman anga den Saduseiman kon ne en. Den kon fu tesi en luku, efu na Masaa Gadu sende en kon tuutuu. Ne den akisi en fu a meke foondoo sani pasa a tapu anda, osi? Da den sa si taki, Masaa Gadu de anga en tuutuu.
eng_text: The Pharisees and Sadducees came, and testing him, asked him to show them a sign from heaven.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Ai baya! Bakadina mofu te tapu lebi, da u sabi taki, tamaa san o hati.
eng_text: But he answered them, "When it is evening, you say, 'It will be fair weather, for the sky is red.'

djk_text: Te mamanten u si a san lebi, da u sabi taki alen o kai tide. We, fa a waka u sabi luku den maiki di tapu e soi, ma u á sabi luku den maiki fu a yuu ten di u e libi nownow?
eng_text: In the morning, 'It will be foul weather today, for the sky is red and threatening.' Hypocrites! You know how to discern the appearance of the sky, but you can't discern the signs of the times!

djk_text: U takuu ati sama u! U tan enke uman di fika den man go e waka anga taa man! Na dati meke u e suku fu si foondoo maiki a tapu fosi. Ma kweti! Mi ná o soi u ná wan taa maiki moo enke a maiki fu a apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu di den e kai Jowna.” Di Masaa Jesesi kaba taki so, ne a komoto a den mindii gwe.
eng_text: An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, and there will be no sign given to it, except the sign of the prophet Jonah." He left them, and departed.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en go a boto. Ne den koti go na abaase. Ma den bakaman be feegete fu tyai beele.
eng_text: The disciples came to the other side and had forgotten to take bread.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi wasikoi den taki: “U luku bun anga a sowda fu den Faliseiman sama anga den Saduseiman.”
eng_text: Jesus said to them, "Take heed and beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees."

djk_text: Namo di Masaa Jesesi taki so, ne den bakaman fi en pakisei go, den pakisei kon. Ne den e taki den na den taki: “Kande, na di u feegete fu tyai a beele meke a taki so?”
eng_text: They reasoned among themselves, saying, "We brought no bread."

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi sabi taki na so den e denki. Ne a piki den taki: “Saide meke a biibi di u abi a mi nyoni so? Fa u sa denki taki, na beele toli mi e taki?
eng_text: Jesus, perceiving it, said, "Why do you reason among yourselves, you of little faith, 'because you have brought no bread?'

djk_text: U nái fusutan mi ete, no? U feegete di mi be teke feifi beele gi feifi dunsu sama nyan, te den bee be fuu? Te onmen tenti bakisi be fika a tapu ete!
eng_text: Don't you yet perceive, neither remember the five loaves for the five thousand, and how many baskets you took up?

djk_text: Soseefi, u be de ape si, fa mi be booko seibin beele paati gi fo dunsu sama. Ma toku, a be sai den, te onmen tenti bakisi be fika a tapu tu.
eng_text: Nor the seven loaves for the four thousand, and how many baskets you took up?

djk_text: We, da fa a kan taki, u á poi fusutan taki a ná beele mi e taki? U luku bun anga sowda fu den Faliseiman anga den Saduseisama!”
eng_text: How is it that you don't perceive that I didn't speak to you concerning bread? But beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees."

djk_text: We, di Masaa Jesesi taki so fosi, ne den bakaman fi en fusutan kiinkiin taki, a ná a sowda fu baka beele ai taki. Ma na a poli leli fu den Faliseiman anga den Saduseiman.
eng_text: Then they understood that he didn't tell them to beware of the yeast of bread, but of the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

djk_text: Namo di den de na a pisiwataa fu Sesaleya Filipi, ne Masaa Jesesi akisi den bakaman fi en taki: “Fa den sama e kai a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya?”
eng_text: Now when Jesus came into the parts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, "Who do men say that I, the Son of Man, am?"

djk_text: Ne den bakaman piki en taki: “We, u yee son sama e taki, yu na Johanisi a Dopuman. Ne en weki baka komoto a dede. Taawan e taki, yu na Eliya, a apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu a fositen. Taawan e taki, yu na Jelemija ofu wan fu den taa apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu. Ne en weki a dede kon a libi ya baka.”
eng_text: They said, "Some say John the Baptizer, some, Elijah, and others, Jeremiah, or one of the prophets."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi akisi den taki: “Ma u, no? Sama u e taki a mi?”
eng_text: He said to them, "But who do you say that I am?"

djk_text: We, ne Simon Peitilisi piki en taki: “Yu na a Kelestesi, a Manpikin fu a libilibi Masaa Gadu!”
eng_text: Simon Peter answered, "You are the Christ, the Son of the living God."

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi piki en baka taki: “Seigi fi yu Simon, manpikin fu Jowna! Bika a ná libisama meke i sabi a sani de. Ma na mi Tata a tapu anda, ne puu en kon a kiin gi yu.
eng_text: Jesus answered him, "Blessed are you, Simon Bar Jonah, for flesh and blood has not revealed this to you, but my Father who is in heaven.

djk_text: We, fu tuutuu! Mi e taigi yu taki, yu na Peitilisi . We, na a gaanbigi taanga siton tapu ya mi o meke a keliki fu mi. Da a didibii anga ala a taanga di a abi anga hii dedekondee seefi ná o poi wini a keliki fu mi.
eng_text: I also tell you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build my assembly, and the gates of Hades will not prevail against it.

djk_text: Da mi e gi yu a sooto, fu a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu. Da san i tei a goontapu ya, da a o de teitei a Masaa Gadu, a tapu anda tu. Soseefi san i losi a goontapu ya, da a o de losilosi a Masaa Gadu, a tapu anda.”
eng_text: I will give to you the keys of the Kingdom of Heaven, and whatever you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven; and whatever you release on earth will have been released in heaven."

djk_text: We, ne di a taki so, ne a bali den bakaman fi en taki, den á mu taigi sama taki, en na a Kelestesi.
eng_text: Then he commanded the disciples that they should tell no one that he was Jesus the Christ.

djk_text: Ne fanafu a ten de, ne Masaa Jesesi e soi den bakaman fi en san o kon miti en. Ai taigi den, fa a mu go a Jelusalem Foto, da den gaansama fu Dyu keliki anga den apaiti begiman anga den leliman fu weiti o kisi en tyai en go kii a koloisi. Ma baka dii dei, da a o weki baka komoto a dede.
eng_text: From that time, Jesus began to show his disciples that he must go to Jerusalem and suffer many things from the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up.

djk_text: Ma di Masaa Jesesi taki so, ne Peitilisi tyai en go a wan, bali taki: “Masaa! Ná taki den sani de. Bika den ná o poi pasa anga yu, kweti kweti!”
eng_text: Peter took him aside, and began to rebuke him, saying, "Far be it from you, Lord! This will never be done to you."

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi daai luku Peitilisi. Ne a kaasi en taki: “Pasa komoto a mi baka ya! Yu didibii, saatan yu! Yu de enke wan siton a mi pasi, fu mi naki futu kai na a pasi fu Masaa Gadu. Peitilisi! A sani di i taki de, á de enke fa Masaa Gadu e pakisei. I taki enke fa libisama e pakisei.”
eng_text: But he turned, and said to Peter, "Get behind me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to me, for you are not setting your mind on the things of God, but on the things of men."

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi daai taki anga ala den bakaman fi en. A taki: “Efu wan sama wani waka a mi baka, da a á mu teli enseefi moo. Da a mu e tyai a sitaafu di o kon ne en tapu, enke wan sama e tyai wan koloisi, fu den go sipikii en kii.
eng_text: Then Jesus said to his disciples, "If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

djk_text: Bika na sama di kaba libi a libi enke fa enseefi wani fu mi ede, sa fende a libi di Masaa Gadu wani gi. Ma sama di o libi go doo enke fa enseefi wani, da a o lasi a hii libi fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, and whoever will lose his life for my sake will find it.

djk_text: Ma sowtu wini a abi efu wan sama abi ala gudu fu goontapu, ma a lasi go kai a didibii faya? Bika sani seefi á de a goontapu ya, di waiti sai fu kengi anga a libi fu tego?
eng_text: For what will it profit a man, if he gains the whole world, and forfeits his life? Or what will a man give in exchange for his life?

djk_text: Bika, te a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya o kon makandii anga den Masaa Gadu Kondee Basiya fi en, da hii dyendee anga makiti di en Tata, Masaa Gadu a tapu abi o de fi en. Da a o kuutu fa, ibii sama du san a taki. Da ibiiwan o fende paiman, fu fa a be libi a goontapu.
eng_text: For the Son of Man will come in the glory of his Father with his angels, and then he will render to everyone according to his deeds.

djk_text: Da mi e taigi u tuutuu taki: Somen fu u di taampu ya ná o tesi dede, fosi u si a Nyun Tii fu a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya.”
eng_text: Most certainly I tell you, there are some standing here who will in no way taste of death, until they see the Son of Man coming in his Kingdom."

djk_text: Namo sigisi dei a baka, ne Masaa Jesesi teke Peitilisi anga Jakowbesi anga Johanisi tyai anga en go, te a wan hei mongo.
eng_text: After six days, Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John his brother, and brought them up into a high mountain by themselves.

djk_text: Ma wanboo wanboo so, te fu den denki, ne Jesesi kengi tan wan hii taa fasi. En fesi e beenki enke a san. Da den koosi di a wei weti kiin enke wan gaan kiin faya.
eng_text: He was transfigured before them. His face shone like the sun, and his garments became as white as the light.

djk_text: Ne fosi den poti pakisei baka, ne tu man kon taampu ne en se, e taki anga en. Den tu man ya na Mosesi anga Eliya.
eng_text: Behold, Moses and Elijah appeared to them talking with him.

djk_text: Namo Peitilisi taigi Masaa taki: “Masaa! Efi i wani, mi sa meke dii masanga ya. Wan fi yu, wan fu Mosesi anga wan fu Eliya. Bika a switi fu toko, fa u de makandii ya!”
eng_text: Peter answered, and said to Jesus, "Lord, it is good for us to be here. If you want, let's make three tents here: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah."

djk_text: Peitilisi á kaba taki seefi! Ne wan weti kiin woluku saka kon a den tapu. Ne den yee wan Tongo a ini a woluku taki: “U luku a lobi Manpikin fu mi de. Mi e piisii anga en. Da ne en u mu poti yesi aliki, fu du san ai taki.”
eng_text: While he was still speaking, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them. Behold, a voice came out of the cloud, saying, "This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Listen to him."

djk_text: We, ne di den dii bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi yee a Tongo ya, ne den feele te, den kai tapu fesi a doti.
eng_text: When the disciples heard it, they fell on their faces, and were very afraid.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi waka go, ne a oli den taki: “U opo! U á feele so!”
eng_text: Jesus came and touched them and said, "Get up, and don't be afraid."

djk_text: Ne di den luku, ne den á si ná wan sama moo enke Masaa Jesesi wawan.
eng_text: Lifting up their eyes, they saw no one, except Jesus alone.

djk_text: We, ne di den e saka a mongo baka, ne Masaa Jesesi bali den taki: “I si a sani di u si na a mongo tapu de, u á mu taigi ná wan sama, ye! Na te a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya dede weki baka fosi, da u sa taki en.”
eng_text: As they were coming down from the mountain, Jesus commanded them, saying, "Don't tell anyone what you saw, until the Son of Man has risen from the dead."

djk_text: Namo den dii bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi akisi en taki: “Masaa! Ma fa a waka den leliman fu weiti e leli sama taki, Eliya fosi mu kon a goontapu, fosi, da a Kelestesi sa kon?”
eng_text: His disciples asked him, saying, "Then why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?"

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “We, Eliya mu waka a fesi fu a Kelestesi kon tuu, fu seeka pasi gi en a fesi.
eng_text: Jesus answered them, "Elijah indeed comes first, and will restore all things,

djk_text: Ma fu tuu, mi e taigi u taki, Eliya kon kaba. Ma den á be wani sabi en. Ne den du ogii anga en, enke fa den wani. Na soseefi den o du anga a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya tu.”
eng_text: but I tell you that Elijah has come already, and they didn't recognize him, but did to him whatever they wanted to. Even so the Son of Man will also suffer by them."

djk_text: We, na di Masaa Jesesi taki so, fosi den bakaman fi en kon kisi kiin taki, na Johanisi a Dopuman a be e taki na a Eliya di be mu kon kaba.
eng_text: Then the disciples understood that he spoke to them of John the Baptizer.

djk_text: Namo di den doo na ala den taa sama, ne wan sama kon a Masaa Jesesi. Ne a kai ne en futu a doti.
eng_text: When they came to the multitude, a man came to him, kneeling down to him, saying,

djk_text: Ne ai begi en taki: “Masaa! Gaantangi, abi tyali ati fu wan manpikin fu mi, baa? Pikinengee siki kisi en ogii ogii. Na somen leisi kaba, a siki ya e naki en towe a ini faya. Soseefi ai naki en iti a wataa.
eng_text:
Lord, have mercy on my son, for he is epileptic, and suffers grievously; for he often falls into the fire, and often into the water.
566	Mi be tyai en kon a den bakaman fi yu, fu den deesi, ma den á poi deesi en.”	566	So I brought him to your disciples, and they could not cure him.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Oho! San mi miti anga den sowtu sama ya? Den nái biibi sai! Taanga yesi namo di den abi so. On langa mi mu de anga u ya, fu oli pasensi ete, fosi u o biibi?” Ne a taigi a man taki: “Tyai a pikin kon gi mi!”
eng_text: Jesus answered, "Faithless and perverse generation! How long will I be with you? How long will I bear with you? Bring him here to me."

djk_text: We, ne den tyai a pikin kon gi en. Ne a yaki a jeje, di be de na a pikin tapu de puu. Ne wanten, ne a pikin kon bun baka.
eng_text: Jesus rebuked him, the demon went out of him, and the boy was cured from that hour.

djk_text: Ne moo lati, ne den bakaman fi en kon ne en bakabaka. Ne den akisi en taki: “Fa a waka, wi dati á be poi puu a takuu jeje na a pikin tapu?”
eng_text: Then the disciples came to Jesus privately, and said, "Why weren't we able to cast it out?"

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Na fu di u ná abi biibi sai! Bika mi e taigi u taki, efu u abi wan pikintoin biibi namo, enke a sii den e kai mosite, da u sa taigi wan gaan mongo taki komoto de. Da a sa wai komoto de tuu. Da ná wan sani o de, di u ná o poi du.
eng_text: He said to them, "Because of your unbelief. For most certainly I tell you, if you have faith as a grain of mustard seed, you will tell this mountain, 'Move from here to there,' and it will move; and nothing will be impossible for you.

djk_text: Ma yu á poi puu den sowtu takuu jeje wan taa fasi, moo enke fu tan sondee nyan e begi Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: But this kind doesn't go out except by prayer and fasting."

djk_text: We, wan taa leisi, ne Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en kon makandii a Galileya de. Ne a taigi den taki: “Wan ten e kon di den o kisi a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya poti a den ogii sama ana.
eng_text: While they were staying in Galilee, Jesus said to them, "The Son of Man is about to be delivered up into the hands of men,

djk_text: Da den o kii en. Ma baka dii dei, da a o opo baka komoto a dede. We, di den bakaman fi en yee so, ne gaan tyali kisi den.”
eng_text: and they will kill him, and the third day he will be raised up." They were exceedingly sorry.

djk_text: Namo den Masaa Jesesi kon doo Kafalnayemu Foto. Ne wan duupu sama di e piki lantimoni a Dyu Kondee, go a Peitilisi. Ne den akisi en taki: “A mesiti fi yu nái pai lantimoni, no?”
eng_text: When they had come to Capernaum, those who collected the didrachma coins came to Peter, and said, "Doesn't your teacher pay the didrachma?"

djk_text: Namo Peitilisi piki den taki: “Hoo! Ai pai, ai!” Namo fa i si Peitilisi doo osu, fosi a opo mofu, ne Masaa Jesesi akisi en taki: “Simon! Fa den kownu fu goontapu ya e piki lantimoni de, on sama den e piki en? Na pikin fu doti a Dyu Kondee ya ofu na den doose kondee sama, di kon tan a Dyu Kondee?”
eng_text: He said, "Yes." When he came into the house, Jesus anticipated him, saying, "What do you think, Simon? From whom do the kings of the earth receive toll or tribute? From their children, or from strangers?"

djk_text: Ne Peitilisi piki en taki: “We! Na den doose kondee sama di kon tan a Dyu Kondee ya.” We, ne Masaa Jesesi taigi en taki: “So! Da wi enke pikin fu doti de fii fu dati. A á de fu wi pai!
eng_text: Peter said to him, "From strangers." Jesus said to him, "Therefore the children are exempt.

djk_text: Ma toku, wi á wani meke den kosi wi fu dati ede. I sabi san? Teke yu uku go uku na a ze. Da a fosi fisi di yu o kisi, da opo en mofu luku. Da yu o si wan moni a ini en mofu. Da teke en tyai go pai a lantimoni fu mi anga yu.”
eng_text: But, lest we cause them to stumble, go to the sea, cast a hook, and take up the first fish that comes up. When you have opened its mouth, you will find a stater coin. Take that, and give it to them for me and you."

djk_text: We, na a seefi yuu ya, ne den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi kon ne en. Ne den akisi en taki: “Masaa! Fu den di de a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu, da on di o de a moo heiwan a ini?”
eng_text: In that hour the disciples came to Jesus, saying, "Who then is greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven?"

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi kai wan pikin kon ne en. Ne a meke a taampu a den mindii de.
eng_text: Jesus called a little child to himself, and set him in their midst,

djk_text: Ne a taki: “I si a pikin ya? Fu tuu! Efu yu á daai kon abi a fasi di wan pikin abi, da yu á poi doo a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: and said, "Most certainly I tell you, unless you turn, and become as little children, you will in no way enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.

djk_text: Ma efi i abi saka fasi enke a pikin ya, da yu o abi wan gaan hei peesi a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Whoever therefore humbles himself as this little child, the same is the greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven.

djk_text: “Sama di du wan bun gi wan pikin enke di i si taampu ya, fu di a de sama fu mi, da na miseefi a du a bun de kaba.
eng_text: Whoever receives one such little child in my name receives me,

djk_text: Ma sama di sa du ogii anga sowan saka fasi sama mu luku bun! Sani ná o waka bun gi en. A sitaafu di Masaa Gadu o gi en sa bigi. A be sa moo betee, den be tei wan gaanbigi siton ne en neki, da den tyai en go towe na a moo dipi peesi fu a ze, meke a dede.
eng_text: but whoever causes one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be better for him that a huge millstone should be hung around his neck, and that he should be sunk in the depths of the sea.

djk_text: “Ma heelu fu a goontapu ya, fu den sani di e tesi sama a Masaa Gadu pasi! Na tuu taki, na so goontapu de. Ma heelu fu den sama di e du sani, fu tyai taawan go a ini tesi!
eng_text:
Woe to the world because of occasions of stumbling! For it must be that the occasions come, but woe to that person through whom the occasion comes!
585	Da efu yu wani du ogii anga yu ana ofu yu futu, fu komoto a Masaa Gadu pasi fu Masaa Gadu, da a moo bun i koti a ana ofu a futu towe puu a i sikin. Bika a moo bun fu lasi wan pisi fi i sikin, ma i fende a libi fu tego. eng_text: Even so it is not the will of your Father who is in heaven that one of these little ones should perish.

eng_text:
If your brother sins against you, go, show him his fault between you and him alone. If he listens to you, you have gained back your brother.

djk_text: Namo Peitilisi waka kon a Masaa Jesesi, ne a akisi en taki: “Masaa! Onmen leisi mi mu gi wan taawan, di du wan sani anga mi, paadon? Efu mi gi en paadon seibin leisi, a á sai, no?”
eng_text: Then Peter came and said to him, "Lord, how often shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? Until seven times?"

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Seibin toon namo á sai, Peitilisi! Ma seibintenti toon fu seibin, i mu gi taawan paadon.”
eng_text: Jesus said to him, "I don't tell you until seven times, but, until seventy times seven.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi gi den wan ageisi toli, da a taki: “A Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu de leti enke wan kownu di abi somen wookoman, di mu pai en.
eng_text: Therefore the Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king, who wanted to reconcile accounts with his servants.

djk_text: Da wan dei, ne a kownu wegi ala den paiman di den mu pai en go, a wegi den kon. Namo a kai wan fu den ondooman fi en, di abi fu pai en onmen tenti miliyun.
eng_text: When he had begun to reconcile, one was brought to him who owed him ten thousand talents.

djk_text: Ma namo, da a man ya á be poi pai a kownu. Ne a kownu taki: ‘U seli en, anga en uman anga en pikin anga ala san a abi, da u tyai a moni kon gi mi. Da mi sa fende mi moni baka.’
eng_text: But because he couldn't pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, with his wife, his children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.

djk_text: “We, ne a wookoman kai anga kini na a kownu fesi, ne a begi en taki: ‘Kee! Masaa, i abi leti! Gaantangi! Oli pasensi gi mi? Mi sa pai yu!’
eng_text: The servant therefore fell down and kneeled before him, saying, 'Lord, have patience with me, and I will repay you all!'

djk_text: Namo di a wookoman begi so, ne tyali kisi a masaa taki, meke a gwe fi en. A á de fu a pai en a paiman moo.
eng_text: The lord of that servant, being moved with compassion, released him, and forgave him the debt.

djk_text: “Da na gwe tapu a man ya de ete! Namo a miti wan taa ondooman fu a seefi kownu a pasi. A man de be mu pai wan sani fu feifi dunsu kolu so. Namo, a dyombo kisi en hub oli taki: ‘Pai mi! Pai mi wanten! Wanten wanten, nownow ya!’
eng_text:
But that servant went out, and found one of his fellow servants, who owed him one hundred denarii, and he grabbed him, and took him by the throat, saying, 'Pay me what you owe!'
606	We, ne a taa ondooman kai anga kini a doti begi en taki: ‘Gaantangi! Oli pasensi gi mi baa, te mi fende a moni, mi sa pai yu baka.’	606	So his fellow servant fell down at his feet and begged him, saying, 'Have patience with me, and I will repay you!'

djk_text: Ma a á wani. Ma so a meke den kisi a man ya poti a dunguu osu taki, meke a tan ape, fu te enke a kaba pai en a hiihii paiman!
eng_text: He would not, but went and cast him into prison, until he should pay back that which was due.

djk_text: “Ma di den taa wookoman fu a masaa si ala san pasa, ne a buduufu den te, ne den lon go taigi den masaa ala san pasa.
eng_text: So when his fellow servants saw what was done, they were exceedingly sorry, and came and told to their lord all that was done.

djk_text: We, ne a masaa kai a wookoman kon ne en baka. Ne a taigi en taki: ‘Yu takuu ati sani yu! A hiihii gaan moni di i be abi fu pai mi, ne mi fika yu, fu di i be begi mi.
eng_text: Then his lord called him in, and said to him, 'You wicked servant! I forgave you all that debt, because you begged me.

djk_text: Da saide meke yu á teke tyali ati luku a taa wookoman fu mi, enke fa mi be teke tyali ati wooko anga yu?’
eng_text: Shouldn't you also have had mercy on your fellow servant, even as I had mercy on you?'

djk_text: We, a masaa ati boon tee, ne a kai sikowtu kon kisi en tyai go a ini sitaafu osu. Meke a tyai pina anga sitaafu, fu te enke a pai en a lasiti kopoo sensi.”
eng_text: His lord was angry, and delivered him to the tormentors, until he should pay all that was due to him.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “We, na soseefi mi Tata sa du anga ibiiwan fu u, efu u nái gi taawan paadon anga u hii ati.”
eng_text: So my heavenly Father will also do to you, if you don't each forgive your brother from your hearts for his misdeeds."

djk_text: We, baka di Masaa Jesesi taki den wowtu ya, ne a komoto a Galileya, koti abaa a Joodani Liba, gwe na a pisiwataa fu Judeja.
eng_text: It happened when Jesus had finished these words, he departed from Galilee, and came into the borders of Judea beyond the Jordan.

djk_text: Ma namo, di a doo, ne tyaipi sama booko kon ne en, kon e waka ne en baka. Ne a deesi den sikiman ape.
eng_text: Great multitudes followed him, and he healed them there.

djk_text: Ma den Faliseiman seefi kon ne en de tu, fu tesi en meke a sa taki sani di á fiti. Namo den akisi en taki: “Fa a weiti fu Gadu de? Wan man sa paati anga en uman, fu iniiwan pikin sani di en anga en abi?”
eng_text: Pharisees came to him, testing him, and saying, "Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any reason?"

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “U á leisi san sikiifi a Masaa Gadu Buku fu dati, no? Bika a sikiifi taki, na a bigin, da Masaa Gadu be meke wan man anga wan uman namo.
eng_text: He answered, "Haven't you read that he who made them from the beginning made them male and female,

djk_text: Di Masaa Gadu du dati, ne a taki: ‘Na fu dati ede meke, wan man e fika en gaansama osu, fu go teke en uman libi. Da den tu sama de mokisa libi toon wan sikin.’
eng_text: and said, 'For this cause a man shall leave his father and mother, and shall join to his wife; and the two shall become one flesh?'

djk_text: Da den nái teli fu tu sama moo, ma den de wan sikin namo. Da san Masaa Gadu poti kon toon wan, da ná wan libisama di mu paati den.”
eng_text: So that they are no more two, but one flesh. What therefore God has joined together, don't let man tear apart."

djk_text: Ne den Faliseiman piki en taki: “We, efu a de so tuu, da saide meke Mosesi be sikiifi taki, manengee sa go naki pampila a lanti taki, en anga en uman paati? Da a sa gi a uman a pampila de, da a sende en gwe?”
eng_text: They asked him, "Why then did Moses command us to give her a bill of divorce, and divorce her?"

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Weeno! Na fu a taanga yesi fu u ede, meke Mosesi be du dati, fu gi u pasi fu u paati anga u uman! Ma na a bigin, da a sani á be de so.
eng_text: He said to them, "Moses, because of the hardness of your hearts, allowed you to divorce your wives, but from the beginning it has not been so.

djk_text: Ma mi e taigi u taki, a sama di o paati anga en uman, boiti efu a du ogii ne en osu, ne a teke wan taa uman, da a kai a ini a motyo libi.”
eng_text: I tell you that whoever divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, and marries another, commits adultery; and he who marries her when she is divorced commits adultery."

djk_text: Namo den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi piki Masaa Jesesi taki: “Ai! Uman anga man toli taanga! Bika efu na so a weiti fu Masaa Gadu de, da a á de fu man teke uman libi. Soseefi a á de fu uman teke man fu libi tu.”
eng_text: His disciples said to him, "If this is the case of the man with his wife, it is not expedient to marry."

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Meke mi taigi u! Ná ala sama sa de so. Ma na den sama di Masaa Gadu kai, fu tan so, da na den namo sa tan so.
eng_text: But he said to them, "Not all men can receive this saying, but those to whom it is given.

djk_text: Bika son sama á poi libi anga uman, fu di mama meke en so kaba. Son sama á poi libi anga uman, fu di taa sama poti en so. Son sama, da na den seefi fende en bun, fu tan so, fu de a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu. Da sama di sa fusutan san mi leli ya, da meke a fusutan en.”
eng_text: For there are eunuchs who were born that way from their mother's womb, and there are eunuchs who were made eunuchs by men; and there are eunuchs who made themselves eunuchs for the Kingdom of Heaven's sake. He who is able to receive it, let him receive it."

djk_text: Namo a seefi yuu de, ne den sama tyai wanlo pikinengee kon a Masaa Jesesi, fu a poti ana a den tapu begi gi den. Ma den bakaman kaasi den fu ogii!
eng_text: Then little children were brought to him, that he should lay his hands on them and pray; and the disciples rebuked them.

djk_text: Namo, Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “U fika den pikin, meke denseefi kon doo a mi tu. U á tapu den! Bika na sama di abi a fasi di pikinengee abi sa poi go doo a ini a Nyun Tii a Masaa Gadu Kondee.”
eng_text: But Jesus said, "Allow the little children, and don't forbid them to come to me; for the Kingdom of Heaven belongs to ones like these."

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi poti ana a den pikin tapu, begi gi den. Ne a gwe.
eng_text: He laid his hands on them, and departed from there.

djk_text: We, ne wan yonkuman kon doo a Masaa Jesesi. Ne a akisi en taki: “Mesiti! Sowtu bun de, fu mi du te, da mi sa fende a libi fu tego?”
eng_text: Behold, one came to him and said, "Good teacher, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?"

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi akisi en taki: “Saide meke yu e akisi, sowtu bun de? Yu á sabi taki, na Masaa Gadu wawan namo bun, no? We, efi i wani fende a libi fu tego, da i mu oli iseefi a den weiti fi en.”
eng_text: He said to him, "Why do you call me good? No one is good but one, that is, God. But if you want to enter into life, keep the commandments."

djk_text: Ne a yonkuman akisi en taki: “On di fu den weiti mi mu oli?” Namo Masaa Jesesi piki en baka taki: “Yu á mu kii sama. Yu á mu waka anga taa uman ofu man! Yu á mu fufuu. Soseefi, yu á mu lei.
eng_text: He said to him, "Which ones?" Jesus said, "'You shall not murder.' 'You shall not commit adultery.' 'You shall not steal.' 'You shall not offer false testimony.'

djk_text: I mu lesipeki i mma anga i dda. Yu mu lobi ala sama enke fa yu lobi iseefi.”
eng_text: 'Honor your father and mother.' And, 'You shall love your neighbor as yourself.'"

djk_text: We, ne a man piki taki: “Ala den weiti de, na sani di mi e oli. Da san fika moo fu mi du, boiti dati?”
eng_text: The young man said to him, "All these things I have observed from my youth. What do I still lack?"

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Efi i wani de wan bunbun sama sondee fowtu, da go seli ala den sani di yu abi. Da gi den pootiman a moni, da yu sa fende gaan gudu a Masaa Gadu a tapu anda. Da, te i kaba, da kon waka a mi baka, enke wan bakaman fu mi.”
eng_text: Jesus said to him, "If you want to be perfect, go, sell what you have, and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me."

djk_text: We, di a yee ala san Masaa Jesesi taigi en, ne a booko sikoo. Ne a bendi ede a doti, ne a waka gwe anga ala gaan tyali na ati. Bika a be abi tyaipi gudu.
eng_text: But when the young man heard the saying, he went away sad, for he was one who had great possessions.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi daai go a den bakaman fi en taki: “Luku de! Fu tuutuu, a taanga gi wan guduman fu kon a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Jesus said to his disciples, "Most certainly I say to you, a rich man will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven with difficulty.

djk_text: Mi e taigi u ete wan toon. A moo makiliki fu wan kameili pasa a nanai olo, moo enke wan guduman pasa go a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to go through a needle's eye, than for a rich man to enter into the Kingdom of God."

djk_text: We, di den bakaman fi en yee so, ne a sani fuka den. Ne den akisi en taki: “We, da sama sa fende a libi fu tego seefi?”
eng_text: When the disciples heard it, they were exceedingly astonished, saying, "Who then can be saved?"

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi luku den dunn. Ne a piki den taki: “Efu na libisama wawan a be didon, da ná wan sama di be o poi fende a libi de. Ma fu Masaa Gadu, da sani seefi á de di a á poi du.”
eng_text: Looking at them, Jesus said, "With men this is impossible, but with God all things are possible."

djk_text: We, ne Peitilisi akisi en taki: “We, wi be fika ala sani di u be abi, kon waka a yu baka. Da sowtu paiman wi dati o fende?”
eng_text: Then Peter answered, "Behold, we have left everything, and followed you. What then will we have?"

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi piki taki: “U aliki ya! Fu tuu! Wan ten e kon, di ala sani o meke kon nyun baka. Da a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya o sidon ne en kownu sutuu anga ala a dyendee di a abi, fu tii ala sani. Da u di be e waka ne en baka seefi o sidon a kownu sutuu, fu kuutu den twalufu lo fu Islayeli Kondee.
eng_text: Jesus said to them, "Most certainly I tell you that you who have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of Man will sit on the throne of his glory, you also will sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

djk_text: Soseefi ala sama di fika osu ofu baala ofu sisa ofu dda ofu mma ofu uman ofu pikin ofu ala san a abi, fu di a wani waka a mi baka, da a o fende den sani ya wan ondoo toon baka. Da bakaten seefi a sa fende a libi fu tego tu.
eng_text: Everyone who has left houses, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name's sake, will receive one hundred times, and will inherit eternal life.

djk_text: Da a yuu de, somen sama di de fesiwan ya o toon bakaman. Da somen di de bakaman ya o daai toon fesiwan.”
eng_text: But many will be last who are first; and first who are last.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi gi den ete wan ageisi toli, fu soi den fa a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu tan. A taki: “Wan guduman be abi wan goon. Ne di mamanten fuuku, ne a go suku sama fu yuu, fu kon yeepi en wooko a goon.
eng_text:
For the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who was the master of a household, who went out early in the morning to hire laborers for his vineyard.
