eng_text: Isn't it lawful for me to do what I want to with what I own? Or is your eye evil, because I am good?'

djk_text: “We, na so den di de a baka ya o daai kon toon fesiwan. Da den di de a fesi ya o daai kon toon bakawan.”
eng_text: So the last will be first, and the first last. For many are called, but few are chosen."

djk_text: Da Masaa Jesesi de a pasi e gwe a Jelusalem. Ne a kai den twalufu bakaman fi en go a wanse. Ne a taigi den taki:
eng_text: As Jesus was going up to Jerusalem, he took the twelve disciples aside, and on the way he said to them,

djk_text: “U si, wi e go a Jelusalem Foto nownow! Da den o kisi a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya, poti a den hei apaiti begiman anga den leliman fu Dyuweiti ana. Da den o kuutu en taki, a mu dede.
eng_text:
Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be delivered to the chief priests and scribes, and they will condemn him to death,
661	Da den o poti mi a den Loma sama ana. Da den o wisiwasi mi, fonmi te a sai den. Da den o tyai mi go sipikii kii a koloisi. Ma di fu dii dei, da mi o weki baka.”	661	and will hand him over to the Gentiles to mock, to scourge, and to crucify; and the third day he will be raised up.

djk_text: Ma namo, da na a seefi yuu de, ne a mma fu den tu manpikin fu Da Sebedi kon a Masaa Jesesi. Ne a kai anga kini a doti a Masaa Jesesi fesi taki: “Masaa oo! Mi wani begi i wan sani, baa?”
eng_text: Then the mother of the sons of Zebedee came to him with her sons, kneeling and asking a certain thing of him.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi akisi en taki: “San i wani?” Namo a mma piki taki: “We, Masaa! Dyonson, yu o de Kownu a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu. Da gaantangi! Meke den tu manpikin fu mi ya sidon a yu se, baa? Wan fu den a yu letise ana, a taawan a yu kukutuse ana.”
eng_text: He said to her, "What do you want?" She said to him, "Command that these, my two sons, may sit, one on your right hand, and one on your left hand, in your Kingdom."

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Yu á sabi san i e akisi mi ya! Bika wan gaan pina de a pasi e kon fu mi nyan. U denki u sa poi nyanmi en anga mi?” Namo den piki en taki: “Eeye Masaa! U sa poi nyanmi en anga yu.”
eng_text: But Jesus answered, "You don't know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I am about to drink, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?" They said to him, "We are able."

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi piki den baka taki: “Na tuu! U sa diingi en tuu! Ma a á didon a mi, fu gi sama peesi a mi leti ana ofu mi kukutu ana se. Bika na den sama di mi Tata, a tapu poti den hei peesi de gi sa fende den.”
eng_text: He said to them, "You will indeed drink my cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with, but to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give; but it is for whom it has been prepared by my Father."

djk_text: We, di den taa tin bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi yee san pasa de, ne den ati boon seefi seefi.
eng_text: When the ten heard it, they were indignant with the two brothers.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi kai ala den kon ne en. Ne a taigi den taki: “U ala fiya sabi fa den edeman fu goontapu ya e tii kondee. Den e dwengi sama poti a den ondoo. Da den sama de seefi e dwengi sama poti a den ondoo fu pee basi a den tapu.
eng_text: But Jesus summoned them, and said, "You know that the rulers of the nations lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.

djk_text: Ma u dati á mu libi so. Pe fu dati, da a sama di wani hei a u mindii, mu saka enseefi fu e dini taawan.
eng_text: It shall not be so among you, but whoever desires to become great among you shall be your servant.

djk_text: Sama di wani toon fesiman fu taawan mu toon saafu gi den taawan.
eng_text: Whoever desires to be first among you shall be your bondservant,

djk_text: Bika a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya, á kon fu sama dini en. Ma a kon fu dini sama. A kon fu gi en libi enke paiman, fu pai gi somen sama, fu kon de bun gi Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: even as the Son of Man came not to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many."

djk_text: We, ne di Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en komoto a Jelikow e gwe, ne tyaipi sama e waka ne en baka.
eng_text: As they went out from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.

djk_text: Ma namo, da tu beendiman be sidon a sikin pasi. Ne di den yee taki, na Masaa Jesesi e pasa de, ne den e bali taki: “Masaa! Masaa! Bakaten Manpikin fu Kownu Dafeti paansu! Teke tyali ati luku wi, baa?”
eng_text: Behold, two blind men sitting by the road, when they heard that Jesus was passing by, cried out, "Lord, have mercy on us, you son of David!"

djk_text: Ma den tyaipi sama di be e waka a Masaa Jesesi baka kaasi den taki: “U tapu mofu ya!” Ma a tan enke na sende, den sende den, fu bali moo taanga. Bika, na now den e bali taanga taki: “Masaa! Bakaten Manpikin fu Kownu Dafeti paansu! U begi i! Teke tyali ati luku wi oo!”
eng_text: The multitude rebuked them, telling them that they should be quiet, but they cried out even more, "Lord, have mercy on us, you son of David!"

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi taampu diin. Ne a kai den kon, ne a akisi den taki: “San u wani, fu mi du gi u?”
eng_text: Jesus stood still, and called them, and asked, "What do you want me to do for you?"

djk_text: Namo den piki taki: “Masaa! U wani i deesi u ain, fu u sa si sani.”
eng_text: They told him, "Lord, that our eyes may be opened."

djk_text: Namo tyali kisi Masaa Jesesi fu den, te ná sipowtu. Ne a waka go, ne a oli den ain. Ne wanten de, ne den ain kiin fu si ala sani. Ne den teke fu waka a Masaa Jesesi baka.
eng_text: Jesus, being moved with compassion, touched their eyes; and immediately their eyes received their sight, and they followed him.

djk_text: Namo, den Masaa Jesesi kon doo koosube fu Jelusalem Foto. Den be de na a foto den e kai Betifage, na a pisi fu Oleifi Mongo. Namo, ne Masaa Jesesi kai tu fu den bakaman fi en kon, fu sende sani.
eng_text: When they drew near to Jerusalem, and came to Bethsphage, to the Mount of Olives, then Jesus sent two disciples,

djk_text: A taigi den taki: “Go na a kondee na abaase anda. U o si tu buliki de, wan uman wan anga en pikin. U losi den teke tyai kon gi mi ya.
eng_text: saying to them, "Go into the village that is opposite you, and immediately you will find a donkey tied, and a colt with her. Untie them, and bring them to me.

djk_text: Efu wan sama sa akisi pe u e go anga den, da u mu piki en taki, na Masaa sende u, fu kon teke den. Bika Masaa abi den fanowdu nownow. Ma te a Masaa kaba anga den, da u o tyai den kon poti baka.”
eng_text: If anyone says anything to you, you shall say, 'The Lord needs them,' and immediately he will send them."

djk_text: Da na fu sani sa waka enke fa wan fositen apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu be sikiifi. Bika a be sikiifi taki:
eng_text: All this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying,

djk_text: “Meke den sama fu Siyon sabi taki, a kownu fu den e kon. Ai kon a den anga ala gaan saka fasi a wan buliki tapu.”
eng_text: Tell the daughter of Zion, behold, your King comes to you, humble, and riding on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a donkey.

djk_text: We, ne den tu bakaman waka go, enke fa Masaa Jesesi sende den. Ne den du san a sende den tu.
eng_text: The disciples went, and did just as Jesus commanded them,

djk_text: Den teke a uman buliki anga en pikin tyai kon. Soseefi den bakaman teke den koosi baala a den buliki mindii baka. Ne Masaa Jesesi subi go sidon na a pikin buliki tapu, fu gwe.
eng_text: and brought the donkey and the colt, and laid their clothes on them; and he sat on them.

djk_text: Da tyaipi tyaipi sama be de anda di teke koosi anga bon ana baala na a pasi tapu pe Masaa Jesesi o pasa anga den buliki.
eng_text: A very great multitude spread their clothes on the road. Others cut branches from the trees, and spread them on the road.

djk_text: Da sama be e waka a Masaa Jesesi baka, den e waka ne en fesi. Da den e bali taki: “Hosana gi a Bakaten Manpikin fu Kownu Dafeti paansu!” “Seigi fu awan, di e kon a ini a nen fu Masaa.” “Hosana gi Masaa Gadu a tapu seefi!”
eng_text: The multitudes who went before him, and who followed kept shouting, "Hosanna to the son of David! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!"

djk_text: Namo di den doo a ini Jelusalem Foto seefi, ne a hii foto seke. Den sama booko kon gwuulu, da den e taki: “Sama kon ya?”
eng_text: When he had come into Jerusalem, all the city was stirred up, saying, "Who is this?"

djk_text: Da taawan e piki taki: “Jesesi! Jesesi! Apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu di komoto a Nasaleti Foto, na a pisiwataa fu Galileya.”
eng_text: The multitudes said, "This is the prophet, Jesus, from Nazareth of Galilee."

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi waka go na a gaan Mama Keliki. Da somen sama be de anda e bai sani, e seli enke na wowoyo. Namo Masaa Jesesi yaki ala den puu de. Ne a toto ala den tafaa pe den be e booko moni, towe a doti. A puu ala den sutuu pe sama be sidon e seli doifi towe gwe.
eng_text: Jesus entered into the temple of God, and drove out all of those who sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the money changers' tables and the seats of those who sold the doves.

djk_text: Na so ai taigi den tu taki: “U á sabi san sikiifi a Masaa Gadu Buku, no? A sikiifi taki: ‘Mi osu mu de wan peesi pe sama e kon, fu begi makandii.’ Na so! Ma fu saide u sama ya meke a toon wan peesi fu kweki fufuuman du?”
eng_text: He said to them, "It is written, 'My house shall be called a house of prayer,' but you have made it a den of robbers!"

djk_text: Namo, di Masaa Jesesi de ape, ne wantu beendiman anga lanman kon suku yeepi ne en. Ne a deesi den kon bun.
eng_text: The blind and the lame came to him in the temple, and he healed them.

djk_text: We, den hei apaiti begiman anga den leliman fu Dyuweiti ape ati boon tuutuu. Bika den si den foondoo sani di ai du ape. Soseefi den e yee pikinengee seefi mu e bali baya ape taki: “Hosana! Bika en na a Bakaten Manpikin fu Kownu Dafeti paansu.”
eng_text: But when the chief priests and the scribes saw the wonderful things that he did, and the children who were crying in the temple and saying, "Hosanna to the son of David!" they were indignant,

djk_text: We, ne den moo hei apaiti begiman komoto kon akisi Masaa Jesesi taki: “I yee bun, fa den pikin e kai yu de?” Namo Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Mi e yee kiinkiin, fa den e kai mi! Ma u dati á leisi san sikiifi a Masaa Gadu Buku, no? A sikiifi taki: ‘Masaa Gadu o meke, te enke petepete pikin seefi e bali baaya gafa en.’ ”
eng_text: and said to him, "Do you hear what these are saying?" Jesus said to them, "Yes. Did you never read, 'Out of the mouth of babes and nursing babies you have perfected praise?'"

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi waka komoto ape. Soseefi a komoto a ini Jelusalem Foto, go siibi na a peesi den e kai Betaniya.
eng_text: He left them, and went out of the city to Bethany, and lodged there.

djk_text: Namo fuuku mamanten, ne Masaa Jesesi opo fu go a Jelusalem Foto baka. Ma angii be moo en.
eng_text: Now in the morning, as he returned to the city, he was hungry.

djk_text: Namo a si wan figasii bon a sikin pasi. Ne a go suku figasii na a bon. Ma ná wan enkii sii a poi fende. Ne a fuuku a bon taki: “I kaba fu meke sii a goontapu! Bika noiti moo wanten i sa meke sii!” Fa i si Masaa Jesesi taki so, a bon dede wanten.
eng_text: Seeing a fig tree by the road, he came to it, and found nothing on it but leaves. He said to it, "Let there be no fruit from you forever!" Immediately the fig tree withered away.

djk_text: Da den bakaman fi en si a foondoo sani di pasa anga a bon ya. Ne den foondoo te, den á sabi san fu du. Namo den go akisi Masaa Jesesi taki: “Da fa a bon du dede wanboo wanboo so?”
eng_text: When the disciples saw it, they marveled, saying, "How did the fig tree immediately wither away?"

djk_text: Namo a piki den taki: “Na tuutuu biibi meke dati pasa. Bika te i sa biibi Masaa Gadu doo yu ati tuutuu, da i sa poi du san mi du ya tu. Soseefi i sa poi du moo gaan foondoo sani moo dati seefi. A winsi na sende i sende wan gaan mongo taki: ‘Diipi go kai a ini ze.’ A sa musu fu go!
eng_text: Jesus answered them, "Most certainly I tell you, if you have faith, and don't doubt, you will not only do what was done to the fig tree, but even if you told this mountain, 'Be taken up and cast into the sea,' it would be done.

djk_text: Fu tuu, ala san i begi akisi Masaa Gadu, a sa du ala dati gi yu. Ma a wan sani, i mu abi biibi doo yu ati, te yu e begi.”
eng_text: All things, whatever you ask in prayer, believing, you will receive."

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi go doo Jelusalem Foto baka. Ne a waka go na a Mama Keliki baka, fu go leli den sama sani anda. Namo den hei apaiti begiman anga den gaansama fu kondee go ne en. Ne den akisi en taki: “Sama gi yu a makiti, fu waka du den sani, di yu e waka e du ya! Sama gi yu a makiti fu du den sani ya?”
eng_text: When he had come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came to him as he was teaching, and said, "By what authority do you do these things? Who gave you this authority?"

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Mi o akisi u wan sani fosi. Te u kaba piki mi dati, da miseefi sa piki u san u akisi mi de.
eng_text: Jesus answered them, "I also will ask you one question, which if you tell me, I likewise will tell you by what authority I do these things.

djk_text: U piki mi! Sama be gi Johanisi a makiti fu dopu sama? Na Masaa Gadu ofu na libisama be sende en?” We, di a akisi so, ne den bendi a se fosi, fu kai pakisei luku, fa fu piki en. Ne den fiti taki: “Efu u piki taki: ‘Na Masaa Gadu sende Johanisi,’ a sa akisi wi taki: ‘Da saide, u á be biibi Johanisi?’
eng_text: The baptism of John, where was it from? From heaven or from men?" They reasoned with themselves, saying, "If we say, 'From heaven,' he will ask us, 'Why then did you not believe him?'

djk_text: Soseefi, efu u piki taki: ‘Na libisama be gi en Johanisi a makiti,’ da wi anga a foluku fu kondee o de a toko. Bika a foluku e si Johanisi enke wan apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: But if we say, 'From men,' we fear the multitude, for all hold John as a prophet."

djk_text: Dati meke den piki Masaa Jesesi taki: “Wi á sabi sama be gi en a makiti.” Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den baka taki: “Di u á sabi kaba sama be gi en a makiti, da mi seefi ná o taigi u sama gi mi a makiti tu.”
eng_text: They answered Jesus, and said, "We don't know." He also said to them, "Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi taki anga den go doo taki: “Mi o gi u wan ageisi toli fu teke poti pakisei bunbun! Wan sama be abi tu manpikin anga wan goon. Ne a sende a moo gaan manpikin fu go wooko na a goon.
eng_text: But what do you think? A man had two sons, and he came to the first, and said, 'Son, go work today in my vineyard.'

djk_text: Ma a pikin ya piki en taki: ‘Nono, mi dda! Mi ná o poi go wooko a goon.’ Ma moo lati, ne a pikin ya fii tyali, fu di a piki so. Ne a komoto langa langa go wooko na a goon, gi a dda.
eng_text: He answered, 'I will not,' but afterward he changed his mind, and went.

djk_text: “We, ne a dda go na a moo nyoni manpikin tu. Ne a sende en fu go wooko na a goon tu. Namo a manpikin ya piki taki: ‘Iya, mi dda! Mi o go. Ma na piki namo a piki, bika a á go seefi seefi.’ ”
eng_text: He came to the second, and said the same thing. He answered, 'I go, sir,' but he didn't go.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi koti a toli taki: “On di fu den tu manpikin ya du san a dda wani?” We, ne den piki en taki: “Awan di be taki, a ná o go, ma toku a go moo lati.” Ne Masaa Jesesi taki: “We, fu tuu, mi e taigi u taki, den gaan polinen sama fu kondee o daai kon de a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu. Ma u dati o fika so.
eng_text: Which of the two did the will of his father?" They said to him, "The first." Jesus said to them, "Most certainly I tell you that the tax collectors and the prostitutes are entering into the Kingdom of God before you.

djk_text: Bika u á si taki, Johanisi taki sani fu Masaa Gadu, ne den dati biibi, no? Weeno! Ma u dati si san pasa de, ne toku u seefi á wani daai libi fu biibi Johanisi.”
eng_text: For John came to you in the way of righteousness, and you didn't believe him, but the tax collectors and the prostitutes believed him. When you saw it, you didn't even repent afterward, that you might believe him.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi taki baka taki: “Wan taa ageisi toli e kon ya, fu soi wan sani. Wan gaan masaa be abi wan goon, fu paandi wan sii enke doloifi. Ne a meke wan wooko sani poti ape, fu kwinsi a sii ya kon toon win. Soseefi a lontu a hii goon anga a hii wooko sani ya poti a ini dyali. Ne a meke wan hei osu go a tapu fu den wakiti man oli waki na a goon. Ne a kai wan duupu sama kon poti a hii wooko ya a den ana, fu du. Bika enseefi o go koi a taa kondee.
eng_text:
Hear another parable. There was a man who was a master of a household, who planted a vineyard, set a hedge about it, dug a winepress in it, built a tower, leased it out to farmers, and went into another country.
710	Namo, den sii fu a goon be kon lepi. Na so a yuu doo, fu go booko den kwinsi toon win. Ne a gaan masaa sende en futuboi go a den sama, fu den sende fi en se gi en.	710	When the season for the fruit drew near, he sent his servants to the farmers, to receive his fruit.
711	Ma den sama feti ogii ogii anga den futuboi fu a gaan masaa, di a sende go. Den fon afu, ne den naki taawan kii anga siton.	711	The farmers took his servants, beat one, killed another, and stoned another.
712	Ma toku, a gaan masaa sende moo ipi futuboi go a den sama baka, fu meke den sama sende fi en se gi en. Ma den disi seefi go tuka anga a seefi ogii, di be miti den fosi futuboi di a masaa be sende go.	712	Again, he sent other servants more than the first: and they treated them the same way.
713	“We, ne a gaan masaa luku taki: ‘Efu mi sende a manpikin fu miseefi go a den sama tu, da den o feele fu du ogii anga en, fu di na a manpikin di miseefi abi.’	713	But afterward he sent to them his son, saying, 'They will respect my son.'
714	“Namo den sama si a manpikin e kon. Ne den taki: ‘Oho, luku anda! A gaan masaa sende a manpikin fi en seefi kon a leisi ya. We, disi na awan kodo manpikin di a dda abi, fu poti enke basi, fu taki, gi ala san a dda seefi abi. Meke u kii en, da a goon o fika gi wi.’	714	But the farmers, when they saw the son, said among themselves, 'This is the heir. Come, let's kill him, and seize his inheritance.'
715	We, ne den lulu a manpikin ya, fu te a kon doo. Ne den ali en puu a ini a goon tyai go kii.”	715	So they took him, and threw him out of the vineyard, and killed him.
716	Namo, ne Masaa Jesesi koti a toli. Ne a akisi den taki: “San u pakisei a gaan masaa o du, te enseefi o kon a den sama ya?”	716	When therefore the lord of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those farmers?

djk_text: Namo den piki en taki: “A gaan masaa ya ati musu boon tuutuu. Da a musu kii den takuu ati sama di be e luku a goon de. Soseefi, a o poti a goon a ini taa sama ana, di sa wani gi en, fi en se.”
eng_text: They told him, "He will miserably destroy those miserable men, and will lease out the vineyard to other farmers, who will give him the fruit in its season."

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi taigi den baka taki: “U á leisi san sikiifi a Masaa Gadu Buku, no? A sikiifi taki: ‘Disi na a siton di meseeman be oli fu wan soso sani. Na dati daai kon toon a siton futu fu a hii osu. Na so Masaa du en wooko. A foondoo gi wi, fu si.’
eng_text: Jesus said to them, "Did you never read in the Scriptures, 'The stone which the builders rejected, the same was made the head of the corner. This was from the Lord. It is marvelous in our eyes?'

djk_text: We, meke mi e taigi u! Masaa Gadu o fika u fu a peesi ya a wan se. Da a o komoto go anga a Nyun Tii fi en a taa taa foluku sama, di wani tan enke fa a wani.
eng_text:
Therefore I tell you, the Kingdom of God will be taken away from you, and will be given to a nation bringing forth its fruit.
720	Bika sama di o kai na a siton ya tapu, o booko pisipisi. Soseefi, efu a siton ya kai a wan sama tapu, da a o masi a sama de fini fini.”	720	He who falls on this stone will be broken to pieces, but on whomever it will fall, it will scatter him as dust.

djk_text: Namo den hei apaiti begiman anga den Faliseiman aliki den toli fu Masaa Jesesi ya, te a kaba. Ne den taki: “Na wi ai poti na ageisi toli de so.”
eng_text: When the chief priests and the Pharisees heard his parables, they perceived that he spoke about them.

djk_text: Da na leti ape kaba den be wani kisi Masaa Jesesi wanten. Ma den á kisi en ape. Bika den be e feele a foluku di e oli Masaa Jesesi enke wan apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: When they sought to seize him, they feared the multitudes, because they considered him to be a prophet.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi gi wan taa ageisi toli baka, fu leli den sama wan sani.
eng_text: Jesus answered and spoke again in parables to them, saying,

djk_text: A taki: “A Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu tan enke fa a toli fu a kownu ya o waka. A kownu ya be abi wan manpikin. Ne a manpikin yuu kisi fu teke wan uman libi. Namo a kownu sete wan toow osu, fu oli gi en.
eng_text:
The Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king, who made a marriage feast for his son,
725	Ala sani fu a fesa seeka te a kaba. Ne a kownu sende futuboi go kai wan paitei sama, fu kon nyan toow osu. Ma den sama ya á wani kon.	725	and sent out his servants to call those who were invited to the marriage feast, but they would not come.
726	A kownu sende futuboi ete wan leisi go kai den baka taki: ‘U kon! Mi seeka ala nyanyan sani, fu oli a feisiti kaba. Mi kii kaw anga taa taa fatu meti boli! U kon piisii na a fesa!’	726	Again he sent out other servants, saying, 'Tell those who are invited, Behold, I have prepared my dinner. My cattle and my fatlings are killed, and all things are ready. Come to the marriage feast!"'

djk_text: Ma winsi fa den futuboi go taki dati, toku den sama á wani kon. Bika den abi taa taa fuka e du. Taawan taki, ai go a goon. Taawan abi taa taa sowtu sani e du.
eng_text: But they made light of it, and went their ways, one to his own farm, another to his merchandise,

djk_text: Wan paitei fu den sama dati kisi den futuboi fu a kownu di a sende go, wai kon. Ne den taki, den o mesaandi den. We, tuutuu den du anga den, te den kii son fu den seefi.
eng_text: and the rest grabbed his servants, and treated them shamefully, and killed them.

djk_text: “Namo a kownu ati boon tuutuu. Ne a sende suudati go kii den sama di kii den futuboi fi en baka. Den suudati boon a hii foto fu den sama de paata a doti.
eng_text: When the king heard that, he was angry, and sent his armies, destroyed those murderers, and burned their city.

djk_text: Namo a kownu kai wan duupu taa futuboi kon. Ne a taigi den taki: ‘Ala sani fu a feisiti de seeka seeka. Ma den sama di mi be kai fu kon, den á waiti fu kon doo ya.
eng_text:
Then he said to his servants, 'The wedding is ready, but those who were invited weren't worthy.
731	Da u go waka na a hii ganda kai ibii sama di u si anda, fu kon nyan a feisiti.’	731	Go therefore to the intersections of the highways, and as many as you may find, invite to the marriage feast.'
732	“We, ne den wookoman go kai ala sama di den miti, fu go na a toow osu. Namo a toow osu bigi te, ai meke huuw anga sama. Bika ala sowtu sama be kon, bun ati wan anga takuu ati wan.	732	Those servants went out into the highways, and gathered together as many as they found, both bad and good. The wedding was filled with guests.
733	“Namo a kownu seefi waka kon doo a ini a toow osu, fu luku sama di kon. Da a si taki, den sama wei toow osu koosi, fiti enke fa a mu de. Ma na wan kodo sama de ape á be wei bunbun koosi.	733	But when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man who didn't have on wedding clothing,
734	Namo a kownu go akisi a sama ya taki: ‘Mi baala? Na so yu wei kon a mi feisiti?’ Namo a sama taampu diin namo, a nái piki a kownu seefi.	734	and he said to him, 'Friend, how did you come in here not wearing wedding clothing?' He was speechless.
735	“We, ne a kownu sende en futuboi taki: ‘U kisi en! U tei en futu anga en ana! Da u iti en go na a gaan dunguu a doose anda. Na soso kee anga kaw tifi de anda.’ ”	735	Then the king said to the servants, 'Bind him hand and foot, take him away, and throw him into the outer darkness; there is where the weeping and grinding of teeth will be.'
736	Namo Masaa Jesesi koti a toli leti ape taki: “Na soseefi Masaa Gadu kai tyaipi tyaipi sama kon. Ma a ná ala den doo peesi, fu Masaa Gadu teke toon sama fi en seefi.”	736	For many are called, but few chosen.

djk_text: Namo den Faliseiman kon gwe. Ne den gwe go kai pakisei luku, fa fu akisi Masaa Jesesi wan sani, fu a piki fasi enseefi.
eng_text: Then the Pharisees went and took counsel how they might entrap him in his talk.

djk_text: Namo den sende bakaman fu den go makandii anga wantu politikiman fu Kownu Helowdesi. Ne den taigi Masaa Jesesi taki: “Fa u sabi yu, da yu na wan gaan letiopu libisama! Yu e leli sama soso tuutuu sani fu Masaa Gadu. Soseefi yu nái kuutu konkuu. Bika yu e soi ibii sama di doo yu, leti san i mu soi en. Da i nái luku taki, disi ofu dati.
eng_text: They sent their disciples to him, along with the Herodians, saying, "Teacher, we know that you are honest, and teach the way of God in truth, no matter whom you teach, for you aren't partial to anyone.

djk_text: We! Taigi u, efu a de fanowdu fu u pai a moo gaan kownu a Loma Foto, a lantimoni.”
eng_text: Tell us therefore, what do you think? Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?"

djk_text: Ma ala fa den kon akisi Masaa Jesesi a sani ya, da a be sabi kaba taki, na wani den wani koli en, fu a piki sani di á bun. Namo a piki den taki: “U bidiigiman! Na wani u wani fasi mi kisi so?
eng_text: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, "Why do you test me, you hypocrites?

djk_text: U tyai a pikin moni di u e pai a lantimoni seefi kon, gi mi, osi?” Namo den sama kon doo anga wan fu den moni ya Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: Show me the tax money." They brought to him a denarius.

djk_text: Ne a teke a moni luku, te a kaba. Ne a taki: “Sama na a sama, di fesi maiki na a moni tapu ya?”
eng_text: He asked them, "Whose is this image and inscription?"

djk_text: We, ne den piki en taki: “A sama de? A fesi di maiki na a moni tapu de, na fu a moo gaan kownu a Loma Foto!” We, ne Masaa Jesesi piki den baka taki: “Efu ne en fesi de na a moni tapu, da a moni ne en sani! Da na musu u musu fu gi en, en sani di a abi! Ma san u dati abi fu gi Masaa Gadu, dati na san de fu Masaa Gadu. Na dati u mu gi Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: They said to him, "Caesar's." Then he said to them, "Give therefore to Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and to God the things that are God's."

djk_text: We, di Masaa Jesesi piki so, ne den foondoo, te ná sipowtu. Namo den fika en, ne den gwe.
eng_text: When they heard it, they marveled, and left him, and went away.

djk_text: A seefi dei de, ne a kulu fu den Saduseiman kon doo a Masaa Jesesi. Den sama ya e biibi taki, te wan sama dede, da a tan dede. Noiti moo a sa weki moo.
eng_text: On that day Sadducees (those who say that there is no resurrection) came to him. They asked him,

djk_text: We, ne den taigi Masaa Jesesi taki: “Mosesi be fika wan weiti gi wi. Ai soi san fu du, te manengee dede fika en uman, sondee pikin. Da na a baala di a man ya abi fu teke a uman libi, fu meke pikin gi a dede baala.
eng_text: saying, "Teacher, Moses said, 'If a man dies, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife, and raise up seed for his brother.'

djk_text: Ma yee ya! Seibin baala be de. Ne a moo gaan wan kon dede, fika en uman sondee pikin. Ne a baala di waka ne en baka teke a uman libi.
eng_text: Now there were with us seven brothers. The first married and died, and having no seed left his wife to his brother.

djk_text: Baka wan pisiten, a baala de seefi kon dede, sondee pikin anga a uman. Meke u taki, a waka so anga ala den taa baala. Bika ala dede, sondee meke pikin anga a uman.
eng_text: In the same way, the second also, and the third, to the seventh.

djk_text: Da te fu kaba, a uman seefi kon dede tu.
eng_text: After them all, the woman died.

djk_text: We, yu á taki, dedesama o weki wan dei baka, no? Da den seibin baala ya seefi musu weki tu. Da on di fu den seibin i pakisei taki, o abi a uman enke uman. Bika ala den seibin be libi anga en a ini den libiten.”
eng_text: In the resurrection therefore, whose wife will she be of the seven? For they all had her."

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “U nái fusutan Masaa Gadu toli! Bika u á sabi san sikiifi a Masaa Gadu Buku. Soseefi u á sabi taki, Masaa Gadu abi makiti, fu du ala sani.
eng_text: But Jesus answered them, "You are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures, nor the power of God.

djk_text: Bika i si den sama di o weki baka? Na Masaa Gadu Kondee a tapu den o go tan enke Masaa Gadu Kondee Basiya anda. Da fu teke uman ofu man libi, dati á sa de anda gi den moo.
eng_text: For in the resurrection they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are like God's angels in heaven.

djk_text: Soseefi u á leisi san sikiifi fu dedesama a Masaa Gadu Buku, no? Bika Masaa Gadu taki de taki:
eng_text: But concerning the resurrection of the dead, haven't you read that which was spoken to you by God, saying,

djk_text: ‘Mi na a Gadu fu Abalaham, Isaki anga Jakopu.’ Da disi e soi taki Masaa Gadu a ná a Gadu fu sama di dede, da a kaba. Ma en na a Gadu fu sama di winsi den dede, toku den e libi ete.”
eng_text: 'I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?' God is not the God of the dead, but of the living."

djk_text: We, di Masaa Jesesi piki so, ne ala sama di be de ape foondoo, te ná sipowtu.
eng_text: When the multitudes heard it, they were astonished at his teaching.

djk_text: Namo den Faliseiman seefi kon yee taki, Masaa Jesesi tapu den Saduseisama mofu, te den á poi piki en baka. Namo denseefi feti lon kon doo.
eng_text: But the Pharisees, when they heard that he had silenced the Sadducees, gathered themselves together.

djk_text: Wan fu den, di be kon de na wan leliman fu Dyuweiti. Na dati go fii Masaa Jesesi mofu luku, fu a sa taki sani fasi enseefi.
eng_text: One of them, a lawyer, asked him a question, testing him.

djk_text: Namo a akisi Masaa Jesesi taki: “On di fu den weiti fu Masaa Gadu moo bigi, fu oli?”
eng_text: Teacher, which is the greatest commandment in the law?

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Na di taki: ‘U mu lobi Masaa Gadu anga u hii ati, u hii fii anga u fusutan.’
eng_text: Jesus said to him, "'You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind.'

djk_text: Na dati na a weiti di moo bigi.
eng_text: This is the first and great commandment.

djk_text: Ma ete wan weiti de fanowdu fu oli enke dati tu. Dati taki: ‘U mu lobi ala taa sama enke fa u lobi u seefi.’
eng_text: A second likewise is this, 'You shall love your neighbor as yourself.'

djk_text: Bika na den tu weiti ya, na a hii mama fu den weiti di Mosesi anga taa taa fositen apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu be sikiifi.”
eng_text: The whole law and the prophets depend on these two commandments."

djk_text: Namo, da den Faliseiman be de ape makandii kaba. Ne Masaa Jesesi seefi o go akisi den wan sani tu.
eng_text: Now while the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them a question,

djk_text: A taki: “Fa u membee fu a Kelestesi seefi? Sowtu gaansama bakaten paansu pikin a de?” Namo den piki en taki: “Na wan bakaten manpikin fu Kownu Dafeti paansu.”
eng_text: saying, "What do you think of the Christ? Whose son is he?" They said to him, "Of David."

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi piki baka taki: “Da saide a Apaiti Jeje fu Masaa Gadu be piki Kownu Dafeti seefi, fu kai a Kelestesi, Masaa? Bika Kownu Dafeti seefi be taki a ini Masaa Gadu Buku taki:
eng_text: He said to them, "How then does David in the Spirit call him Lord, saying,

djk_text: ‘Masaa Gadu taigi mi Masaa taki: “Sidon a mi leti ana se ya, te enke mi poti ala yu feyanti a yu futu ondoo.” ’
eng_text: 'The Lord said to my Lord, sit on my right hand, until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet?'

djk_text: Na so Dafeti seefi be kai a Kelestesi ‘Masaa.’ Da fa u ya sa taki, a Kelestesi na soso wan bakaten manpikin fu Kownu Dafeti paansu namo, da a kaba?”
eng_text: If then David calls him Lord, how is he his son?

djk_text: We, di Masaa Jesesi kaba taki so, ne den á sabi san fu piki moo. Soseefi den e feele tu, fu sete taa sitee anga en, senten a dei de.
eng_text: No one was able to answer him a word, neither did any man dare ask him any more questions from that day forth.

djk_text: Namo, ne Masaa Jesesi daai taki anga a foluku fu kondee ape, makandii anga den bakaman fi en.
eng_text: Then Jesus spoke to the multitudes and to his disciples,

djk_text: A taki: “Den leliman fu Dyuweiti anga den Faliseiman, teke Mosesi peesi tuu, fu leli sama dini Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: saying, "The scribes and the Pharisees sat on Moses' seat.

djk_text: Da u mu e teke san den e taki. Ma luku bun! U á mu teke a sowtu fasi, fa denseefi e libi. Bika den seefi nái waka enke a leli di den e gi.
eng_text: All things therefore whatever they tell you to observe, observe and do, but don't do their works; for they say, and don't do.

djk_text: Ma na taanga weiti den e poti gi sama, fu oli. Ma denseefi nái lobi wan finga a den weiti de, fu meke sama poi si a den, fa a weiti mu oli seefi.
eng_text: For they bind heavy burdens that are grievous to be borne, and lay them on men's shoulders; but they themselves will not lift a finger to help them.

djk_text: “Da na fu sama ain, meke den e du sani. Bika den e sikiifi Masaa Gadu weiti poti a pampila, tei na ana anga fesi ede. Soseefi den e wei apaiti sowtu koosi tu.
eng_text: But all their works they do to be seen by men. They make their phylacteries broad, enlarge the fringes of their garments,

djk_text: Soseefi den e teke peesi sidon a den moo bunbun peesi fu tafaa sikin a ini keliki. Soseefi te feisiti doo, da na den e teke den moo bunbun peesi a tafaa sikin.
eng_text: and love the place of honor at feasts, the best seats in the synagogues,

djk_text: Soseefi, den lobi te ala sama di miti anga den a wowoyo e kai den, Mesiti. Bika den wani ala sama e si den enke gaan bigiman.
eng_text: the salutations in the marketplaces, and to be called 'Rabbi, Rabbi' by men.

djk_text: Ma u enke bakaman fu mi dati á mu tan enke den. Bika u ala ya dati na baala anga baala. Da u á mu meke taawan poti u e kai, Mesiti ya. Bika na wan kodo Masaa fu gi leli namo u ala de abi.
eng_text: But don't you be called 'Rabbi,' for one is your teacher, the Christ, and all of you are brothers.

djk_text: Soseefi, na wankodo Tata di de a tapu namo u ala de abi. Da u á mu si taawan ya enke a sowtu Tata de.
eng_text: Call no man on the earth your father, for one is your Father, he who is in heaven.

djk_text: Soseefi u á mu meke taawan poti u e kai, edeman fu gi leli, tu. Bika na mi, a Kelestesi wawan na a edeman, fu gi leli.
eng_text: Neither be called masters, for one is your master, the Christ.

djk_text: Ma a wi mindii ya, efu yu wani de basi a taawan tapu, da na yu mu saka yuseefi e dini den taawan.
eng_text: But he who is greatest among you will be your servant.

djk_text: Na sama di e saka denseefi so, na den Masaa Gadu o gi wan hei peesi. Ma Masaa Gadu o saka ala sama di e hei denseefi, poti a ondoo fu ala den taawan.”
eng_text: Whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.

djk_text: Soseefi Masaa Jesesi taki go doo taki: “Ma heelu fu u, leliman fu Dyuweiti anga Faliseiman! Bika u na bidiigiman! U taampu e tapu pasi gi den sama di wani kon a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text:
Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you devour widows' houses, and as a pretense you make long prayers. Therefore you will receive greater condemnation.

Because you shut up the Kingdom of Heaven against men; for you don't enter in yourselves, neither do you allow those who are entering in to enter.

djk_text: “Fu tuu! Heelu fu u, leliman fu Dyuweiti anga Faliseiman! Bika u na bidiigiman! U e waka e lontu goontapu, fu suku sama tyai kon toon u bakaman. Da u e meke sowan sama kon ogii tu boo moo u seefi. Da enseefi e kon lepi fu go teke sitaafu a didibii faya, enke u de tu.
eng_text: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you travel around by sea and land to make one proselyte; and when he becomes one, you make him twice as much of a son of Gehenna as yourselves.

djk_text: Na dati meke Masaa Gadu o fika u.

djk_text: Da u ná o si mi moo, te enke u sa bali taki: ‘Seigi fu Awan di e kon a ini a nen fu Masaa.’ ”
eng_text: For I tell you, you will not see me from now on, until you say, 'Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!'"

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi waka go a doose fu a Mama Keliki. We, ne den bakaman fi en seefi teke ne en baka. Da den e gi toli anga Masaa Jesesi. Soseefi den e soi en taki, a Mama Keliki na wan tuutuu moi osu.
eng_text: Jesus went out from the temple, and was going on his way. His disciples came to him to show him the buildings of the temple.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “U si fa a moi tuu? Ma fu tuu a ná o taampu ape moi moi so, go doo. Bika fetiman o komoto kon lulu lulu en booko doo doti.”
eng_text: But he answered them, "You see all of these things, don't you? Most certainly I tell you, there will not be left here one stone on another, that will not be thrown down."

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi waka go doo a peesi den e kai Oleifi Mongo. Na ape a siton, ne den bakaman fi en waka go doo ne en anda tu. A di den wawan de ape anga Masaa Jesesi, ne den akisi en taki: “I sa taigi wi on ten a toli di i taki de o pasa? Soseefi, i sa taigi wi san na a ten, di yu o kon anga a kaba fu goontapu tu?”
eng_text: As he sat on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to him privately, saying, "Tell us, when will these things be? What is the sign of your coming, and of the end of the age?"

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi wasikoi den taki: “Wan sani! U mu e luku bun namo! U mu luku bun, fu sama á fende pasi koli u kisi!
eng_text: Jesus answered them, "Be careful that no one leads you astray.

djk_text: Bika somen sama o kon enke na den na a Kelestesi. Na so den o wooko anga mi nen, fu koli sama kisi. Da den o fende somen sama, koli waka a den baka.
eng_text: For many will come in my name, saying, 'I am the Christ,' and will lead many astray.

djk_text: Soseefi oloku sa e bali na ala se fu goontapu. Ma u á mu dyombo fu dati. Bika ala den sani ya mu pasa leti so. Ma toku, da a ná kaba yuu fu goontapu doo ape ete.
eng_text: You will hear of wars and rumors of wars. See that you aren't troubled, for all this must happen, but the end is not yet.

djk_text: Bika foluku o feti ete anga foluku. Soseefi den kondee anga kondee fu goontapu sa e feti anga denseefi. Gaan angiiten o naki somen peesi fu goontapu tu. Soseefi doti o go e seke e piiti son pisi fu goontapu.
eng_text: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom; and there will be famines, plagues, and earthquakes in various places.

djk_text: Ma ala den sowtu banowtu ya na bigin fu a gaan banowtu ten, di de fu kon seefi. Bika a banowtu fu goontapu o waka enke a hii banowtu di wan bee uman e fii.
eng_text: But all these things are the beginning of birth pains.

djk_text: “Soseefi sama o poti u a kuutu fesi, fu di u e biibi mi ede. Den o pina u, te enke den e kii u seefi. Bika a ten de, da ala sama o buuse u, fu mi ede.
eng_text: Then they will deliver you up to oppression, and will kill you. You will be hated by all of the nations for my name's sake.

djk_text: Da somen biibisama o lasi biibi a mi. Soseefi, son biibisama o sete buuse taa biibiwan. Soseefi biibiwan o de, di o tyai taawan go konkuu gi sama di nái biibi mi.
eng_text: Then many will stumble, and will deliver up one another, and will hate one another.

djk_text: Soseefi, yu o abi sama di o meke enke na den na apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu. Da den o fende somen sama koli poti e biibi den.
eng_text: Many false prophets will arise, and will lead many astray.

djk_text: We, fu di a ten sa e ogii so naamo, da somen sama o kaba fu wooko anga lobi fu taawan.
eng_text: Because iniquity will be multiplied, the love of many will grow cold.

djk_text: Ma ala sama di sa tei ati fu oli doo sa fende a libi fu tego.
eng_text: But he who endures to the end, the same will be saved.

djk_text: Da a Bun Nyunsu di e taki fu a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu seefi mu paati, doo hii goontapu, fu ala sama yee en. Fosi, da a kaba yuu fu goontapu sa kon.”
eng_text: This Good News of the Kingdom will be preached in the whole world for a testimony to all the nations, and then the end will come.

djk_text: Soseefi Masaa Jesesi taki ete taki: “Ma boiti ala san mi taki de, da wan taa ogii o pasa na a ten de tu, di o dyombo sama. Bika ogii ati sama o kon poli a apaiti peesi fu a Mama Keliki wan tuutuu fasi. Den o kon poti wan sani di á fiti ape. Ala dati o waka enke fa a apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu di den e kai Daniyeli be sikiifi a fositen taki, dati musu fu pasa.” A sama di e leisi a sani ya, mu leisi en bunbun fu fusutan san ai leisi.
eng_text:
