eng_text: Now when Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,

djk_text: Ma namo, di den sidon fu nyan, ne wan uman kon doo anga wan moi bataa anga wan gaan dii sumee switi fatu a ini. Ne a waka langa langa, te a Masaa Jesesi, a pe a sidon na a tafaa. Ne a kandi a apaiti fatu a Masaa Jesesi ede anga ala fa a sidon a tafaa fu nyan de.
eng_text: a woman came to him having an alabaster jar of very expensive ointment, and she poured it on his head as he sat at the table.

djk_text: Ma a sani di a uman du ya, á bun gi den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi seefi seefi. Ne den taki: “Saide meke a towe a dii switi fatu de poli so du?
eng_text: But when his disciples saw this, they were indignant, saying, "Why this waste?

djk_text: Bika a be sa moo bun, a be seli a fatu ya puu tyaipi moni. Da den be sa yeepi den pootiman anga a moni ya.”
eng_text: For this ointment might have been sold for much, and given to the poor."

djk_text: Ma di Masaa Jesesi si den e taki, ne a sabi kaba san den e taki. Ne a taigi den taki: “San u fende fowtu na a uman ya? Meke mi taigi u. A á du ogii, ye! Ma na wan gaan bun a du gi mi.
eng_text: However, knowing this, Jesus said to them, "Why do you trouble the woman? Because she has done a good work for me.

djk_text: Bika pootiman o de ya gi u alaten, fu u solugu. Ma mi ná o de anga u ya alaten.
eng_text: For you always have the poor with you; but you don't always have me.

djk_text: Bika a switi fatu di a uman kandi a mi ede ya, da na mi sikin a seeka so a fesi, fu a beli di den o beli mi.
eng_text: For in pouring this ointment on my body, she did it to prepare me for burial.

djk_text: We, fu tuu, mi e taigi u! Ala se fu goontapu pe den sa taki fu a Bun Nyunsu fu mi, den sa taki fu a gaan bun di a uman ya du gi mi ya tu.”
eng_text: Most certainly I tell you, wherever this Good News is preached in the whole world, what this woman has done will also be spoken of as a memorial of her."

djk_text: We, ne Judasi Iskaliyotu, wan fu den twalufu bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi opo vun. Ne tyaa tyaa, fu te a den hei apaiti begiman fu a Mama Keliki.
eng_text: Then one of the twelve, who was called Judas Iscariot, went to the chief priests,

djk_text: Ne a akisi den taki: “San u o pai mi, efu mi meke moiti gi u, fu u kisi en?” Ne den piki en taki: “We, u sa gi yu diitenti pisi solufu moni.” Ne den pai en moi, te a kaba. Ne a gwe.
eng_text: and said, "What are you willing to give me, that I should deliver him to you?" They weighed out for him thirty pieces of silver.

djk_text: Ne fanafu a dei de, ne ai suku wan bun okasi, fu a meke den kisi Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: From that time he sought opportunity to betray him.

djk_text: We, da na a fosi dei di den Dyu be e bigin fu nyan a beele sondee sowda na a Pasika Fesa, ne den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi kon ne en. Ne den akisi en taki: “Masaa! On se i wani u seeka peesi gi yu fi i nyan a Pasika Fesa?”
eng_text: Now on the first day of unleavened bread, the disciples came to Jesus, saying to him, "Where do you want us to prepare for you to eat the Passover?"

djk_text: Ne a piki den taki: “U go na a kondee di de leti a u fesi so, da u go a sowan sowan sama. Da u taigi en taki: ‘A yuu fu Masaa doo. A wani kon nyan a Pasika Fesa a yu osu, makandii anga den bakaman fi en.’ ”
eng_text: He said, "Go into the city to a certain person, and tell him, 'The Teacher says, "My time is at hand. I will keep the Passover at your house with my disciples."'"

djk_text: We, ne den bakaman go du enke fa Masaa Jesesi sende den. Ne den seeka, te a kaba, fu go nyan a Pasika Fesa.
eng_text: The disciples did as Jesus commanded them, and they prepared the Passover.

djk_text: Ne di sapaten, ne Masaa Jesesi anga den twalufu bakaman fi en sidon makandii a tafaa, fu nyan.
eng_text: Now when evening had come, he was reclining at the table with the twelve disciples.

djk_text: Da di den e nyan, ne Masaa Jesesi taki: “Fu tuu! Wan fu u ya o seli mi poti a ini den sama ana, den feyanti fu mi.”
eng_text: As they were eating, he said, "Most certainly I tell you that one of you will betray me."

djk_text: We, di Masaa Jesesi taki so, ne gaan tyali kisi den bakaman fi en, te ná sipowtu. Ne ibiiwan fu den bigin akisi en taki: “Masaa! A sa de taki, na mi o seli yu?”
eng_text: They were exceedingly sorrowful, and each began to ask him, "It isn't me, is it, Lord?"

djk_text: Namo a piki den taki: “We, na a sama di mi anga en dipi beele go a ini a seefi baafun. Ne en o seli mi so.
eng_text: He answered, "He who dipped his hand with me in the dish, the same will betray me.

djk_text: We, a de so taki, den apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu be sikiifi somen sani fu a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya. Da ala den sani de fiya mu pasa enke fa den be taki. Ma, heelu fu a sama di o seli a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya! A moo betee, a á be meke kon a ondoo goontapu wan dei.”
eng_text: The Son of Man goes, even as it is written of him, but woe to that man through whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would be better for that man if he had not been born."

djk_text: We, ne Judasi, a man di o seli en akisi en taki: “We, Mesiti! A sa de taki na mi?” Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Na leti enke fa i seefi taki de, na so a de.”
eng_text: Judas, who betrayed him, answered, "It isn't me, is it, Rabbi?" He said to him, "You said it."

djk_text: Ma di den e nyan te wan pisi, ne Masaa Jesesi teke wan beele. Ne a gi Masaa Gadu daa, te a kaba. Ne a booko en pisipisi, ne a gi den bakaman fi en. Ne a taigi den taki: “U teke a beele ya nyan! Bika a beele ya na mi sikin.”
eng_text: As they were eating, Jesus took bread, gave thanks for it, and broke it. He gave to the disciples, and said, "Take, eat; this is my body."

djk_text: Ne bakadati, ne a teke wan kan win. Ne a gi Masaa Gadu daa baka, te a kaba. Ne a kandi gi den bakaman fi en taki: “Luku ya! U diingi!
eng_text: He took the cup, gave thanks, and gave to them, saying, "All of you drink it,

djk_text: Bika a win ya na mi buulu di o lon, fu Masaa Gadu sa meke wan nyun kuudei anga libisama. Na a buulu ya o lon gi somen sama, fu gi den paadon fu takuudu anga ogii.”
eng_text: for this is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many for the remission of sins.

djk_text: Ne a taigi den baka taki: “Fu tuu, mi e taigi u! Mi ná o diingi win na a fasi ya moo, fu te enke mi anga u miti baka a ini a Nyun Tii fu mi Tata. Na anda u sa diingi en makandii baka, ma na wan hii nyun sowtu fasi.”
eng_text: But I tell you that I will not drink of this fruit of the vine from now on, until that day when I drink it anew with you in my Father's Kingdom."

djk_text: Namo, di den nyan te den kaba, ne den singi wan singi gi Masaa Gadu gaandi. Ne den opo komoto de e gwe na a mongo, di den e kai Oleifi Mongo.
eng_text: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “U si a neti ya? U ala fiya o lowe gwe fika mi, enke fa Masaa Gadu Buku taki. Bika a sikiifi taki: ‘Te mi o kii a soluguman fu den sikapu, da ala den sikapu o lon panya panya gwe na ala se.’
eng_text: Then Jesus said to them, "All of you will be made to stumble because of me tonight, for it is written, 'I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered.'

djk_text: Ma, te mi o weki baka, da mi sa waka go a u fesi a Galileya Kondee.”
eng_text: But after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee."

djk_text: Namo, di Masaa Jesesi taki so, ne Peitilisi piki wanten taki: “Masaa! Winsi ala den taawan ya o lowe gwe fika yu, mi dati noiti o fika yu.”
eng_text: But Peter answered him, "Even if all will be made to stumble because of you, I will never be made to stumble."

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi piki en baka taki: “Peitilisi! Fu tuutuu! Yu seefi o si tide neti. Bika fosi kaka bali, na yu ya seefi o lei kaba taki, yu á sabi mi, te dii boo seefi.”
eng_text: Jesus said to him, "Most certainly I tell you that tonight, before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times."

djk_text: Namo Peitilisi piki en baka taki: “Kweti! Mi fu taki dati? Winsi mi mu dede anga yu seefi, mi ná o sitee taki mi á sabi yu.” We, ne ala den taa bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi piki so, enke fa Peitilisi piki tu.
eng_text: Peter said to him, "Even if I must die with you, I will not deny you." All of the disciples also said likewise.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en e go te, den go doo a dyali di den e kai Getsemanei. Ne a taigi den taki: “U sidon ya luku mi! Mi o go so go begi!”
eng_text: Then Jesus came with them to a place called Gethsemane, and said to his disciples, "Sit here, while I go there and pray."

djk_text: Ne a teke Peitilisi anga den tu manpikin fu Da Sebedi, ne den waka go moo faawe a ini a dyali. Namo, a sani kon taanga gi Masaa Jesesi te, ne gaan tyali kisi en.
eng_text: He took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and severely troubled.

djk_text: Ne a taigi den taki: “Tuutuu tyali anga fuka moo mi te, a sa tyai dede kii mi. U tan ya anga mi! U á mu siibi!”
eng_text: Then he said to them, "My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here, and watch with me."

djk_text: Ne a waka go pikinso moo faawe. Ne a kai tapu fesi a doti anda e begi taki: “Kee, mi Tata! Mi e begi i. A kan di i lai gi mi, fu diingi ya, efi i sa puu en gi mi, fu mi á diingi en, da gaantangi puu en! Ma anga ala fa mi taki ya seefi, ma a ná san mi wani mu pasa. Ma meke sani waka enke fa yu wani!”
eng_text: He went forward a little, fell on his face, and prayed, saying, "My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass away from me; nevertheless, not what I desire, but what you desire."

djk_text: We, di a kaba begi so, ne a waka kon baka a den bakaman fi en. Ma a si den kai a siibi. Ne a kai den taki: “Peitilisi! U á poi meke taanga sikin, fu de anga ain wankodo yuu langa anga mi seefi, no?
eng_text: He came to the disciples, and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, "What, couldn't you watch with me for one hour?

djk_text: We, u weki oli waki! Da u begi taanga, fu didibii á wini u! Bika mi sabi taki u ati wani, ma sikin ná abi kaakiti sai.”
eng_text: Watch and pray, that you don't enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak."

djk_text: Ne a daai gwe baka go begi, di fu tu toon. A begi taki: “Mi Tata! Efu taa fasi á de, da yeepi mi, meke mi diingi a kan di de gi mi fu diingi ya. Bika na san yu wani, na dati mu pasa.”
eng_text: Again, a second time he went away, and prayed, saying, "My Father, if this cup can't pass away from me unless I drink it, your desire be done."

djk_text: Namo a daai go baka, ne a si den bakaman fi en kai a siibi baka. Bika siibi be e hebi den ain.
eng_text: He came again and found them sleeping, for their eyes were heavy.

djk_text: We, ne a fika den de, ne a go begi di fu dii toon. A begi a seefi begi.
eng_text: He left them again, went away, and prayed a third time, saying the same words.

djk_text: We, ne a daai kon baka a den bakaman fi en, ne a taigi den taki: “A siibi u e siibi e boo sikin so? We, a yuu de koosube, di den sa tyai a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya, go poti a ini den ogii ati sama ana.
eng_text: Then he came to his disciples, and said to them, "Sleep on now, and take your rest. Behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

djk_text: U opo meke u gwe! Bika a sama di o seli mi, doo koosube kaba.”
eng_text: Arise, let's be going. Behold, he who betrays me is at hand."

djk_text: We, Masaa Jesesi á kaba taki seefi, ne Judasi, wan fu den twalufu bakaman fi en, kon doo kaba anga wan gaan kulu sama. Den kon anga fetihow anga kodya dyagaa. Na den hei apaiti begiman anga den gaansama fu kondee sende den kon so.
eng_text: While he was still speaking, behold, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and clubs, from the chief priest and elders of the people.

djk_text: Ma a man di be seli Masaa Jesesi be gi den wan maiki a fesi kaba taki: “Awan di mi o bosi, ne en u mu kisi.”
eng_text: Now he who betrayed him gave them a sign, saying, "Whoever I kiss, he is the one. Seize him."

djk_text: Ne wanten, a waka go a Masaa Jesesi, ne a gi en odi taki: “Odi oo, Mesiti!” Ne a bosi en a sikin fesi piyow.
eng_text: Immediately he came to Jesus, and said, "Hail, Rabbi!" and kissed him.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi taigi en taki: “Mi mati! Ná daai daai! Du san i kon fu wanten!” Namo, ne den sama booko huu kon. Ne den kisi Masaa Jesesi gwullu kankan, oli fu den tyai gwe.
eng_text: Jesus said to him, "Friend, why are you here?" Then they came and laid hands on Jesus, and took him.

djk_text: Ma wan fu den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi toosi ana, teke en fetihow puu a dosu, ne a iti go. Ne velen! A koti a futuboi fu a moo hei apaiti begiman yesi, puu towe a doti pow.
eng_text: Behold, one of those who were with Jesus stretched out his hand, and drew his sword, and struck the servant of the high priest, and struck off his ear.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi taigi en taki: “Nono! Toosi i fetihow go a ini a saka baka! Bika a sama di teke fetihow fu feti, na fetihow sa kii den.
eng_text: Then Jesus said to him, "Put your sword back into its place, for all those who take the sword will die by the sword.

djk_text: Bika fa mi de ya, san i denki? Mi sa begi mi Tata, da wanten a sa sende onmen tenti dunsu Masaa Gadu Kondee Basiya fi en, kon puu mi a den sama ya ana.
eng_text: Or do you think that I couldn't ask my Father, and he would even now send me more than twelve legions of angels?

djk_text: Ma efu mi du dati, da fa den sani di sikiifi a Gadu Buku o kon pasa tuu enke fa den be sikiifi?”
eng_text: How then would the Scriptures be fulfilled that it must be so?"

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi daai taki anga den sama di kon kisi en de. A taki: “Fu saide meke u kon a mi ya anga fetihow anga kodya, fu kon kisi mi enke mi na wan gaan fufuuman? Bika ala yuu mi be de a ini a Mama Keliki e leli sama. Ma noiti u be poti ana a mi taki u be o kisi mi.
eng_text: In that hour Jesus said to the multitudes, "Have you come out as against a robber with swords and clubs to seize me? I sat daily in the temple teaching, and you didn't arrest me.

djk_text: Ma den sani ya musu pasa, fu meke den sani di den apaiti takiman fu Gadu be sikiifi mu kon tuu.” We, wanten de, ne ala den bakaman fi en lon gwe fika en wawan de.
eng_text: But all this has happened, that the Scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled." Then all the disciples left him, and fled.

djk_text: Namo den sama di kisi Masaa Jesesi, tyai en go na a osu fu Kayafasi, a moo hei apaiti begiman. Da den leliman fu Dyuweiti anga gaansama fu kondee be kon de makandii, fu den tyai Masaa Jesesi kon.
eng_text: Those who had taken Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were gathered together.

djk_text: Ma anga ala fa den e tyai Masaa Jesesi go de, da Peitilisi seefi be e waka faawe e kon a den baka. Ne den waka te, ne den doo a dyali fu a moo hei apaiti begiman. Peitilisi seefi pasa go a ini a dyali. Ne a go sidon a ini den sama di e oli wakiti na a peesi de. Bika a be wani si fa ala sani o waka anga Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: But Peter followed him from a distance, to the court of the high priest, and entered in and sat with the officers, to see the end.

djk_text: Namo, den hei apaiti begiman anga a hii Dyulanti fu kuutu e suku leilei sani poti a Masaa Jesesi neki tapu, fu den sa fende en kii.
eng_text: Now the chief priests, the elders, and the whole council sought false testimony against Jesus, that they might put him to death;

djk_text: Ma anga ala fa den e piki sani fi en taki, ma den á fende ná wan sani taki, na a sani ya den fende, fu a mu dede. Te fu kaba, ne tu man dati dyombo kon a fesi, fu kotoigi.
eng_text: and they found none. Even though many false witnesses came forward, they found none. But at last two false witnesses came forward,

djk_text: Ne den bali taki: “A be gafa taki, a sa booko a Mama Keliki, da a ini dii dei a sa meke en baka.”
eng_text: and said, "This man said, 'I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.'"

djk_text: Ne vun! A moo hei apaiti begiman opo taampu. Ne a akisi Masaa Jesesi taki: “Yee san den taki fi i de. San yu abi fu piki fu dati?”
eng_text: The high priest stood up, and said to him, "Have you no answer? What is this that these testify against you?"

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi á piki en. A dati meke a moo hei apaiti begiman ya akisi en baka taki: “Mi teke Masaa Gadu nen begi yu, piki wi! Na yu na a Kelestesi, a Manpikin fu Masaa Gadu?”
eng_text: But Jesus held his peace. The high priest answered him, "I adjure you by the living God, that you tell us whether you are the Christ, the Son of God."

djk_text: Namo, Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “We, na iseefi taki de. Da a yuu o doo, da u o si a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya sidon na a leti ana fu Masaa Gadu, di abi ala taanga a goontapu. U o si a komoto a den woluku tapu anda e kon.”
eng_text: Jesus said to him, "You have said it. Nevertheless, I tell you, after this you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming on the clouds of the sky."

djk_text: We, ne di Masaa Jesesi piki so, ne a moo hei apaiti begiman ati teke faya! Ne a piiti en koosi ne en sikin. Ne a taki: “A kosi Masaa Gadu. A á de fu u suku kotoigi moo. Bika u seefi yee, fa a kosi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Then the high priest tore his clothing, saying, "He has spoken blasphemy! Why do we need any more witnesses? Behold, now you have heard his blasphemy.

djk_text: San u denki u mu du anga en?” Ne den piki taki: “Taa fasi á de fu du. A dede namo a mu dede.”
eng_text: What do you think?" They answered, "He is worthy of death!"

djk_text: Ne den bigin towe wataa mofu ne en fesi. Den e naki en anga kofu. Taawan e naki en anga baka ana a sikin fesi.
eng_text: Then they spit in his face and beat him with their fists, and some slapped him,

djk_text: Da den e deleigi en taki: “Kelestesi! I taki yu anga Masaa Gadu e taki, puu gi wi, osi? Sama naki yu?”
eng_text: saying, "Prophesy to us, you Christ! Who hit you?"

djk_text: We a ten de, da Peitilisi be sidon a ini a dyali ete. Namo wan pikin uman di e wooko gi a moo hei apaiti begiman, koi kon ne en. Ne a akisi en taki: “Tan, osi? Man, yu a ná wan fu den man di be e waka anga Masaa Jesesi fu Galileya, no?”
eng_text: Now Peter was sitting outside in the court, and a maid came to him, saying, "You were also with Jesus, the Galilean!"

djk_text: Ma Peitilisi sitee na ala den sama de fesi taki: “Sama? Mi? Nono! Mi á sabi a man di yu e taki de, kweti kweti!”
eng_text: But he denied it before them all, saying, "I don't know what you are talking about."

djk_text: Namo Peitilisi opo komoto de, go taampu na a dyali mofu. Ma wan taa pikin uman kon, ne a taigi den taa sama de taki: “U luku wan fu den man fu Jesesi fu Nasaleti ya!”
eng_text: When he had gone out onto the porch, someone else saw him, and said to those who were there, "This man also was with Jesus of Nazareth."

djk_text: Namo Peitilisi daai sitee e sweli baka taki: “Mi á sabi a sama di u e taki de, kweti kweti!”
eng_text: Again he denied it with an oath, "I don't know the man."

djk_text: Pikinso moo a baka, ne den sama di taampu de kon a Peitilisi, ne den taigi en taki: “Na tuu! Yu na wan fu den man di be e waka a Masaa Jesesi fu Galileya baka tuu. Bika yu e taki enke wan sama fu Galileya.”
eng_text: After a little while those who stood by came and said to Peter, "Surely you are also one of them, for your speech makes you known."

djk_text: Namo, ne Peitilisi taki a o sitee now. Ne ai sitee, ai fuuku enseefi, ai sweli taki: “Mi e taigi u taki, a man de, mi á sabi en wan dei.” Ne di Peitilisi taki so, ne wanten, ne wan kakafoo bali kokoliyekee!
eng_text: Then he began to curse and to swear, "I don't know the man!" Immediately the rooster crowed.

djk_text: We, ne a pakisei a sani, di Masaa Jesesi be taigi en taki: “Peitilisi! Fosi kakafoo bali, yu o lei dii boo taki, yu á sabi mi.” We, ne gaan tyali fuu Peitilisi ati wanten, fu san a du ya. Ne a komoto a doo, poti ana a mindii ede bali wan gaan adyumadye.
eng_text: Peter remembered the word which Jesus had said to him, "Before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times." He went out and wept bitterly.

djk_text: We, ne di debooko, mamanten fuuku, ne den moo hei apaiti begiman anga den gaansama fu kondee oli wan gaan kuutu, fu luku fa den o du fu kii Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: Now when morning had come, all the chief priests and the elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death:

djk_text: Ne den bwui Masaa Jesesi te a kaba, ne den tyai en gwe a Gaaman Pilatesi di Loma lanti be poti, fu tii Dyusama.
eng_text: and they bound him, and led him away, and delivered him up to Pontius Pilate, the governor.

djk_text: Ma di Judasi si taki, den kuutu Masaa Jesesi taki, a mu dede, ne a sani ati en tee! A á sabi fa a mu du. Ne a teke den diitenti pisi moni di den be pai en, ne a tyai den go gi den moo hei apaiti begiman anga den gaansama fu kondee baka.
eng_text: Then Judas, who betrayed him, when he saw that Jesus was condemned, felt remorse, and brought back the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,

djk_text: Ne a taigi den taki: “Mi du wan gaan ogii! Mi seli wan tuutuu sama sondee fowtu, fu kii towe en buulu.” Namo den piki en taki: “Di yu e kon taigi wi, da san i wani wi mu du? U ná abi bisi anga yu! Na yuseefi mu sabi san fu du anga iseefi.”
eng_text: saying, "I have sinned in that I betrayed innocent blood." But they said, "What is that to us? You see to it."

djk_text: Ne di den taigi en so, ne a iti a moni go a ini a Mama Keliki a doti anda. Ne waka gwe, ne a lenge lenge enseefi a tetei kii.
eng_text: He threw down the pieces of silver in the sanctuary, and departed. He went away and hanged himself.

djk_text: We, ne den hei apaiti begiman piki a moni teke. Ne den taki: “A moni ya á bun fu poti na a keliki kasi. Bika a weiti sikiifi taki: ‘Moni di towe buulu á mu go a ini a keliki kasi.’ ”
eng_text: The chief priests took the pieces of silver, and said, "It's not lawful to put them into the treasury, since it is the price of blood."

djk_text: We, ne den kai pakisei te den kaba, fa fu du anga a moni. Namo den fiti taki: “Wi o teke a moni ya go bai wan pisi doti, na a man di e meke doti patu. Da u o meke ape toon wan belipe, fu e beli doose kondee sama.”
eng_text: They took counsel, and bought the potter's field with them, to bury strangers in.

djk_text: We, ne fanafu a ten de, ne den e kai a pisi doti de, Buulu Doti te enke a dei fu tide.
eng_text: Therefore that field was called "The Field of Blood" to this day.

djk_text: Da a hii pisi toli ya waka enke fa a fositen apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu den e kai Jelemija be taki, taki: “Den sama fu Islayeli Kondee oli en, fu wan sama di waiti diitenti pisi solufu moni namo.
eng_text: Then that which was spoken through Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled, saying, "They took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him upon whom a price had been set, whom some of the children of Israel priced,

djk_text: Ne den teke a seefi diitenti pisi solufu moni de bai a pisi tokotoko doti, na a man di e meke doti patu. Na so Masaa Gadu taigi mi fu du.”
eng_text: and they gave them for the potter's field, as the Lord commanded me."

djk_text: We, di den tyai Masaa Jesesi go a Gaaman Pilatesi, ne a gaaman akisi en taki: “Yu na a kownu fu den Dyusama tuu?” Namo, ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “We, na iseefi taki en de kaba.”
eng_text: Now Jesus stood before the governor: and the governor asked him, saying, "Are you the King of the Jews?" Jesus said to him, "So you say."

djk_text: Soseefi den hei apaiti begiman anga den gaansama fu kondee e tyai somen kaagi fu Masaa Jesesi kon a fesi. Ma Masaa Jesesi nái tufee a den seefi!
eng_text: When he was accused by the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.

djk_text: Namo Gaaman Pilatesi akisi en baka taki: “We, yu nái yee den somen kaagi, di den sama e gi fi i de, no? Da yu nái piki, no?”
eng_text: Then Pilate said to him, "Don't you hear how many things they testify against you?"

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi á piki ná wan wowtu. A dati meke a gaaman foondoo te, ná sipowtu.
eng_text: He gave him no answer, not even one word, so that the governor marveled greatly.

djk_text: Ma, da a be de so taki, te a Pasika Fesa doo, da a gaaman be abi a gwenti, fu puu wan sama di lanti wani, a dunguu osu gi den.
eng_text: Now at the feast the governor was accustomed to release to the multitude one prisoner, whom they desired.

djk_text: Ma, da a seefi yuu ten de, da wan gaan ogiiman den e kai Balabasi be de a dunguu osu.
eng_text: They had then a notable prisoner, called Barabbas.

djk_text: We, ne Gaaman Pilatesi daai, ne a taki anga den somen sama di be de ape taki: “Den sama ya! U aliki! Sama u wani mi losi, puu a sitaafu gi u? Mi losi Balabasi gi u, ofuso Jesesi, di den e kai a Kelestesi?”
eng_text: When therefore they were gathered together, Pilate said to them, "Whom do you want me to release to you? Barabbas, or Jesus, who is called Christ?"

djk_text: Bika Pilatesi be sabi kiinkiin taki, fa den tyai Masaa Jesesi kon ne en de, na fu dyalusu ede meke den be tyai en kon.
eng_text: For he knew that because of envy they had delivered him up.

djk_text: Namo, ne Gaaman Pilatesi go sidon na a sutuu pe ai kuutu sama. Na ape a de, ne en uman sende sama taigi en taki: “Pilatesi! Yu á mu de a ini a kuutu fu kuutu a sama di de sondee fowtu de. Bika a neti ya, da mi deen wan deen fi en di go a mi ati tuutuu.”
eng_text: While he was sitting on the judgment seat, his wife sent to him, saying, "Have nothing to do with that righteous man, for I have suffered many things this day in a dream because of him."

djk_text: We, a yuu ten di Gaaman Pilatesi sidon e aliki a mofu fi en uman de, ne den hei apaiti begiman anga den gaansama fu kondee e meke moiti e dwengi den sama taki: “U piki taki, meke a losi Balabasi gi u. Ma meke a kii Jesesi.”
eng_text: Now the chief priests and the elders persuaded the multitudes to ask for Barabbas, and destroy Jesus.

djk_text: We, ne a gaaman akisi den sama baka taki: “On di fu den tu sama ya u wani mi losi gi u?” Namo den sama bali piki taki: “Balabasi! Na Balabasi i mu losi gi wi!”
eng_text: But the governor answered them, "Which of the two do you want me to release to you?" They said, "Barabbas!"

djk_text: Ne Gaaman Pilatesi akisi den taki: “Da san mi mu du anga Jesesi, di den e kai Kelestesi?” Ne den sama bali taki: “Sipikii en kii a koloisi!”
eng_text: Pilate said to them, "What then shall I do to Jesus, who is called Christ?" They all said to him, "Let him be crucified!"

djk_text: Ne Gaaman Pilatesi akisi den baka taki: “We, on ogii seefi a du?” Ho! Den sama bali moo taanga taki: “U sipikii en! U sipikii en a koloisi kii!”
eng_text: But the governor said, "Why? What evil has he done?" But they cried out exceedingly, saying, "Let him be crucified!"

djk_text: We, di Gaaman Pilatesi kon si taki, a opuulu fu kii Masaa Jesesi e bigi naamo, ne a teke wataa, ne a wasi en ana, na ala sama fesi de. Ne a taki: “Mi wasi ana puu mi seefi a ini. Bika mi á poi kuutu sowan sama taki, en buulu mu lon. Da a fika gi u. Ala sani fi en, fika a u neki tapu.”
eng_text: So when Pilate saw that nothing was being gained, but rather that a disturbance was starting, he took water, and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, "I am innocent of the blood of this righteous person. You see to it."

djk_text: We, ne ala den Dyusama di be de ape bali taki: “Eeye! Meke a fika a wi anga den pikin fu wi neki tapu taki, na wi kii en!”
eng_text: All the people answered, "May his blood be on us, and on our children!"

djk_text: Namo, ne Pilatesi losi Balabasi gi den. Ne a sende den suudati fi en, fu den fon Masaa Jesesi. Ne a gi den en, fu den tyai go sipikii kii a koloisi.
eng_text: Then he released to them Barabbas, but Jesus he flogged and delivered to be crucified.

djk_text: Namo, den suudati teke Masaa Jesesi tyai gwe a Gaaman Dyali. Ne den kai ala den taa suudati fu den. Ne ala den fiya ali kon lontu Masaa Jesesi poti a dyali.
eng_text: Then the governor's soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium, and gathered the whole garrison together against him.

djk_text: Ne den puu den koosi fi en, di a be wei, ne en sikin. Ne den wei wan langa lebi dyakiti enke di kownu e wei gi.
eng_text: They stripped him, and put a scarlet robe on him.

djk_text: Ne den teke wan agwago maka, ne den lolo en, te a kaba enke kownu ati, ne den toosi ne en ede soo. Ne den koti wan pisi kamaluwa poti, ne en letise ana, fu pee enke dati na wan kownu tiki. Ne den e wisiwasi en e saka kini a doti e bali taki: “Odi oo kownu fu Dyu! Odi oo!”
eng_text: They braided a crown of thorns and put it on his head, and a reed in his right hand; and they kneeled down before him, and mocked him, saying, "Hail, King of the Jews!"

djk_text: Den e towe wataa mofu ne en. Ne den puu a tiki a ini en ana, ne den e naki en anga en, ne en ede seefi, gwogwo onmen tenti leisi.
eng_text: They spat on him, and took the reed and struck him on the head.

djk_text: We, ne di den mesaandi en, te den kaba, ne den puu a dyakiti di den be wei gi en, teke baka. Ne den wei den seefi kosi gi en baka, di a be wei a fesi. Ne den e tyai en gwe, fu go sipikii kii a koloisi.
eng_text: When they had mocked him, they took the robe off of him, and put his clothes on him, and led him away to crucify him.

djk_text: Ma di den e tyai Masaa Jesesi gwe te wan pisi, ne den miti wan man den e kai Simon fu Sileni Kondee a pasi. We, ne den dwengi en anga taanga fu a tyai a koloisi gi Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: As they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name, and they compelled him to go with them, that he might carry his cross.

djk_text: We, ne den waka te den doo na a peesi. Na a peesi ya den e kai go kai Golgata. Dati wani taki, Edebon Peesi.
eng_text: They came to a place called "Golgotha," that is to say, "The place of a skull."

djk_text: Ne den teke win mokisa anga bita, ne den gi en, fu a diingi. Ma di a tesi en kaba, ne a á wani en.
eng_text: They gave him sour wine to drink mixed with gall. When he had tasted it, he would not drink.

djk_text: We, ne den sipikii Masaa Jesesi na a koloisi. Ne den opo en taampu. Ne den teke den koosi di a be wei, ne den iti lowte luku sama anga sama o wini den koosi fi en. Ne den paati den.
eng_text: When they had crucified him, they divided his clothing among them, casting lots,

djk_text: We, di den du so te den kaba, ne den saka sidon de e oli waki a Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: and they sat and watched him there.

djk_text: Ma den be sikiifi wan sani a wan pisi paanga poti a edese fu a koloisi anda, fu saide meke den kii Masaa Jesesi. Den sikiifi taki:
eng_text: They set up over his head the accusation against him written, "THIS IS JESUS, THE KING OF THE JEWS."

djk_text: Ma boiti Masaa Jesesi, da den be e kii tu taa man makandii anga en de. Wan de ne en letise, a taawan de ne en kukutu ana se. Masaa Jesesi seefi de a mindii. We, den tu taa sama de, na sama di be de gaan fufuu kiiman.
eng_text: Then there were two robbers crucified with him, one on his right hand and one on the left.

djk_text: Da somen sama be e waka e pasa de, a pe den be koloisi Masaa Jesesi. Da te den si Masaa Jesesi, da den e kosi en, e wisiwasi en, e seke ede.
eng_text: Those who passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads,

djk_text: Den taki: “Yu di be taki, yu o booko a Mama Keliki meke a ini dii dei baka! We, da san meke yu á poi yeepi iseefi nownow, puu na a koloisi? Efi yu na a Pikin fu Masaa Gadu tuu, da saka komoto na a koloisi de meke u si, no?”
eng_text: and saying, "You who destroy the temple, and build it in three days, save yourself! If you are the Son of God, come down from the cross!"

djk_text: Soseefi den hei apaiti begiman anga den leliman fu Dyuweiti anga den gaansama fu kondee e sipowtu e poti en wisiwasi tu. Den taki:
eng_text: Likewise the chief priests also mocking, with the scribes, the Pharisees, and the elders, said,

djk_text: “We, a be e yeepi taa sama. Ne san meke a á poi yeepi enseefi? Efu en na a kownu fu Islayeli Kondee tuu, da meke a saka komoto na a koloisi kon a doti, da u sa biibi en.
eng_text:
He saved others, but he can't save himself. If he is the King of Israel, let him come down from the cross now, and we will believe in him.
1020	Bika a be taki, ai poti fitoow a Gadu. We, da meke Gadu yeepi en, no? Efu a wani en? Bika a be taki: ‘Mi na a Manpikin fu Masaa Gadu.’ ”	1020	He trusts in God. Let God deliver him now, if he wants him; for he said, 'I am the Son of God.'

djk_text: We, soseefi den tu fufuu kiiman di den be sipikii a koloisi ne en se de be e wisiwasi en, e kosi en meke sipowtu.
eng_text: The robbers also who were crucified with him cast on him the same reproach.

djk_text: Ma fanafu twalufu yuu, mindii dei, te go miti dii yuu bakadina, ne a hii kondee dunguu pii.
eng_text: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land until the ninth hour.

djk_text: Da na a dii yuu de, ne Masaa Jesesi bali taanga taki: “
eng_text: About the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, "Eli, Eli, lima sabachthani?" That is, "My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?"

djk_text: Ma son fu den sama di taampu de taki: “U yee anda! Ai kai Eliya! Ai kai Eliya, fu kon yeepi en.”
eng_text: Some of them who stood there, when they heard it, said, "This man is calling Elijah."

djk_text: Ne wanten de, ne wan fu den lon go teke wan siponsu, ne a dipi en go a ini wan sowtu win. Ne a poti a wan tiki ede langa gi Masaa Jesesi, fu a diingi.
eng_text: Immediately one of them ran, and took a sponge, and filled it with vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him a drink.

djk_text: Ma den taawan bali taki: “Tan, tan, tan! Meke u luku efu Eliya o kon yeepi en tuu.”
eng_text: The rest said, "Let him be. Let's see whether Elijah comes to save him."

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi bali ete wan leisi taanga, ne en boo koti.
eng_text: Jesus cried again with a loud voice, and yielded up his spirit.

djk_text: We, ne a seefi yuu de, ne a gaanbigi deki koosi di be tapu a kambaa fu Masaa Gadu a ini Mama Keliki, piiti komoto a tapu, fu te a doti tyow. A fika wangang. Namo goontapu seefi e seke, e bali. Gaan siton e bali e piiti.
eng_text: Behold, the veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom. The earth quaked and the rocks were split.

djk_text: Goontapu seke te, somen geebi pe den be beli sama booko opo. Namo somen sama di den be beli a den geebi de, di be de apaiti fasi gi Masaa Gadu, weki komoto a ini den geebi, kon a libi baka.
eng_text: The tombs were opened, and many bodies of the saints who had fallen asleep were raised;

djk_text: Ne den komoto a ini den geebi, di Masaa Jesesi seefi weki baka komoto a dede, di fu dii dei. Ne den go a Jelusalem, a apaiti foto fu Masaa Gadu. Somen sama si den, fa den weki baka so.
eng_text: and coming out of the tombs after his resurrection, they entered into the holy city and appeared to many.

djk_text: Ma di a edeman fu suudati anga den suudati fi en di be e oli waki a Masaa Jesesi si, fa a goontapu seke anga ala san pasa, ne den feele te. Den taki: “A sama ya, na be a Manpikin fu Masaa Gadu tuu.”
eng_text: Now the centurion, and those who were with him watching Jesus, when they saw the earthquake, and the things that were done, feared exceedingly, saying, "Truly this was the Son of God."

djk_text: Ma namo, da somen uman sama seefi be taampu, te a faawe e luku, fa sani e waka anga Masaa Jesesi. Bika den uman ya be waka komoto a Galileya anga Masaa Jesesi fu solugu en naamo.
eng_text: Many women were there watching from afar, who had followed Jesus from Galilee, serving him.

djk_text: Wan fu den na Maliya fu Makidala, a taawan na Maliya, a mma fu Jakowbesi anga Jowsef anga a mma fu den tu manpikin fu Da Sebedi.
eng_text: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of the sons of Zebedee.

djk_text: Ma di sapaten mofu, ne wan guduman den be kai Jowsef fu Alimateya Kondee, kon doo de. Na wan man di be e biibi a Masaa Jesesi tu.
eng_text: When evening had come, a rich man from Arimathaea, named Joseph, who himself was also Jesus' disciple came.

djk_text: Namo a go a Gaaman Pilatesi go akisi en, fu a gi en pasi, fu a teke a dede sikin fu Masaa Jesesi tyai go beli. Ne Pilatesi sende den suudati fi en, go puu a dede sikin fu Masaa Jesesi na a koloisi gi en.
eng_text: This man went to Pilate, and asked for Jesus' body. Then Pilate commanded the body to be given up.

djk_text: Namo, ne Jowsef teke a dede sikin fu Masaa Jesesi, ne a lolo en a sibikoosi te a kaba.
eng_text: Joseph took the body, and wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,

djk_text: Ne a tyai en go beli a wan nyun nyun siton geebi olo, di diki, a be diki fi enseefi, a wan heihei siton sikin. Di a kaba, ne a lolo wan gaan gindin siton tapu a olo mofu, ne a waka gwe.
eng_text: and laid it in his own new tomb, which he had cut out in the rock, and he rolled a great stone to the door of the tomb, and departed.

djk_text: Ma namo, da Maliya fu Makidala anga a taa Maliya be de ape tu. Den be sidon na abaase fu a geebi e luku.
eng_text: Mary Magdalene was there, and the other Mary, sitting opposite the tomb.

djk_text: A taa dei fi en, da a dei di den be e seeka gi a kina dei fu den Dyusama pasa kaba. Ma den hei apaiti begiman anga den Faliseiman go makandii a Gaaman Pilatesi.
eng_text: Now on the next day, which was the day after the Preparation Day, the chief priests and the Pharisees were gathered together to Pilate,

djk_text: Ne den taki: “Masaa! U membee wan sani di a bidiigiman be taki, fosi a dede. A be gafa taki: ‘A o dede. Ma baka dii dei, a o weki baka kon a libi.’
eng_text: saying, "Sir, we remember what that deceiver said while he was still alive: 'After three days I will rise again.'

djk_text: Na dati meke u kon begi gaaman, fu poti suudati oli wakiti na a geebi dii dei langa. Bika efu u á du so, da den bakaman fi en sa go fufuu en, da den go lei taki, na weki a weki baka komoto a dede. Bika efu wi á du dati, da a koli ya o ogii moo fa den be e koli sama a fesi kaba.”
eng_text: Command therefore that the tomb be made secure until the third day, lest perhaps his disciples come at night and steal him away, and tell the people, 'He is risen from the dead;' and the last deception will be worse than the first."

djk_text: We, ne Gaaman Pilatesi piki den taki: “We! U teke suudati, enke wakitiman, tyai go poti, da u seeka a geebi tapu enke fa u sa tapu en.”
eng_text: Pilate said to them, "You have a guard. Go, make it as secure as you can."

djk_text: We, ne di a gaaman gi den pasi so, ne den go tapu a geebi enke fa den poi. Den poti wan maiki ne en fu soi taki, a de tapu tapu. Ne den poti suudati e waki de.
eng_text: So they went with the guard and made the tomb secure, sealing the stone.

djk_text: We, fa i si a kina dei pasa, a fosi dei fu a wiki fuuku mamanten, ne Maliya fu Makidala anga a taa Maliya go luku a geebi fu Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: Now after the Sabbath, as it began to dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to see the tomb.

djk_text: Ma namo, da doti be seke te, ná sipowtu. Bika wan Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee saka komoto a tapu anda kon na a geebi. Ne a puu a gaanbigi siton di be tapu a olo mofu. Ne a sidon na a siton de tapu.
eng_text: Behold, there was a great earthquake, for an angel of the Lord descended from the sky, and came and rolled away the stone from the door, and sat on it.

djk_text: A Basiya ya fesi be e koti faya enke te tapu e koti faya. Da den koosi fi en sikin weti fann enke sukuma.
eng_text: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothing white as snow.

djk_text: We, ne den suudati di be de ape e waki feele te, den e beifi. Namo den de pii enke den dede.
eng_text: For fear of him, the guards shook, and became like dead men.

djk_text: We, ne a Basiya bigin fu taki anga den tu uman taki: “Uman! U á feele so! Mi sabi taki na Masaa Jesesi, di den sipikii kii a koloisi u e suku.
eng_text: The angel answered the women, "Don't be afraid, for I know that you seek Jesus, who has been crucified.

djk_text: We, a á de ya moo! A weki baka leti enke fa a be taigi u fosi, a be dede. U kon luku pe den be poti en a ini a geebi. U si? Sama á de ape moo.
eng_text: He is not here, for he has risen, just like he said. Come, see the place where the Lord was lying.

djk_text: Da u daai go esi baka a osu, fu taigi den bakaman fi en taki, a weki baka komoto a dede. Da a o waka a den fesi go a Galileya. Na anda en anga den o miti, enke fa a be taigi den. We, da na so mi soi u kaba.”
eng_text: Go quickly and tell his disciples, 'He has risen from the dead, and behold, he goes before you into Galilee; there you will see him.' Behold, I have told you."

djk_text: We, na so den uman ya daai gwe baka. Ne den pantan te, ma toku seefi den e piisii gaan piisii. Ne den e lon go, fu tyai a nyunsu ya go gi den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: They departed quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy, and ran to bring his disciples word.

djk_text: Ma, te fu den membee, ne den anga Masaa Jesesi seefi miti a pasi haa! Ne Masaa Jesesi gi den odi taki: “Den uman ya, u weki oo!” We, ne den waka go miti Masaa Jesesi, ne den saka kini a doti ne en fesi, ne den kisi en futu e baasa.
eng_text: As they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, "Rejoice!" They came and took hold of his feet, and worshiped him.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “Uman! U á feele. Ma u go taigi den baala fu mi taki, meke den go a Galileya. Da na anda mi anga den o miti.”
eng_text: Then Jesus said to them, "Don't be afraid. Go tell my brothers that they should go into Galilee, and there they will see me."

djk_text: We, a yuu di den uman ya de a pasi e gwe, ne son fu den suudati komoto a pe den be e oli waki na a geebi. Ne den go a ini a foto, ne den taigi den hei apaiti begiman ala san pasa a pe den be e oli waki, na a geebi.
eng_text: Now while they were going, behold, some of the guards came into the city, and told the chief priests all the things that had happened.

djk_text: We, di den hei apaiti begiman yee so kaba, ne den kai ala den gaansama fu kondee kon makandii anga den. Ne den kuutu, te den kaba. Ne den pai den suudati wan gaan moni.
eng_text: When they were assembled with the elders, and had taken counsel, they gave a large amount of silver to the soldiers,

djk_text: Ne den taigi den taki: “We, u aliki! U mu piki sama taki, u be kai a siibi, ne den bakaman fi en kon fufuu en tyai gwe.
eng_text: saying, "Say that his disciples came by night, and stole him away while we slept.

djk_text: Bika efu a taki ya doo gaaman yesi, da wi sabi fa wi o taki anga en, fu koo en ati, fu u á kisi sitaafu.”
eng_text: If this comes to the governor's ears, we will persuade him and make you free of worry."

djk_text: We, ne den wakitiman teke a moni, ne den e taki leti enke fa den hei apaiti begiman be taigi den, fu den taki. Da enke fa den e taki en de, na so den Dyusama teke en e taki, te doo tide ete seefi.
eng_text: So they took the money and did as they were told. This saying was spread abroad among the Jews, and continues until this day.

djk_text: We, ne den elufu bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi go a Galileya Kondee. Ne den go na a mongo, di a be taigi den a fesi fu den go.
eng_text: But the eleven disciples went into Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had sent them.

djk_text: Ne di den si en, ne den sutu kini a doti ne en fesi, ne den begi en. Ma son fu den be e tan enke den á be wani biibi.
eng_text: When they saw him, they bowed down to him, but some doubted.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi waka kon a den. Ne a taigi den taki: “Mi kisi ala makiti a Masaa Gadu Kondee a tapu anda anga goontapu ya.
eng_text: Jesus came to them and spoke to them, saying, "All authority has been given to me in heaven and on earth.

djk_text: Da u go a hii goontapu, fu go paati a bosikopu gi ala foluku. Meke den daai kon toon bakaman fu mi. U dopu den a ini a nen fu a Tata, a nen fu a Manpikin anga a nen fu a Apaiti Jeje fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Go, and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,

djk_text: Da u leli den, fu den oli ala san mi be leli u. Da fu tuu! Mi de anga u alaten, fu te na a kaba fu goontapu!”
eng_text: teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age." Amen.

djk_text: Disi na a bigin fu a Bun Nyunsu fu Jesesi Kelestesi, a Manpikin fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: The beginning of the Good News of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.

djk_text: Enke fa Jesaja, wan apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu be sikiifi a fositen taki: “Mi Masaa Gadu ya o sende mi bosikopuman go a fesi, fi yu. Da dati o seeka pasi gi yu.
eng_text: As it is written in the prophets, "Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.

djk_text: Da a tongo fu wan bosikopuman o bali a ini a gaan sabana taki: ‘U seeka pasi gi a Masaa, meke a pasi sa kon taampu letiopu tollo.’ ”
eng_text: The voice of one crying in the wilderness, 'Make ready the way of the Lord! Make his paths straight!'"

djk_text: Da Johanisi a Dopuman de a ini a gaan sabana e bali den sama fu kon teke dopu, fu daai libi. Meke Masaa Gadu sa gi den paadon, fu takuudu anga ogii.
eng_text: John came baptizing in the wilderness and preaching the baptism of repentance for forgiveness of sins.

djk_text: Hii Judeja anga ala sama fu Jelusalem kon a Johanisi. Da, te den begi Masaa Gadu paadon fu ala den takuudu anga ogii fu den, da Johanisi e dopu den a ini Joodani Liba.
eng_text: All the country of Judea and all those of Jerusalem went out to him. They were baptized by him in the Jordan river, confessing their sins.

djk_text: Johanisi seefi, be wei koosi di be meke anga a uwii fu a meti di den e kai kameili. Da a be e wei wan banti, di meke anga meti buba ne en nekilasi. Da na makonkon anga bosi oniki na be en nyanyan.
eng_text: John was clothed with camel's hair and a leather belt around his waist. He ate locusts and wild honey.

djk_text: Da a be e bali bosikopu taki: “Awan di o kon a mi baka, makiti bigi moo mi. Mi á dyendee sai, fu bendi losi en susu puu a futu gi en seefi.
eng_text: He preached, saying, "After me comes he who is mightier than I, the thong of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop down and loosen.

djk_text: Mi e dopu u anga wataa! Ma en dati o dopu sama anga a Apaiti Jeje.”
eng_text: I baptized you in water, but he will baptize you in the Holy Spirit."

djk_text: Da a seefi yuu de, ne Masaa Jesesi komoto a Nasaleti, na a pisiwataa fu Galileya kon, ne Johanisi dopu en a ini a Joodani Liba.
eng_text: It happened in those days, that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized by John in the Jordan.

djk_text: Da di Jesesi e komoto a ini a wataa, ne a si, tapu a den woluku piiti opo palan. Ne a si a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu e kon ne en tapu enke wan doifi.
eng_text: Immediately coming up from the water, he saw the heavens parting, and the Spirit descending on him like a dove.

djk_text: Ne wan Tongo taki a tapu anda taki: “Yu na mi Manpikin di mi lobi. Mi hii ati e piisii anga yu.”
eng_text: A voice came out of the sky, "You are my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased."

djk_text: Da wanten wanten, di Masaa Jesesi dopu, ne a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu tyai en gwe a ini a gaan sabana.
eng_text: Immediately the Spirit drove him out into the wilderness.

djk_text: Da, di Masaa Jesesi de a ini a sabana, ne saatan, a didibii kon. Ne a tesi en fotenti dei anga neti langa. Da, den ogii meti fu a sabana be de ape tu. Ma den Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee be de anga Masaa Jesesi, e yeepi en.
eng_text: He was there in the wilderness forty days tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals; and the angels were serving him.

djk_text: Da di den sooto Johanisi a Dopuman ne Masaa Jesesi daai go a Galileya, go e gi den sama a Bun Nyunsu.
eng_text: Now after John was taken into custody, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the Good News of the Kingdom of God,

djk_text: A taki: “A yuu doo, di a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu kon de koosube. Da daai libi, fu biibi a Bun Nyunsu fu Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: and saying, "The time is fulfilled, and the Kingdom of God is at hand! Repent, and believe in the Good News."

djk_text: Da wan dei di Masaa Jesesi e waka pasa na a sikin liba fu a ze fu Galileya, ne a si tu man e towe seepi. Wan fu den man ya na Simon. Da a taawan ne en baala Andeleyasi. Da na sete seepi kisi fisi, na den wooko di den be e du kaba.
eng_text: Passing along by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew the brother of Simon casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “U kon waka a mi baka! Mi sa leli u fa fu kisi libisama pe fu kisi fisi.”
eng_text: Jesus said to them, "Come after me, and I will make you into fishers for men."

djk_text: Ne wanten wanten, den fika den seepi, ne den bigin waka a Masaa Jesesi baka.
eng_text: Immediately they left their nets, and followed him.

djk_text: Ne, di Masaa Jesesi waka go pikinso moo faawe, ne a si ete tu fisiman, Jakowbesi anga Johanisi, den tu manpikin fu Da Sebedi. Den be de a ini wan boto e seeka den seepi.
eng_text: Going on a little further from there, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John, his brother, who were also in the boat mending the nets.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi kai den wanten fu den kon waka ne en baka. Ne den fika den dda, Da Sebedi anga den wookoman a ini a boto, ne den waka a Masaa Jesesi baka.
eng_text: Immediately he called them, and they left their father, Zebedee, in the boat with the hired servants, and went after him.

djk_text: Ne den gwe a Kafalnayemu. Ma namo, di a kina dei fu den Dyu doo, ne Masaa Jesesi go a ini wan fu den Dyu keliki. Ne a bigin leli den sama Gadu wowtu.
eng_text: They went into Capernaum, and immediately on the Sabbath day he entered into the synagogue and taught.

djk_text: Da den sama foondoo, fu a fasi fa ai gi leli fu Masaa Gadu. Bika a á be e leli den enke fa den leliman fu Dyuweiti gwenti leli den. Ma a be e leli den, enke wan sama di sa sidon taki a Masaa Gadu peesi.
eng_text: They were astonished at his teaching, for he taught them as having authority, and not as the scribes.

djk_text: Da a yuu de, da wan man be de a ini a keliki osu de anga wan takuu jeje ne en tapu. Ne a bali taki:
eng_text: Immediately there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit, and he cried out,

djk_text: “San wi anga yu abi, Jesesi fu Nasaleti? A kon i kon fu poli wi kaba a soso? Mi sabi sama a yu! Yu na a Apaiti Sama fu Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: saying, "Ha! What do we have to do with you, Jesus, you Nazarene? Have you come to destroy us? I know you who you are: the Holy One of God!"

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi kaasi en taki: “Tapu mofu! Komoto ne en tapu wanten!”
eng_text: Jesus rebuked him, saying, "Be quiet, and come out of him!"

djk_text: Ne a takuu jeje subi te en sikin e dansi. Ne a bali taanga komoto gwe.
eng_text: The unclean spirit, convulsing him and crying with a loud voice, came out of him.

djk_text: Ala sama fiya foondoo. Taawan e akisi taawan taki: “San a disi? Disi na wan nyun leli anga makiti fu Masaa Gadu! Ai kaasi den takuu jeje, da den e gwe tuu.”
eng_text: They were all amazed, so that they questioned among themselves, saying, "What is this? A new teaching? For with authority he commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey him!"

djk_text: Da a sani di Masaa Jesesi du ya, paati na a hii pisiwataa fu Galileya.
eng_text: The report of him went out immediately everywhere into all the region of Galilee and its surrounding area.

djk_text: Da, baka di den komoto na a keliki osu, ne den go wanten na a osu fu Simon anga Andeleyasi. Da Jakowbesi anga Johanisi go anga den tu.
eng_text: Immediately, when they had come out of the synagogue, they came into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.

djk_text: Da a main fu Simon de a bedi anga feba. Da di den doo na a osu, ne den taigi Masaa Jesesi fu a siki fi en.
eng_text: Now Simon's wife's mother lay sick with a fever, and immediately they told him about her.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi waka go ne en. Ne a oli en ana yeepi en fu a opo sidon. Ne wanten wanten a mma kon bun kelle fu a feba. Ne a seeka sani gi den fu den nyan.
eng_text: He came and took her by the hand, and raised her up. The fever left her, and she served them.

djk_text: Ne di sapaten, di san go a ondoo, ne den tyai somen sikisama anga sama di be abi takuu jeje a den tapu, kon a Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: At evening, when the sun had set, they brought to him all who were sick, and those who were possessed by demons.

djk_text: Da a hii foto ali kon na a osu doo mofu pe Jesesi be de.
eng_text: All the city was gathered together at the door.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi deesi somen sama di be abi ala sowtu siki. Da soseefi a yaki somen takuu jeje puu a sama tapu. Ma Masaa Jesesi á gi den pasi fu taki, bika den sabi sama ne en.
eng_text: He healed many who were sick with various diseases, and cast out many demons. He didn't allow the demons to speak, because they knew him.

djk_text: Mamanten fuuku, fosi san opo, ne Masaa Jesesi go a wan koo peesi, pe en wawan be sa de fu begi taki anga Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Early in the morning, while it was still dark, he rose up and went out, and departed into a deserted place, and prayed there.

djk_text: Simon anga den taa bakaman e suku pe a de.
eng_text: Simon and those who were with him followed after him;

djk_text: Ne, di den fende en, ne den taigi en taki: “Ala sama e suku yu.”
eng_text: and they found him, and told him, "Everyone is looking for you."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Meke u go a den taa kondee di de koosube ya. Mi mu paati a Bun Nyunsu fu Masaa Gadu anda tu. Bika na fu dati ede mi kon a goontapu.”
eng_text: He said to them, "Let's go elsewhere into the next towns, that I may preach there also, because I came out for this reason."

djk_text: Da na so Masaa Jesesi go paati a Bun Nyunsu fu Gadu a ini den keliki fu a hii pisiwataa fu Galileya. Da soseefi a yaki takuu jeje puu a sama tapu.
eng_text: He went into their synagogues throughout all Galilee, preaching and casting out demons.

djk_text: Ne wan gwasiman kon a Masaa Jesesi. Ne a kai ne en kini tapu e begi Masaa Jesesi taki: “Masaa Jesesi! Mi sabi taki efi i wani i sa deesi, baa.”
eng_text: A leper came to him, begging him, kneeling down to him, and saying to him, "If you want to, you can make me clean."

djk_text: Ne tyali fu a man kisi Masaa Jesesi. Ne a langa ana, ne a oli en. Ne a taigi en taki: “Mi wani! Kon bun!”
eng_text: Being moved with compassion, he stretched out his hand, and touched him, and said to him, "I want to. Be made clean."

djk_text: Ne wanten wanten, ne a man kon bun kelle. A gwasi siki komoto ne en sikin gwe fiyaa.
eng_text: When he had said this, immediately the leprosy departed from him, and he was made clean.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi sende a man ya gwe. Ne a bali en taanga taanga taki:
eng_text: He strictly warned him, and immediately sent him out,

djk_text: “Yu á mu taigi ná wan sama a sani di pasa ya, ye! Ma pe fu dati, go a den hei apaiti begiman fu keliki, meke a si yu taki, i kon bun tuutuu. Tyai a paiman fu Gadu enke fa a weiti fu Mosesi e taki. Da den sama anda sa si taki i kon bun tuutuu.”
eng_text: and said to him, "See you say nothing to anybody, but go show yourself to the priest, and offer for your cleansing the things which Moses commanded, for a testimony to them."

djk_text: Ma, di a man gwe, ne ai taki fa Masaa Jesesi deesi en. A paati a bosikopu na ala peesi te, Masaa Jesesi nen bali na ala peesi. Da winsi pe fu a kondee di Masaa Jesesi be go, sama be e kon ne en tyaipi. A dati meke a be e tan a peesi pe sama á be ipi. Ma toku seefi sama be e komoto na ala se e kon ne en.
eng_text: But he went out, and began to proclaim it much, and to spread about the matter, so that Jesus could no more openly enter into a city, but was outside in desert places: and they came to him from everywhere.

djk_text: Da wantu dei a baka, ne Masaa Jesesi daai kon baka a Kafalnayemu. A á de ape langa seefi fosi a hii foto yee taki a de ape.
eng_text: When he entered again into Capernaum after some days, it was heard that he was in the house.

djk_text: Da somen sama kon te, ná wan peesi be de a ini a osu moo. A doo mofu seefi fuu kwaa. A be e gi den sama a wowtu fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Immediately many were gathered together, so that there was no more room, not even around the door; and he spoke the word to them.

djk_text: Ne fo man poti wan lanman a wan daagi tapu, tyai kon a Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: Four people came, carrying a paralytic to him.

djk_text: Ma fu di sama be ipi so, meke den á be poi doo. Ne den subi go na a osu tapu. Ne den booko wan olo na a osu tapu leti a pe Masaa Jesesi be taampu. Ne den saka a lanman anga a daagi pasa na a olo, go a Masaa Jesesi a doti anda.
eng_text: When they could not come near to him for the crowd, they removed the roof where he was. When they had broken it up, they let down the mat that the paralytic was lying on.

djk_text: Da, di Masaa Jesesi si a biibi fu den man ya, ne a taigi a man taki: “Mi mati, ná feele! Mi gi yu paadon fu ala yu takuudu anga ogii kaba.”
eng_text: Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, "Son, your sins are forgiven you."

djk_text: Da wantu leliman fu Dyuweiti be sidon e aliki en tu. Da di den yee Masaa Jesesi taki so, ne den taki a ini den ati taki:
eng_text: But there were some of the scribes sitting there, and reasoning in their hearts,

djk_text: “Fa a man ya e taki so wan sani? Ai oli Gadu a sipowtu! Bika ná wan sama di man fu gi libisama paadon fu takuudu anga ogii, boiti Masaa Gadu wawan.”
eng_text: Why does this man speak blasphemies like that? Who can forgive sins but God alone?

djk_text: Ne wanten wanten, Masaa Jesesi sabi taki na so den e denki. Ne a akisi den taki: “Saide meke u e denki so du?
eng_text: Immediately Jesus, perceiving in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, said to them, "Why do you reason these things in your hearts?

djk_text: Fu taigi a lanman ya taki, a kisi paadon fi en takuudu anga ogii, efu fu taigi en taki: ‘Opo taampu! Teke i daagi waka go a osu!’ on di moo taanga?
eng_text: Which is easier, to tell the paralytic, 'Your sins are forgiven;' or to say, 'Arise, and take up your bed, and walk?'

djk_text: Ma u mu sabi taki, a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya abi makiti a goontapu, fu gi sama paadon fu takuudu anga ogii.” Ne a daai, ne a taigi a lanman taki:
eng_text: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins"--he said to the paralytic--

djk_text: “Opo taampu! Teke i daagi waka go a osu!”
eng_text: I tell you, arise, take up your mat, and go to your house.

djk_text: Ne dyangalan! A man dyombo opo taampu, ne wanten a teke a daagi oli a ondoo ana, ne a waka gwe a osu. Ala sama e luku dunn. Den foondoo, te den e gafa Masaa Gadu taki: “Wi á si a sani ya wanten.”
eng_text: He arose, and immediately took up the mat, and went out in front of them all; so that they were all amazed, and glorified God, saying, "We never saw anything like this!"

djk_text: Masaa Jesesi go baka a wataa mofu na a ze. Ne tyaipi sama kon ne en. Ne a leli den Masaa Gadu wowtu.
eng_text: He went out again by the seaside. All the multitude came to him, and he taught them.

djk_text: Ne di Masaa Jesesi komoto de e gwe, da a be e waka pasa wan pikin osu a sikin pasi, pe den Dyusama e go pai lantimoni. Ne a si wan pikin fu Alefeyosi, di den e kai Leifi, sidon sidon na a osu doo mofu e piki lantimoni gi lanti. Ne Masaa Jesesi kai en taki: “Kon waka a mi baka!” Ne wanten wanten Leifi opo, ne a waka a Masaa Jesesi baka.
eng_text: As he passed by, he saw Levi, the son of Alphaeus, sitting at the tax office, and he said to him, "Follow me." And he arose and followed him.

djk_text: Ne moo lati, ne Leifi kai Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en go nyan ne en osu. Da somen mati fu Leifi di be e piki lantimoni anga sama di be abi polinen a kondee fosi den be kon waka a Masaa Jesesi baka, be sidon a tafaa e nyan anga Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en.
eng_text: It happened, that he was reclining at the table in his house, and many tax collectors and sinners sat down with Jesus and his disciples, for there were many, and they followed him.

djk_text: We, ne di den leliman fu Dyuweiti anga den Faliseiman si taki anga a man di e piki lantimoni anga den polinen man a kondee, Masaa Jesesi sidon e nyan. Ne den akisi den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi taki: “Saide meke ai nyan anga lantiman anga den ogiilibi sama de?”
eng_text: The scribes and the Pharisees, when they saw that he was eating with the sinners and tax collectors, said to his disciples, "Why is it that he eats and drinks with tax collectors and sinners?"

djk_text: Ma di Masaa Jesesi yee den, ne a piki den anga wan ageisi toli taki: “Wan sama di e siki anga wan sama di nái siki, on di fu den abi dataa fanowdu? Na sama di e siki! Bika, dataa de gi sikiman. Mi á kon fu kai den bunbun sama, ma mi kon fu kai den sama di sabi taki, den libi á bun.”
eng_text: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, "Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick. I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance."

djk_text: Ma namo, da den bakaman fu Johanisi anga den Faliseiman be abi ten di den be e de sondee nyan fu begi. Ne wan dei, ne wan duupu sama kon a Masaa Jesesi, ne den akisi en taki: “Masaa Jesesi, saide meke den bakaman fi yu ná abi ten di den e tan sondee nyan fu begi, enke den bakaman fu Johanisi anga den bakaman fu den Faliseiman?”
eng_text: John's disciples and the Pharisees were fasting, and they came and asked him, "Why do John's disciples and the disciples of the Pharisees fast, but your disciples don't fast?"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den anga wan ageisi toli taki: “Fa mi anga den bakaman fu mi de ya, da a de leti enke te wan man toow anga wan uman. Di a man toow, ne a kai somen sama fu kon meke piisii anga en. Da solanga a toowman de na a fesa anga den, da den ná o tan anga angii fu begi, ma na soso nyan meke piisii namo den o de.
eng_text: Jesus said to them, "Can the groomsmen fast while the bridegroom is with them? As long as they have the bridegroom with them, they can't fast.

djk_text: Ma a yuu o kon di den o tyai a toowman puu a den de. Da den sa abi ten di den o go e de anga angii fu begi Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then will they fast in that day.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den baka taki: “Ná wan sama di e teke wan nyun pisi koosi fu nai wan kaasi koosi di piiti. Bika efi i lapu a gaandi koosi anga wan nyunyun pisi, da te i wasi en, da a nyunyun pisi koosi o ali piiti wan pisi fu a gaandi koosi, da a olo o moo bigi.
eng_text: No one sews a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment, or else the patch shrinks and the new tears away from the old, and a worse hole is made.

djk_text: Da na soseefi tu, sama nái poti nyun meke win go a ini gaandi meti buba saka. Efu den poti en, da a win o basi a saka. Da ala den tu, a win anga a saka o poli. A dati meke, nyunyun win meke fu poti a ini nyunyun saka, di á poi basi lasi en.”
eng_text: No one puts new wine into old wineskins, or else the new wine will burst the skins, and the wine pours out, and the skins will be destroyed; but they put new wine into fresh wineskins."

djk_text: Da na a kina dei fu den Dyu, ne Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en e waka pasa a ini wan goon. Ne den bakaman fi en e booko den ede fu wan sani gei kalu, di den sama paandi a ini a goon, e pii e nyan.
eng_text: It happened that he was going on the Sabbath day through the grain fields, and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of grain.

djk_text: Ne den Faliseiman di si akisi en taki: “Luku de! Saide meke den bakaman fi yu e du sani di sama á mu du a kina dei? Yu nái si taki na Gadu weiti den e poli, no?”
eng_text: The Pharisees said to him, "Behold, why do they do that which is not lawful on the Sabbath day?"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “U á leisi a Masaa Gadu Buku san Kownu Dafeti be du di a be de a nowtu, di angii be kii en anga den man fi en, no?
eng_text: He said to them, "Did you never read what David did, when he had need, and was hungry--he, and those who were with him?

djk_text: U á leisi fa a be go a ini a Mama Keliki fu Masaa Gadu, na a ten di Abiyatali be de a moo hei begiman fu Dyu, no? A go, ne a teke a beele di den poti a Gadu fesi, ne a nyan. A weiti á be e gi en pasi fu nyan a beele de. Na den begiman fu keliki namo be sa nyanmi en. Da u á leisi, fa a be gi den bakaman fi en fu den nyan tu, no?
eng_text: How he entered into God's house when Abiathar was high priest, and ate the show bread, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests, and gave also to those who were with him?"

djk_text: Da u meke mi taigi u. A kina dei be meke gi libisama, ma a ná libisama be meke gi kina dei.
eng_text: He said to them, "The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath.

djk_text: Bika a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya, na a gaan Masaa fu a kina dei.”
eng_text: Therefore the Son of Man is lord even of the Sabbath."

djk_text: Masaa Jesesi go a ini wan Dyu keliki baka. Ma, da wan man be de ape, di be siki ne en ana te a be dee fika kamboo.
eng_text: He entered again into the synagogue, and there was a man there who had his hand withered.

djk_text: Da den sama be de koosube e luku Masaa Jesesi. Den be e luku fu si efu a be o deesi a man na a kina dei ya, fu den be fende en go kaagi taki ai du sani di á bun.
eng_text: They watched him, whether he would heal him on the Sabbath day, that they might accuse him.

djk_text: We, na so Masaa Jesesi taigi a man di be siki ne ana taki: “Opo taampu a fesi fu ala sama ya.”
eng_text: He said to the man who had his hand withered, "Stand up."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi akisi den taki: “San Gadu Buku taki fu a kina dei? U mu du bun efu u mu du ogii? Fu deesi wan sama fu a kon bun baka efu fika en fu dede?” Ma ala den sama de pii. Ná wan fu den piki en.
eng_text: He said to them, "Is it lawful on the Sabbath day to do good, or to do harm? To save a life, or to kill?" But they were silent.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi luku den anga atiboon. Ma soseefi a ati en tu, fu di a si taki den sama taanga den ati gi Masaa Gadu te, tyali fu taa sama nái kisi den moo. Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi a man taki: “Langa i ana!” Ne a man langa en ana. Ne a ana kon bun kelle baka.
eng_text: When he had looked around at them with anger, being grieved at the hardening of their hearts, he said to the man, "Stretch out your hand." He stretched it out, and his hand was restored as healthy as the other.

djk_text: Ne den Faliseiman gwe komoto na a keliki. Da den anga den bakaman fu Kownu Helowdesi meke mofu luku fa den sa fende wan Masaa Jesesi kii.
eng_text: The Pharisees went out, and immediately conspired with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en go a wataa mofu, na a ze fu Galileya. Da somen sama fu Galileya anga Judeja anga Jelusalem, Idumeya anga den kondee na abaase fu a Joodani Liba anga a pisiwataa fu Tilosi anga Sidon kon e waka ne en baka. Den be kon ne en fu di den be yee fu ala den sani di a be e du.
eng_text: Jesus withdrew to the sea with his disciples, and a great multitude followed him from Galilee, from Judea,

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den bakaman fi en taki: “U seeka wan boto gi mi, fu den sama á toto kon banda mi.”
eng_text: He spoke to his disciples that a little boat should stay near him because of the crowd, so that they wouldn't press on him.

djk_text: Da Masaa Jesesi deesi somen sama te, ala sama di be abi wan siki be e toto kon, soso fu oli en namo.
eng_text: For he had healed many, so that as many as had diseases pressed on him that they might touch him.

djk_text: Da a yuu de, te den sama di wan takuu jeje be de a den tapu be si Masaa Jesesi, da den be e kai a doti ne en fesi e bali taki: “Yu na a Manpikin fu Masaa Gadu!”
eng_text: The unclean spirits, whenever they saw him, fell down before him, and cried, "You are the Son of God!"

djk_text: Ma, te den takuu jeje be e bali so, da Masaa Jesesi be e kaasi den fu den á taki sama ne en.
eng_text: He sternly warned them that they should not make him known.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi go a wan mongo tapu. Ne a kai den sama di a wani kon ne en. Ne den kon ne en.
eng_text: He went up into the mountain, and called to himself those whom he wanted, and they went to him.

djk_text: Ne a teke twalufu man puu a den mindii. Da na den twalufu man ya a kai aposteli tu. Da den be o de anga en na ala pe a be e go. Ne a sende den twalufu man ya, go a den kondee kondee fu go paati a Bun Nyunsu fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: He appointed twelve, that they might be with him, and that he might send them out to preach,

djk_text: Da a be gi den a makiti tu fu yaki takuu jeje puu a sama tapu.
eng_text: and to have authority to heal sicknesses and to cast out demons:

djk_text: Da na den twalufu man ya a be teke puu a den taawan mindii: Simon di Masaa Jesesi be kai Peitilisi
eng_text: Simon, to whom he gave the name Peter;

djk_text: Jakowbesi, anga en baala Johanisi den tu manpikin fu Da Sebedi. Da Masaa Jesesi be gi den a nen fu Bowanegesi, dati wani taki, Pikin fu Donduu.
eng_text: James the son of Zebedee; John, the brother of James, and he surnamed them Boanerges, which means, Sons of Thunder;

djk_text: Andeleyasi Filipi Baatomeyosi Tadeyesi Mateyesi Jakowbesi a manpikin fu Alefeyosi Tadeyesi Simon Selotu
eng_text: Andrew; Philip; Bartholomew; Matthew; Thomas; James, the son of Alphaeus; Thaddaeus; Simon the Zealot;

djk_text: Judasi Iskaliyotu, di seli Masaa Jesesi, meke den kii en.
eng_text: and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him. He came into a house.

djk_text: Ne bakadati, ne Masaa Jesesi go a wan osu. Da sama kon fuu a osu fu Masaa Jesesi, te en anga den bakaman fi en á be poi nyan.
eng_text: The multitude came together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.

djk_text: Da di den sama fu Masaa Jesesi yee a sani ya, ne den go fu go teke en puu de. Den taki: “A á sabi san ai du moo.”
eng_text: When his friends heard it, they went out to seize him: for they said, "He is insane."

djk_text: Da den leliman fu Dyuweiti di be komoto a Jelusalem Foto kon de taki: “Belisebulu, a basi fu didibii, de ne en tapu! Na Belisebulu e gi en a taanga fu puu takuu jeje a sama tapu.”
eng_text: The scribes who came down from Jerusalem said, "He has Beelzebul," and, "By the prince of the demons he casts out the demons."

djk_text: Ma namo, Masaa Jesesi kai den kon makandii. Ne a gi den wan ageisi toli. A taki: “Fa didibii sa puu didibii a wan peesi?
eng_text: He summoned them, and said to them in parables, "How can Satan cast out Satan?

djk_text: Efu wan kownu fu kondee opo e feti anga enseefi, da a kondee de, a ná booko a o booko, no?
eng_text: If a kingdom is divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.

djk_text: Da, soseefi a de anga wan osu tu. Efu den sama e libi fanya fanya anga feyanti fasi anga denseefi, sowan osu musu booko.
eng_text: If a house is divided against itself, that house cannot stand.

djk_text: Da efu saatan paati paati e feti anga enseefi, da na a kaba pisi fi en a doo, bika a o booko kaba a soso.
eng_text: If Satan has risen up against himself, and is divided, he can't stand, but has an end.

djk_text: Ná wan sama o poi go a ini a osu fu wan gaan taanga man go teke en gudu. Efu a wani go, da a mu kisi a gaan taanga man tei banda fosi. Da, te a tei en banda so kaba, da a sa go a ini a taanga man osu, go teke en gudu.
eng_text: But no one can enter into the house of the strong man to plunder, unless he first binds the strong man; and then he will plunder his house.

djk_text: Da fu tuutuu mi e taigi u taki, Masaa Gadu sa gi sama paadon. Awinsi sowtu ogii a du efu awinsi fa a kosi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Most certainly I tell you, all sins of the descendants of man will be forgiven, including their blasphemies with which they may blaspheme;

djk_text: Ma awinsi sama na yu, efi i kosi a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu, taki ogii fi en, da noiti noiti Masaa Gadu o gi i paadon fu dati.”
eng_text: but whoever may blaspheme against the Holy Spirit never has forgiveness, but is guilty of an eternal sin"

djk_text: Da na so Masaa Jesesi piki den sama, fu di den be taki na Belisebulu, a basi fu didibii, de ne en tapu.
eng_text: --because they said, "He has an unclean spirit."

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi mma anga den baala fi en doo na a osu pe a de. Den taampu a doose, ne den sende bosikopu gi en fu a kon a den.
eng_text: His mother and his brothers came, and standing outside, they sent to him, calling him.

djk_text: Ne den sama di be sidon lontu Masaa Jesesi taigi en taki: “Masaa Jesesi, i mma anga den baala fi yu de a doose. Den e kai yu.”
eng_text: A multitude was sitting around him, and they told him, "Behold, your mother, your brothers, and your sisters are outside looking for you."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “A bun! Ma sama na mi mma? Sama na mi baala?”
eng_text: He answered them, "Who are my mother and my brothers?"

djk_text: Ne a luku den sama di be sidon lontu en, ne a taki: “Luku mi mma anga mi baala ya.
eng_text: Looking around at those who sat around him, he said, "Behold, my mother and my brothers!

djk_text: Ala sama di e du san Masaa Gadu wani, na den na mi baala anga mi sisa anga mi mma.”
eng_text: For whoever does the will of God, the same is my brother, and my sister, and mother."

djk_text: Da, Jesesi de na a ze fu Galileya e leli den sama baka. Da somen sama kon ne en. Ne Masaa Jesesi go a ini wan boto, ne a sidon. Ma ala den taa sama be de a soo a wataa mofu.
eng_text: Again he began to teach by the seaside. A great multitude was gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat in the sea, and sat down. All the multitude were on the land by the sea.

djk_text: Da, ai gi den ageisi toli fu leli den somen sani. Da, di ai leli den, ne a taigi den taki:
eng_text: He taught them many things in parables, and told them in his teaching,

djk_text: “U aliki! Wan dei, da wan paandi goonman be go tyatya wan sii fi en, fu goo.
eng_text:
Listen! Behold, the farmer went out to sow,

1175	Da, wantu taa sii kai a siton ini, a pe doti á be de ipi. Da den sii ya goo esi esi, bika a doti á be dipi.	1175	Others fell on the rocky ground, where it had little soil, and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of soil.

djk_text: Ne a taigi den taki: “Meke sama di abi yesi fu yee, da meke a yee san mi taki ya.”
eng_text: He said, "Whoever has ears to hear, let him hear."

djk_text: Da, di Masaa Jesesi anga den twalufu bakaman fi en anga wantu taa sama di be e waka ne en baka wawan be de, ne den akisi en taki: “Masaa Jesesi, san wani taki a toli di i be leli den sama de?”
eng_text: When he was alone, those who were around him with the twelve asked him about the parables.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “U di e waka a Masaa Gadu pasi, kon sabi somen kibii toli fu a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu. Ma den sama di á de a Masaa Gadu pasi, na ageisi toli fasi mi e gi den en. Bika,
eng_text: He said to them, "To you is given the mystery of the Kingdom of God, but to those who are outside, all things are done in parables,

djk_text: ‘Den e luku anga opo opo ain, ma den nái si. Den e yee anga kiinkiin yesi, ma den nái fusutan san den e yee. Da noiti den daai den libi kon a mi. A dati meke noiti den fende paadon fu den takuudu anga ogii fu den.’ ”
eng_text: that 'seeing they may see, and not perceive; and hearing they may hear, and not understand; lest perhaps they should turn again, and their sins should be forgiven them.'"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi akisi den taki: “U á fusutan a toli, no? Da, fa u o du fusutan den taa toli di mi o teke gi den sama fu leli den sani?”
eng_text: He said to them, "Don't you understand this parable? How will you understand all of the parables?

djk_text: Ne a puu en gi den taki: “A goonman, di be e tyatya a sii, dati na a sama di e paati a wowtu fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: The farmer sows the word.

djk_text: Da somen sama de enke sii di kai a sikin pasi. Solanga den yee a wowtu fu Masaa Gadu, da a didibii e kon, da a piki a wowtu di paandi a ini en ati ini puu wanten wanten.
eng_text: The ones by the road are the ones where the word is sown; and when they have heard, immediately Satan comes, and takes away the word which has been sown in them.

djk_text: Somen sama de enke sii di paandi a wan pisi doti di abi tyaipi siton. Solanga den yee a wowtu fu Masaa Gadu, den e teke en wanten wanten anga gaan piisii.
eng_text: These in the same way are those who are sown on the rocky places, who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with joy.

djk_text: Ma ná wan lutu di den e meke. Den e de namo fu wan satu pisiten. Bika, te nowtu anga pina kon a den tapu fu a wowtu ede, da wanten den e daai fika a biibi.
eng_text: They have no root in themselves, but are short-lived. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, immediately they stumble.

djk_text: Taa sama de enke sii, di paandi a ini maka. Den e yee a wowtu,
eng_text: Others are those who are sown among the thorns. These are those who have heard the word,

djk_text: ma den booko fu a libi anga a feti fu fende tyaipi gudu anga taa sani a goontapu anga a lobi fu goontapu sani seefi, e tyoko a wowtu a ini den ati ini kii, meke a á poi meke nyanyan.
eng_text: and the cares of this age, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.

djk_text: Ma taawan de enke sii, di kai a bunbun doti. Den e yee a wowtu. Den e teke en. Da, den e meke tyaipi tyaipi nyanyan. Son e meke diitenti, sigisitenti anga wan ondoo toon fu san di den be paandi.”
eng_text: Those which were sown on the good ground are those who hear the word, and accept it, and bear fruit, some thirty times, some sixty times, and some one hundred times."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “Te i leti wan lampu a ini wan osu, yu nái toosi en go a kama ondoo efu teke boketi tapu en. Nono! Yu o poti en a tapu, efuso yu o oli en hei fu a sa leti kiin peesi.
eng_text: He said to them, "Is the lamp brought to be put under a basket or under a bed? Isn't it put on a stand?

djk_text: Da, ná wan sani de kibii, di ná o kon a kiin fu sama sabi.
eng_text: For there is nothing hidden, except that it should be made known; neither was anything made secret, but that it should come to light.

djk_text: Meke sama di abi yesi fu yee, yee san mi taki ya!”
eng_text: If any man has ears to hear, let him hear."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den go doo taki: “Na fa u e aliki den sani di u e yee, na so u o fusutan den tu fu teke koni. Bika a de leti enke wan nongo di taki: ‘Fa yu e maiki sani gi sama, na so sama o maiki sani gi yu baka.’ Da moo ipi seefi yu o kisi a tapu.
eng_text: He said to them, "Take heed what you hear. With whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you, and more will be given to you who hear.

djk_text: Bika, a sama di fende wan pikinso koni nownow, ne a wooko anga en, a sa fende moo ipi. Ma, a sama, di ná o wooko anga a pikinso koni di a abi nownow, a sa lasi ala san a be abi.”
eng_text: For whoever has, to him will more be given, and he who doesn't have, even that which he has will be taken away from him."

djk_text: Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “A Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu de enke, te wan goonman, go a goon wan dei, go paandi sii. Di a paandi den sii, te a kaba, ne a go fi en a kondee baka.
