djk_text: Da a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya á kon fu libisama yeepi en. Ma a kon fu dini den, yeepi den a sani. A dati meke a o dede gi ala libisama fu puu den a ogii tyai den kon a Masaa Gadu baka.”
eng_text: For the Son of Man also came not to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en doo Jelikow. Ne moo lati di den e gwe, ne somen somen sama e waka a den baka. Da wan beendiman be sidon a sikin pasi e begi moni. Da na a man ya den be e kai Baatimeyosi. Da a nen ya wani taki, a pikin fu Timeyesi.
eng_text: They came to Jericho. As he went out from Jericho, with his disciples and a great multitude, the son of Timaeus, Bartimaeus, a blind beggar, was sitting by the road.

djk_text: Da di a yee taki na Masaa Jesesi fu Nasaleti e kon, ne ai bali taki: “Masaa Jesesi! Masaa Jesesi! Yu na a Bakaten Manpikin fu Kownu Dafeti paansu! Gaantangi, abi tyali ati fu mi, da yeepi mi, baa!”
eng_text: When he heard that it was Jesus the Nazarene, he began to cry out, and say, "Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!"

djk_text: Da di ai bali so, ne den sama bali en taki: “Man, tapu mofu de!” Ma pe fu a beendiman ya tapu en mofu, ne na bali ai bali moo taanga taki: “Bakaten Manpikin fu Kownu Dafeti paansu! Yeepi mi baa, yeepi mi!”
eng_text: Many rebuked him, that he should be quiet, but he cried out much more, "You son of David, have mercy on me!"

djk_text: Ne di Masaa Jesesi yee a bali, ne a taampu. Ne a taigi den sama taki: “U kai a man di e bali mi anda gi mi.” Ne den go kai a beendiman taki: “Man! Ná feele, kon! Masaa Jesesi e kai yu.”
eng_text: Jesus stood still, and said, "Call him." They called the blind man, saying to him, "Cheer up! Get up. He is calling you!"

djk_text: Ne a dyombo opo taampu, ne a puu a koosi di a be e tapu koo, ne a waka go a Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: He, casting away his cloak, sprang up, and came to Jesus.

djk_text: Di a waka te a doo, ne Masaa Jesesi akisi en taki: “Man, san meke yu e bali mi so? San i wani mi du gi yu?” Ne a man piki Masaa Jesesi taki: “Masaa! Mi wani i deesi mi ain fu mi sa si.”
eng_text: Jesus asked him, "What do you want me to do for you?" The blind man said to him, "Rabboni, that I may see again."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi en taki: “Fu di i poti so wan biibi a mi meke yu ain kon bun enke fa a mu de.” We, di Masaa Jesesi taki so, ne wanten wanten a man ain kiin kelle, ne a bigin fu si sani bunbun. Ne a teke pasi e waka anga Masaa Jesesi anga den taa sama.
eng_text: Jesus said to him, "Go your way. Your faith has made you well." Immediately he received his sight, and followed Jesus in the way.

djk_text: Da di Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en de a pasi e go a Jelusalem, ne den doo na a pikin mongo di den e kai Oleifi Mongo, koosube fu Betifage anga Betaniya Kondee.
eng_text: When they drew near to Jerusalem, to Bethsphage and Bethany, at the Mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples,

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi tu bakaman fi en taki: “U go na a kondee a u fesi ya. Da te u go, da u o si wan pikin buliki teitei. Ná wan sama sidon na a buliki ya tapu lei ete.
eng_text: and said to them, "Go your way into the village that is opposite you. Immediately as you enter into it, you will find a young donkey tied, on which no one has sat. Untie him, and bring him.

djk_text: Da u losi en tyai kon. Da efu wan sama akisi u saide meke u e teke en, da u mu taigi den taki: ‘Masaa abi en fanowdu. Ma u o tyai en kon baka esi esi.’ ”
eng_text: If anyone asks you, 'Why are you doing this?' say, 'The Lord needs him;' and immediately he will send him back here."

djk_text: Da den go na a kondee. Ne den si a buliki wanten wanten. A be de teitei a wan ponsu fu wan osu a sikin pasi. Ne den go fu losi en.
eng_text: They went away, and found a young donkey tied at the door outside in the open street, and they untied him.

djk_text: Namo, da wantu sama si di den e losi a buliki. Ne den bali taki: “San e pasa? Pe u e go anga en?”
eng_text: Some of those who stood there asked them, "What are you doing, untying the young donkey?"

djk_text: Ne den tu bakaman taki: “Nono! A ná fu wi. Ma na Masaa abi en fanowdu. Ma u o tyai en kon gawgaw baka.” Ne den sama taki: “A bun! U sa tyai en go.”
eng_text: They said to them just as Jesus had said, and they let them go.

djk_text: Da na so den tyai a pikin buliki kon gi Masaa Jesesi. Ne den baala den dyakiti na a buliki mindii baka, ne Masaa Jesesi go sidon ne en tapu.
eng_text: They brought the young donkey to Jesus, and threw their garments on it, and Jesus sat on it.

djk_text: Da di a de a pasi e go, ne somen sama puu den dyakiti baala a pasi gi en fu a lei a den tapu. Somen taawan booko uwii poti a pasi gi en fu lei a den tapu.
eng_text: Many spread their garments on the way, and others were cutting down branches from the trees, and spreading them on the road.

djk_text: Da den sama di be e waka, ne en fesi anga en baka be e piisii te. Den e bali baya taki: “Hosana! Seigi fu Awan di e kon a ini a nen fu Masaa.
eng_text: Those who went in front, and those who followed, cried out, "Hosanna ! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!

djk_text: Seigi fu a tii fu wi tata Dafeti di kon baka tuu. Hosana gi Masaa Gadu a tapu seefi!”
eng_text: Blessed is the kingdom of our father David that is coming in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!"

djk_text: Na so a lei go a ini Jelusalem Foto. Ne a saka waka go a ini a Mama Keliki. Ne a luku ala den sani di den sama e du a ini a Mama Keliki. Ne di a kon lati, ne en anga den bakaman fi en go a Betaniya baka.
eng_text: Jesus entered into the temple in Jerusalem. When he had looked around at everything, it being now evening, he went out to Bethany with the twelve.

djk_text: Da a taa dei, ne den komoto a Betaniya. Da angii be kii Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: The next day, when they had come out from Bethany, he was hungry.

djk_text: Da di a luku faawe, ne a si wan figasii bon guun anga uwii pii. Na fu dati ede meke a go luku efu a sa fende nyanyan ne en fu a booko nyan. Ma di a doo na a bon, ne a si taki na soso guun uwii a bon abi. A ná abi ná wan enkii nyanyan. Bika a pisiten fu a yali, fu a bon ya be meke nyanyan á be doo ete.
eng_text: Seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came to see if perhaps he might find anything on it. When he came to it, he found nothing but leaves, for it was not the season for figs.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi fuuku a bon taki: “Noiti moo a wanten fu goontapu i sa meke nyanyan fu sama fende nyan.” Da den bakaman fi en yee di a be fuuku a bon so.
eng_text: Jesus told it, "May no one ever eat fruit from you again!" and his disciples heard it.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en kon a Jelusalem. Ne a go wanten na a Mama Keliki. Ne di a go a ini a Mama Keliki, ne a yaki ala den sama di be e seli sani anga den sama di be e bai sani puu de. Ne a kandi den tafaa fu den sama di be e kengi moni fu bai sani a ini a Mama Keliki baka towe holow. Ne a daai, ne a kandi den tafaa fu den sama di be e seli doifi gi sama fu den go pai Masaa Gadu towe tu.
eng_text: They came to Jerusalem, and Jesus entered into the temple, and began to throw out those who sold and those who bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the money changers, and the seats of those who sold the doves.

djk_text: Ne a tapu ala den sama di be teke a Mama Keliki enke gaan pasi e waka e go e kon anga sani fu seli.
eng_text: He would not allow anyone to carry a container through the temple.

djk_text: Ne a leli den taki: “Wan fu den apaiti takiman fu Gadu be sikiifi a Gadu Buku taki: ‘A osu fu Gadu mu de wan osu, pe ala foluku e kon begi makandii taki anga Masaa Gadu.’ Ma san u e meke Masaa Gadu osu toon? U e meke a toon wan osu fu fufuuman?”
eng_text: He taught, saying to them, "Isn't it written, 'My house will be called a house of prayer for all the nations?' But you have made it a den of robbers!"

djk_text: Da den bigiman fu keliki anga den leliman fu Dyuweiti be yee. Ne den e puubei fu fende wan fasi fu kii en puu a pasi. Den si taki den wowtu di Masaa Jesesi be foondoo den sama. Da na dati meke den be feele.
eng_text: The chief priests and the scribes heard it, and sought how they might destroy him. For they feared him, because all the multitude was astonished at his teaching.

djk_text: Da di neti, ne en anga den bakaman fi en komoto gwe fika a foto enke fa den be gwenti ala neti.
eng_text: When evening came, he went out of the city.

djk_text: Da a taa dei fuuku mamanten, ne Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en e waka pasa a figasii bon di a be fuuku. A di den luku a bon, ne den si taki a dee te, a fika soso tyaka tyaka.
eng_text: As they passed by in the morning, they saw the fig tree withered away from the roots.

djk_text: Ne Peitilisi denki san Masaa Jesesi be taigi a bon eside. Ne a bali taki: “Masaa, luku de! Ná a bon di i be fuuku, no? A dede te a fika soso tyaka tyaka.”
eng_text: Peter, remembering, said to him, "Rabbi, look! The fig tree which you cursed has withered away."

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Efu u biibi Gadu, da u sa taigi a mongo ya taki: ‘Opo komoto ya go a ini ze.’ Da a sa pasa enke fa u taki. Ma efu u á biibi Gadu doo a ini u ati, da a ná o pasa.
eng_text: Jesus answered them, "Have faith in God.

djk_text: A dati meke mi e taigi u taki: Te u akisi Gadu wan sani, da u mu biibi dipi te a ini u ati taki a gi u en kaba. Da a sa pasa so. Wansi san u akisi Masaa Gadu te u e begi, u mu biibi taki u kisi en kaba.
eng_text: Therefore I tell you, all things whatever you pray and ask for, believe that you have received them, and you shall have them.

djk_text: Da te yu go fu go begi taki anga Masaa Gadu, ma yu anga wan sama abi sani, da i mu gi en paadon. Da na soseefi i Tata o gi yu paadon tu fu den ogii di yu du.
eng_text: Whenever you stand praying, forgive, if you have anything against anyone; so that your Father, who is in heaven, may also forgive you your transgressions.

djk_text: Ma efu u á gi paadon, da u Tata a tapu ná o gi u paadon fu den ogii di u du tu.”
eng_text: But if you do not forgive, neither will your Father in heaven forgive your transgressions."

djk_text: Da Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en kon a Jelusalem Foto. Ne a go a ini a Mama Keliki. Ne den leliman fu Dyuweiti anga den moo hei apaiti begiman anga den gaansama fu Dyu Kondee kon ne en.
eng_text: They came again to Jerusalem, and as he was walking in the temple, the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders came to him,

djk_text: Ne den taigi en taki: “Fa yu du den sani a ini a Mama Keliki de, sama sende yu? Sama gi yu pasi fu du den sani di yu du de?”
eng_text: and they began saying to him, "By what authority do you do these things? Or who gave you this authority to do these things?"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “A bun, mi yee san u akisi mi. Ma mi seefi wani akisi u wan sani fosi mi piki u. Da efu u taigi mi, da mi o taigi u tu, sama gi mi pasi fu du den sani di mi du de.”
eng_text: Jesus said to them, "I will ask you one question. Answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.

djk_text: Ne a akisi den taki: “U taigi mi. Johanisi a Dopuman na Masaa Gadu be sende en fu dopu sama, efu na libisama be sende en?”
eng_text: The baptism of John--was it from heaven, or from men? Answer me."

djk_text: Ne den daai luku denseefi san fu den piki. Ne den bende a se. Ne den taki saafi saafi anga denseefi taki: “Efu u piki taki: ‘Na Gadu be sende en,’ da a o akisi u taki: ‘Saide meke u á be biibi a dopu fi en?’
eng_text: They reasoned with themselves, saying, "If we should say, 'From heaven;' he will say, 'Why then did you not believe him?'

djk_text: Da efu u piki taki: ‘Ná libisama be sende en,’ da den sama fu a kondee o opo meke toobi anga wi.” Bika den sama fu a kondee be de sabi sabi taki Johanisi na be wan apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: If we should say, 'From men'"--they feared the people, for all held John to really be a prophet.

djk_text: Dati meke den piki Masaa Jesesi taki: “We, wi á sabi sama be sende Johanisi.” Ne Masaa Jesesi akisi den taki: “U á sabi, no? We, da mi nái taigi u tu sama gi mi pasi fu du den sani de.”
eng_text: They answered Jesus, "We don't know." Jesus said to them, "Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi gi den wan ageisi toli fu wan gaan masaa di koti wan goon. A taki: “Di a kaba koti en, ne a paandi en, te a kaba anga wan sii den e kai doloifi. Di a kaba paandi en, ne a lontu en a dyali, fu sama á kon a ini a goon lawlaw. Soseefi a meke wan siton baki fu mii a doloifi. Ne a meke wan hei sodoo masanga go a tapu a ini a goon, fu waki a goon. Da di a du ala den sani ya, ne a yuu a goon gi taa paandi goon man. Ne a gwe a taa kondee.
eng_text: He began to speak to them in parables. "A man planted a vineyard, put a hedge around it, dug a pit for the winepress, built a tower, rented it out to a farmer, and went into another country.

djk_text: Ne a de anda te di den doloifi lepi, ne a sende wan wookoman fi en, fu go teke fi en se doloifi kon gi en.
eng_text: When it was time, he sent a servant to the farmer to get from the farmer his share of the fruit of the vineyard.

djk_text: Ma di a wookoman go, ne den man kisi en, ne den fonmi en te a fon, ne den sende en gwe anga soso ana ne en masaa baka.
eng_text: They took him, beat him, and sent him away empty.

djk_text: “Ne a masaa fu a goon sende wan taa wookoman go. Ma disi yaaso, na a seefi. Den fonmi en te den basi en ede, du ala sowtu ogii anga en.
eng_text: Again, he sent another servant to them; and they threw stones at him, wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully treated.

djk_text: Da a sende ete wan wookoman fi en go. Ma disi moo ogii. Den fonmi en te den kii en. Na so a masaa fu a goon sende somen somen taa wookoman fi en go. Ma den man du ogii anga ala fiya. Taawan den fon te den swaki potoo, taawan den kii.
eng_text: Again he sent another; and they killed him; and many others, beating some, and killing some.

djk_text: Ne a man e denki a ini enseefi taki: ‘San mi mu du? Sama mi o sende go moo?’ Bika na awan kodo manpikin fi en be fika, di a be sa sende. Ne a taki: ‘I sabi san? Mi o sende awan kodo manpikin fu mi go. Bika disi na mi manpikin, da den musu abi lesipeki gi en.’
eng_text: Therefore still having one, his beloved son, he sent him last to them, saying, 'They will respect my son.'

djk_text: “Ma di den si a manpikin e kon, ne den pakisei taki: ‘A ná a pikin fu a masaa di yuu a goon gi u e kon de, no? Ne en ai! Meke u kii en, bika te a dda dede, da ala sani o fika gi en. Ma efu u kii en, da a goon o toon fu wi.’
eng_text: But those farmers said among themselves, 'This is the heir. Come, let's kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.'

djk_text: Ne den kisi en, ne den naki kii. Ne den fiingi en towe a busi.”
eng_text: They took him, killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi akisi den taki: “San u denki a gaan masaa fu a goon o du di a o yee taki, den kii a manpikin fi en tu? Ne enseefi o go luku en goon, no? Ne enseefi o go! Da a o kii den goon man, di a be yuu a goon gi puu a pasi, da a o yuu en gi taa sama.”
eng_text: What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do? He will come and destroy the farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi akisi den baka taki: “U á leisi Masaa Gadu Buku, no? We, a sikiifi taki: ‘Disi na a siton di meseeman be oli fu wan soso sani. Na dati daai kon toon a siton futu fu a hii osu.
eng_text: Haven't you even read this Scripture: 'The stone which the builders rejected, the same was made the head of the corner.

djk_text: Na so Masaa du en wooko. Ai foondoo gi wi, fu si.’ ”
eng_text: This was from the Lord, it is marvelous in our eyes'?"

djk_text: Da den moo hei apaiti begiman fusutan bunbun taki, na den Masaa Jesesi be e poti na ageisi toli de so. Ne den ati boon ne en ogii ogii. Da na dati meke den be e suku wan fasi fu kisi Masaa Jesesi go sooto wanten wanten. Ma den á be poi kisi en, bika den be sabi taki den sama fu a kondee ati be o boon a den tuutuu. We, na fu dati ede meke den fika en, ne den gwe.
eng_text: They tried to seize him, but they feared the multitude; for they perceived that he spoke the parable against them. They left him, and went away.

djk_text: Ne di den gwe kaba, ne den sende wantu Faliseiman anga wantu bakaman fu Kownu Helowdesi go a Masaa Jesesi. Da den be mu suku Masaa Jesesi mofu fu a taki sani di á bun fu den be sa fende en kii.
eng_text: They sent some of the Pharisees and of the Herodians to him, that they might trap him with words.

djk_text: Di den doo a Masaa Jesesi, ne den taigi en taki: “Mesiti! U sabi taki den sani di yu e taki, na tuutuu sani. Yu na wan kiinkiin sama. Yu e soi libisama fa Masaa Gadu wani den libi. Yu ná abi toobi anga san libisama e taki. Yu á lobi wan sama moo enke taawan. Ma u kon fu akisi yu wan sani.” Ne den akisi en taki: “Taigi u, efu a de fanowdu fu u pai a moo gaan kownu a Loma Foto, a lantimoni.
eng_text: When they had come, they asked him, "Teacher, we know that you are honest, and don't defer to anyone; for you aren't partial to anyone, but truly teach the way of God. Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?

djk_text: Da i si a de fanowdu, fu u pai dati?” Ma Masaa Jesesi be sabi kaba san den be wani du. A sabi taki na suku den be kon suku en mofu fu den be sa fende e kii. Ne a akisi den taki: “Na kon u kon puubei mi, no? Saide meke u kon puubei fu fasi mi so? We, u tyai wan moni kon gi mi, osi?”
eng_text: Shall we give, or shall we not give?" But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said to them, "Why do you test me? Bring me a denarius, that I may see it."

djk_text: Ne den tyai a moni kon gi en. Ne a akisi den taki: “Sama fesi de na a moni ya tapu? Sama nen sikiifi ne en?” Ne den piki taki: “Na a moo gaan kownu a Loma Foto.”
eng_text: They brought it. He said to them, "Whose is this image and inscription?" They said to him, "Caesar's."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi akisi den taki: “We, efu na a moo gaan kownu a Loma Foto fesi, anga en nen den ne en tapu, da na fu a gaan kownu. Da gi a gaan kownu de san de fu a gaan kownu de. Ma gi Masaa Gadu san na fu Masaa Gadu.” Da den foondoo fu a fasi fa Masaa Jesesi piki den ya.
eng_text: Jesus answered them, "Render to Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and to God the things that are God's." They marveled greatly at him.

djk_text: Ne bakadati, ne wantu Saduseisama kon a Masaa Jesesi fu akisi en wan sani. Da den Saduseisama na sama di nái biibi taki te wan sama dede a sa weki baka komoto a dede.
eng_text: There came to him Sadducees, who say that there is no resurrection. They asked him, saying,

djk_text: Namo den taigi Masaa Jesesi taki: “Mesiti! Masaa Gadu be meke Mosesi sikiifi a Gadu Buku gi wi taki: ‘Ofu wan man anga wan uman libi, ma a man dede sondee fu meke pikin anga a uman, da a baka baala fu a man mu libi anga a uman fu meke pikin gi a baala di dede.’ Da na so a weiti fu Mosesi e leli wi.
eng_text:
Teacher, Moses wrote to us, 'If a man's brother dies, and leaves a wife behind him, and leaves no children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up offspring for his brother.'
1530	Ma namo, da seibin baala be de. A moo gaanwan libi anga wan uman te a dede, a á meke ná wan kodo pikin anga en.	1530	There were seven brothers. The first took a wife, and dying left no offspring.
1531	Ne a pikin baala di waka ne en baka teke a uman libi. Ma enseefi dede sondee fu meke wan pikin anga en. Da soseefi di fu dii baala teke a uman libi. Ma enseefi dede sondee fu meke wan pikin anga en.	1531	The second took her, and died, leaving no children behind him. The third likewise;
1532	Da na so ala den seibin baala libi anga a uman te ala den dede. Ná wan di meke wankodo pikin anga en seefi. Ne te fu kaba, ne a uman seefi dede.	1532	and the seven took her and left no children. Last of all the woman also died.
1533	We, Masaa, u wani akisi yu: ‘Te a yuu o doo fu den sama opo komoto a dede, da on di fu den man ya o abi a uman?’ We, bika ala den seibin baala be libi anga en.”	1533	In the resurrection, when they rise, whose wife will she be of them? For the seven had her as a wife.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “U á sabi leti leti san sikiifi a Gadu Buku. Da u á sabi a kaakiti di Masaa Gadu e weki sama puu a dede tu.
eng_text: Jesus answered them, "Isn't this because you are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures, nor the power of God?

djk_text: Bika te sama o opo baka a dede, da uman anga man libi ná o de moo. Den o de enke Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee .
eng_text: For when they will rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are like angels in heaven.

djk_text: Ma boiti dati, da u á leisi san Mosesi be sikiifi poti a Gadu Buku, no? Den Buku fu Mosesi sikiifi taki, wan leisi Mosesi be si wan busi e boon. Ne di a luku a busi bun, ne a yee Masaa Gadu taigi en taki: ‘Mi na a Gadu di den gaansama fu u di den e kai Abalaham, Isaki anga Jakopu e begi.’
eng_text: But about the dead, that they are raised; haven't you read in the book of Moses, about the Bush, how God spoke to him, saying, 'I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob' ?

djk_text: Masaa Gadu á de a Gadu fu sama di e dede gwe, da a kaba. Ma en na a Gadu fu sama di anga ala fa den sikin dede seefi, toku den e libi. Da u misi anga san u akisi de.”
eng_text: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living. You are therefore badly mistaken."

djk_text: Da wan fu den leliman fu Dyuweiti be yee fa Masaa Jesesi piki den Saduseisama wan koni fasi. Ne a man ya waka kon moo koosube. Ne a akisi Masaa Jesesi taki: “Masaa! Fu ala den somen Dyuweiti di de, on di fu den na a moo heiwan?”
eng_text: One of the scribes came, and heard them questioning together. Knowing that he had answered them well, asked him, "Which commandment is the greatest of all?"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “A moo hei weiti na a weti di taki: ‘U aliki, sama fu Islayeli Kondee. Masaa Gadu, a Gadu fu wi, ne na awan kodo Gadu di de.
eng_text: Jesus answered, "The greatest is, 'Hear, Israel, the Lord our God, the Lord is one:

djk_text: Da u mu lobi en anga u hii ati. Da soseefi u mu lobi en anga ala u akaa anga ala u pakisei anga ala u kaakiti.’ Taa weiti á de di bigi moo disi.
eng_text: you shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your mind, and with all your strength.' This is the first commandment.

djk_text: Da di fu tu weiti taki: ‘I mu lobi taa sama enke fa i lobi iseefi.’ Moo gaan weiti moo den tu weiti ya á de.”
eng_text: The second is like this, 'You shall love your neighbor as yourself.' There is no other commandment greater than these."

djk_text: Ne a leliman fu Dyuweiti taigi en taki: “Na tuu Masaa, san yu taki. Na wan kodo tuutuu Gadu namo de. Da ná wan taa Gadu de enke en.
eng_text: The scribe said to him, "Truly, teacher, you have said well that he is one, and there is none other but he,

djk_text: Da u mu lobi en anga u hii ati. Soseefi u mu lobi en anga ala u pakisei anga ala u kaakiti. Da u mu lobi ala taa sama enke fa u lobi useefi. Da den tu weiti ya hei moo enke a weiti di taki: ‘U mu kii meti boon gi Masaa Gadu.’ ”
eng_text: and to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, with all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbor as himself, is more important than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices."

djk_text: Da Masaa Jesesi si taki a man fusutan bunbun, bika a piki en bun. Ne a taigi a man taki: “Yu á de faawe moo fu kon a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu.” Da di Masaa Jesesi piki a man ya so, ne ná wan sama be abi a deki ati moo, fu akisi en wan sani.
eng_text: When Jesus saw that he answered wisely, he said to him, "You are not far from the Kingdom of God." No one dared ask him any question after that.

djk_text: Da di Masaa Jesesi de a ini a Mama Keliki e leli den sama te wan pisi, ne a akisi den taki: “Fa den leliman fu Dyuweiti sa leli u taki Kelestesi, na wan bakaten manpikin fu Kownu Dafeti paansu namo, da a kaba?
eng_text: Jesus responded, as he taught in the temple, "How is it that the scribes say that the Christ is the son of David?

djk_text: Bika, we na a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu be piki Kownu Dafeti seefi taki: ‘Masaa Gadu taigi mi Masaa taki: “Sidon a mi leti ana se ya, te enke mi poti ala den feyanti fi yu a yu futu ondoo.” ’
eng_text: For David himself said in the Holy Spirit, 'The Lord said to my Lord, "Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet."'

djk_text: We, Kownu Dafeti seefi kai en, Masaa. Da efu Kelestesi na be wan bakaten manpikin fu Kownu Dafeti namo, da i denki taki, a be o kai en, Masaa?” We, di Masaa Jesesi piki den so, da a be switi gi den somen sama di be taampu de e aliki.
eng_text: Therefore David himself calls him Lord, so how can he be his son?" The common people heard him gladly.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi bali den taki: “U mu luku bun anga den leliman fu Dyuweiti. Den lobi wei gaan moi langa dii yapon e waka e lontu fu sama mu si den. Da te den e waka a den wowoyo peesi den lobi te den sama e gi den odi anga gaan lesipeki.
eng_text: In his teaching he said to them, "Beware of the scribes, who like to walk in long robes, and to get greetings in the marketplaces,

djk_text: Te den de a ini den Dyu keliki den lobi sidon te a fesi enke bigiman. Da soseefi den e suku a moo bun peesi te den sidon a tafaa fu nyan. Da na so den e poti denseefi enke bunbun sama.
eng_text: and the best seats in the synagogues, and the best places at feasts:

djk_text: Ma u mu luku bun fu u á teke a fasi fu den fu libi. Bika den e teke somen sani fu den pooti uman di man dede fika a ganda. Te anga den osu fu den uman ya seefi den e teke. Da anga ala a fasi de, den e begi gaan langa begi fu soi sama fa den bun anga fa den lobi Gadu. Da den sama ya o kisi a moo gaan sitaafu fu Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: those who devour widows' houses, and for a pretense make long prayers. These will receive greater condemnation."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi waka go sidon na a se fu a baki pe den sama e poti keliki moni te den kon a keliki. Ne a luku fa den sama e poti moni te a kaba. Da somen guduman be poti tyaipi moni.
eng_text: Jesus sat down opposite the treasury, and saw how the multitude cast money into the treasury. Many who were rich cast in much.

djk_text: Da di den poti te wan pisi, ne a si wan pooti uman di á be abi man moo be kon poti tu. Ne ai luku onmen a uman ya o poti. Ne a si a poti tu kopoo sensi go a ini a baki.
eng_text: A poor widow came, and she cast in two small brass coins, which equal a quadrans coin.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi kai den bakaman fi en taki: “U kon!” Ne den kon. Ne a taigi den taki: “U si a pooti uman de? A poti tu kopoo sensi namo go a ini a baki, ma fu tuu, a poti ipi moo ala den taawan di poti.
eng_text: He called his disciples to himself, and said to them, "Most certainly I tell you, this poor widow gave more than all those who are giving into the treasury,

djk_text: Bika den guduman gi san di den á be abi fanowdu. Ma a uman ya poti ala san a be abi. A á kibii ná wan kopoo sensi fi enseefi.”
eng_text: for they all gave out of their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, gave all that she had to live on."

djk_text: Da di Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en komoto a ini a Mama Keliki, ne wan fu den taki: “Masaa, luku de fa a Mama Keliki moi! Den siton di den meke en bigi!”
eng_text: As he went out of the temple, one of his disciples said to him, "Teacher, see what kind of stones and what kind of buildings!"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Weeno! U si ala den gaanbigi osu de? Sama o feti booko ala fiya te a doti. Ná wan ná o taampu de moo.”
eng_text: Jesus said to him, "Do you see these great buildings? There will not be left here one stone on another, which will not be thrown down."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi go sidon na a Oleifi Mongo na abaase fu a Mama Keliki.
eng_text: As he sat on the Mount of Olives opposite the temple, Peter, James, John, and Andrew asked him privately,

djk_text: Ne Peitilisi anga Jakowbesi anga Johanisi anga Andeleyasi kon ne en. Ne den anga en wawan de ape. Ne den akisi en taki: “Masaa Jesesi, on ten a sani di i taigi u de o pasa anga a Mama Keliki? Da san na den maiki di wi o si taki a yuu doo fu sowan sani pasa?”
eng_text: Tell us, when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are all about to be fulfilled?

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “U mu luku bun anga useefi fu sama á koli u kisi puu na a biibi.
eng_text: Jesus, answering, began to tell them, "Be careful that no one leads you astray.

djk_text: Bika somen sama o opo e koli sama taki na den na a Kelestesi. Da den o koli somen sama kisi.
eng_text: For many will come in my name, saying, 'I am he! ' and will lead many astray.

djk_text: U o yee fu oloku feti ya anga fu oloku feti so. Ma u á mu feele! Bika, den sani ya musu fu pasa. Ma te den sani ya e pasa, da u á mu si enke na a kaba fu goontapu doo kaba.
eng_text:
When you hear of wars and rumors of wars, don't be troubled. For those must happen, but the end is not yet.

eng_text: You will be hated by all men for my name's sake, but he who endures to the end, the same will be saved.

djk_text: “Na a ten di de a u fesi e kon, da sama o si a takuu kiiman. A o de na a apaiti peesi fu Masaa Gadu a ini a Mama Keliki a Jelusalem. Da den sama di de a Judeja mu lon go a den mongo go kibii.” A sama di e leisi a sani ya, mu leisi en bunbun fu fusutan san ai leisi.
eng_text: But when you see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not (let the reader understand), then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains,

djk_text: “Den sama di o de a doose á mu go a ini den osu fu go teke sani. Den mu lon.
eng_text: and let him who is on the housetop not go down, nor enter in, to take anything out of his house.

djk_text: Den sama di o de a goon e wooko á mu daai fu go a osu fu go teke koosi. Den mu lon.
eng_text: Let him who is in the field not return back to take his cloak.

djk_text: Da a ten ya o takuu seefi gi den uman di de anga bee, ofu den uman di de anga pikin na ana.
eng_text: But woe to those who are with child and to those who nurse babies in those days!

djk_text: U mu begi Masaa Gadu fu a takuu ten ya á pasa na a koo pisiten fu a yali.
eng_text: Pray that your flight won't be in the winter.

djk_text: Bika wan sitaafu de fu kon a goontapu. Da senten di goontapu sete, te enke tide, noiti so wan sitaafu be kon ete. Da soseefi noiti sowan sitaafu sa kon moo tu.
eng_text: For in those days there will be oppression, such as there has not been the like from the beginning of the creation which God created until now, and never will be.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Gadu satu den dei ya. Bika efu ná so, ná wan sama be o fika anga libi a goontapu. Ala fiya be o dede. Ma a satu den dei ya fu den sama di e biibi ne en ede.
eng_text: Unless the Lord had shortened the days, no flesh would have been saved; but for the sake of the chosen ones, whom he picked out, he shortened the days.

djk_text: “Da te wan sama o kon a u taki: ‘Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi de ya.’ Ofu, ‘A de so.’ Kweti Kweti! U á biibi den, ye!
eng_text: Then if anyone tells you, 'Look, here is the Christ!' or, 'Look, there!' don't believe it.

djk_text: Sama o koli u taki, den na Kelestesi. Taawan o koli u taki, den na apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu. Da den o go e du gaan foondoo sani tu fu puubei fu ali den sama di e biibi a Masaa Gadu puu ne en, efu den be man.
eng_text: For there will arise false christs and false prophets, and will show signs and wonders, that they may lead astray, if possible, even the chosen ones.

djk_text: Mi e taki gi u a fesi. U luku bun anga useefi, fu san di de a fesi fu kon. U á meke sama koli u kisi.”
eng_text: But you watch. "Behold, I have told you all things beforehand.

djk_text: Da, ne Masaa Jesesi taki go doo taki: “Da na a yuu de, te a gaan sitaafu anga pina pasa, ‘da a san fesi o dunguu. Da a mun ná o kiin peesi moo tu.
eng_text: But in those days, after that oppression, the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light,

djk_text: Da hii goontapu, a tapu a den woluku o seke. Da den sitali di de a tapu o komoto a den peesi kai.’
eng_text: the stars will be falling from the sky, and the powers that are in the heavens will be shaken.

djk_text: “Da bakadati, da ala sama o si a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya, a tapu a den woluku ini. A o kon anga gaan dyendee anga ala makiti.
eng_text: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in clouds with great power and glory.

djk_text: Da a o sende den Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee, fu kon piki ala den sama di be e biibi en na ala se fu goontapu, kon na awan.”
eng_text: Then he will send out his angels, and will gather together his chosen ones from the four winds, from the ends of the earth to the ends of the sky.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den go doo taki: “U denki wan figasii bon. Te u si taki, ai piiti boomiki, da u sabi kaba taki, a o meke nyanyan dyonson.
eng_text:
Now from the fig tree, learn this parable. When the branch has now become tender, and puts forth its leaves, you know that the summer is near;

eng_text: Watch therefore, for you don't know when the lord of the house is coming, whether at evening, or at midnight, or when the rooster crows, or in the morning;
