eng_text: lest coming suddenly he might find you sleeping.

djk_text: San mi taki gi u ya, de fu ala sama. U tan na ain! U tan luku on ten mi o kon baka.”
eng_text: What I tell you, I tell all: Watch."

djk_text: Da a yuu di Masaa Jesesi be e taki anga den bakaman fi en de, da a be fika tu dei fosi a Pasika Fesa fu den Dyusama be doo. Da a pisiten ya, den e nyan paata beele di meke sondee sowda.
eng_text: It was now two days before the feast of the Passover and the unleavened bread, and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might seize him by deception, and kill him.

djk_text: Da den hei apaiti begiman anga den leliman fu Dyuweiti taki: “Wi mu suku wan fasi fu kii a man Jesesi puu a pasi. Ma wi á mu kisi en na a fesa ya. Bika, da den sama o opo taampu meke opuulu anga wi.”
eng_text: For they said, "Not during the feast, because there might be a riot of the people."

djk_text: Da Masaa Jesesi be de a wan foto den e kai Betaniya a ini a osu fu wan man den be e kai, Simon a Gwasiman. Da di den sidon fu nyan, ne wan uman kon a ini a osu. Da a tyai wan moi pikin bataa anga wan gaan dii switi sumee fatu fu onmen tenti dunsu kolu a ini. Ne a waka langa langa te a Masaa Jesesi. Ne a opo a bataa, ne a kandi a dii switi sumee fatu kunkunkun towe a Masaa Jesesi ede.
eng_text: While he was at Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at the table, a woman came having an alabaster jar of ointment of pure nard--very costly. She broke the jar, and poured it over his head.

djk_text: Da fa a uman kandi a switi sumee fatu a Masaa Jesesi ede so, da a á be bun gi wantu fu den taa sama di be sidon a tafaa e nyan. Ne den bali a uman taki: “Saide meke yu towe a dii switi fatu ya poli so du?
eng_text: But there were some who were indignant among themselves, saying, "Why has this ointment been wasted?

djk_text: I be sa seli a fatu fu tyaipi moni, da i be paati a moni gi den pootiman.”
eng_text: For this might have been sold for more than three hundred denarii, and given to the poor." They grumbled against her.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi yee den, ne a bali den taki: “U fika en meke a du san ai du. Saide meke u e bali en du? San di a uman ya du na wan bun sani a du gi mi ya.
eng_text: But Jesus said, "Leave her alone. Why do you trouble her? She has done a good work for me.

djk_text: Bika pootiman o de alaten fu solugu. Da efu u wani gi den moni, da alaten u sa gi den. Ma mi na fu wan pisiten mi de ya anga u. Da efu wan sama wani du wan bun gi mi, da na now a mu du en gi mi. A uman ya du ala san a be sa du gi mi.
eng_text: For you always have the poor with you, and whenever you want to, you can do them good; but you will not always have me.

djk_text: Da a sani di a uman du ya, ná wan soso sani. A fatu di a iti a mi ede tapu ya, na seeka a seeka a sikin fu mi kaba. Bika dyonson den o kii mi.
eng_text: She has done what she could. She has anointed my body beforehand for the burying.

djk_text: Da fu tuutuu mi e taigi u taki, goontapu ná o feegete a sani di a uman du gi mi ya. Bika na ala se fu goontapu, pe den o taki a Bun Nyunsu, den sa taki fu a sani di a uman ya du gi mi.”
eng_text: Most certainly I tell you, wherever this Good News may be preached throughout the whole world, that which this woman has done will also be spoken of for a memorial of her."

djk_text: Da Judasi Iskaliyotu, wan fu den twalufu bakaman fi en komoto peb, ne a waka tilo tilo, te a den hei apaiti begiman. Ne a taigi den taki: “Efu u wani, mi sa yeepi u fu kisi a man Jesesi.”
eng_text: Judas Iscariot, who was one of the twelve, went away to the chief priests, that he might deliver him to them.

djk_text: Ne di Judasi taigi den so, den piisii seefi. Ne den taigi Judasi taki: “Judasi, efi i yeepi wi enke fa i taki wi o pai yu.” Da di den taigi en so, ne a daai go baka a Masaa Jesesi. Da fanafu a ten de, ne ai lulu on ten a sa fende pasi fu seli Masaa Jesesi gi den hei apaiti begiman.
eng_text: They, when they heard it, were glad, and promised to give him money. He sought how he might conveniently deliver him.

djk_text: Ma namo, da a fosi dei fu a Pasika Fesa doo. Da den e kii wan pikin sikapu na a fosi dei di den be o nyan a beele sondee sowda. Da di a dei doo, ne den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi akisi en taki: “Masaa, pe i wani meke u nyan a Pasika ya? Efi i taigi wi, da u sa go seeka ala sani.”
eng_text: On the first day of unleavened bread, when they sacrificed the Passover, his disciples asked him, "Where do you want us to go and prepare that you may eat the Passover?"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi kai tu fu den bakaman fi en, ne a sende den taki: “U go a Jelusalem. Da te u o go, da u o si wan man anga wan bungu wataa a pasi.
eng_text: He sent two of his disciples, and said to them, "Go into the city, and there you will meet a man carrying a pitcher of water. Follow him,

djk_text: Da u mu waka ne en baka te na a osu pe ai go. Da te u doo, da u mu taigi a man di abi a osu taki: ‘Masaa Jesesi sende u fu akisi en on pisi fu a osu u sa nyan a Pasika Fesa tide neti.’
eng_text: and wherever he enters in, tell the master of the house, 'The Teacher says, "Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?"'

djk_text: Da a o tyai u go a sodoo go soi wan gaan kambaa. Da ala sani di u abi fanowdu fu seeka sani de a ini a kambaa de kaba. Da u seeka sani de fu u nyan a Pasika.”
eng_text: He will himself show you a large upper room furnished and ready. Get ready for us there."

djk_text: Ne den tu man go enke fa Masaa Jesesi sende den. Di den doo Jelusalem, ne ala sani waka enke fa a be taigi den. Ne den seeka sani fu den nyan a Pasika.
eng_text: His disciples went out, and came into the city, and found things as he had said to them, and they prepared the Passover.

djk_text: Da di sapaten, ne Masaa Jesesi anga den taa bakaman fi en kon na a osu. Ne den sidon fu nyan. Da di den sidon e nyan, te wan pisi, ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “Fu tuutuu, wan fu u di sidon e nyan anga mi ya, o seli mi gi den ogii ati sama den kii.”
eng_text: When it was evening he came with the twelve.

djk_text: Da di Masaa Jesesi taigi den so, a sani be toobi den ati tuutuu. Den ati booko. Ne wan fu wan den e akisi taki: “Sama sa de ya di o seli Masaa, no? Masaa a sa de taki, na mi?”
eng_text: They began to be sorrowful, and to ask him one by one, "Surely not I?" And another said, "Surely not I?"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki taki: “Eeye, wan fu u twalufu di e dipi beele anga mi a ini awan baafun ya, o seli mi.
eng_text: He answered them, "It is one of the twelve, he who dips with me in the dish.

djk_text: We, a de so taki, den apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu be sikiifi fu a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya. Da ala den sani de fiya mu pasa enke fa den be taki. Ma, heelu fu a sama di o seli a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya! A moo betee, a á be meke kon a ondoo goontapu wan dei.”
eng_text: For the Son of Man goes, even as it is written about him, but woe to that man by whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would be better for that man if he had not been born."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi teke wan beele, ne a gi Masaa Gadu daa, ne a booko en pisipisi. Ne a gi den bakaman fi en taki: “U luku ya! Disi na mi sikin. U teke, da u nyan.”
eng_text: As they were eating, Jesus took bread, and when he had blessed, he broke it, and gave to them, and said, "Take, eat. This is my body."

djk_text: Ne a teke wan kan win, ne a gi Masaa Gadu daa, ne a gi den bakaman fi en taki: “U luku ya! U diingi.” Ne den diingi.
eng_text: He took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave to them. They all drank of it.

djk_text: Ne a taigi den taki: “A win ya na mi buulu di sa lon gi somen sama fu meke den anga Masaa Gadu kon bun baka. Disi na wan nyun kuudei di Masaa Gadu o meke anga libisama. Bika na a buulu fu mi o pai fu ala den takuudu anga ogii.
eng_text: He said to them, "This is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many.

djk_text: Da fu tuutuu, mi ná o diingi win na a sowtu fasi ya moo, fu te enke mi de a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu, fu diingi en wan nyun fasi.”
eng_text: Most certainly I tell you, I will no more drink of the fruit of the vine, until that day when I drink it anew in the Kingdom of God."

djk_text: Ne den singi wan singi gi Masaa Gadu gaandi. Ne den opo komoto de e gwe na a mongo, di den e kai Oleifi Mongo.
eng_text: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.

djk_text: Ne di Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en de a pasi e gwe, ne a taigi den taki: “U ala fiya o lon kibii fika. Da a o pasa leti enke fa Masaa Gadu Buku taki. Bika a sikiifi taki: ‘Te mi o kii a soluguman fu den sikapu, da ala den sikapu o lon panya panya gwe na ala se.’ ”
eng_text: Jesus said to them, "All of you will be made to stumble because of me tonight, for it is written, 'I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered.'

djk_text: Ne a taigi den go doo taki: “Ma te mi o opo baka komoto a dede, da mi o go a u fesi fu miti anga u a Galileya.”
eng_text: However, after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee."

djk_text: Ne Peitilisi piki en taki: “Masaa, awansi ala sama o lon kibii fika yu wawan, mi noiti o fika yu.”
eng_text: But Peter said to him, "Although all will be offended, yet I will not."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Peitilisi, fu tuutuu, mi e taigi yu! A neti ya seefi, fosi wan kakafoo bali tu toon, yu o lei dii toon taki yu á sabi mi.”
eng_text: Jesus said to him, "Most certainly I tell you, that you today, even this night, before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times."

djk_text: Ne Peitilisi akisi en taki: “Masaa! Mi o taki mi á sabi yu? Noiti! A moo betee mi anga yu dede! Ma noiti mi o lei taki mi á sabi yu.” Da soseefi den taa bakaman fi en piki tu. Da di Masaa Jesesi taigi den so kaba, ne den gwe.
eng_text: But he spoke all the more, "If I must die with you, I will not deny you." They all said the same thing.

djk_text: Da den go a wan peesi den e kai Getsemanei Dyali.
eng_text: They came to a place which was named Gethsemane. He said to his disciples, "Sit here, while I pray."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den bakaman fi en taki: “U kon sidon ya. Mi o waka go pikinso moo faawe fu begi.” Da a tyai Peitilisi anga Jakowbesi anga Johanisi go anga en.
eng_text: He took with him Peter, James, and John, and began to be greatly troubled and distressed.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi bigin fuka te a taigi den dii bakaman fi en taki: “Ai hebi gi mi! Mi o dede! U tan ya, da u oli begi.”
eng_text: He said to them, "My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here, and watch."

djk_text: Ne a waka go pikinso moo faawe, ne a losi enseefi towe a doti holow.
eng_text: He went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour might pass away from him.

djk_text: Ne a begi taki: “Kee, Masaa Gadu, mi Tata ! Ná wan sani de di yu á poi du. Ala sani fiya i sa du. Da mi begi yu, puu a kan di i lai gi mi ya fu diingi, efu a kan. Ma mi Tata, a ná san mi wani mu pasa, ma meke sani waka enke fa yu wani.”
eng_text: He said, "Abba, Father, all things are possible to you. Please remove this cup from me. However, not what I desire, but what you desire."

djk_text: Da, di Masaa Jesesi begi so, ne a go a den dii bakaman fi en baka. Ne a si den siibi siibi. Ne a weki den. Ne a akisi Peitilisi taki: “Simon! Yu e siibi? Yu á poi meke taanga sikin, fu de anga ain wankodo yuu langa anga mi seefi, no?
eng_text: He came and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, "Simon, are you sleeping? Couldn't you watch one hour?

djk_text: U tan na ain oli waki! Da u begi taanga, fu didibii á wini u. Bika mi sabi taki, u ati wani, ma sikin ná abi kaakiti sai.”
eng_text: Watch and pray, that you may not enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi waka gwe baka, ne a begi a seefi begi enke fa a be begi kaba.
eng_text: Again he went away, and prayed, saying the same words.

djk_text: Ne a daai go a den bakaman fi en baka. Ne a si taki den kai a siibi baka, bika den ain be hebi. Da den á be sabi san fu piki Masaa Jesesi moo tu.
eng_text: Again he returned, and found them sleeping, for their eyes were very heavy, and they didn't know what to answer him.

djk_text: Ne a go baka go begi di fu dii toon. Da di a daai kon baka, ne a si taki den man fi en e siibi baka. Ne a akisi den taki: “U e siibi baka? We, a sai!
eng_text: He came the third time, and said to them, "Sleep on now, and take your rest. It is enough. The hour has come. Behold, the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

djk_text: U opo meke u gwe. Luku de! A yuu doo di a sama di seli a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya, gi den ogii ati sama, doo kaba.”
eng_text: Arise, let us be going. Behold, he who betrays me is at hand."

djk_text: Da fa i si Masaa Jesesi kaba taki so, ne Judasi, wan fu den twalufu bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi doo anga onmen tenti man. Da den be tyai fetihow anga kodya fu kon kisi Masaa Jesesi. Da na den hei apaiti begiman anga den leliman fu Dyuweiti anga den gaansama fu kondee be sende den man ya kon anga Judasi fu kon kisi Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: Immediately, while he was still speaking, Judas, one of the twelve, came--and with him a multitude with swords and clubs, from the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders.

djk_text: Da Judasi be meke mofu anga den sama de kaba taki: “A sama di mi o bosi, da ne en na Jesesi. Da u mu kisi en oli kankan fu a á komoto gwe.” Da na so den anga Judasi be meke mofu.
eng_text: Now he who betrayed him had given them a sign, saying, "Whomever I will kiss, that is he. Seize him, and lead him away safely."

djk_text: Ne di den man doo, ne Judasi waka langa langa go a Masaa Jesesi. Ne a taki: “Mesiti, u de?” Ne a baasa en gwulu, ne a bosi en ne en sikin mofu.
eng_text: When he had come, immediately he came to him, and said, "Rabbi! Rabbi!" and kissed him.

djk_text: Da den man sabi kaba taki na a man de na Jesesi. Ne den kisi en gwaa oli kinkin fu tyai gwe.
eng_text: They laid their hands on him, and seized him.

djk_text: Ma namo, wan fu den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi ali en fetihow salla, ne a koti wan fu den wookoman fu a moo hei apaiti begiman yesi puu felen, towe a doti pow.
eng_text: But a certain one of those who stood by drew his sword, and struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi akisi den sama di kon anga Judasi taki: “Fu saide u tyai fetihow anga kodya fu kon kisi enke mi na wan takuu ati sama di e suku fu booko kondee?
eng_text: Jesus answered them, "Have you come out, as against a robber, with swords and clubs to seize me?

djk_text: Saide meke u á be kisi mi, di mi be de ibii dei a ini a Mama Keliki e leli sama fu Masaa Gadu? Ma na fu di a mu waka enke fa Masaa Gadu Buku be taki a fesi, na dati meke u e du so.”
eng_text: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and you didn't arrest me. But this is so that the Scriptures might be fulfilled."

djk_text: Da di den kisi Masaa Jesesi so kaba, ne ala den bakaman fi en lon kibii fika en wawan. Ne den man tyai Masaa Jesesi gwe.
eng_text: They all left him, and fled.

djk_text: Da di den e tyai Masaa Jesesi gwe, da wan kiyoo be e waka a den baka e luku pe den be e tyai Masaa Jesesi go. A boi ya be wei wan koosi enke pangi ne en neki lasi. Ne den ogii man di kisi Masaa Jesesi e tyai gwe lon kon kisi a kiyoo ya tu gwulu.
eng_text: A certain young man followed him, having a linen cloth thrown around himself, over his naked body. The young men grabbed him,

djk_text: Ma namo, a feti te ala a koosi komoto ne en sikin, ne a lon gwe piipii sondee koosi ne en sikin.
eng_text: but he left the linen cloth, and fled from them naked.

djk_text: Da den man tyai Masaa Jesesi go na a moo hei apaiti begiman. Da den hei apaiti begiman anga den gaansama fu kondee be ali kon miti de. Soseefi den leliman fu Dyuweiti tu.
eng_text: They led Jesus away to the high priest. All the chief priests, the elders, and the scribes came together with him.

djk_text: Namo, da Peitilisi be e waka te a baka e fiingi ain e luku pe den o tyai Masaa Jesesi go. Da a waka anga den fu te a ini a dyali fu a moo hei apaiti begiman. Ne a go sidon e waan faya makandii anga den man di be e oli waki.
eng_text: Peter had followed him from a distance, until he came into the court of the high priest. He was sitting with the officers, and warming himself in the light of the fire.

djk_text: Da den hei apaiti begiman anga ala a Dyulanti fu kuutu sani, oli wan kuutu a ini a osu. Da na a kuutu di den be oli ya, den be o suku sama di be sa taki a seefi sani fu sowtu fowtu den sabi fu Masaa Jesesi, fu a á soi enke na fu soso den kii en. Ma den á fende den sama di be poi fu taki a seefi fowtu sani fu Masaa Jesesi di den sabi.
eng_text: Now the chief priests and the whole council sought witnesses against Jesus to put him to death, and found none.

djk_text: Da na somen sama di be e taki lei lei sani fu Masaa Jesesi. Ma den sani di den be e taki be e kengi anga den seefi.
eng_text: For many gave false testimony against him, and their testimony didn't agree with each other.

djk_text: Ne wantu fu den opo, ne den taki somen lei fu Masaa Jesesi. Den taki:
eng_text: Some stood up, and gave false testimony against him, saying,

djk_text: “We, u yee a taki na libisama meke a Mama Keliki osu fu den Dyu. Da a sa booko en, da a meke en baka a ini dii dei, sondee fu libisama ana. Disi a ná sama taigi wi. Na useefi yee anga u yesi.”
eng_text: We heard him say, 'I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and in three days I will build another made without hands.'

djk_text: Ma ala den sani di den taki ya seefi be e kengi anga den seefi.
eng_text: Even so, their testimony did not agree.

djk_text: Da a moo hei apaiti begiman, di be sidon a mindii fu a kuutu opo taampu, ne a akisi Masaa Jesesi taki: “Saide meke i nái piki a tapu fu den sani di den sama e taki fi i ya? Den sani ya na tuu, efu na lei den e lei gi yu?”
eng_text: The high priest stood up in the midst, and asked Jesus, "Have you no answer? What is it which these testify against you?"

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi á piki en ná wan mofu. A de fi en pii. Ne a moo hei apaiti begiman akisi en baka taki: “Na yu na a Kelestesi, a Manpikin fu a Seigi Wan?”
eng_text: But he stayed quiet, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, "Are you the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “A de letiso enke fa iseefi taki de. Da wan dei e kon di u o si a Manpikin di kon saka toon libisama ya sidon sidon a leti ana se fu Masaa Gadu, di abi ala taki. Da soseefi u sa si mi e kon a tapu a den woluku tu.”
eng_text: Jesus said, "I am. You will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming with the clouds of the sky."

djk_text: Ne di Masaa Jesesi piki so, ne a moo hei apaiti begiman ati boon te, a ali en koosi piiti ne en sikin dalla.
eng_text: The high priest tore his clothes, and said, "What further need have we of witnesses?

djk_text: Ne a taki: “U ná abi ná wan sama fanowdu moo fu taigi u sowtu ogii a man ya du. U yee fa ai meke sipowtu anga Gadu? San wi o du anga en?” Ne ala den man piki taki: “A mu dede!”
eng_text: You have heard the blasphemy! What do you think?" They all condemned him to be worthy of death.

djk_text: Da wantu fu den bigin towe wataa mofu a ini Masaa Jesesi fesi. Ne den tei wan koosi tapu en ain. Da den e naki en, ne en fesi kwaa. Da te den naki en, da den e meke sipowtu anga en taki: “Taigi u, osi! Apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu, sama naki yu?” Da den wakitiman fu kownu, di be e oli waki a kownu paleisi seefi, bigin naki Masaa Jesesi tu.
eng_text: Some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to beat him with fists, and to tell him, "Prophesy!" The officers struck him with the palms of their hands.

djk_text: Da Peitilisi de a ini a dyali fu a osu ete a yuu di den e naki Masaa Jesesi so. Ma namo, da wan fu den uman di e wooko a ini a osu fu a moo hei apaiti begiman si Peitilisi.
eng_text: As Peter was in the courtyard below, one of the maids of the high priest came,

djk_text: Ne a uman ya luku en bun a pe a sidon e waan faya, ne a akisi en taki: “Hei! Yu ná wan fu den man fu Jesesi, no? A man fu Nasaleti Kondee?”
eng_text: and seeing Peter warming himself, she looked at him, and said, "You were also with the Nazarene, Jesus!"

djk_text: Ne Peitilisi seke ede taki: “Nono! Ná mi! Mi á sabi a sama di i e taki de.” Ne a opo fu waka go na a dyali mofu. Ne wanten wanten wan kakafoo bali, kokoliyekee.
eng_text: But he denied it, saying, "I neither know, nor understand what you are saying." He went out on the porch, and the rooster crowed.

djk_text: Da a uman ya si di Peitilisi e waka e gwe. Ne a waka ne en baka. Ne a taigi den sama di taampu na a dyali mofu taki: “A man ya, na wan man fu a man Jesesi!”
eng_text: The maid saw him, and began again to tell those who stood by, "This is one of them."

djk_text: Ne Peitilisi bali taki: “A ná tuu! Yu e lei gi mi.” Ne ala den sama di be taampu de bali taki: “Eeye! Yu na wan fu den bakaman fu a man Jesesi! Yu na wan Galileya sama.”
eng_text: But he again denied it. After a little while again those who stood by said to Peter, "You truly are one of them, for you are a Galilean, and your speech shows it."

djk_text: Ne Peitilisi e sitee te ai sweli, taki a á sabi Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: But he began to curse, and to swear, "I don't know this man of whom you speak!"

djk_text: Fa i si a kaba fu sitee, ne a kakafoo bali baka, kokoliyekee, di fu tu toon. Ne a kisi enseefi wanten san Masaa Jesesi be taigi en. Masaa Jesesi be taigi en taki, fosi wan kaka foo bali tu toon yu o lei dii toon taki, yu á sabi mi. Ne a poti ana a mindii ede bali wan gaan adyumadye.
eng_text: The rooster crowed the second time. Peter remembered the word, how that Jesus said to him, "Before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times." When he thought about that, he wept.

djk_text: Namo, da fuuku mamanten, ne den hei apaiti begiman anga den leliman fu Dyuweiti anga den gaansama fu kondee oli wan gaan kuutu baka. Da na a kuutu ya den be o luku san fu den du anga Masaa Jesesi. Ne den fiti mofu taki den o sende Masaa Jesesi go a Gaaman Pilatesi. Na so den bui en ana, ne den tyai en gwe a Gaaman Pilatesi.
eng_text: Immediately in the morning the chief priests, with the elders and scribes, and the whole council, held a consultation, and bound Jesus, and carried him away, and delivered him up to Pilate.

djk_text: Ne Gaaman Pilatesi akisi Masaa Jesesi taki: “Yu na a kownu fu den Dyu?” Ne Masaa Jesesi piki taki: “Na letiso a de, enke fa i si i taki de.”
eng_text: Pilate asked him, "Are you the King of the Jews?" He answered, "So you say."

djk_text: Den hei apaiti begiman bigin taki ala sowtu ogii anga lei fu Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: The chief priests accused him of many things.

djk_text: Ne Gaaman Pilatesi akisi Masaa Jesesi taki: “I nái taki ná wan sani, no? Yee de, fa den sama e taki somen ogii fi yu.”
eng_text: Pilate again asked him, "Have you no answer? See how many things they testify against you!"

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi de pii. A á piki ná wan sani. Da Gaaman Pilatesi be foondoo di Masaa Jesesi á piki.
eng_text: But Jesus made no further answer, so that Pilate marveled.

djk_text: Da Gaaman Pilatesi be gwenti fu puu wan sama a dunguu osu ala Pasika Fesa. Da ala yali a be e akisi den foluku, sama den wani a puu a dunguu osu. Da na sama di den be wani a be puu a dunguu osu, na a sama de a be e puu.
eng_text: Now at the feast he used to release to them one prisoner, whom they asked of him.

djk_text: Ma namo, da wan ogii kiiman den be e kai Balabasi, be de a dunguu osu a ten de. A man ya anga wantu taa man be kii sama di den be opo feti anga a Loma lanti.
eng_text: There was one called Barabbas, bound with those who had made insurrection, men who in the insurrection had committed murder.

djk_text: Da wanlo sama di be komoto na a kuutu kon a Masaa Jesesi baka e bali gi Gaaman Pilatesi taki: “Gaaman Pilatesi, u wani i puu wan man a sitaafu osu gi wi enke fa i gwenti du ala Pasika.”
eng_text: The multitude, crying aloud, began to ask him to do as he always did for them.

djk_text: Ne Gaaman Pilatesi akisi den taki: “Sama u wani mi puu a dunguu osu gi u a yali ya? U wani meke mi losi a kownu fu den Dyu gi u?”
eng_text: Pilate answered them, saying, "Do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?"

djk_text: Bika Gaaman Pilatesi be sabi taki na fu dyalusu ede meke den hei apaiti begiman anga den leliman fu Dyuweiti be wani kii Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: For he perceived that for envy the chief priests had delivered him up.

djk_text: Ne den hei apaiti begiman, di be de a den sama mindii e sutu faya a ondoo gi den sama fu den meke Gaaman Pilatesi losi Balabasi. Na so den sama bali: “Gaaman Pilatesi, na Balabasi i mu puu a sitaafu gi wi! Na Balabasi u wani meke i puu a sitaafu gi wi!”
eng_text: But the chief priests stirred up the multitude, that he should release Barabbas to them instead.

djk_text: Ne Gaaman Pilatesi akisi den taki: “Da san mi mu du anga a sama di den e kai Kownu fu den Dyu?”
eng_text: Pilate again asked them, "What then should I do to him whom you call the King of the Jews?"

djk_text: Ne den bali taki: “Sipikii en a koloisi puu de!”
eng_text: They cried out again, "Crucify him!"

djk_text: Ne Gaaman Pilatesi akisi den baka taki: “Saide mi mu sipikii en kii? Sowtu ogii a du?” Ne den bigin bali moo taanga taki: “Sipikii en a koloisi! Sipikii en! Sipikii en! Sipikii en puu de.”
eng_text: Pilate said to them, "Why, what evil has he done?" But they cried out exceedingly, "Crucify him!"

djk_text: Da Gaaman Pilatesi á be wani opuulu anga den sama. Na dati meke a losi Balabasi. Ne a meke den suudati fi en wipi Masaa Jesesi wan mesaandi wipi. Ne di a meke den wipi en so kaba, ne a gi den suudati fi en Masaa Jesesi fu den tyai go sipikii kii.
eng_text: Pilate, wishing to please the multitude, released Barabbas to them, and handed over Jesus, when he had flogged him, to be crucified.

djk_text: Ne den suudati tyai Masaa Jesesi go a wan peesi a ini a dyali fu Gaaman Pilatesi, ne den kai ala den suudati kon makandii.
eng_text: The soldiers led him away within the court, which is the Praetorium; and they called together the whole cohort.

djk_text: Ne den puu en koosi, ne den wei wan gaan langa, baaw lebi koosi enke di kownu e wei gi en. Ne den teke wan takuu sowtu maka enke agwago, ne den lolo en enke a ati di kownu e wei. Ne den wei en gi en fu pee enke na wan kownu ati a wei.
eng_text: They clothed him with purple, and weaving a crown of thorns, they put it on him.

djk_text: Ne den bigin meke sipowtu anga en e soso en taki: “Odiyoo lesipeki Kownu fu Dyu!”
eng_text: They began to salute him, "Hail, King of the Jews!"

djk_text: Ne den naki en anga wan tiki ne en ede gwoo. Soseefi den towe wataa mofu ne en. Ne den saka kini a doti e meke sipowtu e soso en enke na lesipeki anga gaandi den e gi en so.
eng_text: They struck his head with a reed, and spat on him, and bowing their knees, did homage to him.

djk_text: Da di den kaba meke sipowtu anga en soso en so kaba, ne den puu a koosi di den be wei gi en, ne den wei enseefi koosi gi en baka. Ne den tyai en puu a ini a kondee go na a peesi pe den be o sipikii en na a koloisi.
eng_text: When they had mocked him, they took the purple off of him, and put his own garments on him. They led him out to crucify him.

djk_text: Da di den de a pasi e tyai Masaa Jesesi fu go sipikii kii, ne den miti a dda fu Aleksandi anga Lufosi di den be e kai Simon fu Sileni Kondee a pasi. Ne den dwengi en fu tyai a koloisi fu Masaa Jesesi gi en.
eng_text: They compelled one passing by, coming from the country, Simon of Cyrene, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to go with them, that he might bear his cross.

djk_text: Na so den tyai Masaa Jesesi go na a peesi di den e kai Golgata. Golgata wani taki, Edebon Peesi.
eng_text: They brought him to the place called Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, "The place of a skull."

djk_text: Ne den gi en win anga mile oli a ini. Ma a á wani diingi en.
eng_text: They offered him wine mixed with myrrh to drink, but he didn't take it.

djk_text: Na so den sipikii Masaa Jesesi na a koloisi. Ne den iti lowte paati a koosi fi en gi den seefi.
eng_text: Crucifying him, they parted his garments among them, casting lots on them, what each should take.

djk_text: Dati be sa de wanten fu neigin yuu mamanten so di den sipikii Masaa Jesesi poti na a koloisi.
eng_text: It was the third hour, and they crucified him.

djk_text: Da den be sipikii wan pisi paanga poti a Masaa Jesesi ede tapu taki:
eng_text: The superscription of his accusation was written over him, "THE KING OF THE JEWS."

djk_text: Da boiti Masaa Jesesi, da den be koloisi tu taa man makandii anga en de. Wan de ne en leti ana se, a taawan de ne en kukutu ana se. Masaa Jesesi be de a mindii. We, den tu taa man de na sama di be de gaan fufuu kiiman.
eng_text: With him they crucified two robbers; one on his right hand, and one on his left.

djk_text: Da a sani ya waka leti enke fa Masaa Gadu wowtu sikiifi taki: “A be de a pe den ogii ati sama de enke en na wan ogii ati sama tu.”
eng_text: The Scripture was fulfilled, which says, "He was numbered with transgressors."

djk_text: Da den sama di be e waka pasa be e seke ede, da den be e bali gi en taki: “O! Luku de. A ná a sama di be o booko a Mama Keliki, da a be meke en baka a ini dii dei, no?
eng_text: Those who passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads, and saying, "Ha! You who destroy the temple, and build it in three days,

djk_text: Da puu iseefi na a koloisi pe i de ape meke u si no, di i taanga so!”
eng_text: save yourself, and come down from the cross!"

djk_text: Da den bigiman fu Dyu keliki anga den leliman fu Dyuweiti be e meke sipowtu anga en e poti en wisiwasi taki: “A be e yeepi taa sama. Ma now a á poi yeepi enseefi.” Ne den e meke sipowtu anga en taki:
eng_text: Likewise, also the chief priests mocking among themselves with the scribes said, "He saved others. He can't save himself.

djk_text: “O, Kelestesi! Kownu fu Islayeli Kondee! Puu iseefi na a koloisi meke u si, no? Da u sa biibi taki yu na a kownu fu den Dyu tuu.” Da soseefi den taa man di den be sipikii na a koloisi de, be e sipowtu anga en tu.
eng_text: Let the Christ, the King of Israel, now come down from the cross, that we may see and believe him. " Those who were crucified with him insulted him.

djk_text: Da di twalufu yuu kisi, ne a hii kondee dunguu pii enke na neti. Da a dunguu ya be oli go miti dii yuu bakadina.
eng_text: When the sixth hour had come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.

djk_text: Da na a dii yuu de, ne Masaa Jesesi bali taanga taki:
eng_text: At the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, "Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani?" which is, being interpreted, "My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?"

djk_text: Da di wanlo sama di be taampu de, yee a bali “
eng_text: Some of those who stood by, when they heard it, said, "Behold, he is calling Elijah."

djk_text: Ne wan man lon go teke wan siponsu, ne a dipi en go a ini wan asin di be de ape, ne a poti a wan tiki ede, ne a langa go a Masaa Jesesi mofu fu a diingi. Ne a man taigi den sama taki: “U tan pii! Meke u luku efu Eliya o kon yeepi en tuu.”
eng_text: One ran, and filling a sponge full of vinegar, put it on a reed, and gave it to him to drink, saying, "Let him be. Let's see whether Elijah comes to take him down."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi bali wan taanga bali, ne en boo koti.
eng_text: Jesus cried out with a loud voice, and gave up the spirit.

djk_text: Da di a edeman fu den suudati si fa Masaa Jesesi boo koti, ne a taki: “Aai! Eeye! A sama ya na a Manpikin fu Masaa Gadu tuu.” Da a seefi yuu di Masaa Jesesi boo koti, ne a gaan deki gaiden di be e tapu a kambaa, piiti dalla fu tapu, te a doti a tu pisi.
eng_text: The veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom.

djk_text: Da wantu uman be taampu a faawe e luku. Da Maliya fu Makidala anga Salome anga Maliya, a mma fu Yowsesi anga Jakowbesi be de a ini tu.
eng_text: There were also women watching from afar, among whom were both Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;

djk_text: Da den uman ya anga tyaipi taa uman be kon anga en, di a be e kon a Jelusalem. Da na den uman ya be e solugu Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en a somen fasi.
eng_text: who, when he was in Galilee, followed him, and served him; and many other women who came up with him to Jerusalem.

djk_text: We, pikinso moo, da a kina dei di den Dyu be e seeka gi, be o kai. Da den Dyusama á be o poi du ná wan sani moo, fu a dei de.
eng_text: When evening had now come, because it was the Preparation Day, that is, the day before the Sabbath,

djk_text: Namo, na a yuu de, ne wan fu den hei man di de wan Dyulanti fu kuutu sani, den be e kai Jowsef fu Alimateya Kondee, kon na a peesi pe den be sipikii Masaa Jesesi. A be de wan sama di e fuuwakiti a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu. Ne Jowsef teke deki ati, ne a go a Gaaman Pilatesi, ne a akisi en taki: “Gaaman Pilatesi, mi kon begi i wan sani, baa. I sa gi mi pasi fu mi puu a dede sikin fu Masaa Jesesi na a koloisi, go beli?”
eng_text: Joseph of Arimathaea, a prominent council member who also himself was looking for the Kingdom of God, came. He boldly went in to Pilate, and asked for Jesus' body.

djk_text: Ne Gaaman Pilatesi akisi en taki: “Jesesi dede kaba? Mi á wani biibi!” Ne a sende kai a edeman fu suudati di be e oli waki na a koloisi fu Masaa Jesesi. Ne a man kon. Ne Gaaman Pilatesi akisi en taki: “A man Jesesi, di den sipikii a mamanten ya, a dede kaba?”
eng_text: Pilate marveled if he were already dead; and summoning the centurion, he asked him whether he had been dead long.

djk_text: Ne a suudati piki taki: “Iya, Gaaman, a dede kaba.” Ne Pilatesi taigi Jowsef taki: “Jowsef! I sa teke a dede sikin fu Jesesi go beli enke fa i akisi.”
eng_text: When he found out from the centurion, he granted the body to Joseph.

djk_text: Ne Jowsef go, ne a bai sibikoosi te a kaba. Ne a puu a dede sikin fu Masaa Jesesi na a koloisi. Ne a lolo en a ini a sibikoosi. Ne a tyai a dede sikin fu Masaa Jesesi go poti a ini wan siton olo di den be diki poti de fu beli sama. Da di a poti a dede sikin go a ini a olo kaba, ne den lolo wan gaanbigi siton tapu a olo mofu.
eng_text: He bought a linen cloth, and taking him down, wound him in the linen cloth, and laid him in a tomb which had been cut out of a rock. He rolled a stone against the door of the tomb.

djk_text: Da Maliya Makidala anga Maliya, a mma fu Yowsesi be go anga Jowsef go luku pe a be o poti a dede sikin fu Masaa Jesesi. Da na so a dede anga a beli fu Masaa Jesesi be waka.
eng_text: Mary Magdalene and Mary, the mother of Joses, saw where he was laid.

djk_text: Da di a kina dei fu den Dyu pasa, ne Maliya fu Makidala anga Salome anga Maliya a mma fu Jakowbesi, bai switi sumee sani fu go lobi na a dede sikin fu Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: When the Sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome, bought spices, that they might come and anoint him.

djk_text: Ne, sonde mamanten fuuku fa i si san opo, ne den dii uman e go na a siton geebi olo.
eng_text: Very early on the first day of the week, they came to the tomb when the sun had risen.

djk_text: Da, di den de a pasi e go, ne den pakisei taki: “Fa wi o du puu a gaanbigi siton na a olo mofu?”
eng_text: They were saying among themselves, "Who will roll away the stone from the door of the tomb for us?"

djk_text: Ma, di den doo na a olo, ne den si taki a gaanbigi siton lolo komoto na a olo mofu kaba.
eng_text: for it was very big. Looking up, they saw that the stone was rolled back.

djk_text: Ne den go a ini a siton geebi olo. Ne haa, den si wan yonkuman. A wei weti koosi fann sidon a den leti ana se. Ne den foondoo, te den poti ana a mofu.
eng_text: Entering into the tomb, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, dressed in a white robe, and they were amazed.

djk_text: Ne a yonkuman taigi den taki: “U á feele! A ná Jesesi fu Nasaleti, di den sipikii kii a koloisi u e suku, no? A opo komoto a dede kon a libi baka! A á de ya! U luku de pe a be didon!
eng_text: He said to them, "Don't be amazed. You seek Jesus, the Nazarene, who has been crucified. He has risen. He is not here. Behold, the place where they laid him!

djk_text: U go, da u taigi den bakaman fi en anga Peitilisi taki: ‘Ai go a den fesi a Galileya. Da a sa miti den anda enke fa a be taigi den.’ ”
eng_text: But go, tell his disciples and Peter, 'He goes before you into Galilee. There you will see him, as he said to you.'"

djk_text: Ne den komoto a ini a siton geebi olo, ne den lon gwe anga gaan feele na ati anga ala beifi sikin. Den á taigi ná wan sama wan sani, bika feele be moo den.
eng_text: They went out, and fled from the tomb, for trembling and astonishment had come on them. They said nothing to anyone; for they were afraid.

djk_text: We, sonde mamanten fuuku di Masaa Jesesi opo baka komoto a dede, da na Maliya fu Makidala na a fosi sama di si en. Di Masaa Jesesi be e waka e deesi sama a be puu seibin takuu jeje na a uman ya tapu.
eng_text: Now when he had risen early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had cast out seven demons.

djk_text: Ne a go, ne a taigi den bakaman di be de anga gaan buduufu na ati e tyali e kee e kusumi.
eng_text: She went and told those who had been with him, as they mourned and wept.

djk_text: Da den á biibi en, di a taigi den taki a si Masaa Jesesi, bika a weki baka komoto a dede kon a libi.
eng_text: When they heard that he was alive, and had been seen by her, they disbelieved.

djk_text: Moo lati, ne Masaa Jesesi soi enseefi gi tu bakaman fi en di den be de a ini a kondee e waka go a den osu. Bika a á be soi enseefi gi den enke fa a be gwenti.
eng_text: After these things he was revealed in another form to two of them, as they walked, on their way into the country.

djk_text: Ne den tu bakaman daai go baka a Jelusalem go taigi den taawan. Ma den taawan á be wani biibi den tu.
eng_text: They went away and told it to the rest. They didn't believe them, either.

djk_text: Da wan leisi, di ala den elufu bakaman sidon e nyan makandii, ne Masaa Jesesi kon a den mindii haa. Ne a bali den fu a fasi fa den nái biibi, anga fu di den á be e biibi den sama di taigi den taki den si en.
eng_text: Afterward he was revealed to the eleven themselves as they sat at the table, and he rebuked them for their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they didn't believe those who had seen him after he had risen.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “U go na ala peesi a goontapu, da u taigi ala sama a Bun Nyunsu fu mi.
eng_text: He said to them, "Go into all the world, and preach the Good News to the whole creation.

djk_text: Da sama di o biibi teke dopu, sa fende a libi fu tego. Ma sama di ná o biibi, o fende a tego sitaafu.”
eng_text: He who believes and is baptized will be saved; but he who disbelieves will be condemned.

djk_text: Ne a taigi den go doo taki: “Den gaan foondoo sani ya, o pasa a mindii fu den sama di e biibi mi tuutuu. Den sa teke mi nen yaki takuu jeje puu a sama tapu. Den o taki taa tongo taki.
eng_text: These signs will accompany those who believe: in my name they will cast out demons; they will speak with new languages;

djk_text: Efu den oli takuu sineki anga ana, sani ná o du den. Efu den diingi takuu sani seefi, sani ná o du den. Den o poti ana a sikiman tapu, da den sikiman sa kon bun baka.”
eng_text: they will take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it will in no way hurt them; they will lay hands on the sick, and they will recover."

djk_text: Da, baka di Masaa Jesesi taki anga den bakaman fi en so, ne Masaa Gadu teke en tyai go a tapu, a Masaa Gadu Kondee. Na anda Masaa Gadu gi en a moo hei peesi ne en leti ana se.
eng_text: So then the Lord , after he had spoken to them, was received up into heaven, and sat down at the right hand of God.

djk_text: Ne den bakaman fi en opo go paati a Bun Nyunsu na ala se. Da Masaa Gadu taampu gi den seefi seefi. Bika den du somen foondoo foondoo sani di e soi taki a Bun Nyunsu di den e tyai, na Masaa Gadu a komoto tuu!
eng_text: They went out, and preached everywhere, the Lord working with them, and confirming the word by the signs that followed. Amen.

djk_text: We, mi Lukasi e sende bigi odi gi yu, mi gaan lesipeki mati Teyofili. So, enke fa i sabi, da somen sama sikiifi sani kaba fu a libi fu Masaa Jesesi. Da, na san den sama di be si anga den eigi ain anga den fosi diniman fu a Bun Nyunsu taigi den, na dati den sikiifi. Ma, miseefi ondoosuku den sani ya fini fini enke fa den waka tuutuu, fu sikiifi sende gi yu.
eng_text: Since many have undertaken to set in order a narrative concerning those matters which have been fulfilled among us,

djk_text: Da yuseefi sa si taki, na pilisisi a seefi enke san, di i be leli kaba.
eng_text: that you might know the certainty concerning the things in which you were instructed.

djk_text: Da a yuu di Helowdesi be de kownu fu Judeja, da i be abi wan apaiti begiman den be e kai Sakalia. A be de a kulu apaiti begiman fu Abiya. A uman fi en na be fu a lo fu Aalon tu, enke Sakalia seefi.
eng_text: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the priestly division of Abijah. He had a wife of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elizabeth.

djk_text: Sakalia anga Elisabeti, na tu sama, di be e libi letiopu fasi gi Masaa Gadu. Den be e oli ala weiti fu Masaa Gadu. Ná wan sama, di be poi fende wan fowtu a den.
eng_text: They were both righteous before God, walking blamelessly in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord.

djk_text: Ma, Sakalia anga Elisabeti á be abi ná wankodo pikin. Bika Elisabeti á be poi de anga bee. Ma soseefi, da Sakalia anga Elisabeti, na be tu gaandi sama kaba tu, di á be poi meke pikin moo.
eng_text: But they had no child, because Elizabeth was barren, and they both were well advanced in years.

djk_text: Ma, namo da wan dei, da Sakalia anga den taa hei apaiti begiman fu a kulu fu Abiya, be mu wooko a ini a Mama Keliki.
eng_text: Now it happened, while he executed the priest's office before God in the order of his division,

djk_text: Da, den be abi a gwenti, fu iti lowte luku on di fu den apaiti begiman mu go a ini a Mama Keliki a dei de, fu boon switi sumee sani gi Masaa Gadu. Di den iti a lowte, ne a soi taki, na Sakalia mu go.
eng_text: according to the custom of the priest's office, his lot was to enter into the temple of the Lord and burn incense.

djk_text: Da, di a go, da somen sama be de na a keliki e begi.
eng_text: The whole multitude of the people were praying outside at the hour of incense.

djk_text: Namo, di Sakalia de a ini a keliki, ne a si wan Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee wan toon wan toon so. A taampu na a leti ana fu a apaiti begi tafaa, di den e boon switi sumee sani gi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: An angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing on the right side of the altar of incense.

djk_text: Da, di Sakalia si a Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee, ne a feele te en ati piiti.
eng_text: Zacharias was troubled when he saw him, and fear fell upon him.

djk_text: Ne a Basiya taigi en taki: “Ná feele, Sakalia! Masaa Gadu yee den begi fi yu. Yu uman, Elisabeti, o meke wan manpikin. Da i mu kai a pikin ya, Johanisi.
eng_text: But the angel said to him, "Don't be afraid, Zacharias, because your request has been heard, and your wife, Elizabeth, will bear you a son, and you shall call his name John.

djk_text: Da a pikin ya o gi yu gaan piisii. Da soseefi a o meke somen taa sama abi gaan piisii tu.
eng_text: You will have joy and gladness; and many will rejoice at his birth.

djk_text: Bika a o de wan bigiman a Masaa Gadu ain. Da noiti a pikin ya á mu diingi win efu taanga diingi di e duungu sama. Da fanafu en mama bee, da a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu o de ne en tapu.
eng_text: For he will be great in the sight of the Lord, and he will drink no wine nor strong drink. He will be filled with the Holy Spirit, even from his mother's womb.

djk_text: “A o tyai somen sama fu Islayeli kon daai libi baka kon a Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: He will turn many of the children of Israel to the Lord, their God.

djk_text: A pikin o de enke a apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu di den be e kai Eliya, enke fa a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu be de a Eliya tapu. Soseefi, leti enke fa a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu be e tii Eliya, na soseefi a o tii a pikin ya tu. Da a o waka a Masaa fesi, fu seeka ala sani gi en, fosi a kon. Da a o daai den dda anga den pikin ati, meke den daai libi bun anga denseefi. A o meke den di á be e aliki Masaa Gadu daai libi kon e libi, enke den sama di e libi bun a Masaa Gadu ain. Leti enke fa mi taki ya, na so a o pasa.”
eng_text: He will go before him in the spirit and power of Elijah, 'to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children,' and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to prepare a people prepared for the Lord."

djk_text: Ne Sakalia akisi a Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee taki: “Fa mi sa sabi taki, den sani di i taki ya na tuu? Bika mi anga Elisabeti gaandi pasa a peesi kaba fu meke pikin.”
eng_text: Zacharias said to the angel, "How can I be sure of this? For I am an old man, and my wife is well advanced in years."

djk_text: Ne a Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee piki en taki: “Mi na Gabiliyeli . Mi e tan koosube fu Masaa Gadu. Ne en sende mi kon, fu taigi yu den sani ya. Ma yu á biibi mi.
eng_text: The angel answered him, "I am Gabriel, who stands in the presence of God. I was sent to speak to you, and to bring you this good news.

djk_text: Da, fu di yu á biibi san mi taigi yu, meke yu ná o poi taki moo, fu te enke a dei di ala den sani di mi taki ya pasa. Bika, a dei o doo, di den sani ya o pasa tuu leti enke fa mi taki.”
eng_text: Behold, you will be silent and not able to speak, until the day that these things will happen, because you didn't believe my words, which will be fulfilled in their proper time."

djk_text: Da den sama di be de a doose be e luku Sakalia fu a kon a doose. A be foondoo den fa Sakalia be tan langa a ini a keliki osu so.
eng_text: The people were waiting for Zacharias, and they marveled that he delayed in the temple.

djk_text: Ne den sama de a doose te, fosi Sakalia kon a doo. Ma di Sakalia kon a doo, ne na anga ana ai taki anga den sama. Bika a á be poi taki moo. Ne den sama sabi kaba taki, Sakalia miti anga wan sani a ini a keliki osu. Bika a be e soi den anga ana.
eng_text: When he came out, he could not speak to them, and they perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple. He continued making signs to them, and remained mute.

djk_text: Ne Sakalia tan du en wooko a ini a Mama Keliki, te di a yuu doo, ne a go a osu baka.
eng_text: It happened, when the days of his service were fulfilled, he departed to his house.

djk_text: Ne a á langa moo bakadati, ne Elisabeti, a uman fu Sakalia, oli bee. Da di a oli a bee kaba, ne a tapu enseefi a osu feifi mun langa. A nái go a pe sama de.
eng_text: After these days Elizabeth, his wife, conceived, and she hid herself five months, saying,

djk_text: Ne Elisabeti taki: “Masaa Gadu, i du gaan bun gi mi, baa! Bika yu puu sen a mi ain, a libisama fesi.”
eng_text: Thus has the Lord done to me in the days in which he looked at me, to take away my reproach among men.

djk_text: Da di Elisabeti de anga sigisi mun bee, ne Masaa Gadu sende Gabiliyeli, wan fu den Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee, go a Nasaleti a Galileya,
eng_text: Now in the sixth month, the angel Gabriel was sent from God to a city of Galilee, named Nazareth,

djk_text: a wan yonkuu uman den e kai Maliya. Jowsef be poti mofu ne en fu libi. Jowsef na be wan bakaten pikin fu Kownu Dafeti paansu.
eng_text: to a virgin pledged to be married to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David. The virgin's name was Mary.

djk_text: Da di a Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee kon a Maliya, ne a gi en odi taki: “Fa ai go, Maliya? I abi bun ede moo ala uman. Masaa Gadu de anga yu. Ne a teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku yu. Bika a abi gaan piisii anga yu.”
eng_text: Having come in, the angel said to her, "Rejoice, you highly favored one! The Lord is with you. Blessed are you among women!"

djk_text: Ma namo, di Maliya yee den wowtu ya, a be feele, te a be wani buuya, bika a á be sabi san den be wani taki.
eng_text: But when she saw him, she was greatly troubled at the saying, and considered what kind of salutation this might be.

djk_text: Ne a Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee taigi en taki: “Ná feele, Maliya! Masaa Gadu teke yu poti apaiti fasi, fu du wan bun gi yu.
eng_text: The angel said to her, "Don't be afraid, Mary, for you have found favor with God.

djk_text: Bika yu sa de anga bee, da yu o meke wan manpikin. Da te a pikin ya meke, da i mu kai en, Jesesi.
eng_text: Behold, you will conceive in your womb, and bring forth a son, and will call his name 'Jesus.'

djk_text: A pikin ya sa hei a Masaa Gadu ain. Da den o kai en, Pikin fu a moo Hei Gadu a tapu. Masaa Gadu o gi en a kownu sutuu fi en avo gaansama Dafeti, fu tii sani.
eng_text: He will be great, and will be called the Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give him the throne of his father, David,

djk_text: Da a o tii den bakaten pikin fu a avo gaansama fu Dyusama, Jakopu. A tii fi en sa de fu tego.”
eng_text: and he will reign over the house of Jacob forever. There will be no end to his Kingdom."

djk_text: Ne Maliya akisi a Basiya taki: “Fa mi o du de anga bee? Mi á siibi anga man wanten.”
eng_text: Mary said to the angel, "How can this be, seeing I am a virgin?"

djk_text: Ne a Basiya piki en taki: “A Apaiti Jeje fu Masaa Gadu o kon a ini yu anga kaakiti, da i sa de anga bee. Da fu di na a Apaiti Jeje o meke i de anga bee, meke den sa kai a pikin ya, Pikin fu Masaa Gadu. A pikin ya libi o seeka de silli apaiti fasi, sondee fowtu gi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: The angel answered her, "The Holy Spirit will come on you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you. Therefore also the holy one who is born from you will be called the Son of God.

djk_text: I sisa Elisabeti de anga sigisi mun bee nownow na a gaandi gaandi yuu fi en ya. Da a sa meke wan manpikin. I si? A Elisabeti, di ala sama be e taki ná o meke pikin ná wan ten moo, ne en de anga bee.
eng_text: Behold, Elizabeth, your relative, also has conceived a son in her old age; and this is the sixth month with her who was called barren.

djk_text: Bika ná wan sani de di Masaa Gadu á poi du. Ala san di Masaa Gadu taki, musu pasa enke fa a taki.”
eng_text: For everything spoken by God is possible."

djk_text: We, ne Maliya piki a Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee taki: “A bun! Mi de a ini mi Masaa ana ini. Meke a du anga mi enke fa i taki de.” Ne, di den taki so, te den kaba, ne a Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee gwe fi en baka.
eng_text: Mary said, "Behold, the handmaid of the Lord; be it to me according to your word." The angel departed from her.

djk_text: Da wan satu pisiten a baka di a Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee taki anga Maliya so kaba, ne Maliya opo, ne a waka esi esi go na a pisiwataa fu Judeja, a wan pikin kondee a den mongo mindii.
eng_text: Mary arose in those days and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Judah,

djk_text: Da di a doo a kondee kaba, ne a go a Sakalia osu. Ne a gi Elisabeti odi.
eng_text: and entered into the house of Zacharias and greeted Elizabeth.

djk_text: Ma namo, di Elisabeti yee a odi fu Maliya, ne a pikin dyombo a ini en bee e sikopu futu. Ne a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu kon a Elisabeti tapu.
eng_text: It happened, when Elizabeth heard Mary's greeting, that the baby leaped in her womb, and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit.

djk_text: Ne Elisabeti bali taki: “Maliya! Seigi fi yu a Masaa Gadu bigi moo ala taa uman. Soseefi seigi fi yu a Masaa Gadu bigi, fu a pikin di de a ini i bee de tu.”
eng_text: She called out with a loud voice, and said, "Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb!

djk_text: Ne Elisabeti taki go doo taki: “Oho! Fa mi du abi a bun ede ya, taki a mama fu mi Masaa kon a mi osu kon luku mi?
eng_text: Why am I so favored, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?

djk_text: Bika, di mi yee a odi fi yu, ne a pikin di de a ini mi bee piisii te a sikopu futu.
eng_text: For behold, when the voice of your greeting came into my ears, the baby leaped in my womb for joy!

djk_text: We, Maliya! Fu di i du san Masaa Gadu wani, da i sa fende seigi ne en. Bika ala den sani di a taigi yu de, o pasa tuu.”
eng_text: Blessed is she who believed, for there will be a fulfillment of the things which have been spoken to her from the Lord!"

djk_text: Ne Maliya seefi daai gafa Masaa Gadu. A taki: “Mi e gafa Masaa Gadu anga mi hii ati.
eng_text: Mary said, "My soul magnifies the Lord.

djk_text: Mi e piisii tuu a ini mi ati anga a Gadu fu mi. Ne en na mi Yeepiman.
eng_text: My spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior,

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu luku mi enke wan mofinawan, ne a opo mi. Da a opo di a opo mi ya, ná abi kaba. Bika fu alaten, sama sa kai mi nen taki, na so Masaa Gadu be seigi mi.
eng_text: for he has looked at the humble state of his handmaid. For behold, from now on, all generations will call me blessed.

djk_text: Bika, na a Sama di abi ala makiti a goontapu, ne en du mi a gaan bun ya. A gaan bun ya, na a Sama di abi ala makiti a goontapu, ne en du mi en. A Sama ya de kiinkiin sondee fowtu.
eng_text: For he who is mighty has done great things for me. Holy is his name.

djk_text: Da alaten Masaa Gadu e du gaan bun naamo gi den sama di e lesipeki en. Bika a abi tyali ati fu libisama.
eng_text: His mercy is for generations of generations on those who fear him.

djk_text: Da Masaa Gadu abi makiti fu du ala sani. Bika a booko den bigi fasi sama anga den hei membee wan saka.
eng_text: He has shown strength with his arm. He has scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.

djk_text: Ai naki den gaan kownu puu a den kownu sutuu. Ma ai opo den saka fasi sama kon poti hei.
eng_text: He has put down princes from their thrones. And has exalted the lowly.

djk_text: Ai paati den gudu fi en gi den pinaman di e angii fi en. Ma ai sende den guduman gwe anga soso ana.
eng_text: He has filled the hungry with good things. He has sent the rich away empty.

djk_text: A abi tyali ati naamo e yeepi den Islayeli.
eng_text: He has given help to Israel, his servant, that he might remember mercy,

djk_text: A á feegete san a be paamisi u tata Abalaham anga den bakapikin fi en, bika alaten ai yeepi den leti enke fa a be paamisi den.”
eng_text: As he spoke to our fathers, to Abraham and his seed forever."

djk_text: Da di Maliya gafa Masaa Gadu so kaba, ne a tan dii mun anga Elisabeti, fosi a daai gwe baka a Nasaleti Foto, a pe a be e tan.
eng_text: Mary stayed with her about three months, and then returned to her house.

djk_text: Da na so, di a yuu doo fu Elisabeti meke, ne a meke a manpikin.
eng_text: Now the time that Elizabeth should give birth was fulfilled, and she brought forth a son.

djk_text: Da di den famii fi en anga den sama fu a pisi kondee pe ai tan, yee taki a meke a pikin, ne den piisii anga en te, ná sipowtu, bika den si taki Masaa Gadu du wan gaan bun gi Elisabeti.
eng_text: Her neighbors and her relatives heard that the Lord had magnified his mercy towards her, and they rejoiced with her.

djk_text: Da di a pikin abi aitin dei, ne den kon fu koti en sani mofu enke fa den Dyu be gwenti, fu soi taki a pikin ya libi de fu Masaa Gadu wawan. Da den be wani kai a pikin Sakalia enke en dda.
eng_text: It happened on the eighth day, that they came to circumcise the child; and they would have called him Zacharias, after the name of the father.

djk_text: Ma Elisabeti taki: “Nono! U á mu kai en Sakalia. U kai en, Johanisi.”
eng_text: His mother answered, "Not so; but he will be called John."

djk_text: Ma den sama taki: “Nono! Wi á poi kai en Johanisi, bika ná wan sama fu a famii abi a nen de.”
eng_text: They said to her, "There is no one among your relatives who is called by this name."

djk_text: Ne den sama daai go a Sakalia, ne den akisi en taki, fa a wani den kai a pikin.
eng_text: They made signs to his father, what he would have him called.

djk_text: Ne a soi den anga ana taki, meke den gi en wan sani meke a sikiifi.
eng_text: He asked for a writing tablet, and wrote, "His name is John." They all marveled.

djk_text: Ne den sama gi en sani fu a sikiifi. Ne a teke den sani, ne a sikiifi taki: “Na a pikin ya den e kai, Johanisi.” Da a sani ya foondoo ala den sama di be de ape. Ne wanten di Sakalia sikiifi so, ne walla en tongo losi. Ne a bigin taki baka. Ne a gi Masaa Gadu bigi nen anga daa.
eng_text: His mouth was opened immediately, and his tongue freed, and he spoke, blessing God.

djk_text: Da ala den sama foondoo te, ná sipowtu. Ala den sama fu a pikin kondee a den mongo mindii de be e taki fu san pasa.
eng_text: Fear came on all who lived around them, and all these sayings were talked about throughout all the hill country of Judea.

djk_text: Da a toli ya paati na a hii mongo pisi fu Judeja. Da ala sama di yee a toli ya e akisi denseefi taki: “We, da san a pikin ya o toon di bigi so?” Bika den be si taki, Masaa Gadu be de anga a pikin ya.
eng_text: All who heard them laid them up in their heart, saying, "What then will this child be?" The hand of the Lord was with him.

djk_text: Da a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu kon a Sakalia tapu, ne a taki wan bosikopu fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: His father, Zacharias, was filled with the Holy Spirit, and prophesied, saying,

djk_text: A taki: “Gaantangi fu Masaa Gadu, a Gadu fu Islayeli. A kon puu wi, den sama fi en a sitaafu.
