djk_text: Bika a neti ya, da a Yeepiman fu u meke kon a goontapu. En na Kelestesi, a na a Masaa fu u. A meke a Betelehem, na a foto fu Kownu Dafeti.
eng_text: For there is born to you, this day, in the city of David, a Savior, who is Christ the Lord.

djk_text: Meke mi soi u fa u sa sabi a pikin ya. Te u go, da u o si a didon lolo lolo a ini koosi, a ini wan baki di den e poti nyanyan gi meti.”
eng_text: This is the sign to you: you will find a baby wrapped in strips of cloth, lying in a feeding trough."

djk_text: Ne wanten di a Basiya taki so, ne onmen tenti taa Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee kon mokisa anga en. Ne den bali baaya gi Masaa Gadu gaandi taki:
eng_text: Suddenly, there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly army praising God, and saying,

djk_text: “U bali baaya gi Masaa Gadu! U bali baaya gi Masaa Gadu ne en kondee a tapu anda. Fii kon a goontapu gi ala libisama di e libi enke fa Masaa Gadu wani. Masaa Gadu abi piisii anga den.”
eng_text: Glory to God in the highest, on earth peace, good will toward men.

djk_text: Da di den Masaa Gadu Kondee Basiya gafa Masaa Gadu so, ne den daai gwe baka a Masaa Gadu Kondee a tapu. Ne den sikapuman piki denseefi taki: “We, baala oo! U kon meke u go a Betelehem, a pe a pikin meke go luku a sani di Masaa Gadu taigi u ya.”
eng_text: It happened, when the angels went away from them into the sky, that the shepherds said one to another, "Let's go to Bethlehem, now, and see this thing that has happened, which the Lord has made known to us."

djk_text: Ne den go a Betelehem. Ne di den doo de, ne den si taki, ala sani waka leti enke fa a Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee be taki. Den si Maliya anga Jowsef anga a pikin. A pikin didon a ini wan baki di den e poti nyanyan gi meti.
eng_text: They came with haste, and found both Mary and Joseph, and the baby was lying in the feeding trough.

djk_text: Da di den sikapuman si en so kaba, ne den go taigi ala sama ala den sani di a Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee be taigi den, fu a pikin.
eng_text: When they saw it, they publicized widely the saying which was spoken to them about this child.

djk_text: Da ala sama di yee a sani fu a pikin ya e poti ana a mofu e foondoo.
eng_text: All who heard it wondered at the things which were spoken to them by the shepherds.

djk_text: Ma Maliya dati, teke ala den sani di a yee ya, oli a ede e poti dipi pakisei.
eng_text: But Mary kept all these sayings, pondering them in her heart.

djk_text: Da di den sikapuman ya daai baka e go a ini a wei, ne den e singi e piisii gaan piisii fu san di den be yee anga san di den si. Bika ala sani be waka enke fa a Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee be taigi den.
eng_text: The shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, just as it was told them.

djk_text: We, ne den de te a pikin abi aitin dei, ne den koti a maiki a manpeesi gi en, enke fa a weiti fu Masaa Gadu taki. Ne den kai a pikin Jesesi, enke fa a Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee be taigi Maliya fu kai a pikin, fosi a be de anga bee fi en.
eng_text: When eight days were fulfilled for the circumcision of the child, his name was called Jesus, which was given by the angel before he was conceived in the womb.

djk_text: Da Maliya anga Jowsef be tyai a pikin go a Jelusalem, fu go poti a Masaa Gadu ana, enke fa a Dyuweiti be taki. Bika a Dyuweiti ya be taki: “Ala fosi manpikin di wan uman meke, a mu gi Masaa Gadu en.” A seefi ten de, da Maliya yuu be doo fu komoto a meke osu tu. Ne a tyai tu doifi go a Jelusalem tu, fu a wasi komoto a meke osu enke fa a Dyuweiti be taki. Bika a Dyuweiti ya be taki: “Te wan uman meke wan pikin, da na fotenti dei langa a mu de a meke osu. Da te a o wasi komoto a meke osu, da a mu tyai tu pikin paansu doifi ofu tu yonkuu doifi go boon gi Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: When the days of their purification according to the law of Moses were fulfilled, they brought him up to Jerusalem, to present him to the Lord

djk_text: Da a yuu di Maliya anga Jowsef e go a Jelusalem, da wan man be de ape den be e kai Simiyon. Simiyon na wan sama di be e libi letiopu fasi gi Masaa Gadu. Soseefi ai lesipeki Masaa Gadu. Da a be e luku on ten Masaa Gadu be o puu den Islayeli sama a sitaafu. Da a Apaiti Jeje fu Masaa Gadu be de ne en tapu.
eng_text: Behold, there was a man in Jerusalem whose name was Simeon. This man was righteous and devout, looking for the consolation of Israel, and the Holy Spirit was on him.

djk_text: Da a Jeje be taigi en taki, a á be o dede fosi a be si Kelestesi, a Kownu di Masaa Gadu be paamisi taki a be o sende kon gi den.
eng_text: It had been revealed to him by the Holy Spirit that he should not see death before he had seen the Lord's Christ.

djk_text: Da di den tyai a pikin kon, ne a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu tyai Simiyon kon a ini a Mama Keliki tu. Da di a doo a ini, ne a si taki den tyai a pikin kon fu seeka enke fa a weiti fu Masaa Gadu taki.
eng_text: He came in the Spirit into the temple. When the parents brought in the child, Jesus, that they might do concerning him according to the custom of the law,

djk_text: Ne a teke a pikin a ini en ana, ne a gafa Masaa Gadu taki:
eng_text: then he received him into his arms, and blessed God, and said,

djk_text: “Kee baa, Masaa Gadu! Now mi sa dede anga wan switi ati.
Ma wan dei o kon di wan takuu sani o pasa anga a pikin ya. A o hati yu moo enke, te den be o sutu yu anga fetihow a i boo fu ati doo kisi taase.”
eng_text: Yes, a sword will pierce through your own soul, that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed."

djk_text: Ma namo, da wan uman den e kai Hana, be de a ini a keliki osu tu. Masaa Gadu be e gi en bosikopu fu gi taa sama. Ne en dda den be e kai Fanuweli, fu a lo fu Aseli. Seibin yali baka, di a uman ya anga en man be libi ne en yonkuu ten, ne a man dede.
eng_text: There was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher (she was of a great age, having lived with a husband seven years from her virginity,

djk_text: Ne a de sondee man, fu te enke fa a abi aititenti a fo yali ya. Da dei anga neti a uman ya e de a ini a Mama Keliki e begi Masaa Gadu. Son dei, a be e de sondee nyan seefi fu begi.
eng_text: and she had been a widow for about eighty-four years), who didn't depart from the temple, worshipping with fastings and petitions night and day.

djk_text: Da a yuu di Simiyon e taki de, ne a mma ya kon a ini a keliki osu tu. Ne di a si a pikin, ne a bigin gi Masaa Gadu daa. Ne ai taigi ala den sama di be e luku fu Masaa Gadu sende a Paamisi Kownu kon fu puu Jelusalem a sitaafu taki: “A Paamisi Kownu kon kaba.”
eng_text: Coming up at that very hour, she gave thanks to the Lord, and spoke of him to all those who were looking for redemption in Jerusalem.

djk_text: Da na so Maliya anga Jowsef seeka ala sani enke fa a Dyuweiti taki, te a kaba. Ne den daai gwe baka a den kondee Nasaleti, na a pisiwataa fu Galileya.
eng_text: When they had accomplished all things that were according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city, Nazareth.

djk_text: Da a pikin e goo e kon. Ai bigi toon manengee. Moo anga moo, ai abi kiin fusutan fu den sani fu Masaa Gadu anga den sani fu libisama. Masaa Gadu seefi de anga en e yeepi en anga ala sani.
eng_text: The child was growing, and was becoming strong in spirit, being filled with wisdom, and the grace of God was upon him.

djk_text: Da Maliya anga Jowsef be gwenti go a Jelusalem ala yali fu nyan a gaan piisii fesa fu den Dyu den e kai Pasika.
eng_text: His parents went every year to Jerusalem at the feast of the Passover.

djk_text: Da di Jesesi abi twalufu yali, ne en anga den go a Jelusalem na a Pasika Fesa.
eng_text: When he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem according to the custom of the feast,

djk_text: Da di a Pasika Fesa kaba, ne den daai baka e gwe a osu, a Nasaleti Foto. Ma Jesesi be fika a baka a Jelusalem. Da Jowsef anga Maliya á be sabi taki, Jesesi fika a baka.
eng_text: and when they had fulfilled the days, as they were returning, the boy Jesus stayed behind in Jerusalem. Joseph and his mother didn't know it,

djk_text: Bika den be denki taki, son ten a be waka anga den taa sama di den anga den be go a Jelusalem na a Pasika Fesa. A dati meke den waka wan hii dei, te di neti fosi den bigin suku en. Den suku en a den famii anga den mati fu den, ma den á fende en.
eng_text: but supposing him to be in the company, they went a day's journey, and they looked for him among their relatives and acquaintances.

djk_text: Da di den á fende en, ne den daai baka gwe a Jelusalem. Na dii dei langa di den suku Jesesi, fosi den go fende en a ini a Mama Keliki fu Dyu. A sidon a den leliman fu Dyuweiti mindii e aliki fa den e leli Gadu wowtu. Da a be e akisi den sani tu. Da den be e gi en piki fu san a be e akisi den.
eng_text: It happened after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the teachers, both listening to them, and asking them questions.

djk_text: Ala den sama be e foondoo fu a fasi fa a be e fusutan sani anga a fasi fa a be e piki den sani.
eng_text: All who heard him were amazed at his understanding and his answers.

djk_text: Da di den si en, ne den foondoo. Ne Maliya bali taki: “Oho, Jesesi! Pikin! San meke i du so anga wi du? Tide meke di fu dii dei di mi anga i dda e booko ede e suku yu!”
eng_text: When they saw him, they were astonished, and his mother said to him, "Son, why have you treated us this way? Behold, your father and I were anxiously looking for you."

djk_text: Ne Jesesi piki den taki: “Fu saide meke u booko ede suku mi so? U á sabi taki, mi mu du den wooko fu mi Tata, no? Efu u be sabi dati, da u á be o booko ede suku mi so.”
eng_text: He said to them, "Why were you looking for me? Didn't you know that I must be in my Father's house?"

djk_text: Ma fa a pikin taki de, en dda anga en mma á be sabi san a wani taigi den. Den á fusutan en seefi.
eng_text: They didn't understand the saying which he spoke to them.

djk_text: Ne den teke en, ne den go baka a Nasaleti. Ma Jesesi be e saka enseefi a den ondoo e du san den taki. Ma Maliya teke den wowtu fu Jesesi oli a ede poti dipi pakisei naamo.
eng_text: And he went down with them, and came to Nazareth. He was subject to them, and his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.

djk_text: Da a pikin e goo e kon. On moo ai bigi, on moo en fusutan fu sani e opo. Masaa Gadu anga libisama lobi en.
eng_text: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and men.

djk_text: Da na di fu tin na feifi yali, fu a tii fu Tibeliyasi, di be de a moo gaan kownu a Loma Foto, ne Johanisi bigin wooko. Kownu Tibeliyasi be abi somen taa edeman ne en ondoo, di be e wooko gi en, fu tii taa pisiwataa enke edeman. Gaaman Pontiyesi Pilatesi be e tii a pisiwataa den be e kai Judeja. Kownu Helowdesi be e tii a pisiwataa den be e kai Galileya. Filipi, a baala fu Kownu Helowdesi, be e tii den tu pisiwataa den e kai Ituleya anga Takownisi. Da Gaaman Lisaniyasi be e tii a pisiwataa den e kai Abileina.
eng_text: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of the region of Ituraea and Trachonitis, and Lysanias tetrarch of Abilene,

djk_text: We, a yuu de, da Anasi anga Kayafasi na be den tu moo hei apaiti begiman. Ne Masaa Gadu kai a pikin fu Sakalia di den e kai Johanisi puu a ini a sabana fu bigin wooko.
eng_text: in the high priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas, the word of God came to John, the son of Zacharias, in the wilderness.

djk_text: Ne Johanisi opo e bali bosikopu gi den sama fu den kondee kondee, na a pisiwataa fu a Joodani Liba taki, fu den kon teke dopu, fu daai libi. Meke Masaa Gadu sa gi den paadon, fu takuudu anga ogii.
eng_text: He came into all the region around the Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for remission of sins.

djk_text: A sani ya waka leti enke fa Masaa Gadu be piki Jesaja, enke wan apaiti takiman fi en, fu sikiifi a fositen taki: “A tongo fu wan bosikopuman o bali a ini a gaan sabana taki: ‘U seeka pasi gi a Masaa, meke a pasi sa kon taampu letiopu tollo.
eng_text: As it is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet, "The voice of one crying in the wilderness, 'Make ready the way of the Lord. Make his paths straight.

djk_text: Meke ala dipi saka peesi kon hei. Meke ala mongo kon booko saka miti doti. Meke ala bendi bendi fu a pasi kon taampu letiopu. Ala den olo olo seefi mu kon seeka silli miti doti.
eng_text: Every valley will be filled. Every mountain and hill will be brought low. The crooked will become straight, and the rough ways smooth.

djk_text: Da ala sama o si a yeepi fu Masaa Gadu.’ ”
eng_text: All flesh will see God's salvation.'"

djk_text: Da, di Johanisi bali a bosikopu ya, ne onmen tenti sama kon ne en fu a dopu den. Ne a taigi den taki: “U takuu ati sineki sani! Fa u du sabi taki, u mu lon gi a gaan atiboon fu Masaa Gadu di de a pasi fu kon?
eng_text: He said therefore to the multitudes who went out to be baptized by him, "You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

djk_text: We, u mu soi tuutuu taki u daai libi. Ma u á mu luku taki, fu di u avo gaansama Abalaham anga Masaa Gadu be de mati, da Masaa Gadu ná o sitaafu u moo. Kweti! Bika efu Masaa Gadu wani, a sa meke den siton di u e si ya, daai kon toon bakaten pikin fu Abalaham, a u peesi.
eng_text: Bring forth therefore fruits worthy of repentance, and don't begin to say among yourselves, 'We have Abraham for our father;' for I tell you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones!

djk_text: Da soseefi a akisi fu Masaa Gadu de na a bon kaba fu faa en. Da ibii bon di de ape, di nái meke bun nyanyan, da den o faa en towe a ini faya boon.”
eng_text: Even now the axe also lies at the root of the trees. Every tree therefore that doesn't bring forth good fruit is cut down, and thrown into the fire."

djk_text: Namo den sama akisi Johanisi taki: “Da san u mu du moo?”
eng_text: The multitudes asked him, "What then must we do?"

djk_text: Ne a piki den taki: “Efi i abi tu impi, gi a sama di ná abi wan. Da efi i abi nyanyan, da gi a sama di ná abi fu nyan.”
eng_text: He answered them, "He who has two coats, let him give to him who has none. He who has food, let him do likewise."

djk_text: Da baka fu den, ne den sama di e piki lantimoni kon ne en fu a dopu den tu. Ne den akisi en taki: “We, Mesiti oo! San u mu du moo?”
eng_text: Tax collectors also came to be baptized, and they said to him, "Teacher, what must we do?"

djk_text: Ne a piki den taki: “Te u e piki lantimoni, u á mu teke moo ipi moo enke san lanti poti.”
eng_text: He said to them, "Collect no more than that which is appointed to you."

djk_text: Ne den suudati seefi kon, ne den akisi en taki: “We, san u dati mu du?” Ne a piki den taki: “U á mu suku toobi anga sama e dwengi den fu gi u moni. Soseefi, u á mu lei gi sama tyai den go a kuutu fu moni ede. U meke a moni di lanti e pai u sai u.”
eng_text: Soldiers also asked him, saying, "What about us? What must we do?" He said to them, "Extort from no one by violence, neither accuse anyone wrongfully. Be content with your wages."

djk_text: Da di den sama yee fa Johanisi taki, ne den pakisei taki: “A ná a Kelestesi, a di Masaa Gadu be taki a o sende kon gi u de ya, no?” Bika den be e luku on ten a Kownu di Masaa Gadu be paamisi den, be o kon.
eng_text: As the people were in expectation, and all men reasoned in their hearts concerning John, whether perhaps he was the Christ,

djk_text: Ma Johanisi piki den taki: “Nono! Mi e dopu u anga wataa. Ma u luku Awan di makiti bigi moo mi, a o kon a mi baka! Ma mi á dyendee sai fu losi susu puu a futu gi en seefi. En dati o dopu sama anga a Apaiti Jeje anga faya.
eng_text: John answered them all, "I indeed baptize you with water, but he comes who is mightier than I, the latchet of whose sandals I am not worthy to loosen. He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit and fire,

djk_text: A de kaba kaba fu seeka a nyanyan fi en. Den bun nyanyan a o kibii ne en baakoto. Ma den poli wan a o iti a ini faya di noiti e tapu, fu den boon poli.”
eng_text: whose fan is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor, and will gather the wheat into his barn; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire."

djk_text: Na so Johanisi e bali den sama naamo e gi den a Bun Nyunsu fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Then with many other exhortations he preached good news to the people,

djk_text: Ma namo, da Johanisi be bali Kownu Helowdesi, fu di kownu be teke en baala uman e libi anga fu den somen taa ogii sani di a be e du.
eng_text: but Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias, his brother's wife, and for all the evil things which Herod had done,

djk_text: Ne kownu komoto, ne a du wan moo gaan ogii. Bika a kisi Johanisi poti a ini dunguu osu.
eng_text: added this also to them all, that he shut up John in prison.

djk_text: Ma bifo den be poti Johanisi a dunguu osu, da somen sama be e kon ne en fu a dopu den. Na so Masaa Jesesi seefi kon fu kon teke dopu tu. Da a yuu di Masaa Jesesi e dopu, ne ai begi. Da di a begi te wan pisi, ne tapu a den woluku piiti opo palan.
eng_text: Now it happened, when all the people were baptized, Jesus also had been baptized, and was praying. The sky was opened,

djk_text: Ne a Apaiti Jeje fu Masaa Gadu saka kon ne en tapu enke wan doifi. Ne wan Tongo taki a tapu anda taki: “Yu na mi Manpikin di mi lobi. Mi hii ati e piisii anga yu.”
eng_text: and the Holy Spirit descended in a bodily form as a dove on him; and a voice came out of the sky, saying "You are my beloved Son. In you I am well pleased."

djk_text: Da Jesesi be abi diitenti yali di a bigin fu wooko leli sama. Da den sama be teke taki, na Jowsef, a pikin fu Eli ne en dda.
eng_text: Jesus himself, when he began to teach, was about thirty years old, being the son (as was supposed) of Joseph, the son of Heli,

djk_text: Eli na be a pikin fu Matati. Da Matati na be a pikin fu Leifi. Da Leifi na be a pikin fu Milki. Da Milki na be a pikin fu Yanai. Yanai na be a pikin fu Jowsef.
eng_text: the son of Matthat, the son of Levi, the son of Melchi, the son of Jannai, the son of Joseph,

djk_text: Da Jowsef na be a pikin fu Matatiyasi. Da Matatiyasi na be a pikin fu Amosi. Da Amosi na be a pikin fu Naahem. Da Naahem na be a pikin fu Hesili. Da Hesili na be a pikin fu Nagai.
eng_text: the son of Mattathias, the son of Amos, the son of Nahum, the son of Esli, the son of Naggai,

djk_text: Nagai na be a pikin fu Maata. Da Maata na be a pikin fu Matatiyasi. Da Matatiyasi na be a pikin fu Semeyen. Da Semeyen na be a pikin fu Yowseki. Da Yowseki na be a pikin fu Yowda.
eng_text: the son of Maath, the son of Mattathias, the son of Semein, the son of Joseph, the son of Judah,

djk_text: Yowda na be a pikin fu Yowanan. Da Yowanan na be a pikin fu Lesa. Da Lesa na be a pikin fu Selubabeli. Da Selubabeli na be a pikin fu Seyaltiyeli. Da Seyaltiyeli na be a pikin fu Neli.
eng_text: the son of Joanan, the son of Rhesa, the son of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, the son of Neri,

djk_text: Neli na be a pikin fu Milki. Da Milki na be a pikin fu Adi. Da Adi na be a pikin fu Kowsan. Da Kowsan na be a pikin fu Emadan. Da Emadan na be a pikin fu Eli.
eng_text: the son of Melchi, the son of Addi, the son of Cosam, the son of Elmodam, the son of Er,

djk_text: Eli na be a pikin fu Josuwa. Da Josuwa na be a pikin fu Eliyesolu. Da Eliyesolu na be a pikin fu Yolemu. Da Yolemu na be a pikin fu Matati. Da Matati na be a pikin fu Leifi.
eng_text: the son of Jose, the son of Eliezer, the son of Jorim, the son of Matthat, the son of Levi,

djk_text: Leifi na be a pikin fu Simiyon. Da Simiyon na be a pikin fu Juda. Da Juda na be a pikin fu Jowsef. Da Jowsef na be a pikin fu Yownan. Da Yownan na be a pikin fu Eliyaken.
eng_text: the son of Simeon, the son of Judah, the son of Joseph, the son of Jonan, the son of Eliakim,

djk_text: Eliyaken na be a pikin fu Meleya. Da Meleya na be a pikin fu Mena. Da Mena na be a pikin fu Matata. Da Matata na be a pikin fu Naatan. Da Naatan na be a pikin fu Dafeti.
eng_text: the son of Melea, the son of Menan, the son of Mattatha, the son of Nathan, the son of David,

djk_text: Dafeti na be a pikin fu Isai. Da Isai na be a pikin fu Obeti. Da Obeti na be a pikin fu Bowasi. Da Bowasi na be a pikin fu Saala. Da Saala na be a pikin fu Nakson.
eng_text: the son of Jesse, the son of Obed, the son of Boaz, the son of Salmon, the son of Nahshon,

djk_text: Nakson na be a pikin fu Amenadabu. Da Amenadabu na be a pikin fu Admen. Da Admen na be a pikin fu Alini. Da Alini na be a pikin fu Sesilon. Da Sesilon na be a pikin fu Pelesi. Da Pelesi na be a pikin fu Juda.
eng_text: the son of Amminadab, the son of Aram, the son of Hezron, the son of Perez, the son of Judah,

djk_text: Juda na be a pikin fu Jakopu. Da Jakopu na be a pikin fu Isaki. Da Isaki na be a pikin fu Abalaham. Da Abalaham na be a pikin fu Telaki. Da Telaki na be a pikin fu Naakolu.
eng_text: the son of Jacob, the son of Isaac, the son of Abraham, the son of Terah, the son of Nahor,

djk_text: Naakolu na be a pikin fu Seluku. Da Seluku na be a pikin fu Lewu. Da Lewu na be a pikin fu Pelegi. Da Pelegi na be a pikin fu Ebeli. Da Ebeli na be a pikin fu Seila.
eng_text: the son of Serug, the son of Reu, the son of Peleg, the son of Eber, the son of Shelah,

djk_text: Seila na be a pikin fu Kaina. Da Kaina na be a pikin fu Alipakisa. Da Alipakisa na be a pikin fu Sem. Da Sem na be a pikin fu Nowa. Da Nowa na be a pikin fu Lameki.
eng_text: the son of Cainan, the son of Arphaxad, the son of Shem, the son of Noah, the son of Lamech,

djk_text: Lameki na be a pikin fu Metusala. Da Metusala na be a pikin fu Heinoki. Da Heinoki na be a pikin fu Yeleti. Da Yeleti na be a pikin fu Mahalaleli. Da Mahalaleli na be a pikin fu Keinan.
eng_text: the son of Methuselah, the son of Enoch, the son of Jared, the son of Mahalaleel, the son of Cainan,

djk_text: Keinan na be a pikin fu Enosi. Da Enosi na be a pikin fu Seti. Da Seti na be a pikin fu Adan. Ma Adan na be a pikin fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: the son of Enos, the son of Seth, the son of Adam, the son of God.

djk_text: Da di Masaa Jesesi komoto a Joodani Liba pe den dopu en, da a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu be de ne en tapu wan taanga fasi. Ne a tyai en gwe a ini a gaan sabana ini.
eng_text: Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, returned from the Jordan, and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness

djk_text: Ne a didibii go tesi en anda. Bika Masaa Jesesi poti nyanyan a wanse, fu begi fotenti dei anga fotenti neti langa a ini a gaan sabana anda. Na so di den fotenti dei pasa, ne angii moo en.
eng_text: for forty days, being tempted by the devil. He ate nothing in those days. Afterward, when they were completed, he was hungry.

djk_text: Ne a didibii taigi en taki: “Di yu na a Manpikin fu Masaa Gadu tuutuu, da taigi den siton ya, meke den toon beele, osi, fi i fende nyan?”
eng_text: The devil said to him, "If you are the Son of God, command this stone to become bread."

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Nono! Masaa Gadu Buku sikiifi taki: ‘A ná nyanyan namo e oli wan sama a libi.’ ”
eng_text: Jesus answered him, saying, "It is written, 'Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.'"

djk_text: Ne didibii tyai en go a wan gaan hei peesi, ne te fi i pingi ain opo, ne a soi Masaa Jesesi ala den kondee kondee fu goontapu anga ala den gudu fu den. Ne a taigi en taki:
eng_text: The devil, leading him up on a high mountain, showed him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.

djk_text: “I si ala den sani di i si de? Na mi abi ala. Da na sama di mi wani, mi e gi den. So, da mi o gi yu ala den kondee ya anga ala den gudu fu den. Soseefi mi o gi yu a makiti fu taki fu den. Ma, da i mu sutu kini a doti begi mi fosi.”
eng_text: The devil said to him, "I will give you all this authority, and their glory, for it has been delivered to me; and I give it to whomever I want.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Nono! Bika, a sikiifi a Masaa Gadu Buku taki: ‘Na Masaa Gadu wawan u mu begi, na Masaa Gadu wawan u mu dini! Ná wan sama moo.’ ”
eng_text: Jesus answered him, "Get behind me Satan! For it is written, 'You shall worship the Lord your God, and you shall serve him only.'"

djk_text: Ne a didibii teke en, ne a tyai en go a Jelusalem, te na a moo hei peesi, na a tapu osu fu a Mama Keliki. Ne a taigi en taki: “Di i na a Manpikin fu Masaa Gadu, da fee saka ya go a doti anda, osi? Da ná wan sani o du yu.
eng_text: He led him to Jerusalem, and set him on the pinnacle of the temple, and said to him, "If you are the Son of God, cast yourself down from here,

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu Buku taki: ‘Masaa Gadu o sende den Basiya fi en kon yeepi yu, fu sani á du yu.
eng_text: for it is written, 'He will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you;'

djk_text: Den Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee o tyai yu na ana meke yu á naki i futu a ná wan siton.’ ”
eng_text: and, 'On their hands they will bear you up, lest perhaps you dash your foot against a stone.'"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en baka taki: “Ma Masaa Gadu Buku sikiifi tu taki: ‘Wi á mu tesi Masaa di de a Gadu fu wi.’ ”
eng_text: Jesus answering, said to him, "It has been said, 'You shall not tempt the Lord your God.'"

djk_text: Da na so didibii tesi Masaa Jesesi na ala fasi fa a man, ma a á be poi kisi en, fu a du san a wani. Ne a fika en de, ne a gwe fosi.
eng_text: When the devil had completed every temptation, he departed from him until another time.

djk_text: Ne bakadati, ne Masaa Jesesi daai kon baka a Galileya. Da a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu be de ne en tapu taanga. Da a á be de ape langa seefi fosi sama be sabi taki, a be de ape.
eng_text: Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee, and news about him spread through all the surrounding area.

djk_text: Bika a be e go a ini den Dyu keliki osu e go e leli den sama Masaa Gadu wowtu. Da ala sama be e gafa en, fu fa den be si a be sabi leli sama den sani.
eng_text: He taught in their synagogues, being glorified by all.

djk_text: Da di a de a Galileya de te wan pisi, ne a go a Nasaleti a pe a be kiya. Ne a de ape te a kina dei fu den Dyu doo, ne a go na a keliki enke fa a be gwenti. Ne a opo taampu fu leisi wan pisi fu Gadu wowtu gi den.
eng_text: He came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up. He entered, as was his custom, into the synagogue on the Sabbath day, and stood up to read.

djk_text: Ne den teke wan pisi fu Gadu wowtu, di Jesaja, wan fositen apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu sikiifi, ne den langa gi en. Ne a opo en, ne a leisi a pisi di sikiifi taki:
eng_text: The book of the prophet Isaiah was handed to him. He opened the book, and found the place where it was written,

djk_text: “A Jeje fu Masaa Gadu de a mi tapu. Masaa Gadu sende mi fu taki a Bun Nyunsu fi en gi den pootiman. Masaa Gadu sende mi, fu taigi den sama di de tetei taki: ‘Mi sa puu den na a katibo di den de ape, fu den de booboo.’ Masaa Gadu sende mi, fu taigi den beendiman taki: ‘Den ain sa kon bun.’ Masaa Gadu sende mi, fu taigi den sama di de a sitaafu anga pina taki: ‘Den sa komoto na a sitaafu anga a pina kon de fu den boo.’
eng_text:
The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has anointed me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to proclaim release to the captives, recovering of sight to the blind, to deliver those who are crushed,
1903	Soseefi a sende mi, fu taigi ala libisama fiya taki: ‘A yuu doo di Masaa Gadu teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku libisama.’ ”	1903	and to proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord.

djk_text: Ne di Masaa Jesesi kaba, ne a lolo a pampila baka, ne a langa gi den baka. Ne a go sidon. Ne ala den sama di be de a ini a keliki osu fika e luku en dunn.
eng_text: He closed the book, gave it back to the attendant, and sat down. The eyes of all in the synagogue were fastened on him.

djk_text: Ne a taigi den taki: “A sama di Masaa Gadu taki a sende na a pisi di u leisi de, na mi.”
eng_text: He began to tell them, "Today, this Scripture has been fulfilled in your hearing."

djk_text: Di a taki so, te a kaba, namo a taki switi gi den sama te, a foondoo den. Ma toku, den á gafa en anga den hii ati, bika den daai e akisi denseefi taki: “Sama na a sama di taki a taki de? A ná a pikin fu Jowsef, no?”
eng_text: All testified about him, and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth, and they said, "Isn't this Joseph's son?"

djk_text: We, ne di Masaa Jesesi si so, ne a piki den taki: “U wani koti odoo gi mi taki: ‘Kaabita e deesi, ma enseefi kini bigi?’ Bika u be yee fu den sani di i e du a Kafalnayemu. Da di i kon a iseefi kondee ya, da du den gi den sama fi yu ya tu meke u si.”
eng_text: He said to them, "Doubtless you will tell me this parable, 'Physician, heal yourself! Whatever we have heard done at Capernaum, do also here in your hometown.'"

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “U aliki bun! Meke mi taigi u: ‘Wan apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu, ná abi nen ne enseefi kondee.’
eng_text: He said, "Most certainly I tell you, no prophet is acceptable in his hometown.

djk_text: “Bika luku a apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu, di den be e kai Eliya. A ten di a be de, na so den á be e oli en fu sani tu. A be tapu a alen hiihii dii yali anga sigisi mun langa, ne en kondee Islayeli ya. Ne wan gaan angiiten be kon a Islayeli Kondee fu di alen á be e kai. Da na a angii yuu ya, da somen pooti uman be de a ini Islayeli Kondee ya, di man dede fika a ganda. Ma toku, Masaa Gadu á be sende Eliya go a wan fu den uman ya. Ma a sende en go, te a wan hii taa kondee den e kai Salefati, na a pisiwataa fu Sidon Kondee fu go du wan gaan foondoo sani gi wan hii taa kondee uman di man dede fika a ganda.
eng_text: But truly I tell you, there were many widows in Israel in the days of Elijah, when the sky was shut up three years and six months, when a great famine came over all the land.

djk_text: Na soseefi a be de na a ten fu a apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu di den be e kai Elisa. A ten de, da somen sama fu Islayeli be de anga gwasi siki. Ma Elisa á deesi ná wan fu den. Ma a fika den go deesi Naamani, wan man di komoto te a wan taa kondee den kai Siliya.”
eng_text: There were many lepers in Israel in the time of Elisha the prophet, yet not one of them was cleansed, except Naaman, the Syrian."

djk_text: We, di Masaa Jesesi taki so, ne den sama di be de a ini a keliki osu, ati boon te, den ain lebi nyan.
eng_text: They were all filled with wrath in the synagogue, as they heard these things.

djk_text: Ne den opo gwugwulu, ne den toto Masaa Jesesi gei gei poti a doo. Ne den tyai en go te, na a mongo mofu fu a kondee, fu toto en towe go a ondoo.
eng_text: They rose up, threw him out of the city, and led him to the brow of the hill that their city was built on, that they might throw him off the cliff.

djk_text: Ma, te fu den membee, ne kuli, a daai waka pasa a den mindii gwe fi en.
eng_text: But he, passing through their midst, went his way.

djk_text: Da Masaa Jesesi go a Kafalnayemu, na a seefi pisiwataa fu Galileya. Da te kina dei, da a be e go a den Dyu keliki go e leli sama Masaa Gadu wowtu.
eng_text: He came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee. He was teaching them on the Sabbath day,

djk_text: Da a be e foondoo den sama, fu a fasi fa a be e leli den. Bika i be sa si taki, a be e leli den enke wan sama di sabi san ai taki.
eng_text: and they were astonished at his teaching, for his word was with authority.

djk_text: Ma namo, da wan dei di a de a ini a keliki osu e leli den sama, da wan sama be de ape anga wan sani ne en tapu. Ne a sani bali na a sama tapu taki:
eng_text: In the synagogue there was a man who had a spirit of an unclean demon, and he cried out with a loud voice,

djk_text: “Jesesi fu Nasaleti! San i kon du ya? A kon i kon fu kii wi kaba? Mi sabi sama a yu! Yu na a Apaiti Sama fu Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: saying, "Ah! what have we to do with you, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know you who you are: the Holy One of God!"

djk_text: Ma wanten Masaa Jesesi kaasi den taki: “Tapu mofu de! Komoto ne en tapu gwe wanten!” Ne a sani towe a man a doti, a den sama fesi, ne a komoto ne en tapu gwe, sondee fu du wan ogii anga a man.
eng_text: Jesus rebuked him, saying, "Be silent, and come out of him!" When the demon had thrown him down in their midst, he came out of him, having done him no harm.

djk_text: Da den sama be foondoo te, den taigi denseefi taki: “Ai kaasi den takuu sani, da wanten den e du san a kumandei den fu du. Anga a gaan makiti anga taanga fi en, a puu a takuu sani na a man tapu.”
eng_text: Amazement came on all, and they spoke together, one with another, saying, "What is this word? For with authority and power he commands the unclean spirits, and they come out!"

djk_text: A nyunsu ya paati na a hii pisiwataa fu Galileya.
eng_text: News about him went out into every place of the surrounding region.

djk_text: Da di Masaa Jesesi komoto na a keliki, ne a go a Simon osu. Ma namo, di den go doo, da a main fu Simon be didon anga taanga feba a kama. Ne den sama di be de ape a ini a osu begi Masaa Jesesi, fu a deesi en gi den.
eng_text: He rose up from the synagogue, and entered into Simon's house. Simon's mother-in-law was afflicted with a great fever, and they begged him for her.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi go a ini a osu. Ne a sende ala den sama go a doo. Ne a waka go taampu na a kama sikin. Ne a kaasi a feba fu a gwe komoto na a mma sikin. Ne wanten a feba gwe. Ne a uman opo, ne a seeka sani gi den, den nyan.
eng_text: He stood over her, and rebuked the fever; and it left her. Immediately she rose up and served them.

djk_text: Da di sapaten, san dongo, ne den sama tyai onmen tenti sama anga ala sowtu siki kon a Masaa Jesesi fu a deesi den. Ne Masaa Jesesi poti ana a den tapu, deesi ala den fiya. Da wansi sowtu siki den sama be abi, toku a deesi ala fiya.
eng_text: When the sun was setting, all those who had any sick with various diseases brought them to him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.

djk_text: Da soseefi a puu somen takuu sani a somen sama tapu. Da den sani be e bali gi Masaa Jesesi taki: “Yu na a Manpikin fu Masaa Gadu!” Ma Masaa Jesesi á be e gi den pasi fu taki. A be e kaasi den fu den tapu mofu wanten. Bika den takuu sani be sabi taki, en na a Kelestesi.
eng_text: Demons also came out from many, crying out, and saying, "You are the Christ, the Son of God!" Rebuking them, he didn't allow them to speak, because they knew that he was the Christ.

djk_text: Da a taa dei fi en, fuuku mamanten, ne Masaa Jesesi wawan opo go a wan koo peesi. Ne den suku en te, den go si en. Ne den begi Masaa Jesesi gaantangi fu a á gwe, ma fu a tan anga den a den kondee de.
eng_text: When it was day, he departed and went into an uninhabited place, and the multitudes looked for him, and came to him, and held on to him, so that he wouldn't go away from them.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Mi mu go a den taa kondee go paati a Bun Nyunsu di e taki, fu a Nyun Tii tu Masaa Gadu tu. Meke den yee. Bika na fu a sani de ede meke mi kon a goontapu.”
eng_text: But he said to them, "I must preach the good news of the Kingdom of God to the other cities also. For this reason I have been sent."

djk_text: We, ne ai waka na ala den kondee kondee fu den Dyu fiya e paati a Bun Nyunsu fu Masaa Gadu gi den a ini den keliki osu fu den.
eng_text: He was preaching in the synagogues of Galilee.

djk_text: Ma namo, da wan dei, da Masaa Jesesi be de a wataa mofu, fu a ze fu Genesaleti. Da somen sama ali kon ne en te a ipi, fu yee Masaa Gadu wowtu.
eng_text: Now it happened, while the multitude pressed on him and heard the word of God, that he was standing by the lake of Gennesaret.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi si tu boto a lampeesi de. Den boto ya na be fu wanlo fisiman di be komoto a peesi kon e losi den seepi e seeka.
eng_text: He saw two boats standing by the lake, but the fishermen had gone out of them, and were washing their nets.

djk_text: Wan fu den fisiman ya na be Simon. Ne a subi go a ini a boto fu Simon. Ne a taigi Simon fu a toosi a boto go a wataa afu, fu a sa taki anga den sama.
eng_text: He entered into one of the boats, which was Simon's, and asked him to put out a little from the land. He sat down and taught the multitudes from the boat.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi sidon a ini a boto taki anga den sama te a kaba. Ne a taigi Simon taki: “So, we Simon! Wai a boto go a mindii wataa! Da i towe i seepi kisi fisi!”
eng_text: When he had finished speaking, he said to Simon, "Put out into the deep, and let down your nets for a catch."

djk_text: Ne Simon piki taki: “Mesiti! A di na yu taki, meke mi o towe a seepi baka. Ma ofuso, mi á be o towe en moo. Bika na hii neti u towe seepi suku fisi kaba sondee fu kisi wan siiba. Ma toku, di na yu taki so, da u sa iti luku baka.”
eng_text: Simon answered him, "Master, we worked all night, and took nothing; but at your word I will let down the net."

djk_text: Ne den iti den seepi a wataa. Ne den kisi fisi te, a seepi e suku fu piiti.
eng_text: When they had done this, they caught a great multitude of fish, and their net was breaking.

djk_text: Ne den bali kai den taa sama di den anga den be e fisi makandii, fu kon yeepi den anga den fisi. Ne den kon a den. Ne den e kisi den fisi poti a ini den tu boto te, a fika pikinso moo fu den tu boto sungu.
eng_text: They beckoned to their partners in the other boat, that they should come and help them. They came, and filled both boats, so that they began to sink.

djk_text: Da di Peitilisi si den somen fisi di den kisi, ne a foondoo te, a kai anga kini a doti, a Masaa Jesesi fesi, bali taki: “Masaa! Komoto a mi se ya, baa! Bika mi a ná wan bun libisama. Mi á waiti sai fi i kon a mi se.”
eng_text: But Simon Peter, when he saw it, fell down at Jesus' knees, saying, "Depart from me, for I am a sinful man, Lord."

djk_text: Soseefi a sani ya foondoo Johanisi anga Jakowbesi, den tu manpikin fu Da Sebedi di be e wooko anga Simon Peitilisi. Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi Simon taki: “Simon! Ná feele moo! I be e kisi fisi. Ma fanafu now, mi o meke i toon sama di e kisi libisama enke fisi tyai kon biibi a mi.”
eng_text: and so also were James and John, sons of Zebedee, who were partners with Simon. Jesus said to Simon, "Don't be afraid. From now on you will be catching people alive."

djk_text: Ne den tyai den boto go poti baka. Ne den komoto a soo, fika ala den sani fu den de, go e waka a Masaa Jesesi baka.
eng_text: When they had brought their boats to land, they left everything, and followed him.

djk_text: Da bakadati, ne Masaa Jesesi go a wan kondee. Ma namo, da wan gwasiman be de ape. Da di a gwasiman si Masaa Jesesi, ne a lon kon sutu kini a doti kai tapu fesi a doti e begi en taki: “Masaa, baa! Mi sabi taki efi i wani, i poi fu deesi mi puu a gwasi siki ya, baa!”
eng_text: It happened, while he was in one of the cities, behold, there was a man full of leprosy. When he saw Jesus, he fell on his face, and begged him, saying, "Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi langa ana oli en. Ne a taki: “Mi wani! Kon bun baka!” Ne wanten di Masaa Jesesi taki so, ne a man kon bun kelle baka.
eng_text: He stretched out his hand, and touched him, saying, "I want to. Be made clean." Immediately the leprosy left him.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi bali en taki: “Ná taigi ná wan sama san mi du gi yu. Ma go na apaiti begiman fu a Mama Keliki, meke den si taki i kon bun. Da du san a weiti fu Mosesi e taigi yu fu du, te i kon bun fu gwasi siki. Bika Masaa Gadu be gi Mosesi wan weiti a sikiifi taki: ‘Wan Islayeli sama di kon bun fu gwasi siki mu tyai wan paiman go gi Masaa Gadu, fu sama sa si taki, a kon bun tuu.’ ”
eng_text: He commanded him to tell no one, "But go your way, and show yourself to the priest, and offer for your cleansing according to what Moses commanded, for a testimony to them."

djk_text: Ma anga ala fa Masaa Jesesi bali a man de, toku sama yee sani fu Masaa Jesesi na a hii peesi de. Ne ala sama e kon a Masaa Jesesi, fu a deesi den fu den siki di den abi.
eng_text: But the report concerning him spread much more, and great multitudes came together to hear, and to be healed by him of their infirmities.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi be lobi go a ini a gaan sabana go begi en wawan. Na so a fika den sama de, ne a go a ini a sabana ini go begi.
eng_text: But he withdrew himself into the desert, and prayed.

djk_text: We, ne wan taa dei, ne Masaa Jesesi e leli den sama Masaa Gadu wowtu baka. Da den Faliseiman anga den leliman fu Dyuweiti seefi be de ape tu. Den be komoto na a hii Galileya anga hii Judeja pisiwataa, anga soseefi Jelusalem Foto. Ma namo, da a taanga fu Masaa Gadu be de a Masaa Jesesi tapu fu deesi siki.
eng_text: It happened on one of those days, that he was teaching; and there were Pharisees and teachers of the law sitting by, who had come out of every village of Galilee, Judea, and Jerusalem. The power of the Lord was with him to heal them.

djk_text: Da di Masaa Jesesi leli den sama te wan pisi, ne wantu man tyai wan lanman a wan daagi tapu kon a Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: Behold, men brought a paralyzed man on a cot, and they sought to bring him in to lay before Jesus.

djk_text: Ma den á be poi pasa go doo a Masaa Jesesi a ini a osu. Bika sama be ipi seefi. Ne den subi go na a osu tapu, ne den puu wantu fu den siton na a osu tapu. Ne den pasa a man anga a daagi na a olo saka go leti a Masaa Jesesi fesi.
eng_text: Not finding a way to bring him in because of the multitude, they went up to the housetop, and let him down through the tiles with his cot into the midst before Jesus.

djk_text: Da di Masaa Jesesi si fa den man di tyai a mati fu den kon ya e biibi taanga, ne a taigi a lanman taki: “Mi mati! I kisi paadon fu den takuudu anga ogii fi yu.”
eng_text: Seeing their faith, he said to him, "Man, your sins are forgiven you."

djk_text: Da di den Faliseiman anga den leliman fu Dyuweiti yee fa Masaa Jesesi taki, ne den kuutu a ini denseefi taki: “Fa wan libisama sa taki so wan sani? Ai oli Gadu a sipowtu! Bika ná wan sama di man fu gi libisama paadon fu takuudu anga ogii, boiti Masaa Gadu wawan.”
eng_text: The scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, "Who is this that speaks blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone?"

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi be sabi san de a ini den. Ne a taigi den taki: “Saide meke u e denki so du?
eng_text: But Jesus, perceiving their thoughts, answered them, "Why are you reasoning so in your hearts?

djk_text: Fu taigi wan sama taki, a kisi paadon fi en takuudu anga ogii, efu fu taigi en taki: ‘Opo taampu waka!’ on di moo taanga?
eng_text: Which is easier to say, 'Your sins are forgiven you;' or to say, 'Arise and walk?'

djk_text: Ma u mu sabi taki, a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya abi makiti a goontapu, fu gi sama paadon fu takuudu anga ogii.” Ne a daai, ne a taigi a lanman taki: “Opo taampu! Teke i daagi waka go a osu!”
eng_text: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins" (he said to the paralyzed man), "I tell you, arise, and take up your cot, and go to your house."

djk_text: Ne dyandyalan, a man dyombo opo na ala den sama fesi. Ne ai waka e gafa Masaa Gadu e gwe a osu.
eng_text: Immediately he rose up before them, and took up that which he was laying on, and departed to his house, glorifying God.

djk_text: Ala sama fiya foondoo. A gei enke den á be wani biibi den ain. Ne den gafa Masaa Gadu taki: “Ai, Masaa Gadu bigi! U si gaan foondoo sani tide.”
eng_text: Amazement took hold on all, and they glorified God. They were filled with fear, saying, "We have seen strange things today."

djk_text: Ne bakadati, ne Masaa Jesesi komoto de e gwe. Ne di ai gwe, ne a si wan man den e kai Leifi, sidon ne en kantoo doo mofu e piki lantimoni. Ne Masaa Jesesi kai en fu a kon toon wan bakaman fi en.
eng_text: After these things he went out, and saw a tax collector named Levi sitting at the tax office, and said to him, "Follow me!"

djk_text: Ne a man opo, ne a fika ala den sani fi en de, ne a waka go fu go waka a Masaa Jesesi baka.
eng_text: He left everything, and rose up and followed him.

djk_text: Da di den de te wan dei, ne Leifi oli wan gaan fesa ne en osu gi Masaa Jesesi. Somen taa mati fu Leifi di be e piki lantimoni anga wantu taa sama be de na a piisii ya tu.
eng_text: Levi made a great feast for him in his house. There was a great crowd of tax collectors and others who were reclining with them.

djk_text: Da di den de na a fesa te wan pisi, ne wan duupu Faliseiman anga leliman fu Dyuweiti si Masaa Jesesi sidon e nyan anga den man di e piki lantimoni anga den taa takuu libi man fu a kondee de. Da a sani ya á bun gi den. Ne den akisi den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi taki: “Fu saide meke u sidon e nyan anga den man di e piki lantimoni anga den taa takuulibi sama de?”
eng_text: Their scribes and the Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, "Why do you eat and drink with the tax collectors and sinners?"

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi yee den. Ne a piki den anga wan ageisi toli taki: “ ‘Na sama di e siki, na dati abi dataa fanowdu. Ma sama di á siki, ná abi dataa fanowdu. Dataa de gi sikiman anga malengiiman.’
eng_text: Jesus answered them, "Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.

djk_text: Mi á kon kai den bunbun sama, ma mi kon fu kai den sama di sabi taki, den libi á bun, fu den daai den libi.”
eng_text: I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance."

djk_text: Ma namo, wan dei, ne wan duupu Faliseiman anga leliman fu weiti akisi Masaa Jesesi taki: “Mesiti! Saide meke den bakaman fi yu ná abi ten, di den e tan sondee nyan fu begi enke wi anga den bakaman fu wi? Den bakaman fu Johanisi a Dopuman seefi, abi ten di den e tan sondee nyan fu Gadu tu.”
eng_text: They said to him, "Why do John's disciples often fast and pray, likewise also the disciples of the Pharisees, but yours eat and drink?"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi gi den wan toli taki: “Fa mi anga den bakaman fu mi de ya, da a de leti enke te wan man toow anga wan uman. Di a man toow, ne a kai somen sama fu kon meke piisii anga en. We, solanga a toowman de na a fesa anga den, da na soso nyan meke piisii namo den o de.
eng_text: He said to them, "Can you make the friends of the bridegroom fast, while the bridegroom is with them?

djk_text: Ma te di a dei o doo, te a toowman ná o de moo, da den sa abi ten di den o go e de sondee nyan fu begi.”
eng_text: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them. Then they will fast in those days."

djk_text: Ne a gi den ete wan ageisi toli. A taki: “A o taanga gi u, fu teke san mi e taki. Bika, te wan gaandi koosi fi i piiti, da anga san yu o lapu en? Ná anga wan gaandi pisi koosi, no? Bika efi i lapu a gaandi koosi anga wan nyunyun pisi, da te i wasi en, da a nyunyun pisi koosi o ali piiti komoto na a gaandi koosi. Da a gaandi koosi o piiti moo bigi.
eng_text: He also told a parable to them. "No one puts a piece from a new garment on an old garment, or else he will tear the new, and also the piece from the new will not match the old.

djk_text: “Na soseefi, a á fiti fu u poti nyun meke win go a ini gaandi saka di meke anga meti buba. Bika a dee taanga kaba. Da di a win o kuku, da a o soopu a gaandi saka basi towe a win poli. Da a kon, i lasi win, i lasi saka.
eng_text: No one puts new wine into old wineskins, or else the new wine will burst the skins, and it will be spilled, and the skins will be destroyed.

djk_text: Nyunyun win meke fu poti a ini nyunyun saka, di á poi basi lasi en.
eng_text: But new wine must be put into fresh wineskins, and both are preserved.

djk_text: “Ma efu wan sama diingi gaandi win, da a ná o wani diingi nyunyun meke win moo. Bika, da a o si enke a gaandi win di a diingi switi moo a nyun meke win.”
eng_text: No man having drunk old wine immediately desires new, for he says, 'The old is better.'"

djk_text: Da a wan kina dei fu den Dyu, ne Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en e waka pasa a wan goon ini. Da wan sani enke alisi de a ini a goon ya. Ne den bakaman fi en booko den sani ya e pii e nyan.
eng_text: Now it happened on the second Sabbath after the first, that he was going through the grain fields. His disciples plucked the heads of grain, and ate, rubbing them in their hands.

djk_text: Ma namo, ne wantu Faliseiman bali gi den taki: “Luku de! U si san u e du? Saide meke u e booko den sani na a kina dei ya fu du? U á si taki fa u e du de na Gadu weiti u e poli, no?”
eng_text: But some of the Pharisees said to them, "Why do you do that which is not lawful to do on the Sabbath day?"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “U á leisi a Masaa Gadu Buku san a avo gaansama fu u di den e kai Kownu Dafeti anga den bakaman fi en be du di angii be kii den, no?
eng_text: Jesus, answering them, said, "Haven't you read what David did when he was hungry, he, and those who were with him;

djk_text: Di den go na a Mama Keliki, ne den teke den beele di den poti a Masaa Gadu fesi de, ne den nyan. Ma a weiti e soi taki, na den apaiti begiman fu Dyu keliki wawan sa nyan den beele de. Ma Kownu Dafeti anga den bakaman fi en nyanmi den.”
eng_text: how he entered into God's house, and took and ate the show bread, and gave also to those who were with him, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests alone?"

djk_text: U meke mi taigi u, meke u sabi: “A Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya, na a gaan Masaa fu a kina dei.”
eng_text: He said to them, "The Son of Man is lord of the Sabbath."

djk_text: Da wan taa kina dei, ne Masaa Jesesi go a ini wan Dyu keliki baka, go e leli sama. Ma namo, wan man be de ape, di be siki ne en letise ana. A ana be dee fika kamboo.
eng_text: It also happened on another Sabbath that he entered into the synagogue and taught. There was a man there, and his right hand was withered.

djk_text: Da wan duupu Faliseiman anga leliman fu Dyuweiti be de a ini a keliki osu, poti ain e luku efu Masaa Jesesi o deesi a siki ana man, na a kina dei ya, fu den sa fende pasi kaagi en.
eng_text: The scribes and the Pharisees watched him, to see whether he would heal on the Sabbath, that they might find an accusation against him.

djk_text: Ma, da Masaa Jesesi be sabi kaba, san den be e pakisei a ini den ati. A dati meke a kai a siki ana man taki: “Man! Opo kon taampu a fesi ya. Ne a man opo, ne a kon taampu de.”
eng_text: But he knew their thoughts; and he said to the man who had the withered hand, "Rise up, and stand in the middle." He arose and stood.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi daai, ne a akisi den sama di de ape taki: “San Gadu Buku e soi u fu u du a kina dei? U mu du bun ofu u mu du ogii? U mu yeepi sama di de fu dede fu puu den a dede mofu ofu u mu fika den fu dede?”
eng_text: Then Jesus said to them, "I will ask you something: Is it lawful on the Sabbath to do good, or to do harm? To save a life, or to kill?"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi luku den dunn. Ne a daai go, ne a taigi a man taki: “Langa i ana, osi?” Ne a man langa ana. Ne wanten de, ne a ana kon bun kelle baka enke fa a be de.
eng_text: He looked around at them all, and said to the man, "Stretch out your hand." He did, and his hand was restored as sound as the other.

djk_text: We, di den Faliseiman anga den leliman fu Dyuweiti si taki Masaa Jesesi deesi a man, ne den ati teke faya. Ne den oli wan kuutu, fu luku fa den sa fende wan fasi fu kii Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: But they were filled with rage, and talked with one another about what they might do to Jesus.

djk_text: Ne wan pisi a baka, ne Masaa Jesesi go a wan mongo go begi. Da a tan de begi wan hiihii neti.
eng_text: It happened in these days, that he went out to the mountain to pray, and he continued all night in prayer to God.

djk_text: Ne di mamanten, ne a kai den sama di be e waka ne en baka kon ne en. Ne di den sama kon, ne a teke twalufu man a ini den toonmi en bakaman, fu waka anga en go na ala peesi pe ai go. Da Masaa Jesesi be e kai den man ya apaiti bosikopuman.
eng_text: When it was day, he called his disciples, and from them he chose twelve, whom he also named apostles:

djk_text: Da den twalufu man di a be teke ya, na be: Simon Peitilisi, anga en baala Andeleyasi Jakowbesi Johanisi Filipi Baatomeyosi
eng_text: Simon, whom he also named Peter; Andrew, his brother; James; John; Philip; Bartholomew;

djk_text: Mateyesi Towmasi Jakowbesi a manpikin fu Alefeyosi Simon Selotu
eng_text: Matthew; Thomas; James, the son of Alphaeus; Simon, who was called the Zealot;

djk_text: Judasi a pikin fu Jakowbesi Judasi Iskaliyotu a man di seli Masaa Jesesi gi den ogii ati sama den kii.
eng_text: Judas the son of James; and Judas Iscariot, who also became a traitor.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi anga den twalufu bakaman fi en anga den taa sama di be lobi waka ne en baka anga somen taa sama ete, saka a mongo go a wan sabana peesi. Namo, da somen sama fu a hii pisiwataa fu Judeja, anga Jelusalem Foto, anga den foto enke Tilosi anga Sidoni na a sikin liba fu a ze, be kon a Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: He came down with them, and stood on a level place, with a crowd of his disciples, and a great number of the people from all Judea and Jerusalem, and the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, who came to hear him and to be healed of their diseases;

djk_text: Den be kon fu yee a leli fi en. Taawan be kon fu a deesi den. Son sama di be abi takuu sani a den tapu, e toobi den, be kon a Masaa Jesesi tu, fu a puu den gi den. Da a puu ala den takuu sani fiya a den sama tapu gi den.
eng_text: as well as those who were troubled by unclean spirits, and they were being healed.

djk_text: Ala sama be e meke moiti fu langa ana oli en. Bika a taanga fu Masaa Gadu be e komoto ne en, e deesi ala den fiya.
eng_text: All the multitude sought to touch him, for power came out from him and healed them all.

djk_text: Da baka di Masaa Jesesi kaba deesi den sama, ne a opo ede luku den bakaman fi en. Ne a taigi den taki: “Seigi fu u di de enke mofinawan. Bika u o fende a bun di de a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: He lifted up his eyes to his disciples, and said, "Blessed are you who are poor, for yours is the Kingdom of God.

djk_text: Da seigi fu sama tu, di e angii fu de enke fa Masaa Gadu wani. Bika Masaa Gadu o gi yu a sani di yu e angii de. Soseefi seigi fu sama di e kee nownow. Bika bakaten, da a kee fu den o daai kon toon lafu.
eng_text: Blessed are you who hunger now, for you will be filled. Blessed are you who weep now, for you will laugh.

djk_text: Da seigi fu yu, di libisama e buuse, fu di u poti biibi na a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya. Seigi o de gi u, anga ala fa den e puu u a den mindii. Den e kosi u, e poli u nen na ala se a kondee.
eng_text: Blessed are you when men shall hate you, and when they shall exclude and mock you, and throw out your name as evil, for the Son of Man's sake.

djk_text: “Da u mu dyombo piisii, te den e du den sani ya anga u. Bika u o kisi wan gaan paiman a Masaa Gadu. Na so den sama fu fositen be du ala sowtu ogii anga den fositen apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu tu.”
eng_text: Rejoice in that day, and leap for joy, for behold, your reward is great in heaven, for their fathers did the same thing to the prophets.

djk_text: “Da heelu fu u di e taki: ‘U gudu kaba, da u ná abi Masaa Gadu fanowdu moo.’ Bika, bakaten den gudu fu u ná o de a teli moo. Da u o fika piipii sondee wan sani. Bika u be nyan den bun fu u pasa a fesi kaba.
eng_text:
But woe to you who are rich! For you have received your consolation.

djk_text: Te sama e kosi u, e fuuku u, da u mu begi fu sani waka bun gi den. Soseefi u mu begi bun gi den sama di e du ogii ati sani anga u.
eng_text: bless those who curse you, and pray for those who mistreat you.

djk_text: Efu wan sama naki i wan baala ana a i sikin fesi, daai a taase fesi gi en, meke a naki tu. Efu wan sama teke i dyakiti, puu i impi gi en tu.
eng_text: To him who strikes you on the cheek, offer also the other; and from him who takes away your cloak, don't withhold your coat also.

djk_text: Soseefi, efu wan sama begi i wan sani fi i, ná ogii gi en. Ma gi en. Efu wan sama teke wan sani fi yu, yu á mu teke en ne en baka.
eng_text: Give to everyone who asks you, and don't ask him who takes away your goods to give them back again.

djk_text: A fasi fa i wani sama libi anga yu, na letiso i mu libi anga sama tu.

As you would like people to do to you, do exactly so to them.

djk_text: Ne a koti wantu nongo gi den taki: “Beendiman á poi tyai beendiman na ana. Ofuso, ala den tu o kai a ini gotoo, dede.
eng_text: He spoke a parable to them. "Can the blind guide the blind? Won't they both fall into a pit?

djk_text: Soseefi wan sikoo pikin á poi sabi sani enke a mesiti fi en. Ma te a leli ala sani fu a mesiti, fosi a o de enke a mesiti.”
eng_text: A disciple is not above his teacher, but everyone when he is fully trained will be like his teacher.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den go doo taki: “Saide meke yu e booko ede, fu puu a pikin mbalububa di de a ini wan taawan ain, ma a gaan pisi gobo di de a ini iseefi ain, i nái si? We, fa i abi a deki ati, fu taigi i baala taki: ‘Baala! Meke mi puu a pikin mbalububa a i ain gi yu,’ ma a gaan pisi gobo a ini iseefi ain de, i nái si en, fu puu? U soso mofu sama! Puu a gaan pisi gobo a iseefi ain fosi, da i ain o kiin sai fu poi puu a pikin mbalububa a i baala ain.”
eng_text: Why do you see the speck of chaff that is in your brother's eye, but don't consider the beam that is in your own eye?

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den baka taki: “Wan bon di e meke soso sii, a ná wan bun bon. Soseefi, wan bon di e meke bun sii, a ná wan soso bon.
eng_text: For there is no good tree that brings forth rotten fruit; nor again a rotten tree that brings forth good fruit.

djk_text: Bika iniiwan bon, na a sii fi en meke i sa sabi en. Leti enke fa i si wan makabon ná o meke figasii, na soseefi, yu ná o fende figasii nyanyan a wan makabon.
eng_text: For each tree is known by its own fruit. For people don't gather figs from thorns, nor do they gather grapes from a bramble bush.

djk_text: Na so a de anga libisama. Wan takuu ati sama ná o taki bunbun sani. Ma wan bunbun ati sama, a bunbun sani a o taki anga en mofu. Bika na san di fuu wan sama boo ati, na dati en mofu o taki kon a doo, fu sama yee.
eng_text: The good man out of the good treasure of his heart brings out that which is good, and the evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart brings out that which is evil, for out of the abundance of the heart, his mouth speaks.

djk_text: Da di Masaa Jesesi taigi den sama den sani de kaba, ne a daai go baka a Kafalnayemu.
eng_text: After he had finished speaking in the hearing of the people, he entered into Capernaum.

djk_text: Ma namo, di a doo de, da wan futuboi fu wan ofisii fu Loma Foto suudati be siki. A ofisii ya be lobi a futuboi fi en ya te, ná sipowtu. Ma, da a be siki tuutuu. Ala yuu na yuu fu a be dede namo.
eng_text: A certain centurion's servant, who was dear to him, was sick and at the point of death.

djk_text: Ma di a ofisii yee fu ala den sani di Masaa Jesesi e du, ne a go begi wantu gaansama fu Dyu Kondee, fu den go begi Masaa Jesesi, fu a kon deesi a futuboi fi en gi en.
eng_text: When he heard about Jesus, he sent to him elders of the Jews, asking him to come and save his servant.

djk_text: Ne den go a Masaa Jesesi, go begi en tangi tangi fu a kon go yeepi a ofisii fu den Loma suudati, fu deesi a futuboi fi en gi den.
eng_text: When they came to Jesus, they begged him earnestly, saying, "He is worthy for you to do this for him,

djk_text: Ne den taigi Masaa Jesesi taki: “A man ya, na wan sama di lobi wi Islayeli sama tuutuu. A lobi wi te, a teke enseefi moni pai meke wan keliki osu gi wi. Da wi si taki a fiti fi i yeepi en gi wi, baa?”
eng_text: for he loves our nation, and he built our synagogue for us."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi komoto, ne ai go anga den na a osu fu a ofisii fu den Loma suudati. Da di den waka, te den koosube, ne a ofisii sende den mati fi en go taigi Masaa Jesesi taki: “Masaa, mi á dyendee sai fi i kon a mi osu.
eng_text: Jesus went with them. When he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying to him, "Lord, don't trouble yourself, for I am not worthy for you to come under my roof.

djk_text: A dati meke miseefi á kon a yu, ma mi puu sama sende kon a yu. Ma taki wan wowtu namo, da a futuboi fu mi o kon bun baka.
eng_text: Therefore I didn't even think myself worthy to come to you; but say the word, and my servant will be healed.

djk_text: Bika miseefi na wan ofisii fu suudati di abi sama a mi ondoo. Ma na soseefi mi abi sama a mi tapu enke basi. Da efu mi sende wan fu den futuboi fu mi taki: ‘Go so!’ Da a musu fu go. Efu mi kai en taki: ‘Kon!’ Da wanten a musu fu kon. Te mi sende den taki: ‘U du dati!’ Da wanten den e du en tu. Soseefi mi sabi taki, efu yu, Masaa Jesesi, taki wan wowtu, da a musu pasa enke fa yu taki.”
eng_text: For I also am a man placed under authority, having under myself soldiers. I tell this one, 'Go!' and he goes; and to another, 'Come!' and he comes; and to my servant, 'Do this,' and he does it."

djk_text: Da di den sama taigi Masaa Jesesi a sani ya, ne a foondoo en te, ná sipowtu. Ne a daai luku den sama di be e waka anga en. Ne a taigi den taki: “A sani ya bigi gi mi tuutuu! Bika a sama ya, di a ná wan Islayeli sama, ne en e biibi mi moo enke u Islayeli sama seefi.”
eng_text: When Jesus heard these things, he marveled at him, and turned and said to the multitude who followed him, "I tell you, I have not found such great faith, no, not in Israel."

djk_text: Ne den sama di be tyai a mofu kon gi Masaa Jesesi, daai gwe baka na a ofisii fu suudati. Di den go doo, ne den si taki, a wookoman fi en kon bun kelle.
eng_text: Those who were sent, returning to the house, found that the servant who had been sick was well.

djk_text: Da bakadati, ne Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en go a wan foto den e kai Nain. Da somen sama be e waka ne en baka.
eng_text: It happened soon afterwards, that he went to a city called Nain. Many of his disciples, along with a great multitude, went with him.

djk_text: Da di den doo na a kondee mofu, ne den si tyaipi sama e waka komoto a ini a kondee e tyai wan sama go beli. A sama di dede ya, na be wan yonkuman. Na be awan kodo manpikin fu wan uman di man dede fika a ganda tu.
eng_text: Now when he drew near to the gate of the city, behold, one who was dead was carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow. Many people of the city were with her.

djk_text: Ma namo, di Masaa Jesesi si a uman, ne gaan tyali fi en kisi en fi en. Ne a taigi en taki: “Uman, ná kee moo, ye!”
eng_text: When the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her, and said to her, "Don't cry."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi waka go oli a daagi. Den sama di e tyai a daagi taampu pii. Ne a taki: “Yonkuman! Mi e taigi yu, Opo kon a libi baka!”
eng_text: He came near and touched the coffin, and the bearers stood still. He said, "Young man, I tell you, arise!"

djk_text: Ne wanten wanten de, ne a dedesama weki. Ne a opo sidon, ne a bigin sete fu taki. Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi a uman taki: “Uman! Luku a pikin fi yu ya!”
eng_text: He who was dead sat up, and began to speak. And he gave him to his mother.

djk_text: Da a sani di pasa ya, bigi gi den sama te, ná sani. Den taki: “Masaa Gadu bigi! A kon yeepi den sama fi en. A sende wan gaan apaiti takiman fi en kon gi wi, fu yeepi wi.”
eng_text: Fear took hold of all, and they glorified God, saying, "A great prophet has arisen among us!" and, "God has visited his people!"

djk_text: Da a nyunsu ya paati a hii Judeja anga ala den pisiwataa di lontu ape.
eng_text: This report went out concerning him in the whole of Judea, and in all the surrounding region.

djk_text: Da den bakaman fu Johanisi a Dopuman seefi yee fu den sani di Masaa Jesesi e du. Ne den go taigi Johanisi a pe a be de a dunguu osu san anga san den yee. Ne di Johanisi yee so, ne a kai tu fu den bakaman fi en kon ne en.
eng_text: The disciples of John told him about all these things.

djk_text: Ne a sende den taki: “U go a Jesesi, da u akisi en, efu ne en na a sama di Masaa Gadu be paamisi fu sende kon a goontapu, fu kon yeepi wi. Efu, kande a sama de, de a baka fu kon ete.”
eng_text: John, calling to himself two of his disciples, sent them to Jesus, saying, "Are you the one who is coming, or should we look for another?"

djk_text: Ne den bakaman fu Johanisi e go, te den go doo Masaa Jesesi. Da di den go doo, da Masaa Jesesi be e deesi somen sama, fu ala sowtu siki. A be e kaasi takuu jeje puu a taawan tapu. A be e deesi den beendiman. Ne den gi Masaa Jesesi a bosikopu fu Johanisi. Den taki: “Johanisi a Dopuman sende u fu u kon akisi yu efu na yu, na a sama di Masaa Gadu be paamisi, fu sende kon yeepi wi a goontapu. Efu, kande a sama de, de a baka, fu kon ete?”
eng_text: When the men had come to him, they said, "John the Baptizer has sent us to you, saying, 'Are you he who comes, or should we look for another?'"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den bakaman fu Johanisi taki: “U go a Johanisi baka. Go taigi en den sani di u e si, anga den sani di u e yee. U taigi en taki: ‘Den beendiman e si sani baka! Lanman e waka. Gwasiman e kon bun baka, sikin gaata kelle. Dofuman e yee sani baka tu. Soseefi dedesama e weki baka tu. Den mofinawan e yee a Bun Nyunsu fu Masaa Gadu.’
eng_text: Jesus answered them, "Go and tell John the things which you have seen and heard: that the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have good news preached to them.

djk_text: U taigi Johanisi tu taki: ‘Seigi fu sama di e biibi san mi e du te doo, sondee fu kuutu mi a ini en ati, wansi sani nái waka enke fa a be pakisei.’ ”
eng_text: Blessed is he who finds no occasion for stumbling in me."

djk_text: Da, di Masaa Jesesi taigi den bakaman fu Johanisi so, ne den daai gwe baka. Ne di den gwe, ne Masaa Jesesi bigin taki anga den sama taki: “Di u be go a ini a gaan sabana go luku Johanisi, sama u si anda? U si wan sama di de enke wan ken di winta e wai go, wai kon enke fa a wani?
eng_text: When John's messengers had departed, he began to tell the multitudes about John, "What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind?

djk_text: U si wan sama di be wei gaan dii koosi e piisii e nyan e diingi? Nono! Den sama di e libi den sowtu libi de, a ini paleisi ini den e de. A ná sabana ini.
eng_text: But what did you go out to see? A man clothed in soft clothing? Behold, those who are gorgeously dressed, and live delicately, are in kings' courts.

djk_text: Efu kande u denki taki, u be o si wan gaan apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu? We, na wan apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu, u si de tuu. Ma Johanisi de moo enke wan apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu seefi.
eng_text: But what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and much more than a prophet.

djk_text: Bika na a Johanisi ya, na a sama di Masaa Gadu Buku be sikiifi taki: ‘Mi o sende wan apaiti takiman fu mi kon, fosi yuseefi kon doo. A o taigi sama fu daai seeka den libi, na a leti pasi fu Masaa Gadu.’
eng_text: This is he of whom it is written, 'Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.'

djk_text: Fu ala den sama di komoto a mama bee, fu sensi di goontapu sete, te kon miti now, da ná wan fu den di hei enke Johanisi ya. Ma iniiwan sama di de a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu, te go doo den moo lagi wan seefi, hei moo a Johanisi ya.”
eng_text: For I tell you, among those who are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptizer, yet he who is least in the Kingdom of God is greater than he.

djk_text: We, den mofinawan anga den sama di e piki lantimoni, be e teke san Johanisi be e taki. Bika den be kon si taki, Masaa Gadu abi leti tuu. Ne den daai den libi, ne den be meke Johanisi dopu den.
eng_text: When all the people and the tax collectors heard this, they declared God to be just, having been baptized with John's baptism.

djk_text: Ma den Faliseiman anga den leliman fu Dyuweiti á be wani a yeepi, di Masaa Gadu be o yeepi den ya. Bika den á be wani daai den libi, fu Johanisi dopu den.
eng_text: But the Pharisees and the lawyers rejected the counsel of God, not being baptized by him themselves.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “San u gei? San mi sa taki fu u?
eng_text:
To what then will I liken the people of this generation? What are they like?
