djk_text: Ma namo, wan Faliseiman den e kai Simon, kai Masaa Jesesi, fu a kon nyan anga en ne en osu. Ne Masaa Jesesi go. Ne a go sidon a tafaa fu nyan.
eng_text: One of the Pharisees invited him to eat with him. He entered into the Pharisee's house, and sat at the table.

djk_text: Ma, da wan uman di be abi polinen a kondee be de na a pisi kondee de tu. Da di a yee taki, Masaa Jesesi de a Simon osu, ne a go na a osu de tu. Da di ai go, ne a tyai wan gaan dii pikin bataa sumee switi fatu.
eng_text: Behold, a woman in the city who was a sinner, when she knew that he was reclining in the Pharisee's house, she brought an alabaster jar of ointment.

djk_text: Di a go doo, ne a saka kini a Masaa Jesesi baka, ne en futuse. Ne a bigin kee. Ne ai kee e bosi Masaa Jesesi futu te, en wataa ain nati Masaa Jesesi futu petee. Ne a deemi en anga en ede uwii. Ne a teke a sumee switi fatu, ne a kandi lobi a Masaa Jesesi futu.
eng_text: Standing behind at his feet weeping, she began to wet his feet with her tears, and she wiped them with the hair of her head, kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.

djk_text: Da di a Faliseiman si a sani ya, ne ai kuutu a ini enseefi taki: “Ma Jesesi sa de wan apaiti takiman fu Gadu tuutuu? A ná kan! Bika efu a be de wan apaiti takiman fu Gadu, da a be musu sabi sama na a uman di e oli en de. Na wan polinen uman.”
eng_text: Now when the Pharisee who had invited him saw it, he said to himself, "This man, if he were a prophet, would have perceived who and what kind of woman this is who touches him, that she is a sinner."

djk_text: Namo, ne Masaa Jesesi taigi en taki: “Simon! Mi abi wan sani di mi fu taigi yu.” Ne Simon taki: “We, Mesiti, i sa taki!”
eng_text: Jesus answered him, "Simon, I have something to tell you." He said, "Teacher, say on."

djk_text: Ne a taigi en taki: “Tu man be yuu moni a wan man. Wan fu den yuu feifi dunsu kolu. A taawan yuu feifi ondoo kolu.
eng_text:
A certain lender had two debtors. The one owed five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.
2054	Ma, den á be poi fende a moni fu pai a man baka. Ne di den de te wan pisi, ne a man taigi den taki: ‘U sabi san? U fika a moni. A á de fu u pai mi en moo.’ Da on di fu den tu sama ya o moo lobi a sama di den be mu pai?”	2054	When they couldn't pay, he forgave them both. Which of them therefore will love him most?

djk_text: Ne Simon piki en taki: “We, mi denki taki, na a sama di be mu pai en feifi dunsu kolu.” Ne Masaa Jesesi taki: “Weeno! I piki bun!”
eng_text: Simon answered, "He, I suppose, to whom he forgave the most." He said to him, "You have judged correctly."

djk_text: Ne a luku a uman, ne a taigi Simon taki: “I si a uman ya? Di yu kai mi kon a yu osu, yu á meke moiti seefi, fu wasi mi futu. Ma a uman ya wasi mi futu anga en wataa ain, deemi en anga en ede uwii.
eng_text: Turning to the woman, he said to Simon, "Do you see this woman? I entered into your house, and you gave me no water for my feet, but she has wet my feet with her tears, and wiped them with the hair of her head.

djk_text: Di yu e gi mi odi, yu á bosi baasa mi. Ma fanafu mi kon ya, ne a uman ya e bosi mi futu.
eng_text: You gave me no kiss, but she, since the time I came in, has not ceased to kiss my feet.

djk_text: Di mi kon a yu osu, yu ná iti fatu a mi ede enke fa a gwenti tu. Ma a uman ya lobi a moo dii switi fatu fu a kondee gi mi futu.
eng_text: You didn't anoint my head with oil, but she has anointed my feet with ointment.

djk_text: A uman di i si yu e si ya, be du ipi ogii. Ma mi gi en paadon fu ala fiya. A dati meke, i si a lobi mi so. Ma a sama di e denki taki, na wan pikin ogii namo a du, ne Masaa Gadu gi en paadon fu dati, da na pikinso namo a o lobi Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: Therefore I tell you, her sins, which are many, are forgiven, for she loved much. But to whom little is forgiven, the same loves little."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi daai, ne a taigi a uman taki: “Uman! I kisi paadon fu ala den takuudu anga ogii di i be du.”
eng_text: He said to her, "Your sins are forgiven."

djk_text: Da, di Masaa Jesesi taki so, ne wantu fu den sama di be sidon e nyan anga en makandii e kuutu taki: “Sama na a man di taki, ai gi sama paadon fu takuudu anga ogii de?”
eng_text: Those who sat at the table with him began to say to themselves, "Who is this who even forgives sins?"

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi taigi a uman taki: “Uman! A biibi fi yu yeepi yu. Da go fi yu a osu baka anga wan piisii ati.”
eng_text: He said to the woman, "Your faith has saved you. Go in peace."

djk_text: Da bakadati, ne Masaa Jesesi go a den kondee kondee. Da ai paati a Bun Nyunsu di e taki, fu a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: It happened soon afterwards, that he went about through cities and villages, preaching and bringing the good news of the Kingdom of God. With him were the twelve,

djk_text: Da den bakaman fi en anga wanlo umansama be de anga en tu. Da Masaa Jesesi be deesi den uman ya, fu ala sowtu takuu siki. Somen fu den, a be puu takuu jeje a den tapu. Wan fu den uman ya na Maliya Makidala, di Masaa Jesesi be puu seibin takuu jeje ne en tapu.
eng_text: and certain women who had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities: Mary who was called Magdalene, from whom seven demons had gone out;

djk_text: Wan taawan na be Johana, a uman fu Kusasi, wan edeman fu a paleisi fu Kownu Helowdesi anga wan taawan den e kai Susana. Soseefi somen somen taawan moo di be e waka anga Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en e lontu. Da den be e puu denseefi moni e bai san di Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en be abi fanowdu gi den.
eng_text: and Joanna, the wife of Chuzas, Herod's steward; Susanna; and many others; who served them from their possessions.

djk_text: Da wan dei, ne somen sama komoto a den kondee kondee fu kon aliki Masaa Jesesi. Ne a gi den wan ageisi toli.
eng_text: When a great multitude came together, and people from every city were coming to him, he spoke by a parable.

djk_text: A taki: “Wan dei, ne wan paandi goonman go tyatya wan sii fi en, fu goo. Ma di a tyatya a sii, ne afu fu a sii kai a sikin pasi. Ne sama waka masi den. Soseefi pikinfoo fee kon piki den sii nyan.
eng_text:
The farmer went out to sow his seed. As he sowed, some fell along the road, and it was trampled under foot, and the birds of the sky devoured it.
2068	Da soseefi afu fu a sii kai a siton ini. Da di a booko ain kon a tapu doti, ne den dede. Bika den lutu fu den á be poi go dipi a ondoo doti, fu fende wataa enke fa a de fanowdu.	2068	Other seed fell on the rock, and as soon as it grew, it withered away, because it had no moisture.
2069	Da soseefi, afu fu a sii kai a ini maka. Da di den goo kon anga den maka makandii, ne den maka pasuma den kii.	2069	Other fell amid the thorns, and the thorns grew with it, and choked it.
2070	Ma afu fu a sii kai a bun doti. Ne den dati goo, te den kon bigi meke nyanyan te, a ipi. A puu wan ondoo toon fu san di a goonman be tyatya.” Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “Sama di abi yesi fu yee, da meke a yee san mi taki ya.”	2070	Other fell into the good ground, and grew, and brought forth fruit one hundred times. As he said these things, he called out, "He who has ears to hear, let him hear!"

djk_text: Ne bakadati, ne den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi akisi en taki: “Masaa Jesesi, san wani taki ageisi toli di i taki de?”
eng_text: Then his disciples asked him, "What does this parable mean?"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “U mu sabi den kibii toli fu a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu. Ma den taa sama, na ageisi toli mi e gi den. ‘Bika anga opoopo ain, den á wani si. Anga opoopo yesi, den á wani yee. Soseefi den á wani fusutan tu.’ ”
eng_text: He said, "To you it is given to know the mysteries of the Kingdom of God, but to the rest in parables; that 'seeing they may not see, and hearing they may not understand.'

djk_text: Ne a taigi den taki: “We, a puu fu a ageisi toli de so. A sii, dati na a wowtu fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.

djk_text: A pasi tapu, di a sii kai, dati na den sama di e yee a wowtu fu Masaa Gadu. Da didibii e kon piki a wowtu puu a ini den ati wanten. Bika a á wani fu den sama biibi Masaa Gadu, fu den fende a libi fu tego.
eng_text: Those along the road are those who hear, then the devil comes, and takes away the word from their heart, that they may not believe and be saved.

djk_text: A pisi siton doti di a sii kai, dati na den sama di, te den yee a wowtu fu Masaa Gadu, da den e teke en anga gaan piisii. Ma a wowtu á go dipi a ini den ati ini. Bika te toobi anga nowtu miti den, fu tesi luku efu den e biibi Gadu tuutuu, da wanten den e fika a biibi.
eng_text: Those on the rock are they who, when they hear, receive the word with joy; but these have no root, who believe for a while, then fall away in time of temptation.

djk_text: A pisi doti anga maka pe a sii kai, dati na den sama di teke a wowtu fu Masaa Gadu tuutuu. Ma a booko ede fu den sani fu goontapu anga a feti fu abi tyaipi gudu anga suku gaan piisii e kii a wowtu fu Masaa Gadu a ini den ati. Bika na den sani ya soso fuu den ati.
eng_text: That which fell among the thorns, these are those who have heard, and as they go on their way they are choked with cares, riches, and pleasures of life, and bring no fruit to maturity.

djk_text: A pisi bun doti, pe a sii kai, dati na wan sama di e aliki a wowtu fu Masaa Gadu anga wan bunbun ati. Ne a gi a wowtu pasi a ini en ati, fu goo. Soseefi ai tei ati oli doo naamo, fu te enke a wowtu puu wini a ini en libi.
eng_text: That in the good ground, these are such as in an honest and good heart, having heard the word, hold it tightly, and bring forth fruit with patience.

djk_text: “Te i leti wan abeni a ini wan osu, yu nái poti en a kama ondoo ofu teke sani tapu en. Nono! Yu o poti en a tapu, ofuso, yu o oli en hei, fu a sa leti kiin peesi gi ala sama a ini a osu. Da te a leti, da ná wan sani o kibii di ná o kon a kiin, fu sama si.
eng_text:
No one, when he has lit a lamp, covers it with a container, or puts it under a bed; but puts it on a stand, that those who enter in may see the light.
2079	Da na soseefi den sani di mi e leli u ya o kon a kiin wan dei.	2079	For nothing is hidden, that will not be revealed; nor anything secret, that will not be known and come to light.
2080	Da a didon a yu, fa yu e aliki sani. Bika sama di kisi wan sani fu Masaa Gadu sa kisi moo. Ma sama di á kisi ná wan sani fu Masaa Gadu sa lasi ala a pikinso di a denki taki a abi.”	2080	Be careful therefore how you hear. For whoever has, to him will be given; and whoever doesn't have, from him will be taken away even that which he thinks he has.

djk_text: Da wan dei, ne Masaa Jesesi be de a wan osu e leli sama Gadu wowtu. Ne en mma anga den baala fi en kon doo. Ma den á be poi go doo Masaa Jesesi. Bika sama de ipi a ini a osu.
eng_text: His mother and brothers came to him, and they could not come near him for the crowd.

djk_text: Ne den taigi Masaa Jesesi taki: “I mma anga den baala fi yu de a doose. Den wani si yu.”
eng_text: It was told him by some saying, "Your mother and your brothers stand outside, desiring to see you."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “A bun! Ma i sabi sama a mi mma anga mi baala? Na den sama di e yee Masaa Gadu wowtu, da den e du san Masaa Gadu taki. Na den na mi mma anga mi baala.”
eng_text: But he answered them, "My mother and my brothers are these who hear the word of God, and do it."

djk_text: Da wan dei, Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en be de a wataa mofu. Ne a taigi den taki: “U go a boto, meke u koti go na abaase fu a ze so.” Ne den go a boto, ne den wai a mindii.
eng_text: Now it happened on one of those days, that he entered into a boat, himself and his disciples, and he said to them, "Let's go over to the other side of the lake." So they launched out.

djk_text: Da di den koti fu abaa, ne Masaa Jesesi kai a siibi. Da di den go, te wan pisi, ne wan gaan winta wai na a ze, e seke a wataa e wasi go a ini a boto te, na fu den sungu namo.
eng_text: But as they sailed, he fell asleep. A wind storm came down on the lake, and they were taking on dangerous amounts of water.

djk_text: Ne den bakaman fi en feele te, den lon go weki en taki: “Masaa! Masaa opo! Kon yeepi wi, wi e sungu dede!” Ne Masaa Jesesi opo, ne a kaasi a winta anga a wataa taki: “U tan pii!” Ne a wataa anga a winta koo pii.
eng_text: They came to him, and awoke him, saying, "Master, master, we are dying!" He awoke, and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water, and they ceased, and it was calm.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi daai go a den bakaman fi en, ne a akisi den taki: “Pe u biibi de?” Da den bakaman fi en feele te, den foondoo. Taawan e akisi taawan taki: “Oho! Sama na a man ya? A winta anga a wataa seefi e du san a taki.”
eng_text: He said to them, "Where is your faith?" Being afraid they marveled, saying one to another, "Who is this, then, that he commands even the winds and the water, and they obey him?"

djk_text: Ne bakadati, ne Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en koti abaa go na a kondee fu den Gelaseini sama, na abaase fu Galileya.
eng_text: They arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is opposite Galilee.

djk_text: Da di Masaa Jesesi komoto a soo, ne wan man fu a kondee kon ne en. Da wanlo takuu sani de na a man ya tapu. A nái wei koosi a sikin efu tan a ini osu moo, ma a fika a kondee go e tan a ini den siton geebi olo. Na onmen langa kaba den takuu sani de ne en tapu e pina en. Den sama fu a kondee meke onmen moiti anga en, bui en na ana anga futu, ma ai booko den bui lon fi en gwe a ini den sabana. Ma namo, di a si Masaa Jesesi, ne a bali taanga towe enseefi a doti taki: “San wi anga yu abi Jesesi, Manpikin fu a moo Hei Gadu a tapu? Gaantangi, ná sitaafu mi, baa?” Bika Masaa Jesesi be kaasi en a fesi kaba, fu komoto na a man tapu gwe.
eng_text: When Jesus stepped ashore, a certain man out of the city who had demons for a long time met him. He wore no clothes, and didn't live in a house, but in the tombs.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi akisi en taki: “Fa den e kai yu nen?” Ne a takuu jeje piki taki: “Na mi den e kai Hipiman.” Bika tyaipi tyaipi takuu sani de ne en tapu.
eng_text: Jesus asked him, "What is your name?" He said, "Legion," for many demons had entered into him.

djk_text: Ne den sani begi Masaa Jesesi taki: “Gaantangi! Ná iti u go a ini Abisi ete, baa? Puu u sende go a ini den agu anda.” Bika wanlo agu be de koosube de a wan pikin mongo, e suku sani fu nyan. Ne Masaa Jesesi yaki den poti go a ini den agu.
eng_text: They begged him that he would not command them to go into the abyss.

djk_text: Ne den takuu sani komoto na a man tapu, ne den go a ini den agu. Ne wanten ala den agu lon saka a mongo huu, te a wataa dyuluu, dede pii.
eng_text: The demons came out from the man, and entered into the pigs, and the herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake, and were drowned.

djk_text: Ne den man di be e luku den agu lon gwe a kondee ganda, go taigi den sama taki, na sowan sani pasa.
eng_text: When those who fed them saw what had happened, they fled, and told it in the city and in the country.

djk_text: Ne ala den sama booko gwullu komoto a den peesi, kon a Masaa Jesesi, fu kon luku san pasa anga denseefi ain. Ne den si a man di den takuu sani be de ne en tapu sidon a Masaa Jesesi se. A wei koosi, de fi en moi anga en bunbun fusutan. Da ala den sama feele fu san den si ya.
eng_text: People went out to see what had happened. They came to Jesus, and found the man from whom the demons had gone out, sitting at Jesus' feet, clothed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.

djk_text: We, ne den sama di be si san pasa, taigi den taawan di kon de, fa Masaa Jesesi puu den takuu jeje na a man tapu.
eng_text: Those who saw it told them how he who had been possessed by demons was healed.

djk_text: Ne a sani ya meke den sama fu a pisiwataa de, begi Masaa Jesesi gaantangi, fu a komoto a den kondee. Ne Masaa Jesesi go a boto baka, ne a koti abaa.
eng_text: All the people of the surrounding country of the Gadarenes asked him to depart from them, for they were very much afraid. He entered into the boat, and returned.

djk_text: Ne a man di a be puu den takuu jeje ne en tapu begi en gaantangi, fu a go anga en.
eng_text: But the man from whom the demons had gone out begged him that he might go with him, but Jesus sent him away, saying,

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi taigi en taki: “Nono! Daai go a den famii fi yu. Go taigi den a gaan bun di Masaa Gadu du gi yu.” Ne a man go enke fa Masaa Jesesi sende en. Ne ai taigi ala sama a gaan bun di Masaa Jesesi du gi en.
eng_text: Return to your house, and declare what great things God has done for you. He went his way, proclaiming throughout the whole city what great things Jesus had done for him.

djk_text: Da somen sama be de na abaase e luku Masaa Jesesi. Da di a doo, ne den piisii anga en te, a ná sipowtu.
eng_text: It happened, when Jesus returned, that the multitude welcomed him, for they were all waiting for him.

djk_text: Ne wan edeman fu Dyu keliki den e kai Yailesi kon a Masaa Jesesi. Ne a saka kini a doti, begi Masaa Jesesi gaantangi, fu a kon go anga en ne en osu.
eng_text: Behold, there came a man named Jairus, and he was a ruler of the synagogue. He fell down at Jesus' feet, and begged him to come into his house,

djk_text: Bika en wankodo umanpikin di be abi twalufu yali be siki te, na fu dede namo. Ne Masaa Jesesi komoto, ne ai go anga Yailesi. Da somen sama be bosu lontu en te, a á be poi waka enke fa a wani.
eng_text: for he had an only daughter, about twelve years of age, and she was dying. But as he went, the multitudes pressed against him.

djk_text: Da wan uman be de a ini den somen sama de di be kisi en mun siki twalufu yali langa sondee fu koti. Ná wan sama be poi deesi en. Da di a yee taki, Masaa Jesesi kon de, ne a feti go ne en. Ne na pe a de a ini den sama de, ne a fende pasi langa ana oli a yekeyeke fu Masaa Jesesi koosi mofu. Ne di a oli en, ne a buulu koti wanten. A kon bun kelle.
eng_text: A woman who had a flow of blood for twelve years, who had spent all her living on physicians, and could not be healed by any,

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi daai, ne a akisi den sama taki: “Sama oli mi?” Ne ala den sama e bali taki: “A ná mi! A ná mi!” Peitilisi dati taigi en taki: “Masaa! Luku onmen sama e oli yu ya, da fa i sa akisi sama oli yu?”
eng_text: Jesus said, "Who touched me?" When all denied it, Peter and those with him said, "Master, the multitudes press and jostle you, and you say, 'Who touched me?'"

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi e taki namo taki: “Wan sama oli mi! Bika mi fii wan kaakiti komoto a mi sikin, go deesi wan sama.”
eng_text: But Jesus said, "Someone did touch me, for I perceived that power has gone out of me."

djk_text: Ne di a uman si taki, Masaa Jesesi sabi taki a oli en tuu, ne a waka kon feele feele a fesi go saka kini a Masaa Jesesi fesi a pe den somen sama de. Ne a taigi Masaa Jesesi ala sani te doo, fu saide meke a waka kon oli en anga fa a kon bun di a oli en koosi mofu. Na so ala sama yee san pasa anga a uman ya.
eng_text: When the woman saw that she was not hidden, she came trembling, and falling down before him declared to him in the presence of all the people the reason why she had touched him, and how she was healed immediately.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi a uman taki: “Uman! A biibi fi yu yeepi yu kaba. Go a osu anga wan piisii ati.”
eng_text: He said to her, "Daughter, cheer up. Your faith has made you well. Go in peace."

djk_text: Da di Masaa Jesesi e taki anga a uman ya, ne wan sama fu Yailesi osu tyai bosikopu kon gi Yailesi a pasi taki: “Yailesi! A pikin fi i dede. A á de fi i meke Masaa Jesesi go a yu osu anda moo. Na fu soso a o go anda.”
eng_text: While he still spoke, one from the ruler of the synagogue's house came, saying to him, "Your daughter is dead. Don't trouble the Teacher."

djk_text: Ma namo, da Masaa Jesesi yee, ne a taigi a dda fu a pikin taki: “Ná feele. Tan poti biibi a mi doo, da yu o si san o pasa. Bika a umanpikin fi yu o de bunbun gusontu gusontu baka.”
eng_text: But Jesus hearing it, answered him, "Don't be afraid. Only believe, and she will be healed."

djk_text: Ne den e go te, den go doo a osu fu Yailesi. Ma Masaa Jesesi á be wani taa sama moo enke, Peitilisi anga Jakowbesi anga Johanisi anga a mma anga a dda fu a pikin go a ini a osu.
eng_text: When he came to the house, he didn't allow anyone to enter in, except Peter, John, James, the father of the child, and her mother.

djk_text: Da di den doo a osu, ne somen sama be de ape e kee e bali e tyali gaan tyali. Bika a pikin be dede. Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “U á bali so! U á kee moo, bika a pikin á dede. A siibi ai siibi.”
eng_text: All were weeping and mourning her, but he said, "Don't weep. She isn't dead, but sleeping."

djk_text: Ma den meke tyuu, wai fesi poti a se gi Masaa Jesesi. Bika den be sabi kiinkiin taki a pikin be dede tuu.
eng_text: They were ridiculing him, knowing that she was dead.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi waka pasa go na pe a pikin didon. Ne a oli a pikin ana, ne a bali taki: “Pikin uman! Opo!”
eng_text: But he put them all outside, and taking her by the hand, he called, saying, "Child, arise!"

djk_text: Ne wanten libi kon a ini a pikin baka. Ne a opo taampu. Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “U gi en nyanyan meke a nyan.”
eng_text: Her spirit returned, and she rose up immediately. He commanded that something be given to her to eat.

djk_text: Da a sani ya foondoo a mma anga a dda te, ná sipowtu. Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “U si a sani di pasa ya, u á mu taigi ná wan sama! U yee!”
eng_text: Her parents were amazed, but he commanded them to tell no one what had been done.

djk_text: Ma namo, ne wan dei, ne Masaa Jesesi kai den twalufu bakaman fi en kon ne en. Ne a gi den makiti anga taki, fu den yaki takuu sani puu a sama tapu anga fu deesi sama.
eng_text: He called the twelve together, and gave them power and authority over all demons, and to cure diseases.

djk_text: Ne a sende den, fu den go a den kondee kondee go taigi ala sama fu a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu. Soseefi a sende den, fu den deesi sama tu.
eng_text: He sent them forth to preach the Kingdom of God, and to heal the sick.

djk_text: Ne a taigi den go doo taki: “Te u o go, da u á mu tyai ná wan sani anga u. U á mu tyai waka tiki. Soseefi u á mu tyai tasi efu nyanyan sani. Da soseefi u mu tyai moni tu. Da anga den koosi di de a u sikin namo u mu go. U á mu tyai taawan.
eng_text: He said to them, "Take nothing for your journey--neither staffs, nor wallet, nor bread, nor money; neither have two coats apiece.

djk_text: “Da, te wan sama teke u oli ne en osu, da na ape u mu tan, fu te enke yuu kisi fu u gwe baka.
eng_text: Into whatever house you enter, stay there, and depart from there.

djk_text: Ma a kan taki, te u o go a wan kondee, da sama á wani yee u taki. Da u mu naki a santi fu u ondoo futu puu towe gi den enke wan maiki taki, den be fende a okasi fu teke a Bun Nyunsu fu Masaa, ma den á be wani. Da u komoto de. Da na den mu sabi.”
eng_text: As many as don't receive you, when you depart from that city, shake off even the dust from your feet for a testimony against them."

djk_text: Ne den bakaman komoto, ne den go a den kondee kondee go e paati a Bun Nyunsu fu Masaa Gadu. Da den e deesi somen sikiman tu.
eng_text: They departed, and went throughout the villages, preaching the Good News, and healing everywhere.

djk_text: We namo, da Kownu Helowdesi yee den foondoo sani di Masaa Jesesi e du. Ne a bigi gi en te, a á sabi san fu a taki. Bika ná wan sama be sabi sama na a sama di be e du den foondoo sani de. Son sama taki: “Na Johanisi a Dopuman di Kownu Helowdesi be kii. Ne en daai komoto a dede kon e du den foondoo sani ya.”
eng_text: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him; and he was very perplexed, because it was said by some that John had risen from the dead,

djk_text: Taawan taki: “Na a apaiti fositen apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu, di den be e kai Eliya. Ne en opo baka komoto a dede kon e du den sani de. Efu ná so, da na wan fu den taa fositen apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu weki komoto a dede. Ala sowtu sani den piki e taki.”
eng_text: and by some that Elijah had appeared, and by others that one of the old prophets had risen again.

djk_text: Ma Kownu Helowdesi taki: “A sa de Johanisi? Na miseefi meke den doo Johanisi ede.” Ne Kownu Helowdesi e meke moiti naamo fu si en.
eng_text: Herod said, "John I beheaded, but who is this, about whom I hear such things?" He sought to see him.

djk_text: Ne baka wan pisiten, ne den apaiti bosikopuman fu Masaa Jesesi di a be sende go a den kondee kondee, daai kon baka. Ne den taigi en ala fa sani waka di den go. Ne Masaa Jesesi teke den, ne en anga den wawan go a wan peesi, koosube fu a kondee di den e kai Betisaida.
eng_text: The apostles, when they had returned, told him what things they had done. He took them, and withdrew apart to a deserted place of a city called Bethsaida.

djk_text: Ma den sama sabi pe Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en e go. Ne den faaka en waka ne en baka go, te na a peesi. Ma di Masaa Jesesi si den, da a piisii anga den. Ne a gi den a Bun Nyunsu di e taki, fu a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu. Ne a deesi ala den sikiman di be kon ne en de.
eng_text: But the multitudes, perceiving it, followed him. He welcomed them, and spoke to them of the Kingdom of God, and he cured those who needed healing.

djk_text: Da di a doo yuu fu neti kai, ne den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi kon ne en, ne den taigi en taki: “Masaa! A á moo bun efi i sende den sama gwe, no? Bika a kon lati kaba. Efi i sende den gwe, da den sa bai sani a den kondee di de koosube ya. Soseefi den sa fende peesi fu siibi tu. Bika a sabana pe u de ya ná abi ná wan sani fu nyan. Soseefi den ná o poi fende peesi ya fu siibi tu.”
eng_text: The day began to wear away; and the twelve came, and said to him, "Send the multitude away, that they may go into the surrounding villages and farms, and lodge, and get food, for we are here in a deserted place."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Nono! U gi den nyanyan meke den nyan!” Ne den piki en taki: “Fa wi o gi den nyanyan fu nyan? Wi abi feifi beele anga tu fisi namo. Efuso, da u mu go bai sani fu nyan gi den.
eng_text: But he said to them, "You give them something to eat." They said, "We have no more than five loaves and two fish, unless we should go and buy food for all these people."

djk_text: Bika a be sa de wan sani fu feifi dunsu manengee.” Ma Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “U meke den sama sidon a doti a kulu, feifitenti, feifitenti te doo.”
eng_text: For they were about five thousand men. He said to his disciples, "Make them sit down in groups of about fifty each."

djk_text: Ne den bakaman meke den sama go sidon enke fa Masaa Jesesi taki.
eng_text: They did so, and made them all sit down.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi teke den feifi beele anga den tu fisi, ne a opo ede luku tapu, ne a begi gi Masaa Gadu daa, te a kaba. Ne a booko den feifi beele anga den tu fisi pisipisi gi den bakaman, fu den go paati. Ne den bakaman gi den sama.
eng_text: He took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to the sky, he blessed them, and broke them, and gave them to the disciples to set before the multitude.

djk_text: Ne den sama teke, ne den nyan te, den bee fuu kinkin. Di den bakaman fi en piki san di den sama nyan fika, a fuu twalufu gaan bakisi.
eng_text: They ate, and were all filled. They gathered up twelve baskets of broken pieces that were left over.

djk_text: Da wan taa dei, ne Masaa Jesesi wawan be go a wan peesi, go begi. Da di a begi te wan pisi, ne den bakaman fi en kon ne en. Ne a akisi den taki: “We, fa mi anga u e waka e lontu ya, sama den sama taki mi, de?”
eng_text: It happened, as he was praying alone, that the disciples were with him, and he asked them, "Who do the multitudes say that I am?"

djk_text: Ne den piki en taki: “We, son sama e taki, yu na Johanisi a Dopuman di Kownu Helowdesi be kii. Ne en weki kon ya baka. Taawan taki, yu na Eliya, a fositen apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu, ne en weki kon baka a goontapu. Efu ná so, da na wan fu den taa fositen apaiti takiman weki komoto a dede.”
eng_text: They answered, "'John the Baptizer,' but others say, 'Elijah,' and others, that one of the old prophets is risen again."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi akisi den baka taki: “We u, no? Fa mi anga u de ya, sama mi de gi u?” Ne Peitilisi piki en taki: “Yu na Kelestesi, a Kownu di Masaa Gadu be paamisi fu sende kon fu yeepi u.”
eng_text: He said to them, "But who do you say that I am?" Peter answered, "The Christ of God."

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi bali den taanga taanga fu den á taigi ná wan sama, sama a de.
eng_text: But he warned them, and commanded them to tell this to no one,

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “We, gaan banowtu de a fesi e kon miti a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya. Bika den gaansama fu kondee anga den hei apaiti begiman anga den leliman fu weiti o kuutu en. Da den o tyai en go kii. Ma baka dii dei, da a o weki kon a libi ya baka.”
eng_text: saying, "The Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up."

djk_text: Ne bakadati, ne a taigi ala den sama taki: “Efu wan sama wani waka a mi baka, da a á mu teli enseefi moo. Ibii dei a mu e tyai a sitaafu di o kon ne en tapu enke wan sama e tyai wan koloisi, fu den go sipikii en kii.
eng_text: He said to all, "If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross, and follow me.

djk_text: Bika ibii sama di sa lasi en libi fu mi ede, sa fende libi. Ma sama di e suku fu kibii a libi fi en sa lasi a libi di Masaa Gadu e gi.
eng_text: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, but whoever will lose his life for my sake, the same will save it.

djk_text: Bika sowtu yeepi a abi, efi i nyan fu a goontapu ya, ma i lasi a libi fu tego fu go a didibii faya?
eng_text: For what does it profit a man if he gains the whole world, and loses or forfeits his own self?

djk_text: Da efu wan sama de, di e sen gi mi anga mi wowtu, da na soseefi a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya o sen gi en tu, te a o daai kon baka. Bika, te mi o kon anga a gaan dyendee fasi fu mi, anga di fu mi Tata anga di fu den apaiti Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee, da mi o sen gi sowan sama tu.”
eng_text: For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words, of him will the Son of Man be ashamed, when he comes in his glory, and the glory of the Father, and of the holy angels.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den go doo taki: “U si fa mi e taki anga u ya? Wantu sama taampu ya, di ná o tesi dede, fosi den si a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: But I tell you the truth: There are some of those who stand here, who will in no way taste of death, until they see the Kingdom of God."

djk_text: Ne aitin dei baka fu di Masaa Jesesi taigi den sama den sani ya, ne a teke Peitilisi anga Jakowbesi anga Johanisi, ne den go a wan mongo go e begi.
eng_text: It happened about eight days after these sayings, that he took with him Peter, John, and James, and went up onto the mountain to pray.

djk_text: Da, di Masaa Jesesi begi doo wan pisi, ne en hii fesi daai kon de wan hii taa fasi. En koosi seefi daai e beenki te, ai meke mala mala.
eng_text: As he was praying, the appearance of his face was altered, and his clothing became white and dazzling.

djk_text: Ne wanten so, ne tu man taampu na a mongo tapu e taki anga en. Da na Eliya anga Mosesi, tu fositen apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu, di be dede gwe langa ten kaba. Da denseefi koosi be e beenki leti enke fa sama a Masaa Gadu a tapu e beenki.
eng_text: Behold, two men were talking with him, who were Moses and Elijah,

djk_text: Da den be kon e taki anga Masaa Jesesi, fu a wooko di a be kon fu du a goontapu ya. Dati na a dede, di a be o dede a Jelusalem.
eng_text: who appeared in glory, and spoke of his departure, which he was about to accomplish at Jerusalem.

djk_text: Da a yuu de, da Peitilisi anga den taa man be e siibi. Ne den weki, ne den si Masaa Jesesi anga a dyendee fasi fi en anga den tu sama di kon e taki anga en.
eng_text: Now Peter and those who were with him were heavy with sleep, but when they were fully awake, they saw his glory, and the two men who stood with him.

djk_text: Ne di den tu sama sete fu gwe, ne Peitilisi bali taki: “Masaa! Pe u de ya switi. Meke u meke dii masanga ya, no? Wan fi yu, wan fu Mosesi anga wan fu Eliya.” Da na fu di Peitilisi be buuya fu san di a be si, meke a taki den sani ya.
eng_text: It happened, as they were parting from him, that Peter said to Jesus, "Master, it is good for us to be here. Let's make three tents: one for you, and one for Moses, and one for Elijah," not knowing what he said.

djk_text: Ma a á kaba taki seefi, ne wan woluku saka komoto a tapu kon tapu, Masaa Jesesi anga den tu taa sama suu gbu. Ne den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi feele te, ná sipowtu.
eng_text: While he said these things, a cloud came and overshadowed them, and they were afraid as they entered into the cloud.

djk_text: Ne wan Tongo taki a ini a woluku taki: “Disi na mi lobi Manpikin, di mi teke sende kon a goontapu! U aliki san ai taigi u!”
eng_text: A voice came out of the cloud, saying, "This is my beloved Son. Listen to him!"

djk_text: Ne, di a Tongo ya taki so kaba, ne den si, taki na Masaa Jesesi wawan too de ape. Eliya anga Mosesi gwe anga a woluku. Ma anga ala fa den man si a sani de seefi, toku den á taigi ná wan sama, fu onmen langa.
eng_text: When the voice came, Jesus was found alone. They were silent, and told no one in those days any of the things which they had seen.

djk_text: Da a taa dei, ne Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en saka komoto na a mongo. Ma namo, di a saka, ne somen sama kon, de fu miti anga en.
eng_text: It happened on the next day, when they had come down from the mountain, that a great multitude met him.

djk_text: Ne wan sama bali wan gaan bali a ini den somen sama de taki: “Mesiti! Gaantangi, kon go yeepi mi anga awan kodo manpikin fu mi, baa?
eng_text: Behold, a man from the crowd called out, saying, "Teacher, I beg you to look at my son, for he is my only child.

djk_text: Bika wan sani e kon ne en tapu taanga taanga seefi. Da te a sani kon ne en tapu, da ai towe en, da ai ali en a doti. Da sukuma e komoto ne en mofu. Da sani nái komoto na a pikin ya tapu moo so. Da ala yuu ai poti a pikin ya sikin swaki malengii naamo.
eng_text: Behold, a spirit takes him, he suddenly cries out, and it convulses him so that he foams, and it hardly departs from him, bruising him severely.

djk_text: Mi be begi den bakaman fi yu, fu den be kaasi a takuu jeje puu ne en tapu gi mi. Ma den á be poi puu en.”
eng_text: I begged your disciples to cast it out, and they couldn't."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taki: “Oho! Libisama! Saide meke u nái biibi ete? On langa mi mu oli pasensi anga u ete, fosi u biibi mi?” Ne a taigi a dda taki: “Tyai a pikin kon gi mi.”
eng_text: Jesus answered, "Faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you and bear with you? Bring your son here."

djk_text: Ne a dda tyai a pikin e kon gi Masaa Jesesi. Da di ai kon anga en, ne a sani subi a pikin te, a towe en a doti e ali. Ne Masaa Jesesi kaasi en puu na a pikin tapu gwe. Ne a komoto wanten na a pikin tapu. Ne a kon bun kelle. Ne Masaa Jesesi teke a pikin, ne a gi a dda en pikin baka.
eng_text: While he was still coming, the demon threw him down and convulsed him violently. But Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, and healed the boy, and gave him back to his father.

djk_text: Da a sani ya foondoo den sama, te den taki: “A kaakiti fu Masaa Gadu bigi! Ai! Masaa Gadu abi tuutuu kaakiti!”
eng_text: They were all astonished at the majesty of God. But while all were marveling at all the things which Jesus did, he said to his disciples,

djk_text: “U aliki bun san mi o taigi u! A á langa moo, da libisama o seli a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya, gi sama fu kii.”
eng_text: Let these words sink into your ears, for the Son of Man will be delivered up into the hands of men.

djk_text: Ma den bakaman fi en á fusutan san a taigi den de. Bika na be wan kibii sani gi den ete. Ma anga ala fa den á fusutan a sani de, toku ná wan fu den be abi a deki ati, fu akisi en san a sani de wani taki.
eng_text: But they didn't understand this saying. It was concealed from them, that they should not perceive it, and they were afraid to ask him about this saying.

djk_text: Ne a yuu de, ne wan gaan takitaki opo a den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi mindii. Den e akisi den na den taki, on di fu u na a moo heiwan fu u ala?
eng_text: There arose an argument among them about which of them was the greatest.

djk_text: Ma, ne di Masaa Jesesi sabi anga san den e feti, ne a teke wan pikin wai kon ne en.
eng_text: Jesus, perceiving the reasoning of their hearts, took a little child, and set him by his side,

djk_text: Ne a taigi den taki: “U si a pikin ya. A ná wan hei sama. Da a sama di sa lesipeki wan sama enke a pikin ya, di á de wan hei sama, da na miseefi a lesipeki kaba. Da sama di lesipeki mi, lesipeki a sama di sende mi kon a goontapu. Da sama di e saka enseefi na ala den taawan ondoo, ne en na a moo heiwan fu ala den taawan a Masaa Gadu ain.”
eng_text: and said to them, "Whoever receives this little child in my name receives me. Whoever receives me receives him who sent me. For whoever is least among you all, this one will be great."

djk_text: We, ne wan fu den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi den e kai Johanisi taigi Masaa Jesesi taki: “Masaa! U si wan sama di teke i nen e puu takuu jeje a sama tapu. Ma u bali, bika a á de a u se.”
eng_text: John answered, "Master, we saw someone casting out demons in your name, and we forbade him, because he doesn't follow with us."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taki: “Nono! U á mu tapu en, bika efu wan sama á de u feyanti, da a de a u se.”
eng_text: Jesus said to him, "Don't forbid him, for he who is not against us is for us."

djk_text: Ma namo, da a yuu be kon koosube, di Masaa Gadu be o teke Masaa Jesesi puu a goontapu ya tyai go ne en kondee a tapu anda baka. Ma, da Masaa Jesesi mu go a Jelusalem fosi.
eng_text: It came to pass, when the days were near that he should be taken up, he intently set his face to go to Jerusalem,

djk_text: Ma, da fosi a komoto a Galileya, fu go a Jelusalem, ne a sende tu bakaman fi en go a fesi, a wan fu den kondee fu den Samaliya sama go suku peesi, fu den siibi a pasi. Ne den go, te den go doo na a kondee. Ne den go akisi den sama peesi, fu den anga Masaa Jesesi siibi.
eng_text: and sent messengers before his face. They went, and entered into a village of the Samaritans, so as to prepare for him.

djk_text: Ma den sama fu Samaliya Kondee á wani gi den peesi, fu di den sabi taki na Jelusalem den e go.
eng_text: They didn't receive him, because he was traveling with his face set towards Jerusalem.

djk_text: Ne den tu bakaman daai kon piki Masaa Jesesi baka taki, den sama á wani. Da, di Jakowbesi anga Johanisi yee taki den sama á wani, ne den akisi Masaa taki: “Masaa! Yu á wani u kai faya komoto a tapu kon boon den puu de, no?”
eng_text: When his disciples, James and John, saw this, they said, "Lord, do you want us to command fire to come down from the sky, and destroy them, just as Elijah did?"

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi bali den taki: “U kaba! A sani di u taki de, a ná wan bun sani.”
eng_text: But he turned and rebuked them, "You don't know of what kind of spirit you are.

djk_text: Ne den go a taa kondee go suku peesi siibi.
eng_text: For the Son of Man didn't come to destroy men's lives, but to save them." They went to another village.

djk_text: Da di den de a pasi e gwe, ne wan sama kon a Masaa Jesesi, ne a taigi en taki: “Mi wani go anga yu, wansi pe yu e go.”
eng_text: As they went on the way, a certain man said to him, "I want to follow you wherever you go, Lord."

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “A bun! Ma sabi taki, den meti abi olo pe den e tan, enke boo peesi. Soseefi den foo fu tapu abi nesi fu boo. Ma a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya, ná abi wanboo peesi taki, na ape ai tan.”
eng_text: Jesus said to him, "The foxes have holes, and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay his head."

djk_text: Ne wan taa dei baka, ne Masaa Jesesi kai wan man taki: “Kon go anga mi fu toon mi bakaman.” Ma a man ya piki taki: “We, Mesiti, mi wani go anga yu, ma gaantangi gi mi pasi, meke mi beli mi dda fosi, baa? Da mi sa kon.”
eng_text: He said to another, "Follow me!" But he said, "Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father."

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Man! Fika den dede, meke den beli den dede. Ma gwe go paati a Bun Nyunsu di e taki, fu a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: But Jesus said to him, "Leave the dead to bury their own dead, but you go and announce the Kingdom of God."

djk_text: Ne wan taa dei, ne wan man taigi Masaa Jesesi taki: “Masaa Jesesi! Mi wani toon bakaman fi yu, fu go anga yu na ala peesi. Ma gaantangi! Gi mi piimisi fu go gi den sama fu mi adyosi fosi, baa?”
eng_text: Another also said, "I want to follow you, Lord, but first allow me to say good-bye to those who are at my house."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Wan sama di e du wan wooko, ma ai du en anga tu ati, á de na a peesi fu yeepi sama, fu kon a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: But Jesus said to him, "No one, having put his hand to the plow, and looking back, is fit for the Kingdom of God."

djk_text: Ne wan dei, ne Masaa Jesesi kai seibintenti a tu taa bakaman fi en kon ne en. Ne a sende den tu tu, tu tu, taki: “U go a den kondee kondee anga den foto. Da moo lati, miseefi o go a den kondee anda tu.”
eng_text: Now after these things, the Lord also appointed seventy others, and sent them two by two ahead of him into every city and place, where he was about to come.

djk_text: Ne a taigi den taki: “Sama de ipi a den peesi peesi di wani yee a Bun Nyunsu fu Masaa Gadu, fu den du san ai taki. Ma wookoman ná ipi sai fu go paati en. U begi Masaa Gadu di de basi fu a wooko, fu a puu moo wookoman sende go a ini a wooko fi en.
eng_text: Then he said to them, "The harvest is indeed plentiful, but the laborers are few. Pray therefore to the Lord of the harvest, that he may send out laborers into his harvest.

djk_text: U go! Mi e sende u go enke te mi be o sende sikapu go a mindii fu takuu meti.
eng_text: Go your ways. Behold, I send you out as lambs among wolves.

djk_text: Ma te u e go, u á mu tyai moni, u á mu tyai saka. Da anga den susu di de a u futu de namo u mu go. U á mu tyai taawan moo enke di u wei de. U á mu tapu a pasi e taki gaan langa bee toli anga sama.
eng_text: Carry no purse, nor wallet, nor sandals. Greet no one on the way.

djk_text: “Da ala osu ini di u o go, da u mu begi gi den sama taki: ‘Meke Masaa Gadu de anga den.’
eng_text: Into whatever house you enter, first say, 'Peace be to this house.'

djk_text: Da efu wan sama de ape di fiti fu kisi a bun di i begi gi en ya, da a bun o tan a ini a osu de. Ma efu a sama de á fiti fu kisi a bun ya, da a bun fi yu o daai kon a yu baka.
eng_text: If a son of peace is there, your peace will rest on him; but if not, it will return to you.

djk_text: Ma te den teke u oli a wan osu, da na a osu de namo u mu tan. U á mu komoto fu awan osu go na a taawan. Te den gi u sani fu nyan, da u mu nyan. U á mu meke sen kisi u. Bika wan wookoman fiti fu kisi a paiman fu a wooko di ai du.
eng_text: Remain in that same house, eating and drinking the things they give, for the laborer is worthy of his wages. Don't go from house to house.

djk_text: “Da te u doo wan kondee, ne den kai u kon, da na san di den poti gi u fu nyan, na dati u mu nyan.
eng_text: Into whatever city you enter, and they receive you, eat the things that are set before you.

djk_text: U deesi den sikiman di de ape. Da u taigi den sama taki: ‘A Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu kon koosube fu u.’
eng_text: Heal the sick who are therein, and tell them, 'The Kingdom of God has come near to you.'

djk_text: Ma, efu u doo a wan kondee, ne den sama á wani yee u taki, da u mu go taampu a mindii ganda, da u bali taigi den taki:
eng_text: But into whatever city you enter, and they don't receive you, go out into its streets and say,

djk_text: ‘U luku ya! Disi na a santi fu a kondee, wi e sibi puu a u futu towe fika ya gi u. Da na wan maiki fu soi taki, u be taigi u a Bun Nyunsu. Da di Masaa Gadu o sitaafu u, da a ná wi fowtu. Bika u be taigi u fu a Nyun Tii fi en, ma u á be wani aliki wi. Kwolon! U e gwe, ye!’ ”
eng_text: 'Even the dust from your city that clings to us, we wipe off against you. Nevertheless know this, that the Kingdom of God has come near to you.'

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den bakaman fi en go doo taki: “U mu de sabi sabi taki, na a gaanbigi dei di Masaa Gadu o kuutu goontapu, da a sitaafu di Masaa Gadu o sitaafu den sama fu a kondee de, o ogii moo enke a sitaafu di a be sitaafu a kondee di den e kai Sowdom.”
eng_text: I tell you, it will be more tolerable in that day for Sodom than for that city.

djk_text: “Ma heelu fu den sama fu Kolasin anga Betisaida Foto! Bika efu den sama fu den takuu foto di den e kai Sidon anga Tilosi be si den gaan foondoo sani di mi du a u mindii ya, da gaandiwe den be o daai den libi. Bika na buduufu buduufu den be o de, fu a takuu libi fu den. Da den be o wei boko koosi a sikin, go sidon a doti e iti asisi a den sikin.
eng_text:
Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon which were done in you, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.
2190	A dati, meke a dei di Masaa Gadu o kuutu goontapu, Kolasin anga Betisaida Foto o kisi moo gaan sitaafu moo den.	2190	But it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon in the judgment than for you.
2191	Da u fu Kafalnayemu Foto. San u e denki? U denki taki, a hei fu u o tyai u go a Masaa Gadu? Nono! A ná o tyai u go a Masaa Gadu. A didibii faya a o tyai u go.”	2191	You, Capernaum, who are exalted to heaven, will be brought down to Hades.
2192	Ne a taigi den bakaman fi en taki: “Efu wan sama e teke san u e taki, da ai teke san mi e taki tu. Ma, efu wan sama nái aliki u, san u e taki, da a nái aliki mi tu. Da sama di nái aliki mi, da a nái aliki Masaa Gadu, di sende mi kon tu.”	2192	Whoever listens to you listens to me, and whoever rejects you rejects me. Whoever rejects me rejects him who sent me.

djk_text: Ne baka wan pisiten, ne den seibintenti a tu bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi di a be sende gwe, daai kon ne en baka anga gaan piisii. Den taigi en taki: “Masaa! Di u teke a nen fi yu kaasi den takuu jeje, da den e du san u taki.”
eng_text: The seventy returned with joy, saying, "Lord, even the demons are subject to us in your name!"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Miseefi be si fa didibii makiti booko langa ten kaba. Mi si a komoto a tapu nyaw kai kon a doti, enke te donduu e koti faya.
eng_text: He said to them, "I saw Satan having fallen like lightning from heaven.

djk_text: We, mi gi u makiti a tapu fu ala wooko fu a feyanti. Soseefi mi gi u makiti a tapu fu sineki anga kukutu tee anga ala taa sani di a feyanti o wani sende kon, fu du ogii anga u. Da fu tuu, ná wan o poi du u ogii.
eng_text: Behold, I give you authority to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy. Nothing will in any way hurt you.

djk_text: Ma u á mu piisii, fu di den takuu jeje e du san u taki. Nono! Ma u mu piisii fu di u sabi taki, u nen sikiifi a Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: Nevertheless, don't rejoice in this, that the spirits are subject to you, but rejoice that your names are written in heaven."

djk_text: Ne a Apaiti Jeje fu Masaa Gadu fuu Masaa Jesesi ati anga gaan piisii. Ne a taki: “Mi Tata! Masaa fu tapu anga goontapu. Mi e gi yu gaantangi, fu di yu kibii den sani ya, gi den koniman anga den leliman fu a goontapu ya, te den á poi sabi den. Ma i meke den mofina sama ya kon sabi den. Ai baa, mi Tata! Gaantangi fi i. Bika na so i si taki a bun.”
eng_text: In that same hour Jesus rejoiced in the Holy Spirit, and said, "I thank you, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you have hidden these things from the wise and understanding, and revealed them to little children. Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den sama taki: “Mi Tata poti ala sani a ini mi ana. Da ná wan sama kaba sabi a Pikin, boiti a Tata. Soseefi ná wan sama sabi a Tata, boiti a Pikin anga den sama di a Pikin wani meke kon sabi en.”
eng_text: Turning to the disciples, he said, "All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows who the Son is, except the Father, and who the Father is, except the Son, and he to whomever the Son desires to reveal him."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi daai luku den bakaman fi en, ne a taigi den taki: “Seigi fu u, fu den sani di u e si anga den di u e yee ya.
eng_text: Turning to the disciples, he said privately, "Blessed are the eyes which see the things that you see,

djk_text: Bika somen apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu anga kownu fu fesiten be angii fu si den sani di u e si ya. Ma den á be si den. Soseefi den be angii fu yee san u e yee ya, ma den á be yee den.”
eng_text: for I tell you that many prophets and kings desired to see the things which you see, and didn't see them, and to hear the things which you hear, and didn't hear them."

djk_text: Ma namo, da wan dei, ne wan leliman fu Dyuweiti go a Masaa Jesesi go tesi en. Ne a akisi en taki: “Mesiti, oo! San mi mu du, fu mi fende a libi, fu ten fu ten a Masaa Gadu?”
eng_text: Behold, a certain lawyer stood up and tested him, saying, "Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi akisi en taki: “San sikiifi a Masaa Gadu Buku? San yu e leisi ne en?”
eng_text: He said to him, "What is written in the law? How do you read it?"

djk_text: Ne a piki en taki: “We, a sikiifi taki: ‘I mu lobi Masaa Gadu anga yu hiihii ati anga i hii fii anga hii i taanga anga hii i fusutan. Da i mu lobi taawan a i se leti enke fa i lobi iseefi.’ ”
eng_text: He answered, "You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your strength, and with all your mind; and your neighbor as yourself."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Na so a de! I piki bun. Libi pilisisi enke fa i taki de, da yu o fende a libi fu tego.”
eng_text: He said to him, "You have answered correctly. Do this, and you will live."

djk_text: We, di a man si taki, Masaa Jesesi á piki en enke fa a be wani, ne a daai, ne a akisi Masaa Jesesi baka taki: “Ma sama na den taa sama, di mi mu lobi enke miseefi?”
eng_text: But he, desiring to justify himself, asked Jesus, "Who is my neighbor?"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi gi en wan ageisi toli taki: “Wan man be komoto a Jelusalem Foto e saka go a Jelikow Foto. Da di ai gwe te wan pisi, ne fufuuman feti anga en. Ne den fonmi en te, a fon, teke den koosi ne en sikin anga ala san a be tyai. Ne den fika en de swaki a sikin pasi. Ne den gwe fu den.
eng_text: Jesus answered, "A certain man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and he fell among robbers, who both stripped him and beat him, and departed, leaving him half dead.

djk_text: Ne te wan pisi, ne wan apaiti begiman fu keliki e kon pasa. Ma di a si a man a doti, ne a koti lontu, waka pasa fi en a taase.
eng_text: By chance a certain priest was going down that way. When he saw him, he passed by on the other side.

djk_text: Te wan pisi baka, ne wan man fu Leifi Lo, di e wooko a ini a Mama Keliki e kon pasa. Ne di a si a man, ne a luku en dunn, ne enseefi koti lontu waka pasa gwe fi en.
eng_text: In the same way a Levite also, when he came to the place, and saw him, passed by on the other side.

djk_text: “Ne bakadati, ne wan Samaliya sama e kon pasa de tu. Ne di a si a man a doti de, ne gaan tyali fu a man kisi en te, ná sipowtu.
eng_text: But a certain Samaritan, as he traveled, came where he was. When he saw him, he was moved with compassion,

djk_text: Ne a go, ne a bendi kiin den soo fi en, lobi deesi gi den, tei den moi, te a kaba. Ne a opo en poti na a buliki fi en tapu, ne a lei anga en, te a wan lanti osu. Ne a seeka en baka, te a kaba.
eng_text: came to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring on oil and wine. He set him on his own animal, and brought him to an inn, and took care of him.

djk_text: Ne a taa dei, ne a teke moni, ne a gi a man di abi a lanti osu taki: ‘Luku ya! Gaantangi! Luku a man ya bun gi mi, baa? Da efu a moni á sai, da te mi e daai, da mi sa pai yu doo.’ ”
eng_text: On the next day, when he departed, he took out two denarii, and gave them to the host, and said to him, 'Take care of him. Whatever you spend beyond that, I will repay you when I return.'

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi akisi a man taki: “On di fu den dii man ya, i denki libi anga en enke a taawan ne en se, di a mu lobi enke enseefi?”
eng_text: Now which of these three do you think seemed to be a neighbor to him who fell among the robbers?"

djk_text: Ne a man taki: “Na a man di be abi tyali ati fi en!” Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Weeno! Na so a de enke fa i piki de tuu. Go, da i libi enke fa a man ya libi.”
eng_text: He said, "He who showed mercy on him." Then Jesus said to him, "Go and do likewise."

djk_text: Da, di Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en de a pasi e go a Jelusalem, ne den doo wan kondee pe wan uman den kai Malita e tan. Ne a kai Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en, fu den go ne en osu. Ne den go.
eng_text: It happened as they went on their way, he entered into a certain village, and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.

djk_text: Da Malita be abi wan sisa den e kai Maliya. Da fanafu di Masaa Jesesi go a ini a osu, ne Maliya go sidon te ne en ini, e aliki san ai taki.
eng_text: She had a sister called Mary, who also sat at Jesus' feet, and heard his word.

djk_text: Ma Malita be e booko ede e seeka nyanyan gi Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en. Ne di Malita wooko te wan pisi, ne a á poi teke en moo. Bika a wooko kon hebi gi en. Ne a go a Masaa Jesesi taki: “Masaa! Yu nái si, no? Fu senten di i kon ya, ne Maliya go sidon fika a wooko gi mi wawan. Yu á poi sende en fu a kon yeepi mi, no?”
eng_text: But Martha was distracted with much serving, and she came up to him, and said, "Lord, don't you care that my sister left me to serve alone? Ask her therefore to help me."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Kee! Malita! Saide meke yu e booko yu ede a somen sani so?
eng_text: Jesus answered her, "Martha, Martha, you are anxious and troubled about many things,

djk_text: Na wankodo sani namo de di yu abi fanowdu. Maliya du a moo bun sani. Da mi ná o puu en ne en.”
eng_text: but one thing is needed. Mary has chosen the good part, which will not be taken away from her."

djk_text: Ma namo, da wan dei, da Masaa Jesesi go a wan peesi go e begi. Di a begi te a kaba, ne wan fu den bakaman fi en kon ne en taki: “Masaa! Leli u begi tu, enke fa Johanisi be leli den bakaman fi en.”
eng_text: It happened, that when he finished praying in a certain place, one of his disciples said to him, "Lord, teach us to pray, just as John also taught his disciples."

djk_text: Ne a piki den taki: “Te u e begi, da u begi so: ‘Kee! Wi Tata! Meke ala sani sa kon lesipeki yu nen, wan apaiti fasi. Meke a Nyun Tii fi yu sa paati a hii goontapu.
eng_text: He said to them, "When you pray, say, 'Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy. May your Kingdom come. May your will be done on earth, as it is in heaven.

djk_text: Wi e begi yu, fu gi wi san wi abi fanowdu, fu nyan ibii dei baka.
eng_text: Give us day by day our daily bread.

djk_text: Gi wi paadon fu takuudu anga ogii di wi e du a yu fesi, leti enke fa wiseefi e gi taawan di e du ogii anga wi paadon. Wi e begi yu, fu kibii wi, meke wi á kai a ini tesi.’ ”
eng_text: Forgive us our sins, for we ourselves also forgive everyone who is indebted to us. Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one.'"

djk_text: Ne a taigi den go doo taki: “Meke u taki, yu abi wan bun mati, ne i go ne en a mindii neti, fu go yuu dii beele.
eng_text: He said to them, "Which of you, if you go to a friend at midnight, and tell him, 'Friend, lend me three loaves of bread,

djk_text: Da yu o go weki en, da i taigi en taki: ‘Mati, gaantangi baa! Mi kon begi i wan sani. Wan mati fu mi komoto a wan faawe peesi kon a mi. Ma mi ná abi ná wan sani fu gi en, fu a nyan.’
eng_text: for a friend of mine has come to me from a journey, and I have nothing to set before him,'

djk_text: Da, meke u taki a mati fi yu piki i taki: ‘Mi ná o poi opo go teke beele gi i moo. Mi anga den pikin sooto doo go didon kaba. Da fika mi, meke mi siibi fu mi.’ Ma fu di a fuka fi i bigi, meke i o go e naki a doo, e begi en naamo.
eng_text: and he from within will answer and say, 'Don't bother me. The door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed. I can't get up and give it to you'?

djk_text: Ma ná fu di yu anga en na mati ede, meke a o opo a doo gi yu. Ma na fu di i tan e naki a doo naamo, te a á poi fende pasi fu siibi, meke a musu opo go teke a beele di yu abi fanowdu gi yu.
eng_text: I tell you, although he will not rise and give it to him because he is his friend, yet because of his persistence, he will get up and give him as many as he needs.

djk_text: “Na dati ede meke mi taigi u taki: ‘Begi, da u o kisi. U suku, da u o fende. U koko, da doo o opo gi u.’
eng_text:
I tell you, keep asking, and it will be given you. Keep seeking, and you will find. Keep knocking, and it will be opened to you.
2228	Bika na sama di e begi en, e kisi. A sama di e suku e fende. Soseefi sama di e koko, da doo e opo gi.	2228	For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.
2229	“Bika luku son fu u ya abi pikin. Da efu wan pikin fu u begi u wan fisi, u o teke wan sineki, da u gi en?	2229	Which of you fathers, if your son asks for bread, will give him a stone? Or if he asks for a fish, he won't give him a snake instead of a fish, will he?

djk_text: Ofu, sama fu u di de ya, o teke wan kukutu tee langa gi en pikin, te a begi en wan igi?
eng_text: Or if he asks for an egg, he won't give him a scorpion, will he?

djk_text: We, efu anga ala fa u de takuu ati sama seefi, ne u sabi fu gi u pikin bun so, da san na u Tata a tapu? Te u begi en, a Apaiti Jeje fi en, a ná o gi u en moo esi, no?”
eng_text: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him?"

djk_text: Da wan taa dei baka, ne Masaa Jesesi yaki wan takuu jeje puu a wan sama tapu. A takuu jeje ya be meke a toon babawman. Ma wanten, di Masaa Jesesi yaki en puu, ne a man e taki bun baka. Da a sani foondoo ala den sama.
eng_text: He was casting out a demon, and it was mute. It happened, when the demon had gone out, the mute man spoke; and the multitudes marveled.

djk_text: Ma wantu fu den sama kosi Masaa Jesesi taki: “A nái foondoo wi taki, ai yaki takuu jeje puu a sama tapu. Bika anga Belisebulu, a edeman fu den didibii ai puu den.”
eng_text: But some of them said, "He casts out demons by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons."

djk_text: Ma namo, da wanlo sama de ape tesi en luku. Ne den taigi en taki: “Di yu na wan sama fu Masaa Gadu tuutuu, da soi u wan maiki, meke u sabi taki, Masaa Gadu de anga yu anga den sani di yu e du.”
eng_text: Others, testing him, sought from him a sign from heaven.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi sabi san de a den baka ede. Ne a taigi den taki: “Efu den sama fu wan kownu kondee opo e feti anga enseefi, da a kondee de, na booko a o booko. Na soseefi, a de anga wan osu pe den sama e libi fanya fanya, feyanti fasi anga denseefi. A osu sama de musu booko saka kaba a soso.
eng_text: But he, knowing their thoughts, said to them, "Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation. A house divided against itself falls.

djk_text: Da u taki, mi e wooko anga didibii, fu puu takuu jeje a sama tapu. We, da na feti didibii e feti anga enseefi, fu booko a hii makiti anga a hii kondee fi enseefi, di ai tii.
eng_text: If Satan also is divided against himself, how will his kingdom stand? For you say that I cast out demons by Beelzebul.

djk_text: We, di u taki, anga a basi fu didibii mi e puu den takuu jeje, we den sama fu u, no? Anga san den e puu den? Bika denseefi e puu takuu jeje a sama tapu. U go akisi den luku. Da u sa si taki, den sama fu useefi o soi u taki, u ná abi leti.
eng_text: But if I cast out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore will they be your judges.

djk_text: Bika anga a taanga fu Masaa Gadu mi e puu den takuu jeje a sama tapu. Den sani di mi e du anga a taanga fu Masaa Gadu ya, de enke wan maiki fu soi u taki, a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu doo a u mindii now.”
eng_text: But if I by the finger of God cast out demons, then the Kingdom of God has come to you.

djk_text: Ne a taki go doo taki: “Te wan taanga man abi bunbun feti sani fu oli waki ne en osu, da a ná abi fu feele ná wan sani. Bika ná wan sama o poi kon fufuu sani a ini en osu.
eng_text:
When the strong man, fully armed, guards his own dwelling, his goods are safe.
2240	Ma, te wan moo taanga man di abi moo bun feti sani kon feti anga en, da a o fonmi en teke ala den feti sani fi en, puu ne en ana. Da a teke den gudu fi en go paati gi taa sama.”	2240	But when someone stronger attacks him and overcomes him, he takes from him his whole armor in which he trusted, and divides his spoils.
2241	Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den go doo taki: “A sama di á de anga mi a wanse, da a sama de e feti fu booko mi saka. Da sama di nái wooko makandii anga mi, fu tyai sama kon a mi, sowan sama e yaki den sama paati, puu a mi.”	2241	He that is not with me is against me. He who doesn't gather with me scatters.

djk_text: Ne a taigi den taki: “Te wan takuu jeje komoto a wan sama tapu, da ai waka e lontu e suku peesi na ala den sabana ini, fu boo. Ma a nái poi fende peesi fu boo. Da, te a á poi fende a peesi fu boo, da ai pakisei taki: ‘Meke mi daai go tan na a peesi pe mi be komoto baka.’
eng_text: The unclean spirit, when he has gone out of the man, passes through dry places, seeking rest, and finding none, he says, 'I will turn back to my house from which I came out.'

djk_text: Da te a daai kon baka, a osu pe a be komoto de leigi leigi. A de kiinkiin sibisibi moi silli.
eng_text: When he returns, he finds it swept and put in order.

djk_text: Da ai gwe baka, da a go kai seibin taa takuu jeje, di ogii moo enseefi. Da den e kon na a sama tapu. Da a libi fu sowan sama o moo ogii bakaten, moo enke fa a be de a fesi kaba.”
eng_text: Then he goes, and takes seven other spirits more evil than himself, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first."

djk_text: Ma, namo di Masaa Jesesi e taki, ne wan uman di be de a ini den sama ini de, bali taki: “Oho! Masaa Gadu seigi a uman di meke yu, fu di Masaa Gadu fende taki, na a uman ya be mu meke yu.”
eng_text: It came to pass, as he said these things, a certain woman out of the multitude lifted up her voice, and said to him, "Blessed is the womb that bore you, and the breasts which nursed you!"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Uman! I si fa u de ya? Den sama di e aliki Masaa Gadu wowtu e du san a taki, fende moo gaan seigi, moo enke a uman di meke mi.”
eng_text: But he said, "On the contrary, blessed are those who hear the word of God, and keep it."

djk_text: Namo somen somen sama e kon a Masaa Jesesi, ne a taki: “Saide meke den sama fu a ten ya abi takuu ati so du? Den e feti fu si maiki fu Gadu. Ma den ná o si ná wan taa maiki moo enke a maiki fu a apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu, di den be e kai Jowna.
eng_text: When the multitudes were gathering together to him, he began to say, "This is an evil generation. It seeks after a sign. No sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah, the prophet.

djk_text: Bika leti enke fa Jowna be de enke wan maiki gi den sama fu Ninifei, na letiso a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya, de enke wan maiki gi den sama fu a ten ya tu.
eng_text: For even as Jonah became a sign to the Ninevites, so will also the Son of Man be to this generation.

djk_text: “A uman kownu fu a kondee di den e kai Seba, na a se fu san dongo, o opo na a gaan kuutu dei, di Masaa Gadu o kuutu sama, fu kuutu den sama fu a ten ya. Bika en dati be komoto langa langa te na a taase fu goontapu fu kon a Salomo, fu kon yee den koni fi en. Ma wan Sama de a u mindii ya, di hei moo Salomo seefi, ma toku, u nái teke en taki.
eng_text: The Queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation, and will condemn them: for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, one greater than Solomon is here.

djk_text: Soseefi ala den sama fu Ninifei o opo, da den o kuutu den sama fu a ten ya. Bika den sama fu Ninifei be yee a wowtu fu Masaa Gadu di Jowna be gi den. Ne den teke en, ne den daai libi wanten. Ma wan Sama de a u mindii ya, di hei moo Jowna, ma toku, u nái teke en taki.”
eng_text: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation, and will condemn it: for they repented at the preaching of Jonah, and behold, one greater than Jonah is here.

djk_text: Ne a taigi den taki: “Ná wan sama e leti wan lampu, da a poti en a sani ondoo, efu a teke sani tapu en. Nono! A o poti en a wan hei peesi, fu ala sama di o kon a ini a osu sa si sani bun anga en.
eng_text:
No one, when he has lit a lamp, puts it in a cellar or under a basket, but on a stand, that those who come in may see the light.
2252	Da na so a de anga wi libisama tu. U ain, na a lampu fu u sikin. Efu u ain de bunbun, ne u opo den fu si sani, da u o si kiinkiin anga den, fu u sabi san u e du. Ma efu u ain dunguu, da u hii sikin seefi dunguu tu. Bika, wansi u leti wan lampu poti de seefi, toku u ná o si san u e du. Da na ini dunguu u e tan. Da u ná o sabi san u e du.	2252	The lamp of the body is the eye. Therefore when your eye is good, your whole body is also full of light; but when it is evil, your body also is full of darkness.
2253	A dati meke, u mu e koni fu u á poti u ain fu luku ogii fu u ain anga u ati dunguu.	2253	Therefore see whether the light that is in you isn't darkness.
2254	Bika efu u hii ati kiin, sondee fu a abi wan baaka, da u sa leti kiin peesi gi taa sama, leti enke wan lampu di e leti kiin peesi gi sama.”	2254	If therefore your whole body is full of light, having no part dark, it will be wholly full of light, as when the lamp with its bright shining gives you light.

djk_text: Da Masaa Jesesi kaba taki seefi, ne wan Faliseiman kai en taki: “Masaa Jesesi, kon go nyan anga mi a mi osu, no?” Ne Masaa Jesesi go anga a Faliseiman ne en osu go nyan.
eng_text: Now as he spoke, a certain Pharisee asked him to dine with him. He went in, and sat at the table.

djk_text: Da di den sidon fu nyan, ne wan sani dangaa a Faliseiman. Bika a si taki Masaa Jesesi e nyan, sondee fu wasi ana na a apaiti fasi fa a Dyuweiti be e soi den, fu wasi den ana fosi den go nyan.
eng_text: When the Pharisee saw it, he marveled that he had not first washed himself before dinner.

djk_text: Da di Masaa Jesesi si taki a sani ya dangaa a Faliseiman, ne a taigi en taki: “U Faliseiman! U e wasi u sikin namo, da u kaba, fu soi kiin a doose. Ma u ati lai anga giili anga takuudu!
eng_text: The Lord said to him, "Now you Pharisees cleanse the outside of the cup and of the platter, but your inward part is full of extortion and wickedness.

djk_text: U wisiwasi sani sondee fusutan! U e feti namo fu wasi doose fu u sikin kiin. Ma fa fu u ati? U á sabi taki, Masaa Gadu wani meke u wasi u ati kiin tu, no?
eng_text: You foolish ones, didn't he who made the outside make the inside also?

djk_text: U feti fu wasi u ati kiin, fu u yeepi den pooti sama a sani. Da te u ati kiin so kaba, da u ná abi fu feti, fu wasi ana moo enke fa u gwenti. Bika efu u ati kiin, da ala sani fu u kiin tu.”
eng_text: But give for gifts to the needy those things which are within, and behold, all things will be clean to you.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taki go doo taki: “Heelu fu u enke Faliseiman de! Bika u nái libi letiopu anga sama, anga u á lobi Masaa Gadu tu. Ma u e paati ala san u abi a tin pisi, da u e gi Masaa Gadu wan fu den tin pisi. Soseefi u e gi en wan pisi fu tin, fu ala u goon nyanyan enke fa a Dyuweiti taki. Da u e si enke u bun kaba. We, a ná enke fu gi Masaa Gadu wan pisi fu tin, fu ala san u abi, ná ogii. Ma dati á sai. Bika feti fu libi letiopu anga ala lobi Masaa Gadu seefi tu.”
eng_text: But woe to you Pharisees! For you tithe mint and rue and every herb, but you bypass justice and the love of God. You ought to have done these, and not to have left the other undone.

djk_text: Ne a taki moo taki: “Heelu ete wan toon, fu u enke Faliseiman! Bika te u go a keliki, da u lobi sidon a den fesiman sutuu a ini a keliki. Soseefi, te u e waka a ganda, da u e wani meke ala sama e gi u odi a sama fesi, enke u hei moo ala taa sama.
eng_text: Woe to you Pharisees! For you love the best seats in the synagogues, and the greetings in the marketplaces.

djk_text: We, heelu fu u! Bika u de leti enke gaandi geebi, di sama e waka e pasa a den tapu, sondee fu den sabi taki, a sowan ogii tapu, den e waka e pasa de.”
eng_text: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like hidden graves, and the men who walk over them don't know it."

djk_text: Ne wan leliman fu Dyuweiti bali gi en taki: “We, Mesiti, oo! Fa yu e kosi den Faliseiman de, u de a ini tu?”
eng_text: One of the lawyers answered him, "Teacher, in saying this you insult us also."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi kosi den now taki: “Heelu fu u enke leliman fu weiti! Bika u e leli den sama Masaa Gadu weiti, da u e suku fu poti ibi a den sama neki tapu, fu den tyai. Ma useefi nái meke moiti, fu diki wan pikinso fu dati tyai seefi.
eng_text: He said, "Woe to you lawyers also! For you load men with burdens that are difficult to carry, and you yourselves won't even lift one finger to help carry those burdens.

djk_text: Da heelu fu u! Bika u e seeka den geebi fu den apaiti fositen apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu. We, na den avo gaansama fu u be kii den.
eng_text: Woe to you! For you build the tombs of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.

djk_text: Da anga dati, u e soi taki, a bun gi u fa den gaansama fu u kii den fositen apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu. Da efu u be de a den peesi, na a seefi sani u be sa du tu. Den gaansama kii. Den pikin e seeka geebi.
eng_text: So you testify and consent to the works of your fathers. For they killed them, and you build their tombs.

djk_text: Ma a ná ogii. Masaa Gadu sabi fa a o du anga u. Bika Masaa Gadu be taki a fesi kaba taki, a sende a apaiti takiman anga apaiti bosikopuman kon gi u. Ma u o kii son fu den. Da taawan u o yaki gwe.
eng_text: Therefore also the wisdom of God said, 'I will send to them prophets and apostles; and some of them they will kill and persecute,

djk_text: “Na fu dati ede meke, Masaa Gadu o akisi u faantiwowtu, fu ala den apaiti takiman fi en di u be kii fanafu goontapu sete.
eng_text: that the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation;

djk_text: Fu a Abeli, a fosi sama di u kii, te go miti Sakalia, di u be kii a Mama Keliki, koosube fu a apaiti begi tafaa. U o tyai a sitaafu fu ala den fiya.”
eng_text: from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zachariah, who perished between the altar and the sanctuary.' Yes, I tell you, it will be required of this generation.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taki go doo taki: “We, heelu fu u enke leliman fu weiti! San meke u abi takuudu so du? Bika u e kibii a tuutuu leli gi den sama, fu den á sa poi sabi en. Ma u seefi nái meke moiti fu du san den weiti taki. Da u e tapu pasi gi den sama di wani kon sabi den.”
eng_text: Woe to you lawyers! For you took away the key of knowledge. You didn't enter in yourselves, and those who were entering in, you hindered."

djk_text: Da, di Masaa Jesesi taki den sani ya, ne den Faliseiman anga den leliman fu weiti ati teke faya.
eng_text: As he said these things to them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to be terribly angry, and to draw many things out of him;

djk_text: Ne fanafu a dei de, ne den e akisi en somen sani, fu tesi en, fu a taki sani di á bun, fu den tyai en go kaagi.
eng_text: lying in wait for him, and seeking to catch him in something he might say, that they might accuse him.

djk_text: Da a yuu di Masaa Jesesi e taki de, ne onmen dunsu sama e kon ne en, te den e banda denseefi. Ma namo, ne Masaa Jesesi daai, ne a bali den bakaman fi en taki: “U mu luku bun anga a sowda fu den Faliseiman. Den e meke enke den na bunbun sama, ma na soso ogii. Mi bali u. U á libi enke den!
eng_text: Meanwhile, when a multitude of many thousands had gathered together, so much so that they trampled on each other, he began to tell his disciples first of all, "Beware of the yeast of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.

djk_text: Bika ná wan sani sa de a kibii te, da a á kon a doo. Soseefi ná wan sani sa pasa bakabaka te, da a á kon fu sama sabi.
eng_text: But there is nothing covered up, that will not be revealed, nor hidden, that will not be known.

djk_text: Da ala san u taki a dunguu, den o yee a gaan dei. Da ala san u taigi useefi a yesi a ini kambaa, den o taampu a osu tapu bali den gi kondee.”
eng_text: Therefore whatever you have said in the darkness will be heard in the light. What you have spoken in the ear in the inner rooms will be proclaimed on the housetops.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den bakaman taki: “Mi mati! Mi e taigi yu tuutuu taki, yu á mu feele den sama di sa kii yu sikin namo, da bakadati den á poi du ná wan sani anga yu moo.
eng_text:
I tell you, my friends, don't be afraid of those who kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.

We, efu Masaa Gadu nái feegete ná wan fu den pikin foo di e fee a tapu anda, da fa fu u enke libisama, di hei moo enke den pikin foo?
