Ne a seefi yuu de, ne wan sama bali a mindii fu den somen sama de taki: “Mesiti! Mi begi i baa, gaantangi. Taigi mi baala, meke a gi mi fu mi se gudu di wi dda dede fika gi u.”
eng_text: One of the multitude said to him, "Teacher, tell my brother to divide the inheritance with me."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Sama poti mi fu koti kuutu paati u gudu gi u?”
eng_text: But he said to him, "Man, who made me a judge or an arbitrator over you?"

djk_text: Ne a taigi den sama di taampu de taki: “U mu koni bun anga useefi, fu u ná abi giili ati. U á feti fu fende sani di u ná abi fanowdu. Bika a ná gudu e meke wan sama libi langa ofu libi switi.”
eng_text: He said to them, "Beware! Keep yourselves from covetousness, for a man's life doesn't consist of the abundance of the things which he possesses."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi gi den wan toli taki: “Wan guduman be koti wan goon fi en. Ne a paandi en, te a kaba. Da a goon meke nyanyan fu tyobo.”
eng_text: He spoke a parable to them, saying, "The ground of a certain rich man brought forth abundantly.

djk_text: Ne a man sidon, ne a pakisei taki: “San mi o du? Bika mi ná abi magisin sai fu poti a nyanyan ya.”
eng_text: He reasoned within himself, saying, 'What will I do, because I don't have room to store my crops?'

djk_text: Ne a de te wan pisi, ne a taki: “Mi sabi kaba san mi o du. Mi o booko den pikin osu fu mi puu, da mi meke moo gaanwan fu poti a nyanyan anga a gudu fu mi.
eng_text: He said, 'This is what I will do. I will pull down my barns, and build bigger ones, and there I will store all my grain and my goods.

djk_text: Da now, mi de enke fa mi wani. Mi abi nyanyan fu onmen yali. A á de fu mi wooko moo. Mi sa nyan diingi meke piisii enke fa mi wani.”
eng_text: I will tell my soul, "Soul, you have many goods laid up for many years. Take your ease, eat, drink, be merry."'

djk_text: Ma te fu a poti pakisei, ne Masaa Gadu taigi en taki: “I lawman yu! Sama taigi i a sani de! A seefi neti ya, a libi boo fi yu sa komoto a yu gwe. Da sama yu o fika den gudu fi yu anga a somen nyanyan fi i di i seeka poti de gi?”
eng_text:
But God said to him, 'You foolish one, tonight your soul is required of you. The things which you have prepared--whose will they be?'
2292	Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “U si! Na so e pasa anga den sama fu a goontapu ya, di e suku fu fende gudu naamo, sondee fu feti fu libi enke fa Masaa Gadu wani, fu den fende gudu ne en anda.”	2292	So is he who lays up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward God.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi daai, ne a taki anga den bakaman fi en baka taki: “U á mu booko u ede taki, san u o nyan ofu san u o wei.
eng_text: He said to his disciples, "Therefore I tell you, don't be anxious for your life, what you will eat, nor yet for your body, what you will wear.

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu gi wi sikin anga libi di de moo enke koosi anga nyanyan. Da efu a sikin anga a libi di Masaa Gadu gi u de moo enke koosi anga nyanyan, da u denki taki, a ná o gi u koosi fu wei anga nyanyan fu nyan?
eng_text: Life is more than food, and the body is more than clothing.

djk_text: We, luku den foo a tapu! Den nái koti goon paandi nyanyan. Soseefi, den ná abi kedee efu baakoto e kibii nyanyan fu nyan taa dei baka. Ma toku, den e nyan e diingi ibii dei. Bika Masaa Gadu e solugu den. We, u libisama, no? U á waiti moo den foo, no? Da Masaa Gadu sa fika u sondee koosi efu sondee nyanyan?
eng_text: Consider the ravens: they don't sow, they don't reap, they have no warehouse or barn, and God feeds them. How much more valuable are you than birds!

djk_text: Sama de di sa booko en ede te, da a libi moo langa moo enke san Masaa Gadu poti gi en?
eng_text: Which of you by being anxious can add a cubit to his height?

djk_text: We, efu booko ede á poi yeepi yu a den pikin sani de, da fu saide meke yu e booko yu ede anga den gaan sani?
eng_text: If then you aren't able to do even the least things, why are you anxious about the rest?

djk_text: “We, luku den boomiki a ini sabana, fa den moi. Den nái wooko. Soseefi den nái nai sani fu wei tu. Ma mi e taigi u taki, anga ala fa Salomo, a fositen kownu fu Islayeli Kondee be e wei moi, toku a á be wei moi kisi den boomiki ya.
eng_text: Consider the lilies, how they grow. They don't toil, neither do they spin; yet I tell you, even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.

djk_text: Efu Masaa Gadu wei den boomiki so moi, da san na yu di hei moo ala den boomiki ya? Bika tide yu e si den, ma tamaa den á de moo. Kee! Libisama, saide meke a biibi di u abi a Masaa Gadu swaki so du?
eng_text: But if this is how God clothes the grass in the field, which today exists, and tomorrow is cast into the oven, how much more will he clothe you, O you of little faith?

djk_text: U á booko u ede anga san u o nyan ofu san u o diingi. U á mu si nyanyan anga diingi enke gaan sani.
eng_text: Don't seek what you will eat or what you will drink; neither be anxious.

djk_text: Bika na sama di á sabi Masaa Gadu e booko den ede anga den sowtu sani de. Ma u Tata di de a tapu sabi san u abi fanowdu.
eng_text: For the nations of the world seek after all of these things, but your Father knows that you need these things.

djk_text: Ma suku fu de a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu. Da a o gi u ala san u fanowdu.”
eng_text: But seek God's Kingdom, and all these things will be added to you.

djk_text: Namo a taigi den bakaman fi en go doo taki: “Mi mati! U nái ipi, ma u á mu feele. Bika a be bun gi Masaa Gadu, u Tata, fu a be teke u poti a ini a Nyun Tii fi en, fu u be sa fende a bun fi en.
eng_text: Don't be afraid, little flock, for it is your Father's good pleasure to give you the Kingdom.

djk_text: U á mu feti fu suku gudu dyunta, poti a goontapu ya namo. Ma u seli den, da u paati a moni gi den pootiman. Na sowan fasi u sa kibii gudu a Masaa Gadu, di ná o poi kaba noiti moo, a Masaa Gadu Kondee anda. Fufuuman ná o poi go anda go fufuu den. Soseefi woon ná o nyanmi den tu. Da na Masaa Gadu i mu kibii i gudu poti. Da noiti den sa poli.
eng_text: Sell that which you have, and give gifts to the needy. Make for yourselves purses which don't grow old, a treasure in the heavens that doesn't fail, where no thief approaches, neither moth destroys.

djk_text: Bika na pe i gudu de, na ape i ati o de tu!”
eng_text: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

djk_text: Ne a taigi den bakaman fi en baka taki: “U seeka useefi, de kaba kaba e luku u Masaa. U meke a faya fu u de leti leti.
eng_text:
Let your waist be dressed and your lamps burning.

djk_text: Da di Masaa Jesesi taki so, te a kaba, ne Peitilisi akisi en taki: “Masaa! Den sani di yu e taigi u ya, na fu ala sama, ofu na fu u wawan?”
eng_text: Peter said to him, "Lord, are you telling this parable to us, or to everybody?"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Mi e taki fu wan futuboi di en masaa be sende, fu gi ibii taa sama a ini a osu, en pisi fu a nyanyan, na a leti yuu.
eng_text: The Lord said, "Who then is the faithful and wise steward, whom his lord will set over his household, to give them their portion of food at the right times?

djk_text: We, te a masaa o kon doo baka, da seigi fu a futuboi de. A masaa o pai en gaan paiman, efu a si taki: ‘Aai! A futuboi ya e wooko enke fa a fiti gi mi.’
eng_text: Blessed is that servant whom his lord will find doing so when he comes.

djk_text: Da fu tuu, mi e taigi u, a masaa de o poti a futuboi toon a basi, di e luku ala en gudu. Na so a masaa ya o du.
eng_text: Truly I tell you, that he will set him over all that he has.

djk_text: Ma meke u taki, a futuboi be pakisei taki: ‘Mi basi ná o kon ete.’ Da a bigin go nyan, diingi anga duunguman. Soseefi ai fon den taawan, uman anga man a ini a osu fu a masaa.
eng_text: But if that servant says in his heart, 'My lord delays his coming,' and begins to beat the menservants and the maidservants, and to eat and drink, and to be drunken,

djk_text: We, da a masaa be o kon a wan dei, anga wan yuu di a futuboi ya á poti pakisei. Bika a futuboi seefi á sabi on dei a masaa o kon baka. Da a masaa be o meke den doo a futuboi ede. Da a poti en go a pe fu sitaafu den sama di nái teke Masaa Gadu taki.
eng_text: then the lord of that servant will come in a day when he isn't expecting him, and in an hour that he doesn't know, and will cut him in two, and place his portion with the unfaithful.

djk_text: Bika, efu wan futuboi sabi san en masaa wani a mu du, ma a nái seeka fu du dati, da a sa fende wan tumisi gaan fonfon.
eng_text: That servant, who knew his lord's will, and didn't prepare, nor do what he wanted, will be beaten with many stripes,

djk_text: “Da a sama di e du wan sani sondee sabi, o kisi lekiti sitaafu. Ma a sama di e du sani anga sabi, da a o kisi ibi sitaafu. Efu wan sama kisi ipi wooko, fu de enke basi fu den, da den o akisi en ipi faantiwowtu tu. On moo ipi wan sama kisi, on moo bigi a faantiwowtu fi en de tu.”
eng_text: but he who didn't know, and did things worthy of stripes, will be beaten with few stripes. To whomever much is given, of him will much be required; and to whom much was entrusted, of him more will be asked.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “A kon mi kon a goontapu, fu sutu faya gi goontapu enke fa den sama e sutu faya boon wan goon. Da a be sa moo bun gi mi, efu a faya ya be sutu kaba.
eng_text:
I came to throw fire on the earth. I wish it were already kindled.

djk_text: Ne di Masaa Jesesi daai, ne a taki anga den somen sama di kon ne en de now taki: “Te u luku tapu, ne u si wan woluku na a se fu san opo, da u e taki alen o kon. Da ai kon tuu.
eng_text: He said to the multitudes also, "When you see a cloud rising from the west, immediately you say, 'A shower is coming,' and so it happens.

djk_text: Te a winta e wai komoto a opuse, da u e taki: ‘A san o ati.’ Da ai ati tuu.
eng_text: When a south wind blows, you say, 'There will be a scorching heat,' and it happens.

djk_text: U soso mofu libisama! Te u luku tapu, u e si efu alen o kai, efu san o pii. Dati u sabi bun. Ma saide meke u á wani opo u ain, fu si den maiki di e pasa leti a u fesi a goontapu a doti ya? Na si u nái si den sani ya, fu sabi on yuu ten fu goontapu u de?
eng_text: You hypocrites! You know how to interpret the appearance of the earth and the sky, but how is it that you don't interpret this time?

djk_text: “Bika u sabi, san di bun fu du anga san di á bun fu du. Da saide meke u nái luku san di de leti fu du?
eng_text: Why don't you judge for yourselves what is right?

djk_text: Bika efu yu anga yu feyanti abi toobi, ne i si taki a wani tyai yu go a kuutu, da i mu meke moiti fu taki fiti anga en, fosi u doo a kuutuman. Ma efu yu á du dati, da den o iti yu go a ini dunguu osu.
eng_text: For when you are going with your adversary before the magistrate, try diligently on the way to be released from him, lest perhaps he drag you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and the officer throw you into prison.

djk_text: Da yu ná o komoto, de fu te enke i pai a lasiti kopoo sensi di den naki lenti gi yu, fu pai.”
eng_text: I tell you, you will by no means get out of there, until you have paid the very last penny. "

djk_text: Ne a seefi yuu de, ne wanlo sama kon taigi Masaa Jesesi taki, den suudati fu Gaaman Pilatesi kii wan duupu Galileya sama, di be de a ini a Mama Keliki e kii wan meti, fu boon enke paiman, fu begi Masaa Gadu. Ne den towe den mokisa den buulu anga a meti di den be e kii de.
eng_text: Now there were some present at the same time who told him about the Galileans, whose blood Pilate had mixed with their sacrifices.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi akisi den taki: “U membee taki, na fu di den sama de be e libi takuu moo ala den taa sama fu Galileya, meke den suudati kii den?
eng_text: Jesus answered them, "Do you think that these Galileans were worse sinners than all the other Galileans, because they suffered such things?

djk_text: Nono! Ná dati meke a ogii de pasa anga den. Bika efu useefi á daai libi, da na letiso a sa pasa anga u tu.”
eng_text: I tell you, no, but unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way.

djk_text: Ne a akisi den baka taki: “San u pakisei fu den tin na aitin sama di a tolen fu Silowam be booko kai kii? U membee taki na fu di den sama de be e libi takuu moo ala taa sama fu Jelusalem meke den sani de pasa anga den?
eng_text: Or those eighteen, on whom the tower in Siloam fell, and killed them; do you think that they were worse offenders than all the men who dwell in Jerusalem?

djk_text: Nono! A ná fu di den ogii moo u. Mi e taigi u tuutuu. Efu u á daai libi, da na letiso useefi sa dede kaba a soso tu.”
eng_text: I tell you, no, but, unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way."

djk_text: Ne a gi den wan toli taki: “Wan yali ten, da wan sama be paandi wan sii den e kai figasii a ini en goon. Ne, di a sama de, te wan dei, ne a go na a goon fi en go suku nyanyan na a figasii bon. Ma a á fende ná wan kodo nyanyan ne en.
eng_text: He spoke this parable. "A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard, and he came seeking fruit on it, and found none.

djk_text: Ne a taigi a man di a be poti e luku a goon taki: ‘Faa a bon ya towe. Bika na fu soso a taampu a ini a goon ya! Na dii yali langa kaba di mi e kon e suku nyanyan na a bon ya, sondee fu fende wan kodo.’
eng_text: He said to the vine dresser, 'Behold, these three years I have come looking for fruit on this fig tree, and found none. Cut it down. Why does it waste the soil?'

djk_text: “Ne a man di e luku a goon taki: ‘Basi! Meke u fika en wan yali ete, baa? Mi o puu gotoo lontu en, da mi o poti doti gi en.
eng_text: He answered, 'Lord, leave it alone this year also, until I dig around it, and fertilize it.

djk_text: Da kande a sa gi nyanyan. Ma efu a á meke ná wan nyanyan, da te i daai kon baka, da i sa faa en towe tuu.’ ”
eng_text: If it bears fruit, fine; but if not, after that, you can cut it down.'"

djk_text: Ne wan dei, ne Masaa Jesesi go a ini wan Dyu keliki go e leli den sama Masaa Gadu wowtu.
eng_text: He was teaching in one of the synagogues on the Sabbath day.

djk_text: Da di a leli, te wan pisi, ne en ain kai anga wan uman a ini a keliki osu. A uman ya be siki te, a fika bukubuku. A á poi opo en ede luku tapu moo seefi. Na tin na aitin yali kaba, di a de anga a siki ya. Da na wan takuu sani namo, i si be siki en poti so.
eng_text: Behold, there was a woman who had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years, and she was bent over, and could in no way straighten herself up.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi kai a uman kon ne en! Ne a taigi en taki: “Uman! I kon bun fu a siki ya!”
eng_text: When Jesus saw her, he called her, and said to her, "Woman, you are freed from your infirmity."

djk_text: Ne a poti ana na a uman ya tapu, ne wanten a uman opo taampu tiloo enke fa a be de fosi. Ne a gafa Masaa Gadu gi en daa.
eng_text: He laid his hands on her, and immediately she stood up straight, and glorified God.

djk_text: Ma a á bun gi a edeman fu a Dyu keliki, fa Masaa Jesesi deesi a uman na a kina dei ya. Ne a akisi den sama taki: “A ná sigisi dei a wiki abi, fu wooko, no? Da saide meke u nái kon a wan fu den sigisi dei ya, fu suku yeepi fu u siki? U á kon a kina dei kon suku yeepi fu u siki, moo.”
eng_text: The ruler of the synagogue, being indignant because Jesus had healed on the Sabbath, said to the multitude, "There are six days in which men ought to work. Therefore come on those days and be healed, and not on the Sabbath day!"

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “I bidiigiman yu! Iseefi e wooko a kina dei. Bika ala kina dei, u e losi den kaw anga den buliki fu u tyai go diingi wataa.
eng_text: Therefore the Lord answered him, "You hypocrites! Doesn't each one of you free his ox or his donkey from the stall on the Sabbath, and lead him away to water?

djk_text: We, a uman ya, no? Wan bakapikin fu Abalaham, di a didibii tei tin na aitin yali langa a sitaafu. Da na fu di na kina dei ede, meke a tetei di tei en á mu losi?”
eng_text: Ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham, whom Satan had bound eighteen long years, be freed from this bondage on the Sabbath day?"

djk_text: We, di Masaa Jesesi taki so, ne sen kisi den di be e sitee anga den, te ná sipowtu. Ma den taa sama piisii te, fu den gaan foondoo sani di Masaa Jesesi e du.
eng_text: As he said these things, all his adversaries were disappointed, and all the multitude rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.

djk_text: Da, ne Masaa Jesesi akisi den baka taki: “Anga san mi sa maiki a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu?
eng_text: He said, "What is the Kingdom of God like? To what shall I compare it?

djk_text: We, a de enke wan sii den e kai mosite, di wan sama paandi ne en goon. A sii ya na wan pikintoin sii, pikinmoo ain á poi si en. Ma, te den paandi en, te a goo, da ai bigi moo ala den taa sani di den paandi a ini a goon. Den ana fi en e bigi paati, te den foo e meke nesi e teke koo a den. Da na so a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu de.”
eng_text: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and put in his own garden. It grew, and became a large tree, and the birds of the sky lodged in its branches."

djk_text: Ne a akisi den baka taki: “San moo mi sa teke maiki a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu?
eng_text: Again he said, "To what shall I compare the Kingdom of God?

djk_text: We, a de enke wan pikintoin sowda di wan uman teke iti a ini wan gaan tyaipi bolon. Da a sowda soopu ala a bolon, te doo. Na so a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu de.”
eng_text: It is like yeast, which a woman took and hid in three measures of flour, until it was all leavened."

djk_text: Ne bakadati, ne Masaa Jesesi komoto de e go a Jelusalem. Da ai leli den sama fu den kondee kondee pe ai pasa, Masaa Gadu wowtu.
eng_text: He went on his way through cities and villages, teaching, and traveling on to Jerusalem.

djk_text: Ne wan sama akisi en taki: “Masaa! Na pikinso sama namo o go a Masaa Gadu?” Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki:
eng_text: One said to him, "Lord, are they few who are saved?" He said to them,

djk_text: “Feti fi i seefi sa de wan fu den sama di o doo pasa go a ini a sumaa doo mofu. Bika mi e taigi u taki, somen fu u o feti, fu pasa go a ini a pikin doo ya, ma den ná o poi.
eng_text:
Strive to enter in by the narrow door, for many, I tell you, will seek to enter in, and will not be able.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den go doo taki: “Te u e wooko anga moni, u mu wooko anga koni. U mu wooko anga en a goontapu ya, fu te a dei o doo, fu go a Masaa Gadu fu tego, fu a sa piisii anga u.

djk_text: Efu sama sa fitoow yu anga wan pikin sani di den poti a ini yu ana, da den sa fitoow yu fu poti gaan sani a ini yu ana. Ma efu sama á poi fitoow yu anga wan pikin sani di den poti a ini yu ana, da den ná o poi fitoow yu fu poti gaanwan a ini yu ana tu.
eng_text: He who is faithful in a very little is faithful also in much. He who is dishonest in a very little is also dishonest in much.

djk_text: Da efu yu á sabi wooko anga moni a goontapu ya wan bun kiinkiin fasi, da fa Masaa Gadu o fitoow yu, fu gi den tuutuu gudu fi en kondee, fu wooko anga den?
eng_text: If therefore you have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true riches?

djk_text: Soseefi, efu yu á sabi seeka taa sama sani wan bun fasi, da fa Masaa Gadu o poti den waiti sani fi en a ini yu ana, fu wooko anga den a goontapu ya?
eng_text: If you have not been faithful in that which is another's, who will give you that which is your own?

djk_text: “Bika ná wan sama sa dini tu masaa makandii. Dati á kan! Ofu yu o lobi awan moo a taawan. Ofu yu o booko a wan saka, da i opo a taawan. Ma yu á poi lobi ala den tu a seefi fasi. Yu á poi waka a Masaa Gadu baka, da yu e feti a moni baka tu. Yu o lobi awan moo a taawan.”
eng_text: No servant can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to one, and despise the other. You aren't able to serve God and mammon ."

djk_text: Ne di Masaa Jesesi taki so, te a kaba, ne den Faliseiman yee. Ne den meke tyuu. Ne den e wisiwasi en, e soso en. Bika den be abi giili ati fu moni enke fa Masaa Jesesi taki de.
eng_text: The Pharisees, who were lovers of money, also heard all these things, and they scoffed at him.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “U á sabi, no? Na u mi e taki. Na libisama ain, ai soi enke u na bunbun sama. Ma Masaa Gadu sabi u ati, te doo. Bika a sani di u e si enke na wan gaan hei sani a libisama, da na gaan wisiwasi sani a Masaa Gadu ain.”
eng_text: He said to them, "You are those who justify yourselves in the sight of men, but God knows your hearts. For that which is exalted among men is an abomination in the sight of God.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den Faliseiman taki: “Fu sensi a ten di Masaa Gadu gi Mosesi den weiti, te doo a yuu di Johanisi a Dopuman kon a goontapu, da na den weiti fu Mosesi anga den taa apaiti takiman fi en be e soi libisama, fa fu waka a Masaa Gadu pasi. Ma fa u de nownow, da Johanisi tyai a Bun Nyunsu di e taki, fu a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu. Da somen sama e feti fu kon a ini.
eng_text: The law and the prophets were until John. From that time the Good News of the Kingdom of God is preached, and everyone is forcing his way into it.

djk_text: Ma a á de taki na bun den weiti fu Mosesi anga den di fu den apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu á bun moo. Nono! Bika tapu anda anga goontapu a doti ya, sa pasa gwe, sondee fu wan pikintoin sani a ini den weiti ya lasi gwe.”
eng_text: But it is easier for heaven and earth to pass away, than for one tiny stroke of a pen in the law to fall.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taki go doo taki: “Efu wan man teke wan uman fu libi, ma a fika en go teke wan taa uman, da a booko Masaa Gadu weiti. Soseefi a man di o libi anga wan uman di en man fika, booko Masaa Gadu weiti tu.”
eng_text: Everyone who divorces his wife, and marries another, commits adultery. He who marries one who is divorced from a husband commits adultery.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi gi den wan ageisi toli fu tu man. A taki: “Tu man be de a wan kondee. Wan fu den man, na be wan gaan guduman di be gudu, te a gudu. A be e wei gaan dii koosi, e meke gaan piisii, e libi enke fa a wani.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den bakaman fi en taki: “Den sani di e kon fu ali sama puu a Masaa Gadu pasi, ná o kaba a goontapu noiti. Ma heelu, fu den sama di e tyai den tesi ya kon miti taawan!

djk_text: Mi e bali u, fu luku bun taki, a sani de á miti u. “Efi i si wan biibiwan e du ogii, da bali en, meke a daai libi, fu kaba anga a ogii di ai du. Da efu a aliki yu, ne a daai libi, da gi en paadon.

eng_text: If he sins against you seven times in the day, and seven times returns, saying, 'I repent,' you shall forgive him."

djk_text: Ne den apaiti bosikopuman fu Masaa Jesesi taigi en taki: “Masaa gaantangi! Yeepi wi, meke a biibi fu wi kon moo taanga, baa.”

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “We, efu u abi biibi enke wan pikintoin mosite sii, da u sa taigi a gaanbigi bon di taampu de taki, meke a opo komoto de anga ala lutu, da a go paandi enseefi a ini ze. Da a o go enke fa u taki.”
eng_text: The Lord said, "If you had faith like a grain of mustard seed, you would tell this sycamore tree, 'Be uprooted, and be planted in the sea,' and it would obey you.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den baka taki: “On di fu u o abi wan wookoman di go wooko a goon ofu di go luku den meti a den sabana, te a kon a osu, da a taigi en taki: ‘Kon sidon nyan?’
eng_text: But who is there among you, having a servant plowing or keeping sheep, that will say, when he comes in from the field, 'Come immediately and sit down at the table,'

eng_text: Even so you also, when you have done all the things that are commanded you, say, 'We are unworthy servants. We have done our duty.'"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi komoto de, ne a teke pasi e go a Jelusalem. Ma namo, da ai waka pasa na a pisi fu Galileya anga Samaliya mindii.

U go a den apaiti begiman na a Mama Keliki, meke den si taki u kon bun tuu.” Ne den teke pasi e go a apaiti begiman. A di den waka te wan pisi, ne den sikin kon bun kelle. A gwasi siki gwe komoto a den sikin.

eng_text: One of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, glorifying God with a loud voice.

djk_text: Ne a taigi a man taki: “Man! Opo waka gwe fi i. A biibi di yu abi deesi yu kaba.”

djk_text: Ne wan dei, ne den Faliseiman kon a Masaa Jesesi, ne den akisi en taki: “On ten a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu o doo goontapu?” Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “We, u aliki! A Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu ná o kon enke fa u denki de. Bika, a nái kon a wan fasi fu sama sa si anga ain.
eng_text: Being asked by the Pharisees when the Kingdom of God would come, he answered them, "The Kingdom of God doesn't come with observation;

djk_text: A ná o kon sowan fasi fi i sa taki, luku en ya ofu luku en so. Bika a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu de a ini a ati fu den sama di e waka ne en baka.”
eng_text: neither will they say, 'Look, here!' or, 'Look, there!' for behold, the Kingdom of God is within you."

djk_text: Ne a taigi den bakaman fi en taki: “Wan ten o kon, di u o angii fu si wan fu den dei, di a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya, o sidon enke kownu, fu taki na ala sani tapu. Ma u ná o poi si en nownow ya ete.
eng_text: He said to the disciples, "The days will come, when you will desire to see one of the days of the Son of Man, and you will not see it.

djk_text: Bika, te a dei di a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya, o daai kon baka, da a o de leti enke, te tapu koti faya kiin, te doo goontapu ya.
eng_text: for as the lightning, when it flashes out of the one part under the sky, shines to the other part under the sky; so will the Son of Man be in his day.

djk_text: Ma fosi en daai kon baka a goontapu so, da en o tyai sitaafu anga pen fosi. Den libisama di nái biibi a Masaa Gadu o poti en a wanse. Den ná o de a mi du seefi.
eng_text: But first, he must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.

djk_text: “Da, te a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya o daai kon baka, da den sama sa e libi leti enke fa den sama be e libi na a ten fu Nowa.

eng_text: They ate, they drank, they married, they were given in marriage, until the day that Noah entered into the ship, and the flood came, and destroyed them all.

djk_text: Ne a taigi den go doo taki: “Da na soseefi a o miti den sama fu a ten ya, leti enke fa a be miti den sama na a ten fu Lot. Na a ten fu Lot, da den sama be e nyan e diingi. Bai sani seli baka. Koti gaan goon paandi, fu meke tyaipi nyanyan. Soseefi den be e meke gaan osu.
eng_text: Likewise, even as it happened in the days of Lot: they ate, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they built;

djk_text: Na so den be e libi te enke a dei di Lot komoto a Sowdom, a kondee pe a be e tan. Na a seefi dei de, faya komoto a tapu kai kon boon ala den sama fu Sowdom kii puu de.

djk_text: “Da na soseefi libisama o go e du den sani fu den, te a Manpikin di kon saka toon libisama ya sa daai kon baka, fu ala libisama si.”

djk_text: Ne a taigi den go doo taki: “Da na a ten de, da efu wan sama de ne en baikon, da a á mu lasi ten fu go a ini en osu go teke sani. Soseefi, efu wan sama de ne en goon e wooko, a á mu suku fu go a ganda, fu go teke sani ne en osu.

eng_text: Whoever seeks to save his life loses it, but whoever loses his life preserves it.

djk_text: Ne a taki go doo taki: “Da tu sama o de a wan kama tapu, da Masaa Gadu o teke wan tyai gwe, da a o fika wan a baka.
eng_text: I tell you, in that night there will be two people in one bed. The one will be taken, and the other will be left.

djk_text: Tu sama o de a ini wan osu e wooko, da Masaa Gadu o teke wan fu den tyai gwe, da a o fika a taawan.
eng_text: There will be two grinding grain together. One will be taken, and the other will be left."

djk_text: We, di Masaa Jesesi taigi den bakaman fi en ala den sani ya, ne den akisi en taki: “Masaa! On se fu goontapu a sani ya o pasa?” Ne Masaa Jesesi koti wan nongo gi den taki: “Na pe wan meti dede fika, na ape tingi foo e kon.”
eng_text: They, answering, asked him, "Where, Lord?" He said to them, "Where the body is, there will the vultures also be gathered together."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi gi den bakaman fi en wan ageisi toli, fu soi den taki, den á mu kon weli fu begi.
eng_text: He also spoke a parable to them that they must always pray, and not give up,

djk_text: A taki: “Wan kuutu bakaa be de a wan kondee. Da a man ya be ogii te, a á be e teli Masaa Gadu. Soseefi a á be abi toobi anga libisama tu.
eng_text: saying, "There was a judge in a certain city who didn't fear God, and didn't respect man.

djk_text: Da wan pooti uman di man dede fika a ganda, be de na a kondee de tu. A uman ya be e kon na a kuutu bakaa naamo alaten, fu a kuutu wan kuutu fu gi enmi en leti. Bika wan sama be du wan ogii anga en.
eng_text: A widow was in that city, and she often came to him, saying, 'Defend me from my adversary!'

djk_text: Da bigin bigin di a uman be e go ne en, da a á be wani yeepi en. Ma di a uman ya tan e go ne en naamo, ne a taki: ‘I sabi san? Anga ala fa mi nái teli Masaa Gadu, soseefi mi ná abi toobi anga libisama, toku mi o yeepi a uman ya. Bika ai kon e kaakeli mi namo. Da mi o yeepi en kuutu a kuutu, fu gi en en leti meke a sani kaba. Da mi ede sa boo. We, bika efu mi á yeepi en, da mi ede ná o abi boo. So, meke mi yeepi en.’ ”
eng_text: He wouldn't for a while, but afterward he said to himself, 'Though I neither fear God, nor respect man,

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “We, efu a takuu ati kuutu bakaa ya, di nái teli Masaa Gadu anga di ná abi toobi anga libisama sabi fu taki so wan sani, fu yeepi a uman ya,
eng_text: The Lord said, "Listen to what the unrighteous judge says.

djk_text: da fa fu Masaa Gadu di abi bun ati? Efu den pikin fi en e begi en wan sani dei anga neti, a o daai daai fosi a gi den en? Nono! A ná o daai daai.
eng_text: Won't God avenge his chosen ones, who are crying out to him day and night, and yet he exercises patience with them?

djk_text: A o kon esi esi, kon gi den san den e begi en. Ma a de wan taa sani, efu te a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya o daai kon baka a goontapu, efu a o fende biibi a libisama.”
eng_text: I tell you that he will avenge them quickly. Nevertheless, when the Son of Man comes, will he find faith on the earth?"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi gi den ete wan ageisi toli fu den sama di e wisiwasi taawan, e naki boo fu ati, enke den bun moo taawan.
eng_text: He spoke also this parable to certain people who were convinced of their own righteousness, and who despised all others.

djk_text: A taki: “Wan dei, ne tu man be go na a Mama Keliki fu go begi. Da wan fu den man ya na wan Faliseiman. Da a taawan na wan man di e piki lantimoni.

Two men went up into the temple to pray; one was a Pharisee, and the other was a tax collector.

djk_text: Da wan dei, ne den tyai den pikin kon a Masaa Jesesi. Den be wani meke Masaa Jesesi be poti ana a den tapu begi gi den. Ma den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi bali den taki: “Nono! U daai baka. U á tyai den pikin de kon a Masaa Jesesi!”
eng_text: They were also bringing their babies to him, that he might touch them. But when the disciples saw it, they rebuked them.

djk_text: Ma, namo Masaa Jesesi si di den bakaman fi en tapu den sama, fu den á tyai den pikin kon ne en. Ne a bali den taki: “U fika den pikin, meke denseefi kon doo a mi tu. U á tapu den! Bika na sama di abi a fasi di pikinengee abi sa poi go doo a ini a Nyun Tii a Masaa Gadu Kondee.
eng_text: Jesus summoned them, saying, "Allow the little children to come to me, and don't hinder them, for the Kingdom of God belongs to such as these.

djk_text: Da a de so taki, efu wan sama nái biibi Masaa Gadu enke fa wan pikinengee e biibi sani, da a ná o poi doo a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: Most certainly, I tell you, whoever doesn't receive the Kingdom of God like a little child, he will in no way enter into it."

djk_text: Namo, ne bakadati, ne wan bigiman fu den Dyu kon ne en. Ne a akisi en taki: “Mi bun Masaa! San mi mu du, fu fende a libi fu tego?”
eng_text: A certain ruler asked him, saying, "Good Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi akisi en taki: “Saide meke yu e kai mi bun Masaa? I sabi san yu e taki, di yu e kai mi, bun Masaa? Bunbun ati sama á de boiti Masaa Gadu wawan.
eng_text: Jesus asked him, "Why do you call me good? No one is good, except one--God.

djk_text: Da yu á sabi san i mu du fi i fende a libi fu tego ete, no? We, fi i mu fende a libi fu tego: ‘Da i á mu waka anga taa uman ofu man, boiti di fi yu! I á mu kii! Soseefi i sabi taki, i á mu fufuu! I á mu lei. I mu lesipeki i mma anga i dda!’ ”
eng_text: You know the commandments: 'Don't commit adultery,' 'Don't murder,' 'Don't steal,' 'Don't give false testimony,' 'Honor your father and your mother.'"

djk_text: Ne a man piki Masaa Jesesi taki: “We, Masaa! Senten mi de pikinengee mi e oli ala den weiti de, te enke tide.”
eng_text: He said, "I have observed all these things from my youth up."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi en baka taki: “Dati na tuu! Ma wan sani de ete di i mu du. Go a osu, da seli ala san yu abi. Da paati a moni gi den pootiman. Da kon baka, fu toon wan bakaman fu mi. Da yu o fende moo gaan gudu a Masaa Gadu a tapu, a bakaten.”
eng_text: When Jesus heard these things, he said to him, "You still lack one thing. Sell all that you have, and distribute it to the poor. You will have treasure in heaven. Come, follow me."

djk_text: Ne di Masaa Jesesi taigi en a sani ya, ne gaan tyali kisi a man te, a fika fu a poti ana a mindii ede bali kee. Bika a be gudu tuutuu.
eng_text: But when he heard these things, he became very sad, for he was very rich.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi daai, ne a taigi den bakaman fi en taki: “U si fa a taanga gi wan guduman fu go doo a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu?
eng_text: Jesus, seeing that he became very sad, said, "How hard it is for those who have riches to enter into the Kingdom of God!

djk_text: A taanga gi wan kameili fu waka pasa a wan nanai olo. Ma mi e taigi u taki, a moo taanga gi wan guduman fu saka enseefi, fu pasa go a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: For it is easier for a camel to enter in through a needle's eye, than for a rich man to enter into the Kingdom of God."

djk_text: Ne di Masaa Jesesi taki so, ne den akisi en taki: “Da efu a guduman ya á poi go a Masaa Gadu, da sama o poi go seefi?”
eng_text: Those who heard it said, "Then who can be saved?"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi luku den, ne a piki den taki: “Efu u luku a libisama fasi, da sani de di á poi pasa. Ma san á poi pasa libisama fasi, na dati Masaa Gadu poi du.”
eng_text: But he said, "The things which are impossible with men are possible with God."

djk_text: Ne Peitilisi piki taki: “We, Masaa wi, no? U fika ala sani, fu kon waka a yu baka, e go anga yu na ala peesi!”
eng_text: Peter said, "Look, we have left everything, and followed you."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Iniiwan sama di lobi mi te, a fika en osu, ofu en uman ofu en baala ofu en dda anga en mma ofu pikin, fu go paati a Bun Nyunsu di e taki, fu a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu,
eng_text: He said to them, "Most certainly I tell you, there is no one who has left house, or wife, or brothers, or parents, or children, for the Kingdom of God's sake,

djk_text: da, nownow, a goontapu ya, den o fende onmen tenti toon fu den sani di den fika, fu kon waka a mi baka. Soseefi bakaten, den o fende a libi fu tego a Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: who will not receive many times more in this time, and in the world to come, eternal life."

djk_text: Ne bakadati, ne Masaa Jesesi kai den twalufu bakaman fi en go a wanse, fu taigi den san o pasa anga en. Ne a taigi den taki: “U si fa wi e go a Jelusalem ya, ala den sani di apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu be taki fu a Manpikin di kon saka toon libisama ya o kon pasa tuu.
eng_text: He took the twelve aside, and said to them, "Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and all the things that are written through the prophets concerning the Son of Man will be completed.

djk_text: Den Faliseiman anga den leliman fu Dyuweiti anga den gaansama fu Islayeli Kondee o kisi mi, da den o tyai mi go gi den doose kondee sama di e taki fu Islayeli, fu den kii. Da den sama de o poti mi a sipowtu, e lafu mi poti mi wisiwasi, e kosi mi. Soseefi den o towe wataa mofu a mi mindii fesi.
eng_text: For he will be delivered up to the Gentiles, will be mocked, treated shamefully, and spit on.

djk_text: Den o wipi mi wan mesaandi fasi fosi, da den o tyai mi go kii. Ma baka dii dei, da mi o weki baka komoto a dede.”
eng_text: They will scourge and kill him. On the third day, he will rise again."

djk_text: Ma anga ala fa Masaa Jesesi taigi den de seefi, toku den á fusutan en pikinso seefi san a wani taki. Bika a de wan kibii toli gi den.
eng_text: They understood none of these things. This saying was hidden from them, and they didn't understand the things that were said.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en e go, te den koosube fu a kondee di den e kai Jelikow. Da wan beendiman be sidon a sikin pasi e begi moni.
eng_text: It happened, as he came near Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the road, begging.

djk_text: Da di a yee den somen sama e takitaki e kon, ne a akisi taki: “San na a somen takitaki di mi e yee e kon anda?”
eng_text: Hearing a multitude going by, he asked what this meant.

djk_text: Ne den taigi en taki: “Na Jesesi fu Nasaleti e kon pasa ya.”
eng_text: They told him that Jesus of Nazareth was passing by.

djk_text: Ne ai bali taki: “Masaa Jesesi! Masaa Jesesi! Gaantangi, abi tyali ati fu mi, da yeepi mi, baa! Bika, na yu na a Bakaten Manpikin fu Kownu Dafeti paansu.”
eng_text: He cried out, "Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!"

djk_text: Da di ai bali so, ne den sama di be e waka a fesi fu a gaan kulu bali en taki: “Man! Tapu mofu de!” Ma pe fu dati, ne ai bali moo taanga taki: “Bakaten Manpikin fu Kownu Dafeti paansu! Gaantangi, yeepi mi, baa?”
eng_text: Those who led the way rebuked him, that he should be quiet; but he cried out all the more, "You son of David, have mercy on me!"

djk_text: Ne di Masaa Jesesi seefi yee a bali, ne a taampu. Ne a taigi den sama taki, meke den go teke a man tyai kon gi en. Ne den go teke a man tyai kon a Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: Standing still, Jesus commanded him to be brought to him. When he had come near, he asked him,

djk_text: Ne di a kon, ne Masaa Jesesi akisi en taki: “Man! San meke yu e bali kai mi so? San i wani mi du gi yu?” Ne a man piki Masaa Jesesi taki: “Masaa! Mi wani i yeepi mi deesi mi ain, fu mi sa si sani baka.”
eng_text: What do you want me to do? He said, "Lord, that I may see again."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi en taki: “A bun! Si bun baka! Bika a biibi di i poti a Masaa Gadu yeepi yu.”
eng_text: Jesus said to him, "Receive your sight. Your faith has healed you."

djk_text: We, di Masaa Jesesi taki so, ne wanten a man ain kiin kelle, ne a bigin fu si sani bunbun baka. Ne ai waka a Masaa Jesesi baka, e gafa Masaa Gadu, fu a bun di a du gi en. Da ala den sama di si san pasa, e gafa Masaa Gadu tu.
eng_text: Immediately he received his sight, and followed him, glorifying God. All the people, when they saw it, praised God.

djk_text: Ne bakadati, ne Masaa Jesesi waka go miti Jelikow Foto fu waka pasa go a Jelusalem.
eng_text: He entered and was passing through Jericho.

djk_text: Da wan guduman den be e kai Sakeyosi be e tan a Jelikow Foto, a pe Masaa Jesesi be e waka pasa. Sakeyosi na be wan edeman fu den man di be e piki lantimoni. Da di Masaa Jesesi be e kon waka pasa, ne a be e feti fu a be sa si Masaa Jesesi. Ma a á be poi si en a ini den somen sama ini. Bika a be satu.
eng_text: There was a man named Zacchaeus. He was a chief tax collector, and he was rich.

djk_text: Ne a lon go a den sama fesi a pe den be o waka pasa. Ne a subi go a ini wan figasii bon fu a be sa si Masaa Jesesi, te a be o waka pasa de.
eng_text: He ran on ahead, and climbed up into a sycamore tree to see him, for he was to pass that way.

djk_text: Da di Masaa Jesesi e waka pasa, ne a opo ede luku tapu, ne a si Sakeyosi a ini a bon. Ne a kai en ne en nen taki: “Sakeyosi! Saka kon a doti wanten. Bika tide mi mu kon a yu osu.”
eng_text: When Jesus came to the place, he looked up and saw him, and said to him, "Zacchaeus, hurry and come down, for today I must stay at your house."

djk_text: Ne wanten wanten, ne Sakeyosi saka komoto a ini a bon kon a doti. Ne a tyai Masaa Jesesi anga gaan poolo anga piisii go ne en osu.
eng_text: He hurried, came down, and received him joyfully.

djk_text: Ma a sani di Masaa Jesesi du ya á bun gi den taa sama seefi. Den ati boon. Bika den taki Masaa Jesesi go na a takuu ati man ya osu.
eng_text: When they saw it, they all murmured, saying, "He has gone in to lodge with a man who is a sinner."

djk_text: Ne Sakeyosi taampu a den sama fesi, ne a taigi Masaa Jesesi taki: “Masaa! Mi sa paati mi gudu a mindii, da mi gi den pootiman fu a kondee wan se. Da efu mi be akisi wan sama lantimoni ipi tumisi, da mi sa gi en fo toon moo ipi moo enke san mi be teke ne en.”
eng_text: Zacchaeus stood and said to the Lord, "Behold, Lord, half of my goods I give to the poor. If I have wrongfully exacted anything of anyone, I restore four times as much."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Masaa Gadu gi den sama fu a osu ya paadon tide, fu ala takuudu anga ogii. Mi be musu kon a Sakeyosi tide. Bika en na wan bakaten pikin fu wi avo gaansama Abalaham paansu tu. Sakeyosi be lasi pasi fu den sani di a be e du, ma fanafu tide a daai kon a Masaa Gadu baka.
eng_text: Jesus said to him, "Today, salvation has come to this house, because he also is a son of Abraham.

djk_text: Bika a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya, kon fu suku den sowtu sama ya, di lasi Masaa Gadu pasi tyai kon a Masaa Gadu baka.”
eng_text: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save that which was lost."

djk_text: Ma namo, da Masaa Jesesi be koosube anga Jelusalem Foto. Na dati meke somen sama di be e waka ne en baka fu go a Jelusalem be denki taki, a á be o langa moo fosi Masaa Gadu puu Islayeli a den feyanti fi en ondoo. Namo, ne a teke wan ageisi toli gi den, fu soi den taki, a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu ná o kon enke fa den e pakisei de.
eng_text: As they heard these things, he went on and told a parable, because he was near Jerusalem, and they supposed that the Kingdom of God would be revealed immediately.

djk_text: A taki: “Wan sama fu wan bun famii be go a wan faawe kondee, fu den poti en toon kownu. Da te den poti en toon kownu kaba, da a be o daai go ne en kondee baka.
eng_text: He said therefore, "A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom, and to return.

djk_text: Ne fosi a gwe, ne a kai tin fu den wookoman fi en kon. Ne den kon. Ne a gi iniiwan fu den wan miliyun kolu taki: ‘U teke a moni ya. Da u wooko anga en, meke a puu wini kon moo ipi, fu te mi o daai kon baka, fu mi fende wini fi en.’ Ne a basi gi den a moni, ne a gwe.
eng_text: He called ten servants of his, and gave them ten mina coins, and told them, 'Conduct business until I come.'

djk_text: Ma den sama fi en kondee be buuse en tee, den sende mofu gi den sama fu a taa kondee taki, den á wani meke a man toon kownu fu den kondee, fu taki fu den.
eng_text: But his citizens hated him, and sent an envoy after him, saying, 'We don't want this man to reign over us.'

djk_text: “Ma toku den sama fu a taa kondee poti a man toon kownu. Ne di den poti en toon kownu, ne a daai gwe baka ne en kondee fu tii a kondee. Ne di a go, ne a sende kai den wookoman fi en di a be gi a moni fu wooko puu wini gi en. Ne den man kon. Ne kownu akisi den taki: ‘Man a moni di mi be fika gi u, fa u wooko anga en? Onmen wini u meke a tapu?’
eng_text:

djk_text: Da bakadati, ne Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en waka go doo a Jelusalem.
eng_text: Having said these things, he went on ahead, going up to Jerusalem.

djk_text: Da di den doo koosube fu a Oleifi Mongo na a pisi fu Betifage anga Betaniya, ne Masaa Jesesi taigi tu bakaman fi en taki:

djk_text: Ne den tu bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi go enke fa a sende den. Ne den si ala sani enke fa a be taigi den.
eng_text: Those who were sent went away, and found things just as he had told them.

djk_text: Ne den go fu losi en. Namo, den sama di abi a buliki, si di den e losi en. Ne den bali akisi den taki: “San e pasa? Pe u e go anga en?”
eng_text: As they were untying the colt, its owners said to them, "Why are you untying the colt?"

djk_text: Ne den tu man piki den taki: “Nono! A ná fu wi. Ma na Masaa abi en fanowdu.” Ne den sama taki: “A bun! U sa tyai en go.” Da na so den tyai a pikin buliki go gi Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: They said, "The Lord needs it."

djk_text: Ne den waka, te den go doo anga en. Ne den baala koosi na a buliki mindii baka. Ne Masaa Jesesi go sidon na a buliki tapu.
eng_text: They brought it to Jesus. They threw their cloaks on the colt, and set Jesus on them.

djk_text: Ne den bigin fu waka go a Jelusalem. Ne somen sama baala koosi na a gaan pasi mindii a doti, fu Masaa Jesesi lei pasa anga a buliki.
eng_text: As he went, they spread their cloaks in the way.

djk_text: Da di den doo koosube fu subi a mongo, ne den sama di be e waka ne en baka e piisii te, den e bali baaya e singi, e gafa Masaa Gadu, fu den gaan foondoo sani di den si Masaa Jesesi du a goontapu.
eng_text: As he was now getting near, at the descent of the Mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works which they had seen,

djk_text: Den e singi taki: “Seigi fu a Kownu di e kon a ini a nen fu Masaa. I poti ati switi makandii a tapu anda! I mu kisi gaandi, te doo na a moo hei peesi a tapu anda!”
eng_text: saying, "Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord! Peace in heaven, and glory in the highest!"

djk_text: Ma di den Faliseiman yee fa den sama e bali e singi, e opo Masaa Jesesi, ne a sani á bun gi den. Ne den taigi Masaa Jesesi taki: “Mesiti! Bali den sama fi i, meke den tapu den mofu de.”
eng_text: Some of the Pharisees from the multitude said to him, "Teacher, rebuke your disciples!"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “U aliki mi bun! Efu den sama ya tapu den mofu, da den siton di de a sikin pasi o bali a den sama ya peesi. Bika a bali ya musu fu bali.”
eng_text: He answered them, "I tell you that if these were silent, the stones would cry out."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi go te a koosube fu Jelusalem. Ne a opo ede luku a kondee. Ne tyali fu a kondee kisi en te a bali kee.
eng_text: When he drew near, he saw the city and wept over it,

djk_text: Ne a taki: “Oho! Sama fu Jelusalem! Efu u be sabi san di be sa yeepi u na a yuu ya, fu u be fende boo, da u á be o libi so. Ma nownow a lati gi u kaba.
eng_text: saying, "If you, even you, had known today the things which belong to your peace! But now, they are hidden from your eyes.

djk_text: Wanlo ogii dei de a fesi e kon, di den feyanti fu u o kon lontu a kondee fu u, poti a dyali. Da u o fika na a kondee ganda de. Ná wan fu u o fende pasi komoto a ini a kondee kon a doo.
eng_text: For the days will come on you, when your enemies will throw up a barricade against you, surround you, hem you in on every side,

djk_text: Da na ape u o de e pina, e sitaafu fu te den kii u anga ala den pikin fu u fiya. Ala den osu di u si meke anga siton de, den o booko te a doti petee. Bika Masaa Gadu be gi u a okasi fu u teke a yeepi di a wani yeepi u, ma kweti u á teke en. U meke a pasa gwe.”
eng_text: and will dash you and your children within you to the ground. They will not leave in you one stone on another, because you didn't know the time of your visitation."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi go a ini a Mama Keliki fu den Dyu. Ne di a go a ini, ne a yaki den sama di e seli sani poti a doo.
eng_text: He entered into the temple, and began to drive out those who bought and sold in it,

djk_text: Ne a taigi den: “Masaa Gadu Buku sikiifi taki: ‘A osu fu Masaa Gadu mu de wan osu pe sama e kon makandii, fu begi.’ Ma san u e meke Gadu osu toon? U e meke a toon wan osu fu fufuuman.”
eng_text: saying to them, "It is written, 'My house is a house of prayer,' but you have made it a 'den of robbers'!"

djk_text: Da, ala dei Masaa Jesesi be e de a ini a Mama Keliki e leli sama Masaa Gadu wowtu. Da den moo hei begiman anga den leliman fu Dyuweiti anga den gaansama fu Islayeli Kondee be e suku namo, fu fende wan fasi fu kii en puu a pasi.
eng_text: He was teaching daily in the temple, but the chief priests and the scribes and the leading men among the people sought to destroy him.

djk_text: Ma den á sabi fa fu den du fu kii en. Bika ala sama be lobi e go ne en, go e aliki Masaa Gadu wowtu.
eng_text: They couldn't find what they might do, for all the people hung on to every word that he said.

djk_text: Da wan dei, da Masaa Jesesi be de a ini a Mama Keliki e leli den sama Masaa Gadu wowtu, e gi den a Bun Nyunsu. Ne den leliman fu Dyuweiti anga den moo hei begiman anga gaansama fu kondee kon ne en.
eng_text: It happened on one of those days, as he was teaching the people in the temple and preaching the Good News, that the priests and scribes came to him with the elders.

djk_text: Ne den akisi en taki: “Fa yu e du den sani sani ya, sama sende yu seefi? Sama gi yu pasi fu du den?”
eng_text: They asked him, "Tell us: by what authority do you do these things? Or who is giving you this authority?"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “A bun, mi yee san u akisi mi. Ma miseefi wani akisi u wan sani, fosi mi piki u. Da efu u piki mi, da mi sa taigi u tu, sama gi mi pasi fu du den sani di mi e du.”
eng_text: He answered them, "I also will ask you one question. Tell me:

djk_text: Ne a akisi den taki: “U taigi mi! Johanisi a Dopuman, na Masaa Gadu be sende en fu dopu sama, ofu na libisama be sende en?”
eng_text: the baptism of John, was it from heaven, or from men?"

djk_text: Ne den daai luku denseefi san fu den piki. Ne den bende a se. Ne den taki saafi anga denseefi taki: “Efu u piki taki: ‘Na Gadu be sende en,’ da a o akisi u taki: ‘Saide meke u á be wani biibi en?’
eng_text: They reasoned with themselves, saying, "If we say, 'From heaven,' he will say, 'Why didn't you believe him?'

djk_text: Ma efu u piki en tu taki: ‘Na libisama be sende en,’ da den sama fu a kondee o naki wi kii anga siton. Bika den sama be teke Johanisi enke wan apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: But if we say, 'From men,' all the people will stone us, for they are persuaded that John was a prophet."

djk_text: A dati meke den piki taki: “Wi á sabi sama be gi Johanisi pasi fu du den sani de.”
eng_text: They answered that they didn't know where it was from.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “We, da mi ná o taigi u tu, sama gi mi pasi fu du den sani ya.”
eng_text: Jesus said to them, "Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi gi den ete wan ageisi toli taki: “Wan sama koti wan gaan goon fi en. Ne di a kaba koti en, ne a paandi en, te a kaba anga wan sii den e kai doloifi. Di a kaba paandi a goon, ne a yuu en gi taa paandi goonman.
eng_text: He began to tell the people this parable. "A man planted a vineyard, and rented it out to some farmers, and went into another country for a long time.

djk_text: Bika a be o gwe a taa kondee fu onmen yali. Ne a de anda te, di den doloifi lepi, ne a sende wan wookoman fi en, fu go fu den gi en afu fu a doloifi, fu a tyai kon gi en. Ma di a wookoman go, ne den man kisi en, ne den fonmi en te a fon, ne den sende en gwe anga soso ana ne en basi baka.
eng_text: At the proper season, he sent a servant to the farmers to collect his share of the fruit of the vineyard. But the farmers beat him, and sent him away empty.

djk_text: Ne a goonman sende wan taa wookoman go. Ma disi yaaso, na a seefi. Den fonmi en te a fon, kosi en te a kosi, ne den sende en gwe baka ne en basi anga soso ana.
eng_text: He sent yet another servant, and they also beat him, and treated him shamefully, and sent him away empty.

djk_text: Ne a masaa fu a goon sende ete wan wookoman fi en go, di fu meke dii. Ma disi moo ogii. Den fonmi en koti en hii sikin, ne den yaki en puu de sende gwe.
eng_text: He sent yet a third, and they also wounded him, and threw him out.

djk_text: “Ne a masaa fu a goon taki a ini enseefi taki: ‘San mi mu du moo? We, mi o sende awan kodo lobi manpikin fu mi go. Bika disi na mi manpikin, da den musu abi lesipeki fi en.’
eng_text: The lord of the vineyard said, 'What shall I do? I will send my beloved son. It may be that seeing him, they will respect him.'

djk_text: “Ma di den si a manpikin fu a masaa e kon, ne den pakisei taki: ‘A ná a pikin fu a masaa di yuu a goon gi u e kon de, no? Ne en ai! Meke u kii en, bika te a masaa ná o de moo, da na a manpikin ya, a o fika a goon gi. Ma efu u kii en, da a goon o kon toon fu wi.’
eng_text:
But when the farmers saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, 'This is the heir. Come, let's kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.'
2599	Ne di a manpikin kon doo, ne den kisi en, ne den iti en puu a ini a goon, ne den naki en kii.”	2599	They threw him out of the vineyard, and killed him. What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do to them?
2600	Ne Masaa Jesesi akisi den taki: “San u denki a basi fu a goon o du di a o yee taki, den kii a manpikin fi en tu? Enseefi o go luku en goon, no? Ne enseefi o go! Da a o kii ala den yuuman fu a goon, da a yuu a goon gi taa sama.” Ne den sama bali taki: “Nono! Noiti a sani ya mu pasa so!”	2600	He will come and destroy these farmers, and will give the vineyard to others. When they heard it, they said, "May it never be!"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi luku den dunn, ne a taigi den taki: “We, a o pasa so tuu. Bika a sikiifi a Masaa Gadu Buku taki: ‘Disi na a siton di meseeman be oli fu wan soso sani. Na dati daai kon toon a siton futu fu a hii osu.’ ”
eng_text: But he looked at them, and said, "Then what is this that is written, 'The stone which the builders rejected, the same was made the chief cornerstone?'

djk_text: Ne a taigi den taki: “Da a sama di o kai na a siton ya tapu, o booko en sikin. Ma efu a siton seefi kai a i tapu, da a o masi yu fini fini.”
eng_text: Everyone who falls on that stone will be broken to pieces, but it will crush whomever it falls on to dust."

djk_text: Da den hei apaiti begiman anga den leliman fu Dyuweiti fusutan kiinkiin taki, na den a poti na ageisi toli de so. Na dati meke den be e suku fu kisi en go sooto wanten. Ma den be feele den somen sama di be de ape. Na dati ede meke den fika en, ne den gwe.
eng_text: The chief priests and the scribes sought to lay hands on him that very hour, but they feared the people--for they knew he had spoken this parable against them.

djk_text: Ma den e waki en namo on ten a o taki wan sani, fu den go kaagi en meke a Loma lanti sooto en. Na so den sende wantu sama go ne en. Da te den go, da den mu du enke den na bunbun sama. Da den mu suku en mofu, fu a taki sani fu den fende en go kaagi en na a Loma gaaman.
eng_text: They watched him, and sent out spies, who pretended to be righteous, that they might trap him in something he said, so as to deliver him up to the power and authority of the governor.

djk_text: Ne den go a Masaa Jesesi, ne den taigi en taki: “Mesiti! U sabi taki den sani di yu e taki na tuutuu sani. Yu na wan kiinkiin sama. Yu e soi libisama fa Masaa Gadu wani den libi. Yu ná abi toobi anga san libisama e taki.
eng_text: They asked him, "Teacher, we know that you say and teach what is right, and aren't partial to anyone, but truly teach the way of God.

djk_text: Ma u kon fu akisi yu wan sani. Taigi u, efu a de fanowdu fu u pai a moo gaan kownu a Loma Foto, a lantimoni.”
eng_text: Is it lawful for us to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?"

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi be sabi kaba taki, na suku den kon suku en mofu fu a taki sani fu den fende en kii. Ne a taigi den taki: “U tyai wan moni kon gi mi, osi?” Ne den tyai a moni kon gi en. Ne a akisi den taki: “Sama fesi anga nen de na a moni ya tapu?” Ne den piki taki: “Na a gaan kownu fu Loma fesi anga en nen de ne en tapu.”
eng_text: But he perceived their craftiness, and said to them, "Why do you test me?

djk_text: Ne a taigi den taki: “We, efu na a moo gaan kownu a Loma Foto fesi, anga en nen de ne en tapu, da na fu a gaan kownu de. Da gi a gaan kownu de san de fu a gaan kownu de. Ma u mu gi Masaa Gadu san na fu Gadu.”
eng_text: He said to them, "Then give to Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and to God the things that are God's."

djk_text: Da a foondoo den fu a fasi fa Masaa Jesesi piki den. Den de pii. Den á sabi san fu piki en moo. A sani di den be kon fu du a puu ná wan wini gi den.
eng_text: They weren't able to trap him in his words before the people. They marveled at his answer, and were silent.

djk_text: Ne bakadati, ne wantu sama fu a keliki kulu di den e kai Saduseiman kon a Masaa Jesesi. Den Saduseisama na sama di nái biibi taki te wan sama dede a sa weki baka.
eng_text: Some of the Sadducees came to him, those who deny that there is a resurrection.

djk_text: Namo den taigi Masaa Jesesi taki: “We, Mesiti oo! Masaa Gadu be meke Mosesi sikiifi wan weiti gi wi taki: ‘Efu wan man libi anga wan uman, ne a dede sondee fu meke pikin anga a uman, da a baka baala fu a man mu libi anga a uman fu meke pikin gi a baala di dede, fu en nen á sa kaba a goontapu.’ Na so a weiti fu Mosesi e leli wi.
eng_text: They asked him, "Teacher, Moses wrote to us that if a man's brother dies having a wife, and he is childless, his brother should take the wife, and raise up children for his brother.

djk_text: Ma namo, da seibin baala be de. A moo gaanwan libi anga wan uman te a dede, a á meke ná wankodo pikin anga a uman.
eng_text: There were therefore seven brothers. The first took a wife, and died childless.

djk_text: Ne a pikin baala di waka ne en baka teke a uman libi. Ma enseefi dede, sondee fu meke wan pikin anga en.
eng_text: The second took her as wife, and he died childless.

djk_text: Da na so ala den seibin baala libi anga a uman, te ala den dede. Ná wan di meke wankodo pikin anga en.
eng_text: The third took her, and likewise the seven all left no children, and died.

djk_text: Ne, kaba kaba fu dati, ne a uman seefi dede tu. We, Masaa, u wani akisi yu disi. ‘Te a yuu o doo fu den dedesama opo komoto a dede, da on di fu den seibin baala ya o abi a uman? Bika ala den seibin baala be libi anga en.’ ”
eng_text: Afterward the woman also died.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “U á sabi san u e akisi. Bika na goontapu ya wawan uman anga man libi de.
eng_text: Jesus said to them, "The children of this age marry, and are given in marriage.

djk_text: Uman anga man libi á de a Masaa Gadu Kondee anda. Bika den sama di de a Masaa Gadu a tapu anda, kon de enke den Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee . Den nái dede moo. Soseefi den nái libi anga uman anga man, fu meke pikin moo, fu fika paansu a baka. Bika den sama di de anda, na Masaa Gadu pikin. Da den dede weki kaba, fu libi tego anga Masaa Gadu. Da na den sama di Masaa Gadu si taki, fiti a libi fu tego, na den a o gi a libi de.
eng_text: But those who are considered worthy to attain to that age and the resurrection from the dead, neither marry, nor are given in marriage.

djk_text: Bika a sikiifi kiinkiin a den buku fu Mosesi taki, den dedesama o opo baka kon a libi ya. Bika, di a gi a toli fu a katuku, a taki: ‘Masaa na a Gadu fu Abalaham, Isaki anga Jakopu.’
eng_text: But that the dead are raised, even Moses showed at the bush, when he called the Lord 'The God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.'

djk_text: Masaa Gadu a ná wan Gadu fu dedesama, ma na wan Gadu fu sama di e libi.”
eng_text: Now he is not the God of the dead, but of the living, for all are alive to him."

djk_text: Ne wan leliman fu Dyuweiti dyombo piki en taki: “Mesiti, san di i taki de na tuu! Yu abi leti!”
eng_text: Some of the scribes answered, "Teacher, you speak well."

djk_text: Ne fanafu a ten de, ne ná wan sama abi deki ati moo fu akisi en sani.
eng_text: They didn't dare to ask him any more questions.

djk_text: Da, di Masaa Jesesi de a ini a Mama Keliki e leli den sama, te wan pisi, ne a akisi den sama taki: “Fa den leliman fu Dyuweiti sa leli u taki, a Kelestesi na Bakaten Manpikin fu Kownu Dafeti paansu namo, da a kaba?
eng_text: He said to them, "Why do they say that the Christ is David's son?

djk_text: We, na so a de tuu! Ma Dafeti seefi sikiifi wan sani a wan pisi fu Masaa Gadu Buku. A sikiifi taki: ‘Masaa Gadu taigi mi Masaa taki: “Sidon a mi leti ana se ya,
eng_text: David himself says in the book of Psalms, 'The Lord said to my Lord, "Sit at my right hand,

djk_text: te enke mi meke ala den feyanti fi yu toon yu futu bangi.” ’
eng_text: until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet."'

djk_text: Da efu Kelestesi na wan bakaten manpikin fu Kownu Dafeti paansu namo, da i denki taki, Kownu Dafeti be o kai en bakaten pikin, ‘Masaa?’ ”
eng_text: David therefore calls him Lord, so how is he his son?

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi bali den bakaman fi en a den somen sama fesi taki:
eng_text: In the hearing of all the people, he said to his disciples,

djk_text: “U mu luku bun anga den leliman fu Dyuweiti. Den lobi wei gaan moi langa dii yapon e waka e lontu kondee, fu sama mu si den. Da te den e waka a den wowoyo peesi, den lobi te den sama e gi den odi anga gaan lesipeki. Te den de a ini den Dyu keliki den lobi sidon, te a fesi enke bigiman. Soseefi den e suku a moo bun peesi, te den sidon a tafaa fu nyan. Na so den e poti denseefi enke bunbun sama kaba.
eng_text:
Beware of the scribes, who like to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the marketplaces, the best seats in the synagogues, and the best places at feasts;
2628	Ma u mu luku bun, fu u á teke a fasi fu den fu libi. Bika den e teke ala sani fu den pooti uman di man dede fika a ganda. Te anga den osu fu den uman ya seefi den e teke. Da anga a takuu ya, den e komoto e go e begi gaan langa begi, fu sama mu si fa den bunbun kisi. We, den sama ya o kisi a moo gaan sitaafu fu Masaa Gadu.”	2628	who devour widows' houses, and for a pretense make long prayers: these will receive greater condemnation.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi opo ede luku a baki di den sama e poti moni a keliki. Ne a si fa den guduman e poti moni a ini a baki.
eng_text: He looked up, and saw the rich people who were putting their gifts into the treasury.

djk_text: Di den poti te wan pisi, ne Masaa Jesesi si wan pooti uman di á be abi man moo, poti tu kopoo sensi go a ini a baki.
eng_text: He saw a certain poor widow casting in two small brass coins.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi luku a sani te a kaba, ne a taigi den bakaman fi en taki: “U si a pooti uman de? A poti tu kopoo sensi namo go a ini a baki, ma a poti ipi moo ala den taawan di poti.
eng_text: He said, "Truly I tell you, this poor widow put in more than all of them,

djk_text: Bika den guduman poti a sakasaka di den á be abi fanowdu. Ma a uman ya poti ala san a be abi fu nyan. A á kibii ná wan kopoo sensi fi enseefi.”
eng_text: for all these put in gifts for God from their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, put in all that she had to live on."

djk_text: Da, di Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en komoto a ini a Mama Keliki, ne wantu fu den bakaman fi en taki: “Luku fa a Mama Keliki moi. Den siton di den meke en bigi. Da den tembee den siton sikin te a moi. Den wei den anga paiman di sama be pai Masaa Gadu de.”
eng_text: As some were talking about the temple and how it was decorated with beautiful stones and gifts, he said,

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Weeno! Na so a de tuu. Ala den siton di u e si de, wanten o kon, di ná wan fu den siton ya o taampu a taawan tapu de moo. Ala den fiya o lulu paati paati.”
eng_text: As for these things which you see, the days will come, in which there will not be left here one stone on another that will not be thrown down.

djk_text: Ne den akisi en taki: “We, Masaa, na on ten a sani de o pasa? Da san na a maiki di wi o si taki, a yuu doo fu sowan sani pasa?”
eng_text: They asked him, "Teacher, so when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are about to happen?"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “U mu luku bun anga useefi, fu sama á koli u kisi puu na a biibi. Bika somen sama o opo teke mi nen, fu e koli sama taki, na den na a Kelestesi, a Kownu di Masaa Gadu be paamisi goontapu. Da den o koli somen sama kisi. Taawan o kon taigi u taki, a ten doo kaba. Ma u á mu biibi san den o taigi u.
eng_text: He said, "Watch out that you don't get led astray, for many will come in my name, saying, 'I am he ,' and, 'The time is at hand.' Therefore don't follow them.

djk_text: Da, te u yee taki, gaan oloku feti e bali a peesi, da u á mu feele. U á mu buuya! Den sani ya musu fu pasa fosi. Ma te den sani ya e pasa, da u á mu si enke na a kaba fu goontapu doo kaba.
eng_text: When you hear of wars and disturbances, don't be terrified, for these things must happen first, but the end won't come immediately."

djk_text: Bika u o yee taki, wan kondee kondee a goontapu o opo feti anga denseefi. Kownu kondee o opo feti anga denseefi.
eng_text: Then he said to them, "Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom.

djk_text: Da doti o seke piiti kii sama a somen pisi fu goontapu. Da gaan angiiten o kon a goontapu tu. Soseefi takuu siki o kon a goontapu kon e kii ala sowtu sama. Gaansama anga pikinengee. Somen somen gaan takuu sani o pasa na ala se fu goontapu. Te a tapu a den woluku seefi gaan maiki o de fu si. Da den sani ya o meke ala sama feele.
eng_text: There will be great earthquakes, famines, and plagues in various places. There will be terrors and great signs from heaven.

djk_text: “Ma fosi ala den sani ya pasa, da den o lon a u baka, suku fu kii u. Den o kisi u tyai go a den keliki osu fu den, a kuutu. Somen fu u den o kisi sooto a dunguu osu. Soseefi den o kisi u tyai go a fesi fu den kownu anga den tiiman fu kondee, fu kuutu u fu di u e waka a mi baka.
eng_text: But before all these things, they will lay their hands on you and will persecute you, delivering you up to synagogues and prisons, bringing you before kings and governors for my name's sake.

djk_text: Da u mu teke den okasi ya, fu taigi ala sama fu saide u e biibi a Bun Nyunsu fu mi.
eng_text: It will turn out as a testimony for you.

djk_text: Ma, te den kisi u fu tyai go a kuutu, da u á mu booko u ede san u o taki.
eng_text: Settle it therefore in your hearts not to meditate beforehand how to answer,

djk_text: Bika miseefi o gi u den leti taki fu u taki a yuu de. Mi o gi u fusutan, fu piki ala san den o akisi u. Da te u piki den te u kaba, da ná wan fu den di o fende wan sani fu taki moo.
eng_text: for I will give you a mouth and wisdom which all your adversaries will not be able to withstand or to contradict.

djk_text: Da u dda anga mma anga u baala anga u famii anga den mati fu u, o tyai o go seli gi den ogii ati sama fu kii. Da den o kii son wan fu u.
eng_text: You will be handed over even by parents, brothers, relatives, and friends. They will cause some of you to be put to death.

djk_text: Soseefi ala sama o abi ogii ati fu u, fu di u de fu mi ede.
eng_text: You will be hated by all men for my name's sake.

djk_text: Ma u á feele. Bika sama di o tei ati fu oli doo, da ná wan uwii fi en ede sa lasi. Awinsi u dede seefi, toku u sa opo baka fende a libi fu tego a Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: And not a hair of your head will perish.

djk_text: Ne a taigi den go doo taki: “Te u si taki suudati fu taa kondee kon feti anga Jelusalem, lontu den poti a dyali, da u mu sabi taki, a ten doo fu den feti booko en kaba anga en a soso.
eng_text:
But when you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies, then know that its desolation is at hand.
2648	Da den sama di de a Judeja mu lon go kibii a den gaan mongo mindii. Den sama di de a kondee ganda mu lon komoto de. Den sama di de a ini goon e wooko, á mu daai go a kondee moo. Den mu lon.	2648	Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains. Let those who are in the midst of her depart. Let those who are in the country not enter therein.
2649	Bika na a yuu de, da Masaa Gadu o sitaafu Jelusalem tuutuu, enke fa a be meke den apaiti takiman fi en be taki a fesi kaba.	2649	For these are days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.
2650	“Da a ten de o takuu seefi gi den uman di de anga bee anga den uman di de anga pikin na ana. Bika na so wan gaan ibi sitaafu o kon na a kondee. Masaa Gadu o puu en atiboon a den tapu.	2650	Woe to those who are pregnant and to those who nurse infants in those days! For there will be great distress in the land, and wrath to this people.
2651	Somen fu den sama den o kii anga fetihow. Da taawan den o kisi tyai go panya na ala se fu goontapu. Da den o teke Jelusalem fu den e du anga en enke fa den wani. Da den doose kondee sama o tan a Jelusalem, fu te a ten di Masaa Gadu be poti gi den doo, da a sa puu den de.”	2651	They will fall by the edge of the sword, and will be led captive into all the nations. Jerusalem will be trampled down by the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled.
2652	Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den go doo taki: “Da na a yuu de, te a gaan sitaafu anga pina pasa, da den sama o si gaan maiki a tapu, a den woluku, na a san anga a mun anga den sitali. Da a ze wataa fu goontapu ya o seke e meke balibali, te ala sama fu hii goontapu o feele gaan feele.	2652	There will be signs in the sun, moon, and stars; and on the earth anxiety of nations, in perplexity for the roaring of the sea and the waves;
2653	Da libisama o feele te, den ná o sabi fa fu du, fu di den e si dede a den fesi. Bika den á sabi san e kon a goontapu. Da tapu a den woluku o seke te, ala den sani a tapu anda seefi o seke.	2653	men fainting for fear, and for expectation of the things which are coming on the world: for the powers of the heavens will be shaken.
2654	Da bakadati, da ala sama o si a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya e kon a tapu, a den woluku ini anga gaan taanga anga a dyendee fasi di e beenki.	2654	Then they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.
2655	Da, te u si den sani ya bigin pasa, da u mu de sabi sabi taki, a yuu di den o puu u a ini a gaan pina de koosube.”	2655	But when these things begin to happen, look up, and lift up your heads, because your redemption is near.

djk_text: Namo a teke wan ageisi toli gi den taki: “U denki wan figasii bon. Te u si taki, ai piiti boomiki, da u sabi kaba taki, a o meke nyanyan dyonson.
eng_text: He told them a parable. "See the fig tree, and all the trees.

djk_text: We, da na soseefi, te u si den sani di mi taigi u ya bigin e pasa, da u mu sabi taki, a yuu doo fu a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu kon a goontapu.
eng_text: Even so you also, when you see these things happening, know that the Kingdom of God is near.

djk_text: Da u fusutan mi bun. Te u si den sani ya e pasa, da u mu sabi taki, a kaba fu a yuu ten fu goontapu di u e libi de koosube. Da mi e taigi u taki, a paansu fu den sama ya, ná o kaba a goontapu fosi den sani ya pasa.
eng_text: Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all things are accomplished.

djk_text: Tapu a den woluku anga a goontapu pe u de ya o lasi go kaba a soso, ma mi wowtu di mi taki, ná o lasi ná wan ten.”
eng_text: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will by no means pass away.

djk_text: Ne a taki gi den baka taki: “U mu de kaba kaba fu miti mi. U á mu booko u ede anga solugu fu a goontapu ya. U á mu de a yayo libi, te u feegete taki mi o kon. U á mu de ape e duungu te, da a dei kon kisi u sondee fu u poti pakisei. Da u mu luku bun! Bika a dei ya o kon. Da winsi pe i de a o kisi yu namo.
eng_text:
So be careful, or your hearts will be loaded down with carousing, drunkenness, and cares of this life, and that day will come on you suddenly.
2661	A dati meke, u mu e begi Masaa Gadu naamo, fu a gi u kaakiti fu u oli a biibi go doo. U mu begi en fu a yeepi u, fu pasa ala den sani di mi kai de, sondee fu u lasi a biibi fu u. Da, te u oli a biibi doo, da u sa taampu na a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya, fesi.”	2661	Therefore be watchful all the time, praying that you may be counted worthy to escape all these things that will happen, and to stand before the Son of Man.

djk_text: Da na so Masaa Jesesi be e go na a Mama Keliki ala dei, go leli den sama Masaa Gadu wowtu. Mamanten a be e leli den, te sapaten, da a be e komoto a Jelusalem, go siibi na a Oleifi Mongo enke fa a be gwenti.
eng_text: Every day Jesus was teaching in the temple, and every night he would go out and spend the night on the mountain that is called Olivet.

djk_text: Da te mamanten, da a be e daai kon baka, fu leli den sama a ini a Mama Keliki.
eng_text: All the people came early in the morning to him in the temple to hear him.

djk_text: Da a fesa fu den Islayeli di den e kai Pasika be kon koosube. Na a fesa ya, da den e nyan paata beele di meke sondee sowda.
eng_text: Now the feast of unleavened bread, which is called the Passover, drew near.

djk_text: Da den hei apaiti begiman anga den leliman fu Dyuweiti be e suku wan koni fasi, fu kii Masaa Jesesi. Ma den á poi, bika den be e feele a foluku.
eng_text: The chief priests and the scribes sought how they might put him to death, for they feared the people.

djk_text: Na a seefi yuu de, ne saatan, a didibii go a ini Judasi Iskaliyotu ati ini. Judasi na be wan fu den twalufu bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi tu.
eng_text: Satan entered into Judas, who was surnamed Iscariot, who was numbered with the twelve.

djk_text: Ne a komoto, ne tilo tilo tilo, te a den hei begiman anga den edeman fu suudati di be e oli waki na a Mama Keliki. Ne a taigi den taki: “Mi sa yeepi u, fu u fende Jesesi kisi.”
eng_text: He went away, and talked with the chief priests and captains about how he might deliver him to them.

djk_text: Da di Judasi taigi den so, ne den piisii te den taigi en taki: “Judasi! Efi i yeepi wi kisi en enke fa i taki, wi o pai yu.”
eng_text: They were glad, and agreed to give him money.

djk_text: Da di a yee so, ne a daai gwe baka. Da fanafu a ten de, ne ai meke moiti fu den fende Masaa Jesesi kisi sondee fu a foluku sabi.
eng_text: He consented, and sought an opportunity to deliver him to them in the absence of the multitude.

djk_text: Ne den de, te a dei doo fu den kii a pikin sikapu fu den nyan a piisii ya.
eng_text: The day of unleavened bread came, on which the Passover must be sacrificed.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi sende Peitilisi anga Johanisi taki: “U go seeka boli sani fu u nyan a Pasika.”
eng_text: He sent Peter and John, saying, "Go and prepare the Passover for us, that we may eat."

djk_text: Ne den akisi Masaa Jesesi taki: “Masaa! On se i wani meke u go seeka sani?”
eng_text: They said to him, "Where do you want us to prepare?"

djk_text: Ne a piki den taki: “U go a Jelusalem. Da te u go, da u o si wan man anga wan bungu wataa a pasi. Da u mu waka ne en baka, te na a osu pe ai go. Da te a go a ini a osu, da useefi mu go a ini tu.
eng_text: He said to them, "Behold, when you have entered into the city, a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you. Follow him into the house which he enters.

djk_text: Da u taigi a man di abi a osu taki: ‘A Mesiti sende u, fu akisi yu on pisi a kambaa de, pe en anga den bakaman fi en sa nyan a Pasika Fesa tide neti.’
eng_text: Tell the master of the house, 'The Teacher says to you, "Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?"'

djk_text: Da a o soi u wan gaan kambaa a sodoo. Da ala sani u abi fanowdu fu seeka sani de a ini a kambaa de kaba. Da na ape u mu go seeka sani fu u nyan a Pasika.”
eng_text: He will show you a large, furnished upper room. Make preparations there."

djk_text: Ne den go. Di den doo a kondee, ne den si ala sani enke fa Masaa Jesesi be taigi den. Ne den seeka sani fu a Pasika Fesa.
eng_text: They went, found things as he had told them, and they prepared the Passover.

djk_text: Ne di sapaten, ne Masaa Jesesi anga den taa apaiti bosikopuman fi en kon doo na a osu. Ne ala den go sidon a tafaa fu nyan.
eng_text: When the hour had come, he sat down with the twelve apostles.

djk_text: Da di den sidon e nyan, te wan pisi, ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “Fu tuutuu! Mi e taigi u taki, mi be angii fu nyan a Pasika ya anga u. Bika dyonson, a yuu o doo fu mi tyai a gaan sitaafu di de fu kon a mi tapu.
eng_text: He said to them, "I have earnestly desired to eat this Passover with you before I suffer,

djk_text: Da mi ná o nyan sowan Pasika Fesa anga u moo ete, fu te enke ala den sani di u e membee anga a fesa ya kon pasa. A yuu de, da a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu o doo goontapu.”
eng_text: for I tell you, I will no longer by any means eat of it until it is fulfilled in the Kingdom of God."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi teke a kan win, ne a gi Masaa Gadu daa, ne a gi den bakaman fi en taki: “U luku ya! U teke, da u diingi lontu.
eng_text: He received a cup, and when he had given thanks, he said, "Take this, and share it among yourselves,

djk_text: Bika mi ná o diingi win moo ete, fu te enke a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu doo.”
eng_text: for I tell you, I will not drink at all again from the fruit of the vine, until the Kingdom of God comes."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi teke a beele, ne a gi Masaa Gadu daa, moi te a kaba. Ne a booko en pisipisi, ne a gi den bakaman fi en taki: “U luku ya! Disi na mi sikin di mi e gi fu u ede. Da u du disi fu e membee mi alaten.”
eng_text: He took bread, and when he had given thanks, he broke it, and gave to them, saying, "This is my body which is given for you. Do this in memory of me."

djk_text: Da di den nyan te den kaba, ne a teke a kan win, ne a taigi den taki: “A win ya na mi buulu di sa lon gi somen sama, fu meke den kon de bun gi Masaa Gadu baka. Disi na wan nyun kuudei Masaa Gadu meke anga u, fu di mi buulu o lon gi u. Bika na a buulu fu mi o pai fu ala den somen takuudu anga ogii fu libisama.”
eng_text: Likewise, he took the cup after supper, saying, "This cup is the new covenant in my blood, which is poured out for you.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taki baka taki: “Wan fu u di sidon e nyan anga mi ya, o seli mi gi den ogii ati sama den kii.
eng_text: But behold, the hand of him who betrays me is with me on the table.

djk_text: We, a de so taki, na so a musu fu pasa. Bika Masaa Gadu be fiti a sani ya poti kaba, fu pasa anga a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya. Ma heelu fu a sama di o seli en!”
eng_text: The Son of Man indeed goes, as it has been determined, but woe to that man through whom he is betrayed!"

djk_text: We, di Masaa Jesesi taki so, ne den bakaman e akisi den na den taki: “Sama sa de ya di o seli en so?”
eng_text: They began to question among themselves, which of them it was who would do this thing.

djk_text: Ne a seefi yuu de, ne den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi kisi wan gaan toobi anga denseefi. Den e sitee anga denseefi on di fu den na a moo heiwan a den mindii.
eng_text: There arose also a contention among them, which of them was considered to be greatest.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi kon a den mindii, ne a taigi den taki: “U aliki mi bun. Den kownu fu goontapu ya, e tii den kondee, da den e dwengi libisama fu libi enke fa den wani. Da den e suku fu libisama si den hei moo taa sama.
eng_text: He said to them, "The kings of the nations lord it over them, and those who have authority over them are called 'benefactors.'

djk_text: Ma a sowtu libi de á mu de a u mindii. A sama di e saka enseefi fu dini den taawan, ne en na a moo heiwan na u mindii.
eng_text: But not so with you. But one who is the greater among you, let him become as the younger, and one who is governing, as one who serves.
