djk_text: A ini a goontapu libi, da a basi e sidon a tafaa, da ai meke en wookoman tyai nyanyan kon poti a tafaa gi en. Da a basi di sidon a tafaa, hei moo a wookoman. Ma mi de enke wan wookoman a u mindii e poti nyanyan a tafaa gi u. Na soseefi u mu libi anga useefi tu.”
eng_text: For who is greater, one who sits at the table, or one who serves? Isn't it he who sits at the table? But I am in the midst of you as one who serves.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den bakaman fi en go doo taki: “Na u na den sama di be de anga mi a ini den pina anga gaan banowtu te enke now.
eng_text: But you are those who have continued with me in my trials.

djk_text: We, na fu dati ede meke mi e paamisi u taki, te mi de kownu a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu, da mi o gi u fu taki a libisama tapu. Bika na so mi Tata be paamisi mi taki, a be o gi mi taki a sama tapu. Da na so mi e paamisi u tu. U sa nyan diingi anga mi a tapu anda. Da useefi sa sidon anga mi a kownu sutuu, fu kuutu den twalufu lo sama fu Islayeli Kondee.”
eng_text: I confer on you a kingdom, even as my Father conferred on me,

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi kai Peitilisi, ne a taigi en taki: “Simon! Masaa Gadu gi saatan, a didibii pasi fu a tesi yu. Da a o tesi u leti enke te den e wai alisi puu buba.
eng_text: The Lord said, "Simon, Simon, behold, Satan asked to have you, that he might sift you as wheat,

djk_text: Ma mi begi gi i, fi yu á fika a biibi. Bika yu o buuya fu den sani di o pasa anga mi. Ma te i daai kon baka a biibi, da i mu yeepi den taawan, fu den kon moo taanga a ini biibi.”
eng_text: but I prayed for you, that your faith wouldn't fail. You, when once you have turned again, establish your brothers ."

djk_text: Ne Peitilisi piki en taki: “Nono, Masaa! Efu na dunguu osu yu o go, mi sa go anga yu. Winsi na dede seefi, mi sa dede anga yu.”
eng_text: He said to him, "Lord, I am ready to go with you both to prison and to death!"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Peitilisi! Fu tuu, mi e taigi yu: ‘A neti ya seefi, fosi wan kakafoo bali, da yu o lei dii toon taki, yu á sabi mi.’ ”
eng_text: He said, "I tell you, Peter, the rooster will by no means crow today until you deny that you know me three times."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi akisi den baka taki: “Di mi be sende u go a den kondee kondee, fu go paati a Bun Nyunsu, sondee fu u be tyai moni efu tasi, efu taa susu boiti di u be wei a u futu, u be pina?” Ne den piki en taki: “Nono Masaa! Wi á be pina, fu ná wan sani.”
eng_text: He said to them, "When I sent you out without purse, and wallet, and shoes, did you lack anything?" They said, "Nothing."

djk_text: Ne a taigi den baka taki: “We, u aliki. Te u o go a peesi moo, ma wan fu u abi wan saka, a mu tyai en. Efu wan fu u abi moni, a mu tyai en tu. Efu wan sama ná abi fetihow, meke a seli en impi, da a bai wan bunbun fetihow.
eng_text: Then he said to them, "But now, whoever has a purse, let him take it, and likewise a wallet. Whoever has none, let him sell his cloak, and buy a sword.

djk_text: Bika, Masaa Gadu Buku sikiifi taki: ‘Den teli mi anga den takuu ati sama enke mi anga den na awan.’ Da ala san Masaa Gadu Buku be sikiifi fu mi, a yuu doo, fu ala den mu pasa tuu.”
eng_text: For I tell you that this which is written must still be fulfilled in me: 'He was counted with transgressors.' For that which concerns me has an end."

djk_text: Ne den taigi en taki: “Mesiti! Luku ya! U abi tu fetihow ya kaba.” Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “A sai. Meke u fika a toli fosi.”
eng_text: They said, "Lord, behold, here are two swords." He said to them, "That is enough."

djk_text: Bakadati, ne Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en go na a mongo di den e kai Oleifi Mongo enke fa den be gwenti.
eng_text: He came out, and went, as his custom was, to the Mount of Olives. His disciples also followed him.

djk_text: Ne di den waka te den doo na a Oleifi Mongo, ne a taigi den taki: “U begi Masaa Gadu, fu u á kai a ini den tesi fu didibii, fu a wini u.”
eng_text: When he was at the place, he said to them, "Pray that you don't enter into temptation."

djk_text: Ne a waka go pikinso moo faawe enke pe wan sama sa fiingi wan siton doo. Ne a saka kini a doti, ne a begi Masaa Gadu taki:
eng_text: He was withdrawn from them about a stone's throw, and he knelt down and prayed,

djk_text: “Kee, mi Tata! Mi begi yu, puu a ogii di de fu miti mi ya a pasi gi mi.
eng_text: saying, "Father, if you are willing, remove this cup from me. Nevertheless, not my will, but yours, be done."

djk_text: Ma mi Tata, a ná san mi wani mu pasa. Ma na san yu wani, na dati mu pasa.” Ne a seefi yuu de, ne wan Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee saka komoto a tapu, kon gi en kaakiti.
eng_text: An angel from heaven appeared to him, strengthening him.

djk_text: Ma sani kon ibi gi Masaa Jesesi te, ná sipowtu. Ne a bigin e begi moo taanga te, en sweti daai kon de enke buulu e doopu a doti towtow.
eng_text: Being in agony he prayed more earnestly. His sweat became like great drops of blood falling down on the ground.

djk_text: Di a kaba begi, ne a daai go a den bakaman fi en baka. Da di a daai go a den, ne a si ala den fiya e siibi. Bika, gaan tyali be kisi.
eng_text: When he rose up from his prayer, he came to the disciples, and found them sleeping because of grief,

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “Oho! Na siibi u e siibi so? U tan na ain begi, fu u á kai a ini den tesi fu didibii.”
eng_text: and said to them, "Why do you sleep? Rise and pray that you may not enter into temptation."

djk_text: Da Masaa Jesesi á kaba taki seefi, ne den si wan gaan kulu sama e kon. Judasi, wan fu den twalufu bakaman fi en be e waka a fesi. Ne a waka kon koosube fu Masaa Jesesi, fu a bosi en.
eng_text: While he was still speaking, behold, a multitude, and he who was called Judas, one of the twelve, was leading them. He came near to Jesus to kiss him.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi akisi en taki: “Oho Judasi! Anga wan bosi yu e seli a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya?”
eng_text: But Jesus said to him, "Judas, do you betray the Son of Man with a kiss?"

djk_text: Da di den tyaipi sama kon kaba, ne den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi akisi en taki: “Masaa Jesesi, san i wani meke u du? Bika wi abi fetihow ya!”
eng_text: When those who were around him saw what was about to happen, they said to him, "Lord, shall we strike with the sword?"

djk_text: A yuu di den taawan e akisi de, te fu den denki, ne wan fu den koti a letise yesi fu wan fu den wookoman fu a moo hei begiman falan.
eng_text: A certain one of them struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his right ear.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi bali den taki: “Nono! U kaba!” Ne a go oli a yesi fu a man, ne a kon bun baka.
eng_text: But Jesus answered, "Let me at least do this"--and he touched his ear, and healed him.

djk_text: Ne a akisi den hei apaiti begiman anga den edeman fu suudati di e waki a Mama Keliki anga den gaansama fu kondee taki: “Saide meke u kon anga fetihow anga kodya, fu kon kisi mi enke mi na wan kiiman?
eng_text: Jesus said to the chief priests, captains of the temple, and elders, who had come against him, "Have you come out as against a robber, with swords and clubs?

djk_text: Saide meke u á be kisi mi, di mi be de ibii dei a ini a Mama Keliki e leli sama Masaa Gadu wowtu? Ma a bun! Now, da na a yuu fu u anga didibii doo. Bika ne en abi taki a u tapu nownow.”
eng_text: When I was with you in the temple daily, you didn't stretch out your hands against me. But this is your hour, and the power of darkness."

djk_text: Da di den kisi Masaa Jesesi so kaba, ne den tyai en go na a osu fu a moo hei begiman. Ma, da Peitilisi be e waka te a baka e luku pe den be e tyai en go.
eng_text: They seized him, and led him away, and brought him into the high priest's house. But Peter followed from a distance.

djk_text: Ne den tyai Masaa Jesesi go te na a osu, ne den tyai en go a ini. Ma, da den be meke wan gaan faya. Da somen sama be sidon de e waan faya. Ne di Peitilisi kon a ini a dyali, ne a go sidon e waan faya anga den man ya tu.
eng_text: When they had kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard, and had sat down together, Peter sat among them.

djk_text: Ma namo, da wan fu den uman di e wooko a ini a osu si en de. Ne a uman ya luku en bun, ne a taki: “Hei! A man ya, a ná wan fu den man, fu a man di den tyai kon ya, no?”
eng_text: A certain servant girl saw him as he sat in the light, and looking intently at him, said, "This man also was with him."

djk_text: Ne Peitilisi seke ede taki: “Nono! A ná mi! Mi á sabi a sama di i e taki de wan dei. Sama ne en?”
eng_text: He denied Jesus, saying, "Woman, I don't know him."

djk_text: Ne den de, te wan pisi, ne wan taa sama kon de. Ne a luku Peitilisi, ne a taki: “Ma fa mi e si, a man ya, a musu de wan man fu a man di den tyai kon ya.” Ne Peitilisi piki taki: “Nono, baa! Mi á sabi a man di yu e kai de. Ná lei gi mi, mi á sabi en.”
eng_text: After a little while someone else saw him, and said, "You also are one of them!" But Peter answered, "Man, I am not!"

djk_text: Ne den de, te enke wan sani fu baka wan yuu langa so, ne wan sama opo a taki baka taki: “A man ya! A musu de wan sama fu a man Jesesi. Bika en na wan sama fu Galileya.”
eng_text: After about one hour passed, another confidently affirmed, saying, "Truly this man also was with him, for he is a Galilean!"

djk_text: Ne Peitilisi bali den taki: “U fika mi! Mi á sabi a man di u taki de!” Ne wanten fa i si Peitilisi kaba sitee so, ne a kakafoo bali kokoliyekee.
eng_text: But Peter said, "Man, I don't know what you are talking about!" Immediately, while he was still speaking, a rooster crowed.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi daai luku Peitilisi. Ne a membee wanten fa Masaa Jesesi be taigi en taki: “A neti ya seefi, fosi wan kaka foo bali, yu o lei dii toon, taki yu á sabi mi.”
eng_text: The Lord turned, and looked at Peter. Then Peter remembered the Lord's word, how he said to him, "Before the rooster crows you will deny me three times."

djk_text: Ne a komoto a doo, poti ana a mindii ede bali wan gaan adyumadye.
eng_text: He went out, and wept bitterly.

djk_text: Da, di den tyai Masaa Jesesi go a ini a osu, ne den suudati di be e oli waki ne en e poti en wisiwasi e sipowtu anga en.
eng_text: The men who held Jesus mocked him and beat him.

djk_text: Ne den teke wan koosi, ne den tei en fesi, tapu en ain. Ne den e naki en anga kofu, da den e akisi en taki: “Efi yu na wan apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu tuu, da taigi u sama naki yu, no?”
eng_text: Having blindfolded him, they struck him on the face and asked him, "Prophesy! Who is the one who struck you?"

djk_text: Ne den teke ala sowtu takuu takuu kosi e kosi en, fu te a sai den.
eng_text: They spoke many other things against him, insulting him.

djk_text: Da di a mamanten fi en, ne den gaansama fu Islayeli Kondee anga den moo hei begiman anga den leliman fu Dyuweiti oli wan kuutu, fu Masaa Jesesi ede.
eng_text: As soon as it was day, the assembly of the elders of the people was gathered together, both chief priests and scribes, and they led him away into their council, saying,

djk_text: Ne den akisi Masaa Jesesi taki: “Man, taigi wi! Yu na a kownu di Gadu be paamisi, taki a o sende kon a goontapu?” Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Awansi mi taigi u seefi, u ná o biibi mi.
eng_text: If you are the Christ, tell us. But he said to them, "If I tell you, you won't believe,

djk_text: Soseefi, efu mi akisi u wan sani tu, u ná o piki mi.
eng_text: and if I ask, you will in no way answer me or let me go.

djk_text: Ma a ná o langa moo, fosi a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya, o sidon na a leti ana se fu Masaa Gadu, a pe a de anga a gaan taanga fi en.”
eng_text: From now on, the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the power of God."

djk_text: Ne den akisi en taki: “We, fa i taki de, da yu na a Pikin fu Masaa Gadu?” Ne a taigi den taki: “We, a de letiso enke fa i si, useefi taki de.”
eng_text: They all said, "Are you then the Son of God?" He said to them, "You say it, because I am."

djk_text: Ne ala den fiya bali taki: “Oo! U ná abi ná wan sama fanowdu moo, fu tyai kaagi fi en kon gi wi. Bika useefi yee ne enseefi mofu taki, a taki en na Pikin fu Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: They said, "Why do we need any more witness? For we ourselves have heard from his own mouth!"

djk_text: Ne den opo, ne den tyai Masaa Jesesi go a Gaaman Pilatesi.
eng_text: The whole company of them rose up and brought him before Pilate.

djk_text: Ne di den doo Gaaman Pilatesi, ne den taigi en taki: “Gaaman Pilatesi, a man ya e leli den sama fu a kondee sani fu daai den ede. A taigi u taki, u á mu pai a moo gaan kownu a Loma Foto, a lantimoni. Soseefi a taki, en na a Kelestesi, a Kownu di Masaa Gadu be paamisi, fu sende kon gi u.”
eng_text: They began to accuse him, saying, "We found this man perverting the nation, forbidding paying taxes to Caesar, and saying that he himself is Christ, a king."

djk_text: Ne Gaaman Pilatesi akisi en taki: “Man, taigi mi. Yu na a kownu fu den Dyu, tuu?” Ne Masaa Jesesi piki taki: “Na letiso a de, enke fa i si i taki de.”
eng_text: Pilate asked him, "Are you the King of the Jews?" He answered him, "So you say."

djk_text: Ne Gaaman Pilatesi taigi den moo hei begiman anga ala den taa sama di be kon de taki: “We, a man di u tyai kon a mi ya, mi á fende ná wan fowtu ne en, fu mi mu sitaafu en. Bika a sani di a taki de, a ná wan ogii sani.”
eng_text: Pilate said to the chief priests and the multitudes, "I find no basis for a charge against this man."

djk_text: Ne ala den sama e bali taanga taki: “Ai daai den sama ede anga den sani di ai leli den. Bika a bigin a Galileya waka te, go doo Judeja. Da nownow, a de te a Jelusalem ya.”
eng_text: But they insisted, saying, "He stirs up the people, teaching throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee even to this place."

djk_text: We, di Gaaman Pilatesi yee den sama taki a bigin a Galileya, ne a akisi den taki: “A man ya na wan sama fu a pisiwataa fu Galileya?”
eng_text: But when Pilate heard Galilee mentioned, he asked if the man was a Galilean.

djk_text: Ne den piki taki: “Iya! Gaaman Pilatesi.” Ma di a yee taki na a pisiwataa fu Helowdesi a komoto, ne a sende Masaa Jesesi go a Kownu Helowdesi, di be de a Jelusalem a yuu ten de.
eng_text: When he found out that he was in Herod's jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who was also in Jerusalem during those days.

djk_text: Da di Kownu Helowdesi si den tyai Masaa Jesesi kon ne en, ne a piisii te a bigi. Bika a be e yee fu den gaan foondoo sani di Masaa Jesesi e du. Ma a á be si Masaa Jesesi seefi anga en ain wan dei. A dati meke a be switi gi en so. Da a be e luku fu Masaa Jesesi du wan foondoo sani, fu a be si anga en eigi ain.
eng_text: Now when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceedingly glad, for he had wanted to see him for a long time, because he had heard many things about him. He hoped to see some miracle done by him.

djk_text: Ne di Masaa Jesesi de ape, ne Kownu Helowdesi akisi en onmen tenti sani. Ma ná wan di Masaa Jesesi taigi en.
eng_text: He questioned him with many words, but he gave no answers.

djk_text: Ne den moo hei begiman anga den leliman fu Dyuweiti e taki, ala sowtu ogii anga lei fu Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: The chief priests and the scribes stood, vehemently accusing him.

djk_text: Te wan pisi, ne Kownu Helowdesi anga den bakaman fi en seefi bigin sipowtu anga Masaa Jesesi, e poti en wisiwasi. Ne den teke wan gaan moi koosi enke di kownu e wei, ne den wei gi en. Ne den e poti en wisiwasi e soso en tee, ne den sende en go a Gaaman Pilatesi baka.
eng_text: Herod with his soldiers humiliated him and mocked him. Dressing him in luxurious clothing, they sent him back to Pilate.

djk_text: Da na a dei de seefi, Gaaman Pilatesi anga Kownu Helowdesi kon de bun baka anga denseefi. Bika langa ten a fesi, den be de feyanti anga denseefi.
eng_text: Herod and Pilate became friends with each other that very day, for before that they were enemies with each other.

djk_text: Ne Gaaman Pilatesi kai den moo hei begiman anga den tiiman fu Islayeli Kondee anga ala taa sama kon makandii.
eng_text: Pilate called together the chief priests and the rulers and the people,

djk_text: Ne a taigi den taki: “We, u tyai a man ya kon a mi taki, a du ogii, bika ai daai den sama ede. Mi akisi en ala fasi, ma mi á si ná wan ogii di a du, fu mi sitaafu en enke fa u e taki de.
eng_text: and said to them, "You brought this man to me as one that perverts the people, and see, I have examined him before you, and found no basis for a charge against this man concerning those things of which you accuse him.

djk_text: Da mi si taki, Kownu Helowdesi á fende fowtu ne en tu. A dati meke, a sende en kon gi mi baka. A á du ná wan ogii fu a mu dede.
eng_text: Neither has Herod, for I sent you to him, and see, nothing worthy of death has been done by him.

djk_text: Da mi o meke den wipi en, da mi losi en baka.”
eng_text: I will therefore chastise him and release him."

djk_text: Ma namo, da Gaaman Pilatesi be gwenti fu puu wan sama a dunguu osu ala Pasika Fesa. Da ibii yali, a be e akisi den, sama den wani a puu a dunguu osu. Da na sama di den be wani, a be puu a dunguu osu gi den.
eng_text: Now he had to release one prisoner to them at the feast.

djk_text: Ma ala den sama bigin bali taanga taki: “Nono! Yu á mu losi en. Kii en puu de. Kii en! Na Balabasi u wani i puu a sitaafu osu gi u.”
eng_text: But they all cried out together, saying, "Away with this man! Release to us Barabbas!"--

djk_text: Balabasi, na be wan ogii kiiman di den be poti a dunguu osu a ten de. Bika en anga wantu taa man be kii sama, di den be opo feti anga a Loma lanti di be e tii Islayeli a ten de.
eng_text: one who was thrown into prison for a certain revolt in the city, and for murder.

djk_text: Ma Gaaman Pilatesi be wani puu Masaa Jesesi namo namo. A dati meke a taigi den sama taki: “Nono! Mi o losi a man ya. Bika mi á si ogii ne en.”
eng_text: Then Pilate spoke to them again, wanting to release Jesus,

djk_text: Ma den e bali namo taki: “Nono! Kii Jesesi! Kii Jesesi! Sipikii en kii puu de!”
eng_text: but they shouted, saying, "Crucify! Crucify him!"

djk_text: Ne Gaaman Pilatesi akisi den baka di fu dii toon taki: “Ma fu saide meke u wani meke mi kii a man ya? On sowtu ogii a du? Mi dati, mi á si ná wan ogii ne en fu mi mu kii en. Na fu dati, meke mi o meke den wipi en. Da mi o losi en meke a go fi en.”
eng_text: He said to them the third time, "Why? What evil has this man done? I have found no capital crime in him. I will therefore chastise him and release him."

djk_text: Ma den tan e bali namo taki, den mu sipikii en a koloisi kii puu de.
eng_text: But they were urgent with loud voices, asking that he might be crucified. Their voices and the voices of the chief priests prevailed.

djk_text: Ne Gaaman Pilatesi á sabi san fu a du moo. Ne a taigi den taki: “So! U du enke fa u sabi.” Ne a puu Balabasi a dunguu osu gi den. Di ne en den wani, ne a puu en a dunguu osu. Ma a fika Masaa Jesesi gi den fu den tyai go sipikii kii.
eng_text: Pilate decreed that what they asked for should be done.

djk_text: Da, di den de a pasi e tyai Masaa Jesesi fu go kii, te wan pisi, ne den miti wan man fu Sileni den e kai Simon. A be komoto ne en goon e kon a ganda. Ne den dwengi en fu tyai a koloisi fu Masaa Jesesi gi en. Ne a tyai a koloisi gi Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: When they led him away, they grabbed one Simon of Cyrene, coming from the country, and laid on him the cross, to carry it after Jesus.

djk_text: Da a yuu di den e tyai Masaa Jesesi fu go kii, da somen sama be e waka ne en baka. Tyali fu Masaa Jesesi kisi den sama te, den uman poti ana a mindii ede e bali e kee.
eng_text: A great multitude of the people followed him, including women who also mourned and lamented him.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi daai luku den, ne a taigi den taki: “Uman fu Jelusalem! U á kee gi mi. Ma u kee gi useefi anga den pikin fu u.
eng_text: But Jesus, turning to them, said, "Daughters of Jerusalem, don't weep for me, but weep for yourselves and for your children.

djk_text: Bika wanten fu pina o kon. Te a ten de doo, da sama o de di o go e taki: ‘Seigi fu uman di á meke pikin wanten, anga uman di ná abi pikin a bobi tu!’
eng_text: For behold, the days are coming in which they will say, 'Blessed are the barren, the wombs that never bore, and the breasts that never nursed.'

djk_text: Bika na a ten de, da somen sama o de, di o go e bali taki: ‘Den gaan mongo ya, gaantangi! U kai kon a mi tapu, baa?’ Da den o taigi den pikin mongo taki: ‘U kai kon tapu u meke ná wan pikinso fu u fika na a goontapu ya moo.’ Ogii namo di a ten de o ogii so.
eng_text: Then they will begin to tell the mountains, 'Fall on us!' and tell the hills, 'Cover us.'

djk_text: Bika efu na anga a kuwa kuwa udu den e du so, da a dee udu, no? Du fi en ná o moo ogii, no?”
eng_text: For if they do these things in the green tree, what will be done in the dry?"

djk_text: Da den be e tyai tu taa man, fu go sipikii kii anga Masaa Jesesi makandii. Den tu man ya be du gaan ogii na a kondee.
eng_text: There were also others, two criminals, led with him to be put to death.

djk_text: Ne den tyai Masaa Jesesi go na a peesi di den e kai Edebon Peesi. Ne den sipikii Masaa Jesesi anga den tu taa man de. Ne den opo den koloisi taampu. Wan fu den man be de a Masaa Jesesi leti ana se. A taawan be de ne en kukutu ana se. Masaa Jesesi seefi be de a mindii.
eng_text: When they came to the place that is called The Skull, they crucified him there with the criminals, one on the right and the other on the left.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taki: “Mi Tata! Ná luku a ogii di den sama ya du anga mi ya. Ma gi den paadon. Bika den á sabi san den e du.” Ne den suudati iti lowte paati den koosi fu Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: Jesus said, "Father, forgive them, for they don't know what they are doing." Dividing his garments among them, they cast lots.

djk_text: Ne ala den somen sama di be kon de taampu e luku san e pasa. Den edeman fu kondee seefi be taampu e luku tu. Da den dati e sipowtu anga Masaa Jesesi, e wisiwasi en taki: “A be e yeepi taa sama. Ma now a á poi yeepi enseefi. Da meke a yeepi enseefi, meke u si, no? Efu en na a Kelestesi di Masaa Gadu sende kon.” Na so den edeman fu a kondee be e sipowtu anga en.
eng_text: The people stood watching. The rulers with them also scoffed at him, saying, "He saved others. Let him save himself, if this is the Christ of God, his chosen one!"

djk_text: Den suudati seefi be e sipowtu anga en tu. Ne den tyai wan win anga bita deesi a ini kon gi en fu a diingi.
eng_text: The soldiers also mocked him, coming to him and offering him vinegar,

djk_text: Ne den taigi en taki: “O! Kownu fu den Dyu! Saka komoto na a koloisi meke u si, no?”
eng_text: and saying, "If you are the King of the Jews, save yourself!"

djk_text: Da den be sikiifi wan sani poti na a koloisi fu Masaa Jesesi a tapu de taki:
eng_text: An inscription was also written over him in letters of Greek, Latin, and Hebrew: "THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS."

djk_text: Da wan fu den ogii ati man di den be sipikii a Masaa Jesesi se, bigin sipowtu anga Masaa Jesesi, e poti en wisiwasi taki: “Man! I na a Kownu di Masaa Gadu be paamisi taki, a be o sende kon gi u? We, soi u taki, i ne en tuu. Puu iseefi na a koloisi, da i puu wi tu!”
eng_text: One of the criminals who was hanged insulted him, saying, "If you are the Christ, save yourself and us!"

djk_text: Ma a taa man di be de na taase ana fu Masaa Jesesi bali en taki: “Man! Tapu mofu de! Yu nái feele Masaa Gadu na a dede mofu di u de ya, no?
eng_text: But the other answered, and rebuking him said, "Don't you even fear God, seeing you are under the same condemnation?

djk_text: Mi anga yu e kisi a sitaafu, fu a ogii di u du. Ma a man ya á du ná wan enkii ogii, fu a mu kisi a sitaafu ya. Da kaba anga a sani de.”
eng_text: And we indeed justly, for we receive the due reward for our deeds, but this man has done nothing wrong."

djk_text: Ne a daai luku Masaa Jesesi. Ne a taigi en taki: “Masaa Jesesi! Te yu e tii sani enke kownu, da gaantangi membee mi, baa?”
eng_text: He said to Jesus, "Lord, remember me when you come into your Kingdom."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “A bun! Tuutuu, mi e taigi u taki, tide seefi mi anga yu o de na Paladeisi fu Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: Jesus said to him, "Assuredly I tell you, today you will be with me in Paradise."

djk_text: Da di san ati, twalufu yuu kisi, ne a hii kondee dunguu pii enke na neti. A dunguu ya be oli go miti dii yuu bakadina. A san seefi á be pii moo.
eng_text: It was now about the sixth hour , and darkness came over the whole land until the ninth hour.

djk_text: Ne a gaan deki gaiden di be e tapu a kambaa, pe a moo hei begiman anga Masaa Gadu be e miti wan toon wan yali, piiti dalla fu tapu, te a doti tyoo.
eng_text: The sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was torn in two.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi bali anga taanga tongo taki: “Mi Tata! Mi poti mi jeje a ini yu ana.” Ne di a taki so, ne en boo koti kelen. A dede.
eng_text: Jesus, crying with a loud voice, said, "Father, into your hands I commit my spirit!" Having said this, he breathed his last.

djk_text: Da di a edeman fu den suudati si fa ala sani waka, ne a taki: “Aai! Eeye! A man ya na wan bunbun letiopu sama fu Masaa Gadu tuu.”
eng_text: When the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, "Certainly this was a righteous man."

djk_text: Ne di den somen sama di be kon de si fa ala sani waka, ne den naki ana a boo fu ati. Den á sabi saide meke so wan gaan ogii pasa. Tyali kisi den. Da na so den paati go a osu.
eng_text: All the multitudes that came together to see this, when they saw the things that were done, returned home beating their breasts.

djk_text: Den somen mati fu Masaa Jesesi anga den uman di be komoto a Galileya pisiwataa kon anga en be taampu, te a wanse, e luku fa a hii sani ya waka.
eng_text: All his acquaintances, and the women who followed with him from Galilee, stood at a distance, watching these things.

djk_text: We, wan edeman a ini a Dyulanti fu kuutu, di den e kai Jowsef be de ape tu. En na be fu a kondee den e kai Alimateya. Ala sama be e lesipeki en. Ne di sapaten, ne a go a Gaaman Pilatesi go begi en, fu a gi en a dede sikin fu Masaa Jesesi, a go beli. Jowsef na wan sama di be e fuuwakiti a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu. Da a á be piki anga den taa Dyulanti, fu kuutu Masaa Jesesi a kukutu kuutu fu den. Bika en na be de wan letiopu ati sama.
eng_text: Behold, a man named Joseph, who was a member of the council, a good and righteous man

djk_text: Ne Gaaman Pilatesi gi Jowsef pasi, fu teke a dede sikin fu Masaa Jesesi go beli. Ne Jowsef go, ne a puu a dede sikin na a koloisi. Ne a lolo en a ini wan sibikoosi. Ne a tyai a dede sikin fu Masaa Jesesi go poti a ini wan nyunyun siton geebi olo, di den be diki poti de, fu beli sama.
eng_text: He took it down, and wrapped it in a linen cloth, and laid him in a tomb that was cut in stone, where no one had ever been laid.

djk_text: Da pikinso moo, da a kina dei fu den Dyu be o kai. Da den Dyu á be o poi du ná wan sani enke wooko moo.
eng_text: It was the day of the Preparation, and the Sabbath was drawing near.

djk_text: Da den uman di be kon anga Masaa Jesesi be go anga Jowsef go luku fa a be o beli a sikin fu Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: The women, who had come with him out of Galilee, followed after, and saw the tomb, and how his body was laid.

djk_text: Da di den si fa Jowsef beli en kaba, ne den daai gwe a osu. Da den e seeka switi sumee sani, fu go lobi na a sikin fu Masaa Jesesi. Ma di den si taki, na kina dei kai kaba, ne den fika e luku, fu a kina dei pasa enke fa a weiti fu Islayeli Kondee be de.
eng_text: They returned, and prepared spices and ointments. On the Sabbath they rested according to the commandment.

djk_text: Da, sonde mamanten fuuku, di a kina dei fu den Dyu pasa, ne den teke den switi sumee sani di den be seeka fu go lobi na a dede sikin fu Masaa Jesesi enke fa den Dyusama be gwenti. Ne den go na a siton olo geebi, a pe den be beli Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: But on the first day of the week, at early dawn, they and some others came to the tomb, bringing the spices which they had prepared.

djk_text: Ma di den doo na a olo, ne den si taki a olo de wongong. A gaanbigi siton di den be lolo tapu a geebi wai komoto na a olo mofu.
eng_text: They found the stone rolled away from the tomb.

djk_text: Ne den waka go a ini a geebi olo go luku a sikin fu Masaa Jesesi. Ma di den go, den á si a dede sikin fu Masaa Jesesi de moo.
eng_text: They entered in, and didn't find the Lord Jesus' body.

djk_text: Ne den e akisi denseefi taki: “Oho! San pasa anga a dede sikin fu Masaa Jesesi?” Den á sabi san den be mu denki fu sowan sani. Da fa den e taki de, te fu den denki, ne haa, den si tu man taampu a den fesi. Den wei weti koosi fann e koti faya gelen gelen.
eng_text: It happened, while they were greatly perplexed about this, behold, two men stood by them in dazzling clothing.

djk_text: Ne den uman ya dyombo te, den kai anga kini tapu fesi a doti. Ne den tu man akisi den taki: “Tan! Uman, sama sende u fu u kon suku a libiwan a mindii fu den dedewan?
eng_text: Becoming terrified, they bowed their faces down to the earth. They said to them, "Why do you seek the living among the dead?

djk_text: A sama di u e suku de á de ya. Bika ai libi baka. U feegete san a be taigi u di u anga en be de a Galileya?
eng_text: He isn't here, but is risen. Remember what he told you when he was still in Galilee,

djk_text: A be taigi u taki, den be o seli a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya, gi den ogii ati sama. Da den be o sipikii en kii a koloisi. Ma di fu dii dei, te a be dede, da a be o weki komoto a dede kon a libi baka. U sabi ete?”
eng_text: saying that the Son of Man must be delivered up into the hands of sinful men, and be crucified, and the third day rise again?"

djk_text: Ne di den man taigi den uman ya so, ne den kisi denseefi taki: “Ai! Na tuu! Na so a be taigi u tuu.”
eng_text: They remembered his words,

djk_text: Ne den opo taampu baka, ne den lon go a Jelusalem, a den elufu bakaman fi en anga den taa sama fi en go taigi den ala san den si.
eng_text: returned from the tomb, and told all these things to the eleven, and to all the rest.

djk_text: Den uman di be de na, Maliya Makidala, anga wan taawan den e kai Johana. Maliya, a mma fu Jakowbesi anga somen taa uman ete. Da di den taigi den so, ne den á wani biibi den. Den si enke na soso sani den e taki.
eng_text: Now they were Mary Magdalene, Joanna, and Mary the mother of James. The other women with them told these things to the apostles.

djk_text: Ma Peitilisi seefi opo, ne a lon te na a geebi. Ne di a go doo, ne a bendi luku go a ini a geebi. Ne na den koosi di den be lolo Masaa Jesesi wawan a si de. Ne a daai go a osu baka. A sani ya foondoo en te, a akisi enseefi san sa pasa anga a sikin fu Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: But Peter got up and ran to the tomb. Stooping and looking in, he saw the strips of linen lying by themselves, and he departed to his home, wondering what had happened.

djk_text: Da na a seefi dei ya, ne tu sama fu Masaa Jesesi be komoto a Jelusalem e go a wan kondee den e kai Emayesi. Fu komoto a Jelusalem go na a kondee ya sa de wan sani fu tin na fo kilomeiti so.
eng_text: Behold, two of them were going that very day to a village named Emmaus, which was sixty stadia from Jerusalem.

djk_text: Da di den de a pasi e gwe, da den be e gi den toli, fu san pasa anga Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: They talked with each other about all of these things which had happened.

djk_text: Da di den gi toli te wan pisi, ne wan sama waka kon miti den. Ne ai waka anga den.
eng_text: It happened, while they talked and questioned together, that Jesus himself came near, and went with them.

djk_text: Na Masaa Jesesi be waka kon miti den de, ma den á be sabi taki, ne en. Den ain á be kiin fu den be sabi taki na Masaa Jesesi de ape.
eng_text: But their eyes were kept from recognizing him.

djk_text: Ne di den waka te wan pisi, ne a sama akisi den taki: “We, fu sama u be e taki so? Sowtu toli u e gi taanga gi u so?” Ne den taampu pii. Ne den luku a man ya anga gaan tyali fesi.
eng_text: He said to them, "What are you talking about as you walk, and are sad?"

djk_text: Ne wan fu den tu man ya, di den be e kai Keleyopasi, piki en taki: “Na yu wawan na awan kodo sama di á yee a gaan ogii di pasa a Jelusalem de?”
eng_text: One of them, named Cleopas, answered him, "Are you the only stranger in Jerusalem who doesn't know the things which have happened there in these days?"

djk_text: Ne a sama akisi den taki: “San pasa?” Ne den taigi en taki: “Yu á yee san den du anga a apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu, di den be e kai Jesesi, no? Na be wan sama fu Nasaleti. A man ya be e du gaan foondoo sani a goontapu ya, e leli sama wan apaiti fasi. A be de wan bunbun sama a Masaa Gadu ain anga libisama.
eng_text: He said to them, "What things?" They said to him, "The things concerning Jesus, the Nazarene, who was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people;

djk_text: Ma den moo hei begiman anga den tiiman fu u kisi en, ne den gi den Loma sama di e taki fu a kondee ya fu den sipikii kii a koloisi.
eng_text: and how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him up to be condemned to death, and crucified him.

djk_text: Da wi be denki taki, en na be a kownu di Masaa Gadu be paamisi, fu sende kon fu puu wi a den taa sama ondoo. Ma disi na di fu dii dei kaba di den kii en.
eng_text: But we were hoping that it was he who would redeem Israel. Yes, and besides all this, it is now the third day since these things happened.

djk_text: Ma tide mamanten fuuku, da wantu umansama fu u be go na a geebi fu go lobi switi sumee sani gi a dede sikin fi en. Ne di den daai kon baka, ne den taigi u wan gaan foondoo sani.
eng_text: Also, certain women of our company amazed us, having arrived early at the tomb;

djk_text: Den taigi u taki: ‘Den á si a dede sikin fi en de moo. Ne den taigi u go doo taki, den si tu Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee, di taigi den taki, Masaa Jesesi opo komoto a dede baka. Da ai libi baka.’ ”
eng_text: and when they didn't find his body, they came saying that they had also seen a vision of angels, who said that he was alive.

djk_text: Da, ne wantu fu u komoto go luku. Ne den si taki, a dede sikin fu Masaa Jesesi á de ape moo tuu. Ma den á si Masaa Jesesi seefi.
eng_text: Some of us went to the tomb, and found it just like the women had said, but they didn't see him."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “Tan! Na so u don? Na so a taanga gi u fu biibi ala sani di den apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu be taki a fesi kaba?
eng_text: He said to them, "Foolish men, and slow of heart to believe in all that the prophets have spoken!

djk_text: Bika u be mu sabi kaba taki: ‘A kownu di Masaa Gadu be paamisi, fu sende kon, be mu pina so fosi a be go sidon enke kownu.’ ”
eng_text: Didn't the Christ have to suffer these things and to enter into his glory?"

djk_text: Ne a kai wantu pisi fu den buku fu Mosesi anga den buku fu den taa apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu gi den, fu tyai den pakisei kon baka. A meke den kon fusutan ala den sani fi en di be sikiifi a Masaa Gadu Buku.
eng_text: Beginning from Moses and from all the prophets, he explained to them in all the Scriptures the things concerning himself.

djk_text: Da pikinso moo, da den be o doo na a kondee pe den be e go. Ne Masaa Jesesi du enke, a wani waka pasa.
eng_text: They drew near to the village, where they were going, and he acted like he would go further.

djk_text: Ne den tu sama begi a man taki: “Man! Ná pasa. Siibi anga u ya. Bika, a kon lati kaba.” Ne a taki: “A bun.” Ne a go anga den a osu, fu pasa a neti.
eng_text: They urged him, saying, "Stay with us, for it is almost evening, and the day is almost over." He went in to stay with them.

djk_text: Da di den sidon fu nyan, ne a teke a beele, ne a begi, gi Masaa Gadu daa moi te a kaba, ne a booko paati gi den.
eng_text: It happened, that when he had sat down at the table with them, he took the bread and gave thanks. Breaking it, he gave to them.

djk_text: Ne wanten den ain opo, ne den sabi taki, na Masaa Jesesi de ape. Ma, te fu den poti pakisei, ne woo! A gwe fika den wawan de.
eng_text: Their eyes were opened, and they recognized him, and he vanished out of their sight.

djk_text: Ne den taigi denseefi taki: “A gwe, baa! Luku fa u ati be e piisii di a be e waka anga wi a pasi e kon, da ai puu den sani di sikiifi a Masaa Gadu Buku kiinkiin gi wi.”
eng_text: They said one to another, "Weren't our hearts burning within us, while he spoke to us along the way, and while he opened the Scriptures to us?"

djk_text: Ne den opo. Ne den waka, fu te a Jelusalem. Na ape den anga den taa elufu bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi anga den taa sama fi en be o miti makandii.
eng_text: They rose up that very hour, returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and those who were with them,

djk_text: Ne fa i si den doo, ne den taawan bali taigi den taki: “Na tuu! Masaa Jesesi opo komoto a dede baka tuu. Simon seefi si en.”
eng_text: saying, "The Lord is risen indeed, and has appeared to Simon!"

djk_text: Ne den tu man di be daai baka kon a Jelusalem seefi taigi den taki, denseefi si en tu. Den taigi den fa a waka anga den a pasi go te a Emayesi. Ne na di den sidon fu nyan di a booko a beele gi den fosi, ne den ain opo fu si taki, ne en de ape. Ne te fu den denki, ne woo, a gwe.
eng_text: They related the things that happened along the way, and how he was recognized by them in the breaking of the bread.

djk_text: Ne, te fu den tu man ya kaba taki, ne Masaa Jesesi de a den mindii pii. Ne a gi den odi taki: “Masaa Gadu mu de anga u, ye!”
eng_text: As they said these things, Jesus himself stood among them, and said to them, "Peace be to you."

djk_text: Ne ala den fiya feele te, ná sipowtu. Bika den be denki taki, na wan yooka den be e si.
eng_text: But they were terrified and filled with fear, and supposed that they had seen a spirit.

djk_text: Ma, ne Masaa Jesesi akisi den taki: “Saide meke u e feele so du? Saide meke u nái biibi taki, na mi de ya?
eng_text: He said to them, "Why are you troubled? Why do doubts arise in your hearts?

djk_text: U luku mi ana anga mi futu! Na miseefi de ya! U kon oli mi luku. Bika yooka nái abi meti, ai nái abi bonyo.”
eng_text: See my hands and my feet, that it is truly me. Touch me and see, for a spirit doesn't have flesh and bones, as you see that I have."

djk_text: Ne di a taigi den so kaba, ne a soi den den maiki ne en ana anga en futu, pe den be sipikii en.
eng_text: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his feet.

djk_text: Da a sani di Masaa Jesesi soi den ya, gi den gaan piisii. Da fu piisii ede meke den á be wani biibi taki, na Masaa Jesesi de ape. Da fu soi den taki ne en de ape tuutuu, ne a akisi den taki: “U abi wan sani ya, fu nyan?”
eng_text: While they still didn't believe for joy, and wondered, he said to them, "Do you have anything here to eat?"

djk_text: Ne den teke wan pisi losi fisi, ne den gi en.
eng_text: They gave him a piece of a broiled fish and some honeycomb.

djk_text: Ne a nyanmi a losi fisi leti a den fesi de, meke den si.
eng_text: He took them, and ate in front of them.

djk_text: Ne a taigi den taki: “U sabi san mi be taigi u ete di mi anga u be e waka e lontu? Mi be taigi u taki: ‘Ala den sani di sikiifi a den buku fu Mosesi, anga den apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu, anga den sani di sikiifi a ini den singi buku musu fu pasa tuutuu enke fa den sikiifi den.’ ”
eng_text: He said to them, "This is what I told you, while I was still with you, that all things which are written in the law of Moses, the prophets, and the psalms, concerning me must be fulfilled."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi puu den sani fu Masaa Gadu Buku gi den fini fini. Ne wanten den ain kon kiin, fu fusutan den sani fu Masaa Gadu Buku.
eng_text: Then he opened their minds, that they might understand the Scriptures.

djk_text: Ne a taigi den go doo taki: “We, na so a sikiifi a Masaa Gadu Buku taki: ‘A kownu di Masaa Gadu be paamisi fu sende kon a goontapu musu fu tyai pina, da a dede. Ma na di fu dii dei, da a opo baka komoto a dede.’
eng_text: He said to them, "Thus it is written, and thus it was necessary for the Christ to suffer and to rise from the dead the third day,

djk_text: Da a bosikopu ya mu bali a hii goontapu doo ala foluku, fu den daai libi, meke Masaa Gadu sa gi den paadon, fu den takuudu anga ogii. Bigin a Jelusalem fosi, go doo hii goontapu.
eng_text: and that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name to all the nations, beginning at Jerusalem.

djk_text: We, useefi si taki, ala den sani di be sikiifi a Masaa Gadu Buku pasa tuu, enke fa a be sikiifi.
eng_text: You are witnesses of these things.

djk_text: “Ma, fosi u go, da u mu tan a Jelusalem ya e luku a kaakiti di mi Tata paamisi u. Mi o sende en kon gi u. Da a o kon a u tapu, fu gi u kaakiti fu paati a bosikopu ya.”
eng_text: Behold, I send forth the promise of my Father on you. But wait in the city of Jerusalem until you are clothed with power from on high."

djk_text: Bakadati, ne Masaa Jesesi tyai den go na a kondee di den e kai Betaniya. Ne a opo ana a den tapu, ne a begi Masaa Gadu gi den, fu ala sani fu den waka bun.
eng_text: He led them out as far as Bethany, and he lifted up his hands, and blessed them.

djk_text: Da, di a opo ana e begi gi den so, ne Masaa Gadu teke en tyai go a tapu.
eng_text: It happened, while he blessed them, that he withdrew from them, and was carried up into heaven.

djk_text: Ne den bakaman fi en e gi en gaandi, e gafa en, te a gafa. Ne bakadati, ne den go a Jelusalem baka anga gaan piisii a den ati.
eng_text: They worshiped him, and returned to Jerusalem with great joy,

djk_text: Ne di den doo Jelusalem, ne den go a ini a Mama Keliki go e begi Masaa Gadu e gi en gaandi e gafa en naamo.
eng_text: and were continually in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.

djk_text: We, na a bigin, a Wowtu be de kaba. A Wowtu be de a Masaa Gadu. Da a Wowtu ya, na be Masaa Gadu seefi.
eng_text: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

djk_text: Da senten na a bigin, da a Wowtu ya be de anga Masaa Gadu makandii.
eng_text: The same was in the beginning with God.

djk_text: Da anga a Wowtu ya, Masaa Gadu be meke ala sani di de. Da ná wan sani de, di a ná en meke en.
eng_text: All things were made through him. Without him was not anything made that has been made.

djk_text: Da ne en ala libi e komoto. Da, te wan sama fende a libi ya, da so wan sama komoto a dunguu kon a ini leti.
eng_text: In him was life, and the life was the light of men.

djk_text: Da a leti e leti a ini a dunguu, ma a dunguu á be poi tapu a leti ya.
eng_text: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness hasn't overcome it.

djk_text: We, Masaa Gadu be sende wan sama, den kai Johanisi, kon.
eng_text: There came a man, sent from God, whose name was John.

djk_text: Da a be kon fu taki sani a fesi fu a leti di de fu kon. Da a be mu taki fu ala sama be yee fu den kon a biibi.
eng_text: The same came as a witness, that he might testify about the light, that all might believe through him.

djk_text: Ma a ná Johanisi na be a leti, ma na kon a kon fu taki san a sabi fu a leti.
eng_text: He was not the light, but was sent that he might testify about the light.

djk_text: Da a tuutuu leti, di e leti kiin sani gi ala sama be de fu kon a goontapu.
eng_text: The true light that enlightens everyone was coming into the world.

djk_text: Da a be kon a goontapu, a goontapu di enseefi meke, ma goontapu á be wani teke en enke wan sama di Masaa Gadu sende kon.
eng_text: He was in the world, and the world was made through him, and the world didn't recognize him.

djk_text: Da soseefi a be kon na den eigi Dyusama fi en, ma den á be wani teke en enke den tiiman.
eng_text: He came to his own, and those who were his own didn't receive him.

djk_text: Ma iniiwan sama di teke en enke den tiiman, na den a gi makiti fu toon pikin fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: But as many as received him, to them he gave the right to become God's children, to those who believe in his name:

djk_text: Ma den á toon wan pikin fu Masaa Gadu, enke fa libisama e meke pikin, efu anga a wani fu libisama. Nono! Ma na Masaa Gadu seefi meke den toon pikin fi en.
eng_text: who were born not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.

djk_text: We, a Wowtu be toon libisama. Ne a kon tan a u mindii fu wan pisiten. Da useefi be si a dyendee fasi fi en. A dyendee fasi fi en di u si de, na a dyendee fasi di a wankodo Manpikin fu a Tata sa abi. Na so Masaa Gadu teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku libisama. Da na Masaa Jesesi wi e si kiinkiin, fa Masaa Gadu de.
eng_text: The Word became flesh, and lived among us. We saw his glory, such glory as of the one and only Son of the Father, full of grace and truth.

djk_text: Da Johanisi be e taki fi en. Ne di a si en, ne a bali taki: “Na a sama ya mi be e taki, di mi be taigi u taki: ‘Wan sama o kon a mi baka di bigi moo mi. Bika a be de gaandiwe fosi mi be meke.’ ”
eng_text: John testified about him. He cried out, saying, "This was he of whom I said, 'He who comes after me has surpassed me, for he was before me.'"

djk_text: We, useefi kon sabi Awan de. A abi a gaan bun ati fasi fu Masaa Gadu, di a teke tyaipi bun a bun tapu, te a pasa maiki gi wi.
eng_text: From his fullness we all received grace upon grace.

djk_text: Bika na Mosesi, Masaa Gadu be gi den weiti fu gi wi fu libi. Ma na Masaa Jesesi a meke u kon sabi, fa a teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku sama. Da na Masaa Jesesi u sa si kiinkiin, fa Masaa Gadu tan.
eng_text: For the law was given through Moses. Grace and truth were realized through Jesus Christ.

djk_text: Ná wan libisama di si Masaa Gadu anga ain wanten. Ma na a wankodo Manpikin fi en, di de wan anga a Tata makandii, ne en meke u kon sabi en nownow, enke fa u de.
eng_text: No one has seen God at any time. The one and only Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, he has declared him.

djk_text: We, den gaan edeman fu keliki a Jelusalem sende kai wanlo apaiti begiman fu a Mama Keliki anga wanlo manengee fu Leifi Lo. Ne den sende den fu den go akisi Johanisi sama ne en.
eng_text: This is John's testimony, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, "Who are you?"

djk_text: Ne den go, ne den akisi en taki, efu na en na Kelestesi di Masaa Gadu be o sende kon a goontapu. Ne Johanisi puu taigi den gwelen sondee fu koli den. A taki: “Nono! Kweti kweti! Mi a ná a Kelestesi.”
eng_text: He declared, and didn't deny, but he declared, "I am not the Christ."

djk_text: Ne den akisi en baka taki: “We, da sama a yu, di i taki, yu a ná a Kelestesi? Yu na Eliya?” Ne Johanisi taigi den taki: “Nono!” Ne den akisi en baka taki: “We, yu na a apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu di a be o sende kon?” Ne Johanisi piki den taki: “Nono!”
eng_text: They asked him, "What then? Are you Elijah?" He said, "I am not." "Are you the prophet?" He answered, "No."

djk_text: Ne, te fu kaba, ne den akisi en taki: “We, da sama a yu seefi? Taigi wi meke u fende wan sani fu piki den sama di sende u kon te u daai go baka. San yu e taki fi iseefi?”
eng_text: They said therefore to him, "Who are you? Give us an answer to take back to those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?"

djk_text: Ne Johanisi piki den enke fa Jesaja be sikiifi poti a Masaa Gadu Buku. Bika a be sikiifi taki: “We! Mi na a tongo fu wan sama di e bali basiya a ini a sabana ini taki: ‘Meke a pasi fu Masaa Gadu kon taampu letiopu fasi tiloo.’ ”
eng_text: He said, "I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, 'Make straight the way of the Lord,' as Isaiah the prophet said."

djk_text: We, da den sama fu a paitei fu den Faliseiman be de a ini den sama di be kon de tu.
eng_text: The ones who had been sent were from the Pharisees.

djk_text: Ne den sama akisi Johanisi baka taki: “We, efu yu a ná a Kelestesi, yu a ná Eliya, yu a ná apaiti takiman, da saide meke yu e dopu sama fu du?”
eng_text: They asked him, "Why then do you baptize, if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the prophet?"

djk_text: Ne Johanisi piki den taki: “We, mi e dopu sama anga wataa. Ma wan Sama de a u mindii di u á sabi.
eng_text: John answered them, "I baptize in water, but among you stands one whom you don't know.

djk_text: Da a Sama ya o kon a mi baka. Da anga ala fa a o kon a mi baka de seefi, toku mi á waiti sai fu puu en susu ne en futu gi en.”
eng_text: He is the one who comes after me, who is preferred before me, whose sandal strap I'm not worthy to loosen."

djk_text: Da ala den sani ya be e pasa a Betaniya Kondee na abaase fu a Joodani Liba, pe Johanisi be e dopu sama.
eng_text: These things were done in Bethany beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.

djk_text: Ne a taa dei fi en, ne Johanisi si Masaa Jesesi e waka e kon ne en. Ne a taki: “U luku a Pikin Sikapu di Masaa Gadu gi wi fu puu ala takuudu anga ogii fu libisama gi den.
eng_text: The next day, he saw Jesus coming to him, and said, "Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!

djk_text: Na a sama ya mi be e taki di mi be taigi u taki: ‘Wan sama o kon a mi baka, ma a be de bifo mi. A dati meke a bigi moo mi.’
eng_text: This is he of whom I said, 'After me comes a man who is preferred before me, for he was before me.'

djk_text: Da miseefi á be sabi en. Ma na fu di Dyu Kondee be mu sabi en meke Masaa Gadu sende mi fu dopu sama anga wataa.”
eng_text: I didn't know him, but for this reason I came baptizing in water: that he would be revealed to Israel."

djk_text: Ne Johanisi taki baka taki: “Miseefi si a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu saka komoto a tapu enke wan doifi de tan ne en tapu.
eng_text: John testified, saying, "I have seen the Spirit descending like a dove out of heaven, and it remained on him.

djk_text: Da miseefi á be sabi en. Ma en di sende mi fu mi dopu sama anga wataa, ne en taigi mi taki: ‘A sama di mi o si a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu saka kon de ne en tapu, ne en na a sama di o dopu sama anga a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu.’
eng_text: I didn't recognize him, but he who sent me to baptize in water, he said to me, 'On whomever you will see the Spirit descending, and remaining on him, the same is he who baptizes in the Holy Spirit.'

djk_text: Da mi si a sani di Masaa Gadu taigi mi de tuu. Na fu dati ede meke mi e taigi u taki, a sama di u e si de, na a Manpikin fu Masaa Gadu tuu.”
eng_text: I have seen, and have testified that this is the Son of God."

djk_text: Ne a taa dei fi en, ne Johanisi be taampu de baka anga tu fu den bakaman fi en.
eng_text: Again, the next day, John was standing with two of his disciples,

djk_text: Ne a si Jesesi e waka pasa. Ne a taki: “U luku a Pikin Sikapu fu Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: and he looked at Jesus as he walked, and said, "Behold, the Lamb of God!"

djk_text: Ne di den tu bakaman fi en yee a taki so, ne den waka go e waka a Masaa Jesesi baka.
eng_text: The two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.

djk_text: Ne di Masaa Jesesi daai, ne di a si den e kon ne en baka, ne a akisi den taki: “San u wani?” Ne den piki en taki: “Labai, pe yu e tan?”
eng_text: Jesus turned, and saw them following, and said to them, "What are you looking for?" They said to him, "Rabbi" (which is to say, being interpreted, Teacher), "where are you staying?"

djk_text: Ne a taigi den taki: “We, u kon go anga mi, da u sa si.” Ne den go luku pe ai tan. Ne di den go, ne den tan anga en de te bakadina. Da a be de wan sani fu fo yuu bakadina so.
eng_text: He said to them, "Come, and see." They came and saw where he was staying, and they stayed with him that day. It was about the tenth hour.

djk_text: Da wan fu den tu bakaman fu Johanisi di be go anga Masaa Jesesi na, Andeleyasi, wan baala fu Simon Peitilisi.
eng_text: One of the two who heard John, and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peter's brother.

djk_text: We, ne a feti go ne en baala Simon esi esi. Ne a taigi en taki: “U fende a Mesiyasi .”
eng_text: He first found his own brother, Simon, and said to him, "We have found the Messiah!" (which is, being interpreted, Christ ).

djk_text: Ne a tyai en baala Simon go a Masaa Jesesi. Ne di Masaa Jesesi si en, ne a taki: “Yu na Simon, a manpikin fu Johanisi. Yu o nen Kefasi .”
eng_text: He brought him to Jesus. Jesus looked at him, and said, "You are Simon the son of Jonah. You shall be called Cephas" (which is by interpretation, Peter).

djk_text: Ne a taa dei fi en, ne Masaa Jesesi opo fu go baka a Galileya. Ne a si wan man den e kai Filipi. Ne a kai en taki: “Kon go anga mi.”
eng_text: On the next day, he was determined to go out into Galilee, and he found Philip. Jesus said to him, "Follow me."

djk_text: Da Filipi na be fu a seefi kondee di den e kai Betisaida enke Andeleyasi anga Peitilisi.
eng_text: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, of the city of Andrew and Peter.

djk_text: We, Filipi seefi miti anga Nataniyeli. Ne a taigi en taki: “U fende Jesesi, a manpikin fu Jowsef, fu a kondee di den e kai Nasaleti, di Mosesi anga den taa apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu be sikiifi sani fi en.”
eng_text: Philip found Nathanael, and said to him, "We have found him, of whom Moses in the law, and the prophets, wrote: Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph."

djk_text: Ne Nataniyeli akisi en taki: “Wan bun sa komoto a Nasaleti Kondee?” Ne Filipi taigi en taki: “We, kon go luku, da iseefi sa si.”
eng_text: Nathanael said to him, "Can any good thing come out of Nazareth?" Philip said to him, "Come and see."

djk_text: Ne di Masaa Jesesi si Nataniyeli e kon, ne a taki: “Luku wan bunbun Islayeli e kon de. Wan sama di nái koli sama.”
eng_text: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and said about him, "Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no deceit!"

djk_text: Ne Nataniyeli akisi en taki: “Fa i du sabi mi?” Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Fosi Filipi be kai yu, di i be de na a figasii bon ondoo de, mi be si yu kaba.”
eng_text: Nathanael said to him, "How do you know me?" Jesus answered him, "Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you."

djk_text: Ne Nataniyeli piki en taki: “Labai, yu na a Manpikin fu Masaa Gadu. Yu na a Kownu fu den Islayeli sama.”
eng_text: Nathanael answered him, "Rabbi, you are the Son of God! You are King of Israel!"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Na fu di mi taigi yu taki: ‘Mi be si yu na a figasii bon ondoo,’ meke yu e biibi? Yu o si moo gaan foondoo sani moo enke dati.”
eng_text: Jesus answered him, "Because I told you, 'I saw you underneath the fig tree,' do you believe? You will see greater things than these!"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “Fu tuutuu mi e taigi u taki, u o si tapu a den woluku anda opo waa. Da u o si den Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee e subi e go, e saka e kon na a Manpikin di kon saka toon libisama ya tapu.”
eng_text: He said to him, "Most certainly, I tell you, hereafter you will see heaven opened, and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man."

djk_text: Ne baka tu dei, ne den oli wan toow osu a Kaana, na a pisiwataa fu Galileya. Da Masaa Jesesi mma be de ape tu.
eng_text: The third day, there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee. Jesus' mother was there.

djk_text: Da den be kai Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en fu kon na a toow osu ya tu.
eng_text: Jesus also was invited, with his disciples, to the marriage.

djk_text: Ne di a piisii go te wan pisi, ne a win di den sama be e diingi kaba. Ne Masaa Jesesi mma kon ne en, ne a taigi en taki: “A win fu den sama kaba.”
eng_text: When the wine ran out, Jesus' mother said to him, "They have no wine."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Uman! A sani de a ná mi anga yu booko ede. Mi yuu á kisi fu wooko ete.”
eng_text: Jesus said to her, "Woman, what does that have to do with you and me? My hour has not yet come."

djk_text: Ne Maliya daai, ne a taigi den wookoman, di be e wooko na a toow osu taki: “A san di a o taigi u fu u du, na dati u mu du.”
eng_text: His mother said to the servants, "Whatever he says to you, do it."

djk_text: Da den be abi sigisi gaan dabisan de. Da na ini den dabisan ya den be e lai wataa fu wasi enke fa a weiti fu den Dyu be de. Da iniiwan fu den dabisan ya be sa oli wan sani fu wan ondoo liti so.
eng_text: Now there were six water pots of stone set there after the Jews' way of purifying, containing two or three metretes apiece.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “U fuu den dabisan de anga wataa.” Ne den fuu den anga wataa te den de gwingwingwin.
eng_text: Jesus said to them, "Fill the water pots with water." They filled them up to the brim.

djk_text: Ne a di den fuu den dabisan anga wataa kaba, ne a taigi den taki: “U kisi afu tyai go gi a edeman fu a toow osu, meke a tesi luku.” Ne den go kisi a wataa tyai go gi a edeman fu a toow osu.
eng_text: He said to them, "Now draw some out, and take it to the ruler of the feast." So they took it.

djk_text: Ne di a edeman tesi a wataa di daai kon toon win, ne a bali gi a toow man taki: “Ala sama e poti a moo bun win na a bigin fu ala piisii fu den sama fende diingi. Da te den diingi a moo bun wan te a kisi den, da fosi den e diingi den taawan. Ma yu be kibii a moo bun wan te enke now.” Na fu di a á be sabi pe a win ya komoto meke a be taki so. Na den futuboi wawan di be go kisi a wataa be sabi pe a win ya komoto.
eng_text: When the ruler of the feast tasted the water now become wine, and didn't know where it came from (but the servants who had drawn the water knew), the ruler of the feast called the bridegroom,

djk_text: Da, na di Masaa Jesesi de a Kaana na a pisiwataa fu Galileya a du a gaan foondoo sani ya. A fosi wonduu wooko fu den gaan foondoo foondoo wooko di a o du. Da anga a sani di a du ya, a meke sama si a dyendee fasi fi en. Ne den bakaman fi en kon e biibi ne en.
eng_text: This beginning of his signs Jesus did in Cana of Galilee, and revealed his glory; and his disciples believed in him.

djk_text: Ne bakadati, ne Masaa Jesesi anga en mma anga en baala anga den bakaman fi en go na a kondee di den e kai Kafalnayemu. Da den tan ya wantu dei namo.
eng_text: After this, he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, his brothers, and his disciples; and they stayed there a few days.

djk_text: Da a ten ya, da a gaan piisii fu den Dyu di den e kai Pasika be de koosube. Ne Masaa Jesesi teke pasi e subi go a Jelusalem.
eng_text: The Passover of the Jews was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

djk_text: Ne di a go doo, ne a si sama na a Mama Keliki fu den Dyu e seli kaw anga sikapu anga doifi. Taawan e kengi moni gi taawan.
eng_text: He found in the temple those who sold oxen, sheep, and doves, and the changers of money sitting.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi teke tetei meke wan wipi, ne a yaki ala den fiya puu a ini a Mama Keliki. Soseefi a yaki den sikapu anga den kaw puu na a Mama Keliki tu. Ma a daai den tafaa fu den man di be e kengi moni gi sama towe ala a moni a dati fanyaa.
eng_text: He made a whip of cords, and threw all out of the temple, both the sheep and the oxen; and he poured out the changers' money, and overthrew their tables.

djk_text: Ne a bali den man di be e seli doifi taki: “U gwe komoto ya! U á teke a osu fu mi Tata meke toon wowoyo!”
eng_text: To those who sold the doves, he said, "Take these things out of here! Don't make my Father's house a marketplace!"

djk_text: Da den bakaman fi en kisi denseefi fu wan sani di sikiifi a Gadu Buku. A sikiifi taki: “A feti di mi e feti e meke moiti fu a osu fi i, e boon a ini mi ati enke faya.”
eng_text: His disciples remembered that it was written, "Zeal for your house will eat me up."

djk_text: Ma den edeman fu den Dyu piki Masaa Jesesi taki: “Sama sende i, fi i du den sani de? We, da soi u wan maiki taki yu abi a makiti fu du den sani ya.”
eng_text: The Jews therefore answered him, "What sign do you show us, seeing that you do these things?"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “U sa booko a osu fu Masaa Gadu di u e si ya, da te fu dii dei, da mi sa opo en taampu baka, enke fa a be de.”
eng_text: Jesus answered them, "Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up."

djk_text: Ne den edeman fu den Dyu piki en taki: “Oho! Fotenti a sigisi yali a teke fu meke a gaan keliki osu ya. Ne i taki, efu u booko en i sa meke en baka fosi dii dei?”
eng_text: The Jews therefore said, "It took forty-six years to build this temple! Will you raise it up in three days?"

djk_text: Ma a ná a keliki osu di den e denki de Jesesi e taki. A be e taki fi en eigi sikin.
eng_text: But he spoke of the temple of his body.

djk_text: Da, di a opo komoto a dede baka, ne den bakaman fi en kisi den seefi taki a be taki so wan sani gi den. Ne den biibi den sani di sikiifi a Gadu Buku anga ala sani di Masaa Jesesi be taigi den.
eng_text: When therefore he was raised from the dead, his disciples remembered that he said this, and they believed the Scripture, and the word which Jesus had said.

djk_text: Da, di Masaa Jesesi de a Jelusalem na a Pasika Piisii, da somen sama daai kon e biibi ne en, fu di den be si den gaan foondoo foondoo sani di a be e du.
eng_text: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the Passover, during the feast, many believed in his name, observing his signs which he did.

djk_text: Da anga ala fa den e biibi ne en de seefi, toku Masaa Jesesi nái fitoow den. Bika a be sabi ala den fiya.
eng_text: But Jesus didn't trust himself to them, because he knew everyone,

djk_text: Da a á be de fanowdu fu wan sama taigi en sani fu taa sama. Bika enseefi be sabi kiinkiin san de a ini den sama pakisei.
eng_text: and because he didn't need for anyone to testify concerning man; for he himself knew what was in man.

djk_text: Wan Faliseiman be de, den be e kai Nikodeimisi. Da Nikodeimisi na be wan gaan edeman fu den Dyu.
eng_text: Now there was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews.

djk_text: We, ne a kon a Masaa Jesesi a wan neti, di ala peesi dunguu kaba. Ne a taigi Masaa Jesesi taki: “Labai! Wi sabi taki yu na wan leliman di Masaa Gadu sende kon. Bika ná wan sama di poi du den sani di yu e du, efu Gadu á de anga en.”
eng_text: The same came to him by night, and said to him, "Rabbi, we know that you are a teacher come from God, for no one can do these signs that you do, unless God is with him."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “We, tuutuu mi e taigi yu taki, efu wan sama á meke baka ete wan toon fu fende wan nyun libi, da a ná o poi go si a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: Jesus answered him, "Most certainly, I tell you, unless one is born anew, he can't see the Kingdom of God."

djk_text: Ne Nikodeimisi piki en taki: “Fa wan sama o du meke baka, te a gaandi kaba? A sa go ne en mma bee baka fu a meke en di fu tu toon?”
eng_text: Nicodemus said to him, "How can a man be born when he is old? Can he enter a second time into his mother's womb, and be born?"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Fu tuu mi e taigi yu taki, efu wan sama á meke baka ete wan toon, a wan hii taa fasi anga wataa anga Jeje, a ná o poi go si a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Jesus answered, "Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born of water and spirit, he can't enter into the Kingdom of God!

djk_text: Sama di meke a libisama fasi, a libisama fasi a o de. Ma sama di a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu meke, da na Gadu fasi a o de.
eng_text: That which is born of the flesh is flesh. That which is born of the Spirit is spirit.

djk_text: We, fa mi taigi i de taki, yu mu meke baka ete wan toon, da a á mu foondoo yu.
eng_text: Don't marvel that I said to you, 'You must be born anew.'

djk_text: Winta e wai go a pe a wani. Na a bali fi en namo yu e yee. Ma yu á sabi na on pe a komoto efu na on pe ai go. We, na letiso a de anga ibii sama di a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu a tapu meke baka ete wan toon. Yu nái si a nyunyun meke efu fusutan en, leti enke fa yu nái fusutan a winta. Ma yu sabi taki sowan sani pasa tuu.”
eng_text: The wind blows where it wants to, and you hear its sound, but don't know where it comes from and where it is going. So is everyone who is born of the Spirit."

djk_text: Ma Nikodeimisi piki en taki: “Fa den sani ya o du pasa?”
eng_text: Nicodemus answered him, "How can these things be?"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Yu na wan gaan leliman fu Islayeli Kondee, ne yu á sabi den sani ya?”
eng_text: Jesus answered him, "Are you the teacher of Israel, and don't understand these things?

djk_text: Fu tuu mi e taigi yu taki: “Wi sabi san wi e taki. Bika na den sani di wi si, wi e taki. Ma u á wani biibi san wi e taigi u.
eng_text: Most certainly I tell you, we speak that which we know, and testify of that which we have seen, and you don't receive our witness.

djk_text: We, efu u nái biibi mi, te mi e taki anga u fu den sani fu goontapu ya, da fa u o biibi, te mi o taki anga u fu den sani fu Gadu Kondee a tapu?
eng_text: If I told you earthly things and you don't believe, how will you believe if I tell you heavenly things?

djk_text: “Bika ná wan sama be opo go a Masaa Gadu Kondee a tapu boiti a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya.
eng_text: No one has ascended into heaven, but he who descended out of heaven, the Son of Man, who is in heaven.

djk_text: “We, leti enke fa Mosesi be meke a kopoo sineki opo poti a hei a ini a sabana, na soseefi den o opo a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya, poti a hei tu.
eng_text: As Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of Man be lifted up,

djk_text: Da, ibiiwan sama di o biibi a mi, da yu o fende a libi fu tego a Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

djk_text: “We, bika Masaa Gadu lobi goontapu te, ne a gi den a wankodo Manpikin fi en, fu ibiiwan sama di e biibi ne en á mu go lasi, ma fu den fende a libi fu tego.
eng_text: For God so loved the world, that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

djk_text: Bika fa Masaa Gadu sende en Manpikin kon a goontapu ya, da a á sende en kon fu a kuutu libisama. Ma a sende en kon fu a puu libisama a dede meke den fende a libi fu tego.
eng_text: For God didn't send his Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world should be saved through him.

djk_text: Da, efu wan sama e biibi a ini a Manpikin fu Masaa Gadu ya, da a ná o kisi sitaafu. Ma sama di nái biibi a ini en, da a kuutu i kaba fi i kisi a sitaafu de. Da a o kuutu yu fu di yu á biibi a ini a nen, fu a wankodo Manpikin di Masaa Gadu sende kon gi u.
eng_text: He who believes in him is not judged. He who doesn't believe has been judged already, because he has not believed in the name of the one and only Son of God.

djk_text: Da disi na a sitaafu: Bika a de so taki Masaa Gadu be sende a leti fi en kon a goontapu, ma libisama á be wani a leti ya. Pe fu dati, ne den de fu den a dunguu, bika den á be wani fika den ogii libi fu den fu kon a ini a leti.
eng_text: This is the judgment, that the light has come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light; for their works were evil.

djk_text: Bika wan sama di e du ogii, na wan sama di buuse leti. A ná o kon seefi a pe a leti sa kai ne en fu den wooko fi en kon a kiin.
eng_text: For everyone who does evil hates the light, and doesn't come to the light, lest his works would be exposed.

djk_text: Ma sama di e libi letiopu, ná abi toobi fu kon a ini a leti. Da na so a o soi taki ai du san Masaa Gadu taki.”
eng_text: But he who does the truth comes to the light, that his works may be revealed, that they have been done in God."

djk_text: Ne bakadati, ne Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en go a Judeja pisiwataa. Ne en anga den de ape fu wan pisiten. Ne Masaa Jesesi dopu den sama de.
eng_text: After these things, Jesus came with his disciples into the land of Judea. He stayed there with them, and baptized.

djk_text: Ma Johanisi a Dopuman á be go a dunguu osu ete. Da na so enseefi be e dopu sama tu na a peesi di den e kai Enon, koosube fu a kondee di den e kai Salim. Bika a peesi be abi tyaipi wataa. Da somen sama be kon ne en tu fu a dopu den.
eng_text: John also was baptizing in Enon near Salim, because there was much water there. They came, and were baptized.

djk_text: Da a seefi yuu ten de, ne den bakaman fu Johanisi anga wan Dyu de a wan gaan sitee kwali fu den. Da den be de na a sitee fu san den mu du fu den kon kiin a Gadu fesi.
eng_text: There arose therefore a questioning on the part of John's disciples with some Jews about purification.

djk_text: Ne den bakaman fu Johanisi kon ne en, ne den taigi en taki: “Labai! I sabi a sama di i be taigi wi somen sani fi en? A de na abaase anda e dopu sama. Da ala den sama fiya e go ne en. Na a sama di i be taigi wi somen sani fi en.”
eng_text: They came to John, and said to him, "Rabbi, he who was with you beyond the Jordan, to whom you have testified, behold, the same baptizes, and everyone is coming to him."

djk_text: Ma Johanisi piki den taki: “Ná wan libisama sa du wan sani, efu a ná Masaa Gadu a tapu seefi de anga en.
eng_text: John answered, "A man can receive nothing, unless it has been given him from heaven.

djk_text: U seefi á be yee di mi be taki, mi a ná a Kelestesi, ma na sende Masaa Gadu sende mi kon ne en fesi, no?
eng_text: You yourselves testify that I said, 'I am not the Christ,' but, 'I have been sent before him.'

djk_text: Te wan sama toow anga wan uman, ne en na a man fu a uman. Ma a man o abi wan mati di e seeka ala sani gi en na a toow dei. A ná en o toow anga a uman, ma na seeka namo ai seeka sani gi en. Te a kaba seeka sani, da a o go de fi en a wanse pii fu yee a toowman tongo. Da te a yee en tongo, da a o piisii gaan piisii. We, na a gaan piisii di a mati fu a toowman e piisii de, na so miseefi e piisii tu.
eng_text: He who has the bride is the bridegroom; but the friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears him, rejoices greatly because of the bridegroom's voice. This, my joy, therefore is made full.

djk_text: Bika a sama de mu kon moo anga moo a fesi fu teke peesi, ma mi mu go moo anga moo a baka.
eng_text: He must increase, but I must decrease.

djk_text: “Bika a sama di komoto a Gadu a tapu hei moo ala sama. Ma sama di meke a goontapu, na fu goontapu namo a de. Da na goontapu toli namo a o go e taki.
eng_text: He who comes from above is above all. He who is from the earth belongs to the earth, and speaks of the earth. He who comes from heaven is above all.

djk_text: Ma a sama di komoto a Masaa Gadu hei moo ala taa sama. Da a sama de e taki fu san a si anga san a yee. Ma toku, ná wan libisama wani teke sani ai taki.
eng_text: What he has seen and heard, of that he testifies; and no one receives his witness.

djk_text: Ma, efu wan sama teke den sani di ai taki, da sowan sama e soi kiinkiin taki san Masaa Gadu taki na wan tuutuu sani.
eng_text: He who has received his witness has set his seal to this, that God is true.

djk_text: Bika a sama di Masaa Gadu be sende kon a goontapu e taki den sani di Masaa Gadu gi en fu taki. Bika Masaa Gadu á be gi wi a Jeje fi en afu afu, ma a be gi enmi en hiihii.
eng_text: For he whom God has sent speaks the words of God; for God gives the Spirit without measure.

djk_text: A Tata lobi a Manpikin fi en. Da a poti ala sani a ini en ana.
eng_text: The Father loves the Son, and has given all things into his hand.

djk_text: Da, efu wan sama e poti biibi na a Manpikin fu Masaa Gadu ya, da i abi a libi fu tego kaba. Ma, efu wan sama á wani poti biibi na a Manpikin fu Masaa Gadu ya tapu, da i ná o fende a libi fu tego ya. Bika a atiboon fu Masaa Gadu de a yu tapu kaba.”
eng_text: One who believes in the Son has eternal life, but one who disobeys the Son won't see life, but the wrath of God remains on him."

djk_text: We, ne a seefi yuu ten de, ne den Faliseiman yee taki somen sama e kon a Masaa Jesesi te a ipi fu a dopu de. Da den sama e fika anga Masaa Jesesi e toon bakaman fi en. Da na so Masaa Jesesi be abi moo ipi bakaman moo Johanisi.
eng_text: Therefore when the Lord knew that the Pharisees had heard that Jesus was making and baptizing more disciples than John

djk_text: Wansi a ná enseefi be e dopu den sama seefi, ma na den bakaman fi en.
eng_text: (although Jesus himself didn't baptize, but his disciples),

djk_text: We, ne di Masaa yee taki den Faliseiman kon sabi so kaba, ne a komoto fika Judeja go a Galileya.
eng_text: he left Judea, and departed into Galilee.

djk_text: Ma a be musu fu waka pasa na a pisi kondee di en e kai Samaliya fosi a be doo Galileya.
eng_text: He needed to pass through Samaria.

djk_text: Ne ai go te a go doo a wan foto fu Samaliya den e kai Sikali. Da Sikali de koosube anga wan pisi doti di a gaansama fu den Dyu den kai Jakopu be gi wan fu den pikin fi den kai Jowsef.
eng_text: So he came to a city of Samaria, called Sychar, near the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son, Joseph.

djk_text: We, na ape Jakopu be abi wan peti wataa fi en di de a pe te enke tide. We, di Masaa Jesesi be doo de, da a be weli fu waka. Ne a go koosube na peti. Da a be sa de wan sani fu twalufu yuu mindii dei so.
eng_text: Jacob's well was there. Jesus therefore, being tired from his journey, sat down by the well. It was about the sixth hour .

djk_text: Di Masaa Jesesi sidon de te wan pisi, ne wan uman fu a kondee de kon fu kisi wataa na a peti. Ne Masaa Jesesi akisi en taki: “Gi mi wan pikinso wataa fi yu mi diingi, baa?”
eng_text: A woman of Samaria came to draw water. Jesus said to her, "Give me a drink."

djk_text: Da a yuu de, da den bakaman fi en be go a foto fu bai sani fu den nyan.
eng_text: For his disciples had gone away into the city to buy food.

djk_text: Ne a uman akisi en taki: “Fa yu enke wan Dyusama sa begi mi wataa fu diingi?” Den Dyu anga den Samaliya sama á be e koti.
eng_text: The Samaritan woman therefore said to him, "How is it that you, being a Jew, ask for a drink from me, a Samaritan woman?" (For Jews have no dealings with Samaritans.)

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Efi i be sabi a gaan bun di Masaa Gadu be wani gi yu, anga efi i be sabi a sama di e begi i wataa fu diingi ya, da i be o begi en wataa, da a be o gi yu a wataa di e gi sama libi.”
eng_text: Jesus answered her, "If you knew the gift of God, and who it is who says to you, 'Give me a drink,' you would have asked him, and he would have given you living water."

djk_text: Ne a uman piki en taki: “We, Masaa, yu ná abi ná wan sani fu kisi a wataa. Da soseefi a peti dipi tu. Da pe yu o fende libi wataa fu gi mi?
eng_text: The woman said to him, "Sir, you have nothing to draw with, and the well is deep. From where then have you that living water?

djk_text: I bigi moo u tata Jakopu di be gi wi a peti ya? Bika enseefi anga den pikin fi en anga den meti fi en be diingi a wataa fu a peti ya.”
eng_text: Are you greater than our father, Jacob, who gave us the well, and drank of it himself, as did his children, and his livestock?"

djk_text: Ne Jesesi piki en taki: “A sama di e diingi a wataa ya, te wan pisiten, da dee wataa o kisi en baka.
eng_text: Jesus answered her, "Everyone who drinks of this water will thirst again,

djk_text: Ma a sama di o diingi a wataa di mi o gi en, da ná wanten moo di dee wataa o kisi en. Ma a wataa di mi o gi en o toon gaan liba e lon komoto ne en ini huu enke gaan sula. Da sowan sama abi a libi fu tego kaba.”
eng_text: but whoever drinks of the water that I will give him will never thirst again; but the water that I will give him will become in him a well of water springing up to eternal life."

djk_text: Ne a uman taigi en taki: “Masaa oo! Gi mi a wataa de, meke dee wataa á kisi mi moo, baa? Da a ná o de fu mi kon kisi wataa dise moo.”
eng_text: The woman said to him, "Sir, give me this water, so that I don't get thirsty, neither come all the way here to draw."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi en taki: “Go kai i man, da u kon.”
eng_text: Jesus said to her, "Go, call your husband, and come here."

djk_text: Ne a uman taigi en taki: “Mi ná abi man.” Ne Jesesi taigi en taki: “Na tuu san i taki, taki i ná abi man.
eng_text: The woman answered, "I have no husband." Jesus said to her, "You said well, 'I have no husband,'

djk_text: Bika na feifi man i libi anga den paati kaba. Da a wan di i abi ya seefi a ná yu man tu. Da san yu taki ya na tuu.”
eng_text: for you have had five husbands; and he whom you now have is not your husband. This you have said truly."

djk_text: Ne a uman piki en taki: “Masaa, mi e si taki yu na wan apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: The woman said to him, "Sir, I perceive that you are a prophet.

djk_text: We, bika den gaansama fu u den Samaliya sama be e begi Masaa Gadu na a mongo tapu ya. Ma u den Dyusama taki, na Jelusalem na a moo bun peesi fu begi.”
eng_text: Our fathers worshiped in this mountain, and you Jews say that in Jerusalem is the place where people ought to worship."

djk_text: Ne Jesesi piki en taki: “Uman, biibi mi. A ten e kon, di a ná a mongo tapu ya efu Jelusalem u o go fu go begi a Tata moo.
eng_text: Jesus said to her, "Woman, believe me, the hour comes, when neither in this mountain, nor in Jerusalem, will you worship the Father.

djk_text: U á sabi san u e begi. Ma wi sabi san wi e begi. Bika na den Dyu a tuutuu yeepi fu Masaa Gadu e komoto go a den taa sama.
eng_text: You worship that which you don't know. We worship that which we know; for salvation is from the Jews.

djk_text: Ma a ten e kon, da meke u taki, a de kaba, di den sama di e libi wan letiopu fasi o begi anga den hii ati a ini jeje anga tuu. Bika na den sowtu sama ya Gadu Tata e suku fu begi en na a sowtu fasi ya.
eng_text: But the hour comes, and now is, when the true worshippers will worship the Father in spirit and truth, for the Father seeks such to be his worshippers.

djk_text: Ma Gadu na jeje. Da den sama di e begi en mu begi en, e opo en nen a hei a wan tuutuu fasi anga a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu leti enke fa enseefi de tuutuu.”
eng_text: God is spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth."

djk_text: Ne a uman taigi en taki: “Mi sabi taki a Mesiyasi o kon. Da te a kon, da a o tyai ala sani fiya kon a kiin gi wi.”
eng_text: The woman said to him, "I know that Messiah comes," (he who is called Christ). "When he has come, he will declare to us all things."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “We, uman, a sama di i kai de, ne en i si e taki anga yu ya.”
eng_text: Jesus said to her, "I am he, the one who speaks to you."

djk_text: We, a seefi yuu de, ne den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi kon doo a pe a be de. Ne den foondoo fu si taki a be e taki anga wan uman sama. Ma toku seefi ná wan fu den di taki wan sani fu akisi en taki, san yu akisi en, efu san yu anga en be e taki.
eng_text: At this, his disciples came. They marveled that he was speaking with a woman; yet no one said, "What are you looking for?" or, "Why do you speak with her?"

djk_text: Ne a uman fika a bungu fi en de, ne a lon go a ini a foto go kai sama taki:
eng_text: So the woman left her water pot, and went away into the city, and said to the people,

djk_text: “U kon go luku wan sama di taigi mi, mi hii libi. Da u kon u go luku. Kande sama na a Kelestesi.”
eng_text: Come, see a man who told me everything that I did. Can this be the Christ?

djk_text: Ne den sama komoto a ini a foto booko gwullu go a Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: They went out of the city, and were coming to him.

djk_text: We, a yuu de, da den bakaman be e begi Masaa Jesesi fu a go nyan.
eng_text: In the meanwhile, the disciples urged him, saying, "Rabbi, eat."

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Mi abi wan nyanyan fu nyan di u á sabi.”
eng_text: But he said to them, "I have food to eat that you don't know about."

djk_text: Ne den bakaman fi en taigi den seefi taki: “Tan! A sa de taki wan sama be tyai nyanyan kon gi en fu a nyan?”
