eng_text: The disciples therefore said one to another, "Has anyone brought him something to eat?"

djk_text: Ma Jesesi taigi den taki: “A nyanyan fu mi, na fu du a wani fu mi Tata di sende mi kon, fu a wooko fi en go doo.
eng_text: Jesus said to them, "My food is to do the will of him who sent me, and to accomplish his work.

djk_text: Na u seefi e taki, ete fo mun, da koti alisi yuu doo, no? We, u opo u ain luku den goon. Alisi lepi kaba.
eng_text: Don't you say, 'There are yet four months until the harvest?' Behold, I tell you, lift up your eyes, and look at the fields, that they are white for harvest already.

djk_text: We, sama di e koti e fende en paiman. Da soseefi ai kibii nyanyan fu a libi fu bakaten. Da sama di e paandi anga sama di e koti o piisii makandii.
eng_text: He who reaps receives wages, and gathers fruit to eternal life; that both he who sows and he who reaps may rejoice together.

djk_text: Bika na ya wi e si taki a nongo e kon tuu di taki: ‘Taawan e paandi, taawan e koti.’
eng_text: For in this the saying is true, 'One sows, and another reaps.'

djk_text: Bika, we mi be sende u go fu u koti san taa sama be paandi. Na taa sama be sete a wooko de, ma u kon fu kaba en.”
eng_text: I sent you to reap that for which you haven't labored. Others have labored, and you have entered into their labor."

djk_text: Da somen sama fu Samaliya kon biibi ne en fu a sani di a uman be taigi den. Bika a be taigi den taki: “A taigi mi ala san mi be du.”
eng_text: From that city many of the Samaritans believed in him because of the word of the woman, who testified, "He told me everything that I did."

djk_text: Ne den Samaliya sama di be kon ne en, begi en fu a tan anga den ape. Ne a tan tu dei anga den.
eng_text: So when the Samaritans came to him, they begged him to stay with them. He stayed there two days.

djk_text: Ma somen sama be daai kon e biibi ne en fu den wowtu di enseefi be e taki.
eng_text: Many more believed because of his word.

djk_text: Ne den sama taigi a uman taki: “Now u nái biibi moo fu san i taigi wi. Ma wi e biibi fu di wi eigi yesi yee. Da wi sabi tuutuu taki, a Yeepiman di Masaa Gadu sende kon gi goontapu, ne en de ya.”
eng_text: They said to the woman, "Now we believe, not because of your speaking; for we have heard for ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Savior of the world."

djk_text: Ne tu dei a baka, ne Masaa Jesesi komoto de e go a Galileya.
eng_text: After the two days he went out from there and went into Galilee.

djk_text: We, Masaa Jesesi seefi be taki kiinkiin taki: “Wan apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu ná abi nen ne en eigi kondee.”
eng_text: For Jesus himself testified that a prophet has no honor in his own country.

djk_text: We, di a doo Galileya, ne ala den sama di be si den sani di a be du a Jelusalem, teke en anga gaan piisii. Bika somen fu den be de a Jelusalem na a Pasika Piisii tu.
eng_text: So when he came into Galilee, the Galileans received him, having seen all the things that he did in Jerusalem at the feast, for they also went to the feast.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi doo a peesi di den e kai Kaana, na a pisiwataa fu Galileya, pe a be meke a wataa toon win. Ne di a go doo de, ne wan bigiman di be e wooko a kownu paleisi yee taki a komoto a Judeja kon a Galileya de. Ne a go a Masaa Jesesi fu a kon deesi wan manpikin fi en gi en. Bika a pikin ya be siki swaki te na fu dede namo.
eng_text: Jesus came therefore again to Cana of Galilee, where he made the water into wine. There was a certain nobleman whose son was sick at Capernaum.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Solanga u á si gaan foondoo sani anga gaan maiki, u nái biibi.”
eng_text: Jesus therefore said to him, "Unless you see signs and wonders, you will in no way believe."

djk_text: Ne a man piki en taki: “Masaa, gaantangi kon yeepi mi, baa. Deesi a pikin fu mi gi mi fosi a dede, baa.”
eng_text: The nobleman said to him, "Sir, come down before my child dies."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Go! A pikin fi yu e libi.” We, a man biibi enke fa Masaa Jesesi taki. Ne a go fi en a osu baka.
eng_text: Jesus said to him, "Go your way. Your son lives." The man believed the word that Jesus spoke to him, and he went his way.

djk_text: Ne di a de a pasi e gwe te wan pisi, ne a miti den futuboi fi en a pasi. Ne den taigi en taki: “A pikin fi yu e libi!”
eng_text: As he was now going down, his servants met him and reported, saying "Your child lives!"

djk_text: Ne di a akisi den on ten fu a dei a pikin be kon betee, ne den taigi en taki: “Eside bakadina, wan ten fu wan yuu, ne a feba gwe.”
eng_text: So he inquired of them the hour when he began to get better. They said therefore to him, "Yesterday at the seventh hour, the fever left him."

djk_text: Ne a man si taki na a seefi yuu di Masaa Jesesi be taigi en taki: “Go! A pikin fi yu e libi.” We, ne a man ya anga en hii osu daai kon a biibi.
eng_text: So the father knew that it was at that hour in which Jesus said to him, "Your son lives." He believed, as did his whole house.

djk_text: Da a sani di Masaa Jesesi du ya, ne meke di fu tu gaan foondoo sani di a du, di a daai komoto a Judeja kon a Galileya baka.
eng_text: This is again the second sign that Jesus did, having come out of Judea into Galilee.

djk_text: We, ne baka disi, da ete wan gaan piisii fu den Dyu o de. Ne Masaa Jesesi teke pasi, ne ai go a Jelusalem.
eng_text: After these things, there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

djk_text: We, da a yuu ten de, da wan peti wataa be de a Jelusalem koosube fu den doo mofu fu a kondee. Da disi na a doo di den sama be e tyai den sikapu pasa go a ini a kondee. Da na a peti ya den Dyu be e kai Betisaida. Da den be meke feifi baikon lontu a peti wataa ya.
eng_text: Now in Jerusalem by the sheep gate, there is a pool, which is called in Hebrew, "Bethesda," having five porches.

djk_text: Da somen sikiman be de didon didon a ini den baikon de. Beendiman, lanman anga malengiiman, ala den fiya be de ape didon didon. Ala den fiya de e luku on yuu a wataa o seke.
eng_text: In these lay a great multitude of those who were sick, blind, lame, or paralyzed, waiting for the moving of the water;

djk_text: Bika a abi a yuu, da wan Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee e saka komoto a tapu kon seke a wataa. Da te a wataa seke so kaba, da a sama di o go a ini enke fosi sama, da a sama de e kon bun baka, wansi sowtu siki a be abi.
eng_text: for an angel went down at certain times into the pool, and stirred up the water. Whoever stepped in first after the stirring of the water was made whole of whatever disease he had.

djk_text: We, wan sama di be siki diitenti na aitin yali be de ape didon didon.
eng_text: A certain man was there, who had been sick for thirty-eight years.

djk_text: Da di Masaa Jesesi si en didon didon de, ne a akisi en taki: “Man, yu wani kon bun baka?” Bika Masaa Jesesi be sabi taki a man ya be didon de langa kaba.
eng_text: When Jesus saw him lying there, and knew that he had been sick for a long time, he asked him, "Do you want to be made well?"

djk_text: Ne a sikiman piki en taki: “We, Masaa. Mi ná abi ná wan sama fu poti mi go a ini a wataa, te a wataa e seke. We bika, te a wataa seke, fosi mi go doo, da wan taa sama go a mi fesi kaba.”
eng_text: The sick man answered him, "Sir, I have no one to put me into the pool when the water is stirred up, but while I'm coming, another steps down before me."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi en taki: “Opo! Teke i kama, da i waka go.”
eng_text: Jesus said to him, "Arise, take up your mat, and walk."

djk_text: Ne wanten wanten a sikiman kon bun baka. Ne a teke en kama, ne a go. Ma namo, da ala a sani be e pasa a wan kina dei fu den Dyu.
eng_text: Immediately, the man was made well, and took up his mat and walked. Now it was the Sabbath on that day.

djk_text: Na fu dati ede meke den edeman fu den Dyu taigi a sikiman di kon bun ya taki: “Man! Yu á sabi taki tide na kina dei, no? Yu á mu wooko e tyai i kama na a kina dei ya.”
eng_text: So the Jews said to him who was cured, "It is the Sabbath. It is not lawful for you to carry the mat."

djk_text: Ne a man piki den taki: “We, na a sama di deesi mi meke mi kon bun baka, ne en taigi mi taki, meke mi opo, da mi teke mi kama, da mi waka go.”
eng_text: He answered them, "He who made me well, the same said to me, 'Take up your mat, and walk.'"

djk_text: Ne den akisi en taki: “Sama na a sama di taigi yu a sani de?”
eng_text: Then they asked him, "Who is the man who said to you, 'Take up your mat, and walk'?"

djk_text: Ma a man á be sabi Masaa Jesesi seefi. Bika Masaa Jesesi be gwe fi en komoto na ape saafi saafi. Bika somen somen sama be de ape.
eng_text: But he who was healed didn't know who it was, for Jesus had withdrawn, a crowd being in the place.

djk_text: Ne moo lati, ne Masaa Jesesi miti anga a man ya a ini a Mama Keliki fu den Dyu. Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi en taki: “I si? I kon bun baka. Yu á mu du ogii moo, ye! Efuso wan moo gaan ogii o miti yu.”
eng_text: Afterward Jesus found him in the temple, and said to him, "Behold, you are made well. Sin no more, so that nothing worse happens to you."

djk_text: Ne a man gwe, ne a taigi den edeman fu den Dyu taki, na Masaa Jesesi na a sama di deesi en meke a kon bun baka.
eng_text: The man went away, and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.

djk_text: Na fu dati ede meke den go suku Masaa Jesesi. Ne den meke toobi anga en ogii ogii e suku fu kii en fu di a be deesi a man na a kina dei fu den Dyu.
eng_text: For this cause the Jews persecuted Jesus, and sought to kill him, because he did these things on the Sabbath.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Mi Tata e wooko te enke now, da miseefi e wooko tu.”
eng_text: But Jesus answered them, "My Father is still working, so I am working, too."

djk_text: We, ne den edeman fu den Dyu e meke moiti moo taanga fu den fende en kii. Bika a ná a kina dei fu den Dyu wawan a be booko, ma a kai Masaa Gadu en eigi Tata. Da na so a be e meke enseefi toon wan anga Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: For this cause therefore the Jews sought all the more to kill him, because he not only broke the Sabbath, but also called God his own Father, making himself equal with God.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Fu tuutuu mi e taigi u taki, a Manpikin á poi du ná wan sani boiti san a si a Tata e du. Ma san a Tata e du, na dati a Manpikin e du tu.
eng_text: Jesus therefore answered them, "Most certainly, I tell you, the Son can do nothing of himself, but what he sees the Father doing. For whatever things he does, these the Son also does likewise.

djk_text: Bika a Tata lobi a Manpikin fi en. Da ala san a Tata e du ai soi a Pikin. Da a o soi en moo gaan foondoo sani ete fu du. Da u ala fiya sa foondoo seefi seefi.
eng_text: For the Father has affection for the Son, and shows him all things that he himself does. He will show him greater works than these, that you may marvel.

djk_text: Bika fa i si a Tata e weki den dedesama puu a dede, gi den libi baka, na leti soseefi a Manpikin fi en sa gi iniiwan sama di a wani libi tu.
eng_text: For as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, even so the Son also gives life to whom he desires.

djk_text: We, a Tata nái kuutu ná wan sama, ma a poti ala a kuutu a ini ana fu a Manpikin.
eng_text: For the Father judges no one, but he has given all judgment to the Son,

djk_text: We, na fu ala sama mu lesipeki a Manpikin, enke fa den e lesipeki a Tata meke a du so. Da sama di nái lesipeki a Manpikin, nái lesipeki a Tata tu, di sende a Manpikin kon a goontapu.
eng_text: that all may honor the Son, even as they honor the Father. He who doesn't honor the Son doesn't honor the Father who sent him.

djk_text: “Fu tuutuu mi e taigi u taki, a sama di e biibi san mi e taki tuu, ne ai biibi a sama di sende mi kon a goontapu, da sowan sama abi a libi fu tego kaba. Da a sama de ná o go a kuutu moo. Bika a komoto a dede kon a libi.
eng_text:
Most certainly I tell you, he who hears my word, and believes him who sent me, has eternal life, and doesn't come into judgment, but has passed out of death into life.

Ma den di be libi takuu a Gadu ain, sa opo baka komoto a ini geebi fu go a kuutu poti go a sitaafu.	3030	and will come out; those who have done good, to the resurrection of life; and those who have done evil, to the resurrection of judgment.

As I hear, I judge, and my judgment is righteous; because I don't seek my own will, but the will of my Father who sent me.

djk_text: Ma wan taawan de, di e taki sani fu mi. Da mi sabi taki san ai taki fu mi de, leti enke fa ai taki den tuu.
eng_text: It is another who testifies about me. I know that the testimony which he testifies about me is true.

djk_text: Bika luku. U be sende sama go a Johanisi fu akisi en sani. Ne a piki u, leti enke fa a de tuu.
eng_text: You have sent to John, and he has testified to the truth.

djk_text: Ma toku seefi, mi nái teke a taki fu libisama. Ma mi be taki disi namo fu u be sa komoto a ini takuudu anga ogii kon a Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: But the testimony which I receive is not from man. However, I say these things that you may be saved.

djk_text: Bika Johanisi be de enke wan lampu di be de leti leti e kiin dyelle. Da a be bun gi u fu wan pisiten fu aliki san a be e taki.
eng_text: He was the burning and shining lamp, and you were willing to rejoice for a while in his light.

djk_text: Ma mi abi sani ete di e taki moo taanga fu mi moo enke den wowtu di Johanisi be taki. Dati na den wooko di mi Tata be sende mi fu du ya. Bika den gaan foondoo foondoo wooko di mi e du ya, na den seefi wooko ya e soi taki na mi Tata be sende mi kon.
eng_text: But the testimony which I have is greater than that of John, for the works which the Father gave me to accomplish, the very works that I do, testify about me, that the Father has sent me.

djk_text: “Da soseefi mi Tata di be sende mi kon, seefi e taki sani fu mi. Ma, u á be yee en tongo wan dei. U á si en fesi wan dei, te go taki fu sabi en.
eng_text: The Father himself, who sent me, has testified about me. You have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his form.

djk_text: Da soseefi a wowtu fi en á de a ini u ati ini fu alaten. Bika u á wani biibi a sama di a be sende kon.
eng_text: You don't have his word living in you; because you don't believe him whom he sent.

djk_text: U e feti e suku sani a ini Gadu Buku. Fu di u denki taki a ini Gadu Buku u sa fende a libi fu tego. We, na so a de tuu. Bika na mi a Buku de e taki.
eng_text:
You search the Scriptures, because you think that in them you have eternal life; and these are they which testify about me.
3041	Ma u á wani kon a mi fu u fende a libi fu tego.	3041	Yet you will not come to me, that you may have life.
3042	“Mi nái suku nen a libisama.	3042	I don't receive glory from men.
3043	Ma mi sabi taki fa u e meke de, u á lobi Gadu.	3043	But I know you, that you don't have God's love in yourselves.
3044	Mi Tata sende mi kon a ini en nen, ma u nái oli mi fu wan sani. Te wan taawan o kon a ini en eigi nen, da u o gaapu en gwulu oli seefi.	3044	I have come in my Father's name, and you don't receive me. If another comes in his own name, you will receive him.
3045	Ma fa u o du biibi? Bika u e suku nen a useefi. Ma u nái feti fu fende nen a Gadu a tapu anda.	3045	How can you believe, who receive glory from one another, and you don't seek the glory that comes from the only God?
3046	“U á mu denki taki mi o tyai u go kaagi u a mi Tata. Nono! Kweti kweti! Wan taawan de di de kaba kaba fu kaagi u. Dati na Mosesi di i si u e poti fitoow.	3046	Don't think that I will accuse you to the Father. There is one who accuses you, even Moses, on whom you have set your hope.

djk_text: We bika, efu u be e biibi Mosesi tuutuu, da u be o biibi mi tu. Bika ala den sani di Mosesi sikiifi, na sani fu mi a be e sikiifi.
eng_text: For if you believed Moses, you would believe me; for he wrote about me.

djk_text: Ma, di u nái biibi san a sikiifi, da fa u o du biibi mi?”
eng_text: But if you don't believe his writings, how will you believe my words?"

djk_text: Ne baka wan pisiten, ne Masaa Jesesi go a ini wan sipi fu koti a ze fu Galileya di den e kai Tibeliyasi abaa go na abaase.
eng_text: After these things, Jesus went away to the other side of the sea of Galilee, which is also called the Sea of Tiberias.

djk_text: Da a yuu ten de, da wan gaan ipi sama be e waka a futu e faaka Masaa Jesesi e kon, fu di den be si den gaan foondoo sani, di a be du, deesi den sikiman.
eng_text: A great multitude followed him, because they saw his signs which he did on those who were sick.

djk_text: Na dati meke Masaa Jesesi subi a wan pikin mongo tapu go sidon anga den bakaman fi en.
eng_text: Jesus went up into the mountain, and he sat there with his disciples.

djk_text: Da a ten de, da a gaan piisii fu den Dyu di den e kai Pasika be de koosube.
eng_text: Now the Passover, the feast of the Jews, was at hand.

djk_text: We, ne di Masaa Jesesi opo ede di a si taki na tyaipi sama kon ne en so, ne a akisi Filipi taki: “Filipi, pe u sa bai beele fu den sama ya fende nyan?”
eng_text: Jesus therefore lifting up his eyes, and seeing that a great multitude was coming to him, said to Philip, "Where are we to buy bread, that these may eat?"

djk_text: Ma fa a akisi en de seefi, na akisi a akisi en fu luku fa a o piki. Bika Masaa Jesesi be sabi bunbun san a be wani du.
eng_text: This he said to test him, for he himself knew what he would do.

djk_text: Ne Filipi piki en taki: “Efu u bai wan miliyun anga onmen dunsu kolu beele seefi, toku a ná o sai den sama ya. Winsi ibii sama teke wan pikin pisi seefi.”
eng_text: Philip answered him, "Two hundred denarii worth of bread is not sufficient for them, that everyone of them may receive a little."

djk_text: Ne wan fu den bakaman fi en di den e kai Andeleyasi, a baala fu Simon Peitilisi taigi en taki:
eng_text: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, said to him,

djk_text: “Wan pikin boi de ya di abi feifi pikin beele anga tu fisi. Ma san dati o poi yeepi den somen sama ya?”
eng_text: There is a boy here who has five barley loaves and two fish, but what are these among so many?

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “Meke ala sama go sidon.” Bika a peesi be abi tyaipi gaasi. We, ne den go sidon. Da a be sa de wan sani fu feifi dunsu manengee so.
eng_text: Jesus said, "Have the people sit down." Now there was much grass in that place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi teke den beele, ne a begi gi Masaa Gadu daa moi te a kaba, ne a paati gi den sama di be sidon. Da soseefi a paati den tu fisi gi den sama.
eng_text: Jesus took the loaves; and having given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to those who were sitting down; likewise also of the fish as much as they desired.

djk_text: Da ala sama nyan te den bee fuu. Ne di den kaba nyan, ne Masaa Jesesi sende den bakaman fi en fu den go piki den pisipisi beele di den sama nyan fika. Bika a nyanyan á mu poli.
eng_text: When they were filled, he said to his disciples, "Gather up the broken pieces which are left over, that nothing be lost."

djk_text: Ne den go piki den pisipisi beele di fika. Ne den piki te twalufu bakisi fuu kwaa anga a pisi fu a beele di den sama be nyan fika.
eng_text: So they gathered them up, and filled twelve baskets with broken pieces from the five barley loaves, which were left over by those who had eaten.

djk_text: We, ne di den sama si a gaan foondoo sani di Masaa Jesesi du ya, ne a bigi gi den te, ná sipowtu. Ne den taki: “Fu tuu, a sama ya na a apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu di a be paamisi fu sende kon a goontapu.”
eng_text: When therefore the people saw the sign which Jesus did, they said, "This is truly the prophet who comes into the world."

djk_text: Ma namo, di Masaa Jesesi sabi taki den wani kon kisi en anga taanga fu meke a toon den kownu, ne a go fi en na a mongo tapu go de en wawan.
eng_text: Jesus therefore, perceiving that they were about to come and take him by force, to make him king, withdrew again to the mountain by himself.

djk_text: Ne di sapaten, ne den bakaman fi en go na a ze.
eng_text: When evening came, his disciples went down to the sea,

djk_text: Ne den go a ini wan sipiboto e koti abaa go na a Kafalnayemu. Da a yuu de, da peesi be kon e dunguu kaba. Ma Masaa Jesesi á be go anga den.
eng_text: and they entered into the boat, and were going over the sea to Capernaum. It was now dark, and Jesus had not come to them.

djk_text: Ma namo, wan gaan taanga winta e wai na a ze e seke a wataa hei den paana te, ná sipowtu.
eng_text: The sea was tossed by a great wind blowing.

djk_text: Ne di den go wan sani fu feifi kilomeiti so, ne den si Masaa Jesesi e waka na a wataa tapu e kon miti den na a sipiboto. Ne den feele, te ná sipowtu.
eng_text: When therefore they had rowed about twenty-five or thirty stadia, they saw Jesus walking on the sea, and drawing near to the boat; and they were afraid.

djk_text: Ma a taigi den taki: “U á feele! Na mi!”
eng_text: But he said to them, "It is I . Don't be afraid."

djk_text: Ne di a taigi den so, ne den ati koo. Ne den teke en poti kon a ini a sipi. Ne wanten den doo tu a pe den be e go.
eng_text: They were willing therefore to receive him into the boat. Immediately the boat was at the land where they were going.

djk_text: Da a taa dei fi en, da somen sama be de na abaase fu a ze e foondoo. Den á be sabi on se Masaa Jesesi be go. Bika taa boto moo enke di den bakaman fi en be go a ini á be de ape. Da Masaa Jesesi á be gwe anga den a ini a boto.
eng_text: On the next day, the multitude that stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was no other boat there, except the one in which his disciples had embarked, and that Jesus hadn't entered with his disciples into the boat, but his disciples had gone away alone.

djk_text: Da a yuu de, da wantu boto fu a kondee di den e kai Tibeliyasi be kon koosube na a peesi, pe Masaa Jesesi be teke a beele gi Masaa Gadu daa, paati gi den sama.
eng_text: However boats from Tiberias came near to the place where they ate the bread after the Lord had given thanks.

djk_text: Ma di den sama si taki Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en á de ape, ne den go a ini wan sipiboto, ne den go a Kafalnayemu go suku en.
eng_text: When the multitude therefore saw that Jesus wasn't there, nor his disciples, they themselves got into the boats, and came to Capernaum, seeking Jesus.

djk_text: Ne di den go, ne den si en na a abaase fu a ze. Ne den akisi en taki: “Labai, on yuu i kon ya?”
eng_text: When they found him on the other side of the sea, they asked him, "Rabbi, when did you come here?"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Fu tuutuu mi e taigi u taki, u nái kon suku mi, fu di u be si den foondoo sani di mi du. Ma na fu di u be nyan a beele te a sai u.
eng_text: Jesus answered them, "Most certainly I tell you, you seek me, not because you saw signs, but because you ate of the loaves, and were filled.

djk_text: U á suku nyanyan di e oli u fu wan pisiten naamo. Ma u suku a nyanyan, di a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya e gi u, fu fende libi di de tego. Bika ne en u Tata, Masaa Gadu, be naki sitampu taki, a bun.”
eng_text: Don't work for the food which perishes, but for the food which remains to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give to you. For God the Father has sealed him."

djk_text: Ne den akisi en taki: “We, fa u mu du fu u sa du den wooko di Masaa Gadu wani meke u du?”
eng_text: They said therefore to him, "What must we do, that we may work the works of God?"

djk_text: Ne a piki den taki: “We, san Masaa Gadu wani, na fu u biibi Awan di a sende kon ya.”
eng_text: Jesus answered them, "This is the work of God, that you believe in him whom he has sent."

djk_text: We, ne den akisi en taki: “We, sowtu maiki yu o du gi u fu u sa sabi taki na yu u mu biibi?
eng_text: They said therefore to him, "What then do you do for a sign, that we may see, and believe you? What work do you do?

djk_text: We bika, den avo avo fu wi be nyan mana di den be a ini a gaan sabana ini. Bika Buku sikiifi taki: ‘A gi den beele komoto a Gadu Kondee a tapu fu den nyan.’ ”
eng_text: Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness. As it is written, 'He gave them bread out of heaven to eat.'"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Fu tuutuu mi e taigi u taki, a ná Mosesi be gi den a beele di be e komoto a tapu. Ma na mi Tata e gi u a tuutuu beele di komoto a Gadu anda.
eng_text: Jesus therefore said to them, "Most certainly, I tell you, it wasn't Moses who gave you the bread out of heaven, but my Father gives you the true bread out of heaven.

djk_text: Bika a nowfosi a tuutuu beele komoto a tapu saka kon a goontapu. Da a tuutuu beele ya, e gi ala sama a libi fu tego.”
eng_text: For the bread of God is that which comes down out of heaven, and gives life to the world."

djk_text: Ne den taigi en taki: “We, Masaa, gi wi a beele de fu u nyan alaten, no?”
eng_text: They said therefore to him, "Lord, always give us this bread."

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “Na mi na a beele fu libi. Sama di kon a mi, noiti moo angii sa kii en. Da sama di e biibi a mi, noiti moo dee wataa sa kisi en.
eng_text: Jesus said to them, "I am the bread of life. He who comes to me will not be hungry, and he who believes in me will never be thirsty.

djk_text: Mi be taigi u kaba. U e si mi, ma toku u nái biibi.
eng_text: But I told you that you have seen me, and yet you don't believe.

djk_text: Ala den sama di mi Tata gi mi o kon a mi. Da ala sama di kon a mi, mi ná o daai den baka, fu sende den gwe.
eng_text: All those whom the Father gives me will come to me. He who comes to me I will in no way throw out.

djk_text: Bika mi á komoto a tapu kon a goontapu fu du mi wani. Ma fu du a wani fu mi Tata di sende mi kon.
eng_text: For I have come down from heaven, not to do my own will, but the will of him who sent me.

djk_text: Da san na a wani fu mi Tata? Dati na taki mi á mu meke ná wan fu den sama di a gi mi go lasi. Ma mi mu weki den na a kiiboi dei puu a dede.
eng_text: This is the will of my Father who sent me, that of all he has given to me I should lose nothing, but should raise him up at the last day.

djk_text: Da, disi na a wani fu mi Tata di sende mi kon. Iniiwan sama di si a Manpikin fi en, ne den biibi en, da a sama de abi a libi fu tego. Da a sa weki so wan sama puu a dede na a kiiboi dei.”
eng_text: This is the will of the one who sent me, that everyone who sees the Son, and believes in him, should have eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day."

djk_text: Ma den Dyu e kuutu fu di a taigi den taki en na a beele di komoto a tapu saka kon a goontapu.
eng_text: The Jews therefore murmured concerning him, because he said, "I am the bread which came down out of heaven."

djk_text: Den taki: “Tan! A sama ya, a ná a manpikin fu Jowsef, di den e kai Jesesi, no? U sabi en dda anga en mma. Da fa a sa taki, taki a komoto a tapu saka kon a goontapu?”
eng_text: They said, "Isn't this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How then does he say, 'I have come down out of heaven?'"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “U á kuutu kuutu fu dati.
eng_text: Therefore Jesus answered them, "Don't murmur among yourselves.

djk_text: Ná wan sama sa kon a mi, efu a ná mi Tata di be sende mi kon ali en kon a mi. Da mi sa weki en baka puu a dede na a kiiboi dei.
eng_text: No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him, and I will raise him up in the last day.

djk_text: Da wan fu den apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu be sikiifi taki: ‘Na Gadu seefi e leli ala sama.’ Da iniiwan sama di e aliki a Tata, ne a teke san di Masaa Gadu e leli en, da so wan sama musu kon a mi.
eng_text: It is written in the prophets, 'They will all be taught by God.' Therefore everyone who hears from the Father, and has learned, comes to me.

djk_text: Ná wan sama be si Masaa Gadu wan dei, boiti Awan di komoto a Masaa Gadu. Ne en wawan too, si en.”
eng_text: Not that anyone has seen the Father, except he who is from God. He has seen the Father.

djk_text: Fu tuutuu mi e taigi u: “Iniiwan sama di biibi a mi, da a sama de abi a libi fu tego.
eng_text: Most certainly, I tell you, he who believes in me has eternal life.

djk_text: Mi na a beele di e gi sama libi.
eng_text: I am the bread of life.

djk_text: Den avo avo fu u be nyan a mana a ini a gaan sabana, ma toku den dede.
eng_text: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, and they died.

djk_text: Ma, u luku a beele di komoto a tapu saka kon a goontapu ya. Da, efu wan sama nyan a beele ya, da a ná o dede. Ma yu o fende a libi fu tego.
eng_text: This is the bread which comes down out of heaven, that anyone may eat of it and not die.

djk_text: Mi na a beele di e gi libisama libi. Na Gadu mi komoto. Da a sama di o nyan a beele ya, abi a libi fu tego. Da a beele di mi e taki ya, na mi sikin dugu dugu di mi o gi fu ala libisama ede.”
eng_text: I am the living bread which came down out of heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. Yes, the bread which I will give for the life of the world is my flesh."

djk_text: Ma namo, ne den Dyu bigin sitee anga denseefi. Den taki: “Fa a sa gi wi en sikin dugu dugu meti fu nyan?”
eng_text: The Jews therefore contended with one another, saying, "How can this man give us his flesh to eat?"

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “Fu tuutuu mi e taigi u, efu u á teke a sikin fu a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya fu nyan, da u teke a buulu fi en diingi, da yu ná abi libi ete.
eng_text: Jesus therefore said to them, "Most certainly I tell you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you don't have life in yourselves.

djk_text: A sama di o teke a mi sikin nyan, ne a teke mi buulu diingi, da a abi a libi fu tego kaba. Da mi sa weki en puu a dede na a kiiboi dei.
eng_text: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.

djk_text: Bika mi sikin na tuutuu nyanyan anga mi buulu na tuutuu diingi.
eng_text: For my flesh is food indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.

djk_text: We, efu wan sama teke mi sikin nyan, ne a teke mi buulu diingi, da ai tan a ini mi. Da soseefi mi e tan a ini en tu.
eng_text: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood lives in me, and I in him.

djk_text: Da na mi Tata di abi ala libi sende mi kon. Da, leti enke fa mi Tata di e gi libi gi mi libi, da na letiso den sama di nyan mi sikin sa libi, bika mi e gi den libi.
eng_text: As the living Father sent me, and I live because of the Father; so he who feeds on me, he will also live because of me.

djk_text: We, na fu dati ede meke mi taigi u taki, mi na a beele di saka komoto a tapu kon a goontapu. A á de enke a mana di den avo avo fu u be nyan a ini a gaan sabana ini. Bika anga ala fa den be nyanmi en de seefi, toku den dede. Ma, efu wan sama nyan a beele ya, da a sa abi libi fu tego.”
eng_text: This is the bread which came down out of heaven--not as our fathers ate the manna, and died. He who eats this bread will live forever."

djk_text: Da Masaa Jesesi be leli den sama ala den sani ya di a be de a ini a keliki a Kafalnayemu.
eng_text: He said these things in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.

djk_text: Ma di somen fu den sama di be e waka ne en baka yee san a taki, ne den taki: “A sani di a taigi u de taanga. Da sama o poi teke a sani de?”
eng_text: Therefore many of his disciples, when they heard this, said, "This is a hard saying! Who can listen to it?"

djk_text: Ma fu di Masaa Jesesi be sabi kaba a ini en ati taki na so den sama di e waka ne en baka e kuutu fu san di a taki, ne a taigi den taki: “Oho! San meke u mandii so? Na a sani di mi taigi u de taanga gi u fu teke so?
eng_text: But Jesus knowing in himself that his disciples murmured at this, said to them, "Does this cause you to stumble?

djk_text: We, da on fa a o de gi u seefi, te u o si, a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya, o opo go a tapu baka a pe a be komoto?
eng_text: Then what if you would see the Son of Man ascending to where he was before?

djk_text: Na a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu e gi libi. Libisama á poi gi i libi. Bika den wowtu di mi taki gi u de e tyai a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu kon gi u. Da a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu ya e gi libi.
eng_text: It is the spirit who gives life. The flesh profits nothing. The words that I speak to you are spirit, and are life.

djk_text: “Ma son sama de a u mindii di ná biibi.” Bika Masaa Jesesi be sabi kaba, sama anga sama á be o poti biibi ne en. Da soseefi a be sabi sama be o seli en tu.
eng_text: But there are some of you who don't believe." For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were who didn't believe, and who it was who would betray him.

djk_text: Ne a taigi den taki: “Na fu dati ede meke mi be taigi u taki, ná wan sama sa kon a mi, efu a ná mi Tata gi en a okasi.”
eng_text: He said, "For this cause have I said to you that no one can come to me, unless it is given to him by my Father."

djk_text: Ne fanafu a ten de, ne somen fu den sama di be e waka ne en baka, daai baka gi en. Den á wani waka anga en moo.
eng_text: At this, many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi daai, ne a akisi den twalufu bakaman fi en taki: “We, on fa? U wani gwe tu?”
eng_text: Jesus said therefore to the twelve, "You don't also want to go away, do you?"

djk_text: Ne Simon Peitilisi piki taki: “Masaa! Sama wi sa go moo so? We bika, i abi wowtu di e gi sama tego libi!
eng_text: Simon Peter answered him, "Lord, to whom would we go? You have the words of eternal life.

djk_text: U poti biibi a yu, bika u sabi taki yu na a Apaiti Sama fu Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: We have come to believe and know that you are the Christ, the Son of the living God."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “A ná u twalufu mi be teke kon toon fu mi wawan, no? Ma wan fu u na wan didibii.”
eng_text: Jesus answered them, "Didn't I choose you, the twelve, and one of you is a devil?"

djk_text: Da na a Judasi, a pikin fu Simon Iskaliyotu, ne na a sama di a be e taki. Bika en na be wan fu den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi tu. Da anga ala fa en na be wan fu den twalufu bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi de seefi, toku a seli Masaa Jesesi a bakaten.
eng_text: Now he spoke of Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, for it was he who would betray him, being one of the twelve.

djk_text: We, ne bakadati, ne Masaa Jesesi e waka e lontu a den kondee kondee fu Galileya. A á go a den kondee kondee fu Judeja moo. Bika den edeman fu den Dyu be e suku en fu kii.
eng_text: After these things, Jesus was walking in Galilee, for he wouldn't walk in Judea, because the Jews sought to kill him.

djk_text: Da a yuu de, da wan piisii fu den Dyu be de koosube. Da na a piisii ya, da den Dyu e meke somen masanga, enke fa den gaansama fu den be meke a ini a gaan sabana ini.
eng_text: Now the feast of the Jews, the Feast of Booths, was at hand.

djk_text: Ne den baala fi en kon akisi en taki: “San i de ya e du? Go a Judeja meke den sama di e waka a yu baka si den wooko fi yu di yu e du tu.
eng_text: His brothers therefore said to him, "Depart from here, and go into Judea, that your disciples also may see your works which you do.

djk_text: Ná wan sama di e suku balinen, o de kibii kibii e du sani bakabaka. Go anda meke lanti si taki yu e du den sani de.”
eng_text: For no one does anything in secret, and himself seeks to be known openly. If you do these things, reveal yourself to the world."

djk_text: Bika den baala fi en seefi á be e biibi en.
eng_text: For even his brothers didn't believe in him.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Mi yuu á doo ete. Ma u yuu doo kaba, bika u sa go alaten u wani.
eng_text: Jesus therefore said to them, "My time has not yet come, but your time is always ready.

djk_text: Bika den sama fu kondee á buuse u. Ma mi den nái si na ain seefi. Bika mi e taigi den kiinkiin taki den nái libi bun enke fa Gadu wani.
eng_text: The world can't hate you, but it hates me, because I testify about it, that its works are evil.

djk_text: U wawan go. Mi ná o go na a piisii ya. Bika mi yuu á doo ete.”
eng_text: You go up to the feast. I am not yet going up to this feast, because my time is not yet fulfilled."

djk_text: Ma namo, di Masaa Jesesi taki so, ne a fika fi en a Galileya de.
eng_text: Having said these things to them, he stayed in Galilee.

djk_text: Ma di den baala fi en go kaba, ne enseefi teke pasi fu go na a piisii ya. Ma a á be waka gaangaan fu ala sama si en. Ma a be waka kibii kibii.
eng_text: But when his brothers had gone up to the feast, then he also went up, not publicly, but as it were in secret.

djk_text: We, di a de na a piisii ya kaba, ne den edeman fu den Dyu e suku en. Den e akisi namo taki: “Pe a de? Pe a sama de?”
eng_text: The Jews therefore sought him at the feast, and said, "Where is he?"

djk_text: We, ne ala den sama bigin wan takitaki anga denseefi fu Masaa Jesesi ede. Son fu den e gafa en taki en na wan bunbun sama. Taawan taki: “Ho! Nono! Na wan bidiigiman. Ai bidiigi sama.”
eng_text: There was much murmuring among the multitudes concerning him. Some said, "He is a good man." Others said, "Not so, but he leads the multitude astray."

djk_text: Ma den á be e taki fu ala sama yee. Bika den be e feele den edeman fu den Dyu.
eng_text: Yet no one spoke openly of him for fear of the Jews.

djk_text: We, di den sama be pasa a mindii fu a piisii ya, ne Masaa Jesesi opo go a ini a Mama Keliki. Ne ai leli den sama.
eng_text: But when it was now the midst of the feast, Jesus went up into the temple and taught.

djk_text: Ma den edeman fu den Dyu foondoo te, den taki: “Fa a man ya du sabi sani fu Gadu Buku so? A á be go a sikoo fu leli den sani de!”
eng_text: The Jews therefore marveled, saying, "How does this man know letters, having never been educated?"

djk_text: Ma namo, Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Den sani di mi e leli, a ná fu miseefi, ma na fu Gadu di sende mi kon a goontapu.
eng_text: Jesus therefore answered them, "My teaching is not mine, but his who sent me.

djk_text: Efu wan sama e angii fu du san Gadu taki, da enseefi sa si, efu den sani di mi e leli na fu Gadu, efu na fu miseefi.
eng_text: If anyone desires to do his will, he will know about the teaching, whether it is from God, or if I am speaking from myself.

djk_text: A sama di e taki sani fi enseefi, da na balinen ai suku gi enseefi. Ma a sama di e taki e suku balinen gi a sama di sende en kon, da so wan sama, na wan tuutuu sama. Falisi fasi á de a ini en.”
eng_text: He who speaks from himself seeks his own glory, but he who seeks the glory of him who sent him is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi akisi baka taki: “A ná Mosesi be gi u den weiti fu Gadu, no? Ma ná wan fu den weiti ya di u e oli. We bika, saide meke u e suku fu kii mi?”
eng_text: Didn't Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keeps the law? Why do you seek to kill me?"

djk_text: Ne den piki en taki: “Wan didibii de a yu tapu. Sama e suku fu kii yu?”
eng_text: The multitude answered, "You have a demon! Who seeks to kill you?"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Na wankodo wooko mi du, ne ai dangaa u so kaba.
eng_text: Jesus answered them, "I did one work, and you all marvel because of it.

djk_text: Mosesi be gi u wan weiti taki, u mu koti den pikin manpikin fu u poti a maiki gi den. A wansi na Mosesi seefi poti den weiti gi u fu oli, ma na den gaansama be meke den. Ma toku u e wooko anga a weiti ya a kina dei.
eng_text: Moses has given you circumcision (not that it is of Moses, but of the fathers), and on the Sabbath you circumcise a boy.

djk_text: We, efu u sa koti wan pikin manpikin a kina dei poti a maiki gi en, soso fu di a weiti fu Mosesi á mu booko, da saide meke u e kuutu, fu di mi deesi wan hiihii libisama a kina dei?
eng_text: If a boy receives circumcision on the Sabbath, that the law of Moses may not be broken, are you angry with me, because I made a man completely healthy on the Sabbath?

djk_text: U á mu kuutu sani, enke fa u si den anga ain. Ma u mu wegi den sani go wegi den kon, da u kuutu den a wan leti fasi.”
eng_text: Don't judge according to appearance, but judge righteous judgment."

djk_text: Ma wantu Dyusama fu Jelusalem e akisi taki: “A ná a man ya den edeman fu wi be e suku fu kii, no?
eng_text: Therefore some of them of Jerusalem said, "Isn't this he whom they seek to kill?

djk_text: Ne a de a lanti mindii ya e taki so meke ala sama e si? Da sama á de ya fu tapu enseefi. A sa de taki den gaansama fu u si taki a man ya na a Kelestesi?
eng_text: Behold, he speaks openly, and they say nothing to him. Can it be that the rulers indeed know that this is truly the Christ?

djk_text: Ma te a Kelestesi o kon, ná wan sama o sabi pe a o komoto. Ma a sama ya, u sabi en bunbun. Da u sabi on se a komoto.”
eng_text: However we know where this man comes from, but when the Christ comes, no one will know where he comes from."

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi bali taki moo taanga a pe a be de na a Mama Keliki de e leli den sama. A taki: “Eeye! U sabi mi! U sabi pe mi komoto tu! Ma anga ala fa u sabi mi de, toku mi á kon fu miseefi. Ma na wan sama sende mi kon. Da a sama ya á de wan sama di e lei. Ma u á sabi a sama di sende mi kon.
eng_text: Jesus therefore cried out in the temple, teaching and saying, "You both know me, and know where I am from. I have not come of myself, but he who sent me is true, whom you don't know.

djk_text: Ma mi, mi sabi en. Bika na anda mi komoto. Ne en sende mi kon ya.”
eng_text: I know him, because I am from him, and he sent me."

djk_text: Ne di a taki so, ne den e suku wan fasi fu kisi en. Ma toku ná wan sama di naki ana ne en, bika en yuu á be doo ete.
eng_text: They sought therefore to take him; but no one laid a hand on him, because his hour had not yet come.

djk_text: Ma somen fu den sama be daai kon e biibi ne en. Ne den akisi taki: “Te Kelestesi o kon, a o du moo gaan foondoo sani moo den di a sama ya e du?”
eng_text: But of the multitude, many believed in him. They said, "When the Christ comes, he won't do more signs than those which this man has done, will he?"

djk_text: Ma namo, da den Faliseiman yee taki somen sama e biibi taki Masaa Jesesi na a Kelestesi. Na fu dati ede meke den Faliseiman anga den begiman fu keliki sende sikowtu fu go kisi Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: The Pharisees heard the multitude murmuring these things concerning him, and the chief priests and the Pharisees sent officers to arrest him.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Mi o tan wan pisiten anga u ete. Ma bakadati, da mi o daai go baka, na a sama di be sende mi kon a goontapu.
eng_text: Then Jesus said, "I will be with you a little while longer, then I go to him who sent me.

djk_text: Da u o suku mi, ma u ná o fende mi. Da soseefi tu, u ná o poi kon a pe mi o de.”
eng_text: You will seek me, and won't find me; and where I am, you can't come."

djk_text: Ne den edeman fu den Dyu kuutu kuutu anga den seefi. Den taki: “Da pe a o go te u ná o si en moo? A sa de taki a o go a den taa kondee pe den Dyu paati paati go e tan fu a go leli den Giiki sama?
eng_text: The Jews therefore said among themselves, "Where will this man go that we won't find him? Will he go to the Dispersion among the Greeks, and teach the Greeks?

djk_text: San na a sani di a taki de, taki: ‘Wi o suku mi, ma u ná o fende mi.’ Anga taki pe ai go u ná o poi go anda? San wani taki dati?”
eng_text: What is this word that he said, 'You will seek me, and won't find me; and where I am, you can't come'?"

djk_text: Ma namo, da a kiiboi dei fu a piisii e bigi moo ala den taa dei. We, ne a dei de, ne Masaa Jesesi opo taampu, ne a bali taki taanga taki: “Sama di dee wataa kisi, meke a kon a mi kon diingi.
eng_text: Now on the last and greatest day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried out, "If anyone is thirsty, let him come to me and drink!

djk_text: Bika a sikiifi a Gadu Buku taki, liba fu wataa di e gi libi o lon komoto a ini wan sama di teke biibi a mi, ati, e kon a doo.”
eng_text: He who believes in me, as the Scripture has said, from within him will flow rivers of living water."

djk_text: Da anga ala fa Masaa Jesesi taki ya, da na a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu a be e taki. Bika a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu e gi libi. Da Masaa Gadu o gi den sama di e biibi ne en, a Jeje fi en. Bika a á be gi den sama a Jeje fi en ete, fu di Masaa Jesesi á be opo go fu Masaa Gadu fu teke a waiti fasi fi en ete.
eng_text: But he said this about the Spirit, which those believing in him were to receive. For the Holy Spirit was not yet given, because Jesus wasn't yet glorified.

djk_text: We, son sama di be yee den toli fu Masaa Jesesi be taki: “Eeye! Fu tuu! Disi na a apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: Many of the multitude therefore, when they heard these words, said, "This is truly the prophet."

djk_text: Taawan taki: “Eeye! Disi na a Kelestesi seefi.” Taawan baka taki: “Sama taki so? Na Galileya a Kelestesi be o komoto?
eng_text: Others said, "This is the Christ." But some said, "What, does the Christ come out of Galilee?

djk_text: We bika, Masaa Gadu Buku taki: ‘A Kelestesi na wan bakaten Manpikin fu Kownu Dafeti paansu. Da na Betelehem a o komoto, a pe Kownu Dafeti be e tan.’ ”
eng_text: Hasn't the Scripture said that the Christ comes of the seed of David, and from Bethlehem, the village where David was?"

djk_text: We, na so paati kon a den sama mindii fu Masaa Jesesi ede.
eng_text: So there arose a division in the multitude because of him.

djk_text: Son fu den be wani go kisi en. Ma toku seefi ná wan sama di naki ana ne en.
eng_text: Some of them would have arrested him, but no one laid hands on him.

djk_text: We, di den sikowtu daai go baka a den apaiti begiman fu a Mama Keliki anga den Faliseiman, ne den akisi den taki: “Saide meke u á kisi en tyai kon?”
eng_text: The officers therefore came to the chief priests and Pharisees, and they said to them, "Why didn't you bring him?"

djk_text: Ne den sikowtu piki den taki: “Di u go a taki anga u. Ma namo, di u yee fa ai taki, da u si taki ná wan sama u be yee taki so wanten.”
eng_text: The officers answered, "No man ever spoke like this man!"

djk_text: “Oho! San u taki. A koli u kisi tu?
eng_text: The Pharisees therefore answered them, "You aren't also led astray, are you?

djk_text: Di u de ya, u si taki wan fu den edeman fu u efu wan fu den Faliseiman, biibi ne en wan dei?
eng_text: Have any of the rulers believed in him, or of the Pharisees?

djk_text: U á sabi taki na den sama ya di á sabi ná wan sani fu Gadu weiti e biibi ne en, no? We, heelu fu den!”
eng_text: But this multitude that doesn't know the law is accursed."

djk_text: We, ne Nikodeimisi, wan gaan edeman fu den Dyu, di be kon a Masaa Jesesi wan neti, akisi den taki:
eng_text: Nicodemus (he who came to him by night, being one of them) said to them,

djk_text: “We, fa a weiti fu u de? U sa kuutu wan sama gi en sitaafu sondee fu ondoosuku en fini fini fosi? Efu sondee fu u sabi san a du?”
eng_text: Does our law judge a man, unless it first hears from him personally and knows what he does?

djk_text: Ne den piki en taki: “Oho! I toon fu Galileya tu? Go ondoosuku luku a Gadu Buku fini fini. Da i sa si taki noiti wan apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu o komoto a Galileya Kondee.”
eng_text: They answered him, "Are you also from Galilee? Search, and see that no prophet has arisen out of Galilee. "

djk_text: Ne di den taki so kaba, ne den booko paati, ne den go a osu.
eng_text: Everyone went to his own house,

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi dati go na a mongo di den e kai Oleifi Mongo.
eng_text: but Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.

djk_text: Da a taa dei fi en, fuuku mamanten, ne a kon baka a ini a Mama Keliki fu den Dyu. Da ala sama be e kon ne en. Ne a go sidon, ne ai leli den.
eng_text: Now very early in the morning, he came again into the temple, and all the people came to him. He sat down, and taught them.

djk_text: Ma den leliman fu weiti anga den Faliseiman tyai wan uman kon ne en. Den kisi a uman ya anga e du ogii ne en man osu. Ne den tyai en kon poti a mindii na ala den sama fesi.
eng_text: The scribes and the Pharisees brought a woman taken in adultery. Having set her in the midst,

djk_text: Ne den taigi en taki: “Mesiti, den kisi a uman ya dyonson dyonson ya e du ogii ne en man osu.
eng_text: they told him, "Teacher, we found this woman in adultery, in the very act.

djk_text: Mosesi be sikiifi gi wi a ini a weiti taki, efu u kisi so wan sama u mu naki en anga siton kii. Da san yu e taki fu a uman ya?”
eng_text: Now in our law, Moses commanded us to stone such. What then do you say about her?"

djk_text: Ma a sani di den be akisi Masaa Jesesi ya, na akisi den be akisi en fu tesi en anga fu den fende sani fu go kaagi en. Ma Masaa Jesesi bendi, ne ai sikiifi anga en finga a doti.
eng_text: They said this testing him, that they might have something to accuse him of. But Jesus stooped down, and wrote on the ground with his finger.

djk_text: Ma di den tan e akisi en naamo, ne a opo baka, ne a taigi den taki: “Sama fu u di á du ogii wan dei, da meke a fiingi a fosi siton naki a uman.”
eng_text: But when they continued asking him, he looked up and said to them, "He who is without sin among you, let him throw the first stone at her."

djk_text: Ne a bendi baka e sikiifi a doti.
eng_text: Again he stooped down, and with his finger wrote on the ground.

djk_text: Ma di den yee so, ne ala den fiya go a doo. Den gaanwan anga den yonkuwan, wan fu wan a taawan baka. Den moo gaanwan a fesi, den yonkuwan a baka. Ne na so den fika Masaa Jesesi anga a uman wawan de, enke fa den be tyai en kon poti.
eng_text: They, when they heard it, being convicted by their conscience, went out one by one, beginning from the oldest, even to the last. Jesus was left alone with the woman where she was, in the middle.

djk_text: We, di Masaa Jesesi opo, ne a akisi en taki: “Uman! Pe den sama di be tyai i kon kaagi de? Ná wan sama kuutu yu, no?”
eng_text: Jesus, standing up, saw her and said, "Woman, where are your accusers? Did no one condemn you?"

djk_text: Ne a uman piki en taki: “Masaa, ná wan sama.” Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi en taki: “We, miseefi nái kuutu yu tu. Go a osu. Ma ná du ogii moo.”
eng_text: She said, "No one, Lord." Jesus said, "Neither do I condemn you. Go your way. From now on, sin no more."

djk_text: Da wan taa leisi, da Masaa Jesesi be e leli den sama baka. Ne a leli den taki: “Mi na a leti fu goontapu. A sama di o waka kon a mi baka, a ná o waka a ini dunguu. Ma a sa abi a leti di e gi libi.”
eng_text: Again, therefore, Jesus spoke to them, saying, "I am the light of the world. He who follows me will not walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life."

djk_text: Ma now, ne den Faliseiman taigi en taki: “Yu e taki fu iseefi. Da wi á poi teke a taki fi i de taki na tuu.”
eng_text: The Pharisees therefore said to him, "You testify about yourself. Your testimony is not valid."

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Winsi mi e taki fu miseefi, toku a taki fu mi na tuu. Bika mi sabi pe mi komoto anga pe mi e go. Ma u á sabi pe mi komoto, efu pe mi e go.
eng_text: Jesus answered them, "Even if I testify about myself, my testimony is true, for I know where I came from, and where I am going; but you don't know where I came from, or where I am going.

djk_text: U e kuutu na libisama fasi. Ma mi nái kuutu ná wan sama.
eng_text: You judge according to the flesh. I judge no one.

djk_text: Ma winsi mi kuutu wan sama seefi, toku a kuutu fu mi na tuu. Bika a ná mi wawan e kuutu, ma mi Tata di be sende mi kon de anga mi.
eng_text: Even if I do judge, my judgment is true, for I am not alone, but I am with the Father who sent me.

djk_text: A ini u weiti seefi a sikiifi taki, te tu sama kotoigi fu wan sani, da a de tuu.
eng_text: It's also written in your law that the testimony of two people is valid.

djk_text: We, miseefi taki fu miseefi, ma mi Tata di be sende mi kon e taki fu mi tu.”
eng_text: I am one who testifies about myself, and the Father who sent me testifies about me."

djk_text: Ne den akisi en now taki: “Pe yu Tata de?” Ma Jesesi piki den taki: “U á sabi mi. Da soseefi u á sabi mi Tata tu. Bika, efu u be sabi mi, da u be o sabi mi Tata.”
eng_text: They said therefore to him, "Where is your Father?" Jesus answered, "You know neither me, nor my Father. If you knew me, you would know my Father also."

djk_text: Da Masaa Jesesi be de koosube fu a baki pe den e tyai moni kon poti gi Masaa Gadu a ini a Mama Keliki fu den Dyu. Ma ná wan sama di kisi en. Bika en ten á be kisi ete.
eng_text: Jesus spoke these words in the treasury, as he taught in the temple. Yet no one arrested him, because his hour had not yet come.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “Mi e gwe. Da u o suku mi. Ma u sa dede a ini u takuudu anga ogii. Pe mi e go u ná o poi kon anda.”
eng_text: Jesus said therefore again to them, "I am going away, and you will seek me, and you will die in your sins. Where I go, you can't come."

djk_text: Ne den Dyu edeman taki: “We, on se a o go, di a taki pe ai go u ná o poi kon anda? A sa de taki, na kii a o go kii enseefi?”
eng_text: The Jews therefore said, "Will he kill himself, that he says, 'Where I am going, you can't come?'"

djk_text: Ma a piki den taki: “U na fu ondoo ya. Ma mi na fu tapu anda. U na fu a goontapu ya, ma mi a ná fu a goontapu ya.
eng_text: He said to them, "You are from beneath. I am from above. You are of this world. I am not of this world.

djk_text: Na fu dati ede meke mi be taigi u taki, u sa dede a ini u takuudu anga ogii. Bika, efu u á wani teke taki mi na a sama, di mi taigi u taki mi de, da u o dede a ini u takuudu anga ogii.”
eng_text: I said therefore to you that you will die in your sins; for unless you believe that I am he, you will die in your sins."

djk_text: Ma now den akisi en taki: “We, sama na yu seefi?” Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “We, leti enke fa mi be taigi u kaba na a bigin, na a seefi sama de mi de.
eng_text: They said therefore to him, "Who are you?" Jesus said to them, "Just what I have been saying to you from the beginning.

djk_text: Mi abi somen sani di mi sa teke kuutu u. Bika a sama di sende mi kon, na tuutuu sani ai taki. Da na san a taigi mi, na dati mi e taigi goontapu.”
eng_text: I have many things to speak and to judge concerning you. However he who sent me is true; and the things which I heard from him, these I say to the world."

djk_text: Ma den á fusutan taki na sani fi en Tata a be e taki.
eng_text: They didn't understand that he spoke to them about the Father.

djk_text: Na fu dati ede meke Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “Na te u opo a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya, fosi u o sabi sama ne en. U o sabi taki, a nái du nái wan sani fi enseefi. Bika na san di en Tata leli en, na dati ai taki.
eng_text: Jesus therefore said to them, "When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am he, and I do nothing of myself, but as my Father taught me, I say these things.

djk_text: Da, enke fa Gadu sende mi kon ya, da a de anga mi. A nái fika mi wawan. Bika alaten mi e du san kai anga en.”
eng_text: He who sent me is with me. The Father hasn't left me alone, for I always do the things that are pleasing to him."

djk_text: Da di Masaa Jesesi taki so, ne somen sama daai kon e biibi ne en.
eng_text: As he spoke these things, many believed in him.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den Dyu di be e biibi ne en taki: “Efu u teke den sani di mi e leli u, da u sa de tuutuu bakaman fu mi.
eng_text: Jesus therefore said to those Jews who had believed him, "If you remain in my word, then you are truly my disciples.

djk_text: Da u sa sabi den tuutuu sani fu Gadu. Da te u kon sabi den sani ya so kaba, da a sa meke u fii komoto a saafu, fu u de boo boo.”
eng_text: You will know the truth, and the truth will make you free."

djk_text: Ne den taigi en taki: “Wi na pikin fu Abalaham. Noiti u be de saafu fu wan sama. Da fa yu e taki, u sa kon fii, komoto a saafu, fu de boo boo?”
eng_text: They answered him, "We are Abraham's seed, and have never been in bondage to anyone. How do you say, 'You will be made free?'"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Fu tuutuu mi e taigi u taki, a sama di e du ogii, en na wan saafu fu ogii.
eng_text: Jesus answered them, "Most certainly I tell you, everyone who commits sin is the bondservant of sin.

djk_text: We, efi i de wan saafu e wooko gi wan sama, da na saafu namo i de e go e kon. I nái tan fu ala ten a ini osu. Ma a manpikin fu a sama di yu e wooko gi e tan fu alaten a ini a osu.
eng_text: A bondservant doesn't live in the house forever. A son remains forever.

djk_text: We, efu a Manpikin puu yu a saafu a katibo, meke i fii, da i fii tuutuu.
eng_text: If therefore the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed.

djk_text: Mi sabi taki u na pikin fu Abalaham. Ma u e suku fu kii mi. Bika u nái teke den sani di mi e leli u.
eng_text: I know that you are Abraham's seed, yet you seek to kill me, because my word finds no place in you.

djk_text: Da na san mi Tata soi mi, na dati mi e leli. Ma u e du san u tata taigi u fu du.”
eng_text: I say the things which I have seen with my Father; and you also do the things which you have seen with your father."

djk_text: Ne den taigi Masaa Jesesi taki: “Abalaham na wi tata.” Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “Efu u na be pikin fu Abalaham, da u be o du den sani di Abalaham be e du.
eng_text: They answered him, "Our father is Abraham." Jesus said to them, "If you were Abraham's children, you would do the works of Abraham.

djk_text: Ma now u e suku fu kii mi. Mi di e leli u den tuutuu sani di Masaa Gadu soi mi. Noiti wan ten Abalaham be o du so wan sani.
eng_text: But now you seek to kill me, a man who has told you the truth, which I heard from God. Abraham didn't do this.

djk_text: Na den wooko fu u tata u e du.” Ne den taigi Masaa Jesesi taki: “Wi a ná basa nengee. Wi abi wankodo Tata, dati na Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: You do the works of your father." They said to him, "We were not born of sexual immorality. We have one Father, God."

djk_text: Ne Jesesi taigi den taki: “Efu Gadu na be u Tata, da u be o lobi mi. Bika na Gadu sende mi kon. A ná miseefi komoto kon, ma na Gadu sende mi kon.
eng_text: Therefore Jesus said to them, "If God were your father, you would love me, for I came out and have come from God. For I haven't come of myself, but he sent me.

djk_text: Ma u sabi saide u nái fusutan san mi e taki? Na fu di u á wani aliki mi.
eng_text: Why don't you understand my speech? Because you can't hear my word.

djk_text: Na didibii na u tata. Da na san di bun a u tata, na dati u e du. Fanafu a bigin, ne ai kii libisama. A á poi de a ini den tuutuu sani fu Gadu. Bika tuu á de ne en ati ini seefi seefi. Na soso lei a sabi fu lei. Bika en na wan leiman, a tata fu lei.
eng_text: You are of your father, the devil, and you want to do the desires of your father. He was a murderer from the beginning, and doesn't stand in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks on his own; for he is a liar, and its father.

djk_text: Ma u á wani biibi mi fu den tuutuu sani fu Gadu di mi teke taigi u.
eng_text: But because I tell the truth, you don't believe me.

djk_text: On di fu u sa soi finga a mi taki, mi du ogii wan dei? We, efu na tuutuu sani mi e taki, da saide meke u nái biibi mi?
eng_text: Which of you convicts me of sin? If I tell the truth, why do you not believe me?

djk_text: Sama di de fu Gadu o teke Gadu wowtu. Ma na fu di u a ná sama fu Gadu, na fu dati ede meke u á wani aliki Gadu wowtu.”
eng_text: He who is of God hears the words of God. For this cause you don't hear, because you are not of God."

djk_text: Ma now, ne den Dyu piki en taki: “We, u be taigi yu kaba taki, didibii de a yu tapu, yu ogii sani Samaliya sama yu!”
eng_text: Then the Jews answered him, "Don't we say well that you are a Samaritan, and have a demon?"

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Didibii á de a mi tapu. Na lesipeki mi e lesipeki mi Tata. Ma u nái lesipeki mi.
eng_text: Jesus answered, "I don't have a demon, but I honor my Father, and you dishonor me.

djk_text: Mi nái suku lesipeki gi miseefi. Ma wan sama de di e suku en gi mi. Da na a sama ya e kuutu, leti enke fa a mu de.
eng_text: But I don't seek my own glory. There is one who seeks and judges.

djk_text: Fu tuutuu mi e taigi u taki: ‘Efu wan sama teke den sani di mi e leli ya, da a ná o dede noiti wanten moo.’ ”
eng_text: Most certainly, I tell you, if a person keeps my word, he will never see death."

djk_text: Ne den Dyu taigi en taki: “A nowfosi u e si kiinkiin taki na didibii de a yu tapu. Bika Abalaham dede kaba. Da soseefi den fositen apaiti takiman fu Gadu seefi dede tu. Ne toku i de ya e taki, taki efu wan sama teke den sani di yu e leli, da a ná o dede noiti wanten moo.
eng_text: Then the Jews said to him, "Now we know that you have a demon. Abraham died, and the prophets; and you say, 'If a man keeps my word, he will never taste of death.'

djk_text: I bigi moo wi tata Abalaham efu wan fu den fositen apaiti takiman fu Gadu di dede kaba? San yu e denki fi i seefi?”
eng_text: Are you greater than our father, Abraham, who died? The prophets died. Who do you make yourself out to be?"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Efu mi e suku lesipeki gi mi seefi, da a lesipeki fu mi na wan soso lesipeki. Ma a mi Tata di u taki na a Gadu fu u, ne en e hei mi.
eng_text: Jesus answered, "If I glorify myself, my glory is nothing. It is my Father who glorifies me, of whom you say that he is our God.

djk_text: U á sabi en, ma mi sabi en. Da, efu mi taki, taki mi á sabi en, da mi na wan leiman enke u tu. Ma mi sabi en, da mi e du san a taki.
eng_text: You have not known him, but I know him. If I said, 'I don't know him,' I would be like you, a liar. But I know him, and keep his word.

djk_text: U tata Abalaham be piisii fu tuu, fu di a sabi taki a o si a dei di mi o kon a goontapu ya. Ma a si en tu. Da a piisii, te ná sipowtu.”
eng_text: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day. He saw it, and was glad."

djk_text: Ma den Dyu taigi en taki: “Yu á doo feifitenti yali ete seefi, ne yu e bali taki, i be si Abalaham?”
eng_text: The Jews therefore said to him, "You are not yet fifty years old, and have you seen Abraham?"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “Fu tuutuu mi e taigi u taki: ‘Mi de bifo Abalaham be de.’ ”
eng_text: Jesus said to them, "Most certainly, I tell you, before Abraham came into existence, I AM. "

djk_text: We, di a taki so, ne den lon go teke siton fu naki en kii. Ma Masaa Jesesi pasa a den sama mindii kuli, komoto a Mama Keliki osu gwe fiyaa.
eng_text: Therefore they took up stones to throw at him, but Jesus was hidden, and went out of the temple, having gone through their midst, and so passed by.

djk_text: Ne di Masaa Jesesi e gwe de, ne a miti wan man. Da fanafu a man ya kon a goontapu a be de beendi beendi.
eng_text: As he passed by, he saw a man blind from birth.

djk_text: Ne den bakaman fi en akisi en taki: “Labai! Saide meke a man ya meke kon de beendi beendi so? Sama fu a man ya du ogii? Ne en seefi du ogii? Ofu ne en dda anga en mma?”
eng_text: His disciples asked him, "Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “A ná ogii a man ya du. Soseefi a ná en mma anga dda du ogii tu. Ma a sani ya pasa anga en fu a kaakiti fu Gadu mu kon a kiin.
eng_text: Jesus answered, "Neither did this man sin, nor his parents; but, that the works of God might be revealed in him.

djk_text: We, mi mu wooko den wooko fu a sama di sende mi kon, solanga dei de. Bika neti e kon, da ná wan sama o poi wooko moo.
eng_text: I must work the works of him who sent me, while it is day. The night is coming, when no one can work.

djk_text: Da solanga mi de a goontapu, mi na a leti fu goontapu.”
eng_text: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world."

djk_text: Di a taigi den so, ne a towe wataa mofu a doti, ne a meke poto poto anga en. Ne a teke a papa doti, ne a lobi na a beendiman ain.
eng_text: When he had said this, he spat on the ground, made mud with the saliva, anointed the blind man's eyes with the mud,

djk_text: Ne a taigi a beendiman taki: “Go wasi i fesi a ini Silowam Peti.” We, ne a sama go, ne a wasi en fesi. Ne a man gwe anga kiinkiin ain.
eng_text: and said to him, "Go, wash in the pool of Siloam" (which means "Sent"). So he went away, washed, and came back seeing.

djk_text: We, ne den sama di e tan koosube fi en, anga den sama di be sabi en a fositen di a be beendi ete taki: “Tan, a ná man di be sidon ya e begi moni, no?”
eng_text: The neighbors therefore, and those who saw that he was blind before, said, "Isn't this he who sat and begged?"

djk_text: Wantu fu den baka taki: “Iya! Ne en!” Taawan taki: “Nono, ma a gei en!” Ma a man seefi taki: “Iya! Na mi.”
eng_text: Others were saying, "It is he." Still others were saying, "He looks like him." He said, "I am he."

djk_text: Ne den akisi en taki: “We, on fa yu ain du opo te yu e si sani?”
eng_text: They therefore were asking him, "How were your eyes opened?"

djk_text: Ne a piki taki: “Na wan sama di den e kai Jesesi meke wan poto poto lobi a mi ain. Ne a sende mi fu mi go wasi mi fesi a Silowam Peti. Ne mi go, ne mi wasi mi fesi, ne mi ain kon kiin.”
eng_text: He answered, "A man called Jesus made mud, anointed my eyes, and said to me, 'Go to the pool of Siloam, and wash.' So I went away and washed, and I received sight."

djk_text: Ne den akisi en baka taki: “Pe a sama de, de?” Ne a man piki den taki: “We, mi á sabi.”
eng_text: Then they asked him, "Where is he?" He said, "I don't know."

djk_text: We, ne den teke a man di be beendi fosi, ne den tyai en go a den Faliseiman.
eng_text: They brought him who had been blind to the Pharisees.

djk_text: Ma namo, da a dei di Masaa Jesesi be meke a poto poto opo a man ya ain, na be wan kina dei fu den Dyu.
eng_text: It was a Sabbath when Jesus made the mud and opened his eyes.

djk_text: Ne den Faliseiman akisi a man ya fa en ain be du opo. Ne a sama taigi den taki: “Na poto poto a teke poti a mi ain. Ne mi go wasi mi fesi, ne na so mi ain opo.”
eng_text: Again therefore the Pharisees also asked him how he received his sight. He said to them, "He put mud on my eyes, I washed, and I see."

djk_text: Ne son fu den Faliseiman taki: “A sama de, a ná wan sama fu Gadu! Bika a ná oli a kina dei!” Ma den taawan taki: “Fa wan ogiilibi sama sa du so wan gaan foondoo sani?” Na so den bigin anga wan takitaki anga denseefi.
eng_text: Some therefore of the Pharisees said, "This man is not from God, because he doesn't keep the Sabbath." Others said, "How can a man who is a sinner do such signs?" There was division among them.

djk_text: Ne den akisi a man di be beendi baka taki: “We, san yu e taki fu a sama di opo yu ain de?” Ne a man piki den taki: “We, na wan apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: Therefore they asked the blind man again, "What do you say about him, because he opened your eyes?" He said, "He is a prophet."

djk_text: Ma now den Dyu á wani biibi moo seefi taki a be beendi a fesi, ma now a sa si baka. Ne den kai en dda anga en mma kon.
eng_text: The Jews therefore did not believe concerning him, that he had been blind, and had received his sight, until they called the parents of him who had received his sight,

djk_text: Ne den akisi den taki: “San u e taki? A sama ya na u pikin di u taki be meke beendi beendi? Fa a du taki a sa si now?”
eng_text: and asked them, "Is this your son, whom you say was born blind? How then does he now see?"

djk_text: Ma a dda anga a mma piki den taki: “Wi sabi taki na wi pikin. Da soseefi wi sabi taki a be meke beendi beendi.
eng_text: His parents answered them, "We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind;

djk_text: Ma fa a du kon taki ai si baka, dati u á sabi. Da wi á sabi tu sama meke ai si baka. En seefi bigi sai kaba fu taki. U akisi en meke enseefi taki.”
eng_text: but how he now sees, we don't know; or who opened his eyes, we don't know. He is of age. Ask him. He will speak for himself."

djk_text: Ma na fu di en dda anga en mma be e feele den Dyu edeman, meke den be taki so. Bika den edeman be tapu pasi gi den kaba taki, efu wan sama taki, taki Jesesi na a Kelestesi, da den o puu so wan sama na a keliki.
eng_text: His parents said these things because they feared the Jews; for the Jews had already agreed that if any man would confess him as Christ, he would be put out of the synagogue.

djk_text: Na fu dati ede meke en dda anga en mma be taigi den taki meke den akisi en enseefi, a bigi sai kaba fu taki.
eng_text: Therefore his parents said, "He is of age. Ask him."

djk_text: Ne den kai a man di be beendi kon baka a den di fu tu toon. Ne den taigi en taki: “Man, sweli a Gadu fesi taki na wan tuutuu sani yu o taki. Bika u sabi taki a sama di yu e taki opo yu ain de na wan ogiilibi sama.”
eng_text: So they called the man who was blind a second time, and said to him, "Give glory to God. We know that this man is a sinner."

djk_text: Ne a man piki den taki: “Efu a man de na wan ogiilibi sama mi á sabi. Ma san mi sabi, na taki mi be beendi, ma now mi e si.”
eng_text: He therefore answered, "I don't know if he is a sinner. One thing I do know: that though I was blind, now I see."

djk_text: Ne den akisi en taki: “San a du gi yu? Fa a du opo yu ain?”
eng_text: They said to him again, "What did he do to you? How did he open your eyes?"

djk_text: Ne a man piki den taki: “Mi be taigi u kaba, ma u á wani yee mi. Saide meke u wani meke mi taki a sani ete wan toon? A wani u wani toon bakaman fi en tu?”
eng_text: He answered them, "I told you already, and you didn't listen. Why do you want to hear it again? You don't also want to become his disciples, do you?"

djk_text: Ma now, ne den kosi a man. Den taki: “Nono! Na yu na wan bakaman fu a man de. Ma wi na bakaman fu Mosesi.
eng_text: They insulted him and said, "You are his disciple, but we are disciples of Moses.

djk_text: Wi sabi taki anga Mosesi Gadu be taki. Ma u á sabi seefi seefi, pe a sama ya komoto.”
eng_text: We know that God has spoken to Moses. But as for this man, we don't know where he comes from."

djk_text: Ne a man piki den taki: “We, da a foondoo mi, di u taki u á sabi pe a man ya komoto. Bika a opo mi ain.
eng_text: The man answered them, "How amazing! You don't know where he comes from, yet he opened my eyes.

djk_text: Bika wi sabi taki Gadu nái piki a begi fu wan ogiilibi sama. Ma na sama di e lesipeki en e du sani a taki, na den begi fu den ai piki.
eng_text: We know that God doesn't listen to sinners, but if anyone is a worshipper of God, and does his will, he listens to him.

djk_text: Fu senten di goontapu de, wi á yee noiti ete taki, wan sama be opo wan sama di meke beendi beendi ain.
eng_text: Since the world began it has never been heard of that anyone opened the eyes of someone born blind.

djk_text: Efu a sama ya, a ná Gadu a be komoto, da a á be o poi du so wan sani.”
eng_text: If this man were not from God, he could do nothing."

djk_text: Ne den piki en taki: “Yu á sabi taki na takuudu anga ogii meke den be meke i beendi beendi so, no? Ne san yu abi fu kon leli wi?” Ne den toto en puu poti a doo.
eng_text: They answered him, "You were altogether born in sins, and do you teach us?" They threw him out.

djk_text: We, di Masaa Jesesi yee taki den yaki a man toto en puu poti a doo, ne di a miti anga en baka, ne a akisi en taki: “We, on fa? Yu e biibi na a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya?”
eng_text: Jesus heard that they had thrown him out, and finding him, he said, "Do you believe in the Son of God?"

djk_text: Ne a man piki en taki: “Masaa, on pe a sama de de? Mi wani biibi ne en!”
eng_text: He answered, "Who is he, Lord, that I may believe in him?"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “We, na a sama di i si e taki anga yu ya, ne disi!”
eng_text: Jesus said to him, "You have both seen him, and it is he who speaks with you."

djk_text: Ne a man taki: “Masaa, mi e biibi!” Ne a saka anga kini a doti gi en gaandi.
eng_text: He said, "Lord, I believe!" and he worshiped him.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taki: “We, i si fa mi kon a goontapu ya, da na kon mi kon fu meke libisama kuutu paati anga denseefi, fu den beendiman daai kon sa si anga fu den di e si daai kon toon beendiman.”
eng_text: Jesus said, "I came into this world for judgment, that those who don't see may see; and that those who see may become blind."

djk_text: We, son fu den Faliseiman di be de ape anga en yee tu san a taigi a man ya. Ne den akisi en taki: “Fa i taki de, we, da u beendi tu?”
eng_text: Those of the Pharisees who were with him heard these things, and said to him, "Are we also blind?"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “Efu u be piki taki u be beendi, da u á be o du ogii. Ma fu di u taki u ain kiin kaba, da na fu dati ede meke u fika a ini ogii.”
eng_text: Jesus said to them, "If you were blind, you would have no sin; but now you say, 'We see.' Therefore your sin remains.

djk_text: Fu tuutuu mi e taigi u taki: “A sama di e suku fu pasa a wan taa peesi go a ini a pen fu den sikapu boiti a doo, na wan fufuuman efu wan kiiman.
eng_text:
Most certainly, I tell you, one who doesn't enter by the door into the sheep fold, but climbs up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber.
3274	Ma, a sama di e waka pasa na a doo go a ini a pen fu den sikapu, ne en na wan soluguman fu den sikapu.	3274	But one who enters in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.
3275	Te a kon, da wanten a man di e oli waki na a pen e opo a doo fu a pen gi en. Da o kai den sikapu fi en a nen, da den sikapu o yee en tongo. Da a o tyai den puu a ini a koi go a doo.	3275	The gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen to his voice. He calls his own sheep by name, and leads them out.
3276	Da te a tyai den go a doo, da ai waka a den fesi, da den sikapu e waka ne en baka. Bika den sikapu sabi en tongo.	3276	Whenever he brings out his own sheep, he goes before them, and the sheep follow him, for they know his voice.
3277	Ma te taa sama o kon, da den ná o komoto go waka ne en baka. Ma den o lon gwe, bika den á sabi a sama de.”	3277	They will by no means follow a stranger, but will flee from him; for they don't know the voice of strangers.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi be gi den a ageisi toli ya. Ma den á be fusutan seefi seefi san a be wani taki.
eng_text: Jesus spoke this parable to them, but they didn't understand what he was telling them.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “Fu tuutuu mi e taigi u ete wan toon taki, miseefi na a doo di sama sa waka pasa go a ini a pen fu den sikapu.
eng_text: Jesus therefore said to them again, "Most certainly, I tell you, I am the sheep's door.

djk_text: Ibii sama di be kon a mi fesi, na soso fufuuman anga kiiman. Na fu dati ede meke den sama ná aliki den, leti enke fa i si sikapu nái fitoow wan sama di den á sabi.
eng_text: All who came before me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep didn't listen to them.

djk_text: Da leti enke fa i si wan sama sa waka pasa a wan opo opo doo go a ini wan osu, da na letiso mi de fu u waka pasa go a ini fu fende a bun solugu fu Gadu. Na mi na a doo fu a koi fu den sikapu fu Gadu. A mi u sa go a ini kon a doo on ten u wani.
eng_text: I am the door. If anyone enters in by me, he will be saved, and will go in and go out, and will find pasture.

djk_text: Ma wan fufuuman, te a kon, ai kon namo fu fufuu anga kii anga booko sani poli kaba a soso. Ma mi kon fu gi libi a libi tapu te a pasa peesi.”
eng_text: The thief only comes to steal, kill, and destroy. I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.

djk_text: “Mi na a bunbun soluguman fu den sikapu. Da leti enke fa i si a soluguman fu den sikapu e kibii den sikapu fi en, na letiso mi sa gi mi libi fu kibii den bakaman fu mi tu fu sani á du den.
eng_text: I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.

djk_text: Ma wan sama di den yuu fu luku den sikapu, di á de wan soluguman, á de so. Bika ná en abi den sikapu. Da te a si wan takuu meti e kon, da wanten wanten ai lon gwe fika den sikapu wawan. Da a takuu meti o kon, da a kisi son fu den. Da a yaki den paati.
eng_text: He who is a hired hand, and not a shepherd, who doesn't own the sheep, sees the wolf coming, leaves the sheep, and flees. The wolf snatches the sheep, and scatters them.

djk_text: A sama di den be yuu lon gwe fi en. Bika na yuu namo den yuu en. A ná abi toobi anga den sikapu, bika a ná fi en.
eng_text: The hired hand flees because he is a hired hand, and doesn't care for the sheep.

djk_text: “Ma mi na a bunbun soluguman fu den sikapu. Mi sabi den sikapu fu mi, da den sikapu fu mi seefi sabi mi tu.
eng_text: I am the good shepherd. I know my own, and I'm known by my own;

djk_text: Leti enke fa i si mi anga mi Tata sabi useefi, na letiso mi anga den sikapu fu mi sabi useefi tu. Da mi ná abi toobi fu dede gi den.
eng_text: even as the Father knows me, and I know the Father. I lay down my life for the sheep.

djk_text: Ma mi abi taa sikapu ete, di á de na a kulu ya ete. Da den dati seefi mi mu tyai kon na a kulu ya tu. Bika den o yee mi tongo, da den kon a mi. Da na so a o de: Wankodo ipi sikapu anga wankodo soluguman.
eng_text: I have other sheep, which are not of this fold. I must bring them also, and they will hear my voice. They will become one flock with one shepherd.

djk_text: “Da mi Tata lobi mi, fu di mi e gi mi libi fu dede gi den sikapu fu teke en baka.
eng_text: Therefore the Father loves me, because I lay down my life, that I may take it again.

djk_text: Ná wan sama o puu mi libi a mi. Nono! Kweti kweti! Ma na anga miseefi wani mi e dede. Mi abi a taanga fu dede. Ma soseefi mi abi a taanga fu teke mi libi baka tu. Bika na mi Tata seefi sende mi fu du dati.”
eng_text: No one takes it away from me, but I lay it down by myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. I received this commandment from my Father."

djk_text: Da den wowtu fu Masaa Jesesi di a taki ya, meke den Dyu kisi den wan gaan toobi anga denseefi.
eng_text: Therefore a division arose again among the Jews because of these words.

djk_text: Somen fu den taki: “Na wan takuu jeje de na a man de tapu! Ai law! Saide meke u taampu de e aliki en ete?”
eng_text: Many of them said, "He has a demon, and is insane! Why do you listen to him?"

djk_text: Taawan taki: “Na so wan sama di takuu jeje de ne en tapu e taki? Wan takuu jeje sa opo wan beendiman ain fu meke ai si baka?”
eng_text: Others said, "These are not the sayings of one possessed by a demon. It isn't possible for a demon to open the eyes of the blind, is it?"

djk_text: Da a yuu de, da den be abi wan piisii fesa fu den a Jelusalem. Da te den be e nyan a piisii ya, da den be e pakisei a ten di den be e wei a Mama Keliki gi Masaa Gadu. Da na a moo koo pisiten fu a yali a ini Islayeli Kondee.
eng_text: It was the Feast of the Dedication at Jerusalem.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi de fi en, e koi na den baikon fu a Mama Keliki di den be e kai a Baikon fu Salomo.
eng_text: It was winter, and Jesus was walking in the temple, in Solomon's porch.

djk_text: We, ne den Dyu kon lontu en de, ne den akisi en taki: “We, man, on langa yu o daai daai u ete? Taigi u kiinkiin. Yu na a Kelestesi? Taigi u meke u sabi.”
eng_text: The Jews therefore came around him and said to him, "How long will you hold us in suspense? If you are the Christ, tell us plainly."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Mi be taigi u kaba. Ma u á wani biibi mi san mi taigi u. Bika den wooko di mi e du, a mi Tata nen e soi kiinkiin sama a mi.
eng_text: Jesus answered them, "I told you, and you don't believe. The works that I do in my Father's name, these testify about me.

djk_text: Ma u nái biibi mi. Bika u a ná mi sikapu.
