eng_text: But you don't believe, because you are not of my sheep, as I told you.

djk_text: Den sikapu fu mi e waka a mi baka. Bika den sabi mi tongo, da den e du san mi taki. Da soseefi, miseefi sabi den tu.
eng_text: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me.

djk_text: Da mi e gi den a libi fu tego. Noiti wanten den sa lasi go kaba a soso moo. Da soseefi ná wan sani sa puu den a ini mi ana ini.
eng_text: I give eternal life to them. They will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of my hand.

djk_text: Bika mi Tata di gi mi den, bigi moo ala san di de. Da ná wan sama di poi puu den a ini mi Tata ana ini tu.
eng_text: My Father, who has given them to me, is greater than all. No one is able to snatch them out of my Father's hand.

djk_text: Bika mi anga mi Tata na awan.”
eng_text: I and the Father are one."

djk_text: Ma now di a taki a sani ya, ne den Dyu teke siton baka fu naki en kii.
eng_text: Therefore Jews took up stones again to stone him.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “Mi du somen gaan foondoo foondoo wooko a u mindii fu soi u a kaakiti fu Gadu. We, fu on di fu den sani ya ede, meke u wani naki mi kii anga siton?”
eng_text: Jesus answered them, "I have shown you many good works from my Father. For which of those works do you stone me?"

djk_text: We, ne den Dyu piki en taki: “We, a ná fu wan fu den foondoo foondoo wooko di i du meke u wani kii yu. Ma na fu di yu e oli Gadu a sipowtu. Bika yu na wan kuwownu libisama enke u ya. Ma yu e poti iseefi enke Gadu.”
eng_text: The Jews answered him, "We don't stone you for a good work, but for blasphemy: because you, being a man, make yourself God."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “A ná a ini useefi weiti a taki, Masaa Gadu taki: ‘U na gadu, no?’
eng_text: Jesus answered them, "Isn't it written in your law, 'I said, you are gods?'

djk_text: We, wi sabi taki san Masaa Gadu Buku e taki na tuu fu alaten. Da Masaa Gadu e kai den sama di e teke a bosikopu fi en, gadu.
eng_text: If he called them gods, to whom the word of God came (and the Scripture can't be broken),

djk_text: We, efu na den kuwownu libisama de a kai gadu, da fa fu Awan di Masaa Gadu teke poti apaiti fasi gi enseefi, sende kon a goontapu? Fa u sa taigi mi taki, mi e oli Masaa Gadu a sipowtu, fu di mi taki, mi na a Manpikin fu Masaa Gadu?
eng_text: do you say of him whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world, 'You blaspheme,' because I said, 'I am the Son of God?'

djk_text: We, efu u si taki a ná den wooko fu mi Tata mi e du, da u ná abi fu biibi mi.
eng_text: If I don't do the works of my Father, don't believe me.

djk_text: Ma, efu na den wooko fu mi Tata mi e du, da u ná abi fu biibi mi seefi, ma u biibi den wooko. Bika te u biibi den wooko, da u sa kon fusutan fu sabi taki: A Tata de a ini mi. Da soseefi mi de a ini a Tata tu.”
eng_text: But if I do them, though you don't believe me, believe the works; that you may know and believe that the Father is in me, and I in the Father."

djk_text: Ma di Masaa Jesesi taki so, ne den e suku baka fu kisi en tyai gwe. Ma a waka saafi komoto a den ini de gwe.
eng_text: They sought again to seize him, and he went out of their hand.

djk_text: Ne a koti go na abaa fu a Joodani Liba, a pe Johanisi be e dopu sama fosi. Ne a tan de.
eng_text: He went away again beyond the Jordan into the place where John was baptizing at first, and there he stayed.

djk_text: Ne somen sama kon ne en taki: “Na tuu. Johanisi a á be e du ná wan foondoo sani. Ma ala san di a be taki fu a sama ya, ala den fiya na tuu.”
eng_text: Many came to him. They said, "John indeed did no sign, but everything that John said about this man is true."

djk_text: We, somen sama kon e biibi a Masaa Jesesi di a de ape.
eng_text: Many believed in him there.

djk_text: Ma namo, da wan man Lasalesi be de a wan pikin foto den e kai Betaniya. Da wan uman den e kai Maliya be e tan de tu anga en sisa Malita. Ma namo, da Lasalesi be kai a siki.
eng_text: Now a certain man was sick, Lazarus from Bethany, of the village of Mary and her sister, Martha.

djk_text: Da a Maliya ya, na a seefi uman di o tutu a sumee switi fatu a Masaa Jesesi futu dee Masaa futu baka anga en ede uwii. Da ne en baala Lasalesi be kai a siki.
eng_text: It was that Mary who had anointed the Lord with ointment, and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother, Lazarus, was sick.

djk_text: Da den tu sisa fu Lasalesi ya sende bosikopu gi Masaa Jesesi taki: “Masaa! I lobi mati kai a siki.”
eng_text: The sisters therefore sent to him, saying, "Lord, behold, he for whom you have great affection is sick."

djk_text: Ma di Masaa Jesesi yee a bosikopu, ne a taki: “A siki di a siki de, a ná wan siki di o kii en. Ma a siki o meke Masaa Gadu fende gaandi. Bika a Manpikin fu Masaa Gadu seefi o fende gaandi.”
eng_text: But when Jesus heard it, he said, "This sickness is not to death, but for the glory of God, that God's Son may be glorified by it."

djk_text: We, Masaa Jesesi be lobi Malita anga en sisa anga Lasalesi tuutuu.
eng_text: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.

djk_text: Ma toku di a yee taki Lasalesi siki, a tan tu dei moo a pe a be de.
eng_text: When therefore he heard that he was sick, he stayed two days in the place where he was.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den bakaman fi en taki: “Meke u go baka a Judeja!”
eng_text: Then after this he said to the disciples, "Let's go into Judea again."

djk_text: Ma den bakaman fi en taigi en taki: “Labai! Wantu dei pasa, den sama fu Judeja be wani kii yu anga siton, ne yu o go anda baka?”
eng_text: The disciples told him, "Rabbi, the Jews were just trying to stone you, and are you going there again?"

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “A ná twalufu yuu wan dei abi, no? We, sama di e waka a dei, ná o naki en futu. Bika ai si a leti fu a goontapu ya.
eng_text: Jesus answered, "Aren't there twelve hours of daylight? If a man walks in the day, he doesn't stumble, because he sees the light of this world.

djk_text: Ma sama di e waka a neti, o naki en futu. Bika a ná abi ná wan leti.
eng_text: But if a man walks in the night, he stumbles, because the light isn't in him."

djk_text: Ne baka di a taki a sani ya, ne a taigi den bakaman fi en taki: ‘A mati fu wi, Lasalesi siibi. Ma mi e go anda fu weki en.’ ”
eng_text: He said these things, and after that, he said to them, "Our friend, Lazarus, has fallen asleep, but I am going so that I may awake him out of sleep."

djk_text: We, ne den bakaman fi en taigi en taki: “We, efu ai siibi, da a o betee.”
eng_text: The disciples therefore said, "Lord, if he has fallen asleep, he will recover."

djk_text: Ma na a dede fu Lasalesi Masaa Jesesi be e taki. Ma den bakaman fi en be denki taki na fu siibi wawan a be e taki.
eng_text: Now Jesus had spoken of his death, but they thought that he spoke of taking rest in sleep.

djk_text: We, na fu dati ede meke Masaa Jesesi taigi den kiinkiin taki: “Lasalesi dede kaba.
eng_text: So Jesus said to them plainly then, "Lazarus is dead.

djk_text: Ma na fu u ede, mi piisii fu di mi á be de ape. Bika u abi a sani di o pasa de fanowdu. A o meke u a biibi fu u kon moo taanga. Ma, u meke u go ne en nownow.”
eng_text: I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, so that you may believe. Nevertheless, let's go to him."

djk_text: Ma, Towmasi, di den be e kai Toolengi, taigi den taa bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi taki: “Meke u go anga en fu u sa dede anga en.”
eng_text: Thomas therefore, who is called Didymus, said to his fellow disciples, "Let's go also, that we may die with him."

djk_text: We, di Masaa Jesesi kon a Betaniya, ne den taigi en taki: “Lasalesi de a ini geebi fo dei kaba.”
eng_text: So when Jesus came, he found that he had been in the tomb four days already.

djk_text: Ma somen Dyu be komoto a Jelusalem kon a Betaniya fu kee pina anga Malita anga Maliya fu a dede fu a baala fi en. Bika Jelusalem anga Betaniya be sa de wan sani fu dii kilomeiti so koosube anga denseefi.
eng_text: Now Bethany was near Jerusalem, about fifteen stadia away.

djk_text: We, fa i si Malita yee taki Masaa Jesesi kon de, ne wanten a opo go miti en. Ma Maliya fika sidon sidon a osu.
eng_text: Then when Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went and met him, but Mary stayed in the house.

djk_text: Ne Malita taigi Masaa Jesesi taki: “Masaa! Efi i be de ya, mi baala á be o dede.
eng_text: Therefore Martha said to Jesus, "Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn't have died.

djk_text: Ma toku, now mi sabi taki ala sani di i begi akisi Masaa Gadu, a o gi yu en.”
eng_text: Even now I know that, whatever you ask of God, God will give you."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi en taki: “Malita! I baala o opo baka!”
eng_text: Jesus said to her, "Your brother will rise again."

djk_text: Ne Malita taigi en taki: “We, Masaa, mi sabi taki a o opo baka te ala den dede sama o opo baka na a kiiboi dei.”
eng_text: Martha said to him, "I know that he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Mi na a sama di e weki sama puu a dede. Na mi na a sama di e gi libi. Sama di e biibi a mi, sa libi, wansi a dede.
eng_text: Jesus said to her, "I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in me will still live, even if he dies.

djk_text: Da sama di de a libi, ne ai biibi a mi, ná o dede ná wan ten! Yu e biibi dati?”
eng_text: Whoever lives and believes in me will never die. Do you believe this?"

djk_text: Ne Malita taigi en taki: “Iya, Masaa! Mi e biibi taki yu na a Kelestesi, a Manpikin fu Masaa Gadu di be mu kon a goontapu.”
eng_text: She said to him, "Yes, Lord. I have come to believe that you are the Christ, God's Son, he who comes into the world."

djk_text: We, ne di Masaa Jesesi taki so, ne Malita go, ne a kai en sisa saafi taki: “A Mesiti kon kaba, ai kai yu.”
eng_text: When she had said this, she went away, and called Mary, her sister, secretly, saying, "The Teacher is here, and is calling you."

djk_text: We, di Maliya yee so, ne a opo pala, waka go a Masaa.
eng_text: When she heard this, she arose quickly, and went to him.

djk_text: Bika Masaa Jesesi á be doo a ini a kondee ete, ma a be de a pe a be taki anga Malita ete.
eng_text: Now Jesus had not yet come into the village, but was in the place where Martha met him.

djk_text: We, sama fu Judeja di be de a ini osu de be e gi en taanga sikin. Namo di den si taki, Maliya opo pala waka go a doose, ne den waka go ne en baka. Den denki taki, ai go na a geebi fu go kee anda.
eng_text: Then the Jews who were with her in the house, and were consoling her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up quickly and went out, followed her, saying, "She is going to the tomb to weep there."

djk_text: We, di Maliya doo na a peesi pe Masaa Jesesi de, di a si en, ne a kai a Masaa Jesesi futu, ne a taki: “Masaa, efi i be de ya, mi baala á be o dede, baa!”
eng_text: Therefore when Mary came to where Jesus was, and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying to him, "Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn't have died."

djk_text: Ma namo, di Masaa Jesesi si Maliya anga den taa sama fu Judeja di be kon ne en e kee so, ne wan gaan tyali kisi en a ini en ati.
eng_text: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews weeping who came with her, he groaned in the spirit, and was troubled,

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi akisi den taki: “On pe u poti en?” Ne den taigi en taki: “Masaa, kon, da i sa si!”
eng_text: and said, "Where have you laid him?" They told him, "Lord, come and see."

djk_text: Ma namo, ne wataa lon a Masaa Jesesi ain pala pala.
eng_text: Jesus wept.

djk_text: Na fu dati ede meke den Dyu taki: “Kee! Luku fa a be lobi en, baa.”
eng_text: The Jews therefore said, "See how much affection he had for him!"

djk_text: Ma wantu fu den taki: “We, a ná a man ya be e meke den beendiman kon si baka, no? Ne fa a waka a á be poi yeepi a man ya, fu a á dede?”
eng_text: Some of them said, "Couldn't this man, who opened the eyes of him who was blind, have also kept this man from dying?"

djk_text: Ma wan gaan tyali kisi Masaa Jesesi baka a ini en ati. Ne na so a go na a geebi. Ma namo, da a geebi ya na be wan siton olo. Da den be tapu a geebi mofu anga wan siton.
eng_text: Jesus therefore, again groaning in himself, came to the tomb. Now it was a cave, and a stone lay against it.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi taki: “U puu a siton na a geebi mofu!” Ma Malita, a sisa fu a man di dede, taigi en taki: “Masaa! Ai tingi kaba. Bika na fo dei kaba di a de a ini a geebi.”
eng_text: Jesus said, "Take away the stone." Martha, the sister of him who was dead, said to him, "Lord, by this time there is a stench, for he has been dead four days."

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Mi á be taigi i kaba taki, efi i biibi, yu o si a hei fasi fu Gadu, no?”
eng_text: Jesus said to her, "Didn't I tell you that if you believed, you would see God's glory?"

djk_text: We, ne den puu a siton na a geebi mofu. Ne Masaa Jesesi opo ede luku tapu, ne a taki: “Mi Tata! Gaantangi fi yu fu di a de taki i yee mi kaba.
eng_text: So they took away the stone from the place where the dead man was lying. Jesus lifted up his eyes, and said, "Father, I thank you that you listened to me.

djk_text: Mi sabi tuutuu taki yu e yee mi alaten. Ma na fu den sama di taampu lontu ya ede meke mi e taki so, fu den sa kon biibi taki na yu be sende mi kon a goontapu.”
eng_text: I know that you always listen to me, but because of the multitude that stands around I said this, that they may believe that you sent me."

djk_text: We, ne di Masaa Jesesi taki so, ne a bali kai Lasalesi taanga taki: “Lasalesi! Kon a doo!”
eng_text: When he had said this, he cried with a loud voice, "Lazarus, come out!"

djk_text: We, ne a dedesama komoto kon a doo. En futu anga en ana de teitei anga geebi koosi ne en sikin. Da en fesi seefi be de teitei anga wan koosi. Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “U losi en meke a go!”
eng_text: He who was dead came out, bound hand and foot with wrappings, and his face was wrapped around with a cloth. Jesus said to them, "Free him, and let him go."

djk_text: We, di den sama di be kon a Maliya si a sani di Masaa Jesesi du, ne den daai kon e biibi ne en.
eng_text: Therefore many of the Jews, who came to Mary and saw what Jesus did, believed in him.

djk_text: Ma wantu fu den go a den Faliseiman go taigi den san Masaa Jesesi du.
eng_text: But some of them went away to the Pharisees, and told them the things which Jesus had done.

djk_text: We, na fu dati ede meke den Faliseiman anga den apaiti begiman fu a Mama Keliki, kai wan gaan kuutu makandii, anga a Dyulanti di e kuutu sani. Ne den e akisi taki: “San wi mu du? We, bika a sama e du somen somen foondoo foondoo wooko.
eng_text: The chief priests therefore and the Pharisees gathered a council, and said, "What are we doing? For this man does many signs.

djk_text: Efu wi á luku bun, da ala sama o daai kon e biibi ne en. Da den Loma o kon feti booko a Mama Keliki anga a nasi fu wi kaba a soso.”
eng_text: If we leave him alone like this, everyone will believe in him, and the Romans will come and take away both our place and our nation."

djk_text: Ma Kayafasi, wan fu den man, di be de a moo hei apaiti begiman, na a yali de, taigi den taki: “U á sabi ná wan sani!
eng_text: But a certain one of them, Caiaphas, being high priest that year, said to them, "You know nothing at all,

djk_text: U á sabi taki a moo bun fu wankodo sama dede gi a nasi, moo enke pe fu a hii nasi dede go kaba a soso, no?”
eng_text: nor do you consider that it is advantageous for us that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation not perish."

djk_text: Ma a ná enseefi be taki a sani de. Ma na fu di a be de a moo hei apaiti begiman a yali de, na fu dati ede meke Masaa Gadu be meke a taki den wowtu ya taki: “Masaa Jesesi mu dede gi a hii nasi.
eng_text: Now he didn't say this of himself, but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus would die for the nation,

djk_text: Ma a ná den Dyu wawan a o dede gi, ma a o tyai ala den sama fu Masaa Gadu, di de paati paati a hii goontapu, kon makandii a wan ipi.”
eng_text: and not for the nation only, but that he might also gather together into one the children of God who are scattered abroad.

djk_text: We, ne fanafu a dei di de oli a kuutu de, ne den poti taki den sa kii en namo.
eng_text: So from that day forward they took counsel that they might put him to death.

djk_text: We, na fu dati ede meke Masaa Jesesi á be e waka a na a pisiwataa fu Judeja moo a pe ala sama sa si en. Ma a komoto de go a wan foto den e kai Efalamu, di de koosube fu wan sabana. Ne en anga den bakaman fi en de ape.
eng_text: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews, but departed from there into the country near the wilderness, to a city called Ephraim. He stayed there with his disciples.

djk_text: Ma namo, da a Pasika Piisii fu den Dyu be de koosube fu doo. Da somen sama fu a pisi de, be subi go a Jelusalem fu go kiin denseefi enke fa a weiti taki fu den be sa de kaba kaba fosi a Pasika Piisii doo.
eng_text: Now the Passover of the Jews was at hand. Many went up from the country to Jerusalem before the Passover, to purify themselves.

djk_text: Di den taampu a ini a Mama Keliki, ne den be e suku Masaa Jesesi. Den e akisi den na den taki: “San u denki? U denki taki a o kon fu nyan a Pasika Piisii ya?”
eng_text: Then they sought for Jesus and spoke one with another, as they stood in the temple, "What do you think--that he isn't coming to the feast at all?"

djk_text: Bika den hei apaiti begiman anga den Faliseiman be poti taki, efu wan sama sabi pe a de, den mu taigi den, fu den go kisi en.
eng_text: Now the chief priests and the Pharisees had commanded that if anyone knew where he was, he should report it, that they might seize him.

djk_text: Da sigisi dei fosi a Pasika Piisii, ne Masaa Jesesi kon baka a Betaniya, a pe a be weki Lasalesi puu a dede.
eng_text: Then six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, where Lazarus was, who had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.

djk_text: Da di a kon, ne den sama seeka nyanyan gi en di sapaten doo. We, Malita be e sete tafaa. Da Lasalesi na be wan fu den sama di be de a tafaa de fu nyan anga Masaa Jesesi
eng_text: So they made him a supper there. Martha served, but Lazarus was one of those who sat at the table with him.

djk_text: Ne Maliya teke wan gaan dii sumee switi fatu, ne a kandi ala a Masaa Jesesi futu te a kaba. Ne a dee Masaa Jesesi futu baka anga en ede uwii. Ne a hii osu fuu kwaa anga a sumee fu a sumee switi fatu ya.
eng_text: Mary, therefore, took a pound of ointment of pure nard, very precious, and anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped his feet with her hair. The house was filled with the fragrance of the ointment.

djk_text: Ma wan fu den bakaman fi en, Judasi Iskaliyotu, di be o seli en taki:
eng_text: Then Judas Iscariot, Simon's son, one of his disciples, who would betray him, said,

djk_text: “Saide meke den á seli a fatu ya, da den be gi den pootiman a moni? Bika, efu den be seli en, da den be o fende tyaipi moni. Bika beina a wan hii yali i mu wooko fosi i sa fende a moni fu bai a oli ya.”
eng_text: Why wasn't this ointment sold for three hundred denarii, and given to the poor?

djk_text: Ma a á be taki den sani fu den pootiman ede. Bika a ná pootiman be ati en so. Ma ne en be e oli a monisaka, fu poti ala moni di sama be e gi den. Da a be e fende a moni e fufuu bun.
eng_text: Now he said this, not because he cared for the poor, but because he was a thief, and having the money box, used to steal what was put into it.

djk_text: Ma Jesesi taigi en taki: “U fika en! A be de fanowdu fu a kibii a fatu ya te enke a dei fu tide fu towe a mi futu fu lesipeki mi fu a dei di den o beli mi.
eng_text: But Jesus said, "Leave her alone. She has kept this for the day of my burial.

djk_text: Den pootiman de alaten anga u ya. Ma mi ná o de alaten a u mindii.”
eng_text: For you always have the poor with you, but you don't always have me."

djk_text: We, di somen fu den sama fu Judeja yee taki Masaa Jesesi de ape, ne den kon de tu. Da den á be kon fu Masaa Jesesi ede wawan, ma fu den be sa si Lasalesi di Masaa Jesesi be weki puu a dede tu.
eng_text: A large crowd therefore of the Jews learned that he was there, and they came, not for Jesus' sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.

djk_text: Da den hei apaiti begiman meke mofu, kuudei anga den seefi, fu kii Lasalesi tu.
eng_text: But the chief priests conspired to put Lazarus to death also,

djk_text: Bika na fi en ede meke somen fu den sama fu Judeja di be go de, fika a leli fu den Dyu edeman ya, daai kon e biibi a Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: because on account of him many of the Jews went away and believed in Jesus.

djk_text: Ne a taa dei, ne den somen sama di be kon na a piisii yee taki Masaa Jesesi de a pasi e kon a Jelusalem.
eng_text: On the next day a great multitude had come to the feast. When they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,

djk_text: Ne den teke palon taka oli a den ana, ne den go a doose go miti en a pasi. Ne den e bali baaya gi en taki: “Hosana! Seigi fu Awan di e kon a ini a nen fu Masaa. Seigi fu a Kownu fu Islayeli sama!”
eng_text: they took the branches of the palm trees, and went out to meet him, and cried out, "Hosanna ! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord, the King of Israel!"

djk_text: Da Masaa Jesesi be fende wan buliki, ne a subi go sidon ne en tapu. Da a sani ya waka leti enke fa a be sikiifi a Gadu Buku taki:
eng_text: Jesus, having found a young donkey, sat on it. As it is written,

djk_text: “U á feele, sama fu Siyon! U luku a kownu fu u, sidon a wan pikin yonkuu buliki tapu e kon.”
eng_text: Don't be afraid, daughter of Zion. Behold, your King comes, sitting on a donkey's colt.

djk_text: Ma a yuu ten de, da den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi á be fusutan en ete. Ma bakaten di a dede weki go fende a waiti fasi fi en, fosi, ne den kon sabi taki, na so wan sani fi en be sikiifi a Gadu Buku anga fa denseefi be du den sani ya gi en.
eng_text: His disciples didn't understand these things at first, but when Jesus was glorified, then they remembered that these things were written about him, and that they had done these things to him.

djk_text: Da ala den somen sama di be de anga en di a be weki Lasalesi puu a dede, be e taigi taa sama fa a be kai Lasalesi puu a ini a geebi olo weki en puu a dede.
eng_text: The multitude therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of the tomb, and raised him from the dead, was testifying about it.

djk_text: Da na fu dati ede meke i si somen sama be lon go miti Masaa Jesesi so, fu di den be yee taki a so wan gaan foondoo sani a be du.
eng_text: For this cause also the multitude went and met him, because they heard that he had done this sign.

djk_text: Ma den Faliseiman taigi den na den taki: “U si? Wi á poi du ná wan sani fu oli den. Bika hii goontapu lon go ne en go e waka ne en baka.”
eng_text: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, "See how you accomplish nothing. Behold, the world has gone after him."

djk_text: Da wantu Giiki sama be de a ini fu den somen sama di be kon fu begi Masaa Gadu tu na a piisii ya.
eng_text: Now there were certain Greeks among those that went up to worship at the feast.

djk_text: We, ne den kon a Filipi, wan fu den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi di be e tan a Betisaida na a pisiwataa fu Galileya, ne den begi en taki: “Man, gaantangi, u wani miti anga Masaa Jesesi, baa.”
eng_text: These, therefore, came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida of Galilee, and asked him, saying, "Sir, we want to see Jesus."

djk_text: We, ne Filipi komoto, ne a go taigi Andeleyasi. Ne Filipi anga Andeleyasi komoto, ne den go taigi Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: Philip came and told Andrew, and in turn, Andrew came with Philip, and they told Jesus.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi piki den sama taki: “We, a yuu doo kaba, di a dyendee fasi fu a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya, mu kon a doo.”
eng_text: Jesus answered them, "The time has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den go doo taki: “Fu tuutuu mi e taigi u, solanga wan ain kalu de, ma a á kai a doti fu poli, da na a wankodo ain kalu de wawan o tan. Ma, efu a kai a doti poli, da fosi a o goo kon meke tyaipi nyanyan.
eng_text: Most certainly I tell you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it remains by itself alone. But if it dies, it bears much fruit.

djk_text: A sama di e feti fu kibii en libi sa lasi en. Ma sama di ná abi toobi fu lasi en libi a goontapu ya fu mi ede, sa fende libi fu tego.
eng_text: He who loves his life will lose it. He who hates his life in this world will keep it to eternal life.

djk_text: Efu wan sama wani dini mi, da a mu e waka a mi baka. Bika mi wani meke den sama di e dini mi mu de a pe mi de. Da mi Tata o hei den sama di wani fu dini mi gi den gaan lesipeki.”
eng_text: If anyone serves me, let him follow me. Where I am, there will my servant also be. If anyone serves me, the Father will honor him.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi taki baka taki: “We, enke fa mi de ya, da mi ati de anga fuka. Ma san mi sa taki? Mi sa begi mi Tata fu a puu den sani di de a fesi fu kon miti mi? Ma nono! Bika na fu a sani ya ede, meke mi be kon, fu nyan gaan pina na a yuu ya.
eng_text:
Now my soul is troubled. What shall I say? 'Father, save me from this time?' But for this cause I came to this time.
3398	Mi Tata! Meke libisama si a hei fasi anga a kaakiti fi i di yu abi!” We, ne wan Tongo taki a tapu anda taki: “Mi meke libisama si a waiti fasi anga a kaakiti fu mi kaba. Da mi sa meke den si en ete moo anga moo.”	3398	Father, glorify your name! Then there came a voice out of the sky, saying, "I have both glorified it, and will glorify it again."

djk_text: We, ne den sama di taampu de yee di a Tongo taki. Ne den taki: “Donduu e bali!” Taawan taki: “Na wan Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee taki anga en.”
eng_text: The multitude therefore, who stood by and heard it, said that it had thundered. Others said, "An angel has spoken to him."

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “A ná fu mi ede meke a Tongo ya taki. Ma na fu u ede.
eng_text: Jesus answered, "This voice hasn't come for my sake, but for your sakes.

djk_text: We, bika a yuu doo kaba fu Gadu kuutu goontapu. Da now, den o puu a edeman fu a goontapu ya ne en tii.
eng_text: Now is the judgment of this world. Now the prince of this world will be cast out.

djk_text: Ma mi, te den sa opo mi, da mi sa ali ala sama kon a mi.”
eng_text: And I, if I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to myself."

djk_text: Da Masaa Jesesi be taki den sani ya, fu soi den sowtu dede a be o dede.
eng_text: But he said this, signifying by what kind of death he should die.

djk_text: Ma den sama piki en taki: “We, a sikiifi a Gadu Buku taki, a Kelestesi o libi fu tego. We, da fa i du e taki, den o opo a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya? Sama yu e kai a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya?”
eng_text: The multitude answered him, "We have heard out of the law that the Christ remains forever. How do you say, 'The Son of Man must be lifted up?' Who is this Son of Man?"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “U waka a ini a leti, solanga u leti ya de a mindii ete, fu dunguu á kon kisi u. We bika, na wan pikin pisiten namo, a leti ya de a u mindii ete. Bika a sama di e waka a ini dunguu á sabi na on se ai go.
eng_text: Jesus therefore said to them, "Yet a little while the light is with you. Walk while you have the light, that darkness doesn't overtake you. He who walks in the darkness doesn't know where he is going.

djk_text: We, u poti biibi na a leti ya tapu, solanga a de a u mindii ete. Da u sa toon pikin fu a leti.” We, ne na so Masaa Jesesi taki, ne a gwe. Ne a kibii enseefi gi den.
eng_text: While you have the light, believe in the light, that you may become children of light." Jesus said these things, and he departed and hid himself from them.

djk_text: Bika anga ala fa den be si den foondoo wooko di Masaa Jesesi be e du de seefi, toku seefi den á be wani poti biibi ne en.
eng_text: But though he had done so many signs before them, yet they didn't believe in him,

djk_text: We, da na so a sani, di a fositen apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu di den be e kai Jesaja be taki kon tuu. Bika a be taki: “Masaa! Sama be biibi a bosikopu di u be e tyai? Da ná wan sama de di sabi bunbun san na den foondoo.”
eng_text: that the word of Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spoke, "Lord, who has believed our report? To whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?"

djk_text: We, na fu dati ede meke den á poi biibi, leti enke fa Jesaja be taki baka taki:
eng_text: For this cause they couldn't believe, for Isaiah said again,

djk_text: “Masaa Gadu dunguu den ain, fu den á si sani. Da soseefi a taanga den ati, fu den á poi fusutan den sani fi en. Da den á poi daai den libi kon, fu mi deesi den.”
eng_text: He has blinded their eyes and he hardened their heart, lest they should see with their eyes, and perceive with their heart, and would turn, and I would heal them.

djk_text: Da na fu di Jesaja be si a hei fasi fi en anga a waiti fasi di a be o abi.
eng_text: Isaiah said these things when he saw his glory, and spoke of him.

djk_text: Ma anga ala fa, toku somen fu den edeman fu den Dyu daai kon e biibi ne en. Ma na fu den Faliseiman ede meke den á be wani meke taa sama sabi. Bika, efu den Faliseiman be yee, den be o puu den na a keliki.
eng_text: Nevertheless even of the rulers many believed in him, but because of the Pharisees they didn't confess it, so that they wouldn't be put out of the synagogue,

djk_text: Bika den be wani abi bun nen a sama, moo enke pe fu den suku bun nen a Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: for they loved men's praise more than God's praise.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi taki anga moo taanga tongo taki: “Sama di e biibi a mi, a ná mi wawan namo ai biibi, ma ai biibi na a sama di sende mi kon.
eng_text: Jesus cried out and said, "Whoever believes in me, believes not in me, but in him who sent me.

djk_text: Da sama di e si mi, á si mi wawan, ma a si a sama di sende mi kon.
eng_text: He who sees me sees him who sent me.

djk_text: Mi kon a goontapu enke wan leti, fu meke ibii sama di biibi a mi á tan a dunguu.
eng_text: I have come as a light into the world, that whoever believes in me may not remain in the darkness.

djk_text: Ma kaba, efu wan sama yee san mi e leli, ne a á biibi, mi ná o kuutu en. Bika mi á be kon fu sitaafu goontapu, ma mi kon fu puu den a dede gi den tuutuu libi.
eng_text: If anyone listens to my sayings, and doesn't believe, I don't judge him. For I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.

djk_text: Ma sama di poti mi a wanse, ne a á wani teke a leli fu mi, da so wan sama abi en kuutuman kaba. Da a seefi leli di a yee mi e leli ya, sa kuutu en na a kiiboi dei.
eng_text: He who rejects me, and doesn't receive my sayings, has one who judges him. The word that I spoke, the same will judge him in the last day.

djk_text: Bika den sani di mi e leli, a ná mi seefi sani. Ma na mi Tata di sende mi kon, ne enseefi be taigi mi san mi mu taki anga fa mi mu taki den.
eng_text: For I spoke not from myself, but the Father who sent me, he gave me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.

djk_text: Da mi sabi taki den sani di a sende mi fu mi taki ya, e yeepi sama, fu den fende a libi fu tego. Da san mi e taki, na san mi Tata be taigi mi fu taki.”
eng_text: I know that his commandment is eternal life. The things therefore which I speak, even as the Father has said to me, so I speak."

djk_text: Da a yuu de, da a Pasika Fesa be de koosube kaba. Da Masaa Jesesi be sabi taki a yuu fi en doo fu a fika a goontapu ya go ne en Tata. Ma namo, da Masaa Jesesi be lobi den sama fi en alaten, ma now, da a o soi den fa a lobi di a be lobi den ala den yuu bigi.
eng_text: Now before the feast of the Passover, Jesus, knowing that his time had come that he would depart from this world to the Father, having loved his own who were in the world, he loved them to the end.

djk_text: Ne, di den e nyan na a sapaten, da a didibii be poti a pakisei gi Judasi, a pikin fu Simon Iskaliyotu kaba a ini en ati ini fu a seli Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: During supper, the devil having already put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon's son, to betray him,

djk_text: We, Masaa Jesesi be sabi taki en Tata be poti ala sani a ini en ana. Bika a sabi taki na Masaa Gadu a komoto, da na Masaa Gadu ai go baka tu.
eng_text: Jesus, knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he came forth from God, and was going to God,

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi opo, ne a puu en dyakiti poti a wanse. Ne a teke wan duku tei ne en mindii.
eng_text: arose from supper, and laid aside his outer garments. He took a towel, and wrapped a towel around his waist.

djk_text: Ne a kandi wataa poti a ini wan gaan beenki, ne a bigin wasi den bakaman fi en futu. Ne a teke a duku di a be tei en mindii, ne a dee den futu te a kaba.
eng_text: Then he poured water into the basin, and began to wash the disciples' feet, and to wipe them with the towel that was wrapped around him.

djk_text: Ma di a doo Simon Peitilisi, ne Simon taigi en taki: “Nono Masaa! Yu o wasi mi futu?”
eng_text: Then he came to Simon Peter. He said to him, "Lord, do you wash my feet?"

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Simon, yu á sabi san mi e du ete. Ma bakaten yu o sabi.”
eng_text: Jesus answered him, "You don't know what I am doing now, but you will understand later."

djk_text: Ne Simon piki en taki: “Nono! Kweti kweti! Yu ná o wasi mi futu.” Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Efu mi á wasi yu futu, da yu ná o poi de wan bakaman fu mi moo.”
eng_text: Peter said to him, "You will never wash my feet!" Jesus answered him, "If I don't wash you, you have no part with me."

djk_text: Ne Simon taigi en taki: “Masaa, a ná mi futu wawan fi i wasi, ma wasi mi ana anga mi ede tu.”
eng_text: Simon Peter said to him, "Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head!"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “We, sama di wasi kaba, a á de fu den wasi en hii sikin moo. Ma ne en futu namo den mu wasi. Bika a kiin kaba. Ma fa u de ya u kiin kaba, ma a ná ala u fiya.”
eng_text: Jesus said to him, "Someone who has bathed only needs to have his feet washed, but is completely clean. You are clean, but not all of you."

djk_text: Bika a be sabi sama be o seli en. A dati meke a taki, a ná ala den fiya kiin.
eng_text: For he knew him who would betray him, therefore he said, "You are not all clean."

djk_text: We, di a kaba wasi den futu kaba, ne a wei en dyakiti baka, ne a go teke en peesi a tafaa baka. Ne a akisi den taki: “U sabi san mi du gi u de?
eng_text: So when he had washed their feet, put his outer garment back on, and sat down again, he said to them, "Do you know what I have done to you?

djk_text: U e kai mi, Mesiti. U e kai mi, Masaa. We, u abi leti tuu fu kai mi so. Bika a so mi de tuu.
eng_text: You call me, 'Teacher' and 'Lord.' You say so correctly, for so I am.

djk_text: We, leti enke fa mi, a Masaa anga a Mesiti fu u wasi u futu, na soseefi u mu wasi u na u futu tu.
eng_text: If I then, the Lord and the Teacher, have washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another's feet.

djk_text: Bika mi du a sani ya soi u, fu useefi du e gi taa sama, leti enke fa mi be du en gi u.
eng_text: For I have given you an example, that you also should do as I have done to you.

djk_text: Fu tuutuu mi e taigi u taki, wan futuboi á hei moo en masaa. Da soseefi wan bosikopuman á bigi moo a sama di sende en a bosikopu.
eng_text: Most certainly I tell you, a servant is not greater than his lord, neither one who is sent greater than he who sent him.

djk_text: We, now u sabi den sani di mi e leli u. Da seigi fu u, efu u e du den tu.”
eng_text: If you know these things, blessed are you if you do them.

djk_text: “Ma a ná u ala fiya mi e taki. Bika mi sabi den sama di mi teke kon toon fu miseefi. Ma a wowtu fu Gadu Buku di taki: ‘A sama di de a tafaa e nyan beele anga mi opo en futu fu taampu mi,’ mu kon leti.
eng_text: I don't speak concerning all of you. I know whom I have chosen. But that the Scripture may be fulfilled, 'He who eats bread with me has lifted up his heel against me.'

djk_text: Mi e taigi u a sani ya a fesi. Fu te a pasa so, fu u sa sabi taki, na mi na a sama di mi be taigi u taki mi de.
eng_text: From now on, I tell you before it happens, that when it happens, you may believe that I am he.

djk_text: Fu tuutuu mi e taigi u taki, a sama di o teke wan sama di mi o sende kon, da na miseefi a teke de. Da a sama di o teke mi, da a teke a Sama di sende mi kon a goontapu tu.”
eng_text: Most certainly I tell you, he who receives whomever I send, receives me; and he who receives me, receives him who sent me."

djk_text: Da di Masaa Jesesi taki a sani de, ne gaan tyali kon fuu en ati. Ne a taigi den kiinkiin taki: “Fu tuutuu mi e taigi u taki, wan fu u o seli mi.”
eng_text: When Jesus had said this, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, "Most certainly I tell you that one of you will betray me."

djk_text: Ne di Masaa Jesesi taki so, ne den bakaman fi en luku denseefi te doo. Bika den á sabi on di fu den a be e taki.
eng_text: The disciples looked at one another, perplexed about whom he spoke.

djk_text: We, wan fu den bakaman fi en, a bakaman di a be lobi te, de ne en se de.
eng_text: One of his disciples, whom Jesus loved, was at the table, leaning against Jesus' breast.

djk_text: Na fu dati ede meke Simon Peitilisi soi en anga ana kibii kibii fu a akisi Masaa Jesesi sama na a sama di o seli en.
eng_text: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, and said to him, "Tell us who it is of whom he speaks."

djk_text: We, ne a diipi go moo koosube fu Masaa Jesesi, ne a akisi en taki: “Masaa! Sama na a sama di o seli yu?”
eng_text: He, leaning back, as he was, on Jesus' breast, asked him, "Lord, who is it?"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “A sama di mi o gi a pisi beele di mi o dipi go a ini a baafun ya, ne en o seli mi.” Ne na so Masaa Jesesi dipi a beele go a ini a baafun, ne a gi Judasi, a pikin fu Simon Iskaliyotu.
eng_text: Jesus therefore answered, "It is he to whom I will give this piece of bread when I have dipped it." So when he had dipped the piece of bread, he gave it to Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot.

djk_text: Ne di a teke a beele, ne wanten wanten, ne saatan, a didibii saka go a ini en ati ini. Ne Jesesi taigi en taki: “Go du san i mu du esi esi.”
eng_text: After the piece of bread, then Satan entered into him. Then Jesus said to him, "What you do, do quickly."

djk_text: Ma ná wan fu den taawan di be de a tafaa be sabi fu saide meke Masaa Jesesi be taki so anga en.
eng_text: Now no man at the table knew why he said this to him.

djk_text: Son fu den be denki taki na fu di Judasi be e tyai a monisaka meke Masaa Jesesi be taigi en taki, fu a go bai sani fu den nyan a piisii, efuso fu a gi den pootiman wan sani.
eng_text: For some thought, because Judas had the money box, that Jesus said to him, "Buy what things we need for the feast," or that he should give something to the poor.

djk_text: We, ne di Judasi teke a beele, ne wanten, ne a go a doose. Ne neti kai, peesi be dunguu pii.
eng_text: Therefore having received that morsel, he went out immediately. It was night.

djk_text: We, di Judasi go a doose kaba, ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “We, a yuu doo, di a hei di a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya abi, mu kon fu si. Da a hei fu Gadu seefi o de fu si tu.
eng_text: When he had gone out, Jesus said, "Now the Son of Man has been glorified, and God has been glorified in him.

djk_text: We, leti enke fa a be hei Gadu, da na soseefi Gadu o hei a Manpikin ya moo. Da na wanten wanten a o hei en.
eng_text: If God has been glorified in him, God will also glorify him in himself, and he will glorify him immediately.

djk_text: Mi lobi wan. Wan pikin ten namo mi o de anga u ete. Da u o suku mi. Ma, leti enke fa mi be taigi den Dyu kaba, na so soseefi mi e taigi u now taki, pe mi e go, u ná o poi kon anda.
eng_text: Little children, I will be with you a little while longer. You will seek me, and as I said to the Jews, 'Where I am going, you can't come,' so now I tell you.

djk_text: Mi o gi u wan nyunyun weiti fu u oli. Dati na taki: U mu lobi useefi. Leti enke fa mi be lobi u, na soseefi u mu lobi useefi tu.
eng_text: A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another, just like I have loved you; that you also love one another.

djk_text: Da te u lobi useefi, da ala sama sa si taki u na bakaman fu mi.”
eng_text: By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you have love for one another."

djk_text: Ma now, ne Simon Peitilisi akisi en taki: “Masaa! On pe yu e go?” Ma Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Yu á poi kon anga mi a leisi di mi e go ya. Ma bakaten, da i sa go anga mi.”
eng_text: Simon Peter said to him, "Lord, where are you going?" Jesus answered, "Where I am going, you can't follow now, but you will follow afterwards."

djk_text: Ne Peitilisi akisi en taki: “Masaa! Saide meke mi á poi go anga yu a leisi ya? Mi de kaba kaba fu lasi mi libi, fi yu ede!”
eng_text: Peter said to him, "Lord, why can't I follow you now? I will lay down my life for you."

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi akisi en taki: “I de kaba kaba fu lasi yu libi fu mi ede, enke fa yu taki tuu? We, fu tuutuu mi e taigi yu taki, fosi wan kakafoo bali a neti ya, yu o lei dii toon taki, yu á sabi mi.”
eng_text: Jesus answered him, "Will you lay down your life for me? Most certainly I tell you, the rooster won't crow until you have denied me three times.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den bakaman fi en taki: “U ati á mu dege dege. U poti biibi a Gadu! Da soseefi u poti biibi a mi tu.
eng_text:
Don't let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.
3460	Bika tanpeesi de nofu na pe mi Tata e tan. Efu a á be de so, da mi be o taigi u. Bika mi e go fu seeka peesi gi u.	3460	In my Father's house are many homes. If it weren't so, I would have told you. I am going to prepare a place for you.
3461	Da te mi go seeka u peesi te mi kaba, da mi o daai kon baka fu teke u tyai kon a mi, fu u sa de ape mi de tu.	3461	If I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and will receive you to myself; that where I am, you may be there also.
3462	We, u sabi pe mi e go. Da soseefi u sabi a pasi fu kon anda tu.”	3462	Where I go, you know, and you know the way.

djk_text: Ne Towmasi piki en taki: “Nono, Masaa! Wi á sabi pe yu e go. Da fa wi o sabi a pasi fu kon anda?”
eng_text: Thomas said to him, "Lord, we don't know where you are going. How can we know the way?"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “We, na mi na a pasi. Na mi na a tuu. Na mi na a libi. Ná wan sama sa kon a mi Tata, efu mi á tyai en go ne en.
eng_text: Jesus said to him, "I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.

djk_text: Efu u sabi mi, da u o sabi mi Tata tu. We, fanafu now, da u sabi en. Bika u be si en.”
eng_text: If you had known me, you would have known my Father also. From now on, you know him, and have seen him."

djk_text: Ne Filipi taigi en taki: “Masaa! Soi wi a Tata, da a sai u kaba.”
eng_text: Philip said to him, "Lord, show us the Father, and that will be enough for us."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Fu on langa di mi de ya anga u, Filipi, ne yu á sabi mi ete? Sama di si mi, si mi Tata seefi. Da fa yu e akisi mi taki: ‘Soi u a Tata?’
eng_text: Jesus said to him, "Have I been with you such a long time, and do you not know me, Philip? He who has seen me has seen the Father. How do you say, 'Show us the Father?'

djk_text: Yu nái biibi taki mi anga mi Tata de wan, no? U á de paati paati. Den sani di mi e leli u, a ná sani fu miseefi. Ma na a Tata di e tan a mi ini, ne en e du en wooko.
eng_text: Don't you believe that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? The words that I tell you, I speak not from myself; but the Father who lives in me does his works.

djk_text: Biibi mi, taki mi anga mi Tata á de paati paati, ma u de wan. Efuso, da u biibi mi fu den wooko namo.
eng_text: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me; or else believe me for the very works' sake.

djk_text: Fu tuutuu mi e taigi u taki, sama di poti biibi a mi, a sa du den wooko di mi e du tu. Da moo gaan wooko seefi a sa du. Bika mi e go a mi Tata.
eng_text: Most certainly I tell you, he who believes in me, the works that I do, he will do also; and he will do greater works than these, because I am going to my Father.

djk_text: Da winsi san u sa begi akisi mi Tata a mi nen, da mi sa gi u, fu mi Tata mu kisi balinen na a Manpikin fi en.
eng_text: Whatever you will ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

djk_text: Iniiwan sani di u sa begi akisi na mi nen, mi sa gi u.”
eng_text: If you will ask anything in my name, I will do it.

djk_text: “Efu u lobi mi, da u mu du san mi sende u fu du.
eng_text: If you love me, keep my commandments.

djk_text: Da mi sa begi a Tata, da a sa gi u wan taa Yeepiman, di o tan anga u fu tego.
eng_text: I will pray to the Father, and he will give you another Counselor, that he may be with you forever,--

djk_text: Dati na a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu, di e soi u den tuutuu sani fu Gadu. Da den sama fu a goontapu ya di á de a Gadu pasi ná o poi fende a Jeje ya. Bika den á si en. Da soseefi den á sabi en tu. Ma u sabi en, bika ai tan anga u. Da soseefi a o tan a ini u tu.
eng_text: the Spirit of truth, whom the world can't receive; for it doesn't see him, neither knows him. You know him, for he lives with you, and will be in you.

djk_text: “Mi ná o fika u enke pikin di de sondee mma anga dda a baka. Mi o daai kon a u baka.
eng_text: I will not leave you orphans. I will come to you.

djk_text: Pikinso moo, da goontapu ná o si mi moo. Ma u dati, u sa si mi. Bika mi o libi baka. Da u sa libi tu.
eng_text: Yet a little while, and the world will see me no more; but you will see me. Because I live, you will live also.

djk_text: Da a yuu ten de, da u sa si taki mi anga mi Tata á de paati paati. Ma u de wan. Da soseefi u o si taki mi anga u á de paati paati tu. Ma u de wan.
eng_text: In that day you will know that I am in my Father, and you in me, and I in you.

djk_text: Da sama di teke san mi e taigi en fu a du, ne ai du den, da so wan sama lobi mi. Da, efu wan sama lobi mi so, da mi Tata seefi o lobi en tu. Da mi seefi o lobi so wan sama tu. Da mi o opo miseefi gi en fu a kon sabi mi.”
eng_text: One who has my commandments, and keeps them, that person is one who loves me. One who loves me will be loved by my Father, and I will love him, and will reveal myself to him."

djk_text: We, ne wan taa Judasi, boiti Iskaliyotu, akisi Jesesi taki: “Masaa, san meke na u namo yu o opo iseefi gi? San meke i ná o opo yuseefi gi hii goontapu?”
eng_text: Judas (not Iscariot) said to him, "Lord, what has happened that you are about to reveal yourself to us, and not to the world?"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Sama di lobi mi, o go e du san a yee a mi. Da mi Tata o lobi en. Da mi anga mi Tata o kon, da wi o tan anga en.
eng_text: Jesus answered him, "If a man loves me, he will keep my word. My Father will love him, and we will come to him, and make our home with him.

djk_text: Ma, efu wan sama á lobi mi, da a ná o teke den wowtu di mi e leli en. Bika a wowtu di u e yee, a ná mi wowtu, ma na fu a Tata di sende mi kon.”
eng_text: He who doesn't love me doesn't keep my words. The word which you hear isn't mine, but the Father's who sent me.

djk_text: “We, mi e taigi u den sani fu di mi de anga u ya ete.
eng_text: I have said these things to you, while still living with you.

djk_text: Ma a Yeepiman, a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu, di mi Tata o sende kon a mi nen, sa leli u ala sani. Da soseefi a sa tyai ala san di mi be taigi u kon baka a ini u pakisei.
eng_text: But the Counselor, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, he will teach you all things, and will remind you of all that I said to you.

djk_text: We, mi sa gi u wan koo ati. A koo ati di mi e gi u ya de taa fasi enke di fu goontapu. A dati meke a á de fu u dege dege ofu feele.”
eng_text: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, give I to you. Don't let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den go doo taki: “U be yee di mi be taigi u taki, mi e gwe, ma mi o kon baka a u. Efu u be lobi mi, da u ati be o piisii, di mi taigi u taki, mi e gwe a mi Tata. Bika mi Tata bigi moo mi.
eng_text: You heard how I told you, 'I go away, and I come to you.' If you loved me, you would have rejoiced, because I said 'I am going to my Father;' for the Father is greater than I.

djk_text: We, mi be taki den sani ya gi u a fesi, fu te a yuu o doo di den o pasa, fu u sa biibi.
eng_text: Now I have told you before it happens so that, when it happens, you may believe.

djk_text: “Mi ná o taki langa anga u moo, bika a edeman fu a goontapu ya e kon. Ma a ná abi ná wan taki a mi tapu.
eng_text: I will no more speak much with you, for the prince of the world comes, and he has nothing in me.

djk_text: Ma, na fu di goontapu mu kon sabi kiinkiin taki, mi lobi mi Tata, na dati ede meke mi e du enke fa mi Tata taigi mi. We, u opo meke u gwe komoto ya.”
eng_text: But that the world may know that I love the Father, and as the Father commanded me, even so I do. Arise, let us go from here.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “Mi na a tuutuu doloifi bon. Da mi Tata na a sama di abi a goon seefi fu solugu.
eng_text:
I am the true vine, and my Father is the farmer.
