As the branch can't bear fruit by itself, unless it remains in the vine, so neither can you, unless you remain in me.
3494	“Mi na a doloifi bon. U na den taka fu mi. Sama di e tan a ini mi, ne mi tan ne en ini, da so wan sama o meke tyaipi nyanyan. Bika sondee mi u á poi du ná wan sani.	3494	I am the vine. You are the branches. He who remains in me, and I in him, the same bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.
3495	Sama di á tan a ini mi, den sa koti en puu towe enke wan dee doloifi taka. Da den e piki den taka ya towe a ini faya fu den boon.	3495	If a man doesn't remain in me, he is thrown out as a branch, and is withered; and they gather them, throw them into the fire, and they are burned.
3496	Efu u tan a ini mi, ne den leli fu mi tan na u ini, da u sa begi akisi san u wani, da u sa fende en.	3496	If you remain in me, and my words remain in you, you will ask whatever you desire, and it will be done for you.
3497	Da, te u meke nyanyan, da na sowan fasi mi Tata o kisi balinen. Da u sa soi taki u na bakaman fu mi tuutuu.	3497	In this is my Father glorified, that you bear much fruit; and so you will be my disciples.

djk_text: Da, leti enke fa mi Tata lobi mi, na soseefi miseefi lobi u tu. So u tan a ini a lobi fu mi.
eng_text: Even as the Father has loved me, I also have loved you. Remain in my love.

djk_text: Efu u du san mi e taki, da u sa tan a ini mi lobi. Bika mi tan a ini a lobi fu mi Tata fu di mi e du san a taigi mi fu du.
eng_text: If you keep my commandments, you will remain in my love; even as I have kept my Father's commandments, and remain in his love.

djk_text: “Da mi taigi u den sani ya, fu a piisii fu mi tan a u ini ati. Da soseefi mi taigi u den sani ya, fu a piisii fu u mu goo a ini u ati te a pasa peesi.
eng_text: I have spoken these things to you, that my joy may remain in you, and that your joy may be made full.

djk_text: Da mi e sende u taki, u lobi useefi, enke fa mi lobi u.
eng_text:
This is my commandment, that you love one another, even as I have loved you.
3502	We, bika ná wan sama sa lobi wan sama moo enke a sama di ná abi toobi fu poti en libi gi wan taa sama.	3502	Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.
3503	Da u na mi mati, efu u e du san mi sende u fu du.	3503	You are my friends, if you do whatever I command you.
3504	Mi nái kai u futuboi moo. Bika wan futuboi á sabi san en masaa e du. Ma mi e kai u, mi mati. Bika mi be taigi u ala san mi be yee fu mi Tata.	3504	No longer do I call you servants, for the servant doesn't know what his lord does. But I have called you friends, for everything that I heard from my Father, I have made known to you.
3505	A ná u be kon a mi, ma na mi be piki u puu a den taawan mindii fu u go, da u meke nyanyan. Da te u meke nyanyan, da a nyanyan fu u sa tan fu tego. Da iniiwan sani di u o akisi mi Tata a mi nen, a o gi u en.	3505	You didn't choose me, but I chose you, and appointed you, that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should remain; that whatever you will ask of the Father in my name, he may give it to you.
3506	Ma mi poti gi u taki: U lobi useefi.	3506	I command these things to you, that you may love one another.

djk_text: “Efu kondee á lobi u, da u mu sabi taki, den á be lobi mi a fesi kaba bifo u.
eng_text: If the world hates you, you know that it has hated me before it hated you.

djk_text: Efu u be de fu kondee, da kondee be o lobi u, bika u be o de anga den na a wanse. Ma fu di u á de fu kondee, bika mi be piki u puu a den kondee sama mindii, na fu dati ede meke den á poi si u na ain.
eng_text: If you were of the world, the world would love its own. But because you are not of the world, since I chose you out of the world, therefore the world hates you.

djk_text: U feegete den wowtu di mi be taigi u taki, wan futuboi á a bigi moo en masaa? We, leti enke fa i si den feti a mi baka fu pina mi, na leti soseefi den o feti a u baka pina u fu mi ede. Da, leti enke fa son sama be aliki mi wowtu e du san mi taki, na letiso sama sa aliki u san u e taki tu.
eng_text: Remember the word that I said to you: 'A servant is not greater than his lord.' If they persecuted me, they will also persecute you. If they kept my word, they will keep yours also.

djk_text: Ma na fu di den á sabi mi Tata di sende mi kon, meke den o du ala den sani ya anga u fu mi ede.
eng_text: But all these things will they do to you for my name's sake, because they don't know him who sent me.

djk_text: We, efu mi á be kon taki anga den, da den á be o du ogii. Ma, enke fa u de, den á poi sitee taki, den ná ogii.
eng_text: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not have had sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.

djk_text: Wan sama di buuse mi, buuse mi Tata tu.
eng_text: He who hates me, hates my Father also.

djk_text: Efu mi á be du so gaan foondoo sani a den mindii, di wan taawan á be du ete, da den á be o du ogii. Ma now den si ala san di mi du, ne toku den buuse mi. Da soseefi den buuse mi Tata tu.
eng_text: If I hadn't done among them the works which no one else did, they wouldn't have had sin. But now have they seen and also hated both me and my Father.

djk_text: Ma fa i si den sani ya pasa de, na fu di san sikiifi a Gadu Buku mu kon tuu. Bika Gadu Buku sikiifi taki: ‘Mi á be du wan sani anga den, ne toku den á poi si mi na ain.’
eng_text: But this happened so that the word may be fulfilled which was written in their law, 'They hated me without a cause.'

djk_text: “Ma mi o sende a Yeepiman, a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu di e leli sama den tuutuu sani fu Gadu kon. Da te a kon, da a sa taki sani fu mi.
eng_text:
When the Counselor has come, whom I will send to you from the Father, the Spirit of truth, who proceeds from the Father, he will testify about me.
3516	Da useefi o taki sani fu mi tu. Bika u be de anga mi fanafu a bigin.”	3516	You will also testify, because you have been with me from the beginning.
3517	Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “Mi taigi u den sani ya a fesi fu u á buuya bakaten fu u lasi biibi.	3517	These things have I spoken to you, so that you wouldn't be caused to stumble.

djk_text: Bika den edeman o puu u a den keliki. Da a o kon seefi taki, den o kii u. Da te den kii u, da den o denki taki na Gadu den e du wan bun.
eng_text: They will put you out of the synagogues. Yes, the time comes that whoever kills you will think that he offers service to God.

djk_text: Ma den o du den sani ya anga u, fu di den á sabi mi Tata. Da soseefi den á sabi mi tu.
eng_text: They will do these things because they have not known the Father, nor me.

djk_text: We, mi taigi u den sani ya, fu te a yuu o doo di den o pasa, fu u sabi taki, we, na so mi be taigi u. Da mi á be taigi u den sani ya a fesi, bika mi be de anga u ete.
eng_text: But I have told you these things, so that when the time comes, you may remember that I told you about them. I didn't tell you these things from the beginning, because I was with you.

djk_text: “Ma now mi o daai gwe na a sama di sende mi kon ya baka. Ma ná wan fu u e akisi moo na on se mi e go.
eng_text: But now I am going to him who sent me, and none of you asks me, 'Where are you going?'

djk_text: Ma na den sani di mi taigi u de, na den meke gaan tyali kisi u?
eng_text: But because I have told you these things, sorrow has filled your heart.

djk_text: Ma mi e taigi u tuutuu taki, na wan gaan yeepi a de gi u, fa i si mi e gwe ya. Bika, efu mi á gwe, da a Yeepiman ná poi kon. Ma te mi go kaba, da mi o sende en kon gi u.
eng_text: Nevertheless I tell you the truth: It is to your advantage that I go away, for if I don't go away, the Counselor won't come to you. But if I go, I will send him to you.

djk_text: Da, te a kon, da a sa soi kondee san na takuudu anga ogii. Da a o soi den san na a leti fasi fu libi anga fa Masaa Gadu o sitaafu libisama.
eng_text: When he has come, he will convict the world about sin, about righteousness, and about judgment;

djk_text: Da a o soi den san na takuudu anga ogii, fu di den á biibi a mi.
eng_text: about sin, because they don't believe in me;

djk_text: Da a o soi den san na a leti fasi fu libi, fu di mi e daai go baka a mi Tata. Da u ná o poi si mi moo.
eng_text: about righteousness, because I am going to my Father, and you won't see me any more;

djk_text: Da a o soi den fa Masaa Gadu o sitaafu kondee, bika a kuutu a edeman fu a goontapu fu a fende en sitaafu kaba.
eng_text: about judgment, because the prince of this world has been judged.

djk_text: “Ma mi abi somen sani ete di mi wani taigi u. Ma, enke fa u de nownow, u ná o poi tyai den.
eng_text:
I have yet many things to tell you, but you can't bear them now.
3529	Ma te a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu di e leli sama den tuutuu sani fu Gadu kon, da a o tii u, e tyai u a hii den sani di de tuutuu. Bika a ná o teke enseefi sani taigi u, ma san a be yee, na dati a o taki. Da soseefi a o taigi u den sani di de a fesi fu kon ete tu.	3529	However when he, the Spirit of truth, has come, he will guide you into all truth, for he will not speak from himself; but whatever he hears, he will speak. He will declare to you things that are coming.
3530	We, da a o meke libisama si a hei anga a balinen di mi abi. Bika a o teke sani fu mi taigi u.	3530	He will glorify me, for he will take from what is mine, and will declare it to you.
3531	Ala san mi Tata abi na fu mi. Na fu dati ede meke mi taigi u taki, a o teke sani fu mi taigi u.	3531	All things whatever the Father has are mine; therefore I said that he takes of mine, and will declare it to you.
3532	“Pikinso moo, da u ná o si mi moo. Ma pikinso moo, da u o si mi baka. Bika mi e go a mi Tata.”	3532	A little while, and you will not see me. Again a little while, and you will see me.

djk_text: We, ne wantu fu den bakaman fi en akisi den na den taki, san na a sani di a taki de taki: “Pikinso moo, da u ná o si mi moo? Ma, pikinso moo, da u o si mi baka? Bika mi e go a mi Tata?”
eng_text: Some of his disciples therefore said to one another, "What is this that he says to us, 'A little while, and you won't see me, and again a little while, and you will see me;' and, 'Because I go to the Father?'"

djk_text: Ne den taki go doo taki: “San wani taki, pikinso moo? We, wi á sabi san a sani de wani taki.”
eng_text: They said therefore, "What is this that he says, 'A little while?' We don't know what he is saying."

djk_text: We, di Masaa Jesesi si taki den wani akisi en wan sani, ne a akisi den taki: “We, fa u e kuutu anga useefi saafi saafi de? Na fu di mi taki: ‘Pikinso moo, da u ná o si mi moo. Ma pikinso moo, da u o si mi baka?’ U á sabi san dati wani taki, no?
eng_text: Therefore Jesus perceived that they wanted to ask him, and he said to them, "Do you inquire among yourselves concerning this, that I said, 'A little while, and you won't see me, and again a little while, and you will see me?'

djk_text: We, fu tuutuu mi e taigi u, u sa bali kee, ma goontapu sa piisii. Da gaan tyali o de a u ati. Ma a tyali fu u o kengi kon toon piisii.
eng_text: Most certainly I tell you, that you will weep and lament, but the world will rejoice. You will be sorrowful, but your sorrow will be turned into joy.

djk_text: A de leti enke te wan uman de anga bee. Te a yuu fi en doo fu a meke, da a bee e nyanmi en, te ná sipowtu. Ma te a meke kaba, da a nái pakisei a pen moo. Piisii namo, di ai piisii so fu di wan sama kon a goontapu.
eng_text: A woman, when she gives birth, has sorrow, because her time has come. But when she has delivered the child, she doesn't remember the anguish any more, for the joy that a human being is born into the world.

djk_text: We, na letiso a de anga u tu. Nownow, enke fa u de, gaan tyali de a u ati. Ma mi o si u baka. Da u ati sa piisii. Da ná wan sama o poi puu a piisii fu u ya.
eng_text: Therefore you now have sorrow, but I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one will take your joy away from you.

djk_text: Da a yuu ten de, da u ná o akisi mi ná wan sani moo. Fu tuutuu mi e taigi u taki, ala sani di u begi akisi mi Tata a mi nen, da a sa gi u den.
eng_text:
In that day you will ask me no questions. Most certainly I tell you, whatever you may ask of the Father in my name, he will give it to you.
3540	Fu te enke now, u á be begi akisi mi wan sani a mi nen ete. We, u begi akisi, no? U o fende. Da te u o fende, da a piisii fu u o goo kon te a pasa maiki.	3540	Until now, you have asked nothing in my name. Ask, and you will receive, that your joy may be made full.
3541	“We, ala den sani di mi be taigi u, mi be taigi anga ageisi toli. Ma a ten koosube, di mi ná o taki anga u a sowan fasi moo. Ma mi o taki anga u, wan kiin fasi e leli u den sani fu mi Tata.	3541	I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. But the time is coming when I will no more speak to you in figures of speech, but will tell you plainly about the Father.
3542	Da a yuu ten de, da u sa begi akisi mi Tata sani a mi nen. Da mi ná o taigi u taki, mi sa begi mi Tata gi u.	3542	In that day you will ask in my name; and I don't say to you, that I will pray to the Father for you,
3543	Bika, mi Tata seefi lobi u, fu di u lobi mi e biibi taki ne en mi komoto kon ya.	3543	for the Father himself loves you, because you have loved me, and have believed that I came forth from God.
3544	We, na mi Tata mi komoto kon a goontapu tuu. Da na soseefi mi o fika a goontapu ya baka go a mi Tata baka.”	3544	I came out from the Father, and have come into the world. Again, I leave the world, and go to the Father.

djk_text: Ne den bakaman fi en taigi en taki: “Weeno! I si? Now yu e taki kiin anga u sondee fu taki anga ageisi toli.
eng_text: His disciples said to him, "Behold, now you speak plainly, and speak no figures of speech.

djk_text: Now wi e si taki a á de fanowdu fu sama akisi sani, bika, i sabi ala sani. Na fu dati ede meke u e biibi taki na Masaa Gadu i komoto.”
eng_text: Now we know that you know all things, and don't need for anyone to question you. By this we believe that you came forth from God."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “A nowfosi u e biibi?
eng_text: Jesus answered them, "Do you now believe?

djk_text: We, fu tuutuu mi e taigi u taki, wan yuu e kon, da a de kaba, di u o paati fika mi wawan kodo. Ibiiwan fu u o go ne en osu. Ma toku seefi, a ná mi wawan de. Bika mi Tata de anga mi.
eng_text: Behold, the time is coming, yes, and has now come, that you will be scattered, everyone to his own place, and you will leave me alone. Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.

djk_text: We, mi be taigi u den sani ya fu u sa abi koo ati fu di mi anga u de wan. A ini goontapu ya gaan pina anga sitaafu e kon a tapu. Ma u á lasi ati. Bika, mi wini goontapu kaba.”
eng_text: I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have oppression; but cheer up! I have overcome the world."

djk_text: Ne di Masaa Jesesi taki anga den so te a kaba, ne a opo en ede luku tapu, ne a taki: “Mi Tata! A yuu doo kaba. Soi sama a waiti di a Manpikin fi i abi, fu a Manpikin fi yu sa soi sama a waiti fasi fi yu tu.
eng_text: Jesus said these things, and lifting up his eyes to heaven, he said, "Father, the time has come. Glorify your Son, that your Son may also glorify you;

djk_text: We, bika i gi en taki na ala sama tapu, fu a sa gi den sama di i gi en a libi fu tego.
eng_text: even as you gave him authority over all flesh, he will give eternal life to all whom you have given him.

djk_text: We, a libi fu tego, dati na fu den kon sabi yu, enke awan kodo tuutuu Gadu. Da soseefi fu den kon sabi Jesesi Kelestesi tu di i be sende kon a goontapu.
eng_text: This is eternal life, that they should know you, the only true God, and him whom you sent, Jesus Christ.

djk_text: Mi soi hii goontapu a waiti fasi fi yu. Mi kaba anga a wooko di i be gi mi fu du.
eng_text: I glorified you on the earth. I have accomplished the work which you have given me to do.

djk_text: We, mi Tata, meke mi fende a hei anga a waiti fasi fu mi baka, di mi be abi bifo goontapu be meke.
eng_text: Now, Father, glorify me with your own self with the glory which I had with you before the world existed.

djk_text: “Mi meke den sama di i gi mi a goontapu ya kon sabi i kiinkiin. Na yu be abi den kaba, ma yu gi mi den. Da den teke yu wowtu oli.
eng_text: I revealed your name to the people whom you have given me out of the world. They were yours, and you have given them to me. They have kept your word.

djk_text: Da now den kon sabi taki ala den sani di mi abi, na yu den komoto.
eng_text: Now they have known that all things whatever you have given me are from you,

djk_text: Bika mi gi den yu wowtu. Da den teke den. We, den kon sabi kiinkiin tu taki na yu mi komoto. Da den e biibi tu taki na yuseefi be sende mi kon.
eng_text: for the words which you have given me I have given to them, and they received them, and knew for sure that I came forth from you, and they have believed that you sent me.

djk_text: “We, na den mi e begi gi. Ná den sama fu a goontapu ya mi e begi gi. Ma na fu den wawan di i be gi mi. Bika den na fi yu.
eng_text: I pray for them. I don't pray for the world, but for those whom you have given me, for they are yours.

djk_text: Ala den sama di mi abi na fi yu. Da soseefi ala den sama fi yu na fu mi. Da libisama si a waiti fasi fu mi a den.
eng_text: All things that are mine are yours, and yours are mine, and I am glorified in them.

djk_text: Mi á de a goontapu moo, ma den de a goontapu ete. Da, mi e kon a yu. Mi Tata di de apaiti fu ala sani di de. Tata, kibii den sama di i gi mi ya a ini a kaakiti fu a nen fi yu, meke den de wan makandii, leti enke fa mi anga yu de wan.
eng_text: I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I am coming to you. Holy Father, keep them through your name which you have given me, that they may be one, even as we are.

djk_text: Alaten di mi be de a goontapu, mi be e kibii den a ini a kaakiti fu a nen fi yu di i gi mi. Mi be e luku den seefi fu ná wan fu den go lasi, boiti a ogii ati wan, di be meke fu go lasi kaba a soso fu a sani di Gadu Buku taki mu kon tuu.
eng_text: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in your name. Those whom you have given me I have kept. None of them is lost, except the son of destruction, that the Scripture might be fulfilled.

djk_text: “Da Tata, now mi e kon a yu. Ma mi e taki den sani ya a goontapu ete. Bika mi wani meke a piisii fu mi goo a ini den ati ini te a pasa maiki.
eng_text: But now I come to you, and I say these things in the world, that they may have my joy made full in themselves.

djk_text: Mi be gi den yu wowtu. Ma goontapu buuse den. Bika den á de fu goontapu, leti enke fa miseefi á de fu goontapu tu.
eng_text: I have given them your word. The world hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

djk_text: Da Tata, mi nái begi fi i puu den na goontapu. Ma mi e begi fi i kibii den fu a didibii á koli den kisi.
eng_text: I pray not that you would take them from the world, but that you would keep them from the evil one.

djk_text: Den á de fu kondee, leti enke fa miseefi á de fu kondee.
eng_text: They are not of the world even as I am not of the world.

djk_text: Mi Tata, teke den sama ya poti apaiti meke den kon si sani kiinkiin, enke fa den de tuutuu. Bika a wowtu fi yu na a tuu.
eng_text: Sanctify them in your truth. Your word is truth.

djk_text: Leti enke fa yu be sende mi kon a goontapu, na letiso mi e sende den go a goontapu tu.
eng_text: As you sent me into the world, even so I have sent them into the world.

djk_text: Na fu den ede meke mi e poti miseefi a wan apaiti fasi gi yu. Da meke den seefi sa poti denseefi na tuutuu apaiti fasi gi yu tu.
eng_text: For their sakes I sanctify myself, that they themselves also may be sanctified in truth.

djk_text: “Ma mi nái begi gi den disi wawan. Ma mi e begi gi ala den taawan di o yee den wowtu, da den daai kon e biibi a mi.
eng_text: Not for these only do I pray, but for those also who believe in me through their word,

djk_text: Tata, mi e begi fu den ala fiya kon de wan makandii, leti enke fa mi anga yu de wan. Da efu den de wan, da goontapu sa sabi taki na yu be sende mi kon.
eng_text: that they may all be one; even as you, Father, are in me, and I in you, that they also may be one in us; that the world may believe that you sent me.

djk_text: Mi be gi den a seefi waiti fasi di i be gi mi, fu den sa de wan makandii, enke fa mi anga yu de wan.
eng_text: The glory which you have given me, I have given to them; that they may be one, even as we are one;

djk_text: Da mi de a den ati ini, da yu de a mi ati ini. Da na so den o de wan tuutuu fu hii goontapu mu si taki na yu be sende mi kon. Bika yu lobi den, leti enke fa i lobi mi.
eng_text: I in them, and you in me, that they may be perfected into one; that the world may know that you sent me, and loved them, even as you loved me.

djk_text: “Mi Tata, mi wani fu den sama di i gi mi ya, mu de anga mi a pe mi de, fu den si a waiti fasi fu mi di yu gi mi. Bika i be lobi mi bifo goontapu be meke.
eng_text: Father, I desire that they also whom you have given me be with me where I am, that they may see my glory, which you have given me, for you loved me before the foundation of the world.

djk_text: We, mi Tata, yu di e du sani sondee kukutu fasi, goontapu á sabi yu. Ma mi sabi yu. Da now, den sama di i gi mi ya kon sabi taki na yu be sende mi kon.
eng_text: Righteous Father, the world hasn't known you, but I knew you; and these knew that you sent me.

djk_text: Mi meke den kon sabi yu kiinkiin enke fa i de. Da mi sa meke den kon sabi yu moo, fu den sa abi a sowtu lobi di yu abi gi mi. Da miseefi o de a den ati ini tu.”
eng_text: I made known to them your name, and will make it known; that the love with which you loved me may be in them, and I in them."

djk_text: Di Masaa Jesesi kaba a begi fi en, ne en anga den bakaman fi en gwe. Da den o pasa na a kiiki di den e kai, Kidilon go na a taase. Ma namo, da wan dyali be de ape. Ne Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en go de.
eng_text: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went out with his disciples over the brook Kidron, where there was a garden, into which he and his disciples entered.

djk_text: Ma Judasi, a man di o seli Masaa Jesesi be sabi a peesi tu. Bika en anga Masaa Jesesi anga den taa bakaman fi en be lobi kon makandii de.
eng_text: Now Judas, who betrayed him, also knew the place, for Jesus often met there with his disciples.

djk_text: We, ne Judasi teke wan lo Loma suudati anga wan lo sikowtu fu a Mama Keliki fu den Dyu a Jelusalem. Den Faliseiman anga den hei apaiti begiman be gi en den. Namo di den kon, da den kon anga lantei anga fambo anga feti sani.
eng_text: Judas then, having taken a detachment of soldiers and officers from the chief priests and the Pharisees, came there with lanterns, torches, and weapons.

djk_text: We, fu di Masaa Jesesi be sabi ala san be o miti en a fesi kaba, na fu dati ede meke a waka go miti den. Ne a akisi den taki: “Sama u e suku?”
eng_text: Jesus therefore, knowing all the things that were happening to him, went forth, and said to them, "Who are you looking for?"

djk_text: Ne den piki en taki: “Na Jesesi fu Nasaleti u e suku!” Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Na mi de ya! Ma namo, da Judasi di o seli Masaa Jesesi seefi be taampu de tu anga den taa sama.”
eng_text: They answered him, "Jesus of Nazareth." Jesus said to them, "I am he." Judas also, who betrayed him, was standing with them.

djk_text: We, di Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Na mi de ya!” Ne ala den fiya kiki go anga baka ne den kai.
eng_text: When therefore he said to them, "I am he," they went backward, and fell to the ground.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi akisi den baka taki: “Sama u e suku?” Ne den piki en taki: “Na Jesesi fu Nasaleti u e suku.”
eng_text: Again therefore he asked them, "Who are you looking for?" They said, "Jesus of Nazareth."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “Mi taigi u kaba. Na mi de ya!” Ne a taigi den go doo taki: “We, efu na mi u e suku, da u fika den bakaman fu mi ya meke den gwe!”
eng_text: Jesus answered, "I told you that I am he. If therefore you seek me, let these go their way,"

djk_text: We, na so a wowtu kon leti enke fa a be taki: “Ná wan enkii wan fu den sama di i be gi mi, di mi lasi.”
eng_text: that the word might be fulfilled which he spoke, "Of those whom you have given me, I have lost none."

djk_text: We, ma namo, da Simon Peitilisi be abi wan fetihow ne en de. Ne a teke a fetihow, ne velen, a koti a letise yesi fu a futuboi fu a moo hei begiman, puu. Na a futuboi ya nen den be e kai Maakusi.
eng_text: Simon Peter therefore, having a sword, drew it, and struck the high priest's servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant's name was Malchus.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi taigi Peitilisi taki: “Peitilisi! Toosi i fetihow poti baka a ini en saka! I denki taki a fiti fu mi wai komoto a pasi gi a pina sitaafu di mi Tata poti gi mi fu pina ya?”
eng_text: Jesus therefore said to Peter, "Put the sword into its sheath. The cup which the Father has given me, shall I not surely drink it?"

djk_text: Ne a yuu de, ne a kulu suudati kon anga a edeman fu den anga den sikowtu fu a Mama Keliki, ne den kisi Masaa Jesesi. Ne den tei en ana.
eng_text: So the detachment, the commanding officer, and the officers of the Jews, seized Jesus and bound him,

djk_text: Ne, den tyai en go a wan osu fu wan man den e kai Anasi. Da Kayafasi na be a moo hei apaiti begiman, a yali de. Da a be libi anga wan umanpikin fu Anasi.
eng_text: and led him to Annas first, for he was father-in-law to Caiaphas, who was high priest that year.

djk_text: Da a Kayafasi ya, na a seefi sama di be gi den edeman fu den Dyu a lai taki, a moo betee wan man dede gi a hii foluku, pe fu a foluku dede kaba a soso.
eng_text: Now it was Caiaphas who advised the Jews that it was expedient that one man should perish for the people.

djk_text: We, Simon Peitilisi anga wan taa bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi e waka go a Masaa Jesesi baka. Da a bakaman ya na wan sama di a moo hei apaiti begiman fu a Mama Keliki be sabi. Da na fu dati ede meke a bakaman ya go te a ini a dyali fu a moo hei apaiti begiman, a Masaa Jesesi baka.
eng_text: Simon Peter followed Jesus, as did another disciple. Now that disciple was known to the high priest, and entered in with Jesus into the court of the high priest;

djk_text: Ma Peitilisi fika taampu taampu a doose. We, na fu dati ede meke a bakaman ya, di a moo hei apaiti begiman be sabi go a doose, ne a taki anga a uman di be taampu na a doo mofu fu a dyali. Ne a uman meke Peitilisi pasa kon a ini a dyali.
eng_text: but Peter was standing at the door outside. So the other disciple, who was known to the high priest, went out and spoke to her who kept the door, and brought in Peter.

djk_text: We, a uman di be de na a doo mofu taigi Peitilisi taki: “Yu a ná wan bakaman fu a man, no?” Ne Peitilisi piki taki: “Nono! Ná mi!”
eng_text: Then the maid who kept the door said to Peter, "Are you also one of this man's disciples?" He said, "I am not."

djk_text: Ma namo, da den futuboi anga den sikowtu di be e oli waki na a gaaman osu be meke wan koofaya faya fu den de a waan. We, ne Peitilisi seefi go taampu de e waan a faya tu. Bika a peesi be koo.
eng_text: Now the servants and the officers were standing there, having made a fire of coals, for it was cold. They were warming themselves. Peter was with them, standing and warming himself.

djk_text: We, ne a moo hei apaiti begiman e akisi Masaa Jesesi wanlo sani fu den bakaman fi en, anga somen sani fu a leli fi en.
eng_text: The high priest therefore asked Jesus about his disciples, and about his teaching.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Mi be de a lanti mindii alaten e leli sama. Mi be de a ini den keliki e leli sama, te go doo a Mama Keliki anga ala peesi pe den Dyu e kon makandii tu. Mi á be de bakabaka e taki sani.
eng_text: Jesus answered him, "I spoke openly to the world. I always taught in synagogues, and in the temple, where the Jews always meet. I said nothing in secret.

djk_text: We, saide meke na mi yu e akisi den sani de? Akisi den sama di be e yee den sani di mi be e leli den. Den sa sabi fu taigi u san mi be e taki.”
eng_text: Why do you ask me? Ask those who have heard me what I said to them. Behold, these know the things which I said."

djk_text: We ne, di Masaa Jesesi taki so, ne wan fu den sikowtu di be taampu de, naki en wan baala ana kwaa ne en sikin fesi taki: “On fa? Na so yu e taki anga a moo hei apaiti begiman fu a Mama Keliki?”
eng_text: When he had said this, one of the officers standing by slapped Jesus with his hand, saying, "Do you answer the high priest like that?"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki taki: “We, efu mi taki ogii, da taigi mi sowtu ogii mi taki? Ma efu na wan tuu sani mi taki, da saide meke yu e naki mi?”
eng_text: Jesus answered him, "If I have spoken evil, testify of the evil; but if well, why do you beat me?"

djk_text: We, ne Anasi sende en go anga teitei ana a Kayafasi, a moo hei apaiti begiman.
eng_text: Annas sent him bound to Caiaphas, the high priest.

djk_text: We, da a yuu di Peitilisi taampu e waan faya de, ne den akisi en taki: “Yu na wan bakaman fu a man tu?” Ma Peitilisi sitee, a taki: “Nono! Ná mi!”
eng_text: Now Simon Peter was standing and warming himself. They said therefore to him, "You aren't also one of his disciples, are you?" He denied it, and said, "I am not."

djk_text: Ne bakadati, ne wan futuboi fu a moo hei apaiti begiman, wan famii fu Maakusi, a man di Peitilisi be koti en yesi puu, akisi Peitilisi taki: “Na yu anga en mi be si a ini a dyali, no?”
eng_text: One of the servants of the high priest, being a relative of him whose ear Peter had cut off, said, "Didn't I see you in the garden with him?"

djk_text: Ma Peitilisi sitee baka. Ne wanten de, ne kokoliyekee, a kakafoo bali.
eng_text: Peter therefore denied it again, and immediately the rooster crowed.

djk_text: Ne a taa dei fuuku mamanten, ne den komoto a Kayafasi, ne den tyai Masaa Jesesi go a Gaaman Pilatesi osu. Ma den edeman fu den Dyu seefi á go a ini a gaaman osu. Bika den be wani oli den seefi kiin, enke fa a leli fu den be taki. Bika den be wani nyan a Pasika. Na fu dati ede meke Gaaman Pilatesi komoto kon a den a doose. Ne a akisi den taki: “We, on sowtu ogii a sama ya du, meke u e tyai en kon a mi?”
eng_text: They led Jesus therefore from Caiaphas into the Praetorium. It was early, and they themselves didn't enter into the Praetorium, that they might not be defiled, but might eat the Passover.

djk_text: Ne den piki en taki: “Efu a sama ya á be du ná wan ogii, u á be o tyai en kon a yu.”
eng_text: They answered him, "If this man weren't an evildoer, we wouldn't have delivered him up to you."

djk_text: We, ne Pilatesi taigi den taki: “We, u teke en, da u seefi kuutu en enke fa a weiti fu u e soi u.” Ma den Dyu piki en taki: “We, a Loma weiti nái gi wi enke Dyu pasi fu u kii sama.”
eng_text: Pilate therefore said to them, "Take him yourselves, and judge him according to your law." Therefore the Jews said to him, "It is not lawful for us to put anyone to death,"

djk_text: We, da na so den wowtu fu Masaa Jesesi be kon tuu. Bika a be pingi den a fesi pilisisi fa a dede fi en be o dede.
eng_text: that the word of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spoke, signifying by what kind of death he should die.

djk_text: We, ne Pilatesi go baka a ini en paleisi, na a pisi pe a kuutu be e oli, ne a kai Masaa Jesesi kon. Ne a akisi Masaa Jesesi taki: “We, san yu e taki? Yu na a kownu fu den Dyu?”
eng_text: Pilate therefore entered again into the Praetorium, called Jesus, and said to him, "Are you the King of the Jews?"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “A sani di yu akisi mi de, na yu seefi akisi en, efu na san taa sama be taigi yu fu mi?”
eng_text: Jesus answered him, "Do you say this by yourself, or did others tell you about me?"

djk_text: Ne Gaaman Pilatesi akisi en taki: “Oho! Fa yu e akisi mi so? I si taki mi na wan Dyusama? A ná yu eigi sama anga den hei apaiti begiman tyai yu kon a mi ya, no? San i du seefi?”
eng_text: Pilate answered, "I'm not a Jew, am I? Your own nation and the chief priests delivered you to me. What have you done?"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Fa mi e tii sani enke kownu á de enke a tii fu kownu a goontapu ya. Bika efu a be de so, da den bakaman fu mi be o opo feti anga den sama, di kon kisi mi tyai kon poti ya. Ma nono! Mi kownu tii a ná fu a goontapu ya.”
eng_text: Jesus answered, "My Kingdom is not of this world. If my Kingdom were of this world, then my servants would fight, that I wouldn't be delivered to the Jews. But now my Kingdom is not from here."

djk_text: We, ne Pilatesi taigi en taki: “We, da meke u taki, da yu na wan kownu?” Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “A leti enke fa yu taki de. Mi na wan kownu! Na fu dati ede mi meke, mi kon a goontapu, fu soi den sama san na tuu. We, ala sama di lobi tuu, o go e aliki mi san mi e taki.”
eng_text: Pilate therefore said to him, "Are you a king then?" Jesus answered, "You say that I am a king. For this reason I have been born, and for this reason I have come into the world, that I should testify to the truth. Everyone who is of the truth listens to my voice."

djk_text: Ne Gaaman Pilatesi taigi en taki: “Tuu? San na tuu?”
eng_text: Pilate said to him, "What is truth?" When he had said this, he went out again to the Jews, and said to them, "I find no basis for a charge against him.

djk_text: We, u aliki! Wi abi a gwenti fu te a Pasika o kai, fu mi losi wan sama puu a dunguu osu gi u. Da san u wani? U wani mi losi a kownu fu u ya gi u?”
eng_text: But you have a custom, that I should release someone to you at the Passover. Therefore do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?"

djk_text: Ma ala den pii den mofu e bali taki: “No! No! Wi á wani i losi en! Losi Balabasi gi u!” Da Balabasi na be wan abani.
eng_text: Then they all shouted again, saying, "Not this man, but Barabbas!" Now Barabbas was a robber.

djk_text: Ma now, ne Pilatesi meke den teke Masaa Jesesi tyai gwe fu den wipi en.
eng_text: So Pilate then took Jesus, and flogged him.

djk_text: Ne bakadati, ne den suudati teke wan tetei di gei agwago maka, ne den beei en kon enke wan kownu ati. Ne den toosi en gi Masaa Jesesi ne en ede suu. Ne den teke wan baaw lebi dyakiti, ne den wei gi en.
eng_text: The soldiers twisted thorns into a crown, and put it on his head, and dressed him in a purple garment.

djk_text: Ne den taigi en taki: “Odiyoo! Odiyoo Kownu fu den Dyu! Ne den e naki en ne en fesi.”
eng_text: They kept saying, "Hail, King of the Jews!" and they kept slapping him.

djk_text: We, ne Gaaman Pilatesi go a doo baka, ne a taigi den taki: “We, u luku ya. Mi e tyai a sama ya kon a doo a u fesi. Mi á fende ná wan fowtu ne en. Da mi o losi en.”
eng_text: Then Pilate went out again, and said to them, "Behold, I bring him out to you, that you may know that I find no basis for a charge against him."

djk_text: We, da na so Masaa Jesesi kon a doo anga a maka ati ne en ede anga a dyakiti ne en sikin. Ne Gaaman Pilatesi taigi den taki: “We, u luku a sama ya, ye!”
eng_text: Jesus therefore came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple garment. Pilate said to them, "Behold, the man!"

djk_text: Ma di den hei apaiti begiman anga den sikowtu fu a Mama Keliki si en, ne den bali taki: “U kii en! U kii en! U sipikii en a koloisi kii.” Ne Gaaman Pilatesi taigi den taki: “We, u teke en, da u tyai go sipikii a koloisi! Ma miseefi á fende ná wan fowtu ne en.”
eng_text: When therefore the chief priests and the officers saw him, they shouted, saying, "Crucify! Crucify!" Pilate said to them, "Take him yourselves, and crucify him, for I find no basis for a charge against him."

djk_text: We, ne den Dyu piki en taki: “We, wi fende fowtu ne en, bika wi abi wan weiti di e soi wi taki a mu dede. Bika a be meke enseefi toon a Manpikin fu Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: The Jews answered him, "We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God."

djk_text: We, di a gaaman yee den sama taki so, ne a moo feele.
eng_text: When therefore Pilate heard this saying, he was more afraid.

djk_text: We, ne a go baka a ini gaaman osu, ne a taigi Masaa Jesesi taki: “On kondee na fi yu?” Ma Masaa Jesesi á piki en.
eng_text: He entered into the Praetorium again, and said to Jesus, "Where are you from?" But Jesus gave him no answer.

djk_text: Ne Gaaman Pilatesi taigi en taki: “Oho! Yu nái piki mi, no? Yu á sabi taki mi abi makiti fu meke den sipikii yu a koloisi kii, ma mi abi makiti fu meke den losi yu tu, no?”
eng_text: Pilate therefore said to him, "Aren't you speaking to me? Don't you know that I have power to release you, and have power to crucify you?"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Yu á be poi abi ná wan sowtu makiti a mi tapu, efu a ná Gadu be gi yu en. Na fu dati ede meke a sama di i si tyai mi kon gi yu ya, du moo gaan ogii moo yu.”
eng_text: Jesus answered, "You would have no power at all against me, unless it were given to you from above. Therefore he who delivered me to you has greater sin."

djk_text: Da fanafu a yuu de, ne Gaaman Pilatesi be e meke ala sowtu moiti fu losi Masaa Jesesi. Ma den Dyu e bali gi en taki: “Efi i losi a sama de gwe, da yu anga a moo gaan kownu a Loma Foto o kisi toobi. Bika wan sama di e meke enseefi toon kownu, na wan feyantiman fu a gaan kownu de.”
eng_text: At this, Pilate was seeking to release him, but the Jews cried out, saying, "If you release this man, you aren't Caesar's friend! Everyone who makes himself a king speaks against Caesar!"

djk_text: Da di Gaaman Pilatesi yee den wowtu ya, ne a meke Masaa Jesesi komoto kon a doo. Ne Gaaman Pilatesi go sidon na a sutuu fi en, a pe a be e sidon koti kuutu. Da na a sutuu fi en ya den be e kai, Hei Siton Tapu. Ma den Dyu be e kai en, Gabata.
eng_text: When Pilate therefore heard these words, he brought Jesus out, and sat down on the judgment seat at a place called "The Pavement," but in Hebrew, "Gabbatha."

djk_text: Da den sani ya be e pasa na a seefi dei di den be seeka sani fu nyan a Pasika Piisii. Da a be sa de wan sani fu twalufu yuu so. Ne Gaaman Pilatesi taigi den Dyu taki: “We, u luku a kownu fu u ya!”
eng_text: Now it was the Preparation Day of the Passover, at about the sixth hour. He said to the Jews, "Behold, your King!"

djk_text: Ma den bali taki: “U kii en! U kii en! U sipikii en a koloisi kii!” Ne Gaaman Pilatesi taigi den taki: “Na a kownu fu u, mi mu sipikii a koloisi kii?” Ma den hei apaiti begiman piki en taki: “Wi ná abi ná wan enkii kownu boiti a moo gaan kownu a Loma Foto!”
eng_text: They cried out, "Away with him! Away with him! Crucify him!" Pilate said to them, "Shall I crucify your King?" The chief priests answered, "We have no king but Caesar!"

djk_text: We, di den taki so, ne Gaaman Pilatesi gi den en fu den tyai go sipikii kii a koloisi.
eng_text: So then he delivered him to them to be crucified. So they took Jesus and led him away.

djk_text: Da Masaa Jesesi seefi be e tyai a koloisi di den o sipikii en kii. Ne den e go te, den go doo na a peesi di den e kai, Bongo Pita Peesi. Ma den Dyu be e kai a peesi ya, Golgata.
eng_text: He went out, bearing his cross, to the place called "The Place of a Skull," which is called in Hebrew, "Golgotha,"

djk_text: Da na ape den sipikii Masaa Jesesi na a koloisi. Da den sipikii ete tu man makandii anga en tu. Wan ne en kukutuse ana, a taawan ne en letise ana. Masaa Jesesi seefi de a mindii.
eng_text: where they crucified him, and with him two others, on either side one, and Jesus in the middle.

djk_text: Ma namo, da Gaaman Pilatesi be sikiifi wan sani poti na a koloisi fu Masaa Jesesi a tapu. Da a be sikiifi taki:
eng_text: Pilate wrote a title also, and put it on the cross. There was written, "JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS."

djk_text: Da somen Dyu be leisi a sani di sikiifi na a koloisi a tapu anda. Bika a peesi pe den be sipikii Masaa Jesesi na a koloisi be de koosube fu a foto. Da a be sikiifi a sani ya a ini den tongo fu den Dyu, den Loma anga den Giiki sama.
eng_text: Therefore many of the Jews read this title, for the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city; and it was written in Hebrew, in Latin, and in Greek.

djk_text: Ma den hei apaiti begiman e go a Pilatesi taki: “Yu á mu sikiifi taki: ‘En na Kownu fu den Dyu!’ Ma i mu sikiifi taki: ‘A be taki en na Kownu fu den Dyu.’ ”
eng_text: The chief priests of the Jews therefore said to Pilate, "Don't write, 'The King of the Jews,' but, 'he said, I am King of the Jews.'"

djk_text: Ma namo, ne Pilatesi piki den taki: “San mi sikiifi, tan sikiifi!”
eng_text: Pilate answered, "What I have written, I have written."

djk_text: We, di den suudati sipikii Masaa Jesesi na a koloisi kaba, ne den teke den koosi fi en, ne den meke fo ipi fu ibii suudati sa fende wan ipi. Ma now, da a fika ete wan koosi fi en. Da a koosi ya á be nai, ma a be wan gaan pisi koosi.
eng_text: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also the coat. Now the coat was without seam, woven from the top throughout.

djk_text: Na fu dati ede den taigi den na den taki: “Meke wi á piiti en, ma meke wi iti lowte luku sama o wini en.” Da den sani ya pasa fu san sikiifi a Gadu Buku mu kon tuu. Bika Gadu Buku be sikiifi taki: “Den paati mi koosi den na den, den iti lowte fu paati mi koosi.”
eng_text: Then they said to one another, "Let's not tear it, but cast lots for it to decide whose it will be," that the Scripture might be fulfilled, which says, "They parted my garments among them. For my cloak they cast lots." Therefore the soldiers did these things.

djk_text: Da a mma fu Masaa Jesesi anga en mma pikin sisa anga Maliya, a uman fu Kolopasi anga Maliya Makidala be taampu koosube fu a koloisi fu pe den be koloisi Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: But there were standing by the cross of Jesus his mother, and his mother's sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.

djk_text: We, di Masaa Jesesi si en mma taampu anga a bakaman fi en di a be lobi te, ne a taigi en mma taki: “Uman! Luku i pikin de!”
eng_text: Therefore when Jesus saw his mother, and the disciple whom he loved standing there, he said to his mother, "Woman, behold your son!"

djk_text: Ne bakadati, ne a taigi a bakaman fi en taki: “Luku i mama de!” Ne fanafu a ten de, ne a bakaman fi en de teke en ne en osu e solugu.
eng_text: Then he said to the disciple, "Behold, your mother!" From that hour, the disciple took her to his own home.

djk_text: Ma di Masaa Jesesi sabi taki a du ala den sani di a abi fu du, ne a taki ete wan sani fu meke ala sani di Gadu Buku sikiifi kon tuu. A taki: “Dee wataa kisi mi, baa!”
eng_text: After this, Jesus, seeing that all things were now finished, that the Scripture might be fulfilled, said, "I am thirsty."

djk_text: Ma namo, da den be abi wan patu anga wan sowtu win enke asin a ini. Ne den teke wan siponsu, sungu go a ini a win, ne den fasi en a wan tiki ede, ne den tyai go ne en mofu.
eng_text: Now a vessel full of vinegar was set there; so they put a sponge full of the vinegar on hyssop, and held it at his mouth.

djk_text: Ma di Jesesi diingi a asin kaba, ne a taki: “A kaba!” Ne na so a bendi en ede, ne a tapu boo.
eng_text: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, "It is finished." He bowed his head, and gave up his spirit.

djk_text: Ma fu di den edeman fu Dyusama be mu seeka sani fu nyan a Pasika Piisii, meke den go begi Gaaman Pilatesi, fu a sende sama go naki den bon fu den futu booko. Da den dede sikin fu den á be de na a koloisi a hii kina dei de. Bika a kina dei di e kon de, na be wan apaiti kina dei gi den.
eng_text: Therefore the Jews, because it was the Preparation Day, so that the bodies wouldn't remain on the cross on the Sabbath (for that Sabbath was a special one), asked of Pilate that their legs might be broken, and that they might be taken away.

djk_text: We, na so den suudati kon, ne den booko den bon fu a fosi man futu. Ne den go, ne den booko den bon fu a taa man di den be koloisi de tu.
eng_text: Therefore the soldiers came, and broke the legs of the first, and of the other who was crucified with him;

djk_text: Ma di den kon fu booko den bon fu Masaa Jesesi, ne den si taki a dede kaba. Ne den á booko den moo.
eng_text: but when they came to Jesus, and saw that he was already dead, they didn't break his legs.

djk_text: Ma wan fu den suudati sutu en anga wan lansi ne en sikin bee. Ne wanten, ne buulu anga wataa lon komoto a ini en sikin kon a doo.
eng_text: However one of the soldiers pierced his side with a spear, and immediately blood and water came out.

djk_text: Da a sama di e taki den sani ya, ne enseefi si den anga ain. Da fa ai taki ya, da na tuutuu sani ai taki, fu te i yee den, fi i sa daai teke biibi.
eng_text: He who has seen has testified, and his testimony is true. He knows that he tells the truth, that you may believe.

djk_text: Bika den sani di i si pasa ya, pasa fu den sani di sikiifi a Gadu Buku mu kon tuu. Bika Gadu Buku sikiifi taki: “Den ná o booko ná wan bon fi en.”
eng_text: For these things happened, that the Scripture might be fulfilled, "A bone of him will not be broken."

djk_text: Da a wan taa peesi a taki baka taki: “Sama o si a sama di den sutu a sutu de.”
eng_text: Again another Scripture says, "They will look on him whom they pierced."

djk_text: We, ne wan man den e kai Jowsef fu Alimateya Kondee, di be e waka a Masaa Jesesi baka tu kon. Dati be de wan kibii toli. Bika a be e feele den edeman fu den Dyu. Ne a go begi Gaaman Pilatesi, fu a puu a dede sikin fu Masaa Jesesi na a koloisi. Ne Gaaman Pilatesi gi en pasi. Ne a go, ne a go puu a dede sikin fu Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: After these things, Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, asked of Pilate that he might take away Jesus' body. Pilate gave him permission. He came therefore and took away his body.

djk_text: Da Nikodeimisi, di be kon a Masaa Jesesi a wan neti seefi kon tu. Da a tyai sumee switi sani di den e seeka dede sikin te anga wan sani fu diitenti a dii kilo so. Da a be mokisa den sani ya te a mokisa.
eng_text: Nicodemus, who at first came to Jesus by night, also came bringing a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about a hundred Roman pounds.

djk_text: Ne den teke a dede sikin fu Masaa Jesesi, ne den lolo en a ini weti koosi mokisa anga den sumee switi sani, enke fa den Dyu be gwenti beli dedesama.
eng_text: So they took Jesus' body, and bound it in linen cloths with the spices, as the custom of the Jews is to bury.

djk_text: Da koosube fu pe den be sipikii Masaa Jesesi, wan dyali be de. Da wan nyunyun geebi be de a ini a dyali ya, pe den á be beli ná wan sama ete.
eng_text: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden. In the garden was a new tomb in which no man had ever yet been laid.

djk_text: We, da a kina dei be koosube fu kai. Da fu di a geebi be de koosube anga pe den be sipikii Masaa Jesesi na a koloisi kii, na dati meke den tyai en go poti a ini a geebi ya.
eng_text: Then because of the Jews' Preparation Day (for the tomb was near at hand) they laid Jesus there.

djk_text: We, na a fosi dei fu a wiki, fuuku musude, ne Maliya Makidala go na a geebi fu Masaa Jesesi. Ma namo, di a go, ne a si taki a siton á de na a geebi mofu moo.
eng_text: Now on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene went early, while it was still dark, to the tomb, and saw the stone taken away from the tomb.

djk_text: Na fu dati ede meke a lon go a Simon Peitilisi anga a taa bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi di a be lobi te. Ne a taigi den taki: “Den puu Masaa na a geebi, da wi á sabi pe den poti en.”
eng_text: Therefore she ran and came to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple whom Jesus loved, and said to them, "They have taken away the Lord out of the tomb, and we don't know where they have laid him!"

djk_text: We, ne Peitilisi anga a taa bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi opo, ne den go na a geebi.
eng_text: Therefore Peter and the other disciple went out, and they went toward the tomb.

djk_text: Den tu be makandii, ma a taa bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi lon pasa Peitilisi. Ne na so en fosi doo na a geebi.
eng_text: They both ran together. The other disciple outran Peter, and came to the tomb first.

djk_text: We, ne di a bende luku, ne a si den sibi koosi wawan de. Ma a á go a ini a geebi.
eng_text: Stooping and looking in, he saw the linen cloths lying, yet he didn't enter in.

djk_text: We, ne Simon Peitilisi seefi doo. Ma en go te a ini a geebi. Ne a si den koosi di den be lolo Masaa Jesesi de.
eng_text: Then Simon Peter came, following him, and entered into the tomb. He saw the linen cloths lying,

djk_text: Ma a angisa di den be tei Masaa Jesesi ede á be de a pe den taa koosi be de, ma a be de te a wanse a wan taa peesi.
eng_text: and the cloth that had been on his head, not lying with the linen cloths, but rolled up in a place by itself.

djk_text: Ma, ne a taa bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi di fosi be doo na a geebi go a ini a geebi tu. Ne di a si den sani, ne fosi a daai kon e biibi.
eng_text: So then the other disciple who came first to the tomb also entered in, and he saw and believed.

djk_text: Bika te enke now, da den á be fusutan a wowtu di sikiifi a Gadu Buku taki Masaa Jesesi mu opo baka komoto a dede ete.
eng_text: For as yet they didn't know the Scripture, that he must rise from the dead.

djk_text: We, ne na so den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi go baka a osu.
eng_text: So the disciples went away again to their own homes.

djk_text: Ma Maliya dati taampu a doose fu a geebi, ne a bali kee. Da di a kee te wan pisi, ne a bendi luku go a ini a geebi.
eng_text: But Mary was standing outside at the tomb weeping. So, as she wept, she stooped and looked into the tomb,

djk_text: Ne a si tu Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee sidon a pe a dede sikin fu Masaa Jesesi be de. Den de anga weti koosi fann. Wan fu den Basiya ya sidon ne en ede se. A taawan sidon ne en futu se, leti enke fa den be poti a dede sikin fu Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: and she saw two angels in white sitting, one at the head, and one at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.

djk_text: Ne den taigi Maliya taki: “Uman! Saide meke yu e kee so?” Ne a taigi den taki: “Den puu mi Masaa ya, da mi á sabi pe den tyai en go.”
eng_text: They told her, "Woman, why are you weeping?" She said to them, "Because they have taken away my Lord, and I don't know where they have laid him."

djk_text: Ne di a taki so, ne a daai fesi, ne a si Masaa Jesesi taampu taampu de. Ma a á be sabi taki na be Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: When she had said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing, and didn't know that it was Jesus.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi taigi en taki: “Uman! Saide meke yu e kee so? Sama yu e suku?” Ma Maliya denki taki na a man di be e kiinmi a dyali e luku den boomiki be e taki anga en. Na fu dati ede meke a taigi a man taki: “Masaa, efu na yu tyai en gwe, taigi mi, pe i poti en, mi sa go teke en.”
eng_text: Jesus said to her, "Woman, why are you weeping? Who are you looking for?" She, supposing him to be the gardener, said to him, "Sir, if you have carried him away, tell me where you have laid him, and I will take him away."

djk_text: Ma now, ne Masaa Jesesi kai en taki: “Maliya!” Ne Maliya daai en fesi, ne a bali taki: “Labuni!” Labuni wani taki, Mesiti, na Dyu Tongo.
eng_text: Jesus said to her, "Mary." She turned and said to him, "Rabboni !" which is to say, "Teacher !"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi en taki: “Ná oli mi! Bika mi á go a mi Tata ete. Ma go a den baala fu mi, da taigi den taki, mi e opo go a mi Tata, di de a Tata fu u tu. Mi e go a mi Gadu di de a Gadu fu u tu.”
eng_text: Jesus said to her, "Don't hold me, for I haven't yet ascended to my Father; but go to my brothers, and tell them, 'I am ascending to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.'"

djk_text: We, ne Maliya Makidala go taigi den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi taki: “Mi si Masaa! Da na so so, a taigi mi.”
eng_text: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had said these things to her.

djk_text: We, a seefi fosi dei fu a wiki de, di sapaten, da den bakaman fi en be de makandii a ini wan osu sooto sooto doo. Bika den be e feele den edeman fu den Dyu. Ne te fu den denki, ne Masaa Jesesi kon taampu a den mindii haa. Ne a taigi den taki: “Meke Masaa Gadu de anga u!”
eng_text: When therefore it was evening, on that day, the first day of the week, and when the doors were locked where the disciples were assembled, for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the midst, and said to them, "Peace be to you."

djk_text: Ne di a taigi den so, ne a soi den en ana anga en sikin bansa. We, now, ne den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi piisii, te ná sipowtu, fu di den si Masaa.
eng_text: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his side. The disciples therefore were glad when they saw the Lord.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den ete wan toon taki: “Meke Masaa Gadu gi u koo ati fu libi, ye! Leti enke fa i si mi Tata be sende mi kon a goontapu, na soseefi mi e sende u tu.”
eng_text: Jesus therefore said to them again, "Peace be to you. As the Father has sent me, even so I send you."

djk_text: Ne di a taki so, ne a boo a den tapu vuuu taki: “U teke a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: When he had said this, he breathed on them, and said to them, "Receive the Holy Spirit!

djk_text: Den sama di u o gi paadon fu takuudu anga ogii, o kisi paadon tuu. Ma sama di u á gi paadon, ná o kisi paadon tu.”
eng_text: If you forgive anyone's sins, they have been forgiven them. If you retain anyone's sins, they have been retained."

djk_text: Ma Towmasi, wan fu den twalufu bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi, di den be e kai Toolengi tu, á be de a den taawan mindii, di Masaa Jesesi be kon a den.
eng_text: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, wasn't with them when Jesus came.

djk_text: Ne di a kon, ne den taa bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi taigi en taki: “Wi si Masaa!” Ma a taigi den taawan taki: “Solanga mi seefi á si den sipikii maiki a ini en ana ini fu mi poti mi finga anga solanga mi á poti mi finga na a lansi mofu ne en sikin bansa, mi ná o biibi.”
eng_text: The other disciples therefore said to him, "We have seen the Lord!" But he said to them, "Unless I see in his hands the print of the nails, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe."

djk_text: Da baka aitin dei, di den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi be de makandii baka a ini wan osu sooto sooto doo, da Towmasi be de a ini a osu ini anga den tu. Ne te fu den denki, ne Masaa Jesesi kon a ini a osu, ne a go taampu a den mindii dyan. Ne a taigi den taki: “Meke Gadu gi u koo ati fu libi, ye!”
eng_text: After eight days again his disciples were inside, and Thomas was with them. Jesus came, the doors being locked, and stood in the midst, and said, "Peace be to you."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi Towmasi taki: “Luku mi ana ya. Langa i finga kon fii a maiki a ini mi ana. Da tyai ana kon poti na lansi mofu a mi sikin bansa. I mu fika a fasi di yu abi de, taki yu ná biibi. Ma biibi!”
eng_text: Then he said to Thomas, "Reach here your finger, and see my hands. Reach here your hand, and put it into my side. Don't be unbelieving, but believing."

djk_text: We, ne Towmasi bali taki: “Oho! Masaa Gadu, mi Gadu! Yu na mi Gadu!”
eng_text: Thomas answered him, "My Lord and my God!"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi en taki: “Towmasi! A di yu si mi anga ain fosi yu e biibi? We, seigi fu den sama di e biibi, winsi den á si anga ain.”
eng_text: Jesus said to him, "Because you have seen me, you have believed. Blessed are those who have not seen, and have believed."

djk_text: Da Masaa Jesesi du somen somen taa maiki ete a den bakaman fi en fesi, di á sikiifi a ini a buku ya.
eng_text: Therefore Jesus did many other signs in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book;

djk_text: Ma den sani ya sikiifi fu u mu biibi taki, Jesesi na a Kelestesi, a Manpikin fu Masaa Gadu. Da te u e biibi so kaba, da u o fende a tego libi, fu di u anga en de wan.
eng_text: but these are written, that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that believing you may have life in his name.

djk_text: Ne bakadati, ne Masaa Jesesi tyai enseefi kon soi den bakaman fi en ete wan toon na a ze den e kai Tibeliyasi. Da a toli waka so:
eng_text: After these things, Jesus revealed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias. He revealed himself this way.

djk_text: Wan fu den toon, da Simon Peitilisi anga Towmasi, di den be e kai Toolengi, anga Nataniyeli, di fu a peesi di den e kai Kaana, na a pisiwataa fu Galileya, anga den tu manpikin fu Da Sebedi anga ete tu taa bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi be de a wan peesi.
eng_text: Simon Peter, Thomas called Didymus, Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two others of his disciples were together.

djk_text: Ne Simon Peitilisi taigi den taki: “Mi o go a onti towe seepi a liba!” Ne den taigi en taki: “Wi o go anga yu tu.” We, ne den opo go a ini a boto. Ma a hiihii neti de, den á kisi ná wan sani.
eng_text: Simon Peter said to them, "I'm going fishing." They told him, "We are also coming with you." They immediately went out, and entered into the boat. That night, they caught nothing.

djk_text: Ne a seefi dei de, fuuku mamanten, ne Masaa Jesesi kon taampu a mofu wataa de. Ma den bakaman fi en á be sabi taki na Masaa Jesesi de ape.
eng_text: But when day had already come, Jesus stood on the beach, yet the disciples didn't know that it was Jesus.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi akisi den taki: “Pikin, san u kisi?” Ne den piki en taki: “Iya, nono!”
eng_text: Jesus therefore said to them, "Children, have you anything to eat?" They answered him, "No."

djk_text: Ne a taigi den taki: “U iti a seepi fu u go na a letise fu a boto, da u sa kisi.” Ne den iti den seepi, ne den kisi fisi tee, den á poi ali a seepi kon a tapu.
eng_text: He said to them, "Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and you will find some." They cast it therefore, and now they weren't able to draw it in for the multitude of fish.

djk_text: Ma a bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi di a be lobi te, taigi Peitilisi taki: “Na Masaa Jesesi de ape!” We, di Simon Peitilisi yee taki, na Masaa Jesesi de ape, ne a wei en koosi baka esi, bika a be puu en koosi fu di a be e go fisi. Ne, dyulu, a dyombo a liba.
eng_text: That disciple therefore whom Jesus loved said to Peter, "It's the Lord!" So when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he wrapped his coat around him (for he was naked), and threw himself into the sea.

djk_text: Ma den taa bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi kon a sikin soo anga a boto, bika den be sa de wan sani fu wan ondoo meiti so fu sikin soo. We, ne na so den ali a seepi kon anga den fisi ne en.
eng_text: But the other disciples came in the little boat (for they were not far from the land, but about two hundred cubits away), dragging the net full of fish.

djk_text: We, di den kon a soo, ne den si taki koofaya be de leti leti de anga fisi ne en tapu e losi. Da soseefi beele be de tu.
eng_text: So when they got out on the land, they saw a fire of coals there, and fish laid on it, and bread.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “U tyai wantu fu den fisi di u kisi dyonson de kon gi mi.”
eng_text: Jesus said to them, "Bring some of the fish which you have just caught."

djk_text: Ne Simon Peitilisi go a ini boto, ne a ali a seepi kon a soo. Da a seepi be fuu anga wan ondoo feifitenti a dii gaanbigi fisi. Ma anga ala fa a seepi ya be abi den tyaipi fisi ya, toku a á piiti.
eng_text: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land, full of great fish, one hundred fifty-three; and even though there were so many, the net wasn't torn.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “U kon meke u nyan.” Ma ná wan fu den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi di be e peefuu fu akisi en taki, sama a yu? Bika den be sabi taki na Masaa.
eng_text: Jesus said to them, "Come and eat breakfast." None of the disciples dared inquire of him, "Who are you?" knowing that it was the Lord.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi kon, ne a teke a beele, ne a paati gi den. Da soseefi a teke den fisi paati gi den tu.
eng_text: Then Jesus came and took the bread, gave it to them, and the fish likewise.

djk_text: Da disi na di fu dii toon, di Masaa Jesesi tyai enseefi kon soi den bakaman fi en baka di a weki baka komoto a dede.
eng_text: This is now the third time that Jesus was revealed to his disciples, after he had risen from the dead.

djk_text: Ne di den kaba nyan, ne Masaa akisi Simon Peitilisi taki: “Simon, manpikin fu Johanisi! I lobi mi moo enke den taa bakaman fu mi ya?” Ne Simon piki en taki: “Iya, Masaa! I seefi sabi taki mi lobi yu.” Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi en taki: “Luku den pikin sikapu fu mi bun.”
eng_text: So when they had eaten their breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, "Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me more than these?" He said to him, "Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you." He said to him, "Feed my lambs."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi akisi en di fu tu toon taki: “Simon, manpikin fu Johanisi! I lobi mi?” Ne Simon piki en taki: “Iya, Masaa! I seefi sabi taki mi lobi yu.” Ne Masaa Jesesi taki en taki: “Luku den sikapu fu mi.”
eng_text: He said to him again a second time, "Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me?" He said to him, "Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you." He said to him, "Tend my sheep."

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi akisi en di fu dii toon taki: “Simon, manpikin fu Johanisi, i lobi mi?” We, now, ne Peitilisi ati booko, fu di Masaa akisi en di fu dii toon taki, efu a lobi en. Ne a taigi Masaa taki: “Masaa! Yu sabi ala sani. Iseefi sabi tu taki mi lobi yu.” Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi en taki: “Luku den sikapu fu mi.
eng_text: He said to him the third time, "Simon, son of Jonah, do you have affection for me?" Peter was grieved because he asked him the third time, "Do you have affection for me?" He said to him, "Lord, you know everything. You know that I have affection for you." Jesus said to him, "Feed my sheep.

djk_text: Fu tuutuu mi e taigi yu Simon, di i be moo yonkuu, da iseefi be e wei i koosi, da i be e go a pe i be wani. Ma te yu o gaandi, da yu o langa i ana fu sama tei koosi gi yu, da den o tyai yu go a pe yu á be sa wani go.”
eng_text: Most certainly I tell you, when you were young, you dressed yourself, and walked where you wanted to. But when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and another will dress you, and carry you where you don't want to go."

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi taigi Peitilisi a sani ya, fu pingi en a fesi, fu a be sabi fa en dede o waka. Da a dede fu Peitilisi ya, o hei Masaa Gadu. Ne di a taigi en so kaba, ne a kai en taki: “Kon go anga mi.”
eng_text: Now he said this, signifying by what kind of death he would glorify God. When he had said this, he said to him, "Follow me."

djk_text: Ma di Peitilisi daai luku baka, ne a si taki a bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi di a be lobi te, e waka ne en baka tu. Da na a seefi bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi ya be sidon koosube fu Masaa Jesesi di den be e nyan a Pasika Piisii na a neti, di a be akisi en taki: “Masaa, sama na a sama di o seli yu?”
eng_text: Then Peter, turning around, saw a disciple following. This was the disciple whom Jesus sincerely loved, the one who had also leaned on Jesus' breast at the supper and asked, "Lord, who is going to betray You?"

djk_text: We, di Peitilisi si en, ne a akisi Masaa Jesesi taki: “Masaa, fa fu a sama de? San o pasa anga en dati?”
eng_text: Peter seeing him, said to Jesus, "Lord, what about this man?"

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi en taki: “Efu mi wani a tan a libi fu te mi kon baka, san fi i de ne en? San yu mu du, na waka yu mu waka a mi baka.”
eng_text: Jesus said to him, "If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you? You follow me."

djk_text: Ne fanafu a ten de, ne den taa bakaman fu Masaa be abi wan taki e taki den na den taki, a bakaman fi en ya, ná o dede. Ma Masaa Jesesi á be taki, taki a á be o dede. Ma a be taki: “Efu mi wani a tan a libi fu te mi kon baka, san fi i de ne en?”
eng_text: This saying therefore went out among the brothers , that this disciple wouldn't die. Yet Jesus didn't say to him that he wouldn't die, but, "If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you?"

djk_text: We, na a seefi bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi de, ne i si e taigi yu den sani ya. Da soseefi ne en sikiifi a buku ya tu. Da wi sabi taki den sani di ai taki puu komoto ne en mofu na tuu.
eng_text: This is the disciple who testifies about these things, and wrote these things. We know that his witness is true.

djk_text: Da Masaa Jesesi du somen taa sani ete. Ma, efu den mu poti ala den sani di a du ya, wan fu wan a buku, da mi á biibi taki hii goontapu o poi oli ala den buku di den sa sikiifi ya.
eng_text: There are also many other things which Jesus did, which if they would all be written, I suppose that even the world itself wouldn't have room for the books that would be written.

djk_text: Mi lobi mati Teyofili! Na mi Lukasi e sikiifi a buku ya gi yu. A taa buku di mi be sende gi yu kaba, be soi san Masaa Jesesi be du, anga fa a be leli sama.
eng_text: The first book I wrote, Theophilus, concerned all that Jesus began both to do and to teach,

djk_text: Mi be sikiifi fa a wooko te doo a dei di Masaa Gadu puu en ya libilibi go poti ne en kondee a tapu anda. Ma fosi dati, da a Apaiti Jeje di teke en hii libi abaa be piki en fa fu taigi en apaiti bosikopuman, fu wooko go doo. Na den dati a teke poti fika a baka ya, fu paati en bosikopu.
eng_text: until the day in which he was received up, after he had given commandment through the Holy Spirit to the apostles whom he had chosen.

djk_text: Bika di a dede weki baka, da na den ai soi enseefi libilibi somen leisi. Hii fotenti dei, fu den si fa a dede weki tuu. Soseefi ai leli den moo sani, fu sabi fa Masaa Gadu poti fu tii sani.
eng_text: To these he also showed himself alive after he suffered, by many proofs, appearing to them over a period of forty days, and speaking about God's Kingdom.

djk_text: Wan fu den leisi di a soi den enseefi, namo a tapu den taki, den á mu komoto a Jelusalem Foto ete. Bika na ape den o fende a gaanbigi bun di Masaa Jesesi be taigi den kaba taki, en Tata be paamisi.
eng_text: Being assembled together with them, he commanded them, "Don't depart from Jerusalem, but wait for the promise of the Father, which you heard from me.

djk_text: Bika a ná o langa, da san o pasa de sa bigi moo fa Johanisi be e teke wataa dopu sama. Bika na Masaa Gadu o teke en Apaiti Jeje dopu den.
eng_text: For John indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit not many days from now."

djk_text: Wan fu den taa leisi di a soi den enseefi, ne den akisi en efu na a pisiten ya kaba, a o tii Dyu Kondee enke fa Masaa Gadu be paamisi, fu sende a edeman de kon enke kownu. Efu na a pisiten ya a o meke Dyu Kondee toon a moo hei kondee fu goontapu.
eng_text: Therefore when they had come together, they asked him, "Lord, are you now restoring the kingdom to Israel?"

djk_text: Namo a piki taki: “U ná abi fu sabi ala dati. Mi Tata, Masaa Gadu á gi u pasi fu dati. En wawan namo sabi. Bika ne en poti a dei anga a ten fu ala dati.
eng_text: He said to them, "It isn't for you to know times or seasons which the Father has set within his own authority.

djk_text: Ma sabi namo taki, Masaa Gadu Apaiti Jeje o teke u hii libi. A o gi u kaakiti, fu puu mi toli taigi taawan a Jelusalem Foto doo Judeja pisiwataa. Soseefi Samaliya pisiwataa doo ala taa uku fu goontapu.”
eng_text: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you. You will be witnesses to me in Jerusalem, in all Judea and Samaria, and to the uttermost parts of the earth."

djk_text: Den be taampu makandii di Jesesi kaba soi den so. Ne den si en futu e opo komoto a doti, da ai gwe a tapu, te pasa den woluku anda. Ne wan woluku wai tapu en. Na so Masaa Gadu opo en tyai gwe ne en kondee a tapu anda.
eng_text: When he had said these things, as they were looking, he was taken up, and a cloud received him out of their sight.

djk_text: A kon fu den de ape e luku tapu naamo, fa a gwe so. Te fu den denki, tu Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee anga weti koosi taampu a den mindii de.
eng_text: While they were looking steadfastly into the sky as he went, behold, two men stood by them in white clothing,

djk_text: Namo den Masaa Gadu Kondee Basiya taigi den taki: “Den manengee fu Galileya pisiwataa ya! San u taampu e luku ete? A Jesesi di opo gwe a tapu tide ya, na leti ya a o saka wan dei baka komoto a tapu anda.”
eng_text: who also said, "You men of Galilee, why do you stand looking into the sky? This Jesus, who was received up from you into the sky will come back in the same way as you saw him going into the sky."

djk_text: Namo den be taampu makandii na a mongo di abi a nen fu Oleifi. A á de faawe fu Jelusalem Foto, ma na wan kilomeiti faawe so. Da di sani waka so kaba, ne den komoto de gwe a Jelusalem Foto.
eng_text: Then they returned to Jerusalem from the mountain called Olivet, which is near Jerusalem, a Sabbath day's journey away.

djk_text: Di den doo anda, ne den subi go a tapu sodoo na a kambaa pe den be e tan na a yuu di den de a Jelusalem Foto de. Den be de ape: Peitilisi Johanisi Jakowbesi Andeleyasi Filipi Towmasi Baatomeyosi Mateyesi Jakowbesi, a manpikin fu Alefeyosi Simon Selotu Judasi, a manpikin fu Jakowbesi.
eng_text: When they had come in, they went up into the upper room, where they were staying; that is Peter, John, James, Andrew, Philip, Thomas, Bartholomew, Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, Simon the Zealot, and Judas the son of James.

djk_text: Somen leisi den be e miti makandii, fu tei ati oli doo anga begi. Maliya, a mma fu Jesesi anga den taa baala fu Jesesi be de ape tu. Wan duupu taa uman seefi.
eng_text: All these with one accord continued steadfastly in prayer and supplication, along with the women, and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brothers.

djk_text: Namo wan fu den dei, ne Peitilisi opo taampu a den mindii. Den be de ape wan ondoo anga twenti biibisama so.
eng_text: In these days, Peter stood up in the midst of the disciples (and the number of names was about one hundred twenty), and said,

djk_text: Namo a taigi den taki: “Biibiwan! U ala sabi taki, na Judasi tyai sama go kisi Masaa Jesesi. Dati waka enke fa a Apaiti Jeje fu Masaa Gadu be piki Kownu Dafeti a fositen, fu sikiifi.
eng_text:
Brothers, it was necessary that this Scripture should be fulfilled, which the Holy Spirit spoke before by the mouth of David concerning Judas, who was guide to those who took Jesus.
3729	Da a kon, na Masaa Jesesi seefi be teke Judasi makandii anga wi taa elufu poti fu du en wooko.”	3729	For he was numbered with us, and received his portion in this ministry.
3730	A Judasi ya na di be tyai sama go kisi Jesesi. Ne a teke a moni di den pai en fu dati go bai wan hii pisi doti. Ma bakadati, a teke tetei tei lenge lenge enseefi kii. Namo a koti komoto anda kai kon anga mindii fesi a doti, basi en hii bee tutu komoto a doo.	3730	Now this man obtained a field with the reward for his wickedness, and falling headlong, his body burst open, and all his intestines gushed out.
3731	Di sama fu Jelusalem Foto yee a toli de, ne den kai a doti pe a moni fi en bai, Akeldama. Dati taki, a ini den tongo, Buulu Doti.	3731	It became known to everyone who lived in Jerusalem that in their language that field was called 'Akeldama,' that is, 'The field of blood.'
3732	Namo Peitilisi taki ete taki: “Fa a de, a hii peesi fu Judasi fika fu busi goo tapu. Sama á de fu go tan ape moo wanten. Dati waka enke fa Masaa Gadu be piki Kownu Dafeti a fositen fu sikiifi na a singi buku den e kai Psalm. Bika a be sikiifi taki: ‘Ala a peesi fi en fika fu busi goo tapu. Sama á de fu go tan ape moo wanten.’ Ma a be sikiifi tu taki: ‘Poti wan taawan ne en peesi, fu du a wooko.’ ”	3732	For it is written in the book of Psalms, 'Let his habitation be made desolate.
