3949	Stefanisi soi ete taki: “Ma wi avo a ini a sabana be e tyai a tenti osu fu Masaa Gadu di e kotoigi taki, a de a den mindii. A be meke leti enke di a be soi Mosesi a tapu, fu luku meke dati.	3949	Our fathers had the tabernacle of the testimony in the wilderness, even as he who spoke to Moses commanded him to make it according to the pattern that he had seen;

djk_text: Ma na pikin fu den wooko doo anga en, fu Josuwa tii puu a kondee a taa foluku ana. Masaa Gadu yaki den gi den anga en makiti. Ne Dyusama kon tan wooko ya anga a apaiti tenti, yali fu yali, go doo bakaten di Dafeti toon kownu seefi.”
eng_text: which also our fathers, in their turn, brought in with Joshua when they entered into the possession of the nations, whom God drove out before the face of our fathers, to the days of David,

djk_text: Stefanisi soi ete taki: “Kownu Dafeti na wan man di Masaa Gadu lobi. A teke gaan bun ati fasi luku en somen fasi. Namo, Dafeti akisi a Gadu fu wi avo gaansama Jakopu ya, fu meke wan osu poti a Gadu ya.
eng_text: who found favor in the sight of God, and asked to find a habitation for the God of Jacob.

djk_text: Ma a tapu en, fu du dati. Na a ten fu Dafeti manpikin Salomo fosi, ne a gi Salomo dati pasi fu meke a osu de.”
eng_text: But Solomon built him a house.

djk_text: We, di Stefanisi e taki, ne a akisi a Dyulanti fu kuutu de taki: “Ma a gaan Masaa Gadu a tapu sa poi tan a ini wan osu di libisama meke anga ana? Bika enseefi be piki en fositen apaiti takiman fu sikiifi taki:
eng_text: However, the Most High doesn't dwell in temples made with hands, as the prophet says,

djk_text: ‘Mi enke Masaa Gadu de a mi kondee a tapu, fu tii ala sani. Hii goontapu de a mi ondoo futu. Da sowtu osu libisama o poi meke fu poti mi?
eng_text: 'heaven is my throne, and the earth a footstool for my feet. What kind of house will you build me?' says the Lord; 'or what is the place of my rest?

djk_text: Bika na mi abi ala makiti fu meke san de fu si anga ain ya.’ ”
eng_text: Didn't my hand make all these things?'

djk_text: Stefanisi soi ete taki: “Ma u sama ya abi tuutuu taanga yesi. U ati noiti poi teke taki di Masaa Gadu e meke en Apaiti Jeje e piki u, fu du. U gei doose kondee sama, taa foluku di á sabi Masaa Gadu. Na letiso u avo seefi be tan.
eng_text:
You stiff-necked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, you always resist the Holy Spirit! As your fathers did, so you do.
3957	Fositen apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu á de di den á be pina. Den be e kii sama e soi den fa Masaa Gadu paamisi fu sende en wookoman kon di o wooko enke fa a wani. A leti wookoman ya kon na a ten fu u ya, ne u dati poti en gi lanti kii.	3957	Which of the prophets didn't your fathers persecute? They killed those who foretold the coming of the Righteous One, of whom you have now become betrayers and murderers.
3958	Na fu soso Masaa Gadu meke Basiya fi en tyai en weiti kon gi u. Bika u nái wooko anga den.”	3958	You received the law as it was ordained by angels, and didn't keep it!

djk_text: We, a Dyulanti di e kuutu sani de aliki san a taki fu den de, ne den ati boon te. Ala den mofu e dansi seefi.
eng_text: Now when they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed at him with their teeth.

djk_text: A Apaiti Jeje teke Stefanisi hii libi. Ne a taampu e luku tapu, da ai si sani a tapu anda, fa Masaa Gadu dyendee fu gi gaandi. Masaa Jesesi taampu anda a Masaa Gadu letise.
eng_text: But he, being full of the Holy Spirit, looked up steadfastly into heaven, and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,

djk_text: Namo a taigi a Dyulanti di e kuutu de taki: “Nownow, mi e si a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya. A taampu anda na a moo hei peesi a Masaa Gadu letise ana.”
eng_text: and said, "Behold, I see the heavens opened, and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God!"

djk_text: Namo a Dyulanti di e kuutu de bali taki: “Kaba anga den takuu taki de!” Ne den tapu ana a yesi. Soseefi den dyombo kon gaapu en oli.
eng_text: But they cried out with a loud voice, and stopped their ears, and rushed at him with one accord.

djk_text: Ne a lanti de gi Dyusama ape, fu seepi tyai gwe a doose fu Jelusalem Foto go towe a doti. Ne den puu yasi a sikin gi wan yonkuman den e kai Sawlesi, fu oli gi den. Namo den teke siton fiingi naki en te, fu kii.
eng_text: They threw him out of the city, and stoned him. The witnesses placed their garments at the feet of a young man named Saul.

djk_text: A yuu de, ai bali kai Masaa Jesesi nen taki: “Masaa! Mi fika mi jeje gi yu fu teke.”
eng_text: They stoned Stephen as he called out, saying, "Lord Jesus, receive my spirit!"

djk_text: Ne a kai anga kini, da ai bali begi Masaa Gadu taki: “Mi e begi, fu den sa fende paadon a yu, fu a ogii di den e du ya.” Na so a komoto a goontapu.
eng_text: He kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, "Lord, don't hold this sin against them!" When he had said this, he fell asleep.

djk_text: A kii fu Stefanisi na wan sani di kai gi Sawlesi. Bigin fu a dei de libi kon moo taanga gi biibisama de. Dyusama e lon du ogii anga den. Da den e lowe panya gwe na a pisiwataa fu Judeja, soseefi Samaliya. Na den apaiti bosikopuman namo be fika de.
eng_text: Saul was consenting to his death. A great persecution arose against the assembly which was in Jerusalem in that day. They were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judea and Samaria, except for the apostles.

djk_text: Da na wan duupu manengee di e oli pakisei anga Masaa Gadu be teke Stefanisi dede sikin go beli. Den kee anga ala tyali fi en ede te.
eng_text: Devout men buried Stephen, and lamented greatly over him.

djk_text: A ten ya Sawlesi nái meke sipowtu anga biibisama. Ai meke moiti fu kaba den anga ala a biibi libi. Ai waka osu fu osu e kisi biibi uman anga man seepi go gi lanti, fu sooto.
eng_text: But Saul ravaged the assembly, entering into every house, and dragged both men and women off to prison.

djk_text: Ma den biibisama di be lowe fika Jelusalem be e waka lontu den peesi pe den lowe go. Da den e paati a Bun Nyunsu fu Masaa Jesesi na ala pe den doo.
eng_text: Therefore those who were scattered abroad went around preaching the word.

djk_text: Wan biibiwan den e kai Filipi seefi be doo wan foto na a pisiwataa fu Samaliya. Ne ai taigi den sama anda taki, Jesesi na a Kelestesi.
eng_text: Philip went down to the city of Samaria, and proclaimed to them the Christ.

djk_text: Namo den sama ape aliki en. Den e si tu fa ai du foondoo sani enke maiki taki, na Masaa Gadu taampu gi en. Ne den ala booko kon teke san ai taki.
eng_text: The multitudes listened with one accord to the things that were spoken by Philip, when they heard and saw the signs which he did.

djk_text: Bika den e si takuu jeje e bali komoto a somen sama tapu. Lanman anga malengii sama e kon bun.
eng_text: For unclean spirits came out of many of those who had them. They came out, crying with a loud voice. Many who had been paralyzed and lame were healed.

djk_text: Ala san e pasa de tyai gaan piisii a ini a foto ya. Ala sama ape e poolo.
eng_text: There was great joy in that city.

djk_text: Ma fosi a ten de, da wan tofuuman den e kai Simon be e tan a ini a foto fu Samalitan sama ya. A be e kai enseefi bigiman. Ala sama fu a foto be e foondoo, fu den tofuu di ai du.
eng_text: But there was a certain man, Simon by name, who used to practice sorcery in the city, and amazed the people of Samaria, making himself out to be some great one,

djk_text: Pikin anga bigi, hei anga lagi fu a foto be e teke ala san ai taki. Bika den be e denki na Masaa Gadu gi en a hii kaakiti fi en, fu wooko gi en.
eng_text: to whom they all listened, from the least to the greatest, saying, "This man is that great power of God."

djk_text: Na so meke tofuu di ai du be e meke den sama e foondoo onmen langa kaba na a peesi de.
eng_text: They listened to him, because for a long time he had amazed them with his sorceries.

djk_text: Ma di Filipi kon doo de, ne a taigi den sama a Bun Nyunsu, fa Masaa Gadu poti fu tii sama. Soseefi ai soi den fa Masaa Jesesi na a Kelestesi. Namo uman anga man teke biibi na a peesi de, te go dopu.
eng_text: But when they believed Philip preaching good news concerning the Kingdom of God and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.

djk_text: Simon seefi go dopu. A teke biibi a san a yee Filipi e taki. Namo a bigin waka wanten anga Filipi na ala pe ai go. Da ai foondoo naamo, fu san Filipi e du enke maiki taki, na Masaa Gadu taampu gi en.
eng_text: Simon himself also believed. Being baptized, he continued with Philip. Seeing signs and great miracles occurring, he was amazed.

djk_text: Namo nyunsu fu dise go doo Jelusalem Foto a den apaiti bosikopuman. Den yee fa Samaliya pisiwataa teke Masaa Gadu bosikopu, fu Masaa Jesesi. Ne den puu tu fu den, Johanisi anga Peitilisi go luku den sama anda.
eng_text: Now when the apostles who were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent Peter and John to them,

djk_text: Ne den komoto go doo, te begi gi den sama di teke biibi de, fu a Apaiti Jeje sa lai den sama libi.
eng_text: who, when they had come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Spirit;

djk_text: Bika den be teke biibi de, te be dopu enke maiki taki, den e biibi Masaa Jesesi. Ma a Apaiti Jeje dati á be lai den libi ete.
eng_text: for as yet he had fallen on none of them. They had only been baptized in the name of Christ Jesus.

djk_text: Namo Peitilisi anga Johanisi poti ana, a ibiiwan fu den tapu, begi gi den. Ne Masaa Gadu meke en Apaiti Jeje lai den libi tu.
eng_text: Then they laid their hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.

djk_text: Namo Simon luku san pasa de. A si taki, te den apaiti bosikopuman poti ana begi gi wan sama, da a Apaiti Jeje e lai a hii libi de. Namo a teke moni fu go pai den apaiti bosikopuman, fi en seefi sa poi du dati tu.
eng_text: Now when Simon saw that the Holy Spirit was given through the laying on of the apostles' hands, he offered them money,

djk_text: A taki: “Gaantangi! Seli a kaakiti ya gi mi, fu poi poti ana begi, da a Apaiti Jeje teke a sama de libi tu.”
eng_text: saying, "Give me also this power, that whomever I lay my hands on may receive the Holy Spirit."

djk_text: Ma Peitilisi piki en taki: “Luku bun! Masaa Gadu o kaba yu a soso anga ala i moni. Bika yu á mu denki taki, a gaanbigi bun di Masaa Gadu e gi, da yu o poi bai en anga moni. Kweti!
eng_text: But Peter said to him, "May your silver perish with you, because you thought you could obtain the gift of God with money!

djk_text: Yu ati á taampu leti a Masaa Gadu fesi, da i ná abi pasi fu du a wooko ya!
eng_text: You have neither part nor lot in this matter, for your heart isn't right before God.

djk_text: Daai libi komoto na a takuu ati fasi de! Da begi Masaa Gadu paadon, fu a takuu fasi di toosi yu fu denki so.
eng_text: Repent therefore of this, your wickedness, and ask God if perhaps the thought of your heart may be forgiven you.

djk_text: Bika bita fasi anga giili koko a yu ati, da ai subi yu fu du sani. Da takuudu e wooko enke basi a i tapu.”
eng_text: For I see that you are in the gall of bitterness and in the bondage of iniquity."

djk_text: Namo Simon piki taki: “Mi e begi! U yeepi mi begi paadon! Akisi Masaa Gadu, fu san u taki o pasa anga mi de á sa go doo.”
eng_text: Simon answered, "Pray for me to the Lord, that none of the things which you have spoken happen to me."

djk_text: Johanisi anga Peitilisi be kaba de. Den soi san den be si fu Masaa Jesesi anga ala fini fini sama a dati. Ne den e gwe a Jelusalem baka, da den e miti somen Samaliya sama kondee a pasi. Da den e gi den a Bun Nyunsu tu.
eng_text: They therefore, when they had testified and spoken the word of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and preached the Good News to many villages of the Samaritans.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Gadu sende wan Basiya fi en go taigi Filipi taki: “Seeka fu go mindii dei ten, na a pasi di abaa a sabana, komoto a Jelusalem Foto go kai a Gaasa.”
eng_text: But an angel of the Lord spoke to Philip, saying, "Arise, and go toward the south to the way that goes down from Jerusalem to Gaza. This is a desert."

djk_text: We, a go si wan Etiyopiya Kondee man de. En na a moo heiman fu luku moni toli anda. Na wan apaiti wookoman gi a uman kownu den e kai Kandaki. Da a be go begi a Jelusalem Foto, te ai daai baka ya so.
eng_text: He arose and went; and behold, there was a man of Ethiopia, a eunuch of great authority under Candace, queen of the Ethiopians, who was over all her treasure, who had come to Jerusalem to worship.

djk_text: A sidon a ini en wagi di asi e hali enke buliki wagi. Da ai leisi a pisi buku di Jesaja enke fositen apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu be sikiifi.
eng_text: He was returning and sitting in his chariot, and was reading the prophet Isaiah.

djk_text: Namo, a Apaiti Jeje di de a Filipi libi piki en taki: “Filipi! Go moo koosube fu a wagi fu a man de!”
eng_text: The Spirit said to Philip, "Go near, and join yourself to this chariot."

djk_text: Ne Filipi lon esi esi go koosube fu a wagi. Da ai yee a Etiyopiya man e leisi san Masaa Gadu apaiti takiman Jesaja be sikiifi. Namo Filipi akisi en taki: “Fa yu e leisi de, a sani kiin gi yu fu sabi?”
eng_text: Philip ran to him, and heard him reading Isaiah the prophet, and said, "Do you understand what you are reading?"

djk_text: Namo a man piki en taki: “Fa a sa kiin gi mi, fu sabi san mi e leisi? Sama á de fu soi mi san na a sani seefi!” Namo a kai Filipi, fu dyombo go sidon ne en se a ini a wagi.
eng_text: He said, "How can I, unless someone explains it to me?" He begged Philip to come up and sit with him.

djk_text: A pisi fu a Masaa Gadu Buku di ai leisi taki: “Den e tyai en go kii! Ma ai tan pii teke ala dati enke pikin sikapu, di den kisi fu tyai go kaabu uwii puu ne en sikin.
eng_text: Now the passage of the Scripture which he was reading was this, "He was led as a sheep to the slaughter. As a lamb before his shearer is silent, so he doesn't open his mouth.

djk_text: Den du ogii anga ala pina en. En toli seefi, den á kuutu leti, ne den puu en futu a goontapu. Da fa a sa du poi meke paansu sama fu waka ne en baka ya?”
eng_text: In his humiliation, his judgment was taken away. Who will declare His generation? For his life is taken from the earth."

djk_text: Namo, a man akisi Filipi taki: “Anga sama den du san a fositen apaiti takiman sikiifi ya? Na a apaiti takiman di sikiifi en seefi ofu na wan taa sama?”
eng_text: The eunuch answered Philip, "Who is the prophet talking about? About himself, or about someone else?"

djk_text: Namo Filipi teke a Bun Nyunsu soi en fa san be sikiifi Masaa Gadu Buku ape e fiti anga san pasa anga Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: Philip opened his mouth, and beginning from this Scripture, preached to him Jesus.

djk_text: Da fa den de a waka tapu so, ne den e pasa wan peesi de anga wataa. Namo a man daai luku a wataa, ne a akisi taki: “I si enke mi doo peesi fu dopu kaba? Bika luku wataa so!”
eng_text: As they went on the way, they came to some water, and the eunuch said, "Behold, here is water. What is keeping me from being baptized?"

djk_text: We, ne a tapu wagi wanten. Ne den saka komoto go a ini a wataa, en anga Filipi makandii. Ne Filipi dopu en.
eng_text: He commanded the chariot to stand still, and they both went down into the water, both Philip and the eunuch, and he baptized him.

djk_text: Di den kaba, go a soo baka, a Etiyopiya man á si Filipi moo. A Apaiti Jeje puu en de foondoo fasi tyai go poti a wan hii taa peesi. A Etiyopiya man á fuka fu dati seefi. A dyombo a ini en wagi anga ala piisii.
eng_text: When they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught Philip away, and the eunuch didn't see him any more, for he went on his way rejoicing.

djk_text: Na wan faawe peesi Filipi kisi en seefi. A Apaiti Jeje tyai en go poti na a foto den e kai Asotesi. Da ai waka anga a Bun Nyunsu a den foto fu a pisi anda. Namo a go doo a foto den e kai Sesaleya seefi.
eng_text: But Philip was found at Azotus. Passing through, he preached the Good News to all the cities, until he came to Caesarea.

djk_text: Sawlesi dati ati nái kaba boon a den di e waka na a pasi fu Masaa. Ai waka e pina den e kisi gi lanti, fu kii. Wan dei, a go na a moo hei Dyu fu a Mama Keliki.
eng_text: But Saul, still breathing threats and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went to the high priest,

djk_text: Ne a akisi paamisi fu gwe a Damasikosi Foto, go kisi uman anga man di e waka na a Nyun Pasi anda, fu tyai kon sitaafu a Jelusalem. Den langa pampila makiti en, meke fesiman fu Dyu keliki anda sa si taki, a abi pasi fu du so.
eng_text: and asked for letters from him to the synagogues of Damascus, that if he found any who were of the Way, whether men or women, he might bring them bound to Jerusalem.

djk_text: Namo a teke pasi e gwe Damasikosi Foto. A be doo koosube kaba. Te fu a denki, wan kiin faya koti komoto a tapu, kon kai lontu en hii sikin.
eng_text: As he traveled, it happened that he got close to Damascus, and suddenly a light from the sky shone around him.

djk_text: Wanten a kai a doti, da ai yee wan Tongo e taki: “Sawlesi! Sawlesi! Saide yu mu e lon du ogii ala suku fu pina mi so?”
eng_text: He fell on the earth, and heard a voice saying to him, "Saul, Saul, why do you persecute me?"

djk_text: Namo a piki taki: “Masaa! Sama a yu?” Namo a piki en taki: “Mi na Jesesi di baka yu e lon fu pina so!”
eng_text: He said, "Who are you, Lord?" The Lord said, "I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.

djk_text: A Tongo soi ete taki: “Ma opo go doo Damasikosi Foto. Sama de anda fu taigi yu san fu du.”
eng_text: But rise up, and enter into the city, and you will be told what you must do."

djk_text: A hii ten de, da den man di anga en be de a waka tapu dyombo te, den de diin. Bika den e yee a Tongo e taki, ma den nái si a sama di e taki.
eng_text: The men who traveled with him stood speechless, hearing the sound, but seeing no one.

djk_text: Namo Sawlesi opo taampu, ma a nái si sani moo. Ne den taawan oli en na ana tyai go doo Damasikosi Foto.
eng_text: Saul arose from the ground, and when his eyes were opened, he saw no one. They led him by the hand, and brought him into Damascus.

djk_text: Dii dei langa a tan sondee si, sondee nyan anga ala sondee diingi wataa.
eng_text: He was without sight for three days, and neither ate nor drank.

djk_text: Da wan biibiwan den e kai Ananiyasi be e tan a Damasikosi Foto. Masaa go meke ai si jeje sani enke ai deen so, da ai yee en tongo e taki: “Ananiyasi!” A piki taki: “Iya, Masaa.”
eng_text: Now there was a certain disciple at Damascus named Ananias. The Lord said to him in a vision, "Ananias!" He said, "Behold, it's me, Lord."

djk_text: Masaa taki: “Go na a letiopu sitaati di kaasi abaa a foto ya. Na a osu fu a man den e kai Judasi i mu go akisi fu a man den e kai Sawlesi, fu Taasisi Foto. Nownow ya, a de ape e begi.”
eng_text: The Lord said to him, "Arise, and go to the street which is called Straight, and inquire in the house of Judah for one named Saul, a man of Tarsus. For behold, he is praying,

djk_text: Soseefi Masaa taki go doo taki: “Mi e soi enseefi jeje sani nownow ya enke ai deen. Da ai si yu Ananiyasi e waka kon na a osu pe a de, ne yu poti ana begi gi en meke ai si sani baka.”
eng_text: and in a vision he has seen a man named Ananias coming in, and laying his hands on him, that he might receive his sight."

djk_text: Namo Ananiyasi piki en taki: “Masaa! Fa i sa sende mi go na a man de? Mi yee taki, ai du ogii anga sama fi yu a Jelusalem Foto!
eng_text: But Ananias answered, "Lord, I have heard from many about this man, how much evil he did to your saints at Jerusalem.

djk_text: A kon fi en ya na fu kisi ibii sama di teke biibi fu kai yu nen. Bika a Jelusalem Foto anda pampila naki gi en makiti fu kon du dati ya.”
eng_text: Here he has authority from the chief priests to bind all who call on your name."

djk_text: Namo Masaa piki taki: “Na mi e sende yu go ne en! Bika mi teke enseefi toon sama fu mi. Da a toon wooko sani fu mi, fu du mi wooko. Bika a o waka tyai mi nen paati, fu soi Dyusama, soseefi taa foluku tu. Soseefi go doo kownu kownu fu goontapu.
eng_text: But the Lord said to him, "Go your way, for he is my chosen vessel to bear my name before the nations and kings, and the children of Israel.

djk_text: Bika mi o soi en san wani taki tyotyo fu mi nen di a o paati doo moo anga moo sama, fu yee fu mi.”
eng_text: For I will show him how many things he must suffer for my name's sake."

djk_text: We, ne Ananiyasi komoto wanten go na a osu pe Sawlesi de. Ne a poti ana a Sawlesi ede taki: “Baala Sawlesi! Na Masaa Jesesi soi enseefi a yu na a pasi di waka doo ya. Ne a sende mi, fu kon meke yu si baka. Soseefi fu kon meke a Apaiti Jeje lai yu hii libi.”
eng_text: Ananias departed, and entered into the house. Laying his hands on him, he said, "Brother Saul, the Lord, who appeared to you on the road by which you came, has sent me, that you may receive your sight, and be filled with the Holy Spirit."

djk_text: Fa i si Ananiyasi taki so, Sawlesi si baka wanten. A fii enke na fisi buba be tapu en ain komoto kai. Bakadati, ne a opo go meke den dopu en.
eng_text: Immediately something like scales fell from his eyes, and he received his sight. He arose and was baptized.

djk_text: Ne a nyan te en bee simpan, en hii sikin kon taanga baka. Ne Sawlesi tan wantu dei ete anga den biibiwan fu Damasikosi Foto ape.
eng_text: He took food and was strengthened. Saul stayed several days with the disciples who were at Damascus.

djk_text: Da ai go waka makandii anga den biibiwan a den Dyu keliki fu anda. Da ai bali a bosikopu taki: “Fu tuu! Jesesi na a Manpikin fu Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: Immediately in the synagogues he proclaimed the Christ, that he is the Son of God.

djk_text: Namo den sama di yee dati foondoo taki: “A man di be de a Jelusalem Foto e feti anga biibi. A be kon ya, fu kisi ibii biibiwan di e kai Masaa Jesesi nen, tyai go gi fu Dyu keliki anda, fu sitaafu. Ma fa a du daai e taki taa fasi so?”
eng_text: All who heard him were amazed, and said, "Isn't this he who in Jerusalem made havoc of those who called on this name? And he had come here intending to bring them bound before the chief priests!"

djk_text: We, na bigin fu taki taa fasi Sawlesi be de. Bika na moo anga moo ai tyai sani kon a fesi, fu soi fa Jesesi na a Kelestesi di sende kon, fu tii ala sani. Dyusama á be de fu taampu ne en fesi sitee anga san ai taki.
eng_text: But Saul increased more in strength, and confounded the Jews who lived at Damascus, proving that this is the Christ.

djk_text: Ma baka wan pisiten, ne den Dyusama fiti mofu fu kisi en kii.
eng_text: When many days were fulfilled, the Jews conspired together to kill him,

djk_text: Ma a kisi wan pingi fu dati. Ná sipowtu lulu fu kisi en kii den sete dei anga neti na ala den pasi mofu fu waka kon a ini a foto.
eng_text: but their plot became known to Saul. They watched the gates both day and night that they might kill him,

djk_text: Namo den taa biibiwan kibii en puu a ini a foto. Den tei tetei a wan gaan bakisi, saka en puu a wan fensee fu a hei siton di sikotu lontu a hii foto ya.
eng_text: but his disciples took him by night, and let him down through the wall, lowering him in a basket.

djk_text: Namo a gwe te go doo Jelusalem Foto. Ne a go suku fu libi anga ala wooko makandii anga den biibiwan de. Ma den e wai a pasi gi en. Den e pantan fu biibi taki, a toon biibiwan.
eng_text: When Saul had come to Jerusalem, he tried to join himself to the disciples; but they were all afraid of him, not believing that he was a disciple.

djk_text: Ma Balnabasi luku a toli bun, ne a teke en tyai go miti den apaiti bosikopuman. Ne a soi ala fa Sawlesi si Masaa Jesesi, taki mofu mofu anga en a Damasikosi Pasi. Fa Sawlesi á be feele fu taampu a lanti fesi anda, taki sani a ini a nen fu Jesesi.
eng_text: But Barnabas took him, and brought him to the apostles, and declared to them how he had seen the Lord in the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how at Damascus he had preached boldly in the name of Jesus.

djk_text: Namo den teke Sawlesi wanten fu wooko a den mindii. Den sanga waka wooko lontu hii Jelusalem Foto makandii.
eng_text: He was with them entering into Jerusalem,

djk_text: Sondee feele ai taampu e taki sani a ini a nen fu Masaa. Da Dyusama di e taki Giiki Tongo ape teke fu sitee anga en. Da ai soi den fa a sani de seefi. Namo den fiti mofu fu kii en puu.
eng_text: preaching boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus. He spoke and disputed against the Hellenists, but they were seeking to kill him.

djk_text: Ma biibiwan ape kisi wan pingi fu dati. Ne den meke moiti puu en de tyai gwe a wan taa pisiwataa den e kai Sesaleya. Den poti en anda a boto baka seefi tyai gwe moo faawe abaa ze gwe a Taasisi Foto a wan taa kondee.
eng_text: When the brothers knew it, they brought him down to Caesarea, and sent him off to Tarsus.

djk_text: A ten de, da sani á be taanga so moo gi biibiwan fu Judeja, Galileya anga Samaliya pisiwataa. Den biibi e moo taanga. Den e lesipeki Masaa Gadu. A Apaiti Jeje e wooko, fu meke den kulu e goo moo anga moo tu.
eng_text: So the assemblies throughout all Judea and Galilee and Samaria had peace, and were built up. They were multiplied, walking in the fear of the Lord and in the comfort of the Holy Spirit.

djk_text: A ten ya, Peitilisi e waka lontu somen taa peesi anga a bosikopu fu Masaa Gadu. A go doo biibiwan na a foto den e kai Lida.
eng_text: It happened, as Peter went throughout all those parts, he came down also to the saints who lived at Lydda.

djk_text: Ne a go si wan lanman den e kai Eneya ape. Aitin yali langa a didon sondee waka.
eng_text: There he found a certain man named Aeneas, who had been bedridden for eight years, because he was paralyzed.

djk_text: Namo Peitilisi taigi en taki: “Eneya! Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi betee yu tide. Opo taampu! I seefi lolo i sibi peesi.” Ne Eneya opo waka letiso!
eng_text: Peter said to him, "Aeneas, Jesus Christ heals you. Get up and make your bed!" Immediately he arose.

djk_text: Namo sama komoto a Lida Foto doo a pisiwataa fu Salon si a hii toli ya. Ne den daai dini Masaa de wanten.
eng_text: All who lived at Lydda and in Sharon saw him, and they turned to the Lord.

djk_text: Da boiti Lida Foto, da Jopa Foto be de anda tu. Wan biibi uman be de ape den e kai Tabita. Dati na Dolkasi a ini Giiki Tongo. A be e du somen bun gi taawan doo mofinawan tu.
eng_text: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which when translated, means Dorcas. This woman was full of good works and acts of mercy which she did.

djk_text: We, ne a uman ya siki a Jopa Foto di Peitilisi de a Lida Foto. Namo a dede te wasi seeka poti a wan kambaa a wan tapu sodoo.
eng_text: It happened in those days that she fell sick, and died. When they had washed her, they laid her in an upper room.

djk_text: Lida Foto á be faawe fu Jopa Foto. Ne biibiwan a Jopa Foto yee taki, Peitilisi de ape. Ne den sende tu manengee go piki en taki, Tabita dede a Jopa Foto. Meke a kon a den sondee daai daai.
eng_text: As Lydda was near Joppa, the disciples, hearing that Peter was there, sent two men to him, imploring him not to delay in coming to them.

djk_text: Namo Peitilisi seeka gwe anga den. Fa a doo, den tyai en go a tapu sodoo na a dede. Wan duupu uman di man dede fika a ganda, be de ape. Tabita be lobi yeepi den a sani. Den kon a Peitilisi anga ala kee e soi en koosi di Tabita be lobi meke gi den.
eng_text: Peter got up and went with them. When he had come, they brought him into the upper room. All the widows stood by him weeping, and showing the coats and garments which Dorcas had made while she was with them.

djk_text: Namo Peitilisi sende den gwe a doo. Ne a saka kini begi a ini a kambaa. Bakadati, ne a daai taigi a dede taki: “Tabita! Opo!” Namo Tabita opo ain luku Peitilisi anga ala opo sidon.
eng_text: Peter put them all out, and kneeled down and prayed. Turning to the body, he said, "Tabitha, get up!" She opened her eyes, and when she saw Peter, she sat up.

djk_text: Ne Peitilisi langa ana gi en, hali en opo taampu. Ne a kai den uman di be go a doose kon, soseefi taa biibiwan fu Masaa Gadu de. Den kon luku a libilibi Tabita di be dede.
eng_text: He gave her his hand, and raised her up. Calling the saints and widows, he presented her alive.

djk_text: A hii Jopa Foto yee a toli, ne somen sama daai teke fu biibi Masaa Jesesi de.
eng_text: And it became known throughout all Joppa, and many believed in the Lord.

djk_text: Ma Peitilisi á komoto a Jopa Foto wanten baka. A tan wantu dei moo anga den biibiwan ape na a osu fu Simon. Dati e dee meti buba, fu teke meke sani enke kaw buba.
eng_text: It happened, that he stayed many days in Joppa with one Simon, a tanner.

djk_text: Da wan suudati be de na a pisiwataa fu Sesaleya, den e kai Koneilisi. Na wan Italiya ofisii di abi wan ondoo suudati ne en ondoo.
eng_text: Now there was a certain man in Caesarea, Cornelius by name, a centurion of what was called the Italian Regiment,

djk_text: Ma a be lobi Masaa Gadu anga ala lesipeki. Ala sama a ini en osu seefi tu. A be e tyai yeepi gi mofinawan a ini a Dyu foluku naamo seefi. Soseefi a be e begi dei fu dei tu.
eng_text: a devout man, and one who feared God with all his house, who gave gifts for the needy generously to the people, and always prayed to God.

djk_text: Wan dei, a de ne en osu dii yuu bakadina so. Ne ai si jeje sani enke ai deen so. Wan Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee waka libilibi kon a ini en osu, te doo ne en fesi taigi en taki: “Koneilisi!”
eng_text: At about the ninth hour of the day , he clearly saw in a vision an angel of God coming to him, and saying to him, "Cornelius!"

djk_text: Namo a pii ain e luku a Masaa Gadu Kondee Basiya, anga ala feele anga dansi sikin. Namo a taki: “Mi Masaa! San i wani anga mi?” Namo a Basiya taki: “Na den begi di i e begi anga ala den bun di i e gi mofinawan. Ne ala dati piisii Masaa Gadu, fu denki yu!
eng_text: He, fastening his eyes on him, and being frightened, said, "What is it, Lord?" He said to him, "Your prayers and your gifts to the needy have gone up for a memorial before God.

djk_text: Da a wani yu sende wantu wookoman fi yu go a Jopa Foto go kai Simon di den e kai Peitilisi tu.
eng_text: Now send men to Joppa, and get Simon, who is surnamed Peter.

djk_text: Ai tan na a osu fu wan man den e kai Simon anda tu. Dati e dee meti buba, fu teke meke sani enke kaw buba. En osu de koosube sikin liba fu a ze.”
eng_text: He lodges with one Simon, a tanner, whose house is by the seaside. "

djk_text: Fa i si a Masaa Gadu Kondee Basiya gwe, Koneilisi kai tu wookoman kon, makandii anga wan suudati di a sabi taki, lobi Masaa Gadu. Na wan di ai fitoow, fu poti oli wakiti gi enseefi.
eng_text: When the angel who spoke to him had departed, Cornelius called two of his household servants and a devout soldier of those who waited on him continually.

djk_text: Namo a taigi den dii man ya, ala san a Masaa Gadu Kondee Basiya kon sende en. Bakadati, ne a sende den gwe a Jopa Foto a Peitilisi.
eng_text: Having explained everything to them, he sent them to Joppa.

djk_text: Wan dei baka dati, ne den de a pasi. Den be doo koosube fu Jopa Foto kaba. A ten de Peitilisi de a Jopa Foto e subi go a tapu sodoo fu a osu anda, fu go begi na a mindii dei twalufu yuu de.
eng_text: Now on the next day as they were on their journey, and got close to the city, Peter went up on the housetop to pray at about noon.

djk_text: Ma angii be e kii en, ne a piki den sama a ini a osu dati. Namo den e seeka sani gi en fu nyan. Ne a go sidon a tapu anda e wakiti den. Te fu a denki, ne ai si jeje sani enke ai deen.
eng_text: He became hungry and desired to eat, but while they were preparing, he fell into a trance.

djk_text: Tapu anda wai opo, ne wan sani komoto a ini anda e kon a doti. Wan sani enke wan gaan duku tei oli a den fo kanti fi en.
eng_text: He saw heaven opened and a certain container descending to him, like a great sheet let down by four corners on the earth,

djk_text: A kon doo te a Peitilisi fesi, ne ai si sowtu a sowtu fo futu meti, sowtu a sowtu meti di e hali anga bee a doti, sowtu a sowtu foo di e fee a tapu.
eng_text: in which were all kinds of four-footed animals of the earth, wild animals, reptiles, and birds of the sky.

djk_text: Namo a yee wan Tongo e taigi en taki: “Peitilisi! Opo taampu! I sa nyan ala sani yu e si de. Kii nyan san i wani!”
eng_text: A voice came to him, "Rise, Peter, kill and eat!"

djk_text: Ma Peitilisi piki baka taki: “Kweti, Masaa! Enke Dyusama, noiti mi nyan wanten san Dyuweiti taki, á de fiti. Noiti mi nyan san á de kiin fasi gi Dyusama!”
eng_text: But Peter said, "Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten anything that is common or unclean."

djk_text: Namo a Tongo piki di fu tu leisi taki: “Mi enke Masaa Gadu ya sende yu taki, nownow den fiti fi yu enke Dyusama nyan. Da yu á mu piki taki, den á de kiin fasi gi yu enke Dyusama.”
eng_text: A voice came to him again the second time, "What God has cleansed, you must not call unclean."

djk_text: We, na te dii leisi seefi a taigi Peitilisi a seefi sani ya. Namo wantoon so, Peitilisi si a duku anga den meti e gwe a tapu baka, te doo pe a be komoto a tapu anda.
eng_text: This was done three times, and immediately the vessel was received up into heaven.

djk_text: Namo Peitilisi sidon e wegi san a si de. A leti ape a de, ne den man di Koneilisi be sende kon doo de. Den be akisi a ini a foto, ne sama soi den a osu fu Simon. Ne den kon doo na a doo mofu fi en.
eng_text: Now while Peter was very perplexed in himself what the vision which he had seen might mean, behold, the men who were sent by Cornelius, having made inquiry for Simon's house, stood before the gate,

djk_text: Namo den bali akisi efu Simon di den e kai Peitilisi de ape.
eng_text: and called and asked whether Simon, who was surnamed Peter, was lodging there.

djk_text: A ten de Peitilisi de na a tapu osu ete e wegi san a be si. Namo a Apaiti Jeje piki en taki: “Peitilisi! Dii man kon suku yu.
eng_text: While Peter was pondering the vision, the Spirit said to him, "Behold, three men seek you.

djk_text: Saka go a den, bika den kon kai yu fu go anga den a pe den komoto. Na foluku di á de Dyusama, ma go anga den sondee fu meke sani. Bika na mi sende den kon kai yu.”
eng_text: But arise, get down, and go with them, doubting nothing; for I have sent them."

djk_text: Namo Peitilisi saka wanten go taigi den man taki: “U luku mi di u e suku ya! San u wani?”
eng_text: Peter went down to the men, and said, "Behold, I am he whom you seek. Why have you come?"

djk_text: Ne den taigi en taki: “U komoto a wan man den e kai Koneilisi, wan ofisii fu suudati. A de wan letiopu man, di e lesipeki a Gadu fu Dyusama. Ala Dyusama sabi anda fa ai libi bun anga Dyusama. Masaa Gadu sende wan apaiti Masaa Gadu Kondee Basiya go taigi en, fu sende kai yu, fu aliki ala san yu o taigi en.”
eng_text: They said, "Cornelius, a centurion, a righteous man and one who fears God, and well spoken of by all the nation of the Jews, was directed by a holy angel to invite you to his house, and to listen to what you say."

djk_text: Namo Peitilisi aliki, ne a taki: “A bun!” Ne a kai den man kon a ini osu, gi den siibi peesi. Taa dei, ne a opo gwe anga den. Wantu biibi man fu Jopa Foto go anga den tu.
eng_text: So he called them in and lodged them. On the next day Peter arose and went out with them, and some of the brothers from Joppa accompanied him.

djk_text: A taa dei fu dati, ne en anga den go doo Sesaleya Foto. Koneilisi be seeka fu a kon fi en. A kai ala en famii poti sidon makandii anga ala en bun mati fi en.
eng_text: On the next day they entered into Caesarea. Cornelius was waiting for them, having called together his relatives and his near friends.

djk_text: Fa i si Peitilisi de fu doo go a ini a osu, Koneilisi lon kon miti en a doose. A saka anga kini ne en fesi e gi en gaandi.
eng_text: When it happened that Peter entered, Cornelius met him, fell down at his feet, and worshiped him.

djk_text: Ma Peitilisi hali en opo taampu taki: “Opo taampu! Mi á de wan sani moo yu. Bika mi anga yu na libisama anga libisama!”
eng_text: But Peter raised him up, saying, "Stand up! I myself am also a man."

djk_text: Na so den e taki, den doo go a ini osu. Namo, na onmen sama Peitilisi go si e wakiti de.
eng_text: As he talked with him, he went in and found many gathered together.

djk_text: Ne a gi odi anga ala taki: “U sabi fa Dyuweiti e tapu Dyusama fu mosoo anga taa foluku. Mi dati kon ya, fu di Masaa Gadu seefi soi mi taki, mi á mu si moo enke u á de kiin fasi. Mi á mu si moo enke u á de fiti.
eng_text: He said to them, "You yourselves know how it is an unlawful thing for a man who is a Jew to join himself or come to one of another nation, but God has shown me that I shouldn't call any man unholy or unclean.

djk_text: Na dati meke di den kon kai mi, mi á meke sani. Da mi kon ya kaba, fu sabi saide u sende kai mi.”
eng_text: Therefore also I came without complaint when I was sent for. I ask therefore, why did you send for me?"

djk_text: Namo Koneilisi piki taki: “Tide na di fu fo dei, da a be de dii yuu bakadina enke nownow. Mi be de a osu e begi. Te fu mi denki, ne wan man wei weti koosi taampu a mi fesi.
eng_text: Cornelius said, "Four days ago, I was fasting until this hour, and at the ninth hour, I prayed in my house, and behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing,

djk_text: A taigi mi taki: ‘Koneilisi! Na den begi di i e begi Masaa Gadu, soseefi den bun di yu e gi mofinawan. Ne a sende mi kon taigi yu taki, ala dati piisii en fu denki yu.
eng_text: and said, 'Cornelius, your prayer is heard, and your gifts to the needy are remembered in the sight of God.

djk_text: A wani yu sende sama go a Jopa Foto go kai Simon di den e kai Peitilisi tu. Ai tan na a osu fu wan man den e kai Simon anda tu. Dati e dee meti buba, fu teke meke sani enke kaw buba. En osu de a sikin liba fu a ze.’
eng_text: Send therefore to Joppa, and summon Simon, who is surnamed Peter. He lodges in the house of Simon a tanner, by the seaside. When he comes, he will speak to you.'

djk_text: We, ne mi sende sama wanten kon kai yu. Da a bun fa i kon. U de ya a Masaa Gadu fesi ya, fu aliki ala san a gi yu, fu taigi wi.”
eng_text: Therefore I sent to you at once, and it was good of you to come. Now therefore we are all here present in the sight of God to hear all things that have been commanded you by God."

djk_text: We, ne Peitilisi piki taki: “Mi kon e si tuu taki, sama á de wan sani moo taawan gi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Peter opened his mouth and said, "Truly I perceive that God doesn't show favoritism;

djk_text: Ibii foluku sama, ma yu e dini en anga ala wooko leti fasi gi en, da dati e switi en ati kaba.
eng_text: but in every nation he who fears him and works righteousness is acceptable to him.

djk_text: Masaa Gadu seefi mofu paamisi wi Dyusama dati a Dyu Kondee. Ne u sabi taki, ibii libisama ati poi kon de switi anga Masaa Gadu. Jesesi Kelestesi du a wooko fu tyai a yeepi de. A man de poti fu wooko enke Masaa gi ibiiwan.
eng_text: The word which he sent to the children of Israel, preaching good news of peace by Jesus Christ--he is Lord of all--

djk_text: U ala ya be yee a toli fi en di be pasa a Dyu Kondee. A be bigin wooko na a pisiwataa fu Galileya, baka fu a ten di Johanisi be e dopu sama.
eng_text: you yourselves know what happened, which was proclaimed throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;

djk_text: Dati na Jesesi di goo a Nasaleti Foto. Masaa Gadu meke en Apaiti Jeje teke en hii libi, fu gi en kaakiti fu wooko lontu Dyu Kondee e du bun. A tyai yeepi puu sama a ini dwengi fu didibii. Da ai deesi den tu.
eng_text: even Jesus of Nazareth, how God anointed him with the Holy Spirit and with power, who went about doing good and healing all who were oppressed by the devil, for God was with him.

djk_text: “Mi anga taawan di be e waka anga en na kotoigi di si san a waka du na a hii Dyu Kondee. A wooko fu Jelusalem Foto doo ala taa pisi de. Ne den kisi en kii a koloisi.
eng_text: We are witnesses of everything he did both in the country of the Jews, and in Jerusalem; whom they also killed, hanging him on a tree.

djk_text: Ma baka dii dei, ne Masaa Gadu weki en kon a libi ya baka. Ne a meke a soi enseefi libilibi a son sama namo.
eng_text: God raised him up the third day, and gave him to be revealed,

djk_text: A ná a hii Dyu foluku a soi enseefi! Na den wan namo di Masaa Gadu seefi be fiti a fesi fu de enke kotoigi di si dati, fu taki baka. Na wi dati nyan diingi anga en, di a dede weki kon a libi ya baka.
eng_text: not to all the people, but to witnesses who were chosen before by God, to us, who ate and drank with him after he rose from the dead.

djk_text: Ne a sende wi fu paati en Bun Nyunsu gi a hii Dyu foluku. U mu leli den taki, ne en Masaa Gadu poti fu kuutu ibii sama. Den di de a libi ya ete anga den di dede kaba.
eng_text: He commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that this is he who is appointed by God as the Judge of the living and the dead.

djk_text: Masaa Gadu be piki fositen apaiti takiman fi en fu sikiifi taki ala dati taki, fu a wooko di dati du, da sama biibi en o fende paadon fu den takuudu anga ogii.”
eng_text: All the prophets testify about him, that through his name everyone who believes in him will receive remission of sins."

djk_text: Na so Peitilisi e taki. Namo, ne a Apaiti Jeje kon lai a hii libi fu den sama di e aliki de.
eng_text: While Peter was still speaking these words, the Holy Spirit fell on all those who heard the word.

djk_text: Den biibi Dyuwan di be kon anga Peitilisi ape foondoo. Bika den si taki, na a seefi gaanbigi bun, fa Masaa Gadu be gi den a Apaiti Jeje, na dati ai gi taa foluku de tu.
eng_text: They of the circumcision who believed were amazed, as many as came with Peter, because the gift of the Holy Spirit was also poured out on the Gentiles.

djk_text: Bika den yee den dati e gi Masaa Gadu gaandi a ini sowtu a sowtu taa kondee tongo di á de denseefi tongo. Namo Peitilisi taki,
eng_text: For they heard them speaking in other languages and magnifying God. Then Peter answered,

djk_text: “Efu Masaa Gadu e wooko a taa foluku ya so, da sama á poi peefuu taki, wi á mu dopu den! Bika ne en gi den a seefi Apaiti Jeje di a be gi u enke Dyusama tu.”
eng_text: Can any man forbid the water, that these who have received the Holy Spirit as well as we should not be baptized?

djk_text: Namo a meke den teke dopu a ini a nen fu Masaa Jesesi. Ne den kaba du a wooko di den kon du de. Ma den sama akisi den fu tan wantu dei moo anga den.
eng_text: He commanded them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they asked him to stay some days.

djk_text: We, biibi Dyusama anga den apaiti bosikopuman na a pisiwataa fu Judeja kisi fu yee fa taa foluku di á de Dyusama teke biibi a Masaa Gadu bosikopu de.
eng_text: Now the apostles and the brothers who were in Judea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.

djk_text: Di Peitilisi doo Jelusalem Foto, ne a sani ya tyai sitee fi en anga biibi Dyusama di e oli taki, taa foluku mu oli Dyuweiti fosi den sa teke biibi.
eng_text: When Peter had come up to Jerusalem, those who were of the circumcision contended with him,

djk_text: Ne den taki: “I go nyan makandii anga foluku di á de Dyu? I peefuu poti futu a sama osu di nái oli Dyuweiti!”
eng_text: saying, "You went in to uncircumcised men, and ate with them!"

djk_text: Ma Peitilisi teke ala san pasa seefi taigi den.
eng_text: But Peter began, and explained to them in order, saying,

djk_text: A taki: “Mi be de wan dei e begi a Jopa Foto. Te fu mi denki, ne mi e si jeje sani enke na deen. Wan sani enke wan gaan duku tei oli a den fo kanti fi en saka komoto a tapu e kon a doti, te kon doo a mi fesi.

Ne a taigi en fu sende sama go a Jopa Foto, go kai Simon di den e kai Peitilisi.	4108	He told us how he had seen the angel standing in his house, and saying to him, 'Send to Joppa, and get Simon, whose surname is Peter,
4109	Bika dati o gi en Masaa Gadu bosikopu fu yeepi en anga ala sama a ini en osu, wookoman fi en tu. Ala den o komoto na a pasi fu takuudu anga ogii, fu fende libi tego.”	4109	who will speak to you words by which you will be saved, you and all your house.'
4110	Peitilisi soi ete taki: “Di mi bigin taki sani fu Masaa Gadu, ne a Apaiti Jeje saka kon teke peesi a den libi, na a seefi fasi enke a fosi dei di dati be saka kon a wi enke Dyu.	4110	As I began to speak, the Holy Spirit fell on them, even as on us at the beginning.
4111	Namo a denki kon a mi, fu san Masaa Jesesi be taigi wi taki, Johanisi be e dopu sama anga wataa. Ma mi o dopu biibiwan anga a Apaiti Jeje.	4111	I remembered the word of the Lord, how he said, 'John indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit.'
4112	We, Masaa Gadu gi taa foluku a seefi gaanbigi bun de, enke fa a be gi wi Dyusama dati, fu a biibi a Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi ede! Mi á be poi tapu Masaa Gadu fu du dati.”	4112	If then God gave to them the same gift as us, when we believed in the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I, that I could withstand God?

djk_text: We, di Peitilisi e taki, da den aliki. Namo dati koo den ati, meke den gafa Masaa Gadu di meke taa foluku seefi poi daai libi, fu fende libi tego.
eng_text: When they heard these things, they held their peace, and glorified God, saying, "Then God has also granted to the Gentiles repentance to life!"

djk_text: A dede fu Stefanisi be meke biibiwan lowe komoto a Jelusalem Foto doo te a Finisiya pisiwataa. Wantu doo Antiyokiya Foto. Taawan abaa gwe a Sipolosi Tabiki a mindii ze. A ini a lowe, da den nái gi taa foluku Masaa Gadu bosikopu boiti Dyusama.
eng_text: They therefore who were scattered abroad by the oppression that arose about Stephen traveled as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, speaking the word to no one except to Jews only.

djk_text: Wantu biibi Sipolosi Kondee sama be de a ini a lowe. Wantu biibisama fu Sileni Kondee tu. Na den dati doo Antiyokiya Foto, ne den gi Giiki foluku a Bun Nyunsu fu Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: But there were some of them, men of Cyprus and Cyrene, who, when they had come to Antioch, spoke to the Hellenists, preaching the Lord Jesus.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Gadu wooko taanga, fu yeepi den anga a wooko ya. Ne wan gaan kulu Giiki sama teke a biibi.
eng_text: The hand of the Lord was with them, and a great number believed and turned to the Lord.

djk_text: Namo a toli ya paati go doo a kulu biibiwan a Jelusalem Foto. Ne den dati sende Balnabasi gwe na Antiyokiya Foto a den di toon biibiwan anda.
eng_text: The report concerning them came to the ears of the assembly which was in Jerusalem. They sent out Barnabas to go as far as Antioch,

djk_text: Di Balnabasi doo anda, da a si fa Masaa Gadu teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku den sama anda. Ne a piisii te, da ai waka e sende den taki: “Biibiwan! Poti na ati fu tan teke Masaa Jesesi taki, fu tan waka ne en baka. Da u oli so go doo!”
eng_text: who, when he had come, and had seen the grace of God, was glad. He exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they should remain near to the Lord.

djk_text: Bika Balnabasi be de wan bun libisama di sabi yeepi taawan. A Apaiti Jeje be teke en hii libi. A be abi taanga biibi a Masaa Jesesi tu. Namo moo anga moo sama e teke a biibi.
eng_text: For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Spirit and of faith, and many people were added to the Lord.

djk_text: Di a komoto de baka, ne a gwe te a Taasisi Foto go suku Sawlesi.
eng_text: Barnabas went out to Tarsus to look for Saul.

djk_text: Di a fende en, ne a tyai en kon na Antiyokiya Foto. Ne den tan wan hii yali de. A kulu biibiwan de be e wooko makandii anga den. Wan gaan kulu be de ape e leli sani fu Masaa Jesesi moo fini fini. Na a ten ya sama bigin kai biibiwan, Kelesten.
eng_text: When he had found him, he brought him to Antioch. It happened, that for a whole year they were gathered together with the assembly, and taught many people. The disciples were first called Christians in Antioch.

djk_text: Na a seefi yali ya, wantu biibiwan komoto a Jelusalem kon luku biibiwan na Antiyokiya Foto de. Na be biibiwan di Masaa Jesesi e piki san fu taki.
eng_text: Now in these days, prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.

djk_text: Namo a Apaiti Jeje piki wan fu den, den e kai Agabesi fa gaan angiiten de fu kon na a hii Dyu Kondee, go doo taa peesi di Loma kownu e tii. Ne a soi den taawan ape dati. A be pasa so tuu na a ten fu Kownu Kalawdiyosi.
eng_text: One of them named Agabus stood up, and indicated by the Spirit that there should be a great famine all over the world, which also happened in the days of Claudius.

djk_text: Ibii biibiwan ape be suku onmen sani a poi poti, fu sende go yeepi den biibiwan na a pisiwataa fu Judeja.
eng_text: As any of the disciples had plenty, each determined to send relief to the brothers who lived in Judea;

djk_text: Ne den sende den sani de letiso, go a den gaansama fu biibiwan keliki anda, fu paati gi den biibiwan. Balnabasi anga Sawlesi tyai en go gi den.
eng_text: which they also did, sending it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.

djk_text: A yuu de, da Kownu Helowdesi be opo fu kisi biibiwan pina anga ala sitaafu.
eng_text: Now about that time, King Herod stretched out his hands to oppress some of the assembly.

djk_text: Jakowbesi enke baala fu Johanisi dati a meke den teke satu fetihow doo en ede kii.
eng_text: He killed James, the brother of John, with the sword.

djk_text: A sani ya kai gi den Dyusama. Ne a gi en moo kankan fu du ogii anga biibiwan. Namo a sende kisi Peitilisi. Ma na ini a fesa pe Dyusama e nyan beele sondee sowda.
eng_text: When he saw that it pleased the Jews, he proceeded to seize Peter also. This was during the days of unleavened bread.

djk_text: Namo a meke den sooto en anga ala suudati fu oli wakiti ne en. Hiihii fo kulu suudati e oli wakiti kengi. Da a be poti fu tyai Peitilisi go na a foluku fesi, fu kaagi en kii, te a Pasika Fesa be o kai pasa.
eng_text: When he had arrested him, he put him in prison, and delivered him to four squads of four soldiers each to guard him, intending to bring him out to the people after the Passover.

djk_text: Namo a poti Peitilisi a dunguu osu de fosi. A ten de, a hii kulu biibiwan e begi yeepi gi en naamo.
eng_text: Peter therefore was kept in the prison, but constant prayer was made by the assembly to God for him.

djk_text: A neti be doo fu mamanten fi en, da a kownu be o tyai en go na a foluku fesi, fu kaagi. Peitilisi be didon e siibi a tu suudati mindii. Den bui en wanse ana miti a wan, a taase ana miti na a taawan. Doo mofu fu a dunguu osu baka, suudati taampu e oli wakiti.
eng_text: The same night when Herod was about to bring him out, Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains. Guards in front of the door kept the prison.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Gadu sende wan Masaa Gadu Kondee Basiya go a Peitilisi de. Ne a hii dunguu kambaa kiin anga faya! Ne a Basiya seke seke Peitilisi ne en bansa weki taki: “Opo!” Wantoon de seefi den keti koti komoto a Peitilisi ana kai a doti.
eng_text: And behold, an angel of the Lord stood by him, and a light shone in the cell. He struck Peter on the side, and woke him up, saying, "Stand up quickly!" His chains fell off from his hands.

djk_text: Ne a taigi Peitilisi taki: “Banti i mindii seeka i koosi a sikin! Teke i dalaila toosi fasi a futu.” Namo Peitilisi du ala dati. Ne a Masaa Gadu Kondee Basiya taki: “Toosi i yasi a sikin, da teke a mi baka.”
eng_text: The angel said to him, "Get dressed and put on your sandals." He did so. He said to him, "Put on your cloak, and follow me."

djk_text: Na so a waka ne en baka, te a doose! A hii sani ya e pasa, ma Peitilisi e si enke na jeje sani ai si en enke deen.
eng_text: And he went out and followed him. He didn't know that what was being done by the angel was real, but thought he saw a vision.

djk_text: Namo, den pasa a fosi peesi pe wakiti e oli. Den pasa di fu tu, go doo a insii doo, fu a gaan doo mofu, fu doo sitaati a ini a foto. Dati seefi wai opo waa. Ne a Masaa Gadu Kondee Basiya waka wan hii sitaati langa anga en, ne woo. Peitilisi á si en moo.
eng_text: When they were past the first and the second guard, they came to the iron gate that leads into the city, which opened to them by itself. They went out, and went down one street, and immediately the angel departed from him.

djk_text: Namo Peitilisi kisi enseefi taki: “Na Masaa Gadu sende wan Basiya fi en kon puu mi a ini Kownu Helowdesi ana. A puu mi na ala san a Dyu foluku be wani a du anga mi tamaa.”
eng_text: When Peter had come to himself, he said, "Now I truly know that the Lord has sent out his angel and delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from everything the Jewish people were expecting."

djk_text: Namo a taampu wegi luku san fu du. Ne a teke pasi langa te na a osu fu Maliya, a mma fu Johanisi, di den e kai Maakusi tu. Somen biibiwan be de ape e begi gi Peitilisi.
eng_text: Thinking about that, he came to the house of Mary, the mother of John whose surname was Mark, where many were gathered together and were praying.

djk_text: Namo Peitilisi koko a doo. Ne wan pikin umanpikin den e kai Lowdee, di e wooko na a osu de, kon aliki sama de ape.
eng_text: When Peter knocked at the door of the gate, a maid named Rhoda came to answer.

djk_text: Namo a piisii fu yee Peitilisi tongo na a baka doo. A piisii ya buuya en feegete fu opo a doo. Ma a lon go piki den biibiwan di e begi a ini osu taki: “Peitilisi de na a baka doo.”
eng_text: When she recognized Peter's voice, she didn't open the gate for joy, but ran in, and reported that Peter was standing in front of the gate.

djk_text: Ma den piki en anda taki: “Kaba anga a law taki de!” Ma ai tan taki so go doo. Ne den piki en baka taki: “Da kande na a Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee di de fu taampu gi en, kon de!”
eng_text: They said to her, "You are crazy!" But she insisted that it was so. They said, "It is his angel."

djk_text: Ma Peitilisi e koko naamo. Ne den go opo waka go na a doo, ne haa! Peitilisi de ape tuu! A foondoo den, fu taampu opo opo mofu.
eng_text: But Peter continued knocking. When they had opened, they saw him, and were amazed.

djk_text: Namo Peitilisi tapu ana a mofu, fu den á balibali na a peesi. Ne a taigi den fa Masaa Gadu puu en na a dunguu osu. Ne a sende den fu gi Jakowbesi a toli ya tu, soseefi ala den taa biibi baala. Namo, a komoto a Jelusalem Foto de.
eng_text: But he, beckoning to them with his hand to be silent, declared to them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. He said, "Tell these things to James, and to the brothers." Then he departed, and went to another place.

djk_text: Di peesi kiin, da gaan dyugu dyugu pasa a den suudati fu Helowdesi mindii. Den á poi fusutan san sa pasa anga Peitilisi.
eng_text: Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers about what had become of Peter.

djk_text: Helowdesi meke den suku en na a hii peesi, sondee wini. Ne a go ondoosuku den suudati di be oli wakiti a neti de. Bakadati, a meke den kii den. Ne enseefi komoto wan pisiten a Judeja pisiwataa de go fosi a Sesaleya Foto.
eng_text: When Herod had sought for him, and didn't find him, he examined the guards, and commanded that they should be put to death. He went down from Judea to Caesarea, and stayed there.

djk_text: A ten de, Helowdesi ati be e boon a sama fu Tilosi Foto anga Sidon Foto. Ne den miti mofu kon begi en. Bika ne en e seli nyanyan gi den. Den meke moiti fende Balastesi, wan ondooman di e wooko te a ini Helowdesi kambaa, fu yeepi den meke den anga en kon de switi baka.
eng_text: Now Herod was very angry with the people of Tyre and Sidon. They came with one accord to him, and, having made Blastus, the king's personal aide, their friend, they asked for peace, because their country depended on the king's country for food.

djk_text: Namo Helowdesi poti wan dei fu piisii makandii na a kondee. A dei de, ne a wei en moi kownu koosi, teke peesi ne en kownu sutuu. Da ai taki anga den somen sama di be kon dyunta de.
eng_text: On an appointed day, Herod dressed himself in royal clothing, sat on the throne, and gave a speech to them.

djk_text: Da den sama e bali gafa en taki: “Yu di e taki de, a ná sama! Yu na wan gadu seefi tongo e taki de.”
eng_text: The people shouted, "The voice of a god, and not of a man!"

djk_text: We, da na so Helowdesi be e peefuu, fu teke Masaa Gadu peesi. Ne Masaa Gadu sende wan Masaa Gadu Kondee Basiya fi en, go naki en wan gaan siki kii, anga woon.
eng_text: Immediately an angel of the Lord struck him, because he didn't give God the glory, and he was eaten by worms and died.

djk_text: A ten ya, a Bun Nyunsu fu Masaa Gadu nái paati fu soso na a peesi.
eng_text: But the word of God grew and multiplied.

djk_text: Balnabasi anga Sawlesi be tyai a moni go, di biibiwan fu Antiyokiya Foto be piki sende gi biibiwan fu Jelusalem Foto. Ne den daai komoto anda baka. Namo den tyai Johanisi di den e kai Maakusi tu anga den.
eng_text: Barnabas and Saul returned to Jerusalem, when they had fulfilled their service, also taking with them John whose surname was Mark.

djk_text: Da a ini a kulu biibiwan fu Antiyokiya, da i be abi apaiti takiman anga leliman. Den be de: Balnabasi; Simiyon, di den e kai Nigeli ; Lusiyasi fu Sileni Kondee; Manayen, di kiya makandii anga Helowdesi, gaaman fu wan fu den fo pisi fu Dyu Kondee; Sawlesi tu.
eng_text: Now in the assembly that was at Antioch there were some prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon who was called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen the foster brother of Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.

djk_text: Wan dei, ala den dati teke fu tan makandii anga angii fu begi. Namo a Apaiti Jeje piki den de taki, a o teke Balnabasi anga Sawlesi go bigin du wan apaiti wooko di a be kai den toon biibisama, fu du.
eng_text: As they served the Lord and fasted, the Holy Spirit said, "Separate Barnabas and Saul for me, for the work to which I have called them."

djk_text: Namo, den tan begi doo anga angii. Soseefi den poti ana begi gi Balnabasi anga Sawlesi. Bakadati, ne den meke den go bigin a apaiti wooko.
eng_text: Then, when they had fasted and prayed and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.

djk_text: Na so a Apaiti Jeje sende den gwe. Namo den gwe a waka tapu doo Selusiya Foto. Ne den koti a ze go kai a Sipolosi, a tabiki kondee a mindii anda.
eng_text: So, being sent out by the Holy Spirit, they went down to Seleucia. From there they sailed to Cyprus.

djk_text: Den kai a Salamesi Foto de. Ne den sete go a den Dyu keliki ape, fu gi a Bun Nyunsu de. Johanisi be e waka anga den fu yeepi den wooko.
eng_text: When they were at Salamis, they proclaimed the word of God in the Jewish synagogues. They had also John as their attendant.

djk_text: Den teke fu waka lontu a hii tabiki kondee ya go kai a taase fi en a Paafosi Foto. Namo den miti wan tofuuman de, den e kai Baljesesi. A be de wan Dyusama. Ma a be e lei taki, en na apaiti takiman anga kaakiti fu Masaa Gadu piki en san fu taki.
eng_text: When they had gone through the island to Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew, whose name was Bar Jesus,

djk_text: A be e wooko anga Gaaman Selkiyesi Pawlesi fu a peesi de. A gaaman ya e wooko anga fusutan fu du sani. Namo a yee taki, Balnabasi anga Sawlesi e paati Masaa Gadu bosikopu, ne a sende kai den fu yee san den e taki.
eng_text: who was with the proconsul, Sergius Paulus, a man of understanding. This man summoned Barnabas and Saul, and sought to hear the word of God.

djk_text: Namo Elimasi toto futu fu buuya a sani ya. Dati na a nen Baljesesi enke a tofuuman a ini Giiki Tongo. Ai dyombo a mindii fu leli a gaaman sani, fu a á sa teke a biibi.
eng_text: But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation) withstood them, seeking to turn aside the proconsul from the faith.

djk_text: Namo Sawlesi di den e kai Pawlesi tu, be lai anga Apaiti Jeje. Ne a luku a tofuuman dunn.
eng_text: But Saul, who is also called Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, fastened his eyes on him,

djk_text: Ne a taigi en taki: “Manpikin fu didibii! I fuu anga koli bidiigi fasi! Yu e lei taki, sani fu Masaa Gadu á de tuu! I mu kon kaba anga a fasi de! Yu feyantiman fu ala bunbun sani!
eng_text: and said, "Full of all deceit and all cunning, you son of the devil, you enemy of all righteousness, will you not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?

djk_text: Luku ya! Masaa Gadu daai feti anga yu baka! I beendi fu wan hii pisiten. I kaba si sani fosi!” Wanten de, Elimasi si peesi e dunguu, fu te a nái si sani moo. A kon fu ai waka e fiifii lontu suku sama fu tyai en puu de.
eng_text: Now, behold, the hand of the Lord is on you, and you will be blind, not seeing the sun for a season!" Immediately a mist and darkness fell on him. He went around seeking someone to lead him by the hand.

djk_text: Namo a gaaman si san pasa ya. Soseefi a aliki a leli fu Masaa Gadu. A sani bigi gi en, namo wanten a teke biibi.
eng_text: Then the proconsul, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the teaching of the Lord.

djk_text: Namo Pawlesi anga den taawan di anga en e wooko abaa a ze baka na ape. Den komoto a Paafosi go te a Pelika Foto na a pisiwataa fu Pamfiliya. Namo Johanisi á wani go doo anga den, ne a daai baka gwe a Jelusalem Foto.
eng_text: Now Paul and his company set sail from Paphos, and came to Perga in Pamphylia. John departed from them and returned to Jerusalem.

djk_text: Ne den Pawlesi go doo Pelika Foto. Den gwe moo faawe a soo seefi na a Antiyokiya Foto fu Pisidiya pisiwataa. Fa i si Dyu kina dei doo, den gwe a ini wan Dyu keliki go sidon anga Dyusama de.
eng_text: But they, passing on from Perga, came to Antioch of Pisidia. They went into the synagogue on the Sabbath day, and sat down.

djk_text: Namo Dyusama de leisi a ini den weiti buku fu Mosesi anga buku di taa fositen apaiti takiman be sikiifi. Ne fesiman fu keliki de meke den taigi den Pawlesi taki: “Baala! Pasi de gi sama di abi wan sani fu tyai kon a fesi, fu gi taawan nyun kaakiti ya.”
eng_text: After the reading of the law and the prophets, the rulers of the synagogue sent to them, saying, "Brothers, if you have any word of exhortation for the people, speak."

djk_text: Namo Pawlesi opo taampu taki, a abi sani fu taki. Ne a taki: “Dyusama fu mi ya! Ala taa foluku ya, di e lesipeki a Gadu fu Dyusama! U aliki!
eng_text: Paul stood up, and beckoning with his hand said, "Men of Israel, and you who fear God, listen.

djk_text: Na Masaa Gadu di u e dini ya be teke u Dyusama avo toon sama fi enseefi. Ne a meke den goo toon wan gaan foluku enke saafu, a sama kondee Egepte. A meke den toon wan taanga foluku anda, di a puu a saafu anga en makiti.
eng_text: The God of this people chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they stayed as aliens in the land of Egypt, and with an uplifted arm, he led them out of it.

djk_text: Ne a tyai den hiihii fotenti yali langa a ini a gaan sabana anga ala fa den be e taanga yesi gi en. Ma a teke ala dati anga langa pasensi te go doo Kanahan Kondee.
eng_text: For a period of about forty years he put up with them in the wilderness.

djk_text: A kondee de be abi taanga foluku e tan de kaba. Ne hiihii seibin fu den di Masaa Gadu yeepi den wini, figi puu a pasi, teke a kondee di a be paamisi den gi den fu denseefi.
eng_text: When he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan, he gave them their land for an inheritance, for about four hundred fifty years.

djk_text: Na so fo ondoo anga feifitenti yali kon pasa. Ne a bigin gi den taanga tiiman, fu tyai den feti anga den feyanti, te enke a lasiti wan fu den. Dati na Samuweli enke apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: After these things he gave them judges until Samuel the prophet.

djk_text: Baka fi en, ne den á wani a sowtu tiiman ya moo. Den wani kownu, ne den begi Masaa Gadu dati. Namo a piki taki: ‘Teke Sawl poti kownu.’ Dati paansu waka na a lo fu Benyameni di dda de Kesi. Sawl tii den hii fotenti yali langa.
eng_text: Afterward they asked for a king, and God gave to them Saul the son of Kish, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, for forty years.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Gadu puu en na a kownu wooko poti Dafeti toon kownu. A lobi a Dafeti ya te, ne a taki: ‘Yu Dafeti! Manpikin fu Isai, i kai a mi ati. Bika yu e waka enke fa mi wani.’
eng_text: When he had removed him, he raised up David to be their king, to whom he also testified, 'I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after my heart, who will do all my will.'

djk_text: “A Yeepiman fu a Dyu foluku na Jesesi. Bika a meke na paansu sama fu a Dafeti ya, enke fa Masaa Gadu be paamisi Dafeti seefi.
eng_text: From this man's seed, God has brought salvation to Israel according to his promise,

djk_text: Fosi a bigin en wooko, ne Masaa Gadu sende Johanisi du wan wooko ne en fesi. A bali bosikopu fu sama kon teke dopu, fu daai libi. Meke Masaa Gadu sa gi den paadon, fu ogii di den du pasa kaba.
eng_text: before his coming, when John had first preached the baptism of repentance to Israel.

djk_text: Di Johanisi se wooko de fu kaba, ne a taki: ‘U tan luku, wan taawan o kon du en se wooko a du fu mi baka. Na dati na a Kelestesi fu tyai yeepi! A dyendee te, mi á waiti sai fu puu susu a futu gi en seefi enke saafu.’ ”
eng_text: As John was fulfilling his course, he said, 'What do you suppose that I am? I am not he. But behold, one comes after me the sandals of whose feet I am not worthy to untie.'

djk_text: Namo Pawlesi soi ete taki: “Mi Dyusama ya di de paansu sama fu Abalaham! Soseefi taa foluku ya, di e lesipeki a Gadu fu Dyusama. Masaa Gadu bosikopu doo wi ya, fu tyai yeepi.
eng_text: Brothers, children of the stock of Abraham, and those among you who fear God, the word of this salvation is sent out to you.

djk_text: Dyusama a Jelusalem Foto anga fesiman anda á be biibi. Den fende taki, a fiti fu kii. Ma na san Masaa Gadu be piki fositen apaiti takiman fu sikiifi taki, musu fu pasa. Den di kii en e fende ala dati e leisi ibii Dyu dei a den keliki sondee fusutan.
eng_text: For those who dwell in Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they didn't know him, nor the voices of the prophets which are read every Sabbath, fulfilled them by condemning him.

djk_text: Den á be fende wan enkii fowtu fu kii en so. Ma anga ala dati, toku den begi Gaaman Pilatesi fu kii en gi den.
eng_text: Though they found no cause for death, they still asked Pilate to have him killed.

djk_text: “Na so den du ala san Masaa Gadu be piki fositen apaiti takiman fu sikiifi taki, musu fu pasa. Te doo kii en a koloisi seefi, ne den puu en tyai go beli na a sowtu geebi di u gwenti beli dede.
eng_text: When they had fulfilled all things that were written about him, they took him down from the tree, and laid him in a tomb.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Gadu weki en kon a libi ya baka.
eng_text: But God raised him from the dead,

djk_text: Ne a soi enseefi a den bakaman fi en somen leisi. Den dati be komoto a Galileya kon a Jelusalem Foto anga en, fosi den be kii en. Na den dati de kotoigi di si, fu waka taigi a hii Dyu foluku nownow.
eng_text: and he was seen for many days by those who came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses to the people.

djk_text: “Na ala dati mi anga den di e wooko anga mi ya e taigi u nownow. San Masaa Gadu be paamisi wi avo pasa nownow gi wi Dyu enke paansu fu den. Gi taa foluku seefi di e lesipeki a biibi fu Dyu. U ala mu sabi taki, Masaa Gadu weki Jesesi kon a libi ya baka. Masaa Gadu be piki en apaiti takiman a sani ya fu sikiifi a di fu tu Psalm taki: ‘Mi Manpikin! Yu meke a goontapu ya tide, fu ala ain sa si yu, di de fu tii ala san mi abi.’
eng_text: We bring you good news of the promise made to the fathers,

djk_text: Namo a weki en kon a libi ya baka, fu noiti moo poi dede. En sikin seefi noiti a fika loto poli tu. A be piki apaiti takiman a fositen fu sikiifi dati taki: ‘A seigi di mi be paamisi Dafeti, fu Awan di libi de apaiti fasi, musu fu kon pasa.’
eng_text:
Concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he has spoken thus: 'I will give you the holy and sure blessings of David.'
