eng_text: of whom are the fathers, and from whom is Christ as concerning the flesh, who is over all, God, blessed forever. Amen.

djk_text: We, ala den á fende a yeepi di Masaa Gadu be paamisi den. Ma a fowtu fu dati á de a Masaa Gadu. Bika na di a nái si ala den fu kai Islayeli.
eng_text: But it is not as though the word of God has come to nothing. For they are not all Israel, that are of Israel.

djk_text: Soseefi a nái si ala den fu kai pikin fu Abalaham, anga ala fa libisama fasi, den de paansu sama fu Abalaham! Bika a paamisi be taki: “Na a paansu sama fu Isaki namo mi o kai yu bakapikin.”
eng_text: Neither, because they are Abraham's seed, are they all children. But, "In Isaac will your seed be called."

djk_text: Dati taki, a ná paansu sama di Abalaham meke libisama fasi. Ma na a paansu sama, di biibi Masaa Gadu paamisi tyai gi Abalaham.
eng_text: That is, it is not the children of the flesh who are children of God, but the children of the promise are counted as a seed.

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu be paamisi taki: “Abalaham! Te a leti yuu fu mi doo, da mi o kon baka. Da yu uman Sala o meke wan manpikin.”
eng_text: For this is a word of promise, "At the appointed time I will come, and Sarah will have a son."

djk_text: We, ne a meke wi avo gaansama Isaki, di toon manengee, ne a gi en uman Lebeka bee, fu wan toolengi manpikin.
eng_text: Not only so, but Rebecca also conceived by one, by our father Isaac.

djk_text: Da den tu pikin be de a bee ete, sondee fu du bun ofu ogii. Ne Masaa Gadu be fiti poti de kaba, fu du en wooko go doo anga wan fu den, fika a taawan.
eng_text: For being not yet born, neither having done anything good or bad, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him who calls,

djk_text: A á be teke awan de wooko, fu di a be bun moo a taawan. Ma na di enseefi be fiti poti kaba, fu teke awan fika a taawan. Bika den be de a bee ete, di a piki a mma fu den taki: “Di moo yonkuwan o de basi fu a moo gaanwan, di fosi meke.”
eng_text: it was said to her, "The elder will serve the younger."

djk_text: Na soseefi, a be piki apaiti takiman a fositen, fu sikiifi taki: “Na mi seefi lobi wooko anga Jakopu, fika Esaw di de moo gaanwan.”
eng_text: Even as it is written, "Jacob I loved, but Esau I hated."

djk_text: We, da sama o piki mi de taki: “Da Masaa Gadu nái wooko anga leti!” Ma kaba anga a denki de!
eng_text: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? May it never be!

djk_text: Bika a be piki Mosesi taki: “Na mi e teke taawan wooko fika taawan. Na mi e teke tyali ati fasi luku sama di mi wani.”
eng_text: For he said to Moses, "I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion."

djk_text: Da fa ai wooko nái go anga libisama wani. A nái de moiti di sama seefi meke tu. Ma ne en seefi e teke tyali ati gi sama sani di denseefi á wooko fu fende.
eng_text: So then it is not of him who wills, nor of him who runs, but of God who has mercy.

djk_text: Bika en Buku sikiifi fa a taigi Fala-ow taki: “Na mi seefi gi yu makiti de. Da mi o wooko anga mi makiti, meke hii goontapu sa si fa mi de Masaa Gadu anga ala makiti.”
eng_text: For the Scripture says to Pharaoh, "For this very purpose I caused you to be raised up, that I might show in you my power, and that my name might be proclaimed in all the earth."

djk_text: Dati taki, a teke tyali ati fasi luku taawan, fu yeepi den. Ma enseefi baka e taanga taawan yesi, fu sitee anga en.
eng_text: So then, he has mercy on whom he desires, and he hardens whom he desires.

djk_text: Da sama o piki mi de taki: “Da Masaa Gadu á mu kaagi sama di e taanga yesi. Bika ne enseefi poti a sama fu wooko so, da a sama ná o poi wooko taa fasi.”
eng_text: You will say then to me, "Why does he still find fault? For who withstands his will?"

djk_text: Ma mi e piki yu de taki: “Yu libisama á bigi sai fu sitee taki anga Masaa Gadu. Yu ná o daai fa a poti fu wooko. Bika tokotoko di sama e teke meke patu ya nái poi taigi a sama de taki: ‘Yu á meke mi bun.’ ”
eng_text: But indeed, O man, who are you to reply against God? Will the thing formed ask him who formed it, "Why did you make me like this?"

djk_text: Bika na a sama e wooko enke basi fu daai a tokotoko toon a patu di enseefi wani. Wan taa leisi baka, da ai daai en toon taa sowtu patu. Ai meke dyendee wan, ai meke di á kaba dyendee so.
eng_text: Or hasn't the potter a right over the clay, from the same lump to make one part a vessel for honor, and another for dishonor?

djk_text: Na so Masaa Gadu de basi fu wooko fa enseefi wani, fu meke goontapu si en gaan atiboon, anga ala en makiti di o kaba sama a soso. Ma ai oli langa pasensi anga sama nownow.
eng_text: What if God, willing to show his wrath, and to make his power known, endured with much patience vessels of wrath made for destruction,

djk_text: Da ai teke tyali ati fasi luku wan apaiti kulu sama. Den dati o si en gaan dyendee fasi, di a be poti fu gi den fosi a be meke goontapu ya seefi. A o gi den gaandi makandii anga enseefi.
eng_text: and that he might make known the riches of his glory on vessels of mercy, which he prepared beforehand for glory,

djk_text: Dati na wi, di a kai kon teke biibi, toon sama fi enseefi. Na wi ai kai en osu sama, di de Dyusama mokisa anga ala taa sowtu foluku tu.
eng_text: us, whom he also called, not from the Jews only, but also from the Gentiles?

djk_text: A be piki en apaiti takiman Hoseya a fositen, fu sikiifi taki: “Sama di á be de mi foluku, ne mi teke toon mi foluku. Sama di be de mi buuseman, ne mi teke toon sama di mi lobi.”
eng_text: As he says also in Hosea, "I will call them 'my people,' which were not my people; and her 'beloved,' who was not beloved."

djk_text: Soseefi a sikiifi taki: “Peesi be de, pe mi sama á be de. Ma den dati o toon peesi, pe sama o de fu kai pikin fu a libilibi Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: It will be that in the place where it was said to them, 'You are not my people,' There they will be called 'children of the living God.'

djk_text: Ma a be piki en apaiti takiman Jesaja, a fositen, fu bali taki: “Dyusama di de Islayeli sama ipi enke santi fu liba di á poi teli. Ma na wantu namo o fende a yeepi fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Isaiah cries concerning Israel, "If the number of the children of Israel are as the sand of the sea, it is the remnant who will be saved;

djk_text: Bika fa a paamisi fu sitaafu Islayeli sama a Dyu Kondee de nái daai daai, fu kon doo. Ibiiwan fiya o fende en paiman de, fu takuudu anga ogii.”
eng_text: for He will finish the work and cut it short in righteousness, because the LORD will make a short work upon the earth."

djk_text: A be piki Jesaja fu sikiifi ete taki: “We! Masaa Sebaot makiti bigi tumisi, fu sitaafu. Da fi enseefi á be teke fu yeepi, da na a hii Dyu paansu sama be o kaba a soso. Sani be o waka enke Sowdom Foto di a be boon, figi puu a goontapu. Da goontapu be o piki taki, na so a be du anga Gomola Foto tu.”
eng_text: As Isaiah has said before, "Unless the Lord of Armies had left us a seed, we would have become like Sodom, and would have been made like Gomorrah."

djk_text: Da u sa taki, taa foluku di á be abi fasi fu toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu, ne biibi tyai dati gi den sama de.
eng_text: What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, who didn't follow after righteousness, attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith;

djk_text: Ma Dyusama, na Masaa Gadu weiti den e oli, fu toon bun sama gi en. Da na dati e tyai dyakata gi den.
eng_text: but Israel, following after a law of righteousness, didn't arrive at the law of righteousness.

djk_text: Da yu o piki mi de taki: “Fa dati kan?” Da mi e piki taki: “We, den nái wooko anga biibi, ma anga weiti. Ne den gei sama di misi pasi, soseefi puu pakisei a wan siton di poti tapu pasi de. We, ne a dyakata den towe.”
eng_text: Why? Because they didn't seek it by faith, but as it were by works of the law. They stumbled over the stumbling stone;

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu be meke en Buku sikiifi taki: “Luku ya! Mi poti wan siton a Siyon de, fu dyakata sama towe. Ma sama di poti biibi ne en tapu noiti o kai a sen.”
eng_text: even as it is written, "Behold, I lay in Zion a stumbling stone and a rock of offense; and no one who believes in him will be disappointed."

djk_text: Mi lobi biibiwan! A angii bigi a mi ati seefi, fu si a yeepi ya go doo mi eigi foluku enke Dyusama. Mi e begi Masaa Gadu seefi, fu dati.
eng_text: Brothers, my heart's desire and my prayer to God is for Israel, that they may be saved.

djk_text: Bika mi de kotoigi fu si taki, den dyadya fu du sani fu Masaa Gadu. Ma den nái kaba fusutan sani fi en sai, meke wini á de gi den.
eng_text: For I testify about them that they have a zeal for God, but not according to knowledge.

djk_text: Den á poi si taki, ne enseefi mu seeka den toon bun sama gi enseefi. Ne den teke weiti e wooko fu fende yeepi, meke den lasi fa a wani wooko anga den.
eng_text: For being ignorant of God's righteousness, and seeking to establish their own righteousness, they didn't subject themselves to the righteousness of God.

djk_text: Bika na Kelestesi kon, fu tapu a wooko di weiti be abi. Da na biibi en e seeka sama kon bun gi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: For Christ is the fulfillment of the law for righteousness to everyone who believes.

djk_text: Bika Mosesi seefi be sikiifi on ten weiti sa seeka sama kon bun. A taki: “Na sondee fowtu i mu wooko anga den weiti fosi, da i sa fende libi tego.”
eng_text: For Moses writes about the righteousness of the law, "The one who does them will live by them."

djk_text: Namo a sikiifi tu fa biibi sa seeka sama kon bun. A wasikoi taki: “Ná denki taki, da na Masaa Gadu Kondee a tapu u mu meke sama subi go suku yeepi.” Dati mu soi taki, u seefi ná abi fu subi go saka a Kelestesi puu anda, kon du dati ya.
eng_text: But the righteousness which is of faith says this, "Don't say in your heart, 'Who will ascend into heaven?' (that is, to bring Christ down);

djk_text: Soseefi a sikiifi taki: “Ná denki taki, da na a moo dipi pisi fu ondoo doti u mu meke sama saka go.” Dati e soi taki, u seefi ná abi fu saka gwe anda go opo a Kelestesi kon du dati ya.
eng_text: or, 'Who will descend into the abyss?' (that is, to bring Christ up from the dead.)"

djk_text: Kweti! A sikiifi taki: “Wowtu di Masaa Gadu taki á de faawe. Ibiiwan mofu sa fende dati taki baka. Ibiiwan ati sa fende dati teke oli poti de, fu fusutan.” Bika dati na Masaa Gadu nyunsu di wi e bali lontu goontapu nownow.
eng_text: But what does it say? "The word is near you, in your mouth, and in your heart"; that is, the word of faith, which we preach:

djk_text: A bosikopu de, na fu taigi taawan taki, Jesesi na Masaa a tapu fu ala taawan. Da u ati mu abi a biibi fa Masaa Gadu weki en kon a libi ya baka. Da u seeka kon toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu kaba.
eng_text: that if you will confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord, and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved.

djk_text: Bika te ati abi biibi, da yu e kon toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu. Soseefi, te yu e taigi taawan fa Jesesi de Masaa a tapu fu ala taawan, da yu o fende libi tego.
eng_text: For with the heart, one believes unto righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation.

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu Buku be sikiifi taki: “Ibiiwan di biibi, noiti sa kai a sen.”
eng_text: For the Scripture says, "Whoever believes in him will not be disappointed."

djk_text: Luku fa a sikiifi taki: “Ibiiwan di biibi.” Na Dyusama, soseefi taa foluku di á de Dyu, ai si den a seefi fasi. Bika na wan kodo Masaa namo de gi ala sama. Na dati meke ibiiwan sa fende seigi, te den kai en fu suku yeepi.
eng_text: For there is no distinction between Jew and Greek; for the same Lord is Lord of all, and is rich to all who call on him.

djk_text: Bika en Buku piki u taki: “Ibiiwan di begi kai Masaa fu suku yeepi, a o yeepi dati.”
eng_text: For, "Whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved."

djk_text: Ma yu o akisi mi de baka taki: “Fa den sa begi kai a Masaa de, ma den á be biibi san a kon du? Fa den sa biibi, ma den á be yee fi en? Fa den sa yee fi en, ma sama á be go bolotyasi en bosikopu gi den?
eng_text: How then will they call on him in whom they have not believed? How will they believe in him whom they have not heard? How will they hear without a preacher?

djk_text: Fa fu go bolotyasi en bosikopu, ma enseefi á sende yu go?” Ma kaba anga den sowtu denki de! Bika en Buku piki u taki: “Bali baya! Den di a sende anga en bosikopu futu kisi de. Da piisii seefi.”
eng_text: And how will they preach unless they are sent? As it is written: "How beautiful are the feet of those who preach the Good News of peace, who bring glad tidings of good things!"

djk_text: Ma na di ala den á biibi a Bun Nyunsu ya. Bika Jesaja piki dati a Masaa Gadu Buku taki: “Masaa! Wi tyai yu bosikopu go, ma den á biibi.”
eng_text: But they didn't all listen to the glad news. For Isaiah says, "Lord, who has believed our report?"

djk_text: Bika fu a biibi mu kon, da yesi mu poti ne en bosikopu. Da u sa fusutan a wowtu Kelestesi di a sende gi wi.
eng_text: So faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.

djk_text: Ma mi e piki taki, na yee den á yee dati? Kweti! Bika apaiti takiman sikiifi dati piki a fositen taki: “Na hii goontapu, apaiti bosikopuman waka bolotyasi. Ne faawe kondee seefi yee wowtu di a sende den fu taki.”
eng_text: But I say, didn't they hear? Yes, most certainly, "Their sound went out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world."

djk_text: Da mi e piki baka taki: “Ne Islayeli a Dyu Kondee á fusutan dati? Kweti! Bika Mosesi sikiifi piki baka taki: ‘Dyusama! U o dyalusu anga taa foluku di u nái teli enke mi foluku. U ati o bita a den di u e si enke á sabi noti fu mi.’ ”
eng_text: But I ask, didn't Israel know? First Moses says, "I will provoke you to jealousy with that which is no nation, with a nation void of understanding I will make you angry."

djk_text: Soseefi Jesaja peefuu sikiifi baka taki: “Taa foluku noiti be e suku fu fende mi, fu dini, ma den o kon sabi mi. Noiti den be e pakisei luku sama mi de, ma mi o soi den mi seefi.”
eng_text: Isaiah is very bold, and says, "I was found by those who didn't seek me. I was revealed to those who didn't ask for me."

djk_text: Ma a be sikiifi piki Islayeli taki: “Hii dei mi e langa ana fu go seeka a taanga yesi foluku ya. Ma den e sitee anga mi naamo.”
eng_text: But as to Israel he says, "All day long I stretched out my hands to a disobedient and contrary people."

djk_text: Ma u sa akisi mi de taki: “Da Masaa Gadu á fika en foluku, no?” Kweti! Mi di ai wooko ya ete, na Islayeli sama fu Dyu Kondee tu. Enke paansu sama fu Abalaham, da mi komoto na a lo sama den e kai Benyameni sama.
eng_text: I ask then, did God reject his people? May it never be! For I also am an Israelite, a descendant of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.

djk_text: Da kweti! Masaa Gadu á poi fika en foluku. Bika a be sabi den a fesi, fosi a be teke den toon fi enseefi. Denki a toli fu Masaa Gadu Buku di Eliya be go kaagi den Dyusama gi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: God didn't reject his people, which he foreknew. Or don't you know what the Scripture says about Elijah? How he pleads with God against Israel:

djk_text: Da Eliya be taki: “Dyusama e kii apaiti takiman, di yu o sende go a den. Den e booko a apaiti begi tafaa, pe meti e boon, enke paiman, fu begi yu paadon. Da na mi wawan fika na a kondee. Ne den e suku fu kii mi baka.”
eng_text: Lord, they have killed your prophets, they have broken down your altars; and I am left alone, and they seek my life.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Gadu be piki en taki: “Kweti! A ná yu wawan fika! Mi e si ete seibin dunsu osu, di e teli enke sama fu mi ete. Denseefi á teke fu dini Baal, a falisi gadu.”
eng_text: But how does God answer him? "I have reserved for myself seven thousand men, who have not bowed the knee to Baal."

djk_text: Da na letiso tide seefi wantu Dyusama e biibi ete. Ne a teke den disi e kai osu sama fi enseefi, di a teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku.
eng_text: Even so then at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.

djk_text: Da na gaan bun ati fasi namo di a teke luku u, meke a gi u a bun ya. Da u á poi taki, u wooko fu fende dati. Bika, da u á be o poi kai dati, a teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku wi.
eng_text: And if by grace, then it is no longer of works; otherwise grace is no longer grace. But if it is of works, it is no longer grace; otherwise work is no longer work.

djk_text: Da u sa piki a toli ya taki, a bun de na di hii Islayeli e feti fu fende. Ma denseefi moiti noiti poi doo peesi, fu fende dati. Ne Masaa Gadu teke wantu fu den namo gi dati, ne a fika a moo gaanse fu den, sondee fu poi fusutan dati.
eng_text: What then? That which Israel seeks for, that he didn't obtain, but the chosen ones obtained it, and the rest were hardened.

djk_text: Na fu dati apaiti takiman be sikiifi a fositen taki: “A fika den, enke den kai a siibi. Da den ain nái si, den yesi nái yee, fu fusutan sani fi en. Na so Dyusama tan, te enke tide seefi.”
eng_text: According as it is written, "God gave them a spirit of stupor, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear, to this very day."

djk_text: Dafeti seefi be sikiifi fu dati taki: “Meke weiti gei tafaa sete gi den, fu go nyan. Ma na sani fu kisi den enke kaapana. Den o naki futu na a siton, di poti tapu pasi anda, meke den dyakata so. Da den sa fende a paiman di fiti den.
eng_text: David says, "Let their table be made a snare, and a trap, a stumbling block, and a retribution to them.

djk_text: Meke den ain dunguu, da den á sa fusutan sani fi yu. Da taanga ten sa banowtu den naamo, fu den tyai.”
eng_text: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see. Bow down their back always."

djk_text: Ma mi e akisi miseefi taki: “Sama di naki futu e dyakata kai, ma a ná fu tan didon fika de?” Da mi e piki taki: “Kweti!” Bika di Dyusama á biibi, ne Masaa Gadu yeepi go doo taa foluku. Meke a sa tyai dyalusu gi den, fu suku a yeepi de tu.
eng_text: I ask then, did they stumble that they might fall? May it never be! But by their fall salvation has come to the Gentiles, to provoke them to jealousy.

djk_text: Da na a ogii fu den, meke yeepi go doo taa foluku. Na di den dyakata, ne taa foluku fende pasi kon taampu. We, da di den o taampu baka, no? Da dati musu moo tyai bun gi taa foluku.
eng_text: Now if their fall is the riches of the world, and their loss the riches of the Gentiles; how much more their fullness?

djk_text: Da mi e taigi u taa foluku biibiwan de taki, na mi Masaa Gadu gi en taki enke apaiti bosikopuman, fu gi u de. Na wan dyendee sani di mi e teke fu bigi.
eng_text: For I speak to you who are Gentiles. Since then as I am an apostle to Gentiles, I glorify my ministry;

djk_text: Ma mi wani mi eigi foluku si a u, fa ai wooko anga u de. Meke a sa tyai dyalusu gi den, fu suku a yeepi de tu. Da mi o fende pasi yeepi wantu fu den.
eng_text: if by any means I may provoke to jealousy those who are my flesh, and may save some of them.

djk_text: Bika na di Dyusama dyakata, ne a yeepi go doo hii goontapu. Da di den o seeka kon taampu baka, da dati musu moo tyai bun gi goontapu. A piisii de o bigi enke na wan sama be dede, ne Masaa Gadu go weki en baka.
eng_text: For if the rejection of them is the reconciling of the world, what would their acceptance be, but life from the dead?

djk_text: Den moo gaandi avo Dyu gaansama, na lutu fu a hii Dyu. Na apaiti sama gi Masaa Gadu. Ne a hii paansu sama fu den toon fu Masaa Gadu. Bika te fosi pisi nyanyan fu goon puu gi Masaa Gadu daa, da a hii goon toon fi en. Lutu fu bon di paandi gi en, da ala taka, ala uwii fu a bon, toon fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: If the first fruit is holy, so is the lump. If the root is holy, so are the branches.

djk_text: Da wan nongo e koti gi taa foluku biibiwan. A taki, na di haw taka fu a bon nái puu bunbun sii, ne den koti den puu poti a wanse. Ne yu enke busi bon taka fende pasi go sutu nama goo na a bon de, fu fende kaakiti de, fu puu bunbun sii.
eng_text: But if some of the branches were broken off, and you, being a wild olive, were grafted in among them, and became partaker with them of the root and of the richness of the olive tree;

djk_text: Da ná meke bigi anga Dyusama. Ma sabi taki, a ná busi bon taka di fende pasi nama goo de, e gi a lutu kaakiti. Ma na a lutu e gi den taka kaakiti.
eng_text: don't boast over the branches. But if you boast, it is not you who support the root, but the root supports you.

djk_text: Ma kande yu o meke bigi taki, i de wan sani! Bika a nongo e taki, son haw taka fu a bon koti puu poti a wanse. Ne den teke yu nama poti a Dyusama peesi.
eng_text: You will say then, "Branches were broken off, that I might be grafted in."

djk_text: We, a bun! Ma sabi taki, na di den haw taka de nái puu bunbun sii. Dati taki, den Dyusama de á wani teke biibi, ma yu teke biibi. Da kaba meke bigi. Ma koni bun!
eng_text: True; by their unbelief they were broken off, and you stand by your faith. Don't be conceited, but fear;

djk_text: Bika a koti taka fu a bon seefi di meke de poti a wanse. Da san na yu, meke a á sa poi koti yu puu poti a wanse tu.
eng_text: for if God didn't spare the natural branches, neither will he spare you.

djk_text: Denki taki, Masaa Gadu e wooko anga switi taki anga yu de. Ma en ati sa boon, bali anga ala sitaafu tu. Dyusama di á wani biibi si dati kaba. Namo, ne a kon wooko anga switi taki anga yu. Ma puu biibi, da yu o si! Ai koti yuseefi puu poti a wanse tu.
eng_text: See then the goodness and severity of God. Toward those who fell, severity; but toward you, goodness, if you continue in his goodness; otherwise you also will be cut off.

djk_text: Bika haw taka fu a bon, di be koti puu sa poi teke kon nama poti de baka. Da den e goo de baka enke fa den be meke de. Masaa Gadu poi du so baka anga Dyusama di teke biibi.
eng_text: They also, if they don't continue in their unbelief, will be grafted in, for God is able to graft them in again.

djk_text: Bika taka fu busi bon á be de fu a bon de seefi. Ma dati poi koti kon nama fasi goo de. Da fa fu taka di be de fu a bon kaba seefi? Dati na Dyusama di musu poi toon bun sama baka gi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: For if you were cut out of that which is by nature a wild olive tree, and were grafted contrary to nature into a good olive tree, how much more will these, which are the natural branches, be grafted into their own olive tree?

djk_text: Taa foluku biibiwan! Da ná meke bigi anga Dyusama. Fusutan san fu den Masaa Gadu piki wi ya. Noiti sama be sabi a sani ya wanten. A de so taki, na Masaa Gadu seefi tapu den Dyusama ati, fu den á sa teke biibi, te enke a kaba wooko anga en bosikopu, a taa foluku a hii goontapu.
eng_text: For I don't desire you to be ignorant, brothers, of this mystery, so that you won't be wise in your own conceits, that a partial hardening has happened to Israel, until the fullness of the Gentiles has come in,

djk_text: Da na so a o go yeepi a foluku fu Islayeli Kondee baka. Bika a apaiti takiman be sikiifi piki fu dati taki: “A Masaa fu yeepi Islayeli Kondee o saka komoto a Siyon a tapu. Da a o meke a paansu sama fu Jakopu kaba anga a dini fu falisi sani, di á de Gadu.
eng_text: and so all Israel will be saved. Even as it is written, "There will come out of Zion the Deliverer, and he will turn away ungodliness from Jacob.

djk_text: A nyun kuudei di mi ya o meke anga den taki, mi o gi den paadon fu ala takuudu anga ogii.”
eng_text: This is my covenant to them, when I will take away their sins."

djk_text: Da nownow den de feyanti fu Masaa Gadu, fu di den daai baka gi en Bun Nyunsu. Ma dati na fu a sa fende pasi go wooko doo yu enke taa foluku. Ma a ná enke den á de en lobi foluku moo. Bika den na paansu sama, fu Abalaham, Isaki anga Jakopu. Na den a be paamisi fu teke wooko, tyai bun doo ala taa foluku.
eng_text: Concerning the Good News, they are enemies for your sake. But concerning the election, they are beloved for the fathers' sake.

djk_text: Da te a kai wan sama kon gi gaan bun kaba, fu a teke wooko, da noiti ai puu dati baka na a sama ana.
eng_text: For the gifts and the calling of God are irrevocable.

djk_text: Bika luku fa yu enke taa foluku be e taanga yesi gi en. Ne fu fende pasi wooko tyali ati fasi anga yu, ne a Dyu foluku kon taanga yesi fosi.
eng_text: For as you in time past were disobedient to God, but now have obtained mercy by their disobedience,

djk_text: Da a Dyu foluku kon taanga yesi nownow, ma na fu fende pasi daai go wooko tyali ati fasi baka anga den seefi, enke fa a kon wooko tyali ati fasi anga yu de.
eng_text: even so these also have now been disobedient, that by the mercy shown to you they may also obtain mercy.

djk_text: Da u sa satu ala sani fu a biifi ya taki, Masaa Gadu mokisa ala sama poti taki, den abi taanga yesi. Da a sa fende pasi, fu wooko tyali ati fasi anga ala den.
eng_text: For God has shut up all to disobedience, that he might have mercy on all.

djk_text: We, den gaan bun fu Masaa Gadu ya dipi! Soseefi a koni fi en, fu wooko leti fasi, anga a gaan sabi di a abi, fu du. Fasi á de fu sama kisi ala san a poti fu du tu. Soseefi fa a wani sani mu waka, bigi pasa u fusutan.
eng_text: Oh the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and the knowledge of God! How unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past tracing out!

djk_text: U sa poi sabi Masaa Gadu denki, di a abi? U sa poi soi en taki, na disi anga dati bun, fu a du?
eng_text: For who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has been his counselor?

djk_text: U fosi sa poi go gi Masaa Gadu wan sani taki, a mu pai wi fu dati baka?
eng_text: Or who has first given to him, and it will be repaid to him again?

djk_text: Bika ala san de ya komoto a Masaa Gadu seefi. Ne a poti ala den sani enke fa a wani. Da ai daai den sani go doo kaba so tu. Da a fiti fu bali gafa en naamo tego. Amen, na so a de!
eng_text: For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things. To him be the glory for ever! Amen.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Mi e begi u taki, denki a tyali ati fasi di Masaa Gadu teke, fu du somen bun gi wi. Da langa iseefi gi en, meke ala pisi fu sikin de apaiti fasi. Na so i sa fiti fu dini en, meke a sa piisii.
eng_text: Therefore I urge you, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, which is your spiritual service.

djk_text: Da kaba anga a sowtu libi fu goontapu, di nái teli Masaa Gadu. Kengi pakisei, fu denki a nyun fasi di Masaa Gadu wani. Da a o piisii fa yu e du leti san a wani. Soseefi yu o kon sabi san a poti gi yu fu du taki, na soso bun naamo.
eng_text: Don't be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the good, well-pleasing, and perfect will of God.

djk_text: Mi wooko di a gi mi, dati na gaan bun ati fasi namo a teke luku mi. Da mi e taki, noiti u mu denki enke u hei moo taawan, anga a apaiti taanga di Masaa Gadu gi, fu wooko.
eng_text: For I say, through the grace that was given me, to every man who is among you, not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think; but to think reasonably, as God has apportioned to each person a measure of faith.

djk_text: Bika ai si wi ala makandii enke wan sikin. Da wan sikin abi somen sowtu pisi, da ibii pisi abi en wooko gi a sikin.
eng_text: For even as we have many members in one body, and all the members don't have the same function,

djk_text: Wi ala di mokisa libi anga Kelestesi de enke wan sikin. Da ala fa u de somen sowtu sama seefi, ma u mokisa makandii a wan.
eng_text: so we, who are many, are one body in Christ, and individually members one of another.

djk_text: A gi sowtu a sowtu apaiti taanga, fu wooko. Na so a teke gaan bun ati fasi luku wi, meke ibiiwan kisi a apaiti taanga, fu a wooko di a gi dati. A gi son wan a taanga, fu de apaiti takiman. Da meke a sama de du a wooko de anga a biibi di a abi.
eng_text: Having gifts differing according to the grace that was given to us, if prophecy, let us prophesy according to the proportion of our faith;

djk_text: Efu na fu yeepi taawan, da yeepi den. Efu na fu fusutan dipi sani fi en, fu leli taawan. Da leli den seefi!
eng_text: or service, let us give ourselves to service; or he who teaches, to his teaching;

djk_text: Efu na fu wasikoi taawan a Masaa Gadu pasi, da wasikoi den! Efu na fu paati yu sani anga taawan, fu fende san den fanowdu. Da paati en anga den, sondee fu tapu baka! Efu na fu tii taa biibiwan, da feti tii den! Efu na fu wooko tyali ati fasi anga taawan. Da teke piisii fasi, wooko tyali ati fasi anga den.
eng_text: or he who exhorts, to his exhorting: he who gives, let him do it with liberality; he who rules, with diligence; he who shows mercy, with cheerfulness.

djk_text: Meke lobi taawan á de mofu lobi namo. Ma buuse ibii sowtu takuu fasi di de. Nama hii pakisei a san leti gi Masaa Gadu, fu du.
eng_text: Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor that which is evil. Cling to that which is good.

djk_text: Yu na osu sama fu Masaa Gadu, di mu lobi ala taawan de, enke yu eigi osu sama. Waka a fesi, fu soi fa fu lesipeki taawan moo enke yuseefi.
eng_text: In love of the brothers be tenderly affectionate one to another; in honor preferring one another;

djk_text: Towe ala lesi fasi! Meke moiti, fu wooko gi Masaa Gadu naamo. Soi taanga angii, fu du sani fi en. Dyombo ibii leisi du san wi Masaa sende yu.
eng_text: not lagging in diligence; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;

djk_text: Tei ati piisii doo, fu luku fu fende gaan bun, di a poti fu gi bakaten. Meke pasensi tyai yu doo dati. Kaba kaagi te banowtu kon a yu pasi. Noiti kaba pakisei san yu begi en taki, a o du en wan dei namo.
eng_text: rejoicing in hope; enduring in troubles; continuing steadfastly in prayer;

djk_text: Taa biibiwan de a ini taanga ten? Da dyombo go yeepi anga san yu abi. Yu osu doo mu opo gi taawan di doo yu, fu gi siibipe anga ala nyanyan seefi.
eng_text: contributing to the needs of the saints; given to hospitality.

djk_text: We, efu taawan e lon du ogii anga yu, da ná fuuku en. Ma begi seigi gi en. Mi e taki en baka! Begi seigi gi en, ma ná fuuku en!
eng_text: Bless those who persecute you; bless, and don't curse.

djk_text: Te taawan de anga poolo, da nama go poolo anga en, fu a bun di miti en. Taawan de anga tyali, nama go tyali anga en, fu a ogii di miti en.
eng_text: Rejoice with those who rejoice. Weep with those who weep.

djk_text: U mu booko ede makandii gi useefi. Noiti si iseefi hei moo taawan. Da te sani de fu du, da nama makandii du en sondee, fu go pee basi. Noiti denki enke yu ede e wooko moo bun, ofu koni moo taawan.
eng_text: Be of the same mind one toward another. Don't set your mind on high things, but associate with the humble. Don't be wise in your own conceits.

djk_text: Te taawan du sani anga yu, da ná puubei fu pai en anga ogii baka. Teke fu libi leti anga taawan, da yu o de sondee kaagi taki, yu libi á bun.
eng_text: Repay no one evil for evil. Respect what is honorable in the sight of all men.

djk_text: Suku fi yu se naamo, fi yu ati sa de switi a taawan.
eng_text: If it is possible, as much as it is up to you, be at peace with all men.

djk_text: Mi lobi biibiwan! Te taawan nái wooko leti anga yu, da noiti wooko takuu fasi anga en baka. Fika en gi Masaa Gadu. Bika en Buku sikiifi taki: “Na mi Masaa Gadu de fu pai sama. Da na mi o gi ibiiwan san fiti en.” Ma en Buku sikiifi tu taki:
eng_text: Don't seek revenge yourselves, beloved, but give place to God's wrath. For it is written, "Vengeance belongs to me; I will repay, says the Lord."

djk_text: “Ma efu yu feyanti de anga angii, da gi en nyanyan! Wataa moo en, gi en wataa. Libi switi anga en o meke a sidon denki, fa a abi yeepi fanowdu. Da Masaa Gadu sa fende pasi, fu go kengi en.”
eng_text: Therefore "If your enemy is hungry, feed him. If he is thirsty, give him a drink; for in doing so, you will heap coals of fire on his head."

djk_text: Ma ogii sa wooko enke basi a yuseefi tapu, te yu e du ogii baka anga taawan di du ogii anga yu. Ma te taawan du ogii anga yu, ma yu e libi switi anga en, da ogii sa fika a yu ondoo futu.
eng_text: Don't be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.

djk_text: We, da ibii kondee abi lanti fu tii sama. Da ná si den enke noti, fu du sani pasa den mofu. Bika a makiti fu den tii sani, anga ala taki gi taawan de komoto a Masaa Gadu. Taa fasi á de fu fende makiti.
eng_text: Let every soul be in subjection to the higher authorities, for there is no authority except from God, and those who exist are ordained by God.

djk_text: Da sama di taanga yesi fu sitee anga mofu di lanti poti, da ai feti anga Masaa Gadu seefi. Da yu o tuka anga lanti, fu fende a sitaafu di poti, fu san i du. Bika den á fika soso ana.
eng_text: Therefore he who resists the authority, withstands the ordinance of God; and those who withstand will receive to themselves judgment.

djk_text: Bika lanti á poti fu tyai feele gi sama, di e wooko leti. Na den di e wooko takuu fasi abi fu feele. Da te yu á wani feele lanti, da wooko leti. Da den o naki yu a sikoo taki: “Moi so!”
eng_text: For rulers are not a terror to the good work, but to the evil. Do you desire to have no fear of the authority? Do that which is good, and you will have praise from the same,

djk_text: Bika lanti á poti, fu du ogii anga sama. Ma na fu luku fa sama e waka. Da na sama pasa den mofu, abi fu waka anga feele. Bika na lanti mu sitaafu sama, meke den ana bigi sai, anga wapu di den e tyai. Na Masaa Gadu wooko den de.
eng_text: for he is a servant of God to you for good. But if you do that which is evil, be afraid, for he doesn't bear the sword in vain; for he is a servant of God, an avenger for wrath to him who does evil.

djk_text: Da biibiwan mu waka a lanti ondoo. A ná fu a feele ede taki, den poi sitaafu yu. Ma konsensi seefi e piki yu taki, dati na a leti fasi.
eng_text: Therefore you need to be in subjection, not only because of the wrath, but also for conscience' sake.

djk_text: Da pai lantimoni na a kondee. Bika na dati e pai lantiman, fu a wooko, di Masaa Gadu poti den gi sama de. Den e wooko hii dei, fu fende a dei beele ya.
eng_text: For this reason you also pay taxes, for they are servants of God's service, attending continually on this very thing.

djk_text: Da pai ala san poti fu pai lanti. Gi a lantimoni na a fasi di dati poti. Gi ala taa sowtu moni na a fasi di dati poti. Gi lesipeki na a fasi di de fu dati. Gi gaandi na a fasi di de fu dati.
eng_text: Give therefore to everyone what you owe: taxes to whom taxes are due; customs to whom customs; respect to whom respect; honor to whom honor.

djk_text: Ná oli paiman di de fu gi! Oli namo taki, i mu gi taawan lobi enke fa Masaa Gadu wani. Bika lobi taawan, na dati en weiti wani.
eng_text: Owe no one anything, except to love one another; for he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law.

djk_text: Bika weiti di a gi Mosesi taki: “Ná waka gi yu uman ofu man. Ná kii taawan. Ná fufuu taawan. Ná abi takuu losutu a taawan sani.” Da ala den weiti de e soi fu lobi taawan. Lobi, na fu du gi taawan, enke san i wani fi iseefi.
eng_text: For the commandments, "You shall not commit adultery," "You shall not murder," "You shall not steal," "You shall not give false testimony," "You shall not covet," and whatever other commandments there are, are all summed up in this saying, namely, "You shall love your neighbor as yourself."

djk_text: Noiti lobi e du ogii anga taawan. Libi sowan fasi, da na fa a hii weiti fu Masaa Gadu e taki dati.
eng_text: Love doesn't harm a neighbor. Love therefore is the fulfillment of the law.

djk_text: Bika fusutan san de fu kon nownow. Seeka fu dati, enke sani e kon miti sama, fu dyombo en puu en a siibi. Kelestesi de, fu kon baka anga ala bun di Masaa Gadu paamisi wi. Dati koosube moo di u be bigin biibi nyunyun.
eng_text: Do this, knowing the time, that it is already time for you to awaken out of sleep, for salvation is now nearer to us than when we first believed.

djk_text: Bika a takuu ten ya gwe faawe kaba, fu Kelestesi mu kon doo. Enke te neti gwe faawe kaba, fu dei doo. Da kaba libi enke fa neti dunguu moi, fu kibii du ogii. Libi enke fa dei kiin moi, fu si bun di yu e du.
eng_text: The night is far gone, and the day is near. Let's therefore throw off the works of darkness, and let's put on the armor of light.

djk_text: Libi enke fa dei kiin moi fu si yu e waka leti. Ná diingi duungu, fu lontu anga takitaki, a kulu. Ná waka gi yu uman ofu man. Ná teke sikin, fu du sani, di de fu kai sen sani. Ná kwali meke toobi. Ná abi takuu losutu a taawan sani.
eng_text: Let us walk properly, as in the day; not in reveling and drunkenness, not in sexual promiscuity and lustful acts, and not in strife and jealousy.

djk_text: Bika i libi mokisa anga Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi, fu teke a fasi fi en. Da puu denki a fa takuu losutu e tyai sama libisama fasi, enke fa u be gwenti libi switi useefi ati namo.
eng_text: But put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the flesh, for its lusts.

djk_text: Son biibiwan abi a swaki fasi, fu san fiti ofu san á fiti. Ma teli den ete, sondee fu poli anga den. Sitee seefi á mu de a u mindii, fu dati.
eng_text: Now accept one who is weak in faith, but not for disputes over opinions.

djk_text: Taawan sa denki kina á de fu nyanyan sani. Ma taawan abi a swaki fasi taki, kina de fu nyan sani enke meti so. Da ai nyan guluntu namo.
eng_text: One man has faith to eat all things, but he who is weak eats only vegetables.

djk_text: Ma sama di kina á de gi, mu kaba soso taawan di nái denki enke den. Sama di e denki kina de seefi, mu kaba kaagi den di e denki kina á de. Bika na Masaa Gadu teke denseefi, e kai osu sama fi en.
eng_text: Don't let him who eats despise him who doesn't eat. Don't let him who doesn't eat judge him who eats, for God has accepted him.

djk_text: Da sama ná abi leti, fu go a wan taawan osu, fu go kuutu a taawan de wookoman? Na a basi di abi den wookoman, e si sowtu wookoman e piisii en. Na soseefi, da wi Masaa taanga, fu meke den taawan waka piisii Masaa Gadu tu.
eng_text: Who are you who judge another's servant? To his own lord he stands or falls. Yes, he will be made to stand, for God has power to make him stand.

djk_text: Da wan sa denki, dei abi kina fu oli enke weiti. Taawan sa denki, dei ná abi kina fu oli enke weiti. Da meke ibiiwan denki san enseefi e si fiti, fu teke wooko sondee fu go muliki taawan di nái denki enke en.
eng_text: One man esteems one day as more important. Another esteems every day alike. Let each man be fully assured in his own mind.

djk_text: Bika fu wan sama poti wan dei, fu gi Masaa daa, da ai si dati fu gi Masaa Gadu gaandi. Efu wan taawan poti taki, kina á de fu son meti, da ai si dati fu gi Masaa Gadu gaandi. Efu wan poti taki, kina de, da ai si dati fu gi Masaa Gadu gaandi. Da ibiiwan e gi Masaa Gadu daa anga fi en fasi.
eng_text: He who observes the day, observes it to the Lord; and he who does not observe the day, to the Lord he does not observe it. He who eats, eats to the Lord, for he gives God thanks. He who doesn't eat, to the Lord he doesn't eat, and gives God thanks.

djk_text: Bika a libi á de fu wan sama seefi. A dede seefi á de fu wan sama seefi.
eng_text: For none of us lives to himself, and none dies to himself.

djk_text: Libi anga dede na fu tyai gaandi gi wi Masaa. Bika ne en wawan e fiti ala dati poti, gi wi. Da na fu gafa en namo anga a libi, go doo dede seefi.
eng_text: For if we live, we live to the Lord. Or if we die, we die to the Lord. If therefore we live or die, we are the Lord's.

djk_text: Bika Kelestesi dede weki kon a libi ya baka, fu soi fa a de wooko enke basi, fu libiwan go doo dedewan seefi.
eng_text: For to this end Christ died, rose, and lived again, that he might be Lord of both the dead and the living.

djk_text: Da gaantangi! Kaba kaagi, ofu soso wan taa biibiwan di e denki taa fasi. Fika ala sani gi bakaten, te u ala sa doo Masaa Gadu fesi, fu a kuutu.
eng_text: But you, why do you judge your brother? Or you again, why do you despise your brother? For we will all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.

djk_text: Bika en Buku sikiifi taki: “Solanga mi Masaa Gadu ya de! Mi e sweli taki, ibiiwan musu kon sutu kini a mi fesi. Da ibiiwan o bali kai mi: ‘Masaa,’ na ala lanti fesi.”
eng_text: For it is written, "'As I live,' says the Lord, 'to me every knee will bow. Every tongue will confess to God.'"

djk_text: Na so ibiiwan o abi fu faantiwowtu a Masaa Gadu fesi, fu fa a be libi, doo saide a be teke a fasi di a libi de seefi.
eng_text: So then each one of us will give account of himself to God.

djk_text: Da kaba kaagi a taawan. Denki fu kaba du a sani di wan taawan e denki abi kina. Meke a á sa dyakata komoto a Masaa Gadu pasi.
eng_text: Therefore let's not judge one another any more, but judge this rather, that no man put a stumbling block in his brother's way, or an occasion for falling.

djk_text: Mi Pawlesi ya libi mokisa anga Masaa Jesesi, da mi á poi lei. Tuutuu! Nyanyan sani á de, fu nyan poli yu libi gi Masaa Gadu! Ma sama di e denki taki, kina de fu nyan dati, da ai si dati enke dati poi poli sama libi.
eng_text: I know, and am persuaded in the Lord Jesus, that nothing is unclean of itself; except that to him who considers anything to be unclean, to him it is unclean.

djk_text: We, da te a taawan abi kina fu dati, ma i teke dati nyan fu a si, da i nái wooko lobi fasi. Bika a moo betee i tapu nyan a sani de, fu a taawan ede. Da a yeepi di Kelestesi dede tyai gi a taawan, á sa poli, fi yu nyan sani ede.
eng_text: Yet if because of food your brother is grieved, you walk no longer in love. Don't destroy with your food him for whom Christ died.

djk_text: Bika yu taanga a ini a biibi kaba. Ma kenisi anga taawan di á taanga enke yu. Yu o tyai nen taki, yu du wan ogii.
eng_text: Then don't let your good be slandered,

djk_text: Bika a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu, a ná kina fu nyan ofu diingi toli. Ma na fa fu libi letiopu fasi. Fa ati mu de switi a Masaa Gadu, anga taawan seefi. Fa a Apaiti Jeje e tyai piisii a ini sama libi.
eng_text: for the Kingdom of God is not eating and drinking, but righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.

djk_text: Da na fu waka anga Kelestesi so, na dati sa piisii Masaa Gadu ati. Soseefi, da lesipeki anga gafa o komoto a taawan kon doo yu, fu dati ede.
eng_text: For he who serves Christ in these things is acceptable to God and approved by men.

djk_text: Wi o satu a hii toli ya taki, u mu e feti naamo, fu u ati de switi makandii. Feti fu taawan fusutan sani fu Masaa Gadu, moo anga moo.
eng_text: So then, let us follow after things which make for peace, and things by which we may build one another up.

djk_text: Ma kaba tyai nyanyan anga diingi toli kon poli a yeepi di Masaa Gadu tyai. Bika tuutuu! Nyanyan á de fu nyan poli wan sama libi gi Masaa Gadu. Ma fu dwengi wan taawan go nyan san ai denki enke dati abi kina, da a o tyai ogii gi en.
eng_text: Don't overthrow God's work for food's sake. All things indeed are clean, however it is evil for that man who creates a stumbling block by eating.

djk_text: Da tapu nyan a meti de! Tapu diingi a taanga diingi de! Tapu ibii taa sani di sa dwengi taawan go du enke yu, ma enseefi e denki enke dati abi kina. Bika dati sa tyai ogii gi en.
eng_text: It is good to not eat meat, drink wine, nor do anything by which your brother stumbles, is offended, or is made weak.

djk_text: Da du san yu e denki bun gi yu, anga a nyan toli ya, sondee fu tyai dati go muliki taawan. Bika na wan gaan seigi fu sama di e du sani anga biibi taki, dati na a leti fasi.
eng_text: Do you have faith? Have it to yourself before God. Happy is he who doesn't judge himself in that which he approves.

djk_text: Ma te i pantan fu nyan wan sani, da gaantangi, ná nyan! Seigi fu dati ná o de gi yu! Bika biibi fu du dati á de. Da yu o fii enke i toon poli sama gi Masaa Gadu. Bika du sani sondee biibi taki, na a leti fasi, na dati e tyai ogii.
eng_text: But he who doubts is condemned if he eats, because it isn't of faith; and whatever is not of faith is sin. (14:24) Now to him who is able to establish you according to my Good News and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery which has been kept secret through long ages, (14:25) but now is revealed, and by the Scriptures of the prophets, according to the commandment of the eternal God, is made known for obedience of faith to all the nations; (14:26) to the only wise God, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory forever! Amen.

djk_text: We, wi di biibi taanga kaba, sabi san fiti anga san fowtu! Ma pasensi anga den wan di biibi á kaba taanga enke wi. Fudaagi a swaki fasi fu den. Ná libi fu tyai wini gi yuseefi namo.
eng_text: Now we who are strong ought to bear the weaknesses of the weak, and not to please ourselves.

djk_text: Naamo ibiiwan mu libi, fu tyai wini gi taawan, meke den sa fusutan Masaa Gadu pasi moo anga moo. Meke den sa teke fu waka so tu, sondee fu sama dwengi den.
eng_text: Let each one of us please his neighbor for that which is good, to be building him up.

djk_text: Bika Kelestesi seefi á be libi, fu tyai wini gi enseefi namo. Ma a be libi enke fa Masaa Gadu Buku sikiifi taki: “Te den e saanti yu Masaa Gadu de, da ai kai a miseefi buba.”
eng_text: For even Christ didn't please himself. But, as it is written, "The reproaches of those who reproached you fell on me."

djk_text: Bika ala san en Buku be sikiifi a fesi, na fu leli sama libi ne en pasi. Da dati sa meke sama poi tei ati fu oli doo ne en pasi. Soseefi fende kaakiti fu taampu moo taanga, fu poi mokisa makandii luku fu fende gaan bun, di Masaa Gadu paamisi wi a ini en Buku.
eng_text: For whatever things were written before were written for our learning, that through patience and through encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope.

djk_text: Mi e begi Masaa Gadu di poi gi wi tei ati fu oli doo, soseefi kaakiti fu taampu taanga. Meke u sa poi fiti anga fa taawan e denki sani fu Kelestesi Jesesi. Meke u sa poi waka enke Kelestesi Jesesi seefi.
eng_text: Now the God of patience and of encouragement grant you to be of the same mind one with another according to Christ Jesus,

djk_text: Soseefi u sa poi mokisa tongo, fu bali gafa Masaa Gadu, di de a Gadu fu wi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi. Soseefi en Tata tu.
eng_text: that with one accord you may with one mouth glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

djk_text: Fu taki ala san taki pasa de wan satu fasi. Da a de so taki, u ati mu de switi makandii a wan. A taawan mu e fii taki, yu e teli en fu biibiwan enke yuseefi. Wooko na a fasi fa Kelestesi tyai yu, kon toon osu sama fu Masaa Gadu, fu gi Masaa Gadu gafa.
eng_text: Therefore accept one another, even as Christ also accepted you, to the glory of God.

djk_text: Mi e piki u taki, Kelestesi na Awan di kon fu wooko gi Dyusama. Masaa Gadu be paamisi wi avo Dyu gaansama taki, a o de wan paansu sama di lo o waka komoto a den.
eng_text: Now I say that Christ has been made a servant of the circumcision for the truth of God, that he might confirm the promises given to the fathers,

djk_text: Ma a yeepi fi en pasa go doo taa foluku tu. Na so denseefi sa gafa en tu. Bika a luku denseefi anga tyali ati fasi tu. A be meke en apaiti takiman sikiifi a sani ya a fositen anda taki: “Yu tyali ati fasi de gi taa foluku seefi. Da te mi doo den mindii, da mi o singi gi yu gaandi!”
eng_text: and that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy. As it is written, "Therefore will I give praise to you among the Gentiles, and sing to your name."

djk_text: Wan taa peesi sikiifi baka taki: “Meke den taa foluku poolo seefi. Bika piisii sani o kon miti den de. Masaa Gadu o teke den kon mokisa anga en Dyu foluku.”
eng_text: Again he says, "Rejoice, you Gentiles, with his people."

djk_text: Wan taa peesi sikiifi baka tu taki: “Meke den taa foluku bali gafa a gaan Masaa fu wi. Bali gafa en na ala uku fu goontapu pe u de.”
eng_text: Again, "Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles! Let all the peoples praise him."

djk_text: A be piki Jesaja seefi, fu sikiifi taki: “A sa de wan bakaten pikin na a paansu fu Kownu Dafeti dda, Isai. Ne en Masaa Gadu o poti tii taa foluku, meke denseefi sa poi luku fu fende bun, di a paamisi tu.”
eng_text: Again, Isaiah says, "There will be the root of Jesse, he who arises to rule over the Gentiles; in him the Gentiles will hope."

djk_text: We, u e luku fu fende bun, di Masaa Gadu paamisi. Da meke a poti u ati switi anga enseefi, anga ala piisii, fu biibi. Da u o moo luku taanga, fu fende san a paamisi wi. Bika en Apaiti Jeje seefi o gi wi a taanga de.
eng_text: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope, in the power of the Holy Spirit.

djk_text: Mi lobi biibiwan! Mi e yee naamo taki, sani e go bun a u mindii anda. Mi sabi tu, fa u e yeepi taawan de. U e fusutan sani fu Masaa Gadu de tu, fu poi leli, anga ala soi taawan a leti pasi.
eng_text: I myself am also persuaded about you, my brothers , that you yourselves are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish others.

djk_text: Ma mi teke fu sikiifi den seefi sani de taanga taanga ya ete, fu sokoo u denki a den baka. Bika na Masaa Gadu seefi teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku mi, meke a gi mi a wooko ya.
eng_text: But I write the more boldly to you in part, as reminding you, because of the grace that was given to me by God,

djk_text: Da mi na wookoman fu Kelestesi Jesesi, fu gi taa foluku en Bun Nyunsu. Mi de enke wan apaiti begiman fu tyai sama di biibi go ne en fesi. Da en Apaiti Jeje kiin den libi, meke a sa teke paiman di den tyai gi en, anga piisii.
eng_text: that I should be a servant of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles, serving as a priest the Good News of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be made acceptable, sanctified by the Holy Spirit.

djk_text: Da fa mi mokisa libi anga Kelestesi Jesesi, meke mi poi wooko gi Masaa Gadu. Na so namo mi sa gafa miseefi.
eng_text: I have therefore my boasting in Christ Jesus in things pertaining to God.

djk_text: Bika na Kelestesi e du Masaa Gadu wooko. Da mi á poi gafa taa fasi, boiti fa mi si ai wooko anga mi, fu tyai taa foluku kon teke Masaa Gadu taki. Bika den yee, soseefi si en taanga, di ai wooko a ini mi.
eng_text: For I will not dare to speak of any things except those which Christ worked through me, for the obedience of the Gentiles, by word and deed,

djk_text: A meke mi e du foondoo sani, enke maiki fu soi taki, en Apaiti Jeje gi mi taanga. Na so mi wooko komoto a Jelusalem Foto, lontu doo faawe pisiwataa enke Ililiya seefi. Da mi kaba bali Kelestesi Bun Nyunsu a den somen peesi anda.
eng_text: in the power of signs and wonders, in the power of God's Spirit; so that from Jerusalem, and around as far as to Illyricum, I have fully preached the Good News of Christ;

djk_text: Ma mi e angii fu doo enke fosiwan, a peesi di á yee a Bun Nyunsu ete. Sowan fasi, da a fondamenti fu mi wooko á sa sete a pe taawan be wooko pasa kaba. Bika, da a be sa gei mi teke taawan sani, fu wooko.
eng_text: yes, making it my aim to preach the Good News, not where Christ was already named, that I might not build on another's foundation.

djk_text: A wooko fu mi mu waka enke fa wan apaiti takiman be sikiifi a fositen anda taki: “Pe den á yee sani fi en ete, sa yee fi en, fu fusutan fa a tan. Bika noiti den be yee dati ape, ma den o kon fusutan now.”
eng_text: But, as it is written, "They will see, to whom no news of him came. They who haven't heard will understand."

djk_text: Na dati meke mi waka lontu somen peesi anga a wooko ya. Da na dati e tapu mi, fu kon luku u de. Ma a ná enke mi nái denki naamo, fu kon luku, u fu Loma Foto de!
eng_text: Therefore also I was hindered these many times from coming to you,

djk_text: Da now di nyun pisiwataa á de gi mi moo pe sama á yee a Bun Nyunsu, ne mi e denki fu kon luku u de. Bika yali fu yali kaba, mi e angii, fu doo u de.
eng_text: but now, no longer having any place in these regions, and having these many years a longing to come to you,

djk_text: Mi o de a pasi fu gwe a Sipanyoo Kondee anga ala a pisiwataa anda. Da mi o tapu pikinso a u de, fu u sa yeepi mi go doo anga a waka ya. Mi be sa wani tan langa a u de, fu abi wan switi ten makandii. Ma mi ná o poi.
eng_text: whenever I journey to Spain, I will come to you. For I hope to see you on my journey, and to be helped on my way there by you, if first I may enjoy your company for a while.

djk_text: Nownow mi e gwe a Jelusalem Foto, fu du wan wooko gi sama fu Masaa Gadu anda.
eng_text: But now, I say, I am going to Jerusalem, serving the saints.

djk_text: Biibiwan fu Masadoniya anga Akasi pisiwataa piki moni poti, fu sende yeepi pooti biibiwan a Jelusalem Foto. Da dati dyunta anda nownow, fu mi go teke tyai go gi den.
eng_text: For it has been the good pleasure of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor among the saints who are at Jerusalem.

djk_text: We, den wooko switi anga Dyu biibiwan sowan fasi. Den musu! Bika a biibi di tyai seigi go doo den, dati komoto a Dyusama go a den. Da denseefi abi fu teke san den abi, fu seigi den Dyusama baka, fu denseefi sa abi sani di den fanowdu tu.
eng_text: Yes, it has been their good pleasure, and they are their debtors. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, they owe it to them also to serve them in fleshly things.

djk_text: Te mi tyai a moni go a Jelusalem Foto, fosi mi o de a waka, fu gwe a Sipanyoo Kondee. Da na a waka de, mi o fufuu pasi kon luku u de.
eng_text: When therefore I have accomplished this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will go on by way of you to Spain.

djk_text: Tuutuu mi sabi taki, mi o doo u de. Mi o kon soi u, fa a seigi di Kelestesi tyai gi wi bigi, fu meke u piisii de!
eng_text: I know that, when I come to you, I will come in the fullness of the blessing of the Good News of Christ.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Mi e sende u, fu taampu yeepi mi feti anga begi. Bika wi mokisa libi anga wi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi, fu poi wooko makandii. A Apaiti Jeje mokisa u, fu lobi makandii enke osu sama fi en.
eng_text: Now I beg you, brothers, by our Lord Jesus Christ, and by the love of the Spirit, that you strive together with me in your prayers to God for me,

djk_text: Da begi, fu Masaa Gadu e puu mi na ana fu taanga yesi sama a Judeja pisiwataa. Meke a moni di mi o tyai go a Jelusalem Foto seefi piisii biibiwan anda. Meke den sa teke dati.
eng_text: that I may be delivered from those who are disobedient in Judea, and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints;

djk_text: Da mi sa doo u de anga piisii. Fu Masaa Gadu wani, da mi denki mi o doo u de, anga ala koo ati, fu u sa gi useefi taanga sikin, wan switi fasi.
eng_text: that I may come to you in joy through the will of God, and together with you, find rest.

djk_text: Noti moo, enke meke Masaa Gadu de anga u ala anda. Ne en de, fu tyai sama ati kon switi makandii. Amen, na so a de!
eng_text: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.

djk_text: Mi e begi u taki, Feibe o kon a u de wan dei. Da u solugu en bun gi mi. Bika ai biibi wi Masaa enke u de seefi. A de wan bun wookoman fu Masaa a mindii fu taa biibiwan a Kenkeleyen Foto.
eng_text: I commend to you Phoebe, our sister, who is a servant of the assembly that is at Cenchreae,

djk_text: Puu en a boto wan fasi, di fiti wan biibiwan enke u seefi, di abi Masaa Jesesi. Solugu en fiti fa biibiwan mu luku taawan. Taampu anga en na ala san a teke fu du. Bika enseefi lobi yeepi taawan, enke fa a be solugu mi somen leisi.
eng_text: that you receive her in the Lord, in a way worthy of the saints, and that you assist her in whatever matter she may need from you, for she herself also has been a helper of many, and of my own self.

djk_text: Tyai odi go doo Pelesela anga en man Akwila de. Den be mokisa makandii anga mi, na a wooko fu Kelestesi Jesesi.
eng_text: Greet Prisca and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus,

djk_text: Den be puu mi a dede mofu seefi, soseefi poti den eigi libi a tiki ede, fu a wooko de ete. Da mi á poi gi den daa sai. Somen biibiwan anda mu fende a daa ya tu. Taa foluku biibiwan seefi mu gi den daa, fu san den du gi mi.
eng_text: who for my life, laid down their own necks; to whom not only I give thanks, but also all the assemblies of the Gentiles.

djk_text: Meke odi go doo biibiwan di e miti begi makandii a den Akwila osu. Odi mu go doo mi gaan mati Epeneitesi, di fosi teke biibi na a pisiwataa fu Asiya anda, fu komoto a takuudu anga ogii. Bika ne en baka futu taawan teke.
eng_text: Greet the assembly that is in their house. Greet Epaenetus, my beloved, who is the first fruits of Achaia to Christ.

djk_text: Gi odi doo Maliya de gi mi. A de wan bun wookoman fu Masaa Jesesi, di tyotyo tyai somen yeepi gi u de seefi.
eng_text: Greet Mary, who labored much for us.

djk_text: Odi mu go doo mi eigi Dyusama Adonikesi anga en uman, Yuniya, di be sooto makandii anga mi. Ala sama sabi taki, Kelestesi Jesesi teke den enke apaiti bosikopuman. Den be de biibisama fosi mi ya seefi.
eng_text: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my relatives and my fellow prisoners, who are notable among the apostles, who also were in Christ before me.

djk_text: Gi odi go doo mi gaan mati Ampiliyatesi. A de biibiwan makandii anga wi, fu abi Kelestesi enke Masaa tu.
eng_text: Greet Amplias, my beloved in the Lord.

djk_text: Odi mu go doo Elibanesi tu, di seefi be mokisa anga mi, fu wooko gi Kelestesi. Bali mi gaan mati Stakesi seefi odi gi mi de.
eng_text: Greet Urbanus, our fellow worker in Christ, and Stachys, my beloved.

djk_text: Gaan odi mu go doo Apelesi di be teke gaan pina, ma a be oli biibi pasa dati, fu teke kai fitoow bakaman fu Kelestesi. Tyai odi go doo ala biibiwan di de wookoman a ini Alistobolesi osu.
eng_text: Greet Apelles, the approved in Christ. Greet those who are of the household of Aristobulus.

djk_text: Bali mi eigi Dyusama Helodiyoni wan gaanbigi odi, gi mi tu. Mi e sende odi go doo ala biibiwan, di e tan a ini Nalisesi osu tu.
eng_text: Greet Herodion, my kinsman. Greet them of the household of Narcissus, who are in the Lord.

djk_text: Bali Tilipeina anga Tilifosa odi gi mi. Den tu uman ya tyotyo na a wooko fu wi Masaa. Odi mu doo Pelsisi tu, enke wan uman di tyotyo na a wooko ya tu, fu tyai somen yeepi.
eng_text: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who labor in the Lord. Greet Persis, the beloved, who labored much in the Lord.

djk_text: Gi Lufosi odi! Masaa Gadu teke en wan apaiti fasi poti a u de mindii. Odi mu doo en mma seefi di e wooko anga mi enke eigi manpikin, di a meke.
eng_text: Greet Rufus, the chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.

djk_text: Bali odi na Asinkeletesi, soseefi Feleikon. Helilmesi, soseefi Patolobesi anga Helimasi. Gi odi doo ala biibiwan, di e miti fu begi makandii anga den disi.
eng_text: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brothers who are with them.

djk_text: Odi mu doo Filologesi anga en uman Julija. Nelosi anga en sisa tu. Olimpasi anga ala biibiwan di e miti fu begi makandii anga den disi tu.
eng_text: Greet Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints who are with them.

djk_text: Bali ala biibiwan anda wan switi odi a ini a nen fu Masaa gi wi. Odi komoto dise seefi e kon anda, fu den kulu biibiwan dise.
eng_text: Greet one another with a holy kiss. The assemblies of Christ greet you.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Mi e begi u, fu luku bun anga falisi leliman. Den e waka e leli sani di kengi anga di fu apaiti bosikopuman fu Kelestesi. Da den e tyai paati, fu meke paitei biibiwan di nái go anga denseefi, meke somen sama e lasi Masaa Gadu pasi. Da ná mosoo anga den!
eng_text: Now I beg you, brothers, look out for those who are causing the divisions and occasions of stumbling, contrary to the doctrine which you learned, and turn away from them.

djk_text: Bika den nái wooko gi wi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi. Ma na fu tyai wini gi denseefi. Den tongo gaata, fu taki kisi sama poti a den ondoo. Da den e poti falisi pakisei namo, gi sama di nái denki fu luku bun anga den.
eng_text: For those who are such don't serve our Lord, Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by their smooth and flattering speech, they deceive the hearts of the innocent.

djk_text: Bika u dati nen bali taki, u e waka a Kelestesi pasi. Dati e piisii mi ati. Ma mi e wasikoi u ete, fu wooko koni anga u fusutan, fu sabi san bun fu du. Meke a fusutan sa de sondee fu mokisa wan doopu ogii de.
eng_text: For your obedience has become known to all. I rejoice therefore over you. But I desire to have you wise in that which is good, but innocent in that which is evil.

djk_text: Da gawgaw, Masaa Gadu o booko didibii makiti gi u, fu sama á sa poi tyai paati de moo. Bika a wani u ala ati de switi makandii. Wi Masaa Jesesi mu tan taampu gi u de, fu teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku u de.
eng_text: And the God of peace will quickly crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

djk_text: Bigi odi komoto a Timotiyesi ya doo u anda. A mokisa e wooko anga mi, gi Kelestesi Jesesi. Lusiyasi anga Yason anga Sosipateli e sende odi tu. Den dii biibiwan ya, na mi eigi foluku sama enke Dyu tu.
eng_text: Timothy, my fellow worker, greets you, as do Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my relatives.

djk_text: We, na Pawlesi e taki na a biifi ya. Ma na mi enke Telitiyosi e sikiifi gi en ya. Mi seefi e sende odi gi u anda tu. Bika mi anga u e biibi a seefi Masaa makandii.
eng_text: I, Tertius, who write the letter, greet you in the Lord.

djk_text: Odi komoto a Gaayosi, di oli wi ne en osu, e solugu, di u doo ya. A kulu biibiwan, di e miti begi makandii ne en osu e sende odi tu. Elastesi seefi, enke a lantiman di e oli moni fu a foto ya, fu pai sama. Odi komoto tu, a wi biibi baala Kwalitesi.
eng_text: Gaius, my host and host of the whole assembly, greets you. Erastus, the treasurer of the city, greets you, as does Quartus, the brother.

djk_text: Mi e begi ya baka, meke wi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi tan teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku u de. Amen, na so a de!
eng_text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all! Amen.

djk_text: Masaa Gadu wani, ne a kai mi Pawlesi ya poti enke apaiti bosikopuman fu Kelestesi Jesesi. Mi anga u biibi baala Sositenesi e sikiifi a biifi ya.
eng_text: Paul, called to be an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, and our brother Sosthenes,

djk_text: A de gi a hii kulu sama a Kolenti Foto di Masaa Gadu kai kon poti apaiti fasi enke sama fi en seefi. Soseefi u di mokisa libi anga Kelestesi Jesesi. Ibii taawan seefi di e kai wi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi nen suku yeepi.
eng_text: to the assembly of God which is at Corinth; those who are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called to be saints, with all who call on the name of our Lord Jesus Christ in every place, both theirs and ours:

djk_text: Meke u Tata, Masaa Gadu anga Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku u de. Soseefi, meke u ati de switi.
eng_text: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

djk_text: We, mi e gi Masaa Gadu daa ibii yuu naamo. Bika a teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku yu de seefi, fu di i mokisa libi anga Kelestesi Jesesi.
eng_text: I always thank my God concerning you, for the grace of God which was given you in Christ Jesus;

djk_text: Namo, ne a gi yu ala san yu fanowdu, te doo yu mofu seefi kon poi taki a sowtu fasi di a wani. Soseefi yu fusutan poi sabi sani fi en tu.
eng_text: that in everything you were enriched in him, in all speech and all knowledge;

djk_text: Na so yu kon moo si taki, a bosikopu fu Kelestesi, di wi ya be gi u de na tuutuu sani.
eng_text: even as the testimony of Christ was confirmed in you:

djk_text: Da dati sa meke i poi taampu, fu luku wi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi fu kon baka, sondee fu mankei den apaiti taanga di Masaa Gadu e gi, fu wooko, di a teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku yu de.
eng_text: so that you come behind in no gift; waiting for the revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ;

djk_text: Soseefi, da enseefi taampu, fu oli yu doo, meke finga á sa poi soi, fu kaagi yu anga leti na a dei di wi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi o doo baka.
eng_text: who will also confirm you until the end, blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.

djk_text: Fu tuu, Masaa Gadu de fitoow fasi, da ai du san a paamisi. Ne enseefi kai yu kon, fu libi makandii anga en Manpikin, Jesesi Kelestesi di de wi Masaa.
eng_text: God is faithful, through whom you were called into the fellowship of his Son, Jesus Christ, our Lord.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Na ini a nen fu wi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi, mi e bali u taki, denki sani fu Kelestesi go na a wan se. De sondee sitee fasi. Kaba anga paati fasi. Libi fiti makandii a wan.
eng_text: Now I beg you, brothers, through the name of our Lord, Jesus Christ, that you all speak the same thing and that there be no divisions among you, but that you be perfected together in the same mind and in the same judgment.

djk_text: Bika mi yee dise taki, kwali de a u mindii de. Na so sama na a osu fu Kolowei kon piki mi ya.
eng_text: For it has been reported to me concerning you, my brothers, by those who are from Chloe's household, that there are contentions among you.

djk_text: Den taigi mi fa sowan e taki anda taki, ai teke a baka futu fu Pawlesi. Taawan taki, ai teke fu Apolos. Taawan taki, ai teke fu Kefasi. Taawan taki, na den teke fu Kelestesi.
eng_text: Now I mean this, that each one of you says, "I follow Paul," "I follow Apollos," "I follow Cephas," and, "I follow Christ."

djk_text: Ma fa u sa paati useefi so? Bika a ná Kelestesi paati u poti so. Enke fa mi Pawlesi de ya, mofina fu mi! Mi á be teke dede a koloisi fu pai gi wan enkii sama, da mi nen á meke fu kai dopu sama.
eng_text: Is Christ divided? Was Paul crucified for you? Or were you baptized into the name of Paul?

djk_text: Mi e gi Masaa Gadu daa taki, mi á be dopu wan enkii sama de. Boiti Kelesiposi anga Gaayosi.
eng_text: I thank God that I baptized none of you, except Crispus and Gaius,

djk_text: Da sama á poi taki, mi kai mi nen dopu en de.
eng_text: so that no one should say that I had baptized you into my own name.

djk_text: Tan, osi? Mi be dopu Stefanasi anga sama fi en osu de tu. Ma mi á denki taki, mi be dopu taa sama de moo.
eng_text: (I also baptized the household of Stephanas; besides them, I don't know whether I baptized any other.)

djk_text: Bika Kelestesi á sende mi fu teke dopu wooko poti a fesi. Ma mi mu taki en Bun Nyunsu wan fasi di nái waka anga gaan kufaliki wowtu fu goontapu koniman. Bika dati o poli a taanga fu san Kelestesi du na a koloisi fu yeepi sama.
eng_text: For Christ sent me not to baptize, but to preach the Good News--not in wisdom of words, so that the cross of Christ wouldn't be made void.

djk_text: Ma a hii toli fu a koloisi na wan soso sani gi sama di de fu kaba a soso tego. Ma na sama di fende a yeepi fu Masaa Gadu e si a taanga fi en bosikopu.
eng_text: For the word of the cross is foolishness to those who are dying, but to us who are saved it is the power of God.

djk_text: Na so meke Masaa Gadu Buku be sikiifi a fesi taki: “Mi o soso gaan kufaliki wowtu fu goontapu koniman. A hii fusutan fu sama seefi di abi fusutan libisama fasi.”
eng_text: For it is written, "I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, I will bring the discernment of the discerning to nothing."

djk_text: Dati taki, fu Masaa Gadu se, da a denki fu goontapu koniman wai poti a wanse enke wisiwasi sani. Soseefi di fu leliman fu Dyuweiti anga goontapu takiman tu.
eng_text: Where is the wise? Where is the scribe? Where is the lawyer of this world? Hasn't God made foolish the wisdom of this world?

djk_text: Bika na Masaa Gadu abi ala koni. Ma a á meke wan enkii sama a goontapu anga koni fu poi sabi enseefi. Namo a poti fu yeepi sama di teke biibi na a bosikopu di wi e paati, da sama e si dati enke na soso sani.
eng_text: For seeing that in the wisdom of God, the world through its wisdom didn't know God, it was God's good pleasure through the foolishness of the preaching to save those who believe.

djk_text: Bika Dyusama nái teke biibi makiliki. Den e wani si wonduu enke maiki fosi. Taa foluku wani yee gaan kufaliki wowtu fu goontapu koniman fosi.
eng_text: For Jews ask for signs, Greeks seek after wisdom,

djk_text: Ma wi dati e taki namo fu a Kelestesi di dede a koloisi. Da ai ati Dyusama enke na sani fu wai puu a pasi. Taa foluku dati e kai dati wisiwasi toli sondee yeepi.
eng_text: but we preach Christ crucified; a stumbling block to Jews, and foolishness to Greeks,

djk_text: Ma sama di Masaa Gadu kai kon toon fi enseefi e si a taanga fu a bosikopu ya. Soseefi a koni fasi fa Masaa Gadu wooko de. Winsi na Dyu ofu taa foluku biibiwan.
eng_text: but to those who are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ is the power of God and the wisdom of God.

djk_text: We, libisama e soso a koloisi toli! Ma na dati e soi a gaan dipi koni fu Masaa Gadu di pasa ala gaan koni fu goontapu. Den e kai en sani sondee taanga. Ma na dati e soi Masaa Gadu taanga di bigi moo ala taanga fu goontapu.
eng_text: Because the foolishness of God is wiser than men, and the weakness of God is stronger than men.

djk_text: Bika biibiwan! Luku u di Masaa Gadu kai kon toon sama fi enseefi de. Somen fu u á be de fu teke kai koniman. Somen fu u á be de fu teli enke bigiman anga makiti. Somen fu u á komoto a gudu balinen famii.
eng_text: For you see your calling, brothers, that not many are wise according to the flesh, not many mighty, and not many noble;

djk_text: Bika na san goontapu e soso, na dati Masaa Gadu teke fu wisiwasi goontapu koniman. Soseefi a teke u di goontapu e kai sama sondee makiti, fu wisiwasi goontapu makiti bigiman.
eng_text: but God chose the foolish things of the world that he might put to shame those who are wise. God chose the weak things of the world, that he might put to shame the things that are strong;

djk_text: Soseefi a teke u puu a mofina famii. Soseefi sama di goontapu e kai noti. Soseefi sama di goontapu e si lagi. Bika na so Masaa Gadu wani wooko fu wisiwasi ala san goontapu e teke fu bigi.
eng_text: and God chose the lowly things of the world, and the things that are despised, and the things that are not, that he might bring to nothing the things that are:

djk_text: Da sama ná o de fu gafa enseefi a Masaa Gadu fesi taki, a de wan sani. Kweti!
eng_text: that no flesh should boast before God.

djk_text: Bika ne en du a hii wooko di mokisa wi libi anga Kelestesi Jesesi, di tyai u kon si Masaa Gadu koni. Bika a meke u kon de bun gi en. Soseefi u kon de apaiti fasi fu goo kon tan fa a wani. Soseefi u sa go doo a libi pe u sa kaba koti paati anga takuudu anga ogii.
eng_text: But of him, you are in Christ Jesus, who was made to us wisdom from God, and righteousness and sanctification, and redemption:

djk_text: Na so meke Masaa Gadu Buku be sikiifi a fesi taki: “Meke sama kaba gafa denseefi. Gafa Masaa Gadu wawan namo!”
eng_text: that, according as it is written, "He who boasts, let him boast in the Lord."

djk_text: Biibiwan! Luku mi ya seefi. Di mi be kon gi u Masaa Gadu bosikopu di a puu soi wi, mi á be kon enke gaan kufaliki takiman ofu gaan koniman de.
eng_text: When I came to you, brothers, I didn't come with excellence of speech or of wisdom, proclaiming to you the testimony of God.

djk_text: Bika mi be fende en fanowdu, fu taki namo fu Masaa Jesesi anga a hii wooko di a du na a koloisi. Da mi be poti ala taa sani a wanse.
eng_text: For I determined not to know anything among you, except Jesus Christ, and him crucified.

djk_text: Pakisei fa mi be taampu a u fesi fu taki. Mi be de anga ala swaki libisama fasi. Mi sikin be e dansi anga ala feele.
eng_text: I was with you in weakness, in fear, and in much trembling.

djk_text: Mi be e taki sondee daai a taki enke gaan kufaliki taki fu goontapu koniman. Bika mi be fitoow a taanga fu a Apaiti Jeje namo, fu wooko anga u, meke u teke biibi.
eng_text: My speech and my preaching were not in persuasive words of human wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power,

djk_text: Da u á be sa teke biibi komoto a gaan kufaliki taki fu libisama. Ma na a taanga fu Masaa Gadu be sa wooko anga u, fu teke biibi.
eng_text: that your faith wouldn't stand in the wisdom of men, but in the power of God.

djk_text: We, a ná enke Masaa Gadu bosikopu ná abi kufaliki koni. Ma na sama di lepi fiti fu wi soi den pisi de. Da a taki nái de enke gaan kufaliki taki fu goontapu koniman ofu goontapu bigiman di Masaa Gadu o puu poti a wanse.
eng_text: We speak wisdom, however, among those who are full grown; yet a wisdom not of this world, nor of the rulers of this world, who are coming to nothing.

djk_text: A bosikopu di wi e tyai e soi Masaa Gadu gaan koni fasi fu wooko. Noiti a fesi a be soi sama disi wanten. A be de kibii toli hii fositen te doo na a ten ya fosi di a poti fu tyai en kon a kiin gi sama fi en.
eng_text: But we speak God's wisdom in a mystery, the wisdom that has been hidden, which God foreordained before the worlds for our glory,

djk_text: Bigiman fu goontapu noiti sabi a gaan koni fasi di Masaa Gadu e wooko ya. Bika efu den be sabi, da den á be o koloisi a Masaa di a poti dyendee fasi anga enseefi.
eng_text: which none of the rulers of this world has known. For had they known it, they wouldn't have crucified the Lord of glory.

djk_text: Masaa Gadu Buku be sikiifi a fositen fu ala dati taki: “Sani di noiti ain si. Noiti yesi yee. Noiti pakisei denki. Na den foondoo sani de Masaa Gadu fiti seeka poti gi sama di lobi en.”
eng_text: But as it is written, "Things which an eye didn't see, and an ear didn't hear, which didn't enter into the heart of man, these God has prepared for those who love him."

djk_text: Namo a Apaiti Jeje fu Masaa Gadu piki u ala den sani ya, fu tyai den kon a kiin gi wi. Bika a poi si ala dipi denki fu Masaa Gadu seefi.
eng_text: But to us, God revealed them through the Spirit. For the Spirit searches all things, yes, the deep things of God.

djk_text: We, da sama sa poi si a denki fu wan taawan? Na a jeje fi yuseefi namo sa poi si yuseefi denki. Na so sama á poi si Masaa Gadu denki tu, boiti enseefi Jeje.
eng_text: For who among men knows the things of a man, except the spirit of the man, which is in him? Even so, no one knows the things of God, except God's Spirit.

djk_text: Da wi á kon sabi Masaa Gadu sani wan fasi fa goontapu e denki sani, jeje fasi. Ma na Masaa Gadu gi wi en Jeje, di piki u fu sabi san anga san Masaa Gadu du, di a teke bun ati fasi namo luku wi.
eng_text: But we received, not the spirit of the world, but the Spirit which is from God, that we might know the things that were freely given to us by God.

djk_text: Na so meke wi nái wooko anga gaan kufaliki wowtu fu goontapu koniman, fu taki Masaa Gadu sani. Bika na a Jeje fi en seefi e gi u wowtu fu taki. Soseefi ai piki wi ala san a wani u taki.
eng_text: Which things also we speak, not in words which man's wisdom teaches, but which the Holy Spirit teaches, comparing spiritual things with spiritual things.

djk_text: Da sama sondee Masaa Gadu Jeje nái poi teke taki di komoto na Jeje ya. Den e si dati enke wisiwasi taki. Bika na a Jeje namo e yeepi sama fu fusutan den.
eng_text: Now the natural man doesn't receive the things of God's Spirit, for they are foolishness to him, and he can't know them, because they are spiritually discerned.

djk_text: Ma sama anga a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu poi keli sani fu Masaa Gadu luku, fu fusutan. Da sama sondee Masaa Gadu Jeje nái poi keli a sama de seefi luku efu a taampu leti ofu fowtu.
eng_text: But he who is spiritual discerns all things, and he himself is judged by no one.

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu Buku be sikiifi a fesi taki: “Sama á sabi Masaa Gadu denki, fu poi soi en san fu du.” Ma wi di de anga Masaa Gadu Jeje sabi a denki fu Kelestesi.
eng_text: For who has known the mind of the Lord, that he should instruct him? But we have Christ's mind.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Ma toku di mi be de a u anda, da mi á be poi taki anga u ete enke sama anga Masaa Gadu Jeje. Mi be mu taki anga u enke sama di abi libisama fasi ete. Bika u be de nyunyun biibisama di á kaba sabi san fiti anga fowtu.
eng_text: Brothers, I couldn't speak to you as to spiritual, but as to fleshly, as to babies in Christ.

djk_text: Da na safu sani mi be mu leli u enke pikinengee di á poi nyan taanga sani, ma na meliki. U be de nyunyun biibiwan di á poi teke taanga sani fu Masaa Gadu. Ma san ogii nownow, na di toku ete u á poi teke den taanga leli de!
eng_text: I fed you with milk, not with meat; for you weren't yet ready. Indeed, not even now are you ready,

djk_text: Bika u tan libisama fasi ete. Sani enke dyalusu anga kwali de a u mindii de ete. Da u tan libisama fasi de ete. Soseefi u tan enke ibii taa sama a goontapu ya di nái biibi.
eng_text: for you are still fleshly. For insofar as there is jealousy, strife, and factions among you, aren't you fleshly, and don't you walk in the ways of men?

djk_text: Bika u de ape e paati useefi. Taawan taki, a teke a baka futu fu Pawlesi. Taawan taki, ai teke fu Apolos. We, da luku de fa u tan enke sama a goontapu ya di nái biibi.
eng_text: For when one says, "I follow Paul," and another, "I follow Apollos," aren't you fleshly?

djk_text: Ma mofina fu mi Pawlesi ya! Mofina fu Apolos tu. Bika wi na wookoman fu Masaa Gadu namo u de fu gi u de en bosikopu, fu biibi. Ma ibiiwan fu wi, da a gi en pisi wooko, fu du.
eng_text: Who then is Apollos, and who is Paul, but servants through whom you believed; and each as the Lord gave to him?

djk_text: Leti enke fa wan goon abi wookoman di bigin paandi, na so mi bigin a wooko. Ma soseefi wookoman mu de fu nati san paandi, na so Apolos tan leli u go doo. Ma na Masaa Gadu poti kaakiti gi a hii wooko, meke a goo.
eng_text: I planted. Apollos watered. But God gave the increase.

djk_text: Da a kon, a bigi fu a wooko á didon na a wookoman di paandi ofu a wookoman di e nati san paandi. Kweti! Ma na Awan di e meke a goo. Dati na Masaa Gadu seefi.
eng_text: So then neither he who plants is anything, nor he who waters, but God who gives the increase.

djk_text: A wooko fu paandiman anga man di e nati san paandi na awan bigi, fu tyai a seefi bun. Ma, na Masaa Gadu o pai ibiiwan na a fasi fa a du fi en se wooko.
eng_text: Now he who plants and he who waters are the same, but each will receive his own reward according to his own labor.

djk_text: Bika wi na wookoman di a poti namo, fu yeepi en wooko. A goon fu wooko dati na u ala enke sama di de fi en. Soseefi, da wi ala makandii de enke wan osu di a bow fu tan.
eng_text: For we are God's fellow workers. You are God's farming, God's building.

djk_text: Namo, ne a teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku mi, meke a poti mi enke gaan sabiman di poi sete a fondamenti pe tapu wi enke a osu fi en mu bow. Namo taa wookoman kon bow fu den se a dati tapu. Ma meke ibiiwan luku bun namo fa ai bow.
eng_text: According to the grace of God which was given to me, as a wise master builder I laid a foundation, and another builds on it. But let each man be careful how he builds on it.

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu poti awan kodo fondamenti kaba di tapu hii osu ya mu bow. Dati na Jesesi Kelestesi.
eng_text: For no one can lay any other foundation than that which has been laid, which is Jesus Christ.

djk_text: Da ibii wookoman mu bow leti anga bun wooko sani enke gowtu, solufu anga dii siton na a fondamenti ya tapu. Bika sama di bow anga soso wooko sani enke uwii, dee gaasi anga udu, da a nái bow leti.
eng_text: But if anyone builds on the foundation with gold, silver, costly stones, wood, hay, or stubble;

djk_text: Bika a gaan kuutu dei, da na ape yu o si taki, ala sani o kon a kiin fa ibiiwan be bow. Bika na faya o tesi ibiiwan pisi wooko luku.
