eng_text: each man's work will be revealed. For the Day will declare it, because it is revealed in fire; and the fire itself will test what sort of work each man's work is.

djk_text: Da te a wooko sani di wan sama be teke bow sa tan taampu sondee boon, da a sa fende paiman fu a wooko de.
eng_text: If any man's work remains which he built on it, he will receive a reward.

djk_text: Ma sama di be bow anga soso wooko sani, da a faya o boon ala dati. Da enseefi fika enke a pasa a wan nanai olo. Ma a sa taampu soso ana sondee paiman taki, a á be bow leti.
eng_text: If any man's work is burned, he will suffer loss, but he himself will be saved, but as through fire.

djk_text: Bika u mu fusutan taki, u anda na Masaa Gadu osu. A meke dati fi en Apaiti Jeje teke peesi tan.
eng_text: Don't you know that you are a temple of God, and that God's Spirit lives in you?

djk_text: We, ibiiwan di wooko takuu fu poli Masaa Gadu osu, da Masaa Gadu o kaba a sama de seefi a soso baka. Bika u na wan apaiti tanpeesi gi en, fu a tan.
eng_text: If anyone destroys the temple of God, God will destroy him; for God's temple is holy, which you are.

djk_text: Kaba koli iseefi anga a toli ya! Komoto a goontapu koni, efu na dati yu abi. Da i sa kon tyai nen fu lawman seefi. Ma i sabi taki, i teke tuutuu koni fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Let no one deceive himself. If anyone thinks that he is wise among you in this world, let him become a fool, that he may become wise.

djk_text: Bika goontapu koni na soso sani gi Masaa Gadu. A sikiifi a ini en Buku taki: “A tyai a koni fu goontapu go fasi, meke denseefi si a hii falisi koni fasi fu den de.”
eng_text: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God. For it is written, "He has taken the wise in their craftiness."

djk_text: Wan taa peesi sikiifi baka taki: “Masaa Gadu sabi taki, a denki fu goontapu koniman na soso sani di nái tyai wini.”
eng_text: And again, "The Lord knows the reasoning of the wise, that it is worthless."

djk_text: Da meke sama á gafa sama enke edeman di baka futu ai teke, fu waka de. Bika fa a de seefi, da na u enke biibiwan de Masaa Gadu gi ala san u fanowdu sowan fasi.
eng_text: Therefore let no one boast in men. For all things are yours,

djk_text: A poti edeman enke mi anga Apolos anga Kefasi enke wookoman gi u. Soseefi ala bun di a meke ya go doo a libi tego seefi. A yeepi di e kon baka dede seefi tu. Sani fu nownow anga san de fu kon seefi. Ala meke fu piisii u.
eng_text: whether Paul, or Apollos, or Cephas, or the world, or life, or death, or things present, or things to come. All are yours,

djk_text: Bika u na sama fu Kelestesi di komoto a Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: and you are Christ's, and Christ is God's.

djk_text: We, da sama mu si wi namo enke wookoman fu Kelestesi. A gi wi a wooko fu soi en bosikopu di noiti a fesi a be meke sama sabi. Da a be de wan kibii toli hii fositen te doo a ten ya.
eng_text: So let a man think of us as Christ's servants, and stewards of God's mysteries.

djk_text: Da wookoman enke u ya poti fu luku a wooko de gi wi basi. U mu solugu namo fu du dati fitoow fasi.
eng_text: Here, moreover, it is required of stewards, that they be found faithful.

djk_text: Ma mi ná bisi fa u wani keli mi anga mi wooko. Ala taa sama seefi tu. Bika miseefi á poi keli miseefi anga dati.
eng_text: But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged by you, or by man's judgment. Yes, I don't judge my own self.

djk_text: Bika miseefi sa si enke mi de sondee fowtu! Ma dati á wani taki, mi de sondee fowtu tuu. Na Masaa wawan e si ala sani, fu kuutu fa mi e wooko.
eng_text: For I know nothing against myself. Yet I am not justified by this, but he who judges me is the Lord.

djk_text: Da ná poti useefi anda enke u poi keli taawan wooko fosi a yuu fu Masaa seefi kon du dati. Bika a o tyai ala san di kibii seefi kon a kiin, doo fa wan ati be e wooko seefi. Da a sa gafa ibiiwan na a fasi di fiti.
eng_text: Therefore judge nothing before the time, until the Lord comes, who will both bring to light the hidden things of darkness, and reveal the counsels of the hearts. Then each man will get his praise from God.

djk_text: A hii toli di pasa, da mi Pawlesi kai miseefi anga Apolos nen, fu soi fa u á mu pasa a maiki di sikiifi a Masaa Gadu Buku fu keli sama. A taki: “Ná keli taawan poti a hei ofu poti lagi, wan fasi di á fiti Masaa Gadu.” Da u á sa poi gafa useefi fu dati tu.
eng_text: Now these things, brothers, I have in a figure transferred to myself and Apollos for your sakes, that in us you might learn not to think beyond the things which are written, that none of you be puffed up against one another.

djk_text: Bika sama meke u sa poi keli taawan luku? Na Masaa Gadu gi u ala san u abi de. Da u á sa poi gafa useefi de?
eng_text: For who makes you different? And what do you have that you didn't receive? But if you did receive it, why do you boast as if you had not received it?

djk_text: Bika u e du enke u abi ala sani kaba, da sani á de moo fu poi leli u. U sidon e tii ala sani kaba anga Masaa Gadu. Ma, da na sondee wi ya. Da kaba koli useefi! Efu a ten fu fende a bigi de be doo kaba, da wi dise á be o lasi en. Na wi anga u be o sidon a hei so.
eng_text: You are already filled. You have already become rich. You have come to reign without us. Yes, and I wish that you did reign, that we also might reign with you.

djk_text: Bika luku wi enke apaiti bosikopuman dise, da a gei Masaa Gadu lagi wi poti na ala taa sama ondoo. Den e si wi enke sani fu kisi tyai go kii. Ala ain de a wi tapu ala se, fu hii goontapu go doo Engel seefi.
eng_text: For, I think that God has displayed us, the apostles, last of all, like men sentenced to death. For we are made a spectacle to the world, both to angels and men.

djk_text: Da makandii wi e dini Kelestesi, ma goontapu e kai wi dise lawman, da den e kai u anda koniman. Den e kai wi ya swaki fasi sama, da den e kai u anda taanga makiti sama. Den e kai wi ya sakasaka, da den hei u anda gi gaandi.
eng_text: We are fools for Christ's sake, but you are wise in Christ. We are weak, but you are strong. You have honor, but we have dishonor.

djk_text: Nownow na tyotyo sondee nyan diingi wi dise de. Koosi seefi fu wei a sikin e mankei wi. Wi e teke fonfon anga ala waka sanga sondee tanpeesi.
eng_text: Even to this present hour we hunger, thirst, are naked, are beaten, and have no certain dwelling place.

djk_text: Wi mu langa ana wooko taanga, fu fende san u fanowdu. Da anga ala dati sama e bali kosi wi son leisi ete. Ma wi nái bali kosi baka. Wi e bali begi suku seigi gi den. Te den e lon du ogii anga wi, da u e fudaagi.
eng_text: We toil, working with our own hands. When people curse us, we bless. Being persecuted, we endure.

djk_text: Te den e taki takuu fu wi, da wi e bali piki lesipeki fasi anga Masaa Gadu bosikopu, fu yeepi den. Fu taki leti, goontapu e teke wi fu sibifutu koosi anga ala santi, fu sibi towe a dyiko.
eng_text: Being defamed, we entreat. We are made as the filth of the world, the dirt wiped off by all, even until now.

djk_text: We, ala san mi sikiifi pasa de, a ná fu gi u sen. Ma na fu leli u bun sani enke lobi biibi pikin fu mi.
eng_text: I don't write these things to shame you, but to admonish you as my beloved children.

djk_text: Bika dunsu sama sa wani kon leli u sani fu Kelestesi de. Ma on di fu den u sa kai biibi dda di u abi enke mi? Bika na mi fosi kon gi u a Bun Nyunsu, meke u teke biibi de.
eng_text: For though you have ten thousand tutors in Christ, yet not many fathers. For in Christ Jesus, I became your father through the Good News.

djk_text: Da fu dati ede, mi e taki, u luku mi! Da teke a fasi di mi abi, fu waka a Kelestesi baka.
eng_text: I beg you therefore, be imitators of me.

djk_text: Na so meke mi sende Timotiyesi di de mi lobi biibi manpikin kon luku u de gi mi. Ai dini Masaa wan fitoow fasi. Da a sa soi u baka fa mi e libi enke sama fu Kelestesi Jesesi. Soseefi fa mi e leli ala biibi kulu sama na ala se.
eng_text: Because of this I have sent Timothy to you, who is my beloved and faithful child in the Lord, who will remind you of my ways which are in Christ, even as I teach everywhere in every assembly.

djk_text: Ma son sama denki de taki, mi á wani kon luku u de moo. Ne son fu den bigin denki bigi fu denseefi anda.
eng_text: Now some are puffed up, as though I were not coming to you.

djk_text: Ma efu Masaa Gadu wani, da luku ya! Mi e kon de kaba! Mi sa si fa den e meke bigi de, efu na soso mofu den abi sondee Masaa Gadu taanga fu wooko.
eng_text: But I will come to you shortly, if the Lord is willing. And I will know, not the word of those who are puffed up, but the power.

djk_text: Bika a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu nái waka anga soso taki wawan namo. En taanga mu e wooko fu si de tu.
eng_text: For the Kingdom of God is not in word, but in power.

djk_text: We, mi e kon de kaba. Ma fa u wani mi kon de seefi? Anga wipi na ana ofu safu switi fasi, fu u sa si mi dipi lobi gi u?
eng_text: What do you want? Shall I come to you with a rod, or in love and a spirit of gentleness?

djk_text: Bika mi yee wan toli dise. A ogii! Wan biibiwan a u mindii de mu motyo te, ne ai du san foluku di nái biibi seefi nái peefuu du. Bika ai waka anga en dda uman!
eng_text: It is actually reported that there is sexual immorality among you, and such sexual immorality as is not even named among the Gentiles, that one has his father's wife.

djk_text: We, da fa u taawan sa sidon de e gafa useefi! Bika a sani de bigi fu tyai baaka gi seefi. Soseefi, a bigi fu puu a sama de a u mindii poti a doo.
eng_text: You are puffed up, and didn't rather mourn, that he who had done this deed might be removed from among you.

djk_text: Bika fu mi se dise, da mi á de a u mindii anda nownow libisama fasi! Ma jeje fasi, da mi taampu makandii anga u de, te fiti dise kaba san fu du anga a sama de.
eng_text: For I most certainly, as being absent in body but present in spirit, have already, as though I were present, judged him who has done this thing.

djk_text: Da u ala enke biibiwan mu kai wan gaan kuutu, fu taki a taki. Da u sa si enke mi seefi de anga u de, fu tii a kuutu. Soseefi, u sa taampu makandii de a ini a nen fu wi Masaa Jesesi. Da a sa fika fu wooko a ini a taanga fu Masaa Jesesi,
eng_text: In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, you being gathered together, and my spirit, with the power of our Lord Jesus Christ,

djk_text: fu poti a takuuduman de a didibii ana. Meke a kaba a soso libisama fasi. Da Masaa Gadu sa poi yeepi en wan jeje fasi ete, na a gaan kuutu dei.
eng_text: are to deliver such a one to Satan for the destruction of the flesh, that the spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord Jesus.

djk_text: Ma u taawan mu kaba sidon gafa useefi de anga ala fa wan gaan motyo sama de a u mindii de so. Bika wan nongo koti taki, wan pikintoin sowda e kengi a hii bolon.
eng_text: Your boasting is not good. Don't you know that a little yeast leavens the whole lump?

djk_text: Da u sa nyan fesa taki, Kelestesi dede pai gi wi enke a pikin sikapu di kii fu dati. Ma, towe ala takuudu anga ogii puu fosi, fu kon de kiin. Da u sa de enke fa Dyusama mu nyan a Pasika Fesa sondee fu baka beele nyan sondee soda.
eng_text: Purge out the old yeast, that you may be a new lump, even as you are unleavened. For indeed Christ, our Passover, has been sacrificed in our place.

djk_text: Da meke u nyan fesa enke fa Dyusama e piisii fu a meti di kii fu pai na a Pasika Fesa. A fesa ya á mu waka anga a haw fasi fu libi. Na so takuudu anga ogii á mu lolo de enke fa haw soda á bun fu baka a soifili beele fu a fesa de, da a mu towe. Da u sa piisii wan kiin anga tuutuu fasi.
eng_text: Therefore let us keep the feast, not with old yeast, neither with the yeast of malice and wickedness, but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.

djk_text: Mi be sikiifi wan biifi gi u kaba taki, kaba mosoo anga sama di abi motyo fasi.
eng_text: I wrote to you in my letter to have no company with sexual sinners;

djk_text: Ma dati á wani taki, na sama di á teke biibi. Bika hii goontapu, da yu musu waka miti den sowtu motyo sama de. Giiliman ofu bidiigiman seefi tu. Soseefi sama di e dini afokodeei sani. Fi yu á wani miti den dati, da i mu komoto a goontapu.
eng_text: yet not at all meaning with the sexual sinners of this world, or with the covetous and extortioners, or with idolaters; for then you would have to leave the world.

djk_text: Bika sama mi e taki dati na sama di e kai enseefi biibisama, ma ai motyo. A giiliman. Ai taki takuu fu taawan. A de diingiman ofu bidiigiman. Ai dini afokodeei sani. Nyan seefi yu á mu sidon nyan anga den sowtu sama de.
eng_text: But as it is, I wrote to you not to associate with anyone who is called a brother who is a sexual sinner, or covetous, or an idolater, or a slanderer, or a drunkard, or an extortioner. Don't even eat with such a person.

djk_text: Ma efu sowan sama á de biibisama, da mi ná abi den fu kuutu. Mi wooko á de fu kuutu sama a doose fu biibisama. Ma na fu kuutu a kulu fu biibiwan.
eng_text: For what have I to do with also judging those who are outside? Don't you judge those who are within?

djk_text: Na Masaa Gadu seefi o kuutu sama a doose fu biibisama. Ma wi mu wooko enke fa a sikiifi a Masaa Gadu Buku taki: “Puu a takuuduman a u mindii de.”
eng_text: But those who are outside, God judges. "Put away the wicked man from among yourselves."

djk_text: Gaantangi! Biibisama di abi toobi mu kaba tyai dati go kuutu a lanti fu kondee, fu suku leti anda. Bika den dati na sama di á teke biibi. Ma meke sama fu Masaa Gadu seeka en gi u.
eng_text: Dare any of you, having a matter against his neighbor, go to law before the unrighteous, and not before the saints?

djk_text: Bika fa u sabi, da na biibisama o yeepi Masaa Gadu kuutu goontapu na a gaan kuutu dei. Da u musu poi koti pikin kuutu a u mindii de kaba.
eng_text: Don't you know that the saints will judge the world? And if the world is judged by you, are you unworthy to judge the smallest matters?

djk_text: Sabi taki, wi o yeepi Masaa Gadu fu kuutu Engel seefi. Da u musu fu poi koti pikin toobi di e pasa ibii dei de.
eng_text: Don't you know that we will judge angels? How much more, things that pertain to this life?

djk_text: Biibisama di u e si lagi fasi enke noti de seefi sa musu abi abi a koni, fu koti toobi di e pasa ibii dei de! Poti den sidon du dati, da i sa si.
eng_text: If then, you have to judge things pertaining to this life, do you set them to judge who are of no account in the assembly?

djk_text: Mi taki dati, fu gi u sen. Bika fa a gei wan kodo fusutan biibisama á de a u mindii de seefi, fu kuutu toobi di u abi enke biibiwan de?
eng_text: I say this to move you to shame. Isn't there even one wise man among you who would be able to decide between his brothers?

djk_text: Bika biibiwan e seepi taawan tyai go kuutu a lanti fu kondee fesi de. Moo ogii seefi, sama di mu koti a kuutu á de biibisama seefi.
eng_text: But brother goes to law with brother, and that before unbelievers!

djk_text: Ma, da a be ogii kaba taki, biibisama anga biibisama e abi toobi de. Bika a be sa moo bun fu gwili ogii fu taawan kuwaa na ati. Saide biibiwan á poi fudaagi ogii fu taawan de?
eng_text: Therefore it is already altogether a defect in you, that you have lawsuits one with another. Why not rather be wronged? Why not rather be defrauded?

djk_text: Moo ogii seefi, na yu teke fu du ogii anga taawan de. Yu e bidiigi taawan anga sani go doo taa biibiwan enke u seefi!
eng_text: No, but you yourselves do wrong, and defraud, and that against your brothers.

djk_text: U mu kaba koli useefi! Sabi taki, sama di e du ogii, da a ná o fende a bun di de a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu. Da motyo sama mu luku bun! Sama di e dini afokodeei sani tu. Sama di e suku taawan uman ofu man. Manengee di e makume pikin manpikin. Manengee di e libi anga taa manengee.
eng_text: Or don't you know that the unrighteous will not inherit the Kingdom of God? Don't be deceived. Neither the sexually immoral, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor male prostitutes, nor homosexuals,

djk_text: Fufuuman anga giiliman. Diingiman anga sama di e taki takuu fu taawan. Bidiigiman tu. Ala den sama de ná o fende a bun di de a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: nor thieves, nor covetous, nor drunkards, nor slanderers, nor extortioners, will inherit the Kingdom of God.

djk_text: Fosi u be teke biibi, da u be abi den takuu fasi de tu. Ma u kon wasi kiin nownow. Ne u libi kon de apaiti fasi. U kon de letiopu gi Masaa Gadu, fu di u taampu a ini a nen fu Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi anga a Apaiti Jeje fu wi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Such were some of you, but you were washed. But you were sanctified. But you were justified in the name of the Lord Jesus, and in the Spirit of our God.

djk_text: Bika mi ya sa taki: “Mi komoto a katibo fu ala sani. Da mi sa du ala san mi wani.” Ma ala san mi wani du á bun fu tyai wini! Libisama fasi, da takuu losutu de fu du anga sikin. Ma den á mu poi wooko enke basi a mi tapu.
eng_text: All things are lawful for me, but not all things are expedient. "All things are lawful for me," but I will not be brought under the power of anything.

djk_text: Son sama e denki taki: “Nyanyan á be meke fi en anga bee mu wooko makandii, no?” Na so tuu! Ma den dati meke fu wan satu pisiten namo. Bika Masaa Gadu o tyai kaba gi den. Ma sikin á meke fu wooko makandii anga motyo fasi. Bika a sikin meke fu Masaa Gadu teke wooko tego.
eng_text: Foods for the belly, and the belly for foods, but God will bring to nothing both it and them. But the body is not for sexual immorality, but for the Lord; and the Lord for the body.

djk_text: Bika a ná Masaa Jesesi wawan namo Masaa Gadu poti fu weki puu a dede. A o wooko anga en taanga makiti, fu weki wi ya seefi anga wi hii sikin.
eng_text: Now God raised up the Lord, and will also raise us up by his power.

djk_text: Soseefi, da sabi taki, ibiiwan fu wi anga Kelestesi mokisa libi. Da fa u sa teke dati tyai go mokisa anga motyo? Mi ya dati noiti o du dati, ye!
eng_text: Don't you know that your bodies are members of Christ? Shall I then take the members of Christ, and make them members of a prostitute? May it never be!

djk_text: Bika u mu sabi fa Masaa Gadu Buku sikiifi, fu sama di miti uman anga man fasi. A taki, den tu sama de mokisa libi toon wan sikin. Na so sama di go miti anga wan motyo, mokisa libi anga en toon wan sikin tu.
eng_text: Or don't you know that he who is joined to a prostitute is one body? For, "The two," says he, "will become one flesh."

djk_text: Ma sama di mokisa libi anga Masaa, da jeje fasi, a toon wan anga Masaa tu.
eng_text: But he who is joined to the Lord is one spirit.

djk_text: Da wai a pasi gi motyo fasi! Bika ala taa takuudu anga ogii nái du anga yu sikin. Ma motyo fasi dati e kai a yu sikin seefi.
eng_text: Flee sexual immorality! "Every sin that a man does is outside the body," but he who commits sexual immorality sins against his own body.

djk_text: Soseefi, i sabi taki, yu sikin na a osu pe Masaa Gadu Apaiti Jeje e tan. Bika Masaa Gadu sende en kon teke peesi de. Da yu á de fi iseefi moo.
eng_text: Or don't you know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit which is in you, which you have from God? You are not your own,

djk_text: Bika Kelestesi pai fi yu sikin. Na so Masaa Gadu bai en teke anga wan gaan paiman. Da a toon sani fu teke gi Masaa Gadu gaandi.
eng_text: for you were bought with a price. Therefore glorify God in your body and in your spirit, which are God's.

djk_text: We, u be sende biifi akisi mi wantu sani. A fosi sani di mi wani piki u taki, na wan bun sani fu biibi man tan libi sondee uman.
eng_text: Now concerning the things about which you wrote to me: it is good for a man not to touch a woman.

djk_text: Boiti efu wan sama á poi tan sondee fu waka motyo fasi. Da meke a man de teke wan uman fi enseefi. Soseefi uman mu teke wan man fi enseefi.
eng_text: But, because of sexual immoralities, let each man have his own wife, and let each woman have her own husband.

djk_text: Da noiti uman mu fuufeli uman anga man fasi gi en man. Dati ne en wooko fu du. Noiti man seefi mu fuufeli uman anga man fasi gi en uman. Dati ne en wooko fu du tu.
eng_text: Let the husband render to his wife the affection owed her, and likewise also the wife to her husband.

djk_text: A uman á mu denki taki, en sikin na fi en wawan teke wooko fa a wani. Bika en sikin toon fu a man tu. A man seefi á mu denki taki, en sikin na fi en wawan teke wooko fa a wani. Bika en sikin toon fu a uman tu.
eng_text: The wife doesn't have authority over her own body, but the husband. Likewise also the husband doesn't have authority over his own body, but the wife.

djk_text: Da noiti uman anga man mu taki nono gi denseefi. Boiti efu den fiti makandii fu teke wan yuu begi. Ma bakadati, da kon siibi makandii baka. Meke didibii á sa fende pasi tesi u tyai go du ogii, fu di u á poi dwengi useefi oli bun fasi.
eng_text: Don't deprive one another, unless it is by consent for a season, that you may give yourselves to fasting and prayer, and may be together again, that Satan doesn't tempt you because of your lack of self-control.

djk_text: Ma mi á sende u namo namo fu libi anga uman ofu libi anga man. Ma mi e soi namo fa a hii toli ya mu waka seefi.
eng_text: But this I say by way of concession, not of commandment.

djk_text: Bika fu mi se, da ibiiwan be mu poi taampu taanga fu libi enke mi. Ma a didon a Masaa Gadu di e gi ibiiwan apaiti taanga fu wooko. Da wan e poi du disi, da a taawan e poi du dati.
eng_text: Yet I wish that all men were like me. However each man has his own gift from God, one of this kind, and another of that kind.

djk_text: Ma sama di de sondee uman ofu man ofu yu man dede kaba, da tan enke mi. Libi sondee teke uman libi ofu teke man libi baka.
eng_text: But I say to the unmarried and to widows, it is good for them if they remain even as I am.

djk_text: Ma efu losutu fu uman anga man taanga moo yu sikin, da sete wan libi. Bika dati moo bun moo buulu de ape e faya anga losutu fasi.
eng_text: But if they don't have self-control, let them marry. For it's better to marry than to burn.

djk_text: We, mi e taigi ala uman anga man di libi kaba wan weiti di Masaa seefi poti. A taki: “Wan uman noiti mu fika en man.”
eng_text: But to the married I command--not I, but the Lord--that the wife not leave her husband

djk_text: Efu toku wan uman fika en man, da a mu tan sondee taa man. Efu a mu libi baka seefi, da a mu daai go na a seefi man baka. Na sowan man seefi noiti mu fika en uman.
eng_text: (but if she departs, let her remain unmarried, or else be reconciled to her husband), and that the husband not leave his wife.

djk_text: Ma biibiwan di libi anga uman ofu man di á de biibisama? Masaa seefi á poti wan weiti fini fini fu dati. Ma mi seefi denki taki, wan biibi man mu tan libi anga sowan uman, efu a uman de wani so.
eng_text: But to the rest I--not the Lord--say, if any brother has an unbelieving wife, and she is content to live with him, let him not leave her.

djk_text: Soseefi wan biibi uman mu tan libi anga en man di á teke biibi, efu a man wani dati.
eng_text: The woman who has an unbelieving husband, and he is content to live with her, let her not leave her husband.

djk_text: Bika man di á teke biibi libi mokisa anga en biibi uman, fu de apaiti fasi gi Masaa Gadu. Soseefi uman di á teke biibi seefi libi mokisa anga en biibi man, fu de apaiti fasi gi Masaa Gadu. Masaa Gadu e si den so, fu a sa luku pikin fu den wan apaiti fasi moo pikin fu sama di nái biibi.
eng_text: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified in the wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified in the husband. Otherwise your children would be unclean, but now they are holy.

djk_text: Ma efu a uman ofu man di á teke biibi wani fika yu, da meke a go fi en. Biibiwan ná abi fu tei denseefi fasi anga dati. Bika Masaa Gadu kai wi fu libi anga switi ati.
eng_text: Yet if the unbeliever departs, let there be separation. The brother or the sister is not under bondage in such cases, but God has called us in peace.

djk_text: Bika, kande i sa meke a man fi i daai teke a biibi seefi. Kande i sa meke a uman fi i daai teke a biibi seefi tu.
eng_text: For how do you know, wife, whether you will save your husband? Or how do you know, husband, whether you will save your wife?

djk_text: Da de san i de di Masaa Gadu kai yu teke toon sama fi enseefi. Na so mi e leli biibiwan na ala se.
eng_text: Only, as the Lord has distributed to each man, as God has called each, so let him walk. So I command in all the assemblies.

djk_text: Sama di be koti maiki a manpeesi toon Dyusama, meke a de fi en so. Sama di á be koti maiki so, meke a de fi en so tu.
eng_text: Was anyone called having been circumcised? Let him not become uncircumcised. Has anyone been called in uncircumcision? Let him not be circumcised.

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu nái teli bigi, efu yu koti maiki ofu yu á koti maiki a manpeesi. San e teli dati na fu wan sama e teke Masaa Gadu taki, fu libi.
eng_text: Circumcision is nothing, and uncircumcision is nothing, but the keeping of the commandments of God.

djk_text: Da meke ibiiwan de san a de, di Masaa Gadu be kai en teke toon sama fi en.
eng_text: Let each man stay in that calling in which he was called.

djk_text: Efu wan sama be de saafu a katibo, meke a de fi en so, sondee booko ede. Mi á taki, okasi kon fu komoto saafu a katibo, da yu á mu gaapu dati.
eng_text: Were you called being a bondservant? Don't let that bother you, but if you get an opportunity to become free, use it.

djk_text: Bika te Masaa kai wan saafu teke toon sama fi en, da a puu dati a saafu fu sama. Sama di á be de saafu tu, ne a kai yu teke toon fi en, da yu de fu wooko ne en ondoo enke saafu.
eng_text: For he who was called in the Lord being a bondservant is the Lord's free man. Likewise he who was called being free is Christ's bondservant.

djk_text: Bika a pai wan gaan paiman di bai yu teke. Da kaba si yuseefi enke i de saafu a katibo fu sama.
eng_text: You were bought with a price. Don't become bondservants of men.

djk_text: We, biibiwan! Da de san i de di Masaa Gadu kai yu teke toon sama fi en.
eng_text: Brothers, let each man, in whatever condition he was called, stay in that condition with God.

djk_text: Da u be sende biifi akisi mi fu yonkuu uman mu tan libi sondee man. We, Masaa seefi á poti weiti fini fini fu dati. Ma mi o soi san miseefi e denki. Da di na Masaa teke tyali ati fasi namo luku mi, da u sa fitoow mi taki.
eng_text: Now concerning virgins, I have no commandment from the Lord, but I give my judgment as one who has obtained mercy from the Lord to be trustworthy.

djk_text: Na wan bun sani fu tan libi sondee uman ofu man. Bika taanga ten sa de fu dati, da yu be sa wai gi dati.
eng_text: I think that it is good therefore, because of the distress that is on us, that it is good for a man to be as he is.

djk_text: Ma dati á wani taki, wan man sete wan libi kaba, da a mu booko dati baka. Kweti! Ma sama di ná abi uman moo á mu go feti sete wan taa libi baka.
eng_text: Are you bound to a wife? Don't seek to be freed. Are you free from a wife? Don't seek a wife.

djk_text: A ná enke man di libi anga uman baka du wan ogii. Yonkuu uman di teke wan man libi seefi tu. Ma sama di sete wan libi mu sabi taki, a libi de abi tyotyo libisama fasi. Da mi á be sa wani u miti dati.
eng_text: But if you marry, you have not sinned. If a virgin marries, she has not sinned. Yet such will have oppression in the flesh, and I want to spare you.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Mi wani soi anga ala dati fa a libi fu goontapu ya satu. Da meke wan man di libi anga uman poi de anga Masaa Gadu enke di a be de sondee uman.
eng_text: But I say this, brothers: the time is short, that from now on, both those who have wives may be as though they had none;

djk_text: Meke sama anga buduufu sabi taki, buduufu ya á de fu tan tego. Meke sama anga piisii sabi taki, piisii ya á de fu tan tego.
eng_text: and those who weep, as though they didn't weep; and those who rejoice, as though they didn't rejoice; and those who buy, as though they didn't possess;

djk_text: Sama di e bai sani seli baka á mu teke a moni ya teli enke moo gaan sani. Bika dyonson, da a hii goontapu ya o pasa gwe.
eng_text: and those who use the world, as not using it to the fullest. For the mode of this world passes away.

djk_text: Da mi wani u libi sondee booko ede. Bika man sondee uman abi wan kodo booko ede namo, fu libi piisii Masaa Gadu. Da ai wooko anga hii pakisei a den sani fu Masaa.
eng_text: But I desire to have you to be free from cares. He who is unmarried is concerned for the things of the Lord, how he may please the Lord;

djk_text: Ma te man libi anga uman, da ai booko ede ala fasi anga goontapu sani, fu libi piisii en uman. Da ai abi tu booko ede.
eng_text: but he who is married is concerned about the things of the world, how he may please his wife.

djk_text: Soseefi uman sondee man anga yonkuu uman e abi wan kodo booko ede. Dati na fu gi ten anga hii pakisei a san bigi gi Masaa. Den e libisama fasi anga jeje fasi gi Masaa. Ma te den libi anga man, da den e booko ede anga goontapu sani fu libi piisii den man.
eng_text: There is also a difference between a wife and a virgin. The unmarried woman cares about the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and in spirit. But she who is married cares about the things of the world--how she may please her husband.

djk_text: Mi booko a hii toli ya pisipisi, ma a ná fu banda u anda. Kweti! Ma na fu yeepi u. Bika mi wani goontapu libi á sa muliki u pakisei di mu de a Masaa Gadu wawan. Na so mi wani u libi enke fa a mu de.
eng_text: This I say for your own profit; not that I may ensnare you, but for that which is appropriate, and that you may attend to the Lord without distraction.

djk_text: Dda di abi yonkuu umanpikin! Efu yu e si enke i fowtu fu fika en sondee fu teke man libi, da gi en pasi fu du dati. Na wan bun sani, da a ná ogii. Bika a goo doo peesi kaba.
eng_text: But if any man thinks that he is behaving inappropriately toward his virgin, if she is past the flower of her age, and if need so requires, let him do what he desires. He doesn't sin. Let them marry.

djk_text: Ma efu yu fende taki, yu yonkuu umanpikin mu tan sondee fu libi anga man, da yu abi pasi fu fika en so. Na wan bun sani tu. A á mu de namo taki, na sama dwengi yu fu wooko so.
eng_text: But he who stands steadfast in his heart, having no necessity, but has power over his own heart, to keep his own virgin, does well.

djk_text: Soo! Da yonkuu umanpikin teke man libi na wan bun sani. Yonkuu umanpikin tan sondee teke man libi moo bun baka seefi.
eng_text: So then both he who gives his own virgin in marriage does well, and he who doesn't give her in marriage does better.

djk_text: Bika wan weiti taki, uman di libi anga man noiti mu fika dati go teke taa man. Na te a man dede fosi, da a sa teke taa man libi baka di mu de wan biibi man tu.
eng_text: A wife is bound by law for as long as her husband lives; but if the husband is dead, she is free to be married to whomever she desires, only in the Lord.

djk_text: Ma fu mi se, da a be sa moo bun fu a be sa tan sondee fu libi anga man baka, te a man dede. Dati na wan sani di mi sabi Masaa Gadu Jeje e piki mi.
eng_text: But she is happier if she stays as she is, in my judgment, and I think that I also have God's Spirit.

djk_text: Da u be sende biifi akisi mi sani fu nyan meti di kii fu begi falisi gadu. We, ibii sani yu o du á mu waka anga gaanbigi sabi di u ala abi namo. Dati na bigi fasi! Ma lobi taawan. Da yu o du sani fi enseefi biibi kon moo taanga.
eng_text: Now concerning things sacrificed to idols: We know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.

djk_text: Bika son sama e denki taki, a sabi ala sani. Ma meke a sama sabi taki, noiti sama kaba sabi sani wanten.
eng_text: But if anyone thinks that he knows anything, he doesn't yet know as he ought to know.

djk_text: Ma na te wan sama lobi Masaa Gadu namo, da Masaa Gadu e sabi yu enke sama di ai teli.
eng_text: But if anyone loves God, the same is known by him.

djk_text: Da u be sende biifi akisi mi sani fu nyan meti di kii fu begi falisi gadu. We, u ala sabi taki, falisi gadu a goontapu ya á de wan sani. Na Masaa Gadu na awan kodo tuutuu Gadu.
eng_text: Therefore concerning the eating of things sacrificed to idols, we know that no idol is anything in the world, and that there is no other God but one.

djk_text: Bika tyaipi falisi gadu de a goontapu anga tapu anda. Den falisi gadu lai, soseefi somen sowtu masaa de tu.
eng_text: For though there are things that are called "gods," whether in the heavens or on earth; as there are many "gods" and many "lords";

djk_text: Ma wi kon sabi taki, na wan kodo Gadu namo de. Dati na a Tata fu wi pe ala sani komoto. A libi seefi. Wan kodo Masaa namo de tu. Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi di Masaa Gadu sende meke ala sani. U mokisa libi anga en fende a libi fu Masaa Gadu di a abi.
eng_text: yet to us there is one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we for him; and one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom are all things, and we live through him.

djk_text: Ma a ná ala sama sabi ala dati. Da den e teli falisi gadu fu wan gaan sani. Bika den de swaki libisama fasi ete. Da efu den nyan meti di kii fu begi falisi gadu, da konsensi e kaagi den.
eng_text: However, that knowledge isn't in all men. But some, with consciousness of the idol until now, eat as of a thing sacrificed to an idol, and their conscience, being weak, is defiled.

djk_text: Ma nyanyan toli á bigi fu tyai wi doo Masaa Gadu fesi. Efu u e nyan, efu u nái nyan, dati nái meke u bigi ofu lagi gi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: But food will not commend us to God. For neither, if we don't eat, are we the worse; nor, if we eat, are we the better.

djk_text: Ma luku bun namo, te yu sabi taki, yu abi pasi fu du wan sani. Bika swaki sama di á sabi enke yu konsensi o kaagi den de. Da yu o meke dati naki en futu!
eng_text: But be careful that by no means does this liberty of yours become a stumbling block to the weak.

djk_text: Bika yu sabi sani. Ma kande wan swakiwan di á sabi sani enke yu de ape. Da ai si yu sidon e nyan a peesi pe meti e nyan di kii fu begi falisi gadu. Da yu o meke enseefi teke nyan tu.
eng_text: For if a man sees you who have knowledge sitting in an idol's temple, won't his conscience, if he is weak, be emboldened to eat things sacrificed to idols?

djk_text: Ma en konsensi swaki libisama fasi ete. Da yu di sabi sani so tyai wan sani kon paati a swaki sama de anga Masaa Gadu. We, na wan sama di Kelestesi be teke dede pai fu yeepi tu. Ma yu meke a lasi ala dati.
eng_text: And through your knowledge, he who is weak perishes, the brother for whose sake Christ died.

djk_text: Da yu du wan gaan ogii anga a taa biibiwan taki, i poli a konsensi fi en di swaki libisama fasi ete. Da anga Kelestesi seefi i du a gaan ogii de tu.
eng_text: Thus, sinning against the brothers, and wounding their conscience when it is weak, you sin against Christ.

djk_text: We, mi á wani nyan wan sani, da ai tyai taawan futu go naki. Fu mi se, da mi hii libi langa, mi be o tapu nyan meti de. Bika mi á wani tyai taa biibiwan futu go naki.
eng_text: Therefore if food causes my brother to stumble, I will eat no meat forevermore, that I don't cause my brother to stumble.

djk_text: Ma, da na dwengi mi de? Kweti! Mi na apaiti bosikopuman fu wi Masaa Jesesi. Mi be si en anga ain. Mi wooko tyai u kon toon biibisama.
eng_text: Am I not free? Am I not an apostle? Haven't I seen Jesus Christ, our Lord? Aren't you my work in the Lord?

djk_text: Da taa sama sa taki, mi á de apaiti bosikopuman fi en. Ma u anda á poi taki dati. Bika fa mi tyai u kon toon biibisama na wan maiki fu soi dati.
eng_text: If to others I am not an apostle, yet at least I am to you; for you are the seal of my apostleship in the Lord.

djk_text: Na so mi e piki ala den sama di e sitee taki, mi á de apaiti bosikopuman.
eng_text: My defense to those who examine me is this.

djk_text: We, da wi enke apaiti bosikopuman abi pasi fu meke yu biibiwan de mu solugu wi anga nyanyan anga diingi.
eng_text: Have we no right to eat and to drink?

djk_text: Wi dise abi pasi fu libi anga wan biibi uman tyai waka lontu anga wi. Taa apaiti bosikopuman du dati. Den tyuku tyuku baala fu Masaa Jesesi anga Kefasi seefi.
eng_text: Have we no right to take along a wife who is a believer, even as the rest of the apostles, and the brothers of the Lord, and Cephas?

djk_text: Da u si enke mi anga Balnabasi ná abi pasi fu kaba du taa wooko solugu u seefi?
eng_text: Or have only Barnabas and I no right to not work?

djk_text: Bika suudati a wooko tapu nái du taa wooko solugu enseefi. Sama di paandi wan goon mu libi fu a nyanyan di sii puu de. Sama di e kweki kaw mu diingi a meliki di ai puu.
eng_text: What soldier ever serves at his own expense? Who plants a vineyard, and doesn't eat of its fruit? Or who feeds a flock, and doesn't drink from the flock's milk?

djk_text: Ala a taki de waka libisama fasi. Ma Masaa Gadu weiti taki fu dati tu.
eng_text: Do I speak these things according to the ways of men? Or doesn't the law also say the same thing?

djk_text: Bika Mosesi weiti sikiifi taki: “Noiti tei wan kaw mofu te ai wooko yu goon. Gi en pasi fu nyan na a wooko tapu.” Ma kaba denki na kaw namo taki Masaa Gadu e taki de so.
eng_text: For it is written in the law of Moses, "You shall not muzzle an ox while it treads out the grain." Is it for the oxen that God cares,

djk_text: Bika dati sikiifi gi wi enke wookoman fi en. Sama di wooko a wan goon mu poi luku fu fende wini fu dati. Sama di koti a nyanyan fu a goon tu.
eng_text: or does he say it assuredly for our sake? Yes, it was written for our sake, because he who plows ought to plow in hope, and he who threshes in hope should partake of his hope.

djk_text: Da na wi ya wooko, fu gi u anda a Bun Nyunsu. Da a ná ogii, fu luku fu fende wini a u anda baka.
eng_text: If we sowed to you spiritual things, is it a great thing if we reap your fleshly things?

djk_text: Wi abi pasi fu fende wini a u de moo taa wookoman di e fende wini a u de nownow. Ma kweti! Bika a moo betee u banda useefi teke ala sowtu pina, fu meke wi á tyai wan enkii sani kon poti muliki a Bun Nyunsu fu Kelestesi.
eng_text: If others partake of this right over you, don't we yet more? Nevertheless we did not use this right, but we bear all things, that we may cause no hindrance to the Good News of Christ.

djk_text: Ma u sabi taki, wookoman na a apaiti begi tafaa a ini a Mama Keliki be sa nyan fu a paiman di tyai kon poti begi Masaa Gadu de. Fesiman fu Dyu keliki be sa nyan a meti di sama e tyai go kii begi Masaa Gadu paadon na a apaiti begi tafaa.
eng_text: Don't you know that those who serve around sacred things eat from the things of the temple, and those who wait on the altar have their portion with the altar?

djk_text: Na so Masaa fiti poti gi wi di e tyai a Bun Nyunsu. U mu fende solugu a sama di e teke biibi a dati.
eng_text: Even so the Lord ordained that those who proclaim the Good News should live from the Good News.

djk_text: Ma mi nái luku fu u solugu mi. Winsi fa mi abi pasi fu dati seefi. Da fa mi sikiifi ya baka á de fu suku dati tu. A moo betee mi dede! Bika mi á wani poli awan kodo bun nen di mi abi fu gafa.
eng_text: But I have used none of these things, and I don't write these things that it may be done so in my case; for I would rather die, than that anyone should make my boasting void.

djk_text: Bika fa mi e gi a Bun Nyunsu ya, ma mi á poi gafa miseefi anga en. Bika na Kelestesi kisi mi poti fu du a wooko ya namo namo. Da heelu fu mi, efu mi á du en!
eng_text: For if I preach the Good News, I have nothing to boast about; for necessity is laid on me; but woe is to me, if I don't preach the Good News.

djk_text: Bika efu mi be e du a wooko ya anga miseefi wani, da mi be o teke paiman fi en. Ma kweti! Na Kelestesi sende mi. Da na mi wooko di mi musu fu du.
eng_text: For if I do this of my own will, I have a reward. But if not of my own will, I have a stewardship entrusted to me.

djk_text: Ma luku a paiman fu di mi e tyai a Bun Nyunsu ya. Na di mi e du a wooko ya sondee fu suku san mi abi pasi fu teke. Da dati e gi mi piisii.
eng_text: What then is my reward? That, when I preach the Good News, I may present the Good News of Christ without charge, so as not to abuse my authority in the Good News.

djk_text: Ma mi á de a dwengi taki, sama na mi basi fu a wooko ya. Ma toku miseefi poti miseefi fu wooko piisii ala sama. Da mi sa wini onmen mi poi meke kon toon biibisama.
eng_text: For though I was free from all, I brought myself under bondage to all, that I might gain the more.

djk_text: Da te mi doo Dyusama, da mi e oli miseefi Dyu, fu wini son fu den. Weiti nái wooko a mi tapu. Ma te mi doo sama anga weiti fasi, da mi e oli miseefi weiti fasi tu, fu wini son fu den de.
eng_text: To the Jews I became as a Jew, that I might gain Jews; to those who are under the law, as under the law, that I might gain those who are under the law;

djk_text: Te mi doo taa foluku sondee weiti fasi, da mi e oli miseefi sondee weiti fasi tu, fu wini son fu den. Ma dati nái wani taki, mi e kaba anga a tuutuu weiti fa Kelestesi leli wi libi.
eng_text: to those who are without law, as without law (not being without law toward God, but under law toward Christ), that I might win those who are without law.

djk_text: Soseefi, te mi doo biibiwan di swaki libisama fasi ete, da mi nái du sani enke mi sabi moo den. Na so mi e wooko ala fasi gi ala sowtu sama, fu yeepi onmen mi poi wini gi Kelestesi.
eng_text: To the weak I became as weak, that I might gain the weak. I have become all things to all men, that I may by all means save some.

djk_text: Ala a wooko ya na fu a Bun Nyunsu sa go doo ala sama. Da mi anga den makandii sa fende den dyendee seigi di Masaa Gadu paamisi.
eng_text: Now I do this for the sake of the Good News, that I may be a joint partaker of it.

djk_text: Ma somen sama e tiingi a lo fu sitee lon. Ma na wan kodo namo o toon winiman fu a gaan paiman. Da meke moiti seefi, fu wini a gaan paiman ya.
eng_text: Don't you know that those who run in a race all run, but one receives the prize? Run like that, that you may win.

djk_text: Sama di o go sitee lon e seeka bun, fu wai son sani di ai losutu poti a wanse fosi. Ma na fu wini gowtu ati wei a ede, di á de fu wei tego. Wiseefi mu wai son sani di wi e losutu poti wan se, fu wini a gowtu ati fu wei tego.
eng_text: Every man who strives in the games exercises self-control in all things. Now they do it to receive a corruptible crown, but we an incorruptible.

djk_text: Mi ya seefi e meke moiti! Mi nái lon enke mi lasi pasi daai lontu enke mi nái si pe fu lon go wini. Mi nái feti enke kofuman di kofu e kai a soso peesi, fu naki a winta.
eng_text: I therefore run like that, as not uncertainly. I fight like that, as not beating the air,

djk_text: Kweti! Mi e dwengi losutu fu sikin, fu dati á wooko enke basi a mi tapu. Da a ná o de taki, mi leli somen sama fende Masaa Gadu paamisi, ma miseefi lasi a gaan winiman paiman.
eng_text: but I beat my body and bring it into submission, lest by any means, after I have preached to others, I myself should be rejected.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Pakisei wi avo gaansama. U sabi fa ala den be waka makandii komoto a saafu a Egepte Kondee anga Mosesi! Masaa Gadu poti wan woluku a den fesi a tapu, fu kibii den. A piiti a ze a mindii dee wan pasi fu waka abaa.
eng_text: Now I would not have you ignorant, brothers, that our fathers were all under the cloud, and all passed through the sea;

djk_text: Ne ala den pasa anga a woluku a ini a ze wataa. Na so den dopu toon sama fu Mosesi.
eng_text: and were all baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea;

djk_text: Masaa Gadu solugu ala den anga wan apaiti sowtu nyanyan di ai towe ibii neti komoto a tapu wan foondoo sowtu jeje fasi.
eng_text: and all ate the same spiritual food;

djk_text: A poti wan apaiti sowtu siton fu wataa lon wan foondoo sowtu jeje fasi, fu fende diingi. Dati be de Kelestesi seefi di be e waka anga den na ala pe den e go.
eng_text: and all drank the same spiritual drink. For they drank of a spiritual rock that followed them, and the rock was Christ.

djk_text: Ma toku a moo gaanse fu den á tyai denseefi piisii Masaa Gadu. Na dati meke a hii sabana doti be tiingi ala se anga dedewan fu den di kai fika de.
eng_text: However with most of them, God was not well pleased, for they were overthrown in the wilderness.

djk_text: A hii toli de meke fu wasikoi wi nownow, fu luku bun! Bika fu sani á mu waka so anga wi, da wi á mu meke takuu losutu tyai wi du ogii enke den.
eng_text: Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things, as they also lusted.

djk_text: Meke wi á dini falisi gadu enke somen fu den. Bika Masaa Gadu Buku sikiifi taki: “A foluku poti enseefi fu nyan diingi fesa gi falisi gadu. Den e opo dansi fanya fanya tu.”
eng_text: Neither be idolaters, as some of them were. As it is written, "The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play."

djk_text: We, meke wi á teke motyo fasi enke son fu den. Ne Masaa Gadu be mu kii twenti a dii dunsu (23.000) fu den a ini wan dei namo.
eng_text: Neither let us commit sexual immorality, as some of them committed, and in one day twenty-three thousand fell.

djk_text: Meke wi á tesi Masaa enke somen fu den. Ne a be mu puu sineki go nyan den kii.
eng_text: Neither let us test the Lord, as some of them tested, and perished by the serpents.

djk_text: Meke wi á kaagi a Masaa yesi enke somen fu den. Ne a be sende wan Engel fi en go kii den kaba a soso.
eng_text: Neither grumble, as some of them also grumbled, and perished by the destroyer.

djk_text: Ala den sani de pasa, fu wasikoi wi san u á mu du. Ne Masaa Gadu meke den sikiifi fika gi wi, na a pisi yuu ten pe goontapu de fu kaba ya!
eng_text: Now all these things happened to them by way of example, and they were written for our admonition, on whom the ends of the ages have come.

djk_text: Bika son sama sa denki taki, a taampu taanga a ini biibi. Ma luku bun! Tesi e suku fu towe i puu a Masaa Gadu pasi.
eng_text: Therefore let him who thinks he stands be careful that he doesn't fall.

djk_text: Ma den tesi ya á taanga moo san taa libisama e tyai. Soseefi Masaa Gadu de fitoow fasi fu meke dati á sa bigi pasa u. Ai meke wan pasi tu, fu waka pasa tesi.
eng_text: No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above what you are able, but will with the temptation also make the way of escape, that you may be able to endure it.

djk_text: Mi lobi biibiwan! Na dati meke, wai a pasi gi falisi gadu!
eng_text: Therefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.

djk_text: Mi sikiifi a sani ya fu taki anga u enke sama anga fusutan. Da teke den keli luku efu na tuu.
eng_text: I speak as to wise men. Judge what I say.

djk_text: Luku fa wi e membee a dede fu Kelestesi. Makandii wi e teke wan kan win diingi gi daa, fu membee en buulu di mokisa wi ala. Wi e teke wan beele nyan gi daa, fu membee en sikin di mokisa wi ala.
eng_text: The cup of blessing which we bless, isn't it a sharing of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, isn't it a sharing of the body of Christ?

djk_text: Da fa na wan beele namo wi e booko pisipisi nyan e soi fa wi ala na awan kodo sikin fu Kelestesi. Winsi fa wi ipi seefi, ma ibiiwan na wan pisi fu a sikin.
eng_text: Because there is one loaf of bread, we, who are many, are one body; for we all partake of the one loaf of bread.

djk_text: Biibiwan! A ini Islayeli Kondee, da Dyusama e kii meti begi Masaa Gadu. Da ala sama di nyan dati mokisa anga Masaa Gadu di abi a apaiti begi tafaa, pe den kii dati.
eng_text: Consider Israel according to the flesh. Don't those who eat the sacrifices participate in the altar?

djk_text: We, mi á wani taki, falisi gadu de wan sani. Meti di kii fu nyan begi falisi gadu seefi á de wan sani tu.
eng_text: What am I saying then? That a thing sacrificed to idols is anything, or that an idol is anything?

djk_text: Ma sabi taki, meti di kii fu nyan begi falisi gadu, na wan sani fu dini takuu jeje. Da fa dati á de gi Masaa Gadu, da mi á wani u mokisa useefi anga en.
eng_text: But I say that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to demons, and not to God, and I don't desire that you would have fellowship with demons.

djk_text: Bika wi e diingi awan kodo kan win fu membee Masaa. Da fa u sa mokisa dati fu nyan sani di poti enke paiman gi takuu jeje?
eng_text: You can't both drink the cup of the Lord and the cup of demons. You can't both partake of the table of the Lord, and of the table of demons.

djk_text: Bika, da u e dwengi Masaa, fu dyalusu. Ma fa u denki, u si enke u taanga moo Masaa, fu poi kibii gi en sitaafu?
eng_text: Or do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? Are we stronger than he?

djk_text: Bika mi ya komoto a katibo, fu poi du ala san mi wani. Ma ala san mi wani du á bun fu tyai yeepi gi taawan.
eng_text: All things are lawful for me, but not all things are profitable. "All things are lawful for me," but not all things build up.

djk_text: Da meke ibiiwan á suku fu wooko fu yeepi en wawan namo. Ma san yu e du mu poi yeepi wan taawan.
eng_text: Let no one seek his own, but each one his neighbor's good.

djk_text: Luku fa wenkii lai anga meti fu bai nyan. Da bai nyan seefi sondee fu konsensi piki yu taki, na meti di kii fu nyan begi falisi gadu.
eng_text: Whatever is sold in the butcher shop, eat, asking no question for the sake of conscience,

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu Buku sikiifi taki: “Na Masaa Gadu abi goontapu anga ala san fuu en.”
eng_text: for "the earth is the Lord's, and its fullness."

djk_text: We, da sama di á de biibisama sa kai yu a tee. Go nyan efu yu wani. Winsi san den puu gi yu, nyan sondee konsensi piki yu taki, na meti di kii fu nyan begi falisi gadu.
eng_text: But if one of those who don't believe invites you to a meal, and you are inclined to go, eat whatever is set before you, asking no questions for the sake of conscience.

djk_text: Ma efu wan sama bali piki yu taki: “Na meti di kii fu nyan begi falisi gadu, yu e nyan!” Da ná nyanmi en, fu lesipeki a sama de anga ala en konsensi.
eng_text: But if anyone says to you, "This was offered to idols," don't eat it for the sake of the one who told you, and for the sake of conscience. For "the earth is the Lord's, and all its fullness."

djk_text: Mi á wani taki, na di fi yuseefi konsensi fu lesipeki de. Ma na di fu a taawan. Winsi i taki, yu á de a katibo! I sa nyan a sani! Sama konsensi ná abi leti fu kaagi den fu dati.
eng_text: Conscience, I say, not your own, but the other's conscience. For why is my liberty judged by another conscience?

djk_text: I gi Masaa Gadu daa kaba fu nyan a sani. Da sama á mu poi kaagi yu taki, i e nyan wan sani di á bun!
eng_text: If I partake with thankfulness, why am I denounced for that for which I give thanks?

djk_text: Ma yee ya! Winsi san de fu nyan ofu diingi ofu du seefi, meke a waka fu taawan sa poi gi Masaa Gadu gaandi.
eng_text: Whether therefore you eat, or drink, or whatever you do, do all to the glory of God.

djk_text: Ma ná du sani fu bangula taawan tyai futu go naki. Winsi na Dyusama ofu taa foluku ofu na a kulu biibiwan fu Masaa Gadu seefi.
eng_text: Give no occasions for stumbling, either to Jews, or to Greeks, or to the assembly of God;

djk_text: Wooko enke fa mi nái suku fu du wan enkii sani di mu yeepi miseefi namo. Ma na fu yeepi ala taawan, meke Masaa Gadu sa puu denseefi a takuudu anga ogii tu.
eng_text: even as I also please all men in all things, not seeking my own profit, but the profit of the many, that they may be saved.

djk_text: We, da tiiki a fasi fu mi enke fa mi tiiki fu Kelestesi.
eng_text: Be imitators of me, even as I also am of Christ.

djk_text: Mi e gafa u dise, fa u e membee ala den fasi fu mi de. Soseefi u teke fu waka anga fa mi be leli u.
eng_text: Now I praise you, brothers, that you remember me in all things, and hold firm the traditions, even as I delivered them to you.

djk_text: Ma mi wani leli u tu taki, Kelestesi na a ede fu ibii manengee. Masaa Gadu na a ede fu Kelestesi. Ibii manengee na a ede fi en uman.
eng_text: But I would have you know that the head of every man is Christ, and the head of the woman is the man, and the head of Christ is God.

djk_text: Da manengee á mu wei sani tapu en ede, te ai begi. Soseefi te a de apaiti takiman a den taawan mindii. Bika, da ai gi en ede sen anga dati.
eng_text: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonors his head.

djk_text: Ma na uman mu wei sani tapu en ede, te ai begi. Soseefi, te a de apaiti takiman a den taawan mindii. Bika a sa gi en ede sen sondee dati. A poti enseefi enke manengee di de piipii ede sondee sani tapu dati.
eng_text: But every woman praying or prophesying with her head unveiled dishonors her head. For it is one and the same thing as if she were shaved.

djk_text: Bika efu uman á wani wei sani tapu en ede, da meke a go pii en ede fika sondee uwii tu. Ma efu dati na wan sen sani gi wan uman, da meke a tapu en ede de.
eng_text: For if a woman is not covered, let her also be shorn. But if it is shameful for a woman to be shorn or shaved, let her be covered.

djk_text: Bika na manengee á mu wei sani tapu en ede. Da ai soi fa Masaa Gadu meke en, fu soi en dyendee fasi taki, sani á de ne en tapu. Ma a uman meke fu soi dyendee fi en man. Da a mu tapu en ede soi taki, en man de ne en tapu.
eng_text: For a man indeed ought not to have his head covered, because he is the image and glory of God, but the woman is the glory of the man.

djk_text: Bika a ná wan pisi sikin fu a uman Masaa Gadu be teke meke a man. Ma na wan pisi sikin fu a man a be teke meke a uman.
eng_text: For man is not from woman, but woman from man;

djk_text: Soseefi a man á be meke fu de enke yeepi fi en uman. Ma na a uman be meke fu de enke yeepi fi en man.
eng_text: for neither was man created for the woman, but woman for the man.

djk_text: Na so meke uman mu abi wan sani di tapu en ede, fu soi taki, ai hei en man poti ne en tapu. Da den Engel di lontu wi seefi sa si fa ai tyai enseefi gi en man sowan fasi.
eng_text: For this cause the woman ought to have authority on her head, because of the angels.

djk_text: Ma enke sama di mokisa libi anga Masaa, da a man fanowdu en uman leti enke fa a uman fanowdu en man.
eng_text: Nevertheless, neither is the woman independent of the man, nor the man independent of the woman, in the Lord.

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu be teke wan pisi sikin fu a man meke a uman, ma na uman e meke man ya tu. Na so ala sani komoto a Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: For as woman came from man, so a man also comes through a woman; but all things are from God.

djk_text: Da useefi teke a hii sani ya luku wegi luku efu a bun fu uman á mu wei sani tapu en ede, te ai begi.
eng_text: Judge for yourselves. Is it appropriate that a woman pray to God unveiled?

djk_text: Goontapu libi seefi e soi wi taki, te wan man kweki langa uwii, da ai tan wan fasi enke sani fu sen.
eng_text: Doesn't even nature itself teach you that if a man has long hair, it is a dishonor to him?

djk_text: Ma uman anga langa uwii e fende gaandi fu dati. Na so a meke fu tyai langa uwii enke a sani di mu tapu en ede.
eng_text: But if a woman has long hair, it is a glory to her, for her hair is given to her for a covering.

djk_text: Da sama sa wani sitee anga a toli ya! Ma u mu luku taki, ala taa kulu biibi lontu wi e gi den man gaandi sowan fasi. Den á gwenti du taa fasi.
eng_text: But if any man seems to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither do God's assemblies.

djk_text: We, mi wani leli u wan sani ya. Bika mi á poi gafa u fa u e du en anda. U e poti nyanyan fu nyan diingi membee Masaa, ma a nái waka fu yeepi taawan. U e du ogii anga taawan de.
eng_text: But in giving you this command, I don't praise you, that you come together not for the better but for the worse.

djk_text: A fosi sani mi yee dise taki, te u kon makandii so, da onmen sowtu paitei sama e sidon de anga paati fasi. We, mi e si enke fu wan pisi, da ai waka so tuu.
eng_text: For first of all, when you come together in the assembly, I hear that divisions exist among you, and I partly believe it.

djk_text: Bika paati fasi mu de a biibiwan mindii. Da u sa si sowtu wan fu u na tuutuu biibiwan.
eng_text: For there also must be factions among you, that those who are approved may be revealed among you.

djk_text: We, te u poti nyanyan makandii, fu nyan diingi membee Masaa, da a nái waka enke na Masaa u e nyan diingi fu membee tuutuu.
eng_text: When therefore you assemble yourselves together, it is not the Lord's supper that you eat.

djk_text: Bika ibiiwan e teke san enseefi tyai kon sondee fu paati anga taawan. Da pootiwan e fika anga angii de. Ma taawan fende nyan fuu bee, te diingi duungu seefi!
eng_text: For in your eating each one takes his own supper first. One is hungry, and another is drunken.

djk_text: Da fa u peefuu du so? Bika u abi osu fu nyan diingi fuu bee fosi u kon de. U á be abi fu kon du dati a mindii fu Masaa Gadu sama, fu gi pootiwan sen? U wani soi taki, u hei moo den? Fa mi mu taki a sani ya? Mi á poi gafa u!
eng_text: What, don't you have houses to eat and to drink in? Or do you despise God's assembly, and put them to shame who don't have? What shall I tell you? Shall I praise you? In this I don't praise you.

djk_text: Bika Masaa seefi be leli mi ya, fa a nyan beele, diingi win membee a dede di a be teke. Meke mi leli u dati baka ya. Luku a neti di Judasi be o konkuu en. Da a be teke wan beele namo wai kon, fu ala den nyan makandii.
eng_text: For I received from the Lord that which also I delivered to you, that the Lord Jesus on the night in which he was betrayed took bread.

djk_text: Namo a gi daa, da ai booko a beele pisipisi paati. Da ai taki: “A beele ya na mi sikin fu nyan. Da u e membee fa a teke dede pai a u peesi. Tan nyanmi en naamo seefi, fu membee a wooko di mi du de.”
eng_text: When he had given thanks, he broke it, and said, "Take, eat. This is my body, which is broken for you. Do this in memory of me."

djk_text: Di den kaba nyan, ne a teke wan kan win poti taki: “A kan win ya na mi buulu fu diingi. Da u e membee fa a lon fu Masaa Gadu meke wan nyun kuudei wooko anga sama fi en. Tan diingi en naamo seefi, fu membee a wooko di mi du de.”
eng_text: In the same way he also took the cup, after supper, saying, "This cup is the new covenant in my blood. Do this, as often as you drink, in memory of me."

djk_text: We, da ibii leisi u nyan diingi dati, da u e membee fa Masaa meke a nyun kuudei di e soi goontapu a dede fi en, te enke a sa daai kon baka.
eng_text: For as often as you eat this bread and drink this cup, you proclaim the Lord's death until he comes.

djk_text: Da luku bun fu sama á nyan dati wan fasi di á fiti. Bika, da yu du wan gaan ogii anga a sikin fu Masaa, soseefi a buulu fi en. Da yu o kisi sitaafu.
eng_text: Therefore whoever eats this bread or drinks the Lord's cup in a way unworthy of the Lord will be guilty of the body and the blood of the Lord.

djk_text: Ma meke ibiiwan keli enseefi luku fosi a nyan a beele anga diingi fu a kan win ya.
eng_text: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of the bread, and drink of the cup.

djk_text: Bika ibii sama sa nyan diingi. Ma sabi taki, a sa toon wan kaagi gi yu a Masaa Gadu, efu yu nái membee a sikin fu Kelestesi na a fasi di fiti.
eng_text: For he who eats and drinks in an unworthy way eats and drinks judgment to himself, if he doesn't discern the Lord's body.

djk_text: Na so meke somen biibiwan a u mindii de e siki anga ala swaki so. A tyai dede gi somen de kaba seefi.
eng_text: For this cause many among you are weak and sickly, and not a few sleep.

djk_text: Ma wegi yuseefi luku fosi i nyan. Da Masaa Gadu á sa abi fu kaagi yu sowan fasi, fu gi sitaafu.
eng_text: For if we discerned ourselves, we wouldn't be judged.

djk_text: Sitaafu di a o gi fu dati seefi na fu dwengi yu poti fa a wani. Da yu á sa fende sitaafu tego makandii anga goontapu sama di á wani teke biibi.
eng_text: But when we are judged, we are punished by the Lord, that we may not be condemned with the world.

djk_text: We, da biibiwan! Nyan makandii fu membee a dede fu Masaa. Ma tan luku taawan, fu nyan makandii de.
eng_text: Therefore, my brothers, when you come together to eat, wait for one another.

djk_text: Efu na fu angii wan sama wani nyan, da meke a nyan a osu fosi. Da a sa wai gi Masaa Gadu sitaafu, fu a takuu fasi de a den taawan mindii. Kwolon! Mi tapu de fosi. Te mi doo u anda, mi sa leli u den taa taa sani fu a toli ya.
eng_text: But if anyone is hungry, let him eat at home, lest your coming together be for judgment. The rest I will set in order whenever I come.

djk_text: Biibiwan! U be sende akisi mi, fa fu den apaiti taanga fu a Jeje. We, mi wani u fusutan a sani ya bun.
eng_text: Now concerning spiritual things, brothers, I don't want you to be ignorant.

djk_text: U seefi sabi fa u be tan fosi u be teke biibi. U be gwenti lasi pasi go dini falisi gadu di ná abi libi.
eng_text: You know that when you were heathen , you were led away to those mute idols, however you might be led.

djk_text: Ma kon sabi taki, noiti sama di a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu e tii sa poi kosi ofu fuuku Jesesi. Noiti sama sa poi taki, na Jesesi na a Masaa tu, sondee fu a Apaiti Jeje ya meke a poi.
eng_text: Therefore I make known to you that no man speaking by God's Spirit says, "Jesus is accursed." No one can say, "Jesus is Lord," but by the Holy Spirit.

djk_text: Da Masaa Gadu gi u sowtu a sowtu apaiti taanga fu wooko. Ma a Jeje di poti den gi u, na awan seefi Jeje ete.
eng_text: Now there are various kinds of gifts, but the same Spirit.

djk_text: A gi somen apaiti sowtu wooko fu du. Ma na a seefi Masaa e gi den.
eng_text: There are various kinds of service, and the same Lord.

djk_text: A gi somen apaiti taanga fu wooko. Ma na a seefi Masaa Gadu e du sani sowtu a sowtu fasi a ini wi so.
eng_text: There are various kinds of workings, but the same God, who works all things in all.

djk_text: Da a Jeje ya e puu kon a kiin sowtu apaiti taanga a gi ibiiwan, fu wooko. Da ibii yuu dati e de fu yeepi taawan.
eng_text: But to each one is given the manifestation of the Spirit for the profit of all.

djk_text: Bika ai gi son wan apaiti taanga fu koni fu taki sani wan leti fasi. Ai gi taawan fu sabi taki Masaa Gadu bosikopu.
eng_text: For to one is given through the Spirit the word of wisdom, and to another the word of knowledge, according to the same Spirit;

djk_text: Ai gi taawan fu biibi taanga. Taawan ai gi fu deesi sowtu a sowtu siki. Ma na a seefi jeje e gi den.
eng_text: to another faith, by the same Spirit; and to another gifts of healings, by the same Spirit;

djk_text: Taawan ai gi fu du foondoo sani. Taawan ai gi fu de apaiti takiman. Taawan fu poi tesi sowtu jeje e wooko. Taawan fu taki sowtu a sowtu tongo taki. Taawan fu fusutan tongo taki.
eng_text: and to another workings of miracles; and to another prophecy; and to another discerning of spirits; to another different kinds of languages; and to another the interpretation of languages.

djk_text: Ma na awan kodo seefi Jeje e gi somen apaiti makiti fu wooko so. Da ai paati gi ibiiwan san a wani dati mu du apaiti fasi.
eng_text: But the one and the same Spirit works all of these, distributing to each one separately as he desires.

djk_text: Bika luku fa sama sikin abi sowtu a sowtu pisi. Ma a hii sikin de wan kodo sikin namo. Na so sama fu Masaa Gadu de somen, ma na awan kodo sikin fu Kelestesi namo dati.
eng_text: For as the body is one, and has many members, and all the members of the body, being many, are one body; so also is Christ.

djk_text: Bika u de somen sama, da u de somen sowtu fasi. Taawan na Dyu, taawan á de Dyu. Taawan na saafu a katibo, taawan á de saafu a katibo. Ma a seefi Jeje teke peesi a ini ibiiwan fu wi, ne a mokisa wi ala toon wan sikin, di u teke dopu.
eng_text: For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, whether bond or free; and were all given to drink into one Spirit.

djk_text: Bika wan sama sikin á meke anga wan kodo pisi namo. Ma a de pisi fu pisi.
eng_text: For the body is not one member, but many.

djk_text: Ma futu á poi taki, fa a á de ana, da a á poi teli enke a sikin.
eng_text: If the foot would say, "Because I'm not the hand, I'm not part of the body," it is not therefore not part of the body.

djk_text: Yesi á poi taki, fa a á de ain, da a á poi teli enke a sikin.
eng_text: If the ear would say, "Because I'm not the eye, I'm not part of the body," it's not therefore not part of the body.

djk_text: Bika efu ala a sikin na be ain, da fa a be o poi yee sani? Efu ala a sikin na be yesi, da fa a be o poi sumee sani?
eng_text: If the whole body were an eye, where would the hearing be? If the whole were hearing, where would the smelling be?

djk_text: We, na Masaa Gadu meke a sikin anga sowtu a sowtu pisi so. Ne a poti ibiiwan a pe fu a sikin a wani.
eng_text: But now God has set the members, each one of them, in the body, just as he desired.

djk_text: Bika efu ala a sikin be meke anga wan kodo pisi namo, da fa a be sa de fu kai wan hii sikin?
eng_text: If they were all one member, where would the body be?

djk_text: Ma fa a de, da na somen pisi a sikin abi. Ma na wan kodo sikin namo de ape.
eng_text: But now they are many members, but one body.

djk_text: Da ain á poi taki, a ná abi ana fanowdu. Ede seefi á poi taki, a ná abi futu fanowdu.
eng_text: The eye can't tell the hand, "I have no need for you," or again the head to the feet, "I have no need for you."

djk_text: Ma pisi fu a sikin di soi swaki seefi moo de fanowdu gi a sikin.
eng_text: No, much rather, those members of the body which seem to be weaker are necessary.

djk_text: Wi e moo wei koosi gi pisi fu a sikin di u e buuse taki, den á lesipeki fu si. Pisi fu a sikin di e takuu na ain, da wi e moo wei moi sani gi dati.
eng_text: Those parts of the body which we think to be less honorable, on those we bestow more abundant honor; and our unpresentable parts have more abundant propriety;

djk_text: Ma moi pisi fu a sikin ná abi fanowdu fu wei sani gi so. Bika Masaa Gadu sete a sikin na a fasi taki, den di e soi lagi a sama ain mu moo gi lesipeki.
eng_text: whereas our presentable parts have no such need. But God composed the body together, giving more abundant honor to the inferior part,

djk_text: Na so ala pisi fu a sikin sa fii taki, taawan nái teli bigi moo taawan. Da ibiiwan sa booko ede yeepi a taawan enke fa ai yeepi enseefi.
eng_text: that there should be no division in the body, but that the members should have the same care for one another.

djk_text: Efu wan pisi e fii pen, da ala taa pisi e fii pen anga en. Efu wan pisi e fende gafa, da ala taa pisi e fii piisii anga en.
eng_text: When one member suffers, all the members suffer with it. Or when one member is honored, all the members rejoice with it.

djk_text: Da wi na a sikin fu Kelestesi. Ibiiwan na wan pisi fu a sikin ya.
eng_text: Now you are the body of Christ, and members individually.

djk_text: Masaa Gadu gi wi somen sowtu apaiti taanga fu wooko. A fosi peesi, fu de apaiti bosikopuman. Bakadati, apaiti takiman. Bakadati, apaiti leliman. Taawan fu du foondoo sani. Taawan fu deesi sowtu a sowtu siki. Taawan fu poi yeepi taawan. Taawan fu tii sani. Taawan fu taki sowtu a sowtu tongo.
eng_text: God has set some in the assembly: first apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then miracle workers, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, and various kinds of languages.

djk_text: Ma ibiiwan wooko á de fu de apaiti bosikopuman. Ibiiwan wooko á de fu de apaiti takiman. Ibiiwan wooko á de fu de apaiti leliman. Ibiiwan wooko á de fu poi du foondoo sani.
eng_text: Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Are all miracle workers?

djk_text: Ibiiwan wooko á de fu poi deesi sowtu a sowtu siki. Ibiiwan wooko á de fu poi taki tongo. Ibiiwan wooko á de fu poi fusutan tongo, fu taigi taawan.
eng_text: Do all have gifts of healings? Do all speak with various languages? Do all interpret?

djk_text: Ma meke ibiiwan feti fu Masaa Gadu gi en apaiti taanga, fu du wooko di moo de fanowdu. Ma anga ala dati, da luku seefi san na a leti fasi fu wooko anga taawan.
eng_text: But earnestly desire the best gifts. Moreover, I show a most excellent way to you.

djk_text: Bika winsi mi sabi apaiti tongo di sama ofu Engel e taki seefi, ma mi de sondee tuutuu lobi. Da mi wowtu sa gei soso gengen anga boko beenki, fu bali muliki sama yesi.
eng_text: If I speak with the languages of men and of angels, but don't have love, I have become sounding brass, or a clanging cymbal.

djk_text: A ná abi toobi, efu mi na wan apaiti takiman. Efu Masaa Gadu soi mi ala kibii toli fi en. Efu mi sabi ala san de fu sabi. Efu mi biibi bigi fu toto gaan mongo puu a pasi. Ma sondee tuutuu lobi, da mi na wan soso sani.
eng_text: If I have the gift of prophecy, and know all mysteries and all knowledge; and if I have all faith, so as to remove mountains, but don't have love, I am nothing.

djk_text: Efu mi e paati ala san mi abi fu soso seefi. Efu mi towe mi sikin boon a faya gi taawan seefi. Ma sondee tuutuu lobi, da mi na wan soso sani.
eng_text: If I dole out all my goods to feed the poor, and if I give my body to be burned, but don't have love, it profits me nothing.

djk_text: Bika tuutuu lobi e gi langa pasensi fasi. Ai gi switi fasi. Ai tapu dyalusu, ai tapu suku gafanen, ai tapu hei membee.
eng_text: Love is patient and is kind; love doesn't envy. Love doesn't brag, is not proud,

djk_text: Tuutuu lobi e kaba saanti taawan. Ai tapu suku wini fi i wawan namo. Ai tapu gaw atiboon fasi ofu oli taawan na ati.
eng_text: doesn't behave itself inappropriately, doesn't seek its own way, is not provoked, takes no account of evil;

djk_text: Te sani nái waka leti, da tuutuu lobi e wai piisii poti a wanse. Ma ai gi piisii te sani e go tuutuu, enke fa sani mu waka.
eng_text: doesn't rejoice in unrighteousness, but rejoices with the truth;

djk_text: A ini ala sani, da tuutuu lobi e kibii taawan. Ai biibi naamo. Ai luku naamo a san de fende. Ai fudaagi naamo tu.
eng_text: bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.

djk_text: Tuutuu lobi noiti e kaba. Ma fu de apaiti takiman sa kaba wan dei. Sowtu a sowtu tongo taki seefi sa kaba tu. Apaiti sabi fu Masaa Gadu bosikopu seefi tu.
eng_text: Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will be done away with. Where there are various languages, they will cease. Where there is knowledge, it will be done away with.

djk_text: Bika na nownow u á kaba sabi ala san de fu sabi. Bosikopu fu apaiti takiman seefi nái kaba soi kiinkiin san de fu kon bakaten seefi.
eng_text: For we know in part, and we prophesy in part;

djk_text: Ma a ten o doo di ala san Masaa Gadu meke fu tan tego sa soi denseefi kiinkiin enke fa den de seefi. Da u sa kaba denki den sani wan fasi di á kaba doo peesi.
eng_text: but when that which is complete has come, then that which is partial will be done away with.

djk_text: Bika pikinengee ten fu wan sama, da ai taki sani pikinengee fasi. Ai denki sani pikinengee fasi. Ma te a toon manengee, da ala a pikinengee fasi e kon kaba.
eng_text: When I was a child, I spoke as a child, I felt as a child, I thought as a child. Now that I have become a man, I have put away childish things.

djk_text: Da goontapu ya, da na wan difii fasi enke bwuingi kai a sipikii fesi, na so wi e si san Masaa Gadu fiti poti fu kon. Da sani nái kaba de kiinkiin a den peesi. U nái kaba si sani enke fa den de seefi. Ma bakaten, da ala sani o de fesi a fesi. Da fa Masaa Gadu e si mi tuutuu, na so mi o si ala sani.
eng_text: For now we see in a mirror, dimly, but then face to face. Now I know in part, but then I will know fully, even as I was also fully known.

djk_text: Da luku ya! Dii sani fika gi wi fu du nownow. Fu biibi. Soseefi luku fu fende Masaa Gadu paamisi anga fu lobi tuutuu. Ma a moo gaanwan fu den dii dati na fu lobi tuutuu.
eng_text: But now faith, hope, and love remain--these three. The greatest of these is love.

djk_text: We, da feti fu wooko anga tuutuu lobi. Ma suku den apaiti taanga di a Jeje e gi tu. Moomoo fu de wan apaiti takiman.
eng_text: Follow after love, and earnestly desire spiritual gifts, but especially that you may prophesy.

djk_text: Bika sama di e taki a wan tongo di a Apaiti Jeje gi en, nái taki anga libisama. Ma anga Masaa Gadu wawan ai taki. Bika taa sama nái fusutan san ai taki. Na a Apaiti Jeje gi en kibii toli fu taki.
eng_text: For he who speaks in another language speaks not to men, but to God; for no one understands; but in the Spirit he speaks mysteries.

djk_text: Ma a apaiti takiman dati e taki sani di taawan e fusutan. Da ai yeepi den, fu kon moo taanga. Ai bali den puu a sani di á bun. Soseefi ai gi taanga sikin anga koo ati na a biibi.
eng_text: But he who prophesies speaks to men for their edification, exhortation, and consolation.

djk_text: Ma a sama di e taki a wan taa tongo di a Apaiti Jeje e gi en, da ne en wawan di e taki namo e kon taanga. Ma a apaiti takiman, e yeepi a hii kulu biibiwan fu den kon taanga tu.
eng_text: He who speaks in another language edifies himself, but he who prophesies edifies the assembly.

djk_text: We, mi be sa wani fu u ala fiya be fende wan taa tongo na a Apaiti Jeje fu taki. Ma a be sa moo bun fu u be de wan apaiti takiman. Bika wan apaiti takiman e moo tyai yeepi gi taa sama. Boiti efu wan sama de ape anga apaiti taanga, fu puu den tongo taki gi taawan.
eng_text: Now I desire to have you all speak with other languages, but rather that you would prophesy. For he is greater who prophesies than he who speaks with other languages, unless he interprets, that the assembly may be built up.

djk_text: Bika biibiwan! Efu mi kon a u kon e taki taa tongo taki, sondee fu u sabi san mi e taki, da on yeepi seefi mi be sa tyai kon gi u anga dati? A moo bun mi kon taigi u wan sani di Masaa Gadu puu kon a kiin gi mi. Efu ná so, mi kon soi u wan sani fi en di u á be sabi ete. Soseefi, fu mi leli u, taigi u san mi sabi.
eng_text: But now, brothers, if I come to you speaking with other languages, what would I profit you, unless I speak to you either by way of revelation, or of knowledge, or of prophesying, or of teaching?

djk_text: Sani enke foiti ofu gitali di den e pee poku ná abi tongo fu taki. Ma i sa sabi sowtu singi den e pee a den. Bika gitali anga foiti nái piki a seefi fasi. Ma efu yu sabi pee den kiin, da taawan e sabi a singi di yu e pee.
eng_text: Even things without life, giving a voice, whether pipe or harp, if they didn't give a distinction in the sounds, how would it be known what is piped or harped?

djk_text: Soseefi tu, efu a tutu á piki kiin, da den suudati ná o sabi taki, den mu seeka fu opo go a feti.
eng_text: For if the trumpet gave an uncertain sound, who would prepare himself for war?

djk_text: Na so a sa waka anga u tu, efu u e taki tongo di sama nái fusutan. A de leti enke yu e taki anga winta.
eng_text: So also you, unless you uttered by the tongue words easy to understand, how would it be known what is spoken? For you would be speaking into the air.

djk_text: Bika goontapu lai anga sowtu a sowtu tongo. Ma ibiiwan de fu sama di sabi dati sa fusutan.
eng_text: There are, it may be, so many kinds of sounds in the world, and none of them is without meaning.

djk_text: Ma efu mi anga wan sama de, ne mi á sabi a tongo fi en, da te a o taki, da mi ná o fusutan san ai taki. Da a de taki, mi nái fusutan a sama di e taki. Ma soseefi tu, a sama di e taki nái fusutan mi tu.
eng_text: If then I don't know the meaning of the sound, I would be to him who speaks a foreigner, and he who speaks would be a foreigner to me.

djk_text: Na so meke a bun fu suku den apaiti taanga di a Jeje e gi. Ma suku moomoo den apaiti taanga di sa yeepi den sama fu Masaa Gadu, fu den sa taampu moo taanga.
eng_text: So also you, since you are zealous for spiritual gifts, seek that you may abound to the building up of the assembly.

djk_text: A dati meke efu wan sama e taki a wan tongo di sama nái fusutan, da a mu begi Masaa Gadu, fu Masaa Gadu gi en koni, fu a sa puu a tongo taki de kon a kiin gi sama, fu den fusutan.
eng_text: Therefore let him who speaks in another language pray that he may interpret.

djk_text: Bika efu mi e begi a wan tongo di sama nái fusutan, da mi jeje e begi Masaa Gadu tuu, ma mi seefi nái fusutan.
eng_text: For if I pray in another language, my spirit prays, but my understanding is unfruitful.

djk_text: Da fa a mu de seefi? Mi o begi anga mi jeje, ma mi o begi anga mi fusutan tu. Mi o singi anga mi jeje, ma mi o singi fu sama sa fusutan mi tu.
eng_text: What is it then? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also. I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.

djk_text: Bika efu yu gi Masaa Gadu daa anga yu jeje namo, da fa den taawan di de ape o de wan anga yu, fu bali: “Amen, na so a de!” Bika a á sabi san yu e taki.
eng_text: Otherwise if you bless with the spirit, how will he who fills the place of the unlearned say the "Amen" at your giving of thanks, seeing he doesn't know what you say?

djk_text: Bika a yu gi daa bun, ma toku seefi a á tyai yeepi gi den taawan di nái fusutan, fu den kon taampu moo taanga na a biibi.
eng_text: For you most certainly give thanks well, but the other person is not built up.

djk_text: We, mi e gi Masaa Gadu daa, fu di mi sa taki taa tongo di sama nái fusutan moo u ala de.
eng_text: I thank my God, I speak with other languages more than you all.

djk_text: Ma te mi de a biibiwan mindii, da a moo betee, fu mi taki feifi wowtu namo di sama sa fusutan, fu den leli sani. Moo enke mi taki dunsu dunsu wowtu a wan tongo di ná wan sama poi fusutan.
eng_text: However in the assembly I would rather speak five words with my understanding, that I might instruct others also, than ten thousand words in another language.

djk_text: Biibiwan! U kaba anga pikinengee fasi. Ma na a se fu sabi du ogii, da u mu de enke pikinengee. Ma na se fu bunbun fusutan, da u mu de enke gaansama.
eng_text: Brothers, don't be children in thoughts, yet in malice be babies, but in thoughts be mature.

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu Buku sikiifi a fesi taki: “Mi Masaa Gadu ya, o sende taa kondee sama kon taki anga den sama ya. Soseefi mi o sende sama kon di o taki anga den a taa tongo tu. Ma toku, den ná o teke mi taki fu biibi.”
eng_text: In the law it is written, "By men of strange languages and by the lips of strangers I will speak to this people. Not even thus will they hear me, says the Lord."

djk_text: U sa si de fa taki tongo taki á de wan foondoo maiki gi sama di e biibi. Ma a de gi den di nái biibi. Na apaiti takiman de gi den di e biibi. Ma a ná gi sama di nái biibi.
eng_text: Therefore other languages are for a sign, not to those who believe, but to the unbelieving; but prophesying is for a sign, not to the unbelieving, but to those who believe.

djk_text: Bika meke sama di nái biibi anga swaki biibiwan seefi kon doo a ini a miti makandii fu u enke a kulu fu Masaa Gadu sama de, da u ala e taki tongo taki, da u sa si! Den o denki, na buuya taki, u e taki.
eng_text: If therefore the whole assembly is assembled together and all speak with other languages, and unlearned or unbelieving people come in, won't they say that you are crazy?

djk_text: Ma meke u ala wooko enke apaiti takiman de, da u sa si! A taki de o kai doo dipi fu den ati, meke den membee ogii fu denseefi.
eng_text: But if all prophesy, and someone unbelieving or unlearned comes in, he is reproved by all, and he is judged by all.
