djk_text: Da a kibii pisi fu den ati o kon a doo, fu denseefi si. Da den o kai anga kini begi Masaa Gadu. Soseefi den o si taki, Masaa Gadu de a u mindii de tuu.
eng_text: And thus the secrets of his heart are revealed. So he will fall down on his face and worship God, declaring that God is among you indeed.

djk_text: We, biibiwan! Fa sani mu waka te u kon makandii? U bali singi towe. Teke Masaa Gadu sani leli. Taki san Masaa tyai kon a kiin gi yu de. Taki tongo taki. Puu dati taigi taawan. Ma ala sani mu waka fu yeepi u ala.
eng_text: What is it then, brothers? When you come together, each one of you has a psalm, has a teaching, has a revelation, has another language, has an interpretation. Let all things be done to build each other up.

djk_text: Da meke tu, te dii sama namo bali tongo taki. Ma den á mu taki dyabaadya. Da taawan mu de ape anga apaiti makiti fu fusutan tongo taki taigi taawan.
eng_text: If any man speaks in another language, let it be two, or at the most three, and in turn; and let one interpret.

djk_text: Ma efu ná wan sama abi apaiti makiti fu fusutan tongo taki taigi taawan, da u á mu taki taanga fu taawan yee. Ma taki saafi fi yu anga Masaa Gadu wawan.
eng_text: But if there is no interpreter, let him keep silent in the assembly, and let him speak to himself, and to God.

djk_text: Meke tu ofu dii apaiti takiman namo taki. Da meke taawan keli luku efu na Masaa Gadu bosikopu tuu.
eng_text: Let the prophets speak, two or three, and let the others discern.

djk_text: Ma efu wan sama e aliki, ne Masaa tyai sani kon a kiin gi en na a seefi yuu de, da meke di be e taki tapu mofu fosi.
eng_text: But if a revelation is made to another sitting by, let the first keep silent.

djk_text: Meke den apaiti takiman á taki dyabaadya. Ma du en wan fu wan a taawan baka. Da taawan sa fende wan sani leli de. Taawan sa fende wan sani fu opo waka go doo anga a biibi.
eng_text: For you all can prophesy one by one, that all may learn, and all may be exhorted.

djk_text: Bika a Jeje di e gi makiti fu de apaiti takiman nái subi yu fu a taki mu komoto sondee yuseefi wani.
eng_text: The spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets,

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu á de wan buuya Gadu. Ma sani fi en e waka switi fasi. Luku ibii taa peesi pe Masaa Gadu sama e kon makandii. Meke sani waka a u de so tu.
eng_text: for God is not a God of confusion, but of peace. As in all the assemblies of the saints,

djk_text: Uman á mu sete takitaki de, ma a mu saka enseefi anga ala tan pii de. Na so Masaa Gadu weiti taki, fu dati.
eng_text: let your wives keep silent in the assemblies, for it has not been permitted for them to speak; but let them be in subjection, as the law also says.

djk_text: Efu a uman wani sabi wan sani, da meke a akisi en man dati a osu. Bika na wan takuu sani fu uman e takitaki a ini a kon makandii fu Masaa Gadu sama.
eng_text: If they desire to learn anything, let them ask their own husbands at home, for it is shameful for a woman to chatter in the assembly.

djk_text: U aliki mi! Na sama tyai Masaa Gadu bosikopu kon gi u de. A ná u bigin a wooko fu paati dati. Soseefi, a ná u wawan namo a bosikopu ya doo tu.
eng_text: What? Was it from you that the word of God went out? Or did it come to you alone?

djk_text: Da sama sa denki taki, en na apaiti takiman a den taawan mindii ofu Masaa Gadu gi en apaiti taanga fu wooko. Ma sabi taki, ala san mi sikiifi ya, na Masaa Gadu seefi soi mi, fu sikiifi den poti so gi u, fu teke wooko.
eng_text: If any man thinks himself to be a prophet, or spiritual, let him recognize the things which I write to you, that they are the commandment of the Lord.

djk_text: Da efu wan sama poti den taki fu mi a wanse, da a á fiti fu taa sama teke dati taki tu.
eng_text: But if anyone is ignorant, let him be ignorant.

djk_text: We, da biibiwan! Feti fu wooko enke apaiti takiman, ma ná tapu anga a taki fu tongo taki.
eng_text: Therefore, brothers, desire earnestly to prophesy, and don't forbid speaking with other languages.

djk_text: Ma meke ala sani waka wan fasi di fiti sondee buuya fasi.
eng_text: Let all things be done decently and in order.

djk_text: We, biibiwan! Mi o membee u baka san na a Bun Nyunsu di mi be gi u, te u be teke biibi. U teke dati kaba enke u fasi fu libi seefi.
eng_text: Now I declare to you, brothers, the Good News which I preached to you, which also you received, in which you also stand,

djk_text: Tan biibi dati fu kaba koti paati anga takuudu anga ogii, fu fende san Masaa Gadu paamisi. Ma efu u fika a biibi ya, da u sa lasi ala dati. Da na fu soso u be teke a biibi.
eng_text: by which also you are saved, if you hold firmly the word which I preached to you--unless you believed in vain.

djk_text: Mi be taigi u somen sani fu a biibi. Ma a hii mama fu a Bun Nyunsu ya taki, Kelestesi kon teke dede pai a u peesi tuu. Da u sa fende paadon fu u takuudu anga ogii. Masaa Gadu Buku be sikiifi fu dati a fesi taki, sani o waka so.
eng_text: For I delivered to you first of all that which I also received: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures,

djk_text: Namo Kelestesi beli a ini wan geebi. Ma baka dii dei, ne Masaa Gadu weki en kon a libi ya baka tuu. Na so Masaa Gadu Buku sikiifi taki, sani o waka so.
eng_text: that he was buried, that he was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,

djk_text: Namo Kelestesi soi enseefi libilibi a Kefasi enke wan fu den twalufu bakaman fi en. Bakadati, a soi enseefi na ala den twalufu makandii.
eng_text: and that he appeared to Cephas, then to the twelve.

djk_text: Bakadati, a soi enseefi libilibi a moo enke feifi ondoo taa biibiwan makandii a wan peesi. Somen fu den dati dede kaba, ma son fu den de leti a libi ya ete.
eng_text: Then he appeared to over five hundred brothers at once, most of whom remain until now, but some have also fallen asleep.

djk_text: Bakadati, ne a soi enseefi libilibi a Jakowbesi enke wan fu den twalufu bakaman. Bakadati, ne a soi enseefi libilibi na ala den twalufu bakaman makandii.
eng_text: Then he appeared to James, then to all the apostles,

djk_text: Te fu kaba, ne a soi enseefi libilibi a mi Pawlesi ya tu. Namo mi teke biibi wanboo wanboo enke te pikin yuu á be kisi fu meke.
eng_text: and last of all, as to the child born at the wrong time, he appeared to me also.

djk_text: Bika mi na wan apaiti bosikopuman di á waiti fu teli enke apaiti bosikopuman fi en. Bika mi be lon du gaan ogii anga a kulu sama fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: For I am the least of the apostles, who is not worthy to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the assembly of God.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Gadu teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku mi. Ne mi de san mi de tide ya. Ma dati á waka fu soso. Bika somen sama toon biibisama, di mi tyotyo wooko moo ala taa apaiti bosikopuman fi en. A ná anga taanga fu miseefi libisama fasi. Ma anga gaan bun ati fasi namo di ai teke, fu wooko a ini mi anga en taanga.
eng_text: But by the grace of God I am what I am. His grace which was bestowed on me was not futile, but I worked more than all of them; yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.

djk_text: Ma a ná abi toobi, efu na wan fu den taa apaiti bosikopuman gi u anda en bosikopu. Na a seefi bosikopu wi e tyai, di u teke biibi de.
eng_text: Whether then it is I or they, so we preach, and so you believed.

djk_text: We, wi dati e tyai a bosikopu fa Kelestesi weki kon a libi ya baka. Da fa sama sa sitee anda taki, dede á poi weki kon a libi baka?
eng_text: Now if Christ is preached, that he has been raised from the dead, how do some among you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?

djk_text: Bika efu a dede á poi weki baka, da Kelestesi seefi á weki kon a libi baka!
eng_text: But if there is no resurrection of the dead, neither has Christ been raised.

djk_text: Da efu Kelestesi á weki kon a libi baka, da wi ya e paati wan wisiwasi bosikopu. Da na fu soso u teke biibi anda tu.
eng_text: If Christ has not been raised, then our preaching is in vain, and your faith also is in vain.

djk_text: Da wi na leiman di e kotoigi falisi sani fu Masaa Gadu. Bika u taki, a weki Kelestesi kon a libi baka. Ma kweti! A be sa de wan lei sani, efu Masaa Gadu á be makiti sai fu weki dede baka. Da a á be o poi weki Kelestesi baka.
eng_text: Yes, we are found false witnesses of God, because we testified about God that he raised up Christ, whom he didn't raise up, if it is so that the dead are not raised.

djk_text: We, efu Masaa Gadu á makiti sai fu weki dede, da Kelestesi dede nownow ete.
eng_text: For if the dead aren't raised, neither has Christ been raised.

djk_text: Da efu Kelestesi dede nownow ete, da wini á de fu fende a wi bosikopu di u anda teke biibi. Soseefi, da u á poi komoto a takuudu anga ogii tu.
eng_text: If Christ has not been raised, your faith is vain; you are still in your sins.

djk_text: Da biibisama di dede kaba, noiti moo o weki baka. Den lasi fu tego.
eng_text: Then they also who are fallen asleep in Christ have perished.

djk_text: Da fu a tyotyo di wi e teke a goontapu fu a biibi a ini ala san u e luku fu fende a Kelestesi ya. Ma fu sani fu dati á de fu kon moo, baka dede, da sama mu tyali gi wi enke den moo ogii ede sama di de.
eng_text: If we have only hoped in Christ in this life, we are of all men most pitiable.

djk_text: Ma a hii sani na tuutuu Kelestesi weki kon a libi ya baka. En fosi weki enke sama fu Masaa Gadu di noiti moo sa dede baka. Da sabi taki, ala taawan fu Masaa Gadu di dede musu weki so tu.
eng_text: But now Christ has been raised from the dead. He became the first fruits of those who are asleep.

djk_text: Bika wan kodo man namo be tyai dede kon a goontapu. Na so wan kodo man namo tyai libi kon baka.
eng_text: For since death came by man, the resurrection of the dead also came by man.

djk_text: Bika Adan enke fosi sowtu sama be wooko takuu. Ne a hii paansu sama di waka ne en baka fende dede enke paiman. Na so a Kelestesi wooko bun. Ne a hii paansu sama di waka ne en baka seefi fende libi tu.
eng_text: For as in Adam all die, so also in Christ all will be made alive.

djk_text: Ma ibiiwan abi en yuu di Masaa Gadu poti gi en. Kelestesi fosi weki baka. Da a hii kulu sama fu Kelestesi, te a o kon baka.
eng_text: But each in his own order: Christ the first fruits, then those who are Christ's, at his coming.

djk_text: Da na a kaba fu goontapu. Da Kelestesi o fika na ala sani tapu. Bika a o booko ala a makiti anga taanga fu goontapu puu. Da a sa sidon enke kownu. Bakadati, da a o langa a hii tii fu sani go a ini ana fi en Tata, Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Then the end comes, when he will deliver up the Kingdom to God, even the Father; when he will have abolished all rule and all authority and power.

djk_text: Bika a mu de kownu fu tii sani doo a ten di a sa kaba booko makiti fu ala feyanti fi en poti ne en ondoo futu.
eng_text: For he must reign until he has put all his enemies under his feet.

djk_text: A mama feyanti di a mu booko puu ete seefi, dati na dede seefi.
eng_text: The last enemy that will be abolished is death.

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu Buku sikiifi taki, a poti Kelestesi na ala sani tapu. Ma dati á wani taki, Masaa Gadu seefi. Bika na Masaa Gadu gi en a hii bigi ya.
eng_text: For, "He put all things in subjection under his feet." But when he says, "All things are put in subjection," it is evident that he is excepted who subjected all things to him.

djk_text: Da te Kelestesi kaba anga fi en se wooko taki, ala sani kon de ne en ondoo futu. Da a Manpikin fu Masaa Gadu ya o saka enseefi poti a ondoo fu Masaa Gadu, di be meke ala sani kon de na a Manpikin fi en ya ondoo futu. Da Masaa Gadu sa de a moo heiwan fu ala sani.
eng_text: When all things have been subjected to him, then the Son will also himself be subjected to him who subjected all things to him, that God may be all in all.

djk_text: We, efu dede nái weki baka, da saide son sama e biibi de taki, den sa teke dopu tyai yeepi gi sama fu den di dede kaba? Bika dati na biibi taki, sani de baka dede ete.
eng_text: Or else what will they do who are baptized for the dead? If the dead aren't raised at all, why then are they baptized for the dead?

djk_text: Saide meke wi enke apaiti bosikopuman e du a wooko ya, ma a sa tyai dede gi wi seefi?
eng_text: Why do we also stand in jeopardy every hour?

djk_text: Biibiwan! Mi ya dati, ogii lontu mi fu tyai dede gi mi seefi. Ma toku, mi de anga piisii a ini. Mi sa gafa a manii fu mi ya, fu di a tyai yeepi, meke u anda kon de sama fu wi Masaa, Kelestesi Jesesi seefi.
eng_text: I affirm, by the boasting in you which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.

djk_text: Bika u si fa pikinmoo sama meke takuu meti kii mi a Efese Foto. Da na bun fu goontapu mi e suku, fu tyai miseefi go so faawe? Bika fu Masaa Gadu ná o weki sama baka, “Da meke u nyan diingi piisii. Tamaa dede sa doo, fu ala sani kaba.”
eng_text: If I fought with animals at Ephesus for human purposes, what does it profit me? If the dead are not raised, then "let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die."

djk_text: Ma ná meke sama koli yu! Ná mosoo anga poli sama. Bika winsi i be taampu bun, ma den o poli yuseefi tu.
eng_text: Don't be deceived! "Evil companionships corrupt good morals."

djk_text: Da poti ede leti fu si sani. Kaba anga takuudu anga ogii. Bika sama de leti a u mindii de di toku nái fusutan Masaa Gadu. Mi taki so, fu gi u sen!
eng_text: Wake up righteously, and don't sin, for some have no knowledge of God. I say this to your shame.

djk_text: Son sama o sitee de taki, dede fu weki baka, da fa den sikin o tan?
eng_text: But someone will say, "How are the dead raised?" and, "With what kind of body do they come?"

djk_text: We, na wan lawlaw sani a sama de akisi de. Bika useefi e paandi sii anda. Da a nái loto poli a ondoo doti fosi, da a sutu ede kon a tapu, fu toon wan sani, no?
eng_text: You foolish one, that which you yourself sow is not made alive unless it dies.

djk_text: Soseefi u nái paandi a hii gaan bon fu sani enke kalu so. Ma na wan sii namo. Da fa a waka wan hii gaan kalu bon e goo kon komoto na a sii de?
eng_text: That which you sow, you don't sow the body that will be, but a bare grain, maybe of wheat, or of some other kind.

djk_text: We, na Masaa Gadu e gi ibii sii wan sowtu bon di mu goo kon komoto de. Da ai goo enke fa a fiti poti gi en. Da ibii bon sikin abi en fasi.
eng_text: But God gives it a body even as it pleased him, and to each seed a body of its own.

djk_text: Soseefi ala sikin kengi anga denseefi. Libisama sikin anga meti sikin. Foo sikin anga fisi. Ibiiwan kengi.
eng_text: All flesh is not the same flesh, but there is one flesh of men, another flesh of animals, another of fish, and another of birds.

djk_text: Masaa Gadu meke sani a tapu anda anga goontapu ya tu. Da den di fu tapu sikin e beenki kengi anga di fu goontapu ya.
eng_text: There are also celestial bodies, and terrestrial bodies; but the glory of the celestial differs from that of the terrestrial.

djk_text: A san a tapu anda e beenki en fasi. A mun e beenki en fasi. Den sitali e beenki den fasi. Ma ibii sitali baka e beenki kengi anga a taawan.
eng_text: There is one glory of the sun, another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars; for one star differs from another star in glory.

djk_text: Na so di Masaa Gadu o weki dede baka. Da sikin di dede ya e beli loto poli, ma te a o weki baka, da a o toon sikin di noiti moo sa poi loto poli.
eng_text: So also is the resurrection of the dead. It is sown in corruption; it is raised in incorruption.

djk_text: Sikin fu tyai go beli e tan ogii sondee waiti fasi. Ma te a o weki baka, da a o toon dyendee sani. Sikin fu tyai go beli e swaki sondee kaakiti. Ma te a o weki baka, da a o toon taanga kaakiti sikin.
eng_text: It is sown in dishonor; it is raised in glory. It is sown in weakness; it is raised in power.

djk_text: Sikin fu tyai go beli de libisama fasi a goontapu. Ma a nyun sikin de fu libi jeje fasi a tapu anda. Da fa i si u fende sikin fu libi ya, na so u o fende a sikin fu libi a tapu anda tu.
eng_text: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body and there is also a spiritual body.

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu Buku sikiifi fu dati taki: “A fosi sowtu sama na Adan, di Masaa Gadu meke goontapu fasi ya.” Ma a kiiboi sowtu Sama na Kelestesi di de Masaa Gadu Kondee fasi, fu tyai a sowtu libi de gi taawan.
eng_text: So also it is written, "The first man, Adam, became a living soul." The last Adam became a life-giving spirit.

djk_text: Ma a fosi sowtu sikin fu sama á gei a jeje sowtu sikin fu tapu anda. Bika fa sikin di meke goontapu fasi fosi kon, da a jeje sowtu sikin fu Masaa Gadu Kondee musu kon tu.
eng_text: However that which is spiritual isn't first, but that which is natural, then that which is spiritual.

djk_text: A fosi sowtu sikin meke komoto a doti fu goontapu ya. Ma a lasiti sowtu sikin komoto a Masaa Gadu Kondee a tapu.
eng_text: The first man is of the earth, made of dust. The second man is the Lord from heaven.

djk_text: Namo ibii paansu sama fu Adan enke fosi sowtu Sama fende a sowtu sikin fi en. Na so ibii paansu sama fu Kelestesi enke a kiiboi sowtu sama seefi o fende a sowtu sikin fi en tu.
eng_text: As is the one made of dust, such are those who are also made of dust; and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.

djk_text: We, wi de anga a sowtu sikin fu tan a goontapu ya. Ma bakaten, da wi o de anga a sowtu sikin fu tan a Masaa Gadu Kondee a tapu.
eng_text: As we have borne the image of those made of dust, let's also bear the image of the heavenly.

djk_text: We, biibiwan! Mi wani soi anga ala dati taki, sikin buba anga buulu, na fu loto poli. Noiti dati sa poi libi tego na a peesi pe noiti moo sani sa poi dede loto poli. Da a ná o poi fende a bun di de a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Now I say this, brothers, that flesh and blood can't inherit the Kingdom of God; neither does corruption inherit incorruption.

djk_text: Luku ya! Masaa Gadu taigi mi wan bosikopu di noiti a be soi sama wanten. Da a be de wan kibii toli. A taki, somen fu wi ná o dede seefi, fosi wi ala faandi teke a nyun sowtu sikin.
eng_text: Behold, I tell you a mystery. We will not all sleep, but we will all be changed,

djk_text: Di a kaba yuu o doo, da wan Engel o boo wan tutu taki, ala sani kaba. Da fosi i pingi ain opo, da den dede biibiwan o weki anga wan hii nyun sowtu sikin. Da ala biibiwan di be de a libi ete seefi o faandi so tu.
eng_text: in a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound, and the dead will be raised incorruptible, and we will be changed.

djk_text: Bika a sowtu sikin di poi dede mu faandi toon wan di noiti moo poi dede. Soseefi a sikin di poi loto poli mu faandi toon wan di noiti moo poi loto poli.
eng_text: For this corruptible must put on incorruption, and this mortal must put on immortality.

djk_text: Na so u sikin o faandi fu noiti moo poi dede loto poli. Da sani waka de enke fa Masaa Gadu Buku taki: “Dede komoto a pasi, fu tego. Na so gaan wini kon.”
eng_text: But when this corruptible will have put on incorruption, and this mortal will have put on immortality, then what is written will happen: "Death is swallowed up in victory."

djk_text: Da gaan piisii bali o piki taki: “Dede! Yu á poi de winiman moo! Bika i fika sondee tifi, fu feele.”
eng_text: Death, where is your sting? Hades , where is your victory?

djk_text: Tuutuu! Dede abi tifi fu feele taki, u mu go kisi sitaafu fu wi takuudu anga ogii. Bika u á poi wooko anga weiti fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law.

djk_text: Ma gaantangi fu Masaa Gadu! A sende wi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi kon teke dede pai fu wi takuudu anga ogii, meke u sa fende libi. Na so gaan wini kon gi wi.
eng_text: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

djk_text: We, da lobi biibiwan! Da taampu taanga doo anga a biibi. Meke wan enkii sani á poi seke u puu a den sani fu Masaa Gadu! Ma wooko gi Masaa Gadu pasa peesi enke wookoman di á lesi. Sabi taki, dati noiti o de fu soso.
eng_text: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the Lord's work, because you know that your labor is not in vain in the Lord.

djk_text: We, biibiwan! Mi o taki fu a moni di u e piki fu solugu pootiwan a Jelusalem Foto. Mi taigi biibiwan na a pisiwataa fu Galasiya kaba, fa dati mu waka. Useefi teke fu wooko so tu.
eng_text: Now concerning the collection for the saints, as I commanded the assemblies of Galatia, you do likewise.

djk_text: A fosi dei fu a wiki, da poti pikinso moni di i fende fu a wiki go a wanse. Kibii dati sondee fu wooko anga en. Da te mi o doo de, da u ná abi fu fanya fanya suku moni, fu sende gi den sama fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: On the first day of the week, let each one of you save, as he may prosper, that no collections be made when I come.

djk_text: Soseefi, suku wantu fitoow manengee a u mindii de. Da mi o kon naki sitampu poti den a wooko, fu biibiwan a Jelusalem Foto sa sabi taki, na den dati mi sende anga sani di u piki makandii, fu tyai yeepi gi den.
eng_text: When I arrive, I will send whoever you approve with letters to carry your gracious gift to Jerusalem.

djk_text: Soseefi, efu a mu de taki, mi seefi mu go anda, da den sa waka makandii anga mi go anda.
eng_text: If it is appropriate for me to go also, they will go with me.

djk_text: Ma fosi mi doo u de, da a waka fu mi o lolo a somen peesi a ini a hii pisiwataa fu Masadoniya, fu go luku den sama anda fosi.
eng_text: But I will come to you when I have passed through Macedonia, for I am passing through Macedonia.

djk_text: Da te mi o doo u de, da mi sa tan wan hii pisiten anga u. Kande mi pasa a hii koo pisi fu a yali a u mindii de seefi. Da u sa poi yeepi mi seeka sani wanten, fu go moo faawe a pe mi o denki fu go bakadati.
eng_text: But with you it may be that I will stay, or even winter, that you may send me on my journey wherever I go.

djk_text: We, efu mi mu kon luku u de nownow, da mi ná o poi tan langa anga u. Bika na waka tapu mi o pasa u, fu wan satu pisi ten namo. Ma mi á wani so. Bika mi wani tan langa a u de, efu Masaa Gadu wani en so.
eng_text: For I do not wish to see you now in passing, but I hope to stay a while with you, if the Lord permits.

djk_text: Ma fa a de, da mi de a Efese Foto ya fosi, te enke Penkisite Fesa sa kai pasa.
eng_text: But I will stay at Ephesus until Pentecost,

djk_text: Bika doo opo bigi gi mi a Efese Foto ya, fu tyai Masaa Gadu bosikopu paati. Ma fa pasi opo bigi gi mi, na so tyaipi sama taampu sete, fu tapu mi anga a wooko ya.
eng_text: for a great and effective door has opened to me, and there are many adversaries.

djk_text: We, Timotiyesi de a waka tapu nownow. Efu a doo u de, da u á mu libi wan fasi anga en. Ma solugu taki, a fii switi a u mindii. Bika na fa mi ya e wooko gi Masaa Gadu, na so enseefi tu.
eng_text: Now if Timothy comes, see that he is with you without fear, for he does the work of the Lord, as I also do.

djk_text: Da sama á mu wooko ape anga en enke a nái de wan sani. Ma meke a komoto de baka anga wan switi ati. Bika mi de ya e luku en anga den taa biibi baala di e waka anga en, fu daai kon mi ya.
eng_text: Therefore let no one despise him. But set him forward on his journey in peace, that he may come to me; for I expect him with the brothers.

djk_text: Ma on ten Apolos o kon luku u anda, mi á sabi. Na moo onmen leisi mi sende en kaba, fu du dati makandii anga den taa baala di e waka anga en. Ma ai fende naamo taki, a nái kon ete. We, fa i si a o fende a okasi fu kon anda bakaten, da a o kon.
eng_text: Now concerning Apollos, the brother, I strongly urged him to come to you with the brothers; and it was not at all his desire to come now; but he will come when he has an opportunity.

djk_text: We, mi e wasikoi ete wan leisi taki, luku bun! Taampu taanga doo anga a biibi. Meke wan enkii sani á poi seke u. Noiti feele wan enkii sani tu.
eng_text: Watch! Stand firm in the faith! Be courageous! Be strong!

djk_text: Membee naamo taki, meke ala san i teke fu du waka anga lobi.
eng_text: Let all that you do be done in love.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Ete wan sani mi wani sende u! U sabi Stefanasi anga den sama fi en osu taki, na den fosi teke biibi na a hii pisiwataa fu Akasi anda. Ne den poti den hii libi yeepi sama di Masaa Gadu poti apaiti fasi anda.
eng_text: Now I beg you, brothers (you know the house of Stephanas, that it is the first fruits of Achaia, and that they have set themselves to serve the saints),

djk_text: We, da teke den sowtu man de taki, den fiti fu teli enke edeman a u tapu. Soseefi teli ala taawan di e wooko makandii anga den tu.
eng_text: that you also be in subjection to such, and to everyone who helps in the work and labors.

djk_text: Piisii moo mi ya di Stefanasi anga Footunatesi anga Akaikosi kon luku mi ya! Mi piisii anga den fu u anda peesi, di u á de ya kaba.
eng_text: I rejoice at the coming of Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus; for that which was lacking on your part, they supplied.

djk_text: Bika den gi mi nyun kankan wan jeje fasi enke fa den e gi u anda tu. Da teli man enke den disi fu bigi!
eng_text: For they refreshed my spirit and yours. Therefore acknowledge those who are like that.

djk_text: We, ala kulu biibiwan fu Masaa Gadu a den peesi lontu a hii pisi fu Asiya dise sende bigi odi gi u. Akwila anga en uman Pelesela anga biibiwan di e miti makandii a den osu seefi. Den ala na sama di e waka a Masaa baka makandii anga u anda.
eng_text: The assemblies of Asia greet you. Aquila and Priscilla greet you much in the Lord, together with the assembly that is in their house.

djk_text: Ala Masaa Gadu sama dise e bali u anda odi. Bali ala biibiwan anda wan switi odi a ini a nen fu Masaa gi wi.
eng_text: All the brothers greet you. Greet one another with a holy kiss.

djk_text: We, a pisi biifi di e kon ya, na miseefi o teke a sikiifi tiki oli sikiifi taki, mi Pawlesi e sende bigi odi gi u anda tu.
eng_text: This greeting is by me, Paul, with my own hand.

djk_text: U yee ya! Sama di á lobi Masaa Gadu mu luku bun! Bika a poti wan gaan fuuku a den dati tapu. Mi e begi Masaa gaantangi taki, Masaa! Kon esi esi, baa! Dati na Malanata!
eng_text: If any man doesn't love the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be accursed . Come, Lord!

djk_text: Ma u ala anda dati, da Masaa Jesesi taampu anga u ala, fu teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku u de.
eng_text: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

djk_text: Noti moo enke mi lobi u tuutuu. Bika u ala de fu Kelestesi Jesesi makandii de. Amen, na so a de!
eng_text: My love to all of you in Christ Jesus. Amen.

djk_text: Masaa Gadu poti mi Pawlesi ya toon apaiti bosikopuman fu Masaa Jesesi. Da mi sikiifi a biifi ya gi a hii kulu sama a Kolenti Foto di Masaa Gadu kai kon poti apaiti fasi enke sama fi en seefi. Ma a biifi mu doo kulu biibiwan fu Akasi tu. Mi anga wi lobi biibi baala Timotiyesi e sende odi.
eng_text: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother, to the assembly of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints who are in the whole of Achaia:

djk_text: Meke u Tata, Masaa Gadu anga Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku u de. Soseefi, meke u ati de switi.
eng_text: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

djk_text: Bali gafa Masaa Gadu di de Gadu anga Tata fu wi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi. Bika na useefi Tata di abi tyali ati gi u enke pikin fi en. Ai koo wi ati naamo, fu biibi doo.
eng_text: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort;

djk_text: Ibii booko ede, da a taampu de fu koo wi ati. Da wiseefi e poi koo taawan ati baka anga san a du gi wi, te denseefi abi booko ede.
eng_text: who comforts us in all our affliction, that we may be able to comfort those who are in any affliction, through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.

djk_text: Bika a libi fu Kelestesi a goontapu lai booko ede. Da wi enke sama fi en e fende booko ede fi en ede. Ma fi en ede tu meke Masaa Gadu e koo wi ati naamo.
eng_text: For as the sufferings of Christ abound to us, even so our comfort also abounds through Christ.

djk_text: Da sabi taki, wi ya abi booko ede, ma na fu Masaa Gadu mu koo u anda ati tyai gaan bun gi u. Bika u anda abi booko ede enke wi ya. Da fa ai koo wi dise ati o koo u anda ati tu. Da u sa abi pasensi de.
eng_text: But if we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation. If we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which produces in you the patient enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer.

djk_text: Wi abi a taanga denki ya. Bika u sabi taki, na fu a biibi ede meke u abi booko ede enke wi ya. Da Masaa Gadu o koo u de ati enke fa ai koo wi ya ati tu, fu biibi doo.
eng_text: Our hope for you is steadfast, knowing that, since you are partakers of the sufferings, so also are you of the comfort.

djk_text: Mi lobi biibiwan! Booko ede di wi ya be abi na a pisiwataa fu Asiya sa soi u anda san na banowtu. A be bigi te, ne u be denki kaba taki, u futu o komoto a goontapu!
eng_text: For we don't desire to have you uninformed, brothers, concerning our affliction which happened to us in Asia, that we were weighed down exceedingly, beyond our power, so much that we despaired even of life.

djk_text: A be soi enke Masaa Gadu dei be doo fu puu wi ya. Ma kweti! Na fu seefi a be fika wi fu si taki, efu u dede, da ne en wawan yeepi namo fika di poi weki dede baka.
eng_text: Yes, we ourselves have had the sentence of death within ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God who raises the dead,

djk_text: Soseefi a meke u si taki, a fika wi a dede mofu, ma a poi puu wi baka a ini ala dati sondee fu u dede. Da ibii tu fasi u sa poi denki anga fitoow taki, yeepi o komoto ne en namo doo wi.
eng_text: who delivered us out of so great a death, and does deliver; on whom we have set our hope that he will also still deliver us;

djk_text: Da u tan begi a yeepi ya gi wi dise, fu fende. Da moo sama o si dati, fu bali gafa Masaa Gadu, fa ai teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku wi ala.
eng_text: you also helping together on our behalf by your supplication; that, for the gift bestowed on us by means of many, thanks may be given by many persons on your behalf.

djk_text: Wi dise e gafa fa a o yeepi wi sowan fasi. Bika wi konsensi e piki wi taki, wi e libi leti anga sama. Moomoo u fu anda. Soseefi na sondee takuu fasi wi e libi, fu piisii en. A ná anga goontapu koni, ma ne en gaan bun ati fasi namo di a teke, fu yeepi wi anga dati.
eng_text: For our boasting is this: the testimony of our conscience, that in holiness and sincerity of God, not in fleshly wisdom but in the grace of God we behaved ourselves in the world, and more abundantly toward you.

djk_text: Da ala san wi e sikiifi sende gi u anda á taanga fu fusutan tu. Wi á kibii sani ya tu di wi á sikiifi. Da a ná wi ya meke u nái kaba fusutan ala dati de. Ma wi abi a taanga denki taki, dati o kengi namo.
eng_text: For we write no other things to you, than what you read or even acknowledge, and I hope you will acknowledge to the end;

djk_text: U o fusutan ala sani de namo. Da te Masaa Jesesi o kon baka, da u anda o poi poolo gafa fa wi dise be wooko. Wi ya seefi o poi poolo anga u de tu.
eng_text: as also you acknowledged us in part, that we are your boasting, even as you also are ours, in the day of our Lord Jesus.

djk_text: Mi be sabi kaba taki, mi anga u de bun so. Ne mi be poti kaba fu kon luku u de hii tu leisi seefi, fu moo tyai yeepi gi u.
eng_text: In this confidence, I was determined to come first to you, that you might have a second benefit;

djk_text: Te mi o de a pasi, fu gwe a Masadoniya anga te mi o daai komoto anda o de tu leisi mi tapu a u de. Da u sa seeka mi de anga san mi fanowdu na a waka, fu gwe a Judeja pisiwataa.
eng_text: and by you to pass into Macedonia, and again from Macedonia to come to you, and to be sent forward by you on my journey to Judea.

djk_text: Da meke sama kaba denki de taki, mi paamisi so, ma mi o wooko goontapu fasi enke sama nái teli Masaa Gadu anga tu mofu taki. Den e piki taki, den o du so, da den kengi baka taki, den ná o du so moo.
eng_text: When I therefore was thus determined, did I show fickleness? Or the things that I purpose, do I purpose according to the flesh, that with me there should be the "Yes, yes" and the "No, no?"

djk_text: Bika ala yuu, da Masaa Gadu e du san a paamisi, meke sama sa fitoow en. Da meke wi seefi á taki, wi o du wan sani, ma wi e kengi baka taki, wi ná o du en moo. Kweti!
eng_text: But as God is faithful, our word toward you was not "Yes and no."

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu Manpikin, Jesesi Kelestesi bosikopu di mi anga Silasi anga Timotiyesi paati doo u de nái waka enke sani fu meke sama pantan. Noiti en taki e kengi anga san a be paamisi kaba.
eng_text: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us, by me, Silvanus, and Timothy, was not "Yes and no," but in him is "Yes."

djk_text: Luku fa a be paamisi taki, a o sende a Kelestesi kon yeepi libisama. Namo a kon so tuu, meke u sa bali gafa en taki: “Amen !” Na so a de tuu enke fa a be paamisi.
eng_text: For however many are the promises of God, in him is the "Yes." Therefore also through him is the "Amen," to the glory of God through us.

djk_text: Da luku fa ai wooko anga wi ala tu. Ai yeepi wi anga u de makandii, fu taampu taanga a ini a mokisa libi anga Kelestesi. A kandi en apaiti fatu seeka u libi.
eng_text: Now he who establishes us with you in Christ, and anointed us, is God;

djk_text: Ne a sende en Jeje kon teke peesi a wi ati, enke wan sitampu di a naki a wi, fu soi taki, u na sama fi en. Soseefi enke a maiki fu soi taki, tuutuu u sa fende ala taa sani di de fu kon ete.
eng_text: who also sealed us, and gave us the down payment of the Spirit in our hearts.

djk_text: Ma mi á kon a Kolenti Foto de ete enke fa mi be paamisi. Bika mi á wani kon taki hati fasi anga u de, fu san u e du de ete. Na dati tuu, mi e taki leti. Masaa Gadu ain de a mi tapu, meke mi á poi lei.
eng_text: But I call God for a witness to my soul, that I didn't come to Corinth to spare you.

djk_text: Mi á wani kon anga wan taki de, fu meke u fii de enke wi ya e basi u anga a biibi. Na makandii wi ala mu taampu fu wooko anga a biibi, da piisii sa de a u de. Bika na biibi Kelestesi namo e meke u ala taampu taanga.
eng_text: Not that we have lordship over your faith, but are fellow workers with you for your joy. For you stand firm in faith.

djk_text: Na dati puu mi, fu mi á kon luku u de ete. Bika mi á wani kon taki taanga anga u de, fu sani mu waka baka enke a taa leisi, fu tyai buduufu.
eng_text: But I determined this for myself, that I would not come to you again in sorrow.

djk_text: Bika te mi meke u buduufu, da mi seefi e buduufu. Ma fu mi anga u mu buduufu makandii, da sama ná o de fu koi mi de.
eng_text: For if I make you sorry, then who will make me glad but he who is made sorry by me?

djk_text: Na so meke mi sikiifi piki u, pe fu kon taki a ogii di be pasa de. Da a sa seeka fosi mi kon, meke u di mu piisii mi ná o de fu buduufu mi. Mi sabi taki, u o du enke fa mi be soi na a biifi de, fu u sa piisii makandii.
eng_text: And I wrote this very thing to you, so that, when I came, I wouldn't have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all, that my joy would be shared by all of you.

djk_text: Bika na booko ede fu anda meke mi be sikiifi a biifi de, anga wataa ain seefi. Mi á be sikiifi en fu buduufu u, ma na fu be soi fa mi lobi u dipi pasa peesi.
eng_text: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote to you with many tears, not that you should be made sorry, but that you might know the love that I have so abundantly for you.

djk_text: Bika a sama di be du a ogii de be buduufu u de moo mi ya seefi. A buduufu naki ibiiwan pikinso de. Mi taki na pikinso, bika mi á wani sutu faya baka na a toli ya.
eng_text: But if any has caused sorrow, he has caused sorrow, not to me, but in part (that I not press too heavily) to you all.

djk_text: Bika a sitaafu di gaanse fu u anda be fiti gi dati be sai gi en kaba.
eng_text: Sufficient to such a one is this punishment which was inflicted by the many;

djk_text: Da a doo peesi now fu gi en paadon, fu fende kankan bigin libi leti baka. Efu u á du so, tyali o moo en. Da a sa bigin denki taki, noiti moo paadon sa de gi en.
eng_text: so that on the contrary you should rather forgive him and comfort him, lest by any means such a one should be swallowed up with his excessive sorrow.

djk_text: Da mi e begi u taki, u kai u seefi kon makandii baka, da u kai en poti sidon. Da u fiti taki, u seeka a toli fi en baka. U lobi en fu kon a u mindii baka.
eng_text: Therefore I beg you to confirm your love toward him.

djk_text: Saide mi be sikiifi a biifi de tu taki, u be mu puu en a u mindii. Mi be wani keli u luku efu u e du ala san mi e akisi u fu du. We, ne u soi dati kaba.
eng_text: For to this end I also wrote, that I might know the proof of you, whether you are obedient in all things.

djk_text: Da mi e akisi u ya baka taki, gi en paadon. Da mi mokisa anga u de, fu dati. Fu mi se, a fende en kaba, fu san a be du anga mi dati. Mi á be teke en bigi kaba lasitan paadon fu gi en. Kelestesi e si fa mi du so, fu u sa si a mi fa fu du tu.
eng_text: Now I also forgive whomever you forgive anything. For if indeed I have forgiven anything, I have forgiven that one for your sakes in the presence of Christ,

djk_text: Da didibii á sa poi fende wini a u mindii de. Bika u ala sabi fa ai denki fu sutu faya a sani.
eng_text: that no advantage may be gained over us by Satan; for we are not ignorant of his schemes.

djk_text: Sabi taki doo be opo bigi gi mi a Towasi Foto pe mi be doo anga a Bun Nyunsu fu Kelestesi. Sama be lobi a toli ya fu teke anga ala piisii.
eng_text: Now when I came to Troas for the Good News of Christ, and when a door was opened to me in the Lord,

djk_text: Ma saide mi ati á be kaba sidon de! Bika mi lobi biibi baala Titesi á be kon doo mi ete fu soi fa ai go anga u anda. Da mi be e booko ede fu u ede, meke mi be bali adyosi de pasa go doo Masadoniya.
eng_text: I had no relief for my spirit, because I didn't find Titus, my brother, but taking my leave of them, I went out into Macedonia.

djk_text: We, gafa Masaa Gadu, fu di u mokisa libi anga Kelestesi. Ai tyai u lontu enke en gaan fesa pe ai soi goontapu fa a feti wini u teke. Na so wi e doo ala se anga en leli di e soi fa a de seefi, fu paati dati enke switi sumee gi en.
eng_text: Now thanks be to God, who always leads us in triumph in Christ, and reveals through us the sweet aroma of his knowledge in every place.

djk_text: Bika ai piisii fu si wi enke a switi fatu fu Kelestesi di a lobi fu tyatya doo en fesi. Ai doo sama o teke dati tu, fu fende libi tego anga sama ná o teke fu fende sitaafu tego.
eng_text: For we are a sweet aroma of Christ to God, in those who are saved, and in those who perish;

djk_text: Bika den di o fende sitaafu tego e teke en enke den sumee tingi dede sani. Ma den di o fende libi tego e teke dati enke den sumee switi sani. A wooko fu Masaa Gadu ya bigi pasa san libisama poi du.
eng_text: to the one a stench from death to death; to the other a sweet aroma from life to life. Who is sufficient for these things?

djk_text: Bika wi ya nái waka paati dati enke sama di e lontu, fu meke moni. Ma enke wookoman di mokisa libi anga Kelestesi, da wi sabi fa Masaa Gadu ain de a wi tapu, fu si wi e paati en tuutuu bosikopu di a sende wi.
eng_text: For we are not as so many, peddling the word of God. But as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God, we speak in Christ.

djk_text: Kaba denki, wi e gafa useefi ya! Wi nái tyai a wooko ya anga lenti a pampila di sama maiki fu u mu soi taki, na Masaa Gadu bosikopu. U anda seefi u á fanowdu fu gi u a maiki de.
eng_text: Are we beginning again to commend ourselves? Or do we need, as do some, letters of commendation to you or from you?

djk_text: Bika na u libi na a maiki fu soi fa na Masaa Gadu bosikopu wi e tyai. Sama sa si fa u anda libi kengi nyun. Na dati taawan mu fende leisi enke na wan pampila di taki, a libi ya maiki a u ati.
eng_text: You are our letter, written in our hearts, known and read by all men;

djk_text: U libi na san Kelestesi lenti fu soi enke maiki taki, a bosikopu di wi ya tyai kengi u. Da a á de pampila di sikiifi tiki maiki. Na a Jeje fi en teke u libi di á de siton fu maiki, ma sama sa fende leisi de taki, a libi ya de a u ati.
eng_text: being revealed that you are a letter of Christ, served by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tablets of stone, but in tablets that are hearts of flesh.

djk_text: Bika di u mokisa libi anga Kelestesi, ne ala dati waka so. U mu taki dati sondee pantan. Bika u sabi taki, na so Masaa Gadu seefi e si a toli ya.
eng_text: Such confidence we have through Christ toward God;

djk_text: Wi enke libisama á be o poi du a wooko ya. Sani á de fu useefi be sa du te, da a be o doo peesi gi Masaa Gadu. Ne enseefi be abi fu wooko so anga wi.
eng_text: not that we are sufficient of ourselves, to account anything as from ourselves; but our sufficiency is from God;

djk_text: A teke wi, fu soi a nyun fasi di a poti fu dini en. Dati á de fu leli wooko anga en weiti. Ma na a Jeje fi en kon wooko a wi. En weiti taanga fu oli meke u be fiti fu dede tego. Ma a Jeje gi taanga fu poi teke en taki fende libi tego.
eng_text: who also made us sufficient as servants of a new covenant; not of the letter, but of the Spirit. For the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life.

djk_text: Bika a gaandi fasi fu dini en be sikiifi a siton gi Dyusama. Dati á be meke fu tan tego. Ma toku a be waka dyendee fasi kon a den. A be beenki Mosesi hii fesi te den á be poi luku en. Ma a be taanga fu oli, meke sama di e wooko anga dati fiti fu dede tego.
eng_text: But if the service of death, written engraved on stones, came with glory, so that the children of Israel could not look steadfastly on the face of Moses for the glory of his face; which was passing away:

djk_text: Ma a nyun fasi fu dini, da ne en Jeje kon gi taanga, fu poi teke en taki, soseefi fende paadon go doo libi tego. Da a wooko ya musu moo waka dyendee fasi kon a sama.
eng_text: won't service of the Spirit be with much more glory?

djk_text: Bika Mosesi wooko di waka kon dyendee fasi de bosikopu taki, sama á poi oli weiti, meke den fiti fu dede tego. Ma di a sende kon nownow e puu sama a takuudu anga ogii fende libi tego. Da a musu waka moo dyendee fasi kon a sama.
eng_text: For if the service of condemnation has glory, the service of righteousness exceeds much more in glory.

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu bosikopu di Mosesi be e leli na a gaandi fasi fu dini en. Da dati be beenki en fesi dyendee fasi, ma a á be meke fu tan tego. Na di a sende kon nownow meke fu tan tego, da a musu moo bigi.
eng_text: For most certainly that which has been made glorious has not been made glorious in this respect, by reason of the glory that surpasses.

djk_text: Di a be sende Mosesi fu leli sama dini en dati á be meke fu tan wooko dyendee fasi tego. Ma a be waka kon a sama dyendee fasi. Da di meke fu wooko dyendee fasi tego musu moo waka dyendee fasi kon.
eng_text: For if that which passes away was with glory, much more that which remains is in glory.

djk_text: Da u mu tan taki san Masaa Gadu paamisi wi. U mu e denki taanga fasi fu fende san a bosikopu de taki sondee pantan. Bika u sabi taki, dati noiti poi kengi.
eng_text: Having therefore such a hope, we use great boldness of speech,

djk_text: Da u ná abi fu du enke fa Mosesi be abi fu du. A be tapu a dyendee fasi fu Masaa Gadu ne en fesi, di á meke fu tan tego de seefi anga koosi. Da taa Dyusama ain á be sa kai ne en.
eng_text: and not as Moses, who put a veil on his face, that the children of Israel wouldn't look steadfastly on the end of that which was passing away.

djk_text: Bika sama be taanga yesi fu fusutan te doo tide ete seefi, den e wooko anga a gaandi kuudei fu dini. Da ai tapu gi den, fu si pe a wani tii den go. Wan sani tapu dati gi den ete. Na biibi Kelestesi e wai a sani de puu.
eng_text: But their minds were hardened, for until this very day at the reading of the old covenant the same veil remains, because in Christ it passes away.

djk_text: Ma enke tide, te Dyusama e wooko anga a gaandi fasi fu dini, da wan sani e tapu den fusutan go doo den ati seefi.
eng_text: But to this day, when Moses is read, a veil lies on their heart.

djk_text: Ma ibiiwan di daai biibi Masaa Jesesi, da na leti enke san be tapu a dyendee a Mosesi fesi wai komoto, fu meke a dyendee fu Masaa Gadu kon fu si.
eng_text: But whenever one turns to the Lord, the veil is taken away.

djk_text: Bika wi Masaa seefi anga a Jeje di a sende kon nownow na a wan. Da te dati go a wan sama libi, da ai booko a taanga di weiti be abi fu wooko enke basi ne en tapu.
eng_text: Now the Lord is the Spirit and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.

djk_text: Da sani á tapu wi enke biibiwan fesi moo, meke u libi sa soi Masaa Gadu dyendee. Bika ai kengi u moo anga moo gei Masaa Jesesi. Na so wi Masaa e wooko anga Jeje fi en di taanga.
eng_text: But we all, with unveiled face beholding as in a mirror the glory of the Lord, are transformed into the same image from glory to glory, even as from the Lord, the Spirit.

djk_text: Na dati meke wi ya kon toon Masaa Gadu wookoman. Enseefi wooko tyali ati fasi gi u sani di useefi á poi wooko fu fende. Da noiti wi o lasi ati, fu booko saka anga a wooko ya. Kweti!
eng_text: Therefore seeing we have this ministry, even as we obtained mercy, we don't faint.

djk_text: Wi e wooko leti naamo. U ná abi kibii takuu fasi fu gi useefi sen. U nái bendi a bosikopu taa fasi. U nái leli lei sani, ma na Masaa Gadu tuu taki. Da finga á poi soi kai wi falisi leliman. Masaa Gadu seefi ain e si fa wi e wooko leti.
eng_text: But we have renounced the hidden things of shame, not walking in craftiness, nor handling the word of God deceitfully; but by the manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man's conscience in the sight of God.

djk_text: Bika sama di toku wi bosikopu kibii gi, da na den di á poi si a dyendee fi en, da den de fu go fende sitaafu tego a Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Even if our Good News is veiled, it is veiled in those who perish;

djk_text: Didibii e ligei den di á wani teke dati. A tapu den fusutan, meke den á poi si a gaan dyendee fasi fu Kelestesi a ini a Bun Nyunsu, di e soi fa a de enke Masaa Gadu seefi.
eng_text: in whom the god of this world has blinded the minds of the unbelieving, that the light of the Good News of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God, should not dawn on them.

djk_text: Bika san wi ya e leli sama á de fu gi useefi gaandi. Na Kelestesi wi e soi taawan fu si fa a de Masaa, fu teke en taki. Wi ya na wookoman namo fu di enseefi sende u kon wooko gi u de.
eng_text: For we don't preach ourselves, but Christ Jesus as Lord, and ourselves as your servants for Jesus' sake;

djk_text: Na Masaa Gadu di bigin fu goontapu be kumandei a dunguu peesi fu kiin, meke dei booko. Ne en abi a bosikopu fu Kelestesi ya di a meke kiin u ati. Bika a soi wi Masaa Gadu dyendee de anga en libi.
eng_text: seeing it is God who said, "Light will shine out of darkness," who has shone in our hearts, to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.

djk_text: A dyendee fi en de na gaan gudu, fu teke poti waiti fasi! Ma na u libi a mu fende waiti sai fu poti dati. Da a wooko enke sama kibii waiti sani fi en a ini soso tokotoko patu. Da a nái de taanga fu wi seefi moo.
eng_text: But we have this treasure in clay vessels, that the exceeding greatness of the power may be of God, and not from ourselves.

djk_text: Da winsi feyanti fu a biibi e fuka wi ala se, ma den nái poi booko wi saka. Sani wani buuya wi son leisi, ma wi nái feele enke yeepi á de.
eng_text: We are pressed on every side, yet not crushed; perplexed, yet not to despair;

djk_text: Sama e lon du ogii anga u, ma noiti Masaa Gadu fika wi. Son leisi wi e mesaandi kisi mankei, ma wi á fika fu kii ete.
eng_text: pursued, yet not forsaken; struck down, yet not destroyed;

djk_text: U sabi fa Jesesi fende dede a sama, da dati sa teke u sikin tu. Ma u nái kaba libi so, fu soi taawan fa a de libilibi ete e gi u libisama fasi taanga, fu poi go doo.
eng_text: always carrying in the body the putting to death of the Lord Jesus, that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our body.

djk_text: Bika u de ibii yuu koosube fu dede, fu biibi en ede. Bika na Masaa Gadu wani u mu libi so, fu soi taawan fa Jesesi e gi u libisama fasi taanga, fu poi go doo.
eng_text: For we who live are always delivered to death for Jesus' sake, that the life also of Jesus may be revealed in our mortal flesh.

djk_text: Da banowtu e tyai wi doo dede mofu. Ma na fu meke a sowtu libi fu wi ya mu poi waka doo yu de, fu fende libi tego.
eng_text: So then death works in us, but life in you.

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu Buku sikiifi taki: “Na biibi fi yu Masaa Gadu, meke mi e taki fi yu yeepi.” Na so wi e biibi nownow, meke wi ya seefi e taki fi en yeepi.
eng_text: But having the same spirit of faith, according to that which is written, "I believed, and therefore I spoke." We also believe, and therefore also we speak;

djk_text: Bika wi sabi fa a weki Masaa Jesesi kon a libi ya baka. Ne wi mokisa weki anga en de fu doo makandii ne en fesi wan dei.
eng_text: knowing that he who raised the Lord Jesus will raise us also with Jesus, and will present us with you.

djk_text: Da a hii tyotyo fu wi ya na fu yeepi u anda, fu meke moo sama yee fu biibi, fa ai teke gaan bun ati fasi namo, fu gi paadon. Da moo anga moo sama sa de tu, fu gi en daa, bali gafa gi en gaandi.
eng_text: For all things are for your sakes, that the grace, being multiplied through the many, may cause the thanksgiving to abound to the glory of God.

djk_text: Da noiti wi o lasi ati booko saka. Sani sa tyai mankei a u sikin seefi, ma na doose fu sikin namo e wasi gwe. Ma inise e seeka dei fu dei kon taampu moo taanga.
eng_text: Therefore we don't faint, but though our outward man is decaying, yet our inward man is renewed day by day.

djk_text: Bika u nái si a hii tyotyo fu wi ya bigi. Na fu wan satu pisiten namo, fu Masaa Gadu seeka gaan dyendee gi u ne en kondee anda, fu piisii tego. A paiman de o wegi a hii tyotyo ya.
eng_text: For our light affliction, which is for the moment, works for us more and more exceedingly an eternal weight of glory;

djk_text: Da wai ain komoto na a hii tyotyo fu wan satu pisiten namo ya. Meke u sutu pakisei a den gaan dyendee di u o fende bakaten, ma den á de fu si ya ete. Dati o tan tego.
eng_text: while we don't look at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen. For the things which are seen are temporal, but the things which are not seen are eternal.

djk_text: Bika u sabi fa u sikin de enke masanga a kampu di á meke fu libi tego. Dede e naki en booko, da u komoto gwe a tuutuu osu a kondee seefi. Dati na a nyun sikin di meke a tapu anda fu libi tego. A á de sama ana wooko.
eng_text: For we know that if the earthly house of our tent is dissolved, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal, in the heavens.

djk_text: Ma fu de a ini a sikin ya, da u e dyeme. Bika u e angii fu go fende boo na a tuutuu osu a tapu anda. Wi o fende sani anda wei tapu useefi enke nyun sikin fu libi tego.
eng_text: For most certainly in this we groan, longing to be clothed with our habitation which is from heaven;

djk_text: Bika a nyun sikin a tapu na wi osu fu teke wi anda. Na dati meke u ná o tan anda enke u mankei sani enke sikin fu wei tapu useefi. Kweti!
eng_text: if so be that being clothed we will not be found naked.

djk_text: Wi sikin ya de enke masanga a kampu di á meke fu libi tego. Wi de a ini e dyeme e kusumi e tyotyo. U nái wani komoto go fika sondee sani fu wei tapu useefi enke sikin. Ma u e wani a nyun sikin, meke wi libisama fasi kengi toon sani fu libi tego.
eng_text: For indeed we who are in this tent do groan, being burdened; not that we desire to be unclothed, but that we desire to be clothed, that what is mortal may be swallowed up by life.

djk_text: Na so Masaa Gadu meke wi enke sama fi en, fu luku den bun di de fu kon de. Da en Jeje di a sende kon teke peesi a wi, na a maiki fu soi wi taki, tuutuu u sa fende ala taa sani di de fu kon ete.
eng_text: Now he who made us for this very thing is God, who also gave to us the down payment of the Spirit.

djk_text: Ai gi wi taanga biibi tu taki, Masaa Gadu o du ala dati wan dei namo. Ma solanga u de anga sikin fu goontapu, da u á doo a libi tego anda a wi Masaa ete.
eng_text: Therefore we are always confident and know that while we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord;

djk_text: Ma u e libi ya anga fitoow ne en, winsi u á poi si dati anga ain ya ete.
eng_text: for we walk by faith, not by sight.

djk_text: Enke fa mi be taki kaba, u nái pantan a Masaa Gadu enke a ná o gi u ala dati. Wi e fende en moo bun tu, fu fika a sikin ya go teke a nyun sikin enke a tuutuu osu fu libi tego anga wi Masaa.
eng_text: We are courageous, I say, and are willing rather to be absent from the body, and to be at home with the Lord.

djk_text: Na so meke wi e feti moo enke ala taa sani, fu libi piisii en anga ala san wi e du anga sikin ya. Te u sa doo a nyun sikin a tapu anda seefi tu.
eng_text: Therefore also we make it our aim, whether at home or absent, to be well pleasing to him.

djk_text: Bika u ala o go doo na a kuutu sutuu fu Kelestesi fesi. Da ibiiwan o fende a paiman di fiti fa a libi anga sikin ya. Den di dini en bun makandii anga den di á dini en bun.
eng_text: For we must all be revealed before the judgment seat of Christ; that each one may receive the things in the body, according to what he has done, whether good or bad.

djk_text: We, wi kon sabi ya fa u mu libi lesipeki en. Da u nái sipowtu! Ma wi e suku fu soi taawan a leti denki ya tu. Masaa Gadu e si a leti fasi fu wi ya. Mi denki u anda seefi konsensi e piki u dati tu.
eng_text: Knowing therefore the fear of the Lord, we persuade men, but we are revealed to God; and I hope that we are revealed also in your consciences.

djk_text: Mi nái taki dati baka fu gafa wiseefi a u anda. Ma na fu gi u kankan, fu sabi soi siteeman fa wi ya de. Da u sa poi piki den. Bika den e gafa anga switi taki soi fa den bigi anga taanga. Doose fu den libi e soi so, ma inise di u nái si dati á de so.
eng_text: For we are not commending ourselves to you again, but speak as giving you occasion of boasting on our behalf, that you may have something to answer those who boast in appearance, and not in heart.

djk_text: Den e kaagi wi ya taki, wi e kon taki sani anda enke wi fusutan nái wooko moo. Ma den á sabi fa wi ati de fu dini Masaa Gadu fa a wani. Da anga kiin fusutan wi e taki, fu ala dati mu tyai yeepi gi u de.
eng_text: For if we are beside ourselves, it is for God. Or if we are of sober mind, it is for you.

djk_text: Bika san e toosi wi fu tyai a bosikopu ya na di u kon sabi san Kelestesi du. A lobi ala sama, meke a teke dede taki, u mokisa dede anga en de.
eng_text: For the love of Christ constrains us; because we judge thus, that one died for all, therefore all died.

djk_text: A dede di a teke taki, useefi dede de kaba. Da wi di fende a nyun libi ya mu kaba waka piisii useefi ati namo. Ma bigin libi piisii en di teke u peesi dede, ma a weki kon a libi ya baka.
eng_text: He died for all, that those who live should no longer live to themselves, but to him who for their sakes died and rose again.

djk_text: Da kaba keli fa sama bigi anga wan goontapu fasi. Na a fasi de u be e keli Kelestesi fosi u be toon biibisama. Ma dati á mu de so moo.
eng_text: Therefore we know no one after the flesh from now on. Even though we have known Christ after the flesh, yet now we know him so no more.

djk_text: Bika wi di mokisa libi anga en toon wan hii nyun sowtu sama. A haw fasi fu libi kaba, meke wan hii nyun fasi kon de di kengi anga dati.
eng_text: Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old things have passed away. Behold, all things have become new.

djk_text: Na Masaa Gadu ala a yeepi de komoto. A meke Kelestesi dede tyai wi kon de bun gi enseefi, toon mati fi en. Ne a sende wi ya e paati a bosikopu de taki, na so sama e kon de switi anga en, fu toon mati fi en.
eng_text: But all things are of God, who reconciled us to himself through Jesus Christ, and gave to us the ministry of reconciliation;

djk_text: A bosikopu ya e soi fa a sende Kelestesi kon puu feyanti fasi fu sama toon mati fi en. Ai figi takuudu anga ogii puu a kaagi fu sitaafu. Na so a sende wi fu bali ala se fa sama sa toon mati fi en.
eng_text: namely, that God was in Christ reconciling the world to himself, not reckoning to them their trespasses, and having committed to us the word of reconciliation.

djk_text: Da wi ya taampu a Kelestesi peesi, fu waka lontu. A leli di wi e gi na Masaa Gadu taki di abi ala kaakiti. We, da wi teke Kelestesi peesi e sende u ya taki, teke fa Masaa Gadu poti fu toon mati fi en, da a ati kon de switi anga en.
eng_text: We are therefore ambassadors on behalf of Christ, as though God were entreating by us: we beg you on behalf of Christ, be reconciled to God.

djk_text: Bika na Kelestesi di noiti abi takuudu anga ogii, ne Masaa Gadu kengi en poti a u peesi. Da a teke a sitaafu fu wi takuudu anga ogii, meke sama mokisa libi anga en kon de bun gi Masaa Gadu kaba.
eng_text: For him who knew no sin he made to be sin on our behalf; so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.

djk_text: Da wi di e wooko makandii anga Masaa Gadu ya e bali u anda taki, luku bun! A gi u paadon sondee useefi wooko fu fende dati. Ma u á mu wisiwasi a sani ya taki, u komoto go baka a ini takuu libi.
eng_text: Working together, we entreat also that you not receive the grace of God in vain,

djk_text: Bika wan peesi sikiifi a ini en Buku taki: “Di mi yuu doo fu yeepi, ne mi yee a begi fu u. Na mi yuu di fiti fu sende a Yeepiman.” Da aliki ya! Ne en yuu di fiti doo ya tuu, fu sende a Yeepiman.
eng_text: for he says, "At an acceptable time I listened to you, in a day of salvation I helped you." Behold, now is the acceptable time. Behold, now is the day of salvation.

djk_text: Da wi ya nái du sani fu tapu pasi gi taawan a Masaa Gadu bosikopu di wi e tyai. Bika wi o meke den á teke a biibi.
eng_text: We give no occasion of stumbling in anything, that our service may not be blamed,

djk_text: Ma u e du doo taki seefi, fu soi fa na tuutuu fasi wi e dini Masaa Gadu. Na so u e oli pasensi pasa ala sowtu banowtu anga banda fu sama. Te toko kon fu buuya wi tu. A ini ala sowtu taanga libi seefi.
eng_text: but in everything commending ourselves, as servants of God, in great endurance, in afflictions, in hardships, in distresses,

djk_text: A ini fonfon doo tei fiingi a dunguu osu. Te sama miti a bosu e pii ain gi wi fu kii wi. Soseefi a ini tyotyo wooko pasa neti sondee siibi. Son leisi anga ala angii bee seefi.
eng_text: in beatings, in imprisonments, in riots, in labors, in watchings, in fastings;

djk_text: Ma wi e tan poti ede ete sondee takuu pakisei. U e fusutan fa fu piisii Masaa Gadu ete. U e teke pasensi libi switi anga taawan ete. Na so u e wooko enke fa a Jeje fi en wani anga fa Masaa Gadu taki fu lobi tuutuu.
eng_text: in pureness, in knowledge, in patience, in kindness, in the Holy Spirit, in sincere love,

djk_text: Ala yuu u de fu taki Masaa Gadu tuutuu bosikopu di e wooko kaakiti fasi. Wan se, u e tan libi fa a fiti en. A taase, u e tan leli taawan en bosikopu fu tapu a mofu fu siteeman di e kaagi wi biibi.
eng_text: in the word of truth, in the power of God; by the armor of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,

djk_text: Sama e hei ofu lagi wi, den e gafa ofu kosi wi, u nái luku. Wi di e taki a tuutuu sani, ma son sama e kai wi leiman ete.
eng_text: by glory and dishonor, by evil report and good report; as deceivers, and yet true;

djk_text: Wi taampu a Kelestesi peesi, fu wooko. U anda sabi dati. Ma son sama á wani teke dati. Da ala yuu wi de a dede mofu, ma Masaa Gadu e oli u a libi. U e teke fonfon, ma kii fu wi á poi fende peesi!
eng_text: as unknown, and yet well known; as dying, and behold, we live; as punished, and not killed;

djk_text: Buduufu e miti wi, ma piisii fu Masaa Gadu de a wi ete. U de enke pootiman, ma na wi e tyai a bosikopu fu gaan gudu gi sama. Tuutuu! Wi gei sama sondee gudu, ma na wi Masaa Gadu gi ala gudu di enseefi abi!
eng_text: as sorrowful, yet always rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, and yet possessing all things.

djk_text: Mi lobi biibiwan a Kolenti Foto de! Wi ya á kibii wi fii gi u anda. U puu u hii ati gi u de.
eng_text: Our mouth is open to you, Corinthians. Our heart is enlarged.

djk_text: Wi á wooko anga pikin pisi fu u ati namo soi u de lobi. Kweti! Na u anda wooko so anga wi ya.
eng_text: You are not restricted by us, but you are restricted by your own affections.

djk_text: Ma mi o taki anga u de now enke fa dda e leli en pikin. U opo a dipi fu u ati anda lobi wi ya baka.
eng_text: Now in return, I speak as to my children, you also be open wide.

djk_text: U á mu tyai u biibi libi sipowtu fasi a mindii fu sama di libi nái waka biibi fasi. Leti fasi anga kukutu fasi nái go. A biibi fasi anga goontapu fasi kengi enke fa kiin fu debooko kengi anga dunguu neti.
eng_text: Don't be unequally yoked with unbelievers, for what fellowship have righteousness and iniquity? Or what fellowship has light with darkness?

djk_text: Kelestesi anga didibii den e kai Beliyali á poi go! Na so biibiwan seefi kengi anga sama di nái biibi.
eng_text: What agreement has Christ with Belial? Or what portion has a believer with an unbeliever?

djk_text: A kulu biibisama na san a libilibi Masaa Gadu teke enke en osu fu tan. Da en osu nái go anga afokodeei sani. Wan peesi sikiifi a ini en Buku taki: “Mi o teke peesi a mi sama, fu waka a den mindii. Mi o de den Gadu, da den de mi foluku.”
eng_text: What agreement has a temple of God with idols? For you are a temple of the living God. Even as God said, "I will dwell in them, and walk in them; and I will be their God, and they will be my people."

djk_text: Wan taa peesi sikiifi baka taki: “Mi e sende u fu komoto a mindii sama, di nái waka a mi baka. Wai gi ibii takuu fasi fu den. Da mi o teke u fu miseefi.”
eng_text: Therefore "'Come out from among them, and be separate,' says the Lord. 'Touch no unclean thing. I will receive you.

djk_text: “Da mi o de enke lobi Tata gi u, da u de mi umanpikin anga manpikin. Na so mi enke Masaa Gadu, di abi ala makiti e taki.”
eng_text: I will be to you a Father. You will be to me sons and daughters,' says the Lord Almighty."

djk_text: Mi lobi biibiwan! Masaa Gadu paamisi wi den sani de. Da meke dati gi u kankan fu libi apaiti fasi anga u sikin. Towe ala takuu pakisei kiin yu fusutan a ini yu ede. Libi, fu gi Masaa Gadu gaandi. Kenisi anga san nái piisii en.
eng_text: Having therefore these promises, beloved, let us cleanse ourselves from all defilement of flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.

djk_text: Mi e begi u taki, gi wi ya u hii ati. Denki fa noiti wi libi kukutu fasi anga u de. Noiti u tyai poli gi u de biibi libi. Noiti u koli u suku wini gi u seefi namo.
eng_text: Open your hearts to us. We wronged no one. We corrupted no one. We took advantage of no one.

djk_text: Mi nái taki ala dati fu soi enke sama de ape e kaagi wi ya fu den sani de. Ma na fa mi be taki kaba. A ná sipowtu lobi u lobi u de na ati. Dede ofu libi á poi tapu dati.
eng_text: I say this not to condemn you, for I have said before, that you are in our hearts to die together and live together.

djk_text: Da mi e opo mi ati taki anga ala gaan fitoow anga u. Mi e gafa u taanga taki, a ná sipowtu koo ati u e gi mi anga u biibi libi de. U e piisii mi pasa ala toko di e miti wi ya seefi.
eng_text: Great is my boldness of speech toward you. Great is my boasting on your behalf. I am filled with comfort. I overflow with joy in all our affliction.

djk_text: Bika di wi ya be doo Masadoniya pisiwataa, da tyotyo be meke u ná abi losutu. Sama be tapu wi e meke toko anga a leli fu Masaa Gadu. Den be lontu wi ala se. Da wi ati be fuu anga booko ede fu anda.
eng_text: For even when we had come into Macedonia, our flesh had no relief, but we were afflicted on every side. Fightings were outside. Fear was inside.

djk_text: Ma gaantangi fu Masaa Gadu di e koo saka fasi sama ati. Bika a be meke Titesi komoto a u anda kon doo wi ya, ne dati koo wi ati ya.
eng_text: Nevertheless, he who comforts the lowly, God, comforted us by the coming of Titus;

djk_text: Ma a ná dati wawan. Moomoo di a taigi wi ya taki u anda biibi libi tyai bun gi en. Soseefi u e buduufu de anga ala booko ede piiti ati fu mi ede. Tuutuu a hii fasi fu u ape gi mi ya piisii.
eng_text: and not by his coming only, but also by the comfort with which he was comforted in you, while he told us of your longing, your mourning, and your zeal for me; so that I rejoiced still more.

djk_text: Ma u be buduufu de fu sani di mi be sikiifi a biifi sende gi u de. Da a ná dati piisii mi ya so. Ma na a yeepi di dati tyai gi u de. Da a bun gi mi taki, mi be sikiifi u so. Mi si taki, a sutu u ati.
eng_text: For though I made you sorry with my letter, I do not regret it, though I did regret it. For I see that my letter made you sorry, though just for a while.

djk_text: Da mi e piisii ya, ma a ná fu di mi be sikiifi sani di buduufu u de! Ma na di a buduufu de, meke u daai libi. Na so a wani u mu buduufu, fu fende bun. Da a kon, fa mi meke u buduufu á tyai ogii gi u.
eng_text: I now rejoice, not that you were made sorry, but that you were made sorry to repentance. For you were made sorry in a godly way, that you might suffer loss by us in nothing.

djk_text: Bika buduufu fa Masaa Gadu wani e tyai yeepi, fu meke sama fende bun. Da ala a buduufu de e komoto baka. Ma goontapu buduufu nái meke sama fende bun so. Ma ai tyai paati kon gi sama anga Masaa Gadu tego.
eng_text: For godly sorrow works repentance to salvation, which brings no regret. But the sorrow of the world works death.

djk_text: Buduufu fa Masaa Gadu wani tyai wini a u de. U e feti now tapu sama a ogii. U wani mi sabi fa u e bali den. U ati e boon a sama di á wani yee. U e feele Masaa Gadu sitaafu. U wani takuuduman fende paiman. U e angii fu mi kon si fa u wani teke taki. We, da u á engee go na a takuuse de.
eng_text: For behold, this same thing, that you were made sorry in a godly way, what earnest care it worked in you. Yes, what defense, indignation, fear, longing, zeal, and vengeance! In everything you demonstrated yourselves to be pure in the matter.

djk_text: We, mi á be sikiifi a biifi gi u fu booko ede anga a sama di be du a ogii de. A ná fu be teke se fu sama di a be du a ogii de tu. Ma na fu useefi be sa keli a Masaa Gadu fesi luku, efu u e lesipeki mi taki sai.
eng_text: So although I wrote to you, I wrote not for his cause that did the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered the wrong, but that your earnest care for us might be revealed in you in the sight of God.

djk_text: Namo fa u wooko de koo wi ya ati. Bika u du san mi be sende u. Moomoo seefi, a piisii wi ya fa u wooko anga Titesi de. Wi si taki, a piisii enseefi. Bika u ala tyai bun gi en biibi libi de.
eng_text: Therefore we have been comforted. In our comfort we rejoiced the more exceedingly for the joy of Titus, because his spirit has been refreshed by you all.

djk_text: We, mi be gafa u gi en fosi a be kon de. Da u á gi mi sen. Sani waka enke fa ala san mi e taigi u de e de tuu. Da fa mi be gafa u gi en soi taki, mi nái taki lei sani.
eng_text: For if in anything I have boasted to him on your behalf, I was not disappointed. But as we spoke all things to you in truth, so our glorying also which I made before Titus was found to be truth.

djk_text: Da a de ya e membee ete fa u teke mi taki wooko de. Fa u puu en bun a boto anga ala teke fu wooko switi anga en tu. Namo ai lesipeki u ya bigi moo fosi a be kon luku u de seefi.
eng_text: His affection is more abundantly toward you, while he remembers all of your obedience, how with fear and trembling you received him.

djk_text: Mi dati ati saka ya tu. Bika mi e piisii taki, mi sa fitoow u de a sani.
eng_text: I rejoice that in everything I am confident concerning you.

djk_text: Mi lobi biibiwan! Luku fa Masaa Gadu teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku Masadoniya biibiwan. Namo, ne den nái sipowtu anga yeepi taawan a sani.
eng_text: Moreover, brothers, we make known to you the grace of God which has been given in the assemblies of Macedonia;

djk_text: A ini a tyotyo fu denseefi de, ma den abi gaan piisii ete. Den pooti de, ma fa den e yeepi taawan anga san den abi de bigi.
eng_text: how that in much proof of affliction the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded to the riches of their liberality.

djk_text: Mi sa kotoigi taki, den gi taawan san den poi! Eeye, moo enke san den poi seefi sondee sama dwengi den fu du so. Bika na denseefi ati opo fu du dati.
eng_text: For according to their power, I testify, yes and beyond their power, they gave of their own accord,

djk_text: Den begi wi ya seefi, fu gi den pasi du dati. Bika den wani mokisa tyai nen taki, denseefi yeepi Masaa Gadu sama a nowtu. Den e si dati enke wan gaan sani.
eng_text: begging us with much entreaty to receive this grace and the fellowship in the service to the saints.

djk_text: Namo, san den gi dyombo u ya seefi, wi á be fuuwakiti so. Ma den á du dati fu sama ain ede. Na Masaa Gadu fosi den piki fu du so, fu piisii en. Bakadati, ne den kon piki wi fu du san wi ya seefi wani, di de san Masaa Gadu wani tu.
eng_text: This was not as we had hoped, but first they gave their own selves to the Lord, and to us through the will of God.

djk_text: Da na wi ya be sende Titesi fu kon kaba piki a moni di enseefi be bigin piki de kaba. Da u anda sa fende pasi soi fa useefi wani yeepi taawan sowan fasi.
eng_text: So we urged Titus, that as he made a beginning before, so he would also complete in you this grace.

djk_text: Bika u libi bun somen sowtu fasi de kaba. U abi gaan biibi. U abi dipi fusutan, fu leli taawan. U sabi san Masaa Gadu wani. U wani yeepi taawan. Wi sabi taki, u anda lobi wi ya ape tu. Gaantangi, da soi bun fasi de go doo, fu yeepi biibiwan a nowtu tu.
eng_text: But as you abound in everything, in faith, utterance, knowledge, all earnestness, and in your love to us, see that you also abound in this grace.

djk_text: U á mu si enke mi kumandei u fu du dati anga taanga. Ma di mi si biibiwan fu Masadoniya pisiwataa feti yeepi taawan, ne mi wani u anda du so tu. Da u sa soi taki, u seefi lobi taawan enke den tu.
eng_text: I speak not by way of commandment, but as proving through the earnestness of others the sincerity also of your love.

djk_text: Bika u sabi fa wi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku sama. En enke a guduman di abi ala san Masaa Gadu abi, ne a mu fika ala dati a tapu anda kon toon pootiman ya, fu be poi yeepi u. Ne u fende dyendee di Masaa Gadu seeka poti gi sama fi en.
eng_text: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that, though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that you through his poverty might become rich.

djk_text: Da luku ya fa mi e denki u anda mu si a hii toli ya. Pakisei a yali di pasa fa u be teke fesi yeepi taawan enke fosiwan. Da na u fosi be angii fu du dati.
eng_text: I give a judgment in this: for this is expedient for you, who were the first to start a year ago, not only to do, but also to be willing.

djk_text: Da du a wooko de go doo kaba fi en. Da ibiiwan sa si taki, u be sete dati, ne u poti fu du en go doo kaba. Da meke ibiiwan ape gi san a poi gi.
eng_text: But now complete the doing also, that as there was the readiness to be willing, so there may be the completion also out of your ability.

djk_text: Soso soi namo taki, i wani gi, da gi san i poi gi, da ai piisii Masaa Gadu kaba. Ma a ná enke sama mu gi sani pasa san a poi.
eng_text: For if the readiness is there, it is acceptable according to what you have, not according to what you don't have.

djk_text: Wi ya nái sende u de fu poti u seefi a fuka, fu yeepi taawan. Kweti! Ma paati san yu abi na a fasi taki, yu abi ete, ma taawan seefi fende tu.
eng_text: For this is not that others may be eased and you distressed,

djk_text: Nownow, di u abi sani sai, da u mu yeepi taawan. Bika di useefi o de a nowtu, ne den abi sani sai, da den o yeepi u baka. Na so u ala sa abi san u fanowdu.
eng_text: but for equality. Your abundance at this present time supplies their lack, that their abundance also may become a supply for your lack; that there may be equality.

djk_text: Dati sikiifi a Masaa Gadu Buku taki: “Moo lati, da sama di be dyunta tyaipi, da den á be abi pasa maiki. Soseefi den di á be dyunta tyaipi moo lati á be abi mendii tu.”
eng_text: As it is written, "He who gathered much had nothing left over, and he who gathered little had no lack."

djk_text: We, a ná sipowtu daa mi e gi Masaa Gadu fu Titesi ede. Bika ai booko ede ya gi u anda enke mi ya seefi.
eng_text: But thanks be to God, who puts the same earnest care for you into the heart of Titus.

djk_text: Fa ai kon luku u anda á de taki, na wi ya e sende en so. Ma ne enseefi teke fu du dati. Ai piisii en, da ai wani du dati seefi fosi mi ya denki fu sende en.
eng_text: For he indeed accepted our exhortation, but being himself very earnest, he went out to you of his own accord.

djk_text: Wan taa lobi biibi baala wi o sende anga Titesi kon luku u de. Ai tyai bun nen a kulu biibiwan fu ala se taki, ai tyai a wooko fu a Bun Nyunsu wan leti fasi.
eng_text: We have sent together with him the brother whose praise in the Good News is known through all the assemblies.

djk_text: Moomoo, na biibi kulu sama gi wi en, fu waka lontu anga wi makandii. Da a sa kotoigi fu wi di sama poti enke basi fu solugu a moni fu Masaa Gadu sama. Bika den wani sama si taki, wi e tyai dati doo den tuu. We, wi e du a wooko ya fu gi wi Masaa gaandi anga ala wan angii fu yeepi sama tuutuu.
eng_text: Not only so, but who was also appointed by the assemblies to travel with us in this grace, which is served by us to the glory of the Lord himself, and to show our readiness.

djk_text: Bika na biibiwan ati opo, fu piki sani sende go yeepi taawan. Da wi á wani sama fende pasi kaagi wi, enke u e puu a ini dati, fu teke fu u seefi.
eng_text: We are avoiding this, that any man should blame us concerning this abundance which is administered by us.

djk_text: Wi wani wooko wan fasi, fu Masaa Gadu keli taki, dati bun. Ma libisama seefi mu poi keli taki, dati bun tu.
eng_text: Having regard for honorable things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.

djk_text: Wan taa lobi biibi baala wi o sende anga den Titesi kon de. Somen sowtu fasi kaba a wooko soi fa ai dini Masaa Gadu bun. A sabi fa u anda e wooko taanga fu yeepi taawan, meke a moo angii fu kon luku u de.
eng_text: We have sent with them our brother, whom we have many times proved earnest in many things, but now much more earnest, by reason of the great confidence which he has in you.

djk_text: Fu Titesi dati u sabi fa a wooko fitoow fasi somen leisi anga mi, fu yeepi u de seefi. Ma u mu oli den tu biibi baala di o kon anga en de seefi bun anga lobi tu. Biibiwan dise si den waiti sende a den peesi, fu lontu anga wi. Den libi tyai gafa gi Kelestesi gaandi kaba.
eng_text: As for Titus, he is my partner and fellow worker for you. As for our brothers, they are the apostles of the assemblies, the glory of Christ.

djk_text: Da gaantangi wooko lesipeki anga den dii man ya. Soi den lobi, te den kon de. Meke ala den taa kulu biibiwan sa poi si fa u nái gafa u de fu soso naamo ala yuu.
eng_text: Therefore show the proof of your love to them in front of the assemblies, and of our boasting on your behalf.

djk_text: Da a á de fanowdu fu tan sikiifi naamo taki, u mu piki sani fu sende go yeepi a nowtu fu biibiwan, di de apaiti fasi gi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: It is indeed unnecessary for me to write to you concerning the service to the saints,

djk_text: Bika mi sabi fa u abi angii fu yeepi taawan nowtu anda. Mi e gafa u dise so naamo a Masadoniya biibiwan mindii taki, na u fu Akasi pisiwata fosi sete a angii fu du dati senten a yali di pasa de. Da na u meke denseefi teke fu du so tu.
eng_text: for I know your readiness, of which I boast on your behalf to them of Macedonia, that Achaia has been prepared for a year past. Your zeal has stirred up very many of them.

djk_text: Ma toku, mi e sende den dii lobi biibi baala kon a u de ete, fu yeepi u piki den sani di u mu sende go yeepi den. Meke ala ain sa si fa mi nái gafa u de fu soso. Da seeka san u piki poti de, enke fa mi paati mofu kaba taki, u o du so.
eng_text: But I have sent the brothers that our boasting on your behalf may not be in vain in this respect, that, just as I said, you may be prepared,

djk_text: Bika efu u á seeka dati so, da u o gi mi sen. A o soi enke mi gafa u doo fitoow u fu soso, efu sama komoto a Masadoniya dise kon anga mi anda. Da a o tyai sen gi u de moo mi ya seefi.
eng_text: so that I won't by any means, if there come with me any of Macedonia and find you unprepared, we (to say nothing of you) should be disappointed in this confident boasting.

djk_text: Na so meke, mi si en fanowdu fu sende den dii lobi baala ya a mi fesi. Da den sa kon yeepi u de, fu kaba piki a bun di u o sende seeka poti kaba kaba, enke fa u be paamisi de. U mu piki ala dati sondee dwengi, fu sende yeepi taawan.
eng_text: I thought it necessary therefore to entreat the brothers that they would go before to you, and arrange ahead of time the generous gift that you promised before, that the same might be ready as a matter of generosity, and not of greediness.

djk_text: Ma membee a nongo di koti taki, sama paandi pikinso alisi namo, en goon ná o puu tyaipi wini. Bika on moo wan sama tyatya towe, da en goon o moo puu wini gi en bakaten.
eng_text: Remember this: he who sows sparingly will also reap sparingly. He who sows bountifully will also reap bountifully.

djk_text: Da ibiiwan mu denki bun san a poi gi, da a poti san en ati wani. Ná gi wan sani di nái kai a yu ati. Meke sama á dwengi yu tu, fu gi san iseefi á wani. Bika san Masaa Gadu lobi na sama di o gi anga en hii ati, wan switi fasi.
eng_text: Let each man give according as he has determined in his heart; not grudgingly, or under compulsion; for God loves a cheerful giver.

djk_text: Da Masaa Gadu di poi teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku yu, sa gi yu tyaipi sani baka pasa peesi. Da yu sa abi ala san yu abi fanowdu ibii yuu naamo. Soseefi, da i sa poi tan du somen bun go doo gi taawan.
eng_text: And God is able to make all grace abound to you, that you, always having all sufficiency in everything, may abound to every good work.

djk_text: Na letiso sikiifi a Masaa Gadu Buku taki: “Sama di tyatya tyaipi yeepi doo pooti taawan, Masaa Gadu noiti wanten moo sa feegete a leti fasi fi en de.”
eng_text: As it is written, "He has scattered abroad, he has given to the poor. His righteousness remains forever."

djk_text: Da a de so taki, na Masaa Gadu e gi sama sani fu paandi naamo, meke nyanyan e goo fu fende nyan. Da a musu poi gi u san u fanowdu naamo, fu poi goo a ini a leti wooko fu yeepi taawan seefi tu.
eng_text: Now may he who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food, supply and multiply your seed for sowing, and increase the fruits of your righteousness;
