djk_text: Ala fasi a o gi sani pasa peesi, fu poi tan yeepi taawan. Ma soseefi san u o piki sende anga wi fu tyai go yeepi taawan, o tyai gaan piisii gi den, fu gafa Masaa Gadu fu dati.
eng_text: you being enriched in everything to all liberality, which works through us thanksgiving to God.

djk_text: Da sabi taki, boiti fu a yeepi di u o sende gi biibiwan so, ma u o meke den gafa Masaa Gadu pasa peesi tu.
eng_text: For this service of giving that you perform not only makes up for lack among the saints, but abounds also through many givings of thanks to God;

djk_text: Fa u yeepi de o meke sama si fa u lobi teke Masaa Gadu taki. Da den o gafa en, fu fa u nái kai useefi biibisama a Kelestesi Bun Nyunsu fu soso. Ma u e du san e piisii en tu taki, u ati opo sondee dwengi paati san u abi anga den, go doo taawan tu.
eng_text: seeing that through the proof given by this service, they glorify God for the obedience of your confession to the Good News of Christ, and for the liberality of your contribution to them and to all;

djk_text: Da te den mu begi gi u de, da den o pakisei u anga daa na ati. Bika den e si a gaan bun ati fasi namo di Masaa Gadu teke luku u, fu meke u ati opo fu yeepi taawan.
eng_text: while they themselves also, with supplication on your behalf, yearn for you by reason of the exceeding grace of God in you.

djk_text: We, meke u gi Masaa Gadu daa makandii ya! Bika a du gaan bun gi wi pasa peesi anga a yeepi di a sende kon gi wi.
eng_text: Now thanks be to God for his unspeakable gift!

djk_text: We, mi Pawlesi e kon saka fasi, soseefi piisii fasi u de enke Kelestesi seefi. Ma gaantangi, bali den sama di e kaagi mi fu dati taki, fesi a fesi, da mi gei feeleman di e kaku anga taki. Ma te mi komoto de, da mi abi ati fu sikiifi taanga biifi sende gi u.
eng_text: Now I Paul, myself, entreat you by the humility and gentleness of Christ; I who in your presence am lowly among you, but being absent am bold toward you.

djk_text: We, mi e begi u de fu solugu taki, te mi kon doo de, mi á fende sama kaasi de. Bika den e libi anga a denki taki, wi ya de goontapu fasi ete.
eng_text: Yes, I beg you that I may not, when present, show courage with the confidence with which I intend to be bold against some, who consider us to be walking according to the flesh.

djk_text: Bika ala fa wi de libisama ete enke ibii taa sama. Ma kweti! Wi biibi feti nái sitee goontapu fasi.
eng_text: For though we walk in the flesh, we don't wage war according to the flesh;

djk_text: Wi feti sani á tan enke goontapu feti sani, fu teke feti. Na Masaa Gadu seeka wi anga en taanga makiti, fu poi naki taanga feti peesi fu a feyanti booko seefi.
eng_text: for the weapons of our warfare are not of the flesh, but mighty before God to the throwing down of strongholds,

djk_text: Da siteeman nái poi taampu a wi fesi anga falisi leli. Bika wi e naki ala gaan taki fu den puu a pasi, fu kaba tapu sama fu si doo Masaa Gadu leli. U e kisi a hii falisi denki fu den banda, meke sama fende pasi denki enke fa Kelestesi wani.
eng_text: throwing down imaginations and every high thing that is exalted against the knowledge of God, and bringing every thought into captivity to the obedience of Christ;

djk_text: U de sete sete, fu kaasi ibii taanga yesi fasi a sama. U sa go doo, te enke sama di wani teke taki seeka doo peesi fa Kelestesi wani.
eng_text: and being in readiness to avenge all disobedience, when your obedience will be made full.

djk_text: U mu luku a sani ya dipi sondee fu si en makiliki fasi di á de tuu. Bika siteeman de di e naki ati anda taki, na den Kelestesi poti fu taki. Ma den mu sabi taki, en anga den á de wan fasi moo wi ya.
eng_text: Do you look at things only as they appear in front of your face? If anyone trusts in himself that he is Christ's, let him consider this again with himself, that, even as he is Christ's, so also we are Christ's.

djk_text: Bika fu mi ya be o gafa pasa peesi seefi fa Masaa Gadu poti mi fu taki, da a á be o de fu booko u saka puu a Kelestesi anda. Ma na fu yeepi u de taampu moo taanga. Meke mi á be o fende sen fu dati.
eng_text: For though I should boast somewhat abundantly concerning our authority, (which the Lord gave for building you up, and not for casting you down) I will not be disappointed,

djk_text: Ma toku mi ná o gafa so. Bika den biifi di mi sende kon a u de be sa gei sani fu dyombo u.
eng_text: that I may not seem as if I desire to terrify you by my letters.

djk_text: Bika son sama bali de kaba taki, mi e sikiifi pepee sani anga ala taanga taki. Ma te miseefi kon doo de, da mi gei soso sama anga wisiwasi taki.
eng_text: For, "His letters," they say, "are weighty and strong, but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech is despised."

djk_text: Ma meke den di e taki dati luku bun san sikiifi a ini biifi di mi sende komoto dise. Da den o si te mi doo de, fa mi o du enke fa mi sikiifi.
eng_text: Let such a person consider this, that what we are in word by letters when we are absent, such are we also in deed when we are present.

djk_text: Ma wi ya ná o peefuu go maiki useefi luku anga sama e gafa denseefi de, fa den bigi. U ná o hei kisi den. Bika denseefi poti den fasi fu maiki luku sama moo bigi. Den nái wooko anga Masaa Gadu koni.
eng_text: For we are not bold to number or compare ourselves with some of those who commend themselves. But they themselves, measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves with themselves, are without understanding.

djk_text: Bika wi ya noiti o teke useefi gafa a pe Masaa Gadu á poti wi fu wooko. Na pe a sende u go wooko mi ya o gafa fa mi wooko leti gi sama de. U anda na peesi pe mi wooko pasa so.
eng_text: But we will not boast beyond proper limits, but within the boundaries with which God appointed to us, which reach even to you.

djk_text: Ma mi á be o poi go gafa a pe Masaa Gadu á sende mi go wooko. Da den be o abi leti, efu mi á be wooko pasa u de. Ma koloku, na wi ya fosi doo u de anga a Bun Nyunsu fosi den.
eng_text: For we don't stretch ourselves too much, as though we didn't reach to you. For we came even as far as to you with the Good News of Christ,

djk_text: Da noiti wi e go gafa useefi a pe taawan fosi wooko kaba. Wi ya taanga denki, na fu meke u anda biibi goo moo anga moo. Da dati o moo meke u si de fa na wi ya Masaa Gadu poti fu taki de tuu.
eng_text: not boasting beyond proper limits in other men's labors, but having hope that as your faith grows, we will be abundantly enlarged by you in our sphere of influence,

djk_text: Da dati o opo pasi meke wi ya sa go doo taa pisiwataa di á kisi a Bun Nyunsu ete. Wi ya nái go sidon e gafa e wooko a pe taa sama fosi wooko kaba taki, u bigi. Kweti!
eng_text: so as to preach the Good News even to the parts beyond you, not to boast in what someone else has already done.

djk_text: Wan peesi sikiifi ne en Buku taki: “U mu gafa namo fa wi Masaa e du en wooko.”
eng_text: But "he who boasts, let him boast in the Lord."

djk_text: Bika a ná sama di e gafa enseefi sa de waiti fu fende gafa taki, a bigi tuu. Ma na sama di wooko e soi taki, na Masaa Gadu sende en.
eng_text: For it isn't he who commends himself who is approved, but whom the Lord commends.

djk_text: Mi denki taki, u sa tan pasensi doo fu teke san mi e taki enke lawman ya. We, mi e si taki, u pasensi teke den kaba, da mi o taki go doo.
eng_text: I wish that you would bear with me in a little foolishness, but indeed you do bear with me.

djk_text: Bika mi e booko ede anga u de enke fa Masaa Gadu e du. Mi e dyalusu seefi enke u na mi umanpikin di mi paamisi a man den e kai Kelestesi. Da mi e waki u fu taawan á fende u puu ne en ana.
eng_text: For I am jealous over you with a godly jealousy. For I married you to one husband, that I might present you as a pure virgin to Christ.

djk_text: Mi e feele fu san kande sa miti u de. Luku a koni fasi fa a sineki didibii be fende pasi koli Efa. Kande dati sa miti u de, meke u hii libi á de gi Kelestesi wawan moo.
eng_text: But I am afraid that somehow, as the serpent deceived Eve in his craftiness, so your minds might be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.

djk_text: Bika sama leli u de hii taa sani fu wan Jesesi di e wooko kengi anga Jesesi di mi e leli. Dati na wan jeje di kengi anga di Masaa Gadu sende. Soseefi wan nyunsu di kengi anga di fu Jesesi. Ne u teke ala dati anda.
eng_text: For if he who comes preaches another Jesus, whom we did not preach, or if you receive a different spirit, which you did not receive, or a different "good news", which you did not accept, you put up with that well enough.

djk_text: We, mi á denki taki, mi á bigi doo den di teke denseefi poti gaanbigi Masaa Gadu bosikopuman de.
eng_text: For I reckon that I am not at all behind the very best apostles.

djk_text: Mi ya tongo á gaata enke den, ma mi sabi sani fu Masaa Gadu tuutuu fasi. Mi fasi fu waka e meke u si ala dati a mi.
eng_text: But though I am unskilled in speech, yet I am not unskilled in knowledge. No, in every way we have been revealed to you in all things.

djk_text: Ma u si enke na ogii taki, mi be saka miseefi du son wooko enke ibii taawan de? We, na fu be soi fa u mu libi fu taampu hei gi Masaa Gadu de. Ne mi gi u Masaa Gadu Bun Nyunsu sondee fu meke u pai mi fu dati.
eng_text: Or did I commit a sin in humbling myself that you might be exalted, because I preached to you God's Good News free of charge?

djk_text: Ma mi be teke moni a taa kulu biibiwan, fu solugu miseefi tuu. Ma na fu be poi kon doo u de anga Masaa Gadu wooko.
eng_text: I robbed other assemblies, taking wages from them that I might serve you.

djk_text: Ma u mindii de, te mi be abi moni fanowdu, da mi á be poti a fuka de gi u. Bika biibiwan be komoto a Masadoniya pisiwataa kon yeepi mi. Den e du dati go doo ete seefi. Da mi á denki bakaten seefi mi o fuka u de so tu.
eng_text: When I was present with you and was in need, I wasn't a burden on anyone, for the brothers, when they came from Macedonia, supplied the measure of my need. In everything I kept myself from being burdensome to you, and I will continue to do so.

djk_text: Mi nái lei, dati sa tan so tu. Kelestesi e wooko a ini mi sondee fu taki lei. Sama fu Akasi pisiwataa anda noiti o poi tapu mi taki, a gafa fu mi ya á de leti.
eng_text: As the truth of Christ is in me, no one will stop me from this boasting in the regions of Achaia.

djk_text: Ma a ná enke dati e soi taki, mi á lobi u de. Masaa Gadu e si fa mi lobi u de kisi.
eng_text: Why? Because I don't love you? God knows.

djk_text: Ma mi o tan sondee fu u anda solugu mi anga moni. Bika mi á wani sama teke mi teli anga leti enke mi anga den di e du dati ape na a wan.
eng_text: But what I do, that I will do, that I may cut off occasion from them that desire an occasion, that in which they boast, they may be found even as we.

djk_text: Den dati na falisi bosikopuman! Ma den e si denseefi enke gaan bosikopuman di Kelestesi sende fu taki. Den e koli sama biibi a lei de. Bika den e meke enke gaan bosikopuman tuu.
eng_text: For such men are false apostles, deceitful workers, masquerading as Christ's apostles.

djk_text: Ma dati nái foondoo mi ya! Bika didibii enke saatan seefi e soi enseefi enke dyendee Engel, di de anga a leti kiin fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: And no wonder, for even Satan masquerades as an angel of light.

djk_text: Da dati á mu foondoo u de tu. Bika wookoman fu didibii musu meke enke na Masaa Gadu e sende den leli sama leti fasi. Ma fika den gi Masaa Gadu. A o sitaafu den fiti a takuu wooko de.
eng_text: It is no great thing therefore if his servants also masquerade as servants of righteousness, whose end will be according to their works.

djk_text: Ma mi e taki ya baka taki, sama á mu si mi enke lawman de! Fu u wani, da si mi so te mi o gafa miseefi nownow pikinso enke fa den falisi bosikopuman e du de. Mi o soi u de sama a mi.
eng_text: I say again, let no one think me foolish. But if so, yet receive me as foolish, that I also may boast a little.

djk_text: We, ma Masaa Jesesi á be o gafa enseefi so. Bika fu wooko so e gei lawman.
eng_text: That which I speak, I don't speak according to the Lord, but as in foolishness, in this confidence of boasting.

djk_text: Ma di somen sama de ape e gafa denseefi wan goontapu fasi, da mi o gafa soi miseefi tu.
eng_text: Seeing that many boast after the flesh, I will also boast.

djk_text: U gwenti teke gafaman taki di den e leli u de kaba. Bika u denki taki, u sabi wooko leti.
eng_text: For you bear with the foolish gladly, being wise.

djk_text: Ma meke mi taigi u de taki, dati na taki fu sama di wani wooko enke basi a u tapu. Na sama di wani soigi u puu wini gi denseefi namo. Na sama di e teke hei peesi, fu naki taawan a sikin fesi de seefi.
eng_text: For you bear with a man, if he brings you into bondage, if he devours you, if he takes you captive, if he exalts himself, if he strikes you on the face.

djk_text: Sen e kisi mi ya fu di wi ya á taanga sai enke den. Bika wi ya á poi naki sama a sikin fesi de sowan fasi. Da mi law fu taki mi o gafa miseefi enke den lawman de.
eng_text: I speak by way of disparagement, as though we had been weak. Yet however any is bold (I speak in foolishness), I am bold also.

djk_text: Bika den e gafa taki, den de Hebelei sama. Den na paansu fu wi avo Abalaham. Den na Islayeli sama. We, mi seefi tu.
eng_text: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they the seed of Abraham? So am I.

djk_text: Den e gafa taki, na den e dini Kelestesi. Mi e taki enke lawman ya. We, mi e dini en moo den! Mi e du en wooko taanga moo den. Den á sooto somen leisi fi en ede enke mi ya. Den á fende fonfon somen leisi fi en ede enke mi. Somen leisi mi pasa a dede mofu seefi.
eng_text: Are they servants of Christ? (I speak as one beside himself) I am more so; in labors more abundantly, in prisons more abundantly, in stripes above measure, in deaths often.

djk_text: Dyulanti wipi mi feifi leisi a diitenti a neigin wipi fu den.
eng_text: Five times from the Jews I received forty stripes minus one.

djk_text: Dii leisi sama wipi mi anga a tiki wipi fu den. Wan leisi sama piki siton naki mi fu kii. Dii leisi a waka tapu, sipi sungu fu kii mi a wataa. Wan hii neti wan hii dei mi suwen a ini a gaan ze.
eng_text: Three times I was beaten with rods. Once I was stoned. Three times I suffered shipwreck. I have been a night and a day in the deep.

djk_text: Mi e waka lontu naamo, mi e pasa takuu liba. Mi e pasa gaanbigi abani peesi. Eigi Dyusama e meke toko, taa foluku tu. Mi doo foto ofu mi doo bakabini peesi, na toko. Mi de a sipi, ze e meke toko. A mindii fu falisi biibisama seefi na toko tu.
eng_text: I have been in travels often, perils of rivers, perils of robbers, perils from my countrymen, perils from the Gentiles, perils in the city, perils in the wilderness, perils in the sea, perils among false brothers;

djk_text: Mi e tyotyo wooko pasa son neti sondee siibi. Mi pasa dei sondee nyan anga diingi wataa kaba. Son leisi, koosi fu wei e mankei mi sikin, da mi fika gi gaan koo.
eng_text: in labor and travail, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, and in cold and nakedness.

djk_text: Anga ala dati, da ibii dei booko ede fu ala den biibiwan fu mi na ala se de a mi. Nowtu fu den e kai a mi sikin buba fu tyai.
eng_text: Besides those things that are outside, there is that which presses on me daily, anxiety for all the assemblies.

djk_text: Wan biibiwan nái fii wan sani te, da mi á fii anga en. Wan biibiwan nái du wan ogii te, da dati á kon koti mi ati.
eng_text: Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who is caused to stumble, and I don't burn with indignation?

djk_text: Ma toku efu mi mu gafa miseefi, da na fu soi a swaki libisama fasi fu mi di á taanga.
eng_text: If I must boast, I will boast of the things that concern my weakness.

djk_text: Mi nái lei! Masaa Gadu enke Tata fu wi Masaa Jesesi di fiti fu gafa tego e si.
eng_text: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus Christ, he who is blessed forevermore, knows that I don't lie.

djk_text: Bika luku Damasikosi Foto. A gaaman di e wooko a Kownu Aletasi ondoo de be kumandei suudati fu lulu mi kisi a ibii pasi mofu.
eng_text: In Damascus the governor under King Aretas guarded the city of the Damascenes desiring to arrest me.

djk_text: Da mi be fende pasi lowe. Ma na tetei biibi baala ape be tei a gaan bakisi kibii mi saka puu a wan fensee fu a gaan hei siton sikotu di meke lontu a foto.
eng_text: Through a window I was let down in a basket by the wall, and escaped his hands.

djk_text: Ma na di mi mu gafa, da meke mi gafa miseefi doo gaan jeje sani di Masaa Gadu meke mi si somen leisi tu. Ma a ná enke den gafa ya o tyai wini gi wan enkii sama.
eng_text: It is doubtless not profitable for me to boast. For I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.

djk_text: Ma na di mi sabi wan sama di libi mokisa anga Kelestesi. Tin na fo yali pasa, Masaa Gadu be tyai en go doo en kondee a tapu anda. Mi á kaba fusutan fu na anga ala en libisama fasi anga sikin ofu na jeje fasi sondee sikin. Masaa Gadu wawan sabi.
eng_text: I know a man in Christ, fourteen years ago (whether in the body, I don't know, or whether out of the body, I don't know; God knows), such a one caught up into the third heaven.

djk_text: Mi sabi namo fa sani waka anga a man de. Fu na anga ala en libisama fasi ofu jeje fasi namo, mi á kaba fusutan.
eng_text: I know such a man (whether in the body, or outside of the body, I don't know; God knows),

djk_text: Ma a subi go doo a dyendee peesi fu Masaa Gadu a tapu anda pe sama fi en e dede komoto ya go. San a miti anga san a yee anda foondoo te, ne fasi á de ya fu poi taki dati. Da a á sabi fa fu soi taawan ala dati.
eng_text: how he was caught up into Paradise, and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.

djk_text: Mi o gafa fa sani waka anga a man de. Ma a ná miseefi mi e gafa so. Bika fu mi mu gafa miseefi, da na fu soi a swaki libisama fasi fu mi di á taanga.
eng_text: On behalf of such a one I will boast, but on my own behalf I will not boast, except in my weaknesses.

djk_text: Fu mi mu gafa san pasa anga a man de, da toku mi á gafa enke lawman. Bika na tuutuu sani. Ma mi ná o gafa, fu sama poti mi bigi pasa miseefi de. Keli mi luku namo san mi e taki doo san mi e du.
eng_text: For if I would desire to boast, I will not be foolish; for I will speak the truth. But I refrain, so that no man may think more of me than that which he sees in me, or hears from me.

djk_text: Masaa Gadu á wani mi abi hei membee fu dati ede taki, a meke mi si somen gaan jeje sani. Ne a fika wan sani enke maka a mi buba e sutu mi seefi. Na so a fika didibii, fu poti en wookoman fu banowtu mi.
eng_text: By reason of the exceeding greatness of the revelations, that I should not be exalted excessively, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, a messenger of Satan to torment me, that I should not be exalted excessively.

djk_text: Mi begi wi Masaa te doo dii leisi seefi, fu puu a banowtu ya a mi buba.
eng_text: Concerning this thing, I begged the Lord three times that it might depart from me.

djk_text: Ma ai piki mi naamo taki: “San yu fanowdu, na fu mi poi teke mi gaan bun ati fasi namo luku yu. Da yu libi mu de swaki libisama fasi di á taanga. Da te mi e yeepi yu, da dati e soi fa na mi taanga de a yu.”
eng_text: He has said to me, "My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness." Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.

djk_text: Da dini Kelestesi e piisii mi, winsi mi de swaki libisama fasi di á taanga. Da sama sa kosi mi seefi. Toko sa miti mi. Sama sa lon du ogii anga mi doo soseefi taa nowtu. Bika mi libi mu soi swaki libisama fasi di á taanga. Da te Kelestesi e yeepi mi, da dati e soi fa Masaa Gadu taanga de a mi.
eng_text: Therefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in injuries, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses, for Christ's sake. For when I am weak, then am I strong.

djk_text: We, mi e si taki, mi gafa ya enke den lawman de tu. Ma na u anda dwengi mi so. Bika na u be mu gafa mi. Den man di e poti denseefi gaanbigi bosikopuman de á bigi moo mi. Winsi fa mi á de noti seefi.
eng_text: I have become foolish in boasting. You compelled me, for I ought to have been commended by you, for in nothing was I inferior to the very best apostles, though I am nothing.

djk_text: Ma mi na wan apaiti bosikopuman, di poti fu taki tuu. Bika sani e pasa a ini mi libi a u mindii de, di e soi dati. Maiki de fu si taki, Masaa Gadu de anga mi. Foondoo sani anga wonduu tu. Na so mi tei ati fu oli doo, pasa ala sowtu tesi tu.
eng_text: Truly the signs of an apostle were worked among you in all patience, in signs and wonders and mighty works.

djk_text: Luku fa mi e libi bun anga u de, doo ala taa kulu biibiwan tu. Mi á gi u de pasi fu solugu mi anga moni seefi. Ma dati á wani taki, mi á wooko bun anga u. Na di mi á wani poti mi fuka a u sikoo. Da u gi mi paadon, efu u si enke mi fowtu.
eng_text: For what is there in which you were made inferior to the rest of the assemblies, unless it is that I myself was not a burden to you? Forgive me this wrong.

djk_text: Na dii leisi kaba di mi de fu kon luku u de. Ma mi de sondee fu wani poti mi fuka a u sikoo ete. Mi á wani u gudu, ma na u seefi mi wani de a mi se. Bika gaansama nái sidon luku fi en nyoni pikin mu solugu en. Ne en mu solugu a pikin.
eng_text: Behold, this is the third time I am ready to come to you, and I will not be a burden to you; for I seek not your possessions, but you. For the children ought not to save up for the parents, but the parents for the children.

djk_text: Na so meke na mi teke fu gi u de ala san mi abi. Mi o du ala san mi poi fu yeepi u de. Bika fa mi lobi u anda dipi so, da a á sa moi taki, u lobi fu mi dati de swaki fasi.
eng_text: I will most gladly spend and be spent for your souls. If I love you more abundantly, am I loved the less?

djk_text: Da son sama o bali piki mi de taki: “Eeye Pawlesi! Na so yu á wani poti yu fuka fu sama solugu yu. Ma yu e wooko moo koli fasi sende taawan kon puu moni a sama saka ya.”
eng_text: But be it so, I did not myself burden you. But, being crafty, I caught you with deception.

djk_text: Ma mi e piki den dati taki, mi noiti sende sama kon de ete anga bosikopu taki u mu sende moni gi mi dise.
eng_text: Did I take advantage of you by anyone of them whom I have sent to you?

djk_text: Mi be sende Titesi kon luku u de makandii anga wan taa lobi biibi baala, ma a á be wooko koli fasi de. A á be puu moni a u saka de. Bika mi sabi fa Titesi e wooko na a seefi fasi fa mi e denki sani jeje fasi.
eng_text: I exhorted Titus, and I sent the brother with him. Did Titus take any advantage of you? Didn't we walk in the same spirit? Didn't we walk in the same steps?

djk_text: U luku san mi wani soi u anga a langa taki ya. A ná fu feti taki gi miseefi. Ma na fu Masaa Gadu mu yee fa mi e taki anga u di mokisa libi anga Kelestesi anda. Da ala san mi e du doo taki seefi mu meke u di mi lobi de so dipi biibi kon moo taanga.
eng_text: Again, do you think that we are excusing ourselves to you? In the sight of God we speak in Christ. But all things, beloved, are for your edifying.

djk_text: Bika mi e feele enke mi o kon miti u de enke fa mi á wani u de. Da mi o de fa u á wani mi de tu. Mi feele enke u e kwali de. Dyalusu anga kaakeli boon ati fasi. Sama e suku wini fi enseefi namo. Sama e kosi taawan anga ala konkuu tyai taki. Hei membee fasi anga ala fanya fanya fasi.
eng_text: For I am afraid that by any means, when I come, I might find you not the way I want to, and that I might be found by you as you don't desire; that by any means there would be strife, jealousy, outbursts of anger, factions, slander, whisperings, proud thoughts, riots;

djk_text: Mi e feele enke mi o kon teke sen de baka a Masaa Gadu fesi. Bika son sama o buduufu mi de, di be mu kaba de kaba anga takuu libi. Den de ape ete enke fa den be de a fesi, sondee fii, fu a takuudu libi di nái waka kiin fasi. Da den á daai libi ete, fu fika sani enke motyo fasi, anga ala taa sowtu fasi di de sen sani.
eng_text: that again when I come my God would humble me before you, and I would mourn for many of those who have sinned before now, and not repented of the uncleanness and sexual immorality and lustfulness which they committed.

djk_text: We, na di fu dii leisi mi o kon a u de now. Da Masaa Gadu maiki fu wasikoi sama na dii tu, da ai sitaafu. En Buku seefi sikiifi taki: “Tu go miti dii kotoigi piki wan sani, da a sai lanti fu piki taki, i du a ogii tuu.”
eng_text: This is the third time I am coming to you. "At the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established."

djk_text: Da du fu tu leisi mi be doo a u de, da mi be wasikoi u de fosi leisi. Mi e sende wasikoi u de komoto a faawe ya anga a biifi ya baka, meke tu. Mi poti fu kon luku u de, fu wasikoi sama de anga takuu libi de ete, meke dii. Da a sa sai fu mi gi sitaafu tu.
eng_text: I have said beforehand, and I do say beforehand, as when I was present the second time, so now, being absent, I write to those who have sinned before now, and to all the rest, that, if I come again, I will not spare;

djk_text: Bika u be piki mi de fa mi e taki anga u taki, na Kelestesi seefi tongo u e yee a mi. Namo u sabi de fa a wooko anga en taanga a u mindii de tuu, di nái waka swaki libisama fasi.
eng_text: seeing that you seek a proof of Christ who speaks in me; who toward you is not weak, but is powerful in you.

djk_text: Bika a be dede swaki fasi di á taanga a koloisi. Ma di a weki baka, da anga Masaa Gadu taanga makiti. Da wi di mokisa libi anga en de swaki libisama fasi, ma u de anga Masaa Gadu taanga makiti, fu poi wooko gi en.
eng_text: For he was crucified through weakness, yet he lives through the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we will live with him through the power of God toward you.

djk_text: Ma a bun, fu keli yuseefi luku efu yu abi a biibi libi tuu. Wegi i seefi bun. Da yu o sabi efu Jesesi Kelestesi de ini a yu libi. Bika i sa luku te a kaba, da yu á de fu Kelestesi Jesesi ete seefi.
eng_text: Test your own selves, whether you are in the faith. Test your own selves. Or don't you know as to your own selves, that Jesus Christ is in you?--unless indeed you are disqualified.

djk_text: Keli wi ya libi luku tu, fu si taki, wi fiti fu kai apaiti bosikopuman fu Kelestesi di a poti fu taki gi en de.
eng_text: But I hope that you will know that we aren't disqualified.

djk_text: Mi e begi taki, u de sa komoto a ibii takuudu. Mi nái begi taki, sama mu kai mi apaiti bosikopuman fu Jesesi Kelestesi di a poti fu taki de. Bika winsi sama nái teli mi de so, ma efu u ya libi leti de namo, da a bun gi mi kaba.
eng_text: Now I pray to God that you do no evil; not that we may appear approved, but that you may do that which is honorable, though we are as reprobate.

djk_text: Bika mi á de fu feti anga san e waka enke fa Masaa Gadu tuutuu leli taki. Na dati mi de fu leli taawan fu du.
eng_text: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.

djk_text: Da ai piisii mi te u taampu taanga fu biibi. Da mi sa wooko anga u a swaki libisama fasi di á taanga. San mi e begi gi u dati na fu u libi sa seeka na a leti fasi gi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: For we rejoice when we are weak and you are strong. And this we also pray for, even your perfecting.

djk_text: Da mi e sikiifi wasikoi u ya, ala fa mi á de anda. Fu te mi doo de, fu mi á sa abi fu sitaafu u de anga a taanga di Masaa Gadu gi mi fu taki. Bika a á poti mi fu toto sama puu ne en pasi, ma na fu yeepi sama taampu taanga.
eng_text: For this cause I write these things while absent, that I may not deal sharply when present, according to the authority which the Lord gave me for building up, and not for tearing down.

djk_text: Mi lobi biibiwan! Enke kiiboi sani, da u tan bun! Feti seefi fu komoto a takuudu fu seeka a libi. Gi taawan koo ati. Mokisa denki sani go na a wan se. U ati mu de switi makandii. Masaa Gadu di e gi lobi anga switi ati fu taawan sa taampu gi u.
eng_text: Finally, brothers, rejoice. Be perfected, be comforted, be of the same mind, live in peace, and the God of love and peace will be with you.

djk_text: Bali ala biibiwan anda wan switi odi a ini a nen fu Masaa gi wi.
eng_text: Greet one another with a holy kiss.

djk_text: Ala biibiwan dise sende odi gi u ala anda.
eng_text: All the saints greet you.

djk_text: Mi e begi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi, fu teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku u de. Fu u ala anda sa si a dipi fasi di Masaa Gadu lobi u. Da meke a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu teke ibiiwan de libi tu, meke u sa wooko switi makandii.
eng_text: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, the love of God, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit, be with you all. Amen.

djk_text: Mi Pawlesi e sikiifi a biifi ya enke apaiti bosikopuman fu Masaa Jesesi. A ná sama poti mi na a wooko ya, meke sama á de fu gafa fu dati. Na Jesesi Kelestesi anga u Tata, Masaa Gadu, di be weki en kon a libi baka.
eng_text: Paul, an apostle (not from men, neither through man, but through Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead),

djk_text: Mi sikiifi a biifi ya makandii anga taa biibi baala di e mokisa wooko anga mi dise. A de gi ala kulu fu biibiwan na a pisiwataa fu Galasiya anda.
eng_text: and all the brothers who are with me, to the assemblies of Galatia:

djk_text: Meke u Tata, Masaa Gadu anga Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku u de. Soseefi, meke u ati de switi.
eng_text: Grace to you and peace from God the Father, and our Lord Jesus Christ,

djk_text: We, luku fa Masaa Jesesi be poti enseefi teke dede gi wi enke paiman, fu takuudu anga ogii. Ma, soseefi, a puu wi a ini a takuu goontapu fu didibii. Na so u Tata, Masaa Gadu wani.
eng_text: who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us out of this present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father--

djk_text: Da bali gafa Masaa Gadu naamo, gi en gaandi alaten. Amen, na so a de!
eng_text: to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

djk_text: Ma a foondoo mi, fu a satu pisiten di mi komoto de, ne u e feegete Masaa Gadu kaba. Bika u e diipi komoto ne en di kai u kon toon sama fi enseefi, di a teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku, ne a meke Kelestesi puu wi a takuudu anga ogii. Da fa u sa abaa gwe a taa falisi leli di á de a tuutuu Bun Nyunsu de?
eng_text: I marvel that you are so quickly deserting him who called you in the grace of Christ to a different "good news";

djk_text: A falisi bosikopu de a ná di fu Masaa Gadu tuutuu wan. Mi e taki so, fu wasikoi u a son sama, leti a u mindii de, di wani buuya u. Den e daai a tuutuu Bun Nyunsu fu Kelestesi.
eng_text: and there isn't another "good news." Only there are some who trouble you, and want to pervert the Good News of Christ.

djk_text: Ma sama di e daai a Bun Nyunsu, fu kengi anga a tuutuu wan di wi ya be tyai, da a mu luku bun! Winsi na wi ya seefi, ofu wan Engel be sa du dati. Masaa Gadu o fuuku en fu tego.
eng_text: But even though we, or an angel from heaven, should preach to you any "good news" other than that which we preached to you, let him be cursed.

djk_text: Wi be taigi u kaba, senten a fosi leisi di wi be kon de. Mi e taki en baka, fu wasikoi sama di e daai a Bun Nyunsu kengi anga a tuutuu wan, di wi ya be tyai, te u anda be teke biibi moimoi. Luku bun! Masaa Gadu o fuuku en fu tego!
eng_text: As we have said before, so I now say again: if any man preaches to you any "good news" other than that which you received, let him be cursed.

djk_text: We, mi nái taki sani fu sama mu gafa mi. Kweti! Bika efu mi suku gafanen a sama, da mi á de wookoman fu Kelestesi moo, di mi e dini. Bika na Masaa Gadu namo mi wani mu gafa mi.
eng_text: For am I now seeking the favor of men, or of God? Or am I striving to please men? For if I were still pleasing men, I wouldn't be a servant of Christ.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Meke mi puu kon a kiin taki, a Bun Nyunsu di mi e tyai ya á de wan koni di komoto a libisama.
eng_text: But I make known to you, brothers, concerning the Good News which was preached by me, that it is not according to man.

djk_text: Pe mi fende a Bun Nyunsu ya á de taki, na libisama taigi mi en. A ná sama leli mi en tu. Ma na Jesesi Kelestesi seefi puu en kon a kiin gi mi, go doo a wooko di a du seefi.
eng_text: For neither did I receive it from man, nor was I taught it, but it came to me through revelation of Jesus Christ.

djk_text: Bika u ala sabi fa mi be e libi enke fa ala Dyusama e denki sani. Mi be lon du ogii seefi anga den kulu sama di e waka a Jesesi baka, fu kaba den a soso puu a goontapu.
eng_text: For you have heard of my way of living in time past in the Jews' religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the assembly of God, and ravaged it.

djk_text: Bika mi be teke Dyusama libi fu bigi! Mi be de a fesi fu somen biya fu mi a Dyu Kondee, a ini a feti fu wooko anga weiti, di avo Dyu gaansama fika gi wi, fa fu dini Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: I advanced in the Jews' religion beyond many of my own age among my countrymen, being more exceedingly zealous for the traditions of my fathers.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Gadu be abi taa denki anga mi! Fosi mi be meke seefi, da a be fiti poti kaba, fu teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku mi, fu teke mi toon sama fi enseefi. Ne di a yuu di a wani doo,
eng_text: But when it was the good pleasure of God, who separated me from my mother's womb, and called me through his grace,

djk_text: ne a tyai mi kon sabi awan kodo Manpikin, Jesesi. Ne enseefi poti mi na a wooko fu soi foluku di á de Dyu, a Bun Nyunsu fi en. Na dati meke mi á go suku koni a sama, ofu meke sama leli mi san fu du.
eng_text: to reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the Gentiles, I didn't immediately confer with flesh and blood,

djk_text: Mi á go a Jelusalem Foto seefi a den apaiti bosikopuman anda, fu leli mi san fu du tu. Den toon apaiti bosikopuman fosi mi tuu, ma toku mi á go a den so. Ma mi teke pasi gwe a wan gaan sabana na Alabiya Kondee pe sama de. Di mi komoto anda baka seefi, ne mi daai go a Damasikosi Foto baka.
eng_text: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those who were apostles before me, but I went away into Arabia. Then I returned to Damascus.

djk_text: Ne na baka dii yali fosi mi go a Jelusalem Foto, ne mi miti Peitilisi de. Ma na tu wiki namo mi tan de.
eng_text: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to visit Peter, and stayed with him fifteen days.

djk_text: Den taa apaiti bosikopuman seefi mi á be si de, boiti Peitilisi. Nono! Ma wan fu den taawan be de ape tu. Dati na Jakowbesi di fu Masaa Jesesi eigi baala.
eng_text: But of the other apostles I saw no one, except James, the Lord's brother.

djk_text: Fu tuu! Na Masaa Gadu fesi mi de, da mi á poi lei. Na tuutuu sani mi e sikiifi.
eng_text: Now about the things which I write to you, behold, before God, I'm not lying.

djk_text: Di mi komoto de, ne mi go lontu na a taa pisiwataa fu Siliya pisiwataa. Soseefi taa pisiwataa fu Silisiya pisiwataa.
eng_text: Then I came to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.

djk_text: A ten de, da den kulu biibiwan fu Kelestesi na a pisiwataa fu Judeja noiti be si mi anga ain wanten.
eng_text: I was still unknown by face to the assemblies of Judea which were in Christ,

djk_text: Den be e yee namo fu mi taki: “A man di be e lon du ogii anga wi biibiwan, e sende sama nownow, fu teke a seefi biibi de. We, a sa de taki, na a seefi man di be e tapu sama a dati, fosifosi?”
eng_text: but they only heard: "He who once persecuted us now preaches the faith that he once tried to destroy."

djk_text: We, a sani ya be meke den poolo te, ne den e gi Masaa Gadu gaandi, fu mi ede.
eng_text: And they glorified God in me.

djk_text: Namo baka tin na fo yali fosi mi go doo Jelusalem Foto baka. Mi anga Balnabasi. Mi be tyai Titesi anga mi tu.
eng_text: Then after a period of fourteen years I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking Titus also with me.

djk_text: Mi á be go de taki, na sama be sende kai mi. Kweti! Na Masaa Gadu be piki mi, fu go a den edeman di sama e teli de, so bigi. Bika mi mu soi den fa mi dati e soi foluku, di á de Dyu, a Bun Nyunsu. Mi go taki fiti anga den, fu buuya á sa komoto a den, fu kon poli a wooko di mi e du, soseefi du pasa kaba.
eng_text: I went up by revelation, and I laid before them the Good News which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately before those who were respected, for fear that I might be running, or had run, in vain.

djk_text: We, Titesi seefi di e yeepi mi wooko na wan lala Giiki sama. Da den be sa sende en go koti maiki a manpeesi taki, na so namo a sa poi kon toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu. Ma kweti!
eng_text: But not even Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised.

djk_text: Na wan duupu taa sama be pee biibisama, bolo kon kibii luku fa ala sani o waka de. Den be wani si efu sama di mokisa libi anga Kelestesi Jesesi komoto a weiti ondoo. Den wani dwengi u go meke weiti wooko enke basi a u tapu baka.
eng_text: This was because of the false brothers secretly brought in, who stole in to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage;

djk_text: Ma wi á du san den wani. Kweti! Bika wi mu oli a Bun Nyunsu, di de Masaa Gadu bosikopu, na a leti fasi gi u anda, go doo.
eng_text: to whom we gave no place in the way of subjection, not for an hour, that the truth of the Good News might continue with you.

djk_text: Den apaiti bosikopuman, di sama e teli bigi de, á be suku fu mi daai fa mi e taki Masaa Gadu bosikopu. Di mi e kai den so á wani taki, mi e teli den bigi tumisi, winsi fa den be waka anga Kelestesi Jesesi seefi. Bika a u mindii, da u nái keli taawan bigi moo taawan. Ma fa mi be taki kaba, den á be suku fu mi daai fa mi e taki Masaa Gadu bosikopu.
eng_text: But from those who were reputed to be important (whatever they were, it makes no difference to me; God doesn't show partiality to man)--they, I say, who were respected imparted nothing to me,

djk_text: Ma den si a toli hii taa fasi. Den fusutan taki, na Masaa Gadu seefi poti mi, fu soi foluku di á de Dyu, a Bun Nyunsu. A poti Peitilisi tu, ma na fu soi Dyusama a seefi bosikopu ya.
eng_text: but to the contrary, when they saw that I had been entrusted with the Good News for the uncircumcision, even as Peter with the Good News for the circumcision

djk_text: A kai Peitilisi poti en kaakiti toon apaiti bosikopuman, sende go a Dyusama. Na soseefi a kai mi dati poti en kaakiti toon apaiti bosikopuman, sende go a foluku di á de Dyu.
eng_text: (for he who appointed Peter to the apostleship of the circumcision appointed me also to the Gentiles);

djk_text: Gaan tiiman fu biibiwan enke Jakowbesi, Peitilisi anga Johanisi na dii apaiti bosikopuman di si a hii toli ya. Den fusutan fa Masaa Gadu teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku mi, fu poti mi na a wooko ya. Ne den soi taki, den o wooko makandii anga mi anga Balnabasi. Bika den seke wi ana taki, u na fu go a den foluku di á de Dyu, ma den o go a den Dyusama.
eng_text: and when they perceived the grace that was given to me, James and Cephas and John, they who were reputed to be pillars, gave to me and Barnabas the right hand of fellowship, that we should go to the Gentiles, and they to the circumcision.

djk_text: Wan sani namo den begi mi. Mi á mu feegete den mofina biibiwan. Mi mu feti fu yeepi den anga san den abi fanowdu. We, fu tuu, na wan sani di mi feti du ibii yuu, enke fa den be akisi mi de.
eng_text: They only asked us to remember the poor--which very thing I was also zealous to do.

djk_text: Ma di Peitilisi be kon na Antiyokiya Foto, da a be meke wan gaan fowtu. Ma mi á kibii en. Mi luku en ne en mindii fesi, soi en sowtu ogii a du.
eng_text: But when Peter came to Antioch, I resisted him to his face, because he stood condemned.

djk_text: Bika a be gwenti sidon nyan makandii anga taa foluku biibiwan. Ma a koti mofu wanten di Jakowbesi sende biibi Dyusama kon luku den biibiwan de. A feele san den o taki fi en. Bika den dati koti a maiki a manpeesi, fu toon Masaa Gadu sama di e oli weiti.
eng_text: For before some people came from James, he ate with the Gentiles. But when they came, he drew back and separated himself, fearing those who were of the circumcision.

djk_text: Namo ala taa biibi Dyu fu ape tiiki ne en baka, ala fa den sabi taki, dati á de wan leti fasi, fu wooko. Balnabasi seefi kai go a ini a ogii ya.
eng_text: And the rest of the Jews joined him in his hypocrisy; so that even Barnabas was carried away with their hypocrisy.

djk_text: Namo mi si taki, den nái tyai denseefi fiti fa a Bun Nyunsu taki. Ne mi kai Peitilisi poti a den taawan fesi taki: “Mi sabi fa yu de wan Dyusama di nái libi moo anga Dyu fasi. Da yu kon de enke foluku di á de Dyu. Da saide yu e fende taki, taa foluku biibiwan mu teke Dyusama fasi?”
eng_text: But when I saw that they didn't walk uprightly according to the truth of the Good News, I said to Peter before them all, "If you, being a Jew, live as the Gentiles do, and not as the Jews do, why do you compel the Gentiles to live as the Jews do?

djk_text: Ne mi taki ete taki: “Libisama fasi, da mi anga yu, Peitilisi, na Dyusama di leli dini Masaa Gadu, na a fasi fu Dyusama anga weiti. Da wi á de taa foluku sama di wi e kai gaan takuuduman, di e booko Masaa Gadu weiti.
eng_text:
We, being Jews by nature, and not Gentile sinners,
5878	Ma u kon sabi taki, sama á poi wooko anga weiti, fu toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu. Da na biibi di u ya seefi poti a Kelestesi Jesesi namo, meke useefi toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu. Na dati meke wi e taki, sama á poi wooko anga weiti, fu toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu.”	5878	yet knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law but through faith in Jesus Christ, even we believed in Christ Jesus, that we might be justified by faith in Christ, and not by the works of the law, because no flesh will be justified by the works of the law.
5879	Da fa useefi be mu teke biibi a Kelestesi, fu toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu, da dati e soi fa useefi taampu enke fa takuuduman a ini foluku di á de Dyu seefi taampu. A hii toli ya e gei Kelestesi taampu a baka fu takuuduman di e booko weiti! Ma kweti!	5879	But if, while we sought to be justified in Christ, we ourselves also were found sinners, is Christ a servant of sin? Certainly not!
5880	Ma fu daai baka, fu wooko anga weiti taki, da a o poti mi toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu, da na gaan ogii mi du. Bika, da mi komoto na a biibi namo, di poti mi toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu.	5880	For if I build up again those things which I destroyed, I prove myself a law-breaker.
5881	Bika mi ya na dedewan, fu di weiti e soi taki, mi nái teli weiti, da mi mu dede. Ma na ala dati opo pasi gi mi, fu poi fende libi anga Masaa Gadu. Bika mi mokisa dede anga Kelestesi na a koloisi.	5881	For I, through the law, died to the law, that I might live to God.
5882	Da now mi e libi. Ma a ná anga miseefi taanga mi e libi moo, ma na Kelestesi e libi a mi ini solanga mi de a goontapu. Da mi abi biibi na awan kodo Manpikin fu Masaa Gadu fu yeepi mi. Bika a lobi mi te, ne a teke dede enke a paiman, fu pai a mi peesi.	5882	I have been crucified with Christ, and it is no longer I that live, but Christ living in me. That life which I now live in the flesh, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself up for me.
5883	We, na gaan bun ati fasi namo di Masaa Gadu teke luku mi so. Ne a du dati gi mi. A meke Kelestesi teke dede pai a mi peesi. Da dati á mu waka fu soso, taki sama e kon toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu, te den wooko anga weiti. Kweti!	5883	I don't make void the grace of God. For if righteousness is through the law, then Christ died for nothing!

djk_text: Ma biibiwan fu Galasiya pisiwataa! U nái fusutan sani moo, no? Sama kon fende pasi buuya u de so? Bika mi be puu kon a kiin gi u kaba, fa u fende yeepi. Jesesi Kelestesi poti enseefi gi den, den kii a koloisi enke paiman, fu teke dede pai a wi peesi.
eng_text: Foolish Galatians, who has bewitched you not to obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ was openly set forth among you as crucified?

djk_text: We, da u piki mi! Saide meke Masaa Gadu be gi u a Apaiti Jeje fi en? Na di u teke biibi fitoow a Bun Nyunsu fi en di e bali lontu, ofu na di u wooko anga weiti?
eng_text: I just want to learn this from you. Did you receive the Spirit by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?

djk_text: We, na di u be fende a Apaiti Jeje so, meke u be poi bigin a biibi libi. Da u law de fu denki taki, na useefi mu wooko anga sikin, fu toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Are you so foolish? Having begun in the Spirit, are you now completed in the flesh?

djk_text: We, u be teke somen pina anda fu a biibi ya ede kaba, da mi á denki u sa meke dati pasa fu soso. Kweti!
eng_text: Did you suffer so many things in vain, if it is indeed in vain?

djk_text: We, u aliki ya baka. Saide meke Masaa Gadu e wooko anga a Apaiti Jeje fi en a ini u de, fu du foondoo sani? Na di u teke biibi, fitoow a Bun Nyunsu fi en di e bali lontu, ofu na di u wooko anga weiti?
eng_text: He therefore who supplies the Spirit to you, and works miracles among you, does he do it by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?

djk_text: Bika saide Masaa Gadu Buku be sikiifi taki: “Na di Abalaham be teke biibi fitoow Masaa Gadu namo, meke a toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu kaba?”
eng_text: Even as Abraham "believed God, and it was counted to him for righteousness."

djk_text: We, na fu soi taki, na sama di teke fitoow biibi Masaa Gadu enke Abalaham, e teli enke paansu sama fu Abalaham.
eng_text: Know therefore that those who are of faith, the same are children of Abraham.

djk_text: We, Masaa Gadu Buku be sikiifi fu dati a fesi taki: “Ala taa foluku di á de Dyusama sa teke biibi fitoow mi, da den toon bun sama gi mi Masaa Gadu ya.” We, na a Bun Nyunsu a be gi Abalaham seefi a fesi, di a be taigi en taki: “Mi o teke a paansu sama fi yu, fu tyai seigi go doo ala foluku a goontapu.”
eng_text: The Scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, preached the Good News beforehand to Abraham, saying, "In you all the nations will be blessed."

djk_text: We, san u e si tide dei? Ala sama di teke biibi fitoow Masaa Gadu, da na so ai seigi den tuu, enke fa a be seigi Abalaham, di Abalaham be biibi en.
eng_text: So then, those who are of faith are blessed with the faithful Abraham.

djk_text: Bika sama di e wooko anga Dyuweiti, fu toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu, da den dati fende fuuku, fu di Masaa Gadu be taki, den abi fowtu. Bika sama á de fu wooko anga weiti enke fa a mu de. Bika Masaa Gadu Buku sikiifi taki: “Masaa Gadu fuuku ibii sama taki, den abi fowtu, bika den á poi wooko fini fini anga den weiti fu Mosesi.”
eng_text: For as many as are of the works of the law are under a curse. For it is written, "Cursed is everyone who doesn't continue in all things that are written in the book of the law, to do them."

djk_text: Da Masaa Gadu nái meke sama toon bun sama gi en seefi, te den wooko anga weiti. Ma na sama di poti fitoow ne en tapu namo, ai du dati gi. Bika en Buku sikiifi taki: “Wan sama sa toon bun sama gi mi Masaa Gadu ya, te a teke biibi fitoow mi ya namo.”
eng_text: Now that no man is justified by the law before God is evident, for, "The righteous will live by faith."

djk_text: Ma te sama e wooko anga weiti, da na feti du sani anga sikin, fu toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu. Da a nái de taki, na teke biibi fitoow Masaa Gadu. Ma Masaa Gadu Buku sikiifi taki: “Na sama di poi wooko fini fini anga weiti sa fende libi fu tego a Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: The law is not of faith, but, "The man who does them will live by them."

djk_text: Ma Masaa Gadu fuuku ala sama di á poi wooko fini fini anga weiti taki, den mu dede. Wi enke biibiwan á de a ini, winsi fa useefi nái wooko fini fini anga weiti. Bika Kelestesi teke a fuuku a wi peesi. Bika Masaa Gadu Buku sikiifi taki: “Ibii sama di den tei lenge lenge a wan udu ponsu kii, fuuku.”
eng_text: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us. For it is written, "Cursed is everyone who hangs on a tree,"

djk_text: Na so ibii sama, winsi pe a de, ma a de fu Kelestesi, da a sa fende a seigi, di Masaa Gadu be paamisi Abalaham. Soseefi a sa meke en Apaiti Jeje teke peesi a ini a libi fu a sama di teke biibi fitoow so!
eng_text: that the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Christ Jesus; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.

djk_text: We, biibiwan! Masaa Gadu be kuudei anga Abalaham kaba taki, a o gi en bun di a paamisi en. Da a á poi booko ofu kengi mofu moo. Bika luku te sama a goontapu seefi kuudei naki sitampu a lanti, da den á poi booko, ofu kengi dati moo.
eng_text: Brothers, speaking of human terms, though it is only a man's covenant, yet when it has been confirmed, no one makes it void, or adds to it.

djk_text: We, Masaa Gadu be paamisi Abalaham bun anga a paansu sama fi en. Ma luku de! A á be taki: “Den paansu sama fi yu.” Ma a taki: “A paansu sama fi yu.” Dati na wankodo sama namo di de a Kelestesi.
eng_text: Now the promises were spoken to Abraham and to his seed. He doesn't say, "To seeds," as of many, but as of one, "To your seed," which is Christ.

djk_text: Dati wani taki, a be kuudei anga Abalaham taki: “Mi musu gi yu bun di mi paamisi yu.” Namo baka fo ondoo diitenti (430) yali, ne a sende weiti kon, fu sama wooko. Ma dati á poi booko a kuudei fi en anga Abalaham. Bika a nái kengi mofu. Bika a kuudei á be de fu Abalaham mu wooko fosi a gi Abalaham bun di a paamisi en.
eng_text: Now I say this. A covenant confirmed beforehand by God in Christ, the law, which came four hundred thirty years after, does not annul, so as to make the promise of no effect.

djk_text: Bika kon u taki, na wooko anga weiti e meke Masaa Gadu gi sama en gaan bun, sama á be o poi taki, na fu di Masaa Gadu paamisi gaan bun namo. We, da kweti! Bika u si fa a be paamisi Abalaham sani namo, ne a du en gi en. Da na gaan bun ati fasi namo a teke luku en de so.
eng_text: For if the inheritance is of the law, it is no more of promise; but God has granted it to Abraham by promise.

djk_text: Bika saide a poti weiti fu sama wooko? Na fu soi den sama namo taki, a abi leti fu taki, den fiti sitaafu. Weiti kon fu soi efu yu e wooko bun ofu fowtu. Na so sani mu waka doo a yuu ten pe Awan kon doo, di de a Paansu Sama di Masaa Gadu be paamisi, fu kon du bun. Da luku fa weiti waka kon a goontapu. Masaa Gadu sende en anga Engel poti a Mosesi ana, fu gi den Dyusama.
eng_text: What then is the law? It was added because of transgressions, until the seed should come to whom the promise has been made. It was ordained through angels by the hand of a mediator.

djk_text: Da saide sama mu taampu a mindii fu wan wooko so? Na te moo enke tu sama de fu du wan sani, da sama mu de fu luku, efu ai go leti. Ma a kuudei fi en anga Abalaham á be abi dati fanowdu. Bika ne en wawan be mu du wan sani.
eng_text: Now a mediator is not between one, but God is one.

djk_text: We, da ai gei fu wooko anga weiti e sitee anga te Masaa Gadu paamisi sama bun! Ma kweti! Bika efu weiti be poi gi sama libi fu tego, da wooko anga den be o meke sama toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Is the law then against the promises of God? Certainly not! For if there had been a law given which could make alive, most certainly righteousness would have been of the law.

djk_text: Ma kweti! Masaa Gadu Buku sikiifi taki, ala sama na takuuduman. Da na biibi Jesesi Kelestesi sa puu sama a takuudu anga ogii. Da a sama sa fende bun di Masaa Gadu paamisi Abalaham anga a paansu biibisama fi en.
eng_text: But the Scriptures imprisoned all things under sin, that the promise by faith in Jesus Christ might be given to those who believe.

djk_text: Ma fosi biibi Masaa Jesesi be kon doo, da weiti be mu kon wooko a u tapu fosi. Bika dati mu soi wi taki, wi á poi komoto a Masaa Gadu sitaafu. A wooko so doo a ten di Masaa Gadu puu kon a kiin, fa wan fasi de fu komoto na a sitaafu fi en, toon bun sama gi en. Dati na fu teke biibi a Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: But before faith came, we were kept in custody under the law, confined for the faith which should afterwards be revealed.

djk_text: We, da weiti gei wan wookoman di wan gudu dda abi, fu kweki en nyoni pikin te enke a lepi sai fu komoto na a wookoman de ondoo. Na so u tan a weiti ondoo doo na a yuu ten fu u sa teke biibi a Kelestesi, fu toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: So that the law has become our tutor to bring us to Christ, that we might be justified by faith.

djk_text: We, di u sa teke biibi nownow, da weiti á de enke wookoman a u tapu moo, fu soi san fiti anga san fowtu.
eng_text: But now that faith has come, we are no longer under a tutor.

djk_text: Bika di u teke biibi a Kelestesi Jesesi, da u toon pikin fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: For you are all children of God, through faith in Christ Jesus.

djk_text: Bika wi teke a dopu fu Kelestesi. Dati wani taki, u mokisa libi anga Kelestesi.
eng_text: For as many of you as were baptized into Christ have put on Christ.

djk_text: Da mokisa libi anga Kelestesi á de taki, Dyusama kengi anga foluku di á de Dyu. Saafu a katibo seefi á kengi anga fiiman. Kengi á de tu fu uman efu man. Bika Masaa Gadu e si wi ala enke sama fu Kelestesi Jesesi, da a kaba.
eng_text: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free man, there is neither male nor female; for you are all one in Christ Jesus.

djk_text: Da u di de fu Kelestesi, na a paansu sama fu Abalaham. Na u dati abi fu fende den bun di Masaa Gadu be paamisi Abalaham anga en paansu sama.
eng_text: If you are Christ's, then you are Abraham's seed and heirs according to promise.

djk_text: Ma te wan dda gudu, da en gudu na fu toon fi en pikin. Ma te a pikin nyoni, da a dda á poi poti a gudu ne en ana ete. Ma wan dei o doo pe a pikin o de basi fu a gudu namo. Ma nownow, da a pikin anga a saafu fu a dda gei na awan sama di ná abi noti.
eng_text: But I say that so long as the heir is a child, he is no different from a bondservant, though he is lord of all;

djk_text: A dda e poti wookoman na a pikin tapu seefi, fu leli en waka, anga fu luku en. Soseefi wookoman di abi fusutan fu tii a gudu. Ma te a dei doo pe a dda fii taki, en pikin bigi, da ai poti a gudu ne en ana, fu de basi fi en.
eng_text: but is under guardians and stewards until the day appointed by the father.

djk_text: Na so wiseefi be de fosi Masaa Jesesi kon doo. Wi á be doo peesi, meke sowtu a sowtu weiti be e wooko enke basi a u tapu.
eng_text: So we also, when we were children, were held in bondage under the elemental principles of the world.

djk_text: Ma di a yuu fu Masaa Gadu doo, ne a sende en Manpikin kon, meke komoto a mama bee, wan libisama fasi. Namo a saka enseefi meke wan weiti wooko enke gaan basi ne en tapu, enke fa Masaa Gadu wani.
eng_text: But when the fullness of the time came, God sent out his Son, born to a woman, born under the law,

djk_text: Na so a bai wi puu na a katibo fu weiti, meke a kaba wooko enke gaan basi a u tapu. Da u toon pikin fu Masaa Gadu nownow.
eng_text: that he might redeem those who were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of children.

djk_text: We, di u toon pikin fu Masaa Gadu kaba, ne a sende a seefi Apaiti Jeje di de a ini en Manpikin kon a ini wi tu. Da dati gi wi kaakiti, fu bali kai Masaa Gadu taki: “Abba, wi lobi Tata.”
eng_text: And because you are children, God sent out the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, "Abba, Father!"

djk_text: Da u sa dini en, sondee fu den weiti wooko enke gaan basi a u tapu. Bika sama di toon pikin fi en, na fu a gi bun di a abi, fu gi pikin.
eng_text: So you are no longer a bondservant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.

djk_text: Ma di u á be leli sabi Masaa Gadu ete, da u be abi falisi sani e dini enke na Gadu. Den be e wooko enke gaan basi a u tapu.
eng_text: However at that time, not knowing God, you were in bondage to those who by nature are not gods.

djk_text: Ma yu kon leli sabi Masaa Gadu now. Fu taki leti, ne en kon sabi yu enke sama fi en. Da a ná sani fu daai go teke a haw goontapu fasi baka, fu meke weiti di á doo peesi wooko a i tapu baka. Bika den á poi meke i kon de bun gi Masaa Gadu. Kweti!
eng_text: But now that you have come to know God, or rather to be known by God, why do you turn back again to the weak and miserable elemental principles, to which you desire to be in bondage all over again?

djk_text: Ma a tyali de! Bika u bigin baka fu oli a Dyu kina dei. Soseefi ibii fosi dei fu mun anga apaiti taa ten fu yali. Soseefi son yali di de apaiti gi Dyusama.
eng_text: You observe days, months, seasons, and years.

djk_text: We, mi sidon anga pakisei fu u ya. Bika a gei na fu soso mi be simpan, du a hii wooko di mi be du a u mindii anda.
eng_text: I am afraid for you, that I might have wasted my labor for you.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Gaantangi, mi e begi u! U waka enke mi. Komoto na a katibo, pe weiti e wooko enke gaan basi a sama tapu. Bika mi enke Dyu komoto a dati kon tan enke u di á de Dyu de. Da luku fa u be diki mi, tyai a tapu a fosi leisi di mi be kon de. U be libi bun anga mi ala fasi.
eng_text: I beg you, brothers, become as I am, for I also have become as you are. You did me no wrong,

djk_text: Ma u be si taki, na siki be tyai mi kon de, di mi be gi u a Bun Nyunsu.
eng_text: but you know that because of weakness of the flesh I preached the Good News to you the first time.

djk_text: Ma fa mi á be kaba de gusontu fasi, da a siki fu mi be musu tan ogii gi u, fu oli mi enke seekitiman. Da u be sa wai fesi gi mi. Ma kweti! U be puu mi a boto anga piisii seefi, te moo so á be de. Winsi na wan Engel seefi be doo de, u á be o libi bun anga en moo so. Bika u be libi anga mi enke mi na Kelestesi Jesesi seefi.
eng_text: That which was a temptation to you in my flesh, you didn't despise nor reject; but you received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.

djk_text: We, da u feegete fa u be taki, u e poolo fu mi ede? U sabi ete fa u be piisii, di mi be gi u a Bun Nyunsu? A be switi gi u te, u ain seefi u be sa diki poti gi mi. Tuutuu!
eng_text: What was the blessing you enjoyed? For I testify to you that, if possible, you would have plucked out your eyes and given them to me.

djk_text: Ma fa u daai e wooko taa fasi anga mi, enke u toon feyanti so? Na fu di mi e soi u, fa Masaa Gadu bosikopu de tuutuu?
eng_text: So then, have I become your enemy by telling you the truth?

djk_text: We, sama de anda e leli u falisi bosikopu. Den e meke enke den abi u fanowdu. Ma a ná tuu! Bika san den abi a den denki á bun! Den wani u kaba aliki mi anga san mi e leli u. Den wani wini u poti a den se. Da u sa aliki den anga den falisi leli fu den.
eng_text: They zealously seek you in no good way. No, they desire to alienate you, that you may seek them.

djk_text: We, a ná ogii fu sama kon libi soi, fa yu de fanowdu gi en, fu teke en taki. Ma a taki mu de wan bunbun sani, fu yeepi yu. Na sowan fasi mi dati e wooko anga u anda. Ma a ná te mi de a u mindii de namo.
eng_text: But it is always good to be zealous in a good cause, and not only when I am present with you.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Te mi pakisei u anda, da mi e fii en dipi a mi ati, enke fa bee e nyan mama, fi en pikin. Da a fii ya sa tan, te enke mi yee taki, u poti yesi e teke den leli fu Kelestesi, fu wooko.
eng_text: My little children, of whom I am again in travail until Christ is formed in you--

djk_text: We, mi angii ya, fu doo u anda baka, fu taigi u den sani ya fesi fesi. Da mi sa taki wan moo switi mati fasi anga u. Bika na booko mi e booko ede nownow tuutuu, fu u ede.
eng_text: but I could wish to be present with you now, and to change my tone, for I am perplexed about you.

djk_text: Bika son fu u wani daai go teke den weiti poti wooko enke gaan basi a u tapu baka. Ma luku wan toli di sikiifi, a ini den seefi weiti buku de.
eng_text: Tell me, you that desire to be under the law, don't you listen to the law?

djk_text: A sikiifi taki Abalaham be abi tu manpikin. Ibiiwan abi en mma. Wan fu den mma na Abalaham tuutuu uman. Dati á be de saafu a katibo, meke en paansu pikin seefi á de saafu. A taa mma na be saafu a katibo, meke en paansu pikin na be saafu.
eng_text: For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the handmaid, and one by the free woman.

djk_text: A manpikin fu a saafu uman á meke foondoo fasi. Ma di fu a fii uman dati meke foondoo fasi. Bika na san Masaa Gadu be paamisi Abalaham.
eng_text: However, the son by the handmaid was born according to the flesh, but the son by the free woman was born through promise.

djk_text: A toli ya dipi! Bika a gei den tu sowtu kuudei di Masaa Gadu meke anga libisama. A fosiwan dati, a meke anga Mosesi a Sinai Mongo. Dati na fu weiti wooko enke gaan basi a sama tapu. Da a gei Aakali enke saafu mma di e meke paansu di de saafu, a katibo.
eng_text: These things contain an allegory, for these are two covenants. One is from Mount Sinai, bearing children to bondage, which is Hagar.

djk_text: Sinai Mongo pe a kuudei ya meke, dati de na Alabiya Kondee. Da nownow seefi, na ape paansu fu a saafu uman e tan. A peesi de anga Jelusalem Foto fu goontapu ya taampu a seefi fasi anga weiti, fu wooko enke gaan basi a sama tapu. Da den gei Aakali, enke saafu mma di e meke paansu di de saafu a katibo.
eng_text: For this Hagar is Mount Sinai in Arabia, and answers to the Jerusalem that exists now, for she is in bondage with her children.

djk_text: Ma Jelusalem Foto fu tapu, gei a mma di á de saafu a katibo. Bika wi di o doo anda na biibisama di komoto na a katibo fu weiti.
eng_text: But the Jerusalem that is above is free, which is the mother of us all.

djk_text: Masaa Gadu Buku sikiifi fu dati taki: “Dyombo piisii, yu enke uman di fosi á meke pikin! Bika yu á be sabi bee nyan fu pikin. Ma dyonson yu paansu sama o ipi moo a uman, di fosi be meke pikin anga a man.”
eng_text: For it is written, "Rejoice, you barren who don't bear. Break forth and shout, you that don't travail. For more are the children of the desolate than of her who has a husband."

djk_text: We, biibiwan! Wi na a paansu pikin di Masaa Gadu be meke en Apaiti Jeje paamisi Abalaham, na a fasi fu Isaki.
eng_text: Now we, brothers, as Isaac was, are children of promise.

djk_text: Ma san Masaa Gadu Buku sikiifi ete? A manpikin di á meke foondoo fasi, lon du ogii anga di a Apaiti Jeje fu Masaa Gadu meke foondoo fasi. Na dati e pasa nownow tu.
eng_text: But as then, he who was born according to the flesh persecuted him who was born according to the Spirit, so also it is now.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Gadu Buku sikiifi taki: “Towe a mma saafu anga en manpikin di a meke! Bika dati á meke fu fende a gudu fu a dda. A gudu de, na fu a manpikin fu a mma di á de saafu.”
eng_text: However what does the Scripture say? "Throw out the handmaid and her son, for the son of the handmaid will not inherit with the son of the free woman."

djk_text: Biibiwan! Ala san pasa a fositen de mu soi fa wi á de paansu sama fu a mama saafu. Wi na paansu sama fu a fii mama.
eng_text: So then, brothers, we are not children of a handmaid, but of the free woman.

djk_text: We, Kelestesi puu wi a katibo fu weiti tuu, meke den á poi wooko enke gaan basi a u tapu moo. Da meke u feti fu tan libi sondee u de saafu a katibo fu den.
eng_text: Stand firm therefore in the liberty by which Christ has made us free, and don't be entangled again with a yoke of bondage.

djk_text: We, mi Pawlesi ya e wasikoi biibisama di sa komoto go koti a maiki a manpeesi taki, na fu toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu. Yu o lasi a hii yeepi di Kelestesi tyai, fu meke i toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Behold, I, Paul, tell you that if you receive circumcision, Christ will profit you nothing.

djk_text: Wan toon moo, mi e wasikoi! Biibisama di komoto go koti a maiki a manpeesi taki, na fu toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu: “Luku ya!” Bakadati, da i mu wooko anga ala den weiti tu, sondee wan enkii fowtu.
eng_text: Yes, I testify again to every man who receives circumcision, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.

djk_text: Da i naki paati anga Kelestesi tu. Bika yu teke fu wooko anga weiti, fu toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu. Da yu daai baka gi fa Masaa Gadu poti nownow, fu teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku sama, fu meke a toon bun sama gi enseefi.
eng_text: You are alienated from Christ, you who desire to be justified by the law. You have fallen away from grace.

djk_text: Bika wi dati na a Apaiti Jeje fu Masaa Gadu piki u, san fu biibi. A de so taki, na Masaa Gadu seefi e meke u toon bun sama gi enseefi. Da u e luku fu fende dati seefi na a dei di u o doo ne en fesi.
eng_text: For we, through the Spirit, by faith wait for the hope of righteousness.

djk_text: Bika wi biibiwan mokisa libi anga Kelestesi Jesesi, meke Masaa Gadu nái si kengi fu biibisama di koti maiki a manpeesi, ofu den di á koti maiki. Kweti! Bika na sama di teke biibi, poti fitoow a Kelestesi namo, na dati e poi dini Masaa Gadu, fu lobi taawan.
eng_text: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision amounts to anything, nor uncircumcision, but faith working through love.

djk_text: We, u be e waka bunbun kaba anga a Bun Nyunsu. Ma sama kon daai u ede ape, meke u nái fusutan a tuutuu fasi fi en moo?
eng_text: You were running well! Who interfered with you that you should not obey the truth?

djk_text: A ná Masaa Gadu sende a sama de fu kon buuya u, puu na a leti pasi pe a be teke u poti toon sama fi enseefi kaba! Kweti!
eng_text: This persuasion is not from him who calls you.

djk_text: Da u á mu si a falisi leli enke na wan pikin sani. Bika ai wooko enke a nongo di koti taki, wan pikintoin sowda taanga sai, fu faandi a hii bolon.
eng_text: A little yeast grows through the whole lump.

djk_text: We, mi anga u de, na sama fu Masaa makandii. Da mi sabi taki, u e denki enke mi, fu fa sama e toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu. Ma den di e kon buuya u de, da Masaa Gadu musu sitaafu den, winsi sama a den.
eng_text: I have confidence toward you in the Lord that you will think no other way. But he who troubles you will bear his judgment, whoever he is.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Da fa sama sa kon lei gi mi de taki, mi e leli sama fu koti a maiki a manpeesi, fu toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu? Bika, da Dyusama á be o lon du ogii anga mi moo. A be o switi gi den taki, mi e puu sama na a biibi di taki, na Kelestesi dede a koloisi enke paiman, fu meke sama toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: But I, brothers, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still persecuted? Then the stumbling block of the cross has been removed.

djk_text: We, den sama di wani buuya u so, a gei den lobi koti a maiki a manpeesi tumisi! Ma saide na a buba mofu fu a manpeesi namo den e koti, mi á sabi. Bika den be sa koti a hii manpeesi puu wanten.
eng_text: I wish that those who disturb you would cut themselves off.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Masaa Gadu kai u kon toon sama fi enseefi, ne a puu u tuutuu na a katibo fu weiti. Ma fu komoto na a katibo libi fu weiti á wani taki, pasi opo fu waka du takuu losutu di fuu wi ati libisama fasi. Kweti! Ma na fu libi seefi soi taawan taki, u lobi den.
eng_text: For you, brothers, were called for freedom. Only don't use your freedom for gain to the flesh, but through love be servants to one another.

djk_text: Bika ala san Masaa Gadu weiti wani, dati e kai a wankodo weiti namo: “Lobi taawan enke fa i lobi iseefi.”
eng_text: For the whole law is fulfilled in one word, in this: "You shall love your neighbor as yourself."

djk_text: Ma efu na ogii u e du anga taawan, enke takuu meti fu nyan taawan kii, da u luku bun! Bika u sa kaba anga useefi a soso de. U sa booko a hii kulu biibiwan.
eng_text: But if you bite and devour one another, be careful that you don't consume one another.

djk_text: San mi wani taigi u na disi: U waka naamo enke fa a Apaiti Jeje wani. Ma noiti waka du takuu losutu di fuu wi ati libisama fasi.
eng_text: But I say, walk by the Spirit, and you won't fulfill the lust of the flesh.

djk_text: Bika takuu losutu fuu wi ati libisama fasi. Da den nái fiti anga san a Apaiti Jeje wani. Soseefi san Masaa Gadu Apaiti Jeje wani nái fiti anga den takuu losutu di fuu wi ati libisama fasi. Den e feti fu anga denseefi, a ini wi. Na so meke sama sa poti fu du wan sani, a á poi du en.
eng_text: For the flesh lusts against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; and these are contrary to one another, that you may not do the things that you desire.

djk_text: Ma te wi e du naamo san a Apaiti Jeje wani, da weiti ná abi fu wooko enke basi a u tapu, fu katibo u.
eng_text: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.

djk_text: Bika takuu losutu di fuu wi ati libisama fasi, e de kiin fu si a wan sama libi: Motyo fasi Poli denki Wakawaka libi
eng_text: Now the works of the flesh are obvious, which are: adultery, sexual immorality, uncleanness, lustfulness,

djk_text: Dini falisi gadu Obiya ofu tofuu fasi, fu fuuku taawan Feyanti fasi Kwali Bigi ain fu sama sani Kaakeli feti anga taawan Meke paitei, fu sitee anga taawan Suku wini fi i wawan namo Go teke kulu, fu dini falisi sani
eng_text: idolatry, sorcery, hatred, strife, jealousies, outbursts of anger, rivalries, divisions, heresies,

djk_text: Dyalusu fu taawan sani Diingi duungu Teke gaan duungu kulu, waka wooko duunguman fasi, a kondee ganda. Somen taa sowtu takuu losutu de ete seefi. Mi be bali u de kaba taki, sama di e du den sani ya, ná o poi fende a bun di de a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: envyings, murders, drunkenness, orgies, and things like these; of which I forewarn you, even as I also forewarned you, that those who practice such things will not inherit the Kingdom of God.

djk_text: Ma te a Apaiti Jeje fu Masaa Gadu e tii i libi, da na den sani ya sama o si a yu: Yu o lobi taawan Yu o abi tuutuu piisii Yu o abi switi fasi Yu o abi langa pasensi Yu go e du bun gi taawan Yu o abi fitoow fasi.
eng_text: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,

djk_text: Yu o abi saka fasi Yu o go e denki taawan nowtu Yu o poi fu dwengi iseefi oli bun fasi. Weiti á de fu sitaafu sama di e du san a Apaiti Jeje wani so. Kweti!
eng_text: gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.

djk_text: Bika sama di de fu Kelestesi Jesesi e kaba anga takuu losutu di fuu sama ati, libisama fasi. Bika di den sipikii a Kelestesi kii a koloisi enke paiman, da denseefi mokisa dede anga en de. Meke den á de a goontapu ya moo, fu du ogii.
eng_text: Those who belong to Christ have crucified the flesh with its passions and lusts.

djk_text: We, efu a Apaiti Jeje gi wi wan hii nyun libi so, da meke u tan waka enke fa a wani.
eng_text: If we live by the Spirit, let's also walk by the Spirit.

djk_text: Ma u á mu meke enke u bigi pasa taawan fu dati. U á mu pee enke u letiopu moo taawan. Soseefi u á mu abi bigi ain a taawan sani.
eng_text: Let's not become conceited, provoking one another, and envying one another.

djk_text: We, biibiwan di e libi enke fa a Apaiti Jeje wani, kande u kisi wan taa biibiwan di misi waka. Da toku so, teke saafi saka fasi, yeepi en kon taampu baka. Bika tesi sa kon a yuseefi pasi tu.
eng_text: Brothers, even if a man is caught in some fault, you who are spiritual must restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness; looking to yourself so that you also aren't tempted.

djk_text: Da te taawan de a fuka, da teke tyali ati fasi yeepi en. Da u e du san Kelestesi wani de.
eng_text: Bear one another's burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.

djk_text: Bika efi i e pee bigi fi i seefi, sondee taki i de wan sani, da na koli yu e koli iseefi!
eng_text: For if a man thinks himself to be something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.

djk_text: Yu wooko na fu keli i seefi luku, fa yu e wooko anga yu biibi. Da efu yu si taki, yu e waka leti, da i sa poolo anga iseefi. Ma a ná fu go maiki iseefi anga taawan taki, i bun moo den. Kweti!
eng_text: But let each man test his own work, and then he will take pride in himself and not in his neighbor.

djk_text: Bika ibiiwan sa gi faantiwowtu fi en seefi a Masaa Gadu fesi.
eng_text: For each man will bear his own burden.

djk_text: We, meke den sama di e teke leli fu wan leliman, di e leli den sani fu Masaa Gadu, solugu en na ala fasi.
eng_text: But let him who is taught in the word share all good things with him who teaches.

djk_text: Ma kaba waka na a fasi di iseefi e denki. Yu ná o poi sipowtu anga Masaa Gadu sowan fasi. Bika a ná fu soso nongo koti taki, na san i paandi o goo kon lepi gi iseefi fu nyan.
eng_text: Don't be deceived. God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.

djk_text: Bika sama di e libi anga takuu losutu di fuu en ati libisama fasi, da Masaa Gadu o kuutu en, fu gi sitaafu tego. Ma sama di libi enke fa a Apaiti Jeje wani, da Masaa Gadu o gi en libi tego makandii anga enseefi.
eng_text: For he who sows to his own flesh will from the flesh reap corruption. But he who sows to the Spirit will from the Spirit reap eternal life.

djk_text: Da noiti weli fu libi na a fasi di e piisii Masaa Gadu. Bika efu wi á lasi ati, da te en yuu di a wani doo, da a o gi wi bun, fu dati.
eng_text: Let us not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season, if we don't give up.

djk_text: We, da meke u á daai daai ibii yuu, te u fende wan okasi fu du bun gi taawan. Feti yeepi taawan. Moomoo, yeepi taa biibiwan enke useefi di de sama fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: So then, as we have opportunity, let's do what is good toward all men, and especially toward those who are of the household of the faith.

djk_text: We, luku ya! Miseefi ana oli a sikiifi tiki now, fu sikiifi a pisi fu a biifi ya. Mi e sikiifi en moo bigi seefi.
eng_text: See with what large letters I write to you with my own hand.

djk_text: Na falisi leliman e leli taki, maiki mu koti a manpeesi, fu toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu. Bika den e suku fu Dyusama oli den bun. Bika den e feele enke Dyusama o lon du ogii anga den, efu den leli sama taki, na di Kelestesi dede a koloisi.
eng_text: As many as desire to look good in the flesh, they compel you to be circumcised; only that they may not be persecuted for the cross of Christ.

djk_text: Bika, denseefi nái libi enke fa den weiti taki. Ma den wani namo, fu fende u koti a maiki a u manpeesi, fu Dyusama sa gafa den.
eng_text: For even they who receive circumcision don't keep the law themselves, but they desire to have you circumcised, that they may boast in your flesh.

djk_text: Ma mi dati noiti o suku a sowtu gafa de! Mi o tan bali a nyunsu, fa wi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi dede a koloisi enke a paiman, fu puu wi a takuudu anga ogii. Da fa den nái teli Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi fu wan sani, na so miseefi nái teli san denseefi e teli fu sani tu. Den ná o poi meke mi toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu. Kweti!
eng_text: But far be it from me to boast, except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu seefi nái teli sama fu bigi, efu a koti a maiki a manpeesi, ofu den á koti a maiki a manpeesi. Ma na sama di e libi a hii nyun sowtu libi namo ai teli.
eng_text: For in Christ Jesus neither is circumcision anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creation.

djk_text: Da mi e begi Masaa Gadu, fu meke den sama di abi a nyun libi ya ati de switi. Soseefi, meke a teke tyali ati fasi luku den. Na so mi e begi, gi a hii Islayeli foluku fu Masaa Gadu tu.
eng_text: As many as walk by this rule, peace and mercy be on them, and on God's Israel.

djk_text: We, mi e bali ala sama di e weli mi ede anda anga a toli di mi sikiifi na a biifi ya. U kaba muliki mi so! Bika fa mi de fu Jesesi, da soo maiki fu dati e soi a mi sikin buba.
eng_text: From now on, let no one cause me any trouble, for I bear the marks of the Lord Jesus branded on my body.

djk_text: Da mi e begi wi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi, fu teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku u de. Meke u jeje libi sa taampu moo anga moo taanga de. Amen, na so de!
eng_text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. Amen.

djk_text: Mi Pawlesi e sikiifi a biifi ya gi u biibiwan a Efese Foto. Soseefi sama di Masaa Gadu teke poti apaiti fasi, ne u biibi doo. Bika na Masaa Gadu wani, ne a poti mi toon apaiti bosikopuman fu Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, to the saints who are at Ephesus, and the faithful in Christ Jesus:

djk_text: Da meke u Tata, Masaa Gadu anga Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku u de. Soseefi, meke u ati de switi.
eng_text: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

djk_text: We, gaantangi fu a Gadu anga Tata fu wi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi! A gi u ala sowtu jeje seigi, fu teke wooko go doo a hii pisi fu tapu anda seefi. Bika u mokisa libi anga Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi.
eng_text: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in Christ;

djk_text: Langa ten fosi a be meke goontapu seefi, ne a be fiti poti kaba fu teke u toon sama fi enseefi taki, u sa mokisa libi anga Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi. Da dati sa meke a teke wi poti apaiti fasi. Soseefi u sa poi taampu sondee kaagi ne en fesi.
eng_text: even as he chose us in him before the foundation of the world, that we would be holy and without blemish before him in love;

djk_text: Na a gaan lobi fi en meke a sende Jesesi Kelestesi kon teke dede pai a wi peesi, meke u sa toon pikin fi en. Tuutuu, a hii sani ya piisii Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: having predestined us for adoption as children through Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his desire,

djk_text: Da meke u bali gafa en, fu a gaan dyendee di a teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku wi. Tuutuu, a wooko switi anga wi. A meke en wankodo lobi Manpikin mokisa libi anga ibiiwan fu wi.
eng_text: to the praise of the glory of his grace, by which he freely bestowed favor on us in the Beloved,

djk_text: A meke en wankodo lobi Manpikin mokisa libi anga ibiiwan fu wi, fu puu wi a takuudu anga ogii. Bika di a teke a dede, ne en buulu lon pai fu wi takuudu anga ogii, meke u fende paadon. Da a nái teli a ten moo di u be taanga yesi fu teke en taki. Tuutuu, a gaan bun ati fasi di a teke luku wi ya, bigi pasa maiki.
eng_text: in whom we have our redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of his grace,

djk_text: Da ai teke gaan bun ati fasi namo e luku wi, moo anga moo ete. Tuutuu, a abi gaan koni fu wooko leti fasi a ini ala san ai du.
eng_text: which he made to abound toward us in all wisdom and prudence,

djk_text: Na so wan gaan koni fasi a wooko, fu du a hii wooko di a be fiti poti a fesi. Na sani di noiti a fesi sama be sabi wanten, meke a be de wan kibii toli hii fositen. Ne na nownow fosi a poti fu tyai en kon a kiin, di Kelestesi kon. A piisii Masaa Gadu seefi seefi, fu bolotyasi a hii sani ya so.
eng_text: making known to us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he purposed in him

djk_text: A poti ala a sani de fu pasa, te en yuu doo. Da a de taki, wansi wan sani de a goontapu ofu tapu anda seefi. Kelestesi e wooko enke basi a tapu fu ala san Masaa Gadu meke so.
eng_text: to an administration of the fullness of the times, to sum up all things in Christ, the things in the heavens, and the things on the earth, in him;

djk_text: Soseefi, da ala san a poti a Kelestesi ana toon fu wiseefi tu. Bika u mokisa libi anga en. Na langa ten a fesi Masaa Gadu be fiti poti so, fosi a be meke goontapu seefi. Namo, ne a wooko so nownow tuu.
eng_text: in whom also we were assigned an inheritance, having been foreordained according to the purpose of him who works all things after the counsel of his will;
