djk_text: We, da wi enke Dyusama di teke biibi ya be sidon langa ten e luku fu fende san be paamisi fu fa a Kelestesi o kon. Namo a doo a wi mindii, te wooko foondoo fasi tuu. A du ala san be paamisi fi en, fu ibii taa foluku sa luku dati, fu gafa a dyendee sani fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: to the end that we should be to the praise of his glory, we who had before hoped in Christ:

djk_text: We, da taa foluku sama de! Sabi taki, yuseefi di mokisa libi anga Kelestesi, da san Masaa Gadu be paamisi, e toon fi yu tu. Dati na ala san a poti a Kelestesi ana. Bika yu teke biibi na a tuutuu bosikopu fu Masaa Gadu, di de a Bun Nyunsu di i yee. Namo, ne a gi yu en Apaiti Jeje enke wan sitampu di naki a yu.
eng_text: in whom you also, having heard the word of the truth, the Good News of your salvation--in whom, having also believed, you were sealed with the Holy Spirit of promise,

djk_text: A Apaiti Jeje ya na wan maiki fu soi wi taki, u sa fende ala den gaan bun di Masaa Gadu paamisi fu gi den sama fi en. Soseefi a Jeje ya puu wi na a katibo fu ibii sani di be e wooko enke basi a u tapu. Da a foondoo fasi fa Masaa Gadu wooko ya fiti fu bali gafa en.
eng_text: who is a pledge of our inheritance, to the redemption of God's own possession, to the praise of his glory.

djk_text: We, mi yee dise fa u taa foluku sama anda teke biibi poti fitoow a wi Masaa Jesesi. Soseefi u kon abi lobi fu ala sama di Masaa Gadu teke poti apaiti fasi de.
eng_text: For this cause I also, having heard of the faith in the Lord Jesus which is among you, and the love which you have toward all the saints,

djk_text: Mi e gi Masaa Gadu daa naamo, fu u ede ala yuu mi e begi. Mi e membee u a ini begi tu.
eng_text: don't cease to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers,

djk_text: We, a Masaa Gadu ya na di fu wi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi. Soseefi a Tata fu wi a tapu di wooko gaan foondoo fasi anga en kaakiti, fu yeepi wi. Mi e begi en, fu a Apaiti Jeje fi en gi u apaiti koni fu wooko leti. Soseefi, fu fusutan enseefi doo san a du gi wi. Da u sa poi waka moo anga moo enke fa a wani.
eng_text: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give to you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him;

djk_text: Da wi di a kai kon toon fi enseefi ain sa moo kiin. Da u ati o opo fu sabi a foondoo fasi di u mu luku en, fu tyai wi. Soseefi fa san a poti fu gi sama fi en bakaten foondoo tuutuu.
eng_text: having the eyes of your hearts enlightened, that you may know what is the hope of his calling, and what are the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,

djk_text: Soseefi, fa a makiti di a abi bigi pasa maiki, fu yeepi sama di teke biibi. A makiti fi en ya bigi!
eng_text: and what is the exceeding greatness of his power toward us who believe, according to that working of the strength of his might

djk_text: Na dati a be teke weki Kelestesi a dede kon a libi ya baka. Soseefi a opo en tyai go poti na a gaan hei peesi ne en se a tapu anda.
eng_text: which he worked in Christ, when he raised him from the dead, and made him to sit at his right hand in the heavenly places,

djk_text: Namo a sidon a Masaa Gadu se anda, a tapu fu ala basi di e tii taawan. Makiti di hei ofu lagi moo taawan. Soseefi taangawan di de a taawan tapu anga ala gaan bigiman di sidon a tapu. Da nen á de fu kai te, da a sa hei doo a nen di a abi fu wooko. Na so a sa tan fu tego seefi.
eng_text: far above all rule, and authority, and power, and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this age, but also in that which is to come.

djk_text: Na Masaa Gadu seefi poti ala sani ne en ondoo so. Ne a opo en poti a tapu fu ala sani. Ne a poti en enke edeman fu a kulu biibiwan fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: He put all things in subjection under his feet, and gave him to be head over all things for the assembly,

djk_text: A kulu sama ya, na a sikin fi en. Da en na a edeman fu dati. Ma ede anga sikin á poi wooko apaiti fu denseefi. Den e seeka denseefi fu de enke fa Masaa Gadu wani. Ma ne en tyai ala sani kon de bun gi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: which is his body, the fullness of him who fills all in all.

djk_text: We, yu á be e koti anga Masaa Gadu. Da a libi fi en á be de a yu. Da yu be e teli fu dedewan kaba. Bika yu á be e teke en taki. Ma yu be de anga takuudu anga ogii.
eng_text: You were made alive when you were dead in transgressions and sins,

djk_text: U be e waka enke den sama fu a goontapu ya, di á sabi Masaa Gadu e waka. U be e poti useefi a ondoo fu a gaan basi fu takuu jeje di lontu goontapu, e tii sama di á teke biibi, fu meke den e taanga yesi gi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: in which you once walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit who now works in the children of disobedience;

djk_text: Ma wi enke Dyusama be tan so fosi u be teke biibi tu. Wi be de enke sama di e taanga yesi gi Masaa Gadu tu. U be e waka a ini ala sowtu takuu losutu di fuu wi ati libisama fasi. Soseefi ala sowtu takuu pakisei. Na so u be gwenti be e meke Masaa Gadu ati boon, fu sitaafu enke ibii taawan di e du den sani ya ete.
eng_text: among whom we also all once lived in the lust of our flesh, doing the desires of the flesh and of the mind, and were by nature children of wrath, even as the rest.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Gadu abi gaan tyali ati fasi fu wi. Ne i si a teke dati wooko so switi anga wi, bika a lobi wi tuutuu.
eng_text: But God, being rich in mercy, for his great love with which he loved us,

djk_text: Ma wi dati á be e koti anga Masaa Gadu di e gi libi, meke libi á be de gi wi moo. Da na wan sowtu dede u be dede ape kaba. Bika u á be e teke en taki, fu du san ai soi wi. Ma fu di u mokisa libi anga Kelestesi, ne Masaa Gadu gi wi a sowtu libi fi en, baka di a dede weki baka. Tuutuu, na so Masaa Gadu teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku yu de tu. Soseefi, a tyai yeepi meke yu komoto a takuudu anga ogii.
eng_text: even when we were dead through our trespasses, made us alive together with Christ (by grace you have been saved),

djk_text: Bika na di u mokisa libi anga Kelestesi Jesesi, meke ala san de fi en toon fu wi tu. Fa a dede weki kon a libi ya baka, da wiseefi dede weki kon a libi ya so te! Fa a opo go sidon a Masaa Gadu se anda, fu wooko anga ala Masaa Gadu makiti, da wiseefi opo go sidon anga en a Masaa Gadu se anda tu.
eng_text: and raised us up with him, and made us to sit with him in the heavenly places in Christ Jesus,

djk_text: Da winsi on ten fu goontapu, ibiiwan sa si a wi fa Masaa Gadu foondoo bigi pasa maiki. Sama á de fu fusutan fa a bigi so, te u luku fa a du gaan bun gi wi di a sende Kelestesi Jesesi kon.
eng_text: that in the ages to come he might show the exceeding riches of his grace in kindness toward us in Christ Jesus;

djk_text: Ma fa mi be taki kaba, da na gaan bun ati fasi a teke luku wi, fu di u biibi namo. Ne a puu wi a takuudu anga ogii. Ma u seefi á wooko fu dati. Kweti! Ne enseefi teke a gaan bun de langa gi u.
eng_text: for by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God,

djk_text: Bika a á wani wan enkii sama poi gafa taki, enseefi wooko anga weiti fu toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: not of works, that no one would boast.

djk_text: Bika enke fa u libi kon tan nownow, da ne en teke u poti so, fu di u mokisa libi anga Kelestesi Jesesi namo. Ne u tan hii nyun sowtu fasi gi en, fu poi du den bun di a be fiti poti langa ten a fesi fu wi yeepi taawan.
eng_text: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.

djk_text: Ma pakisei fa Dyusama e si yu, enke taa foluku. Den taki, yu á de fu Masaa Gadu enke den. Soseefi yu á koti maiki a manpeesi enke den. We, ala dati na sani fu du libisama fasi anga sikin namo.
eng_text: Therefore remember that once you, the Gentiles in the flesh, who are called "uncircumcision" by that which is called "circumcision," (in the flesh, made by hands);

djk_text: Da na a ten di yu be e libi sondee Kelestesi, ne yu á be de foluku fu Masaa Gadu enke den tuu. Yu be de a doose fu Masaa Gadu foluku. Da san a be kuudei anga sama fi en á be de gi yu. Yu á be abi fu luku fu fende sani ne en bakaten tu. Bika yu á be e koti anga Masaa Gadu fu sabi en tu.
eng_text: that you were at that time separate from Christ, alienated from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of the promise, having no hope and without God in the world.

djk_text: Ma nownow, da u mokisa libi anga Kelestesi Jesesi, ne u diipi kon koosube fu Masaa Gadu. Bika Kelestesi dede meke en buulu lon pai fi yu takuudu anga ogii.
eng_text: But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far off are made near in the blood of Christ.

djk_text: Bika na Kelestesi de fu tyai yu enke taa foluku anga wi enke Dyu ati kon de switi makandii. Da u sa kaba si useefi enke feyanti. Da u sa mosoo toon wan famii. Da u ná o buuse useefi moo. Bika wi Dyuweiti na a sani di be kaasi abaa a wi mindii, fu tyai paati. Ma a puu ala dati a wi mindii.
eng_text: For he is our peace, who made both one, and broke down the middle wall of partition,

djk_text: Anga enseefi sikin a pai, fu meke wan hii nyun sowtu sama di mokisa kon makandii fu Dyu anga taa foluku. Bika a puu a hii fasi fu wooko anga Dyuweiti. Da wi ati sa kon de switi makandii fu kaba buuse useefi.
eng_text: having abolished in the flesh the hostility, the law of commandments contained in ordinances, that he might create in himself one new man of the two, making peace;

djk_text: Bika a dede fi en na a koloisi, puu den weiti di be e paati wi. Ne a opo pasi meke wi tu sowtu sama ya makandii sa go doo Masaa Gadu enke a wan seefi sowtu sama fi en.
eng_text: and might reconcile them both in one body to God through the cross, having killed the hostility thereby.

djk_text: Na so a kon tyai a switi bosikopu gi biibiwan fu taa foluku di be de faawe fu Masaa Gadu. Soseefi gi biibi Dyu di be de koosube fi en kaba.
eng_text: He came and preached peace to you who were far off and to those who were near.

djk_text: Bika a puu wi ala a takuudu anga ogii, fu poi diipi makandii go doo Masaa Gadu, fu di a Apaiti Jeje fi en de a ini wi ala.
eng_text: For through him we both have our access in one Spirit to the Father.

djk_text: We, da yu enke taa foluku ape á de a doose fu Masaa Gadu foluku moo. Soseefi yu á de enke taa kondee sama gi en moo. Ma si yuseefi now enke sama di a teke poti apaiti fasi, fu poi tan ne en kondee a tapu anda. Yu na tyuku tyuku famii fi en, di de a ini en osu tu.
eng_text: So then you are no longer strangers and foreigners, but you are fellow citizens with the saints, and of the household of God,

djk_text: Bika a hii wooko fi en ya fondamenti sete enke ai meke wan osu. Ne a poti apaiti bosikopuman anga apaiti takiman na a wooko fu sete dati. Ma a siton futu fu a hii osu ya seefi na Kelestesi Jesesi.
eng_text: being built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Christ Jesus himself being the chief cornerstone;

djk_text: Bika ne en mokisa a kulu fu biibiwan toon wan hii taanga osu sama. Da ai meke ai goo bigi naamo toon wan gaan apaiti tanpeesi gi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: in whom the whole building, fitted together, grows into a holy temple in the Lord;

djk_text: Da yu de seefi de enke Masaa Gadu tanpeesi pe en Apaiti Jeje e tan tu. Na so u mokisa libi anga Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: in whom you also are built together for a habitation of God in the Spirit.

djk_text: We, mi wooko fu dini Kelestesi Jesesi, na fu tyai a bosikopu de kon yeepi yu enke taa foluku. Na dati mi e du, meke den kisi mi sooto ya.
eng_text: For this cause I, Paul, am the prisoner of Christ Jesus on behalf of you Gentiles,

djk_text: Ma u sabi anda taki, na gaan bun ati fasi namo di Masaa Gadu teke luku mi, fu poti a wooko ya a mi ana, fu tyai bun gi u de.
eng_text: if it is so that you have heard of the administration of that grace of God which was given me toward you;

djk_text: Ne a puu kon a kiin gi mi san a fiti poti fu du gi sama. Na sani di noiti sama be sabi a fesi wanten. Da a be de wan kibii toli. San mi sikiifi pasa de, na wan satu pisi fu a hii toli de.
eng_text: how that by revelation the mystery was made known to me, as I wrote before in few words,

djk_text: Te i leisi en, da i sa si san mi fusutan fu Masaa Gadu, fu fa a fiti poti fu du. Na sani di noiti a fesi sama be sabi wanten. A be de wan kibii toli fu Kelestesi di kon meke ala dati pasa.
eng_text: by which, when you read, you can perceive my understanding in the mystery of Christ;

djk_text: Bika sama á be sabi a toli de a fesi wanten. Ma nownow, da a meke a Apaiti Jeje fi en e piki den apaiti bosikopuman fu Masaa Jesesi dati. Soseefi biibiwan di de apaiti takiman fu Masaa Jesesi. Bika den na wookoman di a teke poti apaiti fasi fi en enseefi.
eng_text: which in other generations was not made known to the children of men, as it has now been revealed to his holy apostles and prophets in the Spirit;

djk_text: A bosikopu seefi e soi taki, taa foluku seefi sa fende bun di Masaa Gadu be paamisi Dyusama tu. Soseefi a mokisa den anga biibi Dyusama toon a seefi kulu sama, di de a sikin fu Masaa Jesesi. Bika den mokisa libi anga Kelestesi Jesesi di den biibi a Bun Nyunsu.
eng_text: that the Gentiles are fellow heirs, and fellow members of the body, and fellow partakers of his promise in Christ Jesus through the Good News,

djk_text: Da mi na wookoman fu tyai a Bun Nyunsu ya. Na gaan bun ati fasi namo di Masaa Gadu teke luku mi, fu gi mi a wooko ya. Ne a poti taanga gi mi, fu poi du en.
eng_text: of which I was made a servant, according to the gift of that grace of God which was given me according to the working of his power.

djk_text: Bika mi á be fiti fu fende a wooko ya. I sa kai mi a moo lagiwan di Masaa Gadu teke poti apaiti fasi gi enseefi. Ma toku, a fitoow mi a gaan wooko, fu soi taa foluku sowtu sani ai gi sama di biibi Kelestesi. Den sani ya foondoo pasa maiki.
eng_text: To me, the very least of all saints, was this grace given, to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,

djk_text: Na so a poti mi, fu kiin taawan ain, fu si san a fiti poti fu du. Na sani di noiti a fesi sama be sabi wanten. A be de wan kibii toli. Na Masaa Gadu wawan be sabi dati.
eng_text: and to make all men see what is the administration of the mystery which for ages has been hidden in God, who created all things through Jesus Christ;

djk_text: Ma nownow, da a wani goontapu mu si a hii toli ya na a kulu sama fi en. Den sa luku den biibiwan de fu si dati. Basi di e tii taawan anga makiti di hei ofu lagi moo taawan seefi sa si dati. Da den musu piki taki, Masaa Gadu abi gaan leti koni fu wooko anga ala san ai du.
eng_text: to the intent that now through the assembly the manifold wisdom of God might be made known to the principalities and the powers in the heavenly places,

djk_text: Bika den o si fa a du san a be fiti poti fu du a fesi anga a kon fu wi Masaa, Kelestesi Jesesi.
eng_text: according to the eternal purpose which he purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord;

djk_text: Da wi mokisa libi anga a Kelestesi Jesesi ya, di u teke biibi fitoow en. Na dati meke u ná abi fu pantan moo fu Masaa Gadu, bika wi doo peesi fu diipi go doo en fesi.
eng_text: in whom we have boldness and access in confidence through our faith in him.

djk_text: Na ala dati meke, u á mu booko saka lasi ati fu di mi sooto ya. Kweti! Bika na fu tyai bun gi u anda meke den kisi mi sooto. Da kaka ede poolo seefi taki, u waiti de fu mi teke sitaafu fu u ede.
eng_text: Therefore I ask that you may not lose heart at my troubles for you, which are your glory.

djk_text: We, da mi e sutu kini gi u Tata, Masaa Gadu a tapu gaandi, fu a hii wooko di a du ya.
eng_text: For this cause, I bow my knees to the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,

djk_text: A de a Tata tuu fu ibii paansu fu libiwan di a meke ya doo tapu anda seefi.
eng_text: from whom every family in heaven and on earth is named,

djk_text: A lai foondoo fasi fu wooko. Da mi e begi fu a teke wan fu den foondoo fasi ya wooko, meke en Apaiti Jeje gi u taanga, fu poi du ala san a wani.
eng_text: that he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, that you may be strengthened with power through his Spirit in the inward man;

djk_text: Soseefi, fu meke ibii yuu u sa wooko anga biibi, fu Kelestesi sa teke peesi a ini u ati de naamo enke osu fi en. Soseefi fu u sa denki doo du sani di e waka anga gaan lobi fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith; to the end that you, being rooted and grounded in love,

djk_text: Da makandii anga ibii taawan di a teke poti apaiti fasi u sa poi fusutan a baala anga a langa, a hei anga dipi fu a lobi fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: may be strengthened to comprehend with all the saints what is the breadth and length and height and depth,

djk_text: Da yu sa poi fusutan fa Kelestesi lobi yu de wan fasi di bigi pasa wi fusutan. Da na so Masaa Gadu sa teke peesi tii yu hii libi de.
eng_text: and to know Christ's love which surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.

djk_text: We, da bali gafa Masaa Gadu! Luku fa a kaakiti fi en e wooko taanga a ini wi libi kaba. Da a poi du moo sani ete pasa san u e denki anga san u e begi seefi.
eng_text: Now to him who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us,

djk_text: Da meke a kulu biibiwan fi en gi en gaandi tego. Soseefi gi en gaandi fu di wi mokisa libi anga Kelestesi Jesesi. Amen, na so a de!
eng_text: to him be the glory in the assembly and in Christ Jesus to all generations forever and ever. Amen.

djk_text: We, mi de ya a dunguu osu fu di mi e dini Masaa Jesesi. Da mi e sende u dati taki, waka fiti wan biibisama anda, fu di Masaa Gadu kai u kon poti fu libi so.
eng_text: I therefore, the prisoner in the Lord, beg you to walk worthily of the calling with which you were called,

djk_text: Teke saka fasi anga saafi switi fasi fu taawan. Abi langa pasensi fudaagi taawan. Dati sa soi fa u lobi taawan.
eng_text: with all lowliness and humility, with patience, bearing with one another in love;

djk_text: Da fa a Apaiti Jeje fu Masaa Gadu de a u ala, meke u de awan seefi sama. Da feti libi fiti anga useefi, meke u ati sa de switi makandii. Da dati sa tei u ala na awan go doo.
eng_text: being eager to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.

djk_text: Bika wi ala na a wan seefi sama di de wan sikin namo. Soseefi Masaa Gadu gi ibiiwan a seefi Apaiti Jeje fi en. U abi denseefi paamisi fu Masaa Gadu di u e luku fu fende tu, di a kai u kon toon sama fi enseefi.
eng_text: There is one body, and one Spirit, even as you also were called in one hope of your calling;

djk_text: Soseefi, u abi a seefi Masaa Jesesi di e tii wi ala. U abi a seefi biibi a Masaa Jesesi tu. Soseefi a seefi dopu fi en.
eng_text: one Lord, one faith, one baptism,

djk_text: Wi abi a seefi Masaa Gadu e dini, di de Tata fu wi ala. A de a tapu fu tii ibiiwan, da a teke peesi a ini ibiiwan fu wi. Soseefi ai gi ibiiwan a wooko di a wani a du.
eng_text: one God and Father of all, who is over all, and through all, and in us all.

djk_text: Ma Kelestesi abi somen sowtu wooko, ne a gi ibiiwan en apaiti fasi fu wooko. Na so a teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku ibiiwan, na a fasi fa a wani gi dati gudu di enseefi abi fu gi biibiwan.
eng_text: But to each one of us was the grace given according to the measure of the gift of Christ.

djk_text: Na dati Masaa Gadu Buku be sikiifi a fesi taki: “A opo gwe a tapu anda baka. Ne a tyai sama di a wini teke na a feti gwe anga en. Da ai gi den sama fi en gaanbigi bun di enseefi abi fu gi sama.”
eng_text: Therefore he says, "When he ascended on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts to men."

djk_text: Ma san wani taki: “A opo gwe a tapu anda baka?” Bika, da a musu de taki, a sama de be saka kon doo a moo dipi pisi a goontapu ya fosi, fu teke a wini.
eng_text: Now this, "He ascended," what is it but that he also first descended into the lower parts of the earth?

djk_text: We, a sama di saka kon ya, da na a seefi sama de musu opo gwe na a moo hei peesi a tapu anda tu, fu teke peesi enke gaan winiman fu tii ala sani anda.
eng_text: He who descended is the one who also ascended far above all the heavens, that he might fill all things.

djk_text: We, da a poti apaiti bosikopuman, soseefi apaiti takiman fi en ya. Soseefi apaiti bolotyasiman fi en Bun Nyunsu, soseefi apaiti soluguman fu biibiwan. Soseefi apaiti leliman fu leli taawan.
eng_text: He gave some to be apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, shepherds and teachers;

djk_text: Ala den dati mu tyai biibiwan kon sabi fa fu seeka denseefi, fu poi du a wooko fu Kelestesi. Da a hii kulu sama di de sikin fi enseefi sa poi goo kon taampu taanga a ini a biibi.
eng_text: for the perfecting of the saints, to the work of serving, to the building up of the body of Christ;

djk_text: Te fu kaba, da wi ala sa abi a seefi fasi fu biibi. Soseefi u sa sabi Masaa Gadu Manpikin, Jesesi Kelestesi wan leti fasi. Da a sa wooko taanga a ini u libi, fu poi abi a sowtu biibi di Kelestesi be abi a Masaa Gadu tu.
eng_text: until we all attain to the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, to a full grown man, to the measure of the stature of the fullness of Christ;

djk_text: Da u ná o de enke pikinengee di lawlaw fu koli kisi. Falisi leliman ná o poi kon puu wi na a tuutuu fasi fu biibi. Bika wi ná o de fu seke enke paana di nái sidon a wan peesi. U ná o buuya te den e leli sama falisi sani, di denseefi meke anga koni, fu buuya sama wai puu na a leti pasi.
eng_text: that we may no longer be children, tossed back and forth and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the trickery of men, in craftiness, after the wiles of error;

djk_text: Ma wi dati sa taampu anga a tuutuu leli fu Masaa Gadu. Da u sa goo anga lobi makandii ala fasi enke fa Kelestesi soi wi. Bika a de wi edeman, fu tii wi di de a sikin fi en.
eng_text: but speaking truth in love, we may grow up in all things into him, who is the head, Christ;

djk_text: Da, te ibii pisi fu a sikin miti enke fa a mu de, da ibii pisi sa poi du a wooko di a mu du, fu yeepi a hii sikin anga a yeepi di a mu tyai, fu meke a tan bun. Da a hii sikin e goo moo taanga. Na so wiseefi sa goo kon lobi makandii, fu taampu moo taanga na a biibi, fu dini Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: from whom all the body, being fitted and knit together through that which every joint supplies, according to the working in measure of each individual part, makes the body increase to the building up of itself in love.

djk_text: Ma mi e teke a nen fu Kelestesi sende u taki, u kaba fu waka enke foluku di á sabi Masaa Gadu. Bika den abi soso lawlaw pakisei fu libi.
eng_text: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that you no longer walk as the rest of the Gentiles also walk, in the futility of their mind,

djk_text: Den á wani leli sabi Masaa Gadu. Den daai baka gi en, ne den fusutan dunguu fu sabi sani enke fa a mu de. Namo den wai paati anga a sowtu libi fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: being darkened in their understanding, alienated from the life of God, because of the ignorance that is in them, because of the hardening of their hearts;

djk_text: Bika den ná abi wan doopu sen fu a takuu libi, meke den nái tapu baka gi a waka libi. Ma den teke motyo fasi, naamo seefi.
eng_text: who having become callous gave themselves up to lust, to work all uncleanness with greediness.

djk_text: Ma u dati sabi a libi di Kelestesi leli wi. Ne u e libi hii taa fasi.
eng_text: But you did not learn Christ that way;

djk_text: Bika fa mi sabi, da sama be soi u anda a bosikopu fi en. Den be leli u waka fiti fa a wani u mokisa libi anga enseefi. Ne u kon sabi a tuutuu fasi di a abi.
eng_text: if indeed you heard him, and were taught in him, even as truth is in Jesus:

djk_text: Ma denki, fosi yu be teke biibi, fa takuu losutu di be fuu yu ati e goo moo anga moo takuu. A be sa tyai yu go fende kaba a soso a Masaa Gadu. Bika a be e koli yu du takuu sani. Ma yu kon leli fu fika a hii haw fasi de.
eng_text: that you put away, as concerning your former way of life, the old man, that grows corrupt after the lusts of deceit;

djk_text: Namo yu leli teke fu waka wan hii nyun fasi. Dati na wan hii nyun fasi fu denki sani.
eng_text: and that you be renewed in the spirit of your mind,

djk_text: Yu kon leli fu de wan hii nyun sowtu paansu sama di gei Masaa Gadu seefi. Da libi enke fa Masaa Gadu e leli u leti fasi. Soseefi de a apaiti fasi di a teke yu poti.
eng_text: and put on the new man, who in the likeness of God has been created in righteousness and holiness of truth.

djk_text: Da kaba teke mofu wooko fu lei, ma taigi taawan tuutuu fasi fa sani de. Bika wi na a wan kulu sama di de a sikin fu Kelestesi.
eng_text: Therefore putting away falsehood, speak truth each one with his neighbor. For we are members of one another.

djk_text: Kenisi anga du ogii, winsi atiboon seefi. A ati mu koo gawgaw baka sondee fu fende pasi doo neti.
eng_text: Be angry, and don't sin. Don't let the sun go down on your wrath,

djk_text: Meke didibii á poi fende okasi tyai yu go du sani di á bun.
eng_text: neither give place to the devil.

djk_text: Efu yu be e fufuu, da kaba anga dati. Go wooko leti fasi fende san i fanowdu, fu solugu iseefi. Da i sa poi yeepi taa mofinawan seefi anga dati.
eng_text: Let him who stole steal no more; but rather let him labor, working with his hands the thing that is good, that he may have something to give to him who has need.

djk_text: Kaba taki wan fasi fu sutu taawan na ati. Ma taki sani di sa yeepi taawan anga a biibi libi. Meke ibii okasi di kon fu taki sani sa poi opo pasi soi taawan, fa Masaa Gadu poi teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku denseefi tu.
eng_text: Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but such as is good for building up as the need may be, that it may give grace to those who hear.

djk_text: Ma kaba anga libi di nái fiti a Apaiti Jeje. Dati sa buduufu en di Masaa Gadu poti a yu enke maiki fu soi taki, yu na apaiti sama fi en. Ne en mu tyai yu doo a dei di Masaa Gadu o kaba losi yu puu a takuudu anga ogii tu.
eng_text: Don't grieve the Holy Spirit of God, in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.

djk_text: Da kaba buuse taawan anga bita fasi na ati. Kaba meke boon ati subi yu balibali taawan. Kaba teke boon ati libi anga taawan di du sani anga yu seefi. Kaba kwali anga taawan tu. Kaba saanti ofu kosi taawan. Ala dati wani taki, kaba libi anga fasi di nái soi lobi.
eng_text: Let all bitterness, wrath, anger, outcry, and slander, be put away from you, with all malice.

djk_text: Ma libi switi anga taawan. Teke tyali ati fasi luku taawan. Teke paadon gi taawan enke fa Masaa Gadu du anga yuseefi sondee i be fiti dati. Bika na a wooko fu Kelestesi namo meke a du dati.
eng_text: And be kind to one another, tenderhearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.

djk_text: We, u na pikin fu Masaa Gadu di a lobi. Da waka enke fa u sabi enseefi be o waka fu du sani ya.
eng_text: Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children.

djk_text: Soseefi, waka soi taki, u lobi taawan enke fa Kelestesi seefi lobi u te teke dede gi u. Na so a pai a wi peesi enke sama teke meti boon begi Masaa Gadu paadon, fu takuudu anga ogii. A wooko fi en ya piisii Masaa Gadu, fu teke enke wan sumee switi sani di doo ne en fesi.
eng_text: Walk in love, even as Christ also loved you, and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling fragrance.

djk_text: Da ná du sani fu sama poi kaagi u anga leti. Kaba anga poli libi. Kaba anga ibii sowtu motyo fasi. Kaba anga fafa ati fu suku sani. Den fasi de á mu de a wi! Bika Masaa Gadu teke wi poti apaiti fasi.
eng_text: But sexual immorality, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not even be mentioned among you, as becomes saints;

djk_text: Da kaba puu poli taki a mofu. Kaba anga taki di nái soi lesipeki. Kaba anga sipowtu anga gaan taki. Den nái fiti biibisama. Ma poti i mofu gi Masaa Gadu daa, fi en yeepi di ai gi somen sowtu fasi.
eng_text: nor filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not appropriate; but rather giving of thanks.

djk_text: Bika sabi taki, sani ná o waka bun gi sama anga motyo fasi. Soseefi sama anga waka libi fu wooko poli fasi anga sikin. Soseefi sama anga fafa ati a moni baka. Bika den libi de gei dini afokodeei sani. Da sama di de a ini den libi de, ná o fende a bun di de a ini a Nyun Tii fu Kelestesi anga Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Know this for sure, that no sexually immoral person, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, has any inheritance in the Kingdom of Christ and God.

djk_text: Kweti! Meke sama á kon fende pasi koli yu du den sowtu ogii de. Bika sama di taanga yesi du den, da Masaa Gadu o sitaafu en.
eng_text: Let no one deceive you with empty words. For because of these things, the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.

djk_text: We, da koti naamo komoto a pasi gi sama di e du den sowtu ogii de seefi tu.
eng_text: Therefore don't be partakers with them.

djk_text: Bika a fesi, da u seefi be de a dunguu tu. Ma yu toon sama fi en now, meke sani fi en de a kiin gi yu fu sabi. Da waka enke sama di sani fi en de a kiin gi.
eng_text: For you were once darkness, but are now light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,

djk_text: Bika fu libi enke sani fi en de a kiin gi yu fu sabi, da yu mu e du san bun. Soseefi du san leti. Libi tuutuu fasi enke fa Masaa Gadu wani.
eng_text: for the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth,

djk_text: We, e keli luku naamo, fu sabi san fu du, fu piisii Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: proving what is well pleasing to the Lord.

djk_text: Ma ná mosoo anga sama di e du san nái tyai yeepi. Bika sani fu Masaa Gadu dunguu gi den fu sabi. Da den e du soso wisiwasi sani. Ma tyai yuseefi meke a sa kon a kiin gi den taki, a libi fu den á bun.
eng_text: Have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather even reprove them.

djk_text: Bika den kibii sani di den e du na gaan sen sani di á bun fu taki.
eng_text: For the things which are done by them in secret, it is a shame even to speak of.

djk_text: Ma te sani de a dunguu gi sama, da faya mu kiin a peesi. Da sani sa poi kon a kiin gi en fu sabi.
eng_text: But all things, when they are reproved, are revealed by the light, for everything that reveals is light.

djk_text: A dati meke den taki: “Sama di e siibi weki! Opo komoto a den dedesama mindii de. Da Kelestesi o leti faya poti gi i.”
eng_text: Therefore he says, "Awake, you who sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you."

djk_text: Ma kenisi seefi anga fa fu libi. Feti teke leti koni fu wooko naamo. Ná libi enke sama di ná abi koni.
eng_text: Therefore watch carefully how you walk, not as unwise, but as wise;

djk_text: Da te a kai fu du bun, da noiti koti pasi komoto gi dati. Bika goontapu takuu noya. Son sama e waka e du soso ogii naamo a ini.
eng_text: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.

djk_text: Ma poti ede leti! Da kaba du sani enke lawman di nái denki fosi den du. Ma keli luku naamo fu fusutan san fu du piisii Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Therefore don't be foolish, but understand what the will of the Lord is.

djk_text: Ná diingi te fu duungu! Dati o poli yu libi. Ma meke a Apaiti Jeje fu Masaa Gadu lai yu libi.
eng_text: Don't be drunken with wine, in which is dissipation, but be filled with the Spirit,

djk_text: Da te u kon miti makandii, da u wooko anga san sikiifi a Psalm, a singi buku, fu soi useefi sani. U singi ibii sowtu singi di e gafa Masaa Gadu. U singi piisii gi Masaa Gadu ibii yuu anga singi di en Apaiti Jeje poti a u ati tu.
eng_text: speaking to one another in psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs; singing, and making melody in your heart to the Lord;

djk_text: U gi u Tata, Masaa Gadu a tapu daa ala yuu, fu a wooko di wi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi du gi wi.
eng_text: giving thanks always concerning all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, to God, even the Father;

djk_text: We, u mu saka a u seefi ondoo fu Kelestesi. Bika a so a taki fu u libi.
eng_text: subjecting yourselves one to another in the fear of Christ.

djk_text: Biibi uman! Saka a yu man ondoo. Teke en taki, leti enke fa yu e saka a Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi ondoo e teke en taki.
eng_text: Wives, be subject to your own husbands, as to the Lord.

djk_text: Bika na a man na edeman fi en uman enke fa Kelestesi na a edeman fu a hii kulu sama di de sikin fi enseefi. Ne a puu den a takuudu anga ogii, enke Yeepiman fu den, di meke den toon sama fi enseefi.
eng_text: For the husband is the head of the wife, and Christ also is the head of the assembly, being himself the savior of the body.

djk_text: Da a hii kulu sama fi en ya mu saka ne en ondoo e teke en taki. Na so ibii uman mu saka a den man ondoo teke en man taki na ala fasi tu.
eng_text: But as the assembly is subject to Christ, so let the wives also be to their own husbands in everything.

djk_text: Man! U mu lobi u uman tuutuu fasi enke fa Kelestesi lobi a hii kulu sama fi en. Ne a poti enseefi teke dede pai a den peesi seefi, fu puu den a takuudu anga ogii.
eng_text: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the assembly, and gave himself up for it;

djk_text: Na so a meke den toon wan apaiti sowtu sama gi Masaa Gadu. Bika a wowtu fi en wasi den libi kon kiin enke fa wataa e wasi sani kiin.
eng_text: that he might sanctify it, having cleansed it by the washing of water with the word,

djk_text: A wooko fi en ya meke a kulu sama fi en hii libi kiin gi enseefi. Den de sondee wan enkii poli fasi. Finga á poi soi kaagi den anga leti. Na so a teke den poti apaiti fasi sondee fowtu.
eng_text: that he might present the assembly to himself gloriously, not having spot or wrinkle or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish.

djk_text: Da na so a man mu lobi en uman tuutuu fasi enke ne enseefi sikin dati. Da te ai wooko bun anga en uman, da anga enseefi ai wooko so.
eng_text: Even so husbands also ought to love their own wives as their own bodies. He who loves his own wife loves himself.

djk_text: Bika sama á de di e buuse enseefi sikin. Ma ai nyan poti gi en, soseefi ai luku en bun enke fa Kelestesi e luku a hii kulu sama fi en.
eng_text: For no man ever hated his own flesh; but nourishes and cherishes it, even as the Lord also does the assembly;

djk_text: Bika wi na a sikin fi en.
eng_text: because we are members of his body, of his flesh and bones.

djk_text: Masaa Gadu Buku be sikiifi a sani ya a fesi taki: “Na dati meke a man e fika en gaansama osu, fu go teke en uman libi. Da den tu sama de mokisa libi toon wan sikin.”
eng_text: For this cause a man will leave his father and mother, and will be joined to his wife. The two will become one flesh.

djk_text: A sani de e taki fu fa Kelestesi anga a hii kulu sama fi en mokisa libi. Na wan gaan sani di noiti a fesi sama be sabi wanten. Ma a be de wan kibii toli.
eng_text: This mystery is great, but I speak concerning Christ and of the assembly.

djk_text: Ma soseefi dati e soi fa man mu lobi en uman enke fa a lobi enseefi. Da soseefi uman mu lesipeki en man, fu saka teke en taki.
eng_text: Nevertheless each of you must also love his own wife even as himself; and let the wife see that she respects her husband.

djk_text: We, den pikin mu teke den dda anga den mma taki. Bika a pikin ya toon sama fu Masaa Jesesi, da na so fiti fu a libi.
eng_text: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu Buku be sikiifi a fesi fu a fosi weiti di waka anga wan paamisi a ini den tin weiti. A weiti de taki: “I mu lesipeki i mma anga i dda.”
eng_text: Honor your father and mother, which is the first commandment with a promise:

djk_text: Da ai go doo taki: “Da Masaa Gadu o meke sani waka bun gi yu. Soseefi a o gi yu langa libi a goontapu tu.”
eng_text: that it may be well with you, and you may live long on the earth.

djk_text: Dada ná dwengi i pikin fu soso tu, fu meke a daai kon buuse yu. Ma leli a pikin fu saka teke taki, fu a sa waka leti. Soi a pikin ala fa fu waka fiti Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: You fathers, don't provoke your children to wrath, but nurture them in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.

djk_text: De saafu a katibo! U saka u seefi a den gaan masaa fu u ondoo e teke den taki. Lesipeki den, fu waka kenisi sondee taanga yesi gi en. Wooko gi en anga yu hii ati taki enke na Kelestesi yu e dini sowan fasi.
eng_text: Servants, be obedient to those who according to the flesh are your masters, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as to Christ;

djk_text: Da yu á mu wooko enke na libisama yu e suku fu piisii, te den ain de a yu tapu namo. Ma wooko enke na Kelestesi yu e dini, meke yu e wooko anga yu hii ati ala yuu. Na so Masaa Gadu wani.
eng_text: not in the way of service only when eyes are on you, as men pleasers; but as servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart;

djk_text: We, da te yu de saafu a katibo, da poti yuseefi wooko anga yu hii ati. Bika fa a de, da a ná fu sama ede meke yu e wooko bun so, ma na Kelestesi yu e dini sowan fasi.
eng_text: with good will doing service, as to the Lord, and not to men;

djk_text: Bika sabi taki, sama di de saafu a katibo ofu sama di de fiiman, Masaa Gadu paamisi fu pai ibiiwan fu bun di a du.
eng_text: knowing that whatever good thing each one does, he will receive the same again from the Lord, whether he is bound or free.

djk_text: We, gaan masaa fu saafu! Luku bun fa yu e wooko anga yu saafu. Wooko switi anga den, fu piisii Masaa Gadu. Kaba pii ain dwengi den anga sitaafu. Bika sabi taki, a tuutuu gaan Masaa fu wi ala de a Masaa Gadu Kondee a tapu. Dati nái keli taawan bigi moo taawan. Te a kai fu a kuutu, da ai kuutu ibiiwan anga leti, winsi na saafu ofu na sama di á de a saafu.
eng_text: You masters, do the same things to them, and give up threatening, knowing that he who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no partiality with him.

djk_text: We, fosi mi tapu a biifi ya, da mi e sende u fu taampu taanga fitoow Masaa Jesesi. Teke en taanga lai yu libi, fu gi yu makiti fu feti biibi fasi.
eng_text: Finally, be strong in the Lord, and in the strength of his might.

djk_text: Da teke feti sani di Masaa Gadu gi wi fu feti biibi fasi. Meke te didibii kon muliki yu anga den somen takuu koni fi en fu koli yu kisi, yu sa poi feti baka.
eng_text: Put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.

djk_text: Bika a hii suwa anga feti fu wi, a á de anga libisama sikin anga buulu. Ma anga basi di e tii taawan anga makiti di hei ofu lagi moo taawan anga gaan bigiman di e ligei a dunguu goontapu ya anga ala sowtu takuu jeje di lontu goontapu, te doo a pisi fu tapu anda.
eng_text: For our wrestling is not against flesh and blood, but against the principalities, against the powers, against the world's rulers of the darkness of this age, and against the spiritual forces of wickedness in the heavenly places.

djk_text: Da na dati meke u mu teke den feti sani di Masaa Gadu gi wi, fu kibii useefi. Da te didibii wani du ogii anga wi, da u sa poi taampu sondee fu a towe wi. Na so u mu feti doo kaba fu a feti. Da u taampu kankan enke winiman.
eng_text: Therefore put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to withstand in the evil day, and, having done all, to stand.

djk_text: Da sete iseefi! Enke suudati banti mindii e go a feti. Dati na te wi sabi a tuutuu leli fu Masaa Gadu. Enke suudati teke insii sani wei kibii boo fu ati. Dati na te u du san bun gi Masaa Gadu doo.
eng_text: Stand therefore, having the utility belt of truth buckled around your waist, and having put on the breastplate of righteousness,

djk_text: Soseefi sete iseefi enke suudati wei a susu fu waka soi taawan a Bun Nyunsu di e tyai sama ati kon de switi.
eng_text: and having fitted your feet with the preparation of the Good News of peace;

djk_text: Enke suudati tyai insii sani fu tapu lai. Dati na te u poti fitoow a Masaa Gadu. Da ai tapu faya lansi di didibii e sutu kon taki, ai tyai poli sani kon a yu fusutan, fu du ogii.
eng_text: above all, taking up the shield of faith, with which you will be able to quench all the fiery darts of the evil one.

djk_text: Da enke suudati wei taanga ati fu kibii en ede peesi. Dati na te u tei ati oli biibi doo. Bika didibii e suku fu koli u kisi anga lei fi en. Ma, da u sa poi piki en anga wowtu fu Masaa Gadu di a Apaiti Jeje poti gi u. Da dati e koti didibii enke saapu fetihow di suudati e tyai fu koti feyanti kii.
eng_text: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God;

djk_text: We, soseefi, da taampu anga begi naamo. Begi ala yuu na a fasi di Masaa Gadu Apaiti Jeje e piki yu. Da luku naamo sowtu yeepi de fu begi gi ala taawan di Masaa Gadu teke poti apaiti fasi. Noiti weli fu begi gi taawan so.
eng_text: with all prayer and requests, praying at all times in the Spirit, and being watchful to this end in all perseverance and requests for all the saints:

djk_text: U begi gi mi tu, meke Masaa Gadu yeepi mi, fu mi sa opo mofu soi a tuutuu fasi, di Masaa Gadu fiti poti a Bun Nyunsu. Meke a poti wowtu a ini mi mofu fu taki sondee feele, fu den kon fusutan. Bika na sani di noiti a fesi sama be sabi wanten. A be de wan kibii toli.
eng_text: on my behalf, that utterance may be given to me in opening my mouth, to make known with boldness the mystery of the Good News,

djk_text: Bika mi wooko enke apaiti bosikopuman na fu soi sama dati. Na fu dati meke den kisi mi sooto ya. Da begi fu mi sa fende yeepi, fu wooko sondee feele, fu poi soi ala dati enke fa a mu de.
eng_text: for which I am an ambassador in chains; that in it I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.

djk_text: We, mi e sende Tikikesi kon luku u anda, fu taigi u fa sani e go anga mi ya. U ala sabi en enke wan lobi biibi baala. A de wan wookoman di e wooko fitoow fasi fu dini Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: But that you also may know my affairs, how I am doing, Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will make known to you all things;

djk_text: Na dati meke, mi akisi en, fu kon luku u anda gi mi. Fu tuu, te a kon, da a sa taigi u fa ai go anga u biibiwan dise. Soseefi, a sa puu pantan di u abi anda, fu fa sani e go anga wi dise.
eng_text: whom I have sent to you for this very purpose, that you may know our state, and that he may comfort your hearts.

djk_text: We, mi e begi u Tata, Masaa Gadu anga Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi, meke u ala di teke biibi anda ati sa de switi. Soseefi fu u ati sa opo lobi useefi makandii.
eng_text: Peace be to the brothers, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

djk_text: Mi e begi Masaa Gadu di poti u fu wi lobi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi tego, fu tan teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku u.
eng_text: Grace be with all those who love our Lord Jesus Christ with incorruptible love. Amen.

djk_text: Mi Pawlesi anga Timotiyesi na wookoman fu Kelestesi Jesesi di wi e dini. Na wi e sikiifi a biifi ya makandii gi ala sama a Filipi Foto anda di Masaa Gadu poti apaiti fasi de. Dati wani taki, sama di mokisa libi anga Kelestesi Jesesi. Soseefi edeman fu biibiwan anga taa fesiman di taampu a den edeman de baka.
eng_text: Paul and Timothy, servants of Jesus Christ; To all the saints in Christ Jesus who are at Philippi, with the overseers and servants :

djk_text: Da meke u Tata, Masaa Gadu anga Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku u de. Soseefi, meke u ati de switi.
eng_text: Grace to you, and peace from God, our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.

djk_text: We, ibii yuu mi pakisei u ya, da mi e gi Masaa Gadu daa, fu u ede.
eng_text: I thank my God whenever I remember you,

djk_text: Anga ala piisii mi e kai u anda nen naamo, fu begi gi u so.
eng_text: always in every request of mine on behalf of you all making my requests with joy,

djk_text: Bika senten a fosi dei di u toon biibisama, ne u yeepi a wooko ya wanten ala sowtu fasi, fu meke a Bun Nyunsu paati moo anga moo. Te enke tide ete, u e du dati go doo.
eng_text: for your partnership in furtherance of the Good News from the first day until now;

djk_text: Ma, soseefi di mi sabi tuutuu taki, na Masaa Gadu sete a bun wooko ya a ini u libi. Da a o tyai dati wan bun fasi go doo a dei, di Kelestesi Jesesi o kon baka seefi.
eng_text: being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ.

djk_text: We, da fa mi e pakisei u anda na wan sani di mi musu fu du. Bika u de a mi ati. Soseefi, u taampu anga mi na a Bun Nyunsu di Masaa Gadu teke gaan bun ati fasi, poti a mi ana, fu paati. We, mi be de a dunguu osu, na so u be yeepi. Doo a kuutu dei pe den be tyai mi go seefi, fu soi fa a Bun Nyunsu na Masaa Gadu tuutuu bosikopu. Soseefi, fa mi e taki en leti fasi, fu sama sa fitoow teke biibi. Da u be gi mi taanga sikin sowan fasi.
eng_text: It is even right for me to think this way on behalf of all of you, because I have you in my heart, because, both in my bonds and in the defense and confirmation of the Good News, you all are partakers with me of grace.

djk_text: We, Masaa Gadu de enke mi kotoigi fu piki taki, mi nái lei taki mi e angii fu miti u de! Soseefi mi lobi u enke fa Masaa Jesesi lobi u tu!
eng_text: For God is my witness, how I long after all of you in the tender mercies of Christ Jesus.

djk_text: We, fa mi e begi gi u, da luku san mi e begi ya. Meke a lobi di u abi makandii de sa goo, fu fusutan moo anga moo fa Masaa Gadu de seefi. Da u o moo sabi fini fini san fiti anga san fowtu.
eng_text: This I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment;

djk_text: Na sowan fasi u sa poi teke a se fu bun ibii yuu. Soseefi, mi e begi meke u sa de tuutuu letiopu fasi, fu taampu enke fa Masaa Gadu wani. Soseefi, meke u á sa du sani, fu finga sa poi soi kaagi u anga leti doo a gaan kuutu dei fu Kelestesi.
eng_text: so that you may approve the things that are excellent; that you may be sincere and without offense to the day of Christ;

djk_text: Da u hii libi anga manii sa de bun sani gi Masaa Gadu enke fa Jesesi Kelestesi seeka en. A libi de o meke Masaa Gadu fende gafa anga gaandi.
eng_text: being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Mi wani u sabi fa banowtu e miti mi ya, ma a á poi tapu a bosikopu di wi e tyai. Ai tyai moo ipi sama kon biibi a Bun Nyunsu ya seefi.
eng_text: Now I desire to have you know, brothers, that the things which happened to me have turned out rather to the progress of the Good News;

djk_text: Bika ala suudati a kownu paleisi ya doo ala taa sama dise seefi kon sabi saide mi de a dunguu osu. Den si taki, na namo fu di mi e dini a Kelestesi.
eng_text: so that it became evident to the whole palace guard, and to all the rest, that my bonds are in Christ;

djk_text: Da ala dati e gi taa biibiwan ya moo deki ati, fu waka taki Masaa Gadu bosikopu, sondee feele. Ai gi den moo fitoow a Masaa Gadu tu. Bika den e si fa ai yeepi mi ya taki, a o yeepi den so tu.
eng_text: and that most of the brothers in the Lord, being confident through my bonds, are more abundantly bold to speak the word of God without fear.

djk_text: We, na tuu taki, son biibiwan dise e taki Masaa Gadu bosikopu, fu sama mu poti den bigi moo mi. Bika den e dyalusu, da den e sitee anga mi fu fa Masaa Gadu e wooko anga mi. Ma sowan fu den e taki en kiin ati fasi ya sondee a takuu sowtu fasi de.
eng_text: Some indeed preach Christ even out of envy and strife, and some also out of good will.

djk_text: Den dati e taki Masaa Gadu bosikopu fu a Kelestesi, bika den lobi mi. Den sabi taki, na Masaa Gadu poti mi fu feti meke sama si taki, en Bun Nyunsu na wan tuu sani, fu teke biibi.
eng_text: The former insincerely preach Christ from selfish ambition, thinking that they add affliction to my chains;

djk_text: Ma den taawan e dyalusu, da den e sitee anga mi, fu sama mu poti den bigi moo mi. Da den nái wooko wan leti fasi. Bika den wani sokoo a banowtu fu mi ya kon moo taanga gi mi.
eng_text: but the latter out of love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the Good News.

djk_text: Ma mi ná abi toobi anga den. Den e sitee ofu den lobi mi, ma den e taki a bosikopu ya namo, da ai piisii mi kaba. Na so mi o piisii go doo seefi.
eng_text: What does it matter? Only that in every way, whether in pretense or in truth, Christ is proclaimed. I rejoice in this, yes, and will rejoice.

djk_text: Bika mi sabi taki, a kuutu di mi o go seefi o waka bun gi mi, fu di u taampu a mi baka anga begi. Soseefi a Apaiti Jeje fu Jesesi Kelestesi o teke peesi yeepi mi.
eng_text: For I know that this will turn out to my salvation, through your supplication and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,

djk_text: Bika a angii di mi abi, soseefi san mi e luku fu fende, na fu mi á de feele fasi. Soseefi fu mi á du sani tyai sen gi miseefi. Ma ibii yuu mi mu wooko leti fasi sondee feele wan enkii sama, doo fa mi de ya nownow seefi. Da mi sa tan gi a Kelestesi gaandi fa mi e taki sani doo fa mi e du sani seefi, winsi mi o dede ofu mi o libi.
eng_text: according to my earnest expectation and hope, that I will in no way be disappointed, but with all boldness, as always, now also Christ will be magnified in my body, whether by life, or by death.

djk_text: Bika fu mi se, da a libi ya na fu tan gi a Kelestesi gaandi. Da dede dati sa moo bun gi mi baka seefi.
eng_text: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

djk_text: Ma efu mi de a libi ya doo, toku mi sa du moo ipi wooko gi a Kelestesi. Na dati meke, mi á sabi sowtu se fu teke, dede ofu libi.
eng_text: But if I live on in the flesh, this will bring fruit from my work; yet I don't know what I will choose.

djk_text: Tuutuu! Ai taanga gi mi sowtu se fu teke. Mi e angii taanga fu dede gwe a Kelestesi anda. Bika dati moo bun seefi.
eng_text: But I am in a dilemma between the two, having the desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better.

djk_text: Ma fu di u anda abi mi taanga fanowdu de ete, meke a moo de fanowdu seefi fu mi de a libi ya ete.
eng_text: Yet, to remain in the flesh is more needful for your sake.

djk_text: Da na fu dati meke mi abi a taanga denki taki, mi o de a libi go doo, fu yeepi u meke u biibi sa moo kisi futu a doti. Da u sa moo piisii a ini u biibi tu.
eng_text: Having this confidence, I know that I will remain, yes, and remain with you all, for your progress and joy in the faith,

djk_text: Da u o moo poi gafa Kelestesi Jesesi gi sama taki, a oli mi a libi, fu kon doo u anda baka seefi.
eng_text: that your rejoicing may abound in Christ Jesus in me through my presence with you again.

djk_text: We, da san fanowdu u anda nownow, na fu libi enke fa a Kelestesi Bun Nyunsu taki. Da winsi mi doo anda fu kon luku u ofu mi á doo anda moo, ma mi sa yee fa u taampu taanga de. Soseefi u mokisa libi a wan, fu feti makandii soi taki, a Bun Nyunsu na wan tuutuu sani, fu teke biibi.
eng_text: Only let your way of life be worthy of the Good News of Christ, that, whether I come and see you or am absent, I may hear of your state, that you stand firm in one spirit, with one soul striving for the faith of the Good News;

djk_text: Soseefi siteeman á poi meke u pantan na a pasi ya, fu meke u feele sani. Da den o kon si taki, na den o lasi a hii sitee ya. Bika u dati abi Masaa Gadu di taampu gi u, meke u sa wini.
eng_text: and in nothing frightened by the adversaries, which is for them a proof of destruction, but to you of salvation, and that from God.

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu e teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku u. Ne a poti u toon wookoman gi a Kelestesi, fu dini en. Ma dati á wani taki, fu biibi en namo fa a tyai yeepi. Kweti! Ma na fu teke banowtu fi en ede tu, fu di u e teke en taki.
eng_text: Because it has been granted to you on behalf of Christ, not only to believe in him, but also to suffer on his behalf,

djk_text: Na so meke u e fende banowtu de enke fa u be si dati be miti mi de. Soseefi u e yee fa ai miti mi ya ete.
eng_text: having the same conflict which you saw in me, and now hear is in me.

djk_text: We, a Kelestesi e gi u taanga di u abi fanowdu. Soseefi lobi fu koo u ati. A seefi Apaiti Jeje di be e tyai en, de fu tyai wi tu. Soseefi u abi tyali ati fasi fu wooko anga taawan.
eng_text: If there is therefore any exhortation in Christ, if any consolation of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any tender mercies and compassion,

djk_text: Da u libi de fu piisii mi ya! U denki sani go na a wan se. U lobi ibiiwan a seefi fasi. U libi switi fasi makandii enke wan. U poti ede makandii suku a seefi sani fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: make my joy full, by being like-minded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind;

djk_text: Noiti suku wini fi i wawan namo. Noiti suku gafanen fi iseefi. Noiti keli iseefi hei moo taawan. Lesipeki taawan moo iseefi.
eng_text: doing nothing through rivalry or through conceit, but in humility, each counting others better than himself;

djk_text: Teke ain luku san taawan mankei, da booko ede anga a taawan nowtu.
eng_text: each of you not just looking to his own things, but each of you also to the things of others.

djk_text: Denki sani na a fasi fa Kelestesi Jesesi e denki.
eng_text: Have this in your mind, which was also in Christ Jesus,

djk_text: Luku fa a abi a hii bigi fu Masaa Gadu a tapu anda fosi a saka kon ya. Ma a á teke fu tyai a fasi de waka lontu goontapu suku wini fi enseefi.
eng_text: who, existing in the form of God, didn't consider equality with God a thing to be grasped,

djk_text: Kweti! A saka enseefi puu a hii bigi fi en poti a wanse. Ne a teke a saka fasi fu wan wookoman di gei saafu e dini basi. Na so a teke libisama fasi enke ibii taawan ya.
eng_text: but emptied himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in the likeness of men.

djk_text: Namo enke wan libisama, ne a saka baka fu waka dini Masaa Gadu a tapu. A teke Masaa Gadu taki te doo dede wan lagi fasi a koloisi seefi.
eng_text: And being found in human form, he humbled himself, becoming obedient to death, yes, the death of the cross.

djk_text: Na so meke Masaa Gadu hei en pasa ala taawan. Ne a fende makiti fu taampu a fesi fu ala taa sani di nen i sa kai.
eng_text: Therefore God also highly exalted him, and gave to him the name which is above every name;

djk_text: Na so Masaa Jesesi de basi fu ala sani a tapu anda doo goontapu ya seefi. Soseefi doo a moo lagi peesi a dedekondee seefi. Ibiiwan fu den sani ya abi fu saka gi en.
eng_text: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of those in heaven, those on earth, and those under the earth,

djk_text: Ibiiwan fu den tongo abi fu piki taki: “Eeye! Jesesi Kelestesi na a moo gaan Masaa di de.” Na sowan fasi Masaa Gadu enke Tata fu wi ala sa fende gaandi.
eng_text: and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

djk_text: Mi lobi biibiwan! Da teke a fasi fi en de tu. Masaa Gadu tyai yeepi puu u a takuudu anga ogii. Da enke fa u gwenti teke en taki de kaba, da feti naamo libi leti. Moo libi so seefi anga ala lesipeki anga gaan kenisi fi en. Ma a ná te mi de ape namo, ma winsi mi á de ape seefi.
eng_text: So then, my beloved, even as you have always obeyed, not only in my presence, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.

djk_text: Bika ne en gi u en taanga fu teke en taki, meke u poi libi so. Da u sa poi du den sani di a fiti poti.
eng_text: For it is God who works in you both to will and to work, for his good pleasure.

djk_text: Da winsi san de fu du, ná kuutu fu dati. Du en sondee hali go anga hali kon.
eng_text: Do all things without murmurings and disputes,

djk_text: Da finga ná o poi soi kaagi u anga leti. Bika u sa de sondee takuudu fasi a mindii fu a takuu goontapu pe ogii ati sama e waka e libi takuudu fasi ya. U o de a den mindii enke lobi pikin fu Masaa Gadu di bun, fu si enke te neti dunguu, ma sitali a tapu e beenki fu si kiinkiin.
eng_text: that you may become blameless and harmless, children of God without blemish in the midst of a crooked and perverse generation, among whom you are seen as lights in the world,

djk_text: Na so u mu tan, fu tyai a bosikopu fa Masaa Gadu e gi libi tego. Da mi ya seefi o poi gafa u de na a dei di Masaa Jesesi o kon baka. Bika u libi sa soi fa mi á kon wooko de fu soso.
eng_text: holding up the word of life; that I may have something to boast in the day of Christ, that I didn't run in vain nor labor in vain.

djk_text: U teke biibi, ne u poti u libi gi Masaa Gadu enke te Dyu begiman e poti bunbun meti boon, fu gi Masaa Gadu daa. Da efu mi teke dede dise tu, da a gei mi buulu di lon na a diingi di mu towe a dati tapu, fu meke a daa doo peesi seefi. A hii sani ya e piisii mi. Bika mi anga u mokisa gi u libi a Masaa Gadu so.
eng_text: Yes, and if I am poured out on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I rejoice, and rejoice with you all.

djk_text: Da piisii de tu. U poolo, fu di mi anga u mokisa gi Masaa Gadu u hii libi so.
eng_text: In the same way, you also rejoice, and rejoice with me.

djk_text: We, efu Masaa Jesesi wani, da a ná o langa fosi mi sende Timotiyesi kon luku u de. Mi o kisi nyun kaakiti, te a sa daai kon taigi mi ya baka, fa sani e go anga u anda.
eng_text: But I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, that I also may be cheered up when I know how you are doing.

djk_text: We, mi o sende Timotiyesi kon luku u de, bika mi ná abi taa sama ya boiti en di e fii gi u anda enke mi ya. Fu tuu, ai booko ede ya, fa ai go anga u anda.
eng_text: For I have no one else like-minded, who will truly care about you.

djk_text: Mi e taigi u a sani ya, fu u sa sabi taki, den taawan ya e suku soso wini fu denseefi namo. Da den nái feti a sani fu Kelestesi Jesesi baka.
eng_text: For they all seek their own, not the things of Jesus Christ.

djk_text: Ma u sabi Timotiyesi dati, fa ai dini Masaa Gadu tuutuu fitoow fasi. Bika di wi be de a u anda, da u be si dati. Fa a be mokisa wooko anga mi enke wooko manpikin di e yeepi en dda a sani. Na so a be e yeepi mi, meke moo sama kon biibi a Bun Nyunsu.
eng_text: But you know the proof of him, that, as a child serves a father, so he served with me in furtherance of the Good News.

djk_text: We, na a Timotiyesi ya mi e denki fu sende kon luku u de. Fa i si mi o kisi fu sabi taki, mi o komoto a dunguu osu ya, da na so mi o sende en wanten.
eng_text: Therefore I hope to send him at once, as soon as I see how it will go with me.

djk_text: Mi abi a biibi tu taki, mi o fii komoto a dunguu osu ya. Da te dati pasa, da a ná o langa fosi miseefi sa kon luku u de.
eng_text: But I trust in the Lord that I myself also will come shortly.

djk_text: We, mi si en fanowdu fu sende wi lobi biibi baala Eipafoditesi kon gi u de baka. U be gi mi en, fu teke u peesi waka yeepi mi wooko. Da a yeepi mi so tuu, te mi be abi en fanowdu. Na wan man di be mokisa wooko anga mi tuutuu. Wi feti makandii sowan fasi enke tu suudati di e tyai wini gi a basi. Na so u wooko soi fa Masaa Gadu bosikopu di wi e taki na a tuutuu wan.
eng_text: But I counted it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, fellow worker, fellow soldier, and your apostle and servant of my need;

djk_text: Ma fa u de, da Eipafoditesi e angii fu u anda. Soseefi, a kon sabi taki, u e yee anda taki, ai siki dise. Ne ai fii wan fasi ya.
eng_text: since he longed for you all, and was very troubled, because you had heard that he was sick.

djk_text: We, fu tuu, a be siki dise tuutuu enke fa u yee anda. Pikinmoo en boo be koti, ma na tyali ati fasi Masaa Gadu teke luku en, meke a kon bun baka. Da a kon, na miseefi Masaa Gadu yeepi de so. Bika di a kon bun en baka, da a kibii mi fu tyali á kon a mi tapu moo san mi abi ya kaba.
eng_text: For indeed he was sick, nearly to death, but God had mercy on him; and not on him only, but on me also, that I might not have sorrow on sorrow.

djk_text: We, da gawgaw mi e sende en kon gi u anda baka. Bika mi wani u piisii de, te u sa si en baka. Efu mi yee dise taki, u piisii so, da wan koko sa losi komoto a mi ati.
eng_text: I have sent him therefore the more diligently, that, when you see him again, you may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.

djk_text: We, da poolo puu en a boto anga piisii de. Na so Masaa Gadu wani. Bika sama enke Eipafoditesi fiti fu gi gaandi.
eng_text: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all joy, and hold such in honor,

djk_text: Bika a be poti en libi a dede mofu seefi, fu a wooko fu Kelestesi ede. A yeepi mi wan fasi di u anda seefi á be o poi.
eng_text: because for the work of Christ he came near to death, risking his life to supply that which was lacking in your service toward me.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Moo fala, da u tan piisii doo, fu di u mokisa libi anga Masaa. Soseefi noiti mi o weli fu sikiifi u a seefi toli di mi be wasikoi u kaba, fu meke u á sa fende pasi buuya de. Ma u sa taampu sondee pantan fasi.
eng_text: Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord. To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not tiresome, but for you it is safe.

djk_text: Da mi e sikiifi naamo taki, luku bun anga den takuu feyanti! Na sama di muliki enke sukumofu dagu, fu waka du den ogii fu den naamo. Den e leli sama taki, den mu meke den koti den poti a maiki gi den fosi, da den sa toon sama fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Beware of the dogs, beware of the evil workers, beware of the false circumcision.

djk_text: We, na wi Masaa Gadu e si enke sama di koti a maiki fu toon fi enseefi! Bika en Apaiti Jeje teke peesi a ini wi, meke u poi dini en. Da u e piisii fu san Kelestesi Jesesi du gi wi sondee fu teli san useefi de.
eng_text: For we are the circumcision, who worship God in the Spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh;

djk_text: Libisama fasi, da mi ya dati be sa poi fu teli san miseefi de. Mi abi sani fu gafa kai moo son taawan di e teli san denseefi de.
eng_text: though I myself might have confidence even in the flesh. If any other man thinks that he has confidence in the flesh, I yet more:

djk_text: Luku ya! Den koti a maiki a manpeesi gi mi, di mi tapu wan wiki. Da mi na Islayeli sama. Mi meke a ini a lo fu Benyameni. Mi na lala Hebelei sama. Na a fasi fu a Dyuweiti, da mi na be Faliseiman.
eng_text: circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of Hebrews; concerning the law, a Pharisee;

djk_text: Mi be dyadya a ini ala san Masaa Gadu wani mi du. Ne mi lon du ogii anga den di e waka a Kelestesi baka. Fu oli weiti be e meke sama kon de bun gi Masaa Gadu, da mi be o de sondee fowtu.
eng_text: concerning zeal, persecuting the assembly; concerning the righteousness which is in the law, found blameless.

djk_text: Ma ala san mi be sa kai fu teli miseefi kon toon sani fu du gaan ogii anga mi. Bika den sa tapu mi fu poti hii fitoow a Kelestesi namo.
eng_text: However, what things were gain to me, these have I counted loss for Christ.

djk_text: Moo ogii seefi! Mi teli den sani de enke soso sani, fu mi sa fende a moo gaan waiti sani seefi. Dati na fu kon sabi Kelestesi Jesesi enke mi Masaa. Na fi en ede meke mi fika ala den sani de enke tyobo sani a dyiko, fu fende wini a Kelestesi.
eng_text: Yes most certainly, and I count all things to be loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus, my Lord, for whom I suffered the loss of all things, and count them nothing but refuse, that I may gain Christ

djk_text: Ne di mi mokisa libi anga Kelestesi so, meke mi nái teli ala fa Dyuweiti e leli mi moo fu meke mi kon de bun gi Masaa Gadu. Ma na mi biibi na a wooko di Kelestesi du namo tyai mi kon de bun kaba.
eng_text: and be found in him, not having a righteousness of my own, that which is of the law, but that which is through faith in Christ, the righteousness which is from God by faith;

djk_text: We, da mi o leli sabi Kelestesi, fu mokisa anga a taanga di Masaa Gadu teke weki en kon a libi ya baka. Ma soseefi a pina di a be teke doo fende fa a be teke dede seefi.
eng_text: that I may know him, and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, becoming conformed to his death;

djk_text: Da mi sa luku Masaa Gadu, fu weki miseefi komoto a dede kon a libi baka enke en.
eng_text: if by any means I may attain to the resurrection from the dead.

djk_text: Ma a ná enke mi doo peesi kaba. A ná enke mi kaba seeka enke fa Masaa Gadu wani mi de seefi. Ma mi e feti seefi fu de enke fa Kelestesi wani mi mu de seefi, di a kisi mi teke toon sama fi en.
eng_text: Not that I have already obtained, or am already made perfect; but I press on, if it is so that I may take hold of that for which also I was taken hold of by Christ Jesus.

djk_text: Biibiwan! We, tuutuu! Mi á kaba de fa Kelestesi wani mi mu de seefi. Ma na wan sani di mi poti fu du! Da mi nái sidon, ma mi e waka pasa ala san fika a mi baka, fu luku fesi san de fu du, da mi e du ala dati.
eng_text: Brothers, I don't regard myself as yet having taken hold, but one thing I do. Forgetting the things which are behind, and stretching forward to the things which are before,

djk_text: Na so mi o feti fu fende san mi wani wini enke paiman, fu go teke a Masaa Gadu Kondee a tapu. Bika na fu dati Masaa Gadu kai wi kon mokisa libi anga Kelestesi Jesesi.
eng_text: I press on toward the goal for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.

djk_text: We, da meke u ala di de fa Masaa Gadu wani, denki sani a fasi de. Fu kande son sama e denki sani taa fasi de, da a fika gi Masaa Gadu, fu meke a kon si a toli ya so.
eng_text: Let us therefore, as many as are perfect, think this way. If in anything you think otherwise, God will also reveal that to you.

djk_text: Ma winsi fa wan sama de seefi, na feti a mu feti go anga fesi doo, fu doo fa Masaa Gadu wani a mu de seefi.
eng_text: Nevertheless, to the extent that we have already attained, let us walk by the same rule. Let us be of the same mind.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Da teke a sowtu fasi fu mi de. Luku sama di e libi enke mi de tu, da teke dati so tu.
eng_text: Brothers, be imitators together of me, and note those who walk this way, even as you have us for an example.

djk_text: Bika taawan de ape e go doo anga a takuu sowtu libi. Dati e soi fa den na feyanti fu a wooko di Kelestesi du na a koloisi, fu puu wi a takuudu anga ogii. Mi be taigi u a sani ya kaba, ma mi e taki en ya baka anga ala gaan tyali seefi.
eng_text: For many walk, of whom I told you often, and now tell you even weeping, as the enemies of the cross of Christ,

djk_text: Den o fende sitaafu tego. Bika losutu fu den sikin e wooko enke basi a den tapu, enke na dati a Gadu fu dini. Da den nái sen fu a ogii fasi de, ma den e gafa seefi fu dati. Na so den e denki na a fasi fu goontapu di nái teli Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: whose end is destruction, whose god is the belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who think about earthly things.

djk_text: Bika wi dati na sama fu Masaa Gadu Kondee a tapu, di de u tuutuu tanpeesi. Da wi de ya e luku Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi fu komoto anda kon a wi, enke wi Yeepiman di puu wi a takuudu anga ogii.
eng_text: For our citizenship is in heaven, from where we also wait for a Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ;

djk_text: Da a o faandi wi sikin fu goontapu ya poti hii nyun sowtu fasi fu toon a sowtu dyendee sikin fi en, di meke fu tan a tapu anda. Na so a o wooko anga a gaan makiti fi en, di poi dwengi ala sani poti ne en ondoo.
eng_text: who will change the body of our humiliation to be conformed to the body of his glory, according to the working by which he is able even to subject all things to himself.

djk_text: We, biibiwan! Da u de a mi ati tuutuu, soseefi wan angii de fu kon miti u de baka. Bika u e piisii mi fa u e libi. Mi sa gafa u so. Ma, soseefi, da pakisei naamo san mi be sikiifi gi u kaba. Bika teke libi so o meke u taampu taanga a ini a biibi.
eng_text: Therefore, my brothers, beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, so stand firm in the Lord, my beloved.

djk_text: Ediya anga Sintika anda! Gaantangi, u tu uman de mu feti libi makandii enke sisa. Bika u tu na sama fu Masaa.
eng_text: I exhort Euodia, and I exhort Syntyche, to think the same way in the Lord.

djk_text: Sisikosi! Yu nen wani taki, wooko makandii. Da yeepi den tu uman de meke den fiti makandii baka. Bika den be yeepi mi wooko tyai sama kon biibi a Bun Nyunsu. Den be wooko makandii anga Kelemensi anga ibii taawan di be mokisa wooko makandii anga mi tu. Da sabi taki, Masaa Gadu sikiifi ala den nen makandii a tapu anda ne en buku fu libi.
eng_text: Yes, I beg you also, true yokefellow, help these women, for they labored with me in the Good News, with Clement also, and the rest of my fellow workers, whose names are in the book of life.

djk_text: U mu piisii ala yuu, fu di u mokisa libi anga Masaa. Wan toon moo mi e taki, u mu piisii!
eng_text: Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, "Rejoice!"

djk_text: Wooko switi anga ibii sowtu sama. A konbaka fu Masaa de koosube.
eng_text: Let your gentleness be known to all men. The Lord is at hand.

djk_text: Da noiti booko ede fu sani de. Ma begi fu dati. Soi san u fanowdu, da wanten de gi daa kaba, fu di u sabi fa a yeepi u anga dati kaba.
eng_text: In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.

djk_text: Da Masaa Gadu o meke u ati de switi fasi. Bika u abi fitoow a Kelestesi Jesesi, fu yeepi u. Da dati o meke Masaa Gadu koo u ati wan fasi di useefi á poi fusutan na a ten fu booko ede de.
eng_text: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Moo fala, da denki namo san de fu kai bun. Denki tuutuu sani. Denki sani di waiti fu soi lesipeki. Denki san de leti a libisama fesi doo Masaa Gadu seefi. Denki san de kiin fasi. Denki san e fiti sama. Denki san de fu gi gaandi.
eng_text: Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honorable, whatever things are just, whatever things are pure, whatever things are lovely, whatever things are of good report; if there is any virtue, and if there is any praise, think about these things.

djk_text: Wooko anga ala san mi be leli u kaba. U waka doo enke fa u be teke a leli ya. San u be yee a mi, soseefi fa u be si mi e waka. Da Masaa Gadu di e meke sama ati de switi fasi sa de anga u.
eng_text: The things which you learned, received, heard, and saw in me: do these things, and the God of peace will be with you.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Mi e gi Masaa gaantangi dise anga ala piisii. Bika baka langa, ma toku u soi mi ya baka fa u e angii fu yeepi mi a sani dise ete. Mi be sabi taki, u be wani yeepi mi so, ma na a okasi u á be fende de ete.
eng_text: But I rejoice in the Lord greatly, that now at length you have revived your thought for me; in which you did indeed take thought, but you lacked opportunity.

djk_text: Ma ná enke mi sidon ya anga nowtu seefi. Bika mi pasa ala sowtu libi, ne mi leli tifeedi anga san mi abi.
eng_text: Not that I speak in respect to lack, for I have learned in whatever state I am, to be content in it.

djk_text: Da mi de tifeedi sondee san mi fanowdu. Winsi san e miti mi, winsi pe mi de. Mi nyan fuu bee ofu mi de anga angii. Efu sani á sai mi ofu mi abi sani pasa peesi.
eng_text: I know how to be humbled, and I know also how to abound. In everything and in all things I have learned the secret both to be filled and to be hungry, both to abound and to be in need.

djk_text: Mi leli tifeedi ala fasi, fu di Kelestesi e gi mi taanga fu poi anga ala sani.
eng_text: I can do all things through Christ, who strengthens me.

djk_text: Ma toku u fiti de fu gafa, fu di u sende sani gi mi so, meke mi abi ala san mi fanowdu a ini mi banowtu ten ya.
eng_text: However you did well that you shared in my affliction.

djk_text: We, biibiwan a Filipi Foto de! U sabi enke fa miseefi sabi ya, fa na u anda namo be sende moni yeepi mi anga san mi be fanowdu di mi be de fu komoto a Masadoniya pisiwataa anda. Bika mi be kaba gi Masaa Gadu bosikopu de.
eng_text: You yourselves also know, you Philippians, that in the beginning of the Good News, when I departed from Macedonia, no assembly shared with me in the matter of giving and receiving but you only.

djk_text: Di mi be de a Tesalonika Foto seefi, u be yeepi mi. Na u wawan namo be e sende sani fu yeepi mi na a nowtu di mi be de, te doo somen leisi seefi.
eng_text: For even in Thessalonica you sent once and again to my need.

djk_text: A ná enke na a sani di u sende gi mi bigi gi mi so! Nono! Ma na a paiman di Masaa Gadu o dyunta moo anga moo gi u a tapu anda, fu san u du naamo de.
eng_text: Not that I seek for the gift, but I seek for the fruit that increases to your account.

djk_text: We, meke mi piki u taki, mi be kisi ala den gaan bun di u be sende gi Eipafoditesi tyai den doo a mi. Den be ipi pasa peesi. Masaa Gadu e si dati enke te Dyu kii wan bunbun meti boon gi en daa.
eng_text: But I have all things, and abound. I am filled, having received from Epaphroditus the things that came from you, a sweet-smelling fragrance, an acceptable and well-pleasing sacrifice to God.

djk_text: We, a Masaa Gadu di mi e dini ya na di abi ala gudu. Da a poi gi u, san u seefi abi fanowdu a wan gaan foondoo fasi di useefi á poti fusutan. Bika u na sama di mokisa libi anga Kelestesi.
eng_text: My God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.

djk_text: Da meke u gi u Tata, Masaa Gadu gaandi tego. Amen, na so a de!
eng_text: Now to our God and Father be the glory forever and ever! Amen.

djk_text: We, da bali odi doo ala sama di Masaa Gadu poti apaiti fasi, fu waka a Kelestesi Jesesi baka de. Biibiwan di e wooko makandii anga mi dise e sende bigi odi gi u.
eng_text: Greet every saint in Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me greet you.

djk_text: Ala sama di de apaiti fasi gi Masaa Gadu seefi e sende bigi odi. Moomoo, den biibiwan di e wooko na a paleisi, fu a moo gaan kownu a Loma Foto.
eng_text: All the saints greet you, especially those who are of Caesar's household.

djk_text: Da a fika fu Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi de anga u ala, fu tan teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku u. Amen, na so a de!
eng_text: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

djk_text: Mi Pawlesi ya na Masaa Gadu wani, ne a poti mi apaiti bosikopuman fu Kelestesi Jesesi. Na mi anga u biibi baala Timotiyesi e sikiifi a biifi ya.
eng_text: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother,

djk_text: A de gi u ala, di Masaa Gadu poti wan apaiti fasi a Kolose Foto anda anga biibiwan di poti fitoow doo, fu du san a Kelestesi taki. We, da meke u Tata, Masaa Gadu teke gaan bun ati fasi luku u de. Soseefi, meke u ati de switi.
eng_text: to the saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colossae: Grace to you and peace from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.

djk_text: We, ibii leisi wi dise e begi gi u anda, da wi e gi Masaa Gadu, a Tata fu wi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi, daa fu u ede.
eng_text: We give thanks to God the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,

djk_text: Bika wi e yee dise fa u anda poti taanga biibi a Kelestesi Jesesi. Soseefi, u yee fa u abi gaan lobi de fu ibii sama fu Masaa Gadu tu.
eng_text: having heard of your faith in Christ Jesus, and of the love which you have toward all the saints,

djk_text: We, fa u e libi de so, na fu di u poti biibi a Masaa Gadu, da u e luku fu fende bun di a paamisi sama di e teke en taki. Bika den di e du san a wani o fende ala dati a Masaa Gadu Kondee a tapu. U be yee a toli de kaba senten a dei di a tuutuu Bun Nyunsu fu Masaa Jesesi be doo u de.
eng_text: because of the hope which is laid up for you in the heavens, of which you heard before in the word of the truth of the Good News,

djk_text: We, na Masaa Gadu wookoman Eipafalasi kon gi u a bosikopu de. Na a seefi bosikopu di taa wookoman fu Masaa Gadu e paati nownow na ala se. Da moo sama e teke biibi ne en tu. Da den e kon sabi libi fiti Masaa Gadu enke san pasa a u de. Bika senten a dei useefi yee en, ne u kon e fusutan fa Masaa Gadu teke gaan bun ati fasi namo, fu luku u. Wi sabi dise taki, na Eipafalasi be leli u ala dati. We, enseefi na wan bun fitoow wookoman fu Kelestesi makandii anga wi dise, fu tyai yeepi gi u de. Na wan tuutuu lobi baala fu wi ya!
eng_text: which has come to you; even as it is in all the world and is bearing fruit and growing, as it does in you also, since the day you heard and knew the grace of God in truth;

djk_text: Namo Eipafalasi seefi kon taigi wi dise fa a si a Apaiti Jeje teke peesi e tii u de libi. Ne dati meke u kon abi gaan dipi lobi fu ibii taa sama fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: who also declared to us your love in the Spirit.

djk_text: We, senten a dei di u yee dati, da wi á puu dei ya ete, di wi nái begi gi u. Meke u fusutan sa opo moo anga moo, fu u moo sabi san Masaa Gadu wani. Soseefi fu u sa kisi moo leti koni, fu wooko. Ma soseefi tu, fu u sa si kiin, sowtu kengi lei sani abi anga den tuutuu sani fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: For this cause, we also, since the day we heard this, don't cease praying and making requests for you, that you may be filled with the knowledge of his will in all spiritual wisdom and understanding,

djk_text: Bika na den fasi de sa meke u waka fiti Masaa. Da u libi sa e piisii Masaa Gadu ala fasi. Dati wani taki, u tan du bun sani gi taawan. U feti moo anga moo, fu sabi Masaa Gadu wan leti fasi tu.
eng_text: that you may walk worthily of the Lord, to please him in all respects, bearing fruit in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of God;

djk_text: We, meke moo anga moo dyendee taanga fu Masaa Gadu teke peesi a u libi tu, fu u sa taampu moo taanga. Da sani á sa kon miti u, di sa poi moo u. Winsi san, ma toku u sa poi tei ati fu oli doo. Soseefi, u sa fudaagi ala sani.
eng_text: strengthened with all power, according to the might of his glory, for all endurance and perseverance with joy;

djk_text: Soseefi, gi Masaa Gadu, a Tata fu wi, daa anga ala piisii. Bika a teke u anda kon poti fu fende ala san a paamisi den sama fi en di a poti apaiti fasi. Den o fende a bun di de a ini a Nyun Tii, a Masaa Gadu Kondee di e beenki gaan dyendee fasi.
eng_text: giving thanks to the Father, who made us fit to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light;

djk_text: Bika a puu wi na a se fu dunguu a didibii ondoo, ne a tyai u kon poti na a Nyun Tii fu a lobi Manpikin fi en ondoo.
eng_text: who delivered us out of the power of darkness, and translated us into the Kingdom of the Son of his love;

djk_text: Bika a meke dati du wan gaan wooko di tyai yeepi gi wi, fu Masaa Gadu sa poi gi wi paadon fu wi takuudu anga ogii.
eng_text: in whom we have our redemption, the forgiveness of our sins;

djk_text: We, ná wan sama di sa si Masaa Gadu anga ain. Ma efi i si a Manpikin fi en, da na Masaa Gadu seefi i si de kaba. Ne na edeman fu ala sani di Masaa Gadu meke a goontapu.
eng_text: who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation.

djk_text: Bika ne en Masaa Gadu be sende meke ala sani. San ain poi si ya anga san ain á poi si doo a tapu seefi. Dati wani taki, sutuu fu sidon tii peesi anga gaan bigiman di sidon a tapu anga basi di e tii taawan anga makiti di hei ofu lagi moo taawan. Masaa Gadu Manpikin de a tapu fu ala, da den meke fu saka denseefi ne en ondoo gi en gaandi tu.
eng_text: For by him all things were created, in the heavens and on the earth, things visible and things invisible, whether thrones or dominions or principalities or powers; all things have been created through him, and for him.
