djk_text: A Manpikin ya be de kaba, fosi ala sani be meke. Ne en oli ala sani taampu a den peesi, meke den nái kaba a soso.
eng_text: He is before all things, and in him all things are held together.

djk_text: Ne enseefi na edeman fu Masaa Gadu kulu sama, di ai kai en sikin. Ne en meke den poi toon sama fi en, da ai gi den a libi di Masaa Gadu wani gi sama. Soseefi a de a fesi fu ala san meke taki, en fosi dede weki baka, da ai libi tego. We, da na ala fasi a teke fesi fu ala sani.
eng_text: He is the head of the body, the assembly, who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all things he might have the preeminence.

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu seefi fiti poti taki, ne enseefi teke peesi a ini a sikin di a Manpikin ya abi. Da ne en Masaa Gadu seefi de ape.
eng_text: For all the fullness was pleased to dwell in him;

djk_text: Soseefi Masaa Gadu seefi fiti poti, ne a sende en kon teke dede a koloisi, meke en buulu lon. Na so a pai fu sama takuudu anga ogii, fu tyai ala sani kon de bun gi Masaa Gadu baka. Dati wani taki, ala san de a ondoo goontapu ya anga Masaa Gadu Kondee a tapu seefi, kon de mati fasi anga en.
eng_text: and through him to reconcile all things to himself, by him, whether things on the earth, or things in the heavens, having made peace through the blood of his cross.

djk_text: Da yu de seefi be de tuutuu faawe fu Masaa Gadu. Bika yu be e libi feyanti fasi anga en. I be de anga takuu pakisei anga ala takuudu.
eng_text: You, being in past times alienated and enemies in your mind in your evil works,

djk_text: Ma nownow, da na hii taa fasi yu kon de. Masaa Gadu meke i toon mati fi en, ne i kon de bun gi enseefi. Bika Kelestesi teke dede a yu peesi. En boo be koti libisama fasi, fu meke yu kon de fa Masaa Gadu wani. Da yu taampu sondee kaagi a Masaa Gadu fesi, fu finga á sa poi soi a yu taki, yu abi fowtu.
eng_text: yet now he has reconciled in the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and without blemish and blameless before him,

djk_text: Na so! Ma taampu doo anga a biibi sondee pantan ne en bosikopu. Soseefi pasi á mu fende koli i kaba luku fu fende san Masaa Gadu paamisi sama di e teke en taki. U be yee dati kaba na a dei di sama be tyai a Bun Nyunsu kon gi u de. Ala wookoman fu Masaa Gadu di e dini en te doo mi Pawlesi ya seefi e gi dati na ala se fu goontapu.
eng_text: if it is so that you continue in the faith, grounded and steadfast, and not moved away from the hope of the Good News which you heard, which is being proclaimed in all creation under heaven; of which I, Paul, was made a servant.

djk_text: We, fu puu bun gi u anda, meke mi e teke sitaafu a dunguu osu ya. Da anga ala piisii. Bika ibii wookoman fu a Kelestesi musu teke pina sowan fasi, fu yeepi tyai a pina di en wookoman mu tyai ete a sikin buba, fu yeepi a hii kulu sama fi en. Da na fa a poti gi mi, na so mi e tyai ya, fu puu bun gi u enke sama fi anda. Bika sama fi en ne enseefi sikin.
eng_text: Now I rejoice in my sufferings for your sake, and fill up on my part that which is lacking of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body's sake, which is the assembly;

djk_text: We, mi toon wookoman fu den sama fu Masaa Gadu so, bika enseefi gi mi a wooko, fu soi u leti san Masaa Gadu fiti poti fu du gi u de, a ini en wowtu.
eng_text: of which I was made a servant, according to the stewardship of God which was given me toward you, to fulfill the word of God,

djk_text: Noiti a fesi a be soi sama a bosikopu ya ete. Da a be de wan kibii toli hii fositen te doo na a ten ya fosi, pe a fiti poti, fu tyai en kon a kiin gi sama fi en.
eng_text: the mystery which has been hidden for ages and generations. But now it has been revealed to his saints,

djk_text: Namo a poti dati a sama fi en ana, fu soi den foondoo sani di a fiti poti fu du. A bosikopu ya taki, a Kelestesi e teke peesi a ini yu enke taa foluku seefi. Da yuseefi de fu luku fu fende dyendee sani di Masaa Gadu paamisi en sama a Masaa Gadu Kondee.
eng_text: to whom God was pleased to make known what are the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory;

djk_text: We, da na fu a Kelestesi ya namo wi e taigi sama. Soseefi wi e wasikoi den, fu den á taanga yesi gi en. Wi e leli ibiiwan den sani fi en. Winsi sama den de. Wi e wooko anga a leti koni di u abi, fu leli. Da te a dei o doo fu taampu a Masaa Gadu fesi, da sama sa taampu de enke fa Masaa Gadu wani.
eng_text: whom we proclaim, admonishing every man and teaching every man in all wisdom, that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus;

djk_text: Na dati meke mi e naki sikin e tyotyo wooko so. Mi e feti taanga enke fa mi kan anga ala a kaakiti di Masaa Gadu gi mi, fu du a wooko fi en.
eng_text: for which I also labor, striving according to his working, which works in me mightily.

djk_text: We, mi e soi fa mi e wooko taanga, fu u mu sabi fa mi e tyotyo e meke moiti, fu yeepi u de. Soseefi, fu yeepi biibiwan a Laodiseya Foto anga ibii taa biibiwan, di noiti si mi fesi wan dei.
eng_text: For I desire to have you know how greatly I struggle for you, and for those at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;

djk_text: Ala dati na fu meke u ala taampu moo taanga a ini a biibi. Da sama á sa poi meke u lasi ati pantan ofu taanga yesi gi a bosikopu fu Masaa Gadu. Soseefi, fu meke u ala sa poi mokisa libi makandii enke wan, fu di u lobi useefi. Da u sa kon fusutan a hiihii bosikopu fu Masaa Gadu, di noiti a fesi a be tyai kon a kiin fosi a ten ya. Dati e taki fu Kelestesi.
eng_text: that their hearts may be comforted, they being knit together in love, and gaining all riches of the full assurance of understanding, that they may know the mystery of God, both of the Father and of Christ,

djk_text: Bika ne en wawan namo poi gi sama a leti koni fu fusutan sani fu Masaa Gadu, di a wani sama mu sabi.
eng_text: in whom are all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge hidden.

djk_text: Mi taki a sani ya, fu u á meke sama koli u kisi anga den switi toli toli fu den.
eng_text: Now this I say that no one may delude you with persuasiveness of speech.

djk_text: Bika mi á de a u mindii de libisama fasi. Ma mi hii ati de a u anda. Da jeje fasi mi de ape. Soseefi mi e piisii fu e yee u e libi fiti anga useefi de enke tuutuu biibi famii. Mi e yee tu, fa u tan poti fitoow a Kelestesi sondee pantan.
eng_text: For though I am absent in the flesh, yet am I with you in the spirit, rejoicing and seeing your order, and the steadfastness of your faith in Christ.

djk_text: We, fa u teke fu biibi Kelestesi Jesesi de, da na fu meke a wooko enke gaan Masaa a u tapu. Da tan teke fu waka fiti fa ai taki, fu mokisa libi anga en.
eng_text: As therefore you received Christ Jesus, the Lord, walk in him,

djk_text: Dati wani taki, tan taampu anga san i be yee fi en a bigin fu a biibi. Meke dati goo sowan fasi kon moo taanga. Da noiti pantan anga a biibi fi en bosikopu di u be teke leli. Da u e gi en daa naamo fu a biibi libi ya.
eng_text: rooted and built up in him, and established in the faith, even as you were taught, abounding in it in thanksgiving.

djk_text: Da luku bun taki, sama á fende pasi koli u tyai go fasi poti a den ondoo, fu wooko enke basi a u tapu. Bika den o leli u lawlaw denki di libisama seefi abi fu dini Masaa Gadu. Soseefi, fu oli kina anga fasi di sama seefi meke fu libi. Ma den á de fa a Kelestesi poti fu waka.
eng_text: Be careful that you don't let anyone rob you through his philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the elements of the world, and not after Christ.

djk_text: Bika a hii sani seefi taki, Masaa Gadu teke libisama fasi anga sikin buba, saka kon toon wan libisama. A sama de na a Kelestesi.
eng_text: For in him all the fullness of the Godhead dwells bodily,

djk_text: A makiti moo ala sowtu basi di e tii taawan anga makiti di hei ofu lagi moo taawan. We, da yu mokisa libi anga en, meke yu doo peesi enke sama di sabi Masaa Gadu, fu libi fiti en.
eng_text: and in him you are made full, who is the head of all principality and power;

djk_text: Dati wani taki, yu mokisa libi anga Kelestesi. Ne a puu yu na a libi pe losutu fu sikin be e wooko enke basi a yu tapu, fu kon toon sama fi en. Dati na wan sowtu maiki di kengi anga fa Dyusama dati be e koti maiki, fu toon sama fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: in whom you were also circumcised with a circumcision not made with hands, in the putting off of the body of the sins of the flesh, in the circumcision of Christ;

djk_text: Ma yu dati dopu go a ondoo wataa taki, na mokisa dede beli a ondoo doti anga en. Di i opo komoto a ini a wataa na mokisa opo kon a libi ya baka anga en, fu teke wan hii nyun sowtu libi. Bika yu biibi Masaa Gadu makiti fu puu yu a takuudu anga ogii gi libi enke fa a be gi a Kelestesi baka di a be dede.
eng_text: having been buried with him in baptism, in which you were also raised with him through faith in the working of God, who raised him from the dead.

djk_text: We, luku fa dati pasa anga yu. Bika fosi i be teke biibi, da yu be e boo, ma yu be e teli fu dedewan. Bika yu á be de sama fu Masaa Gadu di sabi libi fa a wani. Da yu á be e teke en taki. Yu be e waka a ini takuudu anga ogii. Ma toku, ne Masaa Gadu gi yu wan hii nyun sowtu libi mokisa anga a Kelestesi. Soseefi paadon, fu yu takuudu anga ogii.
eng_text: You were dead through your trespasses and the uncircumcision of your flesh. He made you alive together with him, having forgiven us all our trespasses,

djk_text: We, takuudu anga ogii fu wi, da Masaa Gadu weiti e bali wi fu dati. Ai soi wi taki, na taanga yesi gi en, fu fende sitaafu. Da ala dati be e sikiifi a buku e poti de. Ma di a Kelestesi dede, meke a puu a hii buku de fiingi towe. I sa taki, a mokisa en naki kii anga a Kelestesi na a koloisi.
eng_text: wiping out the handwriting in ordinances which was against us; and he has taken it out of the way, nailing it to the cross;

djk_text: Na so a booko a hii makiti fu basi di e tii taawan anga makiti di hei ofu lagi moo taawan saka. Den naki gaan sen na ala lanti fesi. Bika den si a gaanbigi fasi di a Kelestesi wini den na a koloisi, te enke hii goontapu doo tapu anda seefi si.
eng_text: having stripped the principalities and the powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it.

djk_text: We, da tapu yesi gi sama di e kaagi u fu kande u nyan son sani ofu diingi son sani. U oli son fesa ofu fesa fu son mun. U nái oli a kina dei fu Dyusama.
eng_text: Let no one therefore judge you in eating, or in drinking, or with respect to a feast day or a new moon or a Sabbath day,

djk_text: Bika a tuutuu sani seefi na a Kelestesi. Den taa sani di waka ne en fesi de na fu be leli Dyusama fa en enke tuutuu sani di o kon seefi tan. Ne den waka ne en fesi enke fa kaaka fu sani e kai fosi a sani seefi doo.
eng_text: which are a shadow of the things to come; but the body is Christ's.

djk_text: Da kaba aliki sama di e taki, yu ná o fende Masaa Gadu paamisi. Bika yu nái dini Masaa Gadu enke fa ai denki. Soseefi yu nái waka fa ai leli fu taawan wooko enke basi a yu tapu. Yu nái teke en leli fu begi den Engel tu. A taki, a si jeje sani fu Masaa Gadu enke ai deen, da yu nái teke tu. Bika na hei membee meke a sama de e denki taki, a sabi dini Masaa Gadu moo taawan, enke fa en takuu ati e soi en.
eng_text: Let no one rob you of your prize by a voluntary humility and worshipping of the angels, dwelling in the things which he has not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,

djk_text: Da a leli di dati e gi á de fa a tuutuu bosikopu fu a Kelestesi de. Bika na a taki fu disi namo u mu teke enke edeman fu leli sama fi en, moo anga moo fu sabi Masaa Gadu. Soseefi fu kon fusutan en bosikopu moo anga moo fiti en. Bika na ede e oli sikin tei ala sukuufu miti, fu a sa goo, da ai si san a hii sikin abi fanowdu fu libi.
eng_text: and not holding firmly to the Head, from whom all the body, being supplied and knit together through the joints and ligaments, grows with God's growth.

djk_text: Bika u teke biibi mokisa dede anga a Kelestesi, da u ná abi fu teke kina anga fasi oli suku yeepi moo enke sama a goontapu di á sabi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: If you died with Christ from the elements of the world, why, as though living in the world, do you subject yourselves to ordinances,

djk_text: Bika den weiti e soi san mofu á mu tesi seefi. San ana á mu oli seefi. San finga á mu nama seefi.
eng_text: Don't handle, nor taste, nor touch

djk_text: Ma ala den sani de na bunbun sani di Masaa Gadu meke fu sama teke wooko. Te i wooko anga den seefi, da den nái de fu si moo, meke a á fanowdu fu tapu sama a den sowtu sani de. Bika na sama seefi meke den weiti de e leli taawan.
eng_text: (all of which perish with use), according to the precepts and doctrines of men?

djk_text: Da taawan e si den falisi leliman de enke den abi leti koni. Bika ai soi enke na tuu, fu leli sama meke taawan wooko enke basi a den tapu. Soseefi fu poti sikin teke pina. Ma den sani de nái yeepi, fu meke sama wooko enke basi dwengi losutu fi en sikin. Ma na meke ai meke sama keli enseefi hei moo taawan seefi.
eng_text: Which things indeed appear like wisdom in self-imposed worship, and humility, and severity to the body; but aren't of any value against the indulgence of the flesh.

djk_text: Ma efu yu mokisa libi anga a Kelestesi tuu, da i mokisa dede weki anga en baka a wan hii nyun sowtu libi. Da poti denki suku san e teli fu gaan sani a Masaa Gadu Kondee. Bika na tapu anda a Kelestesi sidon a Masaa Gadu letise, fu fende gaandi.
eng_text: If then you were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God.

djk_text: Da si san ai teli fu gaan sani anda, fu gaan sani ya tu. Ma kaba feti a goontapu sani ya baka.
eng_text: Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth.

djk_text: Bika yu mokisa dede na a koloisi anga a Kelestesi, meke i kaba anga takuudu anga ogii ya tu. Da goontapu ya seefi á de yu tuutuu tanpeesi. Bika na Masaa Gadu a tapu anda yu mokisa libi makandii anga a Kelestesi.
eng_text: For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.

djk_text: Ne en namo poi gi sama a libi fu Masaa Gadu Kondee a tapu di á de fu si a goontapu ya. Ma a dei di a o kon baka, da a o de fu si a yu, fu meke yu mokisa fende gaandi anga en.
eng_text: When Christ, our life, is revealed, then you will also be revealed with him in glory.

djk_text: We, da kaba libi enke fa sikin e fii fu du sani, enke sama a goontapu di á sabi Masaa Gadu. Kaba anga waka libi. Kaba anga motyo fasi fu sikin. Kaba anga fafa ati fu sani. Kaba anga takuu losutu. Kaba anga giili ati fu sani, di e teli enke yu teke falisi gadu e dini.
eng_text: Put to death therefore your members which are on the earth: sexual immorality, uncleanness, depraved passion, evil desire, and covetousness, which is idolatry;

djk_text: Da Masaa Gadu ati e faya a den sowtu sama de, fu gi den sitaafu.
eng_text: for which things' sake the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.

djk_text: Bika na fosi i be toon biibisama, ne i be de a sowtu sama anga takuudu.
eng_text: You also once walked in those, when you lived in them;

djk_text: Ma nownow, da kaba den sowtu ogii fasi ya tu. Kaba boon ati fasi. Poi fu dwengi atiboon fasi. Kaba du ogii, meke taawan fii. Kaba taki sani ati taawan. Kaba kosi taawan gi sen.
eng_text: but now you also put them all away: anger, wrath, malice, slander, and shameful speaking out of your mouth.

djk_text: Kaba lei. Bika yu komoto a ini a fasi di i be de fosi.
eng_text: Don't lie to one another, seeing that you have put off the old man with his doings,

djk_text: I teke fu toon wan hii nyun sowtu sama di meke fu goo kon tan enke fa Masaa Gadu seefi de. Soseefi fu kon fusutan fa Masaa Gadu de.
eng_text: and have put on the new man, who is being renewed in knowledge after the image of his Creator,

djk_text: We, ibii sama di toon a hii nyun sowtu sama, da na a seefi Kelestesi teke peesi a ibiiwan fu den. Da den nái teli moo taki, disi na Dyu ofu dati á de Dyu. Disi koti maiki a manpeesi toon Dyusama ofu dati á koti. Disi na doose kondee sama ofu dati na bakabusi sama. Disi na saafu a katibo ofu dati na fii sama sondee katibo. Kweti!
eng_text: where there can't be Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, bondservant, freeman; but Christ is all, and in all.

djk_text: We, Masaa Gadu poti yu wan apaiti fasi toon sama di a lobi tuutuu. Da teke booko ede fu taawan. Wooko switi anga taawan. Noiti si yuseefi hei moo taawan. Ná suku wini fi yu wawan namo. Teke pasensi anga taawan.
eng_text: Put on therefore, as God's chosen ones, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and perseverance;

djk_text: Fudaagi taawan. Pakisei fa Masaa Gadu gi yu paadon, da paadon taawan so tu.
eng_text: bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you, so you also do.

djk_text: A moo gaan sani fu du a ini ala dati na fu wooko anga lobi fu taawan. Bika lobi sa tei u mokisa, fu poi libi makandii.
eng_text: Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection.

djk_text: Soseefi, da feti fu de switi makandii doo anga useefi. A Kelestesi gi u a taanga fu dati. Na so Masaa Gadu kai u kon poti enke wan sikin, fu wooko. Da tan sowan fasi e gi Masaa Gadu daa naamo, fu ala san ai du gi u.
eng_text: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body; and be thankful.

djk_text: Feti fu sabi Masaa Gadu bosikopu fu a Kelestesi, da tyai yuseefi so. Dati wani taki, teke leti koni wooko fu leli anga wasikoi taawan, fu fusutan. Wooko anga san sikiifi a Psalm singi buku, fu meke singi fu singi. Ibii taa sowtu singi di e gafa Masaa Gadu tu. Singi di Masaa Gadu Jeje poti a u ati tu. Singi ibii yuu anga u hii ati gi Masaa Gadu, fu gi en daa, fi en gaan bun fasi.
eng_text: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord.

djk_text: Soseefi winsi san yu e du, winsi san yu e taki, meke a de fu Masaa Jesesi ede. Da gi u Tata, Masaa Gadu daa ibii yuu, fu a wooko di dati du gi u.
eng_text: Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father, through him.

djk_text: Biibi uman! Saka a yu man ondoo. Teke en taki. Bika na dati fiti uman di e libi gi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi.
eng_text: Wives, be in subjection to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.

djk_text: Man! U mu lobi u uman tuutuu fasi! Da u á mu libi goofu anga a uman.
eng_text: Husbands, love your wives, and don't be bitter against them.

djk_text: Biibi pikin mu teke en gaansama taki ala fasi! Bika ai switi gi Masaa fu si sama de fi en tan so.
eng_text: Children, obey your parents in all things, for this pleases the Lord.

djk_text: Dada fu pikin á mu du anga a pikin te, fu bita a pikin ati. Bika dati sa meke a pikin lasi ati a ini san de fu du.
eng_text: Fathers, don't provoke your children, so that they won't be discouraged.

djk_text: Biibiwan di de saafu a katibo mu teke taki ala fasi fi en gaan masaa di de libisama fasi ya. A ná te en ain de a yu tapu namo enke na sama ati yu wani switi. Bika wooko anga yu hii ati fu di na wi Masaa ati yu wani switi.
eng_text: Servants, obey in all things those who are your masters according to the flesh, not just when they are looking, as men pleasers, but in singleness of heart, fearing God.

djk_text: Da winsi san yu e du, da du en bun enke fa yu poi. A ná sama yu e wooko gi. Ma na wi Masaa seefi.
eng_text: And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord, and not for men,

djk_text: Bika sabi taki, na Masaa Gadu seefi o pai yu fiti fa yu wooko. Na so ibii sama yu wooko enke fa a wani o fende bun di a paamisi fu gi. Da wooko de taki na gi wi Masaa di de a Kelestesi.
eng_text: knowing that from the Lord you will receive the reward of the inheritance; for you serve the Lord Christ.

djk_text: Ma sabi soseefi taki, efu wan sama tan du ogii, winsi sama a yu, Masaa Gadu o sitaafu yu fiti yu ogii. Denki soseefi taki, Masaa Gadu nái keli sama hei moo sama. Da ai kuutu ibiiwan anga leti fu gi san fiti dati.
eng_text: But he who does wrong will receive again for the wrong that he has done, and there is no partiality.

djk_text: We, da meke gaan masaa di de biibisama mu wooko bun anga saafu fu den. Gi den san den fanowdu. Pakisei fa yuseefi abi wan gaan Masaa a tapu, fu teke dati taki tu.
eng_text: Masters, give to your servants that which is just and equal, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.

djk_text: We, tan anga begi naamo. Da de anga ain e waki luku. Da wanten de gi Masaa Gadu seefi daa kaba fi en yeepi.
eng_text: Continue steadfastly in prayer, watching therein with thanksgiving;

djk_text: Moomoo, da begi gi mi, meke pasi sa opo fu taki san Masaa Gadu fiti poti fu du gi sama di a sende fu a Kelestesi. Bika na wan bosikopu di noiti a fesi a be soi sama wanten, meke a be de wan kibii toli hii fositen te doo na a ten ya. Ne a poti dati a mi ana, fu tyai kon a kiin gi sama. Na fu dati ede den kisi mi sooto ya.
eng_text: praying together for us also, that God may open to us a door for the word, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds;

djk_text: Da begi fu mi sa poi opo den sama ain, fu si fa a hii toli ya de seefi. Meke den sa si tu fa na Masaa Gadu seefi fiti poti fu wooko so. Bika na mi wooko fu tyai a toli ya kon a kiin.
eng_text: that I may reveal it as I ought to speak.

djk_text: Waka anga leti koni fu wooko a mindii fu sama di nái biibi. De sete sete, fu gaapu ibii okasi di kon fu taki anga den.
eng_text: Walk in wisdom toward those who are outside, redeeming the time.

djk_text: Tyai a taki ya wan piisii fasi fu den sama sa wani aliki. Ala disi sa meke yuseefi leli taki anga sama di wani sabi saide yu abi a biibi di yu abi.
eng_text: Let your speech always be with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.

djk_text: We, mi o sende Tikikesi kon luku u de, fu soi fa ala sani didon a mi dise. Na mi lobi baala, soseefi fitoow wookoman na a wooko makandii anga mi ya.
eng_text: All my affairs will be made known to you by Tychicus, the beloved brother, faithful servant, and fellow bondservant in the Lord.

djk_text: Na dati meke mi sende en, fu kon luku u anda. Da a sa taigi u fa ala sani didon anga wi dise. A o koo u ati anda tu, fu kaba pantan gi wi dise.
eng_text: I am sending him to you for this very purpose, that he may know your circumstances and comfort your hearts,

djk_text: Mi o sende makandii anga u paandasi sama anda den e kai Onesimesi. Bika a de wan fitoow wookoman na a wooko makandii anga mi ya. Mi lobi enseefi tuutuu tu. Den tu man ya o kon taigi u anda fa ala sani e waka dise.
eng_text: together with Onesimus, the faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will make known to you everything that is going on here.

djk_text: Alestakesi bali u anda bigi odi. A de a dunguu osu ya anga mi. Maakusi enke tyuku famii fu Balnabasi seefi e bali odi. Mi be taki kaba, efu a kon luku u anda, da puu en a boto bun, meke a sa fii switi a u mindii de.
eng_text: Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, greets you, and Mark, the cousin of Barnabas (concerning whom you received commandments, "if he comes to you, receive him"),

djk_text: Soseefi Yestesi di nen Jesesi tu, sende bigi odi gi u de. Tuu, fu biibi Dyusama di e waka wooko anga mi dise, da na den dii kodo man di mi kai pasa de namo. Wi e paati a leli di e taki fu a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu. Fu tuu, den gi mi koo ati ya.
eng_text: and Jesus who is called Justus. These are my only fellow workers for the Kingdom of God who are of the circumcision, men who have been a comfort to me.

djk_text: We, odi komoto ya fu Eipafalasi, di seefi e wooko gi Kelestesi Jesesi. U sabi en taki, a de wan paandasi sama fu u anda. A nái tapu begi Masaa Gadu ya anga en hii ati gi u anda, meke u sa taampu anga biibi doo sondee pantan. Soseefi, fu u sa de ala fa Masaa Gadu wani. Da u sa de fa a wani sama mu de seefi, sondee fu poi seke seke.
eng_text: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, salutes you, always striving for you in his prayers, that you may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.

djk_text: Bika Eipafalasi e booko ede ya, da ai feti fa a poi, fu yeepi u. Soseefi yeepi biibisama fu Laodiseya Foto anga biibiwan fu Hiyelapolesi Foto tu. Mi sa taki, Eipafalasi tan so tuu, bika na mi seefi ain e si ya fa ai feti so tuu.
eng_text: For I testify about him, that he has great zeal for you, and for those in Laodicea, and for those in Hierapolis.

djk_text: We, u sabi dataa Lukasi anda enke wi tuutuu lobi baala. Ai sende bigi odi ya tu. Demasi seefi sende odi gi u.
eng_text: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas greet you.

djk_text: Mi e sende u anda seefi taki, u gi odi doo den biibiwan fu Laodiseya Foto. U gi odi doo a uman den e kai Nimfa a Laodiseya Foto de. U gi odi go doo ala taa biibiwan di e miti begi makandii na a uman de osu.
eng_text: Greet the brothers who are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the assembly that is in his house.

djk_text: Moo fala, mi e sende u anda wan sani ete! Leisi a biifi ya a mindii fu ala taa biibiwan a Kolose Foto de, meke den yee. Tyai en go doo biibiwan fu Laodiseya Foto tu, fu fende leisi. Mi be sende wan biifi gi den dati, meke den gi u fu Kolose Foto dati fu leisi tu.
eng_text: When this letter has been read among you, cause it to be read also in the assembly of the Laodiceans; and that you also read the letter from Laodicea.

djk_text: Gaantangi, gi Alikepesi a bosikopu ya taki, meke a du a wooko di Masaa Gadu poti ne en ana, go doo.
eng_text: Tell Archippus, "Take heed to the ministry which you have received in the Lord, that you fulfill it."

djk_text: Mi Pawlesi ya seefi teke a sikiifi tiki nownow ya, fu sikiifi bali u bigi odi anda. U á mu feegete taki, mi de a dunguu osu ya! U tan begi gi mi, fu a pisiten di mi de ya. Meke Masaa Gadu teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku u anda.
eng_text: The salutation of me, Paul, with my own hand: remember my bonds. Grace be with you. Amen.

djk_text: Mi Pawlesi anga Silfanas anga Timotiyesi e sikiifi a biifi ya sende gi a hii kulu Tesalonika biibiwan, di de sama fu u Tata Masaa Gadu anga Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi anda. Meke Masaa Gadu teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku u de. Soseefi, meke u ati de switi.
eng_text: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

djk_text: We, te wi de makandii e begi, da wi e pakisei u anda. Da wi e gi Masaa Gadu daa fu u anda ede, te ná sipowtu.
eng_text: We always give thanks to God for all of you, mentioning you in our prayers,

djk_text: Bika wi sabi fa a biibi libi fu u e puu wini gi taawan. Bika u lobi taawan. Soseefi, u oli biibi doo, fu tan luku wi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi. Fa u de so bun! Bika u sabi libi a u Tata, Masaa Gadu, fesi.
eng_text: remembering without ceasing your work of faith and labor of love and patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, before our God and Father.

djk_text: We, lobi biibiwan! Wi sabi fu tuu taki, na Masaa Gadu seefi teke u anda toon sama fi enseefi. Bika a lobi u tuutuu.
eng_text: We know, brothers loved by God, that you are chosen,

djk_text: Bika u teke a Bun Nyunsu di wi ya e tyai. Ma u á teke dati soso fu a taki fu wi wawan. Ma na Masaa Gadu seefi soi u en taanga anga den foondoo sani di a du. Soseefi en Jeje piki u ati taki, a hii bosikopu fi en na tuu. Soseefi fa wi dise be waka bun anda, meke u be sa si a wi fa fu libi.
eng_text: and that our Good News came to you not in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Spirit, and with much assurance. You know what kind of men we showed ourselves to be among you for your sake.

djk_text: Na so u kon tiiki Masaa Jesesi anga wi ya anga libi tuutuu. Bika gaan banowtu kon a u tapu anda tu, fu a bosikopu fu Masaa Gadu ede. Ma toku, ne u teke a bosikopu anga ala gaan piisii, di a Apaiti Jeje e gi sama.
eng_text: You became imitators of us, and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Spirit,

djk_text: Da ibii taa biibiwan fu a pisiwataa fu Masadoniya anda, anga a pisi fu Akasi dise seefi e luku u anda fu si, fa fu tyai denseefi.
eng_text: so that you became an example to all who believe in Macedonia and in Achaia.

djk_text: Na so u anda toon sama di e soi taawan, fa Masaa Gadu e tyai yeepi. A ná sama fu a hii pisiwataa fu Masadoniya anda anga a hii pisi fu Akasi dise wawan sabi so. Ma u nen bali na ala taa peesi, fa u poti tuutuu biibi a Masaa Gadu. Da wi ya ná abi fu taki dati moo,
eng_text: For from you the word of the Lord has been declared, not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith toward God has gone out; so that we need not to say anything.

djk_text: bika den sama seefi e taki kaba. Den e taki, fa u anda be puu wi ya a boto bun anda. Soseefi, u daai fika a dini fu falisi gadu anda, go dini Masaa Gadu seefi. Ne u toon sama now di e dini a tuutuu Masaa Gadu di e libi tego.
eng_text: For they themselves report concerning us what kind of a reception we had from you; and how you turned to God from idols, to serve a living and true God,

djk_text: Namo, ne u sidon e luku en Manpikin, di a weki puu a dede, fu komoto a Masaa Gadu Kondee a tapu anda kon baka. Na a seefi Jesesi de puu wi a ini fa Masaa Gadu o kuutu libisama anga ala gaan atiboon, fu ogii di den e du.
eng_text: and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead--Jesus, who delivers us from the wrath to come.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Fa u sabi, da fa wi dise be waka kon a u anda á komoto fu soso.
eng_text: For you yourselves know, brothers, our visit to you wasn't in vain,

djk_text: Fosi wi be kon anda, da sama be du ogii anga wi a Filipi Foto seefi. Fa u sabi, da den poli wi nen ala sowtu fasi, fu booko wi saka. Ma toku Masaa Gadu be gi wi taanga sikin, fu poi kon doo u anda anga en Bun Nyunsu.
eng_text: but having suffered before and been shamefully treated, as you know, at Philippi, we grew bold in our God to tell you the Good News of God in much conflict.

djk_text: Da wi be fende kankan fu wooko so, fu di na wan bunbun sani wi tyai kon gi de. Bika a ná wan bosikopu fu koli u anda kisi. Soseefi, a á de wan sani fu fende wini a u anda tapu wan fasi di á fiti.
eng_text: For our exhortation is not of error, nor of uncleanness, nor in deception.

djk_text: Kweti! Ma na Masaa Gadu luku wi, te a kaba. Ne a fitoow wi fu sende taki a Bun Nyunsu ya. Da na fa a wani wi e taki en, ma u nái puubei taki en fa libisama wani. Masaa Gadu seefi e keli wi ati luku. Da a sa kotoigi fu dati taki, na tuu.
eng_text: But even as we have been approved by God to be entrusted with the Good News, so we speak; not as pleasing men, but God, who tests our hearts.

djk_text: Ma u anda seefi sabi taki, noiti wi dise e tyai a bosikopu fu Masaa Gadu enke koliman. Noiti wi e suku fu koli sama kisi poti a wi ondoo. Wi nái wooko tu, fu fende wini a sama tapu wan fasi di á fiti. Masaa Gadu seefi e si, fu kotoigi fu dati taki, na tuu.
eng_text: For neither were we at any time found using words of flattery, as you know, nor a cloak of covetousness (God is witness),

djk_text: U sabi anda kaba tu taki, wi dise nái suku gafa a sama, fu a wooko di wi e du ya. U anda seefi, wi nái suku gafa, te go taki taa sama. Ma wi ya be sa pee bigiman! Bika wi na apaiti bosikopuman fu Kelestesi.
eng_text: nor seeking glory from men (neither from you nor from others), when we might have claimed authority as apostles of Christ.

djk_text: Ma nono! Pe fu pee bigiman, ne wi wooko switi makandii fasi anga u anda. Wi be solugu u anda enke fa wan mma e luku en pikin di a meke.
eng_text: But we were gentle among you, like a nursing mother cherishes her own children.

djk_text: Na lobi wi dise lobi u anda bigi so! Na dati meke wi kon gi u anda a Bun Nyunsu di Masaa Gadu sende wi, fu taki. Ma a ná taki namo, da a kaba. Wi hii libi seefi wi poti fu yeepi u anda, di de a wi ya ati tuutuu.
eng_text: Even so, affectionately longing for you, we were well pleased to impart to you, not the Good News of God only, but also our own souls, because you had become very dear to us.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Bika pakisei baka, di wi be de a u anda. Luku fa wi be wooko taanga dei anga neti fu solugu useefi. Bika wi á be wani de wan ibi a u anda tapu, anga a wooko di Masaa Gadu sende wi, fu taki a Bun Nyunsu.
eng_text: For you remember, brothers, our labor and travail; for working night and day, that we might not burden any of you, we preached to you the Good News of God.

djk_text: Masaa Gadu anga u anda seefi sa kotoigi fu dati taki, na tuu. Bika u sabi fa wi dise hii libi be de fiti Masaa Gadu. Fa wi be wooko leti anga ibiiwan a u mindii anda. Fa wi á be gi sama olo fu kaagi wi anga leti. Na so wi be tyai wiseefi anga a biibi anda.
eng_text: You are witnesses with God, how holy, righteously, and blamelessly we behaved ourselves toward you who believe.

djk_text: Fa u sabi anda, da wi dise be wooko anga ibii biibiwan anda enke fa wan dda e luku en eigi pikin.
eng_text: As you know, we exhorted, comforted, and implored every one of you, as a father does his own children,

djk_text: Wi be e taigi ibii wan anda sani, fu gi u taanga sikin a ini a biibi. Fu meke u á pantan, a gaan banowtu ten. Wi be e feti anga u anda naamo, fu tan libi piisii Masaa Gadu. Bika ne en kai u kon poti a ini a Nyun Tii fi en fu fende a dyendee di enseefi abi.
eng_text: to the end that you should walk worthily of God, who calls you into his own Kingdom and glory.

djk_text: We, da wi dise e tan gi Masaa Gadu daa, fu fa u anda teke en bosikopu sowan fasi. Bika u teke dati enke na Masaa Gadu seefi mofu taki. Ma u á si en enke na libisama taki. We, tuutuu, na Masaa Gadu bosikopu. Bika u seefi si on taanga a wooko a u ati anda.
eng_text: For this cause we also thank God without ceasing, that, when you received from us the word of the message of God, you accepted it not as the word of men, but, as it is in truth, the word of God, which also works in you who believe.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Bika luku fa u anda tiiki den kulu sama fu Masaa Gadu di e biibi Kelestesi Jesesi a Judeja pisiwataa. Bika san be pasa anga den pasa anga u anda seefi tu taki, Dyusama di nái biibi be lon du ogii anga den. Na so sama fu u paandasi anda, di nái biibi du anga u tu.
eng_text: For you, brothers, became imitators of the assemblies of God which are in Judea in Christ Jesus; for you also suffered the same things from your own countrymen, even as they did from the Jews;

djk_text: We, a ná a tide Dyusama bigin wooko so anga sama. Bika pakisei fa den fositen apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu. Taade ya, ne den kii Masaa Jesesi tu. Nownow seefi, den e lon du ogii anga wi tu. Den nái wooko bun anga sama. Da dati nái piisii Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: who killed both the Lord Jesus and their own prophets, and drove us out, and didn't please God, and are contrary to all men;

djk_text: Bika den e puubei ala sowtu fasi fu tapu wi anga a bosikopu, fu soi taa foluku di á de Dyusama, a yeepi di Masaa Gadu tyai. We, da a ogii fu den go doo wan peesi pe Masaa Gadu ati boon, fu gi den wan gaan sitaafu.
eng_text: forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they may be saved; to fill up their sins always. But wrath has come on them to the uttermost.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Na wan pisiten kaba, di wi dise be mu komoto wan sowtu fasi a u anda mindii. Ma u á feegete u! Bika winsi wi dise ain nái si u anda moo, ma toku wi ya ati de a u anda ete. Da wan angii de a wi fu miti fesi a fesi baka.
eng_text: But we, brothers, being bereaved of you for a short season, in presence, not in heart, tried even harder to see your face with great desire,

djk_text: Da wi be fiti mofu ya kaba, fu kon luku u anda baka. Mi Pawlesi ya, na moo enke wan leisi mi puubei fu kon kaba. Ma nono! Saatan, a didibii e tapu a pasi gi wi, fu kon.
eng_text: because we wanted to come to you--indeed, I, Paul, once and again--but Satan hindered us.

djk_text: Bika na u anda e gi wi ya piisii fu luku a dei fu wi Masaa Jesesi kon. Da u anda o taampu anga wi ne en fesi, meke wi sa poi gafa taki, a wooko di wi be du, puu wini.
eng_text: For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Isn't it even you, before our Lord Jesus at his coming?

djk_text: Fu tuu, da na u anda e gi wi dise gaandi anga piisii! Bika na u na a hei anga a piisii fu wi dise.
eng_text: For you are our glory and our joy.

djk_text: Na so meke wi dise á poi tei en moo fu tan luku namo. Ne wi fiti taki, wi dati o fika a baka na Atena Foto.
eng_text: Therefore when we couldn't stand it any longer, we thought it good to be left behind at Athens alone,

djk_text: Ma u sabi Timotiyesi di wi ya o sende kon anda. Na wi biibi baala di e wooko makandii anga wi gi Masaa Gadu, fu bali a Bun Nyunsu. A sa kon gi u anda taanga sikin. A sa taigi u fu oli biibi doo.
eng_text: and sent Timothy, our brother and God's servant in the Good News of Christ, to establish you, and to comfort you concerning your faith;

djk_text: Bika wi á wani biibiwan mu fuka anga banowtu te, da dati meke a daai baka gi a biibi. Bika fa u sabi, da fii banowtu fu a biibi, na wan sani di fiti fa Masaa Gadu taki sani mu waka.
eng_text: that no one be moved by these afflictions. For you know that we are appointed to this task.

djk_text: Wi dise seefi be taigi u anda kaba, di wi be de anda taki, banowtu o kon a wi ala tapu fu a biibi ede. Na dati e pasa anga wi ala kaba, enke fa u be sabi a fesi.
eng_text: For most certainly, when we were with you, we told you beforehand that we are to suffer affliction, even as it happened, and you know.

djk_text: Na dati ede meke wi be sende Timotiyesi kon a u anda. Da a be sa luku fa sani e go, efu u oli a biibi anda ete. Bika wi á poi tan langa moo, sondee fu sabi fa ai go anga u biibi libi. Bika wi pakisei, san sa pasa anga u, te a didibii sa kon tesi u. Efu u kai a ini ogii, da na fu soso kaali wi dise be simpan useefi wooko taanga a u mindii anda.
eng_text: For this cause I also, when I couldn't stand it any longer, sent that I might know your faith, for fear that by any means the tempter had tempted you, and our labor would have been in vain.

djk_text: Ma now, da Timotiyesi kon doo wi ya baka anga moi nyunsu fu u anda. Bika a taki, u tan biibi go doo. U tan e soi taawan fa u abi lobi fu den a ini u ati. U e pakisei wi dise bunbun ete tu. U abi angii fu si wi dise tu, enke fa wi dise seefi abi.
eng_text: But when Timothy came just now to us from you, and brought us glad news of your faith and love, and that you have good memories of us always, longing to see us, even as we also long to see you;

djk_text: Biibiwan! Da wi dise ati nái weli gi u moo, ma wi kisi tuutuu koo ati anga ala fa ala sowtu banowtu e kon a wi tapu dise.
eng_text: for this cause, brothers, we were comforted over you in all our distress and affliction through your faith.

djk_text: Da wi dise kisi nyun taanga sikin baka. Bika wi sabi taki, u taampu taanga anda a ini Masaa pasi ete.
eng_text: For now we live, if you stand fast in the Lord.

djk_text: We, wi á sabi fa fu gi Masaa Gadu daa kisi dise. Ma enseefi e si fa wi e gi en daa, fu fa u anda e meke wi e kisi gaan piisii dise.
eng_text: For what thanksgiving can we render again to God for you, for all the joy with which we rejoice for your sakes before our God;

djk_text: Da dei anga neti wi dise e tan begi, meke wi anga u sa miti fesi a fesi baka. Da wi sa yeepi lapu a biibi fu u anda kisi moo futu a doti.
eng_text: night and day praying exceedingly that we may see your face, and may perfect that which is lacking in your faith?

djk_text: We, da meke wi Tata, Masaa Gadu anga wi Masaa Jesesi opo pasi gi wi, fu doo u anda baka.
eng_text: Now may our God and Father himself, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way to you;

djk_text: Soseefi, meke Masaa e poti moo lobi a u biibiwan anda mindii. Meke u sa abi lobi fu ala taa sama tu, enke fa wi dise abi lobi fu u anda.
eng_text: and the Lord make you to increase and abound in love one toward another, and toward all men, even as we also do toward you,

djk_text: Te dati pasa, da a biibi fu u anda sa seeka kisi moo futu a doti. Da te wi Masaa Jesesi o kon doo anga ala den apaiti wan fi en, da ibiiwan anda o de a wi Tata, Masaa Gadu fesi sondee kaagi. Bika a hii libi fu u anda o soi apaiti fasi gi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: to the end he may establish your hearts blameless in holiness before our God and Father, at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all his saints.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Fosi wi tapu a biifi ya, da wi dise wani sende u anda wan sani. Libi fu piisii Masaa Gadu! Bika u na sama fu Masaa Jesesi. Wi sabi taki, u anda e libi enke fa wi dise be leli u anda kaba. Ma toku wi wani u suku fu libi moo betee moo so.
eng_text: Finally then, brothers, we beg and exhort you in the Lord Jesus, that as you received from us how you ought to walk and to please God, that you abound more and more.

djk_text: Bika na Masaa Jesesi seefi poti a leli fi en ya a wi ana, fu sende u anda. Ne u kon sabi fa fu waka anda.
eng_text: For you know what instructions we gave you through the Lord Jesus.

djk_text: Ma toku, wi wani soi u anda ete, fa Masaa Gadu wani u mu de seefi. A wani u libi de apaiti fasi. Da de sondee fu waka motyo fasi.
eng_text: For this is the will of God: your sanctification, that you abstain from sexual immorality,

djk_text: Ma meke ibiiwan sabi teke wan uman poti a osu. Du dati wan fasi di fiti Masaa Gadu anga ala lesipeki fu libisama tu.
eng_text: that each one of you know how to possess himself of his own vessel in sanctification and honor,

djk_text: Ma u á mu waka enke sama di nái poti Masaa Gadu a teli. Bika na fafa ati den abi fu waka du ala sowtu motyo sani.
eng_text: not in the passion of lust, even as the Gentiles who don't know God;

djk_text: Da wi enke biibiwan á mu du a ogii ya anga taawan. Meke wi á koli taawan, poli san den abi. Bika enke fa wi be soi u kaba taki, Masaa Gadu á lobi so. Da en ati o boon fu dati.
eng_text: that no one should take advantage of and wrong a brother or sister in this matter; because the Lord is an avenger in all these things, as also we forewarned you and testified.

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu kai wi kon toon sama fi enseefi. Da wi mu libi apaiti fasi. Ma wi á mu waka poli fasi enke motyo.
eng_text: For God called us not for uncleanness, but in sanctification.

djk_text: Efu wan sama towe a leli ya, da a towe Masaa Gadu seefi di gi wi en Apaiti Jeje, fu leli wi libi. Bika a ná libisama soi wi a leli ya, ma na Masaa Gadu seefi.
eng_text: Therefore he who rejects this doesn't reject man, but God, who has also given his Holy Spirit to you.

djk_text: We, Masaa Gadu seefi be soi u kaba fa fu wooko anga lobi. Da a á de fanowdu fu sikiifi ya moo, fa fu lobi taa biibiwan.
eng_text: But concerning brotherly love, you have no need that one write to you. For you yourselves are taught by God to love one another,

djk_text: Bika u e libi anda so kaba anga ala taa biibiwan na a hii pisi fu Masadoniya. Biibiwan! Ma toku wi dise e soi u anda ete taki, teke a lobi ya wooko moo bigi moo so.
eng_text: for indeed you do it toward all the brothers who are in all Macedonia. But we exhort you, brothers, that you abound more and more;

djk_text: Ibii biibisama mu e feti namo fu libi bun anga taa sama sondee dyugu taki. U á mu e waka e mumui a ini taa sama sani tumisi. Ma ibii sama mu mumui anga en eigi sani e du en wooko enke fa a fiti. Da di u be de a mindii anda, da na so u be soi u anda kaba, fu libi.
eng_text: and that you make it your ambition to lead a quiet life, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, even as we instructed you;

djk_text: Da biibiwan ná o abi fu sidon taki, na taawan mu solugu den. Soseefi, da sama di nái biibi o luku u, da den taki: “Oho! Luku fa den biibiwan e libi soifili fasi.”
eng_text: that you may walk properly toward those who are outside, and may have need of nothing.

djk_text: Biibiwan! We, wi wani meke u sabi fa fu den biibiwan di dede kaba. Da u ná o buduufu anda enke sama di á sabi taki, sani de fu luku ete baka dede.
eng_text: But we don't want you to be ignorant, brothers, concerning those who have fallen asleep, so that you don't grieve like the rest, who have no hope.

djk_text: Bika Masaa Jesesi seefi be dede koo pii. Ma Masaa Gadu weki en kon libi baka. Na so wi di e biibi kon sabi taki, biibisama di dede kaba, da Masaa Gadu o weki den kon a libi baka enke Jesesi. Da a o tyai den go libi a Jesesi.
eng_text: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so God will bring with him those who have fallen asleep in Jesus.

djk_text: Yee fa Masaa Jesesi seefi be leli wi fu dati taki, wan dei, Masaa o kon teke den biibiwan puu a goontapu. Ma wi á mu denki taki, a o fika den dede biibiwan fu teke a baka, da a o teke den libiwan fosi. Kweti!
eng_text: For this we tell you by the word of the Lord, that we who are alive, who are left to the coming of the Lord, will in no way precede those who have fallen asleep.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Gadu sa bali a tapu taki, a yuu doo. Da a moo hei Engel fi en seefi tongo o piki a tapu. Da wan gaan tutu o boo a tapu anda. Da Masaa Jesesi o saka komoto a tapu anda. Da den dede wan, di be e biibi a Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi fosi o weki baka.
eng_text: For the Lord himself will descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with God's trumpet. The dead in Christ will rise first,

djk_text: Da wantoon so, Masaa Gadu o tyai wi di de a libi makandii anga den di weki gwe a Masaa a den woluku tapu. Da a miti di wi ala o miti ya, a ná fu paati moo wanten. Wi anga Masaa o libi makandii tego.
eng_text: then we who are alive, who are left, will be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air. So we will be with the Lord forever.

djk_text: Da na den wowtu ya u mu e teke taigi taa biibiwan, fu puu buduufu na ati. Meke den sa fende koo ati fu libi.
eng_text: Therefore comfort one another with these words.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Ma fa fu den sani di o pasa fosi Masaa Jesesi kon teke wi so? Soseefi, on yuu dati o pasa? We, a á de, fu fanowdu fu piki ala dati.
eng_text: But concerning the times and the seasons, brothers, you have no need that anything be written to you.

djk_text: Bika useefi sabi taki, a o doo wan dei, te fu sama membee. Dati o pasa enke fa fufuuman e kon a neti haa, fosi fu sama poti pakisei.
eng_text: For you yourselves know well that the day of the Lord comes like a thief in the night.

djk_text: Leti na a yuu di sama o taki: “Goontapu sidon switi, ala sani e waka moi.” Fosi den poti pakisei, da sani kon banowtu den. Da den ná o poi kibii gi a gaan banowtu enke fa bee uman á poi kibii gi a bee ati fu go meke. Ai de fi en moi moi, ma te fu a denki, da a bee musu kon nyanmi en.
eng_text: For when they are saying, "Peace and safety," then sudden destruction will come on them, like birth pains on a pregnant woman; and they will in no way escape.

djk_text: Ma biibiwan! U dati á mu feele! Bika u a ná sama di de a dunguu fu nái si san e pasa. Da Masaa ná o doo a u tapu haa, enke fufuuman.
eng_text: But you, brothers, aren't in darkness, that the day should overtake you like a thief.

djk_text: Bika u ala anda e si sani enke sama a kiin fu dei, fu sabi san e pasa. U a ná sama a dunguu fu neti di nái si fu sabi san e pasa. Kweti!
eng_text: You are all children of light, and children of the day. We don't belong to the night, nor to darkness,

djk_text: Da wi á mu libi enke sama e siibi, da a nái si sani. Na sama di á sabi Masaa Gadu tan so. Ma meke wi dati de anga ain, da poti ede bun tu.
eng_text: so then let's not sleep, as the rest do, but let's watch and be sober.

djk_text: Bika son sama e kai a siibi a neti. Son fu den e diingi duungu. Da den nái sabi san e pasa.
eng_text: For those who sleep, sleep in the night, and those who are drunk are drunk in the night.

djk_text: Ma wi na sama di e si enke u de a kiin fu dei, fu sabi san e pasa. Da meke wi poti ede bun. Meke wi wooko anga a biibi di wi abi. Meke wi wooko anga lobi tu. Meke wi tan luku a yeepi di Masaa o tyai kon. Den sani ya sa kibii wi enke insii sani di suudati e wei fu kibii den seefi a feti.
eng_text: But let us, since we belong to the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and, for a helmet, the hope of salvation.

djk_text: Bika wi a ná sama di Masaa Gadu ati e boon moo fu gi sitaafu. Ma a tyai yeepi puu wi a takuudu anga a sitaafu ya. Bika wi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi teke dede a wi peesi.
eng_text: For God didn't appoint us to wrath, but to the obtaining of salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,

djk_text: Da te a kon baka, da biibiwan di de a libi sa tan libi anga en. Soseefi, biibiwan di dede kaba seefi o weki go libi anga en tu.
eng_text: who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.

djk_text: We, da tan soi ala taa biibiwan anda so go doo enke fa u gwenti kaba. Da den taawan sa kisi moo taanga sikin na biibi. Soseefi, den futu sa moo taanga a ini a biibi.
eng_text: Therefore exhort one another, and build each other up, even as you also do.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Mi wani begi u anda ete wan sani. Lesipeki den edeman di e tii u anda a ini a biibi fu Masaa. Bika den e wooko taanga fu soi u fa fu tyai useefi.
eng_text: But we beg you, brothers, to know those who labor among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you,

djk_text: Gi den gaandi pasa peesi. Libi meke den si taki u lobi den, fu a wooko di den e du. Meke kwali anga toobi á de a u mindii. Ma u ati mu de switi makandii.
eng_text: and to respect and honor them in love for their work's sake. Be at peace among yourselves.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Sende lesiman a u mindii de taki, den mu wooko. Suku fu gi sama di e pantan taanga sikin. Yeepi sama di futu swaki a ini a biibi. Pasensi anga ala sowtu sama.
eng_text: We exhort you, brothers, admonish the disorderly, encourage the fainthearted, support the weak, be patient toward all.

djk_text: Kenisi taki, u á suku fu pai taawan ogii fu ogii baka. Ma suku fu wooko bun anga useefi ibii yuu. Wooko so anga ala taa taa sama tu.
eng_text: See that no one returns evil for evil to anyone, but always follow after that which is good, for one another, and for all.

djk_text: Piisii ala yuu naamo.
eng_text: Rejoice always.

djk_text: Ná weli fu begi, ma begi naamo.
eng_text: Pray without ceasing.

djk_text: Da winsi san, ma tan gi Masaa Gadu daa ete. Bika na so a wani si sama di e waka a Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi baka.
eng_text: In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus toward you.

djk_text: U á mu tei Masaa Gadu Jeje de. Ma gi en pasi fu wooko faya faya.
eng_text: Don't quench the Spirit.

djk_text: Da te apaiti takiman bali wan bosikopu, da u á mu oli dati fu soso sani.
eng_text: Don't despise prophesies.

djk_text: Ma keli luku san komoto a Masaa Gadu, da wooko anga dati.
eng_text: Test all things, and hold firmly that which is good.

djk_text: Wai a pasi gi ibii sowtu ogii naamo.
eng_text: Abstain from every form of evil.

djk_text: Meke Masaa Gadu di e switi sama meke u libi de apaiti fasi gi en. Meke u hii libi, sikin fasi doo jeje fasi wooko sondee fowtu, te wi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi sa kon baka.
eng_text: May the God of peace himself sanctify you completely. May your whole spirit, soul, and body be preserved blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

djk_text: Masaa Gadu di kai u kon toon sama fi en, de fitoow fasi. Da ai du ala san a paamisi, meke a sa du den sani de gi u.
eng_text: He who calls you is faithful, who will also do it.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Wi dise e akisi u anda fu begi gi wi dise tu.
eng_text: Brothers, pray for us.

djk_text: Bali ala biibiwan anda wan switi odi a ini a nen fu Masaa gi wi.
eng_text: Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.

djk_text: Mi e teke a nen fu Masaa sende u taki: “Leisi a biifi ya gi ala taa biibiwan anda.”
eng_text: I solemnly command you by the Lord that this letter be read to all the holy brothers.

djk_text: Meke wi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi tan teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku u anda go doo.
eng_text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.

djk_text: Mi Pawlesi anga Silfanas anga Timotiyesi e sikiifi a biifi ya sende gi a hii kulu Tesalonika biibiwan, di de sama fu u Tata Masaa Gadu anga Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi anda.
eng_text: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ:

djk_text: Meke u Tata, Masaa Gadu anga Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku u de. Soseefi, meke u ati de switi.
eng_text: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Ibii yuu ten, da wi dise e gi Masaa Gadu daa fu anda ede. Dati fiti so. Bika a biibi fu u anda e goo naamo. Soseefi, a lobi fu taa biibiwan anda tu.
eng_text: We are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers, even as it is appropriate, because your faith grows exceedingly, and the love of each and every one of you towards one another abounds;

djk_text: Wi e gafa u fu toko fu dati na ala se a taa kulu biibiwan fu Masaa Gadu mindii. Wi e soi den fa u tei ati fu oli doo. Soseefi fa u tan biibi ete, winsi sama e lon du ogii anga u fu dati.
eng_text: so that we ourselves boast about you in the assemblies of God for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and in the afflictions which you endure.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Gadu e kuutu letiopu fasi. Bika a o kuutu taki, u anda be tuka anga banowtu, fu di u e du san a wani. Da u waiti fu go doo a ini Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: This is an obvious sign of the righteous judgment of God, to the end that you may be counted worthy of the Kingdom of God, for which you also suffer.

djk_text: Ma, da a o pai den sama di e pina u ya anga pina baka.
eng_text: Since it is a righteous thing with God to repay affliction to those who afflict you,

djk_text: Tuutuu! Na so Masaa Gadu o kuutu anga leti. Da u anda anga wi dise di be fende pina o fende paiman. Dati na wan bun switi losutu ten na a yuu di Masaa Jesesi o komoto a Masaa Gadu Kondee a tapu anga ala den makiti Engel fi en.
eng_text: and to give relief to you who are afflicted with us, when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with his mighty angels in flaming fire,

djk_text: A hii kon fi en ya o waka anga gaan faya, fu pai den takuu ati sama a paiman di den mu fende. Bika den nái teli Masaa Gadu, ne den á wani teke a Bun Nyunsu fu wi Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: giving vengeance to those who don't know God, and to those who don't obey the Good News of our Lord Jesus,

djk_text: Da Masaa o yaki den puu ne en fesi, fu go tan tego sondee Masaa Gadu di abi ala makiti anga en gaan dyendee fasi. A sitaafu ya o kaba den a soso.
eng_text: who will pay the penalty: eternal destruction from the face of the Lord and from the glory of his might,

djk_text: Na so sani o waka na a kon fu wi Masaa Jesesi. Da ibiiwan fu den sama fi en o gi en gaandi anga gafa, fu fa a be tyai den. U anda seefi o de a ini hei en nen so. Bika u be biibi den sani fi en, di wi dise be kon taki anda.
eng_text: when he comes to be glorified in his saints, and to be admired among all those who have believed (because our testimony to you was believed) in that day.

djk_text: We, da wi dise e tan begi Masaa Gadu gi u anda naamo, fu gi u anda kaakiti fu poi du ala bun di u wani du anga a biibi libi. Soseefi, fu poi du bun di u sete e du kaba anga a biibi. Da u libi sa waiti sai fu fende a paiman di a kai wi kon poti fu gi.
eng_text: To this end we also pray always for you, that our God may count you worthy of your calling, and fulfill every desire of goodness and work of faith, with power;

djk_text: Na so u o meke wi Masaa Jesesi fende gafanen fu dati. Ma u anda seefi o fende gafa, fu fa Masaa Gadu anga Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku u anda so.
eng_text: that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.

djk_text: Ma meke u taki moo fu a kon di wi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi o kon baka, fu piki ala biibiwan tyai go poti ape enseefi de. Ma biibiwan! Gaantangi, wi o begi u anda wan sani fu dati.
eng_text: Now, brothers, concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, and our gathering together to him, we ask you

djk_text: U á mu gaw fu buuya taki, a dei de pasa kaba. Bika son sama sa kon taki, a Apaiti Jeje soi en so. Son sama sa tyai moi bosikopu kon taki so tu. Son sama sa kon taki, na wi dise sikiifi so a ini wan biifi gi den. Ma toku, u á mu dyombo gaw buuya fu dati.
eng_text: not to be quickly shaken in your mind, nor yet be troubled, either by spirit, or by word, or by letter as from us, saying that the day of Christ had come.

djk_text: Meke sama á koli u wan enkii fasi fu dati! Bika fu tuu, a yuu ten di tyaipi sama o daai baka gi Masaa Gadu mu doo goontapu fosi. Soseefi, wan gaan didibii sama di nái koti anga weiti fu Masaa Gadu o kon a doo fu si fosi. Ma moo lati, da a didibii sama ya o kaba a soso.
eng_text: Let no one deceive you in any way. For it will not be, unless the departure comes first, and the man of sin is revealed, the son of destruction,

djk_text: A didibii sama ya na a gaan feyanti fu Masaa Gadu. Bika a o feti anga ala gadu sani di de. A o hei enseefi poti a tapu fu ala san sama e dini fu gadu. Da a o du te go sidon a ini a Mama Keliki fu Masaa Gadu. Da a o puu kon a doo taki, ne en na Masaa Gadu kaba di sama mu dini.
eng_text: he who opposes and exalts himself against all that is called God or that is worshiped; so that he sits as God in the temple of God, setting himself up as God.

djk_text: Fu tuu! Di mi be de anda, da mi be taigi u fu a sani ya kaba. Da a kon, u musu sabi en ete.
eng_text: Don't you remember that, when I was still with you, I told you these things?

djk_text: Enke fa u sabi kaba, da na wan sani e tapu a gaan didibii sama ya ete fu kon a doo. Ma te a yuu di Masaa Gadu poti gi en doo, da a sa kon a doo, fu si.
eng_text: Now you know what is restraining him, to the end that he may be revealed in his own season.

djk_text: A hii wooko di a o kon du, na fu meke sama wai weiti fu Masaa Gadu poti a wanse. Ai du dati kibii fasi a goontapu ya kaba. Ma enseefi o doo na a wooko tapu, te Masaa Gadu puu a wan di e tapu en fosi.
eng_text: For the mystery of lawlessness already works. Only there is one who restrains now, until he is taken out of the way.

djk_text: Da fa i si dati o pasa, da enseefi kon a doo wanten, fu si. Ma te Masaa Jesesi o kon, da en mofu di a o opo namo o kaba a didibii sama ya a soso. Da a hii makiti fi en sa booko de wanten.
eng_text: Then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord will kill with the breath of his mouth, and destroy by the manifestation of his coming;

djk_text: Ma fosi Masaa Jesesi kon baka so, da a didibii sama ya o du somen gaan foondoo sani, fu koli sama kisi. A didibii seefi o gi en a makiti, fu du ala sowtu foondoo sani. Ma a o du enke na Masaa Gadu gi en a makiti fu du den sani ya.
eng_text: even he whose coming is according to the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,

djk_text: Ala den foondoo sani ya o koli sama di de fu kaba a soso, poti a ini ogii. Bika den sama ya á be lobi a tuutuu bosikopu fu Masaa Gadu, fu a be sa puu den a ini takuudu anga ogii.
eng_text: and with all deception of wickedness for those who are being lost, because they didn't receive the love of the truth, that they might be saved.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Gadu fika den a ini gaan buuya, fu biibi lei sani di kon a den pasi. Na so meke den teke biibi na a didibii sama ya.
eng_text: Because of this, God sends them a working of error, that they should believe a lie;

djk_text: We, da Masaa Gadu sa kuutu taki, na ibii sama di á wani biibi a tuutuu bosikopu fi en seefi abi a fowtu. Bika den á be wani du san fiti Masaa Gadu. Ma den be lobi soso lawlaw sani.
eng_text: that they all might be judged who didn't believe the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Ma Masaa Gadu lobi u anda bigi! Da wi dise abi fu e gi en daa naamo, fu u anda ede. Bika a teke u anda enke fosi wan di a puu a takuudu anga ogii. Bika di a meke en Jeje wooko taanga a u de, meke u libi de apaiti fasi. Soseefi, di u teke biibi na a tuutuu bosikopu fi en.
eng_text: But we are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers loved by the Lord, because God chose you from the beginning for salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief in the truth;

djk_text: We, na fu so meke Masaa Gadu be gi wi dise a Bun Nyunsu fu kon kai u anda. Fu u anda seefi sa fende a gaan dyendee di wi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi seefi abi.
eng_text: to which he called you through our Good News, for the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Da oli biibi taanga doo. Noiti tapu fu biibi san wi dise tyai anga mofu anga biifi kon leli u anda.
eng_text: So then, brothers, stand firm, and hold the traditions which you were taught by us, whether by word, or by letter.

djk_text: We, wi Tata, Masaa Gadu anga wi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi meke wi ala kisi taanga fu oli biibi doo tego seefi. Soseefi, fu tan luku fu fende sani di Masaa Gadu paamisi. Na gaan bun ati fasi namo di Masaa teke luku u, meke a paamisi wi ala den sani ya. Bika a lobi wi ala, pasa peesi.
eng_text: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God our Father, who loved us and gave us eternal comfort and good hope through grace,

djk_text: Da meke a gi u anda taanga sikin. Soseefi, da u mu meke u anda e taki soso bun sani. Soseefi, fu du den bun di u e fii fu du.
eng_text: comfort your hearts and establish you in every good work and word.

djk_text: Da a biifi ya e go doo taki, tan begi gi wi dise naamo. Akisi Masaa Gadu, fu meke a bosikopu fu Masaa sa waka esi esi doo somen sama moo. Meke moo anga moo sama sa gi Masaa Gadu daa. Da den sa gafa en enke u anda tu.
eng_text: Finally, brothers, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may spread rapidly and be glorified, even as also with you;

djk_text: Soseefi, da begi fu a puu wi dise na ana fu takuu ati sama di wani du ogii anga wi. Bika a ná ala sama teke a bosikopu di wi e tyai, da a de fitoow fasi.
eng_text: and that we may be delivered from unreasonable and evil men; for not all have faith.

djk_text: Ma Masaa dati de fitoow fasi! U sa fitoow en fu meke u taampu taanga doo a ini a biibi ya. Soseefi a o kibii u anda fu didibii.
eng_text: But the Lord is faithful, who will establish you, and guard you from the evil one.

djk_text: Da wi e fitoow dise taki, u anda e du ala san wi dise e sende u. Bika u na sama fu Masaa.
eng_text: We have confidence in the Lord concerning you, that you both do and will do the things we command.

djk_text: Da wi dise e begi meke u anda ati sa opo gi a lobi fu Masaa Gadu. Soseefi, meke u anda tei ati fu oli doo enke fa Kelestesi gi u dati.
eng_text: May the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God, and into the patience of Christ.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Mi o teke a nen fu Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi sende u anda fa fu du anga lesi biibiwan. U á mu mosoo anga den. Bika den nái waka na a fasi fa wi dise be soi u anda.
eng_text: Now we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you withdraw yourselves from every brother who walks in rebellion, and not after the tradition which they received from us.

djk_text: U sabi fa wi dise be waka a u mindii anda. Wi á be lesi langa futu gi sama fu solugu wi. Ma wi be tyai useefi anga ala wooko, fu sama be sa si a wi, fa fu du tu.
eng_text: For you know how you ought to imitate us. For we didn't behave ourselves rebelliously among you,

djk_text: Da wi á be meke sama poti u sidon, fu solugu anga nyanyan. Ma u be tyotyo wooko dei anga neti, fu wi á be sa toon ibi a sama tapu.
eng_text: neither did we eat bread from anyone's hand without paying for it, but in labor and travail worked night and day, that we might not burden any of you;

djk_text: Ma wi be abi pasi fu meke sama solugu u de. Ma toku wi á be du so. Bika wi be wani wooko soi u anda, fa useefi mu libi de.
eng_text: not because we don't have the right, but to make ourselves an example to you, that you should imitate us.

djk_text: Di wi be de anda, da na somen leisi wi be soi u kaba taki, ná masi sikin solugu lesiman di á wani wooko.
eng_text: For even when we were with you, we commanded you this: "If anyone will not work, neither let him eat."

djk_text: Bika wi yee dise taki, son wan a u mindii anda lesi te, den á wani wooko solugu denseefi. Da den e waka e sutu mofu mumui a ini sama sani naamo.
eng_text: For we hear of some who walk among you in rebellion, who don't work at all, but are busybodies.

djk_text: Da wi e teke a nen fu Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi, fu kaasi den biibiwan di e du dati. Da wi e bali den taki, kaba anga a libi de! Go wooko solugu iseefi.
eng_text: Now those who are that way, we command and exhort in the Lord Jesus Christ, that with quietness they work, and eat their own bread.

djk_text: Ma u taa biibiwan dati á mu weli fu du den bun di wi e soi u, fu du. Kweti!
eng_text: But you, brothers, don't be weary in doing well.

djk_text: Sama di á wani libi enke fa a biifi ya taki, da puu en nen kon a doo. Da u kaba mosoo anga en, fu a sa fii sen fu a libi di ai libi.
eng_text: If any man doesn't obey our word in this letter, note that man, that you have no company with him, to the end that he may be ashamed.

djk_text: Ma toku, u á mu oli en a feyanti. Ma libi anga en meke ai fii taki, en na wan biibisama di u anda e wasikoi.
eng_text: Don't count him as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.

djk_text: We, na Masaa e switi sama ati, da meke a switi u anda ati ala fasi, ala yuu. Meke Masaa de anga u naamo.
eng_text: Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times in all ways. The Lord be with you all.

djk_text: A fika fu mi Pawlesi seefi teke a sikiifi tiki fu sikiifi a bigi odi ya gi u anda. Mi du dati enke fa mi gwenti a ibii biifi fu mi. Mi poti mi nen anga odi na a seefi fasi.
eng_text: The greeting of me, Paul, with my own hand, which is the sign in every letter: this is how I write.

djk_text: Meke wi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi tan teke gaan bun ati fasi luku u ala go doo.
eng_text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

djk_text: Wi Yeepiman, Masaa Gadu anga Kelestesi Jesesi, di wi e luku, kumandei mi Pawlesi ya, fu de wan apaiti bosikopuman fu Kelestesi Jesesi. Da mi e sikiifi a biifi ya gi yu.
eng_text: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus according to the commandment of God our Savior, and Christ Jesus our hope;

djk_text: Timotiyesi! Mi e sende en gi yu, di teke a bosikopu di mi e tyai. Da mi e kai yu mi pikin a ini a biibi. Meke u Tata, Masaa Gadu anga wi Masaa, Kelestesi Jesesi teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku yu. Soseefi teke tyali ati fasi luku yu. Soseefi, meke yu ati de switi.
eng_text: to Timothy, my true child in faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God our Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

djk_text: Fosi mi be komoto de gwe a Masadoniya, da mi be taigi yu, fu tan doo a Efese de. Da tan du so ete, ma poti ain luku tu, fu tapu sama di e leli taawan falisi leli di nái fiti du fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: As I urged you when I was going into Macedonia, stay at Ephesus that you might command certain men not to teach a different doctrine,

djk_text: Tapu den sama soseefi, fu den á mu poti denki a lawlaw toli. Soseefi haw lolo fositen sama sani. Den sani de e tyai soso sitee anga buuya a sama mindii, pe fu soi fa Masaa Gadu wani den biibi, fu komoto a takuudu anga ogii.
eng_text: neither to pay attention to myths and endless genealogies, which cause disputes, rather than God's stewardship, which is in faith--

djk_text: Bika a wooko fu Masaa Gadu, na fu soi sama fu lobi makandii. Soseefi, fu meke sama ati kon de kiin sondee konsensi fonfon. Soseefi, fu sama mu abi tuutuu biibi.
eng_text: but the goal of this command is love, out of a pure heart and a good conscience and sincere faith;

djk_text: Ma son sama wai komoto na a pasi ya, ne den e waka e sitee, fu taki wisiwasi taki di á de fanowdu.
eng_text: from which things some, having missed the mark, have turned aside to vain talking;

djk_text: Den e meke enke leliman di mu leli taawan wooko anga Masaa Gadu weiti. Da den gei sama di sabi san den e taki. Ma a ná enke den e fusutan weiti di den e soi taawan seefi.
eng_text: desiring to be teachers of the law, though they understand neither what they say, nor about what they strongly affirm.

djk_text: Ma wi sabi saide Masaa Gadu meke den weiti fi en. Na bunbun sani a meke gi sama di wani wooko fiti anga den.
eng_text: But we know that the law is good, if a man uses it lawfully,

djk_text: Da wi sabi taki, weiti á meke fu kaasi sama di e libi leti fasi. Ma na fu kaasi sama di e booko weiti. Sama di ná abi bisi anga weiti anga Masaa Gadu seefi. Sama di e du poli sani. Sama di ná abi lesipeki fu Masaa Gadu sani. Sama di e sipowtu anga Masaa Gadu. Sama di e kii mma anga dda anga taa sowtu kiiman.
eng_text: as knowing this, that law is not made for a righteous man, but for the lawless and insubordinate, for the ungodly and sinners, for the unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,

djk_text: Soseefi, sama anga motyo fasi. Manengee e makume taa manengee. Sama di e seli taawan enke saafu. Sama di e lei. Sama di e daai mofu fu san de be sweli kaba seefi. Na so weiti meke, fu kaasi den sowtu sama de doo ala taa sani di nái fiti a tuutuu leli fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: for the sexually immoral, for homosexuals, for slave-traders, for liars, for perjurers, and for any other thing contrary to the sound doctrine;

djk_text: Tuutuu leli na di e fiti a dyendee Bun Nyunsu fu a seigi Masaa Gadu, di a fitoow poti a mi ya ana tu, fu tyai taki.
eng_text: according to the Good News of the glory of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.

djk_text: We, mi e gi daa doo wi Masaa, Kelestesi Jesesi, di gi mi taanga, fu tyai a wooko ya. Bika a fitoow mi, poti a ini en wooko.
eng_text: And I thank him who enabled me, Christ Jesus our Lord, because he counted me faithful, appointing me to service;

djk_text: A wooko tyali ati fasi anga mi di fosi fosi be toto futu taki soso ogii fi en. Soseefi lon du ogii anga sama di e biibi en. Bika mi á be de biibisama ete, da mi á be sabi taki, na ogii mi be e du so.
eng_text: although I was before a blasphemer, a persecutor, and insolent. However, I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.

djk_text: We, na gaan bun ati fasi namo, di Masaa teke luku mi. Ne a meke mi kon poti hii fitoow ne en. Soseefi mi kon abi a lobi di ai gi wi di mokisa libi anga Kelestesi Jesesi.
eng_text: The grace of our Lord abounded exceedingly with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

djk_text: We, na wan tuu taki, Kelestesi Jesesi kon a goontapu, fu puu sama a takuudu anga ogii. Na sani fu teke, sondee fu sitee. Bika fu sama di be e du ogii, da sama á moo mi.
eng_text: The saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Gadu teke mi, fu soi fa ai luku sama gaan tyali ati fasi. Soseefi, fa Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi pasensi fasi bigi, fu wooko anga taawan di o kon biibi moo lati, fu fende libi tego.
eng_text: However, for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first, Jesus Christ might display all his patience, for an example of those who were going to believe in him for eternal life.

djk_text: Da bali baya gi a Masaa Gadu ya! Gi en ala gaandi. Bika en na a Kownu di noiti poi dede. Da ai tii sani tego. Soseefi, a de Masaa Gadu di u á poi si anga ain. En na awan kodo Gadu di de. Amen, na so a de!
eng_text: Now to the King eternal, immortal, invisible, to God who alone is wise, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.

djk_text: We, Timotiyesi enke mi manpikin a ini a biibi! Mi e fitoow yu, fu du a wooko di mi e sende yu, a ini a biifi ya. Bika Masaa be soi a fesi fa yu o du a wooko ya. A be meke apaiti takiman fi en piki yu dati a fesi. Da dati mu gi yu taanga sikin, fu feti du a wooko ya wan bun fasi.
eng_text: This instruction I commit to you, my child Timothy, according to the prophecies which led the way to you, that by them you may wage the good warfare;

djk_text: Wooko anga biibi. Meke yu ati de kiin sondee konsensi fonfon. Bika son sama biibi poli, fu di den á wani aliki fa konsensi e fon den ati, fu sani di á fiti. Ne dati poli den biibi enke te wataa e tyai boto go naki booko.
eng_text: holding faith and a good conscience; which some having thrust away made a shipwreck concerning the faith;

djk_text: Na so pasa anga Himeneyesi anga Aleksandi. Ne mi fika den a wanse gi didibii, meke a tii den. Da den sa kon si taki, den mu kaba lei, fu gi Masaa Gadu polinen.
eng_text: of whom is Hymenaeus and Alexander; whom I delivered to Satan, that they might be taught not to blaspheme.

djk_text: Fosi mi taki taa sani, da mi wani taigi yu enke biibiwan taki, akisi Masaa Gadu sani naamo gi taawan. Begi naamo gi den. Gi Masaa Gadu daa naamo, fu san ai du gi ala sama.
eng_text: I exhort therefore, first of all, that petitions, prayers, intercessions, and givings of thanks, be made for all men:

djk_text: Du so gi kownu anga taa bigiman fu kondee, fu u libi sa de switi. Da u sa poi tyai useefi wan leti fasi fiti Masaa Gadu anga ala lesipeki fu libisama.
eng_text: for kings and all who are in high places; that we may lead a tranquil and quiet life in all godliness and reverence.

djk_text: Te wi e begi so, da na wan gaan waiti sani gi Masaa Gadu, di de wi Yeepiman. Ai piisii en, fu yee sama e begi so.
eng_text: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Savior;

djk_text: Bika a wani en yeepi di a tyai, mu doo na ala sama. A wani den sama mu kon sabi a tuutuu leli fi en.
eng_text: who desires all people to be saved and come to full knowledge of the truth.

djk_text: Bika na awan kodo Gadu ya namo de. Namo a poti wan kodo sama namo a wi anga en mindii enke mindiiman, fu tyai yeepi. A sama de na Kelestesi Jesesi.
eng_text: For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus,

djk_text: Na a Kelestesi Jesesi ya poti enseefi enke paiman, fu pai puu sama a takuudu anga ogii. A wooko di a du de soi fa Masaa Gadu ten doo, fu tyai yeepi gi sama.
eng_text: who gave himself as a ransom for all; the testimony in its own times;

djk_text: Da na a Bun Nyunsu ya mi mu tyai taki enke apaiti bosikopuman fu Masaa Jesesi. Masaa Gadu poti mi, fu leli foluku di á de Dyusama, fa fu biibi na a tuutuu fasi di Masaa Gadu wani. Mi nái lei! Na tuutuu sani fu teke, mi e taki ya!
eng_text: to which I was appointed a preacher and an apostle (I am telling the truth in Christ, not lying), a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and truth.

djk_text: Da mi e taki go doo taki, mi wani manengee e begi, na ala peesi pe biibisama kon makandii. Ma na manengee di libi de apaiti fasi, fu poi opo ana a tapu begi. Da den mu de sondee fu oli taawan na ati, soseefi biibi sondee pantan taki, Masaa Gadu e yee den.
eng_text: I desire therefore that the men in every place pray, lifting up holy hands without anger and doubting.

djk_text: Da biibi uman ape mu e wei koosi di e soi lesipeki fu den sikin. Den mu abi moi saka fasi. Da den mu wooko anga bunbun fusutan. Ma den mu si beei fu gaan moi uwii, fu lawlaw sani. Soseefi, a wei fu gaan dii gowtu sani ofu gaan dii koosi.
eng_text: In the same way, that women also adorn themselves in decent clothing, with modesty and propriety; not just with braided hair, gold, pearls, or expensive clothing;

djk_text: Bika a moi fu den, dati mu de a bun di den e du fiti Masaa Gadu. Da ala sama sa si taki, den tiiki uman di lobi dini Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: but (which becomes women professing godliness) with good works.

djk_text: Da meke den uman ya libi pii anga ala saka fasi, fu teke Masaa Gadu leli.
eng_text: Let a woman learn in quietness with all subjection.

djk_text: Mi á wani si uman poti denseefi enke basi, fu leli manengee. Ma meke den libi pii fu den.
eng_text: But I don't permit a woman to teach, nor to exercise authority over a man, but to be in quietness.

djk_text: Bika na Adan enke manengee fosi Masaa Gadu be meke, fosi a be meke a uman den e kai Efa.
eng_text: For Adam was first formed, then Eve.

djk_text: Soseefi, da a ná Adan enke manengee, didibii be fende pasi koli, fu poli Masaa Gadu weiti. Ma na a uman didibii be fende pasi koli, poli Masaa Gadu weiti.
eng_text: Adam wasn't deceived, but the woman, being deceived, has fallen into disobedience;

djk_text: Ma toku, Masaa Gadu yeepi de gi uman sama seefi. Winsi a sitaafu de gi den ete, fu meke pikin anga taanga. Ma meke den lobi Masaa Gadu. Meke den tan oli biibi doo. Meke den libi de apaiti fasi. Meke den wooko anga bunbun fusutan. Soseefi moi saka fasi.
eng_text: but she will be saved through her childbearing, if they continue in faith, love, and sanctification with sobriety.

djk_text: We, efu wan sama wani toon edeman, fu luku taa biibiwan, da ai suku wan gaan bun wooko. Dati na wan tuutuu taki.
eng_text: This is a faithful saying: if a man seeks the office of an overseer , he desires a good work.

djk_text: Ma en fasi fu libi mu de bun, fu sama á mu poi fende olo kaagi en anga leti. Da a mu abi wan kodo uman namo. A mu poti en ede bun. A mu e wooko anga bunbun fusutan. A mu abi manii anga lesipeki. En osu doo mu opo gi taawan. A mu poi leli taawan Masaa Gadu leli wan bun fasi.
eng_text: The overseer therefore must be without reproach, the husband of one wife, temperate, sensible, modest, hospitable, good at teaching;

djk_text: Diingi á mu poi peemi en basi. Moni á mu poi peemi en basi tu. A á mu kaakeli. Ma a mu e wooko switi piisii fasi anga taawan.
eng_text: not a drinker, not violent, not greedy for money, but gentle, not quarrelsome, not covetous;

djk_text: A mu sabi tii en osu libi bun. A mu sabi kiya en pikin fu kon komoto bun.
eng_text: one who rules his own house well, having children in subjection with all reverence;

djk_text: Bika efu wan sama á poi tii en osu libi, da fa a sa tii den sama fu Masaa Gadu?
eng_text: (but if a man doesn't know how to rule his own house, how will he take care of the assembly of God?)

djk_text: Da a á mu de wan sama di teke biibi nyun nyun tu. Bika, da kande a sa kisi hei membee. Da Masaa Gadu o abi fu kuutu en fu dati, enke fa a kuutu didibii.
eng_text: not a new convert, lest being puffed up he fall into the same condemnation as the devil.

djk_text: Da sama di nái biibi mu sabi en enke wan bunbun sama. Ofu so, den o fende olo kaagi en anga leti. Bika a didibii o sete sani gi en, fu meke a tyai nen fu takuudu man.
eng_text: Moreover he must have good testimony from those who are outside, to avoid falling into reproach and the snare of the devil.

djk_text: We, manengee di mu taampu a baka fu den edeman, mu tan na a fasi fu lesipeki. Den mu poi taki leti taki. Diingi á mu poi pee den basi. Da den á mu e suku moni ofu wini wan fasi di á fiti.
eng_text: Servants , in the same way, must be reverent, not double-tongued, not addicted to much wine, not greedy for money;

djk_text: Den ati mu taampu kiin, sondee konsensi fonfon. Bika na sowan fasi bun, fu oli a tuutuu leli di Masaa Gadu gi wi.
eng_text: holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.

djk_text: Da wan sama mu waka bun anga a biibi libi fosi, meke sama si dati, da a sa fende a wooko ya.
eng_text: Let them also first be tested; then let them serve if they are blameless.
