djk_text: Kweti! Bika Masaa Gadu be fiti poti a fesi kaba taki, den avo Dyu gaansama de sa fende a gaan bun di sa kon bakaten ya seefi, makandii anga wi. Na wan gaan sani di taki, sondee wi, da den wawan á sa doo peesi fu fende dati.
eng_text: God having provided some better thing concerning us, so that apart from us they should not be made perfect.

djk_text: Den avo Dyu gaansama de libi soi wi, fu useefi sa si fa fu tei ati, fu oli doo tu. We, da yu á si? Fa a de, da somen kotoigi bosu lontu wi, fu luku fa u e meke moiti anga a libi ya. Da de enke sitee lonman di e feti taanga, fu wini. Bika, da ai fika dyendee sani fu sikin, di sa fuka en ana anga en futu. Da ai luku pe fu lon go wini, sondee daai daai. Da useefi mu fika sani fu sikin, enke takuudu anga ogii so, di sa fuka wi. Da u meke moiti!
eng_text: Therefore let us also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin which so easily entangles us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,

djk_text: Soseefi luku Jesesi, fu si fa fu biibi. Bika a waka a u fesi fu opo pasi, tyai u go doo kaba fu a biibi. A be libi ya taki, ai luku fu fende gaan piisii bakaten. Ne a poti enseefi den sipikii kii ya, teke a sen sowtu dede de. Namo, ne a sidon nownow fi en, na a peesi fu fende gaandi a Masaa Gadu se.
eng_text: looking to Jesus, the author and perfecter of faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising its shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.

djk_text: Ma pakisei fa a be teke pina ya. Takuusama be e sitee taki anga en. Den e kai en leiman di á komoto a Masaa Gadu. Ma gaan pasensi tyai en sondee fu tapu biibi. Da libi so tu, meke yu á sa lasi ati.
eng_text: For consider him who has endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, that you don't grow weary, fainting in your souls.

djk_text: We, u e suwa e feti, fu wini takuudu anga ogii. Da u e tuka anga toko fu dati. Ma u buulu á kai na a feti ya ete.
eng_text: You have not yet resisted to blood, striving against sin;

djk_text: We, mi si enke u feegete kaba taki, na Masaa Gadu fasi fu wooko de ape. Bika en Buku sikiifi taki: “Mi pikin! Son leisi, yu e tuka anga toko. Da yu e denki taki, na mi e sitaafu yu so. Ma luku sowtu bun a hii sani de mu leli yu, sondee fu lasi ati. Bika ai tyai kon soi, yu ogii di yuseefi mu fika ete.
eng_text: and you have forgotten the exhortation which reasons with you as with children, "My son, don't take lightly the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when you are reproved by him;

djk_text: Da kaba si a hii sani de enke na sitaafu namo. Bika na lobi! Da te yu e fii enke yu e fende wipi so, da sabi taki, yu na mi tuutuu pikin.”
eng_text: For whom the Lord loves, he chastens, and scourges every son whom he receives."

djk_text: We, da a bun fu fii, enke ai sitaafu yu. Bika ai si yu fi en tuutuu pikin, di ai leli poti enke fa a wani. Bika sowtu dda de, di nái leli en pikin sani, fu kiya poti letiopu?
eng_text: It is for discipline that you endure. God deals with you as with children, for what son is there whom his father doesn't discipline?

djk_text: Da a pikin o fii enke na sitaafu. Ma sama di á fende kiya so noiti sa poi taki, a de tuutuu pikin. Ma a sa de wan yayo ganda pikin di á kiya bun.
eng_text: But if you are without discipline, of which all have been made partakers, then are you illegitimate, and not children.

djk_text: Pakisei di u dda a goontapu ya feti kiya wi. Da wi e gi den daa fu dati. Da na moo saka fasi u mu soi u Tata, Masaa Gadu a tapu, fu dati. Bika a kiya fi en o tyai libi gi wi, makandii anga enseefi tego doo.
eng_text: Furthermore, we had the fathers of our flesh to chasten us, and we paid them respect. Shall we not much rather be in subjection to the Father of spirits, and live?

djk_text: Bika kiya fu goontapu dati na fu a satu libi ya namo. Ne den gaansama fu wi e meke taanga moiti so, fu kiya wi. Ma u Tata, Masaa Gadu moo sabi san de leti, fu tyai bun gi wi, fu seeka u libi moo anga moo kon de enke fa enseefi de.
eng_text: For they indeed, for a few days, punished us as seemed good to them; but he for our profit, that we may be partakers of his holiness.

djk_text: Da kiya e tan enke sani fu fii sitaafu. Ai tyai buduufu, a nái gi piisii. Ma na bakaten, da sama di teke leli a dati sa si a bun di a puu. Da u sa du san a wani namo, anga ala wan switi ati a Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: All chastening seems for the present to be not joyous but grievous; yet afterward it yields the peaceful fruit of righteousness to those who have been exercised thereby.

djk_text: We, biibiwan! Da kande i sa weli de enke sitee lon man booko sikoo, anga ala kikikiki kini, fu kai komoto na a pasi pe ai lon. Da nyun kaakiti de fanowdu fu teke, meke ana anga futu kon taanga baka, fu lon go doo.
eng_text: Therefore lift up the hands that hang down and the feeble knees,

djk_text: Da waka bun meke swakiwan di seefi de fu dyakata komoto sa teke taanga sikin a yu. Da den sa kon taanga baka, fu biibi go doo.
eng_text: and make straight paths for your feet, so that which is lame may not be dislocated, but rather be healed.

djk_text: Da feti naamo, fu meke sama de switi anga taawan de. Feti fu de apaiti fasi gi Masaa Gadu wawan. Bika sama di de taa fasi ná o fende pasi, fu go si Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Follow after peace with all men, and the sanctification without which no man will see the Lord,

djk_text: Da luku bun, fu sama á daai fika a gaan bun ati fasi, di Masaa Gadu teke luku wi. Meke sani á sa de a u mindii fu buuya u, fu poli somen taawan biibi enke bita paansu fika a ini goon, fu goo kwinsi taawan kii.
eng_text: looking carefully lest there be any man who falls short of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you, and many be defiled by it;

djk_text: Motyo biibiwan á mu de ape tu. Meke biibiwan ede á de feke fasi a Masaa Gadu. Bika na so Esaw be tan, ne a be seli a bun di en dda Isaki be o fika gi en, enke moo gaan manpikin. Fu wan peeti nyanyan ede!
eng_text: lest there be any sexually immoral person, or profane person, like Esau, who sold his birthright for one meal.

djk_text: Da kiinkiin u sabi fa bakaten, Esaw be wani fende ala a seigi de baka. A be suku fi en dda Isaki gi en ala a seigi di komoto a Masaa Gadu de. Ma fasi á be de fi en dda kengi san a be fiti poti kaba. Esaw kee begi seefi, ma na sondee fu poi fende a seigi de baka.
eng_text: For you know that even when he afterward desired to inherit the blessing, he was rejected, for he found no place for a change of mind though he sought it diligently with tears.

djk_text: Bika a nyun fasi fu wi dini Masaa Gadu, kengi anga fa a gaandi fasi be wasikoi, fu go koosube fu Masaa Gadu. A ini a gaan sabana, na a mongo pe a be de, da na faya anga ala somoko e boon komoto a doti doo tapu. Gaan winta e wai lontu en, donduu e bali, tapu e koti faya lontu en.
eng_text: For you have not come to a mountain that might be touched, and that burned with fire, and to blackness, darkness, storm,

djk_text: Ne wan tutu bali na a hii peesi, namo en tongo piki gaan makiti fasi, fu taki anga den Dyusama. Ne den feele te, den begi Mosesi, fi en e taki anga Masaa Gadu gi den. Noiti den wani yee en tongo pikinso moo seefi.
eng_text: the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which those who heard it begged that not one more word should be spoken to them,

djk_text: Bika a taki den weiti wan tumisi hebi fasi de. Soseefi ibiiwan fu den Dyusama ofu meti fu den, di be peefuu lobi sikin na a mongo de, da taawan be mu naki en kii anga siton.
eng_text: for they could not stand that which was commanded, "If even an animal touches the mountain, it shall be stoned ";

djk_text: San den Dyusama si a dei de, a gi den tuutuu feele. Mosesi seefi piki taki: “A gi mi seefi feele te tu. Mi hii sikin seefi dansi tu.”
eng_text: and so fearful was the appearance, that Moses said, "I am terrified and trembling."

djk_text: Ma a nyun fasi fu dini Masaa Gadu, tyai wi go doo Masaa Gadu Kondee a tapu anda seefi, na a Jelusalem Foto pe a sidon libilibi anda. A tapu fu Siyon Mongo, pe dunsu dunsu Engel fi en lontu, fu piisii te a bigi naamo.
eng_text: But you have come to Mount Zion, and to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to innumerable multitudes of angels,

djk_text: Ibiiwan pikin fi en mokisa de. Soseefi den di ai kai moo gaan Manpikin fi enseefi. Ala den disi nen sikiifi ne en buku, fu tan anda. Soseefi Masaa Gadu di mu kuutu ala sama de anda anga ala avo gaansama, di be libi fiti, fu de apaiti fasi gi Masaa Gadu nownow.
eng_text: to the general assembly and assembly of the firstborn who are enrolled in heaven, to God the Judge of all, to the spirits of just men made perfect,

djk_text: Soseefi Jesesi de anda, di taampu a mindii fu Masaa Gadu anga libisama, fu yeepi na a nyun kuudei, fu dini Masaa Gadu. Tapu anda seefi na pe a go tyatya en buulu, di meke Masaa Gadu teke tyali fasi luku sama. Dati kengi anga Abeli buulu, di be lon. Bika Masaa Gadu be teke a buulu de, fu luku sama di be kii en anga boon ati.
eng_text: to Jesus, the mediator of a new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling that speaks better than that of Abel.

djk_text: Da feti fu kaba taanga yesi gi Masaa Gadu di bosikopu e taki anga wi nownow. Bika a á be sipowtu anga avo gaansama di be taanga yesi gi san a be kon taki a Sinai Mongo. Da on moo, wi fu nownow sa fende sitaafu fu dati? Bika na tapu anda a de nownow, e taki anga u.
eng_text: See that you don't refuse him who speaks. For if they didn't escape when they refused him who warned on the earth, how much more will we not escape who turn away from him who warns from heaven,

djk_text: A be soi en makiti fasi wan leisi pasa kaba, di a be seke goontapu, anga en tongo. Ne en Buku sikiifi baka taki: “Mi ya o seke goontapu ete wan kodo lasiti leisi baka! Ma, a ná goontapu wawan namo, mi sa seke a leisi de. Bika ala taa sani doo tapu anda seefi, anga ala mi kondee a tapu, dise seefi.”
eng_text: whose voice shook the earth then, but now he has promised, saying, "Yet once more I will shake not only the earth, but also the heavens."

djk_text: Da a wankodo lasiti leisi baka wani taki, wan lasiti leisi namo. Ala sani di a meke o seke, da san be meke, fu fika tego sa taampu go doo. Ma san di á be meke fu fika tego, dati o lasi gwe.
eng_text: This phrase, "Yet once more," signifies the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that have been made, that those things which are not shaken may remain.

djk_text: Da biibiwan seefi o fende a bun di de a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu, di noiti poi kengi. Na dati meke u mu libi anga a gaan bun ati fasi, di Masaa Gadu teke luku wi so. Soseefi a taanga di a gi wi, fu poi dini en, fu piisii en ati. Soseefi lesipeki en go doo feele, anga ala wai komoto a pasi, gi sani di nái fiti en.
eng_text: Therefore, receiving a Kingdom that can't be shaken, let us have grace, through which we serve God acceptably, with reverence and awe,

djk_text: Bika a nái go anga sama di e taanga yesi gi en. A o kaba den dati a soso, enke gaan faya di e boon sani puu a pasi.
eng_text: for our God is a consuming fire.

djk_text: Da u mu tan lobi taa biibiwan, enke fa biibiwan mu lobi.
eng_text: Let brotherly love continue.

djk_text: Te sama di yu á sabi seefi waka doo yu, da ná feegete! Meke yu osu doo opo gi en. Bika somen sama sondee den be sabi, da na Engel di Masaa Gadu be sende go luku den so.
eng_text: Don't forget to show hospitality to strangers, for in doing so, some have entertained angels without knowing it.

djk_text: Biibiwan mu denki taa biibiwan di sooto a dunguu osu, fu a biibi ede. Booko ede yeepi den, enke fa yu be sa wani sama mu feti gi yu. Du so tu gi biibiwan di e teke mesaandi. Bika pakisei efu yuseefi be mu tuka anga dati wan dei.
eng_text: Remember those who are in bonds, as bound with them; and those who are ill-treated, since you are also in the body.

djk_text: Uman anga man di toow mu tan lesipeki denseefi, enke fa a libi fu den be bigin. Den á mu waka gi den seefi. Sitaafu fu dati o fende a Masaa Gadu. Da a kon, wan enkii motyo fasi á mu de a den mindii tu.
eng_text: Let marriage be held in honor among all, and let the bed be undefiled: but God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.

djk_text: Luku bun tu, fu giili fu moni á subi yu, fu lon suku moo anga moo. De tifeedi anga san yu abi. Bika Masaa Gadu be paamisi taki: “Noiti mi o fika u! Noiti yeepi o kaba komoto a mi, fu kon doo a u de.”
eng_text: Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, "I will in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you."

djk_text: Da ibii biibiwan sa abi kankan fu taki: “Masaa na mi Yeepiman, di e puu mi a ini ala sani. Efu mi kai en kon namo, da a doo kaba. Da mi nái feele! Bika, libisama seefi á sa de, fu poi du sani anga mi.”
eng_text: So that with good courage we say, "The Lord is my helper. I will not fear. What can man do to me?"

djk_text: Membee den edeman fu biibiwan, di tyai Masaa Gadu bosikopu kon doo yu de. Na den fosi gi yu a bosikopu de, fu toon biibisama. Luku fa den be tyai denseefi a lanti fesi anga a biibi, go doo kaba fu den libi. Da teke den baka futu so tu.
eng_text: Remember your leaders, men who spoke to you the word of God, and considering the results of their conduct, imitate their faith.

djk_text: Bika Jesesi Kelestesi noiti e kengi. Fa a be e wooko a fesi, na so tide ete seefi, go doo tego seefi.
eng_text: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.

djk_text: Ibii taa sowtu leli na fu kai leiwan, fu wai poti a wanse. Den e soi fa fu oli gwenti anga fasi, di á de fa Masaa Gadu e tyai yeepi. Ma u biibi anga ala fitoow namo, fa a teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku u.
eng_text: Don't be carried away by various and strange teachings, for it is good that the heart be established by grace, not by food, through which those who were so occupied were not benefited.

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu sete wan nyun apaiti begi tafaa gi wi. Na ape a poti a paiman di pai, fu wi takuudu anga ogii. Da sama di sa go doo anga a gaandi fasi fu dini Masaa Gadu, sa lasi a hii yeepi fu dati.
eng_text: We have an altar from which those who serve the holy tabernacle have no right to eat.

djk_text: Bika meti be e kii enke paiman. Da den moo hei apaiti begiman e teke en buulu tyai go poti na a Apaiti Kambaa, di meke seeka gi a apaiti Masaa Gadu wawan. Da a meti sikin mu tyai go boon a doose fu Jelusalem Foto. Da ala lanti, doo Masaa Gadu seefi sa si Awan di teke dede, fu yeepi den sama de.
eng_text: For the bodies of those animals, whose blood is brought into the holy place by the high priest as an offering for sin, are burned outside of the camp.

djk_text: Na so meke Jesesi be mu teke dede a doose fu Jelusalem Foto. Da ala lanti sa si a sikin di teke dede, fu yeepi sama nownow. Da sama di biibi dati sa kon de bun sama gi Masaa Gadu. Bika a buulu di pai de poi wasi libi kon de apaiti fasi gi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Therefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people through his own blood, suffered outside of the gate.

djk_text: Ma teke dede a doose fu Jelusalem Foto, na gaan sen sani. Ma fu yeepi wi, meke Jesesi á be abi bisi anga dati. Da meke u seefi teke en baka futu, fu de sondee bisi, fu waka komoto a fa u be leli dini Masaa Gadu a ini Jelusalem Foto, fu gwe a doose anda go mokisa libi makandii anga Jesesi, na a nyun fasi fu dini.
eng_text: Let us therefore go out to him outside of the camp, bearing his reproach.

djk_text: Bika peesi fu goontapu ya á de tuutuu tanpeesi fu tego, ma na wan satu pisiten namo u de ya. Na Masaa Gadu Kondee a tapu, u e luku fu fende libi tego.
eng_text: For we don't have here an enduring city, but we seek that which is to come.

djk_text: Da Jesesi enke a paiman di teke dede pai gi wi, de a tapu anda nownow enke wi moo hei apaiti begiman. Da bali gafa Masaa Gadu fu dati, meke dati piisii Masaa Gadu. Taigi taawan naamo san a de gi wi. Soseefi fa wi de sama fi en, di e gi en gaandi.
eng_text: Through him, then, let us offer up a sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of lips which proclaim allegiance to his name.

djk_text: Da ná feegete fu du bun gi taawan. Ma wooko anga san i abi makandii anga taawan, fu den sa fende san den abi fanowdu tu. Da ala dati na sani di yu e gi Masaa Gadu de, fu piisii en.
eng_text: But don't forget to be doing good and sharing, for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.

djk_text: Da lesipeki edeman di e tii taa biibiwan, fu tii yu naamo enke soluguman fu sikapu, di e tii sikapu. Meke buuya taanga yesi á sa de ape. Da den o fende paiman fu dati, te den sa poi piisii piki bun fi yu, a Masaa Gadu. Ma taa fasi sa buduufu den, meke den á sa poi piki bun fi yu a Masaa Gadu. Bika na den abi a faantiwowtu, fu luku yu.
eng_text: Obey your leaders and submit to them, for they watch on behalf of your souls, as those who will give account, that they may do this with joy, and not with groaning, for that would be unprofitable for you.

djk_text: Tan begi naamo, fu Masaa Gadu yeepi wi dise. Bika u e fitoow taki, wi konsensi á poi fon wi ati taki, u nái meke moiti anga a biibi libi. Ma ai go enke fa Masaa Gadu wani.
eng_text: Pray for us, for we are persuaded that we have a good conscience, desiring to live honorably in all things.

djk_text: Mi e sende u taki, begi seefi gi mi ya, fu Masaa Gadu sa taampu gi mi. Meke mi sa doo gawgaw a u mindii anda baka.
eng_text: I strongly urge you to do this, that I may be restored to you sooner.

djk_text: Fu u seefi, da mi e begi Masaa Gadu gi u. A meke u ati switi. A weki wi Masaa Jesesi puu a dede, meke en buulu waiti sai enke paiman, fu wi takuudu anga ogii. Dati na a nyun fasi fu dini Masaa Gadu, di noiti moo sa kengi. Soseefi a poti wi Masaa Jesesi enke a moo gaan Edeman, fu luku sama fi en, enke wan gaan Soluguman fu sikapu.
eng_text: Now may the God of peace, who brought again from the dead the great shepherd of the sheep with the blood of an eternal covenant, our Lord Jesus,

djk_text: Mi e begi tu, meke a seeka u libi ala fasi, fu de anga san u abi fanowdu. Da u sa poi du san a wani. Na so a o meke Jesesi Kelestesi yeepi. Da u sa dini en, fu piisii en. Da bali gafa Masaa Gadu tego! Bika a bigi tuutuu! Amen, na so a de!
eng_text: make you complete in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is well pleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Mi e begi u dati gaantangi, fu tan waka enke fa mi e sende u, fu dini na a nyun fasi fi en. Pikinso namo mi sikiifi na a biifi ya soi fa fu libi na a nyun fasi ya. Bika moo ipi sani de ete fu leli.
eng_text: But I exhort you, brothers, endure the word of exhortation, for I have written to you in few words.

djk_text: We, u biibi baala Timotiyesi komoto a dunguu osu kaba. Efu a kon doo mi ya gaw, fosi mi losi ya, da mi o tyai en, te mi e kon luku u anda.
eng_text: Know that our brother Timothy has been freed, with whom, if he comes shortly, I will see you.

djk_text: Wan apaiti fasi mi e sende odi gi ala fesiman fu tii biibiwan de. Soseefi, da gi odi doo ala den di de apaiti fasi gi Masaa Gadu de. Odi komoto a biibiwan fu Italiya Kondee dise gi u anda tu.
eng_text: Greet all of your leaders and all the saints. The Italians greet you.

djk_text: Mi e tapu a biifi ya. Ma mi e begi fu Masaa Gadu tan teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku u ala anda.
eng_text: Grace be with you all. Amen.

djk_text: Mi Jakowbesi ya e sikiifi a biifi ya gi yu enke Masaa Gadu foluku di panya gwe a doose fu Dyu Kondee. Masaa Gadu anga Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi na mi basi di mi e dini.
eng_text: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are in the Dispersion: Greetings.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Poolo te yu e tuka anga ala sowtu tesi. Dati bun.
eng_text: Count it all joy, my brothers , when you fall into various temptations,

djk_text: Bika sabi taki, te yu oli biibi pasa den tesi ya, da dati o leli yu tei ati, fu oli doo.
eng_text: knowing that the testing of your faith produces endurance.

djk_text: Da te yu abi tei ati fu oli doo, da i sa tan enke fa Masaa Gadu wani sama mu de seefi. Bika na tei ati fu oli doo mu tyai yu pasa ala tesi.
eng_text: Let endurance have its perfect work, that you may be perfect and complete, lacking in nothing.

djk_text: Ma te apaiti koni mankei yu fu wooko wan leti fasi a ini den tesi, da begi Masaa Gadu fu dati. Bika ala yuu a de anga en hii ati, fu gi dati sondee weli.
eng_text: But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach; and it will be given to him.

djk_text: Ma te yu e begi, da biibi mu de taki, Masaa Gadu e yee yu. Pikinso pantan á mu e seke yu ati seefi! Efuso yu ati o de enke paana fu liba di nái sidon a wan peesi.
eng_text: But let him ask in faith, without any doubting, for he who doubts is like a wave of the sea, driven by the wind and tossed.

djk_text: Da yu o waka anga tu ati di á sidon fu du wan enkii sani. Sowan sama á taampu bun. A ná o fende san ai begi Masaa Gadu de.
eng_text: For let that man not think that he will receive anything from the Lord.

djk_text: Yu enke biibiwan di pooti seefi mu poolo taki, i hei a Masaa Gadu ain.
eng_text: But let the brother in humble circumstances glory in his high position;

djk_text: Yu di gudu seefi mu poolo taki, i lagi a Masaa Gadu ain. Bika guduman seefi e dede ibii yuu, enke moi boomiki e dede, fosi a poti membee.
eng_text: and the rich, in that he is made humble, because like the flower in the grass, he will pass away.

djk_text: Wan pikin san namo e pii, da a boomiki law kai a doti, meke a hii moi fi en kaba wanten. Na so ai waka anga guduman na a yuu di ai lontu, fu suku gudu e dyunta naamo.
eng_text: For the sun arises with the scorching wind, and withers the grass, and the flower in it falls, and the beauty of its appearance perishes. So also will the rich man fade away in his pursuits.

djk_text: Da seigi fu den sama di e tuka anga ala sowtu tesi, ma den e oli biibi pasa den! Bika Masaa Gadu o gi i libi fu tego makandii anga enseefi, enke fa a paamisi ala sama di lobi en.
eng_text: Blessed is the man who endures temptation, for when he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life, which the Lord promised to those who love him.

djk_text: Ma kaba gi Masaa Gadu ogii nen taki, ne en meke tesi e miti yu. Bika tesi á de fu kon miti Masaa Gadu seefi te, da a sa poi du ogii. Da a nái meke tesi miti sama fu du ogii tu.
eng_text: Let no man say when he is tempted, "I am tempted by God," for God can't be tempted by evil, and he himself tempts no one.

djk_text: A fowtu didon na a sama seefi di e luku sani di sa tesi en. Den e soi switi, fu losutu.
eng_text: But each one is tempted, when he is drawn away by his own lust, and enticed.

djk_text: Da te a losutu goo kon lepi, da ai meke takuudu anga ogii. Da efi i gwenti fu libi so, da meke Masaa Gadu o kuutu yu, fu fende dede tego.
eng_text: Then the lust, when it has conceived, bears sin; and the sin, when it is full grown, brings forth death.

djk_text: Mi lobi biibiwan! Ná meke sama koli yu buuya anga a toli ya.
eng_text: Don't be deceived, my beloved brothers.

djk_text: Bika ala san Masaa Gadu a tapu gi wi na gaan bun sani, di seeka sai fa enseefi wani. A nái daai wooko taa fasi enke a san anga a mun anga den sitali di a meke a tapu, fu daai ibii yuu.
eng_text: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation, nor turning shadow.

djk_text: A abi en fasi di a wani wooko meke u toon pikin fi enseefi. Na a tuutuu wowtu di kon mu seeka u toon fosiwan di libi de fi en wawan namo a mindii fu ala taa sani a goontapu.
eng_text: Of his own will he brought us forth by the word of truth, that we should be a kind of first fruits of his creatures.

djk_text: Mi lobi biibiwan! Da te taawan kon soi yu Masaa Gadu wowtu, da gaw fu aliki! Ma ná gaw fu sitee piki sondee denki! Ná gaw boon ati a taawan tu.
eng_text: So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger;

djk_text: Bika boon ati sama á poi du san de leti gi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: for the anger of man doesn't produce the righteousness of God.

djk_text: Puu towe ala sowtu takuu manii anga goontapu fasi di á fiti. Teke saka fasi na ati. Da wooko enke goon di den puu ala takuu paansu fu paandi soso bun wan. Da Masaa Gadu wowtu sa goo taanga a ini yu, fu puu yu a takuudu anga ogii, fu fende libi tego.
eng_text: Therefore, putting away all filthiness and overflowing of wickedness, receive with humility the implanted word, which is able to save your souls .

djk_text: Namo, te i fusutan Masaa Gadu wowtu, da wooko leti enke fa a taki. Aliki namo, sondee fu du, dati e meke yu koli yu seefi.
eng_text: But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding your own selves.

djk_text: Soso aliki namo gei te sama si a sipikii namo fa en fesi tan.
eng_text: For if anyone is a hearer of the word and not a doer, he is like a man looking at his natural face in a mirror;

djk_text: A si fa en fesi tan fu seeka. Ma te a waka komoto na a sipikii fesi, da a feegete baka wanten fa a be tan.
eng_text: for he sees himself, and goes away, and immediately forgets what kind of man he was.

djk_text: Ma booko ede luku Masaa Gadu wowtu, enke a weiti fu seeka libi. Dati e soi a yeepi di e puu sama a taanga yesi fasi, anga ala a sitaafu fu dati. Ma ná feegete san i si de, fu seeka, da seigi sa de a ini ala san i teke fu du.
eng_text: But he who looks into the perfect law of freedom, and continues, not being a hearer who forgets, but a doer of the work, this man will be blessed in what he does.

djk_text: Sama di taki, ai dini Masaa Gadu mu dwengi en tongo. Bika fi yu á du dati, da yu e koli i seefi. A o de soso kaali, winsi yu e du ala taa sani fu Masaa Gadu ede seefi.
eng_text: If anyone among you thinks himself to be religious while he doesn't bridle his tongue, but deceives his heart, this man's religion is worthless.

djk_text: Bika fu dini u Tata, Masaa Gadu a tapu wan leti fasi, da langa ana yeepi pikin di fika sondee mma anga dda. Yeepi pooti uman di man dede fika a ganda tu. Wai komoto a pasi, fu a sowtu tyobo denki fu goontapu ya á poli yu!
eng_text: Pure religion and undefiled before our God and Father is this: to visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep oneself unstained by the world.

djk_text: We, biibiwan! Na Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi di u e biibi namo abi ala gaandi anga ala gaan dyendee. Da kaba keli sama hei moo sama.
eng_text: My brothers, don't hold the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ of glory with partiality.

djk_text: Kon u taki, tu nyun sama kon a u biibiwan mindii de. Wan gudu wei gaan dyendee koosi e koti faya, wei beenki finga linga. A taawan pooti wei boko koosi a sikin fanyaa.
eng_text: For if a man with a gold ring, in fine clothing, comes into your synagogue , and a poor man in filthy clothing also comes in;

djk_text: We ne wanten u teke a guduwan poti a hei taki: “Subi kon teke peesi a heiwan mindii dise.” Da u daai bali a pootiwan taki: “Pasa go taampu a wanse anda! Ofu, da kon sidon na a se fu u futu bangi a doti ya.”
eng_text: and you pay special attention to him who wears the fine clothing, and say, "Sit here in a good place"; and you tell the poor man, "Stand there," or "Sit by my footstool";

djk_text: Da u du gaan ogii de. Bika u taampu enke lanti di nái kuutu sani leti. U wooko fowtu fasi e keli sama hei moo sama.
eng_text: haven't you shown partiality among yourselves, and become judges with evil thoughts?

djk_text: Mi lobi biibiwan! U mu sabi taki, Masaa Gadu nái si pootiwan fu goontapu ya fu lagi sani. Bika u si fa a teke denseefi toon en sama di a gi somen gaan bun fi en tu. A seeka den libi fu go fende a bun di de a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu. Na so a paamisi fu gi ala sama di lobi en.
eng_text: Listen, my beloved brothers. Didn't God choose those who are poor in this world to be rich in faith, and heirs of the Kingdom which he promised to those who love him?

djk_text: Da u á mu peefuu wooko sondee lesipeki lagi pootiwan de. Bika na guduman makiti e dwengi u de soso kaali. Na den makiti e seepi u tyai go kuutu a gaanlanti fesi. A ná pootiwan e du dati.
eng_text: But you have dishonored the poor man. Don't the rich oppress you, and personally drag you before the courts?

djk_text: Na guduman seefi abi deki ati e wisiwasi a bunbun nen fu wi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi di wi e tyai enke sama fi en.
eng_text: Don't they blaspheme the honorable name by which you are called?

djk_text: We, Masaa Gadu enke Kownu, di e tii ala sani, soi wi a mama fi en weiti a Masaa Gadu Buku, di noiti u mu peefuu taanga yesi gi. A taki: “Lobi taawan enke fa i lobi iseefi.” Dati na a leti fasi fu libi.
eng_text: However, if you fulfill the royal law, according to the Scripture, "You shall love your neighbor as yourself," you do well.

djk_text: Ma sama di e keli sama hei moo sama, e du wan gaan ogii anga ala takuudu. Na so Masaa Gadu weiti e soi wi.
eng_text: But if you show partiality, you commit sin, being convicted by the law as transgressors.

djk_text: Da booko fu a weiti de namo e poli a hii weiti fu Masaa Gadu seefi. Bika winsi ala taa weiti e oli, ma wan kodo booko, da toku a kisi a hii weiti sikin.
eng_text: For whoever keeps the whole law, and yet stumbles in one point, he has become guilty of all.

djk_text: Bika na a seefi Masaa Gadu di poti a weiti taki: “I á mu motyo,” seefi poti taki: “I á mu kii taawan.” Da efi i nái motyo, ma yu e kii, da a weiti di i booko de e kisi a hii weiti sikin kaba.
eng_text: For he who said, "Do not commit adultery," also said, "Do not commit murder." Now if you do not commit adultery, but murder, you have become a transgressor of the law.

djk_text: Da du ala sani anga koni, doo ala san yu e taki seefi! Masaa Gadu o kuutu ala dati fini fini, na a fasi fa a poti en weiti fu tyai sama puu a takuudu anga ogii.
eng_text: So speak, and so do, as men who are to be judged by a law of freedom.

djk_text: Da sama di nái wooko tyali ati fasi anga taawan, da Masaa Gadu seefi ná o wooko tyali ati fasi anga en baka na a gaan kuutu dei. Bika wooko tyali ati fasi anga taawan e tyai wini, fu meke den wooko tyali ati fasi anga yu seefi baka a kuutu.
eng_text: For judgment is without mercy to him who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.

djk_text: We, biibiwan! Ibiiwan sama sa taki anga mofu taki, a abi biibi. Ma efu a biibi libi nái wooko, da bun fu dati ná o poi fende a Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: What good is it, my brothers, if a man says he has faith, but has no works? Can faith save him?

djk_text: Bika efu wan pooti biibiwan a u mindii de e mankei koosi anga nyanyan ibii dei,
eng_text: And if a brother or sister is naked and in lack of daily food,

djk_text: ma mofu namo e taigi en taki: “Gadu o yeepi yu. Gwe anga wan switi ati! Wei deki koosi waan yu sikin! Nyan fuu i bee!” Da a biibi libi nái wooko, fu meke a fende bun de.
eng_text: and one of you tells them, "Go in peace, be warmed and filled"; and yet you didn't give them the things the body needs, what good is it?

djk_text: Na so mofu namo sa taki: “Biibi de.” Ma efu a biibi libi nái wooko, da a tan enke te a boo fu wan libi nái wooko. Da na dedewan.
eng_text: Even so faith, if it has no works, is dead in itself.

djk_text: Da sama sa denki taki, na taa biibiwan fende taanga a Masaa Gadu taki, dati biibi libi mu wooko. Ma enseefi fende taanga fu abi biibi namo, da a kaba. Ma dati á kan! Bika mi ya sabi taki, fu soi taki mi abi biibi, da mi biibi libi mu e wooko.
eng_text: Yes, a man will say, "You have faith, and I have works." Show me your faith without works, and I by my works will show you my faith.

djk_text: Na wan moi sani di u ala sabi taki, wan Gadu de tuu. Ma fa fu takuu jeje? Denseefi e biibi so tu, ma anga ala gaan feele.
eng_text: You believe that God is one. You do well. The demons also believe, and shudder.

djk_text: Meke poli fusutan sama aliki ya! Mi o soi fa biibi libi di nái wooko sa meke yu tyai nen fu soso taki, i na biibisama!
eng_text: But do you want to know, vain man, that faith apart from works is dead?

djk_text: Bika saide Masaa Gadu be teli u avo Abalaham taki, a de bun gi en? Na di en biibi libi be e wooko. Na dati soi en biibi. Bika a teke en wankodo manpikin Isaki seeka poti na a apaiti begi tafaa, fu kii boon gi Masaa Gadu enke paiman.
eng_text: Wasn't Abraham our father justified by works, in that he offered up Isaac his son on the altar?

djk_text: U e si de, a ná mofu namo a be taki, ai biibi. Ma en biibi libi be e wooko enke fa Masaa Gadu sende en fu du. Na dati meke a biibi fi en be doo peesi enke fa biibi mu de.
eng_text: You see that faith worked with his works, and by works faith was perfected;

djk_text: Ne sani waka de enke fa Masaa Gadu Buku sikiifi taki: “Abalaham biibi Masaa Gadu, ne a teli en enke sama di de bun gi en.” A kai Abalaham gaan mati seefi.
eng_text: and the Scripture was fulfilled which says, "Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him as righteousness"; and he was called the friend of God.

djk_text: Dati e soi fa Masaa Gadu e teli sama taki, a de bun gi en. Na sama di biibi libi e wooko, na dati ai teli so. Ma a nái tan teli sama soso kaali so, fu di den mofu namo e taki, den e biibi.
eng_text: You see then that by works, a man is justified, and not only by faith.

djk_text: Bika luku Laakabu, enke wan gaan motyo uman fu Jelikow Foto seefi, di a be teli taki, de bun gi en. Bika en biibi libi be e wooko. Di ogii be de fu miti suudati di Josuwa be sende kibii go ondoosuku Jelikow Foto, ne a teke den kibii a ini en osu. A soi den a pasi fu lowe komoto a ini a foto seefi.
eng_text: In the same way, wasn't Rahab the prostitute also justified by works, in that she received the messengers, and sent them out another way?

djk_text: Da sabi taki, biibi, ma fu a biibi libi nái wooko, da a tan enke te a boo fu wan libi nái wooko. Da na dedewan.
eng_text: For as the body apart from the spirit is dead, even so faith apart from works is dead.

djk_text: Son biibiwan wani teke a wooko, fu leli taawan a biibi libi. Ma sabi taki, na yu libi Masaa Gadu o moo kuutu fini fini.
eng_text: Let not many of you be teachers, my brothers, knowing that we will receive heavier judgment.

djk_text: Bika ibii sama e misi anga libi. Da sama á de di tongo nái misi taigi taawan sani di á fiti. Boiti sama di libi seeka sai, da ala pisi fi en hii sikin e teke taki enke fa Masaa Gadu wani.
eng_text: For in many things we all stumble. If anyone doesn't stumble in word, the same is a perfect man, able to bridle the whole body also.

djk_text: Luku wan gaan meti enke asi. Anga wan pikin tetei namo den e tei en mofu fu tii en hii sikin, fu poti a pasi.
eng_text: Indeed, we put bits into the horses' mouths so that they may obey us, and we guide their whole body.

djk_text: Gaan sipi a ze, di gaan taanga winta e toosi, a wan pikin pali di de ondoo wataa den e tii en, fu poti a hii sipi a pasi.
eng_text: Behold, the ships also, though they are so big and are driven by fierce winds, are yet guided by a very small rudder, wherever the pilot desires.

djk_text: Na so sama tongo nyoni na a hii sikin fi en, ma en wooko bigi. Bika denki pikin tongo fu faya seefi di e sutu boon wan hii gaan busi.
eng_text: So the tongue is also a little member, and boasts great things. See how a small fire can spread to a large forest!

djk_text: Na so tongo sa poli wan sama hii libi toon gaan takuuduman. Ai sokoo sani naamo fu miti sama, hii libi langa. Didibii seefi e suku tongo fu sutu faya, taki den ogii di a wani.
eng_text: And the tongue is a fire. The world of iniquity among our members is the tongue, which defiles the whole body, and sets on fire the course of nature, and is set on fire by Gehenna.

djk_text: Sama makiti fu dwengi ala sowtu meti go doo foo anga meti di e hali anga bee. Ala fisi anga wataa meti seefi.
eng_text: For every kind of animal, bird, creeping thing, and thing in the sea, is tamed, and has been tamed by mankind.

djk_text: Ma sama á de fu dwengi en tongo. Bika ala yuu ai wai go taki ogii. A lai wisi fu puu kii taawan.
eng_text: But nobody can tame the tongue. It is a restless evil, full of deadly poison.

djk_text: Da mofu e teke bali gafa u Tata, Masaa Gadu a tapu. Ma a seefi mofu e teke saanti taawan, di seefi Masaa Gadu meke enke paansu fi enseefi.
eng_text: With it we bless our God and Father, and with it we curse men, who are made in the image of God.

djk_text: Na so mofu e teke bali gafa Masaa Gadu, ma ai saanti taawan tu. We, biibiwan mofu á mu wooko so!
eng_text: Out of the same mouth comes forth blessing and cursing. My brothers, these things ought not to be so.

djk_text: Bika peti wataa á de di mokisa tu sowtu wataa enke bita wataa anga switi wataa.
eng_text: Does a spring send out from the same opening fresh and bitter water?

djk_text: Mi lobi biibiwan! A seefi bon nái meke tu sowtu sii, enke fa figasii anga oleifi sii, nái komoto na a seefi bon. Bon di e meke doloifi sii, á poi meke figasii tu. Tyobo peti wataa ná o poi puu kiin wataa tu.
eng_text: Can a fig tree, my brothers, yield olives, or a vine figs? Thus no spring yields both salt water and fresh water.

djk_text: Da i sa taki, yu e fusutan sani fu Masaa Gadu. Soseefi yu de anga apaiti koni fu wooko wan leti fasi. Ma sondee fu abi apaiti koni fu waka saka fasi anga dati, da yu á mu gafa so.
eng_text: Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show by his good conduct that his deeds are done in gentleness of wisdom.

djk_text: Bika te yu ati fuu anga ala bita dyalusu fasi fu suku hei peesi teke taawan peesi, da yu á mu gafa so. Bika yu e lei gi a tuutuu leli di komoto a Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: But if you have bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your heart, don't boast and don't lie against the truth.

djk_text: Apaiti koni fu wooko wan leti fasi nái waka so. Na a pasi fu didibii pe sama e libi a goontapu ya e waka so, fu suku san denseefi ati e angii. Na takuu jeje e tii a sowtu libi de.
eng_text: This wisdom is not that which comes down from above, but is earthly, sensual, and demonic.

djk_text: Bika dyalusu suku hei peesi e denki yu wawan namo á mu wooko enke basi a biibiwan tapu. Dati sa tyai buuya anga ala sowtu takuudu a u mindii de.
eng_text: For where jealousy and selfish ambition are, there is confusion and every evil deed.

djk_text: Ma, da a sowtu libi di abi apaiti koni fu wooko wan leti fasi enke fa Masaa Gadu wani, da a fosi sani yu o si, na wan libi di seeka kiin. Da a ati e switi a taawan. Soseefi lesipeki taawan denki fu wooko sondee taanga yesi anga dati. Soseefi fii tyali ati fu yeepi taawan. Keli sama hei moo sama nái de ape. Libi seefi nái waka koli koli fasi anga taawan.
eng_text: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceful, gentle, reasonable, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.

djk_text: Te sama e libi switi anga taawan so, da a sa meke taawan si fa fu wooko so tu. Da libi sa waka a den dati mindii anga ala leti fasi gi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Now the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace.

djk_text: Ma san e tyai feti anga ala opuulu a biibiwan mindii? Na te losutu de na ati fu suku sani.
eng_text: Where do wars and fightings among you come from? Don't they come from your pleasures that war in your members?

djk_text: Bika taanga losutu na ati e de fu suku fu fende sani. Soseefi bigi ain a sama sani. Ma ala dati nái meke yu fende san yu e suku. Da ai tyai feti anga ala opuulu na ati. Sowan sama sa kii seefi, fu fende san ai suku. Ma saide a nái poi fende a sani? Na di a nái begi Masaa Gadu dati.
eng_text: You lust, and don't have. You kill, covet, and can't obtain. You fight and make war. You don't have, because you don't ask.

djk_text: A sa begi Masaa Gadu a sani seefi, ma a nái gi enmi en, fu di ai si wan fowtu fasi na a sama taki, a losutu fi en na fu fende sani piisii enseefi ati namo.
eng_text: You ask, and don't receive, because you ask with wrong motives, so that you may spend it for your pleasures.

djk_text: Bika libisama lobi feti a goontapu sani baka. Ma biibiwan mu sabi taki, teke a fasi de fu libi sa meke iseefi daai fika Masaa Gadu toon feyanti fi en tu. Da yu libi sa gei wan uman di á de fu fitoow. Dati e fika en man du ogii anga taawan.
eng_text: You adulterers and adulteresses, don't you know that friendship with the world is enmity with God? Whoever therefore wants to be a friend of the world makes himself an enemy of God.

djk_text: Da a ná fu soso Masaa Gadu Buku sikiifi taki, Masaa Gadu e dyalusu. A de enke a man di e booko ede, fu paati á mu kon fi en anga a jeje di a gi sama.
eng_text: Or do you think that the Scripture says in vain, "The Spirit who lives in us yearns jealously"?

djk_text: Da a wani teke moo gaan bun ati fasi namo, fu luku wi. Ma en Buku sikiifi tu taki: “Sama di hei enseefi, da na feti Masaa Gadu o feti booko dati saka. Na sama di saka ne en ondoo, fu teke en taki, sa fende en gaan bun ati fasi.”
eng_text: But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, "God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble."

djk_text: Da saka a Masaa Gadu ondoo fu teke en taki. Ma toto futu sitee anga didibii, da a o wai a yu pasi.
eng_text: Be subject therefore to God. But resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

djk_text: Diipi go koosube fu Masaa Gadu, da a o kon koosube fi yu baka. Meke sama di e waka anga tu ati seeka dati leti. Meke den di ati á sidon a wan peesi seeka dati.
eng_text: Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners; and purify your hearts, you double-minded.

djk_text: Teke tuutuu ten booko ede, tyali fu kukutu fasi di de a yu libi. Kaba lafu piisii de fosi! Kee seefi!
eng_text: Lament, mourn, and weep. Let your laughter be turned to mourning, and your joy to gloom.

djk_text: Saka a Masaa Gadu ondoo, da a o poti yu a hei.
eng_text: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he will exalt you.

djk_text: Biibiwan mu kaba taki ogii fu taawan. Kaba kaagi fa taawan á bun. Bika, da yu misi Masaa Gadu weiti. Soseefi, da yu poti yuseefi enke gaanlanti fu kuutu. Da ai soi taki, yu nái du san Masaa Gadu wani.
eng_text: Don't speak against one another, brothers. He who speaks against a brother and judges his brother, speaks against the law and judges the law. But if you judge the law, you are not a doer of the law, but a judge.

djk_text: Bika ne en wawan kodo namo de enke gaanlanti fu kuutu den di e booko en weiti anga ala fu kaba den a soso. Soseefi a poi puu sama na a pasi fu takuudu anga ogii. Da fa yu e denki fi yu seefi, fu go teke kuutu wooko?
eng_text: Only one is the lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy. But who are you to judge another?

djk_text: Fa yu enke libisama sa poi fiti a fesi taki, tide, tamaa, na sowan sowan foto wi o go, komoto de go a dati? Da wi o tan wan hii yali ape anga ape, bai sani de komoto go seli meke moni, fu gwe moo faawe.
eng_text: Come now, you who say, "Today or tomorrow let's go into this city, and spend a year there, trade, and make a profit."

djk_text: Bika yu na libisama, yu á sabi san tamaa o tyai gi yu! Libi a goontapu ya na fu wan satu pisiten namo. U makiliki fu wai puu ya enke fa dampu fu kuku patu e wai gwe.
eng_text: Whereas you don't know what your life will be like tomorrow. For what is your life? For you are a vapor, that appears for a little time, and then vanishes away.

djk_text: Da fa u sa naki boo fu ati gafa a fesi san anga san u o du? A moo bun u taki, fu Masaa Gadu wani, da u sa de a libi fu du so anga so. Ma mi sabi saide sama e gafa a fesi san a o du! Na bigi membee e tyai ala dati, fu taki bigi so. Ma sabi taki, na wan gaan ogii fu wooko so.
eng_text: For you ought to say, "If the Lord wills, we will both live, and do this or that."

djk_text: Biibiwan sa sabi sani fu Masaa Gadu seefi, ma a abi taanga yesi, fu teke a leti fasi de fu libi. Da a du ogii anga ala takuudu de.
eng_text: To him therefore who knows to do good, and doesn't do it, to him it is sin.

djk_text: Guduman, aliki ya! Kaba poolo! Ma bali kee kusumi seefi! Bika yu o tuka anga sani.
eng_text: Come now, you rich, weep and howl for your miseries that are coming on you.

djk_text: I dyunta tyaipi gudu goo mongo, ma na fu loto poli. Moi koosi di i abi seefi na fu mitimiti nyan poli.
eng_text: Your riches are corrupted and your garments are moth-eaten.

djk_text: Gowtu doo solufu sani di i dyunta de, o fika fuunsu kaba a soso tu. A kaba a soso fu den sani ya na wan wasikoi taki, iseefi musu fu kaba a soso. Fasi á de fu kibii gi a sitaafu di mu kon tuka anga yu. Bika Masaa Gadu o puu guduman a pasi enke fa faya e boon sani poli. Da bali kee kusumi fu den gudu di i dyunta kibii, a den lasiti dei pe goontapu de fu kaba ya.
eng_text: Your gold and your silver are corroded, and their corrosion will be for a testimony against you, and will eat your flesh like fire. You have laid up your treasure in the last days.

djk_text: Bika pakisei ogii di i du anga wookoman di wooko i goon. I be paamisi den paiman, ma di yuu doo fu pai, ne yu á wani pai den. Namo den be e kusumi gaan kusumi! Da ala a tyali de, wai go nama na a yesi fu Masaa Sebaot, a moo gaan Masaa Gadu a tapu. Da a fika ne en ana, fu pai a sama di du a ogii de anga den taawan.
eng_text: Behold, the wages of the laborers who mowed your fields, which you have kept back by fraud, cry out, and the cries of those who reaped have entered into the ears of the Lord of Armies .

djk_text: Ma libi be waka bun gi yu enke guduman. Yu be fende pasi du sani pasa peesi a goontapu. Na so meti seefi e kweki solugu kon fatu doo peesi, fosi den kii en. Na dati meke i fende pasi du sani doo peesi, fu fende sitaafu na a gaan kuutu dei fu Masaa Gadu so.
eng_text: You have lived delicately on the earth, and taken your pleasure. You have nourished your hearts as in a day of slaughter.

djk_text: Bika yu be seepi den di á du sani seefi, tyai go a kuutu a gaanlanti fesi. Den á be poi toto futu a baka seefi. Da yu e lei de taki, a du sani anga yu, di sai fu kii en.
eng_text: You have condemned, you have murdered the righteous one. He doesn't resist you.

djk_text: We, biibiwan! U tan luku a konbaka fu wi Masaa anga ala pasensi. U pakisei fa wan sama di paandi goon mu e tei ati oli gaan pasensi. Bika ai denki a ten di a goon o puu nyanyan. Da ai tan luku ala sowtu fasi di alen mu kai nati a doti, fu puu bunbun paansu.
eng_text: Be patient therefore, brothers, until the coming of the Lord. Behold, the farmer waits for the precious fruit of the earth, being patient over it, until it receives the early and late rain.

djk_text: Na so biibiwan mu tei ati oli gaan pasensi fitoow wi Masaa. Bika dyonson a sa kon doo ya kaba.
eng_text: You also be patient. Establish your hearts, for the coming of the Lord is at hand.

djk_text: We, biibiwan! Te u e tuka anga tesi, da kaba taki mandii fasi anga ala ogii fu taawan a u mindii de. Da Masaa Gadu ná o abi fu sitaafu u seefi sowan fasi. Bika ne en de fu kuutu ala sani, soseefi a taampu fu kon du dati kaba.
eng_text: Don't grumble, brothers, against one another, so that you won't be judged. Behold, the judge stands at the door.

djk_text: Pakisei son apaiti takiman di Masaa Gadu be meke e taki sani a fesiten a ini en nen. Sama be tyai banowtu kon a den pasi ogii ogii. Ma den á be luku ala dati.
eng_text: Take, brothers, for an example of suffering and of patience, the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.

djk_text: Pakisei ala taawan go doo Jop seefi, di u e si enke seigi sama nownow! Den be biibi Masaa Gadu pasa a ini somen tesi. Jop, dati tan teke tei ati fu oli doo, pasa somen tesi. Ne luku fa Masaa Gadu be daai ala sani kon puu bun gi en bakadati. Na so Masaa Gadu e wooko tyali ati fasi anga ala sama.
eng_text: Behold, we call them blessed who endured. You have heard of the patience of Job, and have seen the Lord in the outcome, and how the Lord is full of compassion and mercy.

djk_text: We, biibiwan! Da moomoo seefi, ná sweli seefi fosi i paamisi taawan wan sani. Ná kai sani nen fu soi taki yu ná o lei. Ná kai Masaa Gadu nen ofu en kondee a tapu anda seefi. Goontapu ya nen seefi yu á mu teke kai. Ma te i taki, ya ofu nono, da a sai kaba. Bika sitaafu fu dati sa de na a gaan kuutu dei fu Masaa Gadu taki, na gaan ogii.
eng_text: But above all things, my brothers, don't swear, neither by heaven, nor by the earth, nor by any other oath; but let your "yes" be "yes," and your "no," "no"; so that you don't fall into hypocrisy.

djk_text: Meke biibiwan di abi banowtu begi Masaa Gadu. Biibiwan di sani e switi gi, mu singi gafa Masaa Gadu, gi en gaandi.
eng_text: Is any among you suffering? Let him pray. Is any cheerful? Let him sing praises.

djk_text: Biibiwan di siki didon mu sende kai fesiman fu keliki, meke den taampu a ini a nen fu Masaa, da den lobi fatu ne en sikin, poti ana ne en tapu begi gi en. Da a sa kon bun baka.
eng_text: Is any among you sick? Let him call for the elders of the assembly, and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord,

djk_text: Ma ala dati mu waka anga a leti biibi. Da Masaa Gadu sa aliki san den begi. Da a o meke a sikiman kon bun baka. Soseefi a sikiman sa fende paadon a Masaa Gadu, fu ala takuudu anga ogii di a be du.
eng_text: and the prayer of faith will heal him who is sick, and the Lord will raise him up. If he has committed sins, he will be forgiven.

djk_text: Na dati meke ibiiwan de mu puu takuudu anga ogii a den ati taigi taawan. Da den sa begi Masaa Gadu paadon makandii gi den seefi, fu seeka ala sani kon bun baka. Da Masaa Gadu o deesi a sikiman, fu di ala den taampu de enke fa a wani. Da den sa poi begi a sowtu fasi, pe taanga anga ala kaakiti e komoto, fu meke sani pasa.
eng_text: Confess your offenses to one another, and pray for one another, that you may be healed. The insistent prayer of a righteous person is powerfully effective.

djk_text: Pakisei Eliya di be de libisama enke mi anga yu. Ma a be poi begi Masaa Gadu faya faya anga en hii ati, meke alen á kai moo a ini a kondee. Namo dii yali anga afu langa alen á kai.
eng_text: Elijah was a man with a nature like ours, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain, and it didn't rain on the earth for three years and six months.

djk_text: Pakisei di a be begi fu alen kai baka. Namo wanten, tapu anda baaka dunguu pii. Alen kai baka wanten meke doti puu nyanyan baka.
eng_text: He prayed again, and the sky gave rain, and the earth brought forth its fruit.

djk_text: We, biibiwan! Son wan e diipi fika biibi a tuutuu leli fu Masaa Gadu. Ma ná fika den sama de wai gwe so! Meke moiti tyai den kon baka na a leti pasi ya.
eng_text: Brothers, if any among you wanders from the truth, and someone turns him back,

djk_text: Bika sama di e diipi gwe sa kai go a ini takuudu anga ogii baka. Ma teke fu tyai den dati puu anda kon baka, da yu meke den fende gaan yeepi di sa puu den na a sitaafu fu Masaa Gadu na a gaan kuutu dei di taki, den mu dede. Na so den sa fende paadon, fu ala san den du.
eng_text: let him know that he who turns a sinner from the error of his way will save a soul from death, and will cover a multitude of sins.

djk_text: Mi Peitilisi na wan apaiti bosikopuman fu Jesesi Kelestesi. Da mi e meke a biifi ya sende gi u biibiwan di panya gwe a den paandasi fu Pontesi, fu Galasiya, fu Kapadosiya, fu Asiya anga fu Bitiniya! Bika Masaa Gadu teke u toon sama fi enseefi. Ne u de nyun sowtu sama enke wakaman di á de fu den paandasi de. A Tata fu u ya be teke u sowan fasi kaba, fosi goontapu be meke seefi. Ne a Apaiti Jeje fi en kon poti u nownow apaiti fasi, di u teke a taki fu Jesesi Kelestesi, di buulu wasi u kon kiin. We, da meke moo anga moo a teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku u. Soseefi, meke u ati de switi.
eng_text: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the chosen ones who are living as foreigners in the Dispersion in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,

djk_text: Bali gafa a Gadu fu wi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi ya di de en Tata. A weki en puu a dede, ne a wooko tyali ati fasi anga wi sowan fasi. Bika enke fa Tata e gi pikin libi, na so ai gi wi a nyun libi fi en de. Da u sa luku, fu fende taa bun di a paamisi wi bakaten seefi tu.
eng_text: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy became our father again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,

djk_text: Ala dati na waiti sani fi en di noiti sa poi poli enke goontapu sani ya. Na ala dati a seeka poti bakaten, fu u go teke a tapu anda, toon fu u seefi.
eng_text: to an incorruptible and undefiled inheritance that doesn't fade away, reserved in Heaven for you,

djk_text: Ma yaaso seefi ai kibii u makiti fasi kaba, solanga biibi tan poti ne en tapu. Da bakaten doo en kondee, te en lasiti pisi fu yeepi sa doo, da ala ogii o wai fika soso bun.
eng_text: who by the power of God are guarded through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.

djk_text: Piisii seefi fu ala dati! Bika na tuutuu sani fu kon miti wi. Ma wi e tuka anga ala sowtu buduufu sani nownow. Ma u á mu luku dati. Bika na fu wan satu pisiten namo.
eng_text: Wherein you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while, if need be, you have been put to grief in various trials,

djk_text: Bika u e pasa a ini den faya sani ya, fu keli u biibi luku. Da u sa fende gafa fu dati, te Jesesi Kelestesi sa daai kon baka. Na so gowtu seefi mu pasa a ini faya, fu keli en luku. Da den e teke en meke dyendee sani di á de fu tan tego seefi.
eng_text: that the proof of your faith, which is more precious than gold that perishes even though it is tested by fire, may be found to result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ--

djk_text: We, u anda lobi Masaa Jesesi anga ala taanga biibi de. Ma a ná enke u si en anga u ain ete seefi. Ma u e piisii bigi de kaba te, ne u á sabi fa fu taki en. Bika na dyendee piisii di e komoto a Masaa Gadu a tapu seefi.
eng_text: whom not having known you love; in whom, though now you don't see him, yet believing, you rejoice greatly with joy unspeakable and full of glory--

djk_text: Bika u sabi taki, wan dei e kon bakaten doo en kondee anda. Da en lasiti pisi fu yeepi o doo, fu ala ogii wai fika soso bun. Na so a biibi ya tyai gi wi.
eng_text: receiving the result of your faith, the salvation of your souls.

djk_text: A be piki son apaiti takiman fi en a sani ya, a fositen. Ma den á be kaba fusutan en kiinkiin. Ma den be e foondoo namo taki, sowtu fasi a o teke gaan bun ati fasi luku sama seefi? Den hii libi langa den be e ondoosuku dati naamo.
eng_text: Concerning this salvation, the prophets sought and searched diligently, who prophesied of the grace that would come to you,

djk_text: Da na a Apaiti Jeje di de a Kelestesi seefi be de a den tapu. Da ai piki den taki, a Kelestesi o kon teke pina. Ma dati o daai toon wini, fu meke Masaa Gadu soi en gaan makiti. We, den á be meke sipowtu, fu ondoosuku on ten anga sowtu maiki o soi a yuu ten, di dati o pasa.
eng_text: searching for who or what kind of time the Spirit of Christ, which was in them, pointed to, when he predicted the sufferings of Christ, and the glories that would follow them.

djk_text: Ma a Apaiti Jeje be e piki den naamo, fa dati ná o pasa na a yuu ten fu den de. Den Engel seefi be giili fu si, fa dati o waka. Ma na bakaten pe wi e libi nownow, ne a sende a Apaiti Jeje fi en komoto a tapu anda, kon meke den apaiti bosikopuman fu Masaa Jesesi poi taigi u de a Bun Nyunsu ya.
eng_text: To them it was revealed, that not to themselves, but to you, they ministered these things, which now have been announced to you through those who preached the Good News to you by the Holy Spirit sent out from heaven; which things angels desire to look into.

djk_text: Da banti a bosikopu ya poti a ede, fu fusutan fa fu libi! Poti ede bun, fu wooko leti. Denki sondee pantan taki, ala san paamisi o kon pasa. Bakaten doo Masaa Gadu Kondee, da en lasiti pisi fu yeepi o doo, fu ala ogii wai fika soso bun. Dati na di Jesesi Kelestesi o kon baka.
eng_text: Therefore prepare your minds for action, be sober and set your hope fully on the grace that will be brought to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ--

djk_text: We, Masaa Gadu e si u, fi en tuutuu pikin, di mu teke en taki ala yuu. Da na di u á be de biibisama ete, ne u be de anga takuudu anga ogii, enke fa useefi e losutu fu libi. Ma nownow, da sani á mu waka so moo!
eng_text: as children of obedience, not conforming yourselves according to your former lusts as in your ignorance,

djk_text: Libi apaiti fasi enke fa Masaa Gadu seefi libi de apaiti fasi. Bika ne en kai u kon toon sama fi enseefi. Da wai a pasi gi takuudu anga ogii. Meke yu libi sa de apaiti fasi a ini ala yu waka.
eng_text: but just as he who called you is holy, you yourselves also be holy in all of your behavior;

djk_text: Bika a be piki Mosesi fu sikiifi taki: “Mi Masaa Gadu ya libi de apaiti fasi, da meke sama fu mi, libi de apaiti fasi tu!”
eng_text: because it is written, "You shall be holy; for I am holy."

djk_text: We, u leli fu kai Masaa Gadu u Tata. Ma sabi soseefi taki, a de fu kuutu ala sani, fu luku san fiti fu pai ibiiwan, sondee fu luku anga fesi. Da lesipeki en a ini ala san yu e du, solanga yu de enke wan wakaman di de nyun sowtu sama ya ete.
eng_text: If you call on him as Father, who without respect of persons judges according to each man's work, pass the time of your living as foreigners here in reverent fear:

djk_text: Sabi taki, ibii paandasi abi en fasi fu libi, di komoto a wi avo gaansama kon doo wi. Da wi e du sani di á waiti gi Masaa Gadu. Da den sani ya e wooko enke basi a u tapu. Ma nownow, da u bai puu na a dwengi libi de, anga wan paiman di waiti sondee fu poi poli, enke gowtu ofu solufu sani.
eng_text: knowing that you were redeemed, not with corruptible things, with silver or gold, from the useless way of life handed down from your fathers,

djk_text: Na a buulu fu Masaa Jesesi di lon gi wi, noiti poi poli. Da a waiti fu pai! Bika noiti a du wan fowtu fu poi kaagi en. Da a dede fi en e wasi ala takuudu anga ogii fu wi, puu a Masaa Gadu fesi. Na so pikin moi sikapu mu kiya bun fosi, da a sa poi kii pai anga en buulu, fu begi paadon!
eng_text: but with precious blood, as of a faultless and pure lamb, the blood of Christ;

djk_text: Da na fosi goontapu be meke seefi, ne a Kelestesi be poti enseefi kaba, fu kon pai fu wi takuudu anga ogii so. Namo, ne a kon doo goontapu ya, na yuu ten pe goontapu de fu kaba ya.
eng_text: who was foreknown indeed before the foundation of the world, but was revealed at the end of times for your sake,

djk_text: Fu biibi en, da na Masaa Gadu seefi i biibi de kaba. Soseefi, da na Masaa Gadu seefi yu e luku fu fende bun de. Bika ne en weki en puu a dede poti hei dyendee fasi anga ala gaandi so. A poti en hei moo ala taawan.
eng_text: who through him are believers in God, who raised him from the dead, and gave him glory; so that your faith and hope might be in God.

djk_text: Bika na Masaa Gadu seefi sende a bosikopu ya kon, fu biibi Masaa Jesesi. Na so meke takuudu anga ogii á poi wooko enke basi a yu tapu de moo. Da ala yuu i sa lobi taa biibiwan now, sondee peepee fasi.
eng_text: Seeing you have purified your souls in your obedience to the truth through the Spirit in sincere brotherly affection, love one another from the heart fervently:

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu gi u a libi fi enseefi. Na so a meke u baka ete wan toon. Ne u kon de enke fa pikin e de paansu fi en tata, di paandi en a ini en mma. Ma a sii di meke a paansu fu wi dati á komoto a libisama, enke paansu di poi poli. Bika na a wowtu fu Masaa Gadu di taanga seefi, fu wooko tego a ini wi.
eng_text: having been born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, through the word of God, which lives and remains forever.

djk_text: Masaa Gadu be piki apaiti takiman fi en, fu sikiifi dati a fositen taki: “Na libisama tan enke gaasi di e goo fu wan satu pisiten namo. Bika dati e dee gawgaw esi esi, da a puu ala boomiki towe. Da ala moi fi en kaba de tu. Na so dyendee fu sama nái tan tego.
eng_text: For, "All flesh is like grass, and all of man's glory like the flower in the grass. The grass withers, and its flower falls;

djk_text: Ma wowtu di mi Masaa Gadu ya mofu taki, noiti e kaba a soso. Bika ai wooko tego.” Da na a bosikopu di apaiti bosikopuman fi en tyai doo yu de, na wowtu di en mofu taki.
eng_text: but the Lord's word endures forever." This is the word of Good News which was preached to you.

djk_text: Da a nyun sowtu sama fu Masaa Gadu ya mu towe ala takuu fasi, di á bun fu taawan. Towe ala peepee fasi wooko sondee bidiigi. Towe ala leilei fasi enke yu e fii tyali ati fasi fu taawan. Taawan sani á mu e ati yu. Kaba taki sani di e saanti taawan.
eng_text: Putting away therefore all wickedness, all deceit, hypocrisies, envies, and all evil speaking,

djk_text: Angii moo anga moo, fu teke Masaa Gadu taki enke nyunyun pikin di e angii fi en meliki. Da yu o goo kon moo sabi libi fiti en, meke a tyai yu doo en kondee bakaten. Da yu o fende en lasiti pisi fu yeepi di taki, ala ogii wai fika soso bun.
eng_text: as newborn babies, long for the pure milk of the Word, that you may grow thereby,

djk_text: Bika yu tesi kaba taki, Masaa abi gaan bun fasi.
eng_text: if indeed you have tasted that the Lord is gracious:

djk_text: Da kon a Masaa, di de a libilibi Siton. Disi na a siton di sama be oli fu wan soso sani. Ma Masaa Gadu daai en kon toon Awan di a teke poti gaan waiti fasi.
eng_text: coming to him, a living stone, rejected indeed by men, but chosen by God, precious.

djk_text: Da teke fu libi enke sama di a mokisa toon en jeje osu sama. Da ibiiwan fu wi de wan pisi libilibi siton fu a osu. Na so u kon de fu wooko enke apaiti begiman, di mu tyai paiman go doo Masaa Gadu. Da ai teke dati anga piisii, fu di u mokisa libi anga Jesesi Kelestesi.
eng_text: You also, as living stones, are built up as a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu Buku sikiifi taki: “Luku ya! Mi poti wan siton futu fu a hii osu a Siyon. A de wan gaan waiti fasi. Na so mi teke en poti. Ma sama di poti biibi ne en tapu noiti o kai a sen.”
eng_text: Because it is contained in Scripture, "Behold, I lay in Zion a chief cornerstone, chosen, and precious: He who believes in him will not be disappointed."

djk_text: We, da yu di teke biibi sa fende gaan yeepi na Awan di waiti sowan fasi. Ma soseefi en Buku sikiifi fu sama di á wani teke biibi taki: “Disi na a siton di meseeman be oli fu wan soso sani. Na dati daai kon toon a siton futu fu a hii osu.”
eng_text: For you who believe therefore is the honor, but for those who are disobedient, "The stone which the builders rejected, has become the chief cornerstone,"

djk_text: Soseefi a sikiifi baka taki: “Sama o dyakata kai ne en.” Da den sama de á sa poi de sama fu Masaa Gadu. Bika den taanga yesi, enke fa Masaa Gadu be taki a sani ya a fesi kaba.
eng_text: and, "a stone of stumbling, and a rock of offense." For they stumble at the word, being disobedient, to which also they were appointed.

djk_text: Ma a teke wi dati toon sama fi enseefi, fu wooko enke apaiti begiman, a fesi fu Masaa Gadu a pe ai tii sani enke kownu. Wi na a foluku di de apaiti fasi, fu soi fa ai puu takuudu anga ogii, wan foondoo fasi. Soseefi, fa a teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku wi, fu puu wi a ini a dunguu fu didibii. Ne a poti u go a pe en sani de a kiin gi wi, fu wooko enke basi a wi tapu.
eng_text: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God's own possession, that you may proclaim the excellence of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light:

djk_text: We, da yu di á be de sama fu Masaa Gadu, ma nownow yu toon sama fi en. Yu di fosi fosi, en tyali ati fasi á be de gi yu, ma nownow dati de gi yu.
eng_text: who in time past were no people, but now are God's people, who had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.

djk_text: Mi lobi biibiwan! U na a nyun sowtu sama enke wakaman di á de sama fu goontapu ya. U de enke sama di kon tan ya fu wan satu pisiten namo. Da mi e sende u taki, libi wan fasi di kengi anga taawan de! Kaba anga takuu fasi di u e losutu, fu libi anga sikin. Bika dati e sitee anga a Gadu libi.
eng_text: Beloved, I beg you as foreigners and pilgrims, to abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul;

djk_text: Waka anga koni, fu du sani leti fasi. Bika u de a taawan mindii di á sabi Masaa Gadu. Da winsi den e kaagi u seefi, ma a á mu de anga leti. Da wan dei Masaa Gadu sa naki den ati, fu si u bun fasi. Da den sa gafa en, meke a sa wooko tyali ati fasi anga denseefi tu, fu teke biibi.
eng_text: having good behavior among the nations, so in that of which they speak against you as evildoers, they may by your good works, which they see, glorify God in the day of visitation.

djk_text: Da biibiwan di e lesipeki Masaa Gadu mu waka a ondoo bigiman ne en tapu, anga a moo gaan kownu di abi a taki fu kondee.
eng_text: Therefore subject yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord's sake: whether to the king, as supreme;

djk_text: Soseefi, a gaaman di e luku kondee anga lanti di de fu sitaafu takuuduman gi Masaa Gadu. Bika na sama di e du bun namo sa fende gaandi a den.
eng_text: or to governors, as sent by him for vengeance on evildoers and for praise to those who do well.

djk_text: Na so Masaa Gadu weiti sende u fu waka. Da u sa tapu siteeman mofu di e taki lawlaw sani. Da den o kon si taki, u e libi bun. Na soso den e kaagi u.
eng_text: For this is the will of God, that by well-doing you should put to silence the ignorance of foolish men:

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu losi u puu a katibo! Ma dati á wani taki, u fii fu waka du san useefi wani, te go doo ogii seefi! Bika wi toon sama fi en, pe a mu wooko enke basi a wi tapu, fu teke en taki.
eng_text: as free, and not using your freedom for a cloak of wickedness, but as bondservants of God.

djk_text: Da lesipeki ibii taawan. Lobi yeepi taa biibiwan. Abi dipi lesipeki fu Masaa Gadu, fu teke en taki. Tan waka soseefi a ondoo fu a gaan kownu.
eng_text: Honor all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.

djk_text: Efu yu de a saafu, da waka a yu basi ondoo. Lesipeki a basi ala fasi. Ná luku efi en ati bun ofu a takuu.
eng_text: Servants, be in subjection to your masters with all fear; not only to the good and gentle, but also to the wicked.

djk_text: Bika a bun, fu miti sitaafu sondee i du sani, fu di i de biibisama. Da Masaa Gadu sa piisii anga yu, fu teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku yu. Da a o tyai bun gi yu.
eng_text: For it is commendable if someone endures pain, suffering unjustly, because of conscience toward God.

djk_text: Ma te i du sani, da i miti sitaafu, da i fiti fu fende dati. Da winsi i oli pasensi teke dati seefi, ma toku gafa fu dati á sa de. Bika dati á poi piisii Masaa Gadu, fu tyai bun gi yu.
eng_text: For what glory is it if, when you sin, you patiently endure beating? But if, when you do well, you patiently endure suffering, this is commendable with God.

djk_text: Da sabi taki, Masaa Gadu kai wi kon toon sama fi enseefi. Ma a be sabi a fesi taki, u o miti sitaafu so. Luku Masaa Jesesi seefi be miti somen sani sondee a be du sani. Da luku de fa fu wooko so tu. Na bun a be e du naamo, da ogii namo e miti en.
eng_text: For to this you were called, because Christ also suffered for us, leaving you an example, that you should follow his steps,

djk_text: Dati sikiifi fi en a Masaa Gadu Buku taki: “Noiti a du wan ogii, noiti lei komoto ne en mofu.”
eng_text: who did not sin, "neither was deceit found in his mouth."

djk_text: Ma sama e taki ogii fi en, da noiti ai piki baka. Takuuduman e sitaafu en, da noiti ai pii ain gi den baka. Ma ai fika ala sani a Masaa Gadu ana. Bika a sabi taki, na dati mu kuutu ala sani wan leti fasi, fu pai ibiiwan.
eng_text: Who, when he was cursed, didn't curse back. When he suffered, didn't threaten, but committed himself to him who judges righteously;

djk_text: Namo, a poti en sikin seefi sipikii kii a koloisi, fu booko a makiti fu takuudu anga ogii gi wi. Bika u mokisa dede anga en de, ne u gwe a ini wan taa sowtu libi, fu libi leti. A teke pina a sikin buba, ne a tyai ala sowtu soo maiki. Ma na fu deesi sama kon bun.
eng_text: who his own self bore our sins in his body on the tree, that we, having died to sins, might live to righteousness; by whose stripes you were healed.

djk_text: Da u be e waka enke sikapu di lasi pasi. Ma nownow, da u daai teke Kelestesi baka futu di de a leti pasi, fu waka. Da ai luku wi anga ala kibii wi enke fa soluguman fu sikapu e kibii en sikapu, fu takuu meti á mu poi du ogii anga den.
eng_text: For you were going astray like sheep; but now have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.

djk_text: Biibi uman! Saka a yu man ondoo. Teke en taki. Efu i man á de biibisama, da moo meke moiti seefi, fu libi bun anga en. Da fu taigi en Gadu toli ná o de fanowdu seefi, fu meke a teke biibi.
eng_text: In the same way, wives, be in subjection to your own husbands; so that, even if any don't obey the Word, they may be won by the behavior of their wives without a word;

djk_text: Bika a o si a bun fasi di yu e libi taki, yu e lesipeki Masaa Gadu, fu piisii Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: seeing your pure behavior in fear.

djk_text: Da ná poti doose fu sikin wawan, fu seeka. Bika a ná moi beei uwii o yeepi a man. A ná gaan dyendee gowtu fu wei beenki sikin anga ala dyendee koosi tu.
eng_text: Let your beauty be not just the outward adorning of braiding the hair, and of wearing jewels of gold, or of putting on fine clothing;

djk_text: Ma na yu ati mu seeka moimoi a ini yu, da ai waiti gi Masaa Gadu tego. Meke a de switi, da a nái tyai opuulu doo taawan. Da a sa de wan gaan piisii sani gi Masaa Gadu
eng_text: but in the hidden person of the heart, in the incorruptible adornment of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God very precious.

djk_text: Bika na so son fositen uman libi be de apaiti fasi gi Masaa Gadu. Ne den be e dini en, anga ala luku fu fende san a paamisi den. Den be gwenti seeka den ati, meke a nái tyai opuulu doo taawan. Na so yu mu du de tu.
eng_text: For this is how the holy women before, who hoped in God also adorned themselves, being in subjection to their own husbands:

djk_text: Abalaham uman Sala be e lesipeki en man fu teke en taki te, da ai kai en, gaan masaa. Na so biibi uman nownow mu waka a den fositen uman de baka, fu du soso bun enke den. Da libi sondee tyai opuulu doo taawan. Da i sa taampu sondee feele, winsi san de fu kon a yu pasi.
eng_text: as Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord, whose children you now are, if you do well, and are not put in fear by any terror.

djk_text: Biibi manengee! Wooko fusutan fasi anga yu uman di de a yu ondoo, fu tii. Libi makandii anga en. Lesipeki en. Denki taki, a á taanga sikin fasi enke yu. Ma enseefi o fende libi tego. Bika Masaa Gadu teke gaan bun ati fasi luku enseefi tu. Efu yu á wooko so, da Masaa Gadu o si dati enke gaan ogii, fu tapu yesi te yu e begi.
eng_text: You husbands, in the same way, live with your wives according to knowledge, giving honor to the woman, as to the weaker vessel, as being also joint heirs of the grace of life; that your prayers may not be hindered.

djk_text: Wan lasiti sani taki, ala biibiwan mu denki go na a wan se. Te wan e miti sani, da u taawan mu e pakisei en. Da u mu poti useefi ne en peesi, fu fii anga en. Da u meke moiti fu yeepi tu. Lobi a taawan enke fa i lobi famii fi iseefi. Libi soi taki, yu á de wan sani moo a taawan.
eng_text: Finally, be all like-minded, compassionate, loving as brothers, tenderhearted, courteous,

djk_text: Te taawan du ogii anga yu, da ná pai ogii fu ogii baka! Te taawan kosi yu, da tapu mofu sondee kosi baka. Ma begi seigi gi en a Masaa Gadu. Na so biibiwan meke fu wooko. Da yuseefi o fende seigi di Masaa Gadu seeka poti a tapu anda.
eng_text: not rendering evil for evil, or insult for insult; but instead blessing; knowing that to this were you called, that you may inherit a blessing.

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu Buku sikiifi fu dati taki: “Fa wan sama libi sa waka bun, soseefi fende switi libi? We, da a mu wooko bun anga en tongo, fu kaba taki lei ofu koli koli taawan.
eng_text: For, "He who would love life, and see good days, let him keep his tongue from evil, and his lips from speaking deceit.

djk_text: A mu e wai a pasi gi ibii taa sowtu ogii seefi, fu du bun na a leti fasi di fiti Masaa Gadu. A mu e feti seefi fu meke ala taawan ati sa de switi makandii! Feti naamo seefi meke u ati switi makandii de.
eng_text: Let him turn away from evil, and do good. Let him seek peace, and pursue it.

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu e piisii anga sama di e wooko leti fasi. Ala san di dati sa opo mofu begi en, da ai poti yesi aliki. Ma a nái go anga sama di e libi takuu fasi.”
eng_text: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears open to their prayer; but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil."

djk_text: Da sama sa de fu du ogii anga yu, fu di yu e feti a bun baka?
eng_text: Now who is he who will harm you, if you become imitators of that which is good?

djk_text: Ma ná fii booko saka. Poolo seefi! Bika Masaa Gadu o seigi yu. Da feele anga ala piiti ati fu den sama de á mu naki yu.
eng_text: But even if you should suffer for righteousness' sake, you are blessed. "Don't fear what they fear, neither be troubled."

djk_text: Ma poti Kelestesi di de yu Masaa, a yu ati enke wan apaiti sani de. Da sete i seefi naamo fu piki taawan fa yu e luku fu fende bun di Masaa Gadu paamisi fu gi bakaten a tapu anda.
eng_text: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts; and always be ready to give an answer to everyone who asks you a reason concerning the hope that is in you, with humility and fear:

djk_text: Piki den wan switi fasi anga ala lesipeki. Denki san Masaa Gadu wani i piki sondee konsensi e fon yu ati taki, i libi nái waka so. Da sen o kisi den di e taki ogii fi yu. Bika a o soi fa yu bun libi anga Kelestesi á tan enke fa den e taki.
eng_text: having a good conscience; that, while you are spoken against as evildoers, they may be disappointed who curse your good way of life in Christ.

djk_text: Bika na so Masaa Gadu wani sani waka anga biibisama. A moo bun, u e du bun gi en, da den e sitaafu u, pe fu du ogii, da den e sitaafu u.
eng_text: For it is better, if it is God's will, that you suffer for doing well than for doing evil.

djk_text: Bika Kelestesi noiti du wan ogii. Ma na dati teke dede wan kodo leisi namo, fu pai gi wi. Na so a tyai wi go doo Masaa Gadu. A dede sikin fasi, ma a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu kaakiti weki en baka kon a libi.
eng_text: Because Christ also suffered for sins once, the righteous for the unrighteous, that he might bring you to God; being put to death in the flesh, but made alive in the spirit;

djk_text: Na so a saka go doo wan dunguu osu anda, pe jeje fu sama di dede e go fasi fika. Ne a tyai Masaa Gadu bosikopu go taigi den de.
eng_text: in which he also went and preached to the spirits in prison,

djk_text: Den dati be taanga yesi na a ten fu Nowa. Den á be wani go kibii a ini a gaan boto di ai meke, ala fa Masaa Gadu gi den somen ten seefi fu teke biibi. Namo, ne a be meke gaan wataa kon sungu hii goontapu kii den. Ma Nowa anga ete seibin sama di be go kibii a ini a boto de dati be diipi pasa a wataa.
eng_text: who before were disobedient, when God waited patiently in the days of Noah, while the ship was being built. In it, few, that is, eight souls, were saved through water.

djk_text: A wataa di kii sama de gei a wataa di biibisama e teke dopu. Biibi e de ape taki, a wataa de e kii den puu na a peesi fu fende sitaafu. Da ai tyai den go a wan nyun libi. Na so Nowa anga en sama seefi be biibi, fu fende nyun libi. Da dopu á de enke na wan wasi kiin sikin wataa. Ma na wan kuudei di taki, u mokisa dede weki anga Jesesi Kelestesi de.
eng_text: This is a symbol of baptism, which now saves you--not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God, through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,

djk_text: Namo a Jesesi Kelestesi ya komoto libilibi ya go doo Masaa Gadu Kondee, go fende gaandi a Masaa Gadu se anda. Ne a de a tapu fu ala taawan di e wooko anda seefi gi Masaa Gadu. Soseefi ala Engel anga ala taa jeje sani di e tii sani, fu pikinwan go miti gaanwan.
eng_text: who is at the right hand of God, having gone into heaven, angels and authorities and powers being made subject to him.

djk_text: Ma a pasi di Kelestesi waka doo tapu anda, da a tyai banowtu. Da seeka anga a denki fu miti dati tu, enke suudati e seeka anga en feti sani, fu kibii enseefi. Da sabi taki, yu enke biibiwan di e fende banowtu a sikin buba sowan fasi tu, da i komoto a takuudu anga ogii tuu.
eng_text: Forasmuch then as Christ suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves also with the same mind; for he who has suffered in the flesh has ceased from sin;

djk_text: Da hii libi langa, yu enke biibiwan nái tan moo enke sama di e du san den e losutu anga sikin. Ma yu o du soso bun naamo gi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: that you no longer should live the rest of your time in the flesh for the lusts of men, but for the will of God.

djk_text: Bika yu libi sai kaba enke sama di nái teli Masaa Gadu. I be e du sani di sen fu si. Soseefi losutu sani di á bun. Soseefi, diingi be e wooko enke basi a yu tapu. Da yu be e duungu waka lontu ganda sondee fusutan. Soseefi sidon nyan diingi, fu taki poli taki go doo du poli sani, fu dini falisi gadu.
eng_text: For we have spent enough of our past time doing the desire of the Gentiles, and having walked in lewdness, lusts, drunken binges, orgies, carousings, and abominable idolatries.

djk_text: Ma nownow, da den taawan di de a ini a libi de ete á poi fusutan san meke yu wai komoto a den mindii. Da den e saanti yu enke na yu na takuu sani.
eng_text: They think it is strange that you don't run with them into the same excess of riot, blaspheming:

djk_text: Den á poi si taki, na den e du sani, fu dyombo sama. Da a kon, na te a Masaa Gadu fesi den o go doo, fu gi faantiwowtu. Bika Masaa Gadu de kaba kaba anda, fu kuutu libiwan, soseefi dedewan tu.
eng_text: who will give account to him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.

djk_text: Na so meke Masaa Jesesi be saka gwe a dedekondee go miti den dedewan. Bika den be miti Masaa Gadu kuutu na a libi ya kaba anga ala sitaafu seefi. Ne a go gi den en Bun Nyunsu, fu fende libi tego makandii anga Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: For to this end the Good News was preached even to the dead, that they might be judged indeed as men in the flesh, but live as to God in the spirit.

djk_text: We, dyonson moo, da fa goontapu e waka nownow ya o pasa gwe. Da libi anga fusutan anga leti denki. De anga ain fu si san e pasa lontu yu. Da i sa poi begi fu ala dati.
eng_text: But the end of all things is near. Therefore be of sound mind, self-controlled, and sober in prayer.

djk_text: A moo gaan sani, na fu poti hii ati lobi taawan. Da i sa poi gwili ogii di den e du anga yu, sondee fu bolotyasi dati poli den nen.
eng_text: And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.

djk_text: Yu osu doo mu opo gi taawan, sondee fu mombii den siibi peesi anga nyanyan. Meke ala dati waka sondee fu dyeme taki, a ibi fu du.
eng_text: Be hospitable to one another without grumbling.
