djk_text: Da den be o tan faawe fu Masaa Gadu, te den boo be o koti. Bika den gei sama di de a ini dunguu. Ma den ain o kon kiin, enke fa peesi e kiin fu si. Bika den o kon sabi Masaa Gadu, da den o toon sama di abi pasi fu tan a Masaa Gadu se.”
eng_text: The people which sat in darkness saw great light; and to them which sat in the region and shadow of death light is sprung up.

djk_text: We, ne fanafu di Masaa Jesesi go tan anda, ne ai bali den sama taki: “U daai libi! Bika a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu de koosube tuutuu.”
eng_text: From that time Jesus began to preach, and to say, Repent: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.

djk_text: We wan dei, da Masaa Jesesi be e waka na a lampeesi pe a gaan ze fu Galileya kon sutu mofu a soo. Ne a si tu baala. Wan fu den na Simon di abi a taa nen fu Peitilisi. A taawan na Andeleyasi. Den tu baala ya be de fisiman, di e towe seepi fu kisi fisi a ini a ze.
eng_text: And Jesus, walking by the sea of Galilee, saw two brethren, Simon called Peter, and Andrew his brother, casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi waka go a den. Ne a taigi den taki: “U kon waka a mi baka! U kon go anga mi na ala pe mi e go. Da mi o leli u onti taa fasi, bika u ná o onti fisi moo. Ma u o kon toon ontiman fu kisi libisama tyai kon biibi a mi.”
eng_text: And he saith unto them, Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men.

djk_text: We, ne den tu baala á du taa fa, ne den wai den seepi wanten poti a wanse. Ne den bigin waka a Masaa Jesesi baka.
eng_text: And they straightway left their nets, and followed him.

djk_text: A di den waka go moo pikinso, ne den si tu taa baala anga den dda, Da Sebedi a ini wan boto. Wan fu den baala na Jakowbesi, a taawan na Johanisi. Den be e seeka den seepi, fu go sete. Ne Masaa Jesesi kai den tu baala ya tu.
eng_text: And going on from thence, he saw other two brethren, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in a ship with Zebedee their father, mending their nets; and he called them.

djk_text: Ne den tu baala ya seefi fika den dda anga ala den seepi anga ala a boto a baka wanten. Ne den go waka a Masaa Jesesi baka tu.
eng_text: And they immediately left the ship and their father, and followed him.

djk_text: Namo, Masaa Jesesi e waka e lontu a hii pisiwataa fu Galileya e leli den sama a ini den keliki osu fu den Dyu. Soseefi ai bali a Bun Nyunsu di e taki, fu a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu. Da ai deesi ala siki anga ala sowtu takuu takuu siki anga nowtu di den sama be abi.
eng_text: And Jesus went about all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing all manner of sickness and all manner of disease among the people.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi nen bali lontu na a hii pisiwataa de, te go doo Siliya. Den sama anda seefi tyai ala sowtu sikiman kon ne en. Sama di be abi sikin ati. Sama di takuu jeje be e bali a den tapu. Soseefi, den be tyai lawman anga lanman. Ne Masaa Jesesi deesi ala den fiya.
eng_text: And his fame went throughout all Syria: and they brought unto him all sick people that were taken with divers diseases and torments, and those which were possessed with devils, and those which were lunatick, and those that had the palsy; and he healed them.

djk_text: Ma namo, da somen sama fu a pisiwataa fu Galileya, anga a pisiwataa fu den tin foto, di den e kai Dekapolisi, anga Jelusalem Foto, anga sama di be e tan na a pisiwataa fu Judeja, anga abaase fu a Joodani Liba, booko kon e waka a Masaa Jesesi baka.
eng_text: And there followed him great multitudes of people from Galilee, and from Decapolis, and from Jerusalem, and from Judaea, and from beyond Jordan.

djk_text: We, ne di Masaa Jesesi si fa somen sama e waka ne en baka, ne a subi go a wan pikin mongo. Ne di a sidon, ne den bakaman fi en kon ne en anda.
eng_text: And seeing the multitudes, he went up into a mountain: and when he was set, his disciples came unto him:

djk_text: Ne a bigin leli den taki:
eng_text: And he opened his mouth, and taught them, saying,

djk_text: “Seigi fu saka fasi sama di sabi taki, den abi Masaa Gadu fanowdu. Bika fu di a abi a saka fasi ya, da a sa de a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

djk_text: Seigi fu sama di e fii tyali, fu ogii di den du. Bika Masaa Gadu o gi den paadon, meke den ati koo.
eng_text: Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.

djk_text: Seigi fu sama di e wooko saka fasi anga taawan. Bika wanten e kon, pe na den anga Masaa Gadu o tii goontapu.
eng_text: Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.

djk_text: Seigi fu sama di e angii fu libi letiopu a Masaa Gadu fesi. Bika Masaa Gadu o yeepi den fu libi so tu, meke den ati koo.
eng_text: Blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled.

djk_text: Seigi fu sama di e wooko tyali ati fasi anga taawan. Bika Masaa Gadu seefi o wooko tyali ati fasi anga den baka.
eng_text: Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.

djk_text: Seigi fu sama di ati kiin a Masaa Gadu fesi. Bika dati o meke den go doo Masaa Gadu Kondee, te go si Masaa Gadu seefi anga ain.
eng_text: Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God.

djk_text: Seigi fu sama di e feti fu puu toobi a sama anga sama mindii. Bika den o kai den pikin fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.

djk_text: Seigi fu sama di ogii e miti soso fu di den e libi bun gi Masaa Gadu. Bika den o de a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Blessed are they which are persecuted for righteousness' sake: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

djk_text: “Seigi fi yu, te sama e kosi yu, e pina yu, e lei gi yu, fu mi ede.
eng_text: Blessed are ye, when men shall revile you, and persecute you, and shall say all manner of evil against you falsely, for my sake.

djk_text: Dyombo piisii seefi fu dati. Bika na letiso den be pina den fositen apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu a fesi. Da u paiman fu kisi bigi a Masaa Gadu Kondee.”
eng_text: Rejoice, and be exceeding glad: for great is your reward in heaven: for so persecuted they the prophets which were before you.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi taki baka taki: “U na a sawtu fu goontapu. Da efu sawtu lasi en tesi, da anga san den o sawtu en fu a kisi tesi baka? Nono! A á bun fu du wan enkii sani moo enke na fu fiingi towe a dyiko namo, da a kaba, fu sama waka ne en tapu. Bika taa sani á de, fu poti gi en moo, fu a kisi tesi, baka.
eng_text: Ye are the salt of the earth: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be salted? it is thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out, and to be trodden under foot of men.

djk_text: “Soseefi, u na a leti kiin fu goontapu. Wan foto di meke a wan mongo ede, á poi de kibii kibii. Bika te sama e pasa, den ain musu kai ne en.
eng_text: Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.

djk_text: We, u nái leti wan lampu, da u poti en a baka sani. Nono! Te u leti wan lampu, u e poti en a hei, a tapu. Da ai leti kiin peesi gi ala sama.
eng_text: Neither do men light a candle, and put it under a bushel, but on a candlestick; and it giveth light unto all that are in the house.

djk_text: Na letiso u mu meke a leti fu u kiin gi ala sama fu si, meke den si den bun wooko di u e du, fu di u e biibi. Da den o gi u Tata a tapu daa, fu dati.
eng_text: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.

djk_text: “Da u á mu denki taki mi kon fu leli sama taki den á mu oli den weiti di Masaa Gadu be meke Mosesi anga den taa apaiti takiman be sikiifi. Kweti! Mi á kon fu leli sama fu den ná oli den weiti moo. Nono. Ma mi kon fu soi sama tuutuu, fa fu libi leti enke fa den weiti taki! Da mi seefi o libi leti enke fa den weiti taki, meke sama si.
eng_text: Think not that I am come to destroy the law, or the prophets: I am not come to destroy, but to fulfil.

djk_text: Bika fu tuutuu, mi e taigi u taki, fu te enke a dei di tapu anga goontapu o lasi go kaba a soso, da ala weiti di Masaa Gadu be poti sa tan, fu meke ala san di Buku taki kon pasa tuu.
eng_text: For verily I say unto you, Till heaven and earth pass, one jot or one tittle shall in no wise pass from the law, till all be fulfilled.

djk_text: Ma son sama e si son fu den weiti ya enke wan soso sani. Da den e leli taawan fu si den weiti ya enke soso sani tu. Da den sowtu sama de o de den moo lagiwan a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu. Ma den sama di e libi leti enke fa den weiti taki, da den e leli taawan fu libi sowan fasi, o hei a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so, he shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven: but whosoever shall do and teach them, the same shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven.

djk_text: Soseefi, u mu sabi tu taki, sama di wani de a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu, mu waka letiopu fasi moo den Faliseiman anga den leliman fu Dyuweiti seefi.
eng_text: For I say unto you, That except your righteousness shall exceed the righteousness of the scribes and Pharisees, ye shall in no case enter into the kingdom of heaven.

djk_text: “Bika u yee ya! Weiti be leli u taki: ‘U á mu kii sama ofuso u sa go a kuutu, fu kisi sitaafu.’
eng_text: Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time, Thou shalt not kill; and whosoever shall kill shall be in danger of the judgment:

djk_text: Ma mi e leli u taki: I mu kisi sitaafu kaba, winsi na boon yu ati boon a wan sama namo. Efu na wan taawan i kosi, kai en wisiwasi man, da na wan moo gaan kuutu bakaa mu leisi sitaafu gi yu! Efu yu e kai taawan lawman, da yu fiti kaba, fu go teke sitaafu a didibii faya.
eng_text: But I say unto you, That whosoever is angry with his brother without a cause shall be in danger of the judgment: and whosoever shall say to his brother, Raca, shall be in danger of the council: but whosoever shall say, Thou fool, shall be in danger of hell fire.

djk_text: “We, kon u taki, i tyai wan paiman anga yu go pai Masaa Gadu na a apaiti begi tafaa. Ne a seefi yuu de, ne i kisi a ini i pakisei de taki, wan sama abi wan sani anga yu, da i mu
eng_text: Therefore if thou bring thy gift to the altar, and there rememberest that thy brother hath ought against thee;

djk_text: saka a paiman di i tyai go gi Masaa Gadu de fika leti ape fosi. Da i go, da i meke en bun anga en te a kaba fosi, da i kon, da boon a paiman gi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Leave there thy gift before the altar, and go thy way; first be reconciled to thy brother, and then come and offer thy gift.

djk_text: “Efu yu anga wan taawan abi sani, da feti fu seeka a taki, meke a toli á go doo kuutu. Bika efu a go doo anda, den o poti yu a sikowtu ana, fu sooto.
eng_text: Agree with thine adversary quickly, whiles thou art in the way with him; lest at any time the adversary deliver thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and thou be cast into prison.

djk_text: Fu tuutuu mi e taigi i taki: Yu ná o komoto anda fosi i kaba koti a sitaafu, fu san i du.”
eng_text: Verily I say unto thee, Thou shalt by no means come out thence, till thou hast paid the uttermost farthing.

djk_text: Namo, ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “We, u be yee kaba taki: ‘Uman anga man, di libi kaba, á mu go a taa man ofu uman.’
eng_text: Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time, Thou shalt not commit adultery:

djk_text: Toku mi e taigi u taki: Efu wan man si wan uman, ne a luku en anga wan losutu ain, da na waka a waka anga en kaba a ini en ati ini.
eng_text: But I say unto you, That whosoever looketh on a woman to lust after her hath committed adultery with her already in his heart.

djk_text: We, efi i letise ain wani tyai yu go du ogii, da a moo betee i diki en puu fiingi towe. Bika a moo bun fi i lasi wan pisi fi i sikin, da i doo Masaa Gadu Kondee, moo enke pe fi i de anga i hii sikin bunbun, da den iti yu go a didibii faya.
eng_text: And if thy right eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell.

djk_text: Soseefi, efi i letise ana e tyai yu go du ogii, da koti en puu towe. Bika a moo bun fi i lasi wan pisi fi i sikin, da i doo Masaa Gadu Kondee, moo enke pe fi i de anga i hii sikin bunbun, da den iti yu go a didibii faya.”
eng_text: And if thy right hand offend thee, cut if off, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell.

djk_text: Soseefi Masaa Jesesi taki baka taki: “U be yee tu taki: ‘Efu wan man o paati anga en uman, da a mu gi en wan biifi di a naki sitampu taki, en anga en paati.’
eng_text: It hath been said, Whosoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorcement:

djk_text: We, mi e taigi u taki, a sama di o towe en uman fu wan taa sani moo enke te a uman waka gi en, da i fika en fu booko a weiti di taki: ‘I á mu go a taa uman ofu man.’ Soseefi a man di o teke wan uman di en man towe, booko a weiti de tu.”
eng_text: But I say unto you, That whosoever shall put away his wife, saving for the cause of fornication, causeth her to commit adultery: and whosoever shall marry her that is divorced committeth adultery.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi taki baka taki: “U be yee tu fa den be taigi den avo fu u taki: ‘Te u sweli wan sweli, da u mu du, san u sweli fu du.’
eng_text: Again, ye have heard that it hath been said by them of old time, Thou shalt not forswear thyself, but shalt perform unto the Lord thine oaths:

djk_text: Ma mi e taigi u taki: Kweti kweti! U á mu sweli! U á mu sweli kai Masaa Gadu Kondee. Bika Masaa Gadu Kondee na pe Masaa Gadu sidon ne en kownu sutuu, e luku ala sani.
eng_text: But I say unto you, Swear not at all; neither by heaven; for it is God's throne:

djk_text: U á mu sweli kai goontapu. Bika goontapu de enke wan futu bangi, pe Gadu e poti en futu. Soseefi, yu á mu sweli kai Jelusalem Foto. Bika, Jelusalem na a foto, pe a gaan Kownu e tan.
eng_text: Nor by the earth; for it is his footstool: neither by Jerusalem; for it is the city of the great King.

djk_text: Soseefi yu á mu teke i ede sweli. Bika yuseefi ná abi makiti fu meke yu ede uwii weti efu daai en kon toon baaka.
eng_text: Neither shalt thou swear by thy head, because thou canst not make one hair white or black.

djk_text: Ma, te i taki: ‘Ya,’ a mu tan ‘Ya.’ Te i taki: ‘Nono,’ a mu tan ‘Nono.’ Bika efu yu mu sweli, fosi sama mu si taki, na tuu, da na didibii se u e go kaba.”
eng_text: But let your communication be, Yea, yea; Nay, nay: for whatsoever is more than these cometh of evil.

djk_text: Soseefi Masaa Jesesi taki baka taki: “Den be taigi u tu taki: ‘Efu wan sama booko wan taawan ain, da a taawan abi pasi fu booko en ain baka. Efu wan sama booko wan taawan tifi, da a taawan abi pasi fu booko en tifi baka.’
eng_text: Ye have heard that it hath been said, An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth:

djk_text: We, mi e taigi u taki: U á mu pai ogii, fu ogii baka. Ma efu wan sama naki i wan baala ana a i letise sikin fesi, da poti a taase gi en, meke a naki tu.
eng_text: But I say unto you, That ye resist not evil: but whosoever shall smite thee on thy right cheek, turn to him the other also.

djk_text: Da efu wan sama wani tyai u go a kuutu, fu di a wani i impi, da a ná yu impi wawan i mu gi en, ma gi en yu dyakiti tu.
eng_text: And if any man will sue thee at the law, and take away thy coat, let him have thy cloke also.

djk_text: Soseefi, efu wan sama e dwengi yu, fu waka wan yuu langa anga en, da waka tu yuu langa anga en.
eng_text: And whosoever shall compel thee to go a mile, go with him twain.

djk_text: Te wan sama begi yu wan sani di yu abi, da yu á mu mombii en. Efu na wan sani fi yu, wan sama wani leni, da yu á mu fika en gwe anga soso ana.”
eng_text: Give to him that asketh thee, and from him that would borrow of thee turn not thou away.

djk_text: Namo, Masaa Jesesi taki baka taki: “Da den be taigi u tu taki: ‘U mu lobi den sama, di e libi bun anga u. Ma u mu buuse den feyanti fu u.’
eng_text: Ye have heard that it hath been said, Thou shalt love thy neighbour, and hate thine enemy.

djk_text: Ma mi e taigi u taki: U lobi den feyanti fu u tu. Da u begi gi den sama, di e lon a u baka e suku fu ogii anga u.
eng_text: But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you;

djk_text: Bika, te u du so, da u de enke fa u Tata a tapu de. We bika, te a san fi en opo a tapu, da ai pii gi takuu ati sama anga bun ati wan makandii. Te a alen fi en e kai, da ai kai gi ala sama. Den bun ati wan go miti den takuu ati wan.
eng_text: That ye may be the children of your Father which is in heaven: for he maketh his sun to rise on the evil and on the good, and sendeth rain on the just and on the unjust.

djk_text: We, efu na den sama di lobi yu namo, yu lobi, ma u á lobi den feyanti fu u, da sowtu paiman u sa fende a Masaa Gadu fu dati? Ná so den sama di e piki lantimoni de tu, no?
eng_text: For if ye love them which love you, what reward have ye? do not even the publicans the same?

djk_text: Da soseefi, efu yu e taki anga den sama di yu anga den sabi namo, da a ná wan apaiti sani dati. Bika na so den sama fu a goontapu ya, di á de a Masaa Gadu pasi e libi tu.
eng_text: And if ye salute your brethren only, what do ye more than others? do not even the publicans so?

djk_text: We, u mu meke moiti fu u libi sondee fowtu, enke fa u Tata, di de a tapu de kiinkiin sondee fowtu.”
eng_text: Be ye therefore perfect, even as your Father which is in heaven is perfect.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “U á mu du sani fu sama ain, fu meke sama si u. Nono! Ofuso, u ná o fende paiman a u Tata a tapu, fu san u du.
eng_text: Take heed that ye do not your alms before men, to be seen of them: otherwise ye have no reward of your Father which is in heaven.

djk_text: Te u e yeepi pootiman a sani, u á mu yeepi den fu suku balinen a sama. Bika yu o wooko enke bidiigiman. Den sama de, te den du wan bun, da den e bali a taki, a keliki anga kondee ganda. Ma fu tuu, mi e taigi u, gafa di sama e gafa den, meke den kisi den paiman kaba.
eng_text: Therefore when thou doest thine alms, do not sound a trumpet before thee, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may have glory of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.

djk_text: Ma, te u e yeepi pootiman a sani, da u mu yeepi den sowan fasi, sondee fu u kukutu ana sabi san u leti ana e du.
eng_text: But when thou doest alms, let not thy left hand know what thy right hand doeth:

djk_text: Da na so, u mu du bun sondee fu sama sabi. Da u Tata, di e si ala san wi e du, o pai wi fu san u du.”
eng_text: That thine alms may be in secret: and thy Father which seeth in secret himself shall reward thee openly.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taki: “Te u o begi, u á mu begi enke den bidiigiman di e begi enke den bun moo taawan a ini keliki anga kondee mindii. Na den sowtu sama de e wani libisama mu gafa den, fu a fasi fa den e begi. Ma fu tuu, mi e taigi u, a balinen di den o fende a sama, na dati na a hii wini, di den fende kaba.
eng_text: And when thou prayest, thou shalt not be as the hypocrites are: for they love to pray standing in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.

djk_text: Da u dati mu wooko taa fasi, te u e begi. U mu waka go a wan peesi pe sama ain á sa kai a u tapu. Da na ape u mu tan, da u begi. Bika u Tata a tapu e si ala sani. Da na a Masaa Gadu ya u sa fende wini, fu di u begi en so.
eng_text: But thou, when thou prayest, enter into thy closet, and when thou hast shut thy door, pray to thy Father which is in secret; and thy Father which seeth in secret shall reward thee openly.

djk_text: “We, den sama di á sabi Masaa Gadu, lobi e begi gaan langa lolo begi. Bika den membee taki, na te den e lolo so fosi, da Masaa Gadu o yee den.
eng_text: But when ye pray, use not vain repetitions, as the heathen do: for they think that they shall be heard for their much speaking.

djk_text: Ma u dati mu begi taa fasi. Bika u Tata, Masaa Gadu sabi ala san u abi fanowdu, fosi u opo mofu begi en wan sani.
eng_text: Be not ye therefore like unto them: for your Father knoweth what things ye have need of, before ye ask him.

djk_text: So! Da u luku ya fa u mu begi. U mu begi taki: ‘Kee! Wi Tata, Masaa Gadu a tapu! Meke ala sani sa kon lesipeki yu nen, wan apaiti fasi.
eng_text: After this manner therefore pray ye: Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name.

djk_text: Meke a Nyun Tii fi yu sa paati a hii goontapu. Meke ala sani sa waka ya enke fa yu wani, leti enke fa ai waka a yu kondee a tapu anda.
eng_text: Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven.

djk_text: Wi e begi yu, fu gi wi san wi abi fanowdu, fu nyan tide baka.
eng_text: Give us this day our daily bread.

djk_text: Gi wi paadon fu ogii di wi e du a yu fesi, leti enke fa wiseefi e gi taawan di e du ogii anga wi paadon.
eng_text: And forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors.

djk_text: Wi e begi yu fu kibii wi, meke wi á kai a ini tesi. Meke a didibii á sa poi tyai u go ini takuudu anga ogii tu.’ ”
eng_text: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil: For thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever. Amen.

djk_text: Namo a taki go doo taki: “Te u sa gi taawan paadon, da u Tata, Masaa Gadu a tapu seefi sa gi u paadon, fu ogii di u e du tu.
eng_text: For if ye forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you:

djk_text: Ma te u nái gi taawan paadon, da Masaa Gadu, u Tata, a tapu seefi, ná o gi u paadon tu.”
eng_text: But if ye forgive not men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “Te u de sondee nyan, fu begi, da u á mu de enke den gaan bidiigiman. Bika te den e de sondee nyan fu begi, da den e poti gaan tyali buduufu fesi, fu sama mu si taki, den de sondee nyan fu begi. Da na so den e suku nen a sama. Ma u aliki mi! Den sama de fende den paiman kaba anga a gafa di sama gafa den de.
eng_text: Moreover when ye fast, be not, as the hypocrites, of a sad countenance: for they disfigure their faces, that they may appear unto men to fast. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.

djk_text: Ma u dati, te u de sondee nyan fu begi wasi, u fesi moi te a kaba. Lobi fatu a u ede, kanmi u uwii te, u de silli.
eng_text: But thou, when thou fastest, anoint thine head, and wash thy face;

djk_text: Da so fasi, sama ná o sabi taki u de sondee nyan fu begi. Ma na Masaa Gadu wawan di e si ala sani, e si. Da a sa pai u fu dati.”
eng_text: That thou appear not unto men to fast, but unto thy Father which is in secret: and thy Father, which seeth in secret, shall reward thee openly.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “U á mu libi so taki, na feti u e feti e suku fu dyunta gudu, poti a goontapu ya namo. Bika goontapu gudu ya, na fu fufuuman kon booko osu teke tyai gwe. Soseefi, na fu udulosu anga fuunsu go nyan poli tu.
eng_text: Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon earth, where moth and rust doth corrupt, and where thieves break through and steal:

djk_text: Ma na feti u mu e feti e libi bun gi Masaa Gadu! Bika Masaa Gadu paamisi den sama di e libi sowan fasi gaan gudu, di noiti noiti o poli. A o dyunta dati poti a Masaa Gadu Kondee gi den. Soseefi, fufuuman á poi fende pasi go fufuu den puu anda.
eng_text: But lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust doth corrupt, and where thieves do not break through nor steal:

djk_text: We, u yee ya! Na pe yu gudu de, na ape yu ati o de tu.
eng_text: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

djk_text: “We, a lampu fu wan libisama sikin, na den ain fi en. Da efu yu ain kiin, da i hii sikin o kiin tu.
eng_text: The light of the body is the eye: if therefore thine eye be single, thy whole body shall be full of light.

djk_text: Ma sama di ain á kiin, da i hii sikin o de dunguu dunguu. Na letiso, efu wan sama ati á kiin, a sa waka a dunguu. Bika na den sama di ati kiin sa waka a leti pasi.”
eng_text: But if thine eye be evil, thy whole body shall be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in thee be darkness, how great is that darkness!

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi taki baka taki: “Ná wan sama di o poi dini tu masaa, sondee fu lobi awan moo enke a taawan. Bika a o lobi awan e teke en taki, moo enke a taawan. Soseefi wan sama á poi dini Masaa Gadu efu moni de wan basi fi en tu.
eng_text: No man can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.

djk_text: Ma efu Masaa Gadu na u basi, da u ná abi fu kusumi. U ná abi fu taki: ‘Oho! San mi o nyan? Oho, san mi o wei a sikin?’ Bika pakisei taki, Masaa Gadu du moo gaan sani gi wi enke libisama. A gi wi sikin anga libi, di bigi moo nyanyan anga koosi. Da efu a gi wi den sani de, da i denki taki, a ná o gi wi sani fu nyan anga sani fu wei?
eng_text: Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink; nor yet for your body, what ye shall put on. Is not the life more than meat, and the body than raiment?

djk_text: We, luku den foo a tapu anda! Peesi fu paandi sani, den ná abi. Magisin fu kibii nyanyan sani, den ná abi tu. Ma toku, den e nyan, e diingi ibii dei. We, wi enke libisama waiti moo foo!
eng_text: Behold the fowls of the air: for they sow not, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns; yet your heavenly Father feedeth them. Are ye not much better than they?

djk_text: I denki taki, libisama sa kusumi fu sani te, da a fende moo langa libi?
eng_text: Which of you by taking thought can add one cubit unto his stature?

djk_text: “Teke yu ain luku den moi boomiki di e goo a goontapu! We, u be yee fu a fositen kownu di den kai Salomo. Na be wan tuutuu poolo man, di be e wei en koosi moi, moo ala sani. Ma toku anga ala a moi dyendee fasi fi en de, toku a á be doo a moi fu den boomiki ya.
eng_text: And why take ye thought for raiment? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow; they toil not, neither do they spin:

djk_text: Ma na Masaa Gadu meke den moi so. Ma toku den ná abi langa libi seefi. Bika na tide den de ete, ma kande den á doo tamaa. Libisama e koti den go boon a ini faya enke soso sani. Ma u ya dati waiti moo boomiki! Da fa u pakisei taki Masaa Gadu ná o poi solugu u anga koosi? Ma na fu di u nái biibi Gadu sai, na dati e tyai a denki de.
eng_text: Wherefore, if God so clothe the grass of the field, which to day is, and to morrow is cast into the oven, shall he not much more clothe you, O ye of little faith?

djk_text: “We, u á mu kusumi moo, pakisei taki: ‘Oho! San u o nyan anga san u o wei a sikin tu?’
eng_text: Therefore take no thought, saying, What shall we eat? or, What shall we drink? or, Wherewithal shall we be clothed?

djk_text: Bika na sama di nái waka a Masaa Gadu pasi e kusumi den fasi de. Ma u Tata a tapu, sabi ala san u abi fanowdu.
eng_text: (For after all these things do the Gentiles seek:) for your heavenly Father knoweth that ye have need of all these things.

djk_text: Da suku fu de a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu. Soseefi fu waka letiopu fasi fiti en. Da a o gi u ala san u fanowdu.
eng_text: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.

djk_text: Ma u á mu feti e kusumi fu a dei fu tamaa. Bika ibii dei abi en eigi booko anga en nowtu.”
eng_text: Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.

djk_text: “Ná kuutu, kaagi taawan, da taawan ná o kuutu, kaagi yu tu.
eng_text: Judge not, that ye be not judged.

djk_text: Bika na a fasi fa yu e kuutu, kaagi taawan, na so taawan o kuutu, kaagi yu baka. Anga a seefi maiki di yu e teke maiki taawan, anga en den o teke maiki yu baka.
eng_text: For with what judgment ye judge, ye shall be judged: and with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you again.

djk_text: Bika saide meke, u e si a pikin mbalububa a ini a ain fu wan taawan, ma a gaan gobo di de a ini iseefi ain, dati i nái si?
eng_text: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother's eye, but considerest not the beam that is in thine own eye?

djk_text: Da fa i sa taigi i baala taki: ‘Baala! Kon mi puu a pikin mbalu a ini yu ain gi yu.’ Ma wan gaan gobo de a ini iseefi ain?
eng_text: Or how wilt thou say to thy brother, Let me pull out the mote out of thine eye; and, behold, a beam is in thine own eye?

djk_text: U bidiigiman u! Puu a gaan gobo a ini iseefi ain fosi, da i sa si kiin fu puu a pikin mbalu di de a ini i baala ain gi en!”
eng_text: Thou hypocrite, first cast out the beam out of thine own eye; and then shalt thou see clearly to cast out the mote out of thy brother's eye.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “U á teke a apaiti sani fu Masaa Gadu, iti gi den dagu anga den agu. Bika te u iti den gi dagu anga den agu, da den ná o si en fu wan sani. Da kande den o teke en, da den waka ne en tapu, masimasi en enke lawlaw sani. Da te fu kaba, da den daai kon nyan yu seefi pisipisi kii.”
eng_text: Give not that which is holy unto the dogs, neither cast ye your pearls before swine, lest they trample them under their feet, and turn again and rend you.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “U begi, da u o kisi. U suku, da u o fende. U koko, da doo o opo gi u.
eng_text: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:

djk_text: Bika sama di e begi, e kisi. Da sama di e suku, e fende. Soseefi sama di e koko, da doo e opo gi den.
eng_text: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.

djk_text: We, sama di de ya, te i manpikin begi yu wan beele, yu o teke wan siton gi en?
eng_text: Or what man is there of you, whom if his son ask bread, will he give him a stone?

djk_text: Te a akisi yu wan fisi, yu o teke wan sineki langa gi en? Nono!
eng_text: Or if he ask a fish, will he give him a serpent?

djk_text: We, efu u, anga ala fa u abi takuu ati seefi, toku u sabi gi u pikin bun sani so, da fa u pakisei, fu u Tata a tapu? A ná o gi sama di e begi en sani, bun sani, no?
eng_text: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children, how much more shall your Father which is in heaven give good things to them that ask him?

djk_text: “We, a fasi fa i wani meke sama libi anga yu, na letiso i mu libi anga sama tu. Disi na a hii mama fu den weiti di Mosesi, anga ala taa taa fositen apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu be sikiifi.”
eng_text: Therefore all things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you, do ye even so to them: for this is the law and the prophets.

djk_text: Soseefi a taki go doo taki: “U doo pasa, go a ini, na a sumaa doo mofu! Bika a baala doo mofu na fu pasa go miti a baala pasi di e go kai a didibii faya. Somen sama de, di e waka na a baala pasi ya, pasa go a ini.
eng_text: Enter ye in at the strait gate: for wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leadeth to destruction, and many there be which go in thereat:

djk_text: Ma a doo di e tyai sama go na a libi fu tego sumaa. Da a pasi fu waka go miti a doo de nyoni, da a taanga fu waka. Somen sama á de di e waka ne en.”
eng_text: Because strait is the gate, and narrow is the way, which leadeth unto life, and few there be that find it.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi wasikoi den sama taki: “U mu koni anga leiman di e lei taki, den na apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu. Den sa koli yu kisi. Bika den e kon a yu tapu enke bunbun saka manii sama. Ma luku bun anga den! Den abi takuu ati enke takuu meti di e kisi taa meti nyan kii.
eng_text: Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep's clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves.

djk_text: A takuu libi fu den e puu a takuu ati di den abi kon a doo, fu si. Bika i si pe bunbun sii fu nyan komoto a maka bon kaba?
eng_text: Ye shall know them by their fruits. Do men gather grapes of thorns, or figs of thistles?

djk_text: Kweti! Na bun ati bon namo sa poi meke bunbun sii fu nyan. Ma takuu ati bon na sii di á bun fu nyan a o meke.
eng_text: Even so every good tree bringeth forth good fruit; but a corrupt tree bringeth forth evil fruit.

djk_text: Takuu ati bon dati á poi meke bunbun sii fu nyan. Da a kon, bun ati bon á poi meke sii di á bun fu nyan tu.
eng_text: A good tree cannot bring forth evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.

djk_text: Da di takuu ati bon nái meke bun sii kaba, da na fu koti go iti a ini faya, fu boon.
eng_text: Every tree that bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.

djk_text: Ala san mi taki de e soi, fa fu luku sama libi, meke u sa sabi den falisi takiman.”
eng_text: Wherefore by their fruits ye shall know them.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi taki go doo taki: “U denki taki na ala sama di e kai mi, ‘Masaa! Masaa!’ o go doo a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu Kondee a tapu anda. Kweti! A ná ala sama di e kai mi, ‘Masaa! Masaa!’ o doo anda. Ma na sama di e libi enke fa mi Tata wani, o doo a tapu anda.
eng_text: Not every one that saith unto me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven.

djk_text: Na a dei di Masaa Gadu o kai ala sama kon a kuutu, da u o yee bali. Taawan o go e bali taki: ‘Oho! Masaa! A ná wi be teke yu nen e tyai a bosikopu fu Masaa Gadu go taigi sama, no? Masaa! A ná wi be e yaki takuu jeje puu a sama tapu anga yu nen, no? Oho! Masaa, a ná wi be e du somen foondoo sani anga yu nen, no?’
eng_text: Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in thy name? and in thy name have cast out devils? and in thy name done many wonderful works?

djk_text: Ma, da mi o piki den taki: ‘U gwe komoto a mi fesi ya! U takuu ati sama u! Bika mi á sabi u enke sama di be e libi enke fa mi wani.’ ”
eng_text: And then will I profess unto them, I never knew you: depart from me, ye that work iniquity.

djk_text: Soseefi Masaa Jesesi taki go doo taki: “Sama di e teke mi taki de enke wan gaan koniman. Bika a koni, da a sabi luku bunbun peesi fu sete en osu.
eng_text: Therefore whosoever heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them, I will liken him unto a wise man, which built his house upon a rock:

djk_text: A sete a fondamenti fi en osu kinkin, fasi a ini wan bunbun taanga doti. Namo gaan alen kai dyullu, ne wataa fuu kon doo na a osu. Soseefi, gaan winta wai huu kon naki a osu. Ma anga ala dati, toku a osu á bunduka kai. Ma a taampu kinkin ete. Bika a fondamenti be sete a ini taanga doti.
eng_text: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell not: for it was founded upon a rock.

djk_text: Ma sama di á wani teke mi taki dati tan enke gaan donman di don. Bika a gei sama di don, fu sabi luku bunbun peesi, fu sete en osu. A gaan donman ya go sete a fondamenti fi en osu wisiwasi fasi a ini fukufuku doti.
eng_text: And every one that heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them not, shall be likened unto a foolish man, which built his house upon the sand:

djk_text: Namo gaan alen kai dyullu, ne wataa fuu kon doo na a osu. Soseefi gaan winta wai huu kon naki a osu. Ne a osu bunduka guwaa dyulu a wataa. Bika a be sete a fukufuku doti ini.”
eng_text: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell: and great was the fall of it.

djk_text: Da a hii fasi fa Masaa Jesesi e gi a leli fu Masaa Gadu ya be foondoo den sama, te ná sipowtu.
eng_text: And it came to pass, when Jesus had ended these sayings, the people were astonished at his doctrine:

djk_text: Bika den leliman fu Dyuweiti be e leli den sani wan hii taa fasi. Ma Masaa Jesesi dati be e leli den, enke wan sama di sa sidon taki a Masaa Gadu peesi.
eng_text: For he taught them as one having authority, and not as the scribes.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi saka a pikin mongo kon a ondoo baka. Da tyaipi sama be de ne en baka e waka.
eng_text: When he was come down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.

djk_text: Wan gwasiman dati be de a ini den sama. Ne a lon kon sutu kini a doti gi Masaa Jesesi. Da ai begi taki: “Masaa! Yu sa wani deesi mi? We, da gaantangi deesi mi, no baa?”
eng_text: And, behold, there came a leper and worshipped him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.

djk_text: Ne wanten wanten, ne Masaa Jesesi langa ana oli en, taki: “Eeye! Mi wani i kon bun.” Da Masaa Jesesi á kaba taki seefi, a gwasi fu a man gwe kaba. A kon bun kele kele.
eng_text: And Jesus put forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will; be thou clean. And immediately his leprosy was cleansed.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi taigi en taki: “Yee ya! Yu á mu go taigi sama fa i du kon bun so! San i mu du, da go a den apaiti begiman na a Mama Keliki a Jelusalem Foto, meke den si fa i kon bun. Soseefi tyai a paiman go pai de, enke fa Mosesi weiti taki, gwasiman mu pai, te den kon bun. Da na dati o meke den sama de si taki, i kon bun tuutuu.”
eng_text: And Jesus saith unto him, See thou tell no man; but go thy way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi o komoto go a wan foto, den e kai Kafalnayemu Foto. Na ape a de, wan ofisii fu den suudati fu Loma Foto, lon kon begi en wan sani.
eng_text: And when Jesus was entered into Capernaum, there came unto him a centurion, beseeching him,

djk_text: A taki: “Masaa! Wan fu den futuboi fu mi lan didon a osu. Ai dede anga sikin ati.”
eng_text: And saying, Lord, my servant lieth at home sick of the palsy, grievously tormented.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en wanten taki: “Mi o kon anda, fu kon deesi en gi yu.”
eng_text: And Jesus saith unto him, I will come and heal him.

djk_text: A ofisii piki en baka taki: “Nono Masaa! Bika mi á waiti sai taki, i sa poti i futu a ini mi osu. Na wan wowtu namo mi wani i taki. Da mi futuboi musu kon bun.”
eng_text: The centurion answered and said, Lord, I am not worthy that thou shouldest come under my roof: but speak the word only, and my servant shall be healed.

djk_text: Soseefi a ofisii taki go doo taki: “Bika mi seefi abi basi a mi tapu. Den e sende mi sani, da mi musu fu du, san den e sende mi. Mi abi suudati a mi ondoo. Den musu fu du, ala san mi e sende den. Efu mi sende wan go a wan peesi, a musu fu go. Mi taigi wan taki, kon! A musu fu kon. Mi taigi wan taki, du so! A musu fu du so.”
eng_text: For I am a man under authority, having soldiers under me: and I say to this man, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.

djk_text: Masaa Jesesi aliki, fa a ofisii fu suudati ya taki, te a kaba. Ne a sani foondoo en te, a daai wanten luku ala sama di taampu ape taki: “Oho! A man di biibi mi a biibi ya! A ná Dyusama, seefi! Ma Dyusama seefi á de di biibi mi a fasi ya wanten. Senten mi e waka lontu a Dyu Kondee, mi á si Dyusama di biibi mi so wanten.”
eng_text: When Jesus heard it, he marvelled, and said to them that followed, Verily I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.

djk_text: Soseefi a taki go doo taki: “Fu tuu! I si fa a man ya biibi mi tide ya? Na letiso somen taa foluku, di á de Dyusama o de na ala uku fu goontapu di o kon sabi fa Masaa Gadu abi makiti. Na den dati o de a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu Kondee a tapu anda, makandii anga den moo gaandi avo gaansama fu wi Dyusama ya, Abalaham, Isaki anga Jakopu. Da na den o sidon makandii anda na a seefi tafaa, fu meke piisii makandii.
eng_text: And I say unto you, That many shall come from the east and west, and shall sit down with Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, in the kingdom of heaven.

djk_text: Ma a ná Dyusama Masaa Gadu o tyai go a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu Kondee a tapu anda, no? Weeno! Ma toku, somen fu den o kai gwe a ini a sitaafu peesi pe soso kee anga tyali de, fu di den nái biibi mi.”
eng_text: But the children of the kingdom shall be cast out into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi daai go taigi a ofisii taki: “Go a osu fi i! Ala sani musu waka enke fa yu biibi taki mi o du.” Ne a seefi yuu di Masaa Jesesi taki so, ne a futuboi fu a ofisii, kon bun kelle.
eng_text: And Jesus said unto the centurion, Go thy way; and as thou hast believed, so be it done unto thee. And his servant was healed in the selfsame hour.

djk_text: Moo lati, ne Masaa Jesesi go a Peitilisi osu. Ne a go si a main fu Peitilisi didon anga feba a kama tapu anda.
eng_text: And when Jesus was come into Peter's house, he saw his wife's mother laid, and sick of a fever.

djk_text: Namo a oli a uman de wan ana namo, ne a feba saka wanten. Ne a main fu Peitilisi ya opo go seeka sani fu nyan gi Masaa Jesesi anga den taawan wanten.
eng_text: And he touched her hand, and the fever left her: and she arose, and ministered unto them.

djk_text: Fa i si neti e doo, sama fu a kondee de seefi tyai somen sama di abi takuu jeje a den tapu kon a Masaa Jesesi. Da Masaa Jesesi e bali den takuu jeje wan kodo mofu namo. Da ala den e komoto wanten wanten a den sama tapu gwe. Soseefi Masaa Jesesi be e deesi ala sama di be abi taanga siki de tu. Ala sikiman be kon betee so moimoi.
eng_text: When the even was come, they brought unto him many that were possessed with devils: and he cast out the spirits with his word, and healed all that were sick:

djk_text: A hii sani ya e waka enke fa Masaa Gadu be piki Jesaja, a fositen apaiti takiman fi en, fu sikiifi taki, dati o kon pasa bakaten. Bika a be sikiifi taki: “A teke ala u takuu siki puu a u tapu. Da enseefi tyai wi siki anga wi nowtu gi wi.”
eng_text: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying, Himself took our infirmities, and bare our sicknesses.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi si taki, somen sama kon lontu en. We, ne ai go fu abaa go na abaase fu a ze, anga den bakaman fi en.
eng_text: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes about him, he gave commandment to depart unto the other side.

djk_text: Namo wan leliman fu Dyuweiti lon kon akisi en taki: “Mesiti! Mi wani kon waka a i baka. Mi wani go na ala pe yu e go.”
eng_text: And a certain scribe came, and said unto him, Master, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.

djk_text: Masaa Jesesi piki en wanten taki: “I sabi san i akisi mi de? I sabi taki, boo peesi á de ya gi mi, enke fa foo abi nesi fu boo? I sabi taki, olo seefi á de ya gi mi fu go didon boo, enke fa busi dagu abi olo fu go didon boo? Bika a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya, da osu á de ya gi en, fu go sidon teke boo.”
eng_text: And Jesus saith unto him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.

djk_text: Namo wan fu den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi dati kon taigi Masaa Jesesi taki: “Masaa! Fosi mi kon waka a yu baka, i sa gi mi pasi fu go beli mi dda fosi, baa?”
eng_text: And another of his disciples said unto him, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en dati taki: “Man! Waka a mi baka. Fika den dede, meke den beli den dede.”
eng_text: But Jesus said unto him, Follow me; and let the dead bury their dead.

djk_text: Namo, ne Masaa Jesesi go a ini a boto. Ne den bakaman fi en seefi teke ne en baka.
eng_text: And when he was entered into a ship, his disciples followed him.

djk_text: A yuu di den e gwe, a wataa e seke te! Den gaan paana e naki kon a ini a boto ogii ogii. Ma Masaa Jesesi didon pii e siibi.
eng_text: And, behold, there arose a great tempest in the sea, insomuch that the ship was covered with the waves: but he was asleep.

djk_text: Na den bakaman fi en e feele te, ne den go weki en. Da den e bali taki: “Oho, oho, oho! Masaa yeepi, no? I nái si taki, wi o dede, no?”
eng_text: And his disciples came to him, and awoke him, saying, Lord, save us: we perish.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Den sama ya! U nái biibi mi sai! Saide u e feele so?” Namo a opo, bali a winta anga a seke wataa taki: “Seke wataa anga winta! U tan pii!” Bakadati, ala sani koo pii tuu.
eng_text: And he saith unto them, Why are ye fearful, O ye of little faith? Then he arose, and rebuked the winds and the sea; and there was a great calm.

djk_text: Den sama di be de ape foondoo, te a ná sipowtu. Da den e taki: “Sama na a sama ya seefi? A abi makiti te, winta anga seke wataa seefi mu e teke en taki.”
eng_text: But the men marvelled, saying, What manner of man is this, that even the winds and the sea obey him!

djk_text: Ne di den doo na a pisi fu den Gadaleini sama, na abaase fu Galileya ze, ne tu man waka kon ne en. Da takuu jeje be de a den tu man ya tapu. Den komoto a den siton olo pe den e beli dedesama e kon. Da ná wan sama be poi fu waka na a pisi pasi ya, bika den tu man ya be ogii seefi seefi.
eng_text: And when he was come to the other side into the country of the Gergesenes, there met him two possessed with devils, coming out of the tombs, exceeding fierce, so that no man might pass by that way.

djk_text: Ma di den si Masaa Jesesi, ne den bali wanten taki: “Pikin fu Masaa Gadu! San wi anga yu abi, meke i kon ya? Na kon i kon poti wi a sitaafu, fosi a yuu fu kisi sitaafu seefi doo?”
eng_text: And, behold, they cried out, saying, What have we to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of God? art thou come hither to torment us before the time?

djk_text: Da wan duupu agu be de na a pisi kondee de. Bika sama be e kweki agu ape.
eng_text: And there was a good way off from them an herd of many swine feeding.

djk_text: Namo den takuu jeje, di de a den tu sama tapu begi Masaa Jesesi taki: “Gaantangi, baa! Te i puu wi a den tu sama ya tapu, gi wi pasi fu go a ini den agu anda, baa?”
eng_text: So the devils besought him, saying, If thou cast us out, suffer us to go away into the herd of swine.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi sende den taki: “Pasa go anda wanten!” Ne wanten wanten, ne den komoto go a ini den agu anda ini. Bakadati, ne ala den agu lon komoto a wan mongo ede, kai go dede a ini a ze.
eng_text: And he said unto them, Go. And when they were come out, they went into the herd of swine: and, behold, the whole herd of swine ran violently down a steep place into the sea, and perished in the waters.

djk_text: Ne den sama di be luku den agu lon go a foto, go taki san pasa ya.
eng_text: And they that kept them fled, and went their ways into the city, and told every thing, and what was befallen to the possessed of the devils.

djk_text: Namo den sama fu a foto aliki a hii toli, te a kaba. Ne den booko go miti Masaa Jesesi. Ne den begi en gaantangi tangi, fu a gwe komoto na a pisi kondee pe den e tan de.
eng_text: And, behold, the whole city came out to meet Jesus: and when they saw him, they besought him that he would depart out of their coasts.

djk_text: Ne bakadati, ne Masaa Jesesi go a boto, ne a abaa go na abaase, na a foto pe a be e tan.
eng_text: And he entered into a ship, and passed over, and came into his own city.

djk_text: Fa i si a doo, ne wan duupu sama tyai wan lanman a daagi tapu kon ne en, fu a deesi en. Ma namo, di Masaa Jesesi si fa den sama di tyai a man kon de e biibi en taanga, ne a taigi a man taki: “Man, ná feele! I kisi paadon fi i takuudu anga ogii kaba.”
eng_text: And, behold, they brought to him a man sick of the palsy, lying on a bed: and Jesus seeing their faith said unto the sick of the palsy; Son, be of good cheer; thy sins be forgiven thee.

djk_text: Ma wan duupu leliman fu Dyuweiti de ape, yee san Masaa Jesesi taki. Ne den kuutu a ini den ati taki: “Ai sipowtu e kosi Masaa Gadu! We, moo so poli fu poli Gadu nen á de!”
eng_text: And, behold, certain of the scribes said within themselves, This man blasphemeth.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi sabi ala san den e pakisei. Ne a piki den taki: “Fu saide u e pakisei ogii fu mi a ini u ati ini so du?
eng_text: And Jesus knowing their thoughts said, Wherefore think ye evil in your hearts?

djk_text: Meke mi akisi u. Fu taigi wan sama taki, a kisi paadon fi en takuudu anga ogii, efu fu taigi en taki, ‘Opo taampu waka!’ on di moo taanga?
eng_text: For whether is easier, to say, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and walk?

djk_text: Ma u mu sabi taki, a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya abi makiti a goontapu, fu gi sama paadon fu takuudu anga ogii.” Ne a daai, ne a taigi a lanman taki: “Opo taampu! Teke i daagi waka go a osu!”
eng_text: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins, (then saith he to the sick of the palsy,) Arise, take up thy bed, and go unto thine house.

djk_text: We, ne a lanman opo, ne a go a osu.
eng_text: And he arose, and departed to his house.

djk_text: Den somen sama di be de ape foondoo te, a fika feele gi den. Den gafa Masaa Gadu fu di a gi libisama a gaan makiti ya.
eng_text: But when the multitudes saw it, they marvelled, and glorified God, which had given such power unto men.

djk_text: Namo, ne Masaa Jesesi komoto de e waka e gwe. Di a waka te wan pisi, ne a si Mateyesi sidon ne en kantoo e piki lantimoni. Ne a kai en taki: “Man, waka a mi baka!” Ne wanten, ne Mateyesi opo waka ne en baka.
eng_text: And as Jesus passed forth from thence, he saw a man, named Matthew, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he saith unto him, Follow me. And he arose, and followed him.

djk_text: Ne moo lati, ne Mateyesi kai Masaa Jesesi anga den taa bakaman fi en, fu den go nyan ne en osu. Da fa i si den go de, da wanlo taa sama di e piki lantimoni enke Mateyesi seefi anga sama di be e tyai polinen a kondee, be de ape tu.
eng_text: And it came to pass, as Jesus sat at meat in the house, behold, many publicans and sinners came and sat down with him and his disciples.

djk_text: Namo di den Faliseiman si Masaa Jesesi sidon anga den sama ya, ne den akisi den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi taki: “Fa a waka a mesiti fu u e mosoo enseefi so anga den man di e piki lantimoni anga den taa polinen man de, te a mu sidon a tafaa anga den e nyan seefi?”
eng_text: And when the Pharisees saw it, they said unto his disciples, Why eateth your Master with publicans and sinners?

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi yee san den e akisi den bakaman fi en. Ne a taigi den taki: “Meke mi akisi u wan sani. San u pakisei dataa de fu du? Na fu deesi sikiman ofu fu deesi sama di de gusontu?”
eng_text: But when Jesus heard that, he said unto them, They that be whole need not a physician, but they that are sick.

djk_text: Ne a taigi den taki: “Faliseiman! U mu go leli san wan fositen apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu be sikiifi. Bika a be sikiifi taki: ‘U á mu denki taki, na te u kii meti boon begi mi, da u e dini mi kaba. Nono! Mi wani u abi tyali ati fu libisama, e fii anga den.’ Bika mi á kon a goontapu fu kai den bunbun sama, ma mi kon fu kai den sama di sabi taki, den libi á bun.”
eng_text: But go ye and learn what that meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice: for I am not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.

djk_text: We, wan taa dei, ne den bakaman fu Johanisi a Dopuman kon a Masaa Jesesi. Ne den taki: “Wi enke bakaman fu Johanisi, wi anga den Faliseiman lobi de sondee nyan, fu begi Masaa Gadu. Ma saide den bakaman fi yu seefi nái de sondee nyan fu begi Masaa Gadu tu?”
eng_text: Then came to him the disciples of John, saying, Why do we and the Pharisees fast oft, but thy disciples fast not?

djk_text: Namo, Masaa Jesesi piki den anga wan ageisi toli. A taki: “I sabi te wan man e toow, da ai oli wan toow osu. Da ai kai en mati fu kon nyan piisii anga en. We, i denki den mati sa sidon de sondee nyan? Nono! Ma, i sabi on ten den mati fi en o de sondee nyan? Na te sama kon puu a man di e toow a den mindii tyai gwe fosi.”
eng_text: And Jesus said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber mourn, as long as the bridegroom is with them? but the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken from them, and then shall they fast.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taki baka taki: “I sa nai nyun pisi koosi anga gaandi wan mokisa? Nono! Bika a nyun pisi o ali a gaandi pisi piiti. Da a piiti o bigi moo di be de kaba.
eng_text: No man putteth a piece of new cloth unto an old garment, for that which is put in to fill it up taketh from the garment, and the rent is made worse.

djk_text: Soseefi, den nái teke nyunyun meke win lai a ini wan gaandi metibuba saka. Bika a nyunyun win o soopu, da a saka ná o poi soopu moo, fu di a gaandi kaba. Da te den lai a win go a ini, da a o basi towe ala. Da a kon taki, i lasi a saka, i lasi a win. Ma te i poti nyunyun meke win a ini nyunyun saka, da te a win o soopu, da a saka seefi o soopu tu. Da ná wan fu den di o lasi.”
eng_text: Neither do men put new wine into old bottles: else the bottles break, and the wine runneth out, and the bottles perish: but they put new wine into new bottles, and both are preserved.

djk_text: Namo wan edeman fu wan Dyu keliki kon sutu kini a Masaa Jesesi fesi e kee taki: “Masaa! Wan pikin umanpikin fu mi dede dyonson dyonson ya a osu. Ma mi e biibi taki, yu poi weki en baka.”
eng_text: While he spake these things unto them, behold, there came a certain ruler, and worshipped him, saying, My daughter is even now dead: but come and lay thy hand upon her, and she shall live.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi komoto anga den bakaman fi en, ne den e go makandii anga a edeman fu a keliki, na a edeman ya osu.
eng_text: And Jesus arose, and followed him, and so did his disciples.

djk_text: Na pasi den de, ne wan uman lon kon a Masaa Jesesi baka. A uman ya be abi wan lasi buulu siki, fu twalufu yali langa kaba. Namo a bendi go oli a koosi mofu fu Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: And, behold, a woman, which was diseased with an issue of blood twelve years, came behind him, and touched the hem of his garment:

djk_text: Da ai pakisei taki: “Efu mi fende Masaa Jesesi koosi oli pikinso namo, mi o kon bun.”
eng_text: For she said within herself, If I may but touch his garment, I shall be whole.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi daai luku wanten, ne a si a uman. Ne a taigi en taki: “Uman! Ná feele! Fu di i biibi mi so taanga, da i kon bun kaba.” Fa i si Masaa Jesesi taki so, a uman betee kaba.
eng_text: But Jesus turned him about, and when he saw her, he said, Daughter, be of good comfort; thy faith hath made thee whole. And the woman was made whole from that hour.

djk_text: We, den waka pikinso moo. Ne den go doo a osu fu a edeman fu a Dyu keliki. Ne Masaa Jesesi si somen sama e pee wan pee enke tuka anda. Da na so den e kee wan gaan kee de tu.
eng_text: And when Jesus came into the ruler's house, and saw the minstrels and the people making a noise,

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi go taigi den taki: “U pasa gwe a doo anga u sani di u e meke! Bika a pikin á dede, na siibi ai siibi.” We, di Masaa Jesesi taki so, ne den sama kii en anga lafu.
eng_text: He said unto them, Give place: for the maid is not dead, but sleepeth. And they laughed him to scorn.

djk_text: Ma di ala sama komoto a doo, ne Masaa Jesesi go a ini a kambaa pe a dede pikin didon. Ne a oli a dede pikin ana, paa. Fa i si a kaba oli en, a pikin opo sidon wanten. Na weki a pikin weki kon a libi baka de so.
eng_text: But when the people were put forth, he went in, and took her by the hand, and the maid arose.

djk_text: We, a nyunsu fu a gaan foondoo toli ya paati esi esi na a hii pisiwataa anda.
eng_text: And the fame hereof went abroad into all that land.

djk_text: Namo, ne Masaa Jesesi daai e gwe. Ma tu beendiman lon kon ne en baka. Da den e bali taki: “Yu Bakaten Manpikin fu Kownu Dafeti paansu! Gaantangi! Yeepi wi anga a tyali ati di yu abi fu wi!”
eng_text: And when Jesus departed thence, two blind men followed him, crying, and saying, Thou Son of David, have mercy on us.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi waka go doo a osu, pe a be e tan. Ma soseefi den beendiman seefi de ne en baka go doo, te a ini a osu. Namo Masaa Jesesi akisi den taki: “U e biibi taki, mi poi deesi u tuu?” Namo den piki en taki: “Masaa! Wi e biibi dati tuutuu!”
eng_text: And when he was come into the house, the blind men came to him: and Jesus saith unto them, Believe ye that I am able to do this? They said unto him, Yea, Lord.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi lobi ana a den ain, saa. Ne a taki: “Da na san u biibi taki mi o du, sa pasa.”
eng_text: Then touched he their eyes, saying, According to your faith be it unto you.

djk_text: Fa i si Masaa Jesesi kaba taki so, den beendiman ain opo waa, den kon e si. Ma Masaa Jesesi wasikoi den taki: “U á mu go taigi ná wan sama.”
eng_text: And their eyes were opened; and Jesus straitly charged them, saying, See that no man know it.

djk_text: Ma anga ala fa a bali den de seefi, toku den paati a mofu na a hii pisiwataa, te ala sama kon sabi.
eng_text: But they, when they were departed, spread abroad his fame in all that country.

djk_text: We, ne di den tu sama gwe, ne den tyai wan babawman kon a Masaa Jesesi, fu a deesi en tu. Bika wan takuu jeje be de na a sama ya tapu, e tapu en mofu fu a á poi taki.
eng_text: As they went out, behold, they brought to him a dumb man possessed with a devil.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi yaki a takuu jeje puu ne en tapu. Ne a kon bun wanten baka, te ai taki. Ne den sama kon e foondoo te, den e taki: “Fu senten di Islayeli Kondee de, noiti so wan sani be pasa ya so wanten.”
eng_text: And when the devil was cast out, the dumb spake: and the multitudes marvelled, saying, It was never so seen in Israel.

djk_text: Ma den Faliseiman taki: “Wi Faliseiman dati sabi fa ai du puu takuu jeje a sama tapu. Na saatan, a basi fu didibii e yeepi en, fu puu den takuu jeje.”
eng_text: But the Pharisees said, He casteth out devils through the prince of the devils.

djk_text: Namo, Masaa Jesesi dati e waka e lontu a den foto foto anga den kondee kondee fu a hii pisiwataa anda. Da ai leli den sama a ini den Dyu keliki, a Bun Nyunsu di e taki, fu a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu. Soseefi, da ala pe a doo, da ai deesi sikiman anga sama di be abi nowtu de.
eng_text: And Jesus went about all the cities and villages, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every sickness and every disease among the people.

djk_text: Ma fa a si den somen sama e kon ne en, ne tyali fu den sama kisi en te, ná sipowtu. Bika a si taki, den sama tan enke fa i sabi sikapu e waka buuya buuya sondee wan soluguman, fu solugu den.
eng_text: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion on them, because they fainted, and were scattered abroad, as sheep having no shepherd.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den bakaman fi en taki: “Somen sama de, di abi yeepi fanowdu. Den de enke wan gaan goon nyanyan di de lepi lepi fu koti poti a baakoto. Ma wookoman á de ipi sai.
eng_text: Then saith he unto his disciples, The harvest truly is plenteous, but the labourers are few;

djk_text: We, u mu begi a Masaa fu a wooko, meke a sende wookoman go na a wooko fi en.”
eng_text: Pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he will send forth labourers into his harvest.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi kai den twalufu bakaman fi en kon, ne a taigi den taki: “U aliki ya! Mi gi u makiti fu u yaki takuu jeje puu a sama tapu. Soseefi mi e gi u makiti fu u deesi ala sowtu sikiman.”
eng_text: And when he had called unto him his twelve disciples, he gave them power against unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal all manner of sickness and all manner of disease.

djk_text: We, da den nen fu den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi di a be teke puu a den taawan mindii, fu de enke apaiti bosikopuman fi en, di den e kai aposteli na be: Simon, a fosiwan fu den aposteli di den be e kai Peitilisi tu Andeleyasi, en baala Jakowbesi, anga en baala Johanisi, den manpikin fu Da Sebedi
eng_text: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these; The first, Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew his brother; James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother;

djk_text: Filipi Baatomeyosi Towmasi Mateyesi di be e piki lantimoni Jakowbesi a manpikin fu Alefeyosi Tadeyesi
eng_text: Philip, and Bartholomew; Thomas, and Matthew the publican; James the son of Alphaeus, and Lebbaeus, whose surname was Thaddaeus;

djk_text: Simon Selotu Judasi Iskaliyotu, di seli Masaa Jesesi, meke den kii en.
eng_text: Simon the Canaanite, and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.

djk_text: Da na den twalufu bakaman fi en ya, a sende na a wooko. A taigi den taki: “Fa i si u o go de, u á mu go a ná wan taa sowtu sama moo enke den Dyusama. Ná den sama fu Samaliya Kondee seefi u mu go.
eng_text: These twelve Jesus sent forth, and commanded them, saying, Go not into the way of the Gentiles, and into any city of the Samaritans enter ye not:

djk_text: Ma na den Dyusama fu u, di den enke lasi sikapu e waka sondee wan soluguman. Na den u mu go.
eng_text: But go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.

djk_text: Te u go, da u taigi den taki, a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu de koosube.
eng_text: And as ye go, preach, saying, The kingdom of heaven is at hand.

djk_text: Soseefi, fa i si u o go de, u mu deesi ala sowtu sikiman kon bun. Efu wan sama dede, u weki en baka, puu a dede. U deesi ala den gwasiman fiya. U yaki ala den takuu jeje puu a den sama tapu. A apaiti taanga, di mi gi u ya, a ná bai u bai en. Da u á mu meke sama pai u fi en tu.
eng_text: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, raise the dead, cast out devils: freely ye have received, freely give.

djk_text: “Da te u o go, ná wan kopoo sensi seefi di u mu tyai go anga u.
eng_text: Provide neither gold, nor silver, nor brass in your purses,

djk_text: U á mu lai nyanyan a saka tyai. U á mu tyai tu dyakiti ofu tu susu tyai go anga u. U á mu tyai moo enke wan waka tiki go anga u tu. Bika a fiti fu wan wookoman nyan, fu a wooko di ai du.
eng_text: Nor scrip for your journey, neither two coats, neither shoes, nor yet staves: for the workman is worthy of his meat.

djk_text: Ma, te u go doo wan foto efu wan kondee, da u suku wan waiti bun manii sama, da u tan ne en osu. Da na ape u mu tan te enke u komoto de fu gwe a wan taa peesi.
eng_text: And into whatsoever city or town ye shall enter, inquire who in it is worthy; and there abide till ye go thence.

djk_text: Ma, te u doo a ini a osu de, da u mu gi den sama de odi taki: ‘Meke Masaa Gadu gi u koo ati fu libi, ye!’
eng_text: And when ye come into an house, salute it.

djk_text: Da efu den sama fu a osu de, waiti fu fende a bun de, da Masaa Gadu o gi den koo ati fu libi tuu. Ma efu den á waiti fu fende en, da den ná o fende en. Da a bun de o daai kon a u baka.
eng_text: And if the house be worthy, let your peace come upon it: but if it be not worthy, let your peace return to you.

djk_text: Ma efu u go a wan kondee ofu wan osu, ne den sama á wani oli u, den á wani yee a bun fu Masaa Gadu, da u mu komoto de gwe. Ma, te u o gwe, da u mu naki u futu puu a doti di be de ne en towe fika de. Dati o soi taki, te Masaa Gadu o gi den sitaafu, da u dati ná abi fowtu a ini. Ma na denseefi fowtu, meke Masaa Gadu o sitaafu den so.
eng_text: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear your words, when ye depart out of that house or city, shake off the dust of your feet.

djk_text: “Bika fu tuutuu mi e taki, a dei di Masaa Gadu o kai ala sama kon a kuutu, da a o gi den sitaafu! A o bigi moo a sitaafu fu Sowdom anga Gomola, den tu ogii foto, di Masaa Gadu be gi faya a fositen.
eng_text: Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city.

djk_text: “Ma u aliki! Fa mi e sende u go ya, da a de enke te mi be o sende sikapu go a mindii fu takuu meti. Da, u mu de na ain e wooko anga ala fusutan. U mu waka anga saka fasi anda.
eng_text: Behold, I send you forth as sheep in the midst of wolves: be ye therefore wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.

djk_text: U mu luku bun anga den sama! Bika den sa kisi u tyai go a kuutu. Den o wipi u a ini den keliki osu fu den tu.
eng_text: But beware of men: for they will deliver you up to the councils, and they will scourge you in their synagogues;

djk_text: Soseefi den o kisi u tyai go a den edeman fu kondee, fu mi ede. Ma ala dati o pasa, fu di u mu fende pasi fu kotoigi fu mi gi ala Dyusama, te go miti taa foluku di á sabi Masaa Gadu du.
eng_text: And ye shall be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them and the Gentiles.

djk_text: Te den kisi u tyai go a den kuutu fu den, da u á mu pantan anga booko ede taki san u o taki. Nono! Bika a yuu de, da Masaa Gadu o gi u san fu u taki.
eng_text: But when they deliver you up, take no thought how or what ye shall speak: for it shall be given you in that same hour what ye shall speak.

djk_text: Bika a ná u o sabi taki so, ma a Apaiti Jeje fu mi Tata di de a u ini, ne en o taki komoto a ini u, kon a doo.
eng_text: For it is not ye that speak, but the Spirit of your Father which speaketh in you.

djk_text: “We, u mu de sabi sabi taki, wan baala o seli en baala gi sama fu kii, fu di ai biibi mi ede. Wan dda seefi o seli en pikin gi sama fu di a pikin e biibi mi ede. Soseefi pikin seefi o seli dda anga mma gi sama fu kii.
eng_text: And the brother shall deliver up the brother to death, and the father the child: and the children shall rise up against their parents, and cause them to be put to death.

djk_text: Meke u taki, ná wan sama o lobi u, fu di u e biibi mi ede. Ma a sama di o tei ati oli fu oli doo, te na a kaba, da a sa fende a yeepi fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake: but he that endureth to the end shall be saved.

djk_text: We, u yee ya! Te u go a wan foto, ne sama e suku toobi anga u de, da u lon komoto de, go a wan taa foto. Bika fu tuu, mi e taigi u taki, u ná o poi kaba a wooko na ala den foto fu Islayeli Kondee ya, fosi a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya daai kon baka a goontapu.
eng_text: But when they persecute you in this city, flee ye into another: for verily I say unto you, Ye shall not have gone over the cities of Israel, till the Son of man be come.

djk_text: “Da fa i si den e du anga u de, na letiso den e du anga mi ya kaba. Bika a sama di e teke leli a wan basi, noiti hei moo a basi. Soseefi wan futuboi á hei moo en masaa.
eng_text: The disciple is not above his master, nor the servant above his lord.

djk_text: Ma a mu soi a futuboi fu kon de enke en masaa. Na dati meke fa den e kosi mi ya taki, na Belisebulu, a basi fu didibii de a mi tapu, da u denki taki, den ná o kosi u so tu? Bika mi anga u na awan.
eng_text: It is enough for the disciple that he be as his master, and the servant as his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebub, how much more shall they call them of his household?

djk_text: “We, mi e taigi u taki, u á mu feele ná wan enkii sama, di wani du ogii anga u! Kweti! Bika ná wan sani o kibii te, da a á kon a kiin wan dei. Da ná wan sani o pasa te, da sama á sabi.
eng_text: Fear them not therefore: for there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; and hid, that shall not be known.

djk_text: Na dati ede meke, den sani di mi e taigi u saafi saafi ya, u mu bali den taanga seefi kon a doo.
eng_text: What I tell you in darkness, that speak ye in light: and what ye hear in the ear, that preach ye upon the housetops.

djk_text: “Soseefi u á mu feele, te sama e suku fu kii u. Bika den sa kii u sikin namo, da a kaba. Ma den á poi kii u jeje. Ma a sama di u mu feele, dati na Masaa Gadu. Bika a sa kaba i sikin a soso, da a towe i sikin anga a jeje fi i go a ini didibii faya .
eng_text: And fear not them which kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul: but rather fear him which is able to destroy both soul and body in hell.

djk_text: U luku den pikin foo di e fee a tapu anda. Ná wan sama di e si den fu gaan sani. Na dati meke den e seli tu, fu wan tiisensi. Ma anga ala fa i si den e fee e lontu anda, ná wan fu den di e puu kai a doti, efu a ná u Tata, Masaa Gadu gi pasi fu dati.
eng_text: Are not two sparrows sold for a farthing? and one of them shall not fall on the ground without your Father.

djk_text: We, u enke libisama, no? Mi e taigi u taki, Masaa seefi sabi onmen uwii de a u ede.
eng_text: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.

djk_text: Na dati meke u ati á mu dege dege. Bika u waiti onmen toon moo enke den pikin foo.
eng_text: Fear ye not therefore, ye are of more value than many sparrows.

djk_text: “Da sama di sa taki fu mi, a fesi fu libisama, da mi sa taki fi en, a mi Tata fesi a tapu tu.
eng_text: Whosoever therefore shall confess me before men, him will I confess also before my Father which is in heaven.

djk_text: Ma efu yu á wani taki fu mi, a fesi fu libisama, da mi seefi ná o taki fi yu a fesi fu mi Tata tu.
eng_text: But whosoever shall deny me before men, him will I also deny before my Father which is in heaven.

djk_text: “Da fa i si mi kon a goontapu ya, da u á mu denki taki, na fii mi tyai kon a goontapu. Nono! A ná fii mi tyai kon. Ma na feti mi tyai kon.
eng_text: Think not that I am come to send peace on earth: I came not to send peace, but a sword.

djk_text: Mi kon fu paati sama anga sama. Bika wan manpikin anga en dda o paati. Wan umanpikin anga en mma o paati. Main anga main o paati. Bika den o kisi gaan toobi fu mi ede.
eng_text: For I am come to set a man at variance against his father, and the daughter against her mother, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.

djk_text: Da den moo gaan feyanti fu wan man, sa de en eigi famii seefi.
eng_text: And a man's foes shall be they of his own household.

djk_text: Ma ibiiwan sama di sa lobi en dda, en mma, en manpikin, ofu en umanpikin moo mi, dati á fiti fu toon bakaman fu mi.
eng_text: He that loveth father or mother more than me is not worthy of me: and he that loveth son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me.

djk_text: Efu wan sama á wani teke den pina anga banowtu di e kon ne en tapu, fu di ai waka a mi baka, da sowan sama á sa poi de mi bakaman. Bika i mu poi tyai pina anga banowtu, fu mi ede.
eng_text: And he that taketh not his cross, and followeth after me, is not worthy of me.

djk_text: Ma sama di o tan libi doo enke fa en seefi wani, dati sa lasi a hii libi fu tego. Ma sama di o fika en hii libi gi Masaa Gadu wawan, da sowan sama sa fende a libi fu tego.
eng_text: He that findeth his life shall lose it: and he that loseth his life for my sake shall find it.

djk_text: “Da sama di teke den bakaman fu mi di e tyai a bosikopu fu mi oli a den osu, da na miseefi den teke oli de kaba. Da sama di teke mi oli a den osu, teke a sama di sende mi kon oli a den osu tu.
eng_text: He that receiveth you receiveth me, and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.

djk_text: Kon u taki, i teke wan apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu oli a yu osu, da i sa fende a seefi paiman di Masaa Gadu o pai ala apaiti takiman fi en a Masaa Gadu Kondee. Dati wani taki, teke wan bun ati sama di lobi Masaa Gadu oli a yu osu, da yuseefi o fende a paiman fu dati. Masaa Gadu o pai yu a seefi paiman di a o pai ala bun ati sama di lobi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: He that receiveth a prophet in the name of a prophet shall receive a prophet's reward; and he that receiveth a righteous man in the name of a righteous man shall receive a righteous man's reward.

djk_text: Soseefi, ibiiwan sama di gi a moo mofina bakaman fu mi soso wan gaasi wataa namo, sa fende paiman fu dati baka. Bika Masaa Gadu o pai en fu dati.”
eng_text: And whosoever shall give to drink unto one of these little ones a cup of cold water only in the name of a disciple, verily I say unto you, he shall in no wise lose his reward.

djk_text: We, da Masaa Jesesi kaba soi den bakaman fi en san den mu go du. Ne enseefi komoto go waka a ini den foto foto fu Galileya pisiwataa anda. Da ai paati a Bun Nyunsu fu Masaa Gadu. Soseefi ai leli den sama anda fa fu libi.
eng_text: And it came to pass, when Jesus had made an end of commanding his twelve disciples, he departed thence to teach and to preach in their cities.

djk_text: Ma Johanisi a Dopuman be de sooto sooto, fasi kankan a dunguu osu ete. Pe a de anda, da ai yee taki, a Kelestesi, e waka e wooko. Namo a sende en bakaman go akisi Masaa Jesesi wan sani.
eng_text: Now when John had heard in the prison the works of Christ, he sent two of his disciples,

djk_text: A meke den akisi en taki: “Fa i de ape? Na yu na a sama di Masaa Gadu be paamisi fu sende kon tyai yeepi kaba? Boiti yu, da taawan á de fu a sende kon moo, no?”
eng_text: And said unto him, Art thou he that should come, or do we look for another?

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi sende den baka taki: “Na go namo u mu go taigi Johanisi san u seefi si mi e du anga san u yee mi e du.
eng_text: Jesus answered and said unto them, Go and shew John again those things which ye do hear and see:

djk_text: U taigi en taki, beendiman e kon si baka. Lan man e opo waka baka. Gwasiman e kon bun tu. Dofuman e kon yee baka. Dede seefi e weki baka. Soseefi a Bun Nyunsu fu Masaa Gadu e paati, te go doo ala mofina wan.”
eng_text: The blind receive their sight, and the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, and the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have the gospel preached to them.

djk_text: Soseefi Masaa Jesesi taki go doo taki: “Go taigi Johanisi taki, ma na sama di tan biibi mi go doo o fende seigi a mi ana.”
eng_text: And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.

djk_text: We, ne den bakaman fu Johanisi gwe baka. Namo Masaa Jesesi akisi den somen sama di de ape taki: “Sama de ya di be go luku, fa Johanisi be e dopu sama a ini a sabana? Fu sowtu sama u be oli en, meke u be go luku en anda so? U be pakisei taki, na wan man di winta poi wai tyai go a pe a wani, fu di a feke?
eng_text: And as they departed, Jesus began to say unto the multitudes concerning John, What went ye out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken with the wind?

djk_text: U be pakisei taki, na wan modoman di e wei gaan dii koosi, u be e go luku anda? Nono! Bika, da na kownu osu u be sa go luku dati.”
eng_text: But what went ye out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? behold, they that wear soft clothing are in kings' houses.

djk_text: Soseefi Masaa Jesesi taki go doo taki: “U piki mi! Saide u be komoto a u osu gwe te a ini a gaan sabana, fu go luku Johanisi so? We fu tuu, na oli u be oli taki, en na wan apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu. Na dati meke u be gwe, go aliki san a abi fu taki. We, fu tuu mi e taki, Johanisi bigi moo wan apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu seefi.
eng_text: But what went ye out for to see? A prophet? yea, I say unto you, and more than a prophet.

djk_text: Bika na Johanisi kon na a Kelestesi fesi, enke fa wan fositen apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu be sikiifi taki, dati musu fu pasa. Bika a be sikiifi taki: ‘Mi o sende wan apaiti takiman fu mi kon, fosi yuseefi kon doo. A o taigi sama fu daai seeka den libi, na a leti pasi fu Masaa Gadu.’
eng_text: For this is he, of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.

djk_text: Fu tuu, da fu ala den sama di komoto a mama bee, da ná wan fu den di hei enke Johanisi ya. Ma toku, ibiiwan mofina di de a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu, fende gaan bun moo enke Johanisi seefi.”
eng_text: Verily I say unto you, Among them that are born of women there hath not risen a greater than John the Baptist: notwithstanding he that is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.

djk_text: Soseefi, Masaa Jesesi taki ete taki: “Ma fu di Johanisi sete paati a bosikopu fu Masaa Gadu, te kon miti tide, da a bosikopu ya e booko pasi naamo. Ala sowtu sama e feti fu teke en, fu kon de a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: And from the days of John the Baptist until now the kingdom of heaven suffereth violence, and the violent take it by force.

djk_text: We, ala fositen apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu be tyai a bosikopu, fu fa Masaa Gadu wani tii sani. Den be e du dati te, Johanisi kon doo nownow.
eng_text: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John.

djk_text: Da sama wani teke taki, na Johanisi Masaa Gadu be e kai Eliya, di a be piki den apaiti takiman fi en fu sikiifi taki, Eliya o waka na a Kelestesi fesi.
eng_text: And if ye will receive it, this is Elias, which was for to come.

djk_text: We, sama di wani fu fusutan a sani ya, mu poti ede pakisei dipi.”
eng_text: He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.

djk_text: Soseefi, Masaa Jesesi taki go doo taki: “Ma meke mi taigi u, fa sama fu a ten ya tan.
eng_text: But whereunto shall I liken this generation? It is like unto children sitting in the markets, and calling unto their fellows,

djk_text: Na pikinengee di e pee den gei. Den pikin e pee poku! Namo afu akisi den taawan taki: ‘Saide u á wani dansi. Bika u naki doon fu dansi, u á wani dansi. U naki doon fu tyali, u á wani tyali. Da san u mu du moo?’
eng_text: And saying, We have piped unto you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned unto you, and ye have not lamented.

djk_text: U si fa den pikin de manii gei sama fu a ten ya? Bika noiti sani de di bun gi den wanten. Johanisi kon, a be e tan sondee nyan, fu begi. Den daai, den taki na didibii de ne en tapu. Da den ná o teke en taki.
eng_text: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, He hath a devil.

djk_text: Now, da a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya, nái tan sondee nyan fu begi. Namo dati á bun gi den baka. Den e kaagi now taki, na fu nyan ai libi. Soseefi den fende taki, ai mati anga soso poli sama. Da den ná o teke en taki tu. Ma koni musu de fu si a den letiopu wooko di ai du.”
eng_text: The Son of man came eating and drinking, and they say, Behold a man gluttonous, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners. But wisdom is justified of her children.

djk_text: Namo, Masaa Jesesi daai wasikoi den foto foto pe a be waka du foondoo sani. Bika den sama anda á daai libi, winsi fa den si foondoo sani di a du.
eng_text: Then began he to upbraid the cities wherein most of his mighty works were done, because they repented not:

djk_text: Namo a wasikoi den taki: “Heelu fu u sama fu Kolasin Foto anga Betisaida Foto! Bika mi du gaan foondoo sani gi u, ma toku u á daai libi. We, u si fa Masaa Gadu be boon den tu ogii fositen foto, den e kai Tilosi anga Sidon. Ma efu na anda mi be du foondoo sani so, da den sama anda be o daai libi. Da Masaa Gadu á be o boon den foto de.
eng_text: Woe unto thee, Chorazin! woe unto thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works, which were done in you, had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.

djk_text: We, u luku ya! Wan dei e kon, di Masaa Gadu o kai ala sama kon a kuutu. Da fu tuu, den sama fu Sidon Foto anga Tilosi Foto ná o kisi gaan sitaafu enke u fu den foto ya.”
eng_text: But I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the day of judgment, than for you.

djk_text: Soseefi, Masaa Jesesi wasikoi Kafalnayemu Foto taki: “U sama fu Kafalnayemu Foto seefi! U pakisei u o subi go doo Masaa Gadu Kondee? Kweti! Na ini a sitaafu peesi fu faya u o kai go. Bika u si fa Masaa Gadu be boon Sowdom Foto a fositen. Ma efu na anda mi be du den foondoo sani so, da den sama de be o daai biibi Masaa Gadu. Da Masaa Gadu á be o boon a foto fu den.
eng_text: And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted unto heaven, shalt be brought down to hell: for if the mighty works, which have been done in thee, had been done in Sodom, it would have remained until this day.
