djk_text: Ma fu tuu mi e taki, wan dei e kon di Masaa Gadu o kai ala sama kon a kuutu. Da Sowdom Foto ná o kisi gaan sitaafu, enke u fu Kafalnayemu Foto de.”
eng_text: But I say unto you, That it shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom in the day of judgment, than for thee.

djk_text: Namo a ten ya, ne Masaa Jesesi begi Masaa Gadu taki: “Kee! Mi Tata, Masaa Gadu! Na yu na a basi fu ala sani tuu. Mi e gi yu gaantangi, fu fa yu meke sama di abi hei membee á poi sabi, a gaan koni di yu abi. Ma na mofina wan i soi a gaan koni di yu abi.
eng_text: At that time Jesus answered and said, I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes.

djk_text: We! Mi Tata, a bun fa yu du so! Bika mi sabi taki, na so yu lobi fu sani waka.”
eng_text: Even so, Father: for so it seemed good in thy sight.

djk_text: Soseefi a daai taigi den sama taki: “Fu tuu! Mi Tata poti ala sani fi en a ini mi ana. Ma na a Tata wawan sabi sama na a Pikin. Taa sama á de di sabi a Pikin enke fa a Tata sabi en. Soseefi, sama á de di sabi a Tata enke fa a Pikin dati sabi en. Da na sama a Pikin meke kon sabi a Tata, na den dati namo sa sabi en.”
eng_text: All things are delivered unto me of my Father: and no man knoweth the Son, but the Father; neither knoweth any man the Father, save the Son, and he to whomsoever the Son will reveal him.

djk_text: Soseefi a kai den sama taki: “Ibii sama anga nowtu, u kon teke boo a mi!
eng_text: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.

djk_text: Da leli fu waka enke fa mi e leli, fu tyai u anga mi taanga. Soseefi, fu tyai u nowtu gi u, enke fa wan sama e tow wan taawan boto tyai. Mi o du a wooko de gi u, bika mi abi saka fasi, fu yeepi sama, meke u sa fende boo.
eng_text: Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls.

djk_text: Mi leli á taanga fu tyai. Bika anga miseefi taanga u o tyai en, meke u sa poi tyai a libi de.”
eng_text: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.

djk_text: Na wan kina dei fu a seefi ten ya, ne Masaa Jesesi e waka pasa a ini wan goon. Wan sowtu sii be taampu enke somen alisi tiki a ini a goon de. Ne den bakaman e piki a ede fi en e nyan. Bika angii be moo den.
eng_text: At that time Jesus went on the sabbath day through the corn; and his disciples were an hungred, and began to pluck the ears of corn, and to eat.

djk_text: Namo den Faliseiman si san den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi e du ya. Na so den go kaagi wanten a Masaa Jesesi taki: “Luku den bakaman fi yu! Den e wooko a kina dei! Den piki den sii! Ma weiti taki, sama á mu wooko a kina dei.”
eng_text: But when the Pharisees saw it, they said unto him, Behold, thy disciples do that which is not lawful to do upon the sabbath day.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Faliseiman! San sikiifi a ini Masaa Gadu Buku taki, Kownu Dafeti anga den sama fi en be du, di angii be moo den?
eng_text: But he said unto them, Have ye not read what David did, when he was an hungred, and they that were with him;

djk_text: A edeman di be e luku a apaiti tenti fu Masaa Gadu á be meke den nyan a beele, di sama e poti gi Masaa Gadu a ini a apaiti tenti de, no? Weeno! Ma i denki taki, den be abi pasi fu nyan a beele de? Kweti! Bika weiti taki, na soso den apaiti begiman fu a Mama Keliki namo mu nyanmi en.
eng_text: How he entered into the house of God, and did eat the shewbread, which was not lawful for him to eat, neither for them which were with him, but only for the priests?

djk_text: Soseefi, da Mosesi weiti taki, den apaiti begiman abi pasi fu wooko a ini a Mama Keliki fu Masaa Gadu, a kina dei. Na dati meke sama á poi kaagi den, te den e wooko a kina dei.
eng_text: Or have ye not read in the law, how that on the sabbath days the priests in the temple profane the sabbath, and are blameless?

djk_text: Fu tuu, mi e taigi u! Wan Sama de a u mindii ya, di hei moo a Mama Keliki seefi.
eng_text: But I say unto you, That in this place is one greater than the temple.

djk_text: Ma wan sani u dati mu kon fusutan. A sikiifi a ini Gadu Buku taki: ‘Boon meti enke paiman fu gi Masaa Gadu ya gaantangi, na wan bun sani. Ma te u wooko anga tyali ati fu taawan, da mi moo lobi dati!’ Efu u be poi fusutan dati, da wi á be o kon kaagi sama di á du ogii.
eng_text: But if ye had known what this meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice, ye would not have condemned the guiltless.

djk_text: Soseefi, da a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya, na a gaan Masaa fu a kina dei.”
eng_text: For the Son of man is Lord even of the sabbath day.

djk_text: We baka fu dati, ne Masaa Jesesi waka go a wan fu den Dyu keliki osu anda.
eng_text: And when he was departed thence, he went into their synagogue:

djk_text: Namo a go si wan man anga wan lan ana anda. Ma wan duupu siteeman be de ape tu. Den dati go wanten go akisi Masaa Jesesi, sani fu sitee anga en. Da te Masaa Jesesi be sa piki wan fowtu fasi, da den be o fende pasi kaagi en. Namo den akisi Masaa Jesesi taki: “Deesi sikiman a kina dei sa de wan sani, di fiti fu du?”
eng_text: And, behold, there was a man which had his hand withered. And they asked him, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath days? that they might accuse him.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi piki den anga wan hiihii ageisi toli. A taki: “Fa i de ape, da i abi wan sikapu! Efu a kai go a ini wan dipi olo a kina dei, san yu o du? We, na moiti i be o meke fu puu en de, winsi fa na kina dei.
eng_text: And he said unto them, What man shall there be among you, that shall have one sheep, and if it fall into a pit on the sabbath day, will he not lay hold on it, and lift it out?

djk_text: Yu e du dati gi wan meti a kina dei, da fa i pakisei fu wan libisama di waiti moo meti? We, u luku ya! A weiti fu Masaa Gadu nái tapu sama, fu du bun gi taawan a kina dei.”
eng_text: How much then is a man better than a sheep? Wherefore it is lawful to do well on the sabbath days.

djk_text: We, baka fu dati, ne Masaa Jesesi daai go na a lanman di de ape. Ne a taigi en taki: “Biya! Mi soi yu, tiiki a lan ana go anga fesi, ye!” Fa i si a sama tiiki a lan ana, a lan ana poi tiiki tuutuu. A kon bun kele kele enke a taase ana.
eng_text: Then saith he to the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched it forth; and it was restored whole, like as the other.

djk_text: Namo den Faliseiman sama di be de ape waka gwe a doose wanten. Den gwe go kai pakisei luku, fa fu fende wan fasi fu puu Masaa Jesesi futu a goontapu.
eng_text: Then the Pharisees went out, and held a council against him, how they might destroy him.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi sabi san den e pakisei fu du. Ne a komoto ape wanten gwe a wan taa peesi. Namo somen sama waka gwe ne en baka. Da ai deesi ala den sikiwan a ini den sama mindii, te enke den kon bun.
eng_text: But when Jesus knew it, he withdrew himself from thence: and great multitudes followed him, and he healed them all;

djk_text: Ma fa i si ai deesi den, da ai taigi den taki: “Ma te u gwe, u á mu taigi sama, sama deesi u so, ye!”
eng_text: And charged them that they should not make him known:

djk_text: We, luku ya! A hii wooko fu Masaa Jesesi ya be e waka enke fa Masaa Gadu be meke a apaiti takiman fi en di den be e kai Jesaja, be sikiifi a fositen.
eng_text: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying,

djk_text: Bika a be sikiifi taki: “Luku a wookoman di mi teke fu du mi wooko! Ai du san fiti mi, ne mi lobi en enke mi gaasi fu ain. Da mi sa poti mi Apaiti Jeje ne en tapu. Da a o soi sama di á sabi Masaa Gadu, fa fu kon sabi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Behold my servant, whom I have chosen; my beloved, in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my spirit upon him, and he shall shew judgment to the Gentiles.

djk_text: Ma a ná o de fu kwali kwali anga sama. Kweti! Soseefi, a ná o hei enseefi, suku balinen tu.
eng_text: He shall not strive, nor cry; neither shall any man hear his voice in the streets.

djk_text: Ma a sa yeepi sama di libi wani go poli, fu den libi á mu go poli. Soseefi a o yeepi sama di wani lasi ati, fu den á sa lasi ati. A sa wooko so go doo a dei di Masaa Gadu o meke goontapu kon toon wan letiopu peesi.
eng_text: A bruised reed shall he not break, and smoking flax shall he not quench, till he send forth judgment unto victory.

djk_text: Da na somen sama di á be sabi Masaa Gadu o kon poti biibi ne en tapu.”
eng_text: And in his name shall the Gentiles trust.

djk_text: We, den be tyai wan sama di abi takuu jeje kon a Masaa Jesesi. Da a sama be beendi tu, da a á be poi taki. Namo Masaa Jesesi deesi en kon bun, kele kele.
eng_text: Then was brought unto him one possessed with a devil, blind, and dumb: and he healed him, insomuch that the blind and dumb both spake and saw.

djk_text: Ne den sama di de ape foondoo gi Masaa Jesesi, te ná sipowtu. Ne den e akisi den seefi taki: “Ma a sa de taki, a sama ya, na a Bakaten Manpikin fu Kownu Dafeti paansu?”
eng_text: And all the people were amazed, and said, Is not this the son of David?

djk_text: We, ne den Faliseiman sama seefi kon yee san den sama de e taki de. Namo den kaagi taki: “Na wi dati sabi fa ai du puu takuu jeje a sama tapu. Na a basi fu takuu jeje, di den e kai Belisebulu seefi gi en a taanga anga a makiti fu du dati.”
eng_text: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, This fellow doth not cast out devils, but by Beelzebub the prince of the devils.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi sabi fa den e denki so! Ne a piki den anga wan ageisi toli taki: “I be abi wan kownu, di e tii wan gaan kondee. We, den sama fu a kondee ya opo e feti anga denseefi. Da a hii kondee fu a kownu ya ná o booko saka, no? Soseefi wan gaan famii ofuso wan foto de. Ne den sama a ini, sete fu feti anga den seefi. Da den sama ya o booko den seefi saka tu.
eng_text: And Jesus knew their thoughts, and said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and every city or house divided against itself shall not stand:

djk_text: We, efu didibii seefi kon daai e puu enseefi, da san ai du? Da na feti ai feti anga enseefi, fu booko a hii makiti anga a hii kondee fi enseefi, di ai tii.
eng_text: And if Satan cast out Satan, he is divided against himself; how shall then his kingdom stand?

djk_text: We, u Faliseiman de! Useefi abi bakaman di e puu takuu jeje a sama tapu tu. U go akisi den a sani ya. Den sa piki u taki, didibii ná o wooko, fu puu enseefi a sama tapu. Bika efu a du so, da ai poli enseefi wooko.
eng_text: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your children cast them out? therefore they shall be your judges.

djk_text: Ma u aliki ya! Di na Masaa Gadu Jeje de a mi tapu kaba, fu puu takuu jeje, da u mu sabi taki, a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu kon doo u ya.
eng_text: But if I cast out devils by the Spirit of God, then the kingdom of God is come unto you.

djk_text: Bika sama ná o poi fu pasa, go teke wan taanga man sani a ini en osu puu a doo. Fosi a sa du dati, da a musu tei a taanga man di abi a osu de fosi.
eng_text: Or else how can one enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong man? and then he will spoil his house.

djk_text: “We, ibii sama di á wani teke a se fu mi, dati o de a didibii ondoo. Bika den sama di nái wooko makandii anga mi, dati e suku fu poli mi wooko.
eng_text: He that is not with me is against me; and he that gathereth not with me scattereth abroad.

djk_text: Ma fu tuu, Masaa Gadu sa gi wan sama paadon, fu ala ogii di a sa du. Soseefi a sa gi en paadon tu, fu ala taa kosi, winsi ai taki ogii fu a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya. Ma a wan sani di noiti Masaa Gadu e gi sama paadon, na te a sama e taki ogii fu a Apaiti Jeje fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Wherefore I say unto you, All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men: but the blasphemy against the Holy Ghost shall not be forgiven unto men.

djk_text: “We, na a sii di wan bon e meke yu o luku, da yu sa sabi fa fu kai a bon seefi. Wan bun ati bon e meke bun sii. Ma na wan takuu ati bon e meke sii di á bun.
eng_text: Either make the tree good, and his fruit good; or else make the tree corrupt, and his fruit corrupt: for the tree is known by his fruit.

djk_text: “Na yu enke ogii ati sama, enke takuu tetei di taampu de, á sa poi puu bunbun taki kon a doo. Bika na san fuu a takuu ati fu u, e kon komoto a doo.
eng_text: O generation of vipers, how can ye, being evil, speak good things? for out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaketh.

djk_text: Ma wan bun ati sama, na bun manii ai puu kon a doo. Ma wan ogii ati sama dati na takuu manii, ai puu kon a doo.
eng_text: A good man out of the good treasure of the heart bringeth forth good things: and an evil man out of the evil treasure bringeth forth evil things.

djk_text: Ma fu tuu, mi e taigi u! Wan dei e kon, da Masaa Gadu o kai ala sama kon a kuutu. Da ibii sama o gi faantiwowtu, fu ala soso taki seefi di a be taki ya.
eng_text: But I say unto you, That every idle word that men shall speak, they shall give account thereof in the day of judgment.

djk_text: Ma sama di be abi bunbun sani e taki, da dati o tyai bun gi a sama de a Masaa Gadu. Ma efu na poli taki i be abi, da dati o tyai sitaafu gi yu a Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: For by thy words thou shalt be justified, and by thy words thou shalt be condemned.

djk_text: We, ne wan duupu leliman fu Dyuweiti o waka kon a Masaa Jesesi. Soseefi, Faliseiman be de a ini kon tu. Namo den sende Masaa Jesesi taki: “Mesiti! Du wan gaan wonduu a tapu anda, osi, meke u si fa yu abi a makiti fu Masaa Gadu tuutuu?”
eng_text: Then certain of the scribes and of the Pharisees answered, saying, Master, we would see a sign from thee.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “U takuu ati sama, di á de fu fitoow! Bika na a sowtu sama enke u de wani si wonduu, enke maiki fosi den sa biibi. Ma mi ya dati ná o soi u wan enkii maiki, moo enke a foondoo toli fu Jowna.
eng_text: But he answered and said unto them, An evil and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given to it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas:

djk_text: Bika u sabi taki, Jowna be beli dii dei anga neti a ini a gaan fisi bee. We, na so den o beli a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya, dii dei anga neti a ondoo doti tu.
eng_text: For as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale's belly; so shall the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.

djk_text: Ma wan dei e kon, da den sama fu Ninifei o opo, da den o kuutu den sama fu a ten ya. Bika den sama fu Ninifei be yee a wowtu fu Masaa Gadu di Jowna be gi den. Ne den teke en, ne den daai libi wanten. Ma wan Sama de a u mindii ya, di hei moo Jowna, ma toku, u nái teke en taki.
eng_text: The men of Nineveh shall rise in judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: because they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.

djk_text: Soseefi a uman kownu fu a kondee na a se fu san dongo, o opo na a gaan kuutu dei, di Masaa Gadu o kuutu sama, fu kuutu den sama fu a ten ya. Bika en dati be komoto langa langa te na a taase fu goontapu fu kon a Salomo, fu kon yee den koni fi en. Ma wan Sama de a u mindii ya, di hei moo Salomo seefi, ma toku, u nái teke en taki.”
eng_text: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for she came from the uttermost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon is here.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi wasikoi den sama go doo taki: “Te wan takuu jeje e komoto na wan sama tapu, da a gwe moimoi, go waka lontu, suku taa tanpeesi a ini gaan sabana. Ma, da a nái poi fende tanpeesi anda.
eng_text: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest, and findeth none.

djk_text: Da ai pakisei taki: ‘Meke mi daai go tan na a peesi pe mi be komoto baka.’ Da te a daai kon baka, a osu pe a be komoto de leigi leigi. A de kiinkiin sibisibi moi silli.
eng_text: Then he saith, I will return into my house from whence I came out; and when he is come, he findeth it empty, swept, and garnished.

djk_text: Ma fosi a go baka, da ai go kai ete seibin taa takuu jeje ogii moo enseefi. Da ala den e go tan a ini a sama makandii. Da a kon, sowan sama libi e kon moo ogii, moo fosi den be puu a takuu jeje gi en. Na letiso sa pasa anga den sama di nái yee mi taki ya tu.”
eng_text: Then goeth he, and taketh with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and they enter in and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first. Even so shall it be also unto this wicked generation.

djk_text: Da di Masaa Jesesi de ape e taki den sani ya, ne en mma anga den baala fi en kon luku en. Den be wani taki anga en. Ma a osu pe Masaa Jesesi be de fuu te, ne den á poi doo Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: While he yet talked to the people, behold, his mother and his brethren stood without, desiring to speak with him.

djk_text: We, ne wan sama lon kon piki Masaa Jesesi a ini a osu taki, en mma anga den baala fi en de a doose e luku en.
eng_text: Then one said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to speak with thee.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi akisi taki: “Sama u e kai mi mma anga mi baala?”
eng_text: But he answered and said unto him that told him, Who is my mother? and who are my brethren?

djk_text: Ne a daai sii soi finga a den bakaman fi en. Ne a taki: “U luku den sama ya! Na den na mi mma anga mi baala, mi tuutuu tyuku tyuku famii.
eng_text: And he stretched forth his hand toward his disciples, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!

djk_text: Bika na ala sama, di e du enke fa mi Tata, Masaa Gadu a tapu wani, na mi baala anga mi sisa anga mi mma.”
eng_text: For whosoever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.

djk_text: Ne a seefi dei de, ne Masaa Jesesi komoto a ini a osu, ne a go sidon a wataa mofu anda.
eng_text: The same day went Jesus out of the house, and sat by the sea side.

djk_text: Ma somen sama booko kon lontu en te, ná sipowtu. Ne a go a ini wan boto fika den sama a soo. Da na anda a tan e taki anga den sama. Da den sama taampu a sikin liba e aliki.
eng_text: And great multitudes were gathered together unto him, so that he went into a ship, and sat; and the whole multitude stood on the shore.

djk_text: Ne a leli den somen sani anga ageisi toli taki: “Wan sama be go a goon, go tyatya wan sii fi en, fu goo.
eng_text: And he spake many things unto them in parables, saying, Behold, a sower went forth to sow;

djk_text: We, di a tyatya a sii, ne afu kai a sikin pasi. Ne pikin foo kon, ne den nyan den.
eng_text: And when he sowed, some seeds fell by the way side, and the fowls came and devoured them up:

djk_text: Soseefi wan duupu sii kai a siton ini, di ná abi tyaipi doti. Ne den disi goo kon wanten. Bika a doti de á be dipi gi den.
eng_text: Some fell upon stony places, where they had not much earth: and forthwith they sprung up, because they had no deepness of earth:

djk_text: Ma fa i si a san pii, ne a boon den. Da fu di den á be abi lutu, ne den dede.
eng_text: And when the sun was up, they were scorched; and because they had no root, they withered away.

djk_text: Da taa sii kai a ini maka, ne den goo. Soseefi, den maka seefi goo tu. Da fu di den goo makandii, meke den maka pasuma den sii kii.
eng_text: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprung up, and choked them:

djk_text: Ma soseefi, wan duupu sii kai a bun doti. Den disi goo bunbun, meke nyanyan, te ná sipowtu. Son fu den meke wan ondoo toon, moo enke san di a be paandi. Taawan meke sigisitenti toon, moo enke san di den be paandi. Taawan baka, meke diitenti toon, moo enke san di den be paandi tu.”
eng_text: But other fell into good ground, and brought forth fruit, some an hundredfold, some sixtyfold, some thirtyfold.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “Sama di abi yesi fu yee, da meke a yee san mi taki de.”
eng_text: Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.

djk_text: We, ne den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi kon ne en, ne den akisi en taki: “We, Masaa! Saide meke yu e leli sama anga ageisi toli?”
eng_text: And the disciples came, and said unto him, Why speakest thou unto them in parables?

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “U enke bakaman fu mi, u naki bun ede, fu kon sabi den dipi toli fu Masaa Gadu. Bika u dati sa kon fusutan a Nyun Tii fi en. Ma den sama anda á fende a gaan bun de, fu di den á wani aliki mi.
eng_text: He answered and said unto them, Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.

djk_text: Bika sama di abi, da a sa fende tyaipi moo, te a pasa maiki. Ma sama di ná abi, da a pikinso di a abi seefi, den o teke puu ne en.
eng_text: For whosoever hath, to him shall be given, and he shall have more abundance: but whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken away even that he hath.

djk_text: Da na fu dati ede meke, mi e taki anga ageisi toli. ‘Bika anga opo opo ain den á wani si. Anga opo opo yesi, den á wani yee. Soseefi den á wani fusutan tu.’
eng_text: Therefore speak I to them in parables: because they seeing see not; and hearing they hear not, neither do they understand.

djk_text: Da fa den de ape, da ai waka anga den enke fa Jesaja a apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu be sikiifi a Masaa Gadu Buku. A be sikiifi taki: ‘U yesi e yee sani fu mi, ma u ná o fusutan dati. U ain e kai a sani fu mi, ma u ná o si dati.
eng_text: And in them is fulfilled the prophecy of Esaias, which saith, By hearing ye shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing ye shall see, and shall not perceive:

djk_text: Bika den sama ya taanga den ati. Den yesi á poi yee sani. Den ain tapu tu. Da den á poi daai den libi kon, fu mi kon deesi den.’
eng_text: For this people's heart is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes they have closed; lest at any time they should see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and should understand with their heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.

djk_text: Ma seigi fu sama di ain kiin fu si sani. Soseefi seigi fu sama di yesi opo fu yee sani.
eng_text: But blessed are your eyes, for they see: and your ears, for they hear.

djk_text: Bika somen fositen apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu anga somen taa fositen letiopu sama, be angii seefi seefi, fu si den sani di u e si anga den sani di u e yee a goontapu fosi den dede. Ma toku, den á be si den.”
eng_text: For verily I say unto you, That many prophets and righteous men have desired to see those things which ye see, and have not seen them; and to hear those things which ye hear, and have not heard them.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “We, mi o puu a toli, fu a sama di e tyatya sii paandi a ini a goon.”
eng_text: Hear ye therefore the parable of the sower.

djk_text: A taigi den taki: “Te wan sama yee a toli fu a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu, da efu a á fusutan a toli kiinkiin, da a ogii ati didibii e kon fufuu a bosikopu puu ne en ati ini. Da sowan sama ati de enke a sikin pasi, pe a sii be kai.
eng_text: When any one heareth the word of the kingdom, and understandeth it not, then cometh the wicked one, and catcheth away that which was sown in his heart. This is he which received seed by the way side.

djk_text: Ma a siton doti pe a sii kai, na sama di yee a wowtu, ne a teke en anga gaan piisii na ati.
eng_text: But he that received the seed into stony places, the same is he that heareth the word, and anon with joy receiveth it;

djk_text: Ma fa i si wan sani miti en fu a wowtu ede, da a nái oli go doo. Wanten ai fika a biibi, daai baka gi Masaa Gadu. Bika a wowtu fu Masaa Gadu á be doo na a dipi fu den ati.
eng_text: Yet hath he not root in himself, but dureth for a while: for when tribulation or persecution ariseth because of the word, by and by he is offended.

djk_text: Da, a peesi pe a sii be kai na a maka ini, dati na a sama di yee a wowtu. Ma a abi booko fu dyendee libi anga pina a goontapu ya e meke a wowtu nái puu a wini di a be mu puu.
eng_text: He also that received seed among the thorns is he that heareth the word; and the care of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, choke the word, and he becometh unfruitful.

djk_text: Ma a bun doti pe a sii be kai, dati na wan sama di yee a wowtu, da a fusutan en kiinkiin. Ne a teke en kibii a ini en ati. Da son meke diitenti, taawan meke sigisitenti. Taawan baka libi e puu wan ondoo, toon fu san di be de.”
eng_text: But he that received seed into the good ground is he that heareth the word, and understandeth it; which also beareth fruit, and bringeth forth, some an hundredfold, some sixty, some thirty.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi gi den ete wan taa ageisi toli fu soi fa a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu de. A taki: “A de leti enke wan basi di be teke wan sii fi en, go tyatya ne en goon.
eng_text: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is likened unto a man which sowed good seed in his field:

djk_text: Namo di neti kon doo, ne wan takuu ati feyantiman fi en go saafi saafi a baka, ne enseefi tyatya wan takuu paansu sii a ini a goon fu a basi.
eng_text: But while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat, and went his way.

djk_text: Ne den de te, a sii goo kon bigi meke nyanyan. Soseefi a takuu paansu sii seefi goo kon tu.
eng_text: But when the blade was sprung up, and brought forth fruit, then appeared the tares also.

djk_text: Ne den wookoman fu a basi go na a basi fu a goon, ne den akisi en taki: ‘Basi! A ná bunbun sii namo i be paandi na a goon, no? We, ne pe den tyaipi takuu sii de komoto, kon goo a den bunbun wan mindii so?’
eng_text: So the servants of the householder came and said unto him, Sir, didst not thou sow good seed in thy field? from whence then hath it tares?

djk_text: “We, ne a basi piki den taki: ‘Oho! Na wan feyantiman fu mi namo i si du anga mi so.’ “Ne den man akisi en taki: ‘We, i wani meke u go puu den takuu uwii a den bun wan mindii?’
eng_text: He said unto them, An enemy hath done this. The servants said unto him, Wilt thou then that we go and gather them up?

djk_text: “Ma a basi piki den taki: ‘Nono! U á mu du dati! Bika fu u suku fu puu den nownow, u o misi puu den bun paansu wan a ini tu!
eng_text: But he said, Nay; lest while ye gather up the tares, ye root up also the wheat with them.

djk_text: Meke ala den goo kon makandii. Te den lepi fu koti, da mi sa meke den wookoman di e koti lepi sii, go koti den takuu paansu puu a ini den bun wan. Da den o tei den a bosu go gi faya. Ma den sa tyai den bun wan go kibii a magisin.’ ”
eng_text: Let both grow together until the harvest: and in the time of harvest I will say to the reapers, Gather ye together first the tares, and bind them in bundles to burn them: but gather the wheat into my barn.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi daai gi den ete wan toli, fu soi fa a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu de. A taki: “A de leti enke a sii di den e kai mosite, di wan sama teke paandi ne en goon.
eng_text: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is like to a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and sowed in his field:

djk_text: Da enke fa u sabi, da mosite sii nyoni moo ala sii di i sa paandi a goon. Ma te a goo kon kaba, da ai bigi moo ala taa sowtu sani a ini a goon. Da ai toon wan bon di foo fu ondoo goontapu e kon meke nesi a den taka fi en, fu tan.”
eng_text: Which indeed is the least of all seeds: but when it is grown, it is the greatest among herbs, and becometh a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in the branches thereof.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi gi den ete wan ageisi toli baka taki: “A fasi fa a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu de, da na leti enke wan uman di e masi bolon. A teke wan pikin sowda towe ne en. Da dati a pikin sowda ya e soopu a hii bolon te, a kon bigi bufuu.”
eng_text: Another parable spake he unto them; The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.

djk_text: Da na so Masaa Jesesi be gi den sama ala den ageisi toli ya. Da a á be e gi den ná wan toli, sondee fu wooko anga ageisi toli.
eng_text: All these things spake Jesus unto the multitude in parables; and without a parable spake he not unto them:

djk_text: Na so a sani di a apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu be sikiifi fositen a Masaa Gadu Buku be kon pasa tuu. A be sikiifi taki: “Mi o taki anga den anga ageisi toli. Da sani di be kibii senten di Masaa Gadu be meke tapu anga goontapu, mi soi den, fu ala sama si.”
eng_text: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying, I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things which have been kept secret from the foundation of the world.

djk_text: Namo, di Masaa Jesesi kaba leli den sama den sani ya, ne a enseefi go a osu. Namo, ne den bakaman fi en kon ne en, ne den akisi en taki: “Masaa! Puu a ageisi toli, fu a takuu uwii a den bunbun wan mindii gi u, baa?”
eng_text: Then Jesus sent the multitude away, and went into the house: and his disciples came unto him, saying, Declare unto us the parable of the tares of the field.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “A bun! Mi sa puu en gi u. A sama di be e tyatya a sii, dati na a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya.
eng_text: He answered and said unto them, He that soweth the good seed is the Son of man;

djk_text: Ma a goon seefi dati na a hii goontapu pe u de ya. Da a bunbun sii na den sama di de a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu. Da den takuu sii dati na den sama di didibii e tii.
eng_text: The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one;

djk_text: Da a gaan feyantiman di i si tyatya den sii de, na a didibii seefi. Da a ten fu koti, dati na a kaba ten fu goontapu. Da den sama di o koti a nyanyan kibii a magisin, dati na den Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee .
eng_text: The enemy that sowed them is the devil; the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers are the angels.

djk_text: “We, enke fa i si den sama be e koti den uwii tei a bosu fu gi faya de, na letiso sani a o waka, na a kaba yuu fu goontapu.
eng_text: As therefore the tares are gathered and burned in the fire; so shall it be in the end of this world.

djk_text: Bika a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya, o sende den Basiya fi en a Masaa Gadu Kondee, go a goontapu, go piki ala sama di e du ogii, anga den di e leli taa sama fu du ogii. Da na so a o puu den a mindii fu den di de a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu, fu towe go a ini a sitaafu peesi pe soso kee anga tyali de.
eng_text: The Son of man shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend, and them which do iniquity;

djk_text: Ma den sama di be libi letiopu gi Masaa Gadu, sa beenki kiin kelle, a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu Kondee a tapu anda, enke fa ala sama e si a san te a opo. Da sama di abi yesi fu yee, meke a yee san mi taki de.”
eng_text: Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.

djk_text: Namo, ne Masaa Jesesi teke ete wan toli leli den fu fa a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu o de. A taki: “A de enke wan gaan gudu di de kibii kibii a wan ini pisi doti. Ne wan sama go si en. Ne a kibii en baka, ma a á piki ná wan sama. Ne a gwe anga gaan piisii ne en ati, ne a seli ala san a be abi a osu, ne a bai a pisi doti de, toon fi enseefi.
eng_text: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto treasure hid in a field; the which when a man hath found, he hideth, and for joy thereof goeth and selleth all that he hath, and buyeth that field.

djk_text: “Da soseefi a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu de enke wan wenkiiman di e suku gaan dii dyamanti siton, fu bai seli baka. Ne ai waka e suku, te a go fende wan di waiti moo ala taawan.
eng_text: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchant man, seeking goodly pearls:

djk_text: Ne a go a osu, ne a seli ala san a be abi fiya, ne a teke ala a moni, ne a go bai a gaan dii dyamanti siton de.”
eng_text: Who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi gi den ete wan toli. A taki: “A Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu de enke wan seepi di wan sama towe. Ne a kisi ala sowtu fisi. Den di bun fu nyan anga den di á bun fu nyan.
eng_text: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a net, that was cast into the sea, and gathered of every kind:

djk_text: Ne di a seepi fuu, ne a man di be towe a seepi ali en kon a soo. Ne den go sidon, ne den e puu den bun wan teke poti a ini sani. Ma den e puu den poli wan fiingi towe.
eng_text: Which, when it was full, they drew to shore, and sat down, and gathered the good into vessels, but cast the bad away.

djk_text: Na so a o de na a kaba fu goontapu. Bika Masaa Gadu o sende den Basiya fi en a Masaa Gadu Kondee go piki den takuu ati sama, puu a mindii fu den bun ati wan di e libi letiopu fasi gi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: So shall it be at the end of the world: the angels shall come forth, and sever the wicked from among the just,

djk_text: Da den sa iti den takuu ati sama ya go ini a gaanbigi faya, pe den o de, e bali e kee gaan kee, e kaw tifi, fu tego.”
eng_text: And shall cast them into the furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi akisi den taki: “Fa mi e taki anga u ya, u e fusutan mi?” Ne den piki taki: “Iya Masaa! U e fusutan yu!”
eng_text: Jesus saith unto them, Have ye understood all these things? They say unto him, Yea, Lord.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den baka taki: “Da a bun, te wan sama e fusutan a toli di e taki, fu a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu. Soseefi, efu makandii anga dati, da a sama sabi den weiti fu Mosesi bun tu, da a moo bun baka. Bika, da na tu koni fu Masaa Gadu kon miti na awan. Da na dobuu koni a sama de abi.”
eng_text: Then said he unto them, Therefore every scribe which is instructed unto the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which bringeth forth out of his treasure things new and old.

djk_text: We, di Masaa Jesesi gi den ala den toli ya, te a kaba, ne a komoto de.
eng_text: And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these parables, he departed thence.

djk_text: Ne a gwe a Nasaleti, a foto pe a be kiya. Ne a go a den keliki anda, go leli sama sani fu Masaa Gadu. Ma ai foondoo den, fu si a fasi fa Masaa Jesesi e leli den. Ne den taki: “Ma, pe a fende a gaan koni anga a gaan kaakiti fu du den foondoo wooko de?
eng_text: And when he was come into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, insomuch that they were astonished, and said, Whence hath this man this wisdom, and these mighty works?

djk_text: Bika, a ná a boi fu Jowsef, a tembeeman de ya, no? Na Maliya ne en mma. Den baala fi en na Jakopu anga Judasi anga Jowsef anga Simon.
eng_text: Is not this the carpenter's son? is not his mother called Mary? and his brethren, James, and Joses, and Simon, and Judas?

djk_text: Den sisa fi en na wi anga den de ya. Da pe a go fende ala den sani de?”
eng_text: And his sisters, are they not all with us? Whence then hath this man all these things?

djk_text: We, na so den teke en fu ogii. Ma Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Na so a de tuu. Wan apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu sa fende lesipeki anga gafa na ala taa peesi fu goontapu, boiti en eigi kondee.”
eng_text: And they were offended in him. But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, save in his own country, and in his own house.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi á du somen foondoo wooko a Nasaleti de. Bika den á be poti biibi ne en.
eng_text: And he did not many mighty works there because of their unbelief.

djk_text: We, da a yuu ten de, da Kownu Helowdesi yee fu den gaan foondoo sani di Masaa Jesesi e du.
eng_text: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard of the fame of Jesus,

djk_text: Ne a taigi den futuboi fi en taki: “Na Johanisi a Dopuman ne en e du den sani de. A opo komoto a dede kon a libi ya baka! A dati meke a abi a gaan kaakiti de, fu du ala den foondoo sani de.”
eng_text: And said unto his servants, This is John the Baptist; he is risen from the dead; and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.

djk_text: We, Helowdesi be teke a uman fu wan baala fi en, den e kai Filipi, enke uman. Na a uman den e kai Helowdiya. We, ne Johanisi be go bali en taki, a sani di a du de á bun. A poli Masaa Gadu weiti anga a uman fi en baala di a teke de. Na fu a sani ya meke, a sende sama go kisi Johanisi. Ne a meke den bwui en, ne den poti en a dunguu osu.
eng_text: For Herod had laid hold on John, and bound him, and put him in prison for Herodias' sake, his brother Philip's wife.

djk_text: Kownu Helowdesi ati be boon te, a be sa kii Johanisi seefi. Ma toku, a be e feele fu du dati. Bika ala sama be e si Johanisi taki, en na wan apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: And when he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.

djk_text: Ma di den de te, ne Kownu Helowdesi fuuyali. Ma namo, da a uman di a be teke, be abi wan umanpikin. Ne a umanpikin fu Helowdiya ya dansi na a fuuyali, a fesi fu ala den bigi bigiman. We, a dansi ya switi gi Kownu Helowdesi te, ná sipowtu.
eng_text: But when Herod's birthday was kept, the daughter of Herodias danced before them, and pleased Herod.

djk_text: Namo Helowdesi kai a umanpikin ya kon. Ne a sweli gi a pikin, a fesi fu ala den bigiman di de ape taki: “Pikin! Wansi san yu akisi mi, mi sa gi yu en.”
eng_text: Whereupon he promised with an oath to give her whatsoever she would ask.

djk_text: We, di kownu taki so, ne a pikin umanpikin lon go, ne en mma. Ne a taigi en taki, na so anga so, kownu paamisi en. Da san a mu du. We, ne a mma taigi en taki: “Go taigi kownu taki, i wani a ede fu Johanisi a Dopuman a wan teepala tapu.” Na so a pikin umanpikin lon go, ne a taigi kownu taki: “Kownu! Gi mi a ede fu Johanisi a Dopuman a wan teepala tapu.”
eng_text: And she, being before instructed of her mother, said, Give me here John Baptist's head in a charger.

djk_text: We, di Kownu Helowdesi yee so, ne a buduufu en te, a á sabi pe fu poti enseefi. Ma a gaan sweli di a be sweli a lanti fesi meke a á be poi kengi mofu moo. Ne wanten, ne a sende sama go a dunguu osu go doo Johanisi ede felen.
eng_text: And the king was sorry: nevertheless for the oath's sake, and them which sat with him at meat, he commanded it to be given her.

djk_text: Ne den poti a koti ede a wan teepala tapu, tyai kon gi a pikin. Ne a pikin ya teke en, ne a tyai go gi en mma, Helowdiya.
eng_text: And his head was brought in a charger, and given to the damsel: and she brought it to her mother.

djk_text: Ne den bakaman fu Johanisi kon teke a dede sikin, ne den beli. Bakadati, ne den go piki Masaa Jesesi taki, na so wan sani pasa.
eng_text: And his disciples came, and took up the body, and buried it, and went and told Jesus.

djk_text: We, di Masaa Jesesi yee san pasa, ne a komoto de. Ne a teke boto koti abaa go a wan peesi, en wawan kodo. Ma di den sama fu kondee anda yee pe a go, ne den booko gwullu waka lontu a soo go ne en baka.
eng_text: When Jesus heard of it, he departed thence by ship into a desert place apart: and when the people had heard thereof, they followed him on foot out of the cities.

djk_text: Fa i si Masaa Jesesi saka komoto a soo, tyaipi sama de a soo anda kaba, e luku en. Namo, tyali kisi Masaa Jesesi fu den somen sama. Ne a deesi ala den sikiman, kon bun de baka silli.
eng_text: And Jesus went forth, and saw a great multitude, and was moved with compassion toward them, and he healed their sick.

djk_text: Da di bakadina, neti mofu, ne den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi kon ne en. Ne den taigi en taki: “Masaa! Ai lati kaba! A ini wan sabana ini u de. Da sende den sama gwe, meke den go a den pikin kondee, go suku sani bai fu nyan.”
eng_text: And when it was evening, his disciples came to him, saying, This is a desert place, and the time is now past; send the multitude away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves victuals.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Nono! A á de fu den gwe! U gi den sani fu den nyan.”
eng_text: But Jesus said unto them, They need not depart; give ye them to eat.

djk_text: We, ne den bakaman piki taki: “Da fa u o du? Bika na feifi beele anga tu losi fisi namo wi abi ya.”
eng_text: And they say unto him, We have here but five loaves, and two fishes.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “U tyai den kon gi mi ya.”
eng_text: He said, Bring them hither to me.

djk_text: Ne a sende ala den sama go sidon a gaasi tapu. Ne a teke den feifi beele anga den tu fisi, ne a opo ede luku tapu, ne a gi Masaa Gadu daa, te a kaba. Ne a booko den feifi beele anga den tu fisi pisipisi gi den bakaman, fu den go paati. Ne den bakaman gi den sama.
eng_text: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the grass, and took the five loaves, and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, and brake, and gave the loaves to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.

djk_text: Ne ala den sama nyan, te den bee fuu. Ma toku beele anga fisi fika ete. Ne di den bakaman piki den pisi beele anga fisi di fika, ne a fuu twalufu bakisi ete.
eng_text: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the fragments that remained twelve baskets full.

djk_text: Da fu den sama di be nyan a beele, a be sa de wan sani fu feifi dunsu manengee, boiti den uman anga den pikinengee di be nyan.
eng_text: And they that had eaten were about five thousand men, beside women and children.

djk_text: Ne wanten bakadati, ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den bakaman fi en, fu go a boto abaa gwe na abaase. Ma en o fika de, fu sende den sama gwe a den osu.
eng_text: And straightway Jesus constrained his disciples to get into a ship, and to go before him unto the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.

djk_text: Ne di a sende ala den sama gwe kaba, ne a subi go a wan mongo tapu, go e begi, en wawan kodo. A yuu ten de, da peesi be kon e dunguu kaba.
eng_text: And when he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into a mountain apart to pray: and when the evening was come, he was there alone.

djk_text: Ma, den bakaman fi en be de, te a mindii wataa kaba anga a boto. Di den go te wan pisi, ne wan gaan winta anga seke wataa e baasi a boto fu den.
eng_text: But the ship was now in the midst of the sea, tossed with waves: for the wind was contrary.

djk_text: Namo di musude, ne Masaa Jesesi waka anga futu na a wataa tapu kon a den.
eng_text: And in the fourth watch of the night Jesus went unto them, walking on the sea.

djk_text: Ma namo, di den si Masaa Jesesi e waka na a wataa tapu e kon, ne den dyombo te, den taki, na wan yooka e kon a den. Ne den feele te, den bali gaan bali.
eng_text: And when the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, It is a spirit; and they cried out for fear.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi bali piki den wanten taki: “U á feele! Na mi de ya! U oli deki ati!”
eng_text: But straightway Jesus spake unto them, saying, Be of good cheer; it is I; be not afraid.

djk_text: Namo Peitilisi piki taki: “Masaa! Na yu de ape tuu? We, efu na yu de ape tuu, da kai mi, meke mi waka na a wataa tapu kon a yu, osi?”
eng_text: And Peter answered him and said, Lord, if it be thou, bid me come unto thee on the water.

djk_text: Namo ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Kon!” Ne Peitilisi komoto a ini a boto, ne ai waka na a tapu wataa go a Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: And he said, Come. And when Peter was come down out of the ship, he walked on the water, to go to Jesus.

djk_text: Ma di a si fa a winta e wai taanga, ne a feele. Ne ai bigin saka seefi go a ondoo wataa. Ne a bali taki: “Masaa! Yeepi mi oo!”
eng_text: But when he saw the wind boisterous, he was afraid; and beginning to sink, he cried, saying, Lord, save me.

djk_text: Ne wanten, ne Masaa Jesesi langa ana oli en. Ne a taigi en taki: “Saide meke i pantan so? Saide meke yu á tan poti biibi a mi doo?”
eng_text: And immediately Jesus stretched forth his hand, and caught him, and said unto him, O thou of little faith, wherefore didst thou doubt?

djk_text: Ne di den subi go a ini a sipi, ne wanten a gaan winta koo pii.
eng_text: And when they were come into the ship, the wind ceased.

djk_text: Ne den sama di be de a ini a boto saka kini a doti ne en fesi de. Ne den taki: “Fu tuu! Yu na a Pikin fu Masaa Gadu tuu.”
eng_text: Then they that were in the ship came and worshipped him, saying, Of a truth thou art the Son of God.

djk_text: Ne den go doo Genesaleti, a kondee di den e go.
eng_text: And when they were gone over, they came into the land of Gennesaret.

djk_text: We, ne den sama fu a kondee be sabi wanten taki, na Masaa Jesesi doo de. Ne den sende bosikopu lontu a hii kondee taki, Masaa Jesesi kon a den de. Ne den tyai ala sowtu siki man kon ne en.
eng_text: And when the men of that place had knowledge of him, they sent out into all that country round about, and brought unto him all that were diseased;

djk_text: Ne den begi en taki: “Gaantangi! Meke den sikiman fu wi lobi ana a yu koosi namo, baa?” Ne Masaa Jesesi gi den fu den du dati. Namo, ala sikiman di lobi ana ne en koosi mofu, kon bun kele kele fu ibii sowtu siki di den be abi.
eng_text: And besought him that they might only touch the hem of his garment: and as many as touched were made perfectly whole.

djk_text: We ne, a seefi yuu de, ne wan duupu Faliseiman sama anga wan duupu leliman fu Dyuweiti komoto te a Jelusalem Foto, kon a Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: Then came to Jesus scribes and Pharisees, which were of Jerusalem, saying,

djk_text: Ne den akisi en taki: “Saide den bakaman fi yu mu e du sani di wi avo á be gwenti? Bika den e nyan sondee wasi ana enke fa avo fu u be poti gi.”
eng_text: Why do thy disciples transgress the tradition of the elders? for they wash not their hands when they eat bread.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “U dati e feti fu wai a leli fu Masaa Gadu poti a wanse, soso fu oli den avo gwenti. Saide?
eng_text: But he answered and said unto them, Why do ye also transgress the commandment of God by your tradition?

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu weiti taki: ‘I mu lesipeki i mma anga i dda.’ Da ‘ibiiwan sama di saanti en dda ofu en mma mu dede.’
eng_text: For God commanded, saying, Honour thy father and mother: and, He that curseth father or mother, let him die the death.

djk_text: Ma u dati taki, wan sama sa taigi en mma anga en dda taki: ‘A sani di a be mu teke fu yeepi den, da a moo betee a gi Masaa Gadu dati enke paiman.’
eng_text: But ye say, Whosoever shall say to his father or his mother, It is a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me;

djk_text: Da a sa fika en mma anga en dda a wanse, sondee fu solugu. Da anga ala den gwenti di den gaansama fika gi u, u e wai Masaa Gadu weiti poti a wanse.
eng_text: And honour not his father or his mother, he shall be free. Thus have ye made the commandment of God of none effect by your tradition.

djk_text: U bidiigiman! Na fu sama enke u ede meke Masaa Gadu be gi a apaiti takiman fi en, den e kai Jesaja, fu sikiifi wan sani a fositen.
eng_text: Ye hypocrites, well did Esaias prophesy of you, saying,

djk_text: Bika a be sikiifi taki: ‘Den sama ya e gafa mi anga den buba mofu, ma den ati de faawe fu mi!
eng_text: This people draweth nigh unto me with their mouth, and honoureth me with their lips; but their heart is far from me.

djk_text: Da fa den e meke enke den e begi mi de, ma, na soso sani den e du. Bika den nái leli sama Masaa Gadu weiti, ma na libisama sani den e leli sama.’ ”
eng_text: But in vain they do worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi kai ala den sama di be de ape kon ne en. Ne a taigi den taki: “U aliki! U mu fusutan mi bun.
eng_text: And he called the multitude, and said unto them, Hear, and understand:

djk_text: Ná den sani di yu e nyan e meke i tyobo a Masaa Gadu ain. Ma na den sani di i e taki anga i mofu. Na den e meke i tyobo a Masaa Gadu ain.”
eng_text: Not that which goeth into the mouth defileth a man; but that which cometh out of the mouth, this defileth a man.

djk_text: We, di Masaa Jesesi taki so, ne den bakaman fi en kon taigi en taki: “Masaa! Fa i si i taki de, ná sipowtu boon den Faliseiman ati boon a yu moo.”
eng_text: Then came his disciples, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the Pharisees were offended, after they heard this saying?

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “U fika den! Bika den á de fu Masaa Gadu. Da ibiiwan sani di á de san mi Tata paandi, da na fu hali puu.
eng_text: But he answered and said, Every plant, which my heavenly Father hath not planted, shall be rooted up.

djk_text: U fika den! Bika den sowtu sama de beendi. Da efu wan beendiman e suku fu tyai beendiman abaa gotoo, da na ala den fiya o kai a ini a gotoo?”
eng_text: Let them alone: they be blind leaders of the blind. And if the blind lead the blind, both shall fall into the ditch.

djk_text: Namo Peitilisi akisi en taki: “Masaa! San na a mama fu a toli di i taki dyonson fu den Faliseiman sama de? I sa puu en fini fini gi wi?”
eng_text: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Declare unto us this parable.

djk_text: Ne a piki den taki: “Oho! Useefi nái fusutan mi kiinkiin ete, no?
eng_text: And Jesus said, Are ye also yet without understanding?

djk_text: Useefi á sabi ete taki, a sani di wan sama e nyan, e go ne en bee. Da te wan pisi, da a kon komoto baka, no? We, kweti! Dati á poi meke i tyobo a Masaa Gadu ain.
eng_text: Do not ye yet understand, that whatsoever entereth in at the mouth goeth into the belly, and is cast out into the draught?

djk_text: Ma na den sani di yu e puu a ini i mofu. Bika, na te a ini ati den sani ape de. Da, den e kon komoto a doo, da den e meke i tyobo a Masaa Gadu ain.
eng_text: But those things which proceed out of the mouth come forth from the heart; and they defile the man.

djk_text: Bika a ini wan sama ati ini ala ogii e komoto. Sani enke kii sama. Waka anga taa uman ofu man. Soseefi motyo libi anga lei. Fufuu seefi tu. Taki ogii fu Masaa Gadu anga poli taawan nen seefi.
eng_text: For out of the heart proceed evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, fornications, thefts, false witness, blasphemies:

djk_text: Da na den sowtu sani ya e kon komoto a doo, fu meke a sama tyobo a Masaa Gadu ain. Ma fu nyan sondee wasi ana enke fa weiti taki, dati á poi meke wan sama tyobo a Masaa Gadu ain.”
eng_text: These are the things which defile a man: but to eat with unwashen hands defileth not a man.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en komoto na a kondee de, ne den go na a pisiwataa fu Tilosi anga Sidon.
eng_text: Then Jesus went thence, and departed into the coasts of Tyre and Sidon.

djk_text: We, ne fa i si den go doo de, ne wan uman lon kon a Masaa Jesesi. A uman ya na be fu a kondee den kai Kaana. A ná be Dyusama. Namo ai bali taki: “Masaa! Na yu na a Bakaten Manpikin fu Kownu Dafeti paansu. Gaantangi abi tyali ati fu mi, baa? Bika wan takuu jeje de na a umanpikin fu mi tapu, e pina en, e tyotyo en.”
eng_text: And, behold, a woman of Canaan came out of the same coasts, and cried unto him, saying, Have mercy on me, O Lord, thou Son of David; my daughter is grievously vexed with a devil.

djk_text: Ma anga ala fa a uman e begi de, toku Masaa Jesesi á piki en seefi seefi. Namo den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi taigi en taki: “Masaa! Gaantangi, bali a uman de, meke a kaba a u baka. Senten, ne ai waka a u baka e muliki wi.”
eng_text: But he answered her not a word. And his disciples came and besought him, saying, Send her away; for she crieth after us.

djk_text: We, ne na nowfosi Masaa Jesesi o piki a uman taki: “Uman! Masaa Gadu á sende mi, fu mi go a taa foluku, moo enke den lasi sikapu fu Islayeli Kondee.”
eng_text: But he answered and said, I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel.

djk_text: Ma toku, a uman kon kai ne en fesi, sutu kini a doti, e begi taki: “Masaa! Gaantangi, ma yeepi mi.”
eng_text: Then came she and worshipped him, saying, Lord, help me.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi piki a uman taki: “A á fiti fu mi puu beele a den pikin ana towe gi den dagu.”
eng_text: But he answered and said, It is not meet to take the children's bread, and to cast it to dogs.

djk_text: Namo a uman piki taki: “Masaa! Na so a de tuu! Ma wan pikin dagu seefi á sa abi pasi, fu kon piki den sakasaka di e kai komoto na a tafaa kon a doti, no?”
eng_text: And she said, Truth, Lord: yet the dogs eat of the crumbs which fall from their masters' table.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Uman! Yu e biibi mi taanga! Da a sani di i si yu e suku de, i fende en kaba.” Masaa Jesesi á kaba taki seefi, namo a umanpikin fu a uman kon bun kelle.
eng_text: Then Jesus answered and said unto her, O woman, great is thy faith: be it unto thee even as thou wilt. And her daughter was made whole from that very hour.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi komoto de. Ne a go koosube fu a ze fu Galileya. Ne a go a wan mongo tapu go sidon.
eng_text: And Jesus departed from thence, and came nigh unto the sea of Galilee; and went up into a mountain, and sat down there.

djk_text: Ne tyaipi sama kon ape ne en. Den tyai lanman, beendiman, masimasi wan, babawman kon ne en. Ne den poti den ne en futu. Namo a deesi ala den fiya.
eng_text: And great multitudes came unto him, having with them those that were lame, blind, dumb, maimed, and many others, and cast them down at Jesus' feet; and he healed them:

djk_text: Ma, da den sama foondoo seefi, di den si fa den babawman e taki. Den lanman e waka. Den masimasi wan kon bun. Den beendiman e si. Da den sama foondoo tuutuu. Ne den gafa Masaa Gadu, a Gadu fu Islayeli Kondee.
eng_text: Insomuch that the multitude wondered, when they saw the dumb to speak, the maimed to be whole, the lame to walk, and the blind to see: and they glorified the God of Israel.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi kai den bakaman fi en, ne a taigi den taki: “Tyali e kisi mi fu den tyaipi sama ya! Bika tide, na di fu dii dei di den de anga mi ya, sondee nyan. Da mi á wani sende den gwe a osu anga angii bee so. Bika falan falan sa kisi den a pasi.”
eng_text: Then Jesus called his disciples unto him, and said, I have compassion on the multitude, because they continue with me now three days, and have nothing to eat: and I will not send them away fasting, lest they faint in the way.

djk_text: Namo den bakaman piki taki: “Masaa! Pe wi o poi fende sani gi den somen sama ya, fu den nyan? Bika luku ya! Nyanyan á de na a sabana ini pe u de ya, fu gi den.”
eng_text: And his disciples say unto him, Whence should we have so much bread in the wilderness, as to fill so great a multitude?

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi akisi den taki: “Onmen beele u abi de?” Namo den piki en taki: “Na seibin beele anga wantu losi fisi namo u abi ya.”
eng_text: And Jesus saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven, and a few little fishes.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi sende ala den sama go sidon a doti.
eng_text: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground.

djk_text: Ne a teke den seibin beele anga den fisi. Ne a gi Masaa Gadu daa, te a kaba. Ne a booko den beele anga den fisi pisipisi, gi den bakaman, fu go paati gi den somen sama.
eng_text: And he took the seven loaves and the fishes, and gave thanks, and brake them, and gave to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.

djk_text: Ne den bakaman fi en teke, ne den paati gi den somen sama te doo. Ne ala den sama nyan te den bee fuu. Ne den bakaman fi en piki den pisipisi beele di fika, te seibin gaan bakisi fuu kwaa.
eng_text: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets full.

djk_text: Da ala den sama di be nyan, da a be sa de wan sani fu fo dunsu manengee, boiti den uman anga den pikinengee di be nyan.
eng_text: And they that did eat were four thousand men, beside women and children.

djk_text: We, ne di Masaa Jesesi sende ala den sama gwe, ne a go a ini wan boto, ne a abaa go na a pisiwataa fu Magadan.
eng_text: And he sent away the multitude, and took ship, and came into the coasts of Magdala,

djk_text: We, ne wan dei, ne den Faliseiman anga den Saduseiman kon ne en. Den kon fu tesi en luku, efu na Masaa Gadu sende en kon tuutuu. Ne den akisi en fu a meke foondoo sani pasa a tapu anda, osi? Da den sa si taki, Masaa Gadu de anga en tuutuu.
eng_text: The Pharisees also with the Sadducees came, and tempting desired him that he would shew them a sign from heaven.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Ai baya! Bakadina mofu te tapu lebi, da u sabi taki, tamaa san o hati.
eng_text: He answered and said unto them, When it is evening, ye say, It will be fair weather: for the sky is red.

djk_text: Te mamanten u si a san lebi, da u sabi taki alen o kai tide. We, fa a waka u sabi luku den maiki di tapu e soi, ma u á sabi luku den maiki fu a yuu ten di u e libi nownow?
eng_text: And in the morning, It will be foul weather to day: for the sky is red and lowring. O ye hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky; but can ye not discern the signs of the times?

djk_text: U takuu ati sama u! U tan enke uman di fika den man go e waka anga taa man! Na dati meke u e suku fu si foondoo maiki a tapu fosi. Ma kweti! Mi ná o soi u ná wan taa maiki moo enke a maiki fu a apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu di den e kai Jowna.” Di Masaa Jesesi kaba taki so, ne a komoto a den mindii gwe.
eng_text: A wicked and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given unto it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas. And he left them, and departed.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en go a boto. Ne den koti go na abaase. Ma den bakaman be feegete fu tyai beele.
eng_text: And when his disciples were come to the other side, they had forgotten to take bread.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi wasikoi den taki: “U luku bun anga a sowda fu den Faliseiman sama anga den Saduseiman.”
eng_text: Then Jesus said unto them, Take heed and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.

djk_text: Namo di Masaa Jesesi taki so, ne den bakaman fi en pakisei go, den pakisei kon. Ne den e taki den na den taki: “Kande, na di u feegete fu tyai a beele meke a taki so?”
eng_text: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have taken no bread.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi sabi taki na so den e denki. Ne a piki den taki: “Saide meke a biibi di u abi a mi nyoni so? Fa u sa denki taki, na beele toli mi e taki?
eng_text: Which when Jesus perceived, he said unto them, O ye of little faith, why reason ye among yourselves, because ye have brought no bread?

djk_text: U nái fusutan mi ete, no? U feegete di mi be teke feifi beele gi feifi dunsu sama nyan, te den bee be fuu? Te onmen tenti bakisi be fika a tapu ete!
eng_text: Do ye not yet understand, neither remember the five loaves of the five thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?

djk_text: Soseefi, u be de ape si, fa mi be booko seibin beele paati gi fo dunsu sama. Ma toku, a be sai den, te onmen tenti bakisi be fika a tapu tu.
eng_text: Neither the seven loaves of the four thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?

djk_text: We, da fa a kan taki, u á poi fusutan taki a ná beele mi e taki? U luku bun anga sowda fu den Faliseiman anga den Saduseisama!”
eng_text: How is it that ye do not understand that I spake it not to you concerning bread, that ye should beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees?

djk_text: We, di Masaa Jesesi taki so fosi, ne den bakaman fi en fusutan kiinkiin taki, a ná a sowda fu baka beele ai taki. Ma na a poli leli fu den Faliseiman anga den Saduseiman.
eng_text: Then understood they how that he bade them not beware of the leaven of bread, but of the doctrine of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.

djk_text: Namo di den de na a pisiwataa fu Sesaleya Filipi, ne Masaa Jesesi akisi den bakaman fi en taki: “Fa den sama e kai a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya?”
eng_text: When Jesus came into the coasts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, Whom do men say that I the Son of man am?

djk_text: Ne den bakaman piki en taki: “We, u yee son sama e taki, yu na Johanisi a Dopuman. Ne en weki baka komoto a dede. Taawan e taki, yu na Eliya, a apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu a fositen. Taawan e taki, yu na Jelemija ofu wan fu den taa apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu. Ne en weki a dede kon a libi ya baka.”
eng_text: And they said, Some say that thou art John the Baptist: some, Elias; and others, Jeremias, or one of the prophets.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi akisi den taki: “Ma u, no? Sama u e taki a mi?”
eng_text: He saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am?

djk_text: We, ne Simon Peitilisi piki en taki: “Yu na a Kelestesi, a Manpikin fu a libilibi Masaa Gadu!”
eng_text: And Simon Peter answered and said, Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi piki en baka taki: “Seigi fi yu Simon, manpikin fu Jowna! Bika a ná libisama meke i sabi a sani de. Ma na mi Tata a tapu anda, ne puu en kon a kiin gi yu.
eng_text: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Blessed art thou, Simon Barjona: for flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee, but my Father which is in heaven.

djk_text: We, fu tuutuu! Mi e taigi yu taki, yu na Peitilisi . We, na a gaanbigi taanga siton tapu ya mi o meke a keliki fu mi. Da a didibii anga ala a taanga di a abi anga hii dedekondee seefi ná o poi wini a keliki fu mi.
eng_text: And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.

djk_text: Da mi e gi yu a sooto, fu a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu. Da san i tei a goontapu ya, da a o de teitei a Masaa Gadu, a tapu anda tu. Soseefi san i losi a goontapu ya, da a o de losilosi a Masaa Gadu, a tapu anda.”
eng_text: And I will give unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.

djk_text: We, ne di a taki so, ne a bali den bakaman fi en taki, den á mu taigi sama taki, en na a Kelestesi.
eng_text: Then charged he his disciples that they should tell no man that he was Jesus the Christ.

djk_text: Ne fanafu a ten de, ne Masaa Jesesi e soi den bakaman fi en san o kon miti en. Ai taigi den, fa a mu go a Jelusalem Foto, da den gaansama fu Dyu keliki anga den apaiti begiman anga den leliman fu weiti o kisi en tyai en go kii a koloisi. Ma baka dii dei, da a o weki baka komoto a dede.
eng_text: From that time forth began Jesus to shew unto his disciples, how that he must go unto Jerusalem, and suffer many things of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and be raised again the third day.

djk_text: Ma di Masaa Jesesi taki so, ne Peitilisi tyai en go a wan, bali taki: “Masaa! Ná taki den sani de. Bika den ná o poi pasa anga yu, kweti kweti!”
eng_text: Then Peter took him, and began to rebuke him, saying, Be it far from thee, Lord: this shall not be unto thee.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi daai luku Peitilisi. Ne a kaasi en taki: “Pasa komoto a mi baka ya! Yu didibii, saatan yu! Yu de enke wan siton a mi pasi, fu mi naki futu kai na a pasi fu Masaa Gadu. Peitilisi! A sani di i taki de, á de enke fa Masaa Gadu e pakisei. I taki enke fa libisama e pakisei.”
eng_text: But he turned, and said unto Peter, Get thee behind me, Satan: thou art an offence unto me: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but those that be of men.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi daai taki anga ala den bakaman fi en. A taki: “Efu wan sama wani waka a mi baka, da a á mu teli enseefi moo. Da a mu e tyai a sitaafu di o kon ne en tapu, enke wan sama e tyai wan koloisi, fu den go sipikii en kii.
eng_text: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

djk_text: Bika na sama di kaba libi a libi enke fa enseefi wani fu mi ede, sa fende a libi di Masaa Gadu wani gi. Ma sama di o libi go doo enke fa enseefi wani, da a o lasi a hii libi fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: and whosoever will lose his life for my sake shall find it.

djk_text: Ma sowtu wini a abi efu wan sama abi ala gudu fu goontapu, ma a lasi go kai a didibii faya? Bika sani seefi á de a goontapu ya, di waiti sai fu kengi anga a libi fu tego?
eng_text: For what is a man profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul? or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?

djk_text: Bika, te a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya o kon makandii anga den Masaa Gadu Kondee Basiya fi en, da hii dyendee anga makiti di en Tata, Masaa Gadu a tapu abi o de fi en. Da a o kuutu fa, ibii sama du san a taki. Da ibiiwan o fende paiman, fu fa a be libi a goontapu.
eng_text: For the Son of man shall come in the glory of his Father with his angels; and then he shall reward every man according to his works.

djk_text: Da mi e taigi u tuutuu taki: Somen fu u di taampu ya ná o tesi dede, fosi u si a Nyun Tii fu a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya.”
eng_text: Verily I say unto you, There be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the Son of man coming in his kingdom.

djk_text: Namo sigisi dei a baka, ne Masaa Jesesi teke Peitilisi anga Jakowbesi anga Johanisi tyai anga en go, te a wan hei mongo.
eng_text: And after six days Jesus taketh Peter, James, and John his brother, and bringeth them up into an high mountain apart,

djk_text: Ma wanboo wanboo so, te fu den denki, ne Jesesi kengi tan wan hii taa fasi. En fesi e beenki enke a san. Da den koosi di a wei weti kiin enke wan gaan kiin faya.
eng_text: And was transfigured before them: and his face did shine as the sun, and his raiment was white as the light.

djk_text: Ne fosi den poti pakisei baka, ne tu man kon taampu ne en se, e taki anga en. Den tu man ya na Mosesi anga Eliya.
eng_text: And, behold, there appeared unto them Moses and Elias talking with him.

djk_text: Namo Peitilisi taigi Masaa taki: “Masaa! Efi i wani, mi sa meke dii masanga ya. Wan fi yu, wan fu Mosesi anga wan fu Eliya. Bika a switi fu toko, fa u de makandii ya!”
eng_text: Then answered Peter, and said unto Jesus, Lord, it is good for us to be here: if thou wilt, let us make here three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.

djk_text: Peitilisi á kaba taki seefi! Ne wan weti kiin woluku saka kon a den tapu. Ne den yee wan Tongo a ini a woluku taki: “U luku a lobi Manpikin fu mi de. Mi e piisii anga en. Da ne en u mu poti yesi aliki, fu du san ai taki.”
eng_text: While he yet spake, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them: and behold a voice out of the cloud, which said, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased; hear ye him.

djk_text: We, ne di den dii bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi yee a Tongo ya, ne den feele te, den kai tapu fesi a doti.
eng_text: And when the disciples heard it, they fell on their face, and were sore afraid.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi waka go, ne a oli den taki: “U opo! U á feele so!”
eng_text: And Jesus came and touched them, and said, Arise, and be not afraid.

djk_text: Ne di den luku, ne den á si ná wan sama moo enke Masaa Jesesi wawan.
eng_text: And when they had lifted up their eyes, they saw no man, save Jesus only.

djk_text: We, ne di den e saka a mongo baka, ne Masaa Jesesi bali den taki: “I si a sani di u si na a mongo tapu de, u á mu taigi ná wan sama, ye! Na te a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya dede weki baka fosi, da u sa taki en.”
eng_text: And as they came down from the mountain, Jesus charged them, saying, Tell the vision to no man, until the Son of man be risen again from the dead.

djk_text: Namo den dii bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi akisi en taki: “Masaa! Ma fa a waka den leliman fu weiti e leli sama taki, Eliya fosi mu kon a goontapu, fosi, da a Kelestesi sa kon?”
eng_text: And his disciples asked him, saying, Why then say the scribes that Elias must first come?

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “We, Eliya mu waka a fesi fu a Kelestesi kon tuu, fu seeka pasi gi en a fesi.
eng_text: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Elias truly shall first come, and restore all things.

djk_text: Ma fu tuu, mi e taigi u taki, Eliya kon kaba. Ma den á be wani sabi en. Ne den du ogii anga en, enke fa den wani. Na soseefi den o du anga a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya tu.”
eng_text: But I say unto you, That Elias is come already, and they knew him not, but have done unto him whatsoever they listed. Likewise shall also the Son of man suffer of them.

djk_text: We, na di Masaa Jesesi taki so, fosi den bakaman fi en kon kisi kiin taki, na Johanisi a Dopuman a be e taki na a Eliya di be mu kon kaba.
eng_text: Then the disciples understood that he spake unto them of John the Baptist.

djk_text: Namo di den doo na ala den taa sama, ne wan sama kon a Masaa Jesesi. Ne a kai ne en futu a doti.
eng_text: And when they were come to the multitude, there came to him a certain man, kneeling down to him, and saying,

djk_text: Ne ai begi en taki: “Masaa! Gaantangi, abi tyali ati fu wan manpikin fu mi, baa? Pikinengee siki kisi en ogii ogii. Na somen leisi kaba, a siki ya e naki en towe a ini faya. Soseefi ai naki en iti a wataa.
eng_text: Lord, have mercy on my son: for he is lunatick, and sore vexed: for ofttimes he falleth into the fire, and oft into the water.

djk_text: Mi be tyai en kon a den bakaman fi yu, fu den deesi, ma den á poi deesi en.”
eng_text: And I brought him to thy disciples, and they could not cure him.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Oho! San mi miti anga den sowtu sama ya? Den nái biibi sai! Taanga yesi namo di den abi so. On langa mi mu de anga u ya, fu oli pasensi ete, fosi u o biibi?” Ne a taigi a man taki: “Tyai a pikin kon gi mi!”
eng_text: Then Jesus answered and said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him hither to me.

djk_text: We, ne den tyai a pikin kon gi en. Ne a yaki a jeje, di be de na a pikin tapu de puu. Ne wanten, ne a pikin kon bun baka.
eng_text: And Jesus rebuked the devil; and he departed out of him: and the child was cured from that very hour.

djk_text: Ne moo lati, ne den bakaman fi en kon ne en bakabaka. Ne den akisi en taki: “Fa a waka, wi dati á be poi puu a takuu jeje na a pikin tapu?”
eng_text: Then came the disciples to Jesus apart, and said, Why could not we cast him out?

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Na fu di u ná abi biibi sai! Bika mi e taigi u taki, efu u abi wan pikintoin biibi namo, enke a sii den e kai mosite, da u sa taigi wan gaan mongo taki komoto de. Da a sa wai komoto de tuu. Da ná wan sani o de, di u ná o poi du.
eng_text: And Jesus said unto them, Because of your unbelief: for verily I say unto you, If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye shall say unto this mountain, Remove hence to yonder place; and it shall remove; and nothing shall be impossible unto you.

djk_text: Ma yu á poi puu den sowtu takuu jeje wan taa fasi, moo enke fu tan sondee nyan e begi Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: Howbeit this kind goeth not out but by prayer and fasting.

djk_text: We, wan taa leisi, ne Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en kon makandii a Galileya de. Ne a taigi den taki: “Wan ten e kon di den o kisi a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya poti a den ogii sama ana.
eng_text: And while they abode in Galilee, Jesus said unto them, The Son of man shall be betrayed into the hands of men:

djk_text: Da den o kii en. Ma baka dii dei, da a o opo baka komoto a dede. We, di den bakaman fi en yee so, ne gaan tyali kisi den.”
eng_text: And they shall kill him, and the third day he shall be raised again. And they were exceeding sorry.

djk_text: Namo den Masaa Jesesi kon doo Kafalnayemu Foto. Ne wan duupu sama di e piki lantimoni a Dyu Kondee, go a Peitilisi. Ne den akisi en taki: “A mesiti fi yu nái pai lantimoni, no?”
eng_text: And when they were come to Capernaum, they that received tribute money came to Peter, and said, Doth not your master pay tribute?

djk_text: Namo Peitilisi piki den taki: “Hoo! Ai pai, ai!” Namo fa i si Peitilisi doo osu, fosi a opo mofu, ne Masaa Jesesi akisi en taki: “Simon! Fa den kownu fu goontapu ya e piki lantimoni de, on sama den e piki en? Na pikin fu doti a Dyu Kondee ya ofu na den doose kondee sama, di kon tan a Dyu Kondee?”
eng_text: He saith, Yes. And when he was come into the house, Jesus prevented him, saying, What thinkest thou, Simon? of whom do the kings of the earth take custom or tribute? of their own children, or of strangers?

djk_text: Ne Peitilisi piki en taki: “We! Na den doose kondee sama di kon tan a Dyu Kondee ya.” We, ne Masaa Jesesi taigi en taki: “So! Da wi enke pikin fu doti de fii fu dati. A á de fu wi pai!
eng_text: Peter saith unto him, Of strangers. Jesus saith unto him, Then are the children free.

djk_text: Ma toku, wi á wani meke den kosi wi fu dati ede. I sabi san? Teke yu uku go uku na a ze. Da a fosi fisi di yu o kisi, da opo en mofu luku. Da yu o si wan moni a ini en mofu. Da teke en tyai go pai a lantimoni fu mi anga yu.”
eng_text: Notwithstanding, lest we should offend them, go thou to the sea, and cast an hook, and take up the fish that first cometh up; and when thou hast opened his mouth, thou shalt find a piece of money: that take, and give unto them for me and thee.

djk_text: We, na a seefi yuu ya, ne den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi kon ne en. Ne den akisi en taki: “Masaa! Fu den di de a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu, da on di o de a moo heiwan a ini?”
eng_text: At the same time came the disciples unto Jesus, saying, Who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi kai wan pikin kon ne en. Ne a meke a taampu a den mindii de.
eng_text: And Jesus called a little child unto him, and set him in the midst of them,

djk_text: Ne a taki: “I si a pikin ya? Fu tuu! Efu yu á daai kon abi a fasi di wan pikin abi, da yu á poi doo a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: And said, Verily I say unto you, Except ye be converted, and become as little children, ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven.

djk_text: Ma efi i abi saka fasi enke a pikin ya, da yu o abi wan gaan hei peesi a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Whosoever therefore shall humble himself as this little child, the same is greatest in the kingdom of heaven.

djk_text: “Sama di du wan bun gi wan pikin enke di i si taampu ya, fu di a de sama fu mi, da na miseefi a du a bun de kaba.
eng_text: And whoso shall receive one such little child in my name receiveth me.

djk_text: Ma sama di sa du ogii anga sowan saka fasi sama mu luku bun! Sani ná o waka bun gi en. A sitaafu di Masaa Gadu o gi en sa bigi. A be sa moo betee, den be tei wan gaanbigi siton ne en neki, da den tyai en go towe na a moo dipi peesi fu a ze, meke a dede.
eng_text: But whoso shall offend one of these little ones which believe in me, it were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and that he were drowned in the depth of the sea.

djk_text: “Ma heelu fu a goontapu ya, fu den sani di e tesi sama a Masaa Gadu pasi! Na tuu taki, na so goontapu de. Ma heelu fu den sama di e du sani, fu tyai taawan go a ini tesi!
eng_text: Woe unto the world because of offences! for it must needs be that offences come; but woe to that man by whom the offence cometh!

djk_text: Da efu yu wani du ogii anga yu ana ofu yu futu, fu komoto a Masaa Gadu pasi fu Masaa Gadu, da a moo bun i koti a ana ofu a futu towe puu a i sikin. Bika a moo bun fu lasi wan pisi fi i sikin, ma i fende a libi fu tego. Moo enke den iti yu hiihii go a ini didibii faya di e boon tego.
eng_text: Wherefore if thy hand or thy foot offend thee, cut them off, and cast them from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life halt or maimed, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into everlasting fire.

djk_text: Soseefi tu, efu yu ain wani luku sani di o puu yu a Masaa Gadu pasi, da a moo bun, i diki en puu towe. Bika a moo bun fi i lasi wan pisi fi i sikin, ma i fende a libi fu tego, moo enke i de anga i tu bunbun ain, ma den iti yu go a ini didibii faya go boon.
eng_text: And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire.

djk_text: “Fu tuu, mi e taigi u! U mu luku bun, fa u e libi anga den pikinengee, enke di i si taampu ya. U á mu si den enke soso sani. Bika den Masaa Gadu Kondee Basiya fu mi Tata a tapu anda, di de ne en fesi ala yuu, e oli waki fu kibii den.
eng_text: Take heed that ye despise not one of these little ones; for I say unto you, That in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father which is in heaven.

djk_text: “Bika, a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya, kon, fu suku ala sama di lasi Masaa Gadu pasi, tyai kon poti a Masaa Gadu pasi baka, fu den fende libi.”
eng_text: For the Son of man is come to save that which was lost.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi gi den wan ageisi toli taki: “Fa i denki fu wan sama di abi wan ondoo sikapu? Kon u taki, wan fu den komoto a den taawan mindii go lasi. Da san i denki? A masaa fi en o fika den neigintenti a neigin taawan a pe den de e nyan na a sabana, da a go suku a lasi wan, te enke a fende en?
eng_text: How think ye? if a man have an hundred sheep, and one of them be gone astray, doth he not leave the ninety and nine, and goeth into the mountains, and seeketh that which is gone astray?

djk_text: Da fu tuu, mi e taigi u! Te a o fende a wankodo di be lasi baka, a o poolo anga en, moo den neigintenti a neigin taawan di á be lasi.
eng_text: And if so be that he find it, verily I say unto you, he rejoiceth more of that sheep, than of the ninety and nine which went not astray.

djk_text: We, na soseefi u Tata, a tapu anda tan tu. Bika a á wani ná wan fu den pikin ya mu go lasi.”
eng_text: Even so it is not the will of your Father which is in heaven, that one of these little ones should perish.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi taki go doo taki: “Efi i baala du wan sani anga yu di á bun, da yu wawan go taki anga en fosi. Da efu a yee san i taki, ne a begi paadon, da i wini en tyai kon poti a pasi kaba.
eng_text: Moreover if thy brother shall trespass against thee, go and tell him his fault between thee and him alone: if he shall hear thee, thou hast gained thy brother.

djk_text: Ma efu a á wani yee yu, da kai wan ofu tu sama moo, da u go taki anga en baka. Da dati o kai anga a weiti di taki, moo enke wan kotoigi mu de, fu tyai wan toli go a kuutu fesi, fu lanti sa piki taki, na so a de tuu.
eng_text: But if he will not hear thee, then take with thee one or two more, that in the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.

djk_text: Da efu a á wani yee u, da u mu tyai a toli go a keliki fesi, a den taa biibiwan. Da efu toku, a sama ya á wani yee a keliki tu, da u mu fika en. Da u oli en enke sama di á sabi Masaa Gadu. Wan sama di de a ini takuudu anga ogii.
eng_text: And if he shall neglect to hear them, tell it unto the church: but if he neglect to hear the church, let him be unto thee as an heathen man and a publican.

djk_text: “Da fu tuu, mi e taigi u: San di u tei a goontapu, sa tei a Masaa Gadu Kondee. San di u losi a goontapu ya sa losi a Masaa Gadu Kondee tu.
eng_text: Verily I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever ye shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.

djk_text: “Fu tuutuu, mi e taigi u: Efu tu fu u tei ati kon awan, fu begi mi Tata a tapu wan sani, mi Tata a tapu o gi u en.
eng_text: Again I say unto you, That if two of you shall agree on earth as touching any thing that they shall ask, it shall be done for them of my Father which is in heaven.
