djk_text: Bika pe tu doo dii sama de makandii a ini mi nen, da mi seefi de leti a den mindii de tu.”
eng_text: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.

djk_text: Namo Peitilisi waka kon a Masaa Jesesi, ne a akisi en taki: “Masaa! Onmen leisi mi mu gi wan taawan, di du wan sani anga mi, paadon? Efu mi gi en paadon seibin leisi, a á sai, no?”
eng_text: Then came Peter to him, and said, Lord, how oft shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? till seven times?

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Seibin toon namo á sai, Peitilisi! Ma seibintenti toon fu seibin, i mu gi taawan paadon.”
eng_text: Jesus saith unto him, I say not unto thee, Until seven times: but, Until seventy times seven.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi gi den wan ageisi toli, da a taki: “A Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu de leti enke wan kownu di abi somen wookoman, di mu pai en.
eng_text: Therefore is the kingdom of heaven likened unto a certain king, which would take account of his servants.

djk_text: Da wan dei, ne a kownu wegi ala den paiman di den mu pai en go, a wegi den kon. Namo a kai wan fu den ondooman fi en, di abi fu pai en onmen tenti miliyun.
eng_text: And when he had begun to reckon, one was brought unto him, which owed him ten thousand talents.

djk_text: Ma namo, da a man ya á be poi pai a kownu. Ne a kownu taki: ‘U seli en, anga en uman anga en pikin anga ala san a abi, da u tyai a moni kon gi mi. Da mi sa fende mi moni baka.’
eng_text: But forasmuch as he had not to pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, and his wife, and children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.

djk_text: “We, ne a wookoman kai anga kini na a kownu fesi, ne a begi en taki: ‘Kee! Masaa, i abi leti! Gaantangi! Oli pasensi gi mi? Mi sa pai yu!’
eng_text: The servant therefore fell down, and worshipped him, saying, Lord, have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.

djk_text: Namo di a wookoman begi so, ne tyali kisi a masaa taki, meke a gwe fi en. A á de fu a pai en a paiman moo.
eng_text: Then the lord of that servant was moved with compassion, and loosed him, and forgave him the debt.

djk_text: “Da na gwe tapu a man ya de ete! Namo a miti wan taa ondooman fu a seefi kownu a pasi. A man de be mu pai wan sani fu feifi dunsu kolu so. Namo, a dyombo kisi en hub oli taki: ‘Pai mi! Pai mi wanten! Wanten wanten, nownow ya!’
eng_text: But the same servant went out, and found one of his fellowservants, which owed him an hundred pence: and he laid hands on him, and took him by the throat, saying, Pay me that thou owest.

djk_text: We, ne a taa ondooman kai anga kini a doti begi en taki: ‘Gaantangi! Oli pasensi gi mi baa, te mi fende a moni, mi sa pai yu baka.’
eng_text: And his fellowservant fell down at his feet, and besought him, saying, Have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.

djk_text: Ma a á wani. Ma so a meke den kisi a man ya poti a dunguu osu taki, meke a tan ape, fu te enke a kaba pai en a hiihii paiman!
eng_text: And he would not: but went and cast him into prison, till he should pay the debt.

djk_text: “Ma di den taa wookoman fu a masaa si ala san pasa, ne a buduufu den te, ne den lon go taigi den masaa ala san pasa.
eng_text: So when his fellowservants saw what was done, they were very sorry, and came and told unto their lord all that was done.

djk_text: We, ne a masaa kai a wookoman kon ne en baka. Ne a taigi en taki: ‘Yu takuu ati sani yu! A hiihii gaan moni di i be abi fu pai mi, ne mi fika yu, fu di i be begi mi.
eng_text: Then his lord, after that he had called him, said unto him, O thou wicked servant, I forgave thee all that debt, because thou desiredst me:

djk_text: Da saide meke yu á teke tyali ati luku a taa wookoman fu mi, enke fa mi be teke tyali ati wooko anga yu?’
eng_text: Shouldest not thou also have had compassion on thy fellowservant, even as I had pity on thee?

djk_text: We, a masaa ati boon tee, ne a kai sikowtu kon kisi en tyai go a ini sitaafu osu. Meke a tyai pina anga sitaafu, fu te enke a pai en a lasiti kopoo sensi.”
eng_text: And his lord was wroth, and delivered him to the tormentors, till he should pay all that was due unto him.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “We, na soseefi mi Tata sa du anga ibiiwan fu u, efu u nái gi taawan paadon anga u hii ati.”
eng_text: So likewise shall my heavenly Father do also unto you, if ye from your hearts forgive not every one his brother their trespasses.

djk_text: We, baka di Masaa Jesesi taki den wowtu ya, ne a komoto a Galileya, koti abaa a Joodani Liba, gwe na a pisiwataa fu Judeja.
eng_text: And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these sayings, he departed from Galilee, and came into the coasts of Judaea beyond Jordan;

djk_text: Ma namo, di a doo, ne tyaipi sama booko kon ne en, kon e waka ne en baka. Ne a deesi den sikiman ape.
eng_text: And great multitudes followed him; and he healed them there.

djk_text: Ma den Faliseiman seefi kon ne en de tu, fu tesi en meke a sa taki sani di á fiti. Namo den akisi en taki: “Fa a weiti fu Gadu de? Wan man sa paati anga en uman, fu iniiwan pikin sani di en anga en abi?”
eng_text: The Pharisees also came unto him, tempting him, and saying unto him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife for every cause?

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “U á leisi san sikiifi a Masaa Gadu Buku fu dati, no? Bika a sikiifi taki, na a bigin, da Masaa Gadu be meke wan man anga wan uman namo.
eng_text: And he answered and said unto them, Have ye not read, that he which made them at the beginning made them male and female,

djk_text: Di Masaa Gadu du dati, ne a taki: ‘Na fu dati ede meke, wan man e fika en gaansama osu, fu go teke en uman libi. Da den tu sama de mokisa libi toon wan sikin.’
eng_text: And said, For this cause shall a man leave father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife: and they twain shall be one flesh?

djk_text: Da den nái teli fu tu sama moo, ma den de wan sikin namo. Da san Masaa Gadu poti kon toon wan, da ná wan libisama di mu paati den.”
eng_text: Wherefore they are no more twain, but one flesh. What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.

djk_text: Ne den Faliseiman piki en taki: “We, efu a de so tuu, da saide meke Mosesi be sikiifi taki, manengee sa go naki pampila a lanti taki, en anga en uman paati? Da a sa gi a uman a pampila de, da a sende en gwe?”
eng_text: They say unto him, Why did Moses then command to give a writing of divorcement, and to put her away?

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Weeno! Na fu a taanga yesi fu u ede, meke Mosesi be du dati, fu gi u pasi fu u paati anga u uman! Ma na a bigin, da a sani á be de so.
eng_text: He saith unto them, Moses because of the hardness of your hearts suffered you to put away your wives: but from the beginning it was not so.

djk_text: Ma mi e taigi u taki, a sama di o paati anga en uman, boiti efu a du ogii ne en osu, ne a teke wan taa uman, da a kai a ini a motyo libi.”
eng_text: And I say unto you, Whosoever shall put away his wife, except it be for fornication, and shall marry another, committeth adultery: and whoso marrieth her which is put away doth commit adultery.

djk_text: Namo den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi piki Masaa Jesesi taki: “Ai! Uman anga man toli taanga! Bika efu na so a weiti fu Masaa Gadu de, da a á de fu man teke uman libi. Soseefi a á de fu uman teke man fu libi tu.”
eng_text: His disciples say unto him, If the case of the man be so with his wife, it is not good to marry.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Meke mi taigi u! Ná ala sama sa de so. Ma na den sama di Masaa Gadu kai, fu tan so, da na den namo sa tan so.
eng_text: But he said unto them, All men cannot receive this saying, save they to whom it is given.

djk_text: Bika son sama á poi libi anga uman, fu di mama meke en so kaba. Son sama á poi libi anga uman, fu di taa sama poti en so. Son sama, da na den seefi fende en bun, fu tan so, fu de a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu. Da sama di sa fusutan san mi leli ya, da meke a fusutan en.”
eng_text: For there are some eunuchs, which were so born from their mother's womb: and there are some eunuchs, which were made eunuchs of men: and there be eunuchs, which have made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven's sake. He that is able to receive it, let him receive it.

djk_text: Namo a seefi yuu de, ne den sama tyai wanlo pikinengee kon a Masaa Jesesi, fu a poti ana a den tapu begi gi den. Ma den bakaman kaasi den fu ogii!
eng_text: Then were there brought unto him little children, that he should put his hands on them, and pray: and the disciples rebuked them.

djk_text: Namo, Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “U fika den pikin, meke denseefi kon doo a mi tu. U á tapu den! Bika na sama di abi a fasi di pikinengee abi sa poi go doo a ini a Nyun Tii a Masaa Gadu Kondee.”
eng_text: But Jesus said, Suffer little children, and forbid them not, to come unto me: for of such is the kingdom of heaven.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi poti ana a den pikin tapu, begi gi den. Ne a gwe.
eng_text: And he laid his hands on them, and departed thence.

djk_text: We, ne wan yonkuman kon doo a Masaa Jesesi. Ne a akisi en taki: “Mesiti! Sowtu bun de, fu mi du te, da mi sa fende a libi fu tego?”
eng_text: And, behold, one came and said unto him, Good Master, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi akisi en taki: “Saide meke yu e akisi, sowtu bun de? Yu á sabi taki, na Masaa Gadu wawan namo bun, no? We, efi i wani fende a libi fu tego, da i mu oli iseefi a den weiti fi en.”
eng_text: And he said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is, God: but if thou wilt enter into life, keep the commandments.

djk_text: Ne a yonkuman akisi en taki: “On di fu den weiti mi mu oli?” Namo Masaa Jesesi piki en baka taki: “Yu á mu kii sama. Yu á mu waka anga taa uman ofu man! Yu á mu fufuu. Soseefi, yu á mu lei.
eng_text: He saith unto him, Which? Jesus said, Thou shalt do no murder, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness,

djk_text: I mu lesipeki i mma anga i dda. Yu mu lobi ala sama enke fa yu lobi iseefi.”
eng_text: Honour thy father and thy mother: and, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

djk_text: We, ne a man piki taki: “Ala den weiti de, na sani di mi e oli. Da san fika moo fu mi du, boiti dati?”
eng_text: The young man saith unto him, All these things have I kept from my youth up: what lack I yet?

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Efi i wani de wan bunbun sama sondee fowtu, da go seli ala den sani di yu abi. Da gi den pootiman a moni, da yu sa fende gaan gudu a Masaa Gadu a tapu anda. Da, te i kaba, da kon waka a mi baka, enke wan bakaman fu mi.”
eng_text: Jesus said unto him, If thou wilt be perfect, go and sell that thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come and follow me.

djk_text: We, di a yee ala san Masaa Jesesi taigi en, ne a booko sikoo. Ne a bendi ede a doti, ne a waka gwe anga ala gaan tyali na ati. Bika a be abi tyaipi gudu.
eng_text: But when the young man heard that saying, he went away sorrowful: for he had great possessions.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi daai go a den bakaman fi en taki: “Luku de! Fu tuutuu, a taanga gi wan guduman fu kon a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, Verily I say unto you, That a rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven.

djk_text: Mi e taigi u ete wan toon. A moo makiliki fu wan kameili pasa a nanai olo, moo enke wan guduman pasa go a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: And again I say unto you, It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

djk_text: We, di den bakaman fi en yee so, ne a sani fuka den. Ne den akisi en taki: “We, da sama sa fende a libi fu tego seefi?”
eng_text: When his disciples heard it, they were exceedingly amazed, saying, Who then can be saved?

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi luku den dunn. Ne a piki den taki: “Efu na libisama wawan a be didon, da ná wan sama di be o poi fende a libi de. Ma fu Masaa Gadu, da sani seefi á de di a á poi du.”
eng_text: But Jesus beheld them, and said unto them, With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.

djk_text: We, ne Peitilisi akisi en taki: “We, wi be fika ala sani di u be abi, kon waka a yu baka. Da sowtu paiman wi dati o fende?”
eng_text: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Behold, we have forsaken all, and followed thee; what shall we have therefore?

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi piki taki: “U aliki ya! Fu tuu! Wan ten e kon, di ala sani o meke kon nyun baka. Da a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya o sidon ne en kownu sutuu anga ala a dyendee di a abi, fu tii ala sani. Da u di be e waka ne en baka seefi o sidon a kownu sutuu, fu kuutu den twalufu lo fu Islayeli Kondee.
eng_text: And Jesus said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That ye which have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of man shall sit in the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

djk_text: Soseefi ala sama di fika osu ofu baala ofu sisa ofu dda ofu mma ofu uman ofu pikin ofu ala san a abi, fu di a wani waka a mi baka, da a o fende den sani ya wan ondoo toon baka. Da bakaten seefi a sa fende a libi fu tego tu.
eng_text: And every one that hath forsaken houses, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name's sake, shall receive an hundredfold, and shall inherit everlasting life.

djk_text: Da a yuu de, somen sama di de fesiwan ya o toon bakaman. Da somen di de bakaman ya o daai toon fesiwan.”
eng_text: But many that are first shall be last; and the last shall be first.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi gi den ete wan ageisi toli, fu soi den fa a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu tan. A taki: “Wan guduman be abi wan goon. Ne di mamanten fuuku, ne a go suku sama fu yuu, fu kon yeepi en wooko a goon.
eng_text: For the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which went out early in the morning to hire labourers into his vineyard.

djk_text: Ne di a fende den wookoman, ne en anga den kuudei taki, a o pai den wan hiihii dei wooko moni. Ne a sende den go wooko na a goon.
eng_text: And when he had agreed with the labourers for a penny a day, he sent them into his vineyard.

djk_text: “Ne a de ape, te wan sani fu neigin yuu so, ne a go a ganda baka. Ne a go si wan duupu taa sama taampu a wowoyo de sondee wooko.
eng_text: And he went out about the third hour, and saw others standing idle in the marketplace,

djk_text: Namo a kai den taki: ‘U kon go wooko gi mi, a mi goon. Mi o pai u enke fa a fiti.’ Ne den go.
eng_text: And said unto them; Go ye also into the vineyard, and whatsoever is right I will give you. And they went their way.

djk_text: “We, ne a de, te wan sani fu twalufu yuu so, ne a go baka go du a seefi sani. Ne di dii yuu, ne a daai go suku sama baka tu.
eng_text: Again he went out about the sixth and ninth hour, and did likewise.

djk_text: Namo neti be e kon doo kaba, a be fika wan kodo yuu namo, fosi wooko komoto. Ne a basi waka go a ganda baka. Ne a si taa taa sama taampu anda ete, sondee wooko. Ne a akisi den taki: ‘Saide u de ya a ganda sondee wooko so?’
eng_text: And about the eleventh hour he went out, and found others standing idle, and saith unto them, Why stand ye here all the day idle?

djk_text: “Namo den piki en taki: ‘Na taa fasi á de. Bika wi á fende wooko, moo enke fa u taampu ya.’ “Namo, ne a basi taigi den taki: ‘U kon go wooko a mi goon!’ Ne a sende den go na a goon.
eng_text: They say unto him, Because no man hath hired us. He saith unto them, Go ye also into the vineyard; and whatsoever is right, that shall ye receive.

djk_text: “Ne den wooko te a yuu kisi, fu den komoto a wooko. Ne a masaa di abi a goon, go taigi a wooko basi taki: ‘Kai den wookoman, da pai den den moni. Bigin a den lasiti wan, di u be teke a wooko a bakadina ya te go miti den fosi wan fu a mamanten.’
eng_text: So when even was come, the lord of the vineyard saith unto his steward, Call the labourers, and give them their hire, beginning from the last unto the first.

djk_text: “We, ne den wookoman kon, di a be yuu na a bakadina mofu. Ne a pai den wan hii dei moni.
eng_text: And when they came that were hired about the eleventh hour, they received every man a penny.

djk_text: Ma namo, di den wookoman di be kon senten mamanten si a moni di den wookoman di be kon bakadina kisi, ne den membee taki, den be o fende moo ipi moni moo enke den. Ma te fu kaba, ne den kon si taki, na a seefi moni den kisi, enke den man di be kon bakadina mofu de tu.
eng_text: But when the first came, they supposed that they should have received more; and they likewise received every man a penny.

djk_text: We, ne di den teke a moni, ne den ati boon na a masaa fu a goon, te ná sipowtu.
eng_text: And when they had received it, they murmured against the goodman of the house,

djk_text: Ne den kuutu taki: ‘Fa a sani ya kan? Den man di kon dyonson ya, den wooko wankodo yuu langa namo, ne i pai wi anga den a seefi moni. Wi, di be de ya e pina e sweti hiihii dei a ini a gaan ati san.’
eng_text: Saying, These last have wrought but one hour, and thou hast made them equal unto us, which have borne the burden and heat of the day.

djk_text: “Namo a masaa piki wan fu den taki: ‘Mi mati! San mi du anga u so, meke u e kuutu mi? Mi á pai u wan hiihii dei moni, enke fa u be kuudei, no?
eng_text: But he answered one of them, and said, Friend, I do thee no wrong: didst not thou agree with me for a penny?

djk_text: We, u teke san mi pai u, da u waka gwe a osu. Bika na miseefi wani pai den taawan a seefi moni di mi pai u.
eng_text: Take that thine is, and go thy way: I will give unto this last, even as unto thee.

djk_text: Da u fika mi, meke mi du san mi wani anga mi eigi moni. A á de fu u dyalusu so, fu di mi abi bun ati fasi fu luku sama.’
eng_text: Is it not lawful for me to do what I will with mine own? Is thine eye evil, because I am good?

djk_text: “We, na so den di de a baka ya o daai kon toon fesiwan. Da den di de a fesi ya o daai kon toon bakawan.”
eng_text: So the last shall be first, and the first last: for many be called, but few chosen.

djk_text: Da Masaa Jesesi de a pasi e gwe a Jelusalem. Ne a kai den twalufu bakaman fi en go a wanse. Ne a taigi den taki:
eng_text: And Jesus going up to Jerusalem took the twelve disciples apart in the way, and said unto them,

djk_text: “U si, wi e go a Jelusalem Foto nownow! Da den o kisi a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya, poti a den hei apaiti begiman anga den leliman fu Dyuweiti ana. Da den o kuutu en taki, a mu dede.
eng_text: Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be betrayed unto the chief priests and unto the scribes, and they shall condemn him to death,

djk_text: Da den o poti mi a den Loma sama ana. Da den o wisiwasi mi, fonmi te a sai den. Da den o tyai mi go sipikii kii a koloisi. Ma di fu dii dei, da mi o weki baka.”
eng_text: And shall deliver him to the Gentiles to mock, and to scourge, and to crucify him: and the third day he shall rise again.

djk_text: Ma namo, da na a seefi yuu de, ne a mma fu den tu manpikin fu Da Sebedi kon a Masaa Jesesi. Ne a kai anga kini a doti a Masaa Jesesi fesi taki: “Masaa oo! Mi wani begi i wan sani, baa?”
eng_text: Then came to him the mother of Zebedee's children with her sons, worshipping him, and desiring a certain thing of him.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi akisi en taki: “San i wani?” Namo a mma piki taki: “We, Masaa! Dyonson, yu o de Kownu a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu. Da gaantangi! Meke den tu manpikin fu mi ya sidon a yu se, baa? Wan fu den a yu letise ana, a taawan a yu kukutuse ana.”
eng_text: And he said unto her, What wilt thou? She saith unto him, Grant that these my two sons may sit, the one on thy right hand, and the other on the left, in thy kingdom.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Yu á sabi san i e akisi mi ya! Bika wan gaan pina de a pasi e kon fu mi nyan. U denki u sa poi nyanmi en anga mi?” Namo den piki en taki: “Eeye Masaa! U sa poi nyanmi en anga yu.”
eng_text: But Jesus answered and said, Ye know not what ye ask. Are ye able to drink of the cup that I shall drink of, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with? They say unto him, We are able.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi piki den baka taki: “Na tuu! U sa diingi en tuu! Ma a á didon a mi, fu gi sama peesi a mi leti ana ofu mi kukutu ana se. Bika na den sama di mi Tata, a tapu poti den hei peesi de gi sa fende den.”
eng_text: And he saith unto them, Ye shall drink indeed of my cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with: but to sit on my right hand, and on my left, is not mine to give, but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared of my Father.

djk_text: We, di den taa tin bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi yee san pasa de, ne den ati boon seefi seefi.
eng_text: And when the ten heard it, they were moved with indignation against the two brethren.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi kai ala den kon ne en. Ne a taigi den taki: “U ala fiya sabi fa den edeman fu goontapu ya e tii kondee. Den e dwengi sama poti a den ondoo. Da den sama de seefi e dwengi sama poti a den ondoo fu pee basi a den tapu.
eng_text: But Jesus called them unto him, and said, Ye know that the princes of the Gentiles exercise dominion over them, and they that are great exercise authority upon them.

djk_text: Ma u dati á mu libi so. Pe fu dati, da a sama di wani hei a u mindii, mu saka enseefi fu e dini taawan.
eng_text: But it shall not be so among you: but whosoever will be great among you, let him be your minister;

djk_text: Sama di wani toon fesiman fu taawan mu toon saafu gi den taawan.
eng_text: And whosoever will be chief among you, let him be your servant:

djk_text: Bika a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya, á kon fu sama dini en. Ma a kon fu dini sama. A kon fu gi en libi enke paiman, fu pai gi somen sama, fu kon de bun gi Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: Even as the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.

djk_text: We, ne di Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en komoto a Jelikow e gwe, ne tyaipi sama e waka ne en baka.
eng_text: And as they departed from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.

djk_text: Ma namo, da tu beendiman be sidon a sikin pasi. Ne di den yee taki, na Masaa Jesesi e pasa de, ne den e bali taki: “Masaa! Masaa! Bakaten Manpikin fu Kownu Dafeti paansu! Teke tyali ati luku wi, baa?”
eng_text: And, behold, two blind men sitting by the way side, when they heard that Jesus passed by, cried out, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, thou Son of David.

djk_text: Ma den tyaipi sama di be e waka a Masaa Jesesi baka kaasi den taki: “U tapu mofu ya!” Ma a tan enke na sende, den sende den, fu bali moo taanga. Bika, na now den e bali taanga taki: “Masaa! Bakaten Manpikin fu Kownu Dafeti paansu! U begi i! Teke tyali ati luku wi oo!”
eng_text: And the multitude rebuked them, because they should hold their peace: but they cried the more, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, thou Son of David.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi taampu diin. Ne a kai den kon, ne a akisi den taki: “San u wani, fu mi du gi u?”
eng_text: And Jesus stood still, and called them, and said, What will ye that I shall do unto you?

djk_text: Namo den piki taki: “Masaa! U wani i deesi u ain, fu u sa si sani.”
eng_text: They say unto him, Lord, that our eyes may be opened.

djk_text: Namo tyali kisi Masaa Jesesi fu den, te ná sipowtu. Ne a waka go, ne a oli den ain. Ne wanten de, ne den ain kiin fu si ala sani. Ne den teke fu waka a Masaa Jesesi baka.
eng_text: So Jesus had compassion on them, and touched their eyes: and immediately their eyes received sight, and they followed him.

djk_text: Namo, den Masaa Jesesi kon doo koosube fu Jelusalem Foto. Den be de na a foto den e kai Betifage, na a pisi fu Oleifi Mongo. Namo, ne Masaa Jesesi kai tu fu den bakaman fi en kon, fu sende sani.
eng_text: And when they drew nigh unto Jerusalem, and were come to Bethphage, unto the mount of Olives, then sent Jesus two disciples,

djk_text: A taigi den taki: “Go na a kondee na abaase anda. U o si tu buliki de, wan uman wan anga en pikin. U losi den teke tyai kon gi mi ya.
eng_text: Saying unto them, Go into the village over against you, and straightway ye shall find an ass tied, and a colt with her: loose them, and bring them unto me.

djk_text: Efu wan sama sa akisi pe u e go anga den, da u mu piki en taki, na Masaa sende u, fu kon teke den. Bika Masaa abi den fanowdu nownow. Ma te a Masaa kaba anga den, da u o tyai den kon poti baka.”
eng_text: And if any man say ought unto you, ye shall say, The Lord hath need of them; and straightway he will send them.

djk_text: Da na fu sani sa waka enke fa wan fositen apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu be sikiifi. Bika a be sikiifi taki:
eng_text: All this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying,

djk_text: “Meke den sama fu Siyon sabi taki, a kownu fu den e kon. Ai kon a den anga ala gaan saka fasi a wan buliki tapu.”
eng_text: Tell ye the daughter of Sion, Behold, thy King cometh unto thee, meek, and sitting upon an ass, and a colt the foal of an ass.

djk_text: We, ne den tu bakaman waka go, enke fa Masaa Jesesi sende den. Ne den du san a sende den tu.
eng_text: And the disciples went, and did as Jesus commanded them,

djk_text: Den teke a uman buliki anga en pikin tyai kon. Soseefi den bakaman teke den koosi baala a den buliki mindii baka. Ne Masaa Jesesi subi go sidon na a pikin buliki tapu, fu gwe.
eng_text: And brought the ass, and the colt, and put on them their clothes, and they set him thereon.

djk_text: Da tyaipi tyaipi sama be de anda di teke koosi anga bon ana baala na a pasi tapu pe Masaa Jesesi o pasa anga den buliki.
eng_text: And a very great multitude spread their garments in the way; others cut down branches from the trees, and strawed them in the way.

djk_text: Da sama be e waka a Masaa Jesesi baka, den e waka ne en fesi. Da den e bali taki: “Hosana gi a Bakaten Manpikin fu Kownu Dafeti paansu!” “Seigi fu awan, di e kon a ini a nen fu Masaa.” “Hosana gi Masaa Gadu a tapu seefi!”
eng_text: And the multitudes that went before, and that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna to the Son of David: Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord; Hosanna in the highest.

djk_text: Namo di den doo a ini Jelusalem Foto seefi, ne a hii foto seke. Den sama booko kon gwuulu, da den e taki: “Sama kon ya?”
eng_text: And when he was come into Jerusalem, all the city was moved, saying, Who is this?

djk_text: Da taawan e piki taki: “Jesesi! Jesesi! Apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu di komoto a Nasaleti Foto, na a pisiwataa fu Galileya.”
eng_text: And the multitude said, This is Jesus the prophet of Nazareth of Galilee.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi waka go na a gaan Mama Keliki. Da somen sama be de anda e bai sani, e seli enke na wowoyo. Namo Masaa Jesesi yaki ala den puu de. Ne a toto ala den tafaa pe den be e booko moni, towe a doti. A puu ala den sutuu pe sama be sidon e seli doifi towe gwe.
eng_text: And Jesus went into the temple of God, and cast out all them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves,

djk_text: Na so ai taigi den tu taki: “U á sabi san sikiifi a Masaa Gadu Buku, no? A sikiifi taki: ‘Mi osu mu de wan peesi pe sama e kon, fu begi makandii.’ Na so! Ma fu saide u sama ya meke a toon wan peesi fu kweki fufuuman du?”
eng_text: And said unto them, It is written, My house shall be called the house of prayer; but ye have made it a den of thieves.

djk_text: Namo, di Masaa Jesesi de ape, ne wantu beendiman anga lanman kon suku yeepi ne en. Ne a deesi den kon bun.
eng_text: And the blind and the lame came to him in the temple; and he healed them.

djk_text: We, den hei apaiti begiman anga den leliman fu Dyuweiti ape ati boon tuutuu. Bika den si den foondoo sani di ai du ape. Soseefi den e yee pikinengee seefi mu e bali baya ape taki: “Hosana! Bika en na a Bakaten Manpikin fu Kownu Dafeti paansu.”
eng_text: And when the chief priests and scribes saw the wonderful things that he did, and the children crying in the temple, and saying, Hosanna to the Son of David; they were sore displeased,

djk_text: We, ne den moo hei apaiti begiman komoto kon akisi Masaa Jesesi taki: “I yee bun, fa den pikin e kai yu de?” Namo Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Mi e yee kiinkiin, fa den e kai mi! Ma u dati á leisi san sikiifi a Masaa Gadu Buku, no? A sikiifi taki: ‘Masaa Gadu o meke, te enke petepete pikin seefi e bali baaya gafa en.’ ”
eng_text: And said unto him, Hearest thou what these say? And Jesus saith unto them, Yea; have ye never read, Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings thou hast perfected praise?

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi waka komoto ape. Soseefi a komoto a ini Jelusalem Foto, go siibi na a peesi den e kai Betaniya.
eng_text: And he left them, and went out of the city into Bethany; and he lodged there.

djk_text: Namo fuuku mamanten, ne Masaa Jesesi opo fu go a Jelusalem Foto baka. Ma angii be moo en.
eng_text: Now in the morning as he returned into the city, he hungered.

djk_text: Namo a si wan figasii bon a sikin pasi. Ne a go suku figasii na a bon. Ma ná wan enkii sii a poi fende. Ne a fuuku a bon taki: “I kaba fu meke sii a goontapu! Bika noiti moo wanten i sa meke sii!” Fa i si Masaa Jesesi taki so, a bon dede wanten.
eng_text: And when he saw a fig tree in the way, he came to it, and found nothing thereon, but leaves only, and said unto it, Let no fruit grow on thee henceforward for ever. And presently the fig tree withered away.

djk_text: Da den bakaman fi en si a foondoo sani di pasa anga a bon ya. Ne den foondoo te, den á sabi san fu du. Namo den go akisi Masaa Jesesi taki: “Da fa a bon du dede wanboo wanboo so?”
eng_text: And when the disciples saw it, they marvelled, saying, How soon is the fig tree withered away!

djk_text: Namo a piki den taki: “Na tuutuu biibi meke dati pasa. Bika te i sa biibi Masaa Gadu doo yu ati tuutuu, da i sa poi du san mi du ya tu. Soseefi i sa poi du moo gaan foondoo sani moo dati seefi. A winsi na sende i sende wan gaan mongo taki: ‘Diipi go kai a ini ze.’ A sa musu fu go!
eng_text: Jesus answered and said unto them, Verily I say unto you, If ye have faith, and doubt not, ye shall not only do this which is done to the fig tree, but also if ye shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; it shall be done.

djk_text: Fu tuu, ala san i begi akisi Masaa Gadu, a sa du ala dati gi yu. Ma a wan sani, i mu abi biibi doo yu ati, te yu e begi.”
eng_text: And all things, whatsoever ye shall ask in prayer, believing, ye shall receive.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi go doo Jelusalem Foto baka. Ne a waka go na a Mama Keliki baka, fu go leli den sama sani anda. Namo den hei apaiti begiman anga den gaansama fu kondee go ne en. Ne den akisi en taki: “Sama gi yu a makiti, fu waka du den sani, di yu e waka e du ya! Sama gi yu a makiti fu du den sani ya?”
eng_text: And when he was come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came unto him as he was teaching, and said, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority?

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Mi o akisi u wan sani fosi. Te u kaba piki mi dati, da miseefi sa piki u san u akisi mi de.
eng_text: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I also will ask you one thing, which if ye tell me, I in like wise will tell you by what authority I do these things.

djk_text: U piki mi! Sama be gi Johanisi a makiti fu dopu sama? Na Masaa Gadu ofu na libisama be sende en?” We, di a akisi so, ne den bendi a se fosi, fu kai pakisei luku, fa fu piki en. Ne den fiti taki: “Efu u piki taki: ‘Na Masaa Gadu sende Johanisi,’ a sa akisi wi taki: ‘Da saide, u á be biibi Johanisi?’
eng_text: The baptism of John, whence was it? from heaven, or of men? And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say unto us, Why did ye not then believe him?

djk_text: Soseefi, efu u piki taki: ‘Na libisama be gi en Johanisi a makiti,’ da wi anga a foluku fu kondee o de a toko. Bika a foluku e si Johanisi enke wan apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: But if we shall say, Of men; we fear the people; for all hold John as a prophet.

djk_text: Dati meke den piki Masaa Jesesi taki: “Wi á sabi sama be gi en a makiti.” Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den baka taki: “Di u á sabi kaba sama be gi en a makiti, da mi seefi ná o taigi u sama gi mi a makiti tu.”
eng_text: And they answered Jesus, and said, We cannot tell. And he said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi taki anga den go doo taki: “Mi o gi u wan ageisi toli fu teke poti pakisei bunbun! Wan sama be abi tu manpikin anga wan goon. Ne a sende a moo gaan manpikin fu go wooko na a goon.
eng_text: But what think ye? A certain man had two sons; and he came to the first, and said, Son, go work to day in my vineyard.

djk_text: Ma a pikin ya piki en taki: ‘Nono, mi dda! Mi ná o poi go wooko a goon.’ Ma moo lati, ne a pikin ya fii tyali, fu di a piki so. Ne a komoto langa langa go wooko na a goon, gi a dda.
eng_text: He answered and said, I will not: but afterward he repented, and went.

djk_text: “We, ne a dda go na a moo nyoni manpikin tu. Ne a sende en fu go wooko na a goon tu. Namo a manpikin ya piki taki: ‘Iya, mi dda! Mi o go. Ma na piki namo a piki, bika a á go seefi seefi.’ ”
eng_text: And he came to the second, and said likewise. And he answered and said, I go, sir: and went not.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi koti a toli taki: “On di fu den tu manpikin ya du san a dda wani?” We, ne den piki en taki: “Awan di be taki, a ná o go, ma toku a go moo lati.” Ne Masaa Jesesi taki: “We, fu tuu, mi e taigi u taki, den gaan polinen sama fu kondee o daai kon de a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu. Ma u dati o fika so.
eng_text: Whether of them twain did the will of his father? They say unto him, The first. Jesus saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That the publicans and the harlots go into the kingdom of God before you.

djk_text: Bika u á si taki, Johanisi taki sani fu Masaa Gadu, ne den dati biibi, no? Weeno! Ma u dati si san pasa de, ne toku u seefi á wani daai libi fu biibi Johanisi.”
eng_text: For John came unto you in the way of righteousness, and ye believed him not: but the publicans and the harlots believed him: and ye, when ye had seen it, repented not afterward, that ye might believe him.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi taki baka taki: “Wan taa ageisi toli e kon ya, fu soi wan sani. Wan gaan masaa be abi wan goon, fu paandi wan sii enke doloifi. Ne a meke wan wooko sani poti ape, fu kwinsi a sii ya kon toon win. Soseefi a lontu a hii goon anga a hii wooko sani ya poti a ini dyali. Ne a meke wan hei osu go a tapu fu den wakiti man oli waki na a goon. Ne a kai wan duupu sama kon poti a hii wooko ya a den ana, fu du. Bika enseefi o go koi a taa kondee.
eng_text: Hear another parable: There was a certain householder, which planted a vineyard, and hedged it round about, and digged a winepress in it, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country:

djk_text: Namo, den sii fu a goon be kon lepi. Na so a yuu doo, fu go booko den kwinsi toon win. Ne a gaan masaa sende en futuboi go a den sama, fu den sende fi en se gi en.
eng_text: And when the time of the fruit drew near, he sent his servants to the husbandmen, that they might receive the fruits of it.

djk_text: Ma den sama feti ogii ogii anga den futuboi fu a gaan masaa, di a sende go. Den fon afu, ne den naki taawan kii anga siton.
eng_text: And the husbandmen took his servants, and beat one, and killed another, and stoned another.

djk_text: Ma toku, a gaan masaa sende moo ipi futuboi go a den sama baka, fu meke den sama sende fi en se gi en. Ma den disi seefi go tuka anga a seefi ogii, di be miti den fosi futuboi di a masaa be sende go.
eng_text: Again, he sent other servants more than the first: and they did unto them likewise.

djk_text: “We, ne a gaan masaa luku taki: ‘Efu mi sende a manpikin fu miseefi go a den sama tu, da den o feele fu du ogii anga en, fu di na a manpikin di miseefi abi.’
eng_text: But last of all he sent unto them his son, saying, They will reverence my son.

djk_text: “Namo den sama si a manpikin e kon. Ne den taki: ‘Oho, luku anda! A gaan masaa sende a manpikin fi en seefi kon a leisi ya. We, disi na awan kodo manpikin di a dda abi, fu poti enke basi, fu taki, gi ala san a dda seefi abi. Meke u kii en, da a goon o fika gi wi.’
eng_text: But when the husbandmen saw the son, they said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and let us seize on his inheritance.

djk_text: We, ne den lulu a manpikin ya, fu te a kon doo. Ne den ali en puu a ini a goon tyai go kii.”
eng_text: And they caught him, and cast him out of the vineyard, and slew him.

djk_text: Namo, ne Masaa Jesesi koti a toli. Ne a akisi den taki: “San u pakisei a gaan masaa o du, te enseefi o kon a den sama ya?”
eng_text: When the lord therefore of the vineyard cometh, what will he do unto those husbandmen?

djk_text: Namo den piki en taki: “A gaan masaa ya ati musu boon tuutuu. Da a musu kii den takuu ati sama di be e luku a goon de. Soseefi, a o poti a goon a ini taa sama ana, di sa wani gi en, fi en se.”
eng_text: They say unto him, He will miserably destroy those wicked men, and will let out his vineyard unto other husbandmen, which shall render him the fruits in their seasons.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi taigi den baka taki: “U á leisi san sikiifi a Masaa Gadu Buku, no? A sikiifi taki: ‘Disi na a siton di meseeman be oli fu wan soso sani. Na dati daai kon toon a siton futu fu a hii osu. Na so Masaa du en wooko. A foondoo gi wi, fu si.’
eng_text: Jesus saith unto them, Did ye never read in the scriptures, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner: this is the Lord's doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?

djk_text: We, meke mi e taigi u! Masaa Gadu o fika u fu a peesi ya a wan se. Da a o komoto go anga a Nyun Tii fi en a taa taa foluku sama, di wani tan enke fa a wani.
eng_text: Therefore say I unto you, The kingdom of God shall be taken from you, and given to a nation bringing forth the fruits thereof.

djk_text: Bika sama di o kai na a siton ya tapu, o booko pisipisi. Soseefi, efu a siton ya kai a wan sama tapu, da a o masi a sama de fini fini.”
eng_text: And whosoever shall fall on this stone shall be broken: but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.

djk_text: Namo den hei apaiti begiman anga den Faliseiman aliki den toli fu Masaa Jesesi ya, te a kaba. Ne den taki: “Na wi ai poti na ageisi toli de so.”
eng_text: And when the chief priests and Pharisees had heard his parables, they perceived that he spake of them.

djk_text: Da na leti ape kaba den be wani kisi Masaa Jesesi wanten. Ma den á kisi en ape. Bika den be e feele a foluku di e oli Masaa Jesesi enke wan apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: But when they sought to lay hands on him, they feared the multitude, because they took him for a prophet.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi gi wan taa ageisi toli baka, fu leli den sama wan sani.
eng_text: And Jesus answered and spake unto them again by parables, and said,

djk_text: A taki: “A Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu tan enke fa a toli fu a kownu ya o waka. A kownu ya be abi wan manpikin. Ne a manpikin yuu kisi fu teke wan uman libi. Namo a kownu sete wan toow osu, fu oli gi en.
eng_text: The kingdom of heaven is like unto a certain king, which made a marriage for his son,

djk_text: Ala sani fu a fesa seeka te a kaba. Ne a kownu sende futuboi go kai wan paitei sama, fu kon nyan toow osu. Ma den sama ya á wani kon.
eng_text: And sent forth his servants to call them that were bidden to the wedding: and they would not come.

djk_text: A kownu sende futuboi ete wan leisi go kai den baka taki: ‘U kon! Mi seeka ala nyanyan sani, fu oli a feisiti kaba. Mi kii kaw anga taa taa fatu meti boli! U kon piisii na a fesa!’
eng_text: Again, he sent forth other servants, saying, Tell them which are bidden, Behold, I have prepared my dinner: my oxen and my fatlings are killed, and all things are ready: come unto the marriage.

djk_text: Ma winsi fa den futuboi go taki dati, toku den sama á wani kon. Bika den abi taa taa fuka e du. Taawan taki, ai go a goon. Taawan abi taa taa sowtu sani e du.
eng_text: But they made light of it, and went their ways, one to his farm, another to his merchandise:

djk_text: Wan paitei fu den sama dati kisi den futuboi fu a kownu di a sende go, wai kon. Ne den taki, den o mesaandi den. We, tuutuu den du anga den, te den kii son fu den seefi.
eng_text: And the remnant took his servants, and entreated them spitefully, and slew them.

djk_text: “Namo a kownu ati boon tuutuu. Ne a sende suudati go kii den sama di kii den futuboi fi en baka. Den suudati boon a hii foto fu den sama de paata a doti.
eng_text: But when the king heard thereof, he was wroth: and he sent forth his armies, and destroyed those murderers, and burned up their city.

djk_text: Namo a kownu kai wan duupu taa futuboi kon. Ne a taigi den taki: ‘Ala sani fu a feisiti de seeka seeka. Ma den sama di mi be kai fu kon, den á waiti fu kon doo ya.
eng_text: Then saith he to his servants, The wedding is ready, but they which were bidden were not worthy.

djk_text: Da u go waka na a hii ganda kai ibii sama di u si anda, fu kon nyan a feisiti.’
eng_text: Go ye therefore into the highways, and as many as ye shall find, bid to the marriage.

djk_text: “We, ne den wookoman go kai ala sama di den miti, fu go na a toow osu. Namo a toow osu bigi te, ai meke huuw anga sama. Bika ala sowtu sama be kon, bun ati wan anga takuu ati wan.
eng_text: So those servants went out into the highways, and gathered together all as many as they found, both bad and good: and the wedding was furnished with guests.

djk_text: “Namo a kownu seefi waka kon doo a ini a toow osu, fu luku sama di kon. Da a si taki, den sama wei toow osu koosi, fiti enke fa a mu de. Ma na wan kodo sama de ape á be wei bunbun koosi.
eng_text: And when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man which had not on a wedding garment:

djk_text: Namo a kownu go akisi a sama ya taki: ‘Mi baala? Na so yu wei kon a mi feisiti?’ Namo a sama taampu diin namo, a nái piki a kownu seefi.
eng_text: And he saith unto him, Friend, how camest thou in hither not having a wedding garment? And he was speechless.

djk_text: “We, ne a kownu sende en futuboi taki: ‘U kisi en! U tei en futu anga en ana! Da u iti en go na a gaan dunguu a doose anda. Na soso kee anga kaw tifi de anda.’ ”
eng_text: Then said the king to the servants, Bind him hand and foot, and take him away, and cast him into outer darkness; there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi koti a toli leti ape taki: “Na soseefi Masaa Gadu kai tyaipi tyaipi sama kon. Ma a ná ala den doo peesi, fu Masaa Gadu teke toon sama fi en seefi.”
eng_text: For many are called, but few are chosen.

djk_text: Namo den Faliseiman kon gwe. Ne den gwe go kai pakisei luku, fa fu akisi Masaa Jesesi wan sani, fu a piki fasi enseefi.
eng_text: Then went the Pharisees, and took counsel how they might entangle him in his talk.

djk_text: Namo den sende bakaman fu den go makandii anga wantu politikiman fu Kownu Helowdesi. Ne den taigi Masaa Jesesi taki: “Fa u sabi yu, da yu na wan gaan letiopu libisama! Yu e leli sama soso tuutuu sani fu Masaa Gadu. Soseefi yu nái kuutu konkuu. Bika yu e soi ibii sama di doo yu, leti san i mu soi en. Da i nái luku taki, disi ofu dati.
eng_text: And they sent out unto him their disciples with the Herodians, saying, Master, we know that thou art true, and teachest the way of God in truth, neither carest thou for any man: for thou regardest not the person of men.

djk_text: We! Taigi u, efu a de fanowdu fu u pai a moo gaan kownu a Loma Foto, a lantimoni.”
eng_text: Tell us therefore, What thinkest thou? Is it lawful to give tribute unto Caesar, or not?

djk_text: Ma ala fa den kon akisi Masaa Jesesi a sani ya, da a be sabi kaba taki, na wani den wani koli en, fu a piki sani di á bun. Namo a piki den taki: “U bidiigiman! Na wani u wani fasi mi kisi so?
eng_text: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, Why tempt ye me, ye hypocrites?

djk_text: U tyai a pikin moni di u e pai a lantimoni seefi kon, gi mi, osi?” Namo den sama kon doo anga wan fu den moni ya Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: Shew me the tribute money. And they brought unto him a penny.

djk_text: Ne a teke a moni luku, te a kaba. Ne a taki: “Sama na a sama, di fesi maiki na a moni tapu ya?”
eng_text: And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription?

djk_text: We, ne den piki en taki: “A sama de? A fesi di maiki na a moni tapu de, na fu a moo gaan kownu a Loma Foto!” We, ne Masaa Jesesi piki den baka taki: “Efu ne en fesi de na a moni tapu, da a moni ne en sani! Da na musu u musu fu gi en, en sani di a abi! Ma san u dati abi fu gi Masaa Gadu, dati na san de fu Masaa Gadu. Na dati u mu gi Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: They say unto him, Caesar's. Then saith he unto them, Render therefore unto Caesar the things which are Caesar's; and unto God the things that are God's.

djk_text: We, di Masaa Jesesi piki so, ne den foondoo, te ná sipowtu. Namo den fika en, ne den gwe.
eng_text: When they had heard these words, they marvelled, and left him, and went their way.

djk_text: A seefi dei de, ne a kulu fu den Saduseiman kon doo a Masaa Jesesi. Den sama ya e biibi taki, te wan sama dede, da a tan dede. Noiti moo a sa weki moo.
eng_text: The same day came to him the Sadducees, which say that there is no resurrection, and asked him,

djk_text: We, ne den taigi Masaa Jesesi taki: “Mosesi be fika wan weiti gi wi. Ai soi san fu du, te manengee dede fika en uman, sondee pikin. Da na a baala di a man ya abi fu teke a uman libi, fu meke pikin gi a dede baala.
eng_text: Saying, Master, Moses said, If a man die, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.

djk_text: Ma yee ya! Seibin baala be de. Ne a moo gaan wan kon dede, fika en uman sondee pikin. Ne a baala di waka ne en baka teke a uman libi.
eng_text: Now there were with us seven brethren: and the first, when he had married a wife, deceased, and, having no issue, left his wife unto his brother:

djk_text: Baka wan pisiten, a baala de seefi kon dede, sondee pikin anga a uman. Meke u taki, a waka so anga ala den taa baala. Bika ala dede, sondee meke pikin anga a uman.
eng_text: Likewise the second also, and the third, unto the seventh.

djk_text: Da te fu kaba, a uman seefi kon dede tu.
eng_text: And last of all the woman died also.

djk_text: We, yu á taki, dedesama o weki wan dei baka, no? Da den seibin baala ya seefi musu weki tu. Da on di fu den seibin i pakisei taki, o abi a uman enke uman. Bika ala den seibin be libi anga en a ini den libiten.”
eng_text: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife shall she be of the seven? for they all had her.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “U nái fusutan Masaa Gadu toli! Bika u á sabi san sikiifi a Masaa Gadu Buku. Soseefi u á sabi taki, Masaa Gadu abi makiti, fu du ala sani.
eng_text: Jesus answered and said unto them, Ye do err, not knowing the scriptures, nor the power of God.

djk_text: Bika i si den sama di o weki baka? Na Masaa Gadu Kondee a tapu den o go tan enke Masaa Gadu Kondee Basiya anda. Da fu teke uman ofu man libi, dati á sa de anda gi den moo.
eng_text: For in the resurrection they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are as the angels of God in heaven.

djk_text: Soseefi u á leisi san sikiifi fu dedesama a Masaa Gadu Buku, no? Bika Masaa Gadu taki de taki:
eng_text: But as touching the resurrection of the dead, have ye not read that which was spoken unto you by God, saying,

djk_text: ‘Mi na a Gadu fu Abalaham, Isaki anga Jakopu.’ Da disi e soi taki Masaa Gadu a ná a Gadu fu sama di dede, da a kaba. Ma en na a Gadu fu sama di winsi den dede, toku den e libi ete.”
eng_text: I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob? God is not the God of the dead, but of the living.

djk_text: We, di Masaa Jesesi piki so, ne ala sama di be de ape foondoo, te ná sipowtu.
eng_text: And when the multitude heard this, they were astonished at his doctrine.

djk_text: Namo den Faliseiman seefi kon yee taki, Masaa Jesesi tapu den Saduseisama mofu, te den á poi piki en baka. Namo denseefi feti lon kon doo.
eng_text: But when the Pharisees had heard that he had put the Sadducees to silence, they were gathered together.

djk_text: Wan fu den, di be kon de na wan leliman fu Dyuweiti. Na dati go fii Masaa Jesesi mofu luku, fu a sa taki sani fasi enseefi.
eng_text: Then one of them, which was a lawyer, asked him a question, tempting him, and saying,

djk_text: Namo a akisi Masaa Jesesi taki: “On di fu den weiti fu Masaa Gadu moo bigi, fu oli?”
eng_text: Master, which is the great commandment in the law?

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Na di taki: ‘U mu lobi Masaa Gadu anga u hii ati, u hii fii anga u fusutan.’
eng_text: Jesus said unto him, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind.

djk_text: Na dati na a weiti di moo bigi.
eng_text: This is the first and great commandment.

djk_text: Ma ete wan weiti de fanowdu fu oli enke dati tu. Dati taki: ‘U mu lobi ala taa sama enke fa u lobi u seefi.’
eng_text: And the second is like unto it, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

djk_text: Bika na den tu weiti ya, na a hii mama fu den weiti di Mosesi anga taa taa fositen apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu be sikiifi.”
eng_text: On these two commandments hang all the law and the prophets.

djk_text: Namo, da den Faliseiman be de ape makandii kaba. Ne Masaa Jesesi seefi o go akisi den wan sani tu.
eng_text: While the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them,

djk_text: A taki: “Fa u membee fu a Kelestesi seefi? Sowtu gaansama bakaten paansu pikin a de?” Namo den piki en taki: “Na wan bakaten manpikin fu Kownu Dafeti paansu.”
eng_text: Saying, What think ye of Christ? whose son is he? They say unto him, The Son of David.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi piki baka taki: “Da saide a Apaiti Jeje fu Masaa Gadu be piki Kownu Dafeti seefi, fu kai a Kelestesi, Masaa? Bika Kownu Dafeti seefi be taki a ini Masaa Gadu Buku taki:
eng_text: He saith unto them, How then doth David in spirit call him Lord, saying,

djk_text: ‘Masaa Gadu taigi mi Masaa taki: “Sidon a mi leti ana se ya, te enke mi poti ala yu feyanti a yu futu ondoo.” ’
eng_text: The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool?

djk_text: Na so Dafeti seefi be kai a Kelestesi ‘Masaa.’ Da fa u ya sa taki, a Kelestesi na soso wan bakaten manpikin fu Kownu Dafeti paansu namo, da a kaba?”
eng_text: If David then call him Lord, how is he his son?

djk_text: We, di Masaa Jesesi kaba taki so, ne den á sabi san fu piki moo. Soseefi den e feele tu, fu sete taa sitee anga en, senten a dei de.
eng_text: And no man was able to answer him a word, neither durst any man from that day forth ask him any more questions.

djk_text: Namo, ne Masaa Jesesi daai taki anga a foluku fu kondee ape, makandii anga den bakaman fi en.
eng_text: Then spake Jesus to the multitude, and to his disciples,

djk_text: A taki: “Den leliman fu Dyuweiti anga den Faliseiman, teke Mosesi peesi tuu, fu leli sama dini Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Saying, The scribes and the Pharisees sit in Moses' seat:

djk_text: Da u mu e teke san den e taki. Ma luku bun! U á mu teke a sowtu fasi, fa denseefi e libi. Bika den seefi nái waka enke a leli di den e gi.
eng_text: All therefore whatsoever they bid you observe, that observe and do; but do not ye after their works: for they say, and do not.

djk_text: Ma na taanga weiti den e poti gi sama, fu oli. Ma denseefi nái lobi wan finga a den weiti de, fu meke sama poi si a den, fa a weiti mu oli seefi.
eng_text: For they bind heavy burdens and grievous to be borne, and lay them on men's shoulders; but they themselves will not move them with one of their fingers.

djk_text: “Da na fu sama ain, meke den e du sani. Bika den e sikiifi Masaa Gadu weiti poti a pampila, tei na ana anga fesi ede. Soseefi den e wei apaiti sowtu koosi tu.
eng_text: But all their works they do for to be seen of men: they make broad their phylacteries, and enlarge the borders of their garments,

djk_text: Soseefi den e teke peesi sidon a den moo bunbun peesi fu tafaa sikin a ini keliki. Soseefi te feisiti doo, da na den e teke den moo bunbun peesi a tafaa sikin.
eng_text: And love the uppermost rooms at feasts, and the chief seats in the synagogues,

djk_text: Soseefi, den lobi te ala sama di miti anga den a wowoyo e kai den, Mesiti. Bika den wani ala sama e si den enke gaan bigiman.
eng_text: And greetings in the markets, and to be called of men, Rabbi, Rabbi.

djk_text: Ma u enke bakaman fu mi dati á mu tan enke den. Bika u ala ya dati na baala anga baala. Da u á mu meke taawan poti u e kai, Mesiti ya. Bika na wan kodo Masaa fu gi leli namo u ala de abi.
eng_text: But be not ye called Rabbi: for one is your Master, even Christ; and all ye are brethren.

djk_text: Soseefi, na wankodo Tata di de a tapu namo u ala de abi. Da u á mu si taawan ya enke a sowtu Tata de.
eng_text: And call no man your father upon the earth: for one is your Father, which is in heaven.

djk_text: Soseefi u á mu meke taawan poti u e kai, edeman fu gi leli, tu. Bika na mi, a Kelestesi wawan na a edeman, fu gi leli.
eng_text: Neither be ye called masters: for one is your Master, even Christ.

djk_text: Ma a wi mindii ya, efu yu wani de basi a taawan tapu, da na yu mu saka yuseefi e dini den taawan.
eng_text: But he that is greatest among you shall be your servant.

djk_text: Na sama di e saka denseefi so, na den Masaa Gadu o gi wan hei peesi. Ma Masaa Gadu o saka ala sama di e hei denseefi, poti a ondoo fu ala den taawan.”
eng_text: And whosoever shall exalt himself shall be abased; and he that shall humble himself shall be exalted.

djk_text: Soseefi Masaa Jesesi taki go doo taki: “Ma heelu fu u, leliman fu Dyuweiti anga Faliseiman! Bika u na bidiigiman! U taampu e tapu pasi gi den sama di wani kon a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: But woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye shut up the kingdom of heaven against men: for ye neither go in yourselves, neither suffer ye them that are entering to go in.

djk_text: We! Heelu fu u, leliman fu Dyuweiti anga Faliseiman! Bika u na bidiigiman! U sidon e nyan ala sani fu pooti uman di man dede fika a ganda. Da u sidon e begi gaan lolo begi gi den baka, enke u na bunbun sama. We, den sani ya o meke Masaa Gadu gi u moo gaan sitaafu.
eng_text: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayer: therefore ye shall receive the greater damnation.

djk_text: “Fu tuu! Heelu fu u, leliman fu Dyuweiti anga Faliseiman! Bika u na bidiigiman! U e waka e lontu goontapu, fu suku sama tyai kon toon u bakaman. Da u e meke sowan sama kon ogii tu boo moo u seefi. Da enseefi e kon lepi fu go teke sitaafu a didibii faya, enke u de tu.
eng_text: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye compass sea and land to make one proselyte, and when he is made, ye make him twofold more the child of hell than yourselves.

djk_text: “Da heelu fu u! Bika u na beendiman di nái si, ma toku, u e suku fu tyai taawan waka a pasi. Bika u de ape e leli sama lei sani taki: ‘Den sa sweli taki, anga a nen fu a Mama Keliki taki, na so mi o du!’ Da efu den á du enke fa den be sweli, da a ná ogii. Ma san ogii, na te den be sa sweli taki, anga a nen fu gowtu di de a ini a Mama Keliki.
eng_text: Woe unto you, ye blind guides, which say, Whosoever shall swear by the temple, it is nothing; but whosoever shall swear by the gold of the temple, he is a debtor!

djk_text: We, u beendiman de! Na law u e law? U taigi mi! A Mama Keliki ofu a gowtu di de a ini, on di e meke a taawan toon apaiti sani gi Masaa Gadu?
eng_text: Ye fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gold, or the temple that sanctifieth the gold?

djk_text: U taki tu taki: ‘Sama sa sweli taki, anga a nen fu a apaiti begi tafaa pe den e poti meti boon, enke paiman gi Masaa Gadu.’ Da efu den á du enke fa den be sweli de, da a ná o ogii. Ma san ogii, na te den be sa sweli taki: ‘Anga a nen fu a meti di e boon enke paiman gi Masaa Gadu de.’
eng_text: And, Whosoever shall swear by the altar, it is nothing; but whosoever sweareth by the gift that is upon it, he is guilty.

djk_text: We! U na beendiman! Bika u piki mi! A meti di den poti e boon enke paiman gi Masaa Gadu ofu a apaiti begi tafaa? On di fu den tu e meke a taawan toon wan apaiti sani gi Masaa Gadu?
eng_text: Ye fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifieth the gift?

djk_text: U nái si taki, na a apaiti begi tafaa e meke a meti toon wan apaiti sani gi Masaa Gadu, no? We, da efi i teke a apaiti begi tafaa sweli, da a meti seefi á de a ini a sweli tu, no?
eng_text: Whoso therefore shall swear by the altar, sweareth by it, and by all things thereon.

djk_text: Soseefi, efi i sweli taki: ‘Anga a nen fu a Mama Keliki.’ Da Masaa Gadu seefi de a ini a sweli de. Bika a dati na a tanpeesi fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: And whoso shall swear by the temple, sweareth by it, and by him that dwelleth therein.

djk_text: Soseefi, efi i sweli taki: ‘Anga a nen fu Masaa Gadu Kondee.’ Da Masaa Gadu seefi de a ini a sweli de. Bika na anda Masaa Gadu sidon ne en kownu sutuu, fu tii ala sani.
eng_text: And he that shall swear by heaven, sweareth by the throne of God, and by him that sitteth thereon.

djk_text: “We, heelu fu u, leliman fu Dyuweiti anga Faliseiman! Bika u na bidiigiman. U e du wan bun, te u goon nyanyan lepi. Bika ibii sani di a goon puu, da u e paati dati a ini tin pisi. Da u e teke wan fu den tin pisi tyai go gi Masaa Gadu, enke fa weiti taki. Ma u e wai a mama fu Masaa Gadu weiti seefi poti a wanse. Bika dati taki, u mu teke tyali ati anga letiopu fasi libi anga biibi Masaa Gadu tu. Na so u be mu libi, sondee fu fika bun, di u gwenti du de kaba.
eng_text: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye pay tithe of mint and anise and cummin, and have omitted the weightier matters of the law, judgment, mercy, and faith: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.

djk_text: Ma tuutuu! U na tiiman di beendi fu si sani! U gei beendi sama di teke koosi, fu doo wataa puu ala pikin pikin feefee. Ma a nái si a gaan meti seefi di de a ini a wataa, fu puu. Ne di a nái si en, ne a misi diingi dati gwili.
eng_text: Ye blind guides, which strain at a gnat, and swallow a camel.

djk_text: “We, heelu fu u, leliman fu Dyuweiti anga Faliseiman! Bika u na bidiigiman. U gei sama di lobi wasi doose fu kan anga beenki, te a kiin. Ma ai e fika inise tyobo tyobo anga soso doti. Bika te sama luku u a doose, da u e gei kele kele letiopu libisama. Ma inise fu u lai anga soso ogii anga fufuu pakisei.
eng_text: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye make clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and excess.

djk_text: U beendi Faliseiman de! A be sa moo bun fu kiin inise fu u, da doose seefi be musu kon kiin tu.
eng_text: Thou blind Pharisee, cleanse first that which is within the cup and platter, that the outside of them may be clean also.

djk_text: “We, heelu fu u, leliman fu Dyuweiti anga Faliseiman! Bika u na bidiigiman. U gei wan geebi. U sabi te den wei geebi fu dedesama, te a kaba? Da doose e sete moi moi. Ma luku go a ini namo, i sa si! A fuu anga soso poli dede tingi sani.
eng_text: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are like unto whited sepulchres, which indeed appear beautiful outward, but are within full of dead men's bones, and of all uncleanness.

djk_text: Bika te sama luku u de so, da u e gei kele kele letiopu libisama. Ma toku, lei manii anga soso ogii fuu u ati.
eng_text: Even so ye also outwardly appear righteous unto men, but within ye are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.

djk_text: “Leliman fu Dyuweiti anga Faliseiman! Heelu fu u! Bika u na bidiigiman. U e waka e wei den geebi fu den fositen apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu, te a moi. Soseefi u e go wei den geebi fu den taa taa letiopu sama.
eng_text: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! because ye build the tombs of the prophets, and garnish the sepulchres of the righteous,

djk_text: Da, te u kaba wei den so, da u taampu e taki: ‘Kee! Na wi be mu de a libi na a ten fu wi avo gaansama, baa! Wegi! Da u á be o kii den apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu ya.’
eng_text: And say, If we had been in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.

djk_text: We na useefi mofu e kai u seefi bakaten pikin enke paansu fu den fositen sama, di kii den apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu de. Da a ná abi misi! U na tuutuu baka bakaten paansu pikin fu den tuu.
eng_text: Wherefore ye be witnesses unto yourselves, that ye are the children of them which killed the prophets.

djk_text: Da meke ai piki gi u naamo, man! Bika na so u avo be sete. Da a kon, na u dati mu kii go doo, fu meke a doo maiki.
eng_text: Fill ye up then the measure of your fathers.

djk_text: “U takuu tetei sineki! Masaa Gadu o sitaafu u a didibii faya, tu! Fa u sa pakisei taki, Masaa Gadu sa fika u kookoo?
eng_text: Ye serpents, ye generation of vipers, how can ye escape the damnation of hell?

djk_text: Bika u seefi o du gaan ogii anga somen letiopu sama na a ten ya tu. Mi o sende somen sowtu wookoman fu mi kon a u. Da u o yaki den puu a ini den foto fu u. U o wipi somen fu den a ini den keliki osu fu u. Soseefi, u o sipikii somen fu den kii a koloisi tu.
eng_text: Wherefore, behold, I send unto you prophets, and wise men, and scribes: and some of them ye shall kill and crucify; and some of them shall ye scourge in your synagogues, and persecute them from city to city:

djk_text: Kaba! Da na leti fa u avo gaansama mu kisi sitaafu a Masaa Gadu, na a seefi fasi u dati sa fiti fu kisi sitaafu tu. Bika u ala o pai fu a buulu fu Abeli, a fosi letiopu sama di u be kii. U o pai fu dati te go doo a buulu fu Sakalia, a pikin fu Belekiya di u be kii koosube fu a apaiti begi tafaa a Mama Keliki.
eng_text: That upon you may come all the righteous blood shed upon the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel unto the blood of Zacharias son of Barachias, whom ye slew between the temple and the altar.

djk_text: Fu tuu! U mu aliki bun san mi e taki ya! Bika u sama fu a ten ya seefi o kisi a sitaafu di mi taki de tu.”
eng_text: Verily I say unto you, All these things shall come upon this generation.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi daai wasikoi den sama fu Jelusalem Foto taki: “Den sama fu Jelusalem Foto! A ná u dati e waka e kii somen apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu, no? Weeno! U e naki somen sama di Masaa Gadu sende kon, fu taki sani fu Masaa Gadu, kii anga siton. Ma i sabi onmen leisi, mi ya suku, fu meke u ali kon tan a mi ondoo, meke mi solugu. Bika mi be wani poti u solugu a mi ondoo, enke fa mama foo e tapu en pikin solugu. Ma kweti! U á wani dati.
eng_text: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, thou that killest the prophets, and stonest them which are sent unto thee, how often would I have gathered thy children together, even as a hen gathereth her chickens under her wings, and ye would not!

djk_text: Na dati meke Masaa Gadu o fika u.
eng_text: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate.

djk_text: Da u ná o si mi moo, te enke u sa bali taki: ‘Seigi fu Awan di e kon a ini a nen fu Masaa.’ ”
eng_text: For I say unto you, Ye shall not see me henceforth, till ye shall say, Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi waka go a doose fu a Mama Keliki. We, ne den bakaman fi en seefi teke ne en baka. Da den e gi toli anga Masaa Jesesi. Soseefi den e soi en taki, a Mama Keliki na wan tuutuu moi osu.
eng_text: And Jesus went out, and departed from the temple: and his disciples came to him for to shew him the buildings of the temple.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “U si fa a moi tuu? Ma fu tuu a ná o taampu ape moi moi so, go doo. Bika fetiman o komoto kon lulu lulu en booko doo doti.”
eng_text: And Jesus said unto them, See ye not all these things? verily I say unto you, There shall not be left here one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi waka go doo a peesi den e kai Oleifi Mongo. Na ape a siton, ne den bakaman fi en waka go doo ne en anda tu. A di den wawan de ape anga Masaa Jesesi, ne den akisi en taki: “I sa taigi wi on ten a toli di i taki de o pasa? Soseefi, i sa taigi wi san na a ten, di yu o kon anga a kaba fu goontapu tu?”
eng_text: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives, the disciples came unto him privately, saying, Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign of thy coming, and of the end of the world?

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi wasikoi den taki: “Wan sani! U mu e luku bun namo! U mu luku bun, fu sama á fende pasi koli u kisi!
eng_text: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Take heed that no man deceive you.

djk_text: Bika somen sama o kon enke na den na a Kelestesi. Na so den o wooko anga mi nen, fu koli sama kisi. Da den o fende somen sama, koli waka a den baka.
eng_text: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.

djk_text: Soseefi oloku sa e bali na ala se fu goontapu. Ma u á mu dyombo fu dati. Bika ala den sani ya mu pasa leti so. Ma toku, da a ná kaba yuu fu goontapu doo ape ete.
eng_text: And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that ye be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet.

djk_text: Bika foluku o feti ete anga foluku. Soseefi den kondee anga kondee fu goontapu sa e feti anga denseefi. Gaan angiiten o naki somen peesi fu goontapu tu. Soseefi doti o go e seke e piiti son pisi fu goontapu.
eng_text: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes, in divers places.

djk_text: Ma ala den sowtu banowtu ya na bigin fu a gaan banowtu ten, di de fu kon seefi. Bika a banowtu fu goontapu o waka enke a hii banowtu di wan bee uman e fii.
eng_text: All these are the beginning of sorrows.

djk_text: “Soseefi sama o poti u a kuutu fesi, fu di u e biibi mi ede. Den o pina u, te enke den e kii u seefi. Bika a ten de, da ala sama o buuse u, fu mi ede.
eng_text: Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted, and shall kill you: and ye shall be hated of all nations for my name's sake.

djk_text: Da somen biibisama o lasi biibi a mi. Soseefi, son biibisama o sete buuse taa biibiwan. Soseefi biibiwan o de, di o tyai taawan go konkuu gi sama di nái biibi mi.
eng_text: And then shall many be offended, and shall betray one another, and shall hate one another.

djk_text: Soseefi, yu o abi sama di o meke enke na den na apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu. Da den o fende somen sama koli poti e biibi den.
eng_text: And many false prophets shall rise, and shall deceive many.

djk_text: We, fu di a ten sa e ogii so naamo, da somen sama o kaba fu wooko anga lobi fu taawan.
eng_text: And because iniquity shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold.

djk_text: Ma ala sama di sa tei ati fu oli doo sa fende a libi fu tego.
eng_text: But he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.

djk_text: Da a Bun Nyunsu di e taki fu a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu seefi mu paati, doo hii goontapu, fu ala sama yee en. Fosi, da a kaba yuu fu goontapu sa kon.”
eng_text: And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations; and then shall the end come.

djk_text: Soseefi Masaa Jesesi taki ete taki: “Ma boiti ala san mi taki de, da wan taa ogii o pasa na a ten de tu, di o dyombo sama. Bika ogii ati sama o kon poli a apaiti peesi fu a Mama Keliki wan tuutuu fasi. Den o kon poti wan sani di á fiti ape. Ala dati o waka enke fa a apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu di den e kai Daniyeli be sikiifi a fositen taki, dati musu fu pasa.” A sama di e leisi a sani ya, mu leisi en bunbun fu fusutan san ai leisi.
eng_text: When ye therefore shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, stand in the holy place, (whoso readeth, let him understand:)

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taki go doo taki: “Te a ogii de o pasa kaba, da u á mu lasi ten e daai daai a ganda ya moo. Ma u mu lon komoto ape wanten wanten gwe. Meke sama di de a Judeja pisiwataa lowe go kibii, a den mongo.
eng_text: Then let them which be in Judaea flee into the mountains:

djk_text: Soseefi sama di sidon a osu, a sodoo á mu saka go daai daai a ini osu, fu suku sani tyai lowe tu.
eng_text: Let him which is on the housetop not come down to take any thing out of his house:

djk_text: Soseefi, sama di o de a goon e wooko, á mu go a osu go lasi ten, fu teke koosi tyai lowe tu.
eng_text: Neither let him which is in the field return back to take his clothes.

djk_text: A hii takuu ten de, sa tyali gi den uman di de anga bee, na a ten de. Soseefi a sa tyali tu, fu den mma di abi pikin a bobi, na a ten de.
eng_text: And woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!

djk_text: Ma soseefi, da u mu begi taki, a takuu ten de á kai na a koo pisiten fu a yali. Soseefi, u mu begi, fu a á kai a wan kina dei.
eng_text: But pray ye that your flight be not in the winter, neither on the sabbath day:

djk_text: Bika goontapu o toon wan gaan banowtu peesi, fu tan. A sa de a moo taanga ten, fu senten goontapu meke, te kon miti nownow. Soseefi, da noiti moo sowan taanga ten sa kon tu.
eng_text: For then shall be great tribulation, such as was not since the beginning of the world to this time, no, nor ever shall be.

djk_text: Ma na fu den biibisama ede, meke Masaa Gadu satu a hii banowtu ten ya. Bika efu Masaa Gadu á be du dati, da ná wan sama be o fika a libi.
eng_text: And except those days should be shortened, there should no flesh be saved: but for the elect's sake those days shall be shortened.

djk_text: “Da efu wan sama taigi u taki: ‘Luku, a Kelestesi leti ya!’ ofu ‘A Kelestesi de so!’ U á mu biibi den, kweti kweti!
eng_text: Then if any man shall say unto you, Lo, here is Christ, or there; believe it not.

djk_text: Bika somen sama o opo e kai denseefi a Kelestesi. Soseefi, sama o opo e pee gaan apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu. Da den sa e du somen gaan foondoo sani. Da efu a be kan, da den be o koli den sama fu Masaa Gadu, di a teke toon fi en seefi tu.”
eng_text: For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets, and shall shew great signs and wonders; insomuch that, if it were possible, they shall deceive the very elect.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den baka taki: “U luku! Mi taigi u ala den sani ya a fesi!
eng_text: Behold, I have told you before.

djk_text: “Bika sama sa kon taigi u taki: ‘A Kelestesi kon, meke u go luku en a ini a gaan sabana ini.’ Soseefi den sa taki: ‘A Kelestesi kon, meke u go luku en a wan kibii kibii peesi.’ U á mu biibi den seefi seefi!
eng_text: Wherefore if they shall say unto you, Behold, he is in the desert; go not forth: behold, he is in the secret chambers; believe it not.

djk_text: Bika, te a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya o kon baka, da a ná o de wan kibii sani. A o de kiinkiin fu ala sama fu goontapu si. A o de leti enke te tapu koti faya na a se fu san opo, da den e si en, a te na se fu san dongo.
eng_text: For as the lightning cometh out of the east, and shineth even unto the west; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.

djk_text: Na pe wan meti dede fika, na a pe tingi foo e kon.”
eng_text: For wheresoever the carcase is, there will the eagles be gathered together.

djk_text: Soseefi Masaa Jesesi taki go doo taki: “Te di ala a hii banowtu ten ya o pasa, ‘da a san fesi o dunguu. Da a mun ná o kiin peesi moo tu. Da den sitali di de a tapu o komoto a den peesi kai. Soseefi ala sani fu tapu o seke komoto a den tanpeesi.’
eng_text: Immediately after the tribulation of those days shall the sun be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light, and the stars shall fall from heaven, and the powers of the heavens shall be shaken:

djk_text: “Bakadati, da wan maiki o soi a tapu taki, a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya e kon. Da den sama fu goontapu o biti finga anga tyali tuutuu te, da den á sabi san fu du. Bika a o kon anga ala a makiti, anga ala a dyendee di Masaa Gadu abi.
eng_text: And then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven: and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn, and they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.

djk_text: Soseefi, da wan gaan tutu o piki a tapu tu. Da a o sende den Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee di e dini en, kon a goontapu, fu piki ala den sama fi en, puu na ala uku fu goontapu tyai kon ne en.”
eng_text: And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den baka taki: “A figasii bon sa leli u wan sani. Te den taka fu a bon ya kengi teke nyun uwii, da u sabi taki, moi ten fu a yali e kon.
eng_text: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When his branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is nigh:

djk_text: We, te u si ala den sani di mi taki ya e pasa tu, da u mu sabi taki, kaba yuu fu goontapu de koosube fu kon tu.
eng_text: So likewise ye, when ye shall see all these things, know that it is near, even at the doors.

djk_text: Fu tuutuu mi e taigi u, den paansu sama ya ná o dede fosi den sani di mi e taigi u ya pasa.
eng_text: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass, till all these things be fulfilled.

djk_text: Bika goontapu anga ala taa sani, di de sa kaba wan dei. Ma den wowtu di mi taki o tan go doo, fu tego.”
eng_text: Heaven and earth shall pass away, but my words shall not pass away.

djk_text: Soseefi Masaa Jesesi soi den ete taki: “Ala san mi taki ya o pasa. Ma sama á sabi a dei di den o pasa, boiti mi Tata, Masaa Gadu a tapu wawan. A Manpikin seefi anga den Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee di e dini Masaa Gadu seefi á sabi a dei tu.
eng_text: But of that day and hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels of heaven, but my Father only.

djk_text: “Ma mi sa taigi u namo fa ala sani o waka a goontapu fosi a konbaka fu a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya. Sani o waka enke fa a be waka na a ten fu Nowa.
eng_text: But as the days of Noe were, so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.

djk_text: Den sama á be wani teke a wasikoi fu Nowa. Ma den be e libi takuu go doo, enke fa den be gwenti. Soso nyan anga diingi anga toow sani be de a den ede. Ma wan dei, ne Nowa doo ede saa, go a ini a gaan boto di a be meke.
eng_text: For as in the days that were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark,

djk_text: Toku den sama á be teke a wasikoi ete taki, sani o kon miti den. We, ne gaan alen kai tyai wataa kon sungu goontapu, kaba den a soso. Na soseefi o pasa a goontapu, fu te enke a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya sa daai kon doo baka tu.
eng_text: And knew not until the flood came, and took them all away; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.

djk_text: “A yuu di a o kon, da yu o abi tu manengee de makandii e wooko goon. Te fu den denki, da a o teke wan, ma a taawan a o fika a baka ya.
eng_text: Then shall two be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

djk_text: Soseefi, tu uman seefi o de makandii e mii bolon. Te fu den denki, mi teke wan, ma a taawan a o fika a baka ya.
eng_text: Two women shall be grinding at the mill; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

djk_text: We, da u dati sabi fa sani o waka kaba. Da u mu de seeka seeka kele kele, sidon anga ain e luku mi. Bika u á sabi on dei na a dei, di a Masaa fu u o kon baka.
eng_text: Watch therefore: for ye know not what hour your Lord doth come.

djk_text: “Bika kon u taki, wan sama be sa sabi on yuu fu neti fufuuman o kon fufuu en, da i denki a á be sa de anga ain e lulu en?
eng_text: But know this, that if the goodman of the house had known in what watch the thief would come, he would have watched, and would not have suffered his house to be broken up.

djk_text: Weeno! Ma u dati á sabi on yuu a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya o kon baka. Na dati meke u mu de anga ain, seeka seeka e luku en. Bika a o kon wan yuu di u á poti pakisei.”
eng_text: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.

djk_text: Soseefi Masaa Jesesi taki ete taki: “U aliki ya! Wan masaa fu wan osu be fika en hii osu a baka gi wan futuboi, fu gi ala taa sama a ini a osu nyanyan, na a leti yuu. A futuboi ya be e wooko fitoow fasi, soseefi ai wooko leti.
eng_text: Who then is a faithful and wise servant, whom his lord hath made ruler over his household, to give them meat in due season?

djk_text: We, te a masaa kon doo baka, da seigi o de gi a futuboi de. A masaa o pai en gaan paiman, efu a si taki: ‘Aai! A futuboi ya e wooko enke fa a fiti gi mi.’
eng_text: Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.

djk_text: Da fu tuu, mi e taigi u, a masaa de o poti a futuboi toon a basi di e luku ala en gudu gi en. Na so a masaa ya o du.
eng_text: Verily I say unto you, That he shall make him ruler over all his goods.

djk_text: Ma meke u taki, a futuboi be pakisei takuu taki: ‘Mi masaa ná o kon ete.’ Namo, ne a go bigin nyan, diingi makandii anga duunguman. Soseefi ai fon den taawan a ini a osu fu a masaa. Da san be o pasa anga en?
eng_text: But and if that evil servant shall say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming;

djk_text: We, da a masaa be o kon wan dei di a futuboi ya á poti pakisei. Bika a futuboi seefi á be sabi on dei a masaa o kon baka.
eng_text: The lord of that servant shall come in a day when he looketh not for him, and in an hour that he is not aware of,

djk_text: Da a masaa be o gi en a seefi sitaafu di ala takuu ati sama mu kisi. Dati wani taki, enseefi o biti finga na a peesi pe soso kaw tifi anga tyali de.”
eng_text: And shall cut him asunder, and appoint him his portion with the hypocrites: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi gi den wan ageisi toli, fu soi fa a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu tan. A taki: “A Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu a tapu gei tin pikin umanpikin, di mu go teke a man di o toow fu tyai kon a pe a toow uman de. We, ne den seeka teke den lampu, ne den e go.
eng_text: Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, which took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.

djk_text: Ma namo, da feifi fu den be waka wan don fasi. Bika, den tyai den lampu, ma den á tyai oli moo enke di de a ini den lampu namo.
eng_text: And five of them were wise, and five were foolish.

djk_text: Ma den feifi taawan be waka wan koni fasi anga ala fusutan. Bika boiti a oli di de a ini den lampu, da den tyai taa oli ete a ini bataa.
eng_text: But the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.

djk_text: “We, na so den go miti a man di o toow. Ma di den go, da a man daai daai wan pisiten fosi a kon. Na so den de ape te, siibi bigin kii den. Ne den kai a siibi.
eng_text: While the bridegroom tarried, they all slumbered and slept.

djk_text: We, ne den siibi te, mindii neti, ne den yee wan balibali taki: ‘U opo! U opo! A toow man e kon. U opo go miti en.’
