eng_text: And at midnight there was a cry made, Behold, the bridegroom cometh; go ye out to meet him.

djk_text: “We, ne ala den tin pikin umanpikin opo gwugwulu. Ne den kisi den lampu fu den, wai kon seeka poti bun.
eng_text: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.

djk_text: We, ne den di be waka wan don fasi akisi den taawan taki: ‘Gaantangi, baa! U gi u afu fu a oli fu u. Bika wi lampu e dede.’
eng_text: And the foolish said unto the wise, Give us of your oil; for our lamps are gone out.

djk_text: “Ma den koni wan piki den taki: ‘Nono baa! U ná o abi ipi sai, da fu wi seefi o kaba. A moo betee useefi go a den seliman, go bai.’
eng_text: But the wise answered, saying, Not so; lest there be not enough for us and you: but go ye rather to them that sell, and buy for yourselves.

djk_text: “Ma fa i si den gwe taki, den o go bai a oli, ne a toow man doo. Ne den feifi di be waka wan koni fasi, go anga en na a toow osu. Ne den sooto a doo.
eng_text: And while they went to buy, the bridegroom came; and they that were ready went in with him to the marriage: and the door was shut.

djk_text: “We, ne te wan pisi, ne den taawan di be go bai oli kon doo. Ne den de ape e koko doo e bali taki: ‘Masaa! Masaa! Gaantangi, opo doo gi wi baa.’
eng_text: Afterward came also the other virgins, saying, Lord, Lord, open to us.

djk_text: Ma a piki den taki: ‘Kweti! Mi á sabi u!’
eng_text: But he answered and said, Verily I say unto you, I know you not.

djk_text: “Ne a taigi den baka taki: ‘U de na kaba kaba alaten. Bika u á sabi a yuu, di mi o daai kon a goontapu.’ ”
eng_text: Watch therefore, for ye know neither the day nor the hour wherein the Son of man cometh.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi teke ete wan ageisi toli, fu soi fa a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu o waka. A taki: “Wan gaan masaa be de ne en kondee. Ma namo, da a be o go a wan taa kondee. Ma, fosi a gwe, ne a kai den wookoman fi en poti, ne a poti den fu luku den gudu fi en.
eng_text: For the kingdom of heaven is as a man travelling into a far country, who called his own servants, and delivered unto them his goods.

djk_text: A gi wan fu den feifi miliyun kolu. Di fu tu a gi tu miliyun. Di fu dii, a gi wan miliyun. A gi den a moni leti enke fa a sabi taki, ibiiwan fu den abi a koni fu wooko anga moni. Ne di a kaba, ne a go a taa kondee.
eng_text: And unto one he gave five talents, to another two, and to another one; to every man according to his several ability; and straightway took his journey.

djk_text: Fa i si a gwe, ne a wookoman di a be gi feifi dunsu go wooko anga a moni wanten. Ne a wooko anga en, te enke a fende feifi miliyun moo poti a tapu.
eng_text: Then he that had received the five talents went and traded with the same, and made them other five talents.

djk_text: Soseefi, a wookoman di a gi tu miliyun go wooko anga fi en tu. Namo a tu miliyun fi en puu ete tu miliyun wini kon a tapu gi en tu.
eng_text: And likewise he that had received two, he also gained other two.

djk_text: Ma a wookoman di meke di fu dii, teke di fi en moni di a masaa fika gi en, ne a diki wan gaan olo, ne a beli en a ondoo doti.
eng_text: But he that had received one went and digged in the earth, and hid his lord's money.

djk_text: “Ma baka wan langa pisiten, ne a masaa fu den daai kon baka. Ne a kai den kon, fu piki en, fa den wooko anga a moni di a be fika gi den.
eng_text: After a long time the lord of those servants cometh, and reckoneth with them.

djk_text: Ne di a be fika feifi miliyun kolu gi, kon doo. Ne a langa a tin miliyun kolu gi a masaa taki: ‘Masaa! A feifi miliyun kolu di i be fika gi mi, de ya. Mi wooko anga en, ne i si mi fende feifi miliyun kolu poti a tapu ete. Da yu á si luku a tin miliyun kolu ya.’
eng_text: And so he that had received five talents came and brought other five talents, saying, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me five talents: behold, I have gained beside them five talents more.

djk_text: Ne a masaa piisii, te ná sipowtu. Ne a taki: ‘Ai boi! Yu na wan bunbun fitoow wookoman! Fu di i wooko so bun anga a pikin sani di mi be gi yu de, meke mi o poti wan moo gaan gudu fu mi a ini yu ana, fu luku. Da pasa kon a ini meke u piisii makandii.’
eng_text: His lord said unto him, Well done, thou good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.

djk_text: “We, ne baka fu dati, ne a taawan di meke tu, di a be fika tu miliyun kolu gi, kon doo. A taki: ‘We, Masaa! Luku a moni fi yu ya. I be fika tu miliyun kolu gi mi. Da mi wooko anga en te, a puu ete tu miliyun kolu a tapu. Da luku a moni fi yu ya.’
eng_text: He also that had received two talents came and said, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me two talents: behold, I have gained two other talents beside them.

djk_text: Namo a masaa piki en taki: ‘Ai boi! Yu na wan bunbun fitoow wookoman. Fu di yu wooko so bun anga a pikin gudu di mi be fika gi yu, meke mi o poti wan moo gaan gudu fu mi a ini yu ana. Pasa kon a ini ya, fu nyan piisii anga mi makandii.’
eng_text: His lord said unto him, Well done, good and faithful servant; thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.

djk_text: “We, ne di fu meke dii, di a be gi wan miliyun seefi wai kon doo. Ne a taki: ‘We, Masaa! Fa i de ya, mi sabi taki, i na wan ogii sama. Yu e koti sani a pe yu á paandi. Da i lobi piki sani a pe yu á be tyatya sii.
eng_text: Then he which had received the one talent came and said, Lord, I knew thee that thou art an hard man, reaping where thou hast not sown, and gathering where thou hast not strawed:

djk_text: Da di mi sabi so fi yu kaba, mi feele. A dati meke mi go diki olo, ne mi beli a moni fi yu. Da yu á si, luku a moni fi yu ya!’
eng_text: And I was afraid, and went and hid thy talent in the earth: lo, there thou hast that is thine.

djk_text: “We, di a wookoman ya taki so, ne a masaa ati boon. Ne a piki en taki: ‘Yu lesi, takuu ati man, yu! Di i sabi taki, mi e koti sani a pe mi á paandi, mi e piki sani a pe mi á tyatya,
eng_text: His lord answered and said unto him, Thou wicked and slothful servant, thou knewest that I reap where I sowed not, and gather where I have not strawed:

djk_text: da i be sa tyai a moni fu mi go poti a banku gi mi, fu a puu wini gi mi? Bika moni a banku e goo.’
eng_text: Thou oughtest therefore to have put my money to the exchangers, and then at my coming I should have received mine own with usury.

djk_text: “Ne a masaa daai, ne a sende den taa wookoman fi en taki: ‘U puu a wan miliyun de ne en ana, da u gi a wookoman fu mi, di abi tin miliyun kaba.’
eng_text: Take therefore the talent from him, and give it unto him which hath ten talents.

djk_text: Bika a sama di abi, ne en den o gi moo. Da a o abi te a pasa maiki. Ma a sama di ná abi seefi seefi, da a pikinso di a abi seefi, den o puu ne en ana, meke a fika anga soso ana.
eng_text: For unto every one that hath shall be given, and he shall have abundance: but from him that hath not shall be taken away even that which he hath.

djk_text: Ne a taigi den wookoman fi en taki: ‘U teke a soso, kaba a soso wookoman ya towe go na a gaan dunguu anda! Da na soso pina anga balibali kaw tifi de anda!’ ”
eng_text: And cast ye the unprofitable servant into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “Te a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya o daai kon a goontapu baka, da a o kon anga ala den Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee . Soseefi ala a hei anga dyendee di Masaa Gadu abi, fu sidon tii ala sani ne en kownu bangi.
eng_text: When the Son of man shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory:

djk_text: Da ala foluku fu goontapu o de ne en fesi. Da a o paati den a tu, leti enke fa wan soluguman fu sikapu e paati den sikapu anga den boko boko.
eng_text: And before him shall be gathered all nations: and he shall separate them one from another, as a shepherd divideth his sheep from the goats:

djk_text: Da den sikapu o de ne en leti ana se. Da den boko boko o de ne en kukutu ana se.
eng_text: And he shall set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.

djk_text: “Da a Kownu o taigi den di de ne en letise ana taki: ‘U kon ya! Masaa Gadu, mi Tata du u gaan bun. Bika senten di a be meke goontapu, ne a be seeka a peesi ya ne en se kaba, fu poti u. Da u kon teke en fu tan.
eng_text: Then shall the King say unto them on his right hand, Come, ye blessed of my Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world:

djk_text: Bika den dei di mi be de gi angii e kii, u be gi mi sani fu nyan. Di wataa be moo mi, u be gi mi wataa mi diingi. Di mi be de enke wakaman sondee tanpeesi, u be teke mi oli a osu.
eng_text: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me drink: I was a stranger, and ye took me in:

djk_text: Di mi be de piipii sondee koosi a sikin, u be teke koosi gi mi, mi wei. Di mi be siki, u be kon luku mi, solugu mi. Di mi be de a dunguu osu, u be kon luku mi.’
eng_text: Naked, and ye clothed me: I was sick, and ye visited me: I was in prison, and ye came unto me.

djk_text: “Da den sama ya, di be e libi letiopu, da a sani ya o bigi gi den te, da den o akisi taki: ‘We, Masaa! On yuu u be si angii e kii yu, ne u be gi yu sani fu nyan? On yuu u be si wataa be moo yu, ne u be gi yu wataa?
eng_text: Then shall the righteous answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, and fed thee? or thirsty, and gave thee drink?

djk_text: On yuu u be si yu enke wakaman a wan peesi sondee tanpeesi, ne u be teke yu oli a u osu? On yuu u be si yu piipii sondee koosi a sikin, ne u be gi yu koosi?
eng_text: When saw we thee a stranger, and took thee in? or naked, and clothed thee?

djk_text: Masaa! On yuu u be si yu sikisiki ofu si yu a dunguu osu, ne u be kon luku yu?’
eng_text: Or when saw we thee sick, or in prison, and came unto thee?

djk_text: Da a Kownu o piki den taki: ‘Fu tuu! Ala den bun di u be e du gi pooti baala fu mi, da na miseefi u be du den gi de.’
eng_text: And the King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren, ye have done it unto me.

djk_text: “Da te a Kownu kaba taki anga den so, da a o daai taki anga den sama di de ne en kukutu ana se. Da a o taigi den taki: ‘U wai komoto a mi fesi ya! U fuuku sani u! U go na a faya di e boon tego, di be seeka poti gi didibii anga den takuu jeje fi en.
eng_text: Then shall he say also unto them on the left hand, Depart from me, ye cursed, into everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels:

djk_text: Bika mi be de anga angii, u á be gi mi sani fu nyan. Wataa be moo mi, u á be gi mi wataa fu diingi.
eng_text: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me no meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me no drink:

djk_text: Mi be de enke wakaman, ma u á be teke mi oli a u osu. Mi be de piipii sondee koosi a sikin, u á be gi mi koosi fu wei. Mi be siki, soseefi mi be de a dunguu osu, ma u á be kon luku mi.’
eng_text: I was a stranger, and ye took me not in: naked, and ye clothed me not: sick, and in prison, and ye visited me not.

djk_text: “Da den o piki a Kownu taki: ‘Oho! Masaa, on yuu u be si yu anga angii, sondee fu gi yu nyanyan? On yuu wataa be e moo yu, ma u á be e gi yu wataa? On yuu i be tan enke wakaman, ma u á be teke yu poti a osu? On yuu i be pina fu koosi, ma u á be solugu yu anga koosi? On yuu i be siki, ne u á be solugu yu? On yuu i be de a dunguu osu, ne u á be kon luku yu?’
eng_text: Then shall they also answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, or athirst, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and did not minister unto thee?

djk_text: We, da a Kownu o piki den taki: ‘Fu tuu! Fa u á be yeepi den pootisama fu mi, da na mi seefi u á be yeepi de!’
eng_text: Then shall he answer them, saying, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye did it not to one of the least of these, ye did it not to me.

djk_text: Da na so den sama di nái libi leti gi Masaa Gadu o go teke a sitaafu fu tego. Ma den di e libi letiopu gi en, o fende libi tego a Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: And these shall go away into everlasting punishment: but the righteous into life eternal.

djk_text: Baka di Masaa Jesesi kaba anga den toli ya, ne a taigi den bakaman fi en wan sani
eng_text: And it came to pass, when Jesus had finished all these sayings, he said unto his disciples,

djk_text: A taki: “Enke fa u de, da u sabi taki taa tamaa, da wi o fii a Pasika Fesa. Da den o kisi a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya, tyai go gi sama, den sipikii a koloisi kii.”
eng_text: Ye know that after two days is the feast of the passover, and the Son of man is betrayed to be crucified.

djk_text: We, ne a seefi yuu ten de, da den hei apaiti begiman anga den gaansama fu kondee be ali kon makandii a ini a osu fu a moo hei apaiti begiman di den e kai Kayafasi.
eng_text: Then assembled together the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders of the people, unto the palace of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas,

djk_text: Den de ape e fiti anga denseefi fa fu du fu kisi Masaa Jesesi a wan koni fasi tyai go kii.
eng_text: And consulted that they might take Jesus by subtilty, and kill him.

djk_text: Ma son fu den taki: “Den mu luku bun fu den á kisi Masaa Jesesi na a Pasika Fesa. Bika, da a o tyai gaan opuulu a ini a kondee.”
eng_text: But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar among the people.

djk_text: Ma namo, da den Masaa Jesesi doo na a kondee di den e kai Betaniya. Ne den go na a osu fu Simon a Gwasiman, go nyan.
eng_text: Now when Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,

djk_text: Ma namo, di den sidon fu nyan, ne wan uman kon doo anga wan moi bataa anga wan gaan dii sumee switi fatu a ini. Ne a waka langa langa, te a Masaa Jesesi, a pe a sidon na a tafaa. Ne a kandi a apaiti fatu a Masaa Jesesi ede anga ala fa a sidon a tafaa fu nyan de.
eng_text: There came unto him a woman having an alabaster box of very precious ointment, and poured it on his head, as he sat at meat.

djk_text: Ma a sani di a uman du ya, á bun gi den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi seefi seefi. Ne den taki: “Saide meke a towe a dii switi fatu de poli so du?
eng_text: But when his disciples saw it, they had indignation, saying, To what purpose is this waste?

djk_text: Bika a be sa moo bun, a be seli a fatu ya puu tyaipi moni. Da den be sa yeepi den pootiman anga a moni ya.”
eng_text: For this ointment might have been sold for much, and given to the poor.

djk_text: Ma di Masaa Jesesi si den e taki, ne a sabi kaba san den e taki. Ne a taigi den taki: “San u fende fowtu na a uman ya? Meke mi taigi u. A á du ogii, ye! Ma na wan gaan bun a du gi mi.
eng_text: When Jesus understood it, he said unto them, Why trouble ye the woman? for she hath wrought a good work upon me.

djk_text: Bika pootiman o de ya gi u alaten, fu u solugu. Ma mi ná o de anga u ya alaten.
eng_text: For ye have the poor always with you; but me ye have not always.

djk_text: Bika a switi fatu di a uman kandi a mi ede ya, da na mi sikin a seeka so a fesi, fu a beli di den o beli mi.
eng_text: For in that she hath poured this ointment on my body, she did it for my burial.

djk_text: We, fu tuu, mi e taigi u! Ala se fu goontapu pe den sa taki fu a Bun Nyunsu fu mi, den sa taki fu a gaan bun di a uman ya du gi mi ya tu.”
eng_text: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached in the whole world, there shall also this, that this woman hath done, be told for a memorial of her.

djk_text: We, ne Judasi Iskaliyotu, wan fu den twalufu bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi opo vun. Ne tyaa tyaa, fu te a den hei apaiti begiman fu a Mama Keliki.
eng_text: Then one of the twelve, called Judas Iscariot, went unto the chief priests,

djk_text: Ne a akisi den taki: “San u o pai mi, efu mi meke moiti gi u, fu u kisi en?” Ne den piki en taki: “We, u sa gi yu diitenti pisi solufu moni.” Ne den pai en moi, te a kaba. Ne a gwe.
eng_text: And said unto them, What will ye give me, and I will deliver him unto you? And they covenanted with him for thirty pieces of silver.

djk_text: Ne fanafu a dei de, ne ai suku wan bun okasi, fu a meke den kisi Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: And from that time he sought opportunity to betray him.

djk_text: We, da na a fosi dei di den Dyu be e bigin fu nyan a beele sondee sowda na a Pasika Fesa, ne den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi kon ne en. Ne den akisi en taki: “Masaa! On se i wani u seeka peesi gi yu fi i nyan a Pasika Fesa?”
eng_text: Now the first day of the feast of unleavened bread the disciples came to Jesus, saying unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare for thee to eat the passover?

djk_text: Ne a piki den taki: “U go na a kondee di de leti a u fesi so, da u go a sowan sowan sama. Da u taigi en taki: ‘A yuu fu Masaa doo. A wani kon nyan a Pasika Fesa a yu osu, makandii anga den bakaman fi en.’ ”
eng_text: And he said, Go into the city to such a man, and say unto him, The Master saith, My time is at hand; I will keep the passover at thy house with my disciples.

djk_text: We, ne den bakaman go du enke fa Masaa Jesesi sende den. Ne den seeka, te a kaba, fu go nyan a Pasika Fesa.
eng_text: And the disciples did as Jesus had appointed them; and they made ready the passover.

djk_text: Ne di sapaten, ne Masaa Jesesi anga den twalufu bakaman fi en sidon makandii a tafaa, fu nyan.
eng_text: Now when the even was come, he sat down with the twelve.

djk_text: Da di den e nyan, ne Masaa Jesesi taki: “Fu tuu! Wan fu u ya o seli mi poti a ini den sama ana, den feyanti fu mi.”
eng_text: And as they did eat, he said, Verily I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.

djk_text: We, di Masaa Jesesi taki so, ne gaan tyali kisi den bakaman fi en, te ná sipowtu. Ne ibiiwan fu den bigin akisi en taki: “Masaa! A sa de taki, na mi o seli yu?”
eng_text: And they were exceeding sorrowful, and began every one of them to say unto him, Lord, is it I?

djk_text: Namo a piki den taki: “We, na a sama di mi anga en dipi beele go a ini a seefi baafun. Ne en o seli mi so.
eng_text: And he answered and said, He that dippeth his hand with me in the dish, the same shall betray me.

djk_text: We, a de so taki, den apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu be sikiifi somen sani fu a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya. Da ala den sani de fiya mu pasa enke fa den be taki. Ma, heelu fu a sama di o seli a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya! A moo betee, a á be meke kon a ondoo goontapu wan dei.”
eng_text: The Son of man goeth as it is written of him: but woe unto that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! it had been good for that man if he had not been born.

djk_text: We, ne Judasi, a man di o seli en akisi en taki: “We, Mesiti! A sa de taki na mi?” Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Na leti enke fa i seefi taki de, na so a de.”
eng_text: Then Judas, which betrayed him, answered and said, Master, is it I? He said unto him, Thou hast said.

djk_text: Ma di den e nyan te wan pisi, ne Masaa Jesesi teke wan beele. Ne a gi Masaa Gadu daa, te a kaba. Ne a booko en pisipisi, ne a gi den bakaman fi en. Ne a taigi den taki: “U teke a beele ya nyan! Bika a beele ya na mi sikin.”
eng_text: And as they were eating, Jesus took bread, and blessed it, and brake it, and gave it to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my body.

djk_text: Ne bakadati, ne a teke wan kan win. Ne a gi Masaa Gadu daa baka, te a kaba. Ne a kandi gi den bakaman fi en taki: “Luku ya! U diingi!
eng_text: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and gave it to them, saying, Drink ye all of it;

djk_text: Bika a win ya na mi buulu di o lon, fu Masaa Gadu sa meke wan nyun kuudei anga libisama. Na a buulu ya o lon gi somen sama, fu gi den paadon fu takuudu anga ogii.”
eng_text: For this is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many for the remission of sins.

djk_text: Ne a taigi den baka taki: “Fu tuu, mi e taigi u! Mi ná o diingi win na a fasi ya moo, fu te enke mi anga u miti baka a ini a Nyun Tii fu mi Tata. Na anda u sa diingi en makandii baka, ma na wan hii nyun sowtu fasi.”
eng_text: But I say unto you, I will not drink henceforth of this fruit of the vine, until that day when I drink it new with you in my Father's kingdom.

djk_text: Namo, di den nyan te den kaba, ne den singi wan singi gi Masaa Gadu gaandi. Ne den opo komoto de e gwe na a mongo, di den e kai Oleifi Mongo.
eng_text: And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “U si a neti ya? U ala fiya o lowe gwe fika mi, enke fa Masaa Gadu Buku taki. Bika a sikiifi taki: ‘Te mi o kii a soluguman fu den sikapu, da ala den sikapu o lon panya panya gwe na ala se.’
eng_text: Then saith Jesus unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock shall be scattered abroad.

djk_text: Ma, te mi o weki baka, da mi sa waka go a u fesi a Galileya Kondee.”
eng_text: But after I am risen again, I will go before you into Galilee.

djk_text: Namo, di Masaa Jesesi taki so, ne Peitilisi piki wanten taki: “Masaa! Winsi ala den taawan ya o lowe gwe fika yu, mi dati noiti o fika yu.”
eng_text: Peter answered and said unto him, Though all men shall be offended because of thee, yet will I never be offended.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi piki en baka taki: “Peitilisi! Fu tuutuu! Yu seefi o si tide neti. Bika fosi kaka bali, na yu ya seefi o lei kaba taki, yu á sabi mi, te dii boo seefi.”
eng_text: Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this night, before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.

djk_text: Namo Peitilisi piki en baka taki: “Kweti! Mi fu taki dati? Winsi mi mu dede anga yu seefi, mi ná o sitee taki mi á sabi yu.” We, ne ala den taa bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi piki so, enke fa Peitilisi piki tu.
eng_text: Peter said unto him, Though I should die with thee, yet will I not deny thee. Likewise also said all the disciples.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en e go te, den go doo a dyali di den e kai Getsemanei. Ne a taigi den taki: “U sidon ya luku mi! Mi o go so go begi!”
eng_text: Then cometh Jesus with them unto a place called Gethsemane, and saith unto the disciples, Sit ye here, while I go and pray yonder.

djk_text: Ne a teke Peitilisi anga den tu manpikin fu Da Sebedi, ne den waka go moo faawe a ini a dyali. Namo, a sani kon taanga gi Masaa Jesesi te, ne gaan tyali kisi en.
eng_text: And he took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and very heavy.

djk_text: Ne a taigi den taki: “Tuutuu tyali anga fuka moo mi te, a sa tyai dede kii mi. U tan ya anga mi! U á mu siibi!”
eng_text: Then saith he unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful, even unto death: tarry ye here, and watch with me.

djk_text: Ne a waka go pikinso moo faawe. Ne a kai tapu fesi a doti anda e begi taki: “Kee, mi Tata! Mi e begi i. A kan di i lai gi mi, fu diingi ya, efi i sa puu en gi mi, fu mi á diingi en, da gaantangi puu en! Ma anga ala fa mi taki ya seefi, ma a ná san mi wani mu pasa. Ma meke sani waka enke fa yu wani!”
eng_text: And he went a little further, and fell on his face, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me: nevertheless not as I will, but as thou wilt.

djk_text: We, di a kaba begi so, ne a waka kon baka a den bakaman fi en. Ma a si den kai a siibi. Ne a kai den taki: “Peitilisi! U á poi meke taanga sikin, fu de anga ain wankodo yuu langa anga mi seefi, no?
eng_text: And he cometh unto the disciples, and findeth them asleep, and saith unto Peter, What, could ye not watch with me one hour?

djk_text: We, u weki oli waki! Da u begi taanga, fu didibii á wini u! Bika mi sabi taki u ati wani, ma sikin ná abi kaakiti sai.”
eng_text: Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.

djk_text: Ne a daai gwe baka go begi, di fu tu toon. A begi taki: “Mi Tata! Efu taa fasi á de, da yeepi mi, meke mi diingi a kan di de gi mi fu diingi ya. Bika na san yu wani, na dati mu pasa.”
eng_text: He went away again the second time, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if this cup may not pass away from me, except I drink it, thy will be done.

djk_text: Namo a daai go baka, ne a si den bakaman fi en kai a siibi baka. Bika siibi be e hebi den ain.
eng_text: And he came and found them asleep again: for their eyes were heavy.

djk_text: We, ne a fika den de, ne a go begi di fu dii toon. A begi a seefi begi.
eng_text: And he left them, and went away again, and prayed the third time, saying the same words.

djk_text: We, ne a daai kon baka a den bakaman fi en, ne a taigi den taki: “A siibi u e siibi e boo sikin so? We, a yuu de koosube, di den sa tyai a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya, go poti a ini den ogii ati sama ana.
eng_text: Then cometh he to his disciples, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

djk_text: U opo meke u gwe! Bika a sama di o seli mi, doo koosube kaba.”
eng_text: Rise, let us be going: behold, he is at hand that doth betray me.

djk_text: We, Masaa Jesesi á kaba taki seefi, ne Judasi, wan fu den twalufu bakaman fi en, kon doo kaba anga wan gaan kulu sama. Den kon anga fetihow anga kodya dyagaa. Na den hei apaiti begiman anga den gaansama fu kondee sende den kon so.
eng_text: And while he yet spake, lo, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and elders of the people.

djk_text: Ma a man di be seli Masaa Jesesi be gi den wan maiki a fesi kaba taki: “Awan di mi o bosi, ne en u mu kisi.”
eng_text: Now he that betrayed him gave them a sign, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he: hold him fast.

djk_text: Ne wanten, a waka go a Masaa Jesesi, ne a gi en odi taki: “Odi oo, Mesiti!” Ne a bosi en a sikin fesi piyow.
eng_text: And forthwith he came to Jesus, and said, Hail, master; and kissed him.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi taigi en taki: “Mi mati! Ná daai daai! Du san i kon fu wanten!” Namo, ne den sama booko huu kon. Ne den kisi Masaa Jesesi gwullu kankan, oli fu den tyai gwe.
eng_text: And Jesus said unto him, Friend, wherefore art thou come? Then came they, and laid hands on Jesus, and took him.

djk_text: Ma wan fu den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi toosi ana, teke en fetihow puu a dosu, ne a iti go. Ne velen! A koti a futuboi fu a moo hei apaiti begiman yesi, puu towe a doti pow.
eng_text: And, behold, one of them which were with Jesus stretched out his hand, and drew his sword, and struck a servant of the high priest's, and smote off his ear.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi taigi en taki: “Nono! Toosi i fetihow go a ini a saka baka! Bika a sama di teke fetihow fu feti, na fetihow sa kii den.
eng_text: Then said Jesus unto him, Put up again thy sword into his place: for all they that take the sword shall perish with the sword.

djk_text: Bika fa mi de ya, san i denki? Mi sa begi mi Tata, da wanten a sa sende onmen tenti dunsu Masaa Gadu Kondee Basiya fi en, kon puu mi a den sama ya ana.
eng_text: Thinkest thou that I cannot now pray to my Father, and he shall presently give me more than twelve legions of angels?

djk_text: Ma efu mi du dati, da fa den sani di sikiifi a Gadu Buku o kon pasa tuu enke fa den be sikiifi?”
eng_text: But how then shall the scriptures be fulfilled, that thus it must be?

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi daai taki anga den sama di kon kisi en de. A taki: “Fu saide meke u kon a mi ya anga fetihow anga kodya, fu kon kisi mi enke mi na wan gaan fufuuman? Bika ala yuu mi be de a ini a Mama Keliki e leli sama. Ma noiti u be poti ana a mi taki u be o kisi mi.
eng_text: In that same hour said Jesus to the multitudes, Are ye come out as against a thief with swords and staves for to take me? I sat daily with you teaching in the temple, and ye laid no hold on me.

djk_text: Ma den sani ya musu pasa, fu meke den sani di den apaiti takiman fu Gadu be sikiifi mu kon tuu.” We, wanten de, ne ala den bakaman fi en lon gwe fika en wawan de.
eng_text: But all this was done, that the scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled. Then all the disciples forsook him, and fled.

djk_text: Namo den sama di kisi Masaa Jesesi, tyai en go na a osu fu Kayafasi, a moo hei apaiti begiman. Da den leliman fu Dyuweiti anga gaansama fu kondee be kon de makandii, fu den tyai Masaa Jesesi kon.
eng_text: And they that had laid hold on Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were assembled.

djk_text: Ma anga ala fa den e tyai Masaa Jesesi go de, da Peitilisi seefi be e waka faawe e kon a den baka. Ne den waka te, ne den doo a dyali fu a moo hei apaiti begiman. Peitilisi seefi pasa go a ini a dyali. Ne a go sidon a ini den sama di e oli wakiti na a peesi de. Bika a be wani si fa ala sani o waka anga Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: But Peter followed him afar off unto the high priest's palace, and went in, and sat with the servants, to see the end.

djk_text: Namo, den hei apaiti begiman anga a hii Dyulanti fu kuutu e suku leilei sani poti a Masaa Jesesi neki tapu, fu den sa fende en kii.
eng_text: Now the chief priests, and elders, and all the council, sought false witness against Jesus, to put him to death;

djk_text: Ma anga ala fa den e piki sani fi en taki, ma den á fende ná wan sani taki, na a sani ya den fende, fu a mu dede. Te fu kaba, ne tu man dati dyombo kon a fesi, fu kotoigi.
eng_text: But found none: yea, though many false witnesses came, yet found they none. At the last came two false witnesses,

djk_text: Ne den bali taki: “A be gafa taki, a sa booko a Mama Keliki, da a ini dii dei a sa meke en baka.”
eng_text: And said, This fellow said, I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.

djk_text: Ne vun! A moo hei apaiti begiman opo taampu. Ne a akisi Masaa Jesesi taki: “Yee san den taki fi i de. San yu abi fu piki fu dati?”
eng_text: And the high priest arose, and said unto him, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi á piki en. A dati meke a moo hei apaiti begiman ya akisi en baka taki: “Mi teke Masaa Gadu nen begi yu, piki wi! Na yu na a Kelestesi, a Manpikin fu Masaa Gadu?”
eng_text: But Jesus held his peace. And the high priest answered and said unto him, I adjure thee by the living God, that thou tell us whether thou be the Christ, the Son of God.

djk_text: Namo, Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “We, na iseefi taki de. Da a yuu o doo, da u o si a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya sidon na a leti ana fu Masaa Gadu, di abi ala taanga a goontapu. U o si a komoto a den woluku tapu anda e kon.”
eng_text: Jesus saith unto him, Thou hast said: nevertheless I say unto you, Hereafter shall ye see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.

djk_text: We, ne di Masaa Jesesi piki so, ne a moo hei apaiti begiman ati teke faya! Ne a piiti en koosi ne en sikin. Ne a taki: “A kosi Masaa Gadu. A á de fu u suku kotoigi moo. Bika u seefi yee, fa a kosi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Then the high priest rent his clothes, saying, He hath spoken blasphemy; what further need have we of witnesses? behold, now ye have heard his blasphemy.

djk_text: San u denki u mu du anga en?” Ne den piki taki: “Taa fasi á de fu du. A dede namo a mu dede.”
eng_text: What think ye? They answered and said, He is guilty of death.

djk_text: Ne den bigin towe wataa mofu ne en fesi. Den e naki en anga kofu. Taawan e naki en anga baka ana a sikin fesi.
eng_text: Then did they spit in his face, and buffeted him; and others smote him with the palms of their hands,

djk_text: Da den e deleigi en taki: “Kelestesi! I taki yu anga Masaa Gadu e taki, puu gi wi, osi? Sama naki yu?”
eng_text: Saying, Prophesy unto us, thou Christ, Who is he that smote thee?

djk_text: We a ten de, da Peitilisi be sidon a ini a dyali ete. Namo wan pikin uman di e wooko gi a moo hei apaiti begiman, koi kon ne en. Ne a akisi en taki: “Tan, osi? Man, yu a ná wan fu den man di be e waka anga Masaa Jesesi fu Galileya, no?”
eng_text: Now Peter sat without in the palace: and a damsel came unto him, saying, Thou also wast with Jesus of Galilee.

djk_text: Ma Peitilisi sitee na ala den sama de fesi taki: “Sama? Mi? Nono! Mi á sabi a man di yu e taki de, kweti kweti!”
eng_text: But he denied before them all, saying, I know not what thou sayest.

djk_text: Namo Peitilisi opo komoto de, go taampu na a dyali mofu. Ma wan taa pikin uman kon, ne a taigi den taa sama de taki: “U luku wan fu den man fu Jesesi fu Nasaleti ya!”
eng_text: And when he was gone out into the porch, another maid saw him, and said unto them that were there, This fellow was also with Jesus of Nazareth.

djk_text: Namo Peitilisi daai sitee e sweli baka taki: “Mi á sabi a sama di u e taki de, kweti kweti!”
eng_text: And again he denied with an oath, I do not know the man.

djk_text: Pikinso moo a baka, ne den sama di taampu de kon a Peitilisi, ne den taigi en taki: “Na tuu! Yu na wan fu den man di be e waka a Masaa Jesesi fu Galileya baka tuu. Bika yu e taki enke wan sama fu Galileya.”
eng_text: And after a while came unto him they that stood by, and said to Peter, Surely thou also art one of them; for thy speech bewrayeth thee.

djk_text: Namo, ne Peitilisi taki a o sitee now. Ne ai sitee, ai fuuku enseefi, ai sweli taki: “Mi e taigi u taki, a man de, mi á sabi en wan dei.” Ne di Peitilisi taki so, ne wanten, ne wan kakafoo bali kokoliyekee!
eng_text: Then began he to curse and to swear, saying, I know not the man. And immediately the cock crew.

djk_text: We, ne a pakisei a sani, di Masaa Jesesi be taigi en taki: “Peitilisi! Fosi kakafoo bali, yu o lei dii boo taki, yu á sabi mi.” We, ne gaan tyali fuu Peitilisi ati wanten, fu san a du ya. Ne a komoto a doo, poti ana a mindii ede bali wan gaan adyumadye.
eng_text: And Peter remembered the word of Jesus, which said unto him, Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice. And he went out, and wept bitterly.

djk_text: We, ne di debooko, mamanten fuuku, ne den moo hei apaiti begiman anga den gaansama fu kondee oli wan gaan kuutu, fu luku fa den o du fu kii Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: When the morning was come, all the chief priests and elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death:

djk_text: Ne den bwui Masaa Jesesi te a kaba, ne den tyai en gwe a Gaaman Pilatesi di Loma lanti be poti, fu tii Dyusama.
eng_text: And when they had bound him, they led him away, and delivered him to Pontius Pilate the governor.

djk_text: Ma di Judasi si taki, den kuutu Masaa Jesesi taki, a mu dede, ne a sani ati en tee! A á sabi fa a mu du. Ne a teke den diitenti pisi moni di den be pai en, ne a tyai den go gi den moo hei apaiti begiman anga den gaansama fu kondee baka.
eng_text: Then Judas, which had betrayed him, when he saw that he was condemned, repented himself, and brought again the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,

djk_text: Ne a taigi den taki: “Mi du wan gaan ogii! Mi seli wan tuutuu sama sondee fowtu, fu kii towe en buulu.” Namo den piki en taki: “Di yu e kon taigi wi, da san i wani wi mu du? U ná abi bisi anga yu! Na yuseefi mu sabi san fu du anga iseefi.”
eng_text: Saying, I have sinned in that I have betrayed the innocent blood. And they said, What is that to us? see thou to that.

djk_text: Ne di den taigi en so, ne a iti a moni go a ini a Mama Keliki a doti anda. Ne waka gwe, ne a lenge lenge enseefi a tetei kii.
eng_text: And he cast down the pieces of silver in the temple, and departed, and went and hanged himself.

djk_text: We, ne den hei apaiti begiman piki a moni teke. Ne den taki: “A moni ya á bun fu poti na a keliki kasi. Bika a weiti sikiifi taki: ‘Moni di towe buulu á mu go a ini a keliki kasi.’ ”
eng_text: And the chief priests took the silver pieces, and said, It is not lawful for to put them into the treasury, because it is the price of blood.

djk_text: We, ne den kai pakisei te den kaba, fa fu du anga a moni. Namo den fiti taki: “Wi o teke a moni ya go bai wan pisi doti, na a man di e meke doti patu. Da u o meke ape toon wan belipe, fu e beli doose kondee sama.”
eng_text: And they took counsel, and bought with them the potter's field, to bury strangers in.

djk_text: We, ne fanafu a ten de, ne den e kai a pisi doti de, Buulu Doti te enke a dei fu tide.
eng_text: Wherefore that field was called, The field of blood, unto this day.

djk_text: Da a hii pisi toli ya waka enke fa a fositen apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu den e kai Jelemija be taki, taki: “Den sama fu Islayeli Kondee oli en, fu wan sama di waiti diitenti pisi solufu moni namo.
eng_text: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremy the prophet, saying, And they took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him that was valued, whom they of the children of Israel did value;

djk_text: Ne den teke a seefi diitenti pisi solufu moni de bai a pisi tokotoko doti, na a man di e meke doti patu. Na so Masaa Gadu taigi mi fu du.”
eng_text: And gave them for the potter's field, as the Lord appointed me.

djk_text: We, di den tyai Masaa Jesesi go a Gaaman Pilatesi, ne a gaaman akisi en taki: “Yu na a kownu fu den Dyusama tuu?” Namo, ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “We, na iseefi taki en de kaba.”
eng_text: And Jesus stood before the governor: and the governor asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And Jesus said unto him, Thou sayest.

djk_text: Soseefi den hei apaiti begiman anga den gaansama fu kondee e tyai somen kaagi fu Masaa Jesesi kon a fesi. Ma Masaa Jesesi nái tufee a den seefi!
eng_text: And when he was accused of the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.

djk_text: Namo Gaaman Pilatesi akisi en baka taki: “We, yu nái yee den somen kaagi, di den sama e gi fi i de, no? Da yu nái piki, no?”
eng_text: Then said Pilate unto him, Hearest thou not how many things they witness against thee?

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi á piki ná wan wowtu. A dati meke a gaaman foondoo te, ná sipowtu.
eng_text: And he answered him to never a word; insomuch that the governor marvelled greatly.

djk_text: Ma, da a be de so taki, te a Pasika Fesa doo, da a gaaman be abi a gwenti, fu puu wan sama di lanti wani, a dunguu osu gi den.
eng_text: Now at that feast the governor was wont to release unto the people a prisoner, whom they would.

djk_text: Ma, da a seefi yuu ten de, da wan gaan ogiiman den e kai Balabasi be de a dunguu osu.
eng_text: And they had then a notable prisoner, called Barabbas.

djk_text: We, ne Gaaman Pilatesi daai, ne a taki anga den somen sama di be de ape taki: “Den sama ya! U aliki! Sama u wani mi losi, puu a sitaafu gi u? Mi losi Balabasi gi u, ofuso Jesesi, di den e kai a Kelestesi?”
eng_text: Therefore when they were gathered together, Pilate said unto them, Whom will ye that I release unto you? Barabbas, or Jesus which is called Christ?

djk_text: Bika Pilatesi be sabi kiinkiin taki, fa den tyai Masaa Jesesi kon ne en de, na fu dyalusu ede meke den be tyai en kon.
eng_text: For he knew that for envy they had delivered him.

djk_text: Namo, ne Gaaman Pilatesi go sidon na a sutuu pe ai kuutu sama. Na ape a de, ne en uman sende sama taigi en taki: “Pilatesi! Yu á mu de a ini a kuutu fu kuutu a sama di de sondee fowtu de. Bika a neti ya, da mi deen wan deen fi en di go a mi ati tuutuu.”
eng_text: When he was set down on the judgment seat, his wife sent unto him, saying, Have thou nothing to do with that just man: for I have suffered many things this day in a dream because of him.

djk_text: We, a yuu ten di Gaaman Pilatesi sidon e aliki a mofu fi en uman de, ne den hei apaiti begiman anga den gaansama fu kondee e meke moiti e dwengi den sama taki: “U piki taki, meke a losi Balabasi gi u. Ma meke a kii Jesesi.”
eng_text: But the chief priests and elders persuaded the multitude that they should ask Barabbas, and destroy Jesus.

djk_text: We, ne a gaaman akisi den sama baka taki: “On di fu den tu sama ya u wani mi losi gi u?” Namo den sama bali piki taki: “Balabasi! Na Balabasi i mu losi gi wi!”
eng_text: The governor answered and said unto them, Whether of the twain will ye that I release unto you? They said, Barabbas.

djk_text: Ne Gaaman Pilatesi akisi den taki: “Da san mi mu du anga Jesesi, di den e kai Kelestesi?” Ne den sama bali taki: “Sipikii en kii a koloisi!”
eng_text: Pilate saith unto them, What shall I do then with Jesus which is called Christ? They all say unto him, Let him be crucified.

djk_text: Ne Gaaman Pilatesi akisi den baka taki: “We, on ogii seefi a du?” Ho! Den sama bali moo taanga taki: “U sipikii en! U sipikii en a koloisi kii!”
eng_text: And the governor said, Why, what evil hath he done? But they cried out the more, saying, Let him be crucified.

djk_text: We, di Gaaman Pilatesi kon si taki, a opuulu fu kii Masaa Jesesi e bigi naamo, ne a teke wataa, ne a wasi en ana, na ala sama fesi de. Ne a taki: “Mi wasi ana puu mi seefi a ini. Bika mi á poi kuutu sowan sama taki, en buulu mu lon. Da a fika gi u. Ala sani fi en, fika a u neki tapu.”
eng_text: When Pilate saw that he could prevail nothing, but that rather a tumult was made, he took water, and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, I am innocent of the blood of this just person: see ye to it.

djk_text: We, ne ala den Dyusama di be de ape bali taki: “Eeye! Meke a fika a wi anga den pikin fu wi neki tapu taki, na wi kii en!”
eng_text: Then answered all the people, and said, His blood be on us, and on our children.

djk_text: Namo, ne Pilatesi losi Balabasi gi den. Ne a sende den suudati fi en, fu den fon Masaa Jesesi. Ne a gi den en, fu den tyai go sipikii kii a koloisi.
eng_text: Then released he Barabbas unto them: and when he had scourged Jesus, he delivered him to be crucified.

djk_text: Namo, den suudati teke Masaa Jesesi tyai gwe a Gaaman Dyali. Ne den kai ala den taa suudati fu den. Ne ala den fiya ali kon lontu Masaa Jesesi poti a dyali.
eng_text: Then the soldiers of the governor took Jesus into the common hall, and gathered unto him the whole band of soldiers.

djk_text: Ne den puu den koosi fi en, di a be wei, ne en sikin. Ne den wei wan langa lebi dyakiti enke di kownu e wei gi.
eng_text: And they stripped him, and put on him a scarlet robe.

djk_text: Ne den teke wan agwago maka, ne den lolo en, te a kaba enke kownu ati, ne den toosi ne en ede soo. Ne den koti wan pisi kamaluwa poti, ne en letise ana, fu pee enke dati na wan kownu tiki. Ne den e wisiwasi en e saka kini a doti e bali taki: “Odi oo kownu fu Dyu! Odi oo!”
eng_text: And when they had platted a crown of thorns, they put it upon his head, and a reed in his right hand: and they bowed the knee before him, and mocked him, saying, Hail, King of the Jews!

djk_text: Den e towe wataa mofu ne en. Ne den puu a tiki a ini en ana, ne den e naki en anga en, ne en ede seefi, gwogwo onmen tenti leisi.
eng_text: And they spit upon him, and took the reed, and smote him on the head.

djk_text: We, ne di den mesaandi en, te den kaba, ne den puu a dyakiti di den be wei gi en, teke baka. Ne den wei den seefi kosi gi en baka, di a be wei a fesi. Ne den e tyai en gwe, fu go sipikii kii a koloisi.
eng_text: And after that they had mocked him, they took the robe off from him, and put his own raiment on him, and led him away to crucify him.

djk_text: Ma di den e tyai Masaa Jesesi gwe te wan pisi, ne den miti wan man den e kai Simon fu Sileni Kondee a pasi. We, ne den dwengi en anga taanga fu a tyai a koloisi gi Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: And as they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name: him they compelled to bear his cross.

djk_text: We, ne den waka te den doo na a peesi. Na a peesi ya den e kai go kai Golgata. Dati wani taki, Edebon Peesi.
eng_text: And when they were come unto a place called Golgotha, that is to say, a place of a skull,

djk_text: Ne den teke win mokisa anga bita, ne den gi en, fu a diingi. Ma di a tesi en kaba, ne a á wani en.
eng_text: They gave him vinegar to drink mingled with gall: and when he had tasted thereof, he would not drink.

djk_text: We, ne den sipikii Masaa Jesesi na a koloisi. Ne den opo en taampu. Ne den teke den koosi di a be wei, ne den iti lowte luku sama anga sama o wini den koosi fi en. Ne den paati den.
eng_text: And they crucified him, and parted his garments, casting lots: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, They parted my garments among them, and upon my vesture did they cast lots.

djk_text: We, di den du so te den kaba, ne den saka sidon de e oli waki a Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: And sitting down they watched him there;

djk_text: Ma den be sikiifi wan sani a wan pisi paanga poti a edese fu a koloisi anda, fu saide meke den kii Masaa Jesesi. Den sikiifi taki:
eng_text: And set up over his head his accusation written, THIS IS JESUS THE KING OF THE JEWS.

djk_text: Ma boiti Masaa Jesesi, da den be e kii tu taa man makandii anga en de. Wan de ne en letise, a taawan de ne en kukutu ana se. Masaa Jesesi seefi de a mindii. We, den tu taa sama de, na sama di be de gaan fufuu kiiman.
eng_text: Then were there two thieves crucified with him, one on the right hand, and another on the left.

djk_text: Da somen sama be e waka e pasa de, a pe den be koloisi Masaa Jesesi. Da te den si Masaa Jesesi, da den e kosi en, e wisiwasi en, e seke ede.
eng_text: And they that passed by reviled him, wagging their heads,

djk_text: Den taki: “Yu di be taki, yu o booko a Mama Keliki meke a ini dii dei baka! We, da san meke yu á poi yeepi iseefi nownow, puu na a koloisi? Efi yu na a Pikin fu Masaa Gadu tuu, da saka komoto na a koloisi de meke u si, no?”
eng_text: And saying, Thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days, save thyself. If thou be the Son of God, come down from the cross.

djk_text: Soseefi den hei apaiti begiman anga den leliman fu Dyuweiti anga den gaansama fu kondee e sipowtu e poti en wisiwasi tu. Den taki:
eng_text: Likewise also the chief priests mocking him, with the scribes and elders, said,

djk_text: “We, a be e yeepi taa sama. Ne san meke a á poi yeepi enseefi? Efu en na a kownu fu Islayeli Kondee tuu, da meke a saka komoto na a koloisi kon a doti, da u sa biibi en.
eng_text: He saved others; himself he cannot save. If he be the King of Israel, let him now come down from the cross, and we will believe him.

djk_text: Bika a be taki, ai poti fitoow a Gadu. We, da meke Gadu yeepi en, no? Efu a wani en? Bika a be taki: ‘Mi na a Manpikin fu Masaa Gadu.’ ”
eng_text: He trusted in God; let him deliver him now, if he will have him: for he said, I am the Son of God.

djk_text: We, soseefi den tu fufuu kiiman di den be sipikii a koloisi ne en se de be e wisiwasi en, e kosi en meke sipowtu.
eng_text: The thieves also, which were crucified with him, cast the same in his teeth.

djk_text: Ma fanafu twalufu yuu, mindii dei, te go miti dii yuu bakadina, ne a hii kondee dunguu pii.
eng_text: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land unto the ninth hour.

djk_text: Da na a dii yuu de, ne Masaa Jesesi bali taanga taki: “
eng_text: And about the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani? that is to say, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?

djk_text: Ma son fu den sama di taampu de taki: “U yee anda! Ai kai Eliya! Ai kai Eliya, fu kon yeepi en.”
eng_text: Some of them that stood there, when they heard that, said, This man calleth for Elias.

djk_text: Ne wanten de, ne wan fu den lon go teke wan siponsu, ne a dipi en go a ini wan sowtu win. Ne a poti a wan tiki ede langa gi Masaa Jesesi, fu a diingi.
eng_text: And straightway one of them ran, and took a spunge, and filled it with vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink.

djk_text: Ma den taawan bali taki: “Tan, tan, tan! Meke u luku efu Eliya o kon yeepi en tuu.”
eng_text: The rest said, Let be, let us see whether Elias will come to save him.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi bali ete wan leisi taanga, ne en boo koti.
eng_text: Jesus, when he had cried again with a loud voice, yielded up the ghost.

djk_text: We, ne a seefi yuu de, ne a gaanbigi deki koosi di be tapu a kambaa fu Masaa Gadu a ini Mama Keliki, piiti komoto a tapu, fu te a doti tyow. A fika wangang. Namo goontapu seefi e seke, e bali. Gaan siton e bali e piiti.
eng_text: And, behold, the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom; and the earth did quake, and the rocks rent;

djk_text: Goontapu seke te, somen geebi pe den be beli sama booko opo. Namo somen sama di den be beli a den geebi de, di be de apaiti fasi gi Masaa Gadu, weki komoto a ini den geebi, kon a libi baka.
eng_text: And the graves were opened; and many bodies of the saints which slept arose,

djk_text: Ne den komoto a ini den geebi, di Masaa Jesesi seefi weki baka komoto a dede, di fu dii dei. Ne den go a Jelusalem, a apaiti foto fu Masaa Gadu. Somen sama si den, fa den weki baka so.
eng_text: And came out of the graves after his resurrection, and went into the holy city, and appeared unto many.

djk_text: Ma di a edeman fu suudati anga den suudati fi en di be e oli waki a Masaa Jesesi si, fa a goontapu seke anga ala san pasa, ne den feele te. Den taki: “A sama ya, na be a Manpikin fu Masaa Gadu tuu.”
eng_text: Now when the centurion, and they that were with him, watching Jesus, saw the earthquake, and those things that were done, they feared greatly, saying, Truly this was the Son of God.

djk_text: Ma namo, da somen uman sama seefi be taampu, te a faawe e luku, fa sani e waka anga Masaa Jesesi. Bika den uman ya be waka komoto a Galileya anga Masaa Jesesi fu solugu en naamo.
eng_text: And many women were there beholding afar off, which followed Jesus from Galilee, ministering unto him:

djk_text: Wan fu den na Maliya fu Makidala, a taawan na Maliya, a mma fu Jakowbesi anga Jowsef anga a mma fu den tu manpikin fu Da Sebedi.
eng_text: Among which was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of Zebedee's children.

djk_text: Ma di sapaten mofu, ne wan guduman den be kai Jowsef fu Alimateya Kondee, kon doo de. Na wan man di be e biibi a Masaa Jesesi tu.
eng_text: When the even was come, there came a rich man of Arimathaea, named Joseph, who also himself was Jesus' disciple:

djk_text: Namo a go a Gaaman Pilatesi go akisi en, fu a gi en pasi, fu a teke a dede sikin fu Masaa Jesesi tyai go beli. Ne Pilatesi sende den suudati fi en, go puu a dede sikin fu Masaa Jesesi na a koloisi gi en.
eng_text: He went to Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus. Then Pilate commanded the body to be delivered.

djk_text: Namo, ne Jowsef teke a dede sikin fu Masaa Jesesi, ne a lolo en a sibikoosi te a kaba.
eng_text: And when Joseph had taken the body, he wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,

djk_text: Ne a tyai en go beli a wan nyun nyun siton geebi olo, di diki, a be diki fi enseefi, a wan heihei siton sikin. Di a kaba, ne a lolo wan gaan gindin siton tapu a olo mofu, ne a waka gwe.
eng_text: And laid it in his own new tomb, which he had hewn out in the rock: and he rolled a great stone to the door of the sepulchre, and departed.

djk_text: Ma namo, da Maliya fu Makidala anga a taa Maliya be de ape tu. Den be sidon na abaase fu a geebi e luku.
eng_text: And there was Mary Magdalene, and the other Mary, sitting over against the sepulchre.

djk_text: A taa dei fi en, da a dei di den be e seeka gi a kina dei fu den Dyusama pasa kaba. Ma den hei apaiti begiman anga den Faliseiman go makandii a Gaaman Pilatesi.
eng_text: Now the next day, that followed the day of the preparation, the chief priests and Pharisees came together unto Pilate,

djk_text: Ne den taki: “Masaa! U membee wan sani di a bidiigiman be taki, fosi a dede. A be gafa taki: ‘A o dede. Ma baka dii dei, a o weki baka kon a libi.’
eng_text: Saying, Sir, we remember that that deceiver said, while he was yet alive, After three days I will rise again.

djk_text: Na dati meke u kon begi gaaman, fu poti suudati oli wakiti na a geebi dii dei langa. Bika efu u á du so, da den bakaman fi en sa go fufuu en, da den go lei taki, na weki a weki baka komoto a dede. Bika efu wi á du dati, da a koli ya o ogii moo fa den be e koli sama a fesi kaba.”
eng_text: Command therefore that the sepulchre be made sure until the third day, lest his disciples come by night, and steal him away, and say unto the people, He is risen from the dead: so the last error shall be worse than the first.

djk_text: We, ne Gaaman Pilatesi piki den taki: “We! U teke suudati, enke wakitiman, tyai go poti, da u seeka a geebi tapu enke fa u sa tapu en.”
eng_text: Pilate said unto them, Ye have a watch: go your way, make it as sure as ye can.

djk_text: We, ne di a gaaman gi den pasi so, ne den go tapu a geebi enke fa den poi. Den poti wan maiki ne en fu soi taki, a de tapu tapu. Ne den poti suudati e waki de.
eng_text: So they went, and made the sepulchre sure, sealing the stone, and setting a watch.

djk_text: We, fa i si a kina dei pasa, a fosi dei fu a wiki fuuku mamanten, ne Maliya fu Makidala anga a taa Maliya go luku a geebi fu Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: In the end of the sabbath, as it began to dawn toward the first day of the week, came Mary Magdalene and the other Mary to see the sepulchre.

djk_text: Ma namo, da doti be seke te, ná sipowtu. Bika wan Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee saka komoto a tapu anda kon na a geebi. Ne a puu a gaanbigi siton di be tapu a olo mofu. Ne a sidon na a siton de tapu.
eng_text: And, behold, there was a great earthquake: for the angel of the Lord descended from heaven, and came and rolled back the stone from the door, and sat upon it.

djk_text: A Basiya ya fesi be e koti faya enke te tapu e koti faya. Da den koosi fi en sikin weti fann enke sukuma.
eng_text: His countenance was like lightning, and his raiment white as snow:

djk_text: We, ne den suudati di be de ape e waki feele te, den e beifi. Namo den de pii enke den dede.
eng_text: And for fear of him the keepers did shake, and became as dead men.

djk_text: We, ne a Basiya bigin fu taki anga den tu uman taki: “Uman! U á feele so! Mi sabi taki na Masaa Jesesi, di den sipikii kii a koloisi u e suku.
eng_text: And the angel answered and said unto the women, Fear not ye: for I know that ye seek Jesus, which was crucified.

djk_text: We, a á de ya moo! A weki baka leti enke fa a be taigi u fosi, a be dede. U kon luku pe den be poti en a ini a geebi. U si? Sama á de ape moo.
eng_text: He is not here: for he is risen, as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.

djk_text: Da u daai go esi baka a osu, fu taigi den bakaman fi en taki, a weki baka komoto a dede. Da a o waka a den fesi go a Galileya. Na anda en anga den o miti, enke fa a be taigi den. We, da na so mi soi u kaba.”
eng_text: And go quickly, and tell his disciples that he is risen from the dead; and, behold, he goeth before you into Galilee; there shall ye see him: lo, I have told you.

djk_text: We, na so den uman ya daai gwe baka. Ne den pantan te, ma toku seefi den e piisii gaan piisii. Ne den e lon go, fu tyai a nyunsu ya go gi den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: And they departed quickly from the sepulchre with fear and great joy; and did run to bring his disciples word.

djk_text: Ma, te fu den membee, ne den anga Masaa Jesesi seefi miti a pasi haa! Ne Masaa Jesesi gi den odi taki: “Den uman ya, u weki oo!” We, ne den waka go miti Masaa Jesesi, ne den saka kini a doti ne en fesi, ne den kisi en futu e baasa.
eng_text: And as they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, All hail. And they came and held him by the feet, and worshipped him.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “Uman! U á feele. Ma u go taigi den baala fu mi taki, meke den go a Galileya. Da na anda mi anga den o miti.”
eng_text: Then said Jesus unto them, Be not afraid: go tell my brethren that they go into Galilee, and there shall they see me.

djk_text: We, a yuu di den uman ya de a pasi e gwe, ne son fu den suudati komoto a pe den be e oli waki na a geebi. Ne den go a ini a foto, ne den taigi den hei apaiti begiman ala san pasa a pe den be e oli waki, na a geebi.
eng_text: Now when they were going, behold, some of the watch came into the city, and shewed unto the chief priests all the things that were done.

djk_text: We, di den hei apaiti begiman yee so kaba, ne den kai ala den gaansama fu kondee kon makandii anga den. Ne den kuutu, te den kaba. Ne den pai den suudati wan gaan moni.
eng_text: And when they were assembled with the elders, and had taken counsel, they gave large money unto the soldiers,

djk_text: Ne den taigi den taki: “We, u aliki! U mu piki sama taki, u be kai a siibi, ne den bakaman fi en kon fufuu en tyai gwe.
eng_text: Saying, Say ye, His disciples came by night, and stole him away while we slept.

djk_text: Bika efu a taki ya doo gaaman yesi, da wi sabi fa wi o taki anga en, fu koo en ati, fu u á kisi sitaafu.”
eng_text: And if this come to the governor's ears, we will persuade him, and secure you.

djk_text: We, ne den wakitiman teke a moni, ne den e taki leti enke fa den hei apaiti begiman be taigi den, fu den taki. Da enke fa den e taki en de, na so den Dyusama teke en e taki, te doo tide ete seefi.
eng_text: So they took the money, and did as they were taught: and this saying is commonly reported among the Jews until this day.

djk_text: We, ne den elufu bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi go a Galileya Kondee. Ne den go na a mongo, di a be taigi den a fesi fu den go.
eng_text: Then the eleven disciples went away into Galilee, into a mountain where Jesus had appointed them.

djk_text: Ne di den si en, ne den sutu kini a doti ne en fesi, ne den begi en. Ma son fu den be e tan enke den á be wani biibi.
eng_text: And when they saw him, they worshipped him: but some doubted.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi waka kon a den. Ne a taigi den taki: “Mi kisi ala makiti a Masaa Gadu Kondee a tapu anda anga goontapu ya.
eng_text: And Jesus came and spake unto them, saying, All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth.

djk_text: Da u go a hii goontapu, fu go paati a bosikopu gi ala foluku. Meke den daai kon toon bakaman fu mi. U dopu den a ini a nen fu a Tata, a nen fu a Manpikin anga a nen fu a Apaiti Jeje fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost:

djk_text: Da u leli den, fu den oli ala san mi be leli u. Da fu tuu! Mi de anga u alaten, fu te na a kaba fu goontapu!”
eng_text: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you alway, even unto the end of the world. Amen.

djk_text: Disi na a bigin fu a Bun Nyunsu fu Jesesi Kelestesi, a Manpikin fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: The beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God;

djk_text: Enke fa Jesaja, wan apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu be sikiifi a fositen taki: “Mi Masaa Gadu ya o sende mi bosikopuman go a fesi, fi yu. Da dati o seeka pasi gi yu.
eng_text: As it is written in the prophets, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.

djk_text: Da a tongo fu wan bosikopuman o bali a ini a gaan sabana taki: ‘U seeka pasi gi a Masaa, meke a pasi sa kon taampu letiopu tollo.’ ”
eng_text: The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.

djk_text: Da Johanisi a Dopuman de a ini a gaan sabana e bali den sama fu kon teke dopu, fu daai libi. Meke Masaa Gadu sa gi den paadon, fu takuudu anga ogii.
eng_text: John did baptize in the wilderness, and preach the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins.

djk_text: Hii Judeja anga ala sama fu Jelusalem kon a Johanisi. Da, te den begi Masaa Gadu paadon fu ala den takuudu anga ogii fu den, da Johanisi e dopu den a ini Joodani Liba.
eng_text: And there went out unto him all the land of Judaea, and they of Jerusalem, and were all baptized of him in the river of Jordan, confessing their sins.

djk_text: Johanisi seefi, be wei koosi di be meke anga a uwii fu a meti di den e kai kameili. Da a be e wei wan banti, di meke anga meti buba ne en nekilasi. Da na makonkon anga bosi oniki na be en nyanyan.
eng_text: And John was clothed with camel's hair, and with a girdle of a skin about his loins; and he did eat locusts and wild honey;

djk_text: Da a be e bali bosikopu taki: “Awan di o kon a mi baka, makiti bigi moo mi. Mi á dyendee sai, fu bendi losi en susu puu a futu gi en seefi.
eng_text: And preached, saying, There cometh one mightier than I after me, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to stoop down and unloose.

djk_text: Mi e dopu u anga wataa! Ma en dati o dopu sama anga a Apaiti Jeje.”
eng_text: I indeed have baptized you with water: but he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost.

djk_text: Da a seefi yuu de, ne Masaa Jesesi komoto a Nasaleti, na a pisiwataa fu Galileya kon, ne Johanisi dopu en a ini a Joodani Liba.
eng_text: And it came to pass in those days, that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized of John in Jordan.

djk_text: Da di Jesesi e komoto a ini a wataa, ne a si, tapu a den woluku piiti opo palan. Ne a si a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu e kon ne en tapu enke wan doifi.
eng_text: And straightway coming up out of the water, he saw the heavens opened, and the Spirit like a dove descending upon him:

djk_text: Ne wan Tongo taki a tapu anda taki: “Yu na mi Manpikin di mi lobi. Mi hii ati e piisii anga yu.”
eng_text: And there came a voice from heaven, saying, Thou art my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.

djk_text: Da wanten wanten, di Masaa Jesesi dopu, ne a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu tyai en gwe a ini a gaan sabana.
eng_text: And immediately the Spirit driveth him into the wilderness.

djk_text: Da, di Masaa Jesesi de a ini a sabana, ne saatan, a didibii kon. Ne a tesi en fotenti dei anga neti langa. Da, den ogii meti fu a sabana be de ape tu. Ma den Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee be de anga Masaa Jesesi, e yeepi en.
eng_text: And he was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted of Satan; and was with the wild beasts; and the angels ministered unto him.

djk_text: Da di den sooto Johanisi a Dopuman ne Masaa Jesesi daai go a Galileya, go e gi den sama a Bun Nyunsu.
eng_text: Now after that John was put in prison, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the gospel of the kingdom of God,

djk_text: A taki: “A yuu doo, di a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu kon de koosube. Da daai libi, fu biibi a Bun Nyunsu fu Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: And saying, The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand: repent ye, and believe the gospel.

djk_text: Da wan dei di Masaa Jesesi e waka pasa na a sikin liba fu a ze fu Galileya, ne a si tu man e towe seepi. Wan fu den man ya na Simon. Da a taawan ne en baala Andeleyasi. Da na sete seepi kisi fisi, na den wooko di den be e du kaba.
eng_text: Now as he walked by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew his brother casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “U kon waka a mi baka! Mi sa leli u fa fu kisi libisama pe fu kisi fisi.”
eng_text: And Jesus said unto them, Come ye after me, and I will make you to become fishers of men.

djk_text: Ne wanten wanten, den fika den seepi, ne den bigin waka a Masaa Jesesi baka.
eng_text: And straightway they forsook their nets, and followed him.

djk_text: Ne, di Masaa Jesesi waka go pikinso moo faawe, ne a si ete tu fisiman, Jakowbesi anga Johanisi, den tu manpikin fu Da Sebedi. Den be de a ini wan boto e seeka den seepi.
eng_text: And when he had gone a little further thence, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who also were in the ship mending their nets.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi kai den wanten fu den kon waka ne en baka. Ne den fika den dda, Da Sebedi anga den wookoman a ini a boto, ne den waka a Masaa Jesesi baka.
eng_text: And straightway he called them: and they left their father Zebedee in the ship with the hired servants, and went after him.

djk_text: Ne den gwe a Kafalnayemu. Ma namo, di a kina dei fu den Dyu doo, ne Masaa Jesesi go a ini wan fu den Dyu keliki. Ne a bigin leli den sama Gadu wowtu.
eng_text: And they went into Capernaum; and straightway on the sabbath day he entered into the synagogue, and taught.

djk_text: Da den sama foondoo, fu a fasi fa ai gi leli fu Masaa Gadu. Bika a á be e leli den enke fa den leliman fu Dyuweiti gwenti leli den. Ma a be e leli den, enke wan sama di sa sidon taki a Masaa Gadu peesi.
eng_text: And they were astonished at his doctrine: for he taught them as one that had authority, and not as the scribes.

djk_text: Da a yuu de, da wan man be de a ini a keliki osu de anga wan takuu jeje ne en tapu. Ne a bali taki:
eng_text: And there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit; and he cried out,

djk_text: “San wi anga yu abi, Jesesi fu Nasaleti? A kon i kon fu poli wi kaba a soso? Mi sabi sama a yu! Yu na a Apaiti Sama fu Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art, the Holy One of God.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi kaasi en taki: “Tapu mofu! Komoto ne en tapu wanten!”
eng_text: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him.

djk_text: Ne a takuu jeje subi te en sikin e dansi. Ne a bali taanga komoto gwe.
eng_text: And when the unclean spirit had torn him, and cried with a loud voice, he came out of him.

djk_text: Ala sama fiya foondoo. Taawan e akisi taawan taki: “San a disi? Disi na wan nyun leli anga makiti fu Masaa Gadu! Ai kaasi den takuu jeje, da den e gwe tuu.”
eng_text: And they were all amazed, insomuch that they questioned among themselves, saying, What thing is this? what new doctrine is this? for with authority commandeth he even the unclean spirits, and they do obey him.

djk_text: Da a sani di Masaa Jesesi du ya, paati na a hii pisiwataa fu Galileya.
eng_text: And immediately his fame spread abroad throughout all the region round about Galilee.

djk_text: Da, baka di den komoto na a keliki osu, ne den go wanten na a osu fu Simon anga Andeleyasi. Da Jakowbesi anga Johanisi go anga den tu.
eng_text: And forthwith, when they were come out of the synagogue, they entered into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.

djk_text: Da a main fu Simon de a bedi anga feba. Da di den doo na a osu, ne den taigi Masaa Jesesi fu a siki fi en.
eng_text: But Simon's wife's mother lay sick of a fever, and anon they tell him of her.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi waka go ne en. Ne a oli en ana yeepi en fu a opo sidon. Ne wanten wanten a mma kon bun kelle fu a feba. Ne a seeka sani gi den fu den nyan.
eng_text: And he came and took her by the hand, and lifted her up; and immediately the fever left her, and she ministered unto them.

djk_text: Ne di sapaten, di san go a ondoo, ne den tyai somen sikisama anga sama di be abi takuu jeje a den tapu, kon a Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: And at even, when the sun did set, they brought unto him all that were diseased, and them that were possessed with devils.

djk_text: Da a hii foto ali kon na a osu doo mofu pe Jesesi be de.
eng_text: And all the city was gathered together at the door.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi deesi somen sama di be abi ala sowtu siki. Da soseefi a yaki somen takuu jeje puu a sama tapu. Ma Masaa Jesesi á gi den pasi fu taki, bika den sabi sama ne en.
eng_text: And he healed many that were sick of divers diseases, and cast out many devils; and suffered not the devils to speak, because they knew him.

djk_text: Mamanten fuuku, fosi san opo, ne Masaa Jesesi go a wan koo peesi, pe en wawan be sa de fu begi taki anga Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, he went out, and departed into a solitary place, and there prayed.

djk_text: Simon anga den taa bakaman e suku pe a de.
eng_text: And Simon and they that were with him followed after him.

djk_text: Ne, di den fende en, ne den taigi en taki: “Ala sama e suku yu.”
eng_text: And when they had found him, they said unto him, All men seek for thee.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Meke u go a den taa kondee di de koosube ya. Mi mu paati a Bun Nyunsu fu Masaa Gadu anda tu. Bika na fu dati ede mi kon a goontapu.”
eng_text: And he said unto them, Let us go into the next towns, that I may preach there also: for therefore came I forth.

djk_text: Da na so Masaa Jesesi go paati a Bun Nyunsu fu Gadu a ini den keliki fu a hii pisiwataa fu Galileya. Da soseefi a yaki takuu jeje puu a sama tapu.
eng_text: And he preached in their synagogues throughout all Galilee, and cast out devils.

djk_text: Ne wan gwasiman kon a Masaa Jesesi. Ne a kai ne en kini tapu e begi Masaa Jesesi taki: “Masaa Jesesi! Mi sabi taki efi i wani i sa deesi, baa.”
eng_text: And there came a leper to him, beseeching him, and kneeling down to him, and saying unto him, If thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.

djk_text: Ne tyali fu a man kisi Masaa Jesesi. Ne a langa ana, ne a oli en. Ne a taigi en taki: “Mi wani! Kon bun!”
eng_text: And Jesus, moved with compassion, put forth his hand, and touched him, and saith unto him, I will; be thou clean.

djk_text: Ne wanten wanten, ne a man kon bun kelle. A gwasi siki komoto ne en sikin gwe fiyaa.
eng_text: And as soon as he had spoken, immediately the leprosy departed from him, and he was cleansed.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi sende a man ya gwe. Ne a bali en taanga taanga taki:
eng_text: And he straitly charged him, and forthwith sent him away;

djk_text: “Yu á mu taigi ná wan sama a sani di pasa ya, ye! Ma pe fu dati, go a den hei apaiti begiman fu keliki, meke a si yu taki, i kon bun tuutuu. Tyai a paiman fu Gadu enke fa a weiti fu Mosesi e taki. Da den sama anda sa si taki i kon bun tuutuu.”
eng_text: And saith unto him, See thou say nothing to any man: but go thy way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing those things which Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.

djk_text: Ma, di a man gwe, ne ai taki fa Masaa Jesesi deesi en. A paati a bosikopu na ala peesi te, Masaa Jesesi nen bali na ala peesi. Da winsi pe fu a kondee di Masaa Jesesi be go, sama be e kon ne en tyaipi. A dati meke a be e tan a peesi pe sama á be ipi. Ma toku seefi sama be e komoto na ala se e kon ne en.
eng_text: But he went out, and began to publish it much, and to blaze abroad the matter, insomuch that Jesus could no more openly enter into the city, but was without in desert places: and they came to him from every quarter.

djk_text: Da wantu dei a baka, ne Masaa Jesesi daai kon baka a Kafalnayemu. A á de ape langa seefi fosi a hii foto yee taki a de ape.
eng_text: And again he entered into Capernaum, after some days; and it was noised that he was in the house.

djk_text: Da somen sama kon te, ná wan peesi be de a ini a osu moo. A doo mofu seefi fuu kwaa. A be e gi den sama a wowtu fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: And straightway many were gathered together, insomuch that there was no room to receive them, no, not so much as about the door: and he preached the word unto them.

djk_text: Ne fo man poti wan lanman a wan daagi tapu, tyai kon a Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: And they come unto him, bringing one sick of the palsy, which was borne of four.

djk_text: Ma fu di sama be ipi so, meke den á be poi doo. Ne den subi go na a osu tapu. Ne den booko wan olo na a osu tapu leti a pe Masaa Jesesi be taampu. Ne den saka a lanman anga a daagi pasa na a olo, go a Masaa Jesesi a doti anda.
eng_text: And when they could not come nigh unto him for the press, they uncovered the roof where he was: and when they had broken it up, they let down the bed wherein the sick of the palsy lay.

djk_text: Da, di Masaa Jesesi si a biibi fu den man ya, ne a taigi a man taki: “Mi mati, ná feele! Mi gi yu paadon fu ala yu takuudu anga ogii kaba.”
eng_text: When Jesus saw their faith, he said unto the sick of the palsy, Son, thy sins be forgiven thee.

djk_text: Da wantu leliman fu Dyuweiti be sidon e aliki en tu. Da di den yee Masaa Jesesi taki so, ne den taki a ini den ati taki:
eng_text: But there were certain of the scribes sitting there, and reasoning in their hearts,

djk_text: “Fa a man ya e taki so wan sani? Ai oli Gadu a sipowtu! Bika ná wan sama di man fu gi libisama paadon fu takuudu anga ogii, boiti Masaa Gadu wawan.”
eng_text: Why doth this man thus speak blasphemies? who can forgive sins but God only?

djk_text: Ne wanten wanten, Masaa Jesesi sabi taki na so den e denki. Ne a akisi den taki: “Saide meke u e denki so du?
eng_text: And immediately when Jesus perceived in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, he said unto them, Why reason ye these things in your hearts?

djk_text: Fu taigi a lanman ya taki, a kisi paadon fi en takuudu anga ogii, efu fu taigi en taki: ‘Opo taampu! Teke i daagi waka go a osu!’ on di moo taanga?
eng_text: Whether is it easier to say to the sick of the palsy, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and take up thy bed, and walk?

djk_text: Ma u mu sabi taki, a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya abi makiti a goontapu, fu gi sama paadon fu takuudu anga ogii.” Ne a daai, ne a taigi a lanman taki:
eng_text: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins, (he saith to the sick of the palsy,)

djk_text: “Opo taampu! Teke i daagi waka go a osu!”
eng_text: I say unto thee, Arise, and take up thy bed, and go thy way into thine house.

djk_text: Ne dyangalan! A man dyombo opo taampu, ne wanten a teke a daagi oli a ondoo ana, ne a waka gwe a osu. Ala sama e luku dunn. Den foondoo, te den e gafa Masaa Gadu taki: “Wi á si a sani ya wanten.”
eng_text: And immediately he arose, took up the bed, and went forth before them all; insomuch that they were all amazed, and glorified God, saying, We never saw it on this fashion.

djk_text: Masaa Jesesi go baka a wataa mofu na a ze. Ne tyaipi sama kon ne en. Ne a leli den Masaa Gadu wowtu.
eng_text: And he went forth again by the sea side; and all the multitude resorted unto him, and he taught them.

djk_text: Ne di Masaa Jesesi komoto de e gwe, da a be e waka pasa wan pikin osu a sikin pasi, pe den Dyusama e go pai lantimoni. Ne a si wan pikin fu Alefeyosi, di den e kai Leifi, sidon sidon na a osu doo mofu e piki lantimoni gi lanti. Ne Masaa Jesesi kai en taki: “Kon waka a mi baka!” Ne wanten wanten Leifi opo, ne a waka a Masaa Jesesi baka.
eng_text: And as he passed by, he saw Levi the son of Alphaeus sitting at the receipt of custom, and said unto him, Follow me. And he arose and followed him.

djk_text: Ne moo lati, ne Leifi kai Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en go nyan ne en osu. Da somen mati fu Leifi di be e piki lantimoni anga sama di be abi polinen a kondee fosi den be kon waka a Masaa Jesesi baka, be sidon a tafaa e nyan anga Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en.
eng_text: And it came to pass, that, as Jesus sat at meat in his house, many publicans and sinners sat also together with Jesus and his disciples: for there were many, and they followed him.

djk_text: We, ne di den leliman fu Dyuweiti anga den Faliseiman si taki anga a man di e piki lantimoni anga den polinen man a kondee, Masaa Jesesi sidon e nyan. Ne den akisi den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi taki: “Saide meke ai nyan anga lantiman anga den ogiilibi sama de?”
eng_text: And when the scribes and Pharisees saw him eat with publicans and sinners, they said unto his disciples, How is it that he eateth and drinketh with publicans and sinners?

djk_text: Ma di Masaa Jesesi yee den, ne a piki den anga wan ageisi toli taki: “Wan sama di e siki anga wan sama di nái siki, on di fu den abi dataa fanowdu? Na sama di e siki! Bika, dataa de gi sikiman. Mi á kon fu kai den bunbun sama, ma mi kon fu kai den sama di sabi taki, den libi á bun.”
eng_text: When Jesus heard it, he saith unto them, They that are whole have no need of the physician, but they that are sick: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.

djk_text: Ma namo, da den bakaman fu Johanisi anga den Faliseiman be abi ten di den be e de sondee nyan fu begi. Ne wan dei, ne wan duupu sama kon a Masaa Jesesi, ne den akisi en taki: “Masaa Jesesi, saide meke den bakaman fi yu ná abi ten di den e tan sondee nyan fu begi, enke den bakaman fu Johanisi anga den bakaman fu den Faliseiman?”
eng_text: And the disciples of John and of the Pharisees used to fast: and they come and say unto him, Why do the disciples of John and of the Pharisees fast, but thy disciples fast not?

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den anga wan ageisi toli taki: “Fa mi anga den bakaman fu mi de ya, da a de leti enke te wan man toow anga wan uman. Di a man toow, ne a kai somen sama fu kon meke piisii anga en. Da solanga a toowman de na a fesa anga den, da den ná o tan anga angii fu begi, ma na soso nyan meke piisii namo den o de.
eng_text: And Jesus said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them? as long as they have the bridegroom with them, they cannot fast.

djk_text: Ma a yuu o kon di den o tyai a toowman puu a den de. Da den sa abi ten di den o go e de anga angii fu begi Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then shall they fast in those days.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den baka taki: “Ná wan sama di e teke wan nyun pisi koosi fu nai wan kaasi koosi di piiti. Bika efi i lapu a gaandi koosi anga wan nyunyun pisi, da te i wasi en, da a nyunyun pisi koosi o ali piiti wan pisi fu a gaandi koosi, da a olo o moo bigi.
eng_text: No man also seweth a piece of new cloth on an old garment: else the new piece that filled it up taketh away from the old, and the rent is made worse.

djk_text: Da na soseefi tu, sama nái poti nyun meke win go a ini gaandi meti buba saka. Efu den poti en, da a win o basi a saka. Da ala den tu, a win anga a saka o poli. A dati meke, nyunyun win meke fu poti a ini nyunyun saka, di á poi basi lasi en.”
eng_text: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles: else the new wine doth burst the bottles, and the wine is spilled, and the bottles will be marred: but new wine must be put into new bottles.

djk_text: Da na a kina dei fu den Dyu, ne Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en e waka pasa a ini wan goon. Ne den bakaman fi en e booko den ede fu wan sani gei kalu, di den sama paandi a ini a goon, e pii e nyan.
eng_text: And it came to pass, that he went through the corn fields on the sabbath day; and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of corn.

djk_text: Ne den Faliseiman di si akisi en taki: “Luku de! Saide meke den bakaman fi yu e du sani di sama á mu du a kina dei? Yu nái si taki na Gadu weiti den e poli, no?”
eng_text: And the Pharisees said unto him, Behold, why do they on the sabbath day that which is not lawful?

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “U á leisi a Masaa Gadu Buku san Kownu Dafeti be du di a be de a nowtu, di angii be kii en anga den man fi en, no?
eng_text: And he said unto them, Have ye never read what David did, when he had need, and was an hungred, he, and they that were with him?

djk_text: U á leisi fa a be go a ini a Mama Keliki fu Masaa Gadu, na a ten di Abiyatali be de a moo hei begiman fu Dyu, no? A go, ne a teke a beele di den poti a Gadu fesi, ne a nyan. A weiti á be e gi en pasi fu nyan a beele de. Na den begiman fu keliki namo be sa nyanmi en. Da u á leisi, fa a be gi den bakaman fi en fu den nyan tu, no?
eng_text: How he went into the house of God in the days of Abiathar the high priest, and did eat the shewbread, which is not lawful to eat but for the priests, and gave also to them which were with him?

djk_text: Da u meke mi taigi u. A kina dei be meke gi libisama, ma a ná libisama be meke gi kina dei.
eng_text: And he said unto them, The sabbath was made for man, and not man for the sabbath:

djk_text: Bika a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya, na a gaan Masaa fu a kina dei.”
