eng_text: Therefore the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.

djk_text: Masaa Jesesi go a ini wan Dyu keliki baka. Ma, da wan man be de ape, di be siki ne en ana te a be dee fika kamboo.
eng_text: And he entered again into the synagogue; and there was a man there which had a withered hand.

djk_text: Da den sama be de koosube e luku Masaa Jesesi. Den be e luku fu si efu a be o deesi a man na a kina dei ya, fu den be fende en go kaagi taki ai du sani di á bun.
eng_text: And they watched him, whether he would heal him on the sabbath day; that they might accuse him.

djk_text: We, na so Masaa Jesesi taigi a man di be siki ne ana taki: “Opo taampu a fesi fu ala sama ya.”
eng_text: And he saith unto the man which had the withered hand, Stand forth.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi akisi den taki: “San Gadu Buku taki fu a kina dei? U mu du bun efu u mu du ogii? Fu deesi wan sama fu a kon bun baka efu fika en fu dede?” Ma ala den sama de pii. Ná wan fu den piki en.
eng_text: And he saith unto them, Is it lawful to do good on the sabbath days, or to do evil? to save life, or to kill? But they held their peace.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi luku den anga atiboon. Ma soseefi a ati en tu, fu di a si taki den sama taanga den ati gi Masaa Gadu te, tyali fu taa sama nái kisi den moo. Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi a man taki: “Langa i ana!” Ne a man langa en ana. Ne a ana kon bun kelle baka.
eng_text: And when he had looked round about on them with anger, being grieved for the hardness of their hearts, he saith unto the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched it out: and his hand was restored whole as the other.

djk_text: Ne den Faliseiman gwe komoto na a keliki. Da den anga den bakaman fu Kownu Helowdesi meke mofu luku fa den sa fende wan Masaa Jesesi kii.
eng_text: And the Pharisees went forth, and straightway took counsel with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en go a wataa mofu, na a ze fu Galileya. Da somen sama fu Galileya anga Judeja anga Jelusalem, Idumeya anga den kondee na abaase fu a Joodani Liba anga a pisiwataa fu Tilosi anga Sidon kon e waka ne en baka. Den be kon ne en fu di den be yee fu ala den sani di a be e du.
eng_text: But Jesus withdrew himself with his disciples to the sea: and a great multitude from Galilee followed him, and from Judaea,

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den bakaman fi en taki: “U seeka wan boto gi mi, fu den sama á toto kon banda mi.”
eng_text: And he spake to his disciples, that a small ship should wait on him because of the multitude, lest they should throng him.

djk_text: Da Masaa Jesesi deesi somen sama te, ala sama di be abi wan siki be e toto kon, soso fu oli en namo.
eng_text: For he had healed many; insomuch that they pressed upon him for to touch him, as many as had plagues.

djk_text: Da a yuu de, te den sama di wan takuu jeje be de a den tapu be si Masaa Jesesi, da den be e kai a doti ne en fesi e bali taki: “Yu na a Manpikin fu Masaa Gadu!”
eng_text: And unclean spirits, when they saw him, fell down before him, and cried, saying, Thou art the Son of God.

djk_text: Ma, te den takuu jeje be e bali so, da Masaa Jesesi be e kaasi den fu den á taki sama ne en.
eng_text: And he straitly charged them that they should not make him known.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi go a wan mongo tapu. Ne a kai den sama di a wani kon ne en. Ne den kon ne en.
eng_text: And he goeth up into a mountain, and calleth unto him whom he would: and they came unto him.

djk_text: Ne a teke twalufu man puu a den mindii. Da na den twalufu man ya a kai aposteli tu. Da den be o de anga en na ala pe a be e go. Ne a sende den twalufu man ya, go a den kondee kondee fu go paati a Bun Nyunsu fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: And he ordained twelve, that they should be with him, and that he might send them forth to preach,

djk_text: Da a be gi den a makiti tu fu yaki takuu jeje puu a sama tapu.
eng_text: And to have power to heal sicknesses, and to cast out devils:

djk_text: Da na den twalufu man ya a be teke puu a den taawan mindii: Simon di Masaa Jesesi be kai Peitilisi
eng_text: And Simon he surnamed Peter;

djk_text: Jakowbesi, anga en baala Johanisi den tu manpikin fu Da Sebedi. Da Masaa Jesesi be gi den a nen fu Bowanegesi, dati wani taki, Pikin fu Donduu.
eng_text: And James the son of Zebedee, and John the brother of James; and he surnamed them Boanerges, which is, The sons of thunder:

djk_text: Andeleyasi Filipi Baatomeyosi Tadeyesi Mateyesi Jakowbesi a manpikin fu Alefeyosi Tadeyesi Simon Selotu
eng_text: And Andrew, and Philip, and Bartholomew, and Matthew, and Thomas, and James the son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus, and Simon the Canaanite,

djk_text: Judasi Iskaliyotu, di seli Masaa Jesesi, meke den kii en.
eng_text: And Judas Iscariot, which also betrayed him: and they went into an house.

djk_text: Ne bakadati, ne Masaa Jesesi go a wan osu. Da sama kon fuu a osu fu Masaa Jesesi, te en anga den bakaman fi en á be poi nyan.
eng_text: And the multitude cometh together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.

djk_text: Da di den sama fu Masaa Jesesi yee a sani ya, ne den go fu go teke en puu de. Den taki: “A á sabi san ai du moo.”
eng_text: And when his friends heard of it, they went out to lay hold on him: for they said, He is beside himself.

djk_text: Da den leliman fu Dyuweiti di be komoto a Jelusalem Foto kon de taki: “Belisebulu, a basi fu didibii, de ne en tapu! Na Belisebulu e gi en a taanga fu puu takuu jeje a sama tapu.”
eng_text: And the scribes which came down from Jerusalem said, He hath Beelzebub, and by the prince of the devils casteth he out devils.

djk_text: Ma namo, Masaa Jesesi kai den kon makandii. Ne a gi den wan ageisi toli. A taki: “Fa didibii sa puu didibii a wan peesi?
eng_text: And he called them unto him, and said unto them in parables, How can Satan cast out Satan?

djk_text: Efu wan kownu fu kondee opo e feti anga enseefi, da a kondee de, a ná booko a o booko, no?
eng_text: And if a kingdom be divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.

djk_text: Da, soseefi a de anga wan osu tu. Efu den sama e libi fanya fanya anga feyanti fasi anga denseefi, sowan osu musu booko.
eng_text: And if a house be divided against itself, that house cannot stand.

djk_text: Da efu saatan paati paati e feti anga enseefi, da na a kaba pisi fi en a doo, bika a o booko kaba a soso.
eng_text: And if Satan rise up against himself, and be divided, he cannot stand, but hath an end.

djk_text: Ná wan sama o poi go a ini a osu fu wan gaan taanga man go teke en gudu. Efu a wani go, da a mu kisi a gaan taanga man tei banda fosi. Da, te a tei en banda so kaba, da a sa go a ini a taanga man osu, go teke en gudu.
eng_text: No man can enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he will first bind the strong man; and then he will spoil his house.

djk_text: Da fu tuutuu mi e taigi u taki, Masaa Gadu sa gi sama paadon. Awinsi sowtu ogii a du efu awinsi fa a kosi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Verily I say unto you, All sins shall be forgiven unto the sons of men, and blasphemies wherewith soever they shall blaspheme:

djk_text: Ma awinsi sama na yu, efi i kosi a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu, taki ogii fi en, da noiti noiti Masaa Gadu o gi i paadon fu dati.”
eng_text: But he that shall blaspheme against the Holy Ghost hath never forgiveness, but is in danger of eternal damnation:

djk_text: Da na so Masaa Jesesi piki den sama, fu di den be taki na Belisebulu, a basi fu didibii, de ne en tapu.
eng_text: Because they said, He hath an unclean spirit.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi mma anga den baala fi en doo na a osu pe a de. Den taampu a doose, ne den sende bosikopu gi en fu a kon a den.
eng_text: There came then his brethren and his mother, and, standing without, sent unto him, calling him.

djk_text: Ne den sama di be sidon lontu Masaa Jesesi taigi en taki: “Masaa Jesesi, i mma anga den baala fi yu de a doose. Den e kai yu.”
eng_text: And the multitude sat about him, and they said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren without seek for thee.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “A bun! Ma sama na mi mma? Sama na mi baala?”
eng_text: And he answered them, saying, Who is my mother, or my brethren?

djk_text: Ne a luku den sama di be sidon lontu en, ne a taki: “Luku mi mma anga mi baala ya.
eng_text: And he looked round about on them which sat about him, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!

djk_text: Ala sama di e du san Masaa Gadu wani, na den na mi baala anga mi sisa anga mi mma.”
eng_text: For whosoever shall do the will of God, the same is my brother, and my sister, and mother.

djk_text: Da, Jesesi de na a ze fu Galileya e leli den sama baka. Da somen sama kon ne en. Ne Masaa Jesesi go a ini wan boto, ne a sidon. Ma ala den taa sama be de a soo a wataa mofu.
eng_text: And he began again to teach by the sea side: and there was gathered unto him a great multitude, so that he entered into a ship, and sat in the sea; and the whole multitude was by the sea on the land.

djk_text: Da, ai gi den ageisi toli fu leli den somen sani. Da, di ai leli den, ne a taigi den taki:
eng_text: And he taught them many things by parables, and said unto them in his doctrine,

djk_text: “U aliki! Wan dei, da wan paandi goonman be go tyatya wan sii fi en, fu goo.
eng_text: Hearken; Behold, there went out a sower to sow:

djk_text: Da, di a tyatya a sii, ne wantu kai a sikin pasi. Ne foo fee kon, ne den nyan ala.
eng_text: And it came to pass, as he sowed, some fell by the way side, and the fowls of the air came and devoured it up.

djk_text: Da, wantu taa sii kai a siton ini, a pe doti á be de ipi. Da den sii ya goo esi esi, bika a doti á be dipi.
eng_text: And some fell on stony ground, where it had not much earth; and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of earth:

djk_text: Da, di a san opo, ne a boon den kii. Bika den ná abi ná wan lutu, fu di a doti á be dipi sai.
eng_text: But when the sun was up, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.

djk_text: Wantu taa sii kai a maka ini. Ne den maka goo banda den kii. Den á meke nyanyan.
eng_text: And some fell among thorns, and the thorns grew up, and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.

djk_text: Ma, taa sii kai a bun doti, ne den goo moi. Den meke nyanyan bun. Son fu den meke diitenti toon moo enke san di a be paandi. Taawan meke sigisitenti toon moo enke san a be paandi. Taawan baka meke wan ondoo toon moo enke san a be paandi.”
eng_text: And other fell on good ground, and did yield fruit that sprang up and increased; and brought forth, some thirty, and some sixty, and some an hundred.

djk_text: Ne a taigi den taki: “Meke sama di abi yesi fu yee, da meke a yee san mi taki ya.”
eng_text: And he said unto them, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.

djk_text: Da, di Masaa Jesesi anga den twalufu bakaman fi en anga wantu taa sama di be e waka ne en baka wawan be de, ne den akisi en taki: “Masaa Jesesi, san wani taki a toli di i be leli den sama de?”
eng_text: And when he was alone, they that were about him with the twelve asked of him the parable.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “U di e waka a Masaa Gadu pasi, kon sabi somen kibii toli fu a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu. Ma den sama di á de a Masaa Gadu pasi, na ageisi toli fasi mi e gi den en. Bika,
eng_text: And he said unto them, Unto you it is given to know the mystery of the kingdom of God: but unto them that are without, all these things are done in parables:

djk_text: ‘Den e luku anga opo opo ain, ma den nái si. Den e yee anga kiinkiin yesi, ma den nái fusutan san den e yee. Da noiti den daai den libi kon a mi. A dati meke noiti den fende paadon fu den takuudu anga ogii fu den.’ ”
eng_text: That seeing they may see, and not perceive; and hearing they may hear, and not understand; lest at any time they should be converted, and their sins should be forgiven them.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi akisi den taki: “U á fusutan a toli, no? Da, fa u o du fusutan den taa toli di mi o teke gi den sama fu leli den sani?”
eng_text: And he said unto them, Know ye not this parable? and how then will ye know all parables?

djk_text: Ne a puu en gi den taki: “A goonman, di be e tyatya a sii, dati na a sama di e paati a wowtu fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: The sower soweth the word.

djk_text: Da somen sama de enke sii di kai a sikin pasi. Solanga den yee a wowtu fu Masaa Gadu, da a didibii e kon, da a piki a wowtu di paandi a ini en ati ini puu wanten wanten.
eng_text: And these are they by the way side, where the word is sown; but when they have heard, Satan cometh immediately, and taketh away the word that was sown in their hearts.

djk_text: Somen sama de enke sii di paandi a wan pisi doti di abi tyaipi siton. Solanga den yee a wowtu fu Masaa Gadu, den e teke en wanten wanten anga gaan piisii.
eng_text: And these are they likewise which are sown on stony ground; who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with gladness;

djk_text: Ma ná wan lutu di den e meke. Den e de namo fu wan satu pisiten. Bika, te nowtu anga pina kon a den tapu fu a wowtu ede, da wanten den e daai fika a biibi.
eng_text: And have no root in themselves, and so endure but for a time: afterward, when affliction or persecution ariseth for the word's sake, immediately they are offended.

djk_text: Taa sama de enke sii, di paandi a ini maka. Den e yee a wowtu,
eng_text: And these are they which are sown among thorns; such as hear the word,

djk_text: ma den booko fu a libi anga a feti fu fende tyaipi gudu anga taa sani a goontapu anga a lobi fu goontapu sani seefi, e tyoko a wowtu a ini den ati ini kii, meke a á poi meke nyanyan.
eng_text: And the cares of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in, choke the word, and it becometh unfruitful.

djk_text: Ma taawan de enke sii, di kai a bunbun doti. Den e yee a wowtu. Den e teke en. Da, den e meke tyaipi tyaipi nyanyan. Son e meke diitenti, sigisitenti anga wan ondoo toon fu san di den be paandi.”
eng_text: And these are they which are sown on good ground; such as hear the word, and receive it, and bring forth fruit, some thirtyfold, some sixty, and some an hundred.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “Te i leti wan lampu a ini wan osu, yu nái toosi en go a kama ondoo efu teke boketi tapu en. Nono! Yu o poti en a tapu, efuso yu o oli en hei fu a sa leti kiin peesi.
eng_text: And he said unto them, Is a candle brought to be put under a bushel, or under a bed? and not to be set on a candlestick?

djk_text: Da, ná wan sani de kibii, di ná o kon a kiin fu sama sabi.
eng_text: For there is nothing hid, which shall not be manifested; neither was any thing kept secret, but that it should come abroad.

djk_text: Meke sama di abi yesi fu yee, yee san mi taki ya!”
eng_text: If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den go doo taki: “Na fa u e aliki den sani di u e yee, na so u o fusutan den tu fu teke koni. Bika a de leti enke wan nongo di taki: ‘Fa yu e maiki sani gi sama, na so sama o maiki sani gi yu baka.’ Da moo ipi seefi yu o kisi a tapu.
eng_text: And he said unto them, Take heed what ye hear: with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you: and unto you that hear shall more be given.

djk_text: Bika, a sama di fende wan pikinso koni nownow, ne a wooko anga en, a sa fende moo ipi. Ma, a sama, di ná o wooko anga a pikinso koni di a abi nownow, a sa lasi ala san a be abi.”
eng_text: For he that hath, to him shall be given: and he that hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he hath.

djk_text: Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “A Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu de enke, te wan goonman, go a goon wan dei, go paandi sii. Di a paandi den sii, te a kaba, ne a go fi en a kondee baka.
eng_text: And he said, So is the kingdom of God, as if a man should cast seed into the ground;

djk_text: Ne a de fi en a kondee. Neti ai siibi, dei ten a de fi en anga ain. Ma a sii goo sondee fu a man sabi fa a du goo.
eng_text: And should sleep, and rise night and day, and the seed should spring and grow up, he knoweth not how.

djk_text: Ma, namo baka wan pisiten, ne den sii goo. Den booko ain kon a tapu doti, ne den goo, te puu boomiki meke nyanyan.
eng_text: For the earth bringeth forth fruit of herself; first the blade, then the ear, after that the full corn in the ear.

djk_text: Da, wanten wanten, di a sii meke nyanyan lepi, ne a goonman teke en babun nefi, ne a go koti den. Bika, a yuu fu koti den sii ya, be doo kaba.”
eng_text: But when the fruit is brought forth, immediately he putteth in the sickle, because the harvest is come.

djk_text: Ne, Masaa Jesesi akisi den baka taki: “Sowtu ageisi toli mi sa teke soi u, fu u sa sabi fa a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu de, moo?
eng_text: And he said, Whereunto shall we liken the kingdom of God? or with what comparison shall we compare it?

djk_text: We, meke u taki: A de enke wan sii den e kai mosite. A sii ya na wan pikintoin sii.
eng_text: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, is less than all the seeds that be in the earth:

djk_text: Ma, te den paandi en, te a goo, da ai bigi moo ala den taa sani di den paandi a ini a goon. Den ana fi en e bigi paati, te den foo e meke nesi e teke koo a den.”
eng_text: But when it is sown, it groweth up, and becometh greater than all herbs, and shooteth out great branches; so that the fowls of the air may lodge under the shadow of it.

djk_text: Da, te Masaa Jesesi be e gi den sama Gadu wowtu, da a be lobi teke den sowtu toli ya gi den sama. Da na a fasi ya, den be sa fusutan san a be wani leli den.
eng_text: And with many such parables spake he the word unto them, as they were able to hear it.

djk_text: Da a á be e taki anga den sondee fu gi den, den sowtu toli ya. Ma, te en anga den bakaman fi en wawan be de, da a be e puu ala sani gi den fini fini.
eng_text: But without a parable spake he not unto them: and when they were alone, he expounded all things to his disciples.

djk_text: Da, di sapaten doo, ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den bakaman fi en taki: “U kon meke u abaa go na abaase.”
eng_text: And the same day, when the even was come, he saith unto them, Let us pass over unto the other side.

djk_text: Ne den fika den somen sama wawan a baka, ne den go a boto anga Masaa Jesesi e go na abaase. Da, wantu taa boto be e koti abaa anga en tu.
eng_text: And when they had sent away the multitude, they took him even as he was in the ship. And there were also with him other little ships.

djk_text: Ma namo, wan gaan winta kisi den a pasi. Da a wataa be seke, meke gaan paana e wasi kon a ini a boto te. A boto fuu kwaa, pikinmoo den sungu.
eng_text: And there arose a great storm of wind, and the waves beat into the ship, so that it was now full.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi be didon a bakase fu a boto, poti ede a wan kunsu e siibi. Ne den bakaman fi en weki en taki: “Mesiti! I á si taki, wi o dede kaba a soso, no? I ná abi toobi seefi taki, wi o dede, no?”
eng_text: And he was in the hinder part of the ship, asleep on a pillow: and they awake him, and say unto him, Master, carest thou not that we perish?

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi opo, ne a kaasi a winta fu tan pii. Ne a taigi a ze taki: “Kaba! Tan pii!” Ne a winta tan pii. A ze seefi koo pii tu. A winta nái wai taanga moo, a ze nái seke moo.
eng_text: And he arose, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, Peace, be still. And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi akisi den bakaman fi en taki: “Saide meke u feele so? U á poti fitoow a mi ete, no?”
eng_text: And he said unto them, Why are ye so fearful? how is it that ye have no faith?

djk_text: Ne den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi feele, te den e akisi denseefi taki: “Sama na a sama ya seefi? A winta anga a ze seefi e teke en taki!”
eng_text: And they feared exceedingly, and said one to another, What manner of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en go doo na abaase fu a ze fu Galileya. Ne den poti boto na a pisiwataa fu den Gelaseini sama.
eng_text: And they came over unto the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes.

djk_text: Fa i si Masaa Jesesi komoto a soo, ne wan man lon kon ne en. Wan takuu jeje be de na a man ya tapu.
eng_text: And when he was come out of the ship, immediately there met him out of the tombs a man with an unclean spirit,

djk_text: Da na den siton geebi mindii a man ya be e tan. A be taanga te, ná wan sama be poi kisi en tei moo. Keti seefi á be poi keti en.
eng_text: Who had his dwelling among the tombs; and no man could bind him, no, not with chains:

djk_text: Na onmen leisi den bui en ana anga en futu anga keti, ma a booko den keti enke lawlaw sani. Ná wan sama di be poi oli en.
eng_text: Because that he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been plucked asunder by him, and the fetters broken in pieces: neither could any man tame him.

djk_text: Dei anga neti a man ya be de a ini a belipe anga den mongo mindii e waka e bali gaan balibali e naki enseefi koti anga siton.
eng_text: And always, night and day, he was in the mountains, and in the tombs, crying, and cutting himself with stones.

djk_text: Da, a man de, te a faawe si Masaa Jesesi, ne a go ne en. Ne a sutu kini a doti, a Masaa Jesesi fesi.
eng_text: But when he saw Jesus afar off, he ran and worshipped him,

djk_text: Ne a bali taki: “San mi anga yu abi nownow kaba, Jesesi, Pikin fu a moo Hei Gadu? Mi teke Gadu nen begi yu, ná sitaafu mi, baa!”
eng_text: And cried with a loud voice, and said, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of the most high God? I adjure thee by God, that thou torment me not.

djk_text: Da, na fu di Masaa Jesesi be kaasi a takuu jeje, fu a gwe komoto na a man tapu wanten wanten, meke a be e bali so.
eng_text: For he said unto him, Come out of the man, thou unclean spirit.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi akisi en taki: “Fa den e kai yu nen?” Ne a takuu jeje piki taki: “Na mi den e kai Hipiman, bika u de ya anga tyaipi man.”
eng_text: And he asked him, What is thy name? And he answered, saying, My name is Legion: for we are many.

djk_text: Ne, den begi Masaa Jesesi taki: “Gaantangi, ná yaki u puu na a pisiwataa ya, baa!”
eng_text: And he besought him much that he would not send them away out of the country.

djk_text: Da, somen somen agu be de a wan mongo koosube de, e suku sani fu nyan.
eng_text: Now there was there nigh unto the mountains a great herd of swine feeding.

djk_text: Ne den takuu jeje begi Masaa Jesesi taki: “Te i puu wi na a sama ya, sende u go a ini den agu, baa!”
eng_text: And all the devils besought him, saying, Send us into the swine, that we may enter into them.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi meke den go. Den takuu jeje komoto na man, ne den go a ini den agu. Ne wanten wanten, ne ala den tu dunsu agu lon saka a mongo hullu, te a ze dubuu. Ná wan di komoto moo. Ala fiya dede.
eng_text: And forthwith Jesus gave them leave. And the unclean spirits went out, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the sea, (they were about two thousand;) and were choked in the sea.

djk_text: Ne, den sama di be e luku den agu si san pasa, ne den lon gwe. Ne den paati a mofu na a hii kondee anga a pisiwataa de, fu san pasa. Da, na so den sama komoto kon luku san pasa.
eng_text: And they that fed the swine fled, and told it in the city, and in the country. And they went out to see what it was that was done.

djk_text: Da, di den doo Masaa Jesesi, ne den si a man, di den tyaipi takuu jeje be de ne en tapu. A sidon de pii, wei koosi moi, de fi en anga en bunbun fusutan baka. Da, den sama feele fu san den si ya.
eng_text: And they come to Jesus, and see him that was possessed with the devil, and had the legion, sitting, and clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.

djk_text: Den sama di be si, taigi sama san den si pasa anga a man, di den takuu jeje be de ne en tapu anga den agu.
eng_text: And they that saw it told them how it befell to him that was possessed with the devil, and also concerning the swine.

djk_text: Ne, di den sama yee so, ne den bigin begi Masaa Jesesi gaantangi fu a komoto a den kondee de gwe.
eng_text: And they began to pray him to depart out of their coasts.

djk_text: Ne, fa i si Masaa Jesesi go a boto baka, ne a man, di den takuu jeje be de ne en tapu begi en taki: “Meke mi go anga yu, baa?”
eng_text: And when he was come into the ship, he that had been possessed with the devil prayed him that he might be with him.

djk_text: Ma, Masaa Jesesi á gi pasi fu dati. Pe fu dati, ne a taigi a man taki: “Nono! Go a osu a den sama fi yu, da taigi den san Masaa du gi yu, anga fa a be abi tyali ati fi yu.”
eng_text: Howbeit Jesus suffered him not, but saith unto him, Go home to thy friends, and tell them how great things the Lord hath done for thee, and hath had compassion on thee.

djk_text: Ne a man go. Ne ai paati a mofu fu san di Masaa Jesesi du gi en na a hii pisi kondee di den e kai Dekapolisi . Da ala sama be e foondoo fu a sani ya.
eng_text: And he departed, and began to publish in Decapolis how great things Jesus had done for him: and all men did marvel.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi abaa a ze fu Galileya baka go na abaase. Da somen sama kon ne en a wataa mofu te a ipi.
eng_text: And when Jesus was passed over again by ship unto the other side, much people gathered unto him: and he was nigh unto the sea.

djk_text: Wan man den e kai Yailesi seefi kon a Masaa Jesesi tu. Di a si Masaa Jesesi, ne, wanten a sutu kini a doti ne en fesi. Yailesi na be wan fu den edeman fu Dyu keliki.
eng_text: And, behold, there cometh one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name; and when he saw him, he fell at his feet,

djk_text: Ne a begi Masaa Jesesi taki: “Masaa Jesesi! Wan pikin umanpikin fu mi e dede, baa. Gaantangi, kon poti yu ana ne en tapu, gi mi baa, fu a kon bun baka, da a o libi!”
eng_text: And besought him greatly, saying, My little daughter lieth at the point of death: I pray thee, come and lay thy hands on her, that she may be healed; and she shall live.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi e go anga en. Da, somen sama be e kon a Masaa Jesesi baka. Den be e toto fu ala se e kon ne en.
eng_text: And Jesus went with him; and much people followed him, and thronged him.

djk_text: Ma, wan uman be de a ini den somen sama de di be abi wan lasi buulu siki. Twalufu yali kaba, di a be kisi en, sondee fu koti.
eng_text: And a certain woman, which had an issue of blood twelve years,

djk_text: Anga ala fa a uman ya, be pai anga ala a moni di a be abi fu suku yeepi a somen somen dataa, toku a á be poi fende yeepi. Pe fu dati, ne na moo a siki be e moo ogii.
eng_text: And had suffered many things of many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was nothing bettered, but rather grew worse,

djk_text: Ma fanafu di a uman ya yee den sani di Masaa Jesesi e du, ne a waka ne en baka a ini den somen sama, ne a oli en koosi.
eng_text: When she had heard of Jesus, came in the press behind, and touched his garment.

djk_text: Bika a be e taki a ini enseefi taki: “Efu mi sa lobi ana ne en koosi namo, mi sa kon bun.”
eng_text: For she said, If I may touch but his clothes, I shall be whole.

djk_text: Ne wanten, a buulu koti. Ne a fii a ini en sikin taki, a kon bun fu den pina fu ala den yali.
eng_text: And straightway the fountain of her blood was dried up; and she felt in her body that she was healed of that plague.

djk_text: Ne a seefi yuu de, ne Masaa Jesesi fii kaakiti e komoto ne en sikin go deesi wan sama. Ne a daai a ini den somen sama, ne a akisi taki: “Sama meli mi koosi?”
eng_text: And Jesus, immediately knowing in himself that virtue had gone out of him, turned him about in the press, and said, Who touched my clothes?

djk_text: Ne, den bakaman fi en taigi en taki: “Masaa Jesesi, fa i sa akisi sama meli yu? Luku onmen sama e toto yu fu ala se ya.”
eng_text: And his disciples said unto him, Thou seest the multitude thronging thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me?

djk_text: Ma, ai daai e luku fu si a sama di meli en.
eng_text: And he looked round about to see her that had done this thing.

djk_text: Ne a uman kon a fesi anga ala feele anga dansi sikin. Bika a sabi san pasa anga en seefi. Ne a saka kini a Masaa Jesesi fesi, ne a taigi en pilisisi ala san pasa anga en, di a oli en.
eng_text: But the woman fearing and trembling, knowing what was done in her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.

djk_text: Ne, Masaa Jesesi taigi en taki: “Uman! A biibi fi yu yeepi yu fi i kon bun baka. Go baka a osu anga koo ati! A gaan pina siki wai pasa gwe.”
eng_text: And he said unto her, Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace, and be whole of thy plague.

djk_text: Da, a ten di Masaa Jesesi e taki anga a uman ya ete, ne wantu sama komoto a Yailesi osu tyai mofu kon. Den taigi Yailesi taki: “A pikin umanpikin fi yu dede. A á de fi i muliki a mesiti fu a go anda moo.”
eng_text: While he yet spake, there came from the ruler of the synagogue's house certain which said, Thy daughter is dead: why troublest thou the Master any further?

djk_text: Ma, Masaa Jesesi yee, di den gi Yailesi a bosikopu. Ne a taigi Yailesi taki: “Ná feele! Ma biibi namo.”
eng_text: As soon as Jesus heard the word that was spoken, he saith unto the ruler of the synagogue, Be not afraid, only believe.

djk_text: Ma, boiti Peitilisi anga Jakowbesi anga Johanisi, da Masaa Jesesi á meke ná wan sama go anga en moo a Yailesi osu.
eng_text: And he suffered no man to follow him, save Peter, and James, and John the brother of James.

djk_text: Da, di den doo Yailesi osu, ne Masaa Jesesi si soso kee anga balibali de. Sama e kee e bali, te ná sipowtu.
eng_text: And he cometh to the house of the ruler of the synagogue, and seeth the tumult, and them that wept and wailed greatly.

djk_text: Ne, di Masaa Jesesi go a ini a osu, ne a akisi den taki: “Saide meke u e kee e bali so du? A pikin á dede! Na siibi namo ai siibi!”
eng_text: And when he was come in, he saith unto them, Why make ye this ado, and weep? the damsel is not dead, but sleepeth.

djk_text: Ne, den sama kii en anga lafu. Ma, Masaa Jesesi poti ala den fiya a doo. Ne, a teke a dda anga a mma fu a pikin anga den dii bakaman fi en, ne den go a pe a pikin de.
eng_text: And they laughed him to scorn. But when he had put them all out, he taketh the father and the mother of the damsel, and them that were with him, and entereth in where the damsel was lying.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi oli a pikin ana, ne a taigi en taki: “
eng_text: And he took the damsel by the hand, and said unto her, Talitha cumi; which is, being interpreted, Damsel, I say unto thee, arise.

djk_text: Ne wanten wanten, ne a pikin umanpikin opo, ne a bigin e waka e lontu a ini a osu. Da a pikin abi twalufu yali kaba. Da a sani, di pasa ya bigi gi den sama, te ná sipowtu.
eng_text: And straightway the damsel arose, and walked; for she was of the age of twelve years. And they were astonished with a great astonishment.

djk_text: Ne, Masaa Jesesi bali den taanga taanga fu den á meke ná wan sama sabi san pasa de. Soseefi tu a taigi den fu den gi a pikin sani fu nyan.
eng_text: And he charged them straitly that no man should know it; and commanded that something should be given her to eat.

djk_text: Masaa Jesesi komoto de, ne a go ne en eigi kondee. Da den bakaman fi en go anga en tu.
eng_text: And he went out from thence, and came into his own country; and his disciples follow him.

djk_text: Ne, di a kina dei fu den Dyu doo, ne a bigin fu leli sama Masaa Gadu wowtu a ini a Dyu keliki. Somen sama, di yee en, foondoo, te den e akisi taki: “Pe a man ya komoto, a anga den sani di ai leli de? Pe a fende a koni de? Sama gi en a kaakiti fu ai du den gaan foondoo wooko di wi yee ai du?
eng_text: And when the sabbath day was come, he began to teach in the synagogue: and many hearing him were astonished, saying, From whence hath this man these things? and what wisdom is this which is given unto him, that even such mighty works are wrought by his hands?

djk_text: A ná a tembeeman de ya, no? A ná a pikin fu Maliya, no? U sabi den baala fi en bunbun, Jakowbesi, Jowsef, Judasi anga Simon. A ná wi anga den sisa fi en e tan a Nasaleti ya, no?” Da na so den teke en fu ogii. Den ná abi bisi anga en.
eng_text: Is not this the carpenter, the son of Mary, the brother of James, and Joses, and of Juda, and Simon? and are not his sisters here with us? And they were offended at him.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Ala sama fu goontapu e lesipeki wan apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu, ma den sama fi en eigi kondee seefi, en eigi famii anga den sama fi en eigi osu ini, nái lesipeki en.”
eng_text: But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, but in his own country, and among his own kin, and in his own house.

djk_text: A á be poi du ná wan foondoo sani de, boiti taki a poti ana a wantu sikiman tapu deesi den.
eng_text: And he could there do no mighty work, save that he laid his hands upon a few sick folk, and healed them.

djk_text: Da, a be foondoo Masaa Jesesi, fu di den sama fi en eigi kondee á be wani poti biibi ne en. Ne a komoto de go a wantu taa kondee na a seefi pisiwataa de, go e leli sama Masaa Gadu wowtu.
eng_text: And he marvelled because of their unbelief. And he went round about the villages, teaching.

djk_text: Ne wan dei, ne a kai den twalufu apaiti bosikopuman fi en kon, ne a sende den, tu tu man, fu den go a den kondee kondee go paati Masaa Gadu wowtu. Ne a taigi den taki: “U go! Mi gi u taanga fu u puu takuu jeje a sama tapu.
eng_text: And he called unto him the twelve, and began to send them forth by two and two; and gave them power over unclean spirits;

djk_text: Ma, te u e go, u á mu tyai ná wan enkii taa sani moo enke wan waka tiki namo a u ana. U á mu tyai beele. U á lai tasi tyai.
eng_text: And commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, save a staff only; no scrip, no bread, no money in their purse:

djk_text: U á mu tyai taa susu anga koosi. Den di u wei de sai kaba.”
eng_text: But be shod with sandals; and not put on two coats.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “Di u o go, te u go a wan osu, da u mu tan de, te enke u kaba fu gwe baka.
eng_text: And he said unto them, In what place soever ye enter into an house, there abide till ye depart from that place.

djk_text: Da, te u doo wan peesi pe sama á wani teke u a den osu efu aliki a bosikopu di u e tyai. Da u mu gwe. Ma fosi u gwe, da u mu naki u futu puu a santi meke den sabi taki den be fende a okasi fu aliki a Bun Nyunsu fu mi. Da a fika gi den.”
eng_text: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear you, when ye depart thence, shake off the dust under your feet for a testimony against them. Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city.

djk_text: Da, na so den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi gwe. Ne den go a den kondee kondee go e bali den sama taki, meke den daai libi.
eng_text: And they went out, and preached that men should repent.

djk_text: Da, den yaki somen takuu jeje puu a sama tapu. Soseefi den lobi oli a somen sikisama sikin deesi den kon bun baka.
eng_text: And they cast out many devils, and anointed with oil many that were sick, and healed them.

djk_text: Da Kownu Helowdesi seefi yee fu den sani di Masaa Jesesi e du. Bika Masaa Jesesi nen be bali na ala peesi. Son sama taki: “Johanisi a Dopuman weki komoto a dede kon a libi baka. A dati meke a abi a kaakiti fu du den gaan foondoo foondoo sani ya.”
eng_text: And king Herod heard of him; (for his name was spread abroad:) and he said, That John the Baptist was risen from the dead, and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.

djk_text: Taawan taki: “Na Eliya! Ne en de ya.” Taawan taki: “Na wan apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu, enke wan fu den fositen apaiti takiman.”
eng_text: Others said, That it is Elias. And others said, That it is a prophet, or as one of the prophets.

djk_text: Ma, di Kownu Helowdesi seefi yee a sani ya, ne a taki: “Na Johanisi di mi be meke den kii, ne weki komoto a dede tuu.”
eng_text: But when Herod heard thereof, he said, It is John, whom I beheaded: he is risen from the dead.

djk_text: Bika, Kownu Helowdesi be meke den kisi Johanisi tei poti a dunguu osu. Da, na fu Helowdiya ede meke a du dati. Bika a be libi anga Helowdiya. Helowdiya na be a uman fu Filipi, a baala fu Helowdesi.
eng_text: For Herod himself had sent forth and laid hold upon John, and bound him in prison for Herodias' sake, his brother Philip's wife: for he had married her.

djk_text: Da Johanisi be e bali Helowdesi taki, a á bun fu a teke a uman fi en baala libi.
eng_text: For John had said unto Herod, It is not lawful for thee to have thy brother's wife.

djk_text: Da, di Helowdiya yee taki na so Johanisi bali Kownu Helowdesi, ne wan takuu atiboon teke en. A be wani kii Johanisi wanten wanten. Ma den á gi en pasi fu du dati,
eng_text: Therefore Herodias had a quarrel against him, and would have killed him; but she could not:

djk_text: bika Kownu Helowdesi be sabi taki Johanisi na be wan sama, di e libi letiopu fasi gi Masaa Gadu. Da a be e feele en. A dati meke a teke Johanisi poti a wan peesi pe sama á be sa fende en kii. Te a be e taki anga Johanisi, en konsensi be e fonmi en, ma toku, a be lobi aliki Johanisi.
eng_text: For Herod feared John, knowing that he was a just man and an holy, and observed him; and when he heard him, he did many things, and heard him gladly.

djk_text: Na so den de, te wan dei, ne Helowdiya fende pasi fu kii Johanisi. Bika wan dei, Helowdesi oli wan gaan fuuyali piisii fi en a ini en paleisi. Da a be kai ala den sama di e wooko ne en ondoo, den edeman fu suudati den hei hei man fu Galileya.
eng_text: And when a convenient day was come, that Herod on his birthday made a supper to his lords, high captains, and chief estates of Galilee;

djk_text: Ma namo, di den de na fesa, te wan pisi, ne a pikin umanpikin fu Helowdiya kon a pe Helowdesi anga ala den taa sama sidon. Ne a dansi de walla. Da fa a dansi so, a switi gi Kownu Helowdesi anga den taa man te, ná sipowtu. Ne Kownu Helowdesi taigi a pikin taki: “Mama! Akisi mi san i wani! Mi sa gi yu en.”
eng_text: And when the daughter of the said Herodias came in, and danced, and pleased Herod and them that sat with him, the king said unto the damsel, Ask of me whatsoever thou wilt, and I will give it thee.

djk_text: Ne Helowdesi taigi en go doo taki: “Mi e sweli taki, ibii sani di i akisi mi, mi o gi yu en. Efu na afu fu a kondee di mi e tii enke kownu ya seefi i wani, mi o gi yu en.”
eng_text: And he sware unto her, Whatsoever thou shalt ask of me, I will give it thee, unto the half of my kingdom.

djk_text: Ne a pikin umanpikin go a doose ne en mma. Ne a akisi en taki: “Mi mma, san mi mu akisi en?” Ne Helowdiya taigi en taki: “Piki Kownu taki i wani a ede fu Johanisi a Dopuman.”
eng_text: And she went forth, and said unto her mother, What shall I ask? And she said, The head of John the Baptist.

djk_text: Di en mma taigi en so, ne wanten wanten a lon go baka a Kownu Helowdesi baka. Ne a taigi en taki: “Mi wani i gi mi a ede fu Johanisi a Dopuman nownow de a ini wan gaan teepala.”
eng_text: And she came in straightway with haste unto the king, and asked, saying, I will that thou give me by and by in a charger the head of John the Baptist.

djk_text: Da, di kownu yee so, ne gaan tyali kisi. Ma na fu a sweli, di a be meke a den bigiman de fesi gi a pikin umanpikin kaba, meke a á be poi puu a mofu de moo.
eng_text: And the king was exceeding sorry; yet for his oath's sake, and for their sakes which sat with him, he would not reject her.

djk_text: Ne wanten, ne a sende wan fu den man suudati go koti a ede fu Johanisi tyai kon. Ne a man go, ne a doo Johanisi ede felen a ini a sitaafu osu.
eng_text: And immediately the king sent an executioner, and commanded his head to be brought: and he went and beheaded him in the prison,

djk_text: Ne a tyai en kon a ini wan teepala. Ne a gi a pikin umanpikin. Ne a pikin umanpikin teke, ne a gi en mma.
eng_text: And brought his head in a charger, and gave it to the damsel: and the damsel gave it to her mother.

djk_text: Da, di den bakaman fu Johanisi yee taki den kii Johanisi, ne den go teke a dede sikin fu Johanisi go beli.
eng_text: And when his disciples heard of it, they came and took up his corpse, and laid it in a tomb.

djk_text: Da den twalufu apaiti bosikopuman fu Masaa Jesesi di a be sende gwe a den peesi peesi daai kon baka. Da den bigin fu taigi Masaa Jesesi ala san den du anga san den be leli den sama fu den peesi peesi pe a be sende den go.
eng_text: And the apostles gathered themselves together unto Jesus, and told him all things, both what they had done, and what they had taught.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “U kon meke u go a wan koo peesi pe sama á de go boo u sikin afu.” Bika somen sama be komoto a den kondee kondee e kon ne en namo e kon e suku yeepi, te den á be abi ten fu nyan wan bun fasi seefi. A dati meke a be wani go anga den bakaman fi en wawan a wan peesi. Ne den go a boto, ne den puu gwe.
eng_text: And he said unto them, Come ye yourselves apart into a desert place, and rest a while: for there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.

djk_text: Da somen sama si di den e puu gwe, ne den sabi kaba taki na sowan peesi sowan peesi den e go. Ne den lon a soo anga futu, fu te na a peesi pe Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en e go.
eng_text: And the people saw them departing, and many knew him, and ran afoot thither out of all cities, and outwent them, and came together unto him.

djk_text: Da den sama doo fika Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en seefi. Da di den koosube di Masaa Jesesi luku, ne a si wataa mofu baaka pii anga libisama. Da tyali fu den sama kisi Masaa Jesesi. Bika den sama be gei sikapu di ná abi tiiman. A dati meke a leli den sani fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: And Jesus, when he came out, saw much people, and was moved with compassion toward them, because they were as sheep not having a shepherd: and he began to teach them many things.

djk_text: Da di bakadina fosi neti kai, ne den bakaman fi en taigi en taki: “We, Masaa Jesesi ai lati namo.
eng_text: And when the day was now far spent, his disciples came unto him, and said, This is a desert place, and now the time is far passed:

djk_text: Da sende den sama gwe. Da den sa bai sani fu nyan a den pikin pikin kondee. Bika ná wan sama e tan ya, da sani á de ya fu bai tu.”
eng_text: Send them away, that they may go into the country round about, and into the villages, and buy themselves bread: for they have nothing to eat.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Nono! U gi den nyanyan meke den nyan.” Ne den bakaman fi en akisi en taki: “We, u ná abi beele fu gi den somen sama ya. I wani meke u go bai beele gi den? A o dii fu u mu bai nyanyan gi ala den somen sama ya.”
eng_text: He answered and said unto them, Give ye them to eat. And they say unto him, Shall we go and buy two hundred pennyworth of bread, and give them to eat?

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi akisi den taki: “Onmen beele u abi de?” Ne den luku, ne den taki: “U abi feifi beele anga tu fisi ya.”
eng_text: He saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? go and see. And when they knew, they say, Five, and two fishes.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den sama taki meke den saka sidon a kulu ini a gaasi.
eng_text: And he commanded them to make all sit down by companies upon the green grass.

djk_text: Fa i si Masaa Jesesi kaba taigi den so, ne den sidon a ini kulu fu wan ondoo anga kulu fu feifitenti sama.
eng_text: And they sat down in ranks, by hundreds, and by fifties.

djk_text: Ne a teke den feifi beele anga den tu fisi. Ne a luku tapu a Masaa Gadu, ne a gi Masaa Gadu daa moi te a kaba. Ne a booko den beele pisipisi anga tu fisi. Ne a gi den bakaman fi en, fu den go paati. Da soseefi a meke den paati den fisi tu.
eng_text: And when he had taken the five loaves and the two fishes, he looked up to heaven, and blessed, and brake the loaves, and gave them to his disciples to set before them; and the two fishes divided he among them all.

djk_text: Ne ala sama nyan te den bee fuu.
eng_text: And they did all eat, and were filled.

djk_text: Da di den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi piki san di den nyan fika, ne a fuu twalufu bakisi.
eng_text: And they took up twelve baskets full of the fragments, and of the fishes.

djk_text: Da fu den manengee wawan di be nyan, da a moo enke feifi dunsu.
eng_text: And they that did eat of the loaves were about five thousand men.

djk_text: Ne wanten bakadati, ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den bakaman fi en, fu go a boto koti abaa go na abaase a Betisaida. Ma en o fika de, fu sende den sama gwe a den osu.
eng_text: And straightway he constrained his disciples to get into the ship, and to go to the other side before unto Bethsaida, while he sent away the people.

djk_text: Ne di a sende ala den sama gwe kaba, ne a subi go a wan mongo tapu, go e begi.
eng_text: And when he had sent them away, he departed into a mountain to pray.

djk_text: A yuu ten de, da peesi be kon e dunguu kaba. Ma, den bakaman fi en be de, te a mindii wataa kaba anga a boto. Ne en wawan be de a soo ete.
eng_text: And when even was come, the ship was in the midst of the sea, and he alone on the land.

djk_text: Ne di a begi te wan pisi, di a daai luku, ne a si taki den de a mindii fu a ze ete e feti anga a boto. Den e puu ma den nái go a fesi. Wan gaan winta e wai na a ze, meke den á poi go a fesi. Namo di musude, ne Masaa Jesesi waka na a wataa tapu tyaa tyaa go miti den. Da a waka enke a be wani pasa den.
eng_text: And he saw them toiling in rowing; for the wind was contrary unto them: and about the fourth watch of the night he cometh unto them, walking upon the sea, and would have passed by them.

djk_text: Da di den si a sama e waka na a ze tapu anga futu e kon, ne den feele te den bigin bali. Den be denki taki na wan yooka e kon a den. Ne Masaa Jesesi bali gi den taki: “U á feele! U oli useefi. Na mi de ya!”
eng_text: But when they saw him walking upon the sea, they supposed it had been a spirit, and cried out:

djk_text: Ne a subi go a ini a boto a den. Da di a subi go a ini a boto, ne a winta saka wanten wanten. Den foondoo te, den fika opo opo mofu.
eng_text: And he went up unto them into the ship; and the wind ceased: and they were sore amazed in themselves beyond measure, and wondered.

djk_text: Da anga ala fa den be si Masaa Jesesi be paati feifi beele anga tu fisi gi onmen dunsu sama, toku den á be wani fusutan ete sama Masaa Jesesi be de.
eng_text: For they considered not the miracle of the loaves: for their heart was hardened.

djk_text: Ne den poti boto a Genesaleti, ne den go a soo.
eng_text: And when they had passed over, they came into the land of Gennesaret, and drew to the shore.

djk_text: Da fa i si den poti futu a soo, ne den sama di be de a lampe sabi kaba taki a man ya, na Masaa Jesesi, di e deesi ala sowtu siki.
eng_text: And when they were come out of the ship, straightway they knew him,

djk_text: Ne den lon lontu kondee paati a mofu te a doo. Ne den sama tyai ala den sikiman kon a Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: And ran through that whole region round about, and began to carry about in beds those that were sick, where they heard he was.

djk_text: Da ibiiwan peesi pe Masaa Jesesi be go, efu na pikin kondee efu wan foto efu na pikin kampu seefi, da den sama be e tyai siki sama kon poti a ganda a pe a be o waka pasa. Da den e begi en taki: “Gaantangi, meke den sama oli i koosi mofu, baa! Da den sa kon bun baka.” Namo, da ala siki sama di be oli kon bun kelle.
eng_text: And whithersoever he entered, into villages, or cities, or country, they laid the sick in the streets, and besought him that they might touch if it were but the border of his garment: and as many as touched him were made whole.

djk_text: Da wan dei, ne den Faliseiman anga wantu leliman fu Dyuweiti komoto a Jelusalem Foto kon a Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: Then came together unto him the Pharisees, and certain of the scribes, which came from Jerusalem.

djk_text: Te wan pisi, ne den si taki, te son fu den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi e nyan, da den nái wasi ana na a fasi fa den Dyu gwenti fu wasi ana na a apaiti fasi fosi den go nyan.
eng_text: And when they saw some of his disciples eat bread with defiled, that is to say, with unwashen, hands, they found fault.

djk_text: Den Faliseiman anga ala den taa Dyusama á be e nyan fosi den wasi den ana a wan apaiti fasi enke fa den gaansama fu den leli den taki,
eng_text: For the Pharisees, and all the Jews, except they wash their hands oft, eat not, holding the tradition of the elders.

djk_text: te den komoto a wowoyo kon, den á mu nyan fosi den wasi a wan apaiti fasi. Da den be e oli somen fu den weiti ete, di den avo gaansama fika gi den. Den be mu wasi den tyobo sani a wan apaiti fasi tu. Den sani enke den kan fu diingi wataa, den patu, beenki fu nyan.
eng_text: And when they come from the market, except they wash, they eat not. And many other things there be, which they have received to hold, as the washing of cups, and pots, brasen vessels, and of tables.

djk_text: Ne den Faliseiman anga den leliman fu Dyuweiti akisi Masaa Jesesi taki: “Saide meke den bakaman fi yu nái oli den weiti di den gaansama poti gi wi. Bika den e nyan sondee fu wasi den ana na a apaiti fasi.”
eng_text: Then the Pharisees and scribes asked him, Why walk not thy disciples according to the tradition of the elders, but eat bread with unwashen hands?

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “U bidiigiman u! Jesaja, a apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu, be abi leti di a be sikiifi fu u a Gadu Buku taki: ‘Den sama ya e lesipeki mi e gi mi gaandi anga den buba mofu, ma a nái doo den ati. Den pakisei de faawe fu mi.
eng_text: He answered and said unto them, Well hath Esaias prophesied of you hypocrites, as it is written, This people honoureth me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.

djk_text: Fa den e bali e hei mi anga den buba mofu de, ná tuu. Bika ná den weiti fu mi den e leli sama. Ma na weiti di libisama seefi meke den e leli sama.’
eng_text: Howbeit in vain do they worship me, teaching for doctines the commandments of men.

djk_text: U poti den weiti fu Masaa Gadu a wanse, da u e teke den weiti di libisama meke fu gaan sani fu wooko.”
eng_text: For laying aside the commandment of God, ye hold the tradition of men, as the washing of pots and cups: and many other such like things ye do.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den go doo taki: “U ná abi toobi fu poti den weiti fu Masaa Gadu a wanse, soso fu u oli den haw gwenti fu u.
eng_text: And he said unto them, Full well ye reject the commandment of God, that ye may keep your own tradition.

djk_text: Mi o taigi u san a avo gaansama fu u di den be e kai Mosesi be sikiifi a Gadu Buku. A be sikiifi taki: ‘U mu lesipeki u dda anga u mma. Da iniiwan sama di kosi en mma efu en dda mu dede.’
eng_text: For Moses said, Honour thy father and thy mother; and, Whoso curseth father or mother, let him die the death:

djk_text: Ma u daai a weiti fu Masaa Gadu ya poti taki: ‘I ná abi fu yeepi i mma anga i dda, fu gi den sani moo, efi i taigi den taki, san i be o gi den, i paamisi fu gi Masaa Gadu dati enke paiman.’
eng_text: But ye say, If a man shall say to his father or mother, It is Corban, that is to say, a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me; he shall be free.

djk_text: Da efu wan sama taki so, da u nái gi en pasi fu yeepi en mma anga en dda a sani moo. Da san u du ya e soi taki u ná abi fu abi toobi anga Masaa Gadu wowtu moo. U wani meke den sama oli den weiti di den avo gaansama fu u fika gi u. Da a fasi fu libi ya e meke u poli a weiti fu Masaa Gadu. Da somen taa sani de tu di u e du na a seefi fasi.”
eng_text: And ye suffer him no more to do ought for his father or his mother;

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi kai ala den sama kon, ne a taigi den taki: “U aliki mi bun! San mi o taigi u ya, na wan sani di u musu fu sabi.
eng_text: And when he had called all the people unto him, he said unto them, Hearken unto me every one of you, and understand:

djk_text: Wan sama nái tyobo a Masaa Gadu fesi fu san di ai nyan go a ini en bee. Ma na den sani di ai taki komoto a ini en mofu ini kon a doo, na den e meke a tyobo a Gadu fesi.
eng_text: There is nothing from without a man, that entering into him can defile him: but the things which come out of him, those are they that defile the man.

djk_text: Meke sama di abi yesi fu yee, yee san mi taki ya!”
eng_text: If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.

djk_text: Da di Masaa Jesesi taigi den so kaba, ne a fika den, ne a go a ini wan osu. Ne den bakaman fi en akisi en taki: “San wani taki a toli di i gi den sama de?”
eng_text: And when he was entered into the house from the people, his disciples asked him concerning the parable.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Na so useefi don fu fusutan sani enke den taa sama de?
eng_text: And he saith unto them, Are ye so without understanding also? Do ye not perceive, that whatsoever thing from without entereth into the man, it cannot defile him;

djk_text: We, a nyanyan di yu e nyan, nái go a yu ati, ma ai go a ini yu bee. Da te a yuu doo, da ai komoto baka.” Da anga disi Masaa Jesesi be wani taigi den taki, den á mu oli kina moo, ma den sa nyan ala san di de fu nyan sondee konsensi fonfon.
eng_text: Because it entereth not into his heart, but into the belly, and goeth out into the draught, purging all meats?

djk_text: Ne a taki go doo taki: “Na den sani di e komoto a u ati e meke u kon tyobo a Masaa Gadu fesi.
eng_text: And he said, That which cometh out of the man, that defileth the man.

djk_text: Den sani enke motyo libi, fufuu anga kii sama, go a taa man ofu taa uman.
eng_text: For from within, out of the heart of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, fornications, murders,

djk_text: Den sani enke giili ati anga takuu fasi, koli sama, fanya libi, dyalusu, saanti sama, bigi fasi anga lawlaw denki.
eng_text: Thefts, covetousness, wickedness, deceit, lasciviousness, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, foolishness:

djk_text: Na den sani ya de a ini wan sama ati. Da te den e komoto a doo, da den e meke a sama tyobo a Masaa Gadu fesi.”
eng_text: All these evil things come from within, and defile the man.

djk_text: Da di Masaa Jesesi taigi den so, ne a komoto de, ne a go a Tilosi. Da di a doo Tilosi, ne a go a ini wan osu. A á be wani meke sama sabi taki a be de ape. Ma Masaa Jesesi á poi de a wan peesi, da a tan kibii.
eng_text: And from thence he arose, and went into the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and entered into an house, and would have no man know it: but he could not be hid.

djk_text: Bika a á be de ape langa seefi fosi wan uman kon ne en. Da a uman ya be abi wan pikin umanpikin di be abi wan sani ne en tapu. Da fa i si a uman ya doo Masaa Jesesi, ne a sutu kini a doti
eng_text: For a certain woman, whose young daughter had an unclean spirit, heard of him, and came and fell at his feet:

djk_text: e begi en fu a puu a takuu jeje na a pikin fi en tapu. A uman ya na be wan Giiki sama di be meke na a kondee di den e kai Silofenisi.
eng_text: The woman was a Greek, a Syrophenician by nation; and she besought him that he would cast forth the devil out of her daughter.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi piki en anga wan ageisi toli taki: “A á bun fu teke a nyanyan fu den pikin towe gi pikin dagu. Meke den pikin fosi nyan.”
eng_text: But Jesus said unto her, Let the children first be filled: for it is not meet to take the children's bread, and to cast it unto the dogs.

djk_text: Ne a uman piki Masaa Jesesi taki: “Masaa san i taki na tuu. Ma den pikin dagu e nyan den sakasaka di den pikin e nyan towe a doti.”
eng_text: And she answered and said unto him, Yes, Lord: yet the dogs under the table eat of the children's crumbs.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki a uman taki: “A bun! Fu di i piki sowan fasi, meke i fende yeepi. Go a osu baka! A pikin umanpikin fi yu kon bun. A takuu jeje komoto ne en tapu.” Na so a uman daai go a osu.
eng_text: And he said unto her, For this saying go thy way; the devil is gone out of thy daughter.

djk_text: Di a doo osu, ne a si a pikin fi en didon a kama tapu pii. A takuu jeje gwe komoto ne en tapu gwe. A kon bun kelle.
eng_text: And when she was come to her house, she found the devil gone out, and her daughter laid upon the bed.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Jesesi komoto a Tilosi waka go a Sidon. Ne a waka go na a pisi di den e kai Dekapolisi na abaase fu a ze fu Galileya.
eng_text: And again, departing from the coasts of Tyre and Sidon, he came unto the sea of Galilee, through the midst of the coasts of Decapolis.

djk_text: Ne di a doo de, ne den tyai wan man kon ne en. A man ya be dofu. Ma soseefi, a di na sani, ne a be e taki. Ne den sama begi Masaa Jesesi fu a poti ana na a man ya tapu meke a kon bun.
eng_text: And they bring unto him one that was deaf, and had an impediment in his speech; and they beseech him to put his hand upon him.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi tyai a man ya puu a ini den somen sama go a wanse. Ne a toosi en finga go a ini a man yesi. Ne a puu en ana baka, ne a towe wataa mofu ne en ana, ne a nama ana na a man tongo.
eng_text: And he took him aside from the multitude, and put his fingers into his ears, and he spit, and touched his tongue;

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi luku tapu, ne a ali wan dipi boo. Ne a taki: “
eng_text: And looking up to heaven, he sighed, and saith unto him, Ephphatha, that is, Be opened.

djk_text: Ne wanten wanten so a man yesi opo woo, ne ai yee sani bun. Da soseefi en tongo losi te ai taki wala wala enke fa wan libisama meke fu taki.
eng_text: And straightway his ears were opened, and the string of his tongue was loosed, and he spake plain.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi bali den sama taki: “U á mu taigi sama taki na mi deesi a man ya, u yee!” Ma anga ala fa a bali den de, toku den e taigi sama taki: “Na Masaa Jesesi deesi a man! Na Masaa Jesesi deesi!”
eng_text: And he charged them that they should tell no man: but the more he charged them, so much the more a great deal they published it;

djk_text: Den á be poi tan pii fu san den si Masaa Jesesi du. A be foondoo den. Den e bali taki: “Ala den sani fiya di Masaa Jesesi e du ai du bun. Ai opo dofuman yesi. Ai losi babaw tongo fu den taki tu.”
eng_text: And were beyond measure astonished, saying, He hath done all things well: he maketh both the deaf to hear, and the dumb to speak.

djk_text: Da somen sama be kon aliki Masaa Jesesi. Den ná abi sani fu nyan. Ne Masaa Jesesi kai den bakaman fi en, ne a taigi den taki:
eng_text: In those days the multitude being very great, and having nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples unto him, and saith unto them,

djk_text: “Tyali fu den sama e kisi mi. Den de ya dii dei anga mi kaba. Da den ná abi ná wan sani fu nyan.
eng_text: I have compassion on the multitude, because they have now been with me three days, and have nothing to eat:

djk_text: Efu mi sende den go a osu so, den sa faaw a pasi fu a angii. Somen fu den e tan faawe.”
eng_text: And if I send them away fasting to their own houses, they will faint by the way: for divers of them came from far.

djk_text: Ne den bakaman fi en akisi en taki: “Pe u o fende nyanyan a ini a sabana ya, pe ná wan sama e tan, fu gi ala den somen sama ya?”
eng_text: And his disciples answered him, From whence can a man satisfy these men with bread here in the wilderness?

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi akisi den taki: “Onmen beele u abi?” Ne den piki en taki: “Wi abi seibin beele.”
eng_text: And he asked them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven.

djk_text: Ne a taigi den sama taki: “U ala fiya sidon a doti.” Da ala den sama sidon enke fa Masaa Jesesi taki. Ne a teke den seibin beele, ne a gi Masaa Gadu daa moi, te a kaba. Ne a booko den beele pisipisi, ne a gi den bakaman fi en. Ne den teke den beele paati gi den sama.
eng_text: And he commanded the people to sit down on the ground: and he took the seven loaves, and gave thanks, and brake, and gave to his disciples to set before them; and they did set them before the people.

djk_text: Da den be abi wantu fisi tu. Ne a teke den fisi, ne a gi Masaa Gadu daa. Ne a gi den bakaman fi en fu paati gi den sama tu.
eng_text: And they had a few small fishes: and he blessed, and commanded to set them also before them.

djk_text: Ne ala den sama nyan te den bee fuu. Da di den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi piki san di den sama nyan fika, a fuu seibin bakisi.
eng_text: So they did eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets.

djk_text: Da fu manengee wawan di nyan a doo fo dunsu. Da di den sama nyan kaba, ne Masaa Jesesi sende den fu den go a osu.
eng_text: And they that had eaten were about four thousand: and he sent them away.

djk_text: Da fa i si a sende den sama gwe, ne en anga den bakaman fi en go a boto, ne den gwe a wan peesi den e kai Dalmanuta.
eng_text: And straightway he entered into a ship with his disciples, and came into the parts of Dalmanutha.

djk_text: Da wantu Faliseiman be yee taki Masaa Jesesi be kon de. Ne den kon fu kon tesi en. Ne den bigin fu sitee anga Masaa Jesesi. Den sitee anga en te, ne den taigi en taki: “We, a bun. Da du wan foondoo sani, osi? Meke u si, da u sa biibi taki, na Masaa Gadu sende i kon a goontapu tuu.”
eng_text: And the Pharisees came forth, and began to question with him, seeking of him a sign from heaven, tempting him.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi dyeme, ne a akisi den taki: “Oho! Libisama! Saide meke u wani meke mi soi u maiki taki, na Masaa Gadu sende mi kon? Fu tuutuu mi ná o soi u ná wan maiki enke fa u wani de!”
eng_text: And he sighed deeply in his spirit, and saith, Why doth this generation seek after a sign? verily I say unto you, There shall no sign be given unto this generation.

djk_text: Ne a daai fesi, ne a waka go a ini wan boto, ne a koti go na abaase fika den taampu taampu de. Da den bakaman fi en be feegete fu bai nyanyan. Da den be abi wan kodo beele namo.
eng_text: And he left them, and entering into the ship again departed to the other side.

djk_text: Da di den be de a pasi e gwe, ne Masaa Jesesi be bali den taki: “U mu luku bun anga a sowda fu den Faliseiman anga di fu Kownu Helowdesi.”
eng_text: And he charged them, saying, Take heed, beware of the leaven of the Pharisees, and of the leaven of Herod.

djk_text: Da di Masaa Jesesi bali den so, ne den e akisi denseefi taki: “San a taki? San wani taki a sani di a taki de? Oo, a fu di u á bai beele meke a taki so.”
eng_text: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have no bread.

djk_text: Ma, da Masaa Jesesi be sabi taki na so den e taki. Ne a taigi den taki: “A ná fu di u á tyai beele meke mi taigi u a sani de. U á fusutan fa mi de ete, no? A so u don?
eng_text: And when Jesus knew it, he saith unto them, Why reason ye, because ye have no bread? perceive ye not yet, neither understand? have ye your heart yet hardened?

djk_text: Luku onmen sani mi du di u si anga u ain anga onmen sani mi du di u yee anga u yesi. U feegete kaba,
eng_text: Having eyes, see ye not? and having ears, hear ye not? and do ye not remember?

djk_text: fa mi be paati feifi beele gi feifi dunsu sama? Da onmen bakisi be de fanowdu fu u be poti san den sama be nyan fika?” Ne den piki en taki: “We, Masaa, na twalufu bakisi be fika.”
eng_text: When I brake the five loaves among five thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? They say unto him, Twelve.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi akisi den baka taki: “Di mi be paati den seibin beele gi den fo dunsu sama, onmen bakisi be fika?” Ne den piki Masaa Jesesi taki: “Masaa, na seibin bakisi be fika.”
eng_text: And when the seven among four thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? And they said, Seven.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi akisi den taki: “Da te enke now, u á fusutan mi ete, no?”
eng_text: And he said unto them, How is it that ye do not understand?

djk_text: Da Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en doo wan peesi den e kai Betisaida. Ne den sama tyai wan beendiman kon ne en. Ne den begi en fu a sa langa ana oli a beendiman meke a si baka.
eng_text: And he cometh to Bethsaida; and they bring a blind man unto him, and besought him to touch him.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi teke a man na ana tyai puu a pe somen sama be de. Ne a towe wataa mofu a ini a man ain, ne a poti ana ne en ain tapu. Ne a akisi en taki: “Yu e si sani kaba?”
eng_text: And he took the blind man by the hand, and led him out of the town; and when he had spit on his eyes, and put his hands upon him, he asked him if he saw ought.

djk_text: Ne a man luku lontu, ne a piki taki: “We, mi e si sama e waka. Ma a gei enke na udu bon e waka e lontu.”
eng_text: And he looked up, and said, I see men as trees, walking.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi poti ana ete wan leisi ne en ain tapu. Ne di Masaa Jesesi puu ana, ne a man luku peesi lontu baka. Ne en ain kiin kelle, ai si sani bun baka enke fa wan libisama mu si.
eng_text: After that he put his hands again upon his eyes, and made him look up: and he was restored, and saw every man clearly.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi sende a man taki: “Go a osu. Ma yu á mu go a ini a kondee go taigi sama taki na mi deesi yu.”
eng_text: And he sent him away to his house, saying, Neither go into the town, nor tell it to any in the town.

djk_text: Ne moo lati, ne Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en go a den kondee kondee di de lontu Sesaleya Filipi. Da di den de a pasi e gwe di den waka doo wan pisi, ne Masaa Jesesi akisi den taki: “Sama den sama e taki mi de?”
eng_text: And Jesus went out, and his disciples, into the towns of Caesarea Philippi: and by the way he asked his disciples, saying unto them, Whom do men say that I am?

djk_text: Ne den piki taki: “We, wantu taki yu na Johanisi a Dopuman. Taawan taki yu na Eliya, ofu wan fu den taa fositen apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu di weki komoto a dede baka.”
eng_text: And they answered, John the Baptist: but some say, Elias; and others, One of the prophets.

djk_text: Da di den piki Masaa Jesesi so, ne a akisi den taki: “We u, no? Sama na mi?” Ne Peitilisi piki en taki: “Yu na a Kelestesi di Masaa Gadu sende kon!”
eng_text: And he saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am? And Peter answereth and saith unto him, Thou art the Christ.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi bali den taanga taanga taki: “U á mu taigi ná wan sama, sama mi de!”
eng_text: And he charged them that they should tell no man of him.

djk_text: Da Masaa Jesesi bigin fu taigi den fu a gaan pina anga sitaafu di de fu kon ne en tapu. Ne a taigi den taki: “Den bigiman fu keliki anga den leliman fu Dyuweiti anga den gaansama fu kondee, o kai a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya a kuutu. Da den o kii en. Ma te den kii en, da baka dii dei, da en o opo baka komoto a geebi.”
eng_text: And he began to teach them, that the Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders, and of the chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.

djk_text: Da di a taigi den so, ne Peitilisi kai en go a wanse. Ne a kaasi en.
eng_text: And he spake that saying openly. And Peter took him, and began to rebuke him.

djk_text: Ma namo, Masaa Jesesi daai luku den taa bakaman fi en. Ne a bali Peitilisi taki: “Pasa komoto a mi baka ya! Yu didibii, saatan yu! Peitilisi! A sani di i taki de, á de enke fa Masaa Gadu e pakisei. I taki enke fa libisama e pakisei.”
eng_text: But when he had turned about and looked on his disciples, he rebuked Peter, saying, Get thee behind me, Satan: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but the things that be of men.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi kai den taa bakaman fi en anga ala den sama di be kon makandii de kon moo koosube ne en. Ne a taigi den taki: “Efu wan sama wani waka a mi baka, da a á mu teli enseefi moo. Da a mu e tyai a sitaafu di o kon ne en tapu enke wan sama e tyai wan koloisi, fu den go sipikii en kii.
eng_text: And when he had called the people unto him with his disciples also, he said unto them, Whosoever will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

djk_text: A sama di wani kibii en libi fu nyan fu a goontapu ya, sa lasi en libi. Ma a sama di ná abi toobi fu lasi en libi fu mi ede anga fu paati a Bun Nyunsu fu Masaa Gadu gi sama o libi tuutuu.
eng_text: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it; but whosoever shall lose his life for my sake and the gospel's, the same shall save it.

djk_text: Da san i wini efi i nyan fu goontapu, gudu te a gudu, ma i lasi a libi fu tego go a didibii faya?
eng_text: For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?

djk_text: San i sa pai fi i fende i libi baka?
eng_text: Or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?

djk_text: Da fa u de a goontapu ya, da somen sama fika Masaa Gadu go e du ala sowtu ogii. Da efu wan sama e sen gi mi anga mi wowtu, da te a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya o daai kon baka, da sen o kisi en fi en tu. Bika, a o kon anga den apaiti Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee anga gaan dyendee fasi fu Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: Whosoever therefore shall be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation; of him also shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he cometh in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “Mi e taigi u kiinkiin taki, son fu u di taampu ya ná o tesi dede, fosi u si a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu kon doo anga ala a taanga fi en.”
eng_text: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That there be some of them that stand here, which shall not taste of death, till they have seen the kingdom of God come with power.

djk_text: Da baka sigisi dei, ne a teke Peitilisi anga Jakowbesi anga Johanisi tyai go a wan hei mongo. Da na den wawan be de ape. Namo di den de na a mongo ede, ne den si Masaa Jesesi fesi anga en hii sikin e beenki mala mala e koti faya gelen gelen.
eng_text: And after six days Jesus taketh with him Peter, and James, and John, and leadeth them up into an high mountain apart by themselves: and he was transfigured before them.

djk_text: En koosi weti fann. Da ná wan sama fu goontapu sa wasi en koosi kiin so.
eng_text: And his raiment became shining, exceeding white as snow; so as no fuller on earth can white them.

djk_text: Ne den si Eliya anga Mosesi kon na a mongo wanboo wanboo so. Ne den bigin taki anga Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: And there appeared unto them Elias with Moses: and they were talking with Jesus.

djk_text: Ne Peitilisi taki: “Masaa! Meke u tan ya! Meke u meke dii pikin osu na a mongo ede ya. Wan fi yu. Wan fu Eliya anga wan fu Mosesi. Bika a switi fu toko fu u de makandii ya!”
eng_text: And Peter answered and said to Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.

djk_text: Da na a feele di Peitilisi feele namo, meke a taki den sani ya. Bika a á be sabi san a mu taki.
eng_text: For he wist not what to say; for they were sore afraid.

djk_text: Da te fu den poti pakisei, ne wanboo wanboo so wan woluku saka kon tapu den. Ne wan Tongo taki a ini a woluku ini taki: “Disi na mi Manpikin, di mi lobi tuutuu. U aliki ne en san ai taigi u.”
eng_text: And there was a cloud that overshadowed them: and a voice came out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.

djk_text: Ne di den luku baka, ne, woo! Den á si ná wan sama moo enke Masaa Jesesi wawan. Eliya anga Mosesi gwe.
eng_text: And suddenly, when they had looked round about, they saw no man any more, save Jesus only with themselves.

djk_text: Ne di den e saka a mongo, ne Masaa Jesesi bali den taki: “U á mu taki san u si ya, ye! Ma, te a Manpikin di kon saka toon libisama a goontapu ya dede, te a opo baka a geebi, da u sa taki san u si ya.”
eng_text: And as they came down from the mountain, he charged them that they should tell no man what things they had seen, till the Son of man were risen from the dead.

djk_text: Da na so den dii man ya oli a toli ya fu denseefi. Ma den dii man e akisi denseefi taki: “San wani taki a o dede, da a opo baka komoto a geebi?”
eng_text: And they kept that saying with themselves, questioning one with another what the rising from the dead should mean.

djk_text: Ne den akisi Masaa Jesesi taki: “Masaa Jesesi! Saide meke den leliman fu Dyuweiti e leli u taki, Eliya mu kon a goontapu fosi Masaa Gadu sende a Kelestesi kon?”
eng_text: And they asked him, saying, Why say the scribes that Elias must first come?

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “We, na so a de tuu, taki Eliya mu kon fosi fu seeka sani bunbun fosi a Kelestesi sa kon. Ma Eliya kon kaba, te den du san den wani anga en enke fa den apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu be taki. Ma san den apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu be taki fu a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya? San libisama o du anga en? Den apaiti takiman fu Gadu be taki kaba taki: ‘Den o pina en, si en enke soso wisiwasi sani.’ ”
eng_text: And he answered and told them, Elias verily cometh first, and restoreth all things; and how it is written of the Son of man, that he must suffer many things, and be set at nought.

djk_text: Di den kon doo a den taa bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi, ne den si den taa bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi anga somen sama. Da den anga wantu leliman fu Dyuweiti be e sitee anga denseefi.
eng_text: And when he came to his disciples, he saw a great multitude about them, and the scribes questioning with them.

djk_text: Da, ne te fu den sama poti pakisei, ne Masaa Jesesi e kon. Da den be foondoo seefi. Ne den sama lon go gi en odi.
eng_text: And straightway all the people, when they beheld him, were greatly amazed, and running to him saluted him.

djk_text: Ne a akisi den taki: “San pasa? San meke u e sitee ya so?”
eng_text: And he asked the scribes, What question ye with them?

djk_text: Ne wan man piki Masaa Jesesi taki: “Masaa, yeepi mi! Mi tyai mi manpikin kon a yu. Wan takuu jeje de ne en tapu. Da a takuu jeje ya e tapu en mofu fu a á poi taki.
eng_text: And one of the multitude answered and said, Master, I have brought unto thee my son, which hath a dumb spirit;

djk_text: Da alaten a takuu jeje kon ne en tapu, ai towe enseefi a doti e kaw tifi e puu sukuma a mofu fukuu. Da ai tiiki tiloo e taanga kwakwakwaa. Da di mi á be si yu, ne mi tyai en go gi den bakaman fi yu fu den puu a takuu jeje ne en tapu. Ma den á be poi puu en.”
eng_text: And wheresoever he taketh him, he teareth him: and he foameth, and gnasheth with his teeth, and pineth away: and I spake to thy disciples that they should cast him out; and they could not.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi bali gi den bakaman fi en anga den taa sama taki: “Oho! Libisama! Saide meke den libisama fu a ten ya nái biibi ete? On langa mi mu oli pasensi anga u ete fosi u kon biibi Gadu? U tyai a pikin kon.”
eng_text: He answereth him, and saith, O faithless generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him unto me.

djk_text: Ne den sama tyai a pikin kon gi Masaa Jesesi. Ne di a takuu jeje si Masaa Jesesi, ne a subi a boi te, en sikin taanga kwakwakwaa. Ne a towe en a doti, e lolo kungulun, kungulun. Sukuma e komoto ne en mofu.
eng_text: And they brought him unto him: and when he saw him, straightway the spirit tare him; and he fell on the ground, and wallowed foaming.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi akisi a man taki: “On langa a pikin ya abi a siki ya kaba?” Ne a man piki taki: “Masaa! Na senten a de pikinengee.
eng_text: And he asked his father, How long is it ago since this came unto him? And he said, Of a child.

djk_text: Na onmen toon a takuu jeje towe en a ini faya anga wataa fu kii. Da gaantangi baa, Masaa, mi e begi yu, efi i poi yeepi mi!”
eng_text: And ofttimes it hath cast him into the fire, and into the waters, to destroy him: but if thou canst do any thing, have compassion on us, and help us.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki a man taki: “I mu abi biibi a Gadu. Bika Masaa Gadu sa du ala sani gi wan sama di poti biibi ne en tapu.”
eng_text: Jesus said unto him, If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth.

djk_text: Ne a man bali wanten taki: “Masaa! Masaa! Mi e biibi. Ma a biibi fu mi á sai. Ma gaantangi, yeepi mi meke mi sa biibi.”
eng_text: And straightway the father of the child cried out, and said with tears, Lord, I believe; help thou mine unbelief.

djk_text: Di Masaa Jesesi luku, ne a si taki moo anga moo sama e kon. Ne fosi den doo, ne a kaasi a sani taki: “Komoto ne en tapu gwe wanten! Yu didibii di e tei en tongo e dofu en yesi fu a á yee sani! Komoto ne en tapu gwe! Da noiti moo i mu kon moo ne en tapu moo.”
eng_text: When Jesus saw that the people came running together, he rebuked the foul spirit, saying unto him, Thou dumb and deaf spirit, I charge thee, come out of him, and enter no more into him.

djk_text: Ne a takuu jeje kon na a pikin tapu moo taanga, ne a bali taanga, ne a gwe. Ne a pikin didon pii enke a dede. Ne den sama denki taki a pikin dede.
eng_text: And the spirit cried, and rent him sore, and came out of him: and he was as one dead; insomuch that many said, He is dead.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi oli en na ana, ne a opo en taampu. Ne a pikin taampu. A kon bun kelle.
eng_text: But Jesus took him by the hand, and lifted him up; and he arose.

djk_text: Da pikin moo a baka Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en go a ini wan osu. Ne den bakaman fi en akisi en taki: “Masaa! Saide meke wi á be poi kaasi a takuu jeje puu na a pikin tapu?”
eng_text: And when he was come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, Why could not we cast him out?

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Den sowtu takuu jeje ya nái gwe efi i á de sondee nyan fu begi Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: And he said unto them, This kind can come forth by nothing, but by prayer and fasting.

djk_text: Da Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en komoto na a kondee. Ne den waka go a Galileya. Da Masaa Jesesi á be wani sama sabi taki a be de ape.
eng_text: And they departed thence, and passed through Galilee; and he would not that any man should know it.

djk_text: Bika a be wani de anga den bakaman fi en wawan fu leli den. Ne a taigi den taki: “Den o seli a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya, gi takuu ati sama fu kii. Da den o kii en. Ma baka dii dei a sa opo baka komoto a geebi.”
eng_text: For he taught his disciples, and said unto them, The Son of man is delivered into the hands of men, and they shall kill him; and after that he is killed, he shall rise the third day.

djk_text: Da den bakaman fi en á be fusutan san a taigi den de. Ma anga ala fa den á fusutan san Masaa Jesesi taki de, toku ná wan fu den be abi a deki ati fu akisi en san wani taki a sani di a taki de.
eng_text: But they understood not that saying, and were afraid to ask him.

djk_text: Da di den doo Kafalnayemu, ne den go a ini wan osu. Ne Masaa Jesesi akisi den taki: “San u be e taki a pasi di u be e kon?”
eng_text: And he came to Capernaum: and being in the house he asked them, What was it that ye disputed among yourselves by the way?

djk_text: Ma den á be poi piki en, bika den be kuutu anga denseefi on di fu den na a moo heiwan fu den ala den.
eng_text: But they held their peace: for by the way they had disputed among themselves, who should be the greatest.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi go sidon, ne a kai den kon. Ne a taigi den taki: “U aliki mi bun. Sama fu u di wani de a moo heiwan mu de a moo pikinwan a u mindii.”
eng_text: And he sat down, and called the twelve, and saith unto them, If any man desire to be first, the same shall be last of all, and servant of all.

djk_text: Ne a kai wan pikin kon ne en. Ne a pikin kon. Ne a lolo a pikin a neki, ne a taigi den taki:
