djk_text: Da wanlo sama di be komoto na a kuutu kon a Masaa Jesesi baka e bali gi Gaaman Pilatesi taki: “Gaaman Pilatesi, u wani i puu wan man a sitaafu osu gi wi enke fa i gwenti du ala Pasika.”
eng_text: And the multitude crying aloud began to desire him to do as he had ever done unto them.

djk_text: Ne Gaaman Pilatesi akisi den taki: “Sama u wani mi puu a dunguu osu gi u a yali ya? U wani meke mi losi a kownu fu den Dyu gi u?”
eng_text: But Pilate answered them, saying, Will ye that I release unto you the King of the Jews?

djk_text: Bika Gaaman Pilatesi be sabi taki na fu dyalusu ede meke den hei apaiti begiman anga den leliman fu Dyuweiti be wani kii Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: For he knew that the chief priests had delivered him for envy.

djk_text: Ne den hei apaiti begiman, di be de a den sama mindii e sutu faya a ondoo gi den sama fu den meke Gaaman Pilatesi losi Balabasi. Na so den sama bali: “Gaaman Pilatesi, na Balabasi i mu puu a sitaafu gi wi! Na Balabasi u wani meke i puu a sitaafu gi wi!”
eng_text: But the chief priests moved the people, that he should rather release Barabbas unto them.

djk_text: Ne Gaaman Pilatesi akisi den taki: “Da san mi mu du anga a sama di den e kai Kownu fu den Dyu?”
eng_text: And Pilate answered and said again unto them, What will ye then that I shall do unto him whom ye call the King of the Jews?

djk_text: Ne den bali taki: “Sipikii en a koloisi puu de!”
eng_text: And they cried out again, Crucify him.

djk_text: Ne Gaaman Pilatesi akisi den baka taki: “Saide mi mu sipikii en kii? Sowtu ogii a du?” Ne den bigin bali moo taanga taki: “Sipikii en a koloisi! Sipikii en! Sipikii en! Sipikii en puu de.”
eng_text: Then Pilate said unto them, Why, what evil hath he done? And they cried out the more exceedingly, Crucify him.

djk_text: Da Gaaman Pilatesi á be wani opuulu anga den sama. Na dati meke a losi Balabasi. Ne a meke den suudati fi en wipi Masaa Jesesi wan mesaandi wipi. Ne di a meke den wipi en so kaba, ne a gi den suudati fi en Masaa Jesesi fu den tyai go sipikii kii.
eng_text: And so Pilate, willing to content the people, released Barabbas unto them, and delivered Jesus, when he had scourged him, to be crucified.

djk_text: Ne den suudati tyai Masaa Jesesi go a wan peesi a ini a dyali fu Gaaman Pilatesi, ne den kai ala den suudati kon makandii.
eng_text: And the soldiers led him away into the hall, called Praetorium; and they call together the whole band.

djk_text: Ne den puu en koosi, ne den wei wan gaan langa, baaw lebi koosi enke di kownu e wei gi en. Ne den teke wan takuu sowtu maka enke agwago, ne den lolo en enke a ati di kownu e wei. Ne den wei en gi en fu pee enke na wan kownu ati a wei.
eng_text: And they clothed him with purple, and platted a crown of thorns, and put it about his head,

djk_text: Ne den bigin meke sipowtu anga en e soso en taki: “Odiyoo lesipeki Kownu fu Dyu!”
eng_text: And began to salute him, Hail, King of the Jews!

djk_text: Ne den naki en anga wan tiki ne en ede gwoo. Soseefi den towe wataa mofu ne en. Ne den saka kini a doti e meke sipowtu e soso en enke na lesipeki anga gaandi den e gi en so.
eng_text: And they smote him on the head with a reed, and did spit upon him, and bowing their knees worshipped him.

djk_text: Da di den kaba meke sipowtu anga en soso en so kaba, ne den puu a koosi di den be wei gi en, ne den wei enseefi koosi gi en baka. Ne den tyai en puu a ini a kondee go na a peesi pe den be o sipikii en na a koloisi.
eng_text: And when they had mocked him, they took off the purple from him, and put his own clothes on him, and led him out to crucify him.

djk_text: Da di den de a pasi e tyai Masaa Jesesi fu go sipikii kii, ne den miti a dda fu Aleksandi anga Lufosi di den be e kai Simon fu Sileni Kondee a pasi. Ne den dwengi en fu tyai a koloisi fu Masaa Jesesi gi en.
eng_text: And they compel one Simon a Cyrenian, who passed by, coming out of the country, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to bear his cross.

djk_text: Na so den tyai Masaa Jesesi go na a peesi di den e kai Golgata. Golgata wani taki, Edebon Peesi.
eng_text: And they bring him unto the place Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, The place of a skull.

djk_text: Ne den gi en win anga mile oli a ini. Ma a á wani diingi en.
eng_text: And they gave him to drink wine mingled with myrrh: but he received it not.

djk_text: Na so den sipikii Masaa Jesesi na a koloisi. Ne den iti lowte paati a koosi fi en gi den seefi.
eng_text: And when they had crucified him, they parted his garments, casting lots upon them, what every man should take.

djk_text: Dati be sa de wanten fu neigin yuu mamanten so di den sipikii Masaa Jesesi poti na a koloisi.
eng_text: And it was the third hour, and they crucified him.

djk_text: Da den be sipikii wan pisi paanga poti a Masaa Jesesi ede tapu taki:
eng_text: And the superscription of his accusation was written over, THE KING OF THE JEWS.

djk_text: Da boiti Masaa Jesesi, da den be koloisi tu taa man makandii anga en de. Wan de ne en leti ana se, a taawan de ne en kukutu ana se. Masaa Jesesi be de a mindii. We, den tu taa man de na sama di be de gaan fufuu kiiman.
eng_text: And with him they crucify two thieves; the one on his right hand, and the other on his left.

djk_text: Da a sani ya waka leti enke fa Masaa Gadu wowtu sikiifi taki: “A be de a pe den ogii ati sama de enke en na wan ogii ati sama tu.”
eng_text: And the scripture was fulfilled, which saith, And he was numbered with the transgressors.

djk_text: Da den sama di be e waka pasa be e seke ede, da den be e bali gi en taki: “O! Luku de. A ná a sama di be o booko a Mama Keliki, da a be meke en baka a ini dii dei, no?
eng_text: And they that passed by railed on him, wagging their heads, and saying, Ah, thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days,

djk_text: Da puu iseefi na a koloisi pe i de ape meke u si no, di i taanga so!”
eng_text: Save thyself, and come down from the cross.

djk_text: Da den bigiman fu Dyu keliki anga den leliman fu Dyuweiti be e meke sipowtu anga en e poti en wisiwasi taki: “A be e yeepi taa sama. Ma now a á poi yeepi enseefi.” Ne den e meke sipowtu anga en taki:
eng_text: Likewise also the chief priests mocking said among themselves with the scribes, He saved others; himself he cannot save.

djk_text: “O, Kelestesi! Kownu fu Islayeli Kondee! Puu iseefi na a koloisi meke u si, no? Da u sa biibi taki yu na a kownu fu den Dyu tuu.” Da soseefi den taa man di den be sipikii na a koloisi de, be e sipowtu anga en tu.
eng_text: Let Christ the King of Israel descend now from the cross, that we may see and believe. And they that were crucified with him reviled him.

djk_text: Da di twalufu yuu kisi, ne a hii kondee dunguu pii enke na neti. Da a dunguu ya be oli go miti dii yuu bakadina.
eng_text: And when the sixth hour was come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.

djk_text: Da na a dii yuu de, ne Masaa Jesesi bali taanga taki:
eng_text: And at the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani? which is, being interpreted, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?

djk_text: Da di wanlo sama di be taampu de, yee a bali “
eng_text: And some of them that stood by, when they heard it, said, Behold, he calleth Elias.

djk_text: Ne wan man lon go teke wan siponsu, ne a dipi en go a ini wan asin di be de ape, ne a poti a wan tiki ede, ne a langa go a Masaa Jesesi mofu fu a diingi. Ne a man taigi den sama taki: “U tan pii! Meke u luku efu Eliya o kon yeepi en tuu.”
eng_text: And one ran and filled a spunge full of vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink, saying, Let alone; let us see whether Elias will come to take him down.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi bali wan taanga bali, ne en boo koti.
eng_text: And Jesus cried with a loud voice, and gave up the ghost.

djk_text: Da di a edeman fu den suudati si fa Masaa Jesesi boo koti, ne a taki: “Aai! Eeye! A sama ya na a Manpikin fu Masaa Gadu tuu.” Da a seefi yuu di Masaa Jesesi boo koti, ne a gaan deki gaiden di be e tapu a kambaa, piiti dalla fu tapu, te a doti a tu pisi.
eng_text: And the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom.

djk_text: Da wantu uman be taampu a faawe e luku. Da Maliya fu Makidala anga Salome anga Maliya, a mma fu Yowsesi anga Jakowbesi be de a ini tu.
eng_text: There were also women looking on afar off: among whom was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;

djk_text: Da den uman ya anga tyaipi taa uman be kon anga en, di a be e kon a Jelusalem. Da na den uman ya be e solugu Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en a somen fasi.
eng_text: (Who also, when he was in Galilee, followed him, and ministered unto him;) and many other women which came up with him unto Jerusalem.

djk_text: We, pikinso moo, da a kina dei di den Dyu be e seeka gi, be o kai. Da den Dyusama á be o poi du ná wan sani moo, fu a dei de.
eng_text: And now when the even was come, because it was the preparation, that is, the day before the sabbath,

djk_text: Namo, na a yuu de, ne wan fu den hei man di de wan Dyulanti fu kuutu sani, den be e kai Jowsef fu Alimateya Kondee, kon na a peesi pe den be sipikii Masaa Jesesi. A be de wan sama di e fuuwakiti a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu. Ne Jowsef teke deki ati, ne a go a Gaaman Pilatesi, ne a akisi en taki: “Gaaman Pilatesi, mi kon begi i wan sani, baa. I sa gi mi pasi fu mi puu a dede sikin fu Masaa Jesesi na a koloisi, go beli?”
eng_text: Joseph of Arimathaea, and honourable counseller, which also waited for the kingdom of God, came, and went in boldly unto Pilate, and craved the body of Jesus.

djk_text: Ne Gaaman Pilatesi akisi en taki: “Jesesi dede kaba? Mi á wani biibi!” Ne a sende kai a edeman fu suudati di be e oli waki na a koloisi fu Masaa Jesesi. Ne a man kon. Ne Gaaman Pilatesi akisi en taki: “A man Jesesi, di den sipikii a mamanten ya, a dede kaba?”
eng_text: And Pilate marvelled if he were already dead: and calling unto him the centurion, he asked him whether he had been any while dead.

djk_text: Ne a suudati piki taki: “Iya, Gaaman, a dede kaba.” Ne Pilatesi taigi Jowsef taki: “Jowsef! I sa teke a dede sikin fu Jesesi go beli enke fa i akisi.”
eng_text: And when he knew it of the centurion, he gave the body to Joseph.

djk_text: Ne Jowsef go, ne a bai sibikoosi te a kaba. Ne a puu a dede sikin fu Masaa Jesesi na a koloisi. Ne a lolo en a ini a sibikoosi. Ne a tyai a dede sikin fu Masaa Jesesi go poti a ini wan siton olo di den be diki poti de fu beli sama. Da di a poti a dede sikin go a ini a olo kaba, ne den lolo wan gaanbigi siton tapu a olo mofu.
eng_text: And he bought fine linen, and took him down, and wrapped him in the linen, and laid him in a sepulchre which was hewn out of a rock, and rolled a stone unto the door of the sepulchre.

djk_text: Da Maliya Makidala anga Maliya, a mma fu Yowsesi be go anga Jowsef go luku pe a be o poti a dede sikin fu Masaa Jesesi. Da na so a dede anga a beli fu Masaa Jesesi be waka.
eng_text: And Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses beheld where he was laid.

djk_text: Da di a kina dei fu den Dyu pasa, ne Maliya fu Makidala anga Salome anga Maliya a mma fu Jakowbesi, bai switi sumee sani fu go lobi na a dede sikin fu Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: And when the sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome, had bought sweet spices, that they might come and anoint him.

djk_text: Ne, sonde mamanten fuuku fa i si san opo, ne den dii uman e go na a siton geebi olo.
eng_text: And very early in the morning the first day of the week, they came unto the sepulchre at the rising of the sun.

djk_text: Da, di den de a pasi e go, ne den pakisei taki: “Fa wi o du puu a gaanbigi siton na a olo mofu?”
eng_text: And they said among themselves, Who shall roll us away the stone from the door of the sepulchre?

djk_text: Ma, di den doo na a olo, ne den si taki a gaanbigi siton lolo komoto na a olo mofu kaba.
eng_text: And when they looked, they saw that the stone was rolled away: for it was very great.

djk_text: Ne den go a ini a siton geebi olo. Ne haa, den si wan yonkuman. A wei weti koosi fann sidon a den leti ana se. Ne den foondoo, te den poti ana a mofu.
eng_text: And entering into the sepulchre, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, clothed in a long white garment; and they were affrighted.

djk_text: Ne a yonkuman taigi den taki: “U á feele! A ná Jesesi fu Nasaleti, di den sipikii kii a koloisi u e suku, no? A opo komoto a dede kon a libi baka! A á de ya! U luku de pe a be didon!
eng_text: And he saith unto them, Be not affrighted: Ye seek Jesus of Nazareth, which was crucified: he is risen; he is not here: behold the place where they laid him.

djk_text: U go, da u taigi den bakaman fi en anga Peitilisi taki: ‘Ai go a den fesi a Galileya. Da a sa miti den anda enke fa a be taigi den.’ ”
eng_text: But go your way, tell his disciples and Peter that he goeth before you into Galilee: there shall ye see him, as he said unto you.

djk_text: Ne den komoto a ini a siton geebi olo, ne den lon gwe anga gaan feele na ati anga ala beifi sikin. Den á taigi ná wan sama wan sani, bika feele be moo den.
eng_text: And they went out quickly, and fled from the sepulchre; for they trembled and were amazed: neither said they any thing to any man; for they were afraid.

djk_text: We, sonde mamanten fuuku di Masaa Jesesi opo baka komoto a dede, da na Maliya fu Makidala na a fosi sama di si en. Di Masaa Jesesi be e waka e deesi sama a be puu seibin takuu jeje na a uman ya tapu.
eng_text: Now when Jesus was risen early the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom he had cast seven devils.

djk_text: Ne a go, ne a taigi den bakaman di be de anga gaan buduufu na ati e tyali e kee e kusumi.
eng_text: And she went and told them that had been with him, as they mourned and wept.

djk_text: Da den á biibi en, di a taigi den taki a si Masaa Jesesi, bika a weki baka komoto a dede kon a libi.
eng_text: And they, when they had heard that he was alive, and had been seen of her, believed not.

djk_text: Moo lati, ne Masaa Jesesi soi enseefi gi tu bakaman fi en di den be de a ini a kondee e waka go a den osu. Bika a á be soi enseefi gi den enke fa a be gwenti.
eng_text: After that he appeared in another form unto two of them, as they walked, and went into the country.

djk_text: Ne den tu bakaman daai go baka a Jelusalem go taigi den taawan. Ma den taawan á be wani biibi den tu.
eng_text: And they went and told it unto the residue: neither believed they them.

djk_text: Da wan leisi, di ala den elufu bakaman sidon e nyan makandii, ne Masaa Jesesi kon a den mindii haa. Ne a bali den fu a fasi fa den nái biibi, anga fu di den á be e biibi den sama di taigi den taki den si en.
eng_text: Afterward he appeared unto the eleven as they sat at meat, and upbraided them with their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they believed not them which had seen him after he was risen.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “U go na ala peesi a goontapu, da u taigi ala sama a Bun Nyunsu fu mi.
eng_text: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.

djk_text: Da sama di o biibi teke dopu, sa fende a libi fu tego. Ma sama di ná o biibi, o fende a tego sitaafu.”
eng_text: He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved; but he that believeth not shall be damned.

djk_text: Ne a taigi den go doo taki: “Den gaan foondoo sani ya, o pasa a mindii fu den sama di e biibi mi tuutuu. Den sa teke mi nen yaki takuu jeje puu a sama tapu. Den o taki taa tongo taki.
eng_text: And these signs shall follow them that believe; In my name shall they cast out devils; they shall speak with new tongues;

djk_text: Efu den oli takuu sineki anga ana, sani ná o du den. Efu den diingi takuu sani seefi, sani ná o du den. Den o poti ana a sikiman tapu, da den sikiman sa kon bun baka.”
eng_text: They shall take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it shall not hurt them; they shall lay hands on the sick, and they shall recover.

djk_text: Da, baka di Masaa Jesesi taki anga den bakaman fi en so, ne Masaa Gadu teke en tyai go a tapu, a Masaa Gadu Kondee. Na anda Masaa Gadu gi en a moo hei peesi ne en leti ana se.
eng_text: So then after the Lord had spoken unto them, he was received up into heaven, and sat on the right hand of God.

djk_text: Ne den bakaman fi en opo go paati a Bun Nyunsu na ala se. Da Masaa Gadu taampu gi den seefi seefi. Bika den du somen foondoo foondoo sani di e soi taki a Bun Nyunsu di den e tyai, na Masaa Gadu a komoto tuu!
eng_text: And they went forth, and preached everywhere, the Lord working with them, and confirming the word with signs following. Amen.

djk_text: We, mi Lukasi e sende bigi odi gi yu, mi gaan lesipeki mati Teyofili. So, enke fa i sabi, da somen sama sikiifi sani kaba fu a libi fu Masaa Jesesi. Da, na san den sama di be si anga den eigi ain anga den fosi diniman fu a Bun Nyunsu taigi den, na dati den sikiifi. Ma, miseefi ondoosuku den sani ya fini fini enke fa den waka tuutuu, fu sikiifi sende gi yu.
eng_text: Forasmuch as many have taken in hand to set forth in order a declaration of those things which are most surely believed among us,

djk_text: Da yuseefi sa si taki, na pilisisi a seefi enke san, di i be leli kaba.
eng_text: That thou mightest know the certainty of those things, wherein thou hast been instructed.

djk_text: Da a yuu di Helowdesi be de kownu fu Judeja, da i be abi wan apaiti begiman den be e kai Sakalia. A be de a kulu apaiti begiman fu Abiya. A uman fi en na be fu a lo fu Aalon tu, enke Sakalia seefi.
eng_text: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judaea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the course of Abia: and his wife was of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elisabeth.

djk_text: Sakalia anga Elisabeti, na tu sama, di be e libi letiopu fasi gi Masaa Gadu. Den be e oli ala weiti fu Masaa Gadu. Ná wan sama, di be poi fende wan fowtu a den.
eng_text: And they were both righteous before God, walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless.

djk_text: Ma, Sakalia anga Elisabeti á be abi ná wankodo pikin. Bika Elisabeti á be poi de anga bee. Ma soseefi, da Sakalia anga Elisabeti, na be tu gaandi sama kaba tu, di á be poi meke pikin moo.
eng_text: And they had no child, because that Elisabeth was barren, and they both were now well stricken in years.

djk_text: Ma, namo da wan dei, da Sakalia anga den taa hei apaiti begiman fu a kulu fu Abiya, be mu wooko a ini a Mama Keliki.
eng_text: And it came to pass, that while he executed the priest's office before God in the order of his course,

djk_text: Da, den be abi a gwenti, fu iti lowte luku on di fu den apaiti begiman mu go a ini a Mama Keliki a dei de, fu boon switi sumee sani gi Masaa Gadu. Di den iti a lowte, ne a soi taki, na Sakalia mu go.
eng_text: According to the custom of the priest's office, his lot was to burn incense when he went into the temple of the Lord.

djk_text: Da, di a go, da somen sama be de na a keliki e begi.
eng_text: And the whole multitude of the people were praying without at the time of incense.

djk_text: Namo, di Sakalia de a ini a keliki, ne a si wan Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee wan toon wan toon so. A taampu na a leti ana fu a apaiti begi tafaa, di den e boon switi sumee sani gi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: And there appeared unto him an angel of the Lord standing on the right side of the altar of incense.

djk_text: Da, di Sakalia si a Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee, ne a feele te en ati piiti.
eng_text: And when Zacharias saw him, he was troubled, and fear fell upon him.

djk_text: Ne a Basiya taigi en taki: “Ná feele, Sakalia! Masaa Gadu yee den begi fi yu. Yu uman, Elisabeti, o meke wan manpikin. Da i mu kai a pikin ya, Johanisi.
eng_text: But the angel said unto him, Fear not, Zacharias: for thy prayer is heard; and thy wife Elisabeth shall bear thee a son, and thou shalt call his name John.

djk_text: Da a pikin ya o gi yu gaan piisii. Da soseefi a o meke somen taa sama abi gaan piisii tu.
eng_text: And thou shalt have joy and gladness; and many shall rejoice at his birth.

djk_text: Bika a o de wan bigiman a Masaa Gadu ain. Da noiti a pikin ya á mu diingi win efu taanga diingi di e duungu sama. Da fanafu en mama bee, da a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu o de ne en tapu.
eng_text: For he shall be great in the sight of the Lord, and shall drink neither wine nor strong drink; and he shall be filled with the Holy Ghost, even from his mother's womb.

djk_text: “A o tyai somen sama fu Islayeli kon daai libi baka kon a Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: And many of the children of Israel shall he turn to the Lord their God.

djk_text: A pikin o de enke a apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu di den be e kai Eliya, enke fa a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu be de a Eliya tapu. Soseefi, leti enke fa a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu be e tii Eliya, na soseefi a o tii a pikin ya tu. Da a o waka a Masaa fesi, fu seeka ala sani gi en, fosi a kon. Da a o daai den dda anga den pikin ati, meke den daai libi bun anga denseefi. A o meke den di á be e aliki Masaa Gadu daai libi kon e libi, enke den sama di e libi bun a Masaa Gadu ain. Leti enke fa mi taki ya, na so a o pasa.”
eng_text: And he shall go before him in the spirit and power of Elias, to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children, and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to make ready a people prepared for the Lord.

djk_text: Ne Sakalia akisi a Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee taki: “Fa mi sa sabi taki, den sani di i taki ya na tuu? Bika mi anga Elisabeti gaandi pasa a peesi kaba fu meke pikin.”
eng_text: And Zacharias said unto the angel, Whereby shall I know this? for I am an old man, and my wife well stricken in years.

djk_text: Ne a Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee piki en taki: “Mi na Gabiliyeli . Mi e tan koosube fu Masaa Gadu. Ne en sende mi kon, fu taigi yu den sani ya. Ma yu á biibi mi.
eng_text: And the angel answering said unto him, I am Gabriel, that stand in the presence of God; and am sent to speak unto thee, and to shew thee these glad tidings.

djk_text: Da, fu di yu á biibi san mi taigi yu, meke yu ná o poi taki moo, fu te enke a dei di ala den sani di mi taki ya pasa. Bika, a dei o doo, di den sani ya o pasa tuu leti enke fa mi taki.”
eng_text: And, behold, thou shalt be dumb, and not able to speak, until the day that these things shall be performed, because thou believest not my words, which shall be fulfilled in their season.

djk_text: Da den sama di be de a doose be e luku Sakalia fu a kon a doose. A be foondoo den fa Sakalia be tan langa a ini a keliki osu so.
eng_text: And the people waited for Zacharias, and marvelled that he tarried so long in the temple.

djk_text: Ne den sama de a doose te, fosi Sakalia kon a doo. Ma di Sakalia kon a doo, ne na anga ana ai taki anga den sama. Bika a á be poi taki moo. Ne den sama sabi kaba taki, Sakalia miti anga wan sani a ini a keliki osu. Bika a be e soi den anga ana.
eng_text: And when he came out, he could not speak unto them: and they perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple: for he beckoned unto them, and remained speechless.

djk_text: Ne Sakalia tan du en wooko a ini a Mama Keliki, te di a yuu doo, ne a go a osu baka.
eng_text: And it came to pass, that, as soon as the days of his ministration were accomplished, he departed to his own house.

djk_text: Ne a á langa moo bakadati, ne Elisabeti, a uman fu Sakalia, oli bee. Da di a oli a bee kaba, ne a tapu enseefi a osu feifi mun langa. A nái go a pe sama de.
eng_text: And after those days his wife Elisabeth conceived, and hid herself five months, saying,

djk_text: Ne Elisabeti taki: “Masaa Gadu, i du gaan bun gi mi, baa! Bika yu puu sen a mi ain, a libisama fesi.”
eng_text: Thus hath the Lord dealt with me in the days wherein he looked on me, to take away my reproach among men.

djk_text: Da di Elisabeti de anga sigisi mun bee, ne Masaa Gadu sende Gabiliyeli, wan fu den Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee, go a Nasaleti a Galileya,
eng_text: And in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from God unto a city of Galilee, named Nazareth,

djk_text: a wan yonkuu uman den e kai Maliya. Jowsef be poti mofu ne en fu libi. Jowsef na be wan bakaten pikin fu Kownu Dafeti paansu.
eng_text: To a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David; and the virgin's name was Mary.

djk_text: Da di a Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee kon a Maliya, ne a gi en odi taki: “Fa ai go, Maliya? I abi bun ede moo ala uman. Masaa Gadu de anga yu. Ne a teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku yu. Bika a abi gaan piisii anga yu.”
eng_text: And the angel came in unto her, and said, Hail, thou that art highly favoured, the Lord is with thee: blessed art thou among women.

djk_text: Ma namo, di Maliya yee den wowtu ya, a be feele, te a be wani buuya, bika a á be sabi san den be wani taki.
eng_text: And when she saw him, she was troubled at his saying, and cast in her mind what manner of salutation this should be.

djk_text: Ne a Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee taigi en taki: “Ná feele, Maliya! Masaa Gadu teke yu poti apaiti fasi, fu du wan bun gi yu.
eng_text: And the angel said unto her, Fear not, Mary: for thou hast found favour with God.

djk_text: Bika yu sa de anga bee, da yu o meke wan manpikin. Da te a pikin ya meke, da i mu kai en, Jesesi.
eng_text: And, behold, thou shalt conceive in thy womb, and bring forth a son, and shalt call his name JESUS.

djk_text: A pikin ya sa hei a Masaa Gadu ain. Da den o kai en, Pikin fu a moo Hei Gadu a tapu. Masaa Gadu o gi en a kownu sutuu fi en avo gaansama Dafeti, fu tii sani.
eng_text: He shall be great, and shall be called the Son of the Highest: and the Lord God shall give unto him the throne of his father David:

djk_text: Da a o tii den bakaten pikin fu a avo gaansama fu Dyusama, Jakopu. A tii fi en sa de fu tego.”
eng_text: And he shall reign over the house of Jacob for ever; and of his kingdom there shall be no end.

djk_text: Ne Maliya akisi a Basiya taki: “Fa mi o du de anga bee? Mi á siibi anga man wanten.”
eng_text: Then said Mary unto the angel, How shall this be, seeing I know not a man?

djk_text: Ne a Basiya piki en taki: “A Apaiti Jeje fu Masaa Gadu o kon a ini yu anga kaakiti, da i sa de anga bee. Da fu di na a Apaiti Jeje o meke i de anga bee, meke den sa kai a pikin ya, Pikin fu Masaa Gadu. A pikin ya libi o seeka de silli apaiti fasi, sondee fowtu gi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: And the angel answered and said unto her, The Holy Ghost shall come upon thee, and the power of the Highest shall overshadow thee: therefore also that holy thing which shall be born of thee shall be called the Son of God.

djk_text: I sisa Elisabeti de anga sigisi mun bee nownow na a gaandi gaandi yuu fi en ya. Da a sa meke wan manpikin. I si? A Elisabeti, di ala sama be e taki ná o meke pikin ná wan ten moo, ne en de anga bee.
eng_text: And, behold, thy cousin Elisabeth, she hath also conceived a son in her old age: and this is the sixth month with her, who was called barren.

djk_text: Bika ná wan sani de di Masaa Gadu á poi du. Ala san di Masaa Gadu taki, musu pasa enke fa a taki.”
eng_text: For with God nothing shall be impossible.

djk_text: We, ne Maliya piki a Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee taki: “A bun! Mi de a ini mi Masaa ana ini. Meke a du anga mi enke fa i taki de.” Ne, di den taki so, te den kaba, ne a Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee gwe fi en baka.
eng_text: And Mary said, Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it unto me according to thy word. And the angel departed from her.

djk_text: Da wan satu pisiten a baka di a Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee taki anga Maliya so kaba, ne Maliya opo, ne a waka esi esi go na a pisiwataa fu Judeja, a wan pikin kondee a den mongo mindii.
eng_text: And Mary arose in those days, and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Juda;

djk_text: Da di a doo a kondee kaba, ne a go a Sakalia osu. Ne a gi Elisabeti odi.
eng_text: And entered into the house of Zacharias, and saluted Elisabeth.

djk_text: Ma namo, di Elisabeti yee a odi fu Maliya, ne a pikin dyombo a ini en bee e sikopu futu. Ne a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu kon a Elisabeti tapu.
eng_text: And it came to pass, that, when Elisabeth heard the salutation of Mary, the babe leaped in her womb; and Elisabeth was filled with the Holy Ghost:

djk_text: Ne Elisabeti bali taki: “Maliya! Seigi fi yu a Masaa Gadu bigi moo ala taa uman. Soseefi seigi fi yu a Masaa Gadu bigi, fu a pikin di de a ini i bee de tu.”
eng_text: And she spake out with a loud voice, and said, Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb.

djk_text: Ne Elisabeti taki go doo taki: “Oho! Fa mi du abi a bun ede ya, taki a mama fu mi Masaa kon a mi osu kon luku mi?
eng_text: And whence is this to me, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?

djk_text: Bika, di mi yee a odi fi yu, ne a pikin di de a ini mi bee piisii te a sikopu futu.
eng_text: For, lo, as soon as the voice of thy salutation sounded in mine ears, the babe leaped in my womb for joy.

djk_text: We, Maliya! Fu di i du san Masaa Gadu wani, da i sa fende seigi ne en. Bika ala den sani di a taigi yu de, o pasa tuu.”
eng_text: And blessed is she that believed: for there shall be a performance of those things which were told her from the Lord.

djk_text: Ne Maliya seefi daai gafa Masaa Gadu. A taki: “Mi e gafa Masaa Gadu anga mi hii ati.
eng_text: And Mary said, My soul doth magnify the Lord,

djk_text: Mi e piisii tuu a ini mi ati anga a Gadu fu mi. Ne en na mi Yeepiman.
eng_text: And my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour.

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu luku mi enke wan mofinawan, ne a opo mi. Da a opo di a opo mi ya, ná abi kaba. Bika fu alaten, sama sa kai mi nen taki, na so Masaa Gadu be seigi mi.
eng_text: For he hath regarded the low estate of his handmaiden: for, behold, from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed.

djk_text: Bika, na a Sama di abi ala makiti a goontapu, ne en du mi a gaan bun ya. A gaan bun ya, na a Sama di abi ala makiti a goontapu, ne en du mi en. A Sama ya de kiinkiin sondee fowtu.
eng_text: For he that is mighty hath done to me great things; and holy is his name.

djk_text: Da alaten Masaa Gadu e du gaan bun naamo gi den sama di e lesipeki en. Bika a abi tyali ati fu libisama.
eng_text: And his mercy is on them that fear him from generation to generation.

djk_text: Da Masaa Gadu abi makiti fu du ala sani. Bika a booko den bigi fasi sama anga den hei membee wan saka.
eng_text: He hath shewed strength with his arm; he hath scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.

djk_text: Ai naki den gaan kownu puu a den kownu sutuu. Ma ai opo den saka fasi sama kon poti hei.
eng_text: He hath put down the mighty from their seats, and exalted them of low degree.

djk_text: Ai paati den gudu fi en gi den pinaman di e angii fi en. Ma ai sende den guduman gwe anga soso ana.
eng_text: He hath filled the hungry with good things; and the rich he hath sent empty away.

djk_text: A abi tyali ati naamo e yeepi den Islayeli.
eng_text: He hath holpen his servant Israel, in remembrance of his mercy;

djk_text: A á feegete san a be paamisi u tata Abalaham anga den bakapikin fi en, bika alaten ai yeepi den leti enke fa a be paamisi den.”
eng_text: As he spake to our fathers, to Abraham, and to his seed for ever.

djk_text: Da di Maliya gafa Masaa Gadu so kaba, ne a tan dii mun anga Elisabeti, fosi a daai gwe baka a Nasaleti Foto, a pe a be e tan.
eng_text: And Mary abode with her about three months, and returned to her own house.

djk_text: Da na so, di a yuu doo fu Elisabeti meke, ne a meke a manpikin.
eng_text: Now Elisabeth's full time came that she should be delivered; and she brought forth a son.

djk_text: Da di den famii fi en anga den sama fu a pisi kondee pe ai tan, yee taki a meke a pikin, ne den piisii anga en te, ná sipowtu, bika den si taki Masaa Gadu du wan gaan bun gi Elisabeti.
eng_text: And her neighbours and her cousins heard how the Lord had shewed great mercy upon her; and they rejoiced with her.

djk_text: Da di a pikin abi aitin dei, ne den kon fu koti en sani mofu enke fa den Dyu be gwenti, fu soi taki a pikin ya libi de fu Masaa Gadu wawan. Da den be wani kai a pikin Sakalia enke en dda.
eng_text: And it came to pass, that on the eighth day they came to circumcise the child; and they called him Zacharias, after the name of his father.

djk_text: Ma Elisabeti taki: “Nono! U á mu kai en Sakalia. U kai en, Johanisi.”
eng_text: And his mother answered and said, Not so; but he shall be called John.

djk_text: Ma den sama taki: “Nono! Wi á poi kai en Johanisi, bika ná wan sama fu a famii abi a nen de.”
eng_text: And they said unto her, There is none of thy kindred that is called by this name.

djk_text: Ne den sama daai go a Sakalia, ne den akisi en taki, fa a wani den kai a pikin.
eng_text: And they made signs to his father, how he would have him called.

djk_text: Ne a soi den anga ana taki, meke den gi en wan sani meke a sikiifi.
eng_text: And he asked for a writing table, and wrote, saying, His name is John. And they marvelled all.

djk_text: Ne den sama gi en sani fu a sikiifi. Ne a teke den sani, ne a sikiifi taki: “Na a pikin ya den e kai, Johanisi.” Da a sani ya foondoo ala den sama di be de ape. Ne wanten di Sakalia sikiifi so, ne walla en tongo losi. Ne a bigin taki baka. Ne a gi Masaa Gadu bigi nen anga daa.
eng_text: And his mouth was opened immediately, and his tongue loosed, and he spake, and praised God.

djk_text: Da ala den sama foondoo te, ná sipowtu. Ala den sama fu a pikin kondee a den mongo mindii de be e taki fu san pasa.
eng_text: And fear came on all that dwelt round about them: and all these sayings were noised abroad throughout all the hill country of Judaea.

djk_text: Da a toli ya paati na a hii mongo pisi fu Judeja. Da ala sama di yee a toli ya e akisi denseefi taki: “We, da san a pikin ya o toon di bigi so?” Bika den be si taki, Masaa Gadu be de anga a pikin ya.
eng_text: And all they that heard them laid them up in their hearts, saying, What manner of child shall this be! And the hand of the Lord was with him.

djk_text: Da a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu kon a Sakalia tapu, ne a taki wan bosikopu fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: And his father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Ghost, and prophesied, saying,

djk_text: A taki: “Gaantangi fu Masaa Gadu, a Gadu fu Islayeli. A kon puu wi, den sama fi en a sitaafu.
eng_text: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel; for he hath visited and redeemed his people,

djk_text: Bika a o toon wan gaan taanga yeepiman na a lo paansu sama fu Kownu Dafeti.
eng_text: And hath raised up an horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David;

djk_text: Da a o gi wi a pikin ya, leti enke fa Masaa Gadu be meke den fositen apaiti takiman fi en be paamisi den gaansama fu wi langa ten kaba a fesi. Da Masaa Gadu be meke den apaiti takiman fi en be paamisi den gaansama taki, ne en be o kon puu wi a den feyanti fu wi ondoo.
eng_text: As he spake by the mouth of his holy prophets, which have been since the world began:

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu taki a be abi tyali ati anga den gaansama fu wi fu yeepi den. Da a be kuudei anga a avo gaansama fu wi, di den be e kai Abalaham taki, a o puu den bakaten pikin fi en a den feyanti fu den ondoo. Bika a be meke wan sweli anga wi tata Abalaham taki, a be o puu wi a den feyanti fu wi ondoo, fu u be sa waka ne en baka kiinkiin sondee feele anga sondee fowtu. Da son langa wi e libi, u be sa waka enke fa Masaa Gadu wani.
eng_text: To perform the mercy promised to our fathers, and to remember his holy covenant;

djk_text: Da a pikin fu mi ya, den sa kai yu, wan apaiti takiman fu a moo hei Masaa Gadu fu tapu. Bika yu o waka a fesi fu Masaa go taigi den sama meke den seeka denseefi fu a kon fi en. Yu o bali bosikopu gi den taki, meke den daai den libi meke Masaa Gadu yeepi den. Da a sa gi den paadon fu den takuudu anga ogii fu den.
eng_text: And thou, child, shalt be called the prophet of the Highest: for thou shalt go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways;

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu abi tyali ati fu libisama. Da a á wani meke den waka a dunguu moo gi dede e sitaafu. A dati meke a sende a leti fi en kon a goontapu, leti enke fa a san e kiin ala peesi te a opo. Na fu den be sa komoto a dunguu kon de fiifii a ini a leti fu Masaa Gadu.” Da na so a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu meke Sakalia taki wan bosikopu.
eng_text: Through the tender mercy of our God; whereby the dayspring from on high hath visited us,

djk_text: Da a pikin e goo e kon. A be e kisi moo fusutan, bika a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu be de anga en. Ne a pikin goo te di a bigi, ne en wawan go a ini wan gaan sabana ini go e tan. Da, di a yuu fu Masaa Gadu doo, ne a komoto a ini a gaan sabana ini kon a den Islayeli fi en. Ne ai bali a bosikopu fu Masaa Gadu gi ala den sama.
eng_text: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, and was in the deserts till the day of his shewing unto Israel.

djk_text: Da na a ten de, da a moo gaan kownu a Loma Foto be sende wan bosikopu go na ala den kondee, di a be abi taki fu den. A taki: “Ala sama fiya mu go sikiifi den nen poti a lanti buku, bika den e teli onmen sama de a ini a kondee.”
eng_text: And it came to pass in those days, that there went out a decree from Caesar Augustus, that all the world should be taxed.

djk_text: Da disi na a fosi toon di den o teli sama a ini a kondee ya. Da a yuu ten ya, na Gaaman Kwiliniyesi na be gaaman fu Siliya.
eng_text: (And this taxing was first made when Cyrenius was governor of Syria.)

djk_text: Da iniiwan sama be mu go poti den nen a lanti buku na a kondee pe den avo fu den be meke.
eng_text: And all went to be taxed, every one into his own city.

djk_text: Da Jowsef be komoto a Nasaleti Foto, a Galileya pisiwataa anga Maliya en poti mofu uman. Ma namo, da Maliya be de anga gaan bee. Ne den go te den doo Betelehem a Judeja pisiwataa. Betelehem na a foto fu a fositen Kownu Dafeti. Bika Jowsef na be wan bakaten manpikin fu Kownu Dafeti paansu. Na dati meke a be mu go a Betelehem, fu go poti en anga Maliya nen.
eng_text: And Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judaea, unto the city of David, which is called Bethlehem; (because he was of the house and lineage of David:)

djk_text: Da di den doo Betelehem, da Maliya yuu be doo fu a meke.
eng_text: And so it was, that, while they were there, the days were accomplished that she should be delivered.

djk_text: Ne a meke. A meke wan manpikin. A fosi pikin fi en. Ne a lolo a pikin a ini koosi, ne a poti en a ini wan baki di den e poti nyanyan gi meti fu nyan. Bika peesi á be de a ini a lanti osu fu den tan. A be fuu gwingwin. Ne na a osu fu den meti den gi den fu siibi.
eng_text: And she brought forth her firstborn son, and wrapped him in swaddling clothes, and laid him in a manger; because there was no room for them in the inn.

djk_text: Da a neti di Maliya meke, da i be abi wantu man a ini wei, na a pisi kondee de. Den be e waki den sikapu fu den.
eng_text: And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night.

djk_text: Ne wanten so wan Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee kon a den. Ne ala peesi kiin dyelle enke gaandei. Na Masaa Gadu seefi a leti ya komoto. Da di den sikapuman si a Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee, ne den dyombo te den bigin feele.
eng_text: And, lo, the angel of the Lord came upon them, and the glory of the Lord shone round about them: and they were sore afraid.

djk_text: Ne a Basiya taigi den taki: “U á feele! Mi tyai a moo gaan piisii nyunsu kon gi u. A nyunsu ya o meke a hii foluku fii gaan piisii.
eng_text: And the angel said unto them, Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people.

djk_text: Bika a neti ya, da a Yeepiman fu u meke kon a goontapu. En na Kelestesi, a na a Masaa fu u. A meke a Betelehem, na a foto fu Kownu Dafeti.
eng_text: For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.

djk_text: Meke mi soi u fa u sa sabi a pikin ya. Te u go, da u o si a didon lolo lolo a ini koosi, a ini wan baki di den e poti nyanyan gi meti.”
eng_text: And this shall be a sign unto you; Ye shall find the babe wrapped in swaddling clothes, lying in a manger.

djk_text: Ne wanten di a Basiya taki so, ne onmen tenti taa Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee kon mokisa anga en. Ne den bali baaya gi Masaa Gadu gaandi taki:
eng_text: And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising God, and saying,

djk_text: “U bali baaya gi Masaa Gadu! U bali baaya gi Masaa Gadu ne en kondee a tapu anda. Fii kon a goontapu gi ala libisama di e libi enke fa Masaa Gadu wani. Masaa Gadu abi piisii anga den.”
eng_text: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.

djk_text: Da di den Masaa Gadu Kondee Basiya gafa Masaa Gadu so, ne den daai gwe baka a Masaa Gadu Kondee a tapu. Ne den sikapuman piki denseefi taki: “We, baala oo! U kon meke u go a Betelehem, a pe a pikin meke go luku a sani di Masaa Gadu taigi u ya.”
eng_text: And it came to pass, as the angels were gone away from them into heaven, the shepherds said one to another, Let us now go even unto Bethlehem, and see this thing which is come to pass, which the Lord hath made known unto us.

djk_text: Ne den go a Betelehem. Ne di den doo de, ne den si taki, ala sani waka leti enke fa a Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee be taki. Den si Maliya anga Jowsef anga a pikin. A pikin didon a ini wan baki di den e poti nyanyan gi meti.
eng_text: And they came with haste, and found Mary, and Joseph, and the babe lying in a manger.

djk_text: Da di den sikapuman si en so kaba, ne den go taigi ala sama ala den sani di a Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee be taigi den, fu a pikin.
eng_text: And when they had seen it, they made known abroad the saying which was told them concerning this child.

djk_text: Da ala sama di yee a sani fu a pikin ya e poti ana a mofu e foondoo.
eng_text: And all they that heard it wondered at those things which were told them by the shepherds.

djk_text: Ma Maliya dati, teke ala den sani di a yee ya, oli a ede e poti dipi pakisei.
eng_text: But Mary kept all these things, and pondered them in her heart.

djk_text: Da di den sikapuman ya daai baka e go a ini a wei, ne den e singi e piisii gaan piisii fu san di den be yee anga san di den si. Bika ala sani be waka enke fa a Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee be taigi den.
eng_text: And the shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, as it was told unto them.

djk_text: We, ne den de te a pikin abi aitin dei, ne den koti a maiki a manpeesi gi en, enke fa a weiti fu Masaa Gadu taki. Ne den kai a pikin Jesesi, enke fa a Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee be taigi Maliya fu kai a pikin, fosi a be de anga bee fi en.
eng_text: And when eight days were accomplished for the circumcising of the child, his name was called JESUS, which was so named of the angel before he was conceived in the womb.

djk_text: Da Maliya anga Jowsef be tyai a pikin go a Jelusalem, fu go poti a Masaa Gadu ana, enke fa a Dyuweiti be taki. Bika a Dyuweiti ya be taki: “Ala fosi manpikin di wan uman meke, a mu gi Masaa Gadu en.” A seefi ten de, da Maliya yuu be doo fu komoto a meke osu tu. Ne a tyai tu doifi go a Jelusalem tu, fu a wasi komoto a meke osu enke fa a Dyuweiti be taki. Bika a Dyuweiti ya be taki: “Te wan uman meke wan pikin, da na fotenti dei langa a mu de a meke osu. Da te a o wasi komoto a meke osu, da a mu tyai tu pikin paansu doifi ofu tu yonkuu doifi go boon gi Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: And when the days of her purification according to the law of Moses were accomplished, they brought him to Jerusalem, to present him to the Lord;

djk_text: Da a yuu di Maliya anga Jowsef e go a Jelusalem, da wan man be de ape den be e kai Simiyon. Simiyon na wan sama di be e libi letiopu fasi gi Masaa Gadu. Soseefi ai lesipeki Masaa Gadu. Da a be e luku on ten Masaa Gadu be o puu den Islayeli sama a sitaafu. Da a Apaiti Jeje fu Masaa Gadu be de ne en tapu.
eng_text: And, behold, there was a man in Jerusalem, whose name was Simeon; and the same man was just and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel: and the Holy Ghost was upon him.

djk_text: Da a Jeje be taigi en taki, a á be o dede fosi a be si Kelestesi, a Kownu di Masaa Gadu be paamisi taki a be o sende kon gi den.
eng_text: And it was revealed unto him by the Holy Ghost, that he should not see death, before he had seen the Lord's Christ.

djk_text: Da di den tyai a pikin kon, ne a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu tyai Simiyon kon a ini a Mama Keliki tu. Da di a doo a ini, ne a si taki den tyai a pikin kon fu seeka enke fa a weiti fu Masaa Gadu taki.
eng_text: And he came by the Spirit into the temple: and when the parents brought in the child Jesus, to do for him after the custom of the law,

djk_text: Ne a teke a pikin a ini en ana, ne a gafa Masaa Gadu taki:
eng_text: Then took he him up in his arms, and blessed God, and said,

djk_text: “Kee baa, Masaa Gadu! Now mi sa dede anga wan switi ati.
eng_text: Lord, now lettest thou thy servant depart in peace, according to thy word:

djk_text: Bika, miseefi si a Yeepiman anga miseefi ain enke fa i paamisi mi.
eng_text: For mine eyes have seen thy salvation,

djk_text: I sende en kon gi wi Islayeli sama anga ala taa sama a goontapu, fu yeepi wi. A pikin ya o puu wi na a se fu dunguu tyai kon na a leti fi i. Da a o leli wi a bun pasi di wi mu waka. Da na fu a pikin ya ede meke somen sama o kai wi Islayeli sama nen taki: ‘A pikin fu Islayeli sama yeepi ala sama fu goontapu.’ ”
eng_text: Which thou hast prepared before the face of all people;

djk_text: We, den wowtu di Simiyon taki ya, foondoo Maliya anga Jowsef te, ná sipowtu.
eng_text: And Joseph and his mother marvelled at those things which were spoken of him.

djk_text: Ne Simiyon begi Masaa Gadu gi den, te a kaba. Ne a taigi Maliya taki: “Maliya! A pikin ya o booko somen sama fu Islayeli Kondee saka. Ma soseefi, a o opo somen sama fu Islayeli Kondee tu. Da a o puu ala den ogii di de a somen sama pakisei fu du kon a doo. Masaa Gadu gi wi a pikin ya enke wan maiki fu soi wi fa Masaa Gadu seefi de. Sani di sama á be si wan dei, den o si ne en. Sani di sama á be yee wan dei, den o yee ne en. Na fu dati ede meke somen sama ná o lobi en.
eng_text: And Simeon blessed them, and said unto Mary his mother, Behold, this child is set for the fall and rising again of many in Israel; and for a sign which shall be spoken against;

djk_text: Ma wan dei o kon di wan takuu sani o pasa anga a pikin ya. A o hati yu moo enke, te den be o sutu yu anga fetihow a i boo fu ati doo kisi taase.”
eng_text: (Yea, a sword shall pierce through thy own soul also,) that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.

djk_text: Ma namo, da wan uman den e kai Hana, be de a ini a keliki osu tu. Masaa Gadu be e gi en bosikopu fu gi taa sama. Ne en dda den be e kai Fanuweli, fu a lo fu Aseli. Seibin yali baka, di a uman ya anga en man be libi ne en yonkuu ten, ne a man dede.
eng_text: And there was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Aser: she was of a great age, and had lived with an husband seven years from her virginity;

djk_text: Ne a de sondee man, fu te enke fa a abi aititenti a fo yali ya. Da dei anga neti a uman ya e de a ini a Mama Keliki e begi Masaa Gadu. Son dei, a be e de sondee nyan seefi fu begi.
eng_text: And she was a widow of about fourscore and four years, which departed not from the temple, but served God with fastings and prayers night and day.

djk_text: Da a yuu di Simiyon e taki de, ne a mma ya kon a ini a keliki osu tu. Ne di a si a pikin, ne a bigin gi Masaa Gadu daa. Ne ai taigi ala den sama di be e luku fu Masaa Gadu sende a Paamisi Kownu kon fu puu Jelusalem a sitaafu taki: “A Paamisi Kownu kon kaba.”
eng_text: And she coming in that instant gave thanks likewise unto the Lord, and spake of him to all them that looked for redemption in Jerusalem.

djk_text: Da na so Maliya anga Jowsef seeka ala sani enke fa a Dyuweiti taki, te a kaba. Ne den daai gwe baka a den kondee Nasaleti, na a pisiwataa fu Galileya.
eng_text: And when they had performed all things according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city Nazareth.

djk_text: Da a pikin e goo e kon. Ai bigi toon manengee. Moo anga moo, ai abi kiin fusutan fu den sani fu Masaa Gadu anga den sani fu libisama. Masaa Gadu seefi de anga en e yeepi en anga ala sani.
eng_text: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, filled with wisdom: and the grace of God was upon him.

djk_text: Da Maliya anga Jowsef be gwenti go a Jelusalem ala yali fu nyan a gaan piisii fesa fu den Dyu den e kai Pasika.
eng_text: Now his parents went to Jerusalem every year at the feast of the passover.

djk_text: Da di Jesesi abi twalufu yali, ne en anga den go a Jelusalem na a Pasika Fesa.
eng_text: And when he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem after the custom of the feast.

djk_text: Da di a Pasika Fesa kaba, ne den daai baka e gwe a osu, a Nasaleti Foto. Ma Jesesi be fika a baka a Jelusalem. Da Jowsef anga Maliya á be sabi taki, Jesesi fika a baka.
eng_text: And when they had fulfilled the days, as they returned, the child Jesus tarried behind in Jerusalem; and Joseph and his mother knew not of it.

djk_text: Bika den be denki taki, son ten a be waka anga den taa sama di den anga den be go a Jelusalem na a Pasika Fesa. A dati meke den waka wan hii dei, te di neti fosi den bigin suku en. Den suku en a den famii anga den mati fu den, ma den á fende en.
eng_text: But they, supposing him to have been in the company, went a day's journey; and they sought him among their kinsfolk and acquaintance.

djk_text: Da di den á fende en, ne den daai baka gwe a Jelusalem. Na dii dei langa di den suku Jesesi, fosi den go fende en a ini a Mama Keliki fu Dyu. A sidon a den leliman fu Dyuweiti mindii e aliki fa den e leli Gadu wowtu. Da a be e akisi den sani tu. Da den be e gi en piki fu san a be e akisi den.
eng_text: And it came to pass, that after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the doctors, both hearing them, and asking them questions.

djk_text: Ala den sama be e foondoo fu a fasi fa a be e fusutan sani anga a fasi fa a be e piki den sani.
eng_text: And all that heard him were astonished at his understanding and answers.

djk_text: Da di den si en, ne den foondoo. Ne Maliya bali taki: “Oho, Jesesi! Pikin! San meke i du so anga wi du? Tide meke di fu dii dei di mi anga i dda e booko ede e suku yu!”
eng_text: And when they saw him, they were amazed: and his mother said unto him, Son, why hast thou thus dealt with us? behold, thy father and I have sought thee sorrowing.

djk_text: Ne Jesesi piki den taki: “Fu saide meke u booko ede suku mi so? U á sabi taki, mi mu du den wooko fu mi Tata, no? Efu u be sabi dati, da u á be o booko ede suku mi so.”
eng_text: And he said unto them, How is it that ye sought me? wist ye not that I must be about my Father's business?

djk_text: Ma fa a pikin taki de, en dda anga en mma á be sabi san a wani taigi den. Den á fusutan en seefi.
eng_text: And they understood not the saying which he spake unto them.

djk_text: Ne den teke en, ne den go baka a Nasaleti. Ma Jesesi be e saka enseefi a den ondoo e du san den taki. Ma Maliya teke den wowtu fu Jesesi oli a ede poti dipi pakisei naamo.
eng_text: And he went down with them, and came to Nazareth, and was subject unto them: but his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.

djk_text: Da a pikin e goo e kon. On moo ai bigi, on moo en fusutan fu sani e opo. Masaa Gadu anga libisama lobi en.
eng_text: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favour with God and man.

djk_text: Da na di fu tin na feifi yali, fu a tii fu Tibeliyasi, di be de a moo gaan kownu a Loma Foto, ne Johanisi bigin wooko. Kownu Tibeliyasi be abi somen taa edeman ne en ondoo, di be e wooko gi en, fu tii taa pisiwataa enke edeman. Gaaman Pontiyesi Pilatesi be e tii a pisiwataa den be e kai Judeja. Kownu Helowdesi be e tii a pisiwataa den be e kai Galileya. Filipi, a baala fu Kownu Helowdesi, be e tii den tu pisiwataa den e kai Ituleya anga Takownisi. Da Gaaman Lisaniyasi be e tii a pisiwataa den e kai Abileina.
eng_text: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judaea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of Ituraea and of the region of Trachonitis, and Lysanias the tetrarch of Abilene,

djk_text: We, a yuu de, da Anasi anga Kayafasi na be den tu moo hei apaiti begiman. Ne Masaa Gadu kai a pikin fu Sakalia di den e kai Johanisi puu a ini a sabana fu bigin wooko.
eng_text: Annas and Caiaphas being the high priests, the word of God came unto John the son of Zacharias in the wilderness.

djk_text: Ne Johanisi opo e bali bosikopu gi den sama fu den kondee kondee, na a pisiwataa fu a Joodani Liba taki, fu den kon teke dopu, fu daai libi. Meke Masaa Gadu sa gi den paadon, fu takuudu anga ogii.
eng_text: And he came into all the country about Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins;

djk_text: A sani ya waka leti enke fa Masaa Gadu be piki Jesaja, enke wan apaiti takiman fi en, fu sikiifi a fositen taki: “A tongo fu wan bosikopuman o bali a ini a gaan sabana taki: ‘U seeka pasi gi a Masaa, meke a pasi sa kon taampu letiopu tollo.
eng_text: As it is written in the book of the words of Esaias the prophet, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.

djk_text: Meke ala dipi saka peesi kon hei. Meke ala mongo kon booko saka miti doti. Meke ala bendi bendi fu a pasi kon taampu letiopu. Ala den olo olo seefi mu kon seeka silli miti doti.
eng_text: Every valley shall be filled, and every mountain and hill shall be brought low; and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough ways shall be made smooth;

djk_text: Da ala sama o si a yeepi fu Masaa Gadu.’ ”
eng_text: And all flesh shall see the salvation of God.

djk_text: Da, di Johanisi bali a bosikopu ya, ne onmen tenti sama kon ne en fu a dopu den. Ne a taigi den taki: “U takuu ati sineki sani! Fa u du sabi taki, u mu lon gi a gaan atiboon fu Masaa Gadu di de a pasi fu kon?
eng_text: Then said he to the multitude that came forth to be baptized of him, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

djk_text: We, u mu soi tuutuu taki u daai libi. Ma u á mu luku taki, fu di u avo gaansama Abalaham anga Masaa Gadu be de mati, da Masaa Gadu ná o sitaafu u moo. Kweti! Bika efu Masaa Gadu wani, a sa meke den siton di u e si ya, daai kon toon bakaten pikin fu Abalaham, a u peesi.
eng_text: Bring forth therefore fruits worthy of repentance, and begin not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, That God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.

djk_text: Da soseefi a akisi fu Masaa Gadu de na a bon kaba fu faa en. Da ibii bon di de ape, di nái meke bun nyanyan, da den o faa en towe a ini faya boon.”
eng_text: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: every tree therefore which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.

djk_text: Namo den sama akisi Johanisi taki: “Da san u mu du moo?”
eng_text: And the people asked him, saying, What shall we do then?

djk_text: Ne a piki den taki: “Efi i abi tu impi, gi a sama di ná abi wan. Da efi i abi nyanyan, da gi a sama di ná abi fu nyan.”
eng_text: He answereth and saith unto them, He that hath two coats, let him impart to him that hath none; and he that hath meat, let him do likewise.

djk_text: Da baka fu den, ne den sama di e piki lantimoni kon ne en fu a dopu den tu. Ne den akisi en taki: “We, Mesiti oo! San u mu du moo?”
eng_text: Then came also publicans to be baptized, and said unto him, Master, what shall we do?

djk_text: Ne a piki den taki: “Te u e piki lantimoni, u á mu teke moo ipi moo enke san lanti poti.”
eng_text: And he said unto them, Exact no more than that which is appointed you.

djk_text: Ne den suudati seefi kon, ne den akisi en taki: “We, san u dati mu du?” Ne a piki den taki: “U á mu suku toobi anga sama e dwengi den fu gi u moni. Soseefi, u á mu lei gi sama tyai den go a kuutu fu moni ede. U meke a moni di lanti e pai u sai u.”
eng_text: And the soldiers likewise demanded of him, saying, And what shall we do? And he said unto them, Do violence to no man, neither accuse any falsely; and be content with your wages.

djk_text: Da di den sama yee fa Johanisi taki, ne den pakisei taki: “A ná a Kelestesi, a di Masaa Gadu be taki a o sende kon gi u de ya, no?” Bika den be e luku on ten a Kownu di Masaa Gadu be paamisi den, be o kon.
eng_text: And as the people were in expectation, and all men mused in their hearts of John, whether he were the Christ, or not;

djk_text: Ma Johanisi piki den taki: “Nono! Mi e dopu u anga wataa. Ma u luku Awan di makiti bigi moo mi, a o kon a mi baka! Ma mi á dyendee sai fu losi susu puu a futu gi en seefi. En dati o dopu sama anga a Apaiti Jeje anga faya.
eng_text: John answered, saying unto them all, I indeed baptize you with water; but one mightier than I cometh, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to unloose: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost and with fire:

djk_text: A de kaba kaba fu seeka a nyanyan fi en. Den bun nyanyan a o kibii ne en baakoto. Ma den poli wan a o iti a ini faya di noiti e tapu, fu den boon poli.”
eng_text: Whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and will gather the wheat into his garner; but the chaff he will burn with fire unquenchable.

djk_text: Na so Johanisi e bali den sama naamo e gi den a Bun Nyunsu fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: And many other things in his exhortation preached he unto the people.

djk_text: Ma namo, da Johanisi be bali Kownu Helowdesi, fu di kownu be teke en baala uman e libi anga fu den somen taa ogii sani di a be e du.
eng_text: But Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias his brother Philip's wife, and for all the evils which Herod had done,

djk_text: Ne kownu komoto, ne a du wan moo gaan ogii. Bika a kisi Johanisi poti a ini dunguu osu.
eng_text: Added yet this above all, that he shut up John in prison.

djk_text: Ma bifo den be poti Johanisi a dunguu osu, da somen sama be e kon ne en fu a dopu den. Na so Masaa Jesesi seefi kon fu kon teke dopu tu. Da a yuu di Masaa Jesesi e dopu, ne ai begi. Da di a begi te wan pisi, ne tapu a den woluku piiti opo palan.
eng_text: Now when all the people were baptized, it came to pass, that Jesus also being baptized, and praying, the heaven was opened,

djk_text: Ne a Apaiti Jeje fu Masaa Gadu saka kon ne en tapu enke wan doifi. Ne wan Tongo taki a tapu anda taki: “Yu na mi Manpikin di mi lobi. Mi hii ati e piisii anga yu.”
eng_text: And the Holy Ghost descended in a bodily shape like a dove upon him, and a voice came from heaven, which said, Thou art my beloved Son; in thee I am well pleased.

djk_text: Da Jesesi be abi diitenti yali di a bigin fu wooko leli sama. Da den sama be teke taki, na Jowsef, a pikin fu Eli ne en dda.
eng_text: And Jesus himself began to be about thirty years of age, being (as was supposed) the son of Joseph, which was the son of Heli,

djk_text: Eli na be a pikin fu Matati. Da Matati na be a pikin fu Leifi. Da Leifi na be a pikin fu Milki. Da Milki na be a pikin fu Yanai. Yanai na be a pikin fu Jowsef.
eng_text: Which was the son of Matthat, which was the son of Levi, which was the son of Melchi, which was the son of Janna, which was the son of Joseph,

djk_text: Da Jowsef na be a pikin fu Matatiyasi. Da Matatiyasi na be a pikin fu Amosi. Da Amosi na be a pikin fu Naahem. Da Naahem na be a pikin fu Hesili. Da Hesili na be a pikin fu Nagai.
eng_text: Which was the son of Mattathias, which was the son of Amos, which was the son of Naum, which was the son of Esli, which was the son of Nagge,

djk_text: Nagai na be a pikin fu Maata. Da Maata na be a pikin fu Matatiyasi. Da Matatiyasi na be a pikin fu Semeyen. Da Semeyen na be a pikin fu Yowseki. Da Yowseki na be a pikin fu Yowda.
eng_text: Which was the son of Maath, which was the son of Mattathias, which was the son of Semei, which was the son of Joseph, which was the son of Juda,

djk_text: Yowda na be a pikin fu Yowanan. Da Yowanan na be a pikin fu Lesa. Da Lesa na be a pikin fu Selubabeli. Da Selubabeli na be a pikin fu Seyaltiyeli. Da Seyaltiyeli na be a pikin fu Neli.
eng_text: Which was the son of Joanna, which was the son of Rhesa, which was the son of Zorobabel, which was the son of Salathiel, which was the son of Neri,

djk_text: Neli na be a pikin fu Milki. Da Milki na be a pikin fu Adi. Da Adi na be a pikin fu Kowsan. Da Kowsan na be a pikin fu Emadan. Da Emadan na be a pikin fu Eli.
eng_text: Which was the son of Melchi, which was the son of Addi, which was the son of Cosam, which was the son of Elmodam, which was the son of Er,

djk_text: Eli na be a pikin fu Josuwa. Da Josuwa na be a pikin fu Eliyesolu. Da Eliyesolu na be a pikin fu Yolemu. Da Yolemu na be a pikin fu Matati. Da Matati na be a pikin fu Leifi.
eng_text: Which was the son of Jose, which was the son of Eliezer, which was the son of Jorim, which was the son of Matthat, which was the son of Levi,

djk_text: Leifi na be a pikin fu Simiyon. Da Simiyon na be a pikin fu Juda. Da Juda na be a pikin fu Jowsef. Da Jowsef na be a pikin fu Yownan. Da Yownan na be a pikin fu Eliyaken.
eng_text: Which was the son of Simeon, which was the son of Juda, which was the son of Joseph, which was the son of Jonan, which was the son of Eliakim,

djk_text: Eliyaken na be a pikin fu Meleya. Da Meleya na be a pikin fu Mena. Da Mena na be a pikin fu Matata. Da Matata na be a pikin fu Naatan. Da Naatan na be a pikin fu Dafeti.
eng_text: Which was the son of Melea, which was the son of Menan, which was the son of Mattatha, which was the son of Nathan, which was the son of David,

djk_text: Dafeti na be a pikin fu Isai. Da Isai na be a pikin fu Obeti. Da Obeti na be a pikin fu Bowasi. Da Bowasi na be a pikin fu Saala. Da Saala na be a pikin fu Nakson.
eng_text: Which was the son of Jesse, which was the son of Obed, which was the son of Booz, which was the son of Salmon, which was the son of Naasson,

djk_text: Nakson na be a pikin fu Amenadabu. Da Amenadabu na be a pikin fu Admen. Da Admen na be a pikin fu Alini. Da Alini na be a pikin fu Sesilon. Da Sesilon na be a pikin fu Pelesi. Da Pelesi na be a pikin fu Juda.
eng_text: Which was the son of Aminadab, which was the son of Aram, which was the son of Esrom, which was the son of Phares, which was the son of Juda,

djk_text: Juda na be a pikin fu Jakopu. Da Jakopu na be a pikin fu Isaki. Da Isaki na be a pikin fu Abalaham. Da Abalaham na be a pikin fu Telaki. Da Telaki na be a pikin fu Naakolu.
eng_text: Which was the son of Jacob, which was the son of Isaac, which was the son of Abraham, which was the son of Thara, which was the son of Nachor,

djk_text: Naakolu na be a pikin fu Seluku. Da Seluku na be a pikin fu Lewu. Da Lewu na be a pikin fu Pelegi. Da Pelegi na be a pikin fu Ebeli. Da Ebeli na be a pikin fu Seila.
eng_text: Which was the son of Saruch, which was the son of Ragau, which was the son of Phalec, which was the son of Heber, which was the son of Sala,

djk_text: Seila na be a pikin fu Kaina. Da Kaina na be a pikin fu Alipakisa. Da Alipakisa na be a pikin fu Sem. Da Sem na be a pikin fu Nowa. Da Nowa na be a pikin fu Lameki.
eng_text: Which was the son of Cainan, which was the son of Arphaxad, which was the son of Sem, which was the son of Noe, which was the son of Lamech,

djk_text: Lameki na be a pikin fu Metusala. Da Metusala na be a pikin fu Heinoki. Da Heinoki na be a pikin fu Yeleti. Da Yeleti na be a pikin fu Mahalaleli. Da Mahalaleli na be a pikin fu Keinan.
eng_text: Which was the son of Mathusala, which was the son of Enoch, which was the son of Jared, which was the son of Maleleel, which was the son of Cainan,

djk_text: Keinan na be a pikin fu Enosi. Da Enosi na be a pikin fu Seti. Da Seti na be a pikin fu Adan. Ma Adan na be a pikin fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Which was the son of Enos, which was the son of Seth, which was the son of Adam, which was the son of God.

djk_text: Da di Masaa Jesesi komoto a Joodani Liba pe den dopu en, da a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu be de ne en tapu wan taanga fasi. Ne a tyai en gwe a ini a gaan sabana ini.
eng_text: And Jesus being full of the Holy Ghost returned from Jordan, and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness,

djk_text: Ne a didibii go tesi en anda. Bika Masaa Jesesi poti nyanyan a wanse, fu begi fotenti dei anga fotenti neti langa a ini a gaan sabana anda. Na so di den fotenti dei pasa, ne angii moo en.
eng_text: Being forty days tempted of the devil. And in those days he did eat nothing: and when they were ended, he afterward hungered.

djk_text: Ne a didibii taigi en taki: “Di yu na a Manpikin fu Masaa Gadu tuutuu, da taigi den siton ya, meke den toon beele, osi, fi i fende nyan?”
eng_text: And the devil said unto him, If thou be the Son of God, command this stone that it be made bread.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Nono! Masaa Gadu Buku sikiifi taki: ‘A ná nyanyan namo e oli wan sama a libi.’ ”
eng_text: And Jesus answered him, saying, It is written, That man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.

djk_text: Ne didibii tyai en go a wan gaan hei peesi, ne te fi i pingi ain opo, ne a soi Masaa Jesesi ala den kondee kondee fu goontapu anga ala den gudu fu den. Ne a taigi en taki:
eng_text: And the devil, taking him up into an high mountain, shewed unto him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.

djk_text: “I si ala den sani di i si de? Na mi abi ala. Da na sama di mi wani, mi e gi den. So, da mi o gi yu ala den kondee ya anga ala den gudu fu den. Soseefi mi o gi yu a makiti fu taki fu den. Ma, da i mu sutu kini a doti begi mi fosi.”
eng_text: And the devil said unto him, All this power will I give thee, and the glory of them: for that is delivered unto me; and to whomsoever I will I give it.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Nono! Bika, a sikiifi a Masaa Gadu Buku taki: ‘Na Masaa Gadu wawan u mu begi, na Masaa Gadu wawan u mu dini! Ná wan sama moo.’ ”
eng_text: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Get thee behind me, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.

djk_text: Ne a didibii teke en, ne a tyai en go a Jelusalem, te na a moo hei peesi, na a tapu osu fu a Mama Keliki. Ne a taigi en taki: “Di i na a Manpikin fu Masaa Gadu, da fee saka ya go a doti anda, osi? Da ná wan sani o du yu.
eng_text: And he brought him to Jerusalem, and set him on a pinnacle of the temple, and said unto him, If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down from hence:

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu Buku taki: ‘Masaa Gadu o sende den Basiya fi en kon yeepi yu, fu sani á du yu.
eng_text: For it is written, He shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee:

djk_text: Den Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee o tyai yu na ana meke yu á naki i futu a ná wan siton.’ ”
eng_text: And in their hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en baka taki: “Ma Masaa Gadu Buku sikiifi tu taki: ‘Wi á mu tesi Masaa di de a Gadu fu wi.’ ”
eng_text: And Jesus answering said unto him, It is said, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.

djk_text: Da na so didibii tesi Masaa Jesesi na ala fasi fa a man, ma a á be poi kisi en, fu a du san a wani. Ne a fika en de, ne a gwe fosi.
eng_text: And when the devil had ended all the temptation, he departed from him for a season.

djk_text: Ne bakadati, ne Masaa Jesesi daai kon baka a Galileya. Da a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu be de ne en tapu taanga. Da a á be de ape langa seefi fosi sama be sabi taki, a be de ape.
eng_text: And Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee: and there went out a fame of him through all the region round about.

djk_text: Bika a be e go a ini den Dyu keliki osu e go e leli den sama Masaa Gadu wowtu. Da ala sama be e gafa en, fu fa den be si a be sabi leli sama den sani.
eng_text: And he taught in their synagogues, being glorified of all.

djk_text: Da di a de a Galileya de te wan pisi, ne a go a Nasaleti a pe a be kiya. Ne a de ape te a kina dei fu den Dyu doo, ne a go na a keliki enke fa a be gwenti. Ne a opo taampu fu leisi wan pisi fu Gadu wowtu gi den.
eng_text: And he came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up: and, as his custom was, he went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and stood up for to read.

djk_text: Ne den teke wan pisi fu Gadu wowtu, di Jesaja, wan fositen apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu sikiifi, ne den langa gi en. Ne a opo en, ne a leisi a pisi di sikiifi taki:
eng_text: And there was delivered unto him the book of the prophet Esaias. And when he had opened the book, he found the place where it was written,

djk_text: “A Jeje fu Masaa Gadu de a mi tapu. Masaa Gadu sende mi fu taki a Bun Nyunsu fi en gi den pootiman. Masaa Gadu sende mi, fu taigi den sama di de tetei taki: ‘Mi sa puu den na a katibo di den de ape, fu den de booboo.’ Masaa Gadu sende mi, fu taigi den beendiman taki: ‘Den ain sa kon bun.’ Masaa Gadu sende mi, fu taigi den sama di de a sitaafu anga pina taki: ‘Den sa komoto na a sitaafu anga a pina kon de fu den boo.’
eng_text: The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, because he hath anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor; he hath sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to preach deliverance to the captives, and recovering of sight to the blind, to set at liberty them that are bruised,

djk_text: Soseefi a sende mi, fu taigi ala libisama fiya taki: ‘A yuu doo di Masaa Gadu teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku libisama.’ ”
eng_text: To preach the acceptable year of the Lord.

djk_text: Ne di Masaa Jesesi kaba, ne a lolo a pampila baka, ne a langa gi den baka. Ne a go sidon. Ne ala den sama di be de a ini a keliki osu fika e luku en dunn.
eng_text: And he closed the book, and he gave it again to the minister, and sat down. And the eyes of all them that were in the synagogue were fastened on him.

djk_text: Ne a taigi den taki: “A sama di Masaa Gadu taki a sende na a pisi di u leisi de, na mi.”
eng_text: And he began to say unto them, This day is this scripture fulfilled in your ears.

djk_text: Di a taki so, te a kaba, namo a taki switi gi den sama te, a foondoo den. Ma toku, den á gafa en anga den hii ati, bika den daai e akisi denseefi taki: “Sama na a sama di taki a taki de? A ná a pikin fu Jowsef, no?”
eng_text: And all bare him witness, and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth. And they said, Is not this Joseph's son?

djk_text: We, ne di Masaa Jesesi si so, ne a piki den taki: “U wani koti odoo gi mi taki: ‘Kaabita e deesi, ma enseefi kini bigi?’ Bika u be yee fu den sani di i e du a Kafalnayemu. Da di i kon a iseefi kondee ya, da du den gi den sama fi yu ya tu meke u si.”
eng_text: And he said unto them, Ye will surely say unto me this proverb, Physician, heal thyself: whatsoever we have heard done in Capernaum, do also here in thy country.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “U aliki bun! Meke mi taigi u: ‘Wan apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu, ná abi nen ne enseefi kondee.’
eng_text: And he said, Verily I say unto you, No prophet is accepted in his own country.

djk_text: “Bika luku a apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu, di den be e kai Eliya. A ten di a be de, na so den á be e oli en fu sani tu. A be tapu a alen hiihii dii yali anga sigisi mun langa, ne en kondee Islayeli ya. Ne wan gaan angiiten be kon a Islayeli Kondee fu di alen á be e kai. Da na a angii yuu ya, da somen pooti uman be de a ini Islayeli Kondee ya, di man dede fika a ganda. Ma toku, Masaa Gadu á be sende Eliya go a wan fu den uman ya. Ma a sende en go, te a wan hii taa kondee den e kai Salefati, na a pisiwataa fu Sidon Kondee fu go du wan gaan foondoo sani gi wan hii taa kondee uman di man dede fika a ganda.
eng_text: But I tell you of a truth, many widows were in Israel in the days of Elias, when the heaven was shut up three years and six months, when great famine was throughout all the land;

djk_text: Na soseefi a be de na a ten fu a apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu di den be e kai Elisa. A ten de, da somen sama fu Islayeli be de anga gwasi siki. Ma Elisa á deesi ná wan fu den. Ma a fika den go deesi Naamani, wan man di komoto te a wan taa kondee den kai Siliya.”
eng_text: And many lepers were in Israel in the time of Eliseus the prophet; and none of them was cleansed, saving Naaman the Syrian.

djk_text: We, di Masaa Jesesi taki so, ne den sama di be de a ini a keliki osu, ati boon te, den ain lebi nyan.
eng_text: And all they in the synagogue, when they heard these things, were filled with wrath,

djk_text: Ne den opo gwugwulu, ne den toto Masaa Jesesi gei gei poti a doo. Ne den tyai en go te, na a mongo mofu fu a kondee, fu toto en towe go a ondoo.
eng_text: And rose up, and thrust him out of the city, and led him unto the brow of the hill whereon their city was built, that they might cast him down headlong.

djk_text: Ma, te fu den membee, ne kuli, a daai waka pasa a den mindii gwe fi en.
eng_text: But he passing through the midst of them went his way,

djk_text: Da Masaa Jesesi go a Kafalnayemu, na a seefi pisiwataa fu Galileya. Da te kina dei, da a be e go a den Dyu keliki go e leli sama Masaa Gadu wowtu.
eng_text: And came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee, and taught them on the sabbath days.

djk_text: Da a be e foondoo den sama, fu a fasi fa a be e leli den. Bika i be sa si taki, a be e leli den enke wan sama di sabi san ai taki.
eng_text: And they were astonished at his doctrine: for his word was with power.

djk_text: Ma namo, da wan dei di a de a ini a keliki osu e leli den sama, da wan sama be de ape anga wan sani ne en tapu. Ne a sani bali na a sama tapu taki:
eng_text: And in the synagogue there was a man, which had a spirit of an unclean devil, and cried out with a loud voice,

djk_text: “Jesesi fu Nasaleti! San i kon du ya? A kon i kon fu kii wi kaba? Mi sabi sama a yu! Yu na a Apaiti Sama fu Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art; the Holy One of God.

djk_text: Ma wanten Masaa Jesesi kaasi den taki: “Tapu mofu de! Komoto ne en tapu gwe wanten!” Ne a sani towe a man a doti, a den sama fesi, ne a komoto ne en tapu gwe, sondee fu du wan ogii anga a man.
eng_text: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him. And when the devil had thrown him in the midst, he came out of him, and hurt him not.

djk_text: Da den sama be foondoo te, den taigi denseefi taki: “Ai kaasi den takuu sani, da wanten den e du san a kumandei den fu du. Anga a gaan makiti anga taanga fi en, a puu a takuu sani na a man tapu.”
eng_text: And they were all amazed, and spake among themselves, saying, What a word is this! for with authority and power he commandeth the unclean spirits, and they come out.

djk_text: A nyunsu ya paati na a hii pisiwataa fu Galileya.
eng_text: And the fame of him went out into every place of the country round about.

djk_text: Da di Masaa Jesesi komoto na a keliki, ne a go a Simon osu. Ma namo, di den go doo, da a main fu Simon be didon anga taanga feba a kama. Ne den sama di be de ape a ini a osu begi Masaa Jesesi, fu a deesi en gi den.
eng_text: And he arose out of the synagogue, and entered into Simon's house. And Simon's wife's mother was taken with a great fever; and they besought him for her.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi go a ini a osu. Ne a sende ala den sama go a doo. Ne a waka go taampu na a kama sikin. Ne a kaasi a feba fu a gwe komoto na a mma sikin. Ne wanten a feba gwe. Ne a uman opo, ne a seeka sani gi den, den nyan.
eng_text: And he stood over her, and rebuked the fever; and it left her: and immediately she arose and ministered unto them.

djk_text: Da di sapaten, san dongo, ne den sama tyai onmen tenti sama anga ala sowtu siki kon a Masaa Jesesi fu a deesi den. Ne Masaa Jesesi poti ana a den tapu, deesi ala den fiya. Da wansi sowtu siki den sama be abi, toku a deesi ala fiya.
eng_text: Now when the sun was setting, all they that had any sick with divers diseases brought them unto him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.

djk_text: Da soseefi a puu somen takuu sani a somen sama tapu. Da den sani be e bali gi Masaa Jesesi taki: “Yu na a Manpikin fu Masaa Gadu!” Ma Masaa Jesesi á be e gi den pasi fu taki. A be e kaasi den fu den tapu mofu wanten. Bika den takuu sani be sabi taki, en na a Kelestesi.
eng_text: And devils also came out of many, crying out, and saying, Thou art Christ the Son of God. And he rebuking them suffered them not to speak: for they knew that he was Christ.

djk_text: Da a taa dei fi en, fuuku mamanten, ne Masaa Jesesi wawan opo go a wan koo peesi. Ne den suku en te, den go si en. Ne den begi Masaa Jesesi gaantangi fu a á gwe, ma fu a tan anga den a den kondee de.
eng_text: And when it was day, he departed and went into a desert place: and the people sought him, and came unto him, and stayed him, that he should not depart from them.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Mi mu go a den taa kondee go paati a Bun Nyunsu di e taki, fu a Nyun Tii tu Masaa Gadu tu. Meke den yee. Bika na fu a sani de ede meke mi kon a goontapu.”
eng_text: And he said unto them, I must preach the kingdom of God to other cities also: for therefore am I sent.

djk_text: We, ne ai waka na ala den kondee kondee fu den Dyu fiya e paati a Bun Nyunsu fu Masaa Gadu gi den a ini den keliki osu fu den.
eng_text: And he preached in the synagogues of Galilee.

djk_text: Ma namo, da wan dei, da Masaa Jesesi be de a wataa mofu, fu a ze fu Genesaleti. Da somen sama ali kon ne en te a ipi, fu yee Masaa Gadu wowtu.
eng_text: And it came to pass, that, as the people pressed upon him to hear the word of God, he stood by the lake of Gennesaret,

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi si tu boto a lampeesi de. Den boto ya na be fu wanlo fisiman di be komoto a peesi kon e losi den seepi e seeka.
eng_text: And saw two ships standing by the lake: but the fishermen were gone out of them, and were washing their nets.

djk_text: Wan fu den fisiman ya na be Simon. Ne a subi go a ini a boto fu Simon. Ne a taigi Simon fu a toosi a boto go a wataa afu, fu a sa taki anga den sama.
eng_text: And he entered into one of the ships, which was Simon's, and prayed him that he would thrust out a little from the land. And he sat down, and taught the people out of the ship.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi sidon a ini a boto taki anga den sama te a kaba. Ne a taigi Simon taki: “So, we Simon! Wai a boto go a mindii wataa! Da i towe i seepi kisi fisi!”
eng_text: Now when he had left speaking, he said unto Simon, Launch out into the deep, and let down your nets for a draught.

djk_text: Ne Simon piki taki: “Mesiti! A di na yu taki, meke mi o towe a seepi baka. Ma ofuso, mi á be o towe en moo. Bika na hii neti u towe seepi suku fisi kaba sondee fu kisi wan siiba. Ma toku, di na yu taki so, da u sa iti luku baka.”
eng_text: And Simon answering said unto him, Master, we have toiled all the night, and have taken nothing: nevertheless at thy word I will let down the net.

djk_text: Ne den iti den seepi a wataa. Ne den kisi fisi te, a seepi e suku fu piiti.
eng_text: And when they had this done, they inclosed a great multitude of fishes: and their net brake.

djk_text: Ne den bali kai den taa sama di den anga den be e fisi makandii, fu kon yeepi den anga den fisi. Ne den kon a den. Ne den e kisi den fisi poti a ini den tu boto te, a fika pikinso moo fu den tu boto sungu.
eng_text: And they beckoned unto their partners, which were in the other ship, that they should come and help them. And they came, and filled both the ships, so that they began to sink.
