eng_text: But as soon as this thy son was come, which hath devoured thy living with harlots, thou hast killed for him the fatted calf.

djk_text: “Ne a dda piki en taki: ‘We, pikin oo! Alaten mi anga yu de makandii ya. Da ala san mi abi, na fi yu.
eng_text: And he said unto him, Son, thou art ever with me, and all that I have is thine.

djk_text: I baala be lasi, fu go kaba a soso. Ma now a daai kon a osu anga libi baka. Da taa fasi á de moo enke, na fu meke piisii anga en namo, da a kaba. Bika a be lasi, ma u fende en baka.’ ”
eng_text: It was meet that we should make merry, and be glad: for this thy brother was dead, and is alive again; and was lost, and is found.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi gi den bakaman fi en wan taa ageisi toli. A taki: “Wan guduman be de. Da a be teke wan man a wooko poti enke basi, fu seeka ala sani, luku den gudu fi en gi en. Da di den de, te wan dei, ne sama kon taigi en taki, a man di a poti enke basi na a wooko fi en, e kii a moni fi en anga nyan. Ne a guduman taki: ‘Na tuu sani u e taigi mi ya?’ Ne den taki: ‘Iya!’ Ne a piki taki: ‘A bun!’
eng_text: And he said also unto his disciples, There was a certain rich man, which had a steward; and the same was accused unto him that he had wasted his goods.

djk_text: Ne a sende kai a man di a be poti enke basi fu a wooko. Ne a taigi en taki: ‘Man! Mi yee wan sani. Mi yee taki, yu e kaba a moni fu mi anga nyan. Da taigi mi, bika mi o ondoosuku luku. Da yu ná o poi de basi fu a wooko moo. Mi o puu yu.’
eng_text: And he called him, and said unto him, How is it that I hear this of thee? give an account of thy stewardship; for thou mayest be no longer steward.

djk_text: “Ne a man pakisei a ini enseefi taki: ‘Oho! San mi o du di a basi o puu mi a wooko? A ganda mi o de sondee wooko. Bika fa mi de ya, mi á taanga sai fu wooko goon fu meke nyanyan gi miseefi. Fu waka a sama osu e begi, mi ná o poi, bika sen e kisi mi.’
eng_text: Then the steward said within himself, What shall I do? for my lord taketh away from me the stewardship: I cannot dig; to beg I am ashamed.

djk_text: Ne a de te wan pisi, ne a taki: ‘Oo! Mi sabi san mi o du, fu te a man puu mi a wooko, fu sama sa teke mi oli a den osu fu solugu, fu mi á pina dede.’
eng_text: I am resolved what to do, that, when I am put out of the stewardship, they may receive me into their houses.

djk_text: “Ne di a pakisei so kaba, ne a sende kai ala den sama di a be yuu sani gi. Ne den kon ne en wan fu wan. Ne a akisi a fosiwan taki: ‘Man, onmen i mu pai a basi fu mi?’
eng_text: So he called every one of his lord's debtors unto him, and said unto the first, How much owest thou unto my lord?

djk_text: Ne a man piki en taki: ‘We, mi mu pai wan ondoo bali oli.’ Di a piki so, ne a man teke a pampila di a be sikiifi onmen a man mu pai, ne a piiti towe. Ne a teke wan taa pampila, ne a gi en taki: ‘Luku ya! Go sidon esi esi, da i sikiifi taki, i mu pai feifitenti bali namo.’ Ne a man teke a pampila, ne a go sidon, ne a sikiifi taki na feifitenti bali namo a mu pai.
eng_text: And he said, An hundred measures of oil. And he said unto him, Take thy bill, and sit down quickly, and write fifty.

djk_text: “Ne a kai a taawan di fu meke tu, ne a akisi en taki: ‘Man! Onmen i mu pai fu den sani di i be yuu?’ Ne a man piki en taki: ‘We, mi mu pai wan ondoo saka bolon.’ Ne a teke a pampila di a be sikiifi onmen a man mu pai, ne a piiti towe. Ne soseefi a gi a man wan taa pampila taki: ‘Luku ya. Ná sikiifi wan ondoo moo, ma sikiifi aititenti namo.’
eng_text: Then said he to another, And how much owest thou? And he said, An hundred measures of wheat. And he said unto him, Take thy bill, and write fourscore.

djk_text: “Ne di a guduman si a fasi fa a man wooko, ne a foondoo en. Bika a wooko anga koni fu seeka en libi gi bakaten. Ne Masaa Jesesi daai, ne a taigi den taki: ‘Den sama fu a goontapu ya, di nái waka a Masaa Gadu pasi e wooko anga moo koni fu seeka denseefi gi bakaten, moo enke den sama di e waka a Masaa Gadu pasi.’ ”
eng_text: And the lord commended the unjust steward, because he had done wisely: for the children of this world are in their generation wiser than the children of light.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den go doo taki: “Te u e wooko anga moni, u mu wooko anga koni. U mu wooko anga en a goontapu ya, fu te a dei o doo, fu go a Masaa Gadu fu tego, fu a sa piisii anga u.
eng_text: And I say unto you, Make to yourselves friends of the mammon of unrighteousness; that, when ye fail, they may receive you into everlasting habitations.

djk_text: Efu sama sa fitoow yu anga wan pikin sani di den poti a ini yu ana, da den sa fitoow yu fu poti gaan sani a ini yu ana. Ma efu sama á poi fitoow yu anga wan pikin sani di den poti a ini yu ana, da den ná o poi fitoow yu fu poti gaanwan a ini yu ana tu.
eng_text: He that is faithful in that which is least is faithful also in much: and he that is unjust in the least is unjust also in much.

djk_text: Da efu yu á sabi wooko anga moni a goontapu ya wan bun kiinkiin fasi, da fa Masaa Gadu o fitoow yu, fu gi den tuutuu gudu fi en kondee, fu wooko anga den?
eng_text: If therefore ye have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true riches?

djk_text: Soseefi, efu yu á sabi seeka taa sama sani wan bun fasi, da fa Masaa Gadu o poti den waiti sani fi en a ini yu ana, fu wooko anga den a goontapu ya?
eng_text: And if ye have not been faithful in that which is another man's, who shall give you that which is your own?

djk_text: “Bika ná wan sama sa dini tu masaa makandii. Dati á kan! Ofu yu o lobi awan moo a taawan. Ofu yu o booko a wan saka, da i opo a taawan. Ma yu á poi lobi ala den tu a seefi fasi. Yu á poi waka a Masaa Gadu baka, da yu e feti a moni baka tu. Yu o lobi awan moo a taawan.”
eng_text: No servant can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.

djk_text: Ne di Masaa Jesesi taki so, te a kaba, ne den Faliseiman yee. Ne den meke tyuu. Ne den e wisiwasi en, e soso en. Bika den be abi giili ati fu moni enke fa Masaa Jesesi taki de.
eng_text: And the Pharisees also, who were covetous, heard all these things: and they derided him.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “U á sabi, no? Na u mi e taki. Na libisama ain, ai soi enke u na bunbun sama. Ma Masaa Gadu sabi u ati, te doo. Bika a sani di u e si enke na wan gaan hei sani a libisama, da na gaan wisiwasi sani a Masaa Gadu ain.”
eng_text: And he said unto them, Ye are they which justify yourselves before men; but God knoweth your hearts: for that which is highly esteemed among men is abomination in the sight of God.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den Faliseiman taki: “Fu sensi a ten di Masaa Gadu gi Mosesi den weiti, te doo a yuu di Johanisi a Dopuman kon a goontapu, da na den weiti fu Mosesi anga den taa apaiti takiman fi en be e soi libisama, fa fu waka a Masaa Gadu pasi. Ma fa u de nownow, da Johanisi tyai a Bun Nyunsu di e taki, fu a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu. Da somen sama e feti fu kon a ini.
eng_text: The law and the prophets were until John: since that time the kingdom of God is preached, and every man presseth into it.

djk_text: Ma a á de taki na bun den weiti fu Mosesi anga den di fu den apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu á bun moo. Nono! Bika tapu anda anga goontapu a doti ya, sa pasa gwe, sondee fu wan pikintoin sani a ini den weiti ya lasi gwe.”
eng_text: And it is easier for heaven and earth to pass, than one tittle of the law to fail.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taki go doo taki: “Efu wan man teke wan uman fu libi, ma a fika en go teke wan taa uman, da a booko Masaa Gadu weiti. Soseefi a man di o libi anga wan uman di en man fika, booko Masaa Gadu weiti tu.”
eng_text: Whosoever putteth away his wife, and marrieth another, committeth adultery: and whosoever marrieth her that is put away from her husband committeth adultery.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi gi den wan ageisi toli fu tu man. A taki: “Tu man be de a wan kondee. Wan fu den man, na be wan gaan guduman di be gudu, te a gudu. A be e wei gaan dii koosi, e meke gaan piisii, e libi enke fa a wani.
eng_text: There was a certain rich man, which was clothed in purple and fine linen, and fared sumptuously every day:

djk_text: Ma a taawan di den be e kai Lasalesi na be wan gaan pinaman. A be pina te, a á be abi ná wan sani seefi. En hii sikin be de anga kaasi kaasi te, a de fonyoo. Den ganda dagu be e leki den kaasi kaasi fi en sikin. Opo seefi a á be poi opo waka komoto a pe a be e sidon. Na sama be e diki en go poti na a guduman mofu doo. Da a be e sidon e waki, efu te a guduman ya nyan, efu sakasaka be kai a doti fu a be fende nyan.
eng_text: And there was a certain beggar named Lazarus, which was laid at his gate, full of sores,

djk_text: Da na so a pinaman de te, ne a dede. Di a dede go a dedekondee, ne den Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee teke en tyai go na Abalaham se .
eng_text: And it came to pass, that the beggar died, and was carried by the angels into Abraham's bosom: the rich man also died, and was buried;

djk_text: “Da baka wan pisiten, ne a guduman seefi dede. Ne den tyai en go beli. Ne a go a didibii kondee, a ini faya pe soso pen anga gaan pina de. Da di a de a ini a gaan pina ya, te wan pisi di a opo en ain luku, ne a si Lasalesi na a Abalaham sikin se.
eng_text: And in hell he lift up his eyes, being in torments, and seeth Abraham afar off, and Lazarus in his bosom.

djk_text: “Ne a bali kai Abalaham taki: ‘Abalaham, tata! Gaantangi abi tyali ati fu mi, baa? Sende Lasalesi meke a dopu en finga a ini wataa tyai kon nati mi tongo gi mi, baa? Bika mi e boon dede a ini a faya ya.’
eng_text: And he cried and said, Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water, and cool my tongue; for I am tormented in this flame.

djk_text: “Ma Abalaham piki en taki: ‘Oho, pikin! Pakisei taki i be abi i bun ten, di i be de a goontapu. Ma Lasalesi be abi wan pina mofina libi. Ma nownow ya, da a de taa fasi. I de a ini faya e bali fu pen, ma Lasalesi de a koo. A fende boo nownow.
eng_text: But Abraham said, Son, remember that thou in thy lifetime receivedst thy good things, and likewise Lazarus evil things: but now he is comforted, and thou art tormented.

djk_text: Ma boiti tu taki, i be nyan i bun a goontapu kaba, da pasi á de fu den sama fu mi dise waka kon a yu anda, ofu fu u anda waka kon a wi dise. Bika wan gaan paati de a wi fu dise anga u fu anda mindii.’
eng_text: And beside all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed: so that they which would pass from hence to you cannot; neither can they pass to us, that would come from thence.

djk_text: “Ne a guduman piki en taki: ‘A bun! Ma gaantangi, mi begi yu baa, tata Abalaham! Sende Lasalesi go na a osu, mi dda, baa?
eng_text: Then he said, I pray thee therefore, father, that thou wouldest send him to my father's house:

djk_text: Da, te a go, da a o si den feifi baala fu mi de. Da gaantangi baa, tata Abalaham! Meke a bali den gi mi, fu den á libi enke mi. Bika efu den libi so, da den o kon a ini a gaan takuu faya ya tu.’
eng_text: For I have five brethren; that he may testify unto them, lest they also come into this place of torment.

djk_text: “Ne Abalaham piki en taki: ‘Den sama fu goontapu anda abi den buku fu Mosesi anga den buku fu den apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu kaba. Meke den baala fi yu leisi san den buku de e taki. Da den libi so.’
eng_text: Abraham saith unto him, They have Moses and the prophets; let them hear them.

djk_text: “Ne a guduman piki en taki: ‘Nono, tata Abalaham! Winsi den abi den buku de seefi, toku den nái leisi den. Ma efu wan sama weki komoto a dede dise go bali den, da den sa daai libi.’
eng_text: And he said, Nay, father Abraham: but if one went unto them from the dead, they will repent.

djk_text: “Ne Abalaham piki en taki: ‘Ná tuu! Bika efu na den buku di den abi anda, den nái leisi, fu waka enke fa den taki, da winsi wan sama weki komoto a dede dise seefi go bali den, den ná o aliki en tu.’ ”
eng_text: And he said unto him, If they hear not Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded, though one rose from the dead.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den bakaman fi en taki: “Den sani di e kon fu ali sama puu a Masaa Gadu pasi, ná o kaba a goontapu noiti. Ma heelu, fu den sama di e tyai den tesi ya kon miti taawan!
eng_text: Then said he unto the disciples, It is impossible but that offences will come: but woe unto him, through whom they come!

djk_text: A moo bun gi sowan sama efu den tei wan gaanbigi siton ne en neki, da den tyai en go iti a ini ze, moo enke pe fu a koli wan fu den mofinawan ya puu a Masaa Gadu pasi, fu go du ogii.
eng_text: It were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he cast into the sea, than that he should offend one of these little ones.

djk_text: Mi e bali u, fu luku bun taki, a sani de á miti u. “Efi i si wan biibiwan e du ogii, da bali en, meke a daai libi, fu kaba anga a ogii di ai du. Da efu a aliki yu, ne a daai libi, da gi en paadon.
eng_text: Take heed to yourselves: If thy brother trespass against thee, rebuke him; and if he repent, forgive him.

djk_text: Winsi na seibin toon a ini wan dei seefi a du ogii anga yu, ma efu a kon begi yu seibin toon paadon taki, a du ogii anga yu tuu, ma a si dati, ne a daai libi. Da gi en paadon!”
eng_text: And if he trespass against thee seven times in a day, and seven times in a day turn again to thee, saying, I repent; thou shalt forgive him.

djk_text: Ne den apaiti bosikopuman fu Masaa Jesesi taigi en taki: “Masaa gaantangi! Yeepi wi, meke a biibi fu wi kon moo taanga, baa.”
eng_text: And the apostles said unto the Lord, Increase our faith.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “We, efu u abi biibi enke wan pikintoin mosite sii, da u sa taigi a gaanbigi bon di taampu de taki, meke a opo komoto de anga ala lutu, da a go paandi enseefi a ini ze. Da a o go enke fa u taki.”
eng_text: And the Lord said, If ye had faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye might say unto this sycamine tree, Be thou plucked up by the root, and be thou planted in the sea; and it should obey you.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den baka taki: “On di fu u o abi wan wookoman di go wooko a goon ofu di go luku den meti a den sabana, te a kon a osu, da a taigi en taki: ‘Kon sidon nyan?’
eng_text: But which of you, having a servant plowing or feeding cattle, will say unto him by and by, when he is come from the field, Go and sit down to meat?

djk_text: Nono! Ná wan fu u. Te a wookoman kon a osu, da yu o meke a lon go seeka enseefi esi esi. Da i meke a go boli nyanyan, sete tafaa gi i fi i go nyan. Da, te yu kaba nyan fosi, da yu o meke a wookoman ya kon nyan.
eng_text: And will not rather say unto him, Make ready wherewith I may sup, and gird thyself, and serve me, till I have eaten and drunken; and afterward thou shalt eat and drink?

djk_text: A basi fu a wooko ná o gi a wookoman ya wan apaiti daa fu a wooko di a du. Bika ne en wooko di a be mu du, a du de.
eng_text: Doth he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded him? I trow not.

djk_text: We, da na so a de anga u tu. Te u wooko gi Masaa Gadu enke fa a wooko de, da a á de fu u suku fu a gi u daa. Bika na u wooko di u mu du, u du de.”
eng_text: So likewise ye, when ye shall have done all those things which are commanded you, say, We are unprofitable servants: we have done that which was our duty to do.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi komoto de, ne a teke pasi e go a Jelusalem. Ma namo, da ai waka pasa na a pisi fu Galileya anga Samaliya mindii.
eng_text: And it came to pass, as he went to Jerusalem, that he passed through the midst of Samaria and Galilee.

djk_text: Ne di a waka, te a doo a wan pikin kondee, ne tin man e waka fu kon miti en. Ala den tin man ya be abi gwasi siki. Ne den taampu, te a faawe,
eng_text: And as he entered into a certain village, there met him ten men that were lepers, which stood afar off:

djk_text: ne den bali gi Masaa Jesesi taki: “Jesesi oo, Masaa! Teke tyali ati fu u! Da gaantangi yeepi u, baa.”
eng_text: And they lifted up their voices, and said, Jesus, Master, have mercy on us.

djk_text: Ne di Masaa Jesesi yee den bali so, ne a daai luku den. Ne a taki: “Kee! A tyali fu den sama de, baa? Ma u sabi san? U go a den apaiti begiman na a Mama Keliki, meke den si taki u kon bun tuu.” Ne den teke pasi e go a apaiti begiman. A di den waka te wan pisi, ne den sikin kon bun kelle. A gwasi siki gwe komoto a den sikin.
eng_text: And when he saw them, he said unto them, Go shew yourselves unto the priests. And it came to pass, that, as they went, they were cleansed.

djk_text: Ma di wan fu den si taki, a kon bun, ne a daai baka kon a Masaa Jesesi. Ne ai bali taki: “Masaa Gadu bun! Masaa Gadu bun! A deesi mi!”
eng_text: And one of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, and with a loud voice glorified God,

djk_text: Ne a lon go kai sutu kini a Masaa Jesesi fesi, fu soi en lesipeki. Ne a gi Masaa Jesesi daa fu a bun di a du gi en. A man ya, na be wan sama fu Samaliya.
eng_text: And fell down on his face at his feet, giving him thanks: and he was a Samaritan.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi akisi en taki: “Tan! Man, a ná ala den tin man kon bun, no? Da san meke na yu wawan daai kon gi Masaa Gadu daa? Pe den taa neigin de?
eng_text: And Jesus answering said, Were there not ten cleansed? but where are the nine?

djk_text: Ná wan fu den daai kon gi Masaa Gadu daa, no? Na a taa kondee sama ya, di á de wan Islayeli sama, ne en wawan daai kon gi Masaa Gadu daa?”
eng_text: There are not found that returned to give glory to God, save this stranger.

djk_text: Ne a taigi a man taki: “Man! Opo waka gwe fi i. A biibi di yu abi deesi yu kaba.”
eng_text: And he said unto him, Arise, go thy way: thy faith hath made thee whole.

djk_text: Ne wan dei, ne den Faliseiman kon a Masaa Jesesi, ne den akisi en taki: “On ten a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu o doo goontapu?” Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “We, u aliki! A Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu ná o kon enke fa u denki de. Bika, a nái kon a wan fasi fu sama sa si anga ain.
eng_text: And when he was demanded of the Pharisees, when the kingdom of God should come, he answered them and said, The kingdom of God cometh not with observation:

djk_text: A ná o kon sowan fasi fi i sa taki, luku en ya ofu luku en so. Bika a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu de a ini a ati fu den sama di e waka ne en baka.”
eng_text: Neither shall they say, Lo here! or, lo there! for, behold, the kingdom of God is within you.

djk_text: Ne a taigi den bakaman fi en taki: “Wan ten o kon, di u o angii fu si wan fu den dei, di a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya, o sidon enke kownu, fu taki na ala sani tapu. Ma u ná o poi si en nownow ya ete.
eng_text: And he said unto the disciples, The days will come, when ye shall desire to see one of the days of the Son of man, and ye shall not see it.

djk_text: U o yee taki, mi de ya efu mi de so, ma u á mu go luku. U á waka a den baka.
eng_text: And they shall say to you, See here; or, see there: go not after them, nor follow them.

djk_text: Bika, te a dei di a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya, o daai kon baka, da a o de leti enke, te tapu koti faya kiin, te doo goontapu ya.
eng_text: For as the lightning, that lighteneth out of the one part under heaven, shineth unto the other part under heaven; so shall also the Son of man be in his day.

djk_text: Ma fosi en daai kon baka a goontapu so, da en o tyai sitaafu anga pen fosi. Den libisama di nái biibi a Masaa Gadu o poti en a wanse. Den ná o de a mi du seefi.
eng_text: But first must he suffer many things, and be rejected of this generation.

djk_text: “Da, te a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya o daai kon baka, da den sama sa e libi leti enke fa den sama be e libi na a ten fu Nowa.
eng_text: And as it was in the days of Noe, so shall it be also in the days of the Son of man.

djk_text: Bika, na a ten fu Nowa, da den be e nyan e diingi. Man be e teke uman e libi, uman be e teke man e libi. Na so den be e libi, te enke a dei di Nowa go a ini a sipi tapu en doo. Ne a gaan wataa kon kii ala den fiya puu a goontapu.”
eng_text: They did eat, they drank, they married wives, they were given in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark, and the flood came, and destroyed them all.

djk_text: Ne a taigi den go doo taki: “Da na soseefi a o miti den sama fu a ten ya, leti enke fa a be miti den sama na a ten fu Lot. Na a ten fu Lot, da den sama be e nyan e diingi. Bai sani seli baka. Koti gaan goon paandi, fu meke tyaipi nyanyan. Soseefi den be e meke gaan osu.
eng_text: Likewise also as it was in the days of Lot; they did eat, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they builded;

djk_text: Na so den be e libi te enke a dei di Lot komoto a Sowdom, a kondee pe a be e tan. Na a seefi dei de, faya komoto a tapu kai kon boon ala den sama fu Sowdom kii puu de.
eng_text: But the same day that Lot went out of Sodom it rained fire and brimstone from heaven, and destroyed them all.

djk_text: “Da na soseefi libisama o go e du den sani fu den, te a Manpikin di kon saka toon libisama ya sa daai kon baka, fu ala libisama si.”
eng_text: Even thus shall it be in the day when the Son of man is revealed.

djk_text: Ne a taigi den go doo taki: “Da na a ten de, da efu wan sama de ne en baikon, da a á mu lasi ten fu go a ini en osu go teke sani. Soseefi, efu wan sama de ne en goon e wooko, a á mu suku fu go a ganda, fu go teke sani ne en osu.
eng_text: In that day, he which shall be upon the housetop, and his stuff in the house, let him not come down to take it away: and he that is in the field, let him likewise not return back.

djk_text: U pakisei san be pasa anga a uman fu Lot, fu san mi e taigi u ya.
eng_text: Remember Lot's wife.

djk_text: Bika sama di e feti, fu kibii en libi sa lasi en libi. Ma sama di ná abi toobi fu lasi en libi fu mi ede sa fende a libi fu tego.”
eng_text: Whosoever shall seek to save his life shall lose it; and whosoever shall lose his life shall preserve it.

djk_text: Ne a taki go doo taki: “Da tu sama o de a wan kama tapu, da Masaa Gadu o teke wan tyai gwe, da a o fika wan a baka.
eng_text: I tell you, in that night there shall be two men in one bed; the one shall be taken, and the other shall be left.

djk_text: Tu sama o de a ini wan osu e wooko, da Masaa Gadu o teke wan fu den tyai gwe, da a o fika a taawan.
eng_text: Two women shall be grinding together; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

djk_text: Soseefi, tu manengee o de a ini goon e wooko, da Masaa Gadu o teke wan fu den tyai gwe, ma a o fika a taawan baka.”
eng_text: Two men shall be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

djk_text: We, di Masaa Jesesi taigi den bakaman fi en ala den sani ya, ne den akisi en taki: “Masaa! On se fu goontapu a sani ya o pasa?” Ne Masaa Jesesi koti wan nongo gi den taki: “Na pe wan meti dede fika, na ape tingi foo e kon.”
eng_text: And they answered and said unto him, Where, Lord? And he said unto them, Wheresoever the body is, thither will the eagles be gathered together.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi gi den bakaman fi en wan ageisi toli, fu soi den taki, den á mu kon weli fu begi.
eng_text: And he spake a parable unto them to this end, that men ought always to pray, and not to faint;

djk_text: A taki: “Wan kuutu bakaa be de a wan kondee. Da a man ya be ogii te, a á be e teli Masaa Gadu. Soseefi a á be abi toobi anga libisama tu.
eng_text: Saying, There was in a city a judge, which feared not God, neither regarded man:

djk_text: Da wan pooti uman di man dede fika a ganda, be de na a kondee de tu. A uman ya be e kon na a kuutu bakaa naamo alaten, fu a kuutu wan kuutu fu gi enmi en leti. Bika wan sama be du wan ogii anga en.
eng_text: And there was a widow in that city; and she came unto him, saying, Avenge me of mine adversary.

djk_text: Da bigin bigin di a uman be e go ne en, da a á be wani yeepi en. Ma di a uman ya tan e go ne en naamo, ne a taki: ‘I sabi san? Anga ala fa mi nái teli Masaa Gadu, soseefi mi ná abi toobi anga libisama, toku mi o yeepi a uman ya. Bika ai kon e kaakeli mi namo. Da mi o yeepi en kuutu a kuutu, fu gi en en leti meke a sani kaba. Da mi ede sa boo. We, bika efu mi á yeepi en, da mi ede ná o abi boo. So, meke mi yeepi en.’ ”
eng_text: And he would not for a while: but afterward he said within himself, Though I fear not God, nor regard man;

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “We, efu a takuu ati kuutu bakaa ya, di nái teli Masaa Gadu anga di ná abi toobi anga libisama sabi fu taki so wan sani, fu yeepi a uman ya,
eng_text: And the Lord said, Hear what the unjust judge saith.

djk_text: da fa fu Masaa Gadu di abi bun ati? Efu den pikin fi en e begi en wan sani dei anga neti, a o daai daai fosi a gi den en? Nono! A ná o daai daai.
eng_text: And shall not God avenge his own elect, which cry day and night unto him, though he bear long with them?

djk_text: A o kon esi esi, kon gi den san den e begi en. Ma a de wan taa sani, efu te a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya o daai kon baka a goontapu, efu a o fende biibi a libisama.”
eng_text: I tell you that he will avenge them speedily. Nevertheless when the Son of man cometh, shall he find faith on the earth?

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi gi den ete wan ageisi toli fu den sama di e wisiwasi taawan, e naki boo fu ati, enke den bun moo taawan.
eng_text: And he spake this parable unto certain which trusted in themselves that they were righteous, and despised others:

djk_text: A taki: “Wan dei, ne tu man be go na a Mama Keliki fu go begi. Da wan fu den man ya na wan Faliseiman. Da a taawan na wan man di e piki lantimoni.
eng_text: Two men went up into the temple to pray; the one a Pharisee, and the other a publican.

djk_text: Ne di den doo, ne a Faliseiman waka go te a fesi, ne a kaka ede luku tapu. Ne a begi taki: ‘Masaa Gadu! Gaantangi fi i taki, mi á de enke den takuu ati sama, den fufuuman, den sama di ná abi toobi anga libisama, den sama di e teke taa sama uman ofu a man di e piki lantimoni de.
eng_text: The Pharisee stood and prayed thus with himself, God, I thank thee, that I am not as other men are, extortioners, unjust, adulterers, or even as this publican.

djk_text: Ibii wiki, na tu toon mi e de sondee nyan fu begi yu. Da ala san mi fende mi e paati en, da mi tyai fi i se kon gi yu enke fa a weiti taki. Da na so a de.’
eng_text: I fast twice in the week, I give tithes of all that I possess.

djk_text: “Ma a man di be e piki lantimoni be fika taampu, te a bakase a ini a keliki osu. Ne a bendi fesi a doti. Bika a á be bun a Masaa Gadu ain seefi. Ne a oli en boo fu ati, ne a begi taki: ‘Kee, Masaa Gadu, mi Tata! Abi tyali ati fu mi, baa? Bika, mi na wan gaan takuu ati sama, tuu. Da gaantangi yeepi mi, baa?’ ”
eng_text: And the publican, standing afar off, would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven, but smote upon his breast, saying, God be merciful to me a sinner.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “U oli a sani ya bun a ede. Fa a man di e piki lantimoni e go a osu de, Masaa Gadu gi en paadon fu ala den takuudu anga ogii di a be abi. Ma Masaa Gadu fika a Faliseiman a go fi en a osu. Bika iniiwan sama di e hei enseefi, Masaa Gadu o booko en saka. Ma ibiiwan sama di e saka enseefi, da Masaa Gadu o hei en.”
eng_text: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other: for every one that exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.

djk_text: Da wan dei, ne den tyai den pikin kon a Masaa Jesesi. Den be wani meke Masaa Jesesi be poti ana a den tapu begi gi den. Ma den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi bali den taki: “Nono! U daai baka. U á tyai den pikin de kon a Masaa Jesesi!”
eng_text: And they brought unto him also infants, that he would touch them: but when his disciples saw it, they rebuked them.

djk_text: Ma, namo Masaa Jesesi si di den bakaman fi en tapu den sama, fu den á tyai den pikin kon ne en. Ne a bali den taki: “U fika den pikin, meke denseefi kon doo a mi tu. U á tapu den! Bika na sama di abi a fasi di pikinengee abi sa poi go doo a ini a Nyun Tii a Masaa Gadu Kondee.
eng_text: But Jesus called them unto him, and said, Suffer little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.

djk_text: Da a de so taki, efu wan sama nái biibi Masaa Gadu enke fa wan pikinengee e biibi sani, da a ná o poi doo a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child shall in no wise enter therein.

djk_text: Namo, ne bakadati, ne wan bigiman fu den Dyu kon ne en. Ne a akisi en taki: “Mi bun Masaa! San mi mu du, fu fende a libi fu tego?”
eng_text: And a certain ruler asked him, saying, Good Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi akisi en taki: “Saide meke yu e kai mi bun Masaa? I sabi san yu e taki, di yu e kai mi, bun Masaa? Bunbun ati sama á de boiti Masaa Gadu wawan.
eng_text: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? none is good, save one, that is, God.

djk_text: Da yu á sabi san i mu du fi i fende a libi fu tego ete, no? We, fi i mu fende a libi fu tego: ‘Da i á mu waka anga taa uman ofu man, boiti di fi yu! I á mu kii! Soseefi i sabi taki, i á mu fufuu! I á mu lei. I mu lesipeki i mma anga i dda!’ ”
eng_text: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Honour thy father and thy mother.

djk_text: Ne a man piki Masaa Jesesi taki: “We, Masaa! Senten mi de pikinengee mi e oli ala den weiti de, te enke tide.”
eng_text: And he said, All these have I kept from my youth up.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi en baka taki: “Dati na tuu! Ma wan sani de ete di i mu du. Go a osu, da seli ala san yu abi. Da paati a moni gi den pootiman. Da kon baka, fu toon wan bakaman fu mi. Da yu o fende moo gaan gudu a Masaa Gadu a tapu, a bakaten.”
eng_text: Now when Jesus heard these things, he said unto him, Yet lackest thou one thing: sell all that thou hast, and distribute unto the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, follow me.

djk_text: Ne di Masaa Jesesi taigi en a sani ya, ne gaan tyali kisi a man te, a fika fu a poti ana a mindii ede bali kee. Bika a be gudu tuutuu.
eng_text: And when he heard this, he was very sorrowful: for he was very rich.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi daai, ne a taigi den bakaman fi en taki: “U si fa a taanga gi wan guduman fu go doo a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu?
eng_text: And when Jesus saw that he was very sorrowful, he said, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!

djk_text: A taanga gi wan kameili fu waka pasa a wan nanai olo. Ma mi e taigi u taki, a moo taanga gi wan guduman fu saka enseefi, fu pasa go a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: For it is easier for a camel to go through a needle's eye, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

djk_text: Ne di Masaa Jesesi taki so, ne den akisi en taki: “Da efu a guduman ya á poi go a Masaa Gadu, da sama o poi go seefi?”
eng_text: And they that heard it said, Who then can be saved?

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi luku den, ne a piki den taki: “Efu u luku a libisama fasi, da sani de di á poi pasa. Ma san á poi pasa libisama fasi, na dati Masaa Gadu poi du.”
eng_text: And he said, The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.

djk_text: Ne Peitilisi piki taki: “We, Masaa wi, no? U fika ala sani, fu kon waka a yu baka, e go anga yu na ala peesi!”
eng_text: Then Peter said, Lo, we have left all, and followed thee.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Iniiwan sama di lobi mi te, a fika en osu, ofu en uman ofu en baala ofu en dda anga en mma ofu pikin, fu go paati a Bun Nyunsu di e taki, fu a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu,
eng_text: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or parents, or brethren, or wife, or children, for the kingdom of God's sake,

djk_text: da, nownow, a goontapu ya, den o fende onmen tenti toon fu den sani di den fika, fu kon waka a mi baka. Soseefi bakaten, den o fende a libi fu tego a Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: Who shall not receive manifold more in this present time, and in the world to come life everlasting.

djk_text: Ne bakadati, ne Masaa Jesesi kai den twalufu bakaman fi en go a wanse, fu taigi den san o pasa anga en. Ne a taigi den taki: “U si fa wi e go a Jelusalem ya, ala den sani di apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu be taki fu a Manpikin di kon saka toon libisama ya o kon pasa tuu.
eng_text: Then he took unto him the twelve, and said unto them, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem, and all things that are written by the prophets concerning the Son of man shall be accomplished.

djk_text: Den Faliseiman anga den leliman fu Dyuweiti anga den gaansama fu Islayeli Kondee o kisi mi, da den o tyai mi go gi den doose kondee sama di e taki fu Islayeli, fu den kii. Da den sama de o poti mi a sipowtu, e lafu mi poti mi wisiwasi, e kosi mi. Soseefi den o towe wataa mofu a mi mindii fesi.
eng_text: For he shall be delivered unto the Gentiles, and shall be mocked, and spitefully entreated, and spitted on:

djk_text: Den o wipi mi wan mesaandi fasi fosi, da den o tyai mi go kii. Ma baka dii dei, da mi o weki baka komoto a dede.”
eng_text: And they shall scourge him, and put him to death: and the third day he shall rise again.

djk_text: Ma anga ala fa Masaa Jesesi taigi den de seefi, toku den á fusutan en pikinso seefi san a wani taki. Bika a de wan kibii toli gi den.
eng_text: And they understood none of these things: and this saying was hid from them, neither knew they the things which were spoken.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en e go, te den koosube fu a kondee di den e kai Jelikow. Da wan beendiman be sidon a sikin pasi e begi moni.
eng_text: And it came to pass, that as he was come nigh unto Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the way side begging:

djk_text: Da di a yee den somen sama e takitaki e kon, ne a akisi taki: “San na a somen takitaki di mi e yee e kon anda?”
eng_text: And hearing the multitude pass by, he asked what it meant.

djk_text: Ne den taigi en taki: “Na Jesesi fu Nasaleti e kon pasa ya.”
eng_text: And they told him, that Jesus of Nazareth passeth by.

djk_text: Ne ai bali taki: “Masaa Jesesi! Masaa Jesesi! Gaantangi, abi tyali ati fu mi, da yeepi mi, baa! Bika, na yu na a Bakaten Manpikin fu Kownu Dafeti paansu.”
eng_text: And he cried, saying, Jesus, thou Son of David, have mercy on me.

djk_text: Da di ai bali so, ne den sama di be e waka a fesi fu a gaan kulu bali en taki: “Man! Tapu mofu de!” Ma pe fu dati, ne ai bali moo taanga taki: “Bakaten Manpikin fu Kownu Dafeti paansu! Gaantangi, yeepi mi, baa?”
eng_text: And they which went before rebuked him, that he should hold his peace: but he cried so much the more, Thou Son of David, have mercy on me.

djk_text: Ne di Masaa Jesesi seefi yee a bali, ne a taampu. Ne a taigi den sama taki, meke den go teke a man tyai kon gi en. Ne den go teke a man tyai kon a Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: And Jesus stood, and commanded him to be brought unto him: and when he was come near, he asked him,

djk_text: Ne di a kon, ne Masaa Jesesi akisi en taki: “Man! San meke yu e bali kai mi so? San i wani mi du gi yu?” Ne a man piki Masaa Jesesi taki: “Masaa! Mi wani i yeepi mi deesi mi ain, fu mi sa si sani baka.”
eng_text: Saying, What wilt thou that I shall do unto thee? And he said, Lord, that I may receive my sight.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi en taki: “A bun! Si bun baka! Bika a biibi di i poti a Masaa Gadu yeepi yu.”
eng_text: And Jesus said unto him, Receive thy sight: thy faith hath saved thee.

djk_text: We, di Masaa Jesesi taki so, ne wanten a man ain kiin kelle, ne a bigin fu si sani bunbun baka. Ne ai waka a Masaa Jesesi baka, e gafa Masaa Gadu, fu a bun di a du gi en. Da ala den sama di si san pasa, e gafa Masaa Gadu tu.
eng_text: And immediately he received his sight, and followed him, glorifying God: and all the people, when they saw it, gave praise unto God.

djk_text: Ne bakadati, ne Masaa Jesesi waka go miti Jelikow Foto fu waka pasa go a Jelusalem.
eng_text: And Jesus entered and passed through Jericho.

djk_text: Da wan guduman den be e kai Sakeyosi be e tan a Jelikow Foto, a pe Masaa Jesesi be e waka pasa. Sakeyosi na be wan edeman fu den man di be e piki lantimoni. Da di Masaa Jesesi be e kon waka pasa, ne a be e feti fu a be sa si Masaa Jesesi. Ma a á be poi si en a ini den somen sama ini. Bika a be satu.
eng_text: And, behold, there was a man named Zacchaeus, which was the chief among the publicans, and he was rich.

djk_text: Ne a lon go a den sama fesi a pe den be o waka pasa. Ne a subi go a ini wan figasii bon fu a be sa si Masaa Jesesi, te a be o waka pasa de.
eng_text: And he ran before, and climbed up into a sycomore tree to see him: for he was to pass that way.

djk_text: Da di Masaa Jesesi e waka pasa, ne a opo ede luku tapu, ne a si Sakeyosi a ini a bon. Ne a kai en ne en nen taki: “Sakeyosi! Saka kon a doti wanten. Bika tide mi mu kon a yu osu.”
eng_text: And when Jesus came to the place, he looked up, and saw him, and said unto him, Zacchaeus, make haste, and come down; for to day I must abide at thy house.

djk_text: Ne wanten wanten, ne Sakeyosi saka komoto a ini a bon kon a doti. Ne a tyai Masaa Jesesi anga gaan poolo anga piisii go ne en osu.
eng_text: And he made haste, and came down, and received him joyfully.

djk_text: Ma a sani di Masaa Jesesi du ya á bun gi den taa sama seefi. Den ati boon. Bika den taki Masaa Jesesi go na a takuu ati man ya osu.
eng_text: And when they saw it, they all murmured, saying, That he was gone to be guest with a man that is a sinner.

djk_text: Ne Sakeyosi taampu a den sama fesi, ne a taigi Masaa Jesesi taki: “Masaa! Mi sa paati mi gudu a mindii, da mi gi den pootiman fu a kondee wan se. Da efu mi be akisi wan sama lantimoni ipi tumisi, da mi sa gi en fo toon moo ipi moo enke san mi be teke ne en.”
eng_text: And Zacchaeus stood, and said unto the Lord; Behold, Lord, the half of my goods I give to the poor; and if I have taken any thing from any man by false accusation, I restore him fourfold.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Masaa Gadu gi den sama fu a osu ya paadon tide, fu ala takuudu anga ogii. Mi be musu kon a Sakeyosi tide. Bika en na wan bakaten pikin fu wi avo gaansama Abalaham paansu tu. Sakeyosi be lasi pasi fu den sani di a be e du, ma fanafu tide a daai kon a Masaa Gadu baka.
eng_text: And Jesus said unto him, This day is salvation come to this house, forsomuch as he also is a son of Abraham.

djk_text: Bika a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya, kon fu suku den sowtu sama ya, di lasi Masaa Gadu pasi tyai kon a Masaa Gadu baka.”
eng_text: For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.

djk_text: Ma namo, da Masaa Jesesi be koosube anga Jelusalem Foto. Na dati meke somen sama di be e waka ne en baka fu go a Jelusalem be denki taki, a á be o langa moo fosi Masaa Gadu puu Islayeli a den feyanti fi en ondoo. Namo, ne a teke wan ageisi toli gi den, fu soi den taki, a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu ná o kon enke fa den e pakisei de.
eng_text: And as they heard these things, he added and spake a parable, because he was nigh to Jerusalem, and because they thought that the kingdom of God should immediately appear.

djk_text: A taki: “Wan sama fu wan bun famii be go a wan faawe kondee, fu den poti en toon kownu. Da te den poti en toon kownu kaba, da a be o daai go ne en kondee baka.
eng_text: He said therefore, A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom, and to return.

djk_text: Ne fosi a gwe, ne a kai tin fu den wookoman fi en kon. Ne den kon. Ne a gi iniiwan fu den wan miliyun kolu taki: ‘U teke a moni ya. Da u wooko anga en, meke a puu wini kon moo ipi, fu te mi o daai kon baka, fu mi fende wini fi en.’ Ne a basi gi den a moni, ne a gwe.
eng_text: And he called his ten servants, and delivered them ten pounds, and said unto them, Occupy till I come.

djk_text: Ma den sama fi en kondee be buuse en tee, den sende mofu gi den sama fu a taa kondee taki, den á wani meke a man toon kownu fu den kondee, fu taki fu den.
eng_text: But his citizens hated him, and sent a message after him, saying, We will not have this man to reign over us.

djk_text: “Ma toku den sama fu a taa kondee poti a man toon kownu. Ne di den poti en toon kownu, ne a daai gwe baka ne en kondee fu tii a kondee. Ne di a go, ne a sende kai den wookoman fi en di a be gi a moni fu wooko puu wini gi en. Ne den man kon. Ne kownu akisi den taki: ‘Man a moni di mi be fika gi u, fa u wooko anga en? Onmen wini u meke a tapu?’
eng_text: And it came to pass, that when he was returned, having received the kingdom, then he commanded these servants to be called unto him, to whom he had given the money, that he might know how much every man had gained by trading.

djk_text: Ne a fosi man go a kownu, ne a taigi en taki: ‘Masaa, yu á si? Mi wooko anga a wan miliyun kolu di i be gi mi. Da a puu tin miliyun kolu wini. Da luku a moni fi i ya anga a wini di a puu.’
eng_text: Then came the first, saying, Lord, thy pound hath gained ten pounds.

djk_text: Ne a masaa fi en taki: ‘Moi so! I wooko bun. Fu di i wooko sowan bun fasi anga a pikin sani ya, meke mi e gi yu moo ipi. Mi o meke i toon edeman fu tin kondee.’
eng_text: And he said unto him, Well, thou good servant: because thou hast been faithful in a very little, have thou authority over ten cities.

djk_text: “Ne di fu tu kon na a masaa. Ne a taigi a masaa taki: ‘Masaa! Luku a wan miliyun kolu fi i ya. Mi wooko anga en. Da a puu feifi miliyun kolu wini. Da luku a moni ya anga a wini di a puu.’
eng_text: And the second came, saying, Lord, thy pound hath gained five pounds.

djk_text: Ne a masaa taki: ‘We, a bun! Fu di i wooko so moi, meke mi o poti i toon edeman fu feifi kondee.’
eng_text: And he said likewise to him, Be thou also over five cities.

djk_text: “Ma a man di fu meke dii kon na a masaa, ne a gi en a moni leti enke fa a be gi enmi en baka. Ne a taigi a masaa taki: ‘Masaa! Luku a moni fi i ya. Mi ná oli en seefi puu a ini. Da a de leti enke fa i be gi mi en. Bika mi sabi taki, i libi taanga, i muliki. Yu e teke sani pe yu á poti. Da yu e koti sani a pe yu á paandi. Da den manii fi i ya mi feele, meke mi lolo en a ini wan duku poti a wanse, fu te i be kon, fu mi be sa gi yu en baka. Da yu á si, luku a moni fi i ya!’
eng_text: And another came, saying, Lord, behold, here is thy pound, which I have kept laid up in a napkin:

djk_text: “Ne a kownu piki en taki: ‘Oo! Na so mi libi taanga? We now, yu o si fa mi libi taanga. Yu na wan wisiwasi kaba a soso wookoman.
eng_text: And he saith unto him, Out of thine own mouth will I judge thee, thou wicked servant. Thou knewest that I was an austere man, taking up that I laid not down, and reaping that I did not sow:

djk_text: Di i sabi taki mi libi taanga so, mi e teke sani a pe mi á poti. Mi e koti sani a pe mi á paandi. Da saide meke yu á be poti a moni fu mi a banku, fu te mi be kon, fu a goo kon moo ipi?’
eng_text: Wherefore then gavest not thou my money into the bank, that at my coming I might have required mine own with usury?

djk_text: Ne a taigi den taa sama di taampu de taki: ‘U puu a moni ne en ana wanten gi a man di abi tin miliyun kolu kaba. Meke a fika anga soso ana!’ ”
eng_text: And he said unto them that stood by, Take from him the pound, and give it to him that hath ten pounds.

djk_text: Ne den taigi en taki: “We, Masaa! A man de abi ipi kaba, bika na tin miliyun a abi.”
eng_text: (And they said unto him, Lord, he hath ten pounds.)

djk_text: Ne a masaa taki: “Mi sabi dati. Ma na so a de kaba. A sama di abi ipi, o fende moo ipi a tapu fu san di a abi kaba. Ma sama di ná abi, a pikinso di a abi seefi den o puu ne en ana gi taa sama, fika en anga soso ana.
eng_text: For I say unto you, That unto every one which hath shall be given; and from him that hath not, even that he hath shall be taken away from him.

djk_text: Da u tyai ala den sama di á be wani mi toon kownu fu taki gi den kon, da u kii den leti a mi fesi ya.”
eng_text: But those mine enemies, which would not that I should reign over them, bring hither, and slay them before me.

djk_text: Da bakadati, ne Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en waka go doo a Jelusalem.
eng_text: And when he had thus spoken, he went before, ascending up to Jerusalem.

djk_text: Da di den doo koosube fu a Oleifi Mongo na a pisi fu Betifage anga Betaniya, ne Masaa Jesesi taigi tu bakaman fi en taki:
eng_text: And it came to pass, when he was come nigh to Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount called the mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples,

djk_text: “U go na a kondee a u fesi so. Da te u go, da u o si wan pikin buliki teitei. Ná wan sama sidon na a buliki ya tapu lei ete. Da u losi en tyai kon gi mi.
eng_text: Saying, Go ye into the village over against you; in the which at your entering ye shall find a colt tied, whereon yet never man sat: loose him, and bring him hither.

djk_text: Da kande sama o akisi fu saide meke u e teke en. Da u mu taigi den taki: ‘Masaa abi en fanowdu!’ ”
eng_text: And if any man ask you, Why do ye loose him? thus shall ye say unto him, Because the Lord hath need of him.

djk_text: Ne den tu bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi go enke fa a sende den. Ne den si ala sani enke fa a be taigi den.
eng_text: And they that were sent went their way, and found even as he had said unto them.

djk_text: Ne den go fu losi en. Namo, den sama di abi a buliki, si di den e losi en. Ne den bali akisi den taki: “San e pasa? Pe u e go anga en?”
eng_text: And as they were loosing the colt, the owners thereof said unto them, Why loose ye the colt?

djk_text: Ne den tu man piki den taki: “Nono! A ná fu wi. Ma na Masaa abi en fanowdu.” Ne den sama taki: “A bun! U sa tyai en go.” Da na so den tyai a pikin buliki go gi Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: And they said, The Lord hath need of him.

djk_text: Ne den waka, te den go doo anga en. Ne den baala koosi na a buliki mindii baka. Ne Masaa Jesesi go sidon na a buliki tapu.
eng_text: And they brought him to Jesus: and they cast their garments upon the colt, and they set Jesus thereon.

djk_text: Ne den bigin fu waka go a Jelusalem. Ne somen sama baala koosi na a gaan pasi mindii a doti, fu Masaa Jesesi lei pasa anga a buliki.
eng_text: And as he went, they spread their clothes in the way.

djk_text: Da di den doo koosube fu subi a mongo, ne den sama di be e waka ne en baka e piisii te, den e bali baaya e singi, e gafa Masaa Gadu, fu den gaan foondoo sani di den si Masaa Jesesi du a goontapu.
eng_text: And when he was come nigh, even now at the descent of the mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works that they had seen;

djk_text: Den e singi taki: “Seigi fu a Kownu di e kon a ini a nen fu Masaa. I poti ati switi makandii a tapu anda! I mu kisi gaandi, te doo na a moo hei peesi a tapu anda!”
eng_text: Saying, Blessed be the King that cometh in the name of the Lord: peace in heaven, and glory in the highest.

djk_text: Ma di den Faliseiman yee fa den sama e bali e singi, e opo Masaa Jesesi, ne a sani á bun gi den. Ne den taigi Masaa Jesesi taki: “Mesiti! Bali den sama fi i, meke den tapu den mofu de.”
eng_text: And some of the Pharisees from among the multitude said unto him, Master, rebuke thy disciples.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “U aliki mi bun! Efu den sama ya tapu den mofu, da den siton di de a sikin pasi o bali a den sama ya peesi. Bika a bali ya musu fu bali.”
eng_text: And he answered and said unto them, I tell you that, if these should hold their peace, the stones would immediately cry out.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi go te a koosube fu Jelusalem. Ne a opo ede luku a kondee. Ne tyali fu a kondee kisi en te a bali kee.
eng_text: And when he was come near, he beheld the city, and wept over it,

djk_text: Ne a taki: “Oho! Sama fu Jelusalem! Efu u be sabi san di be sa yeepi u na a yuu ya, fu u be fende boo, da u á be o libi so. Ma nownow a lati gi u kaba.
eng_text: Saying, If thou hadst known, even thou, at least in this thy day, the things which belong unto thy peace! but now they are hid from thine eyes.

djk_text: Wanlo ogii dei de a fesi e kon, di den feyanti fu u o kon lontu a kondee fu u, poti a dyali. Da u o fika na a kondee ganda de. Ná wan fu u o fende pasi komoto a ini a kondee kon a doo.
eng_text: For the days shall come upon thee, that thine enemies shall cast a trench about thee, and compass thee round, and keep thee in on every side,

djk_text: Da na ape u o de e pina, e sitaafu fu te den kii u anga ala den pikin fu u fiya. Ala den osu di u si meke anga siton de, den o booko te a doti petee. Bika Masaa Gadu be gi u a okasi fu u teke a yeepi di a wani yeepi u, ma kweti u á teke en. U meke a pasa gwe.”
eng_text: And shall lay thee even with the ground, and thy children within thee; and they shall not leave in thee one stone upon another; because thou knewest not the time of thy visitation.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi go a ini a Mama Keliki fu den Dyu. Ne di a go a ini, ne a yaki den sama di e seli sani poti a doo.
eng_text: And he went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold therein, and them that bought;

djk_text: Ne a taigi den: “Masaa Gadu Buku sikiifi taki: ‘A osu fu Masaa Gadu mu de wan osu pe sama e kon makandii, fu begi.’ Ma san u e meke Gadu osu toon? U e meke a toon wan osu fu fufuuman.”
eng_text: Saying unto them, It is written, My house is the house of prayer: but ye have made it a den of thieves.

djk_text: Da, ala dei Masaa Jesesi be e de a ini a Mama Keliki e leli sama Masaa Gadu wowtu. Da den moo hei begiman anga den leliman fu Dyuweiti anga den gaansama fu Islayeli Kondee be e suku namo, fu fende wan fasi fu kii en puu a pasi.
eng_text: And he taught daily in the temple. But the chief priests and the scribes and the chief of the people sought to destroy him,

djk_text: Ma den á sabi fa fu den du fu kii en. Bika ala sama be lobi e go ne en, go e aliki Masaa Gadu wowtu.
eng_text: And could not find what they might do: for all the people were very attentive to hear him.

djk_text: Da wan dei, da Masaa Jesesi be de a ini a Mama Keliki e leli den sama Masaa Gadu wowtu, e gi den a Bun Nyunsu. Ne den leliman fu Dyuweiti anga den moo hei begiman anga gaansama fu kondee kon ne en.
eng_text: And it came to pass, that on one of those days, as he taught the people in the temple, and preached the gospel, the chief priests and the scribes came upon him with the elders,

djk_text: Ne den akisi en taki: “Fa yu e du den sani sani ya, sama sende yu seefi? Sama gi yu pasi fu du den?”
eng_text: And spake unto him, saying, Tell us, by what authority doest thou these things? or who is he that gave thee this authority?

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “A bun, mi yee san u akisi mi. Ma miseefi wani akisi u wan sani, fosi mi piki u. Da efu u piki mi, da mi sa taigi u tu, sama gi mi pasi fu du den sani di mi e du.”
eng_text: And he answered and said unto them, I will also ask you one thing; and answer me:

djk_text: Ne a akisi den taki: “U taigi mi! Johanisi a Dopuman, na Masaa Gadu be sende en fu dopu sama, ofu na libisama be sende en?”
eng_text: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men?

djk_text: Ne den daai luku denseefi san fu den piki. Ne den bende a se. Ne den taki saafi anga denseefi taki: “Efu u piki taki: ‘Na Gadu be sende en,’ da a o akisi u taki: ‘Saide meke u á be wani biibi en?’
eng_text: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then believed ye him not?

djk_text: Ma efu u piki en tu taki: ‘Na libisama be sende en,’ da den sama fu a kondee o naki wi kii anga siton. Bika den sama be teke Johanisi enke wan apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: But and if we say, Of men; all the people will stone us: for they be persuaded that John was a prophet.

djk_text: A dati meke den piki taki: “Wi á sabi sama be gi Johanisi pasi fu du den sani de.”
eng_text: And they answered, that they could not tell whence it was.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “We, da mi ná o taigi u tu, sama gi mi pasi fu du den sani ya.”
eng_text: And Jesus said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi gi den ete wan ageisi toli taki: “Wan sama koti wan gaan goon fi en. Ne di a kaba koti en, ne a paandi en, te a kaba anga wan sii den e kai doloifi. Di a kaba paandi a goon, ne a yuu en gi taa paandi goonman.
eng_text: Then began he to speak to the people this parable; A certain man planted a vineyard, and let it forth to husbandmen, and went into a far country for a long time.

djk_text: Bika a be o gwe a taa kondee fu onmen yali. Ne a de anda te, di den doloifi lepi, ne a sende wan wookoman fi en, fu go fu den gi en afu fu a doloifi, fu a tyai kon gi en. Ma di a wookoman go, ne den man kisi en, ne den fonmi en te a fon, ne den sende en gwe anga soso ana ne en basi baka.
eng_text: And at the season he sent a servant to the husbandmen, that they should give him of the fruit of the vineyard: but the husbandmen beat him, and sent him away empty.

djk_text: Ne a goonman sende wan taa wookoman go. Ma disi yaaso, na a seefi. Den fonmi en te a fon, kosi en te a kosi, ne den sende en gwe baka ne en basi anga soso ana.
eng_text: And again he sent another servant: and they beat him also, and entreated him shamefully, and sent him away empty.

djk_text: Ne a masaa fu a goon sende ete wan wookoman fi en go, di fu meke dii. Ma disi moo ogii. Den fonmi en koti en hii sikin, ne den yaki en puu de sende gwe.
eng_text: And again he sent a third: and they wounded him also, and cast him out.

djk_text: “Ne a masaa fu a goon taki a ini enseefi taki: ‘San mi mu du moo? We, mi o sende awan kodo lobi manpikin fu mi go. Bika disi na mi manpikin, da den musu abi lesipeki fi en.’
eng_text: Then said the lord of the vineyard, What shall I do? I will send my beloved son: it may be they will reverence him when they see him.

djk_text: “Ma di den si a manpikin fu a masaa e kon, ne den pakisei taki: ‘A ná a pikin fu a masaa di yuu a goon gi u e kon de, no? Ne en ai! Meke u kii en, bika te a masaa ná o de moo, da na a manpikin ya, a o fika a goon gi. Ma efu u kii en, da a goon o kon toon fu wi.’
eng_text: But when the husbandmen saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, This is the heir: come, let us kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.

djk_text: Ne di a manpikin kon doo, ne den kisi en, ne den iti en puu a ini a goon, ne den naki en kii.”
eng_text: So they cast him out of the vineyard, and killed him. What therefore shall the lord of the vineyard do unto them?

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi akisi den taki: “San u denki a basi fu a goon o du di a o yee taki, den kii a manpikin fi en tu? Enseefi o go luku en goon, no? Ne enseefi o go! Da a o kii ala den yuuman fu a goon, da a yuu a goon gi taa sama.” Ne den sama bali taki: “Nono! Noiti a sani ya mu pasa so!”
eng_text: He shall come and destroy these husbandmen, and shall give the vineyard to others. And when they heard it, they said, God forbid.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi luku den dunn, ne a taigi den taki: “We, a o pasa so tuu. Bika a sikiifi a Masaa Gadu Buku taki: ‘Disi na a siton di meseeman be oli fu wan soso sani. Na dati daai kon toon a siton futu fu a hii osu.’ ”
eng_text: And he beheld them, and said, What is this then that is written, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner?

djk_text: Ne a taigi den taki: “Da a sama di o kai na a siton ya tapu, o booko en sikin. Ma efu a siton seefi kai a i tapu, da a o masi yu fini fini.”
eng_text: Whosoever shall fall upon that stone shall be broken; but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.

djk_text: Da den hei apaiti begiman anga den leliman fu Dyuweiti fusutan kiinkiin taki, na den a poti na ageisi toli de so. Na dati meke den be e suku fu kisi en go sooto wanten. Ma den be feele den somen sama di be de ape. Na dati ede meke den fika en, ne den gwe.
eng_text: And the chief priests and the scribes the same hour sought to lay hands on him; and they feared the people: for they perceived that he had spoken this parable against them.

djk_text: Ma den e waki en namo on ten a o taki wan sani, fu den go kaagi en meke a Loma lanti sooto en. Na so den sende wantu sama go ne en. Da te den go, da den mu du enke den na bunbun sama. Da den mu suku en mofu, fu a taki sani fu den fende en go kaagi en na a Loma gaaman.
eng_text: And they watched him, and sent forth spies, which should feign themselves just men, that they might take hold of his words, that so they might deliver him unto the power and authority of the governor.

djk_text: Ne den go a Masaa Jesesi, ne den taigi en taki: “Mesiti! U sabi taki den sani di yu e taki na tuutuu sani. Yu na wan kiinkiin sama. Yu e soi libisama fa Masaa Gadu wani den libi. Yu ná abi toobi anga san libisama e taki.
eng_text: And they asked him, saying, Master, we know that thou sayest and teachest rightly, neither acceptest thou the person of any, but teachest the way of God truly:

djk_text: Ma u kon fu akisi yu wan sani. Taigi u, efu a de fanowdu fu u pai a moo gaan kownu a Loma Foto, a lantimoni.”
eng_text: Is it lawful for us to give tribute unto Caesar, or no?

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi be sabi kaba taki, na suku den kon suku en mofu fu a taki sani fu den fende en kii. Ne a taigi den taki: “U tyai wan moni kon gi mi, osi?” Ne den tyai a moni kon gi en. Ne a akisi den taki: “Sama fesi anga nen de na a moni ya tapu?” Ne den piki taki: “Na a gaan kownu fu Loma fesi anga en nen de ne en tapu.”
eng_text: But he perceived their craftiness, and said unto them, Why tempt ye me?

djk_text: Ne a taigi den taki: “We, efu na a moo gaan kownu a Loma Foto fesi, anga en nen de ne en tapu, da na fu a gaan kownu de. Da gi a gaan kownu de san de fu a gaan kownu de. Ma u mu gi Masaa Gadu san na fu Gadu.”
eng_text: And he said unto them, Render therefore unto Caesar the things which be Caesar's, and unto God the things which be God's.

djk_text: Da a foondoo den fu a fasi fa Masaa Jesesi piki den. Den de pii. Den á sabi san fu piki en moo. A sani di den be kon fu du a puu ná wan wini gi den.
eng_text: And they could not take hold of his words before the people: and they marvelled at his answer, and held their peace.

djk_text: Ne bakadati, ne wantu sama fu a keliki kulu di den e kai Saduseiman kon a Masaa Jesesi. Den Saduseisama na sama di nái biibi taki te wan sama dede a sa weki baka.
eng_text: Then came to him certain of the Sadducees, which deny that there is any resurrection; and they asked him,

djk_text: Namo den taigi Masaa Jesesi taki: “We, Mesiti oo! Masaa Gadu be meke Mosesi sikiifi wan weiti gi wi taki: ‘Efu wan man libi anga wan uman, ne a dede sondee fu meke pikin anga a uman, da a baka baala fu a man mu libi anga a uman fu meke pikin gi a baala di dede, fu en nen á sa kaba a goontapu.’ Na so a weiti fu Mosesi e leli wi.
eng_text: Saying, Master, Moses wrote unto us, If any man's brother die, having a wife, and he die without children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.

djk_text: Ma namo, da seibin baala be de. A moo gaanwan libi anga wan uman te a dede, a á meke ná wankodo pikin anga a uman.
eng_text: There were therefore seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and died without children.

djk_text: Ne a pikin baala di waka ne en baka teke a uman libi. Ma enseefi dede, sondee fu meke wan pikin anga en.
eng_text: And the second took her to wife, and he died childless.

djk_text: Da na so ala den seibin baala libi anga a uman, te ala den dede. Ná wan di meke wankodo pikin anga en.
eng_text: And the third took her; and in like manner the seven also: and they left no children, and died.

djk_text: Ne, kaba kaba fu dati, ne a uman seefi dede tu. We, Masaa, u wani akisi yu disi. ‘Te a yuu o doo fu den dedesama opo komoto a dede, da on di fu den seibin baala ya o abi a uman? Bika ala den seibin baala be libi anga en.’ ”
eng_text: Last of all the woman died also.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “U á sabi san u e akisi. Bika na goontapu ya wawan uman anga man libi de.
eng_text: And Jesus answering said unto them, The children of this world marry, and are given in marriage:

djk_text: Uman anga man libi á de a Masaa Gadu Kondee anda. Bika den sama di de a Masaa Gadu a tapu anda, kon de enke den Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee . Den nái dede moo. Soseefi den nái libi anga uman anga man, fu meke pikin moo, fu fika paansu a baka. Bika den sama di de anda, na Masaa Gadu pikin. Da den dede weki kaba, fu libi tego anga Masaa Gadu. Da na den sama di Masaa Gadu si taki, fiti a libi fu tego, na den a o gi a libi de.
eng_text: But they which shall be accounted worthy to obtain that world, and the resurrection from the dead, neither marry, nor are given in marriage:

djk_text: Bika a sikiifi kiinkiin a den buku fu Mosesi taki, den dedesama o opo baka kon a libi ya. Bika, di a gi a toli fu a katuku, a taki: ‘Masaa na a Gadu fu Abalaham, Isaki anga Jakopu.’
eng_text: Now that the dead are raised, even Moses shewed at the bush, when he calleth the Lord the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.

djk_text: Masaa Gadu a ná wan Gadu fu dedesama, ma na wan Gadu fu sama di e libi.”
eng_text: For he is not a God of the dead, but of the living: for all live unto him.

djk_text: Ne wan leliman fu Dyuweiti dyombo piki en taki: “Mesiti, san di i taki de na tuu! Yu abi leti!”
eng_text: Then certain of the scribes answering said, Master, thou hast well said.

djk_text: Ne fanafu a ten de, ne ná wan sama abi deki ati moo fu akisi en sani.
eng_text: And after that they durst not ask him any question at all.

djk_text: Da, di Masaa Jesesi de a ini a Mama Keliki e leli den sama, te wan pisi, ne a akisi den sama taki: “Fa den leliman fu Dyuweiti sa leli u taki, a Kelestesi na Bakaten Manpikin fu Kownu Dafeti paansu namo, da a kaba?
eng_text: And he said unto them, How say they that Christ is David's son?

djk_text: We, na so a de tuu! Ma Dafeti seefi sikiifi wan sani a wan pisi fu Masaa Gadu Buku. A sikiifi taki: ‘Masaa Gadu taigi mi Masaa taki: “Sidon a mi leti ana se ya,
eng_text: And David himself saith in the book of Psalms, The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,

djk_text: te enke mi meke ala den feyanti fi yu toon yu futu bangi.” ’
eng_text: Till I make thine enemies thy footstool.

djk_text: Da efu Kelestesi na wan bakaten manpikin fu Kownu Dafeti paansu namo, da i denki taki, Kownu Dafeti be o kai en bakaten pikin, ‘Masaa?’ ”
eng_text: David therefore calleth him Lord, how is he then his son?

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi bali den bakaman fi en a den somen sama fesi taki:
eng_text: Then in the audience of all the people he said unto his disciples,

djk_text: “U mu luku bun anga den leliman fu Dyuweiti. Den lobi wei gaan moi langa dii yapon e waka e lontu kondee, fu sama mu si den. Da te den e waka a den wowoyo peesi, den lobi te den sama e gi den odi anga gaan lesipeki. Te den de a ini den Dyu keliki den lobi sidon, te a fesi enke bigiman. Soseefi den e suku a moo bun peesi, te den sidon a tafaa fu nyan. Na so den e poti denseefi enke bunbun sama kaba.
eng_text: Beware of the scribes, which desire to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the markets, and the highest seats in the synagogues, and the chief rooms at feasts;

djk_text: Ma u mu luku bun, fu u á teke a fasi fu den fu libi. Bika den e teke ala sani fu den pooti uman di man dede fika a ganda. Te anga den osu fu den uman ya seefi den e teke. Da anga a takuu ya, den e komoto e go e begi gaan langa begi, fu sama mu si fa den bunbun kisi. We, den sama ya o kisi a moo gaan sitaafu fu Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: Which devour widows' houses, and for a shew make long prayers: the same shall receive greater damnation.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi opo ede luku a baki di den sama e poti moni a keliki. Ne a si fa den guduman e poti moni a ini a baki.
eng_text: And he looked up, and saw the rich men casting their gifts into the treasury.

djk_text: Di den poti te wan pisi, ne Masaa Jesesi si wan pooti uman di á be abi man moo, poti tu kopoo sensi go a ini a baki.
eng_text: And he saw also a certain poor widow casting in thither two mites.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi luku a sani te a kaba, ne a taigi den bakaman fi en taki: “U si a pooti uman de? A poti tu kopoo sensi namo go a ini a baki, ma a poti ipi moo ala den taawan di poti.
eng_text: And he said, Of a truth I say unto you, that this poor widow hath cast in more than they all:

djk_text: Bika den guduman poti a sakasaka di den á be abi fanowdu. Ma a uman ya poti ala san a be abi fu nyan. A á kibii ná wan kopoo sensi fi enseefi.”
eng_text: For all these have of their abundance cast in unto the offerings of God: but she of her penury hath cast in all the living that she had.

djk_text: Da, di Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en komoto a ini a Mama Keliki, ne wantu fu den bakaman fi en taki: “Luku fa a Mama Keliki moi. Den siton di den meke en bigi. Da den tembee den siton sikin te a moi. Den wei den anga paiman di sama be pai Masaa Gadu de.”
eng_text: And as some spake of the temple, how it was adorned with goodly stones and gifts, he said,

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Weeno! Na so a de tuu. Ala den siton di u e si de, wanten o kon, di ná wan fu den siton ya o taampu a taawan tapu de moo. Ala den fiya o lulu paati paati.”
eng_text: As for these things which ye behold, the days will come, in the which there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.

djk_text: Ne den akisi en taki: “We, Masaa, na on ten a sani de o pasa? Da san na a maiki di wi o si taki, a yuu doo fu sowan sani pasa?”
eng_text: And they asked him, saying, Master, but when shall these things be? and what sign will there be when these things shall come to pass?

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “U mu luku bun anga useefi, fu sama á koli u kisi puu na a biibi. Bika somen sama o opo teke mi nen, fu e koli sama taki, na den na a Kelestesi, a Kownu di Masaa Gadu be paamisi goontapu. Da den o koli somen sama kisi. Taawan o kon taigi u taki, a ten doo kaba. Ma u á mu biibi san den o taigi u.
eng_text: And he said, Take heed that ye be not deceived: for many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and the time draweth near: go ye not therefore after them.

djk_text: Da, te u yee taki, gaan oloku feti e bali a peesi, da u á mu feele. U á mu buuya! Den sani ya musu fu pasa fosi. Ma te den sani ya e pasa, da u á mu si enke na a kaba fu goontapu doo kaba.
eng_text: But when ye shall hear of wars and commotions, be not terrified: for these things must first come to pass; but the end is not by and by.

djk_text: Bika u o yee taki, wan kondee kondee a goontapu o opo feti anga denseefi. Kownu kondee o opo feti anga denseefi.
eng_text: Then said he unto them, Nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom:

djk_text: Da doti o seke piiti kii sama a somen pisi fu goontapu. Da gaan angiiten o kon a goontapu tu. Soseefi takuu siki o kon a goontapu kon e kii ala sowtu sama. Gaansama anga pikinengee. Somen somen gaan takuu sani o pasa na ala se fu goontapu. Te a tapu a den woluku seefi gaan maiki o de fu si. Da den sani ya o meke ala sama feele.
eng_text: And great earthquakes shall be in divers places, and famines, and pestilences; and fearful sights and great signs shall there be from heaven.

djk_text: “Ma fosi ala den sani ya pasa, da den o lon a u baka, suku fu kii u. Den o kisi u tyai go a den keliki osu fu den, a kuutu. Somen fu u den o kisi sooto a dunguu osu. Soseefi den o kisi u tyai go a fesi fu den kownu anga den tiiman fu kondee, fu kuutu u fu di u e waka a mi baka.
eng_text: But before all these, they shall lay their hands on you, and persecute you, delivering you up to the synagogues, and into prisons, being brought before kings and rulers for my name's sake.

djk_text: Da u mu teke den okasi ya, fu taigi ala sama fu saide u e biibi a Bun Nyunsu fu mi.
eng_text: And it shall turn to you for a testimony.

djk_text: Ma, te den kisi u fu tyai go a kuutu, da u á mu booko u ede san u o taki.
eng_text: Settle it therefore in your hearts, not to meditate before what ye shall answer:

djk_text: Bika miseefi o gi u den leti taki fu u taki a yuu de. Mi o gi u fusutan, fu piki ala san den o akisi u. Da te u piki den te u kaba, da ná wan fu den di o fende wan sani fu taki moo.
eng_text: For I will give you a mouth and wisdom, which all your adversaries shall not be able to gainsay nor resist.

djk_text: Da u dda anga mma anga u baala anga u famii anga den mati fu u, o tyai o go seli gi den ogii ati sama fu kii. Da den o kii son wan fu u.
eng_text: And ye shall be betrayed both by parents, and brethren, and kinsfolks, and friends; and some of you shall they cause to be put to death.

djk_text: Soseefi ala sama o abi ogii ati fu u, fu di u de fu mi ede.
eng_text: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake.

djk_text: Ma u á feele. Bika sama di o tei ati fu oli doo, da ná wan uwii fi en ede sa lasi. Awinsi u dede seefi, toku u sa opo baka fende a libi fu tego a Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: But there shall not an hair of your head perish.

djk_text: Ne a taigi den go doo taki: “Te u si taki suudati fu taa kondee kon feti anga Jelusalem, lontu den poti a dyali, da u mu sabi taki, a ten doo fu den feti booko en kaba anga en a soso.
eng_text: And when ye shall see Jerusalem compassed with armies, then know that the desolation thereof is nigh.

djk_text: Da den sama di de a Judeja mu lon go kibii a den gaan mongo mindii. Den sama di de a kondee ganda mu lon komoto de. Den sama di de a ini goon e wooko, á mu daai go a kondee moo. Den mu lon.
eng_text: Then let them which are in Judaea flee to the mountains; and let them which are in the midst of it depart out; and let not them that are in the countries enter thereinto.

djk_text: Bika na a yuu de, da Masaa Gadu o sitaafu Jelusalem tuutuu, enke fa a be meke den apaiti takiman fi en be taki a fesi kaba.
eng_text: For these be the days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.

djk_text: “Da a ten de o takuu seefi gi den uman di de anga bee anga den uman di de anga pikin na ana. Bika na so wan gaan ibi sitaafu o kon na a kondee. Masaa Gadu o puu en atiboon a den tapu.
eng_text: But woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck, in those days! for there shall be great distress in the land, and wrath upon this people.

djk_text: Somen fu den sama den o kii anga fetihow. Da taawan den o kisi tyai go panya na ala se fu goontapu. Da den o teke Jelusalem fu den e du anga en enke fa den wani. Da den doose kondee sama o tan a Jelusalem, fu te a ten di Masaa Gadu be poti gi den doo, da a sa puu den de.”
eng_text: And they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led away captive into all nations: and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den go doo taki: “Da na a yuu de, te a gaan sitaafu anga pina pasa, da den sama o si gaan maiki a tapu, a den woluku, na a san anga a mun anga den sitali. Da a ze wataa fu goontapu ya o seke e meke balibali, te ala sama fu hii goontapu o feele gaan feele.
eng_text: And there shall be signs in the sun, and in the moon, and in the stars; and upon the earth distress of nations, with perplexity; the sea and the waves roaring;

djk_text: Da libisama o feele te, den ná o sabi fa fu du, fu di den e si dede a den fesi. Bika den á sabi san e kon a goontapu. Da tapu a den woluku o seke te, ala den sani a tapu anda seefi o seke.
eng_text: Men's hearts failing them for fear, and for looking after those things which are coming on the earth: for the powers of heaven shall be shaken.

djk_text: Da bakadati, da ala sama o si a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya e kon a tapu, a den woluku ini anga gaan taanga anga a dyendee fasi di e beenki.
eng_text: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.

djk_text: Da, te u si den sani ya bigin pasa, da u mu de sabi sabi taki, a yuu di den o puu u a ini a gaan pina de koosube.”
eng_text: And when these things begin to come to pass, then look up, and lift up your heads; for your redemption draweth nigh.

djk_text: Namo a teke wan ageisi toli gi den taki: “U denki wan figasii bon. Te u si taki, ai piiti boomiki, da u sabi kaba taki, a o meke nyanyan dyonson.
eng_text: And he spake to them a parable; Behold the fig tree, and all the trees;

djk_text: We, da na soseefi, te u si den sani di mi taigi u ya bigin e pasa, da u mu sabi taki, a yuu doo fu a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu kon a goontapu.
eng_text: So likewise ye, when ye see these things come to pass, know ye that the kingdom of God is nigh at hand.

djk_text: Da u fusutan mi bun. Te u si den sani ya e pasa, da u mu sabi taki, a kaba fu a yuu ten fu goontapu di u e libi de koosube. Da mi e taigi u taki, a paansu fu den sama ya, ná o kaba a goontapu fosi den sani ya pasa.
eng_text: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass away, till all be fulfilled.

djk_text: Tapu a den woluku anga a goontapu pe u de ya o lasi go kaba a soso, ma mi wowtu di mi taki, ná o lasi ná wan ten.”
eng_text: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.

djk_text: Ne a taki gi den baka taki: “U mu de kaba kaba fu miti mi. U á mu booko u ede anga solugu fu a goontapu ya. U á mu de a yayo libi, te u feegete taki mi o kon. U á mu de ape e duungu te, da a dei kon kisi u sondee fu u poti pakisei. Da u mu luku bun! Bika a dei ya o kon. Da winsi pe i de a o kisi yu namo.
eng_text: And take heed to yourselves, lest at any time your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting, and drunkenness, and cares of this life, and so that day come upon you unawares.

djk_text: A dati meke, u mu e begi Masaa Gadu naamo, fu a gi u kaakiti fu u oli a biibi go doo. U mu begi en fu a yeepi u, fu pasa ala den sani di mi kai de, sondee fu u lasi a biibi fu u. Da, te u oli a biibi doo, da u sa taampu na a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya, fesi.”
eng_text: Watch ye therefore, and pray always, that ye may be accounted worthy to escape all these things that shall come to pass, and to stand before the Son of man.

djk_text: Da na so Masaa Jesesi be e go na a Mama Keliki ala dei, go leli den sama Masaa Gadu wowtu. Mamanten a be e leli den, te sapaten, da a be e komoto a Jelusalem, go siibi na a Oleifi Mongo enke fa a be gwenti.
eng_text: And in the day time he was teaching in the temple; and at night he went out, and abode in the mount that is called the mount of Olives.

djk_text: Da te mamanten, da a be e daai kon baka, fu leli den sama a ini a Mama Keliki.
eng_text: And all the people came early in the morning to him in the temple, for to hear him.

djk_text: Da a fesa fu den Islayeli di den e kai Pasika be kon koosube. Na a fesa ya, da den e nyan paata beele di meke sondee sowda.
eng_text: Now the feast of unleavened bread drew nigh, which is called the Passover.

djk_text: Da den hei apaiti begiman anga den leliman fu Dyuweiti be e suku wan koni fasi, fu kii Masaa Jesesi. Ma den á poi, bika den be e feele a foluku.
eng_text: And the chief priests and scribes sought how they might kill him; for they feared the people.

djk_text: Na a seefi yuu de, ne saatan, a didibii go a ini Judasi Iskaliyotu ati ini. Judasi na be wan fu den twalufu bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi tu.
eng_text: Then entered Satan into Judas surnamed Iscariot, being of the number of the twelve.

djk_text: Ne a komoto, ne tilo tilo tilo, te a den hei begiman anga den edeman fu suudati di be e oli waki na a Mama Keliki. Ne a taigi den taki: “Mi sa yeepi u, fu u fende Jesesi kisi.”
eng_text: And he went his way, and communed with the chief priests and captains, how he might betray him unto them.

djk_text: Da di Judasi taigi den so, ne den piisii te den taigi en taki: “Judasi! Efi i yeepi wi kisi en enke fa i taki, wi o pai yu.”
eng_text: And they were glad, and covenanted to give him money.

djk_text: Da di a yee so, ne a daai gwe baka. Da fanafu a ten de, ne ai meke moiti fu den fende Masaa Jesesi kisi sondee fu a foluku sabi.
eng_text: And he promised, and sought opportunity to betray him unto them in the absence of the multitude.

djk_text: Ne den de, te a dei doo fu den kii a pikin sikapu fu den nyan a piisii ya.
eng_text: Then came the day of unleavened bread, when the passover must be killed.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi sende Peitilisi anga Johanisi taki: “U go seeka boli sani fu u nyan a Pasika.”
eng_text: And he sent Peter and John, saying, Go and prepare us the passover, that we may eat.

djk_text: Ne den akisi Masaa Jesesi taki: “Masaa! On se i wani meke u go seeka sani?”
eng_text: And they said unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare?

djk_text: Ne a piki den taki: “U go a Jelusalem. Da te u go, da u o si wan man anga wan bungu wataa a pasi. Da u mu waka ne en baka, te na a osu pe ai go. Da te a go a ini a osu, da useefi mu go a ini tu.
eng_text: And he said unto them, Behold, when ye are entered into the city, there shall a man meet you, bearing a pitcher of water; follow him into the house where he entereth in.

djk_text: Da u taigi a man di abi a osu taki: ‘A Mesiti sende u, fu akisi yu on pisi a kambaa de, pe en anga den bakaman fi en sa nyan a Pasika Fesa tide neti.’
eng_text: And ye shall say unto the goodman of the house, The Master saith unto thee, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?

djk_text: Da a o soi u wan gaan kambaa a sodoo. Da ala sani u abi fanowdu fu seeka sani de a ini a kambaa de kaba. Da na ape u mu go seeka sani fu u nyan a Pasika.”
eng_text: And he shall shew you a large upper room furnished: there make ready.

djk_text: Ne den go. Di den doo a kondee, ne den si ala sani enke fa Masaa Jesesi be taigi den. Ne den seeka sani fu a Pasika Fesa.
eng_text: And they went, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.

djk_text: Ne di sapaten, ne Masaa Jesesi anga den taa apaiti bosikopuman fi en kon doo na a osu. Ne ala den go sidon a tafaa fu nyan.
eng_text: And when the hour was come, he sat down, and the twelve apostles with him.

djk_text: Da di den sidon e nyan, te wan pisi, ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “Fu tuutuu! Mi e taigi u taki, mi be angii fu nyan a Pasika ya anga u. Bika dyonson, a yuu o doo fu mi tyai a gaan sitaafu di de fu kon a mi tapu.
eng_text: And he said unto them, With desire I have desired to eat this passover with you before I suffer:

djk_text: Da mi ná o nyan sowan Pasika Fesa anga u moo ete, fu te enke ala den sani di u e membee anga a fesa ya kon pasa. A yuu de, da a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu o doo goontapu.”
eng_text: For I say unto you, I will not any more eat thereof, until it be fulfilled in the kingdom of God.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi teke a kan win, ne a gi Masaa Gadu daa, ne a gi den bakaman fi en taki: “U luku ya! U teke, da u diingi lontu.
eng_text: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and said, Take this, and divide it among yourselves:

djk_text: Bika mi ná o diingi win moo ete, fu te enke a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu doo.”
eng_text: For I say unto you, I will not drink of the fruit of the vine, until the kingdom of God shall come.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi teke a beele, ne a gi Masaa Gadu daa, moi te a kaba. Ne a booko en pisipisi, ne a gi den bakaman fi en taki: “U luku ya! Disi na mi sikin di mi e gi fu u ede. Da u du disi fu e membee mi alaten.”
eng_text: And he took bread, and gave thanks, and brake it, and gave unto them, saying, This is my body which is given for you: this do in remembrance of me.
