eng_text: Our fathers worshipped in this mountain; and ye say, that in Jerusalem is the place where men ought to worship.

djk_text: Ne Jesesi piki en taki: “Uman, biibi mi. A ten e kon, di a ná a mongo tapu ya efu Jelusalem u o go fu go begi a Tata moo.
eng_text: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, believe me, the hour cometh, when ye shall neither in this mountain, nor yet at Jerusalem, worship the Father.

djk_text: U á sabi san u e begi. Ma wi sabi san wi e begi. Bika na den Dyu a tuutuu yeepi fu Masaa Gadu e komoto go a den taa sama.
eng_text: Ye worship ye know not what: we know what we worship: for salvation is of the Jews.

djk_text: Ma a ten e kon, da meke u taki, a de kaba, di den sama di e libi wan letiopu fasi o begi anga den hii ati a ini jeje anga tuu. Bika na den sowtu sama ya Gadu Tata e suku fu begi en na a sowtu fasi ya.
eng_text: But the hour cometh, and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and in truth: for the Father seeketh such to worship him.

djk_text: Ma Gadu na jeje. Da den sama di e begi en mu begi en, e opo en nen a hei a wan tuutuu fasi anga a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu leti enke fa enseefi de tuutuu.”
eng_text: God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth.

djk_text: Ne a uman taigi en taki: “Mi sabi taki a Mesiyasi o kon. Da te a kon, da a o tyai ala sani fiya kon a kiin gi wi.”
eng_text: The woman saith unto him, I know that Messias cometh, which is called Christ: when he is come, he will tell us all things.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “We, uman, a sama di i kai de, ne en i si e taki anga yu ya.”
eng_text: Jesus saith unto her, I that speak unto thee am he.

djk_text: We, a seefi yuu de, ne den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi kon doo a pe a be de. Ne den foondoo fu si taki a be e taki anga wan uman sama. Ma toku seefi ná wan fu den di taki wan sani fu akisi en taki, san yu akisi en, efu san yu anga en be e taki.
eng_text: And upon this came his disciples, and marvelled that he talked with the woman: yet no man said, What seekest thou? or, Why talkest thou with her?

djk_text: Ne a uman fika a bungu fi en de, ne a lon go a ini a foto go kai sama taki:
eng_text: The woman then left her waterpot, and went her way into the city, and saith to the men,

djk_text: “U kon go luku wan sama di taigi mi, mi hii libi. Da u kon u go luku. Kande sama na a Kelestesi.”
eng_text: Come, see a man, which told me all things that ever I did: is not this the Christ?

djk_text: Ne den sama komoto a ini a foto booko gwullu go a Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: Then they went out of the city, and came unto him.

djk_text: We, a yuu de, da den bakaman be e begi Masaa Jesesi fu a go nyan.
eng_text: In the mean while his disciples prayed him, saying, Master, eat.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Mi abi wan nyanyan fu nyan di u á sabi.”
eng_text: But he said unto them, I have meat to eat that ye know not of.

djk_text: Ne den bakaman fi en taigi den seefi taki: “Tan! A sa de taki wan sama be tyai nyanyan kon gi en fu a nyan?”
eng_text: Therefore said the disciples one to another, Hath any man brought him ought to eat?

djk_text: Ma Jesesi taigi den taki: “A nyanyan fu mi, na fu du a wani fu mi Tata di sende mi kon, fu a wooko fi en go doo.
eng_text: Jesus saith unto them, My meat is to do the will of him that sent me, and to finish his work.

djk_text: Na u seefi e taki, ete fo mun, da koti alisi yuu doo, no? We, u opo u ain luku den goon. Alisi lepi kaba.
eng_text: Say not ye, There are yet four months, and then cometh harvest? behold, I say unto you, Lift up your eyes, and look on the fields; for they are white already to harvest.

djk_text: We, sama di e koti e fende en paiman. Da soseefi ai kibii nyanyan fu a libi fu bakaten. Da sama di e paandi anga sama di e koti o piisii makandii.
eng_text: And he that reapeth receiveth wages, and gathereth fruit unto life eternal: that both he that soweth and he that reapeth may rejoice together.

djk_text: Bika na ya wi e si taki a nongo e kon tuu di taki: ‘Taawan e paandi, taawan e koti.’
eng_text: And herein is that saying true, One soweth, and another reapeth.

djk_text: Bika, we mi be sende u go fu u koti san taa sama be paandi. Na taa sama be sete a wooko de, ma u kon fu kaba en.”
eng_text: I sent you to reap that whereon ye bestowed no labour: other men laboured, and ye are entered into their labours.

djk_text: Da somen sama fu Samaliya kon biibi ne en fu a sani di a uman be taigi den. Bika a be taigi den taki: “A taigi mi ala san mi be du.”
eng_text: And many of the Samaritans of that city believed on him for the saying of the woman, which testified, He told me all that ever I did.

djk_text: Ne den Samaliya sama di be kon ne en, begi en fu a tan anga den ape. Ne a tan tu dei anga den.
eng_text: So when the Samaritans were come unto him, they besought him that he would tarry with them: and he abode there two days.

djk_text: Ma somen sama be daai kon e biibi ne en fu den wowtu di enseefi be e taki.
eng_text: And many more believed because of his own word;

djk_text: Ne den sama taigi a uman taki: “Now u nái biibi moo fu san i taigi wi. Ma wi e biibi fu di wi eigi yesi yee. Da wi sabi tuutuu taki, a Yeepiman di Masaa Gadu sende kon gi goontapu, ne en de ya.”
eng_text: And said unto the woman, Now we believe, not because of thy saying: for we have heard him ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Saviour of the world.

djk_text: Ne tu dei a baka, ne Masaa Jesesi komoto de e go a Galileya.
eng_text: Now after two days he departed thence, and went into Galilee.

djk_text: We, Masaa Jesesi seefi be taki kiinkiin taki: “Wan apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu ná abi nen ne en eigi kondee.”
eng_text: For Jesus himself testified, that a prophet hath no honour in his own country.

djk_text: We, di a doo Galileya, ne ala den sama di be si den sani di a be du a Jelusalem, teke en anga gaan piisii. Bika somen fu den be de a Jelusalem na a Pasika Piisii tu.
eng_text: Then when he was come into Galilee, the Galilaeans received him, having seen all the things that he did at Jerusalem at the feast: for they also went unto the feast.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi doo a peesi di den e kai Kaana, na a pisiwataa fu Galileya, pe a be meke a wataa toon win. Ne di a go doo de, ne wan bigiman di be e wooko a kownu paleisi yee taki a komoto a Judeja kon a Galileya de. Ne a go a Masaa Jesesi fu a kon deesi wan manpikin fi en gi en. Bika a pikin ya be siki swaki te na fu dede namo.
eng_text: So Jesus came again into Cana of Galilee, where he made the water wine. And there was a certain nobleman, whose son was sick at Capernaum.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Solanga u á si gaan foondoo sani anga gaan maiki, u nái biibi.”
eng_text: Then said Jesus unto him, Except ye see signs and wonders, ye will not believe.

djk_text: Ne a man piki en taki: “Masaa, gaantangi kon yeepi mi, baa. Deesi a pikin fu mi gi mi fosi a dede, baa.”
eng_text: The nobleman saith unto him, Sir, come down ere my child die.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Go! A pikin fi yu e libi.” We, a man biibi enke fa Masaa Jesesi taki. Ne a go fi en a osu baka.
eng_text: Jesus saith unto him, Go thy way; thy son liveth. And the man believed the word that Jesus had spoken unto him, and he went his way.

djk_text: Ne di a de a pasi e gwe te wan pisi, ne a miti den futuboi fi en a pasi. Ne den taigi en taki: “A pikin fi yu e libi!”
eng_text: And as he was now going down, his servants met him, and told him, saying, Thy son liveth.

djk_text: Ne di a akisi den on ten fu a dei a pikin be kon betee, ne den taigi en taki: “Eside bakadina, wan ten fu wan yuu, ne a feba gwe.”
eng_text: Then inquired he of them the hour when he began to amend. And they said unto him, Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him.

djk_text: Ne a man si taki na a seefi yuu di Masaa Jesesi be taigi en taki: “Go! A pikin fi yu e libi.” We, ne a man ya anga en hii osu daai kon a biibi.
eng_text: So the father knew that it was at the same hour, in the which Jesus said unto him, Thy son liveth: and himself believed, and his whole house.

djk_text: Da a sani di Masaa Jesesi du ya, ne meke di fu tu gaan foondoo sani di a du, di a daai komoto a Judeja kon a Galileya baka.
eng_text: This is again the second miracle that Jesus did, when he was come out of Judaea into Galilee.

djk_text: We, ne baka disi, da ete wan gaan piisii fu den Dyu o de. Ne Masaa Jesesi teke pasi, ne ai go a Jelusalem.
eng_text: After this there was a feast of the Jews; and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

djk_text: We, da a yuu ten de, da wan peti wataa be de a Jelusalem koosube fu den doo mofu fu a kondee. Da disi na a doo di den sama be e tyai den sikapu pasa go a ini a kondee. Da na a peti ya den Dyu be e kai Betisaida. Da den be meke feifi baikon lontu a peti wataa ya.
eng_text: Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep market a pool, which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda, having five porches.

djk_text: Da somen sikiman be de didon didon a ini den baikon de. Beendiman, lanman anga malengiiman, ala den fiya be de ape didon didon. Ala den fiya de e luku on yuu a wataa o seke.
eng_text: In these lay a great multitude of impotent folk, of blind, halt, withered, waiting for the moving of the water.

djk_text: Bika a abi a yuu, da wan Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee e saka komoto a tapu kon seke a wataa. Da te a wataa seke so kaba, da a sama di o go a ini enke fosi sama, da a sama de e kon bun baka, wansi sowtu siki a be abi.
eng_text: For an angel went down at a certain season into the pool, and troubled the water: whosoever then first after the troubling of the water stepped in was made whole of whatsoever disease he had.

djk_text: We, wan sama di be siki diitenti na aitin yali be de ape didon didon.
eng_text: And a certain man was there, which had an infirmity thirty and eight years.

djk_text: Da di Masaa Jesesi si en didon didon de, ne a akisi en taki: “Man, yu wani kon bun baka?” Bika Masaa Jesesi be sabi taki a man ya be didon de langa kaba.
eng_text: When Jesus saw him lie, and knew that he had been now a long time in that case, he saith unto him, Wilt thou be made whole?

djk_text: Ne a sikiman piki en taki: “We, Masaa. Mi ná abi ná wan sama fu poti mi go a ini a wataa, te a wataa e seke. We bika, te a wataa seke, fosi mi go doo, da wan taa sama go a mi fesi kaba.”
eng_text: The impotent man answered him, Sir, I have no man, when the water is troubled, to put me into the pool: but while I am coming, another steppeth down before me.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi en taki: “Opo! Teke i kama, da i waka go.”
eng_text: Jesus saith unto him, Rise, take up thy bed, and walk.

djk_text: Ne wanten wanten a sikiman kon bun baka. Ne a teke en kama, ne a go. Ma namo, da ala a sani be e pasa a wan kina dei fu den Dyu.
eng_text: And immediately the man was made whole, and took up his bed, and walked: and on the same day was the sabbath.

djk_text: Na fu dati ede meke den edeman fu den Dyu taigi a sikiman di kon bun ya taki: “Man! Yu á sabi taki tide na kina dei, no? Yu á mu wooko e tyai i kama na a kina dei ya.”
eng_text: The Jews therefore said unto him that was cured, It is the sabbath day: it is not lawful for thee to carry thy bed.

djk_text: Ne a man piki den taki: “We, na a sama di deesi mi meke mi kon bun baka, ne en taigi mi taki, meke mi opo, da mi teke mi kama, da mi waka go.”
eng_text: He answered them, He that made me whole, the same said unto me, Take up thy bed, and walk.

djk_text: Ne den akisi en taki: “Sama na a sama di taigi yu a sani de?”
eng_text: Then asked they him, What man is that which said unto thee, Take up thy bed, and walk?

djk_text: Ma a man á be sabi Masaa Jesesi seefi. Bika Masaa Jesesi be gwe fi en komoto na ape saafi saafi. Bika somen somen sama be de ape.
eng_text: And he that was healed wist not who it was: for Jesus had conveyed himself away, a multitude being in that place.

djk_text: Ne moo lati, ne Masaa Jesesi miti anga a man ya a ini a Mama Keliki fu den Dyu. Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi en taki: “I si? I kon bun baka. Yu á mu du ogii moo, ye! Efuso wan moo gaan ogii o miti yu.”
eng_text: Afterward Jesus findeth him in the temple, and said unto him, Behold, thou art made whole: sin no more, lest a worse thing come unto thee.

djk_text: Ne a man gwe, ne a taigi den edeman fu den Dyu taki, na Masaa Jesesi na a sama di deesi en meke a kon bun baka.
eng_text: The man departed, and told the Jews that it was Jesus, which had made him whole.

djk_text: Na fu dati ede meke den go suku Masaa Jesesi. Ne den meke toobi anga en ogii ogii e suku fu kii en fu di a be deesi a man na a kina dei fu den Dyu.
eng_text: And therefore did the Jews persecute Jesus, and sought to slay him, because he had done these things on the sabbath day.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Mi Tata e wooko te enke now, da miseefi e wooko tu.”
eng_text: But Jesus answered them, My Father worketh hitherto, and I work.

djk_text: We, ne den edeman fu den Dyu e meke moiti moo taanga fu den fende en kii. Bika a ná a kina dei fu den Dyu wawan a be booko, ma a kai Masaa Gadu en eigi Tata. Da na so a be e meke enseefi toon wan anga Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Therefore the Jews sought the more to kill him, because he not only had broken the sabbath, but said also that God was his Father, making himself equal with God.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Fu tuutuu mi e taigi u taki, a Manpikin á poi du ná wan sani boiti san a si a Tata e du. Ma san a Tata e du, na dati a Manpikin e du tu.
eng_text: Then answered Jesus and said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, The Son can do nothing of himself, but what he seeth the Father do: for what things soever he doeth, these also doeth the Son likewise.

djk_text: Bika a Tata lobi a Manpikin fi en. Da ala san a Tata e du ai soi a Pikin. Da a o soi en moo gaan foondoo sani ete fu du. Da u ala fiya sa foondoo seefi seefi.
eng_text: For the Father loveth the Son, and sheweth him all things that himself doeth: and he will shew him greater works than these, that ye may marvel.

djk_text: Bika fa i si a Tata e weki den dedesama puu a dede, gi den libi baka, na leti soseefi a Manpikin fi en sa gi iniiwan sama di a wani libi tu.
eng_text: For as the Father raiseth up the dead, and quickeneth them; even so the Son quickeneth whom he will.

djk_text: We, a Tata nái kuutu ná wan sama, ma a poti ala a kuutu a ini ana fu a Manpikin.
eng_text: For the Father judgeth no man, but hath committed all judgment unto the Son:

djk_text: We, na fu ala sama mu lesipeki a Manpikin, enke fa den e lesipeki a Tata meke a du so. Da sama di nái lesipeki a Manpikin, nái lesipeki a Tata tu, di sende a Manpikin kon a goontapu.
eng_text: That all men should honour the Son, even as they honour the Father. He that honoureth not the Son honoureth not the Father which hath sent him.

djk_text: “Fu tuutuu mi e taigi u taki, a sama di e biibi san mi e taki tuu, ne ai biibi a sama di sende mi kon a goontapu, da sowan sama abi a libi fu tego kaba. Da a sama de ná o go a kuutu moo. Bika a komoto a dede kon a libi.
eng_text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that heareth my word, and believeth on him that sent me, hath everlasting life, and shall not come into condemnation; but is passed from death unto life.

djk_text: “Fu tuutuu mi e taigi u taki, a yuu o kon, da a de kaba, di den dedesama sa yee a tongo fu a Manpikin fu Masaa Gadu. Da den sama di o piki mi o fende a libi.
eng_text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The hour is coming, and now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God: and they that hear shall live.

djk_text: Bika, leti enke fa i si mi Tata abi libi fu gi ala sama, na leti soseefi a Pikin abi libi tu fu gi sama.
eng_text: For as the Father hath life in himself; so hath he given to the Son to have life in himself;

djk_text: We, ne a gi en makiti tu fu kuutu libisama fu di enseefi de a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya.
eng_text: And hath given him authority to execute judgment also, because he is the Son of man.

djk_text: U á mu foondoo fu den sani di mi taki ya. Bika wan yuu e kon di ala sama di de a ini geebi sa yee en tongo.
eng_text: Marvel not at this: for the hour is coming, in the which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice,

djk_text: Da ala den fiya o weki komoto a dede baka komoto a ini geebi kon a libi. Da den di be libi bun a Gadu ain, o weki baka fu libi anga Gadu fu tego. Ma den di be libi takuu a Gadu ain, sa opo baka komoto a ini geebi fu go a kuutu poti go a sitaafu.
eng_text: And shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of damnation.

djk_text: “Mi á poi du ná wan sani mi wawan. Ma, leti enke fa mi yee en a mi Tata, na so mi e kuutu sani. Da a kuutu fu mi de leti. Bika mi nái suku mi wani, ma mi e suku a wani fu mi Tata di sende mi kon.
eng_text: I can of mine own self do nothing: as I hear, I judge: and my judgment is just; because I seek not mine own will, but the will of the Father which hath sent me.

djk_text: Efu mi e taki sani fu miseefi, da a taki fu mi á de leti.
eng_text: If I bear witness of myself, my witness is not true.

djk_text: Ma wan taawan de, di e taki sani fu mi. Da mi sabi taki san ai taki fu mi de, leti enke fa ai taki den tuu.
eng_text: There is another that beareth witness of me; and I know that the witness which he witnesseth of me is true.

djk_text: Bika luku. U be sende sama go a Johanisi fu akisi en sani. Ne a piki u, leti enke fa a de tuu.
eng_text: Ye sent unto John, and he bare witness unto the truth.

djk_text: Ma toku seefi, mi nái teke a taki fu libisama. Ma mi be taki disi namo fu u be sa komoto a ini takuudu anga ogii kon a Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: But I receive not testimony from man: but these things I say, that ye might be saved.

djk_text: Bika Johanisi be de enke wan lampu di be de leti leti e kiin dyelle. Da a be bun gi u fu wan pisiten fu aliki san a be e taki.
eng_text: He was a burning and a shining light: and ye were willing for a season to rejoice in his light.

djk_text: Ma mi abi sani ete di e taki moo taanga fu mi moo enke den wowtu di Johanisi be taki. Dati na den wooko di mi Tata be sende mi fu du ya. Bika den gaan foondoo foondoo wooko di mi e du ya, na den seefi wooko ya e soi taki na mi Tata be sende mi kon.
eng_text: But I have greater witness than that of John: for the works which the Father hath given me to finish, the same works that I do, bear witness of me, that the Father hath sent me.

djk_text: “Da soseefi mi Tata di be sende mi kon, seefi e taki sani fu mi. Ma, u á be yee en tongo wan dei. U á si en fesi wan dei, te go taki fu sabi en.
eng_text: And the Father himself, which hath sent me, hath borne witness of me. Ye have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his shape.

djk_text: Da soseefi a wowtu fi en á de a ini u ati ini fu alaten. Bika u á wani biibi a sama di a be sende kon.
eng_text: And ye have not his word abiding in you: for whom he hath sent, him ye believe not.

djk_text: U e feti e suku sani a ini Gadu Buku. Fu di u denki taki a ini Gadu Buku u sa fende a libi fu tego. We, na so a de tuu. Bika na mi a Buku de e taki.
eng_text: Search the scriptures; for in them ye think ye have eternal life: and they are they which testify of me.

djk_text: Ma u á wani kon a mi fu u fende a libi fu tego.
eng_text: And ye will not come to me, that ye might have life.

djk_text: “Mi nái suku nen a libisama.
eng_text: I receive not honour from men.

djk_text: Ma mi sabi taki fa u e meke de, u á lobi Gadu.
eng_text: But I know you, that ye have not the love of God in you.

djk_text: Mi Tata sende mi kon a ini en nen, ma u nái oli mi fu wan sani. Te wan taawan o kon a ini en eigi nen, da u o gaapu en gwulu oli seefi.
eng_text: I am come in my Father's name, and ye receive me not: if another shall come in his own name, him ye will receive.

djk_text: Ma fa u o du biibi? Bika u e suku nen a useefi. Ma u nái feti fu fende nen a Gadu a tapu anda.
eng_text: How can ye believe, which receive honour one of another, and seek not the honour that cometh from God only?

djk_text: “U á mu denki taki mi o tyai u go kaagi u a mi Tata. Nono! Kweti kweti! Wan taawan de di de kaba kaba fu kaagi u. Dati na Mosesi di i si u e poti fitoow.
eng_text: Do not think that I will accuse you to the Father: there is one that accuseth you, even Moses, in whom ye trust.

djk_text: We bika, efu u be e biibi Mosesi tuutuu, da u be o biibi mi tu. Bika ala den sani di Mosesi sikiifi, na sani fu mi a be e sikiifi.
eng_text: For had ye believed Moses, ye would have believed me: for he wrote of me.

djk_text: Ma, di u nái biibi san a sikiifi, da fa u o du biibi mi?”
eng_text: But if ye believe not his writings, how shall ye believe my words?

djk_text: Ne baka wan pisiten, ne Masaa Jesesi go a ini wan sipi fu koti a ze fu Galileya di den e kai Tibeliyasi abaa go na abaase.
eng_text: After these things Jesus went over the sea of Galilee, which is the sea of Tiberias.

djk_text: Da a yuu ten de, da wan gaan ipi sama be e waka a futu e faaka Masaa Jesesi e kon, fu di den be si den gaan foondoo sani, di a be du, deesi den sikiman.
eng_text: And a great multitude followed him, because they saw his miracles which he did on them that were diseased.

djk_text: Na dati meke Masaa Jesesi subi a wan pikin mongo tapu go sidon anga den bakaman fi en.
eng_text: And Jesus went up into a mountain, and there he sat with his disciples.

djk_text: Da a ten de, da a gaan piisii fu den Dyu di den e kai Pasika be de koosube.
eng_text: And the passover, a feast of the Jews, was nigh.

djk_text: We, ne di Masaa Jesesi opo ede di a si taki na tyaipi sama kon ne en so, ne a akisi Filipi taki: “Filipi, pe u sa bai beele fu den sama ya fende nyan?”
eng_text: When Jesus then lifted up his eyes, and saw a great company come unto him, he saith unto Philip, Whence shall we buy bread, that these may eat?

djk_text: Ma fa a akisi en de seefi, na akisi a akisi en fu luku fa a o piki. Bika Masaa Jesesi be sabi bunbun san a be wani du.
eng_text: And this he said to prove him: for he himself knew what he would do.

djk_text: Ne Filipi piki en taki: “Efu u bai wan miliyun anga onmen dunsu kolu beele seefi, toku a ná o sai den sama ya. Winsi ibii sama teke wan pikin pisi seefi.”
eng_text: Philip answered him, Two hundred pennyworth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may take a little.

djk_text: Ne wan fu den bakaman fi en di den e kai Andeleyasi, a baala fu Simon Peitilisi taigi en taki:
eng_text: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, saith unto him,

djk_text: “Wan pikin boi de ya di abi feifi pikin beele anga tu fisi. Ma san dati o poi yeepi den somen sama ya?”
eng_text: There is a lad here, which hath five barley loaves, and two small fishes: but what are they among so many?

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “Meke ala sama go sidon.” Bika a peesi be abi tyaipi gaasi. We, ne den go sidon. Da a be sa de wan sani fu feifi dunsu manengee so.
eng_text: And Jesus said, Make the men sit down. Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi teke den beele, ne a begi gi Masaa Gadu daa moi te a kaba, ne a paati gi den sama di be sidon. Da soseefi a paati den tu fisi gi den sama.
eng_text: And Jesus took the loaves; and when he had given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to them that were set down; and likewise of the fishes as much as they would.

djk_text: Da ala sama nyan te den bee fuu. Ne di den kaba nyan, ne Masaa Jesesi sende den bakaman fi en fu den go piki den pisipisi beele di den sama nyan fika. Bika a nyanyan á mu poli.
eng_text: When they were filled, he said unto his disciples, Gather up the fragments that remain, that nothing be lost.

djk_text: Ne den go piki den pisipisi beele di fika. Ne den piki te twalufu bakisi fuu kwaa anga a pisi fu a beele di den sama be nyan fika.
eng_text: Therefore they gathered them together, and filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves, which remained over and above unto them that had eaten.

djk_text: We, ne di den sama si a gaan foondoo sani di Masaa Jesesi du ya, ne a bigi gi den te, ná sipowtu. Ne den taki: “Fu tuu, a sama ya na a apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu di a be paamisi fu sende kon a goontapu.”
eng_text: Then those men, when they had seen the miracle that Jesus did, said, This is of a truth that prophet that should come into the world.

djk_text: Ma namo, di Masaa Jesesi sabi taki den wani kon kisi en anga taanga fu meke a toon den kownu, ne a go fi en na a mongo tapu go de en wawan.
eng_text: When Jesus therefore perceived that they would come and take him by force, to make him a king, he departed again into a mountain himself alone.

djk_text: Ne di sapaten, ne den bakaman fi en go na a ze.
eng_text: And when even was now come, his disciples went down unto the sea,

djk_text: Ne den go a ini wan sipiboto e koti abaa go na a Kafalnayemu. Da a yuu de, da peesi be kon e dunguu kaba. Ma Masaa Jesesi á be go anga den.
eng_text: And entered into a ship, and went over the sea toward Capernaum. And it was now dark, and Jesus was not come to them.

djk_text: Ma namo, wan gaan taanga winta e wai na a ze e seke a wataa hei den paana te, ná sipowtu.
eng_text: And the sea arose by reason of a great wind that blew.

djk_text: Ne di den go wan sani fu feifi kilomeiti so, ne den si Masaa Jesesi e waka na a wataa tapu e kon miti den na a sipiboto. Ne den feele, te ná sipowtu.
eng_text: So when they had rowed about five and twenty or thirty furlongs, they see Jesus walking on the sea, and drawing nigh unto the ship: and they were afraid.

djk_text: Ma a taigi den taki: “U á feele! Na mi!”
eng_text: But he saith unto them, It is I; be not afraid.

djk_text: Ne di a taigi den so, ne den ati koo. Ne den teke en poti kon a ini a sipi. Ne wanten den doo tu a pe den be e go.
eng_text: Then they willingly received him into the ship: and immediately the ship was at the land whither they went.

djk_text: Da a taa dei fi en, da somen sama be de na abaase fu a ze e foondoo. Den á be sabi on se Masaa Jesesi be go. Bika taa boto moo enke di den bakaman fi en be go a ini á be de ape. Da Masaa Jesesi á be gwe anga den a ini a boto.
eng_text: The day following, when the people which stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was none other boat there, save that one whereinto his disciples were entered, and that Jesus went not with his disciples into the boat, but that his disciples were gone away alone;

djk_text: Da a yuu de, da wantu boto fu a kondee di den e kai Tibeliyasi be kon koosube na a peesi, pe Masaa Jesesi be teke a beele gi Masaa Gadu daa, paati gi den sama.
eng_text: (Howbeit there came other boats from Tiberias nigh unto the place where they did eat bread, after that the Lord had given thanks:)

djk_text: Ma di den sama si taki Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en á de ape, ne den go a ini wan sipiboto, ne den go a Kafalnayemu go suku en.
eng_text: When the people therefore saw that Jesus was not there, neither his disciples, they also took shipping, and came to Capernaum, seeking for Jesus.

djk_text: Ne di den go, ne den si en na a abaase fu a ze. Ne den akisi en taki: “Labai, on yuu i kon ya?”
eng_text: And when they had found him on the other side of the sea, they said unto him, Rabbi, when camest thou hither?

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Fu tuutuu mi e taigi u taki, u nái kon suku mi, fu di u be si den foondoo sani di mi du. Ma na fu di u be nyan a beele te a sai u.
eng_text: Jesus answered them and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Ye seek me, not because ye saw the miracles, but because ye did eat of the loaves, and were filled.

djk_text: U á suku nyanyan di e oli u fu wan pisiten naamo. Ma u suku a nyanyan, di a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya e gi u, fu fende libi di de tego. Bika ne en u Tata, Masaa Gadu, be naki sitampu taki, a bun.”
eng_text: Labour not for the meat which perisheth, but for that meat which endureth unto everlasting life, which the Son of man shall give unto you: for him hath God the Father sealed.

djk_text: Ne den akisi en taki: “We, fa u mu du fu u sa du den wooko di Masaa Gadu wani meke u du?”
eng_text: Then said they unto him, What shall we do, that we might work the works of God?

djk_text: Ne a piki den taki: “We, san Masaa Gadu wani, na fu u biibi Awan di a sende kon ya.”
eng_text: Jesus answered and said unto them, This is the work of God, that ye believe on him whom he hath sent.

djk_text: We, ne den akisi en taki: “We, sowtu maiki yu o du gi u fu u sa sabi taki na yu u mu biibi?
eng_text: They said therefore unto him, What sign shewest thou then, that we may see, and believe thee? what dost thou work?

djk_text: We bika, den avo avo fu wi be nyan mana di den be a ini a gaan sabana ini. Bika Buku sikiifi taki: ‘A gi den beele komoto a Gadu Kondee a tapu fu den nyan.’ ”
eng_text: Our fathers did eat manna in the desert; as it is written, He gave them bread from heaven to eat.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Fu tuutuu mi e taigi u taki, a ná Mosesi be gi den a beele di be e komoto a tapu. Ma na mi Tata e gi u a tuutuu beele di komoto a Gadu anda.
eng_text: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Moses gave you not that bread from heaven; but my Father giveth you the true bread from heaven.

djk_text: Bika a nowfosi a tuutuu beele komoto a tapu saka kon a goontapu. Da a tuutuu beele ya, e gi ala sama a libi fu tego.”
eng_text: For the bread of God is he which cometh down from heaven, and giveth life unto the world.

djk_text: Ne den taigi en taki: “We, Masaa, gi wi a beele de fu u nyan alaten, no?”
eng_text: Then said they unto him, Lord, evermore give us this bread.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “Na mi na a beele fu libi. Sama di kon a mi, noiti moo angii sa kii en. Da sama di e biibi a mi, noiti moo dee wataa sa kisi en.
eng_text: And Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.

djk_text: Mi be taigi u kaba. U e si mi, ma toku u nái biibi.
eng_text: But I said unto you, That ye also have seen me, and believe not.

djk_text: Ala den sama di mi Tata gi mi o kon a mi. Da ala sama di kon a mi, mi ná o daai den baka, fu sende den gwe.
eng_text: All that the Father giveth me shall come to me; and him that cometh to me I will in no wise cast out.

djk_text: Bika mi á komoto a tapu kon a goontapu fu du mi wani. Ma fu du a wani fu mi Tata di sende mi kon.
eng_text: For I came down from heaven, not to do mine own will, but the will of him that sent me.

djk_text: Da san na a wani fu mi Tata? Dati na taki mi á mu meke ná wan fu den sama di a gi mi go lasi. Ma mi mu weki den na a kiiboi dei puu a dede.
eng_text: And this is the Father's will which hath sent me, that of all which he hath given me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up again at the last day.

djk_text: Da, disi na a wani fu mi Tata di sende mi kon. Iniiwan sama di si a Manpikin fi en, ne den biibi en, da a sama de abi a libi fu tego. Da a sa weki so wan sama puu a dede na a kiiboi dei.”
eng_text: And this is the will of him that sent me, that every one which seeth the Son, and believeth on him, may have everlasting life: and I will raise him up at the last day.

djk_text: Ma den Dyu e kuutu fu di a taigi den taki en na a beele di komoto a tapu saka kon a goontapu.
eng_text: The Jews then murmured at him, because he said, I am the bread which came down from heaven.

djk_text: Den taki: “Tan! A sama ya, a ná a manpikin fu Jowsef, di den e kai Jesesi, no? U sabi en dda anga en mma. Da fa a sa taki, taki a komoto a tapu saka kon a goontapu?”
eng_text: And they said, Is not this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? how is it then that he saith, I came down from heaven?

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “U á kuutu kuutu fu dati.
eng_text: Jesus therefore answered and said unto them, Murmur not among yourselves.

djk_text: Ná wan sama sa kon a mi, efu a ná mi Tata di be sende mi kon ali en kon a mi. Da mi sa weki en baka puu a dede na a kiiboi dei.
eng_text: No man can come to me, except the Father which hath sent me draw him: and I will raise him up at the last day.

djk_text: Da wan fu den apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu be sikiifi taki: ‘Na Gadu seefi e leli ala sama.’ Da iniiwan sama di e aliki a Tata, ne a teke san di Masaa Gadu e leli en, da so wan sama musu kon a mi.
eng_text: It is written in the prophets, And they shall be all taught of God. Every man therefore that hath heard, and hath learned of the Father, cometh unto me.

djk_text: Ná wan sama be si Masaa Gadu wan dei, boiti Awan di komoto a Masaa Gadu. Ne en wawan too, si en.”
eng_text: Not that any man hath seen the Father, save he which is of God, he hath seen the Father.

djk_text: Fu tuutuu mi e taigi u: “Iniiwan sama di biibi a mi, da a sama de abi a libi fu tego.
eng_text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me hath everlasting life.

djk_text: Mi na a beele di e gi sama libi.
eng_text: I am that bread of life.

djk_text: Den avo avo fu u be nyan a mana a ini a gaan sabana, ma toku den dede.
eng_text: Your fathers did eat manna in the wilderness, and are dead.

djk_text: Ma, u luku a beele di komoto a tapu saka kon a goontapu ya. Da, efu wan sama nyan a beele ya, da a ná o dede. Ma yu o fende a libi fu tego.
eng_text: This is the bread which cometh down from heaven, that a man may eat thereof, and not die.

djk_text: Mi na a beele di e gi libisama libi. Na Gadu mi komoto. Da a sama di o nyan a beele ya, abi a libi fu tego. Da a beele di mi e taki ya, na mi sikin dugu dugu di mi o gi fu ala libisama ede.”
eng_text: I am the living bread which came down from heaven: if any man eat of this bread, he shall live for ever: and the bread that I will give is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.

djk_text: Ma namo, ne den Dyu bigin sitee anga denseefi. Den taki: “Fa a sa gi wi en sikin dugu dugu meti fu nyan?”
eng_text: The Jews therefore strove among themselves, saying, How can this man give us his flesh to eat?

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “Fu tuutuu mi e taigi u, efu u á teke a sikin fu a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya fu nyan, da u teke a buulu fi en diingi, da yu ná abi libi ete.
eng_text: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except ye eat the flesh of the Son of man, and drink his blood, ye have no life in you.

djk_text: A sama di o teke a mi sikin nyan, ne a teke mi buulu diingi, da a abi a libi fu tego kaba. Da mi sa weki en puu a dede na a kiiboi dei.
eng_text: Whoso eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, hath eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.

djk_text: Bika mi sikin na tuutuu nyanyan anga mi buulu na tuutuu diingi.
eng_text: For my flesh is meat indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.

djk_text: We, efu wan sama teke mi sikin nyan, ne a teke mi buulu diingi, da ai tan a ini mi. Da soseefi mi e tan a ini en tu.
eng_text: He that eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, dwelleth in me, and I in him.

djk_text: Da na mi Tata di abi ala libi sende mi kon. Da, leti enke fa mi Tata di e gi libi gi mi libi, da na letiso den sama di nyan mi sikin sa libi, bika mi e gi den libi.
eng_text: As the living Father hath sent me, and I live by the Father: so he that eateth me, even he shall live by me.

djk_text: We, na fu dati ede meke mi taigi u taki, mi na a beele di saka komoto a tapu kon a goontapu. A á de enke a mana di den avo avo fu u be nyan a ini a gaan sabana ini. Bika anga ala fa den be nyanmi en de seefi, toku den dede. Ma, efu wan sama nyan a beele ya, da a sa abi libi fu tego.”
eng_text: This is that bread which came down from heaven: not as your fathers did eat manna, and are dead: he that eateth of this bread shall live for ever.

djk_text: Da Masaa Jesesi be leli den sama ala den sani ya di a be de a ini a keliki a Kafalnayemu.
eng_text: These things said he in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.

djk_text: Ma di somen fu den sama di be e waka ne en baka yee san a taki, ne den taki: “A sani di a taigi u de taanga. Da sama o poi teke a sani de?”
eng_text: Many therefore of his disciples, when they had heard this, said, This is an hard saying; who can hear it?

djk_text: Ma fu di Masaa Jesesi be sabi kaba a ini en ati taki na so den sama di e waka ne en baka e kuutu fu san di a taki, ne a taigi den taki: “Oho! San meke u mandii so? Na a sani di mi taigi u de taanga gi u fu teke so?
eng_text: When Jesus knew in himself that his disciples murmured at it, he said unto them, Doth this offend you?

djk_text: We, da on fa a o de gi u seefi, te u o si, a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya, o opo go a tapu baka a pe a be komoto?
eng_text: What and if ye shall see the Son of man ascend up where he was before?

djk_text: Na a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu e gi libi. Libisama á poi gi i libi. Bika den wowtu di mi taki gi u de e tyai a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu kon gi u. Da a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu ya e gi libi.
eng_text: It is the spirit that quickeneth; the flesh profiteth nothing: the words that I speak unto you, they are spirit, and they are life.

djk_text: “Ma son sama de a u mindii di ná biibi.” Bika Masaa Jesesi be sabi kaba, sama anga sama á be o poti biibi ne en. Da soseefi a be sabi sama be o seli en tu.
eng_text: But there are some of you that believe not. For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were that believed not, and who should betray him.

djk_text: Ne a taigi den taki: “Na fu dati ede meke mi be taigi u taki, ná wan sama sa kon a mi, efu a ná mi Tata gi en a okasi.”
eng_text: And he said, Therefore said I unto you, that no man can come unto me, except it were given unto him of my Father.

djk_text: Ne fanafu a ten de, ne somen fu den sama di be e waka ne en baka, daai baka gi en. Den á wani waka anga en moo.
eng_text: From that time many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi daai, ne a akisi den twalufu bakaman fi en taki: “We, on fa? U wani gwe tu?”
eng_text: Then said Jesus unto the twelve, Will ye also go away?

djk_text: Ne Simon Peitilisi piki taki: “Masaa! Sama wi sa go moo so? We bika, i abi wowtu di e gi sama tego libi!
eng_text: Then Simon Peter answered him, Lord, to whom shall we go? thou hast the words of eternal life.

djk_text: U poti biibi a yu, bika u sabi taki yu na a Apaiti Sama fu Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: And we believe and are sure that thou art that Christ, the Son of the living God.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “A ná u twalufu mi be teke kon toon fu mi wawan, no? Ma wan fu u na wan didibii.”
eng_text: Jesus answered them, Have not I chosen you twelve, and one of you is a devil?

djk_text: Da na a Judasi, a pikin fu Simon Iskaliyotu, ne na a sama di a be e taki. Bika en na be wan fu den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi tu. Da anga ala fa en na be wan fu den twalufu bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi de seefi, toku a seli Masaa Jesesi a bakaten.
eng_text: He spake of Judas Iscariot the son of Simon: for he it was that should betray him, being one of the twelve.

djk_text: We, ne bakadati, ne Masaa Jesesi e waka e lontu a den kondee kondee fu Galileya. A á go a den kondee kondee fu Judeja moo. Bika den edeman fu den Dyu be e suku en fu kii.
eng_text: After these things Jesus walked in Galilee: for he would not walk in Jewry, because the Jews sought to kill him.

djk_text: Da a yuu de, da wan piisii fu den Dyu be de koosube. Da na a piisii ya, da den Dyu e meke somen masanga, enke fa den gaansama fu den be meke a ini a gaan sabana ini.
eng_text: Now the Jews' feast of tabernacles was at hand.

djk_text: Ne den baala fi en kon akisi en taki: “San i de ya e du? Go a Judeja meke den sama di e waka a yu baka si den wooko fi yu di yu e du tu.
eng_text: His brethren therefore said unto him, Depart hence, and go into Judaea, that thy disciples also may see the works that thou doest.

djk_text: Ná wan sama di e suku balinen, o de kibii kibii e du sani bakabaka. Go anda meke lanti si taki yu e du den sani de.”
eng_text: For there is no man that doeth any thing in secret, and he himself seeketh to be known openly. If thou do these things, shew thyself to the world.

djk_text: Bika den baala fi en seefi á be e biibi en.
eng_text: For neither did his brethren believe in him.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Mi yuu á doo ete. Ma u yuu doo kaba, bika u sa go alaten u wani.
eng_text: Then Jesus said unto them, My time is not yet come: but your time is alway ready.

djk_text: Bika den sama fu kondee á buuse u. Ma mi den nái si na ain seefi. Bika mi e taigi den kiinkiin taki den nái libi bun enke fa Gadu wani.
eng_text: The world cannot hate you; but me it hateth, because I testify of it, that the works thereof are evil.

djk_text: U wawan go. Mi ná o go na a piisii ya. Bika mi yuu á doo ete.”
eng_text: Go ye up unto this feast: I go not up yet unto this feast; for my time is not yet full come.

djk_text: Ma namo, di Masaa Jesesi taki so, ne a fika fi en a Galileya de.
eng_text: When he had said these words unto them, he abode still in Galilee.

djk_text: Ma di den baala fi en go kaba, ne enseefi teke pasi fu go na a piisii ya. Ma a á be waka gaangaan fu ala sama si en. Ma a be waka kibii kibii.
eng_text: But when his brethren were gone up, then went he also up unto the feast, not openly, but as it were in secret.

djk_text: We, di a de na a piisii ya kaba, ne den edeman fu den Dyu e suku en. Den e akisi namo taki: “Pe a de? Pe a sama de?”
eng_text: Then the Jews sought him at the feast, and said, Where is he?

djk_text: We, ne ala den sama bigin wan takitaki anga denseefi fu Masaa Jesesi ede. Son fu den e gafa en taki en na wan bunbun sama. Taawan taki: “Ho! Nono! Na wan bidiigiman. Ai bidiigi sama.”
eng_text: And there was much murmuring among the people concerning him: for some said, He is a good man: others said, Nay; but he deceiveth the people.

djk_text: Ma den á be e taki fu ala sama yee. Bika den be e feele den edeman fu den Dyu.
eng_text: Howbeit no man spake openly of him for fear of the Jews.

djk_text: We, di den sama be pasa a mindii fu a piisii ya, ne Masaa Jesesi opo go a ini a Mama Keliki. Ne ai leli den sama.
eng_text: Now about the midst of the feast Jesus went up into the temple, and taught.

djk_text: Ma den edeman fu den Dyu foondoo te, den taki: “Fa a man ya du sabi sani fu Gadu Buku so? A á be go a sikoo fu leli den sani de!”
eng_text: And the Jews marvelled, saying, How knoweth this man letters, having never learned?

djk_text: Ma namo, Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Den sani di mi e leli, a ná fu miseefi, ma na fu Gadu di sende mi kon a goontapu.
eng_text: Jesus answered them, and said, My doctrine is not mine, but his that sent me.

djk_text: Efu wan sama e angii fu du san Gadu taki, da enseefi sa si, efu den sani di mi e leli na fu Gadu, efu na fu miseefi.
eng_text: If any man will do his will, he shall know of the doctrine, whether it be of God, or whether I speak of myself.

djk_text: A sama di e taki sani fi enseefi, da na balinen ai suku gi enseefi. Ma a sama di e taki e suku balinen gi a sama di sende en kon, da so wan sama, na wan tuutuu sama. Falisi fasi á de a ini en.”
eng_text: He that speaketh of himself seeketh his own glory: but he that seeketh his glory that sent him, the same is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi akisi baka taki: “A ná Mosesi be gi u den weiti fu Gadu, no? Ma ná wan fu den weiti ya di u e oli. We bika, saide meke u e suku fu kii mi?”
eng_text: Did not Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keepeth the law? Why go ye about to kill me?

djk_text: Ne den piki en taki: “Wan didibii de a yu tapu. Sama e suku fu kii yu?”
eng_text: The people answered and said, Thou hast a devil: who goeth about to kill thee?

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Na wankodo wooko mi du, ne ai dangaa u so kaba.
eng_text: Jesus answered and said unto them, I have done one work, and ye all marvel.

djk_text: Mosesi be gi u wan weiti taki, u mu koti den pikin manpikin fu u poti a maiki gi den. A wansi na Mosesi seefi poti den weiti gi u fu oli, ma na den gaansama be meke den. Ma toku u e wooko anga a weiti ya a kina dei.
eng_text: Moses therefore gave unto you circumcision; (not because it is of Moses, but of the fathers;) and ye on the sabbath day circumcise a man.

djk_text: We, efu u sa koti wan pikin manpikin a kina dei poti a maiki gi en, soso fu di a weiti fu Mosesi á mu booko, da saide meke u e kuutu, fu di mi deesi wan hiihii libisama a kina dei?
eng_text: If a man on the sabbath day receive circumcision, that the law of Moses should not be broken; are ye angry at me, because I have made a man every whit whole on the sabbath day?

djk_text: U á mu kuutu sani, enke fa u si den anga ain. Ma u mu wegi den sani go wegi den kon, da u kuutu den a wan leti fasi.”
eng_text: Judge not according to the appearance, but judge righteous judgment.

djk_text: Ma wantu Dyusama fu Jelusalem e akisi taki: “A ná a man ya den edeman fu wi be e suku fu kii, no?
eng_text: Then said some of them of Jerusalem, Is not this he, whom they seek to kill?

djk_text: Ne a de a lanti mindii ya e taki so meke ala sama e si? Da sama á de ya fu tapu enseefi. A sa de taki den gaansama fu u si taki a man ya na a Kelestesi?
eng_text: But, lo, he speaketh boldly, and they say nothing unto him. Do the rulers know indeed that this is the very Christ?

djk_text: Ma te a Kelestesi o kon, ná wan sama o sabi pe a o komoto. Ma a sama ya, u sabi en bunbun. Da u sabi on se a komoto.”
eng_text: Howbeit we know this man whence he is: but when Christ cometh, no man knoweth whence he is.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi bali taki moo taanga a pe a be de na a Mama Keliki de e leli den sama. A taki: “Eeye! U sabi mi! U sabi pe mi komoto tu! Ma anga ala fa u sabi mi de, toku mi á kon fu miseefi. Ma na wan sama sende mi kon. Da a sama ya á de wan sama di e lei. Ma u á sabi a sama di sende mi kon.
eng_text: Then cried Jesus in the temple as he taught, saying, Ye both know me, and ye know whence I am: and I am not come of myself, but he that sent me is true, whom ye know not.

djk_text: Ma mi, mi sabi en. Bika na anda mi komoto. Ne en sende mi kon ya.”
eng_text: But I know him: for I am from him, and he hath sent me.

djk_text: Ne di a taki so, ne den e suku wan fasi fu kisi en. Ma toku ná wan sama di naki ana ne en, bika en yuu á be doo ete.
eng_text: Then they sought to take him: but no man laid hands on him, because his hour was not yet come.

djk_text: Ma somen fu den sama be daai kon e biibi ne en. Ne den akisi taki: “Te Kelestesi o kon, a o du moo gaan foondoo sani moo den di a sama ya e du?”
eng_text: And many of the people believed on him, and said, When Christ cometh, will he do more miracles than these which this man hath done?

djk_text: Ma namo, da den Faliseiman yee taki somen sama e biibi taki Masaa Jesesi na a Kelestesi. Na fu dati ede meke den Faliseiman anga den begiman fu keliki sende sikowtu fu go kisi Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: The Pharisees heard that the people murmured such things concerning him; and the Pharisees and the chief priests sent officers to take him.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Mi o tan wan pisiten anga u ete. Ma bakadati, da mi o daai go baka, na a sama di be sende mi kon a goontapu.
eng_text: Then said Jesus unto them, Yet a little while am I with you, and then I go unto him that sent me.

djk_text: Da u o suku mi, ma u ná o fende mi. Da soseefi tu, u ná o poi kon a pe mi o de.”
eng_text: Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither ye cannot come.

djk_text: Ne den edeman fu den Dyu kuutu kuutu anga den seefi. Den taki: “Da pe a o go te u ná o si en moo? A sa de taki a o go a den taa kondee pe den Dyu paati paati go e tan fu a go leli den Giiki sama?
eng_text: Then said the Jews among themselves, Whither will he go, that we shall not find him? will he go unto the dispersed among the Gentiles, and teach the Gentiles?

djk_text: San na a sani di a taki de, taki: ‘Wi o suku mi, ma u ná o fende mi.’ Anga taki pe ai go u ná o poi go anda? San wani taki dati?”
eng_text: What manner of saying is this that he said, Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither ye cannot come?

djk_text: Ma namo, da a kiiboi dei fu a piisii e bigi moo ala den taa dei. We, ne a dei de, ne Masaa Jesesi opo taampu, ne a bali taki taanga taki: “Sama di dee wataa kisi, meke a kon a mi kon diingi.
eng_text: In the last day, that great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink.

djk_text: Bika a sikiifi a Gadu Buku taki, liba fu wataa di e gi libi o lon komoto a ini wan sama di teke biibi a mi, ati, e kon a doo.”
eng_text: He that believeth on me, as the scripture hath said, out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water.

djk_text: Da anga ala fa Masaa Jesesi taki ya, da na a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu a be e taki. Bika a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu e gi libi. Da Masaa Gadu o gi den sama di e biibi ne en, a Jeje fi en. Bika a á be gi den sama a Jeje fi en ete, fu di Masaa Jesesi á be opo go fu Masaa Gadu fu teke a waiti fasi fi en ete.
eng_text: (But this spake he of the Spirit, which they that believe on him should receive: for the Holy Ghost was not yet given; because that Jesus was not yet glorified.)

djk_text: We, son sama di be yee den toli fu Masaa Jesesi be taki: “Eeye! Fu tuu! Disi na a apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: Many of the people therefore, when they heard this saying, said, Of a truth this is the Prophet.

djk_text: Taawan taki: “Eeye! Disi na a Kelestesi seefi.” Taawan baka taki: “Sama taki so? Na Galileya a Kelestesi be o komoto?
eng_text: Others said, This is the Christ. But some said, Shall Christ come out of Galilee?

djk_text: We bika, Masaa Gadu Buku taki: ‘A Kelestesi na wan bakaten Manpikin fu Kownu Dafeti paansu. Da na Betelehem a o komoto, a pe Kownu Dafeti be e tan.’ ”
eng_text: Hath not the scripture said, That Christ cometh of the seed of David, and out of the town of Bethlehem, where David was?

djk_text: We, na so paati kon a den sama mindii fu Masaa Jesesi ede.
eng_text: So there was a division among the people because of him.

djk_text: Son fu den be wani go kisi en. Ma toku seefi ná wan sama di naki ana ne en.
eng_text: And some of them would have taken him; but no man laid hands on him.

djk_text: We, di den sikowtu daai go baka a den apaiti begiman fu a Mama Keliki anga den Faliseiman, ne den akisi den taki: “Saide meke u á kisi en tyai kon?”
eng_text: Then came the officers to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said unto them, Why have ye not brought him?

djk_text: Ne den sikowtu piki den taki: “Di u go a taki anga u. Ma namo, di u yee fa ai taki, da u si taki ná wan sama u be yee taki so wanten.”
eng_text: The officers answered, Never man spake like this man.

djk_text: “Oho! San u taki. A koli u kisi tu?
eng_text: Then answered them the Pharisees, Are ye also deceived?

djk_text: Di u de ya, u si taki wan fu den edeman fu u efu wan fu den Faliseiman, biibi ne en wan dei?
eng_text: Have any of the rulers or of the Pharisees believed on him?

djk_text: U á sabi taki na den sama ya di á sabi ná wan sani fu Gadu weiti e biibi ne en, no? We, heelu fu den!”
eng_text: But this people who knoweth not the law are cursed.

djk_text: We, ne Nikodeimisi, wan gaan edeman fu den Dyu, di be kon a Masaa Jesesi wan neti, akisi den taki:
eng_text: Nicodemus saith unto them, (he that came to Jesus by night, being one of them,)

djk_text: “We, fa a weiti fu u de? U sa kuutu wan sama gi en sitaafu sondee fu ondoosuku en fini fini fosi? Efu sondee fu u sabi san a du?”
eng_text: Doth our law judge any man, before it hear him, and know what he doeth?

djk_text: Ne den piki en taki: “Oho! I toon fu Galileya tu? Go ondoosuku luku a Gadu Buku fini fini. Da i sa si taki noiti wan apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu o komoto a Galileya Kondee.”
eng_text: They answered and said unto him, Art thou also of Galilee? Search, and look: for out of Galilee ariseth no prophet.

djk_text: Ne di den taki so kaba, ne den booko paati, ne den go a osu.
eng_text: And every man went unto his own house.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi dati go na a mongo di den e kai Oleifi Mongo.
eng_text: Jesus went unto the mount of Olives.

djk_text: Da a taa dei fi en, fuuku mamanten, ne a kon baka a ini a Mama Keliki fu den Dyu. Da ala sama be e kon ne en. Ne a go sidon, ne ai leli den.
eng_text: And early in the morning he came again into the temple, and all the people came unto him; and he sat down, and taught them.

djk_text: Ma den leliman fu weiti anga den Faliseiman tyai wan uman kon ne en. Den kisi a uman ya anga e du ogii ne en man osu. Ne den tyai en kon poti a mindii na ala den sama fesi.
eng_text: And the scribes and Pharisees brought unto him a woman taken in adultery; and when they had set her in the midst,

djk_text: Ne den taigi en taki: “Mesiti, den kisi a uman ya dyonson dyonson ya e du ogii ne en man osu.
eng_text: They say unto him, Master, this woman was taken in adultery, in the very act.

djk_text: Mosesi be sikiifi gi wi a ini a weiti taki, efu u kisi so wan sama u mu naki en anga siton kii. Da san yu e taki fu a uman ya?”
eng_text: Now Moses in the law commanded us, that such should be stoned: but what sayest thou?

djk_text: Ma a sani di den be akisi Masaa Jesesi ya, na akisi den be akisi en fu tesi en anga fu den fende sani fu go kaagi en. Ma Masaa Jesesi bendi, ne ai sikiifi anga en finga a doti.
eng_text: This they said, tempting him, that they might have to accuse him. But Jesus stooped down, and with his finger wrote on the ground, as though he heard them not.

djk_text: Ma di den tan e akisi en naamo, ne a opo baka, ne a taigi den taki: “Sama fu u di á du ogii wan dei, da meke a fiingi a fosi siton naki a uman.”
eng_text: So when they continued asking him, he lifted up himself, and said unto them, He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.

djk_text: Ne a bendi baka e sikiifi a doti.
eng_text: And again he stooped down, and wrote on the ground.

djk_text: Ma di den yee so, ne ala den fiya go a doo. Den gaanwan anga den yonkuwan, wan fu wan a taawan baka. Den moo gaanwan a fesi, den yonkuwan a baka. Ne na so den fika Masaa Jesesi anga a uman wawan de, enke fa den be tyai en kon poti.
eng_text: And they which heard it, being convicted by their own conscience, went out one by one, beginning at the eldest, even unto the last: and Jesus was left alone, and the woman standing in the midst.

djk_text: We, di Masaa Jesesi opo, ne a akisi en taki: “Uman! Pe den sama di be tyai i kon kaagi de? Ná wan sama kuutu yu, no?”
eng_text: When Jesus had lifted up himself, and saw none but the woman, he said unto her, Woman, where are those thine accusers? hath no man condemned thee?

djk_text: Ne a uman piki en taki: “Masaa, ná wan sama.” Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi en taki: “We, miseefi nái kuutu yu tu. Go a osu. Ma ná du ogii moo.”
eng_text: She said, No man, Lord. And Jesus said unto her, Neither do I condemn thee: go, and sin no more.

djk_text: Da wan taa leisi, da Masaa Jesesi be e leli den sama baka. Ne a leli den taki: “Mi na a leti fu goontapu. A sama di o waka kon a mi baka, a ná o waka a ini dunguu. Ma a sa abi a leti di e gi libi.”
eng_text: Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.

djk_text: Ma now, ne den Faliseiman taigi en taki: “Yu e taki fu iseefi. Da wi á poi teke a taki fi i de taki na tuu.”
eng_text: The Pharisees therefore said unto him, Thou bearest record of thyself; thy record is not true.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Winsi mi e taki fu miseefi, toku a taki fu mi na tuu. Bika mi sabi pe mi komoto anga pe mi e go. Ma u á sabi pe mi komoto, efu pe mi e go.
eng_text: Jesus answered and said unto them, Though I bear record of myself, yet my record is true: for I know whence I came, and whither I go; but ye cannot tell whence I come, and whither I go.

djk_text: U e kuutu na libisama fasi. Ma mi nái kuutu ná wan sama.
eng_text: Ye judge after the flesh; I judge no man.

djk_text: Ma winsi mi kuutu wan sama seefi, toku a kuutu fu mi na tuu. Bika a ná mi wawan e kuutu, ma mi Tata di be sende mi kon de anga mi.
eng_text: And yet if I judge, my judgment is true: for I am not alone, but I and the Father that sent me.

djk_text: A ini u weiti seefi a sikiifi taki, te tu sama kotoigi fu wan sani, da a de tuu.
eng_text: It is also written in your law, that the testimony of two men is true.

djk_text: We, miseefi taki fu miseefi, ma mi Tata di be sende mi kon e taki fu mi tu.”
eng_text: I am one that bear witness of myself, and the Father that sent me beareth witness of me.

djk_text: Ne den akisi en now taki: “Pe yu Tata de?” Ma Jesesi piki den taki: “U á sabi mi. Da soseefi u á sabi mi Tata tu. Bika, efu u be sabi mi, da u be o sabi mi Tata.”
eng_text: Then said they unto him, Where is thy Father? Jesus answered, Ye neither know me, nor my Father: if ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also.

djk_text: Da Masaa Jesesi be de koosube fu a baki pe den e tyai moni kon poti gi Masaa Gadu a ini a Mama Keliki fu den Dyu. Ma ná wan sama di kisi en. Bika en ten á be kisi ete.
eng_text: These words spake Jesus in the treasury, as he taught in the temple: and no man laid hands on him; for his hour was not yet come.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “Mi e gwe. Da u o suku mi. Ma u sa dede a ini u takuudu anga ogii. Pe mi e go u ná o poi kon anda.”
eng_text: Then said Jesus again unto them, I go my way, and ye shall seek me, and shall die in your sins: whither I go, ye cannot come.

djk_text: Ne den Dyu edeman taki: “We, on se a o go, di a taki pe ai go u ná o poi kon anda? A sa de taki, na kii a o go kii enseefi?”
eng_text: Then said the Jews, Will he kill himself? because he saith, Whither I go, ye cannot come.

djk_text: Ma a piki den taki: “U na fu ondoo ya. Ma mi na fu tapu anda. U na fu a goontapu ya, ma mi a ná fu a goontapu ya.
eng_text: And he said unto them, Ye are from beneath; I am from above: ye are of this world; I am not of this world.

djk_text: Na fu dati ede meke mi be taigi u taki, u sa dede a ini u takuudu anga ogii. Bika, efu u á wani teke taki mi na a sama, di mi taigi u taki mi de, da u o dede a ini u takuudu anga ogii.”
eng_text: I said therefore unto you, that ye shall die in your sins: for if ye believe not that I am he, ye shall die in your sins.

djk_text: Ma now den akisi en taki: “We, sama na yu seefi?” Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “We, leti enke fa mi be taigi u kaba na a bigin, na a seefi sama de mi de.
eng_text: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? And Jesus saith unto them, Even the same that I said unto you from the beginning.

djk_text: Mi abi somen sani di mi sa teke kuutu u. Bika a sama di sende mi kon, na tuutuu sani ai taki. Da na san a taigi mi, na dati mi e taigi goontapu.”
eng_text: I have many things to say and to judge of you: but he that sent me is true; and I speak to the world those things which I have heard of him.

djk_text: Ma den á fusutan taki na sani fi en Tata a be e taki.
eng_text: They understood not that he spake to them of the Father.

djk_text: Na fu dati ede meke Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “Na te u opo a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya, fosi u o sabi sama ne en. U o sabi taki, a nái du nái wan sani fi enseefi. Bika na san di en Tata leli en, na dati ai taki.
eng_text: Then said Jesus unto them, When ye have lifted up the Son of man, then shall ye know that I am he, and that I do nothing of myself; but as my Father hath taught me, I speak these things.

djk_text: Da, enke fa Gadu sende mi kon ya, da a de anga mi. A nái fika mi wawan. Bika alaten mi e du san kai anga en.”
eng_text: And he that sent me is with me: the Father hath not left me alone; for I do always those things that please him.

djk_text: Da di Masaa Jesesi taki so, ne somen sama daai kon e biibi ne en.
eng_text: As he spake these words, many believed on him.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den Dyu di be e biibi ne en taki: “Efu u teke den sani di mi e leli u, da u sa de tuutuu bakaman fu mi.
eng_text: Then said Jesus to those Jews which believed on him, If ye continue in my word, then are ye my disciples indeed;

djk_text: Da u sa sabi den tuutuu sani fu Gadu. Da te u kon sabi den sani ya so kaba, da a sa meke u fii komoto a saafu, fu u de boo boo.”
eng_text: And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.

djk_text: Ne den taigi en taki: “Wi na pikin fu Abalaham. Noiti u be de saafu fu wan sama. Da fa yu e taki, u sa kon fii, komoto a saafu, fu de boo boo?”
eng_text: They answered him, We be Abraham's seed, and were never in bondage to any man: how sayest thou, Ye shall be made free?

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Fu tuutuu mi e taigi u taki, a sama di e du ogii, en na wan saafu fu ogii.
eng_text: Jesus answered them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whosoever committeth sin is the servant of sin.

djk_text: We, efi i de wan saafu e wooko gi wan sama, da na saafu namo i de e go e kon. I nái tan fu ala ten a ini osu. Ma a manpikin fu a sama di yu e wooko gi e tan fu alaten a ini a osu.
eng_text: And the servant abideth not in the house for ever: but the Son abideth ever.

djk_text: We, efu a Manpikin puu yu a saafu a katibo, meke i fii, da i fii tuutuu.
eng_text: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.

djk_text: Mi sabi taki u na pikin fu Abalaham. Ma u e suku fu kii mi. Bika u nái teke den sani di mi e leli u.
eng_text: I know that ye are Abraham's seed; but ye seek to kill me, because my word hath no place in you.

djk_text: Da na san mi Tata soi mi, na dati mi e leli. Ma u e du san u tata taigi u fu du.”
eng_text: I speak that which I have seen with my Father: and ye do that which ye have seen with your father.

djk_text: Ne den taigi Masaa Jesesi taki: “Abalaham na wi tata.” Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “Efu u na be pikin fu Abalaham, da u be o du den sani di Abalaham be e du.
eng_text: They answered and said unto him, Abraham is our father. Jesus saith unto them, If ye were Abraham's children, ye would do the works of Abraham.

djk_text: Ma now u e suku fu kii mi. Mi di e leli u den tuutuu sani di Masaa Gadu soi mi. Noiti wan ten Abalaham be o du so wan sani.
eng_text: But now ye seek to kill me, a man that hath told you the truth, which I have heard of God: this did not Abraham.

djk_text: Na den wooko fu u tata u e du.” Ne den taigi Masaa Jesesi taki: “Wi a ná basa nengee. Wi abi wankodo Tata, dati na Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: Ye do the deeds of your father. Then said they to him, We be not born of fornication; we have one Father, even God.

djk_text: Ne Jesesi taigi den taki: “Efu Gadu na be u Tata, da u be o lobi mi. Bika na Gadu sende mi kon. A ná miseefi komoto kon, ma na Gadu sende mi kon.
eng_text: Jesus said unto them, If God were your Father, ye would love me: for I proceeded forth and came from God; neither came I of myself, but he sent me.

djk_text: Ma u sabi saide u nái fusutan san mi e taki? Na fu di u á wani aliki mi.
eng_text: Why do ye not understand my speech? even because ye cannot hear my word.

djk_text: Na didibii na u tata. Da na san di bun a u tata, na dati u e du. Fanafu a bigin, ne ai kii libisama. A á poi de a ini den tuutuu sani fu Gadu. Bika tuu á de ne en ati ini seefi seefi. Na soso lei a sabi fu lei. Bika en na wan leiman, a tata fu lei.
eng_text: Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.

djk_text: Ma u á wani biibi mi fu den tuutuu sani fu Gadu di mi teke taigi u.
eng_text: And because I tell you the truth, ye believe me not.

djk_text: On di fu u sa soi finga a mi taki, mi du ogii wan dei? We, efu na tuutuu sani mi e taki, da saide meke u nái biibi mi?
eng_text: Which of you convinceth me of sin? And if I say the truth, why do ye not believe me?

djk_text: Sama di de fu Gadu o teke Gadu wowtu. Ma na fu di u a ná sama fu Gadu, na fu dati ede meke u á wani aliki Gadu wowtu.”
eng_text: He that is of God heareth God's words: ye therefore hear them not, because ye are not of God.

djk_text: Ma now, ne den Dyu piki en taki: “We, u be taigi yu kaba taki, didibii de a yu tapu, yu ogii sani Samaliya sama yu!”
eng_text: Then answered the Jews, and said unto him, Say we not well that thou art a Samaritan, and hast a devil?

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Didibii á de a mi tapu. Na lesipeki mi e lesipeki mi Tata. Ma u nái lesipeki mi.
eng_text: Jesus answered, I have not a devil; but I honour my Father, and ye do dishonour me.

djk_text: Mi nái suku lesipeki gi miseefi. Ma wan sama de di e suku en gi mi. Da na a sama ya e kuutu, leti enke fa a mu de.
eng_text: And I seek not mine own glory: there is one that seeketh and judgeth.

djk_text: Fu tuutuu mi e taigi u taki: ‘Efu wan sama teke den sani di mi e leli ya, da a ná o dede noiti wanten moo.’ ”
eng_text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, If a man keep my saying, he shall never see death.

djk_text: Ne den Dyu taigi en taki: “A nowfosi u e si kiinkiin taki na didibii de a yu tapu. Bika Abalaham dede kaba. Da soseefi den fositen apaiti takiman fu Gadu seefi dede tu. Ne toku i de ya e taki, taki efu wan sama teke den sani di yu e leli, da a ná o dede noiti wanten moo.
eng_text: Then said the Jews unto him, Now we know that thou hast a devil. Abraham is dead, and the prophets; and thou sayest, If a man keep my saying, he shall never taste of death.

djk_text: I bigi moo wi tata Abalaham efu wan fu den fositen apaiti takiman fu Gadu di dede kaba? San yu e denki fi i seefi?”
eng_text: Art thou greater than our father Abraham, which is dead? and the prophets are dead: whom makest thou thyself?

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Efu mi e suku lesipeki gi mi seefi, da a lesipeki fu mi na wan soso lesipeki. Ma a mi Tata di u taki na a Gadu fu u, ne en e hei mi.
eng_text: Jesus answered, If I honour myself, my honour is nothing: it is my Father that honoureth me; of whom ye say, that he is your God:

djk_text: U á sabi en, ma mi sabi en. Da, efu mi taki, taki mi á sabi en, da mi na wan leiman enke u tu. Ma mi sabi en, da mi e du san a taki.
eng_text: Yet ye have not known him; but I know him: and if I should say, I know him not, I shall be a liar like unto you: but I know him, and keep his saying.

djk_text: U tata Abalaham be piisii fu tuu, fu di a sabi taki a o si a dei di mi o kon a goontapu ya. Ma a si en tu. Da a piisii, te ná sipowtu.”
eng_text: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day: and he saw it, and was glad.

djk_text: Ma den Dyu taigi en taki: “Yu á doo feifitenti yali ete seefi, ne yu e bali taki, i be si Abalaham?”
eng_text: Then said the Jews unto him, Thou art not yet fifty years old, and hast thou seen Abraham?

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “Fu tuutuu mi e taigi u taki: ‘Mi de bifo Abalaham be de.’ ”
eng_text: Jesus said unto them, Verily,verily, I say unto you, Before Abraham was, I am.

djk_text: We, di a taki so, ne den lon go teke siton fu naki en kii. Ma Masaa Jesesi pasa a den sama mindii kuli, komoto a Mama Keliki osu gwe fiyaa.
eng_text: Then took they up stones to cast at him: but Jesus hid himself, and went out of the temple, going through the midst of them, and so passed by.

djk_text: Ne di Masaa Jesesi e gwe de, ne a miti wan man. Da fanafu a man ya kon a goontapu a be de beendi beendi.
eng_text: And as Jesus passed by, he saw a man which was blind from his birth.

djk_text: Ne den bakaman fi en akisi en taki: “Labai! Saide meke a man ya meke kon de beendi beendi so? Sama fu a man ya du ogii? Ne en seefi du ogii? Ofu ne en dda anga en mma?”
eng_text: And his disciples asked him, saying, Master, who did sin, this man, or his parents, that he was born blind?

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “A ná ogii a man ya du. Soseefi a ná en mma anga dda du ogii tu. Ma a sani ya pasa anga en fu a kaakiti fu Gadu mu kon a kiin.
eng_text: Jesus answered, Neither hath this man sinned, nor his parents: but that the works of God should be made manifest in him.

djk_text: We, mi mu wooko den wooko fu a sama di sende mi kon, solanga dei de. Bika neti e kon, da ná wan sama o poi wooko moo.
eng_text: I must work the works of him that sent me, while it is day: the night cometh, when no man can work.

djk_text: Da solanga mi de a goontapu, mi na a leti fu goontapu.”
eng_text: As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world.

djk_text: Di a taigi den so, ne a towe wataa mofu a doti, ne a meke poto poto anga en. Ne a teke a papa doti, ne a lobi na a beendiman ain.
eng_text: When he had thus spoken, he spat on the ground, and made clay of the spittle, and he anointed the eyes of the blind man with the clay,

djk_text: Ne a taigi a beendiman taki: “Go wasi i fesi a ini Silowam Peti.” We, ne a sama go, ne a wasi en fesi. Ne a man gwe anga kiinkiin ain.
eng_text: And said unto him, Go, wash in the pool of Siloam, (which is by interpretation, Sent.) He went his way therefore, and washed, and came seeing.

djk_text: We, ne den sama di e tan koosube fi en, anga den sama di be sabi en a fositen di a be beendi ete taki: “Tan, a ná man di be sidon ya e begi moni, no?”
eng_text: The neighbours therefore, and they which before had seen him that he was blind, said, Is not this he that sat and begged?

djk_text: Wantu fu den baka taki: “Iya! Ne en!” Taawan taki: “Nono, ma a gei en!” Ma a man seefi taki: “Iya! Na mi.”
eng_text: Some said, This is he: others said, He is like him: but he said, I am he.

djk_text: Ne den akisi en taki: “We, on fa yu ain du opo te yu e si sani?”
eng_text: Therefore said they unto him, How were thine eyes opened?

djk_text: Ne a piki taki: “Na wan sama di den e kai Jesesi meke wan poto poto lobi a mi ain. Ne a sende mi fu mi go wasi mi fesi a Silowam Peti. Ne mi go, ne mi wasi mi fesi, ne mi ain kon kiin.”
eng_text: He answered and said, A man that is called Jesus made clay, and anointed mine eyes, and said unto me, Go to the pool of Siloam, and wash: and I went and washed, and I received sight.

djk_text: Ne den akisi en baka taki: “Pe a sama de, de?” Ne a man piki den taki: “We, mi á sabi.”
eng_text: Then said they unto him, Where is he? He said, I know not.

djk_text: We, ne den teke a man di be beendi fosi, ne den tyai en go a den Faliseiman.
eng_text: They brought to the Pharisees him that aforetime was blind.

djk_text: Ma namo, da a dei di Masaa Jesesi be meke a poto poto opo a man ya ain, na be wan kina dei fu den Dyu.
eng_text: And it was the sabbath day when Jesus made the clay, and opened his eyes.

djk_text: Ne den Faliseiman akisi a man ya fa en ain be du opo. Ne a sama taigi den taki: “Na poto poto a teke poti a mi ain. Ne mi go wasi mi fesi, ne na so mi ain opo.”
eng_text: Then again the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight. He said unto them, He put clay upon mine eyes, and I washed, and do see.

djk_text: Ne son fu den Faliseiman taki: “A sama de, a ná wan sama fu Gadu! Bika a ná oli a kina dei!” Ma den taawan taki: “Fa wan ogiilibi sama sa du so wan gaan foondoo sani?” Na so den bigin anga wan takitaki anga denseefi.
eng_text: Therefore said some of the Pharisees, This man is not of God, because he keepeth not the sabbath day. Others said, How can a man that is a sinner do such miracles? And there was a division among them.

djk_text: Ne den akisi a man di be beendi baka taki: “We, san yu e taki fu a sama di opo yu ain de?” Ne a man piki den taki: “We, na wan apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: They say unto the blind man again, What sayest thou of him, that he hath opened thine eyes? He said, He is a prophet.

djk_text: Ma now den Dyu á wani biibi moo seefi taki a be beendi a fesi, ma now a sa si baka. Ne den kai en dda anga en mma kon.
eng_text: But the Jews did not believe concerning him, that he had been blind, and received his sight, until they called the parents of him that had received his sight.

djk_text: Ne den akisi den taki: “San u e taki? A sama ya na u pikin di u taki be meke beendi beendi? Fa a du taki a sa si now?”
eng_text: And they asked them, saying, Is this your son, who ye say was born blind? how then doth he now see?

djk_text: Ma a dda anga a mma piki den taki: “Wi sabi taki na wi pikin. Da soseefi wi sabi taki a be meke beendi beendi.
eng_text: His parents answered them and said, We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind:

djk_text: Ma fa a du kon taki ai si baka, dati u á sabi. Da wi á sabi tu sama meke ai si baka. En seefi bigi sai kaba fu taki. U akisi en meke enseefi taki.”
eng_text: But by what means he now seeth, we know not; or who hath opened his eyes, we know not: he is of age; ask him: he shall speak for himself.

djk_text: Ma na fu di en dda anga en mma be e feele den Dyu edeman, meke den be taki so. Bika den edeman be tapu pasi gi den kaba taki, efu wan sama taki, taki Jesesi na a Kelestesi, da den o puu so wan sama na a keliki.
eng_text: These words spake his parents, because they feared the Jews: for the Jews had agreed already, that if any man did confess that he was Christ, he should be put out of the synagogue.

djk_text: Na fu dati ede meke en dda anga en mma be taigi den taki meke den akisi en enseefi, a bigi sai kaba fu taki.
eng_text: Therefore said his parents, He is of age; ask him.

djk_text: Ne den kai a man di be beendi kon baka a den di fu tu toon. Ne den taigi en taki: “Man, sweli a Gadu fesi taki na wan tuutuu sani yu o taki. Bika u sabi taki a sama di yu e taki opo yu ain de na wan ogiilibi sama.”
eng_text: Then again called they the man that was blind, and said unto him, Give God the praise: we know that this man is a sinner.

djk_text: Ne a man piki den taki: “Efu a man de na wan ogiilibi sama mi á sabi. Ma san mi sabi, na taki mi be beendi, ma now mi e si.”
eng_text: He answered and said, Whether he be a sinner or no, I know not: one thing I know, that, whereas I was blind, now I see.

djk_text: Ne den akisi en taki: “San a du gi yu? Fa a du opo yu ain?”
eng_text: Then said they to him again, What did he to thee? how opened he thine eyes?

djk_text: Ne a man piki den taki: “Mi be taigi u kaba, ma u á wani yee mi. Saide meke u wani meke mi taki a sani ete wan toon? A wani u wani toon bakaman fi en tu?”
eng_text: He answered them, I have told you already, and ye did not hear: wherefore would ye hear it again? will ye also be his disciples?

djk_text: Ma now, ne den kosi a man. Den taki: “Nono! Na yu na wan bakaman fu a man de. Ma wi na bakaman fu Mosesi.
eng_text: Then they reviled him, and said, Thou art his disciple; but we are Moses' disciples.

djk_text: Wi sabi taki anga Mosesi Gadu be taki. Ma u á sabi seefi seefi, pe a sama ya komoto.”
eng_text: We know that God spake unto Moses: as for this fellow, we know not from whence he is.

djk_text: Ne a man piki den taki: “We, da a foondoo mi, di u taki u á sabi pe a man ya komoto. Bika a opo mi ain.
eng_text: The man answered and said unto them, Why herein is a marvellous thing, that ye know not from whence he is, and yet he hath opened mine eyes.

djk_text: Bika wi sabi taki Gadu nái piki a begi fu wan ogiilibi sama. Ma na sama di e lesipeki en e du sani a taki, na den begi fu den ai piki.
eng_text: Now we know that God heareth not sinners: but if any man be a worshipper of God, and doeth his will, him he heareth.

djk_text: Fu senten di goontapu de, wi á yee noiti ete taki, wan sama be opo wan sama di meke beendi beendi ain.
eng_text: Since the world began was it not heard that any man opened the eyes of one that was born blind.

djk_text: Efu a sama ya, a ná Gadu a be komoto, da a á be o poi du so wan sani.”
eng_text: If this man were not of God, he could do nothing.

djk_text: Ne den piki en taki: “Yu á sabi taki na takuudu anga ogii meke den be meke i beendi beendi so, no? Ne san yu abi fu kon leli wi?” Ne den toto en puu poti a doo.
eng_text: They answered and said unto him, Thou wast altogether born in sins, and dost thou teach us? And they cast him out.

djk_text: We, di Masaa Jesesi yee taki den yaki a man toto en puu poti a doo, ne di a miti anga en baka, ne a akisi en taki: “We, on fa? Yu e biibi na a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya?”
eng_text: Jesus heard that they had cast him out; and when he had found him, he said unto him, Dost thou believe on the Son of God?

djk_text: Ne a man piki en taki: “Masaa, on pe a sama de de? Mi wani biibi ne en!”
eng_text: He answered and said, Who is he, Lord, that I might believe on him?

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “We, na a sama di i si e taki anga yu ya, ne disi!”
eng_text: And Jesus said unto him, Thou hast both seen him, and it is he that talketh with thee.

djk_text: Ne a man taki: “Masaa, mi e biibi!” Ne a saka anga kini a doti gi en gaandi.
eng_text: And he said, Lord, I believe. And he worshipped him.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taki: “We, i si fa mi kon a goontapu ya, da na kon mi kon fu meke libisama kuutu paati anga denseefi, fu den beendiman daai kon sa si anga fu den di e si daai kon toon beendiman.”
eng_text: And Jesus said, For judgment I am come into this world, that they which see not might see; and that they which see might be made blind.

djk_text: We, son fu den Faliseiman di be de ape anga en yee tu san a taigi a man ya. Ne den akisi en taki: “Fa i taki de, we, da u beendi tu?”
eng_text: And some of the Pharisees which were with him heard these words, and said unto him, Are we blind also?

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “Efu u be piki taki u be beendi, da u á be o du ogii. Ma fu di u taki u ain kiin kaba, da na fu dati ede meke u fika a ini ogii.”
eng_text: Jesus said unto them, If ye were blind, ye should have no sin: but now ye say, We see; therefore your sin remaineth.

djk_text: Fu tuutuu mi e taigi u taki: “A sama di e suku fu pasa a wan taa peesi go a ini a pen fu den sikapu boiti a doo, na wan fufuuman efu wan kiiman.
eng_text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that entereth not by the door into the sheepfold, but climbeth up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber.

djk_text: Ma, a sama di e waka pasa na a doo go a ini a pen fu den sikapu, ne en na wan soluguman fu den sikapu.
eng_text: But he that entereth in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.

djk_text: Te a kon, da wanten a man di e oli waki na a pen e opo a doo fu a pen gi en. Da o kai den sikapu fi en a nen, da den sikapu o yee en tongo. Da a o tyai den puu a ini a koi go a doo.
eng_text: To him the porter openeth; and the sheep hear his voice: and he calleth his own sheep by name, and leadeth them out.

djk_text: Da te a tyai den go a doo, da ai waka a den fesi, da den sikapu e waka ne en baka. Bika den sikapu sabi en tongo.
eng_text: And when he putteth forth his own sheep, he goeth before them, and the sheep follow him: for they know his voice.

djk_text: Ma te taa sama o kon, da den ná o komoto go waka ne en baka. Ma den o lon gwe, bika den á sabi a sama de.”
eng_text: And a stranger will they not follow, but will flee from him: for they know not the voice of strangers.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi be gi den a ageisi toli ya. Ma den á be fusutan seefi seefi san a be wani taki.
eng_text: This parable spake Jesus unto them: but they understood not what things they were which he spake unto them.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “Fu tuutuu mi e taigi u ete wan toon taki, miseefi na a doo di sama sa waka pasa go a ini a pen fu den sikapu.
