eng_text: Then said Jesus unto them again, Verily, verily, I say unto you, I am the door of the sheep.

djk_text: Ibii sama di be kon a mi fesi, na soso fufuuman anga kiiman. Na fu dati ede meke den sama ná aliki den, leti enke fa i si sikapu nái fitoow wan sama di den á sabi.
eng_text: All that ever came before me are thieves and robbers: but the sheep did not hear them.

djk_text: Da leti enke fa i si wan sama sa waka pasa a wan opo opo doo go a ini wan osu, da na letiso mi de fu u waka pasa go a ini fu fende a bun solugu fu Gadu. Na mi na a doo fu a koi fu den sikapu fu Gadu. A mi u sa go a ini kon a doo on ten u wani.
eng_text: I am the door: by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved, and shall go in and out, and find pasture.

djk_text: Ma wan fufuuman, te a kon, ai kon namo fu fufuu anga kii anga booko sani poli kaba a soso. Ma mi kon fu gi libi a libi tapu te a pasa peesi.”
eng_text: The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.

djk_text: “Mi na a bunbun soluguman fu den sikapu. Da leti enke fa i si a soluguman fu den sikapu e kibii den sikapu fi en, na letiso mi sa gi mi libi fu kibii den bakaman fu mi tu fu sani á du den.
eng_text: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep.

djk_text: Ma wan sama di den yuu fu luku den sikapu, di á de wan soluguman, á de so. Bika ná en abi den sikapu. Da te a si wan takuu meti e kon, da wanten wanten ai lon gwe fika den sikapu wawan. Da a takuu meti o kon, da a kisi son fu den. Da a yaki den paati.
eng_text: But he that is an hireling, and not the shepherd, whose own the sheep are not, seeth the wolf coming, and leaveth the sheep, and fleeth: and the wolf catcheth them, and scattereth the sheep.

djk_text: A sama di den be yuu lon gwe fi en. Bika na yuu namo den yuu en. A ná abi toobi anga den sikapu, bika a ná fi en.
eng_text: The hireling fleeth, because he is an hireling, and careth not for the sheep.

djk_text: “Ma mi na a bunbun soluguman fu den sikapu. Mi sabi den sikapu fu mi, da den sikapu fu mi seefi sabi mi tu.
eng_text: I am the good shepherd, and know my sheep, and am known of mine.

djk_text: Leti enke fa i si mi anga mi Tata sabi useefi, na letiso mi anga den sikapu fu mi sabi useefi tu. Da mi ná abi toobi fu dede gi den.
eng_text: As the Father knoweth me, even so know I the Father: and I lay down my life for the sheep.

djk_text: Ma mi abi taa sikapu ete, di á de na a kulu ya ete. Da den dati seefi mi mu tyai kon na a kulu ya tu. Bika den o yee mi tongo, da den kon a mi. Da na so a o de: Wankodo ipi sikapu anga wankodo soluguman.
eng_text: And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice; and there shall be one fold, and one shepherd.

djk_text: “Da mi Tata lobi mi, fu di mi e gi mi libi fu dede gi den sikapu fu teke en baka.
eng_text: Therefore doth my Father love me, because I lay down my life, that I might take it again.

djk_text: Ná wan sama o puu mi libi a mi. Nono! Kweti kweti! Ma na anga miseefi wani mi e dede. Mi abi a taanga fu dede. Ma soseefi mi abi a taanga fu teke mi libi baka tu. Bika na mi Tata seefi sende mi fu du dati.”
eng_text: No man taketh it from me, but I lay it down of myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. This commandment have I received of my Father.

djk_text: Da den wowtu fu Masaa Jesesi di a taki ya, meke den Dyu kisi den wan gaan toobi anga denseefi.
eng_text: There was a division therefore again among the Jews for these sayings.

djk_text: Somen fu den taki: “Na wan takuu jeje de na a man de tapu! Ai law! Saide meke u taampu de e aliki en ete?”
eng_text: And many of them said, He hath a devil, and is mad; why hear ye him?

djk_text: Taawan taki: “Na so wan sama di takuu jeje de ne en tapu e taki? Wan takuu jeje sa opo wan beendiman ain fu meke ai si baka?”
eng_text: Others said, These are not the words of him that hath a devil. Can a devil open the eyes of the blind?

djk_text: Da a yuu de, da den be abi wan piisii fesa fu den a Jelusalem. Da te den be e nyan a piisii ya, da den be e pakisei a ten di den be e wei a Mama Keliki gi Masaa Gadu. Da na a moo koo pisiten fu a yali a ini Islayeli Kondee.
eng_text: And it was at Jerusalem the feast of the dedication, and it was winter.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi de fi en, e koi na den baikon fu a Mama Keliki di den be e kai a Baikon fu Salomo.
eng_text: And Jesus walked in the temple in Solomon's porch.

djk_text: We, ne den Dyu kon lontu en de, ne den akisi en taki: “We, man, on langa yu o daai daai u ete? Taigi u kiinkiin. Yu na a Kelestesi? Taigi u meke u sabi.”
eng_text: Then came the Jews round about him, and said unto him, How long dost thou make us to doubt? If thou be the Christ, tell us plainly.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Mi be taigi u kaba. Ma u á wani biibi mi san mi taigi u. Bika den wooko di mi e du, a mi Tata nen e soi kiinkiin sama a mi.
eng_text: Jesus answered them, I told you, and ye believed not: the works that I do in my Father's name, they bear witness of me.

djk_text: Ma u nái biibi mi. Bika u a ná mi sikapu.
eng_text: But ye believe not, because ye are not of my sheep, as I said unto you.

djk_text: Den sikapu fu mi e waka a mi baka. Bika den sabi mi tongo, da den e du san mi taki. Da soseefi, miseefi sabi den tu.
eng_text: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me:

djk_text: Da mi e gi den a libi fu tego. Noiti wanten den sa lasi go kaba a soso moo. Da soseefi ná wan sani sa puu den a ini mi ana ini.
eng_text: And I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand.

djk_text: Bika mi Tata di gi mi den, bigi moo ala san di de. Da ná wan sama di poi puu den a ini mi Tata ana ini tu.
eng_text: My Father, which gave them me, is greater than all; and no man is able to pluck them out of my Father's hand.

djk_text: Bika mi anga mi Tata na awan.”
eng_text: I and my Father are one.

djk_text: Ma now di a taki a sani ya, ne den Dyu teke siton baka fu naki en kii.
eng_text: Then the Jews took up stones again to stone him.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “Mi du somen gaan foondoo foondoo wooko a u mindii fu soi u a kaakiti fu Gadu. We, fu on di fu den sani ya ede, meke u wani naki mi kii anga siton?”
eng_text: Jesus answered them, Many good works have I shewed you from my Father; for which of those works do ye stone me?

djk_text: We, ne den Dyu piki en taki: “We, a ná fu wan fu den foondoo foondoo wooko di i du meke u wani kii yu. Ma na fu di yu e oli Gadu a sipowtu. Bika yu na wan kuwownu libisama enke u ya. Ma yu e poti iseefi enke Gadu.”
eng_text: The Jews answered him, saying, For a good work we stone thee not; but for blasphemy; and because that thou, being a man, makest thyself God.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “A ná a ini useefi weiti a taki, Masaa Gadu taki: ‘U na gadu, no?’
eng_text: Jesus answered them, Is it not written in your law, I said, Ye are gods?

djk_text: We, wi sabi taki san Masaa Gadu Buku e taki na tuu fu alaten. Da Masaa Gadu e kai den sama di e teke a bosikopu fi en, gadu.
eng_text: If he called them gods, unto whom the word of God came, and the scripture cannot be broken;

djk_text: We, efu na den kuwownu libisama de a kai gadu, da fa fu Awan di Masaa Gadu teke poti apaiti fasi gi enseefi, sende kon a goontapu? Fa u sa taigi mi taki, mi e oli Masaa Gadu a sipowtu, fu di mi taki, mi na a Manpikin fu Masaa Gadu?
eng_text: Say ye of him, whom the Father hath sanctified, and sent into the world, Thou blasphemest; because I said, I am the Son of God?

djk_text: We, efu u si taki a ná den wooko fu mi Tata mi e du, da u ná abi fu biibi mi.
eng_text: If I do not the works of my Father, believe me not.

djk_text: Ma, efu na den wooko fu mi Tata mi e du, da u ná abi fu biibi mi seefi, ma u biibi den wooko. Bika te u biibi den wooko, da u sa kon fusutan fu sabi taki: A Tata de a ini mi. Da soseefi mi de a ini a Tata tu.”
eng_text: But if I do, though ye believe not me, believe the works: that ye may know, and believe, that the Father is in me, and I in him.

djk_text: Ma di Masaa Jesesi taki so, ne den e suku baka fu kisi en tyai gwe. Ma a waka saafi komoto a den ini de gwe.
eng_text: Therefore they sought again to take him: but he escaped out of their hand,

djk_text: Ne a koti go na abaa fu a Joodani Liba, a pe Johanisi be e dopu sama fosi. Ne a tan de.
eng_text: And went away again beyond Jordan into the place where John at first baptized; and there he abode.

djk_text: Ne somen sama kon ne en taki: “Na tuu. Johanisi a á be e du ná wan foondoo sani. Ma ala san di a be taki fu a sama ya, ala den fiya na tuu.”
eng_text: And many resorted unto him, and said, John did no miracle: but all things that John spake of this man were true.

djk_text: We, somen sama kon e biibi a Masaa Jesesi di a de ape.
eng_text: And many believed on him there.

djk_text: Ma namo, da wan man Lasalesi be de a wan pikin foto den e kai Betaniya. Da wan uman den e kai Maliya be e tan de tu anga en sisa Malita. Ma namo, da Lasalesi be kai a siki.
eng_text: Now a certain man was sick, named Lazarus, of Bethany, the town of Mary and her sister Martha.

djk_text: Da a Maliya ya, na a seefi uman di o tutu a sumee switi fatu a Masaa Jesesi futu dee Masaa futu baka anga en ede uwii. Da ne en baala Lasalesi be kai a siki.
eng_text: (It was that Mary which anointed the Lord with ointment, and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.)

djk_text: Da den tu sisa fu Lasalesi ya sende bosikopu gi Masaa Jesesi taki: “Masaa! I lobi mati kai a siki.”
eng_text: Therefore his sisters sent unto him, saying, Lord, behold, he whom thou lovest is sick.

djk_text: Ma di Masaa Jesesi yee a bosikopu, ne a taki: “A siki di a siki de, a ná wan siki di o kii en. Ma a siki o meke Masaa Gadu fende gaandi. Bika a Manpikin fu Masaa Gadu seefi o fende gaandi.”
eng_text: When Jesus heard that, he said, This sickness is not unto death, but for the glory of God, that the Son of God might be glorified thereby.

djk_text: We, Masaa Jesesi be lobi Malita anga en sisa anga Lasalesi tuutuu.
eng_text: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.

djk_text: Ma toku di a yee taki Lasalesi siki, a tan tu dei moo a pe a be de.
eng_text: When he had heard therefore that he was sick, he abode two days still in the same place where he was.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den bakaman fi en taki: “Meke u go baka a Judeja!”
eng_text: Then after that saith he to his disciples, Let us go into Judaea again.

djk_text: Ma den bakaman fi en taigi en taki: “Labai! Wantu dei pasa, den sama fu Judeja be wani kii yu anga siton, ne yu o go anda baka?”
eng_text: His disciples say unto him, Master, the Jews of late sought to stone thee; and goest thou thither again?

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “A ná twalufu yuu wan dei abi, no? We, sama di e waka a dei, ná o naki en futu. Bika ai si a leti fu a goontapu ya.
eng_text: Jesus answered, Are there not twelve hours in the day? If any man walk in the day, he stumbleth not, because he seeth the light of this world.

djk_text: Ma sama di e waka a neti, o naki en futu. Bika a ná abi ná wan leti.
eng_text: But if a man walk in the night, he stumbleth, because there is no light in him.

djk_text: Ne baka di a taki a sani ya, ne a taigi den bakaman fi en taki: ‘A mati fu wi, Lasalesi siibi. Ma mi e go anda fu weki en.’ ”
eng_text: These things said he: and after that he saith unto them, Our friend Lazarus sleepeth; but I go, that I may awake him out of sleep.

djk_text: We, ne den bakaman fi en taigi en taki: “We, efu ai siibi, da a o betee.”
eng_text: Then said his disciples, Lord, if he sleep, he shall do well.

djk_text: Ma na a dede fu Lasalesi Masaa Jesesi be e taki. Ma den bakaman fi en be denki taki na fu siibi wawan a be e taki.
eng_text: Howbeit Jesus spake of his death: but they thought that he had spoken of taking of rest in sleep.

djk_text: We, na fu dati ede meke Masaa Jesesi taigi den kiinkiin taki: “Lasalesi dede kaba.
eng_text: Then said Jesus unto them plainly, Lazarus is dead.

djk_text: Ma na fu u ede, mi piisii fu di mi á be de ape. Bika u abi a sani di o pasa de fanowdu. A o meke u a biibi fu u kon moo taanga. Ma, u meke u go ne en nownow.”
eng_text: And I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, to the intent ye may believe; nevertheless let us go unto him.

djk_text: Ma, Towmasi, di den be e kai Toolengi, taigi den taa bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi taki: “Meke u go anga en fu u sa dede anga en.”
eng_text: Then said Thomas, which is called Didymus, unto his fellowdisciples, Let us also go, that we may die with him.

djk_text: We, di Masaa Jesesi kon a Betaniya, ne den taigi en taki: “Lasalesi de a ini geebi fo dei kaba.”
eng_text: Then when Jesus came, he found that he had lain in the grave four days already.

djk_text: Ma somen Dyu be komoto a Jelusalem kon a Betaniya fu kee pina anga Malita anga Maliya fu a dede fu a baala fi en. Bika Jelusalem anga Betaniya be sa de wan sani fu dii kilomeiti so koosube anga denseefi.
eng_text: Now Bethany was nigh unto Jerusalem, about fifteen furlongs off:

djk_text: We, fa i si Malita yee taki Masaa Jesesi kon de, ne wanten a opo go miti en. Ma Maliya fika sidon sidon a osu.
eng_text: Then Martha, as soon as she heard that Jesus was coming, went and met him: but Mary sat still in the house.

djk_text: Ne Malita taigi Masaa Jesesi taki: “Masaa! Efi i be de ya, mi baala á be o dede.
eng_text: Then said Martha unto Jesus, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.

djk_text: Ma toku, now mi sabi taki ala sani di i begi akisi Masaa Gadu, a o gi yu en.”
eng_text: But I know, that even now, whatsoever thou wilt ask of God, God will give it thee.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi en taki: “Malita! I baala o opo baka!”
eng_text: Jesus saith unto her, Thy brother shall rise again.

djk_text: Ne Malita taigi en taki: “We, Masaa, mi sabi taki a o opo baka te ala den dede sama o opo baka na a kiiboi dei.”
eng_text: Martha saith unto him, I know that he shall rise again in the resurrection at the last day.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Mi na a sama di e weki sama puu a dede. Na mi na a sama di e gi libi. Sama di e biibi a mi, sa libi, wansi a dede.
eng_text: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:

djk_text: Da sama di de a libi, ne ai biibi a mi, ná o dede ná wan ten! Yu e biibi dati?”
eng_text: And whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die. Believest thou this?

djk_text: Ne Malita taigi en taki: “Iya, Masaa! Mi e biibi taki yu na a Kelestesi, a Manpikin fu Masaa Gadu di be mu kon a goontapu.”
eng_text: She saith unto him, Yea, Lord: I believe that thou art the Christ, the Son of God, which should come into the world.

djk_text: We, ne di Masaa Jesesi taki so, ne Malita go, ne a kai en sisa saafi taki: “A Mesiti kon kaba, ai kai yu.”
eng_text: And when she had so said, she went her way, and called Mary her sister secretly, saying, The Master is come, and calleth for thee.

djk_text: We, di Maliya yee so, ne a opo pala, waka go a Masaa.
eng_text: As soon as she heard that, she arose quickly, and came unto him.

djk_text: Bika Masaa Jesesi á be doo a ini a kondee ete, ma a be de a pe a be taki anga Malita ete.
eng_text: Now Jesus was not yet come into the town, but was in that place where Martha met him.

djk_text: We, sama fu Judeja di be de a ini osu de be e gi en taanga sikin. Namo di den si taki, Maliya opo pala waka go a doose, ne den waka go ne en baka. Den denki taki, ai go na a geebi fu go kee anda.
eng_text: The Jews then which were with her in the house, and comforted her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up hastily and went out, followed her, saying, She goeth unto the grave to weep there.

djk_text: We, di Maliya doo na a peesi pe Masaa Jesesi de, di a si en, ne a kai a Masaa Jesesi futu, ne a taki: “Masaa, efi i be de ya, mi baala á be o dede, baa!”
eng_text: Then when Mary was come where Jesus was, and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying unto him, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.

djk_text: Ma namo, di Masaa Jesesi si Maliya anga den taa sama fu Judeja di be kon ne en e kee so, ne wan gaan tyali kisi en a ini en ati.
eng_text: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews also weeping which came with her, he groaned in the spirit, and was troubled,

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi akisi den taki: “On pe u poti en?” Ne den taigi en taki: “Masaa, kon, da i sa si!”
eng_text: And said, Where have ye laid him? They said unto him, Lord, come and see.

djk_text: Ma namo, ne wataa lon a Masaa Jesesi ain pala pala.
eng_text: Jesus wept.

djk_text: Na fu dati ede meke den Dyu taki: “Kee! Luku fa a be lobi en, baa.”
eng_text: Then said the Jews, Behold how he loved him!

djk_text: Ma wantu fu den taki: “We, a ná a man ya be e meke den beendiman kon si baka, no? Ne fa a waka a á be poi yeepi a man ya, fu a á dede?”
eng_text: And some of them said, Could not this man, which opened the eyes of the blind, have caused that even this man should not have died?

djk_text: Ma wan gaan tyali kisi Masaa Jesesi baka a ini en ati. Ne na so a go na a geebi. Ma namo, da a geebi ya na be wan siton olo. Da den be tapu a geebi mofu anga wan siton.
eng_text: Jesus therefore again groaning in himself cometh to the grave. It was a cave, and a stone lay upon it.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi taki: “U puu a siton na a geebi mofu!” Ma Malita, a sisa fu a man di dede, taigi en taki: “Masaa! Ai tingi kaba. Bika na fo dei kaba di a de a ini a geebi.”
eng_text: Jesus said, Take ye away the stone. Martha, the sister of him that was dead, saith unto him, Lord, by this time he stinketh: for he hath been dead four days.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Mi á be taigi i kaba taki, efi i biibi, yu o si a hei fasi fu Gadu, no?”
eng_text: Jesus saith unto her, Said I not unto thee, that, if thou wouldest believe, thou shouldest see the glory of God?

djk_text: We, ne den puu a siton na a geebi mofu. Ne Masaa Jesesi opo ede luku tapu, ne a taki: “Mi Tata! Gaantangi fi yu fu di a de taki i yee mi kaba.
eng_text: Then they took away the stone from the place where the dead was laid. And Jesus lifted up his eyes, and said, Father, I thank thee that thou hast heard me.

djk_text: Mi sabi tuutuu taki yu e yee mi alaten. Ma na fu den sama di taampu lontu ya ede meke mi e taki so, fu den sa kon biibi taki na yu be sende mi kon a goontapu.”
eng_text: And I knew that thou hearest me always: but because of the people which stand by I said it, that they may believe that thou hast sent me.

djk_text: We, ne di Masaa Jesesi taki so, ne a bali kai Lasalesi taanga taki: “Lasalesi! Kon a doo!”
eng_text: And when he thus had spoken, he cried with a loud voice, Lazarus, come forth.

djk_text: We, ne a dedesama komoto kon a doo. En futu anga en ana de teitei anga geebi koosi ne en sikin. Da en fesi seefi be de teitei anga wan koosi. Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “U losi en meke a go!”
eng_text: And he that was dead came forth, bound hand and foot with graveclothes: and his face was bound about with a napkin. Jesus saith unto them, Loose him, and let him go.

djk_text: We, di den sama di be kon a Maliya si a sani di Masaa Jesesi du, ne den daai kon e biibi ne en.
eng_text: Then many of the Jews which came to Mary, and had seen the things which Jesus did, believed on him.

djk_text: Ma wantu fu den go a den Faliseiman go taigi den san Masaa Jesesi du.
eng_text: But some of them went their ways to the Pharisees, and told them what things Jesus had done.

djk_text: We, na fu dati ede meke den Faliseiman anga den apaiti begiman fu a Mama Keliki, kai wan gaan kuutu makandii, anga a Dyulanti di e kuutu sani. Ne den e akisi taki: “San wi mu du? We, bika a sama e du somen somen foondoo foondoo wooko.
eng_text: Then gathered the chief priests and the Pharisees a council, and said, What do we? for this man doeth many miracles.

djk_text: Efu wi á luku bun, da ala sama o daai kon e biibi ne en. Da den Loma o kon feti booko a Mama Keliki anga a nasi fu wi kaba a soso.”
eng_text: If we let him thus alone, all men will believe on him: and the Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation.

djk_text: Ma Kayafasi, wan fu den man, di be de a moo hei apaiti begiman, na a yali de, taigi den taki: “U á sabi ná wan sani!
eng_text: And one of them, named Caiaphas, being the high priest that same year, said unto them, Ye know nothing at all,

djk_text: U á sabi taki a moo bun fu wankodo sama dede gi a nasi, moo enke pe fu a hii nasi dede go kaba a soso, no?”
eng_text: Nor consider that it is expedient for us, that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation perish not.

djk_text: Ma a ná enseefi be taki a sani de. Ma na fu di a be de a moo hei apaiti begiman a yali de, na fu dati ede meke Masaa Gadu be meke a taki den wowtu ya taki: “Masaa Jesesi mu dede gi a hii nasi.
eng_text: And this spake he not of himself: but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus should die for that nation;

djk_text: Ma a ná den Dyu wawan a o dede gi, ma a o tyai ala den sama fu Masaa Gadu, di de paati paati a hii goontapu, kon makandii a wan ipi.”
eng_text: And not for that nation only, but that also he should gather together in one the children of God that were scattered abroad.

djk_text: We, ne fanafu a dei di de oli a kuutu de, ne den poti taki den sa kii en namo.
eng_text: Then from that day forth they took counsel together for to put him to death.

djk_text: We, na fu dati ede meke Masaa Jesesi á be e waka a na a pisiwataa fu Judeja moo a pe ala sama sa si en. Ma a komoto de go a wan foto den e kai Efalamu, di de koosube fu wan sabana. Ne en anga den bakaman fi en de ape.
eng_text: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews; but went thence unto a country near to the wilderness, into a city called Ephraim, and there continued with his disciples.

djk_text: Ma namo, da a Pasika Piisii fu den Dyu be de koosube fu doo. Da somen sama fu a pisi de, be subi go a Jelusalem fu go kiin denseefi enke fa a weiti taki fu den be sa de kaba kaba fosi a Pasika Piisii doo.
eng_text: And the Jews' passover was nigh at hand: and many went out of the country up to Jerusalem before the passover, to purify themselves.

djk_text: Di den taampu a ini a Mama Keliki, ne den be e suku Masaa Jesesi. Den e akisi den na den taki: “San u denki? U denki taki a o kon fu nyan a Pasika Piisii ya?”
eng_text: Then sought they for Jesus, and spake among themselves, as they stood in the temple, What think ye, that he will not come to the feast?

djk_text: Bika den hei apaiti begiman anga den Faliseiman be poti taki, efu wan sama sabi pe a de, den mu taigi den, fu den go kisi en.
eng_text: Now both the chief priests and the Pharisees had given a commandment, that, if any man knew where he were, he should shew it, that they might take him.

djk_text: Da sigisi dei fosi a Pasika Piisii, ne Masaa Jesesi kon baka a Betaniya, a pe a be weki Lasalesi puu a dede.
eng_text: Then Jesus six days before the passover came to Bethany, where Lazarus was which had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.

djk_text: Da di a kon, ne den sama seeka nyanyan gi en di sapaten doo. We, Malita be e sete tafaa. Da Lasalesi na be wan fu den sama di be de a tafaa de fu nyan anga Masaa Jesesi
eng_text: There they made him a supper; and Martha served: but Lazarus was one of them that sat at the table with him.

djk_text: Ne Maliya teke wan gaan dii sumee switi fatu, ne a kandi ala a Masaa Jesesi futu te a kaba. Ne a dee Masaa Jesesi futu baka anga en ede uwii. Ne a hii osu fuu kwaa anga a sumee fu a sumee switi fatu ya.
eng_text: Then took Mary a pound of ointment of spikenard, very costly, and anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped his feet with her hair: and the house was filled with the odour of the ointment.

djk_text: Ma wan fu den bakaman fi en, Judasi Iskaliyotu, di be o seli en taki:
eng_text: Then saith one of his disciples, Judas Iscariot, Simon's son, which should betray him,

djk_text: “Saide meke den á seli a fatu ya, da den be gi den pootiman a moni? Bika, efu den be seli en, da den be o fende tyaipi moni. Bika beina a wan hii yali i mu wooko fosi i sa fende a moni fu bai a oli ya.”
eng_text: Why was not this ointment sold for three hundred pence, and given to the poor?

djk_text: Ma a á be taki den sani fu den pootiman ede. Bika a ná pootiman be ati en so. Ma ne en be e oli a monisaka, fu poti ala moni di sama be e gi den. Da a be e fende a moni e fufuu bun.
eng_text: This he said, not that he cared for the poor; but because he was a thief, and had the bag, and bare what was put therein.

djk_text: Ma Jesesi taigi en taki: “U fika en! A be de fanowdu fu a kibii a fatu ya te enke a dei fu tide fu towe a mi futu fu lesipeki mi fu a dei di den o beli mi.
eng_text: Then said Jesus, Let her alone: against the day of my burying hath she kept this.

djk_text: Den pootiman de alaten anga u ya. Ma mi ná o de alaten a u mindii.”
eng_text: For the poor always ye have with you; but me ye have not always.

djk_text: We, di somen fu den sama fu Judeja yee taki Masaa Jesesi de ape, ne den kon de tu. Da den á be kon fu Masaa Jesesi ede wawan, ma fu den be sa si Lasalesi di Masaa Jesesi be weki puu a dede tu.
eng_text: Much people of the Jews therefore knew that he was there: and they came not for Jesus' sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.

djk_text: Da den hei apaiti begiman meke mofu, kuudei anga den seefi, fu kii Lasalesi tu.
eng_text: But the chief priests consulted that they might put Lazarus also to death;

djk_text: Bika na fi en ede meke somen fu den sama fu Judeja di be go de, fika a leli fu den Dyu edeman ya, daai kon e biibi a Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: Because that by reason of him many of the Jews went away, and believed on Jesus.

djk_text: Ne a taa dei, ne den somen sama di be kon na a piisii yee taki Masaa Jesesi de a pasi e kon a Jelusalem.
eng_text: On the next day much people that were come to the feast, when they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,

djk_text: Ne den teke palon taka oli a den ana, ne den go a doose go miti en a pasi. Ne den e bali baaya gi en taki: “Hosana! Seigi fu Awan di e kon a ini a nen fu Masaa. Seigi fu a Kownu fu Islayeli sama!”
eng_text: Took branches of palm trees, and went forth to meet him, and cried, Hosanna: Blessed is the King of Israel that cometh in the name of the Lord.

djk_text: Da Masaa Jesesi be fende wan buliki, ne a subi go sidon ne en tapu. Da a sani ya waka leti enke fa a be sikiifi a Gadu Buku taki:
eng_text: And Jesus, when he had found a young ass, sat thereon; as it is written,

djk_text: “U á feele, sama fu Siyon! U luku a kownu fu u, sidon a wan pikin yonkuu buliki tapu e kon.”
eng_text: Fear not, daughter of Sion: behold, thy King cometh, sitting on an ass's colt.

djk_text: Ma a yuu ten de, da den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi á be fusutan en ete. Ma bakaten di a dede weki go fende a waiti fasi fi en, fosi, ne den kon sabi taki, na so wan sani fi en be sikiifi a Gadu Buku anga fa denseefi be du den sani ya gi en.
eng_text: These things understood not his disciples at the first: but when Jesus was glorified, then remembered they that these things were written of him, and that they had done these things unto him.

djk_text: Da ala den somen sama di be de anga en di a be weki Lasalesi puu a dede, be e taigi taa sama fa a be kai Lasalesi puu a ini a geebi olo weki en puu a dede.
eng_text: The people therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of his grave, and raised him from the dead, bare record.

djk_text: Da na fu dati ede meke i si somen sama be lon go miti Masaa Jesesi so, fu di den be yee taki a so wan gaan foondoo sani a be du.
eng_text: For this cause the people also met him, for that they heard that he had done this miracle.

djk_text: Ma den Faliseiman taigi den na den taki: “U si? Wi á poi du ná wan sani fu oli den. Bika hii goontapu lon go ne en go e waka ne en baka.”
eng_text: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, Perceive ye how ye prevail nothing? behold, the world is gone after him.

djk_text: Da wantu Giiki sama be de a ini fu den somen sama di be kon fu begi Masaa Gadu tu na a piisii ya.
eng_text: And there were certain Greeks among them that came up to worship at the feast:

djk_text: We, ne den kon a Filipi, wan fu den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi di be e tan a Betisaida na a pisiwataa fu Galileya, ne den begi en taki: “Man, gaantangi, u wani miti anga Masaa Jesesi, baa.”
eng_text: The same came therefore to Philip, which was of Bethsaida of Galilee, and desired him, saying, Sir, we would see Jesus.

djk_text: We, ne Filipi komoto, ne a go taigi Andeleyasi. Ne Filipi anga Andeleyasi komoto, ne den go taigi Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: Philip cometh and telleth Andrew: and again Andrew and Philip tell Jesus.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi piki den sama taki: “We, a yuu doo kaba, di a dyendee fasi fu a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya, mu kon a doo.”
eng_text: And Jesus answered them, saying, The hour is come, that the Son of man should be glorified.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den go doo taki: “Fu tuutuu mi e taigi u, solanga wan ain kalu de, ma a á kai a doti fu poli, da na a wankodo ain kalu de wawan o tan. Ma, efu a kai a doti poli, da fosi a o goo kon meke tyaipi nyanyan.
eng_text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die, it abideth alone: but if it die, it bringeth forth much fruit.

djk_text: A sama di e feti fu kibii en libi sa lasi en. Ma sama di ná abi toobi fu lasi en libi a goontapu ya fu mi ede, sa fende libi fu tego.
eng_text: He that loveth his life shall lose it; and he that hateth his life in this world shall keep it unto life eternal.

djk_text: Efu wan sama wani dini mi, da a mu e waka a mi baka. Bika mi wani meke den sama di e dini mi mu de a pe mi de. Da mi Tata o hei den sama di wani fu dini mi gi den gaan lesipeki.”
eng_text: If any man serve me, let him follow me; and where I am, there shall also my servant be: if any man serve me, him will my Father honour.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi taki baka taki: “We, enke fa mi de ya, da mi ati de anga fuka. Ma san mi sa taki? Mi sa begi mi Tata fu a puu den sani di de a fesi fu kon miti mi? Ma nono! Bika na fu a sani ya ede, meke mi be kon, fu nyan gaan pina na a yuu ya.
eng_text: Now is my soul troubled; and what shall I say? Father, save me from this hour: but for this cause came I unto this hour.

djk_text: Mi Tata! Meke libisama si a hei fasi anga a kaakiti fi i di yu abi!” We, ne wan Tongo taki a tapu anda taki: “Mi meke libisama si a waiti fasi anga a kaakiti fu mi kaba. Da mi sa meke den si en ete moo anga moo.”
eng_text: Father, glorify thy name. Then came there a voice from heaven, saying, I have both glorified it, and will glorify it again.

djk_text: We, ne den sama di taampu de yee di a Tongo taki. Ne den taki: “Donduu e bali!” Taawan taki: “Na wan Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee taki anga en.”
eng_text: The people therefore, that stood by, and heard it, said that it thundered: others said, An angel spake to him.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “A ná fu mi ede meke a Tongo ya taki. Ma na fu u ede.
eng_text: Jesus answered and said, This voice came not because of me, but for your sakes.

djk_text: We, bika a yuu doo kaba fu Gadu kuutu goontapu. Da now, den o puu a edeman fu a goontapu ya ne en tii.
eng_text: Now is the judgment of this world: now shall the prince of this world be cast out.

djk_text: Ma mi, te den sa opo mi, da mi sa ali ala sama kon a mi.”
eng_text: And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will draw all men unto me.

djk_text: Da Masaa Jesesi be taki den sani ya, fu soi den sowtu dede a be o dede.
eng_text: This he said, signifying what death he should die.

djk_text: Ma den sama piki en taki: “We, a sikiifi a Gadu Buku taki, a Kelestesi o libi fu tego. We, da fa i du e taki, den o opo a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya? Sama yu e kai a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya?”
eng_text: The people answered him, We have heard out of the law that Christ abideth for ever: and how sayest thou, The Son of man must be lifted up? who is this Son of man?

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “U waka a ini a leti, solanga u leti ya de a mindii ete, fu dunguu á kon kisi u. We bika, na wan pikin pisiten namo, a leti ya de a u mindii ete. Bika a sama di e waka a ini dunguu á sabi na on se ai go.
eng_text: Then Jesus said unto them, Yet a little while is the light with you. Walk while ye have the light, lest darkness come upon you: for he that walketh in darkness knoweth not whither he goeth.

djk_text: We, u poti biibi na a leti ya tapu, solanga a de a u mindii ete. Da u sa toon pikin fu a leti.” We, ne na so Masaa Jesesi taki, ne a gwe. Ne a kibii enseefi gi den.
eng_text: While ye have light, believe in the light, that ye may be the children of light. These things spake Jesus, and departed, and did hide himself from them.

djk_text: Bika anga ala fa den be si den foondoo wooko di Masaa Jesesi be e du de seefi, toku seefi den á be wani poti biibi ne en.
eng_text: But though he had done so many miracles before them, yet they believed not on him:

djk_text: We, da na so a sani, di a fositen apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu di den be e kai Jesaja be taki kon tuu. Bika a be taki: “Masaa! Sama be biibi a bosikopu di u be e tyai? Da ná wan sama de di sabi bunbun san na den foondoo.”
eng_text: That the saying of Esaias the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spake, Lord, who hath believed our report? and to whom hath the arm of the Lord been revealed?

djk_text: We, na fu dati ede meke den á poi biibi, leti enke fa Jesaja be taki baka taki:
eng_text: Therefore they could not believe, because that Esaias said again,

djk_text: “Masaa Gadu dunguu den ain, fu den á si sani. Da soseefi a taanga den ati, fu den á poi fusutan den sani fi en. Da den á poi daai den libi kon, fu mi deesi den.”
eng_text: He hath blinded their eyes, and hardened their heart; that they should not see with their eyes, nor understand with their heart, and be converted, and I should heal them.

djk_text: Da na fu di Jesaja be si a hei fasi fi en anga a waiti fasi di a be o abi.
eng_text: These things said Esaias, when he saw his glory, and spake of him.

djk_text: Ma anga ala fa, toku somen fu den edeman fu den Dyu daai kon e biibi ne en. Ma na fu den Faliseiman ede meke den á be wani meke taa sama sabi. Bika, efu den Faliseiman be yee, den be o puu den na a keliki.
eng_text: Nevertheless among the chief rulers also many believed on him; but because of the Pharisees they did not confess him, lest they should be put out of the synagogue:

djk_text: Bika den be wani abi bun nen a sama, moo enke pe fu den suku bun nen a Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: For they loved the praise of men more than the praise of God.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi taki anga moo taanga tongo taki: “Sama di e biibi a mi, a ná mi wawan namo ai biibi, ma ai biibi na a sama di sende mi kon.
eng_text: Jesus cried and said, He that believeth on me, believeth not on me, but on him that sent me.

djk_text: Da sama di e si mi, á si mi wawan, ma a si a sama di sende mi kon.
eng_text: And he that seeth me seeth him that sent me.

djk_text: Mi kon a goontapu enke wan leti, fu meke ibii sama di biibi a mi á tan a dunguu.
eng_text: I am come a light into the world, that whosoever believeth on me should not abide in darkness.

djk_text: Ma kaba, efu wan sama yee san mi e leli, ne a á biibi, mi ná o kuutu en. Bika mi á be kon fu sitaafu goontapu, ma mi kon fu puu den a dede gi den tuutuu libi.
eng_text: And if any man hear my words, and believe not, I judge him not: for I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.

djk_text: Ma sama di poti mi a wanse, ne a á wani teke a leli fu mi, da so wan sama abi en kuutuman kaba. Da a seefi leli di a yee mi e leli ya, sa kuutu en na a kiiboi dei.
eng_text: He that rejecteth me, and receiveth not my words, hath one that judgeth him: the word that I have spoken, the same shall judge him in the last day.

djk_text: Bika den sani di mi e leli, a ná mi seefi sani. Ma na mi Tata di sende mi kon, ne enseefi be taigi mi san mi mu taki anga fa mi mu taki den.
eng_text: For I have not spoken of myself; but the Father which sent me, he gave me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.

djk_text: Da mi sabi taki den sani di a sende mi fu mi taki ya, e yeepi sama, fu den fende a libi fu tego. Da san mi e taki, na san mi Tata be taigi mi fu taki.”
eng_text: And I know that his commandment is life everlasting: whatsoever I speak therefore, even as the Father said unto me, so I speak.

djk_text: Da a yuu de, da a Pasika Fesa be de koosube kaba. Da Masaa Jesesi be sabi taki a yuu fi en doo fu a fika a goontapu ya go ne en Tata. Ma namo, da Masaa Jesesi be lobi den sama fi en alaten, ma now, da a o soi den fa a lobi di a be lobi den ala den yuu bigi.
eng_text: Now before the feast of the passover, when Jesus knew that his hour was come that he should depart out of this world unto the Father, having loved his own which were in the world, he loved them unto the end.

djk_text: Ne, di den e nyan na a sapaten, da a didibii be poti a pakisei gi Judasi, a pikin fu Simon Iskaliyotu kaba a ini en ati ini fu a seli Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: And supper being ended, the devil having now put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon's son, to betray him;

djk_text: We, Masaa Jesesi be sabi taki en Tata be poti ala sani a ini en ana. Bika a sabi taki na Masaa Gadu a komoto, da na Masaa Gadu ai go baka tu.
eng_text: Jesus knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he was come from God, and went to God;

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi opo, ne a puu en dyakiti poti a wanse. Ne a teke wan duku tei ne en mindii.
eng_text: He riseth from supper, and laid aside his garments; and took a towel, and girded himself.

djk_text: Ne a kandi wataa poti a ini wan gaan beenki, ne a bigin wasi den bakaman fi en futu. Ne a teke a duku di a be tei en mindii, ne a dee den futu te a kaba.
eng_text: After that he poureth water into a bason, and began to wash the disciples' feet, and to wipe them with the towel wherewith he was girded.

djk_text: Ma di a doo Simon Peitilisi, ne Simon taigi en taki: “Nono Masaa! Yu o wasi mi futu?”
eng_text: Then cometh he to Simon Peter: and Peter saith unto him, Lord, dost thou wash my feet?

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Simon, yu á sabi san mi e du ete. Ma bakaten yu o sabi.”
eng_text: Jesus answered and said unto him, What I do thou knowest not now; but thou shalt know hereafter.

djk_text: Ne Simon piki en taki: “Nono! Kweti kweti! Yu ná o wasi mi futu.” Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Efu mi á wasi yu futu, da yu ná o poi de wan bakaman fu mi moo.”
eng_text: Peter saith unto him, Thou shalt never wash my feet. Jesus answered him, If I wash thee not, thou hast no part with me.

djk_text: Ne Simon taigi en taki: “Masaa, a ná mi futu wawan fi i wasi, ma wasi mi ana anga mi ede tu.”
eng_text: Simon Peter saith unto him, Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “We, sama di wasi kaba, a á de fu den wasi en hii sikin moo. Ma ne en futu namo den mu wasi. Bika a kiin kaba. Ma fa u de ya u kiin kaba, ma a ná ala u fiya.”
eng_text: Jesus saith to him, He that is washed needeth not save to wash his feet, but is clean every whit: and ye are clean, but not all.

djk_text: Bika a be sabi sama be o seli en. A dati meke a taki, a ná ala den fiya kiin.
eng_text: For he knew who should betray him; therefore said he, Ye are not all clean.

djk_text: We, di a kaba wasi den futu kaba, ne a wei en dyakiti baka, ne a go teke en peesi a tafaa baka. Ne a akisi den taki: “U sabi san mi du gi u de?
eng_text: So after he had washed their feet, and had taken his garments, and was set down again, he said unto them, Know ye what I have done to you?

djk_text: U e kai mi, Mesiti. U e kai mi, Masaa. We, u abi leti tuu fu kai mi so. Bika a so mi de tuu.
eng_text: Ye call me Master and Lord: and ye say well; for so I am.

djk_text: We, leti enke fa mi, a Masaa anga a Mesiti fu u wasi u futu, na soseefi u mu wasi u na u futu tu.
eng_text: If I then, your Lord and Master, have washed your feet; ye also ought to wash one another's feet.

djk_text: Bika mi du a sani ya soi u, fu useefi du e gi taa sama, leti enke fa mi be du en gi u.
eng_text: For I have given you an example, that ye should do as I have done to you.

djk_text: Fu tuutuu mi e taigi u taki, wan futuboi á hei moo en masaa. Da soseefi wan bosikopuman á bigi moo a sama di sende en a bosikopu.
eng_text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord; neither he that is sent greater than he that sent him.

djk_text: We, now u sabi den sani di mi e leli u. Da seigi fu u, efu u e du den tu.”
eng_text: If ye know these things, happy are ye if ye do them.

djk_text: “Ma a ná u ala fiya mi e taki. Bika mi sabi den sama di mi teke kon toon fu miseefi. Ma a wowtu fu Gadu Buku di taki: ‘A sama di de a tafaa e nyan beele anga mi opo en futu fu taampu mi,’ mu kon leti.
eng_text: I speak not of you all: I know whom I have chosen: but that the scripture may be fulfilled, He that eateth bread with me hath lifted up his heel against me.

djk_text: Mi e taigi u a sani ya a fesi. Fu te a pasa so, fu u sa sabi taki, na mi na a sama di mi be taigi u taki mi de.
eng_text: Now I tell you before it come, that, when it is come to pass, ye may believe that I am he.

djk_text: Fu tuutuu mi e taigi u taki, a sama di o teke wan sama di mi o sende kon, da na miseefi a teke de. Da a sama di o teke mi, da a teke a Sama di sende mi kon a goontapu tu.”
eng_text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that receiveth whomsoever I send receiveth me; and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.

djk_text: Da di Masaa Jesesi taki a sani de, ne gaan tyali kon fuu en ati. Ne a taigi den kiinkiin taki: “Fu tuutuu mi e taigi u taki, wan fu u o seli mi.”
eng_text: When Jesus had thus said, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.

djk_text: Ne di Masaa Jesesi taki so, ne den bakaman fi en luku denseefi te doo. Bika den á sabi on di fu den a be e taki.
eng_text: Then the disciples looked one on another, doubting of whom he spake.

djk_text: We, wan fu den bakaman fi en, a bakaman di a be lobi te, de ne en se de.
eng_text: Now there was leaning on Jesus' bosom one of his disciples, whom Jesus loved.

djk_text: Na fu dati ede meke Simon Peitilisi soi en anga ana kibii kibii fu a akisi Masaa Jesesi sama na a sama di o seli en.
eng_text: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, that he should ask who it should be of whom he spake.

djk_text: We, ne a diipi go moo koosube fu Masaa Jesesi, ne a akisi en taki: “Masaa! Sama na a sama di o seli yu?”
eng_text: He then lying on Jesus' breast saith unto him, Lord, who is it?

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “A sama di mi o gi a pisi beele di mi o dipi go a ini a baafun ya, ne en o seli mi.” Ne na so Masaa Jesesi dipi a beele go a ini a baafun, ne a gi Judasi, a pikin fu Simon Iskaliyotu.
eng_text: Jesus answered, He it is, to whom I shall give a sop, when I have dipped it. And when he had dipped the sop, he gave it to Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon.

djk_text: Ne di a teke a beele, ne wanten wanten, ne saatan, a didibii saka go a ini en ati ini. Ne Jesesi taigi en taki: “Go du san i mu du esi esi.”
eng_text: And after the sop Satan entered into him. Then said Jesus unto him, That thou doest, do quickly.

djk_text: Ma ná wan fu den taawan di be de a tafaa be sabi fu saide meke Masaa Jesesi be taki so anga en.
eng_text: Now no man at the table knew for what intent he spake this unto him.

djk_text: Son fu den be denki taki na fu di Judasi be e tyai a monisaka meke Masaa Jesesi be taigi en taki, fu a go bai sani fu den nyan a piisii, efuso fu a gi den pootiman wan sani.
eng_text: For some of them thought, because Judas had the bag, that Jesus had said unto him, Buy those things that we have need of against the feast; or, that he should give something to the poor.

djk_text: We, ne di Judasi teke a beele, ne wanten, ne a go a doose. Ne neti kai, peesi be dunguu pii.
eng_text: He then having received the sop went immediately out: and it was night.

djk_text: We, di Judasi go a doose kaba, ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “We, a yuu doo, di a hei di a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya abi, mu kon fu si. Da a hei fu Gadu seefi o de fu si tu.
eng_text: Therefore, when he was gone out, Jesus said, Now is the Son of man glorified, and God is glorified in him.

djk_text: We, leti enke fa a be hei Gadu, da na soseefi Gadu o hei a Manpikin ya moo. Da na wanten wanten a o hei en.
eng_text: If God be glorified in him, God shall also glorify him in himself, and shall straightway glorify him.

djk_text: Mi lobi wan. Wan pikin ten namo mi o de anga u ete. Da u o suku mi. Ma, leti enke fa mi be taigi den Dyu kaba, na so soseefi mi e taigi u now taki, pe mi e go, u ná o poi kon anda.
eng_text: Little children, yet a little while I am with you. Ye shall seek me: and as I said unto the Jews, Whither I go, ye cannot come; so now I say to you.

djk_text: Mi o gi u wan nyunyun weiti fu u oli. Dati na taki: U mu lobi useefi. Leti enke fa mi be lobi u, na soseefi u mu lobi useefi tu.
eng_text: A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.

djk_text: Da te u lobi useefi, da ala sama sa si taki u na bakaman fu mi.”
eng_text: By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.

djk_text: Ma now, ne Simon Peitilisi akisi en taki: “Masaa! On pe yu e go?” Ma Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Yu á poi kon anga mi a leisi di mi e go ya. Ma bakaten, da i sa go anga mi.”
eng_text: Simon Peter said unto him, Lord, whither goest thou? Jesus answered him, Whither I go, thou canst not follow me now; but thou shalt follow me afterwards.

djk_text: Ne Peitilisi akisi en taki: “Masaa! Saide meke mi á poi go anga yu a leisi ya? Mi de kaba kaba fu lasi mi libi, fi yu ede!”
eng_text: Peter said unto him, Lord, why cannot I follow thee now? I will lay down my life for thy sake.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi akisi en taki: “I de kaba kaba fu lasi yu libi fu mi ede, enke fa yu taki tuu? We, fu tuutuu mi e taigi yu taki, fosi wan kakafoo bali a neti ya, yu o lei dii toon taki, yu á sabi mi.”
eng_text: Jesus answered him, Wilt thou lay down thy life for my sake? Verily, verily, I say unto thee, The cock shall not crow, till thou hast denied me thrice.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den bakaman fi en taki: “U ati á mu dege dege. U poti biibi a Gadu! Da soseefi u poti biibi a mi tu.
eng_text: Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.

djk_text: Bika tanpeesi de nofu na pe mi Tata e tan. Efu a á be de so, da mi be o taigi u. Bika mi e go fu seeka peesi gi u.
eng_text: In my Father's house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.

djk_text: Da te mi go seeka u peesi te mi kaba, da mi o daai kon baka fu teke u tyai kon a mi, fu u sa de ape mi de tu.
eng_text: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and receive you unto myself; that where I am, there ye may be also.

djk_text: We, u sabi pe mi e go. Da soseefi u sabi a pasi fu kon anda tu.”
eng_text: And whither I go ye know, and the way ye know.

djk_text: Ne Towmasi piki en taki: “Nono, Masaa! Wi á sabi pe yu e go. Da fa wi o sabi a pasi fu kon anda?”
eng_text: Thomas saith unto him, Lord, we know not whither thou goest; and how can we know the way?

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “We, na mi na a pasi. Na mi na a tuu. Na mi na a libi. Ná wan sama sa kon a mi Tata, efu mi á tyai en go ne en.
eng_text: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.

djk_text: Efu u sabi mi, da u o sabi mi Tata tu. We, fanafu now, da u sabi en. Bika u be si en.”
eng_text: If ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also: and from henceforth ye know him, and have seen him.

djk_text: Ne Filipi taigi en taki: “Masaa! Soi wi a Tata, da a sai u kaba.”
eng_text: Philip saith unto him, Lord, shew us the Father, and it sufficeth us.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Fu on langa di mi de ya anga u, Filipi, ne yu á sabi mi ete? Sama di si mi, si mi Tata seefi. Da fa yu e akisi mi taki: ‘Soi u a Tata?’
eng_text: Jesus saith unto him, Have I been so long time with you, and yet hast thou not known me, Philip? he that hath seen me hath seen the Father; and how sayest thou then, Shew us the Father?

djk_text: Yu nái biibi taki mi anga mi Tata de wan, no? U á de paati paati. Den sani di mi e leli u, a ná sani fu miseefi. Ma na a Tata di e tan a mi ini, ne en e du en wooko.
eng_text: Believest thou not that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? the words that I speak unto you I speak not of myself: but the Father that dwelleth in me, he doeth the works.

djk_text: Biibi mi, taki mi anga mi Tata á de paati paati, ma u de wan. Efuso, da u biibi mi fu den wooko namo.
eng_text: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me: or else believe me for the very works' sake.

djk_text: Fu tuutuu mi e taigi u taki, sama di poti biibi a mi, a sa du den wooko di mi e du tu. Da moo gaan wooko seefi a sa du. Bika mi e go a mi Tata.
eng_text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me, the works that I do shall he do also; and greater works than these shall he do; because I go unto my Father.

djk_text: Da winsi san u sa begi akisi mi Tata a mi nen, da mi sa gi u, fu mi Tata mu kisi balinen na a Manpikin fi en.
eng_text: And whatsoever ye shall ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

djk_text: Iniiwan sani di u sa begi akisi na mi nen, mi sa gi u.”
eng_text: If ye shall ask any thing in my name, I will do it.

djk_text: “Efu u lobi mi, da u mu du san mi sende u fu du.
eng_text: If ye love me, keep my commandments.

djk_text: Da mi sa begi a Tata, da a sa gi u wan taa Yeepiman, di o tan anga u fu tego.
eng_text: And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever;

djk_text: Dati na a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu, di e soi u den tuutuu sani fu Gadu. Da den sama fu a goontapu ya di á de a Gadu pasi ná o poi fende a Jeje ya. Bika den á si en. Da soseefi den á sabi en tu. Ma u sabi en, bika ai tan anga u. Da soseefi a o tan a ini u tu.
eng_text: Even the Spirit of truth; whom the world cannot receive, because it seeth him not, neither knoweth him: but ye know him; for he dwelleth with you, and shall be in you.

djk_text: “Mi ná o fika u enke pikin di de sondee mma anga dda a baka. Mi o daai kon a u baka.
eng_text: I will not leave you comfortless: I will come to you.

djk_text: Pikinso moo, da goontapu ná o si mi moo. Ma u dati, u sa si mi. Bika mi o libi baka. Da u sa libi tu.
eng_text: Yet a little while, and the world seeth me no more; but ye see me: because I live, ye shall live also.

djk_text: Da a yuu ten de, da u sa si taki mi anga mi Tata á de paati paati. Ma u de wan. Da soseefi u o si taki mi anga u á de paati paati tu. Ma u de wan.
eng_text: At that day ye shall know that I am in my Father, and ye in me, and I in you.

djk_text: Da sama di teke san mi e taigi en fu a du, ne ai du den, da so wan sama lobi mi. Da, efu wan sama lobi mi so, da mi Tata seefi o lobi en tu. Da mi seefi o lobi so wan sama tu. Da mi o opo miseefi gi en fu a kon sabi mi.”
eng_text: He that hath my commandments, and keepeth them, he it is that loveth me: and he that loveth me shall be loved of my Father, and I will love him, and will manifest myself to him.

djk_text: We, ne wan taa Judasi, boiti Iskaliyotu, akisi Jesesi taki: “Masaa, san meke na u namo yu o opo iseefi gi? San meke i ná o opo yuseefi gi hii goontapu?”
eng_text: Judas saith unto him, not Iscariot, Lord, how is it that thou wilt manifest thyself unto us, and not unto the world?

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Sama di lobi mi, o go e du san a yee a mi. Da mi Tata o lobi en. Da mi anga mi Tata o kon, da wi o tan anga en.
eng_text: Jesus answered and said unto him, If a man love me, he will keep my words: and my Father will love him, and we will come unto him, and make our abode with him.

djk_text: Ma, efu wan sama á lobi mi, da a ná o teke den wowtu di mi e leli en. Bika a wowtu di u e yee, a ná mi wowtu, ma na fu a Tata di sende mi kon.”
eng_text: He that loveth me not keepeth not my sayings: and the word which ye hear is not mine, but the Father's which sent me.

djk_text: “We, mi e taigi u den sani fu di mi de anga u ya ete.
eng_text: These things have I spoken unto you, being yet present with you.

djk_text: Ma a Yeepiman, a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu, di mi Tata o sende kon a mi nen, sa leli u ala sani. Da soseefi a sa tyai ala san di mi be taigi u kon baka a ini u pakisei.
eng_text: But the Comforter, which is the Holy Ghost, whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance, whatsoever I have said unto you.

djk_text: We, mi sa gi u wan koo ati. A koo ati di mi e gi u ya de taa fasi enke di fu goontapu. A dati meke a á de fu u dege dege ofu feele.”
eng_text: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den go doo taki: “U be yee di mi be taigi u taki, mi e gwe, ma mi o kon baka a u. Efu u be lobi mi, da u ati be o piisii, di mi taigi u taki, mi e gwe a mi Tata. Bika mi Tata bigi moo mi.
eng_text: Ye have heard how I said unto you, I go away, and come again unto you. If ye loved me, ye would rejoice, because I said, I go unto the Father: for my Father is greater than I.

djk_text: We, mi be taki den sani ya gi u a fesi, fu te a yuu o doo di den o pasa, fu u sa biibi.
eng_text: And now I have told you before it come to pass, that, when it is come to pass, ye might believe.

djk_text: “Mi ná o taki langa anga u moo, bika a edeman fu a goontapu ya e kon. Ma a ná abi ná wan taki a mi tapu.
eng_text: Hereafter I will not talk much with you: for the prince of this world cometh, and hath nothing in me.

djk_text: Ma, na fu di goontapu mu kon sabi kiinkiin taki, mi lobi mi Tata, na dati ede meke mi e du enke fa mi Tata taigi mi. We, u opo meke u gwe komoto ya.”
eng_text: But that the world may know that I love the Father; and as the Father gave me commandment, even so I do. Arise, let us go hence.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “Mi na a tuutuu doloifi bon. Da mi Tata na a sama di abi a goon seefi fu solugu.
eng_text: I am the true vine, and my Father is the husbandman.

djk_text: Da u na den taka fu a doloifi bon. Da, efu wan fu den taka fu mi nái meke nyanyan, da mi Tata o koti en towe. Ma iniiwan taka di e meke nyanyan, da a o kiin den moi seeka den fu den meke moo ipi nyanyan.
eng_text: Every branch in me that beareth not fruit he taketh away: and every branch that beareth fruit, he purgeth it, that it may bring forth more fruit.

djk_text: Ma a wowtu di mi taki gi u, meke u de kiinkiin seeka seeka kaba.
eng_text: Now ye are clean through the word which I have spoken unto you.

djk_text: We, u tan a ini mi. Da u meke mi tan a ini u tu. Leti enke fa i si wan taka wawan á poi meke nyanyan, efu a á tan a na a bon, na leti soseefi u seefi ná o poi meke nyanyan tu, efu u á tan a ini mi.
eng_text: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can ye, except ye abide in me.

djk_text: “Mi na a doloifi bon. U na den taka fu mi. Sama di e tan a ini mi, ne mi tan ne en ini, da so wan sama o meke tyaipi nyanyan. Bika sondee mi u á poi du ná wan sani.
eng_text: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.

djk_text: Sama di á tan a ini mi, den sa koti en puu towe enke wan dee doloifi taka. Da den e piki den taka ya towe a ini faya fu den boon.
eng_text: If a man abide not in me, he is cast forth as a branch, and is withered; and men gather them, and cast them into the fire, and they are burned.

djk_text: Efu u tan a ini mi, ne den leli fu mi tan na u ini, da u sa begi akisi san u wani, da u sa fende en.
eng_text: If ye abide in me, and my words abide in you, ye shall ask what ye will, and it shall be done unto you.

djk_text: Da, te u meke nyanyan, da na sowan fasi mi Tata o kisi balinen. Da u sa soi taki u na bakaman fu mi tuutuu.
eng_text: Herein is my Father glorified, that ye bear much fruit; so shall ye be my disciples.

djk_text: Da, leti enke fa mi Tata lobi mi, na soseefi miseefi lobi u tu. So u tan a ini a lobi fu mi.
eng_text: As the Father hath loved me, so have I loved you: continue ye in my love.

djk_text: Efu u du san mi e taki, da u sa tan a ini mi lobi. Bika mi tan a ini a lobi fu mi Tata fu di mi e du san a taigi mi fu du.
eng_text: If ye keep my commandments, ye shall abide in my love; even as I have kept my Father's commandments, and abide in his love.

djk_text: “Da mi taigi u den sani ya, fu a piisii fu mi tan a u ini ati. Da soseefi mi taigi u den sani ya, fu a piisii fu u mu goo a ini u ati te a pasa peesi.
eng_text: These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy might remain in you, and that your joy might be full.

djk_text: Da mi e sende u taki, u lobi useefi, enke fa mi lobi u.
eng_text: This is my commandment, That ye love one another, as I have loved you.

djk_text: We, bika ná wan sama sa lobi wan sama moo enke a sama di ná abi toobi fu poti en libi gi wan taa sama.
eng_text: Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.

djk_text: Da u na mi mati, efu u e du san mi sende u fu du.
eng_text: Ye are my friends, if ye do whatsoever I command you.

djk_text: Mi nái kai u futuboi moo. Bika wan futuboi á sabi san en masaa e du. Ma mi e kai u, mi mati. Bika mi be taigi u ala san mi be yee fu mi Tata.
eng_text: Henceforth I call you not servants; for the servant knoweth not what his lord doeth: but I have called you friends; for all things that I have heard of my Father I have made known unto you.

djk_text: A ná u be kon a mi, ma na mi be piki u puu a den taawan mindii fu u go, da u meke nyanyan. Da te u meke nyanyan, da a nyanyan fu u sa tan fu tego. Da iniiwan sani di u o akisi mi Tata a mi nen, a o gi u en.
eng_text: Ye have not chosen me, but I have chosen you, and ordained you, that ye should go and bring forth fruit, and that your fruit should remain: that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.

djk_text: Ma mi poti gi u taki: U lobi useefi.
eng_text: These things I command you, that ye love one another.

djk_text: “Efu kondee á lobi u, da u mu sabi taki, den á be lobi mi a fesi kaba bifo u.
eng_text: If the world hate you, ye know that it hated me before it hated you.

djk_text: Efu u be de fu kondee, da kondee be o lobi u, bika u be o de anga den na a wanse. Ma fu di u á de fu kondee, bika mi be piki u puu a den kondee sama mindii, na fu dati ede meke den á poi si u na ain.
eng_text: If ye were of the world, the world would love his own: but because ye are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world, therefore the world hateth you.

djk_text: U feegete den wowtu di mi be taigi u taki, wan futuboi á a bigi moo en masaa? We, leti enke fa i si den feti a mi baka fu pina mi, na leti soseefi den o feti a u baka pina u fu mi ede. Da, leti enke fa son sama be aliki mi wowtu e du san mi taki, na letiso sama sa aliki u san u e taki tu.
eng_text: Remember the word that I said unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord. If they have persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they have kept my saying, they will keep yours also.

djk_text: Ma na fu di den á sabi mi Tata di sende mi kon, meke den o du ala den sani ya anga u fu mi ede.
eng_text: But all these things will they do unto you for my name's sake, because they know not him that sent me.

djk_text: We, efu mi á be kon taki anga den, da den á be o du ogii. Ma, enke fa u de, den á poi sitee taki, den ná ogii.
eng_text: If I had not come and spoken unto them, they had not had sin: but now they have no cloke for their sin.

djk_text: Wan sama di buuse mi, buuse mi Tata tu.
eng_text: He that hateth me hateth my Father also.

djk_text: Efu mi á be du so gaan foondoo sani a den mindii, di wan taawan á be du ete, da den á be o du ogii. Ma now den si ala san di mi du, ne toku den buuse mi. Da soseefi den buuse mi Tata tu.
eng_text: If I had not done among them the works which none other man did, they had not had sin: but now have they both seen and hated both me and my Father.

djk_text: Ma fa i si den sani ya pasa de, na fu di san sikiifi a Gadu Buku mu kon tuu. Bika Gadu Buku sikiifi taki: ‘Mi á be du wan sani anga den, ne toku den á poi si mi na ain.’
eng_text: But this cometh to pass, that the word might be fulfilled that is written in their law, They hated me without a cause.

djk_text: “Ma mi o sende a Yeepiman, a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu di e leli sama den tuutuu sani fu Gadu kon. Da te a kon, da a sa taki sani fu mi.
eng_text: But when the Comforter is come, whom I will send unto you from the Father, even the Spirit of truth, which proceedeth from the Father, he shall testify of me:

djk_text: Da useefi o taki sani fu mi tu. Bika u be de anga mi fanafu a bigin.”
eng_text: And ye also shall bear witness, because ye have been with me from the beginning.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “Mi taigi u den sani ya a fesi fu u á buuya bakaten fu u lasi biibi.
eng_text: These things have I spoken unto you, that ye should not be offended.

djk_text: Bika den edeman o puu u a den keliki. Da a o kon seefi taki, den o kii u. Da te den kii u, da den o denki taki na Gadu den e du wan bun.
eng_text: They shall put you out of the synagogues: yea, the time cometh, that whosoever killeth you will think that he doeth God service.

djk_text: Ma den o du den sani ya anga u, fu di den á sabi mi Tata. Da soseefi den á sabi mi tu.
eng_text: And these things will they do unto you, because they have not known the Father, nor me.

djk_text: We, mi taigi u den sani ya, fu te a yuu o doo di den o pasa, fu u sabi taki, we, na so mi be taigi u. Da mi á be taigi u den sani ya a fesi, bika mi be de anga u ete.
eng_text: But these things have I told you, that when the time shall come, ye may remember that I told you of them. And these things I said not unto you at the beginning, because I was with you.

djk_text: “Ma now mi o daai gwe na a sama di sende mi kon ya baka. Ma ná wan fu u e akisi moo na on se mi e go.
eng_text: But now I go my way to him that sent me; and none of you asketh me, Whither goest thou?

djk_text: Ma na den sani di mi taigi u de, na den meke gaan tyali kisi u?
eng_text: But because I have said these things unto you, sorrow hath filled your heart.

djk_text: Ma mi e taigi u tuutuu taki, na wan gaan yeepi a de gi u, fa i si mi e gwe ya. Bika, efu mi á gwe, da a Yeepiman ná poi kon. Ma te mi go kaba, da mi o sende en kon gi u.
eng_text: Nevertheless I tell you the truth; It is expedient for you that I go away: for if I go not away, the Comforter will not come unto you; but if I depart, I will send him unto you.

djk_text: Da, te a kon, da a sa soi kondee san na takuudu anga ogii. Da a o soi den san na a leti fasi fu libi anga fa Masaa Gadu o sitaafu libisama.
eng_text: And when he is come, he will reprove the world of sin, and of righteousness, and of judgment:

djk_text: Da a o soi den san na takuudu anga ogii, fu di den á biibi a mi.
eng_text: Of sin, because they believe not on me;

djk_text: Da a o soi den san na a leti fasi fu libi, fu di mi e daai go baka a mi Tata. Da u ná o poi si mi moo.
eng_text: Of righteousness, because I go to my Father, and ye see me no more;

djk_text: Da a o soi den fa Masaa Gadu o sitaafu kondee, bika a kuutu a edeman fu a goontapu fu a fende en sitaafu kaba.
eng_text: Of judgment, because the prince of this world is judged.

djk_text: “Ma mi abi somen sani ete di mi wani taigi u. Ma, enke fa u de nownow, u ná o poi tyai den.
eng_text: I have yet many things to say unto you, but ye cannot bear them now.

djk_text: Ma te a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu di e leli sama den tuutuu sani fu Gadu kon, da a o tii u, e tyai u a hii den sani di de tuutuu. Bika a ná o teke enseefi sani taigi u, ma san a be yee, na dati a o taki. Da soseefi a o taigi u den sani di de a fesi fu kon ete tu.
eng_text: Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide you into all truth: for he shall not speak of himself; but whatsoever he shall hear, that shall he speak: and he will shew you things to come.

djk_text: We, da a o meke libisama si a hei anga a balinen di mi abi. Bika a o teke sani fu mi taigi u.
eng_text: He shall glorify me: for he shall receive of mine, and shall shew it unto you.

djk_text: Ala san mi Tata abi na fu mi. Na fu dati ede meke mi taigi u taki, a o teke sani fu mi taigi u.
eng_text: All things that the Father hath are mine: therefore said I, that he shall take of mine, and shall shew it unto you.

djk_text: “Pikinso moo, da u ná o si mi moo. Ma pikinso moo, da u o si mi baka. Bika mi e go a mi Tata.”
eng_text: A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me, because I go to the Father.

djk_text: We, ne wantu fu den bakaman fi en akisi den na den taki, san na a sani di a taki de taki: “Pikinso moo, da u ná o si mi moo? Ma, pikinso moo, da u o si mi baka? Bika mi e go a mi Tata?”
eng_text: Then said some of his disciples among themselves, What is this that he saith unto us, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me: and, Because I go to the Father?

djk_text: Ne den taki go doo taki: “San wani taki, pikinso moo? We, wi á sabi san a sani de wani taki.”
eng_text: They said therefore, What is this that he saith, A little while? we cannot tell what he saith.

djk_text: We, di Masaa Jesesi si taki den wani akisi en wan sani, ne a akisi den taki: “We, fa u e kuutu anga useefi saafi saafi de? Na fu di mi taki: ‘Pikinso moo, da u ná o si mi moo. Ma pikinso moo, da u o si mi baka?’ U á sabi san dati wani taki, no?
eng_text: Now Jesus knew that they were desirous to ask him, and said unto them, Do ye inquire among yourselves of that I said, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me?

djk_text: We, fu tuutuu mi e taigi u, u sa bali kee, ma goontapu sa piisii. Da gaan tyali o de a u ati. Ma a tyali fu u o kengi kon toon piisii.
eng_text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, That ye shall weep and lament, but the world shall rejoice: and ye shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy.

djk_text: A de leti enke te wan uman de anga bee. Te a yuu fi en doo fu a meke, da a bee e nyanmi en, te ná sipowtu. Ma te a meke kaba, da a nái pakisei a pen moo. Piisii namo, di ai piisii so fu di wan sama kon a goontapu.
eng_text: A woman when she is in travail hath sorrow, because her hour is come: but as soon as she is delivered of the child, she remembereth no more the anguish, for joy that a man is born into the world.

djk_text: We, na letiso a de anga u tu. Nownow, enke fa u de, gaan tyali de a u ati. Ma mi o si u baka. Da u ati sa piisii. Da ná wan sama o poi puu a piisii fu u ya.
eng_text: And ye now therefore have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no man taketh from you.

djk_text: Da a yuu ten de, da u ná o akisi mi ná wan sani moo. Fu tuutuu mi e taigi u taki, ala sani di u begi akisi mi Tata a mi nen, da a sa gi u den.
eng_text: And in that day ye shall ask me nothing. Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall ask the Father in my name, he will give it you.

djk_text: Fu te enke now, u á be begi akisi mi wan sani a mi nen ete. We, u begi akisi, no? U o fende. Da te u o fende, da a piisii fu u o goo kon te a pasa maiki.
eng_text: Hitherto have ye asked nothing in my name: ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be full.

djk_text: “We, ala den sani di mi be taigi u, mi be taigi anga ageisi toli. Ma a ten koosube, di mi ná o taki anga u a sowan fasi moo. Ma mi o taki anga u, wan kiin fasi e leli u den sani fu mi Tata.
eng_text: These things have I spoken unto you in proverbs: but the time cometh, when I shall no more speak unto you in proverbs, but I shall shew you plainly of the Father.

djk_text: Da a yuu ten de, da u sa begi akisi mi Tata sani a mi nen. Da mi ná o taigi u taki, mi sa begi mi Tata gi u.
eng_text: At that day ye shall ask in my name: and I say not unto you, that I will pray the Father for you:

djk_text: Bika, mi Tata seefi lobi u, fu di u lobi mi e biibi taki ne en mi komoto kon ya.
eng_text: For the Father himself loveth you, because ye have loved me, and have believed that I came out from God.

djk_text: We, na mi Tata mi komoto kon a goontapu tuu. Da na soseefi mi o fika a goontapu ya baka go a mi Tata baka.”
eng_text: I came forth from the Father, and am come into the world: again, I leave the world, and go to the Father.

djk_text: Ne den bakaman fi en taigi en taki: “Weeno! I si? Now yu e taki kiin anga u sondee fu taki anga ageisi toli.
eng_text: His disciples said unto him, Lo, now speakest thou plainly, and speakest no proverb.

djk_text: Now wi e si taki a á de fanowdu fu sama akisi sani, bika, i sabi ala sani. Na fu dati ede meke u e biibi taki na Masaa Gadu i komoto.”
eng_text: Now are we sure that thou knowest all things, and needest not that any man should ask thee: by this we believe that thou camest forth from God.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “A nowfosi u e biibi?
eng_text: Jesus answered them, Do ye now believe?

djk_text: We, fu tuutuu mi e taigi u taki, wan yuu e kon, da a de kaba, di u o paati fika mi wawan kodo. Ibiiwan fu u o go ne en osu. Ma toku seefi, a ná mi wawan de. Bika mi Tata de anga mi.
eng_text: Behold, the hour cometh, yea, is now come, that ye shall be scattered, every man to his own, and shall leave me alone: and yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.

djk_text: We, mi be taigi u den sani ya fu u sa abi koo ati fu di mi anga u de wan. A ini goontapu ya gaan pina anga sitaafu e kon a tapu. Ma u á lasi ati. Bika, mi wini goontapu kaba.”
eng_text: These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.

djk_text: Ne di Masaa Jesesi taki anga den so te a kaba, ne a opo en ede luku tapu, ne a taki: “Mi Tata! A yuu doo kaba. Soi sama a waiti di a Manpikin fi i abi, fu a Manpikin fi yu sa soi sama a waiti fasi fi yu tu.
eng_text: These words spake Jesus, and lifted up his eyes to heaven, and said, Father, the hour is come; glorify thy Son, that thy Son also may glorify thee:

djk_text: We, bika i gi en taki na ala sama tapu, fu a sa gi den sama di i gi en a libi fu tego.
eng_text: As thou hast given him power over all flesh, that he should give eternal life to as many as thou hast given him.

djk_text: We, a libi fu tego, dati na fu den kon sabi yu, enke awan kodo tuutuu Gadu. Da soseefi fu den kon sabi Jesesi Kelestesi tu di i be sende kon a goontapu.
eng_text: And this is life eternal, that they might know thee the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom thou hast sent.

djk_text: Mi soi hii goontapu a waiti fasi fi yu. Mi kaba anga a wooko di i be gi mi fu du.
eng_text: I have glorified thee on the earth: I have finished the work which thou gavest me to do.

djk_text: We, mi Tata, meke mi fende a hei anga a waiti fasi fu mi baka, di mi be abi bifo goontapu be meke.
eng_text: And now, O Father, glorify thou me with thine own self with the glory which I had with thee before the world was.

djk_text: “Mi meke den sama di i gi mi a goontapu ya kon sabi i kiinkiin. Na yu be abi den kaba, ma yu gi mi den. Da den teke yu wowtu oli.
eng_text: I have manifested thy name unto the men which thou gavest me out of the world: thine they were, and thou gavest them me; and they have kept thy word.

djk_text: Da now den kon sabi taki ala den sani di mi abi, na yu den komoto.
eng_text: Now they have known that all things whatsoever thou hast given me are of thee.

djk_text: Bika mi gi den yu wowtu. Da den teke den. We, den kon sabi kiinkiin tu taki na yu mi komoto. Da den e biibi tu taki na yuseefi be sende mi kon.
eng_text: For I have given unto them the words which thou gavest me; and they have received them, and have known surely that I came out from thee, and they have believed that thou didst send me.

djk_text: “We, na den mi e begi gi. Ná den sama fu a goontapu ya mi e begi gi. Ma na fu den wawan di i be gi mi. Bika den na fi yu.
eng_text: I pray for them: I pray not for the world, but for them which thou hast given me; for they are thine.

djk_text: Ala den sama di mi abi na fi yu. Da soseefi ala den sama fi yu na fu mi. Da libisama si a waiti fasi fu mi a den.
eng_text: And all mine are thine, and thine are mine; and I am glorified in them.

djk_text: Mi á de a goontapu moo, ma den de a goontapu ete. Da, mi e kon a yu. Mi Tata di de apaiti fu ala sani di de. Tata, kibii den sama di i gi mi ya a ini a kaakiti fu a nen fi yu, meke den de wan makandii, leti enke fa mi anga yu de wan.
eng_text: And now I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I come to thee. Holy Father, keep through thine own name those whom thou hast given me, that they may be one, as we are.

djk_text: Alaten di mi be de a goontapu, mi be e kibii den a ini a kaakiti fu a nen fi yu di i gi mi. Mi be e luku den seefi fu ná wan fu den go lasi, boiti a ogii ati wan, di be meke fu go lasi kaba a soso fu a sani di Gadu Buku taki mu kon tuu.
eng_text: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in thy name: those that thou gavest me I have kept, and none of them is lost, but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.

djk_text: “Da Tata, now mi e kon a yu. Ma mi e taki den sani ya a goontapu ete. Bika mi wani meke a piisii fu mi goo a ini den ati ini te a pasa maiki.
eng_text: And now come I to thee; and these things I speak in the world, that they might have my joy fulfilled in themselves.

djk_text: Mi be gi den yu wowtu. Ma goontapu buuse den. Bika den á de fu goontapu, leti enke fa miseefi á de fu goontapu tu.
eng_text: I have given them thy word; and the world hath hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

djk_text: Da Tata, mi nái begi fi i puu den na goontapu. Ma mi e begi fi i kibii den fu a didibii á koli den kisi.
eng_text: I pray not that thou shouldest take them out of the world, but that thou shouldest keep them from the evil.

djk_text: Den á de fu kondee, leti enke fa miseefi á de fu kondee.
eng_text: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

djk_text: Mi Tata, teke den sama ya poti apaiti meke den kon si sani kiinkiin, enke fa den de tuutuu. Bika a wowtu fi yu na a tuu.
eng_text: Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth.

djk_text: Leti enke fa yu be sende mi kon a goontapu, na letiso mi e sende den go a goontapu tu.
eng_text: As thou hast sent me into the world, even so have I also sent them into the world.

djk_text: Na fu den ede meke mi e poti miseefi a wan apaiti fasi gi yu. Da meke den seefi sa poti denseefi na tuutuu apaiti fasi gi yu tu.
eng_text: And for their sakes I sanctify myself, that they also might be sanctified through the truth.

djk_text: “Ma mi nái begi gi den disi wawan. Ma mi e begi gi ala den taawan di o yee den wowtu, da den daai kon e biibi a mi.
eng_text: Neither pray I for these alone, but for them also which shall believe on me through their word;

djk_text: Tata, mi e begi fu den ala fiya kon de wan makandii, leti enke fa mi anga yu de wan. Da efu den de wan, da goontapu sa sabi taki na yu be sende mi kon.
eng_text: That they all may be one; as thou, Father, art in me, and I in thee, that they also may be one in us: that the world may believe that thou hast sent me.

djk_text: Mi be gi den a seefi waiti fasi di i be gi mi, fu den sa de wan makandii, enke fa mi anga yu de wan.
eng_text: And the glory which thou gavest me I have given them; that they may be one, even as we are one:

djk_text: Da mi de a den ati ini, da yu de a mi ati ini. Da na so den o de wan tuutuu fu hii goontapu mu si taki na yu be sende mi kon. Bika yu lobi den, leti enke fa i lobi mi.
eng_text: I in them, and thou in me, that they may be made perfect in one; and that the world may know that thou hast sent me, and hast loved them, as thou hast loved me.

djk_text: “Mi Tata, mi wani fu den sama di i gi mi ya, mu de anga mi a pe mi de, fu den si a waiti fasi fu mi di yu gi mi. Bika i be lobi mi bifo goontapu be meke.
eng_text: Father, I will that they also, whom thou hast given me, be with me where I am; that they may behold my glory, which thou hast given me: for thou lovedst me before the foundation of the world.

djk_text: We, mi Tata, yu di e du sani sondee kukutu fasi, goontapu á sabi yu. Ma mi sabi yu. Da now, den sama di i gi mi ya kon sabi taki na yu be sende mi kon.
eng_text: O righteous Father, the world hath not known thee: but I have known thee, and these have known that thou hast sent me.

djk_text: Mi meke den kon sabi yu kiinkiin enke fa i de. Da mi sa meke den kon sabi yu moo, fu den sa abi a sowtu lobi di yu abi gi mi. Da miseefi o de a den ati ini tu.”
eng_text: And I have declared unto them thy name, and will declare it: that the love wherewith thou hast loved me may be in them, and I in them.

djk_text: Di Masaa Jesesi kaba a begi fi en, ne en anga den bakaman fi en gwe. Da den o pasa na a kiiki di den e kai, Kidilon go na a taase. Ma namo, da wan dyali be de ape. Ne Masaa Jesesi anga den bakaman fi en go de.
eng_text: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went forth with his disciples over the brook Cedron, where was a garden, into the which he entered, and his disciples.

djk_text: Ma Judasi, a man di o seli Masaa Jesesi be sabi a peesi tu. Bika en anga Masaa Jesesi anga den taa bakaman fi en be lobi kon makandii de.
eng_text: And Judas also, which betrayed him, knew the place: for Jesus ofttimes resorted thither with his disciples.

djk_text: We, ne Judasi teke wan lo Loma suudati anga wan lo sikowtu fu a Mama Keliki fu den Dyu a Jelusalem. Den Faliseiman anga den hei apaiti begiman be gi en den. Namo di den kon, da den kon anga lantei anga fambo anga feti sani.
eng_text: Judas then, having received a band of men and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees, cometh thither with lanterns and torches and weapons.

djk_text: We, fu di Masaa Jesesi be sabi ala san be o miti en a fesi kaba, na fu dati ede meke a waka go miti den. Ne a akisi den taki: “Sama u e suku?”
eng_text: Jesus therefore, knowing all things that should come upon him, went forth, and said unto them, Whom seek ye?

djk_text: Ne den piki en taki: “Na Jesesi fu Nasaleti u e suku!” Ne Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Na mi de ya! Ma namo, da Judasi di o seli Masaa Jesesi seefi be taampu de tu anga den taa sama.”
eng_text: They answered him, Jesus of Nazareth. Jesus saith unto them, I am he. And Judas also, which betrayed him, stood with them.

djk_text: We, di Masaa Jesesi piki den taki: “Na mi de ya!” Ne ala den fiya kiki go anga baka ne den kai.
eng_text: As soon then as he had said unto them, I am he, they went backward, and fell to the ground.
