djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi akisi den baka taki: “Sama u e suku?” Ne den piki en taki: “Na Jesesi fu Nasaleti u e suku.”
eng_text: Then asked he them again, Whom seek ye? And they said, Jesus of Nazareth.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “Mi taigi u kaba. Na mi de ya!” Ne a taigi den go doo taki: “We, efu na mi u e suku, da u fika den bakaman fu mi ya meke den gwe!”
eng_text: Jesus answered, I have told you that I am he: if therefore ye seek me, let these go their way:

djk_text: We, na so a wowtu kon leti enke fa a be taki: “Ná wan enkii wan fu den sama di i be gi mi, di mi lasi.”
eng_text: That the saying might be fulfilled, which he spake, Of them which thou gavest me have I lost none.

djk_text: We, ma namo, da Simon Peitilisi be abi wan fetihow ne en de. Ne a teke a fetihow, ne velen, a koti a letise yesi fu a futuboi fu a moo hei begiman, puu. Na a futuboi ya nen den be e kai Maakusi.
eng_text: Then Simon Peter having a sword drew it, and smote the high priest's servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant's name was Malchus.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi taigi Peitilisi taki: “Peitilisi! Toosi i fetihow poti baka a ini en saka! I denki taki a fiti fu mi wai komoto a pasi gi a pina sitaafu di mi Tata poti gi mi fu pina ya?”
eng_text: Then said Jesus unto Peter, Put up thy sword into the sheath: the cup which my Father hath given me, shall I not drink it?

djk_text: Ne a yuu de, ne a kulu suudati kon anga a edeman fu den anga den sikowtu fu a Mama Keliki, ne den kisi Masaa Jesesi. Ne den tei en ana.
eng_text: Then the band and the captain and officers of the Jews took Jesus, and bound him,

djk_text: Ne, den tyai en go a wan osu fu wan man den e kai Anasi. Da Kayafasi na be a moo hei apaiti begiman, a yali de. Da a be libi anga wan umanpikin fu Anasi.
eng_text: And led him away to Annas first; for he was father in law to Caiaphas, which was the high priest that same year.

djk_text: Da a Kayafasi ya, na a seefi sama di be gi den edeman fu den Dyu a lai taki, a moo betee wan man dede gi a hii foluku, pe fu a foluku dede kaba a soso.
eng_text: Now Caiaphas was he, which gave counsel to the Jews, that it was expedient that one man should die for the people.

djk_text: We, Simon Peitilisi anga wan taa bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi e waka go a Masaa Jesesi baka. Da a bakaman ya na wan sama di a moo hei apaiti begiman fu a Mama Keliki be sabi. Da na fu dati ede meke a bakaman ya go te a ini a dyali fu a moo hei apaiti begiman, a Masaa Jesesi baka.
eng_text: And Simon Peter followed Jesus, and so did another disciple: that disciple was known unto the high priest, and went in with Jesus into the palace of the high priest.

djk_text: Ma Peitilisi fika taampu taampu a doose. We, na fu dati ede meke a bakaman ya, di a moo hei apaiti begiman be sabi go a doose, ne a taki anga a uman di be taampu na a doo mofu fu a dyali. Ne a uman meke Peitilisi pasa kon a ini a dyali.
eng_text: But Peter stood at the door without. Then went out that other disciple, which was known unto the high priest, and spake unto her that kept the door, and brought in Peter.

djk_text: We, a uman di be de na a doo mofu taigi Peitilisi taki: “Yu a ná wan bakaman fu a man, no?” Ne Peitilisi piki taki: “Nono! Ná mi!”
eng_text: Then saith the damsel that kept the door unto Peter, Art not thou also one of this man's disciples? He saith, I am not.

djk_text: Ma namo, da den futuboi anga den sikowtu di be e oli waki na a gaaman osu be meke wan koofaya faya fu den de a waan. We, ne Peitilisi seefi go taampu de e waan a faya tu. Bika a peesi be koo.
eng_text: And the servants and officers stood there, who had made a fire of coals; for it was cold: and they warmed themselves: and Peter stood with them, and warmed himself.

djk_text: We, ne a moo hei apaiti begiman e akisi Masaa Jesesi wanlo sani fu den bakaman fi en, anga somen sani fu a leli fi en.
eng_text: The high priest then asked Jesus of his disciples, and of his doctrine.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Mi be de a lanti mindii alaten e leli sama. Mi be de a ini den keliki e leli sama, te go doo a Mama Keliki anga ala peesi pe den Dyu e kon makandii tu. Mi á be de bakabaka e taki sani.
eng_text: Jesus answered him, I spake openly to the world; I ever taught in the synagogue, and in the temple, whither the Jews always resort; and in secret have I said nothing.

djk_text: We, saide meke na mi yu e akisi den sani de? Akisi den sama di be e yee den sani di mi be e leli den. Den sa sabi fu taigi u san mi be e taki.”
eng_text: Why askest thou me? ask them which heard me, what I have said unto them: behold, they know what I said.

djk_text: We ne, di Masaa Jesesi taki so, ne wan fu den sikowtu di be taampu de, naki en wan baala ana kwaa ne en sikin fesi taki: “On fa? Na so yu e taki anga a moo hei apaiti begiman fu a Mama Keliki?”
eng_text: And when he had thus spoken, one of the officers which stood by struck Jesus with the palm of his hand, saying, Answerest thou the high priest so?

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki taki: “We, efu mi taki ogii, da taigi mi sowtu ogii mi taki? Ma efu na wan tuu sani mi taki, da saide meke yu e naki mi?”
eng_text: Jesus answered him, If I have spoken evil, bear witness of the evil: but if well, why smitest thou me?

djk_text: We, ne Anasi sende en go anga teitei ana a Kayafasi, a moo hei apaiti begiman.
eng_text: Now Annas had sent him bound unto Caiaphas the high priest.

djk_text: We, da a yuu di Peitilisi taampu e waan faya de, ne den akisi en taki: “Yu na wan bakaman fu a man tu?” Ma Peitilisi sitee, a taki: “Nono! Ná mi!”
eng_text: And Simon Peter stood and warmed himself. They said therefore unto him, Art not thou also one of his disciples? He denied it, and said, I am not.

djk_text: Ne bakadati, ne wan futuboi fu a moo hei apaiti begiman, wan famii fu Maakusi, a man di Peitilisi be koti en yesi puu, akisi Peitilisi taki: “Na yu anga en mi be si a ini a dyali, no?”
eng_text: One of the servants of the high priest, being his kinsman whose ear Peter cut off, saith, Did not I see thee in the garden with him?

djk_text: Ma Peitilisi sitee baka. Ne wanten de, ne kokoliyekee, a kakafoo bali.
eng_text: Peter then denied again: and immediately the cock crew.

djk_text: Ne a taa dei fuuku mamanten, ne den komoto a Kayafasi, ne den tyai Masaa Jesesi go a Gaaman Pilatesi osu. Ma den edeman fu den Dyu seefi á go a ini a gaaman osu. Bika den be wani oli den seefi kiin, enke fa a leli fu den be taki. Bika den be wani nyan a Pasika. Na fu dati ede meke Gaaman Pilatesi komoto kon a den a doose. Ne a akisi den taki: “We, on sowtu ogii a sama ya du, meke u e tyai en kon a mi?”
eng_text: Then led they Jesus from Caiaphas unto the hall of judgment: and it was early; and they themselves went not into the judgment hall, lest they should be defiled; but that they might eat the passover.

djk_text: Ne den piki en taki: “Efu a sama ya á be du ná wan ogii, u á be o tyai en kon a yu.”
eng_text: They answered and said unto him, If he were not a malefactor, we would not have delivered him up unto thee.

djk_text: We, ne Pilatesi taigi den taki: “We, u teke en, da u seefi kuutu en enke fa a weiti fu u e soi u.” Ma den Dyu piki en taki: “We, a Loma weiti nái gi wi enke Dyu pasi fu u kii sama.”
eng_text: Then said Pilate unto them, Take ye him, and judge him according to your law. The Jews therefore said unto him, It is not lawful for us to put any man to death:

djk_text: We, da na so den wowtu fu Masaa Jesesi be kon tuu. Bika a be pingi den a fesi pilisisi fa a dede fi en be o dede.
eng_text: That the saying of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spake, signifying what death he should die.

djk_text: We, ne Pilatesi go baka a ini en paleisi, na a pisi pe a kuutu be e oli, ne a kai Masaa Jesesi kon. Ne a akisi Masaa Jesesi taki: “We, san yu e taki? Yu na a kownu fu den Dyu?”
eng_text: Then Pilate entered into the judgment hall again, and called Jesus, and said unto him, Art thou the King of the Jews?

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “A sani di yu akisi mi de, na yu seefi akisi en, efu na san taa sama be taigi yu fu mi?”
eng_text: Jesus answered him, Sayest thou this thing of thyself, or did others tell it thee of me?

djk_text: Ne Gaaman Pilatesi akisi en taki: “Oho! Fa yu e akisi mi so? I si taki mi na wan Dyusama? A ná yu eigi sama anga den hei apaiti begiman tyai yu kon a mi ya, no? San i du seefi?”
eng_text: Pilate answered, Am I a Jew? Thine own nation and the chief priests have delivered thee unto me: what hast thou done?

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Fa mi e tii sani enke kownu á de enke a tii fu kownu a goontapu ya. Bika efu a be de so, da den bakaman fu mi be o opo feti anga den sama, di kon kisi mi tyai kon poti ya. Ma nono! Mi kownu tii a ná fu a goontapu ya.”
eng_text: Jesus answered, My kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom were of this world, then would my servants fight, that I should not be delivered to the Jews: but now is my kingdom not from hence.

djk_text: We, ne Pilatesi taigi en taki: “We, da meke u taki, da yu na wan kownu?” Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “A leti enke fa yu taki de. Mi na wan kownu! Na fu dati ede mi meke, mi kon a goontapu, fu soi den sama san na tuu. We, ala sama di lobi tuu, o go e aliki mi san mi e taki.”
eng_text: Pilate therefore said unto him, Art thou a king then? Jesus answered, Thou sayest that I am a king. To this end was I born, and for this cause came I into the world, that I should bear witness unto the truth. Every one that is of the truth heareth my voice.

djk_text: Ne Gaaman Pilatesi taigi en taki: “Tuu? San na tuu?”
eng_text: Pilate saith unto him, What is truth? And when he had said this, he went out again unto the Jews, and saith unto them, I find in him no fault at all.

djk_text: We, u aliki! Wi abi a gwenti fu te a Pasika o kai, fu mi losi wan sama puu a dunguu osu gi u. Da san u wani? U wani mi losi a kownu fu u ya gi u?”
eng_text: But ye have a custom, that I should release unto you one at the passover: will ye therefore that I release unto you the King of the Jews?

djk_text: Ma ala den pii den mofu e bali taki: “No! No! Wi á wani i losi en! Losi Balabasi gi u!” Da Balabasi na be wan abani.
eng_text: Then cried they all again, saying, Not this man, but Barabbas. Now Barabbas was a robber.

djk_text: Ma now, ne Pilatesi meke den teke Masaa Jesesi tyai gwe fu den wipi en.
eng_text: Then Pilate therefore took Jesus, and scourged him.

djk_text: Ne bakadati, ne den suudati teke wan tetei di gei agwago maka, ne den beei en kon enke wan kownu ati. Ne den toosi en gi Masaa Jesesi ne en ede suu. Ne den teke wan baaw lebi dyakiti, ne den wei gi en.
eng_text: And the soldiers platted a crown of thorns, and put it on his head, and they put on him a purple robe,

djk_text: Ne den taigi en taki: “Odiyoo! Odiyoo Kownu fu den Dyu! Ne den e naki en ne en fesi.”
eng_text: And said, Hail, King of the Jews! and they smote him with their hands.

djk_text: We, ne Gaaman Pilatesi go a doo baka, ne a taigi den taki: “We, u luku ya. Mi e tyai a sama ya kon a doo a u fesi. Mi á fende ná wan fowtu ne en. Da mi o losi en.”
eng_text: Pilate therefore went forth again, and saith unto them, Behold, I bring him forth to you, that ye may know that I find no fault in him.

djk_text: We, da na so Masaa Jesesi kon a doo anga a maka ati ne en ede anga a dyakiti ne en sikin. Ne Gaaman Pilatesi taigi den taki: “We, u luku a sama ya, ye!”
eng_text: Then came Jesus forth, wearing the crown of thorns, and the purple robe. And Pilate saith unto them, Behold the man!

djk_text: Ma di den hei apaiti begiman anga den sikowtu fu a Mama Keliki si en, ne den bali taki: “U kii en! U kii en! U sipikii en a koloisi kii.” Ne Gaaman Pilatesi taigi den taki: “We, u teke en, da u tyai go sipikii a koloisi! Ma miseefi á fende ná wan fowtu ne en.”
eng_text: When the chief priests therefore and officers saw him, they cried out, saying, Crucify him, crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Take ye him, and crucify him: for I find no fault in him.

djk_text: We, ne den Dyu piki en taki: “We, wi fende fowtu ne en, bika wi abi wan weiti di e soi wi taki a mu dede. Bika a be meke enseefi toon a Manpikin fu Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: The Jews answered him, We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.

djk_text: We, di a gaaman yee den sama taki so, ne a moo feele.
eng_text: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he was the more afraid;

djk_text: We, ne a go baka a ini gaaman osu, ne a taigi Masaa Jesesi taki: “On kondee na fi yu?” Ma Masaa Jesesi á piki en.
eng_text: And went again into the judgment hall, and saith unto Jesus, Whence art thou? But Jesus gave him no answer.

djk_text: Ne Gaaman Pilatesi taigi en taki: “Oho! Yu nái piki mi, no? Yu á sabi taki mi abi makiti fu meke den sipikii yu a koloisi kii, ma mi abi makiti fu meke den losi yu tu, no?”
eng_text: Then saith Pilate unto him, Speakest thou not unto me? knowest thou not that I have power to crucify thee, and have power to release thee?

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi piki en taki: “Yu á be poi abi ná wan sowtu makiti a mi tapu, efu a ná Gadu be gi yu en. Na fu dati ede meke a sama di i si tyai mi kon gi yu ya, du moo gaan ogii moo yu.”
eng_text: Jesus answered, Thou couldest have no power at all against me, except it were given thee from above: therefore he that delivered me unto thee hath the greater sin.

djk_text: Da fanafu a yuu de, ne Gaaman Pilatesi be e meke ala sowtu moiti fu losi Masaa Jesesi. Ma den Dyu e bali gi en taki: “Efi i losi a sama de gwe, da yu anga a moo gaan kownu a Loma Foto o kisi toobi. Bika wan sama di e meke enseefi toon kownu, na wan feyantiman fu a gaan kownu de.”
eng_text: And from thenceforth Pilate sought to release him: but the Jews cried out, saying, If thou let this man go, thou art not Caesar's friend: whosoever maketh himself a king speaketh against Caesar.

djk_text: Da di Gaaman Pilatesi yee den wowtu ya, ne a meke Masaa Jesesi komoto kon a doo. Ne Gaaman Pilatesi go sidon na a sutuu fi en, a pe a be e sidon koti kuutu. Da na a sutuu fi en ya den be e kai, Hei Siton Tapu. Ma den Dyu be e kai en, Gabata.
eng_text: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he brought Jesus forth, and sat down in the judgment seat in a place that is called the Pavement, but in the Hebrew, Gabbatha.

djk_text: Da den sani ya be e pasa na a seefi dei di den be seeka sani fu nyan a Pasika Piisii. Da a be sa de wan sani fu twalufu yuu so. Ne Gaaman Pilatesi taigi den Dyu taki: “We, u luku a kownu fu u ya!”
eng_text: And it was the preparation of the passover, and about the sixth hour: and he saith unto the Jews, Behold your King!

djk_text: Ma den bali taki: “U kii en! U kii en! U sipikii en a koloisi kii!” Ne Gaaman Pilatesi taigi den taki: “Na a kownu fu u, mi mu sipikii a koloisi kii?” Ma den hei apaiti begiman piki en taki: “Wi ná abi ná wan enkii kownu boiti a moo gaan kownu a Loma Foto!”
eng_text: But they cried out, Away with him, away with him, crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Shall I crucify your King? The chief priest answered, We have no king but Caesar.

djk_text: We, di den taki so, ne Gaaman Pilatesi gi den en fu den tyai go sipikii kii a koloisi.
eng_text: Then delivered he him therefore unto them to be crucified. And they took Jesus, and led him away.

djk_text: Da Masaa Jesesi seefi be e tyai a koloisi di den o sipikii en kii. Ne den e go te, den go doo na a peesi di den e kai, Bongo Pita Peesi. Ma den Dyu be e kai a peesi ya, Golgata.
eng_text: And he bearing his cross went forth into a place called the place of a skull, which is called in the Hebrew Golgotha:

djk_text: Da na ape den sipikii Masaa Jesesi na a koloisi. Da den sipikii ete tu man makandii anga en tu. Wan ne en kukutuse ana, a taawan ne en letise ana. Masaa Jesesi seefi de a mindii.
eng_text: Where they crucified him, and two other with him, on either side one, and Jesus in the midst.

djk_text: Ma namo, da Gaaman Pilatesi be sikiifi wan sani poti na a koloisi fu Masaa Jesesi a tapu. Da a be sikiifi taki:
eng_text: And Pilate wrote a title, and put it on the cross. And the writing was, JESUS OF NAZARETH THE KING OF THE JEWS.

djk_text: Da somen Dyu be leisi a sani di sikiifi na a koloisi a tapu anda. Bika a peesi pe den be sipikii Masaa Jesesi na a koloisi be de koosube fu a foto. Da a be sikiifi a sani ya a ini den tongo fu den Dyu, den Loma anga den Giiki sama.
eng_text: This title then read many of the Jews: for the place where Jesus was crucified was nigh to the city: and it was written in Hebrew, and Greek, and Latin.

djk_text: Ma den hei apaiti begiman e go a Pilatesi taki: “Yu á mu sikiifi taki: ‘En na Kownu fu den Dyu!’ Ma i mu sikiifi taki: ‘A be taki en na Kownu fu den Dyu.’ ”
eng_text: Then said the chief priests of the Jews to Pilate, Write not, The King of the Jews; but that he said, I am King of the Jews.

djk_text: Ma namo, ne Pilatesi piki den taki: “San mi sikiifi, tan sikiifi!”
eng_text: Pilate answered, What I have written I have written.

djk_text: We, di den suudati sipikii Masaa Jesesi na a koloisi kaba, ne den teke den koosi fi en, ne den meke fo ipi fu ibii suudati sa fende wan ipi. Ma now, da a fika ete wan koosi fi en. Da a koosi ya á be nai, ma a be wan gaan pisi koosi.
eng_text: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments, and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also his coat: now the coat was without seam, woven from the top throughout.

djk_text: Na fu dati ede den taigi den na den taki: “Meke wi á piiti en, ma meke wi iti lowte luku sama o wini en.” Da den sani ya pasa fu san sikiifi a Gadu Buku mu kon tuu. Bika Gadu Buku be sikiifi taki: “Den paati mi koosi den na den, den iti lowte fu paati mi koosi.”
eng_text: They said therefore among themselves, Let us not rend it, but cast lots for it, whose it shall be: that the scripture might be fulfilled, which saith, They parted my raiment among them, and for my vesture they did cast lots. These things therefore the soldiers did.

djk_text: Da a mma fu Masaa Jesesi anga en mma pikin sisa anga Maliya, a uman fu Kolopasi anga Maliya Makidala be taampu koosube fu a koloisi fu pe den be koloisi Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: Now there stood by the cross of Jesus his mother, and his mother's sister, Mary the wife of Cleophas, and Mary Magdalene.

djk_text: We, di Masaa Jesesi si en mma taampu anga a bakaman fi en di a be lobi te, ne a taigi en mma taki: “Uman! Luku i pikin de!”
eng_text: When Jesus therefore saw his mother, and the disciple standing by, whom he loved, he saith unto his mother, Woman, behold thy son!

djk_text: Ne bakadati, ne a taigi a bakaman fi en taki: “Luku i mama de!” Ne fanafu a ten de, ne a bakaman fi en de teke en ne en osu e solugu.
eng_text: Then saith he to the disciple, Behold thy mother! And from that hour that disciple took her unto his own home.

djk_text: Ma di Masaa Jesesi sabi taki a du ala den sani di a abi fu du, ne a taki ete wan sani fu meke ala sani di Gadu Buku sikiifi kon tuu. A taki: “Dee wataa kisi mi, baa!”
eng_text: After this, Jesus knowing that all things were now accomplished, that the scripture might be fulfilled, saith, I thirst.

djk_text: Ma namo, da den be abi wan patu anga wan sowtu win enke asin a ini. Ne den teke wan siponsu, sungu go a ini a win, ne den fasi en a wan tiki ede, ne den tyai go ne en mofu.
eng_text: Now there was set a vessel full of vinegar: and they filled a spunge with vinegar, and put it upon hyssop, and put it to his mouth.

djk_text: Ma di Jesesi diingi a asin kaba, ne a taki: “A kaba!” Ne na so a bendi en ede, ne a tapu boo.
eng_text: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost.

djk_text: Ma fu di den edeman fu Dyusama be mu seeka sani fu nyan a Pasika Piisii, meke den go begi Gaaman Pilatesi, fu a sende sama go naki den bon fu den futu booko. Da den dede sikin fu den á be de na a koloisi a hii kina dei de. Bika a kina dei di e kon de, na be wan apaiti kina dei gi den.
eng_text: The Jews therefore, because it was the preparation, that the bodies should not remain upon the cross on the sabbath day, (for that sabbath day was an high day,) besought Pilate that their legs might be broken, and that they might be taken away.

djk_text: We, na so den suudati kon, ne den booko den bon fu a fosi man futu. Ne den go, ne den booko den bon fu a taa man di den be koloisi de tu.
eng_text: Then came the soldiers, and brake the legs of the first, and of the other which was crucified with him.

djk_text: Ma di den kon fu booko den bon fu Masaa Jesesi, ne den si taki a dede kaba. Ne den á booko den moo.
eng_text: But when they came to Jesus, and saw that he was dead already, they brake not his legs:

djk_text: Ma wan fu den suudati sutu en anga wan lansi ne en sikin bee. Ne wanten, ne buulu anga wataa lon komoto a ini en sikin kon a doo.
eng_text: But one of the soldiers with a spear pierced his side, and forthwith came there out blood and water.

djk_text: Da a sama di e taki den sani ya, ne enseefi si den anga ain. Da fa ai taki ya, da na tuutuu sani ai taki, fu te i yee den, fi i sa daai teke biibi.
eng_text: And he that saw it bare record, and his record is true: and he knoweth that he saith true, that ye might believe.

djk_text: Bika den sani di i si pasa ya, pasa fu den sani di sikiifi a Gadu Buku mu kon tuu. Bika Gadu Buku sikiifi taki: “Den ná o booko ná wan bon fi en.”
eng_text: For these things were done, that the scripture should be fulfilled, A bone of him shall not be broken.

djk_text: Da a wan taa peesi a taki baka taki: “Sama o si a sama di den sutu a sutu de.”
eng_text: And again another scripture saith, They shall look on him whom they pierced.

djk_text: We, ne wan man den e kai Jowsef fu Alimateya Kondee, di be e waka a Masaa Jesesi baka tu kon. Dati be de wan kibii toli. Bika a be e feele den edeman fu den Dyu. Ne a go begi Gaaman Pilatesi, fu a puu a dede sikin fu Masaa Jesesi na a koloisi. Ne Gaaman Pilatesi gi en pasi. Ne a go, ne a go puu a dede sikin fu Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: And after this Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, besought Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus: and Pilate gave him leave. He came therefore, and took the body of Jesus.

djk_text: Da Nikodeimisi, di be kon a Masaa Jesesi a wan neti seefi kon tu. Da a tyai sumee switi sani di den e seeka dede sikin te anga wan sani fu diitenti a dii kilo so. Da a be mokisa den sani ya te a mokisa.
eng_text: And there came also Nicodemus, which at the first came to Jesus by night, and brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about an hundred pound weight.

djk_text: Ne den teke a dede sikin fu Masaa Jesesi, ne den lolo en a ini weti koosi mokisa anga den sumee switi sani, enke fa den Dyu be gwenti beli dedesama.
eng_text: Then took they the body of Jesus, and wound it in linen clothes with the spices, as the manner of the Jews is to bury.

djk_text: Da koosube fu pe den be sipikii Masaa Jesesi, wan dyali be de. Da wan nyunyun geebi be de a ini a dyali ya, pe den á be beli ná wan sama ete.
eng_text: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden; and in the garden a new sepulchre, wherein was never man yet laid.

djk_text: We, da a kina dei be koosube fu kai. Da fu di a geebi be de koosube anga pe den be sipikii Masaa Jesesi na a koloisi kii, na dati meke den tyai en go poti a ini a geebi ya.
eng_text: There laid they Jesus therefore because of the Jews' preparation day; for the sepulchre was nigh at hand.

djk_text: We, na a fosi dei fu a wiki, fuuku musude, ne Maliya Makidala go na a geebi fu Masaa Jesesi. Ma namo, di a go, ne a si taki a siton á de na a geebi mofu moo.
eng_text: The first day of the week cometh Mary Magdalene early, when it was yet dark, unto the sepulchre, and seeth the stone taken away from the sepulchre.

djk_text: Na fu dati ede meke a lon go a Simon Peitilisi anga a taa bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi di a be lobi te. Ne a taigi den taki: “Den puu Masaa na a geebi, da wi á sabi pe den poti en.”
eng_text: Then she runneth, and cometh to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple, whom Jesus loved, and saith unto them, They have taken away the Lord out of the sepulchre, and we know not where they have laid him.

djk_text: We, ne Peitilisi anga a taa bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi opo, ne den go na a geebi.
eng_text: Peter therefore went forth, and that other disciple, and came to the sepulchre.

djk_text: Den tu be makandii, ma a taa bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi lon pasa Peitilisi. Ne na so en fosi doo na a geebi.
eng_text: So they ran both together: and the other disciple did outrun Peter, and came first to the sepulchre.

djk_text: We, ne di a bende luku, ne a si den sibi koosi wawan de. Ma a á go a ini a geebi.
eng_text: And he stooping down, and looking in, saw the linen clothes lying; yet went he not in.

djk_text: We, ne Simon Peitilisi seefi doo. Ma en go te a ini a geebi. Ne a si den koosi di den be lolo Masaa Jesesi de.
eng_text: Then cometh Simon Peter following him, and went into the sepulchre, and seeth the linen clothes lie,

djk_text: Ma a angisa di den be tei Masaa Jesesi ede á be de a pe den taa koosi be de, ma a be de te a wanse a wan taa peesi.
eng_text: And the napkin, that was about his head, not lying with the linen clothes, but wrapped together in a place by itself.

djk_text: Ma, ne a taa bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi di fosi be doo na a geebi go a ini a geebi tu. Ne di a si den sani, ne fosi a daai kon e biibi.
eng_text: Then went in also that other disciple, which came first to the sepulchre, and he saw, and believed.

djk_text: Bika te enke now, da den á be fusutan a wowtu di sikiifi a Gadu Buku taki Masaa Jesesi mu opo baka komoto a dede ete.
eng_text: For as yet they knew not the scripture, that he must rise again from the dead.

djk_text: We, ne na so den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi go baka a osu.
eng_text: Then the disciples went away again unto their own home.

djk_text: Ma Maliya dati taampu a doose fu a geebi, ne a bali kee. Da di a kee te wan pisi, ne a bendi luku go a ini a geebi.
eng_text: But Mary stood without at the sepulchre weeping: and as she wept, she stooped down, and looked into the sepulchre,

djk_text: Ne a si tu Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee sidon a pe a dede sikin fu Masaa Jesesi be de. Den de anga weti koosi fann. Wan fu den Basiya ya sidon ne en ede se. A taawan sidon ne en futu se, leti enke fa den be poti a dede sikin fu Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: And seeth two angels in white sitting, the one at the head, and the other at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.

djk_text: Ne den taigi Maliya taki: “Uman! Saide meke yu e kee so?” Ne a taigi den taki: “Den puu mi Masaa ya, da mi á sabi pe den tyai en go.”
eng_text: And they say unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? She saith unto them, Because they have taken away my Lord, and I know not where they have laid him.

djk_text: Ne di a taki so, ne a daai fesi, ne a si Masaa Jesesi taampu taampu de. Ma a á be sabi taki na be Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: And when she had thus said, she turned herself back, and saw Jesus standing, and knew not that it was Jesus.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi taigi en taki: “Uman! Saide meke yu e kee so? Sama yu e suku?” Ma Maliya denki taki na a man di be e kiinmi a dyali e luku den boomiki be e taki anga en. Na fu dati ede meke a taigi a man taki: “Masaa, efu na yu tyai en gwe, taigi mi, pe i poti en, mi sa go teke en.”
eng_text: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? whom seekest thou? She, supposing him to be the gardener, saith unto him, Sir, if thou have borne him hence, tell me where thou hast laid him, and I will take him away.

djk_text: Ma now, ne Masaa Jesesi kai en taki: “Maliya!” Ne Maliya daai en fesi, ne a bali taki: “Labuni!” Labuni wani taki, Mesiti, na Dyu Tongo.
eng_text: Jesus saith unto her, Mary. She turned herself, and saith unto him, Rabboni; which is to say, Master.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi en taki: “Ná oli mi! Bika mi á go a mi Tata ete. Ma go a den baala fu mi, da taigi den taki, mi e opo go a mi Tata, di de a Tata fu u tu. Mi e go a mi Gadu di de a Gadu fu u tu.”
eng_text: Jesus saith unto her, Touch me not; for I am not yet ascended to my Father: but go to my brethren, and say unto them, I ascend unto my Father, and your Father; and to my God, and your God.

djk_text: We, ne Maliya Makidala go taigi den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi taki: “Mi si Masaa! Da na so so, a taigi mi.”
eng_text: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had spoken these things unto her.

djk_text: We, a seefi fosi dei fu a wiki de, di sapaten, da den bakaman fi en be de makandii a ini wan osu sooto sooto doo. Bika den be e feele den edeman fu den Dyu. Ne te fu den denki, ne Masaa Jesesi kon taampu a den mindii haa. Ne a taigi den taki: “Meke Masaa Gadu de anga u!”
eng_text: Then the same day at evening, being the first day of the week, when the doors were shut where the disciples were assembled for fear of the Jews, came Jesus and stood in the midst, and saith unto them, Peace be unto you.

djk_text: Ne di a taigi den so, ne a soi den en ana anga en sikin bansa. We, now, ne den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi piisii, te ná sipowtu, fu di den si Masaa.
eng_text: And when he had so said, he shewed unto them his hands and his side. Then were the disciples glad, when they saw the Lord.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den ete wan toon taki: “Meke Masaa Gadu gi u koo ati fu libi, ye! Leti enke fa i si mi Tata be sende mi kon a goontapu, na soseefi mi e sende u tu.”
eng_text: Then said Jesus to them again, Peace be unto you: as my Father hath sent me, even so send I you.

djk_text: Ne di a taki so, ne a boo a den tapu vuuu taki: “U teke a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: And when he had said this, he breathed on them, and saith unto them, Receive ye the Holy Ghost:

djk_text: Den sama di u o gi paadon fu takuudu anga ogii, o kisi paadon tuu. Ma sama di u á gi paadon, ná o kisi paadon tu.”
eng_text: Whose soever sins ye remit, they are remitted unto them; and whose soever sins ye retain, they are retained.

djk_text: Ma Towmasi, wan fu den twalufu bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi, di den be e kai Toolengi tu, á be de a den taawan mindii, di Masaa Jesesi be kon a den.
eng_text: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, was not with them when Jesus came.

djk_text: Ne di a kon, ne den taa bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi taigi en taki: “Wi si Masaa!” Ma a taigi den taawan taki: “Solanga mi seefi á si den sipikii maiki a ini en ana ini fu mi poti mi finga anga solanga mi á poti mi finga na a lansi mofu ne en sikin bansa, mi ná o biibi.”
eng_text: The other disciples therefore said unto him, We have seen the Lord. But he said unto them, Except I shall see in his hands the print of the nails, and put my finger into the print of the nails, and thrust my hand into his side, I will not believe.

djk_text: Da baka aitin dei, di den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi be de makandii baka a ini wan osu sooto sooto doo, da Towmasi be de a ini a osu ini anga den tu. Ne te fu den denki, ne Masaa Jesesi kon a ini a osu, ne a go taampu a den mindii dyan. Ne a taigi den taki: “Meke Gadu gi u koo ati fu libi, ye!”
eng_text: And after eight days again his disciples were within, and Thomas with them: then came Jesus, the doors being shut, and stood in the midst, and said, Peace be unto you.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi Towmasi taki: “Luku mi ana ya. Langa i finga kon fii a maiki a ini mi ana. Da tyai ana kon poti na lansi mofu a mi sikin bansa. I mu fika a fasi di yu abi de, taki yu ná biibi. Ma biibi!”
eng_text: Then saith he to Thomas, reach hither thy finger, and behold my hands; and reach hither thy hand, and thrust it into my side: and be not faithless, but believing.

djk_text: We, ne Towmasi bali taki: “Oho! Masaa Gadu, mi Gadu! Yu na mi Gadu!”
eng_text: And Thomas answered and said unto him, My Lord and my God.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi en taki: “Towmasi! A di yu si mi anga ain fosi yu e biibi? We, seigi fu den sama di e biibi, winsi den á si anga ain.”
eng_text: Jesus saith unto him, Thomas, because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed: blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.

djk_text: Da Masaa Jesesi du somen somen taa maiki ete a den bakaman fi en fesi, di á sikiifi a ini a buku ya.
eng_text: And many other signs truly did Jesus in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book:

djk_text: Ma den sani ya sikiifi fu u mu biibi taki, Jesesi na a Kelestesi, a Manpikin fu Masaa Gadu. Da te u e biibi so kaba, da u o fende a tego libi, fu di u anga en de wan.
eng_text: But these are written, that ye might believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God; and that believing ye might have life through his name.

djk_text: Ne bakadati, ne Masaa Jesesi tyai enseefi kon soi den bakaman fi en ete wan toon na a ze den e kai Tibeliyasi. Da a toli waka so:
eng_text: After these things Jesus shewed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias; and on this wise shewed he himself.

djk_text: Wan fu den toon, da Simon Peitilisi anga Towmasi, di den be e kai Toolengi, anga Nataniyeli, di fu a peesi di den e kai Kaana, na a pisiwataa fu Galileya, anga den tu manpikin fu Da Sebedi anga ete tu taa bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi be de a wan peesi.
eng_text: There were together Simon Peter, and Thomas called Didymus, and Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two other of his disciples.

djk_text: Ne Simon Peitilisi taigi den taki: “Mi o go a onti towe seepi a liba!” Ne den taigi en taki: “Wi o go anga yu tu.” We, ne den opo go a ini a boto. Ma a hiihii neti de, den á kisi ná wan sani.
eng_text: Simon Peter saith unto them, I go a fishing. They say unto him, We also go with thee. They went forth, and entered into a ship immediately; and that night they caught nothing.

djk_text: Ne a seefi dei de, fuuku mamanten, ne Masaa Jesesi kon taampu a mofu wataa de. Ma den bakaman fi en á be sabi taki na Masaa Jesesi de ape.
eng_text: But when the morning was now come, Jesus stood on the shore: but the disciples knew not that it was Jesus.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi akisi den taki: “Pikin, san u kisi?” Ne den piki en taki: “Iya, nono!”
eng_text: Then Jesus saith unto them, Children, have ye any meat? They answered him, No.

djk_text: Ne a taigi den taki: “U iti a seepi fu u go na a letise fu a boto, da u sa kisi.” Ne den iti den seepi, ne den kisi fisi tee, den á poi ali a seepi kon a tapu.
eng_text: And he said unto them, Cast the net on the right side of the ship, and ye shall find. They cast therefore, and now they were not able to draw it for the multitude of fishes.

djk_text: Ma a bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi di a be lobi te, taigi Peitilisi taki: “Na Masaa Jesesi de ape!” We, di Simon Peitilisi yee taki, na Masaa Jesesi de ape, ne a wei en koosi baka esi, bika a be puu en koosi fu di a be e go fisi. Ne, dyulu, a dyombo a liba.
eng_text: Therefore that disciple whom Jesus loved saith unto Peter, It is the Lord. Now when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he girt his fisher's coat unto him, (for he was naked,) and did cast himself into the sea.

djk_text: Ma den taa bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi kon a sikin soo anga a boto, bika den be sa de wan sani fu wan ondoo meiti so fu sikin soo. We, ne na so den ali a seepi kon anga den fisi ne en.
eng_text: And the other disciples came in a little ship; (for they were not far from land, but as it were two hundred cubits,) dragging the net with fishes.

djk_text: We, di den kon a soo, ne den si taki koofaya be de leti leti de anga fisi ne en tapu e losi. Da soseefi beele be de tu.
eng_text: As soon then as they were come to land, they saw a fire of coals there, and fish laid thereon, and bread.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “U tyai wantu fu den fisi di u kisi dyonson de kon gi mi.”
eng_text: Jesus saith unto them, Bring of the fish which ye have now caught.

djk_text: Ne Simon Peitilisi go a ini boto, ne a ali a seepi kon a soo. Da a seepi be fuu anga wan ondoo feifitenti a dii gaanbigi fisi. Ma anga ala fa a seepi ya be abi den tyaipi fisi ya, toku a á piiti.
eng_text: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land full of great fishes, and hundred and fifty and three: and for all there were so many, yet was not the net broken.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi taigi den taki: “U kon meke u nyan.” Ma ná wan fu den bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi di be e peefuu fu akisi en taki, sama a yu? Bika den be sabi taki na Masaa.
eng_text: Jesus saith unto them, Come and dine. And none of the disciples durst ask him, Who art thou? knowing that it was the Lord.

djk_text: We, ne Masaa Jesesi kon, ne a teke a beele, ne a paati gi den. Da soseefi a teke den fisi paati gi den tu.
eng_text: Jesus then cometh, and taketh bread, and giveth them, and fish likewise.

djk_text: Da disi na di fu dii toon, di Masaa Jesesi tyai enseefi kon soi den bakaman fi en baka di a weki baka komoto a dede.
eng_text: This is now the third time that Jesus shewed himself to his disciples, after that he was risen from the dead.

djk_text: Ne di den kaba nyan, ne Masaa akisi Simon Peitilisi taki: “Simon, manpikin fu Johanisi! I lobi mi moo enke den taa bakaman fu mi ya?” Ne Simon piki en taki: “Iya, Masaa! I seefi sabi taki mi lobi yu.” Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi en taki: “Luku den pikin sikapu fu mi bun.”
eng_text: So when they had dined, Jesus saith to Simon Peter, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me more than these? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my lambs.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi akisi en di fu tu toon taki: “Simon, manpikin fu Johanisi! I lobi mi?” Ne Simon piki en taki: “Iya, Masaa! I seefi sabi taki mi lobi yu.” Ne Masaa Jesesi taki en taki: “Luku den sikapu fu mi.”
eng_text: He saith to him again the second time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my sheep.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi akisi en di fu dii toon taki: “Simon, manpikin fu Johanisi, i lobi mi?” We, now, ne Peitilisi ati booko, fu di Masaa akisi en di fu dii toon taki, efu a lobi en. Ne a taigi Masaa taki: “Masaa! Yu sabi ala sani. Iseefi sabi tu taki mi lobi yu.” Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi en taki: “Luku den sikapu fu mi.
eng_text: He saith unto him the third time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? Peter was grieved because he said unto him the third time, Lovest thou me? And he said unto him, Lord, thou knowest all things; thou knowest that I love thee. Jesus saith unto him, Feed my sheep.

djk_text: Fu tuutuu mi e taigi yu Simon, di i be moo yonkuu, da iseefi be e wei i koosi, da i be e go a pe i be wani. Ma te yu o gaandi, da yu o langa i ana fu sama tei koosi gi yu, da den o tyai yu go a pe yu á be sa wani go.”
eng_text: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, When thou wast young, thou girdedst thyself, and walkedst whither thou wouldest: but when thou shalt be old, thou shalt stretch forth thy hands, and another shall gird thee, and carry thee whither thou wouldest not.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Jesesi taigi Peitilisi a sani ya, fu pingi en a fesi, fu a be sabi fa en dede o waka. Da a dede fu Peitilisi ya, o hei Masaa Gadu. Ne di a taigi en so kaba, ne a kai en taki: “Kon go anga mi.”
eng_text: This spake he, signifying by what death he should glorify God. And when he had spoken this, he saith unto him, Follow me.

djk_text: Ma di Peitilisi daai luku baka, ne a si taki a bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi di a be lobi te, e waka ne en baka tu. Da na a seefi bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi ya be sidon koosube fu Masaa Jesesi di den be e nyan a Pasika Piisii na a neti, di a be akisi en taki: “Masaa, sama na a sama di o seli yu?”
eng_text: Then Peter, turning about, seeth the disciple whom Jesus loved following; which also leaned on his breast at supper, and said, Lord, which is he that betrayeth thee?

djk_text: We, di Peitilisi si en, ne a akisi Masaa Jesesi taki: “Masaa, fa fu a sama de? San o pasa anga en dati?”
eng_text: Peter seeing him saith to Jesus, Lord, and what shall this man do?

djk_text: Ne Masaa Jesesi taigi en taki: “Efu mi wani a tan a libi fu te mi kon baka, san fi i de ne en? San yu mu du, na waka yu mu waka a mi baka.”
eng_text: Jesus saith unto him, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee? follow thou me.

djk_text: Ne fanafu a ten de, ne den taa bakaman fu Masaa be abi wan taki e taki den na den taki, a bakaman fi en ya, ná o dede. Ma Masaa Jesesi á be taki, taki a á be o dede. Ma a be taki: “Efu mi wani a tan a libi fu te mi kon baka, san fi i de ne en?”
eng_text: Then went this saying abroad among the brethren, that that disciple should not die: yet Jesus said not unto him, He shall not die; but, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee?

djk_text: We, na a seefi bakaman fu Masaa Jesesi de, ne i si e taigi yu den sani ya. Da soseefi ne en sikiifi a buku ya tu. Da wi sabi taki den sani di ai taki puu komoto ne en mofu na tuu.
eng_text: This is the disciple which testifieth of these things, and wrote these things: and we know that his testimony is true.

djk_text: Da Masaa Jesesi du somen taa sani ete. Ma, efu den mu poti ala den sani di a du ya, wan fu wan a buku, da mi á biibi taki hii goontapu o poi oli ala den buku di den sa sikiifi ya.
eng_text: And there are also many other things which Jesus did, the which, if they should be written every one, I suppose that even the world itself could not contain the books that should be written. Amen.

djk_text: Mi lobi mati Teyofili! Na mi Lukasi e sikiifi a buku ya gi yu. A taa buku di mi be sende gi yu kaba, be soi san Masaa Jesesi be du, anga fa a be leli sama.
eng_text: The former treatise have I made, O Theophilus, of all that Jesus began both to do and teach,

djk_text: Mi be sikiifi fa a wooko te doo a dei di Masaa Gadu puu en ya libilibi go poti ne en kondee a tapu anda. Ma fosi dati, da a Apaiti Jeje di teke en hii libi abaa be piki en fa fu taigi en apaiti bosikopuman, fu wooko go doo. Na den dati a teke poti fika a baka ya, fu paati en bosikopu.
eng_text: Until the day in which he was taken up, after that he through the Holy Ghost had given commandments unto the apostles whom he had chosen:

djk_text: Bika di a dede weki baka, da na den ai soi enseefi libilibi somen leisi. Hii fotenti dei, fu den si fa a dede weki tuu. Soseefi ai leli den moo sani, fu sabi fa Masaa Gadu poti fu tii sani.
eng_text: To whom also he shewed himself alive after his passion by many infallible proofs, being seen of them forty days, and speaking of the things pertaining to the kingdom of God:

djk_text: Wan fu den leisi di a soi den enseefi, namo a tapu den taki, den á mu komoto a Jelusalem Foto ete. Bika na ape den o fende a gaanbigi bun di Masaa Jesesi be taigi den kaba taki, en Tata be paamisi.
eng_text: And, being assembled together with them, commanded them that they should not depart from Jerusalem, but wait for the promise of the Father, which, saith he, ye have heard of me.

djk_text: Bika a ná o langa, da san o pasa de sa bigi moo fa Johanisi be e teke wataa dopu sama. Bika na Masaa Gadu o teke en Apaiti Jeje dopu den.
eng_text: For John truly baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost not many days hence.

djk_text: Wan fu den taa leisi di a soi den enseefi, ne den akisi en efu na a pisiten ya kaba, a o tii Dyu Kondee enke fa Masaa Gadu be paamisi, fu sende a edeman de kon enke kownu. Efu na a pisiten ya a o meke Dyu Kondee toon a moo hei kondee fu goontapu.
eng_text: When they therefore were come together, they asked of him, saying, Lord, wilt thou at this time restore again the kingdom to Israel?

djk_text: Namo a piki taki: “U ná abi fu sabi ala dati. Mi Tata, Masaa Gadu á gi u pasi fu dati. En wawan namo sabi. Bika ne en poti a dei anga a ten fu ala dati.
eng_text: And he said unto them, It is not for you to know the times or the seasons, which the Father hath put in his own power.

djk_text: Ma sabi namo taki, Masaa Gadu Apaiti Jeje o teke u hii libi. A o gi u kaakiti, fu puu mi toli taigi taawan a Jelusalem Foto doo Judeja pisiwataa. Soseefi Samaliya pisiwataa doo ala taa uku fu goontapu.”
eng_text: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judaea, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.

djk_text: Den be taampu makandii di Jesesi kaba soi den so. Ne den si en futu e opo komoto a doti, da ai gwe a tapu, te pasa den woluku anda. Ne wan woluku wai tapu en. Na so Masaa Gadu opo en tyai gwe ne en kondee a tapu anda.
eng_text: And when he had spoken these things, while they beheld, he was taken up; and a cloud received him out of their sight.

djk_text: A kon fu den de ape e luku tapu naamo, fa a gwe so. Te fu den denki, tu Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee anga weti koosi taampu a den mindii de.
eng_text: And while they looked stedfastly toward heaven as he went up, behold, two men stood by them in white apparel;

djk_text: Namo den Masaa Gadu Kondee Basiya taigi den taki: “Den manengee fu Galileya pisiwataa ya! San u taampu e luku ete? A Jesesi di opo gwe a tapu tide ya, na leti ya a o saka wan dei baka komoto a tapu anda.”
eng_text: Which also said, Ye men of Galilee, why stand ye gazing up into heaven? this same Jesus, which is taken up from you into heaven, shall so come in like manner as ye have seen him go into heaven.

djk_text: Namo den be taampu makandii na a mongo di abi a nen fu Oleifi. A á de faawe fu Jelusalem Foto, ma na wan kilomeiti faawe so. Da di sani waka so kaba, ne den komoto de gwe a Jelusalem Foto.
eng_text: Then returned they unto Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet, which is from Jerusalem a sabbath day's journey.

djk_text: Di den doo anda, ne den subi go a tapu sodoo na a kambaa pe den be e tan na a yuu di den de a Jelusalem Foto de. Den be de ape: Peitilisi Johanisi Jakowbesi Andeleyasi Filipi Towmasi Baatomeyosi Mateyesi Jakowbesi, a manpikin fu Alefeyosi Simon Selotu Judasi, a manpikin fu Jakowbesi.
eng_text: And when they were come in, they went up into an upper room, where abode both Peter, and James, and John, and Andrew, Philip, and Thomas, Bartholomew, and Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, and Simon Zelotes, and Judas the brother of James.

djk_text: Somen leisi den be e miti makandii, fu tei ati oli doo anga begi. Maliya, a mma fu Jesesi anga den taa baala fu Jesesi be de ape tu. Wan duupu taa uman seefi.
eng_text: These all continued with one accord in prayer and supplication, with the women, and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brethren.

djk_text: Namo wan fu den dei, ne Peitilisi opo taampu a den mindii. Den be de ape wan ondoo anga twenti biibisama so.
eng_text: And in those days Peter stood up in the midst of the disciples, and said, (the number of names together were about an hundred and twenty,)

djk_text: Namo a taigi den taki: “Biibiwan! U ala sabi taki, na Judasi tyai sama go kisi Masaa Jesesi. Dati waka enke fa a Apaiti Jeje fu Masaa Gadu be piki Kownu Dafeti a fositen, fu sikiifi.
eng_text: Men and brethren, this scripture must needs have been fulfilled, which the Holy Ghost by the mouth of David spake before concerning Judas, which was guide to them that took Jesus.

djk_text: Da a kon, na Masaa Jesesi seefi be teke Judasi makandii anga wi taa elufu poti fu du en wooko.”
eng_text: For he was numbered with us, and had obtained part of this ministry.

djk_text: A Judasi ya na di be tyai sama go kisi Jesesi. Ne a teke a moni di den pai en fu dati go bai wan hii pisi doti. Ma bakadati, a teke tetei tei lenge lenge enseefi kii. Namo a koti komoto anda kai kon anga mindii fesi a doti, basi en hii bee tutu komoto a doo.
eng_text: Now this man purchased a field with the reward of iniquity; and falling headlong, he burst asunder in the midst, and all his bowels gushed out.

djk_text: Di sama fu Jelusalem Foto yee a toli de, ne den kai a doti pe a moni fi en bai, Akeldama. Dati taki, a ini den tongo, Buulu Doti.
eng_text: And it was known unto all the dwellers at Jerusalem; insomuch as that field is called in their proper tongue, Aceldama, that is to say, The field of blood.

djk_text: Namo Peitilisi taki ete taki: “Fa a de, a hii peesi fu Judasi fika fu busi goo tapu. Sama á de fu go tan ape moo wanten. Dati waka enke fa Masaa Gadu be piki Kownu Dafeti a fositen fu sikiifi na a singi buku den e kai Psalm. Bika a be sikiifi taki: ‘Ala a peesi fi en fika fu busi goo tapu. Sama á de fu go tan ape moo wanten.’ Ma a be sikiifi tu taki: ‘Poti wan taawan ne en peesi, fu du a wooko.’ ”
eng_text: For it is written in the book of Psalms, Let his habitation be desolate, and let no man dwell therein: and his bishoprick let another take.

djk_text: Namo Peitilisi taki ete taki: “Da wi fanowdu wan taawan a u mindii ya fu poti na a wooko a Judasi peesi. Ma a mu de wan man di be waka makandii anga wi na a hii yuu di u be e lontu makandii anga Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: Wherefore of these men which have companied with us all the time that the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,

djk_text: A be mu waka makandii anga wi komoto fu a ten di Johanisi be e dopu sama go doo a ten di Masaa Jesesi opo gwe a tapu ya. Bika na sowan man namo sa fiti, fu poi taampu makandii anga wi taa elufu, fu bali a nyunsu taki, a dede weki kon a libi ya baka tuu.”
eng_text: Beginning from the baptism of John, unto that same day that he was taken up from us, must one be ordained to be a witness with us of his resurrection.

djk_text: Namo, den wegi go kon. Ne den fende tu man di fiti fu teke Judasi peesi, Jowsef anga Matiyasi. A Jowsef ya be abi ete tu taa nen, den be e kai Balisabasi anga Yestesi.
eng_text: And they appointed two, Joseph called Barsabas, who was surnamed Justus, and Matthias.

djk_text: Namo den begi Masaa Gadu taki: “Masaa! Gaantangi, soi wi on di fu den tu u mu teke poti na a wooko! Bika na yu e si ala sama ati. Da yu sabi on di fiti fu du a wooko.
eng_text: And they prayed, and said, Thou, Lord, which knowest the hearts of all men, shew whether of these two thou hast chosen,

djk_text: Te i soi wi, da u sa teke dati poti a Judasi peesi, fu du a apaiti bosikopuman fu Masaa Jesesi wooko. Bika a dede komoto a u mindii, fu go na a peesi di fiti en, fu san a du.”
eng_text: That he may take part of this ministry and apostleship, from which Judas by transgression fell, that he might go to his own place.

djk_text: Namo, den daai wan sowtu sani, fu koti luku on di fu den tu man ya mu wini a wooko. Matiyasi wini, ne den poti en a den taa elufu apaiti bosikopuman fu Masaa Jesesi kon toon twalufu apaiti bosikopuman baka.
eng_text: And they gave forth their lots; and the lot fell upon Matthias; and he was numbered with the eleven apostles.

djk_text: A feisiti dei den e kai Penkisite be doo. Dati na seibin wiki baka Pasika feisiti. Dyusama e kon makandii a Jelusalem Foto fu gi Masaa Gadu daa, fu lepi nyanyan di den puu a goon. Den biibiwan be mokisa a wan peesi.
eng_text: And when the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one accord in one place.

djk_text: Wanboo wanboo so, ne den e yee wan sani e bali a tapu a doose anda huuw, enke wan gaan winta e wai. A sani wai kon fuu a hii osu ini pe den de.
eng_text: And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.

djk_text: Namo, den si wan sani a den fesi de gei somen tongo fu faya leti mokisa a wan gaan bosu. Da ai wai paati, wan fu wan e go kisi ibii biibiwan de.
eng_text: And there appeared unto them cloven tongues like as of fire, and it sat upon each of them.

djk_text: Na so a Apaiti Jeje fu Masaa Gadu teke ibiiwan hii libi abaa. Da ai gi ibiiwan, wan taa kondee sama tongo, di enseefi á be sabi taki. Ibiiwan fende a sowtu tongo di a poti gi en.
eng_text: And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.

djk_text: A pisi yuu ya, da sowtu a sowtu Dyusama di e tan a taa taa doose kondee fu goontapu be kon a Jelusalem Foto de. Na be Dyusama di lobi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: And there were dwelling at Jerusalem Jews, devout men, out of every nation under heaven.

djk_text: Namo den yee a gaan takitaki fu den biibisama. Ne den booko go taampu e luku anga ala foondoo. Bika ibiiwan fu den e yee a tongo di a diingi ne en mma bobi. Den biibisama e taki den sowtu a sowtu tongo fu den.
eng_text: Now when this was noised abroad, the multitude came together, and were confounded, because that every man heard them speak in his own language.

djk_text: Ai foondoo den tuutuu, a dyombo den. A kon fu den e akisi taki: “A ná soso Galileya pisiwataa sama de ape, no?
eng_text: And they were all amazed and marvelled, saying one to another, Behold, are not all these which speak Galilaeans?

djk_text: Da fa den du poi taki den sowtu a sowtu tongo di ibiiwan fu wi e taki a den sowtu a sowtu kondee pe u komoto?”
eng_text: And how hear we every man in our own tongue, wherein we were born?

djk_text: Den Dyusama di be kon aliki den biibiwan de, be komoto a tyaipi sowtu kondee kon a Jelusalem Foto de. Taawan komoto na a pisiwataa fu Paltiya. Taawan komoto a Meidiya. Taawan komoto a Elam. Taawan komoto a Mesopatamiya. Taawan komoto a Judeja. Taawan komoto a Kapadosiya. Taawan komoto a Pontesi. Taawan komoto a Asiya.
eng_text: Parthians, and Medes, and Elamites, and the dwellers in Mesopotamia, and in Judaea, and Cappadocia, in Pontus, and Asia,

djk_text: Taawan komoto a Filigiya. Taawan komoto a Pamfiliya. Taawan komoto a Egepte Kondee. Taawan komoto a Sileni Foto a Libiya Kondee. Taawan na foluku fu Loma Foto di e tan a Jelusalem Foto de. Foluku fu Loma Foto seefi di teke fu dini Masaa Gadu na a fasi fu Dyusama.
eng_text: Phrygia, and Pamphylia, in Egypt, and in the parts of Libya about Cyrene, and strangers of Rome, Jews and proselytes,

djk_text: Dyusama di e tan na a gaan tabiki Keleita Kondee seefi tu. Dyusama seefi fu Alabiya Kondee. Ala den sowtu a sowtu kulu ya taki: “Wi abi sowtu a sowtu tongo e taki. Ma fa Galileya sama du poi taki den so? Bika den e taki gaan foondoo sani di Masaa Gadu e du, da wi e fusutan den.”
eng_text: Cretes and Arabians, we do hear them speak in our tongues the wonderful works of God.

djk_text: Den sama foondoo te, ne den á sabi san fu du. Taawan e taigi taawan taki: “San wani taki a sani di e pasa ya?”
eng_text: And they were all amazed, and were in doubt, saying one to another, What meaneth this?

djk_text: Da taawan e deleigi taki: “Fu poi meke a sani de, da na tyaipi win namo den musu diingi duungu so.”
eng_text: Others mocking said, These men are full of new wine.

djk_text: Namo, Peitilisi anga den taa elufu apaiti bosikopuman fu Masaa Jesesi wai kon taampu a fesi. Ne Peitilisi bali taki: “Ala Dyusama di de a Jelusalem Foto ya! Aliki bun fu yee san mi o taki!”
eng_text: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice, and said unto them, Ye men of Judaea, and all ye that dwell at Jerusalem, be this known unto you, and hearken to my words:

djk_text: Namo a taki: “Fa u sa pakisei taki, wi ya diingi duungu? Bika wi ala enke Dyusama sabi taki, u á gwenti diingi duungu neigin yuu mamanten.
eng_text: For these are not drunken, as ye suppose, seeing it is but the third hour of the day.

djk_text: Ma dati na san a fositen apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu di den e kai Joweli be taki. Bika a be taki:
eng_text: But this is that which was spoken by the prophet Joel;

djk_text: ‘Mi enke Masaa Gadu taki: “Luku fa mi o wooko a ini den dei na a ten pe goontapu o de fu kaba. Mi o sende mi Apaiti Jeje go na ala sowtu sama. Da a o piki yu umanpikin anga yu manpikin, fa mi fiti sani poti fu waka. Foondoo fasi enke na deen, na so yonkuman a u mindii de o si san mi wani. Gaansama de seefi o deen tuutuu san mi fiti poti fu du.
eng_text: And it shall come to pass in the last days, saith God,I will pour out of my Spirit upon all flesh: and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, and your young men shall see visions, and your old men shall dream dreams:

djk_text: Uman anga man di e dini mi, winsi den soi lagi, ma den o fende mi Apaiti Jeje tu. Da a sa piki denseefi san fu taigi taawan.
eng_text: And on my servants and on my handmaidens I will pour out in those days of my Spirit; and they shall prophesy:

djk_text: Soseefi hii goontapu foondoo sani o pasa a tapu anda fu si. Ondoo goontapu ya dati maiki fu san e pasa o soi fa mi bigi. Buulu o kai, gaan faya o koti anga ala gaan koko somoko.
eng_text: And I will shew wonders in heaven above, and signs in the earth beneath; blood, and fire, and vapour of smoke:

djk_text: A san a tapu anda o kon dunguu. A mun o kon lebi enke buulu. Na so o pasa fosi a gaan dei fu Masaa kon doo.
eng_text: The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before that great and notable day of the Lord come:

djk_text: Ma ibiiwan di teke fu bali kai Masaa, fu suku yeepi, da a o puu en a dede, gi libi tego.” ’ ”
eng_text: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall call on the name of the Lord shall be saved.

djk_text: Namo Peitilisi taki ete taki: “Mi eigi Dyusama ya! Aliki! Jesesi di goo a Nasaleti Foto, Masaa Gadu poti tuutuu kaakiti gi en hii libi. Da ai du foondoo sani enke maiki fu si taki, na Masaa Gadu seefi e wooko de. Leti a wi kondee ganda ya a meke a waka lontu so. Bika a wani u sabi taki, ne en gi en pasi, fu wooko so.
eng_text: Ye men of Israel, hear these words; Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved of God among you by miracles and wonders and signs, which God did by him in the midst of you, as ye yourselves also know:

djk_text: A Jesesi ya na di Dyusama ya be kisi gi taa foluku kii. Ma Masaa Gadu be sabi dati a fesi. Ne enseefi be poti taki, dati musu fu pasa.
eng_text: Him, being delivered by the determinate counsel and foreknowledge of God, ye have taken, and by wicked hands have crucified and slain:

djk_text: Ma dede á poi kwinsi en oli nama, enke fa ai kwinsi ala taa sani e dwengi anga pen. Bika Masaa Gadu makiti fu weki en, bigi moo dede.
eng_text: Whom God hath raised up, having loosed the pains of death: because it was not possible that he should be holden of it.

djk_text: Dati waka enke fa Masaa Gadu be piki en apaiti takiman Kownu Dafeti a fositen fu sikiifi taki: ‘Mi e si fa Masaa Gadu de a mi se ala yuu. Ai yeepi mi, meke sani á poi du mi.
eng_text: For David speaketh concerning him, I foresaw the Lord always before my face, for he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved:

djk_text: A piisii di dati e gi mi bigi a mi ati! Mi e poolo singi anga tongo. Bika mi o dede seefi, ma mi ati koo ete. Mi e fitoow Masaa Gadu, fu san a poi du gi mi.
eng_text: Therefore did my heart rejoice, and my tongue was glad; moreover also my flesh shall rest in hope:

djk_text: A ná o fika mi a dedekondee . A Apaiti Sama fi en ya, noiti a o meke dati sikin dugu dugu dede loto poli.
eng_text: Because thou wilt not leave my soul in hell, neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu soi mi fa fu sabi waka go fende libi tego. Da ai piisii mi ati tuutuu, fu fa a de anga mi so.’ ”
eng_text: Thou hast made known to me the ways of life; thou shalt make me full of joy with thy countenance.

djk_text: Namo Peitilisi taki ete taki: “Mi eigi Dyu Kondee baala! Sabi taki, wi avo Kownu Dafeti be e sikiifi, ma a ná enseefi a be e taki. Bika u si taki, en dati dede, te den beli. En geebi de fu si leti a goontapu ya ete.
eng_text: Men and brethren, let me freely speak unto you of the patriarch David, that he is both dead and buried, and his sepulchre is with us unto this day.

djk_text: Ma a be e sikiifi sani di Masaa Gadu be e piki en, anga ala sweli seefi taki, dati musu fu pasa so. Masaa Gadu taki: ‘Wan bakaten pikin fu Dafeti paansu, na dati mi o gi yu kownu sutuu, fu tii sani enke yu seefi.’ A Dafeti ya na be tuutuu apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu, di ai piki san a fiti poti fu du.
eng_text: Therefore being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him, that of the fruit of his loins, according to the flesh, he would raise up Christ to sit on his throne;

djk_text: Ne a be poi sikiifi a fesi fa a Kelestesi o dede weki kon a libi ya baka, fu tii ala sani. Bika a be sikiifi taki, dede ná o poi oli en. En dugu dugu sikin seefi noiti o loto poli.”
eng_text: He seeing this before spake of the resurrection of Christ, that his soul was not left in hell, neither his flesh did see corruption.

djk_text: Namo Peitilisi taki ete taki: “Da sabi taki, Masaa Gadu weki a Jesesi kon a libi baka tuu. Wi ya si dati anga ain, fu piki u de.
eng_text: This Jesus hath God raised up, whereof we all are witnesses.

djk_text: Soseefi a kaakiti fu Masaa Gadu opo en tyai gwe a tapu anda, na a moo hei peesi ne en letise ana. Wi Tata, Masaa Gadu gi en a Apaiti Jeje fi en, di a be paamisi. Da ai gi sama dati enke fa u si pasa anga wi tide ya.”
eng_text: Therefore being by the right hand of God exalted, and having received of the Father the promise of the Holy Ghost, he hath shed forth this, which ye now see and hear.

djk_text: Namo Peitilisi taki ete taki: “Da kaba pakisei taki, san Kownu Dafeti be sikiifi de taki, ne enseefi ai taki. Bika a á opo libilibi gwe a tapu a Gadu Kondee. Ma a be sikiifi taki: ‘Masaa Gadu taigi mi Masaa taki: “Sidon a mi leti ana se ya,
eng_text: For David is not ascended into the heavens: but he saith himself, The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,

djk_text: te enke mi meke ala den feyanti fi yu toon yu futu bangi.” ’ ”
eng_text: Until I make thy foes thy footstool.

djk_text: Namo Peitilisi taki ete taki: “Da meke a hii Islayeli foluku ya seefi sabi taki, na a Jesesi ya, Masaa Gadu poti fu ala taawan kai Masaa. Soseefi a poti en, fu de a Kelestesi, di a be paamisi fu tii ala sani. Ne en seefi u de be poti sipikii kii a koloisi.”
eng_text: Therefore let all the house of Israel know assuredly, that God hath made that same Jesus, whom ye have crucified, both Lord and Christ.

djk_text: Namo di Peitilisi e taki, da den sama be e aliki. A hii toli ya kwinsi den na ati. Ne den akisi Peitilisi anga den taa elufu apaiti bosikopuman taki: “Baala! Wi ya dati á sabi san fu du! Na u de mu soi wi san fu du.”
eng_text: Now when they heard this, they were pricked in their heart, and said unto Peter and to the rest of the apostles, Men and brethren, what shall we do?

djk_text: Namo den Peitilisi piki taki: “U mu daai libi, fu teke dopu a ini a nen fu Jesesi Kelestesi. Meke Masaa Gadu sa gi u paadon, fu u takuudu anga ogii. Soseefi, a o meke u fende a gaanbigi bun di taki, en Apaiti Jeje kon teke peesi a ini u.
eng_text: Then Peter said unto them, Repent, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins, and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost.

djk_text: Bika na Masaa Gadu seefi be paamisi ibii sama a Apaiti Jeje ya. Yu de seefi tu anga ala u paansu bakaten seefi. Soseefi ala taa sama, winsi pe te den de. A sa gi ala sama di a teke toon fi en seefi dati.”
eng_text: For the promise is unto you, and to your children, and to all that are afar off, even as many as the Lord our God shall call.

djk_text: Namo Peitilisi taki taa sani ete, fu meke den sama si fa a yeepi fu Masaa Gadu de fanowdu. Namo a wasikoi den taki: “Kon komoto a ini a sitaafu di Masaa Gadu mu gi ala takuuduman di e libi nownow.”
eng_text: And with many other words did he testify and exhort, saying, Save yourselves from this untoward generation.

djk_text: Namo somen fu den de biibi ala san Peitilisi taki te go teke dopu. A dei de na wan dii dunsu sama go a ini a biibi, fu toon biibisama tu.
eng_text: Then they that gladly received his word were baptized: and the same day there were added unto them about three thousand souls.

djk_text: Da sama di teke a biibi be poti denseefi, fu tei ati oli doo, fu teke leli, anga fu du san den apaiti bosikopuman e soi den. Soseefi den be lobi kon mokisa makandii enke biibisama. Da den e booko beele nyan makandii enke fa Masaa Jesesi be soi den, fu nyan pakisei a dede fi en. Den be e tan makandii e begi naamo tu.
eng_text: And they continued stedfastly in the apostles' doctrine and fellowship, and in breaking of bread, and in prayers.

djk_text: Da den apaiti bosikopuman e du gaan foondoo sani naamo enke maiki fu si de taki, Masaa Gadu de anga den. Ala sama be abi gaan lesipeki fu san e pasa a den mindii.
eng_text: And fear came upon every soul: and many wonders and signs were done by the apostles.

djk_text: Ala sama di be teke a biibi be mokisa libi enke wan makandii anga denseefi. Den be e yeepi den seefi a sani anga san den abi.
eng_text: And all that believed were together, and had all things common;

djk_text: Somen leisi son fu den be e seli gudu di a abi, fu teke a moni paati gi di fanowdu yeepi. Na so ibiiwan be e fende san a abi fanowdu.
eng_text: And sold their possessions and goods, and parted them to all men, as every man had need.

djk_text: Ibii dei den be e go makandii, fu begi na a Mama Keliki anda. Den be e kai den seefi kon nyan a den seefi osu. Den á be abi giili ati fu dati, ma anga ala switi fasi na ati.
eng_text: And they, continuing daily with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread from house to house, did eat their meat with gladness and singleness of heart,

djk_text: Den be e gafa Masaa Gadu. Ala sama be abi apaiti lesipeki fu den. Ibii dei Masaa Jesesi be e tyai yeepi, fu moo sama komoto a takuudu anga ogii, da a kulu e goo.
eng_text: Praising God, and having favour with all the people. And the Lord added to the church daily such as should be saved.

djk_text: Da wan fu den dei, dii yuu bakadina so, ne Peitilisi anga Johanisi e go na a Mama Keliki, fu go begi. Bika Dyusama be gwenti go begi anda den ten de.
eng_text: Now Peter and John went up together into the temple at the hour of prayer, being the ninth hour.

djk_text: Namo den de fu pasa na a doo di abi a nen fu Moi Doo, fu go a ini a Mama Keliki. Ma wan lanman be sidon na a doo mofu de. Senten en mma meke en, ne a de lan lan, a á poi waka. Ibii dei, sama e diki en tyai go saka de, fu begi moni. Da ai fiingi ana naamo e begi ala sama di e kon e gwe.
eng_text: And a certain man lame from his mother's womb was carried, whom they laid daily at the gate of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask alms of them that entered into the temple;

djk_text: Namo a si Peitilisi anga Johanisi e waka kon a ini a Mama Keliki. Ne a fiingi ana wanten go begi den seefi.
eng_text: Who seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple asked an alms.

djk_text: Ma den towe ain luku en dunn ne en mindii fesi. Ne Peitilisi taigi en taki: “Luku wi bunbun baka.”
eng_text: And Peter, fastening his eyes upon him with John, said, Look on us.

djk_text: Namo a lanman luku den a den mindii fesi baka. Da ai pakisei taki: “Mi o fende wan bun a den tu man ya.”
eng_text: And he gave heed unto them, expecting to receive something of them.

djk_text: Namo Peitilisi taigi en taki: “Moni anga taa sowtu gudu, dati mi ná abi, fu gi yu! Ma na san mi abi, dati mi e gi yu. A ini a nen fu Jesesi Kelestesi fu Nasaleti Foto, opo waka wanten!”
eng_text: Then Peter said, Silver and gold have I none; but such as I have give I thee: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth rise up and walk.

djk_text: Namo Peitilisi langa ana hali en letise ana, fu a opo taampu. Wanten so den futu fi en kisi kaakiti taanga a doti, fu waka. A betee.
eng_text: And he took him by the right hand, and lifted him up: and immediately his feet and ancle bones received strength.

djk_text: Namo a dyombo opo taampu, da ai waka e go e kon. A á sabi pe fu poti enseefi. Ai waka e daai e lontu e dyombo a tapu, da ai bali e gafa Masaa Gadu. Na so ai waka e gwe makandii anga Peitilisi anga Johanisi a ini a Mama Keliki tu.
eng_text: And he leaping up stood, and walked, and entered with them into the temple, walking, and leaping, and praising God.

djk_text: Ala sama ape si fa ai waka e bali e gafa Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: And all the people saw him walking and praising God:

djk_text: Da den e taki: “Na a lanman di á be poi waka de ape. A be lobi sidon na a doo mofu fu Moi Doo e begi moni.” Den sama foondoo te, den á sabi san fu du, fu san pasa anga a lanman de.
eng_text: And they knew that it was he which sat for alms at the Beautiful gate of the temple: and they were filled with wonder and amazement at that which had happened unto him.

djk_text: Namo a go oli Peitilisi anga Johanisi na ana. Ala sama ape booko kon taampu e foondoo. Den be de na a baikon di meke langa langa a bansa se fu a Mama Keliki, den e kai Salomo Baikon.
eng_text: And as the lame man which was healed held Peter and John, all the people ran together unto them in the porch that is called Solomon's, greatly wondering.

djk_text: Namo di Peitilisi si den kon lontu so, ne a taigi den taki: “Mi eigi Dyu! U e foondoo fu san pasa ya? Ma ná taampu luku wi ya enke na wi abi kaakiti betee a lanman! A ná bun libi fu wi tu meke u poi du dati!”
eng_text: And when Peter saw it, he answered unto the people, Ye men of Israel, why marvel ye at this? or why look ye so earnestly on us, as though by our own power or holiness we had made this man to walk?

djk_text: A taigi den doo taki: “Na Masaa Gadu du a foondoo wooko ya. Wi avo Abalaham be e dini en. Isaki anga Jakopu doo ala taa avo tu. A gi en wookoman Jesesi dyendee. Ma u enke Dyusama ya be kisi en gi Gaaman Pilatesi, fu du ogii anga en gi u. Ma a á be poi fende fowtu fi en, fu sitaafu so, ne a be wani u losi en. Ma u á be wani, bika u á be abi bisi anga en.
eng_text: The God of Abraham, and of Isaac, and of Jacob, the God of our fathers, hath glorified his Son Jesus; whom ye delivered up, and denied him in the presence of Pilate, when he was determined to let him go.

djk_text: Ma u meke a losi wan gaan ogii ati man di e kii sama, pe fi en. U be si ala dati enke wan bun Gaaman Pilatesi du gi u. U á be abi bisi anga di de letiopu ala yuu a Masaa Gadu fesi anga ala hii libi kiin sai gi en.
eng_text: But ye denied the Holy One and the Just, and desired a murderer to be granted unto you;

djk_text: Soseefi ne en Masaa Gadu poti fu tyai sama go fende a libi fi en. Ma u dati poti en kii. Ma Masaa Gadu dati weki en kon a libi baka. Wi ya si dati anga ain, fu piki u de.
eng_text: And killed the Prince of life, whom God hath raised from the dead; whereof we are witnesses.

djk_text: Na a seefi Jesesi de kaakiti fu du foondoo sani so. Na a biibi namo di a lanman ya poti a ini a nen fi en, ne a nen fi en betee en. Ne a futu fi en di u seefi be sabi taki, lan kon taanga a doti so. A betee leti a wi ala fesi tide ya, fu u sa si dati anga ain.”
eng_text: And his name through faith in his name hath made this man strong, whom ye see and know: yea, the faith which is by him hath given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all.

djk_text: Namo a taki ete taki: “Mi eigi Dyu foluku! Na u be du ogii anga en te doo kii en seefi. Ma saide u be poi du dati? U á sabi, den edeman fu Dyu keliki di e taki gi kondee ya seefi á sabi tu.
eng_text: And now, brethren, I wot that through ignorance ye did it, as did also your rulers.

djk_text: Ma sabi now taki, Masaa Gadu be piki en fositen fu sikiifi taki, dati musu fu pasa anga en. Den be sikiifi taki, a Kelestesi di paamisi fu sende kon tii ala sani, dati o teke pina fosi te doo dede seefi.”
eng_text: But those things, which God before had shewed by the mouth of all his prophets, that Christ should suffer, he hath so fulfilled.

djk_text: Namo a taki ete taki: “Ma luku san fu du now! Fii tyali fu u takuudu anga ogii. Da daai libi! Meke Masaa Gadu sa gi u paadon taki, a figi ala san u be du pasa kaba. Soseefi, u jeje libi o fende kaakiti, fu poi libi a hii pisi yuu ya anga boo.
eng_text: Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;

djk_text: Na sowan fasi u sa libi go doo a dei, di a o sende a Kelestesi kon baka gi u, fu tii ala sani. Dati na Jesesi di a be paamisi langa ten a fesi kaba.
eng_text: And he shall send Jesus Christ, which before was preached unto you:

djk_text: A opo gwe a tapu nownow, fu te enke a yuu kisi di a fiti poti fu seeka ala sani kon nyun. Dati o waka enke fa apaiti takiman di hii libi kiin gi en be sikiifi, fa a o seeka ala sani kon nyun.”
eng_text: Whom the heaven must receive until the times of restitution of all things, which God hath spoken by the mouth of all his holy prophets since the world began.

djk_text: Namo a taki: “Masaa Gadu be piki en fositen apaiti takiman Mosesi, fu sikiifi taki: ‘Masaa Gadu paamisi en moo gaan apaiti takiman, fu tyai a foluku enke fa mi be tyai a foluku. A o meke libisama enke ibii taa sama, ma na dati taki ibii taawan mu teke.
eng_text: For Moses truly said unto the fathers, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear in all things whatsoever he shall say unto you.

djk_text: Sama di á wani teke en taki ná o poi libi a ini Masaa Gadu foluku. Ma a o dede komoto a ini dati.’
eng_text: And it shall come to pass, that every soul, which will not hear that prophet, shall be destroyed from among the people.

djk_text: A be piki taa fositen apaiti takiman tu, fu sikiifi sani fu dati. Komoto fu Samuweli doo ala taawan di waka ne en baka be sikiifi. Na san a be piki den taki, musu fu pasa e pasa na a ten fu wi ya.”
eng_text: Yea, and all the prophets from Samuel and those that follow after, as many as have spoken, have likewise foretold of these days.

djk_text: Peitilisi soi ete taki: “Da fa Masaa Gadu be piki apaiti takiman a fositen, fu sikiifi gi wi avo, da na wi enke bakaten pikin fu den ya mu wooko anga a kuudei di a be fiti anga den de. Luku san a be taigi wi moo gaandi avo Abalaham taki: ‘A Kelestesi o meke a ini a paansu sama fi yu, fu seigi hii goontapu.’
eng_text: Ye are the children of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers, saying unto Abraham, And in thy seed shall all the kindreds of the earth be blessed.

djk_text: We, da a sende en wookoman Jesesi kon a u mindii ya kaba. A fosi peesi pe a bigin wooko, da na u kondee ya a kon, fu seigi u taki, a o puu u a takuudu anga ogii.”
eng_text: Unto you first God, having raised up his Son Jesus, sent him to bless you, in turning away every one of you from his iniquities.

djk_text: Na ape den de e taki anga den sama. Namo wantu apaiti begiman anga wantu Saduseiman waka kon a den tapu. A basi fu den wakiti na a Mama Keliki seefi tu.
eng_text: And as they spake unto the people, the priests, and the captain of the temple, and the Sadducees, came upon them,

djk_text: Den kon anga ala gaan boon ati. Bika den yee den e leli sama sani di nái kai gi den. Den á wani yee taki, a dede weki baka fu Jesesi e soi fa dedesama o weki baka.
eng_text: Being grieved that they taught the people, and preached through Jesus the resurrection from the dead.

djk_text: Namo den gaapu den tyai go sooto. Den be kaba fu tyai den go a kuutu kaba. Ma neti be doo kaba. Ne den sooto den fu kuutu tamaa mamanten.
eng_text: And they laid hands on them, and put them in hold unto the next day: for it was now eventide.

djk_text: Ma somen sama di be aliki a taki be teke biibi a dati, fu daai toon biibisama. Na so a kulu biibiwan be e goo naamo. Boiti fu teli uman, da a be doo feifi dunsu biibi manengee kaba.
eng_text: Howbeit many of them which heard the word believed; and the number of the men was about five thousand.

djk_text: A tamaa mamanten, ne den bigiman fu Dyu keliki anga den gaansama fu paandasi kon miti makandii a Jelusalem Foto de, fu oli a kuutu. Soseefi leliman fu Dyu weiti seefi.
eng_text: And it came to pass on the morrow, that their rulers, and elders, and scribes,

djk_text: Anasi, a moo hei apaiti begiman na a Mama Keliki seefi. Soseefi Kayafasi anga taa taa famii a ini a paansu sama di e tyai a wooko ya. Johanisi anga Aleksandi seefi tu.
eng_text: And Annas the high priest, and Caiaphas, and John, and Alexander, and as many as were of the kindred of the high priest, were gathered together at Jerusalem.

djk_text: Namo den tyai Peitilisi anga Johanisi kon taampu a den fesi, da den e akisi den taki: “Pe u fende a kaakiti di deesi a lanman ya? Sama nen abi a makiti di u be teke wooko, fu poi du dati?”
eng_text: And when they had set them in the midst, they asked, By what power, or by what name, have ye done this?

djk_text: Namo wanten de, a Apaiti Jeje fu Masaa Gadu di teke Peitilisi hii libi dati piki en kaba san fu piki. Ne a taki: “Bigiman fu Dyu keliki anga gaansama fu paandasi! U aliki!
eng_text: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Ghost, said unto them, Ye rulers of the people, and elders of Israel,

djk_text: Na wan gaan bun u du, ne dati tyai wi kon a kuutu! Bika na wan sikiman kon bun.
eng_text: If we this day be examined of the good deed done to the impotent man, by what means he is made whole;

djk_text: Hii Dyu Kondee mu sabi taki, a nen fu Jesesi abi makiti. Na dati deesi a lanman. Jesesi Kelestesi fu Nasaleti Foto. U de be poti en sipikii kii, ne Masaa Gadu weki en baka.
eng_text: Be it known unto you all, and to all the people of Israel, that by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom ye crucified, whom God raised from the dead, even by him doth this man stand here before you whole.

djk_text: Bika en Buku sikiifi taki: ‘Disi na a siton di meseeman be oli fu wan soso sani. Na dati daai kon toon a siton futu fu a hii osu.’
eng_text: This is the stone which was set at nought of you builders, which is become the head of the corner.

djk_text: Bika ne en namo poi puu wi na a pasi fu takuudu anga ogii. Goontapu ná abi wan taa nen di Masaa Gadu poti fu sama teke kai fende a yeepi ya.”
eng_text: Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved.

djk_text: We, den si Peitilisi anga Johanisi e taki sondee feele. Ne den foondoo taki: “Den man ya á de leliman anga hei sowtu sama fu kondee. Ma fa den du poi taki so? Namo den pakisei fa den be e si den e waka e lontu makandii anga Jesesi.”
eng_text: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marvelled; and they took knowledge of them, that they had been with Jesus.

djk_text: Namo den kon si tu taki, den á du ogii fu gi sitaafu. Bika a lanman di deesi seefi de leti ape.
eng_text: And beholding the man which was healed standing with them, they could say nothing against it.

djk_text: Namo den puu den poti a doose fu a kuutu peesi. Bika den wani fiti a ondoo luku san fu du anga den.
eng_text: But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council, they conferred among themselves,

djk_text: Namo den fiti taki: “San fu du anga den? Bika na wan gaan foondoo sani den du tuutuu enke wan maiki a hii lanti fesi. Wi á poi kibii a taki de. Ala sama a Jelusalem Foto ya si dati.
eng_text: Saying, What shall we do to these men? for that indeed a notable miracle hath been done by them is manifest to all them that dwell in Jerusalem; and we cannot deny it.

djk_text: Wi o pii ain gi den taki, noiti moo den mu taki sani kai a nen fu a Jesesi de. Da fa den deesi a lanman ná o poi paati moo faawe a ini a kondee tu.”
eng_text: But that it spread no further among the people, let us straitly threaten them, that they speak henceforth to no man in this name.

djk_text: Namo den kai den kon a ini a kuutu peesi baka. Ne den wasikoi den taki: “U mu kaba leli sama sani a ini a nen fu a Jesesi de. Noiti moo u mu kai a nen de moo a wan peesi.”
eng_text: And they called them, and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus.

djk_text: Namo den Peitilisi piki taki: “Teke luku san o moo bun gi Masaa Gadu. Daai aliki san u enke libisama de wani ofu tan du a wooko di enseefi sende wi?
