eng_text: But Peter and John answered and said unto them, Whether it be right in the sight of God to hearken unto you more than unto God, judge ye.

djk_text: We, wi dati á poi kaba taki san wi seefi ain si Jesesi du anga ala san a taki. Soseefi ala san u yee fi en.”
eng_text: For we cannot but speak the things which we have seen and heard.

djk_text: Namo den kuutu puu moo kaasi fu tapu den. Bakadati, ne den losi den fii fu gwe. Bika den á poi fende fowtu a den, fu gi sitaafu. Soseefi, a hii foluku be e gafa Masaa Gadu fu san pasa anga a lanman.
eng_text: So when they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding nothing how they might punish them, because of the people: for all men glorified God for that which was done.

djk_text: Bika a lanman di deesi ya be pasa fotenti yali kaba. Na solanga a be abi a siki kaba.
eng_text: For the man was above forty years old, on whom this miracle of healing was shewed.

djk_text: Namo di den losi den, ne den gwe a mindii fu den taa biibiwan baka. Ne den taigi den fa bigiman fu Dyu keliki anga gaansama fu paandasi kuutu anga den taki, den á mu kai a nen fu Jesesi moo fu leli sama sani.
eng_text: And being let go, they went to their own company, and reported all that the chief priests and elders had said unto them.

djk_text: Den taawan aliki, ne den begi makandii taki: “Masaa Gadu! Yu abi ala makiti, fu meke ala sani. Yu meke yu kondee anga ala san de a tapu anda. Yu meke goontapu anga ala san de ya. Yu meke den ze anga ala san de a ini den wataa fu den peesi.
eng_text: And when they heard that, they lifted up their voice to God with one accord, and said, Lord, thou art God, which hast made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all that in them is:

djk_text: Yu Apaiti Jeje be piki yu wookoman Dafeti di de wi avo gaansama, fu sikiifi taki: ‘Den di á sabi Masaa Gadu abi gaan boon ati e puu kaasi. Foluku fu goontapu e fiti makandii fu du ogii. Ma saide, no?
eng_text: Who by the mouth of thy servant David hast said, Why did the heathen rage, and the people imagine vain things?

djk_text: Soseefi kownu fu goontapu anga taa bigiman, di e taki fu kondee, sete fu sitee anga Masaa Gadu. Den e seeka fu feti anga Awan, di Masaa Gadu paamisi, fu sende kon tii ala sani.’
eng_text: The kings of the earth stood up, and the rulers were gathered together against the Lord, and against his Christ.

djk_text: Na tuu taki! Luku fa den opo makandii ya, fu feti anga yu wookoman Jesesi di de apaiti gi yu. En di yu poti fu tii ala sani. Den simpan ana e feti fu Gaaman Pontiyesi Pilatesi doo Kownu Helowdesi anga a hii Dyu foluku.
eng_text: For of a truth against thy holy child Jesus, whom thou hast anointed, both Herod, and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles, and the people of Israel, were gathered together,

djk_text: Ma ala dati á de nyun sani gi yu. Bika na yu seefi be poti anga yu makiti a fesi kaba taki, dati musu fu pasa.
eng_text: For to do whatsoever thy hand and thy counsel determined before to be done.

djk_text: We, da Masaa! Soi wi san fu du! Luku den ogii di den taki den o du anga wi. Da meke wi ala enke wookoman fi yu fende kaakiti e taki yu bosikopu fu Masaa Jesesi sondee feele.
eng_text: And now, Lord, behold their threatenings: and grant unto thy servants, that with all boldness they may speak thy word,

djk_text: Poti ana yeepi wi fu gi yu bosikopu. Meke foondoo sani e pasa enke maiki fu soi yu makiti. Sikiman mu e kon bun. A kaakiti di yu poti gi Jesesi yeepi wi du ala den sani ya, bika yu poti en apaiti fasi.”
eng_text: By stretching forth thine hand to heal; and that signs and wonders may be done by the name of thy holy child Jesus.

djk_text: Fa den e begi, ne a hii doti, a peesi de seke. Na wan maiki soi fa Masaa Gadu e yee den begi. A Apaiti Jeje fi en teke den hii libi wanten de tu. Ne den opo sondee feele go paati a bosikopu fu Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: And when they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were assembled together; and they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and they spake the word of God with boldness.

djk_text: Da ala den di toon biibisama be e denki go na a wan se. Den be abi a seefi fii fu du sani. Sama abi wan sani nái oli en fi en wawan namo. Ma a be e poti en fi en anga den taawan wooko makandii.
eng_text: And the multitude of them that believed were of one heart and of one soul: neither said any of them that ought of the things which he possessed was his own; but they had all things common.

djk_text: Da a bosikopu fa Jesesi dede weki kon a libi ya baka be e komoto a den twalufu apaiti bosikopuman mofu wan fasi di e wooko anga kaakiti. Da Masaa Gadu e wooko fu tyai bun gi ibii biibiwan.
eng_text: And with great power gave the apostles witness of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus: and great grace was upon them all.

djk_text: Sama á be de a den mindii di be e pina fu san a fuka. Bika somen biibiwan di be abi wan pisi doti ofu wan osu seefi seli dati meke moni.
eng_text: Neither was there any among them that lacked: for as many as were possessors of lands or houses sold them, and brought the prices of the things that were sold,

djk_text: Da ai tyai dati go poti a den twalufu apaiti bosikopuman ana, fu yeepi a wooko. Da te wan sama be fuka, da den be e teke puu a ini san mokisa makandii de, fu yeepi.
eng_text: And laid them down at the apostles' feet: and distribution was made unto every man according as he had need.

djk_text: Wan man a ini den taa biibiwan, den e kai Jowsef. Den apaiti bosikopuman be gi en wan nen den e kai Balnabasi. Dati taki, Manpikin di e du sani, fu koo taawan ati. Na wan Dyusama fu Leifi Lo, ma a be meke a doose fu Dyu Kondee na a gaan tabiki den e kai Sipolosi Kondee.
eng_text: And Joses, who by the apostles was surnamed Barnabas, (which is, being interpreted, The son of consolation,) a Levite, and of the country of Cyprus,

djk_text: A be abi wan hii pisi doti, di a seli meke moni. Ne a tyai dati go poti a den apaiti bosikopuman ana, fu yeepi a wooko.
eng_text: Having land, sold it, and brought the money, and laid it at the apostles' feet.

djk_text: Ma wan man be de ape den e kai Ananiyasi. Ne en uman den be e kai Safila. A be abi wan pisi doti tu di a go seli, fu tyai a moni kon yeepi a wooko.
eng_text: But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession,

djk_text: Ma a teke afu fu a moni di a doti puu oli fi enseefi. Ne a tyai afu go gi den apaiti bosikopuman, fu yeepi a wooko. Da ai leli taki, na ala dati. Na so en anga en uman Safila be miti mofu a baka.
eng_text: And kept back part of the price, his wife also being privy to it, and brought a certain part, and laid it at the apostles' feet.

djk_text: Ma Peitilisi piki en taki: “Ananiyasi! Saide i meke didibii lai yu ati so, fu puubei koli wi so? Bika i oli afu fu a moni di a doti puu! We, koli wi, da na a Apaiti Jeje fu Masaa Gadu seefi i puubei fu koli de!
eng_text: But Peter said, Ananias, why hath Satan filled thine heart to lie to the Holy Ghost, and to keep back part of the price of the land?

djk_text: Ma a á be de fanowdu, fu meke lei kon koli wi so. Bika a goon na be fi yu, winsi i be seli anga yu á be seli en. Da i be sa du san i wani anga a moni di a puu, sondee fu meke lei. Bika fu kon koli wi, da na Masaa Gadu seefi i puubei fu koli de.”
eng_text: Whiles it remained, was it not thine own? and after it was sold, was it not in thine own power? why hast thou conceived this thing in thine heart? thou hast not lied unto men, but unto God.

djk_text: Fa i si Ananiyasi kaba yee den sani ya, a lulu kai a doti wanten dede koo pii. Ala sama di yee a toli ya, a gi den feele.
eng_text: And Ananias hearing these words fell down, and gave up the ghost: and great fear came on all them that heard these things.

djk_text: Wan duupu yonkuman be de ape lolo en a ini sibi koosi, tyai go beli puu wanten.
eng_text: And the young men arose, wound him up, and carried him out, and buried him.

djk_text: Wan dii yuu a baka so, ne en uman Safila seefi kon doo de. A á be sabi taki, na so pasa anga en man.
eng_text: And it was about the space of three hours after, when his wife, not knowing what was done, came in.

djk_text: Namo Peitilisi akisi enseefi taki: “Safila? A moni di i man tyai kon ya, na ala dati a doti seli?” Namo Safila piki wanten taki: “Eeye! Na ala a moni di a doti puu.”
eng_text: And Peter answered unto her, Tell me whether ye sold the land for so much? And she said, Yea, for so much.

djk_text: Ne Peitilisi piki en baka taki: “Safila! Saide yu anga i man miti mofu a baka, fu kon koli wi so? Na a Apaiti Jeje fu Masaa Gadu u e puubei luku efu ai wooko? We, aliki tyaa tyaa na a baka doo de! Na den di kaba beli i man e waka kon doo de baka so. Den o tyai yu seefi go beli.”
eng_text: Then Peter said unto her, How is it that ye have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord? behold, the feet of them which have buried thy husband are at the door, and shall carry thee out.

djk_text: Fa i si Peitilisi kaba taki so, Safila lulu kai a doti, dede koti boo pii. Den di be go beli en man waka kon si en dede dede. Den teke enseefi go beli se anga se anga en man.
eng_text: Then fell she down straightway at his feet, and yielded up the ghost: and the young men came in, and found her dead, and, carrying her forth, buried her by her husband.

djk_text: San pasa ya seke den biibisama anga ibii taawan di yee dati. A gi den feele, fu moo lesipeki Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: And great fear came upon all the church, and upon as many as heard these things.

djk_text: Da naamo Masaa Gadu e meke den apaiti bosikopuman e du somen foondoo sani a Jelusalem Foto de. Ala dati e soi fa Masaa Gadu bigi. Soseefi den biibisama be e fiti go makandii na a Mama Keliki enke fa den be gwenti. Na so den e bosu na a baikon fu a Mama Keliki de, di abi a nen fu Salomo Baikon.
eng_text: And by the hands of the apostles were many signs and wonders wrought among the people; (and they were all with one accord in Solomon's porch.

djk_text: Sama di nái biibi á be e abi deki ati fu go a den mindii. Den be e lesipeki den anga ala gafa fa den e libi.
eng_text: And of the rest durst no man join himself to them: but the people magnified them.

djk_text: Moo anga moo uman anga man be e teke biibi toon biibiwan makandii anga den. Biibiwan e kon moo ipi tyaipi tyaipi.
eng_text: And believers were the more added to the Lord, multitudes both of men and women.)

djk_text: Den apaiti bosikopuman e du foondoo sani. Da a hii peesi e tyai sikiman a daagi go saka a ganda, fu den deesi. Den e biibi fu Peitilisi waka pasa namo, fi en kaaka meke den betee.
eng_text: Insomuch that they brought forth the sick into the streets, and laid them on beds and couches, that at the least the shadow of Peter passing by might overshadow some of them.

djk_text: Sama di e tan a den pikin foto lontu Jelusalem Foto yee san e pasa de. Den seefi booko tyai sikiman kon. Den tyai sama di takuu jeje e muliki. Denseefi kon bun tu.
eng_text: There came also a multitude out of the cities round about unto Jerusalem, bringing sick folks, and them which were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed every one.

djk_text: Namo dyalusu kon miti den apaiti bosikopuman. A moo hei Dyu na a Mama Keliki anga a kulu Saduseiman fi en yee san den e du. Ne den dyalusu. Namo den poti taki, den o du wan sani anga den.
eng_text: Then the high priest rose up, and all they that were with him, (which is the sect of the Sadducees,) and were filled with indignation,

djk_text: Ne den meke den kisi den tyai go sooto.
eng_text: And laid their hands on the apostles, and put them in the common prison.

djk_text: Ma di neti doo, ne Masaa Gadu sende wan Basiya fi en go opo a dunguu osu doo. Ne a puu den apaiti bosikopuman go poti a doose fu a dunguu osu. Ne a taigi den taki:
eng_text: But the angel of the Lord by night opened the prison doors, and brought them forth, and said,

djk_text: “U gwe na a Mama Keliki go leli sama a nyun sowtu libi di Masaa Gadu wani gi den.”
eng_text: Go, stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life.

djk_text: Den du san a taki. Fuuku mamanten den go leli sama anda. A mamanten de, a moo hei Dyu anga den sama fi en hali gwe na a kuutu peesi. Gaansama fu paandasi di e kuutu sani tu. Wookoman fu den go na a dunguu osu, fu tyai den apaiti bosikopuman kon kuutu.
eng_text: And when they heard that, they entered into the temple early in the morning, and taught. But the high priest came, and they that were with him, and called the council together, and all the senate of the children of Israel and sent to the prison to have them brought.

djk_text: Ma di den wookoman go doo na a dunguu osu, ne woo. Den apaiti bosikopuman á de a ini. Namo den daai kon taigi den sama di e oli a kuutu.
eng_text: But when the officers came, and found them not in the prison, they returned, and told,

djk_text: Den taki: “Wi á poi fusutan san pasa de. Den doo fu a dunguu osu de sooto sooto. Wakitiman taampu a fesi fu den sooto sooto doo. Ma woo, di u opo doo go a ini, sama á de a ini.”
eng_text: Saying, The prison truly found we shut with all safety, and the keepers standing without before the doors: but when we had opened, we found no man within.

djk_text: We, a basi fu wakitiman anga den moo hei apaiti begiman, na a Mama Keliki aliki, te a kaba. Ne den á sabi san fu du. Den e pakisei taki: “San pasa anga den man di u be sooto?”
eng_text: Now when the high priest and the captain of the temple and the chief priests heard these things, they doubted of them whereunto this would grow.

djk_text: Na ape den de, ne wan sama kon doo a den tapu anga wan bosikopu taki: “Kon go luku dise! Den man di u be sooto go baka na a Mama Keliki, da den e leli sama sani anda.”
eng_text: Then came one and told them, saying, Behold, the men whom ye put in prison are standing in the temple, and teaching the people.

djk_text: Namo, a basi fu den wakitiman anga den ondooman fi en go kisi den apaiti bosikopuman anda. Ma den á kisi den ogii fasi. Den feele enke den Dyusama ati be sa boon a den, fu naki den kii anga siton enke fa den gwenti, te den ati boon.
eng_text: Then went the captain with the officers, and brought them without violence: for they feared the people, lest they should have been stoned.

djk_text: Namo den teke den apaiti bosikopuman tyai kon na a kuutu peesi. Ne den poti den taampu a den fesi. Namo a moo hei Dyu de taki, a o soi den san na a ogii di den du.
eng_text: And when they had brought them, they set them before the council: and the high priest asked them,

djk_text: A taki: “Wi be bali u fu kaba leli sama sani di Jesesi be taki. Ma u á teke! U moo fuu a kondee ya seefi anga a leli de. Soseefi u e waka e kaagi wi ya taki, u be kii a Jesesi de.”
eng_text: Saying, Did not we straitly command you that ye should not teach in this name? and, behold, ye have filled Jerusalem with your doctrine, and intend to bring this man's blood upon us.

djk_text: Namo Peitilisi anga den taa apaiti bosikopuman piki taki: “Wi á poi teke a taki fu u de. Bika namo namo wi ya mu du san Masaa Gadu sende wi. Da u á poi teke sama taki bigi enke dati.”
eng_text: Then Peter and the other apostles answered and said, We ought to obey God rather than men.

djk_text: Soseefi a soi ete taki: “Na a Gadu ya wi avo gaansama be e dini. Ne en weki Jesesi puu a dede, di u Dyusama de sipikii kii a koloisi.
eng_text: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom ye slew and hanged on a tree.

djk_text: Ne a tyai en gwe ne en kondee a tapu, go poti sidon na a moo hei peesi ne en leti ana se. Ne en a be paamisi, fu poti tii sani. Soseefi a Yeepiman fu puu Islayeli Kondee a ini takuudu anga ogii. Meke den sa daai libi, fu fende paadon a Masaa Gadu, fu ala san den be du pasa kaba.”
eng_text: Him hath God exalted with his right hand to be a Prince and a Saviour, for to give repentance to Israel, and forgiveness of sins.

djk_text: Den soi ete taki: “Wi di taampu a u fesi ya na kotoigi di si san Masaa Gadu du, fu taki baka. Sama di e aliki wi, da a Apaiti Jeje e piki en taki, na tuu. Bika ai teke peesi a sama di wani teke Masaa Gadu taki.”
eng_text: And we are his witnesses of these things; and so is also the Holy Ghost, whom God hath given to them that obey him.

djk_text: Namo, di den kaba aliki den Peitilisi, ne den ati taki, a o boon. Den be kaba fu tyai ala den apaiti bosikopuman go kii.
eng_text: When they heard that, they were cut to the heart, and took counsel to slay them.

djk_text: Na Gamaliyeli enke wan fu den man a ini a lanti fu kuutu tapu dati. Na wan Faliseiman di de leliman fu Dyuweiti tu. Ala sama e lesipeki en. Ne en meke den poti den apaiti bosikopuman a doose fosi.
eng_text: Then stood there up one in the council, a Pharisee, named Gamaliel, a doctor of the law, had in reputation among all the people, and commanded to put the apostles forth a little space;

djk_text: Ne a taigi den taawan taki: “Mi eigi Dyusama! Mi o taki wan sani di u mu denki, fosi u du sani anga den man ya!
eng_text: And said unto them, Ye men of Israel, take heed to yourselves what ye intend to do as touching these men.

djk_text: Luku san be pasa a fesi. A man den be e kai Tewdasi be tyai enseefi enke bigiman. Fo ondoo sama be e waka ne en baka, fu du san ai taki. Ma sama fende en kii panya a hii kulu sama fi en fika a yayo.
eng_text: For before these days rose up Theudas, boasting himself to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves: who was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered, and brought to nought.

djk_text: Baka fu dati, a man den e kai Judasi fu a pisiwataa fu Galileya. A be tyai enseefi bigi tu, na a ten di lanti be e teli sama. Somen sama be waka ne en baka, ma sama be fende en kii panya a hii kulu sama fi en fika a yayo tu.
eng_text: After this man rose up Judas of Galilee in the days of the taxing, and drew away much people after him: he also perished; and all, even as many as obeyed him, were dispersed.

djk_text: “Da mi e taki, u fika den man di u kisi ya. Efu a basi fu den na libisama tu, da a wooko fu den musu booko so tu. A leli di den e tyai seefi o doo wan kaba tu.
eng_text: And now I say unto you, Refrain from these men, and let them alone: for if this counsel or this work be of men, it will come to nought:

djk_text: Ma fu na Masaa Gadu na basi fu a wooko fu den, da wi ná o poi tapu dati, winsi san wi o du. A o kon taki, wi e feti anga Masaa Gadu seefi.”
eng_text: But if it be of God, ye cannot overthrow it; lest haply ye be found even to fight against God.

djk_text: Namo den taawan a ini a lanti fu kuutu teke san a taki. Den á kii den apaiti bosikopuman moo enke fa den be denki. Den kai den kon a ini namo, meke wookoman wipi den. Ne den taigi den taki: “U sa gwe! Ma u mu kaba taki sani a ini a nen fu a Jesesi de, fu leli sama sani!”
eng_text: And to him they agreed: and when they had called the apostles, and beaten them, they commanded that they should not speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.

djk_text: Namo den apaiti bosikopuman komoto de anga ala gaan piisii na ati. Den fende taki, Masaa Gadu teli den bigi fu meke den e tuka anga toko fu a Nen fu Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi ede.
eng_text: And they departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer shame for his name.

djk_text: Namo den teke ibii dei e leli sama a Bun Nyunsu na a Mama Keliki. Den e soi den fa Masaa Jesesi na a Kelestesi.
eng_text: And daily in the temple, and in every house, they ceased not to teach and preach Jesus Christ.

djk_text: A ten ya, Dyusama di e teke a biibi kon ipi. Ma wan sowtu buuya kon a den mindii. A kulu di e taki Giiki Tongo fende taki, Hebelei Tongo wan e paati bee ibii dei anga den. Te den e du a wooko, fu paati nyanyan gi biibi uman di man dede fika a ganda. Da den e moo luku a kulu fu denseefi.
eng_text: And in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplied, there arose a murmuring of the Grecians against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily ministration.

djk_text: Namo den apaiti bosikopuman kai a hii kulu biibiwan a kuutu. Ne den taki: “Wi enke apaiti bosikopuman na fu paati Masaa Gadu bosikopu bunbun. Wi á poi wai dati poti a baka, fu teke sete nyanyan toli.
eng_text: Then the twelve called the multitude of the disciples unto them, and said, It is not reason that we should leave the word of God, and serve tables.

djk_text: Da u e sende u fu suku seibin man tyai kon a fesi, fu wi ya poti na a wooko de. A Apaiti Jeje mu teke den hii libi fu gi den koni fu libi.
eng_text: Wherefore, brethren, look ye out among you seven men of honest report, full of the Holy Ghost and wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.

djk_text: Te den seibin o de na a wooko, da wi enke apaiti bosikopuman o poi poti ede namo fu begi. Soseefi, fu paati a bosikopu.”
eng_text: But we will give ourselves continually to prayer, and to the ministry of the word.

djk_text: San fiti de bun gi ala biibiwan. Ne den suku seibin man di sa fiti a wooko. Filipi, Pokolesi, Nikanolu, Timon anga Palmeinasi. Nikolayesi enke biibiwan, ma na Antiyokiya sama di be teke Dyu fu dini. Stefanisi di libi be bun fu a wooko. A Apaiti Jeje be lai en hii libi, soseefi taanga biibi.
eng_text: And the saying pleased the whole multitude: and they chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Ghost, and Philip, and Prochorus, and Nicanor, and Timon, and Parmenas, and Nicolas a proselyte of Antioch:

djk_text: Na den man ya den tyai kon a fesi, ne den apaiti bosikopuman poti ana begi gi den.
eng_text: Whom they set before the apostles: and when they had prayed, they laid their hands on them.

djk_text: Namo a bosikopu fu Masaa Gadu taki, a o wooko taanga a Jelusalem Foto. Tuutuu, moo sama e teke a bosikopu, da biibisama e moo ipi naamo. Wan hii kulu begiman fu Dyu keliki seefi teke biibi.
eng_text: And the word of God increased; and the number of the disciples multiplied in Jerusalem greatly; and a great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.

djk_text: A Apaiti Jeje di lai Stefanisi hii libi dati e gi en kaakiti. Da ai waka e du foondoo sani de, enke maiki fu soi fa Masaa Gadu bigi. Masaa Gadu seefi be teke gaan bun ati fasi namo, fu yeepi en seefi seefi, a ini ala sani.
eng_text: And Stephen, full of faith and power, did great wonders and miracles among the people.

djk_text: Namo wan duupu sama kon sitee anga en, fu a leli fu Masaa Gadu di ai tyai. Dyusama fu Sileni Kondee anga Alekisandiya Foto, fu wan Dyu keliki den e kai, Fii Saafu Keliki. Wantu Dyusama fu Silisiya anga Asiya seefi kon anga den.
eng_text: Then there arose certain of the synagogue, which is called the synagogue of the Libertines, and Cyrenians, and Alexandrians, and of them of Cilicia and of Asia, disputing with Stephen.

djk_text: Ma Stefanisi be e wooko anga koni fu taki anga den. A Apaiti Jeje di lai en hii libi be e piki en san fu taki. Da den á be e poi sitee anga san ai taki.
eng_text: And they were not able to resist the wisdom and the spirit by which he spake.

djk_text: Namo den go pai sama fu lei gi en taki, den yee ai taki takuu fu Mosesi anga ala taa Masaa Gadu seefi.
eng_text: Then they suborned men, which said, We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses, and against God.

djk_text: Soseefi den du sani fu poti en ogii na a hii foluku fesi. Den meke gaansama fu paandasi anga leliman fu Dyuweiti seefi ati boon ne en. Ne den disi sende sama go kisi en hali tyai go a kuutu.
eng_text: And they stirred up the people, and the elders, and the scribes, and came upon him, and caught him, and brought him to the council,

djk_text: Den tyai sama kon na a kuutu tu, di mu lei gi en taki: “U yee pe ai taki takuu, fu a Mama Keliki di de apaiti fasi gi Masaa Gadu. A taki takuu fu weiti di wi avo Mosesi fika gi wi tu, fu soi fa fu dini.”
eng_text: And set up false witnesses, which said, This man ceaseth not to speak blasphemous words against this holy place, and the law:

djk_text: Den soi ete taki: “A be taki taki, a Jesesi fu den di goo a Nasaleti Foto o booko a hii Dyu Mama Keliki. A o kengi a hii fasi fa Mosesi fika gi wi, fu dini.”
eng_text: For we have heard him say, that this Jesus of Nazareth shall destroy this place, and shall change the customs which Moses delivered us.

djk_text: Namo a hii Dyulanti di e kuutu sani daai luku Stefanisi a mindii fesi. Den si en hii fesi e beenki wan apaiti dyendee fasi enke en na wan Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee .
eng_text: And all that sat in the council, looking stedfastly on him, saw his face as it had been the face of an angel.

djk_text: Namo a moo hei apaiti begiman akisi Stefanisi taki: “Fa den taki de, na so yu e wooko tuu?”
eng_text: Then said the high priest, Are these things so?

djk_text: Namo a piki taki: “Mi Dyusama anga ala dda ya, u aliki! Masaa Gadu na a gaan dyendee Gadu fu gi gaandi. Na so a be soi enseefi a Abalaham enke moo gaandi avo pe u paansu komoto, fosi a be go tan a Halan Foto. A be de a Mesopatamiya Kondee.
eng_text: And he said, Men, brethren, and fathers, hearken; The God of glory appeared unto our father Abraham, when he was in Mesopotamia, before he dwelt in Charran,

djk_text: Na ape a go taigi Abalaham taki: ‘Komoto fika ala i famii anga ala i kondee ya! Mi wani tyai yu go poti na a kondee pe mi wani i mu tan seefi.’
eng_text: And said unto him, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and come into the land which I shall shew thee.

djk_text: Namo a komoto a Mesopatamiya dati na a kondee fu Kaldea sama go tan a Halan Foto, te enke en dda dede. Ne a puu en de, tyai kon poti na a kondee pe u de tide ya. Disi na Kanahan Kondee fu fosi.
eng_text: Then came he out of the land of the Chaldaeans, and dwelt in Charran: and from thence, when his father was dead, he removed him into this land, wherein ye now dwell.

djk_text: Ma Abalaham tan ya sondee a kondee de fi en. Wan pisi doti seefi á be toon fi en. Na a paamisi namo be de taki: ‘Mi o poti a kondee a yu paansu ana.’ A ten de, a be de sondee pikin ete seefi.”
eng_text: And he gave him none inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on: yet he promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his seed after him, when as yet he had no child.

djk_text: Namo a soi ete taki: “Ma a be taigi Abalaham taki: ‘Wan ten e kon bakaten, da a paansu fi yu o komoto ya go fika a sama kondee, fo ondoo yali langa enke saafu.
eng_text: And God spake on this wise, That his seed should sojourn in a strange land; and that they should bring them into bondage, and entreat them evil four hundred years.

djk_text: Mi o abi fu sitaafu a foluku di e saafu den, fu dwengi den losi den, meke den daai kon teke a peesi ya toon fu den seefi. Bika na ya den mu kon tan, fu dini mi.’
eng_text: And the nation to whom they shall be in bondage will I judge, said God: and after that shall they come forth, and serve me in this place.

djk_text: A taigi en ete taki: ‘Manpikin di meke a yu paansu sama, da u mu koti maiki a manpeesi gi en, fu toon sama fu mi. Da san mi paamisi yu o de gi den tu.’ We, Isaki meke, a koti so baka aitin dei. Jakopu meke, letiso. Den twalufu baala di sete den twalufu lo soseefi.”
eng_text: And he gave him the covenant of circumcision: and so Abraham begat Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat the twelve patriarchs.

djk_text: Namo Stefanisi soi ete taki: “Dyalusu meke den twalufu baala enke avo di sete den twalufu lo be seli Jowsef wan fu den baala gwe a Egepte Kondee. Ne dati toon saafu anda, ma Masaa Gadu de anga en.
eng_text: And the patriarchs, moved with envy, sold Joseph into Egypt: but God was with him,

djk_text: A teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku en, a ini ala san e kon tuka anga en. Da ai gi en koni fu wooko. Ne Fala-ow fu Egepte Kondee lobi en. A poti en enke moo bigiman, fu yeepi en tii kondee. Soseefi, fu taki gi en osu anga san a abi.
eng_text: And delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favour and wisdom in the sight of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and he made him governor over Egypt and all his house.

djk_text: “Na a ten de wan gaan angiiten o naki Egepte Kondee anga Kanahan Kondee. Nyanyan á be de ape moo fu den avo fu wi de fende bai.
eng_text: Now there came a dearth over all the land of Egypt and Chanaan, and great affliction: and our fathers found no sustenance.

djk_text: Namo Jakopu enke dda fu den twalufu baala yee fa na Egepte Kondee namo nyanyan de fu fende bai. Ne a sende den manpikin fi en, fu a fosi leisi go bai anda.
eng_text: But when Jacob heard that there was corn in Egypt, he sent out our fathers first.

djk_text: Di den go kon, te wan pisi nyanyan kaba baka fika den. Ne a dda sende den go bai du fu tu leisi. Ne fosi Jowsef meke den sabi taki, en na den baala di den be seli. Na so a Fala-ow seefi kon sabi den famii fi en.
eng_text: And at the second time Joseph was made known to his brethren; and Joseph's kindred was made known unto Pharaoh.

djk_text: “Ne Jowsef sende teke en dda Jakopu kon poti a Egepte Kondee. Soseefi ala taa famii fi en a Kanahan Kondee. Makandii den be de seibintenti na feifi sama.
eng_text: Then sent Joseph, and called his father Jacob to him, and all his kindred, threescore and fifteen souls.

djk_text: Na so wi avo Jowsef anga en dda Jakopu anga den elufu baala go fika a Egepte Kondee. Den tan ape, te enke ibiiwan dede dei doo, di a mu dede.
eng_text: So Jacob went down into Egypt, and died, he, and our fathers,

djk_text: Ma den á beli anda. Den be e kon beli a pe den be komoto a Sikem Kondee na a gaan siton olo pe Abalaham be e beli en famii. A be bai dati a den manpikin fu Hemoli.”
eng_text: And were carried over into Sychem, and laid in the sepulchre that Abraham bought for a sum of money of the sons of Emmor the father of Sychem.

djk_text: Namo Stefanisi soi ete taki: “Da a paansu di komoto a den avo fu wi be fika a Egepte Kondee. A foluku goo kon bigi di somen yali pasa. Ne a yuu diipi doo fu san Masaa Gadu be paamisi Abalaham taki, musu fu pasa.
eng_text: But when the time of the promise drew nigh, which God had sworn to Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt,

djk_text: Namo libi daai gi den a Egepte Kondee di somen yali diipi pasa. Sowtu a sowtu Fala-ow kengi komoto na a kownu wooko. Wan doo na a wooko di á be abi bisi anga fa Jowsef be yeepi Egepte Kondee.
eng_text: Till another king arose, which knew not Joseph.

djk_text: A bigin libi takuu anga den avo fu wi. A koli den poti a pina, da ai dwengi den fu towe ibiiwan yonkuu pikin di den meke.”
eng_text: The same dealt subtilly with our kindred, and evil entreated our fathers, so that they cast out their young children, to the end they might not live.

djk_text: Stefanisi soi ete taki: “Na a yuu ten de Mosesi meke enke wan moi yonkuu pikin gi Masaa Gadu. En mma anga en dda á towe en kii. Ma den kibii en solugu dii mun langa a ini osu.
eng_text: In which time Moses was born, and was exceeding fair, and nourished up in his father's house three months:

djk_text: Di a kon bigi fu kibii solugu a ini osu, ne den poti en a wan peesi, fu sama fende teke. Ne a umanpikin fu Fala-ow fende en teke kiya enke eigi pikin di a meke.
eng_text: And when he was cast out, Pharaoh's daughter took him up, and nourished him for her own son.

djk_text: Na so Mosesi kiya enke Egepte sama. A leli ala koni di den be abi fu leli wooko. Ala en du anga ala en taki be e dwengi lesipeki.”
eng_text: And Moses was learned in all the wisdom of the Egyptians, and was mighty in words and in deeds.

djk_text: Stefanisi soi ete taki: “Di Mosesi goo doo fotenti yali so, ne a fii fu daai ana luku den sama fi en. A iti ain na a pina fu den enke saafu.
eng_text: And when he was full forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brethren the children of Israel.

djk_text: Namo wan dei, ne a si wan Egepte e pina wan Dyu. Ne a naki a Egepte kii seefi.
eng_text: And seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him, and avenged him that was oppressed, and smote the Egyptian:

djk_text: A membee enke dati be o opo en foluku ain, fu si taki, Masaa Gadu poti en, fu yeepi den puu na a saafu. Ma den á si a toli so.
eng_text: For he supposed his brethren would have understood how that God by his hand would deliver them: but they understood not.

djk_text: “Bika a tamaa fi en, ne tu Dyusama e feti. Namo a dyombo a mindii, fu koti a toobi taki: ‘U na baala anga baala enke Dyusama. U á mu du ogii anga u seefi.’
eng_text: And the next day he shewed himself unto them as they strove, and would have set them at one again, saying, Sirs, ye are brethren; why do ye wrong one to another?

djk_text: “Namo a Dyu di e suku a feti toto Mosesi puu ne en se. Ne a piki taki: ‘Sama poti yu fu basi wi? Sama poti yu enke lanti fu kuutu gi wi?’
eng_text: But he that did his neighbour wrong thrust him away, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge over us?

djk_text: A taki go doo taki: ‘San leti i wani du anga mi? I membee yu o fende pasi kii mi enke fa i kii a Egepte eside ya?’
eng_text: Wilt thou kill me, as thou diddest the Egyptian yesterday?

djk_text: Na so a konkuu Mosesi, meke Mosesi be musu fu lowe komoto de go tan a Midiyan Kondee. A teke uman libi anda seefi meke tu manpikin. Ma ai fii enseefi anda naamo, enke a de a sama kondee.”
eng_text: Then fled Moses at this saying, and was a stranger in the land of Madian, where he begat two sons.

djk_text: Stefanisi taki ete taki: “Di a tan fotenti yali anda, ne a Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee go taki anga en a ini wan gaan sabana a Sinai Mongo. A si wan maka katuku e leti faya, ma na a Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee be kon soi enseefi enke faya de.
eng_text: And when forty years were expired, there appeared to him in the wilderness of mount Sina an angel of the Lord in a flame of fire in a bush.

djk_text: A sani ya foondoo Mosesi, ne ai go koosube, fu luku san tan so. Namo a yee Masaa Gadu taki komoto a ini a faya anga en.
eng_text: When Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight: and as he drew near to behold it, the voice of the Lord came unto him,

djk_text: A taki: ‘Na mi Masaa Gadu de ya. Mi na a Gadu fi yu avo Abalaham, Isaki anga Jakopu.’ Namo Mosesi dyombo te, en hii sikin e dansi. A á be abi ati fu luku go de moo seefi.”
eng_text: Saying, I am the God of thy fathers, the God of Abrham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. Then Moses trembled, and durst not behold.

djk_text: “Namo Masaa Gadu taki ete taki: ‘Puu i susu a i futu. A peesi pe i taampu de, na wan apaiti peesi gi mi. Da yu á poi taampu anga susu de.
eng_text: Then said the Lord to him, Put off thy shoes from thy feet: for the place where thou standest is holy ground.

djk_text: Mi saka kon ya, fu di mi e si fa Dyusama fi yu e teke pina enke saafu. Soseefi, mi e yee den dyeme fu den. Mi saka kon, fu puu den na ala dati. Da waka kon ya! Bika na yu mi o sende go teke den puu a Egepte Kondee.’ ”
eng_text: I have seen, I have seen the affliction of my people which is in Egypt, and I have heard their groaning, and am come down to deliver them. And now come, I will send thee into Egypt.

djk_text: Stefanisi soi ete taki: “Na a Mosesi ya Dyusama á be teli! Den taigi en taki: ‘On sama poti yu fu basi wi? Sama poti yu enke lanti fu kuutu gi wi?’ Ma, ne na dati Masaa Gadu poti edeman, fu puu den a katibo. A taanga fu a Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee na a katuku, e tyai en.
eng_text: This Moses whom they refused, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge? the same did God send to be a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel which appeared to him in the bush.

djk_text: Ne a du somen foondoo sani dwengi Egepte puu den a saafu anga taanga. Soseefi di den waka doo a ze den e kai Lebi Ze. Di den de a ini a gaan sabana fotenti yali langa tu.
eng_text: He brought them out, after that he had shewed wonders and signs in the land of Egypt, and in the Red sea, and in the wilderness forty years.

djk_text: “A Mosesi ya be taigi Dyusama taki: ‘Masaa Gadu o poti wan apaiti takiman fi en bakaten, fu tyai en foluku. A o puu wi a saafu enke fa mi Mosesi ya be wooko. Leti a wi mindii ya a o meke libisama fasi.’ ”
eng_text: This is that Moses, which said unto the children of Israel, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear.

djk_text: Stefanisi soi ete taki: “Mosesi anga den taa avo gaansama be e waka a ini a gaan sabana. Tapu fu Sinai Mongo, da Masaa Gadu Kondee Basiya be gi en somen bosikopu fu taigi den, fa Masaa Gadu e gi libi. Ala dati fika gi wi tide ya ete, fu wooko.
eng_text: This is he, that was in the church in the wilderness with the angel which spake to him in the mount Sina, and with our fathers: who received the lively oracles to give unto us:

djk_text: Ma den avo fu wi á be wani poti yesi aliki Mosesi seefi. Den wai en anga ala den bosikopu poti a wanse. Bika den ati de a taa sani enke fu pakisei Egepte Kondee pe den komoto a saafu.”
eng_text: To whom our fathers would not obey, but thrust him from them, and in their hearts turned back again into Egypt,

djk_text: Stefanisi soi ete taki: “Bika wan leisi Mosesi gwe a Sinai Mongo ede, ne den taigi en gaan baala Aalon taki: ‘Mosesi di puu wi a Egepte Kondee tan tumisi langa. Kande sani du en anda, fu a á poi daai kon baka. Meke u meke wan gadu, fu waka a u fesi tyai wi.’
eng_text: Saying unto Aaron, Make us gods to go before us: for as for this Moses, which brought us out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.

djk_text: Den teke sani meke wan pikin gowtu kaw. Den piisii dansi gi en anga ala kii meti boon gi en gaandi anga lesipeki enke fa fu du gi Masaa Gadu namo.”
eng_text: And they made a calf in those days, and offered sacrifice unto the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their own hands.

djk_text: Stefanisi soi ete taki: “Namo Masaa Gadu daai baka fika den, fu dini mun, san anga sitali a tapu. A waka enke san be sikiifi na a buku den e kai Apaiti Takiman fu Masaa Gadu taki: ‘Islayeli foluku waka fotenti yali a ini sabana. U e kii meti teke buulu begi mi paadon.
eng_text: Then God turned, and gave them up to worship the host of heaven; as it is written in the book of the prophets, O ye house of Israel, have ye offered to me slain beasts and sacrifices by the space of forty years in the wilderness?

djk_text: Ma u e dini taa sani! A gadu osu fu Molok di u e tyai a u baka. Lomfa, a sitali di u teke sani meke wan fi en anga ana. Somen sowtu sani u poti e begi. Mi o sitaafu u! Doose kondee sama o kisi u tyai gwe a faawe kondee pasa Babilon Foto seefi.’ ”
eng_text: Yea, ye took up the tabernacle of Moloch, and the star of your god Remphan, figures which ye made to worship them: and I will carry you away beyond Babylon.

djk_text: Stefanisi soi ete taki: “Ma wi avo a ini a sabana be e tyai a tenti osu fu Masaa Gadu di e kotoigi taki, a de a den mindii. A be meke leti enke di a be soi Mosesi a tapu, fu luku meke dati.
eng_text: Our fathers had the tabernacle of witness in the wilderness, as he had appointed, speaking unto Moses, that he should make it according to the fashion that he had seen.

djk_text: Ma na pikin fu den wooko doo anga en, fu Josuwa tii puu a kondee a taa foluku ana. Masaa Gadu yaki den gi den anga en makiti. Ne Dyusama kon tan wooko ya anga a apaiti tenti, yali fu yali, go doo bakaten di Dafeti toon kownu seefi.”
eng_text: Which also our fathers that came after brought in with Jesus into the possession of the Gentiles, whom God drave out before the face of our fathers, unto the days of David;

djk_text: Stefanisi soi ete taki: “Kownu Dafeti na wan man di Masaa Gadu lobi. A teke gaan bun ati fasi luku en somen fasi. Namo, Dafeti akisi a Gadu fu wi avo gaansama Jakopu ya, fu meke wan osu poti a Gadu ya.
eng_text: Who found favour before God, and desired to find a tabernacle for the God of Jacob.

djk_text: Ma a tapu en, fu du dati. Na a ten fu Dafeti manpikin Salomo fosi, ne a gi Salomo dati pasi fu meke a osu de.”
eng_text: But Solomon built him an house.

djk_text: We, di Stefanisi e taki, ne a akisi a Dyulanti fu kuutu de taki: “Ma a gaan Masaa Gadu a tapu sa poi tan a ini wan osu di libisama meke anga ana? Bika enseefi be piki en fositen apaiti takiman fu sikiifi taki:
eng_text: Howbeit the most High dwelleth not in temples made with hands; as saith the prophet,

djk_text: ‘Mi enke Masaa Gadu de a mi kondee a tapu, fu tii ala sani. Hii goontapu de a mi ondoo futu. Da sowtu osu libisama o poi meke fu poti mi?
eng_text: Heaven is my throne, and earth is my footstool: what house will ye build me? saith the Lord: or what is the place of my rest?

djk_text: Bika na mi abi ala makiti fu meke san de fu si anga ain ya.’ ”
eng_text: Hath not my hand made all these things?

djk_text: Stefanisi soi ete taki: “Ma u sama ya abi tuutuu taanga yesi. U ati noiti poi teke taki di Masaa Gadu e meke en Apaiti Jeje e piki u, fu du. U gei doose kondee sama, taa foluku di á sabi Masaa Gadu. Na letiso u avo seefi be tan.
eng_text: Ye stiffnecked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, ye do always resist the Holy Ghost: as your fathers did, so do ye.

djk_text: Fositen apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu á de di den á be pina. Den be e kii sama e soi den fa Masaa Gadu paamisi fu sende en wookoman kon di o wooko enke fa a wani. A leti wookoman ya kon na a ten fu u ya, ne u dati poti en gi lanti kii.
eng_text: Which of the prophets have not your fathers persecuted? and they have slain them which shewed before of the coming of the Just One; of whom ye have been now the betrayers and murderers:

djk_text: Na fu soso Masaa Gadu meke Basiya fi en tyai en weiti kon gi u. Bika u nái wooko anga den.”
eng_text: Who have received the law by the disposition of angels, and have not kept it.

djk_text: We, a Dyulanti di e kuutu sani de aliki san a taki fu den de, ne den ati boon te. Ala den mofu e dansi seefi.
eng_text: When they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed on him with their teeth.

djk_text: A Apaiti Jeje teke Stefanisi hii libi. Ne a taampu e luku tapu, da ai si sani a tapu anda, fa Masaa Gadu dyendee fu gi gaandi. Masaa Jesesi taampu anda a Masaa Gadu letise.
eng_text: But he, being full of the Holy Ghost, looked up stedfastly into heaven, and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,

djk_text: Namo a taigi a Dyulanti di e kuutu de taki: “Nownow, mi e si a Manpikin di saka kon toon libisama ya. A taampu anda na a moo hei peesi a Masaa Gadu letise ana.”
eng_text: And said, Behold, I see the heavens opened, and the Son of man standing on the right hand of God.

djk_text: Namo a Dyulanti di e kuutu de bali taki: “Kaba anga den takuu taki de!” Ne den tapu ana a yesi. Soseefi den dyombo kon gaapu en oli.
eng_text: Then they cried out with a loud voice, and stopped their ears, and ran upon him with one accord,

djk_text: Ne a lanti de gi Dyusama ape, fu seepi tyai gwe a doose fu Jelusalem Foto go towe a doti. Ne den puu yasi a sikin gi wan yonkuman den e kai Sawlesi, fu oli gi den. Namo den teke siton fiingi naki en te, fu kii.
eng_text: And cast him out of the city, and stoned him: and the witnesses laid down their clothes at a young man's feet, whose name was Saul.

djk_text: A yuu de, ai bali kai Masaa Jesesi nen taki: “Masaa! Mi fika mi jeje gi yu fu teke.”
eng_text: And they stoned Stephen, calling upon God, and saying, Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.

djk_text: Ne a kai anga kini, da ai bali begi Masaa Gadu taki: “Mi e begi, fu den sa fende paadon a yu, fu a ogii di den e du ya.” Na so a komoto a goontapu.
eng_text: And he kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, Lord, lay not this sin to their charge. And when he had said this, he fell asleep.

djk_text: A kii fu Stefanisi na wan sani di kai gi Sawlesi. Bigin fu a dei de libi kon moo taanga gi biibisama de. Dyusama e lon du ogii anga den. Da den e lowe panya gwe na a pisiwataa fu Judeja, soseefi Samaliya. Na den apaiti bosikopuman namo be fika de.
eng_text: And Saul was consenting unto his death. And at that time there was a great persecution against the church which was at Jerusalem; and they were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judaea and Samaria, except the apostles.

djk_text: Da na wan duupu manengee di e oli pakisei anga Masaa Gadu be teke Stefanisi dede sikin go beli. Den kee anga ala tyali fi en ede te.
eng_text: And devout men carried Stephen to his burial, and made great lamentation over him.

djk_text: A ten ya Sawlesi nái meke sipowtu anga biibisama. Ai meke moiti fu kaba den anga ala a biibi libi. Ai waka osu fu osu e kisi biibi uman anga man seepi go gi lanti, fu sooto.
eng_text: As for Saul, he made havock of the church, entering into every house, and haling men and women committed them to prison.

djk_text: Ma den biibisama di be lowe fika Jelusalem be e waka lontu den peesi pe den lowe go. Da den e paati a Bun Nyunsu fu Masaa Jesesi na ala pe den doo.
eng_text: Therefore they that were scattered abroad went every where preaching the word.

djk_text: Wan biibiwan den e kai Filipi seefi be doo wan foto na a pisiwataa fu Samaliya. Ne ai taigi den sama anda taki, Jesesi na a Kelestesi.
eng_text: Then Philip went down to the city of Samaria, and preached Christ unto them.

djk_text: Namo den sama ape aliki en. Den e si tu fa ai du foondoo sani enke maiki taki, na Masaa Gadu taampu gi en. Ne den ala booko kon teke san ai taki.
eng_text: And the people with one accord gave heed unto those things which Philip spake, hearing and seeing the miracles which he did.

djk_text: Bika den e si takuu jeje e bali komoto a somen sama tapu. Lanman anga malengii sama e kon bun.
eng_text: For unclean spirits, crying with loud voice, came out of many that were possessed with them: and many taken with palsies, and that were lame, were healed.

djk_text: Ala san e pasa de tyai gaan piisii a ini a foto ya. Ala sama ape e poolo.
eng_text: And there was great joy in that city.

djk_text: Ma fosi a ten de, da wan tofuuman den e kai Simon be e tan a ini a foto fu Samalitan sama ya. A be e kai enseefi bigiman. Ala sama fu a foto be e foondoo, fu den tofuu di ai du.
eng_text: But there was a certain man, called Simon, which beforetime in the same city used sorcery, and bewitched the people of Samaria, giving out that himself was some great one:

djk_text: Pikin anga bigi, hei anga lagi fu a foto be e teke ala san ai taki. Bika den be e denki na Masaa Gadu gi en a hii kaakiti fi en, fu wooko gi en.
eng_text: To whom they all gave heed, from the least to the greatest, saying, This man is the great power of God.

djk_text: Na so meke tofuu di ai du be e meke den sama e foondoo onmen langa kaba na a peesi de.
eng_text: And to him they had regard, because that of long time he had bewitched them with sorceries.

djk_text: Ma di Filipi kon doo de, ne a taigi den sama a Bun Nyunsu, fa Masaa Gadu poti fu tii sama. Soseefi ai soi den fa Masaa Jesesi na a Kelestesi. Namo uman anga man teke biibi na a peesi de, te go dopu.
eng_text: But when they believed Philip preaching the things concerning the kingdom of God, and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.

djk_text: Simon seefi go dopu. A teke biibi a san a yee Filipi e taki. Namo a bigin waka wanten anga Filipi na ala pe ai go. Da ai foondoo naamo, fu san Filipi e du enke maiki taki, na Masaa Gadu taampu gi en.
eng_text: Then Simon himself believed also: and when he was baptized, he continued with Philip, and wondered, beholding the miracles and signs which were done.

djk_text: Namo nyunsu fu dise go doo Jelusalem Foto a den apaiti bosikopuman. Den yee fa Samaliya pisiwataa teke Masaa Gadu bosikopu, fu Masaa Jesesi. Ne den puu tu fu den, Johanisi anga Peitilisi go luku den sama anda.
eng_text: Now when the apostles which were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent unto them Peter and John:

djk_text: Ne den komoto go doo, te begi gi den sama di teke biibi de, fu a Apaiti Jeje sa lai den sama libi.
eng_text: Who, when they were come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Ghost:

djk_text: Bika den be teke biibi de, te be dopu enke maiki taki, den e biibi Masaa Jesesi. Ma a Apaiti Jeje dati á be lai den libi ete.
eng_text: (For as yet he was fallen upon none of them: only they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.)

djk_text: Namo Peitilisi anga Johanisi poti ana, a ibiiwan fu den tapu, begi gi den. Ne Masaa Gadu meke en Apaiti Jeje lai den libi tu.
eng_text: Then laid they their hands on them, and they received the Holy Ghost.

djk_text: Namo Simon luku san pasa de. A si taki, te den apaiti bosikopuman poti ana begi gi wan sama, da a Apaiti Jeje e lai a hii libi de. Namo a teke moni fu go pai den apaiti bosikopuman, fi en seefi sa poi du dati tu.
eng_text: And when Simon saw that through laying on of the apostles' hands the Holy Ghost was given, he offered them money,

djk_text: A taki: “Gaantangi! Seli a kaakiti ya gi mi, fu poi poti ana begi, da a Apaiti Jeje teke a sama de libi tu.”
eng_text: Saying, Give me also this power, that on whomsoever I lay hands, he may receive the Holy Ghost.

djk_text: Ma Peitilisi piki en taki: “Luku bun! Masaa Gadu o kaba yu a soso anga ala i moni. Bika yu á mu denki taki, a gaanbigi bun di Masaa Gadu e gi, da yu o poi bai en anga moni. Kweti!
eng_text: But Peter said unto him, Thy money perish with thee, because thou hast thought that the gift of God may be purchased with money.

djk_text: Yu ati á taampu leti a Masaa Gadu fesi, da i ná abi pasi fu du a wooko ya!
eng_text: Thou hast neither part nor lot in this matter: for thy heart is not right in the sight of God.

djk_text: Daai libi komoto na a takuu ati fasi de! Da begi Masaa Gadu paadon, fu a takuu fasi di toosi yu fu denki so.
eng_text: Repent therefore of this thy wickedness, and pray God, if perhaps the thought of thine heart may be forgiven thee.

djk_text: Bika bita fasi anga giili koko a yu ati, da ai subi yu fu du sani. Da takuudu e wooko enke basi a i tapu.”
eng_text: For I perceive that thou art in the gall of bitterness, and in the bond of iniquity.

djk_text: Namo Simon piki taki: “Mi e begi! U yeepi mi begi paadon! Akisi Masaa Gadu, fu san u taki o pasa anga mi de á sa go doo.”
eng_text: Then answered Simon, and said, Pray ye to the Lord for me, that none of these things which ye have spoken come upon me.

djk_text: Johanisi anga Peitilisi be kaba de. Den soi san den be si fu Masaa Jesesi anga ala fini fini sama a dati. Ne den e gwe a Jelusalem baka, da den e miti somen Samaliya sama kondee a pasi. Da den e gi den a Bun Nyunsu tu.
eng_text: And they, when they had testified and preached the word of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and preached the gospel in many villages of the Samaritans.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Gadu sende wan Basiya fi en go taigi Filipi taki: “Seeka fu go mindii dei ten, na a pasi di abaa a sabana, komoto a Jelusalem Foto go kai a Gaasa.”
eng_text: And the angel of the Lord spake unto Philip, saying, Arise, and go toward the south unto the way that goeth down from Jerusalem unto Gaza, which is desert.

djk_text: We, a go si wan Etiyopiya Kondee man de. En na a moo heiman fu luku moni toli anda. Na wan apaiti wookoman gi a uman kownu den e kai Kandaki. Da a be go begi a Jelusalem Foto, te ai daai baka ya so.
eng_text: And he arose and went: and, behold, a man of Ethiopia, an eunuch of great authority under Candace queen of the Ethiopians, who had the charge of all her treasure, and had come to Jerusalem for to worship,

djk_text: A sidon a ini en wagi di asi e hali enke buliki wagi. Da ai leisi a pisi buku di Jesaja enke fositen apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu be sikiifi.
eng_text: Was returning, and sitting in his chariot read Esaias the prophet.

djk_text: Namo, a Apaiti Jeje di de a Filipi libi piki en taki: “Filipi! Go moo koosube fu a wagi fu a man de!”
eng_text: Then the Spirit said unto Philip, Go near, and join thyself to this chariot.

djk_text: Ne Filipi lon esi esi go koosube fu a wagi. Da ai yee a Etiyopiya man e leisi san Masaa Gadu apaiti takiman Jesaja be sikiifi. Namo Filipi akisi en taki: “Fa yu e leisi de, a sani kiin gi yu fu sabi?”
eng_text: And Philip ran thither to him, and heard him read the prophet Esaias, and said, Understandest thou what thou readest?

djk_text: Namo a man piki en taki: “Fa a sa kiin gi mi, fu sabi san mi e leisi? Sama á de fu soi mi san na a sani seefi!” Namo a kai Filipi, fu dyombo go sidon ne en se a ini a wagi.
eng_text: And he said, How can I, except some man should guide me? And he desired Philip that he would come up and sit with him.

djk_text: A pisi fu a Masaa Gadu Buku di ai leisi taki: “Den e tyai en go kii! Ma ai tan pii teke ala dati enke pikin sikapu, di den kisi fu tyai go kaabu uwii puu ne en sikin.
eng_text: The place of the scripture which he read was this, He was led as a sheep to the slaughter; and like a lamb dumb before his shearer, so opened he not his mouth:

djk_text: Den du ogii anga ala pina en. En toli seefi, den á kuutu leti, ne den puu en futu a goontapu. Da fa a sa du poi meke paansu sama fu waka ne en baka ya?”
eng_text: In his humiliation his judgment was taken away: and who shall declare his generation? for his life is taken from the earth.

djk_text: Namo, a man akisi Filipi taki: “Anga sama den du san a fositen apaiti takiman sikiifi ya? Na a apaiti takiman di sikiifi en seefi ofu na wan taa sama?”
eng_text: And the eunuch answered Philip, and said, I pray thee, of whom speaketh the prophet this? of himself, or of some other man?

djk_text: Namo Filipi teke a Bun Nyunsu soi en fa san be sikiifi Masaa Gadu Buku ape e fiti anga san pasa anga Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: Then Philip opened his mouth, and began at the same scripture, and preached unto him Jesus.

djk_text: Da fa den de a waka tapu so, ne den e pasa wan peesi de anga wataa. Namo a man daai luku a wataa, ne a akisi taki: “I si enke mi doo peesi fu dopu kaba? Bika luku wataa so!”
eng_text: And as they went on their way, they came unto a certain water: and the eunuch said, See, here is water; what doth hinder me to be baptized?

djk_text: Namo Filipi piki en taki: “Yu e biibi Masaa Jesesi tuutuu a ini yu ati? Da a bun! Taa fasi á de, na fu dopu namo.” Namo a man piki taki: “Mi e biibi tuutuu taki, Jesesi na a Kelestesi, dati na a Manpikin fu Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: And Philip said, If thou believest with all thine heart, thou mayest. And he answered and said, I believe that Jesus Christ is the Son of God.

djk_text: We, ne a tapu wagi wanten. Ne den saka komoto go a ini a wataa, en anga Filipi makandii. Ne Filipi dopu en.
eng_text: And he commanded the chariot to stand still: and they went down both into the water, both Philip and the eunuch; and he baptized him.

djk_text: Di den kaba, go a soo baka, a Etiyopiya man á si Filipi moo. A Apaiti Jeje puu en de foondoo fasi tyai go poti a wan hii taa peesi. A Etiyopiya man á fuka fu dati seefi. A dyombo a ini en wagi anga ala piisii.
eng_text: And when they were come up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught away Philip, that the eunuch saw him no more: and he went on his way rejoicing.

djk_text: Na wan faawe peesi Filipi kisi en seefi. A Apaiti Jeje tyai en go poti na a foto den e kai Asotesi. Da ai waka anga a Bun Nyunsu a den foto fu a pisi anda. Namo a go doo a foto den e kai Sesaleya seefi.
eng_text: But Philip was found at Azotus: and passing through he preached in all the cities, till he came to Caesarea.

djk_text: Sawlesi dati ati nái kaba boon a den di e waka na a pasi fu Masaa. Ai waka e pina den e kisi gi lanti, fu kii. Wan dei, a go na a moo hei Dyu fu a Mama Keliki.
eng_text: And Saul, yet breathing out threatenings and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went unto the high priest,

djk_text: Ne a akisi paamisi fu gwe a Damasikosi Foto, go kisi uman anga man di e waka na a Nyun Pasi anda, fu tyai kon sitaafu a Jelusalem. Den langa pampila makiti en, meke fesiman fu Dyu keliki anda sa si taki, a abi pasi fu du so.
eng_text: And desired of him letters to Damascus to the synagogues, that if he found any of this way, whether they were men or women, he might bring them bound unto Jerusalem.

djk_text: Namo a teke pasi e gwe Damasikosi Foto. A be doo koosube kaba. Te fu a denki, wan kiin faya koti komoto a tapu, kon kai lontu en hii sikin.
eng_text: And as he journeyed, he came near Damascus: and suddenly there shined round about him a light from heaven:

djk_text: Wanten a kai a doti, da ai yee wan Tongo e taki: “Sawlesi! Sawlesi! Saide yu mu e lon du ogii ala suku fu pina mi so?”
eng_text: And he fell to the earth, and heard a voice saying unto him, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?

djk_text: Namo a piki taki: “Masaa! Sama a yu?” Namo a piki en taki: “Mi na Jesesi di baka yu e lon fu pina so!”
eng_text: And he said, Who art thou, Lord? And the Lord said, I am Jesus whom thou persecutest: it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks.

djk_text: A Tongo soi ete taki: “Ma opo go doo Damasikosi Foto. Sama de anda fu taigi yu san fu du.”
eng_text: And he trembling and astonished said, Lord, what wilt thou have me to do? And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the city, and it shall be told thee what thou must do.

djk_text: A hii ten de, da den man di anga en be de a waka tapu dyombo te, den de diin. Bika den e yee a Tongo e taki, ma den nái si a sama di e taki.
eng_text: And the men which journeyed with him stood speechless, hearing a voice, but seeing no man.

djk_text: Namo Sawlesi opo taampu, ma a nái si sani moo. Ne den taawan oli en na ana tyai go doo Damasikosi Foto.
eng_text: And Saul arose from the earth; and when his eyes were opened, he saw no man: but they led him by the hand, and brought him into Damascus.

djk_text: Dii dei langa a tan sondee si, sondee nyan anga ala sondee diingi wataa.
eng_text: And he was three days without sight, and neither did eat nor drink.

djk_text: Da wan biibiwan den e kai Ananiyasi be e tan a Damasikosi Foto. Masaa go meke ai si jeje sani enke ai deen so, da ai yee en tongo e taki: “Ananiyasi!” A piki taki: “Iya, Masaa.”
eng_text: And there was a certain disciple at Damascus, named Ananias; and to him said the Lord in a vision, Ananias. And he said, Behold, I am here, Lord.

djk_text: Masaa taki: “Go na a letiopu sitaati di kaasi abaa a foto ya. Na a osu fu a man den e kai Judasi i mu go akisi fu a man den e kai Sawlesi, fu Taasisi Foto. Nownow ya, a de ape e begi.”
eng_text: And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the street which is called Straight, and inquire in the house of Judas for one called Saul, of Tarsus: for, behold, he prayeth,

djk_text: Soseefi Masaa taki go doo taki: “Mi e soi enseefi jeje sani nownow ya enke ai deen. Da ai si yu Ananiyasi e waka kon na a osu pe a de, ne yu poti ana begi gi en meke ai si sani baka.”
eng_text: And hath seen in a vision a man named Ananias coming in, and putting his hand on him, that he might receive his sight.

djk_text: Namo Ananiyasi piki en taki: “Masaa! Fa i sa sende mi go na a man de? Mi yee taki, ai du ogii anga sama fi yu a Jelusalem Foto!
eng_text: Then Ananias answered, Lord, I have heard by many of this man, how much evil he hath done to thy saints at Jerusalem:

djk_text: A kon fi en ya na fu kisi ibii sama di teke biibi fu kai yu nen. Bika a Jelusalem Foto anda pampila naki gi en makiti fu kon du dati ya.”
eng_text: And here he hath authority from the chief priests to bind all that call on thy name.

djk_text: Namo Masaa piki taki: “Na mi e sende yu go ne en! Bika mi teke enseefi toon sama fu mi. Da a toon wooko sani fu mi, fu du mi wooko. Bika a o waka tyai mi nen paati, fu soi Dyusama, soseefi taa foluku tu. Soseefi go doo kownu kownu fu goontapu.
eng_text: But the Lord said unto him, Go thy way: for he is a chosen vessel unto me, to bear my name before the Gentiles, and kings, and the children of Israel:

djk_text: Bika mi o soi en san wani taki tyotyo fu mi nen di a o paati doo moo anga moo sama, fu yee fu mi.”
eng_text: For I will shew him how great things he must suffer for my name's sake.

djk_text: We, ne Ananiyasi komoto wanten go na a osu pe Sawlesi de. Ne a poti ana a Sawlesi ede taki: “Baala Sawlesi! Na Masaa Jesesi soi enseefi a yu na a pasi di waka doo ya. Ne a sende mi, fu kon meke yu si baka. Soseefi fu kon meke a Apaiti Jeje lai yu hii libi.”
eng_text: And Ananias went his way, and entered into the house; and putting his hands on him said, Brother Saul, the Lord, even Jesus, that appeared unto thee in the way as thou camest, hath sent me, that thou mightest receive thy sight, and be filled with the Holy Ghost.

djk_text: Fa i si Ananiyasi taki so, Sawlesi si baka wanten. A fii enke na fisi buba be tapu en ain komoto kai. Bakadati, ne a opo go meke den dopu en.
eng_text: And immediately there fell from his eyes as it had been scales: and he received sight forthwith, and arose, and was baptized.

djk_text: Ne a nyan te en bee simpan, en hii sikin kon taanga baka. Ne Sawlesi tan wantu dei ete anga den biibiwan fu Damasikosi Foto ape.
eng_text: And when he had received meat, he was strengthened. Then was Saul certain days with the disciples which were at Damascus.

djk_text: Da ai go waka makandii anga den biibiwan a den Dyu keliki fu anda. Da ai bali a bosikopu taki: “Fu tuu! Jesesi na a Manpikin fu Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: And straightway he preached Christ in the synagogues, that he is the Son of God.

djk_text: Namo den sama di yee dati foondoo taki: “A man di be de a Jelusalem Foto e feti anga biibi. A be kon ya, fu kisi ibii biibiwan di e kai Masaa Jesesi nen, tyai go gi fu Dyu keliki anda, fu sitaafu. Ma fa a du daai e taki taa fasi so?”
eng_text: But all that heard him were amazed, and said; Is not this he that destroyed them which called on this name in Jerusalem, and came hither for that intent, that he might bring them bound unto the chief priests?

djk_text: We, na bigin fu taki taa fasi Sawlesi be de. Bika na moo anga moo ai tyai sani kon a fesi, fu soi fa Jesesi na a Kelestesi di sende kon, fu tii ala sani. Dyusama á be de fu taampu ne en fesi sitee anga san ai taki.
eng_text: But Saul increased the more in strength, and confounded the Jews which dwelt at Damascus, proving that this is very Christ.

djk_text: Ma baka wan pisiten, ne den Dyusama fiti mofu fu kisi en kii.
eng_text: And after that many days were fulfilled, the Jews took counsel to kill him:

djk_text: Ma a kisi wan pingi fu dati. Ná sipowtu lulu fu kisi en kii den sete dei anga neti na ala den pasi mofu fu waka kon a ini a foto.
eng_text: But their laying await was known of Saul. And they watched the gates day and night to kill him.

djk_text: Namo den taa biibiwan kibii en puu a ini a foto. Den tei tetei a wan gaan bakisi, saka en puu a wan fensee fu a hei siton di sikotu lontu a hii foto ya.
eng_text: Then the disciples took him by night, and let him down by the wall in a basket.

djk_text: Namo a gwe te go doo Jelusalem Foto. Ne a go suku fu libi anga ala wooko makandii anga den biibiwan de. Ma den e wai a pasi gi en. Den e pantan fu biibi taki, a toon biibiwan.
eng_text: And when Saul was come to Jerusalem, he assayed to join himself to the disciples: but they were all afraid of him, and believed not that he was a disciple.

djk_text: Ma Balnabasi luku a toli bun, ne a teke en tyai go miti den apaiti bosikopuman. Ne a soi ala fa Sawlesi si Masaa Jesesi, taki mofu mofu anga en a Damasikosi Pasi. Fa Sawlesi á be feele fu taampu a lanti fesi anda, taki sani a ini a nen fu Jesesi.
eng_text: But Barnabas took him, and brought him to the apostles, and declared unto them how he had seen the Lord in the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how he had preached boldly at Damascus in the name of Jesus.

djk_text: Namo den teke Sawlesi wanten fu wooko a den mindii. Den sanga waka wooko lontu hii Jelusalem Foto makandii.
eng_text: And he was with them coming in and going out at Jerusalem.

djk_text: Sondee feele ai taampu e taki sani a ini a nen fu Masaa. Da Dyusama di e taki Giiki Tongo ape teke fu sitee anga en. Da ai soi den fa a sani de seefi. Namo den fiti mofu fu kii en puu.
eng_text: And he spake boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus, and disputed against the Grecians: but they went about to slay him.

djk_text: Ma biibiwan ape kisi wan pingi fu dati. Ne den meke moiti puu en de tyai gwe a wan taa pisiwataa den e kai Sesaleya. Den poti en anda a boto baka seefi tyai gwe moo faawe abaa ze gwe a Taasisi Foto a wan taa kondee.
eng_text: Which when the brethren knew, they brought him down to Caesarea, and sent him forth to Tarsus.

djk_text: A ten de, da sani á be taanga so moo gi biibiwan fu Judeja, Galileya anga Samaliya pisiwataa. Den biibi e moo taanga. Den e lesipeki Masaa Gadu. A Apaiti Jeje e wooko, fu meke den kulu e goo moo anga moo tu.
eng_text: Then had the churches rest throughout all Judaea and Galilee and Samaria, and were edified; and walking in the fear of the Lord, and in the comfort of the Holy Ghost, were multiplied.

djk_text: A ten ya, Peitilisi e waka lontu somen taa peesi anga a bosikopu fu Masaa Gadu. A go doo biibiwan na a foto den e kai Lida.
eng_text: And it came to pass, as Peter passed throughout all quarters, he came down also to the saints which dwelt at Lydda.

djk_text: Ne a go si wan lanman den e kai Eneya ape. Aitin yali langa a didon sondee waka.
eng_text: And there he found a certain man named Aeneas, which had kept his bed eight years, and was sick of the palsy.

djk_text: Namo Peitilisi taigi en taki: “Eneya! Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi betee yu tide. Opo taampu! I seefi lolo i sibi peesi.” Ne Eneya opo waka letiso!
eng_text: And Peter said unto him, Aeneas, Jesus Christ maketh thee whole: arise, and make thy bed. And he arose immediately.

djk_text: Namo sama komoto a Lida Foto doo a pisiwataa fu Salon si a hii toli ya. Ne den daai dini Masaa de wanten.
eng_text: And all that dwelt at Lydda and Saron saw him, and turned to the Lord.

djk_text: Da boiti Lida Foto, da Jopa Foto be de anda tu. Wan biibi uman be de ape den e kai Tabita. Dati na Dolkasi a ini Giiki Tongo. A be e du somen bun gi taawan doo mofinawan tu.
eng_text: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which by interpretation is called Dorcas: this woman was full of good works and almsdeeds which she did.

djk_text: We, ne a uman ya siki a Jopa Foto di Peitilisi de a Lida Foto. Namo a dede te wasi seeka poti a wan kambaa a wan tapu sodoo.
eng_text: And it came to pass in those days, that she was sick, and died: whom when they had washed, they laid her in an upper chamber.

djk_text: Lida Foto á be faawe fu Jopa Foto. Ne biibiwan a Jopa Foto yee taki, Peitilisi de ape. Ne den sende tu manengee go piki en taki, Tabita dede a Jopa Foto. Meke a kon a den sondee daai daai.
eng_text: And forasmuch as Lydda was nigh to Joppa, and the disciples had heard that Peter was there, they sent unto him two men, desiring him that he would not delay to come to them.

djk_text: Namo Peitilisi seeka gwe anga den. Fa a doo, den tyai en go a tapu sodoo na a dede. Wan duupu uman di man dede fika a ganda, be de ape. Tabita be lobi yeepi den a sani. Den kon a Peitilisi anga ala kee e soi en koosi di Tabita be lobi meke gi den.
eng_text: Then Peter arose and went with them. When he was come, they brought him into the upper chamber: and all the widows stood by him weeping, and shewing the coats and garments which Dorcas made, while she was with them.

djk_text: Namo Peitilisi sende den gwe a doo. Ne a saka kini begi a ini a kambaa. Bakadati, ne a daai taigi a dede taki: “Tabita! Opo!” Namo Tabita opo ain luku Peitilisi anga ala opo sidon.
eng_text: But Peter put them all forth, and kneeled down, and prayed; and turning him to the body said, Tabitha, arise. And she opened her eyes: and when she saw Peter, she sat up.

djk_text: Ne Peitilisi langa ana gi en, hali en opo taampu. Ne a kai den uman di be go a doose kon, soseefi taa biibiwan fu Masaa Gadu de. Den kon luku a libilibi Tabita di be dede.
eng_text: And he gave her his hand, and lifted her up, and when he had called the saints and widows, presented her alive.

djk_text: A hii Jopa Foto yee a toli, ne somen sama daai teke fu biibi Masaa Jesesi de.
eng_text: And it was known throughout all Joppa; and many believed in the Lord.

djk_text: Ma Peitilisi á komoto a Jopa Foto wanten baka. A tan wantu dei moo anga den biibiwan ape na a osu fu Simon. Dati e dee meti buba, fu teke meke sani enke kaw buba.
eng_text: And it came to pass, that he tarried many days in Joppa with one Simon a tanner.

djk_text: Da wan suudati be de na a pisiwataa fu Sesaleya, den e kai Koneilisi. Na wan Italiya ofisii di abi wan ondoo suudati ne en ondoo.
eng_text: There was a certain man in Caesarea called Cornelius, a centurion of the band called the Italian band,

djk_text: Ma a be lobi Masaa Gadu anga ala lesipeki. Ala sama a ini en osu seefi tu. A be e tyai yeepi gi mofinawan a ini a Dyu foluku naamo seefi. Soseefi a be e begi dei fu dei tu.
eng_text: A devout man, and one that feared God with all his house, which gave much alms to the people, and prayed to God alway.

djk_text: Wan dei, a de ne en osu dii yuu bakadina so. Ne ai si jeje sani enke ai deen so. Wan Basiya fu Masaa Gadu Kondee waka libilibi kon a ini en osu, te doo ne en fesi taigi en taki: “Koneilisi!”
eng_text: He saw in a vision evidently about the ninth hour of the day an angel of God coming in to him, and saying unto him, Cornelius.

djk_text: Namo a pii ain e luku a Masaa Gadu Kondee Basiya, anga ala feele anga dansi sikin. Namo a taki: “Mi Masaa! San i wani anga mi?” Namo a Basiya taki: “Na den begi di i e begi anga ala den bun di i e gi mofinawan. Ne ala dati piisii Masaa Gadu, fu denki yu!
eng_text: And when he looked on him, he was afraid, and said, What is it, Lord? And he said unto him, Thy prayers and thine alms are come up for a memorial before God.

djk_text: Da a wani yu sende wantu wookoman fi yu go a Jopa Foto go kai Simon di den e kai Peitilisi tu.
eng_text: And now send men to Joppa, and call for one Simon, whose surname is Peter:

djk_text: Ai tan na a osu fu wan man den e kai Simon anda tu. Dati e dee meti buba, fu teke meke sani enke kaw buba. En osu de koosube sikin liba fu a ze.”
eng_text: He lodgeth with one Simon a tanner, whose house is by the sea side: he shall tell thee what thou oughtest to do.

djk_text: Fa i si a Masaa Gadu Kondee Basiya gwe, Koneilisi kai tu wookoman kon, makandii anga wan suudati di a sabi taki, lobi Masaa Gadu. Na wan di ai fitoow, fu poti oli wakiti gi enseefi.
eng_text: And when the angel which spake unto Cornelius was departed, he called two of his household servants, and a devout soldier of them that waited on him continually;

djk_text: Namo a taigi den dii man ya, ala san a Masaa Gadu Kondee Basiya kon sende en. Bakadati, ne a sende den gwe a Jopa Foto a Peitilisi.
eng_text: And when he had declared all these things unto them, he sent them to Joppa.

djk_text: Wan dei baka dati, ne den de a pasi. Den be doo koosube fu Jopa Foto kaba. A ten de Peitilisi de a Jopa Foto e subi go a tapu sodoo fu a osu anda, fu go begi na a mindii dei twalufu yuu de.
eng_text: On the morrow, as they went on their journey, and drew nigh unto the city, Peter went up upon the housetop to pray about the sixth hour:

djk_text: Ma angii be e kii en, ne a piki den sama a ini a osu dati. Namo den e seeka sani gi en fu nyan. Ne a go sidon a tapu anda e wakiti den. Te fu a denki, ne ai si jeje sani enke ai deen.
eng_text: And he became very hungry, and would have eaten: but while they made ready, he fell into a trance,

djk_text: Tapu anda wai opo, ne wan sani komoto a ini anda e kon a doti. Wan sani enke wan gaan duku tei oli a den fo kanti fi en.
eng_text: And saw heaven opened, and a certain vessel descending unto him, as it had been a great sheet knit at the four corners, and let down to the earth:

djk_text: A kon doo te a Peitilisi fesi, ne ai si sowtu a sowtu fo futu meti, sowtu a sowtu meti di e hali anga bee a doti, sowtu a sowtu foo di e fee a tapu.
eng_text: Wherein were all manner of fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.

djk_text: Namo a yee wan Tongo e taigi en taki: “Peitilisi! Opo taampu! I sa nyan ala sani yu e si de. Kii nyan san i wani!”
eng_text: And there came a voice to him, Rise, Peter; kill, and eat.

djk_text: Ma Peitilisi piki baka taki: “Kweti, Masaa! Enke Dyusama, noiti mi nyan wanten san Dyuweiti taki, á de fiti. Noiti mi nyan san á de kiin fasi gi Dyusama!”
eng_text: But Peter said, Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten any thing that is common or unclean.

djk_text: Namo a Tongo piki di fu tu leisi taki: “Mi enke Masaa Gadu ya sende yu taki, nownow den fiti fi yu enke Dyusama nyan. Da yu á mu piki taki, den á de kiin fasi gi yu enke Dyusama.”
eng_text: And the voice spake unto him again the second time, What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.

djk_text: We, na te dii leisi seefi a taigi Peitilisi a seefi sani ya. Namo wantoon so, Peitilisi si a duku anga den meti e gwe a tapu baka, te doo pe a be komoto a tapu anda.
eng_text: This was done thrice: and the vessel was received up again into heaven.

djk_text: Namo Peitilisi sidon e wegi san a si de. A leti ape a de, ne den man di Koneilisi be sende kon doo de. Den be akisi a ini a foto, ne sama soi den a osu fu Simon. Ne den kon doo na a doo mofu fi en.
eng_text: Now while Peter doubted in himself what this vision which he had seen should mean, behold, the men which were sent from Cornelius had made inquiry for Simon's house, and stood before the gate,

djk_text: Namo den bali akisi efu Simon di den e kai Peitilisi de ape.
eng_text: And called, and asked whether Simon, which was surnamed Peter, were lodged there.

djk_text: A ten de Peitilisi de na a tapu osu ete e wegi san a be si. Namo a Apaiti Jeje piki en taki: “Peitilisi! Dii man kon suku yu.
eng_text: While Peter thought on the vision, the Spirit said unto him, Behold, three men seek thee.

djk_text: Saka go a den, bika den kon kai yu fu go anga den a pe den komoto. Na foluku di á de Dyusama, ma go anga den sondee fu meke sani. Bika na mi sende den kon kai yu.”
eng_text: Arise therefore, and get thee down, and go with them, doubting nothing: for I have sent them.

djk_text: Namo Peitilisi saka wanten go taigi den man taki: “U luku mi di u e suku ya! San u wani?”
eng_text: Then Peter went down to the men which were sent unto him from Cornelius; and said, Behold, I am he whom ye seek: what is the cause wherefore ye are come?

djk_text: Ne den taigi en taki: “U komoto a wan man den e kai Koneilisi, wan ofisii fu suudati. A de wan letiopu man, di e lesipeki a Gadu fu Dyusama. Ala Dyusama sabi anda fa ai libi bun anga Dyusama. Masaa Gadu sende wan apaiti Masaa Gadu Kondee Basiya go taigi en, fu sende kai yu, fu aliki ala san yu o taigi en.”
eng_text: And they said, Cornelius the centurion, a just man, and one that feareth God, and of good report among all the nation of the Jews, was warned from God by an holy angel to send for thee into his house, and to hear words of thee.

djk_text: Namo Peitilisi aliki, ne a taki: “A bun!” Ne a kai den man kon a ini osu, gi den siibi peesi. Taa dei, ne a opo gwe anga den. Wantu biibi man fu Jopa Foto go anga den tu.
eng_text: Then called he them in, and lodged them. And on the morrow Peter went away with them, and certain brethren from Joppa accompanied him.

djk_text: A taa dei fu dati, ne en anga den go doo Sesaleya Foto. Koneilisi be seeka fu a kon fi en. A kai ala en famii poti sidon makandii anga ala en bun mati fi en.
eng_text: And the morrow after they entered into Caesarea. And Cornelius waited for them, and had called together his kinsmen and near friends.

djk_text: Fa i si Peitilisi de fu doo go a ini a osu, Koneilisi lon kon miti en a doose. A saka anga kini ne en fesi e gi en gaandi.
eng_text: And as Peter was coming in, Cornelius met him, and fell down at his feet, and worshipped him.

djk_text: Ma Peitilisi hali en opo taampu taki: “Opo taampu! Mi á de wan sani moo yu. Bika mi anga yu na libisama anga libisama!”
eng_text: But Peter took him up, saying, Stand up; I myself also am a man.

djk_text: Na so den e taki, den doo go a ini osu. Namo, na onmen sama Peitilisi go si e wakiti de.
eng_text: And as he talked with him, he went in, and found many that were come together.

djk_text: Ne a gi odi anga ala taki: “U sabi fa Dyuweiti e tapu Dyusama fu mosoo anga taa foluku. Mi dati kon ya, fu di Masaa Gadu seefi soi mi taki, mi á mu si moo enke u á de kiin fasi. Mi á mu si moo enke u á de fiti.
eng_text: And he said unto them, Ye know how that it is an unlawful thing for a man that is a Jew to keep company, or come unto one of another nation; but God hath shewed me that I should not call any man common or unclean.

djk_text: Na dati meke di den kon kai mi, mi á meke sani. Da mi kon ya kaba, fu sabi saide u sende kai mi.”
eng_text: Therefore came I unto you without gainsaying, as soon as I was sent for: I ask therefore for what intent ye have sent for me?

djk_text: Namo Koneilisi piki taki: “Tide na di fu fo dei, da a be de dii yuu bakadina enke nownow. Mi be de a osu e begi. Te fu mi denki, ne wan man wei weti koosi taampu a mi fesi.
eng_text: And Cornelius said, Four days ago I was fasting until this hour; and at the ninth hour I prayed in my house, and, behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing,

djk_text: A taigi mi taki: ‘Koneilisi! Na den begi di i e begi Masaa Gadu, soseefi den bun di yu e gi mofinawan. Ne a sende mi kon taigi yu taki, ala dati piisii en fu denki yu.
eng_text: And said, Cornelius, thy prayer is heard, and thine alms are had in remembrance in the sight of God.

djk_text: A wani yu sende sama go a Jopa Foto go kai Simon di den e kai Peitilisi tu. Ai tan na a osu fu wan man den e kai Simon anda tu. Dati e dee meti buba, fu teke meke sani enke kaw buba. En osu de a sikin liba fu a ze.’
eng_text: Send therefore to Joppa, and call hither Simon, whose surname is Peter; he is lodged in the house of one Simon a tanner by the sea side: who, when he cometh, shall speak unto thee.

djk_text: We, ne mi sende sama wanten kon kai yu. Da a bun fa i kon. U de ya a Masaa Gadu fesi ya, fu aliki ala san a gi yu, fu taigi wi.”
eng_text: Immediately therefore I sent to thee; and thou hast well done that thou art come. Now therefore are we all here present before God, to hear all things that are commanded thee of God.

djk_text: We, ne Peitilisi piki taki: “Mi kon e si tuu taki, sama á de wan sani moo taawan gi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Then Peter opened his mouth, and said, Of a truth I perceive that God is no respecter of persons:

djk_text: Ibii foluku sama, ma yu e dini en anga ala wooko leti fasi gi en, da dati e switi en ati kaba.
eng_text: But in every nation he that feareth him, and worketh righteousness, is accepted with him.

djk_text: Masaa Gadu seefi mofu paamisi wi Dyusama dati a Dyu Kondee. Ne u sabi taki, ibii libisama ati poi kon de switi anga Masaa Gadu. Jesesi Kelestesi du a wooko fu tyai a yeepi de. A man de poti fu wooko enke Masaa gi ibiiwan.
eng_text: The word which God sent unto the children of Israel, preaching peace by Jesus Christ: (he is Lord of all:)

djk_text: U ala ya be yee a toli fi en di be pasa a Dyu Kondee. A be bigin wooko na a pisiwataa fu Galileya, baka fu a ten di Johanisi be e dopu sama.
eng_text: That word, I say, ye know, which was published throughout all Judaea, and began from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;

djk_text: Dati na Jesesi di goo a Nasaleti Foto. Masaa Gadu meke en Apaiti Jeje teke en hii libi, fu gi en kaakiti fu wooko lontu Dyu Kondee e du bun. A tyai yeepi puu sama a ini dwengi fu didibii. Da ai deesi den tu.
eng_text: How God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Ghost and with power: who went about doing good, and healing all that were oppressed of the devil; for God was with him.
