A ten de, da weiti á be sende kon anga Mosesi ete. Dati e soi fa a á paamisi Abalaham sani, fu di ai wooko anga weiti. Na biibi, meke a be seeka Abalaham kon toon bun sama gi enseefi.
eng_text: For the promise, that he should be the heir of the world, was not to Abraham, or to his seed, through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.

djk_text: Na a biibi namo tyai gaan bun gi en a Masaa Gadu so. Ma fu fende bun mu kon toon, fu wooko anga weiti, da a hii paamisi di Masaa Gadu gi, fu wooko anga biibi sa toon wisiwasi sani.
eng_text: For if they which are of the law be heirs, faith is made void, and the promise made of none effect:

djk_text: Ma sani ná o waka bun gi sama di sa suku fu wooko anga weiti. Bika na boon ati dati sa gi Masaa Gadu taki, den á poi wooko anga weiti, sondee fu booko den. Bika efu sama á mu booko weiti, da weiti á be mu de a goontapu.
eng_text: Because the law worketh wrath: for where no law is, there is no transgression.

djk_text: Da sama á be o poi fende san Masaa Gadu paamisi. Bika ala sama abi taanga yesi gi den weiti fi en. Ma biibi, meke Abalaham anga paansu sama di de bakaten pikin fi en fende dati. Na gaan bun ati fasi namo, di Masaa Gadu teke luku den so. Bika a á wani wan enkii sama misi san a paamisi. Da a ná Dyusama namo, di ana a poti weiti na paansu sama fu Abalaham. Ma en na a Tata fu ala sama di e wooko anga biibi enke enseefi.
eng_text: Therefore it is of faith, that it might be by grace; to the end the promise might be sure to all the seed; not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham; who is the father of us all,

djk_text: Bika en Buku sikiifi, fa a taigi Abalaham taki: “Mi Masaa Gadu ya e kai yu tata, fu somen taa foluku.” Ala dati, na wi di e wooko anga biibi enke Abalaham. Bika enseefi be e biibi enke fa wi e biibi taki, Masaa Gadu poi weki dede. Soseefi a be e si taki, wowtu di Masaa Gadu taki, poi meke sani di á be de, kon de.
eng_text: (As it is written, I have made thee a father of many nations,) before him whom he believed, even God, who quickeneth the dead, and calleth those things which be not as though they were.

djk_text: Soseefi Abalaham be tan naamo anga a denki taki, Masaa Gadu kai en a tata fu somen taa foluku. Da dati musu pasa so. A á luku ne enseefi, bika, da a be sa lasi ati. Ne Masaa Gadu meke a toon a dda fu somen taa foluku tuu, enke fa a paamisi en taki: “Abalaham! A paansu sama di de o de bakaten pikin fi yu, o ipi pasa sitali di de a tapu anda.”
eng_text: Who against hope believed in hope, that he might become the father of many nations; according to that which was spoken, So shall thy seed be.

djk_text: Namo Abalaham biibi dati! Ma sani be lontu en, di be sa meke a lasi ati. A be de sondee pikin ete. A be gaandi pasa a yali fu meke pikin kaba. Bika ete wan yali, da a be tapu wan ondoo yali. En uman Sala seefi yali be gaandi pasa, fu oli bee, lasitan fu meke pikin.
eng_text: And being not weak in faith, he considered not his own body now dead, when he was about an hundred years old, neither yet the deadness of Sara's womb:

djk_text: Ma ala san lontu Abalaham á be poi daai en pakisei. A be e biibi go doo san Masaa Gadu be paamisi en taki, a poi gi en wan pikin, fu meke wan paansu sama di o toon wan gaanbigi lo sama. Pe fu lasi ati, na moo taanga, en biibi e taanga. Na so a hei Masaa Gadu, fu soi goontapu taki, Masaa Gadu bigi.
eng_text: He staggered not at the promise of God through unbelief; but was strong in faith, giving glory to God;

djk_text: Pikinso pantan á be de ne en seefi taki, Masaa Gadu o paamisi en wan sani, da a o taanga gi Masaa Gadu, fu du.
eng_text: And being fully persuaded that, what he had promised, he was able also to perform.

djk_text: Namo Masaa Gadu Buku sikiifi fu dati taki: “Bika Abalaham biibi mi Masaa Gadu ya, ne mi seeka en kon toon bun sama gi mi.”
eng_text: And therefore it was imputed to him for righteousness.

djk_text: A sani de sikiifi gi wi di e biibi nownow tu. Bika na so Masaa Gadu sa seeka wi seefi kon toon bun sama gi enseefi. Da dati á sikiifi namo, fu soi fa Abalaham enke a moo gaandi avo fu Dyusama bigi. Kweti!
eng_text: Now it was not written for his sake alone, that it was imputed to him;

djk_text: Ma a sikiifi fu soi fa Masaa Gadu sa seeka wiseefi kon de bun sama gi enseefi. Ma na te u biibi en, di weki wi Masaa Jesesi puu a dede.
eng_text: But for us also, to whom it shall be imputed, if we believe on him that raised up Jesus our Lord from the dead;

djk_text: Bika na Masaa Gadu seefi be wani fika en, meke sama kii en. Da dati sa de a paiman, fu wasi ala wi takuudu anga ogii puu ne en fesi. Bakadati, ne a weki en kon a libi ya baka, fu seeka wi toon bun sama gi enseefi.
eng_text: Who was delivered for our offences, and was raised again for our justification.

djk_text: Na so biibi wi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi, meke u seeka kon toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu. Ne u anga en kon de switi makandii.
eng_text: Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ:

djk_text: A biibi ya, meke u go doo te a Masaa Gadu fesi, fu si fa a teke gaan bun ati fasi, luku wi. U e bali piisii, te u denki den dyendee di a poti a tapu anda, fu gi u bakaten makandii anga enseefi.
eng_text: By whom also we have access by faith into this grace wherein we stand, and rejoice in hope of the glory of God.

djk_text: Soseefi u e bali piisii, te u e fende banowtu, fu a biibi ede. Bika u sabi fa dati sa meke Masaa Gadu si, fa u e tei ati fu oli doo.
eng_text: And not only so, but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation worketh patience;

djk_text: Da te u abi tei ati fu oli doo, da dati sa meke en ati switi a wi taki, u poi pasa tesi. Da dati o meke u de biibisama, di moo poi luku fu fende san a paamisi wi.
eng_text: And patience, experience; and experience, hope:

djk_text: Da fu luku fu fende san a paamisi wi, dati ná o meke u naki sen! Bika a soi wi kaba, fa a lobi wi dipi, di a gi wi en Apaiti Jeje. Ne dati tyai lobi kon poti a ini wi ati.
eng_text: And hope maketh not ashamed; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us.

djk_text: We, a lobi wi wan gaan dipi fasi taki, na a ten di yeepi á be de gi wi. Da wi be de gaan takuuduman ete, di toku, a sende Kelestesi kon teke dede yeepi wi, di en yuu doo.
eng_text: For when we were yet without strength, in due time Christ died for the ungodly.

djk_text: En lobi fu wi dipi! Bika a á makiliki fu teke dede gi wan taawan, winsi na wan letiopu sama seefi. Ma fu a sama bun fasi ede, meke kande ete i be sa teke dede gi en.
eng_text: For scarcely for a righteous man will one die: yet peradventure for a good man some would even dare to die.

djk_text: Ma a dipi lobi fu Masaa Gadu dati taki, u be de takuuduman, anga ala ogii ete, di a meke Kelestesi kon teke dede gi u.
eng_text: But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.

djk_text: Tuutuu Kelestesi teke dede, fu seeka wi kon toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu. En buulu lon enke paiman, di pai fu ala wi takuudu anga ogii. Na so a puu wi na a atiboon, di be de a wi tapu, fu Masaa Gadu sitaafu bakaten.
eng_text: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we shall be saved from wrath through him.

djk_text: Bika u be de feyanti fu Masaa Gadu ete, di a sende en Manpikin kon teke dede, seeka wi kon toon bun sama gi enseefi. Da u toon mati fi en now. We, da a seefi Manpikin fi en ya de a libi! Da a musu moo luku wi go doo a libi fu tego anga en.
eng_text: For if, when we were enemies, we were reconciled to God by the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we shall be saved by his life.

djk_text: We, da wi e piisii taki, u toon sama fu Masaa Gadu. Bika a sende Jesesi Kelestesi, di de wi Masaa kon, enke paiman di pai, meke u toon mati fi en.
eng_text: And not only so, but we also joy in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom we have now received the atonement.

djk_text: Da na leti enke fa wan man namo be tyai dede kon a hii goontapu. Bika ala sama waka ne en baka enke paansu sama, di de bakaten pikin fu pikin, fi en. Ne den de a ini a ogii fi en tu.
eng_text: Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned:

djk_text: Bika di dede bigin a goontapu, da Mosesi weiti á be kon ete. Da u á poi taki, na a taanga yesi fu weiti be e kii sama so.
eng_text: (For until the law sin was in the world: but sin is not imputed when there is no law.

djk_text: Namo, ne dede wooko enke gaan basi a sama tapu, komoto na a ten fu Adan kon doo a ten di Mosesi weiti kon. Da a dede de á komoto na a taanga yesi, fu den sama seefi gi weiti, enke fa Adan seefi be taanga yesi. Ne dati waka doo ala sama, fu soi fa a bun di mu kon bakaten seefi o waka, doo ala sama tu.
eng_text: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam to Moses, even over them that had not sinned after the similitude of Adam's transgression, who is the figure of him that was to come.

djk_text: Ma a fasi fu a man di tyai a gaan bun kon gi sama, kengi anga di fu a man di be tyai a poli kon. Bika ogii di awan be du be taanga, fu tyai poli gi somen sama. Ma a bun di Jesesi Kelestesi enke a taawan du moo taanga, fu meke Masaa Gadu teke gaan bun ati fasi luku somen sama baka.
eng_text: But not as the offence, so also is the free gift. For if through the offence of one many be dead, much more the grace of God, and the gift by grace, which is by one man, Jesus Christ, hath abounded unto many.

djk_text: Soseefi, da ogii fu awan, meke ala paansu bakaten pikin fi en, fende kaagi a Masaa Gadu, fu sitaafu. Ma a taawan di tyai a gaan bun, meke Masaa Gadu teke gaan bun ati fasi luku somen sama, wan letiopu fasi.
eng_text: And not as it was by one that sinned, so is the gift: for the judgment was by one to condemnation, but the free gift is of many offences unto justification.

djk_text: Bika wan kodo taanga yesi fu wan man, meke dede wooko enke gaan basi a somen sama tapu. Ma wan kodo bun wooko, fu a taa man, du wan moo taanga sani. Bika biibi na a gaan bun ati fasi, di Masaa Gadu teke luku sama, fu Jesesi Kelestesi ede. Da yu sa fende a gaan bun di e seeka sama kon bun gi Masaa Gadu. Soseefi a libi fu tego, makandii anga en, fu tii ala sani.
eng_text: For if by one man's offence death reigned by one; much more they which receive abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness shall reign in life by one, Jesus Christ.)

djk_text: Da meke u taki ala sani satu. Ala sama fende fowtu fu dede, fu wan kodo ogii di wan man namo du. Ma na sowan man namo du wan kodo bun, di puu fowtu fu ala sama, meke den sa fende libi.
eng_text: Therefore as by the offence of one judgment came upon all men to condemnation; even so by the righteousness of one the free gift came upon all men unto justification of life.

djk_text: Bika na wan man namo taanga yesi, meke somen taawan toon takuudu man. Ne a taa man teke Masaa Gadu taki, meke somen taawan seeka kon bun gi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: For as by one man's disobedience many were made sinners, so by the obedience of one shall many be made righteous.

djk_text: Ma weiti be de fanowdu fu taampu a mindii, fu soi sowtu ogii a disi ofu dati. Bika sama mu poi si fa ala ogii di den e du, moo anga moo, e taanga, fu wooko enke basi a den tapu. Da Masaa Gadu gaan bun ati fasi mu moo taanga, fu teke yeepi den.
eng_text: Moreover the law entered, that the offence might abound. But where sin abounded, grace did much more abound:

djk_text: Bika takuudu anga ogii e wooko taanga, fu tyai dede gi sama. Da Masaa Gadu wooko mu moo taanga, fu seeka den kon bun gi enseefi. Dati waka anga a gaan bun ati fasi namo, di a teke luku sama. Ne a meke den fende libi tego doo makandii anga enseefi. Na so a sende wi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi kon yeepi wi.
eng_text: That as sin hath reigned unto death, even so might grace reign through righteousness unto eternal life by Jesus Christ our Lord.

djk_text: Da u sa piki mi de taki, da a bun fu tan du ogii naamo. Da Masaa Gadu o moo fende pasi gi u paadon. Da en gaan bun ati fasi o moo bigi gi u tu.
eng_text: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?

djk_text: Ma kaba wanten anga a denki de! Bika a biibi fu wi taki, u sikin dede komoto a pe takuudu anga ogii e wooko a sama tapu. Da u sikin á de a goontapu moo, fu teke wooko takuu fasi.
eng_text: God forbid. How shall we, that are dead to sin, live any longer therein?

djk_text: Bika u ala sabi taki, di u teke dopu, da u mokisa dede anga Kelestesi Jesesi. Bika a dede fi en taki, na u seefi dede de tu.
eng_text: Know ye not, that so many of us as were baptized into Jesus Christ were baptized into his death?

djk_text: Di u dopu go a ondoo wataa, fu soi fa a beli, da na u seefi beli de tu. Ne u Tata, Masaa Gadu weki en makiti fasi kon wan nyun fasi a libi ya baka. Da na u seefi weki nyun fasi kon a libi de baka.
eng_text: Therefore we are buried with him by baptism into death: that like as Christ was raised up from the dead by the glory of the Father, even so we also should walk in newness of life.

djk_text: Bika sama di mokisa dede anga en, da a musu mokisa weki nyun fasi kon a libi anga en tu.
eng_text: For if we have been planted together in the likeness of his death, we shall be also in the likeness of his resurrection:

djk_text: Bika u sabi taki, den be sipikii en sikin kii a koloisi, da na useefi sikin anga ala a u takuu libi mokisa dede anga en de tu. Na so meke dati á poi wooko enke basi a u tapu moo.
eng_text: Knowing this, that our old man is crucified with him, that the body of sin might be destroyed, that henceforth we should not serve sin.

djk_text: Bika sama di dede, da a komoto a pe takuudu anga ogii e wooko enke basi a sama tapu.
eng_text: For he that is dead is freed from sin.

djk_text: Da a kon, u mokisa dede anga Kelestesi. Da u e fitoow taki, u mokisa weki nyun fasi kon a libi anga en tu.
eng_text: Now if we be dead with Christ, we believe that we shall also live with him:

djk_text: U sabi taki, Masaa Gadu weki Kelestesi kon a libi ya baka, fu noiti moo poi dede. Da dede noiti sa poi wooko enke basi ne en tapu.
eng_text: Knowing that Christ being raised from the dead dieth no more; death hath no more dominion over him.

djk_text: Bika di na a dede kaba, da en sikin komoto a pe takuudu anga ogii e wooko enke basi a sama tapu. Ne a weki kon nyun fasi a libi ya baka, fu libi, fu piisii Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: For in that he died, he died unto sin once: but in that he liveth, he liveth unto God.

djk_text: Na so biibiwan mu denki taki, denseefi sikin dede komoto a pe takuudu anga ogii e wooko enke basi a sama tapu. Ne den mokisa weki anga Kelestesi Jesesi, kon nyun fasi a libi ya baka, fu libi piisii Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Likewise reckon ye also yourselves to be dead indeed unto sin, but alive unto God through Jesus Christ our Lord.

djk_text: Da kaba meke takuudu anga ogii wooko enke gaan basi a yu sikin. Meke takuu losutu di fuu sama ati á poi tyai yu libi.
eng_text: Let not sin therefore reign in your mortal body, that ye should obey it in the lusts thereof.

djk_text: Ná teke wan enkii pisi fu a sikin enke libi enke wooko sani fu du ogii! Meke Masaa Gadu wooko enke basi a yu tapu. Bika u sikin dede kaba, ne a weki nyun fasi kon a libi ya baka. Da now, na wooko sani fu Masaa Gadu teke wooko, enke basi ne en tapu.
eng_text: Neither yield ye your members as instruments of unrighteousness unto sin: but yield yourselves unto God, as those that are alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness unto God.

djk_text: We, takuudu anga ogii á poi wooko enke basi a u tapu moo tu. Bika a ná weiti wooko a u tapu, fu meke u toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu. Ma na gaan bun ati fasi namo a teke luku u, fu du dati gi u.
eng_text: For sin shall not have dominion over you: for ye are not under the law, but under grace.

djk_text: Ma u sa piki mi de taki, Masaa Gadu puu weiti di be e tapu wi, fu kaba du ogii. Da pasi opo fu du ogii seefi! Bika a teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku u, fu gi u paadon. Ma kaba anga a denki de!
eng_text: What then? shall we sin, because we are not under the law, but under grace? God forbid.

djk_text: Bika u ala sabi taki, na san yu teke fu wooko a yu tapu, na dati a yu basi. Da fu takuudu anga ogii e wooko enke basi a yu tapu, da yu o naki paati Masaa Gadu tego. Ma fu Masaa Gadu e wooko enke basi a yu tapu, da yu o toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Know ye not, that to whom ye yield yourselves servants to obey, his servants ye are to whom ye obey; whether of sin unto death, or of obedience unto righteousness?

djk_text: We, meke u gi Masaa Gadu daa seefi! Takuudu anga ogii be e wooko enke basi a yu de seefi tapu, fu du. Ma i poti hii ati e teke Masaa Gadu leli, di paati doo yu de.
eng_text: But God be thanked, that ye were the servants of sin, but ye have obeyed from the heart that form of doctrine which was delivered you.

djk_text: Namo a puu yu na a katibo fu takuudu anga ogii. Ne a seeka yu kon wooko leti fasi gi enseefi.
eng_text: Being then made free from sin, ye became the servants of righteousness.

djk_text: A toli ya dipi gi libisama! Da u o taki en libisama fasi taki, i be e poti i sikin e du poli sani naamo, di e booko Masaa Gadu weiti. Ma now, da poti i sikin fu wooko leti fasi gi Masaa Gadu, meke a kon de apaiti fasi gi en.
eng_text: I speak after the manner of men because of the infirmity of your flesh: for as ye have yielded your members servants to uncleanness and to iniquity unto iniquity; even so now yield your members servants to righteousness unto holiness.

djk_text: Bika di takuudu anga ogii be e wooko enke basi a yu tapu, da denki á be de a yu, fu letiopu fasi mu wooko enke basi a yu tapu.
eng_text: For when ye were the servants of sin, ye were free from righteousness.

djk_text: Da san be de fu fende a ini yu libi, na soso sani di e gi u sen nownow, a Masaa Gadu fesi. Paiman fu dati be o de taki, Masaa Gadu yaki yu puu ne en fesi tego.
eng_text: What fruit had ye then in those things whereof ye are now ashamed? for the end of those things is death.

djk_text: Ma fa a de, da a puu yu komoto na a katibo fu takuudu anga ogii de. Moomoo seefi, ai wooko enke basi a yu tapu, meke yu libi de apaiti fasi. Da dati sa tyai yu go doo libi makandii anga en tego.
eng_text: But now being made free from sin, and become servants to God, ye have your fruit unto holiness, and the end everlasting life.

djk_text: Bika paiman di takuudu anga ogii e tyai, dati na paati anga Masaa Gadu tego. Ma Masaa Gadu gi wi wan gaan bun, di a teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku wi. Ne a meke wi mokisa libi tego anga Kelestesi Jesesi, di de wi Masaa.
eng_text: For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

djk_text: Mi lobi biibiwan! U di mi e sikiifi ya, u sabi weiti toli bunbun. Da u sabi fa dati e wooko a sama tapu, ma na solanga a sama de a libi.
eng_text: Know ye not, brethren, (for I speak to them that know the law,) how that the law hath dominion over a man as long as he liveth?

djk_text: Enke wan weiti di taki, a hii libi fu wan uman, da a tei mokisa anga a man, di de en masaa. Na dede fu a man namo sa booko dati, fu den sa koti paati.
eng_text: For the woman which hath an husband is bound by the law to her husband so long as he liveth; but if the husband be dead, she is loosed from the law of her husband.

djk_text: Boiti dede fi en man, ma a go teke nyun man, enke en masaa, da na waka libi. Na dede fu a man namo sa paati den, fu komoto na a weiti ya ondoo, fu teke nyun man, enke en masaa, fu sama á sa poi taki, na waka libi.
eng_text: So then if, while her husband liveth, she be married to another man, she shall be called an adulteress: but if her husband be dead, she is free from that law; so that she is no adulteress, though she be married to another man.

djk_text: Lobi biibiwan! Na so meke Masaa Gadu meke biibiwan mokisa dede anga Kelestesi, fu paati wi anga weiti, di de Masaa a wi tapu. Da u sa teke Awan di weki kon a libi ya baka, enke u nyun Masaa. Da bun sa de fu fende a wi libi, fu piisii Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Wherefore, my brethren, ye also are become dead to the law by the body of Christ; that ye should be married to another, even to him who is raised from the dead, that we should bring forth fruit unto God.

djk_text: Bika libisama fasi, da ogii be e wooko enke basi a ini wi, fu du san e piisii u seefi ati namo. Ma weiti e bali u naamo na a libi de, ma a á be poi tapu wi. Dati e puu a taanga di takuudu anga ogii abi a ini wi, kon a kiin. Da na libi fu tyai paati gi wi anga Masaa Gadu tego.
eng_text: For when we were in the flesh, the motions of sins, which were by the law, did work in our members to bring forth fruit unto death.

djk_text: Ma now, da Masaa Gadu meke u dede komoto a pe weiti be e wooko enke basi a u tapu. Da u sa libi nyun fasi gi en taki, en Apaiti Jeje sa kon wooko a ini wi. Da a libi de kengi anga fa weiti di sikiifi, be e wooko a u tapu.
eng_text: But now we are delivered from the law, that being dead wherein we were held; that we should serve in newness of spirit, and not in the oldness of the letter.

djk_text: Da u sa piki mi de baka taki: “Da na weiti á bun!” Ma kaba! Bika sondee weiti, da wi á be o sabi takuudu anga nen. Wi á be o sabi san na takuu losutu, efu weiti á be taki: “Kaba anga takuu losutu!”
eng_text: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? God forbid. Nay, I had not known sin, but by the law: for I had not known lust, except the law had said, Thou shalt not covet.

djk_text: Ma di weiti e bali u, da dati e puu a taanga di takuu losutu abi a ini wi ati, kon a kiin. Ma efu weiti á be e bali wi, da takuudu anga ogii be o de kibii kibii a wi ati. Da a be o de enke sani di á de a libi.
eng_text: But sin, taking occasion by the commandment, wrought in me all manner of concupiscence. For without the law sin was dead.

djk_text: Bika fosi fosi, da mi anga ala mi ogii be e libi enke mi bun. Bika mi á be abi fusutan fu weiti di e bali mi taki: “Kaba anga takuu losutu.” Ma di weiti kon e bali mi, ne mi e fii fa takuudu anga ogii de a ini mi ati, fu poli Masaa Gadu weiti.
eng_text: For I was alive without the law once: but when the commandment came, sin revived, and I died.

djk_text: Namo, ne takuudu anga ogii kon e tyai paati, gi mi anga Masaa Gadu. Da a kon, weiti be poti, fu tyai libi makandii gi mi anga Masaa Gadu. Ma den kon e tyai paati gi mi anga en.
eng_text: And the commandment, which was ordained to life, I found to be unto death.

djk_text: Bika takuu losutu e feti a ini mi ati, di weiti daai toon sani fu soi mi, fa a fowtu ya bigi a mi ati. Ne dati e tyai paati gi mi anga Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: For sin, taking occasion by the commandment, deceived me, and by it slew me.

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu weiti e soi a apaiti fasi di weiti seefi abi. Da ai bali wi, fu teke a apaiti fasi de tu. Ai soi wi, fa fu libi leti, anga ala a bun di dati sa tyai gi wi.
eng_text: Wherefore the law is holy, and the commandment holy, and just, and good.

djk_text: Da u sa piki mi de baka taki: “Fa weiti di bun sa tyai paati gi wi anga Masaa Gadu.” Ma kaba wanten anga a denki de! Bika na a ogii fu mi ati e tyai a paati de. A ogii de bigi! Bika fa weiti e bali mi seefi, ma mi e tan taanga yesi ete. Na so a bun weiti daai e soi, fa a ogii fu mi ati taanga tuutuu.
eng_text: Was then that which is good made death unto me? God forbid. But sin, that it might appear sin, working death in me by that which is good; that sin by the commandment might become exceeding sinful.

djk_text: Bika u ala sabi taki, na Masaa Gadu Apaiti Jeje gi wi den weiti. Ma libisama fasi, da mi ya de anga takuu losutu. Bika takuudu anga ogii e wooko enke basi a ini mi.
eng_text: For we know that the law is spiritual: but I am carnal, sold under sin.

djk_text: We, da fa mi e libi so? Bika mi e libi wan fasi di miseefi e buuse fu libi. Dipi fu mi ati, da mi e angii fu libi wan taa fasi, di miseefi á poi.
eng_text: For that which I do I allow not: for what I would, that do I not; but what I hate, that do I.

djk_text: Da mi e libi na a fasi di dipi fu mi ati e buuse. Dati e soi taki, mi e si den weiti fu Masaa Gadu taki, den bun.
eng_text: If then I do that which I would not, I consent unto the law that it is good.

djk_text: Da a kon, a ná anga mi wani mi e libi so. Na a ogii fu mi ati taanga, fu dwengi mi tyai waka na a pasi fu takuudu anga ogii.
eng_text: Now then it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwelleth in me.

djk_text: Bika mi e fii, fa bun á poi komoto a mi libi. Libisama fasi, da mi á taanga sai fu du bun. Ma a ná enke, a angii á de a dipi fu mi ati. Kweti!
eng_text: For I know that in me (that is, in my flesh,) dwelleth no good thing: for to will is present with me; but how to perform that which is good I find not.

djk_text: A angii de a dipi fu mi ati, fu libi enke fa weiti taki. Ma mi á poi! Bika anga ala a angii fu kaba du ogii di de a mi ati, ma mi e du ogii naamo ete.
eng_text: For the good that I would I do not: but the evil which I would not, that I do.

djk_text: Da mi e libi na a fasi di dipi fu mi ati e buuse, fu libi. Da a kon, mi e libi ogii naamo! Ma a ná anga mi wani. Na ogii a mi ati namo di taanga so, fu feti a ini mi te, ne miseefi á poi tapu en.
eng_text: Now if I do that I would not, it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwelleth in me.

djk_text: Da a toon gwenti gi mi taki, ibii bun di mi poti fu du, da a ogii fu mi ati de ape, fu dyombo kon a mindii.
eng_text: I find then a law, that, when I would do good, evil is present with me.

djk_text: Bika dipi fu mi ati e piisii taki Masaa Gadu weiti bun.
eng_text: For I delight in the law of God after the inward man:

djk_text: Ma libisama fasi, da ogii e wooko enke basi a ini mi. Ne a kisi mi sikin tei banda, fu tyai libi ogii fasi naamo. Da ai tapu mi, fu libi enke fa mi e fusutan taki na bun.
eng_text: But I see another law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity to the law of sin which is in my members.

djk_text: Na a nowtu ya mi de enke libisama! Ogii e wooko enke basi a ini mi, da ai tyai paati gi mi anga Masaa Gadu. We, da mi abi yeepi fanowdu, fu booko a nowtu ya puu a mi tapu. On sama sa yeepi mi?
eng_text: O wretched man that I am! who shall deliver me from the body of this death?

djk_text: We, mi e gi Masaa Gadu daa! Wi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi na a sama di kon booko a nowtu ya, puu a mi tapu. Bika mi be e fusutan taki, weiti bun fu oli. Ma libisama fasi, da ogii taanga, fu wooko enke basi a ini mi.
eng_text: I thank God through Jesus Christ our Lord. So then with the mind I myself serve the law of God; but with the flesh the law of sin.

djk_text: Da na so meke Masaa Gadu paadon de gi sama di mokisa libi anga Kelestesi Jesesi. Da a kaagi fu den dati e kaba ne en fesi.
eng_text: There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.

djk_text: Bika mokisa libi anga Kelestesi Jesesi e tyai en Apaiti Jeje go wooko enke basi na a libi de. Da ai kon de wan nyun libi. Ai booko a taanga di ogii be abi a ini wi, enke basi, fu tyai paati gi sama anga Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus hath made me free from the law of sin and death.

djk_text: Weiti á be poi tapu a ogii libi de. Ne Masaa Gadu sende en Manpikin wan libisama fasi kon a goontapu. Ogii á poi wooko enke basi ne en tapu. Namo a poti en sikin teke dede enke paiman gi wi, meke wi ogii libi mokisa dede anga en de.
eng_text: For what the law could not do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh, and for sin, condemned sin in the flesh:

djk_text: Na so u libi kon taampu letiopu fasi, fiti weiti. Ma, da a takuu losutu á mu tyai wi go libi ogii fasi baka. A libi mu de enke fa a Apaiti Jeje e tyai sama.
eng_text: That the righteousness of the law might be fulfilled in us, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.

djk_text: Bika sama di takuu losutu e tyai libisama fasi, abi denki fu libi enke fa takuu losutu e tyai sama. Ma sama di a Apaiti Jeje e tyai, abi denki fu libi enke fa a Apaiti Jeje e tyai sama.
eng_text: For they that are after the flesh do mind the things of the flesh; but they that are after the Spirit the things of the Spirit.

djk_text: Fu abi denki fu libi enke fa takuu losutu e tyai sama, da ai paati sama anga Masaa Gadu tego. Ma abi denki fu libi enke fa a Apaiti Jeje e tyai e sama, da ai meke sama ati de switi anga Masaa Gadu, fu libi tego.
eng_text: For to be carnally minded is death; but to be spiritually minded is life and peace.

djk_text: Bika denki fu libi enke fa takuu losutu e tyai sama, da ai tyai feyanti fasi anga Masaa Gadu. Bika sama di abi a fasi de, noiti poi oli Masaa Gadu weiti. Ma ai sitee naamo anga san Masaa Gadu wani.
eng_text: Because the carnal mind is enmity against God: for it is not subject to the law of God, neither indeed can be.

djk_text: Wan sama di takuu losutu e tyai libisama fasi, noiti sa poi libi fu piisii Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: So then they that are in the flesh cannot please God.

djk_text: Ma yu enke biibiwan á de fu takuudu losutu tyai libisama fasi. Bika a Apaiti Jeje e wooko enke basi a ini yu, efu a teke peesi de tuutuu. Bika noiti wan libi sa poi de fu Kelestesi, efi en Apaiti Jeje á teke peesi de.
eng_text: But ye are not in the flesh, but in the Spirit, if so be that the Spirit of God dwell in you. Now if any man have not the Spirit of Christ, he is none of his.

djk_text: Ma te Kelestesi de a ini a libi, da dede sa kii a sikin fu wi seefi, ma a leti libi di a Apaiti Jeje seeka a ini wi, e tan libi tego.
eng_text: And if Christ be in you, the body is dead because of sin; but the Spirit is life because of righteousness.

djk_text: Da efu a seefi Apaiti Jeje fu Awan, di be weki Jesesi sikin kon a libi ya baka, teke peesi a ini yu libi tuutuu. Da fa a Jeje de be weki Kelestesi Jesesi sikin, na so a o weki yu sikin, di be dede, baka tu.
eng_text: But if the Spirit of him that raised up Jesus from the dead dwell in you, he that raised up Christ from the dead shall also quicken your mortal bodies by his Spirit that dwelleth in you.

djk_text: Mi lobi biibiwan! Da wi sikin á de a katibo moo, fu libi enke fa takuu losutu e tyai sama.
eng_text: Therefore, brethren, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.

djk_text: Bika sama di takuu losutu e tyai, o paati tego anga Masaa Gadu. Ma fi en Apaiti Jeje e tapu a takuu losutu, kii a yu libi, da yu o poi libi tego anga Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: For if ye live after the flesh, ye shall die: but if ye through the Spirit do mortify the deeds of the body, ye shall live.

djk_text: Bika libi enke fa a Apaiti Jeje e tyai sama, da yu sa de fu kai pikin fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, they are the sons of God.

djk_text: A Jeje di teke peesi a ini yu de e puu a pantan di taki, yu o fende sitaafu. A meke u toon pikin fu Masaa Gadu di sa bali kai en taki: “Abba, wi lobi Tata.”
eng_text: For ye have not received the spirit of bondage again to fear; but ye have received the Spirit of adoption, whereby we cry, Abba, Father.

djk_text: En Jeje di teke peesi a ini wi seefi e kotoigi a wi ati taki, wi na pikin fi en tuu.
eng_text: The Spirit itself beareth witness with our spirit, that we are the children of God:

djk_text: Da sama di toon pikin fi en o fende ala sani fi en, enke pikin. A gaan bun anga a dyendee fu Kelestesi. Ma na te u fende banowtu ya, fu di u e du bun, enke enseefi.
eng_text: And if children, then heirs; heirs of God, and joint-heirs with Christ; if so be that we suffer with him, that we may be also glorified together.

djk_text: Da u á mu si banowtu di u e miti ya enke gaan sani. Bika mi sabi taki, a dyendee di a poti fu gi u bakaten, bigi pasa peesi tumisi.
eng_text: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us.

djk_text: Bika luku fa wan gaan angii de na ala san a meke a tapu, te doo doti ya seefi, fu si a ten di a fiti poti, fu gi pikin fi en gaan dyendee so.
eng_text: For the earnest expectation of the creature waiteth for the manifestation of the sons of God.

djk_text: Bika ne enseefi fuuku ala sani, meke goontapu á de nownow enke fa sani be mu de seefi. Da den mu tan wan hii pisiten so, sondee denseefi wani, fu teke gaan angii, e luku fu fende moo betee ten.
eng_text: For the creature was made subject to vanity, not willingly, but by reason of him who hath subjected the same in hope,

djk_text: A ten de, da ala san a meke seefi ná o poi dede poli moo. Den pikin fi en seefi, di a o gi gaandi fu beenki dyendee fasi. Ala taa sani seefi o fende wan pisi bun a ini a dyendee ya.
eng_text: Because the creature itself also shall be delivered from the bondage of corruption into the glorious liberty of the children of God.

djk_text: Bika u ala sabi fa ala san meke a tapu, doo doti ya tan enke tide. Den e tyotyo enke uman de anga bee. Ma te a pikin meke, da a uman boo. Na sowan angii de a den sani, fu komoto ya go doo pe dede poli á sa de moo.
eng_text: For we know that the whole creation groaneth and travaileth in pain together until now.

djk_text: A dyeme fu dati de a wi seefi, di a gi wi en Jeje, enke fosi pisi fu a hii gaan bun di mu kon de. Da wi e angii taanga fu a dei doo di a o gi u dyendee, enke pikin fi en anga ala a nyun sikin.
eng_text: And not only they, but ourselves also, which have the firstfruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for the adoption, to wit, the redemption of our body.

djk_text: A yeepi di a gi wi kaba, mu meke u luku fu fende bun di a paamisi de ete. Ma luku fu fende sani wani taki, ain á poi si a sani ete. Bika, dati á be o de luku fu fende, efu ain be poi si a sani kaba.
eng_text: For we are saved by hope: but hope that is seen is not hope: for what a man seeth, why doth he yet hope for?

djk_text: Da di na sani u e luku fu fende, da a de fanowdu fu tei ati fu oli doo, fu luku Masaa Gadu fu du dati.
eng_text: But if we hope for that we see not, then do we with patience wait for it.

djk_text: Da en Apaiti Jeje e taampu gi wi, te wi á taanga sai. Da kande u be sa begi misi, ma Apaiti Jeje e teke peesi, fusutan san fu begi. Da u e fii ai dyeme a ini wi naamo gi Masaa Gadu, wan fasi di u mofu seefi á poi taki.
eng_text: Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered.

djk_text: Da Masaa Gadu di e si doo dipi fu wi ati, sabi san u abi fanowdu. Ai si doo a pakisei di a Jeje abi, fu begi gi wi. A sabi san ai suku gi sama di libi de apaiti fasi gi en taki, na san enseefi wani.
eng_text: And he that searcheth the hearts knoweth what is the mind of the Spirit, because he maketh intercession for the saints according to the will of God.

djk_text: Da u sabi fa sani e waka gi sama di lobi Masaa Gadu? A ini ala sani di e pasa, da ai meke bun kon komoto gi den. Bika a be sabi a fesi fa a o wooko, anga den di a o kai kon toon sama fi en seefi.
eng_text: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.

djk_text: Bika sama di a be sabi taki, o kon toon sama fi en, da a be maiki den poti a fesi anda kaba, fu de enke fa a Manpikin fi en seefi de, di waka a den taawan de fesi.
eng_text: For whom he did foreknow, he also did predestinate to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brethren.

djk_text: Bika sama di a be maiki a fesi fu teke, da a kai den kon nownow. Da den di a kai kon, da a seeka den toon bun sama gi enseefi. Da den di a seeka toon bun sama gi enseefi, musu fende en dyendee tego tu.
eng_text: Moreover whom he did predestinate, them he also called: and whom he called, them he also justified: and whom he justified, them he also glorified.

djk_text: We, luku fa u sa satu a hii toli ya. U sa taki, na wi se Masaa Gadu nama. Da feyanti á sa poi feti te, da a wini wi na a biibi ya.
eng_text: What shall we then say to these things? If God be for us, who can be against us?

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu á mombii wi en wankodo Manpikin, di a fika teke dede, enke paiman di tyai bun gi wi. Da fa a sa mombii wi den taa bun, di a dede fi en tyai?
eng_text: He that spared not his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how shall he not with him also freely give us all things?

djk_text: Bika na libisama sa fende de ete taki, wi di Masaa Gadu teke toon fi enseefi, fiti fu Masaa Gadu sitaafu ete. Ma kweti! Bika ne enseefi taki, a seeka wi toon bun sama gi enseefi.
eng_text: Who shall lay any thing to the charge of God's elect? It is God that justifieth.

djk_text: Na sama sa kaagi de ete taki, u fiti sitaafu. Ma kweti! Bika Kelestesi Jesesi di teke dede, meke u mokisa dede anga enseefi. Ne a weki kon a libi ya baka, opo go sidon a Masaa Gadu se, a tapu anda, fu begi yeepi gi wi.
eng_text: Who is he that condemneth? It is Christ that died, yea rather, that is risen again, who is even at the right hand of God, who also maketh intercession for us.

djk_text: Da sani á de fu tapu a lobi fu Kelestesi ya. Toobi sa kon! Banowtu sa kon! Angiiten anga ala mankei koosi fu wei sa kon! Sama sa kon sutu wi kii anga koti fetihow!
eng_text: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? shall tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?

djk_text: Ma Masaa Gadu Buku be sikiifi taki: “Masaa Gadu! Fi yu ede, meke sama e du sani anga wi hiihii dei. Den e si wi enke meti, fu teke tyai go doo ede towe.”
eng_text: As it is written, For thy sake we are killed all the day long; we are accounted as sheep for the slaughter.

djk_text: Ma winsi sowtu ogii sa lontu wi, toku u taampu ete na a wini se. Bika Kelestesi lobi wi tumisi, da ai yeepi wi.
eng_text: Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us.

djk_text: Da mi sabi taki, taanga libi anga ala dede seefi á poi wini wi. Engel anga taa jeje di de fu tii sani seefi á poi. Ogii lontu goontapu nownow go doo bakaten seefi á poi. Makiti á de a goontapu di poi tu.
eng_text: For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come,

djk_text: A ini a baaw a tapu anda, te doo a moo dipi pisi fu doti ya, Masaa Gadu á meke sani di poi booko a lobi di a abi gi wi. Bika a lobi bigi, fa a sende wi Masaa, Kelestesi Jesesi kon yeepi wi!
eng_text: Nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

djk_text: Mi á poi lei, bika mi mokisa libi anga Kelestesi. Da teke san mi o taki ya. A Apaiti Jeje seefi e kotoigi anga mi konsensi so.
eng_text: I say the truth in Christ, I lie not, my conscience also bearing me witness in the Holy Ghost,

djk_text: Kusumi moo mi, anga ala booko ede.
eng_text: That I have great heaviness and continual sorrow in my heart.

djk_text: Bika a moo betee na mi libi á be mokisa anga Kelestesi, fu fende yeepi. Da Masaa Gadu be teke mi eigi Dyusama poti a mi peesi, fu fende a yeepi ya.
eng_text: For I could wish that myself were accursed from Christ for my brethren, my kinsmen according to the flesh:

djk_text: Bika den na Islayeli sama di a teke toon pikin fi enseefi. A gi den dyendee. A kuudei anga den avo gaansama, fika gi den. A fitoow den en weiti anga ala a fasi fu dini en. Somen leisi a paamisi fu yeepi den a sani.
eng_text: Who are Israelites; to whom pertaineth the adoption, and the glory, and the covenants, and the giving of the law, and the service of God, and the promises;

djk_text: A paansu sama fu den waka komoto a den moo gaandi avo fu Dyusama. A Kelestesi meke libisama fasi a ini a foluku fu den. Ne a de fu gi gaandi enke Masaa Gadu na ala sani tapu, tego. Amen, na so a de!
eng_text: Whose are the fathers, and of whom as concerning the flesh Christ came, who is over all, God blessed for ever. Amen.

djk_text: We, ala den á fende a yeepi di Masaa Gadu be paamisi den. Ma a fowtu fu dati á de a Masaa Gadu. Bika na di a nái si ala den fu kai Islayeli.
eng_text: Not as though the word of God hath taken none effect. For they are not all Israel, which are of Israel:

djk_text: Soseefi a nái si ala den fu kai pikin fu Abalaham, anga ala fa libisama fasi, den de paansu sama fu Abalaham! Bika a paamisi be taki: “Na a paansu sama fu Isaki namo mi o kai yu bakapikin.”
eng_text: Neither, because they are the seed of Abraham, are they all children: but, In Isaac shall thy seed be called.

djk_text: Dati taki, a ná paansu sama di Abalaham meke libisama fasi. Ma na a paansu sama, di biibi Masaa Gadu paamisi tyai gi Abalaham.
eng_text: That is, They which are the children of the flesh, these are not the children of God: but the children of the promise are counted for the seed.

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu be paamisi taki: “Abalaham! Te a leti yuu fu mi doo, da mi o kon baka. Da yu uman Sala o meke wan manpikin.”
eng_text: For this is the word of promise, At this time will I come, and Sara shall have a son.

djk_text: We, ne a meke wi avo gaansama Isaki, di toon manengee, ne a gi en uman Lebeka bee, fu wan toolengi manpikin.
eng_text: And not only this; but when Rebecca also had conceived by one, even by our father Isaac;

djk_text: Da den tu pikin be de a bee ete, sondee fu du bun ofu ogii. Ne Masaa Gadu be fiti poti de kaba, fu du en wooko go doo anga wan fu den, fika a taawan.
eng_text: (For the children being not yet born, neither having done any good or evil, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him that calleth;)

djk_text: A á be teke awan de wooko, fu di a be bun moo a taawan. Ma na di enseefi be fiti poti kaba, fu teke awan fika a taawan. Bika den be de a bee ete, di a piki a mma fu den taki: “Di moo yonkuwan o de basi fu a moo gaanwan, di fosi meke.”
eng_text: It was said unto her, The elder shall serve the younger.

djk_text: Na soseefi, a be piki apaiti takiman a fositen, fu sikiifi taki: “Na mi seefi lobi wooko anga Jakopu, fika Esaw di de moo gaanwan.”
eng_text: As it is written, Jacob have I loved, but Esau have I hated.

djk_text: We, da sama o piki mi de taki: “Da Masaa Gadu nái wooko anga leti!” Ma kaba anga a denki de!
eng_text: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? God forbid.

djk_text: Bika a be piki Mosesi taki: “Na mi e teke taawan wooko fika taawan. Na mi e teke tyali ati fasi luku sama di mi wani.”
eng_text: For he saith to Moses, I will have mercy on whom I will have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I will have compassion.

djk_text: Da fa ai wooko nái go anga libisama wani. A nái de moiti di sama seefi meke tu. Ma ne en seefi e teke tyali ati gi sama sani di denseefi á wooko fu fende.
eng_text: So then it is not of him that willeth, nor of him that runneth, but of God that sheweth mercy.

djk_text: Bika en Buku sikiifi fa a taigi Fala-ow taki: “Na mi seefi gi yu makiti de. Da mi o wooko anga mi makiti, meke hii goontapu sa si fa mi de Masaa Gadu anga ala makiti.”
eng_text: For the scripture saith unto Pharaoh, Even for this same purpose have I raised thee up, that I might shew my power in thee, and that my name might be declared throughout all the earth.

djk_text: Dati taki, a teke tyali ati fasi luku taawan, fu yeepi den. Ma enseefi baka e taanga taawan yesi, fu sitee anga en.
eng_text: Therefore hath he mercy on whom he will have mercy, and whom he will he hardeneth.

djk_text: Da sama o piki mi de taki: “Da Masaa Gadu á mu kaagi sama di e taanga yesi. Bika ne enseefi poti a sama fu wooko so, da a sama ná o poi wooko taa fasi.”
eng_text: Thou wilt say then unto me, Why doth he yet find fault? For who hath resisted his will?

djk_text: Ma mi e piki yu de taki: “Yu libisama á bigi sai fu sitee taki anga Masaa Gadu. Yu ná o daai fa a poti fu wooko. Bika tokotoko di sama e teke meke patu ya nái poi taigi a sama de taki: ‘Yu á meke mi bun.’ ”
eng_text: Nay but, O man, who art thou that repliest against God? Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it, Why hast thou made me thus?

djk_text: Bika na a sama e wooko enke basi fu daai a tokotoko toon a patu di enseefi wani. Wan taa leisi baka, da ai daai en toon taa sowtu patu. Ai meke dyendee wan, ai meke di á kaba dyendee so.
eng_text: Hath not the potter power over the clay, of the same lump to make one vessel unto honour, and another unto dishonour?

djk_text: Na so Masaa Gadu de basi fu wooko fa enseefi wani, fu meke goontapu si en gaan atiboon, anga ala en makiti di o kaba sama a soso. Ma ai oli langa pasensi anga sama nownow.
eng_text: What if God, willing to shew his wrath, and to make his power known, endured with much longsuffering the vessels of wrath fitted to destruction:

djk_text: Da ai teke tyali ati fasi luku wan apaiti kulu sama. Den dati o si en gaan dyendee fasi, di a be poti fu gi den fosi a be meke goontapu ya seefi. A o gi den gaandi makandii anga enseefi.
eng_text: And that he might make known the riches of his glory on the vessels of mercy, which he had afore prepared unto glory,

djk_text: Dati na wi, di a kai kon teke biibi, toon sama fi enseefi. Na wi ai kai en osu sama, di de Dyusama mokisa anga ala taa sowtu foluku tu.
eng_text: Even us, whom he hath called, not of the Jews only, but also of the Gentiles?

djk_text: A be piki en apaiti takiman Hoseya a fositen, fu sikiifi taki: “Sama di á be de mi foluku, ne mi teke toon mi foluku. Sama di be de mi buuseman, ne mi teke toon sama di mi lobi.”
eng_text: As he saith also in Osee, I will call them my people, which were not my people; and her beloved, which was not beloved.

djk_text: Soseefi a sikiifi taki: “Peesi be de, pe mi sama á be de. Ma den dati o toon peesi, pe sama o de fu kai pikin fu a libilibi Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: And it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people; there shall they be called the children of the living God.

djk_text: Ma a be piki en apaiti takiman Jesaja, a fositen, fu bali taki: “Dyusama di de Islayeli sama ipi enke santi fu liba di á poi teli. Ma na wantu namo o fende a yeepi fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Esaias also crieth concerning Israel, Though the number of the children of Israel be as the sand of the sea, a remnant shall be saved:

djk_text: Bika fa a paamisi fu sitaafu Islayeli sama a Dyu Kondee de nái daai daai, fu kon doo. Ibiiwan fiya o fende en paiman de, fu takuudu anga ogii.”
eng_text: For he will finish the work, and cut it short in righteousness: because a short work will the Lord make upon the earth.

djk_text: A be piki Jesaja fu sikiifi ete taki: “We! Masaa Sebaot makiti bigi tumisi, fu sitaafu. Da fi enseefi á be teke fu yeepi, da na a hii Dyu paansu sama be o kaba a soso. Sani be o waka enke Sowdom Foto di a be boon, figi puu a goontapu. Da goontapu be o piki taki, na so a be du anga Gomola Foto tu.”
eng_text: And as Esaias said before, Except the Lord of Sabaoth had left us a seed, we had been as Sodoma, and been made like unto Gomorrha.

djk_text: Da u sa taki, taa foluku di á be abi fasi fu toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu, ne biibi tyai dati gi den sama de.
eng_text: What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, which followed not after righteousness, have attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith.

djk_text: Ma Dyusama, na Masaa Gadu weiti den e oli, fu toon bun sama gi en. Da na dati e tyai dyakata gi den.
eng_text: But Israel, which followed after the law of righteousness, hath not attained to the law of righteousness.

djk_text: Da yu o piki mi de taki: “Fa dati kan?” Da mi e piki taki: “We, den nái wooko anga biibi, ma anga weiti. Ne den gei sama di misi pasi, soseefi puu pakisei a wan siton di poti tapu pasi de. We, ne a dyakata den towe.”
eng_text: Wherefore? Because they sought it not by faith, but as it were by the works of the law. For they stumbled at that stumblingstone;

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu be meke en Buku sikiifi taki: “Luku ya! Mi poti wan siton a Siyon de, fu dyakata sama towe. Ma sama di poti biibi ne en tapu noiti o kai a sen.”
eng_text: As it is written, Behold, I lay in Sion a stumblingstone and rock of offence: and whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed.

djk_text: Mi lobi biibiwan! A angii bigi a mi ati seefi, fu si a yeepi ya go doo mi eigi foluku enke Dyusama. Mi e begi Masaa Gadu seefi, fu dati.
eng_text: Brethren, my heart's desire and prayer to God for Israel is, that they might be saved.

djk_text: Bika mi de kotoigi fu si taki, den dyadya fu du sani fu Masaa Gadu. Ma den nái kaba fusutan sani fi en sai, meke wini á de gi den.
eng_text: For I bear them record that they have a zeal of God, but not according to knowledge.

djk_text: Den á poi si taki, ne enseefi mu seeka den toon bun sama gi enseefi. Ne den teke weiti e wooko fu fende yeepi, meke den lasi fa a wani wooko anga den.
eng_text: For they being ignorant of God's righteousness, and going about to establish their own righteousness, have not submitted themselves unto the righteousness of God.

djk_text: Bika na Kelestesi kon, fu tapu a wooko di weiti be abi. Da na biibi en e seeka sama kon bun gi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: For Christ is the end of the law for righteousness to every one that believeth.

djk_text: Bika Mosesi seefi be sikiifi on ten weiti sa seeka sama kon bun. A taki: “Na sondee fowtu i mu wooko anga den weiti fosi, da i sa fende libi tego.”
eng_text: For Moses describeth the righteousness which is of the law, That the man which doeth those things shall live by them.

djk_text: Namo a sikiifi tu fa biibi sa seeka sama kon bun. A wasikoi taki: “Ná denki taki, da na Masaa Gadu Kondee a tapu u mu meke sama subi go suku yeepi.” Dati mu soi taki, u seefi ná abi fu subi go saka a Kelestesi puu anda, kon du dati ya.
eng_text: But the righteousness which is of faith speaketh on this wise, Say not in thine heart, Who shall ascend into heaven? (that is, to bring Christ down from above:)

djk_text: Soseefi a sikiifi taki: “Ná denki taki, da na a moo dipi pisi fu ondoo doti u mu meke sama saka go.” Dati e soi taki, u seefi ná abi fu saka gwe anda go opo a Kelestesi kon du dati ya.
eng_text: Or, Who shall descend into the deep? (that is, to bring up Christ again from the dead.)

djk_text: Kweti! A sikiifi taki: “Wowtu di Masaa Gadu taki á de faawe. Ibiiwan mofu sa fende dati taki baka. Ibiiwan ati sa fende dati teke oli poti de, fu fusutan.” Bika dati na Masaa Gadu nyunsu di wi e bali lontu goontapu nownow.
eng_text: But what saith it? The word is nigh thee, even in thy mouth, and in thy heart: that is, the word of faith, which we preach;

djk_text: A bosikopu de, na fu taigi taawan taki, Jesesi na Masaa a tapu fu ala taawan. Da u ati mu abi a biibi fa Masaa Gadu weki en kon a libi ya baka. Da u seeka kon toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu kaba.
eng_text: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.

djk_text: Bika te ati abi biibi, da yu e kon toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu. Soseefi, te yu e taigi taawan fa Jesesi de Masaa a tapu fu ala taawan, da yu o fende libi tego.
eng_text: For with the heart man believeth unto righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation.

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu Buku be sikiifi taki: “Ibiiwan di biibi, noiti sa kai a sen.”
eng_text: For the scripture saith, Whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed.

djk_text: Luku fa a sikiifi taki: “Ibiiwan di biibi.” Na Dyusama, soseefi taa foluku di á de Dyu, ai si den a seefi fasi. Bika na wan kodo Masaa namo de gi ala sama. Na dati meke ibiiwan sa fende seigi, te den kai en fu suku yeepi.
eng_text: For there is no difference between the Jew and the Greek: for the same Lord over all is rich unto all that call upon him.

djk_text: Bika en Buku piki u taki: “Ibiiwan di begi kai Masaa fu suku yeepi, a o yeepi dati.”
eng_text: For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved.

djk_text: Ma yu o akisi mi de baka taki: “Fa den sa begi kai a Masaa de, ma den á be biibi san a kon du? Fa den sa biibi, ma den á be yee fi en? Fa den sa yee fi en, ma sama á be go bolotyasi en bosikopu gi den?
eng_text: How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard? and how shall they hear without a preacher?

djk_text: Fa fu go bolotyasi en bosikopu, ma enseefi á sende yu go?” Ma kaba anga den sowtu denki de! Bika en Buku piki u taki: “Bali baya! Den di a sende anga en bosikopu futu kisi de. Da piisii seefi.”
eng_text: And how shall they preach, except they be sent? as it is written, How beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace, and bring glad tidings of good things!

djk_text: Ma na di ala den á biibi a Bun Nyunsu ya. Bika Jesaja piki dati a Masaa Gadu Buku taki: “Masaa! Wi tyai yu bosikopu go, ma den á biibi.”
eng_text: But they have not all obeyed the gospel. For Esaias saith, Lord, who hath believed our report?

djk_text: Bika fu a biibi mu kon, da yesi mu poti ne en bosikopu. Da u sa fusutan a wowtu Kelestesi di a sende gi wi.
eng_text: So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.

djk_text: Ma mi e piki taki, na yee den á yee dati? Kweti! Bika apaiti takiman sikiifi dati piki a fositen taki: “Na hii goontapu, apaiti bosikopuman waka bolotyasi. Ne faawe kondee seefi yee wowtu di a sende den fu taki.”
eng_text: But I say, Have they not heard? Yes verily, their sound went into all the earth, and their words unto the ends of the world.

djk_text: Da mi e piki baka taki: “Ne Islayeli a Dyu Kondee á fusutan dati? Kweti! Bika Mosesi sikiifi piki baka taki: ‘Dyusama! U o dyalusu anga taa foluku di u nái teli enke mi foluku. U ati o bita a den di u e si enke á sabi noti fu mi.’ ”
eng_text: But I say, Did not Israel know? First Moses saith, I will provoke you to jealousy by them that are no people, and by a foolish nation I will anger you.

djk_text: Soseefi Jesaja peefuu sikiifi baka taki: “Taa foluku noiti be e suku fu fende mi, fu dini, ma den o kon sabi mi. Noiti den be e pakisei luku sama mi de, ma mi o soi den mi seefi.”
eng_text: But Esaias is very bold, and saith, I was found of them that sought me not; I was made manifest unto them that asked not after me.

djk_text: Ma a be sikiifi piki Islayeli taki: “Hii dei mi e langa ana fu go seeka a taanga yesi foluku ya. Ma den e sitee anga mi naamo.”
eng_text: But to Israel he saith, All day long I have stretched forth my hands unto a disobedient and gainsaying people.

djk_text: Ma u sa akisi mi de taki: “Da Masaa Gadu á fika en foluku, no?” Kweti! Mi di ai wooko ya ete, na Islayeli sama fu Dyu Kondee tu. Enke paansu sama fu Abalaham, da mi komoto na a lo sama den e kai Benyameni sama.
eng_text: I say then, Hath God cast away his people? God forbid. For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.

djk_text: Da kweti! Masaa Gadu á poi fika en foluku. Bika a be sabi den a fesi, fosi a be teke den toon fi enseefi. Denki a toli fu Masaa Gadu Buku di Eliya be go kaagi den Dyusama gi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: God hath not cast away his people which he foreknew. Wot ye not what the scripture saith of Elias? how he maketh intercession to God against Israel, saying,

djk_text: Da Eliya be taki: “Dyusama e kii apaiti takiman, di yu o sende go a den. Den e booko a apaiti begi tafaa, pe meti e boon, enke paiman, fu begi yu paadon. Da na mi wawan fika na a kondee. Ne den e suku fu kii mi baka.”
eng_text: Lord, they have killed thy prophets, and digged down thine altars; and I am left alone, and they seek my life.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Gadu be piki en taki: “Kweti! A ná yu wawan fika! Mi e si ete seibin dunsu osu, di e teli enke sama fu mi ete. Denseefi á teke fu dini Baal, a falisi gadu.”
eng_text: But what saith the answer of God unto him? I have reserved to myself seven thousand men, who have not bowed the knee to the image of Baal.

djk_text: Da na letiso tide seefi wantu Dyusama e biibi ete. Ne a teke den disi e kai osu sama fi enseefi, di a teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku.
eng_text: Even so then at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.

djk_text: Da na gaan bun ati fasi namo di a teke luku u, meke a gi u a bun ya. Da u á poi taki, u wooko fu fende dati. Bika, da u á be o poi kai dati, a teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku wi.
eng_text: And if by grace, then is it no more of works: otherwise grace is no more grace. But if it be of works, then is it no more grace: otherwise work is no more work.

djk_text: Da u sa piki a toli ya taki, a bun de na di hii Islayeli e feti fu fende. Ma denseefi moiti noiti poi doo peesi, fu fende dati. Ne Masaa Gadu teke wantu fu den namo gi dati, ne a fika a moo gaanse fu den, sondee fu poi fusutan dati.
eng_text: What then? Israel hath not obtained that which he seeketh for; but the election hath obtained it, and the rest were blinded

djk_text: Na fu dati apaiti takiman be sikiifi a fositen taki: “A fika den, enke den kai a siibi. Da den ain nái si, den yesi nái yee, fu fusutan sani fi en. Na so Dyusama tan, te enke tide seefi.”
eng_text: (According as it is written, God hath given them the spirit of slumber, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear;) unto this day.

djk_text: Dafeti seefi be sikiifi fu dati taki: “Meke weiti gei tafaa sete gi den, fu go nyan. Ma na sani fu kisi den enke kaapana. Den o naki futu na a siton, di poti tapu pasi anda, meke den dyakata so. Da den sa fende a paiman di fiti den.
eng_text: And David saith, Let their table be made a snare, and a trap, and a stumbling block, and a recompence unto them:

djk_text: Meke den ain dunguu, da den á sa fusutan sani fi yu. Da taanga ten sa banowtu den naamo, fu den tyai.”
eng_text: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see, and bow down their back alway.

djk_text: Ma mi e akisi miseefi taki: “Sama di naki futu e dyakata kai, ma a ná fu tan didon fika de?” Da mi e piki taki: “Kweti!” Bika di Dyusama á biibi, ne Masaa Gadu yeepi go doo taa foluku. Meke a sa tyai dyalusu gi den, fu suku a yeepi de tu.
eng_text: I say then, Have they stumbled that they should fall? God forbid: but rather through their fall salvation is come unto the Gentiles, for to provoke them to jealousy.

djk_text: Da na a ogii fu den, meke yeepi go doo taa foluku. Na di den dyakata, ne taa foluku fende pasi kon taampu. We, da di den o taampu baka, no? Da dati musu moo tyai bun gi taa foluku.
eng_text: Now if the fall of them be the riches of the world, and the diminishing of them the riches of the Gentiles; how much more their fulness?

djk_text: Da mi e taigi u taa foluku biibiwan de taki, na mi Masaa Gadu gi en taki enke apaiti bosikopuman, fu gi u de. Na wan dyendee sani di mi e teke fu bigi.
eng_text: For I speak to you Gentiles, inasmuch as I am the apostle of the Gentiles, I magnify mine office:

djk_text: Ma mi wani mi eigi foluku si a u, fa ai wooko anga u de. Meke a sa tyai dyalusu gi den, fu suku a yeepi de tu. Da mi o fende pasi yeepi wantu fu den.
eng_text: If by any means I may provoke to emulation them which are my flesh, and might save some of them.

djk_text: Bika na di Dyusama dyakata, ne a yeepi go doo hii goontapu. Da di den o seeka kon taampu baka, da dati musu moo tyai bun gi goontapu. A piisii de o bigi enke na wan sama be dede, ne Masaa Gadu go weki en baka.
eng_text: For if the casting away of them be the reconciling of the world, what shall the receiving of them be, but life from the dead?

djk_text: Den moo gaandi avo Dyu gaansama, na lutu fu a hii Dyu. Na apaiti sama gi Masaa Gadu. Ne a hii paansu sama fu den toon fu Masaa Gadu. Bika te fosi pisi nyanyan fu goon puu gi Masaa Gadu daa, da a hii goon toon fi en. Lutu fu bon di paandi gi en, da ala taka, ala uwii fu a bon, toon fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: For if the firstfruit be holy, the lump is also holy: and if the root be holy, so are the branches.

djk_text: Da wan nongo e koti gi taa foluku biibiwan. A taki, na di haw taka fu a bon nái puu bunbun sii, ne den koti den puu poti a wanse. Ne yu enke busi bon taka fende pasi go sutu nama goo na a bon de, fu fende kaakiti de, fu puu bunbun sii.
eng_text: And if some of the branches be broken off, and thou, being a wild olive tree, wert graffed in among them, and with them partakest of the root and fatness of the olive tree;

djk_text: Da ná meke bigi anga Dyusama. Ma sabi taki, a ná busi bon taka di fende pasi nama goo de, e gi a lutu kaakiti. Ma na a lutu e gi den taka kaakiti.
eng_text: Boast not against the branches. But if thou boast, thou bearest not the root, but the root thee.

djk_text: Ma kande yu o meke bigi taki, i de wan sani! Bika a nongo e taki, son haw taka fu a bon koti puu poti a wanse. Ne den teke yu nama poti a Dyusama peesi.
eng_text: Thou wilt say then, The branches were broken off, that I might be graffed in.

djk_text: We, a bun! Ma sabi taki, na di den haw taka de nái puu bunbun sii. Dati taki, den Dyusama de á wani teke biibi, ma yu teke biibi. Da kaba meke bigi. Ma koni bun!
eng_text: Well; because of unbelief they were broken off, and thou standest by faith. Be not highminded, but fear:

djk_text: Bika a koti taka fu a bon seefi di meke de poti a wanse. Da san na yu, meke a á sa poi koti yu puu poti a wanse tu.
eng_text: For if God spared not the natural branches, take heed lest he also spare not thee.

djk_text: Denki taki, Masaa Gadu e wooko anga switi taki anga yu de. Ma en ati sa boon, bali anga ala sitaafu tu. Dyusama di á wani biibi si dati kaba. Namo, ne a kon wooko anga switi taki anga yu. Ma puu biibi, da yu o si! Ai koti yuseefi puu poti a wanse tu.
eng_text: Behold therefore the goodness and severity of God: on them which fell, severity; but toward thee, goodness, if thou continue in his goodness: otherwise thou also shalt be cut off.

djk_text: Bika haw taka fu a bon, di be koti puu sa poi teke kon nama poti de baka. Da den e goo de baka enke fa den be meke de. Masaa Gadu poi du so baka anga Dyusama di teke biibi.
eng_text: And they also, if they abide not still in unbelief, shall be graffed in: for God is able to graff them in again.

djk_text: Bika taka fu busi bon á be de fu a bon de seefi. Ma dati poi koti kon nama fasi goo de. Da fa fu taka di be de fu a bon kaba seefi? Dati na Dyusama di musu poi toon bun sama baka gi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: For if thou wert cut out of the olive tree which is wild by nature, and wert graffed contrary to nature into a good olive tree: how much more shall these, which be the natural branches, be graffed into their own olive tree?

djk_text: Taa foluku biibiwan! Da ná meke bigi anga Dyusama. Fusutan san fu den Masaa Gadu piki wi ya. Noiti sama be sabi a sani ya wanten. A de so taki, na Masaa Gadu seefi tapu den Dyusama ati, fu den á sa teke biibi, te enke a kaba wooko anga en bosikopu, a taa foluku a hii goontapu.
eng_text: For I would not, brethren, that ye should be ignorant of this mystery, lest ye should be wise in your own conceits; that blindness in part is happened to Israel, until the fulness of the Gentiles be come in.

djk_text: Da na so a o go yeepi a foluku fu Islayeli Kondee baka. Bika a apaiti takiman be sikiifi piki fu dati taki: “A Masaa fu yeepi Islayeli Kondee o saka komoto a Siyon a tapu. Da a o meke a paansu sama fu Jakopu kaba anga a dini fu falisi sani, di á de Gadu.
eng_text: And so all Israel shall be saved: as it is written, There shall come out of Sion the Deliverer, and shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob:

djk_text: A nyun kuudei di mi ya o meke anga den taki, mi o gi den paadon fu ala takuudu anga ogii.”
eng_text: For this is my covenant unto them, when I shall take away their sins.

djk_text: Da nownow den de feyanti fu Masaa Gadu, fu di den daai baka gi en Bun Nyunsu. Ma dati na fu a sa fende pasi go wooko doo yu enke taa foluku. Ma a ná enke den á de en lobi foluku moo. Bika den na paansu sama, fu Abalaham, Isaki anga Jakopu. Na den a be paamisi fu teke wooko, tyai bun doo ala taa foluku.
eng_text: As concerning the gospel, they are enemies for your sakes: but as touching the election, they are beloved for the fathers' sakes.

djk_text: Da te a kai wan sama kon gi gaan bun kaba, fu a teke wooko, da noiti ai puu dati baka na a sama ana.
eng_text: For the gifts and calling of God are without repentance.

djk_text: Bika luku fa yu enke taa foluku be e taanga yesi gi en. Ne fu fende pasi wooko tyali ati fasi anga yu, ne a Dyu foluku kon taanga yesi fosi.
eng_text: For as ye in times past have not believed God, yet have now obtained mercy through their unbelief:

djk_text: Da a Dyu foluku kon taanga yesi nownow, ma na fu fende pasi daai go wooko tyali ati fasi baka anga den seefi, enke fa a kon wooko tyali ati fasi anga yu de.
eng_text: Even so have these also now not believed, that through your mercy they also may obtain mercy.

djk_text: Da u sa satu ala sani fu a biifi ya taki, Masaa Gadu mokisa ala sama poti taki, den abi taanga yesi. Da a sa fende pasi, fu wooko tyali ati fasi anga ala den.
eng_text: For God hath concluded them all in unbelief, that he might have mercy upon all.

djk_text: We, den gaan bun fu Masaa Gadu ya dipi! Soseefi a koni fi en, fu wooko leti fasi, anga a gaan sabi di a abi, fu du. Fasi á de fu sama kisi ala san a poti fu du tu. Soseefi fa a wani sani mu waka, bigi pasa u fusutan.
eng_text: O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of God! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past finding out!

djk_text: U sa poi sabi Masaa Gadu denki, di a abi? U sa poi soi en taki, na disi anga dati bun, fu a du?
eng_text: For who hath known the mind of the Lord? or who hath been his counseller?

djk_text: U fosi sa poi go gi Masaa Gadu wan sani taki, a mu pai wi fu dati baka?
eng_text: Or who hath first given to him, and it shall be recompensed unto him again?

djk_text: Bika ala san de ya komoto a Masaa Gadu seefi. Ne a poti ala den sani enke fa a wani. Da ai daai den sani go doo kaba so tu. Da a fiti fu bali gafa en naamo tego. Amen, na so a de!
eng_text: For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things: to whom be glory for ever. Amen.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Mi e begi u taki, denki a tyali ati fasi di Masaa Gadu teke, fu du somen bun gi wi. Da langa iseefi gi en, meke ala pisi fu sikin de apaiti fasi. Na so i sa fiti fu dini en, meke a sa piisii.
eng_text: I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God, which is your reasonable service.

djk_text: Da kaba anga a sowtu libi fu goontapu, di nái teli Masaa Gadu. Kengi pakisei, fu denki a nyun fasi di Masaa Gadu wani. Da a o piisii fa yu e du leti san a wani. Soseefi yu o kon sabi san a poti gi yu fu du taki, na soso bun naamo.
eng_text: And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.

djk_text: Mi wooko di a gi mi, dati na gaan bun ati fasi namo a teke luku mi. Da mi e taki, noiti u mu denki enke u hei moo taawan, anga a apaiti taanga di Masaa Gadu gi, fu wooko.
eng_text: For I say, through the grace given unto me, to every man that is among you, not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think; but to think soberly, according as God hath dealt to every man the measure of faith.

djk_text: Bika ai si wi ala makandii enke wan sikin. Da wan sikin abi somen sowtu pisi, da ibii pisi abi en wooko gi a sikin.
eng_text: For as we have many members in one body, and all members have not the same office:

djk_text: Wi ala di mokisa libi anga Kelestesi de enke wan sikin. Da ala fa u de somen sowtu sama seefi, ma u mokisa makandii a wan.
eng_text: So we, being many, are one body in Christ, and every one members one of another.

djk_text: A gi sowtu a sowtu apaiti taanga, fu wooko. Na so a teke gaan bun ati fasi luku wi, meke ibiiwan kisi a apaiti taanga, fu a wooko di a gi dati. A gi son wan a taanga, fu de apaiti takiman. Da meke a sama de du a wooko de anga a biibi di a abi.
eng_text: Having then gifts differing according to the grace that is given to us, whether prophecy, let us prophesy according to the proportion of faith;

djk_text: Efu na fu yeepi taawan, da yeepi den. Efu na fu fusutan dipi sani fi en, fu leli taawan. Da leli den seefi!
eng_text: Or ministry, let us wait on our ministering: or he that teacheth, on teaching;

djk_text: Efu na fu wasikoi taawan a Masaa Gadu pasi, da wasikoi den! Efu na fu paati yu sani anga taawan, fu fende san den fanowdu. Da paati en anga den, sondee fu tapu baka! Efu na fu tii taa biibiwan, da feti tii den! Efu na fu wooko tyali ati fasi anga taawan. Da teke piisii fasi, wooko tyali ati fasi anga den.
eng_text: Or he that exhorteth, on exhortation: he that giveth, let him do it with simplicity; he that ruleth, with diligence; he that sheweth mercy, with cheerfulness.

djk_text: Meke lobi taawan á de mofu lobi namo. Ma buuse ibii sowtu takuu fasi di de. Nama hii pakisei a san leti gi Masaa Gadu, fu du.
eng_text: Let love be without dissimulation. Abhor that which is evil; cleave to that which is good.

djk_text: Yu na osu sama fu Masaa Gadu, di mu lobi ala taawan de, enke yu eigi osu sama. Waka a fesi, fu soi fa fu lesipeki taawan moo enke yuseefi.
eng_text: Be kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love; in honour preferring one another;

djk_text: Towe ala lesi fasi! Meke moiti, fu wooko gi Masaa Gadu naamo. Soi taanga angii, fu du sani fi en. Dyombo ibii leisi du san wi Masaa sende yu.
eng_text: Not slothful in business; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;

djk_text: Tei ati piisii doo, fu luku fu fende gaan bun, di a poti fu gi bakaten. Meke pasensi tyai yu doo dati. Kaba kaagi te banowtu kon a yu pasi. Noiti kaba pakisei san yu begi en taki, a o du en wan dei namo.
eng_text: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;

djk_text: Taa biibiwan de a ini taanga ten? Da dyombo go yeepi anga san yu abi. Yu osu doo mu opo gi taawan di doo yu, fu gi siibipe anga ala nyanyan seefi.
eng_text: Distributing to the necessity of saints; given to hospitality.

djk_text: We, efu taawan e lon du ogii anga yu, da ná fuuku en. Ma begi seigi gi en. Mi e taki en baka! Begi seigi gi en, ma ná fuuku en!
eng_text: Bless them which persecute you: bless, and curse not.

djk_text: Te taawan de anga poolo, da nama go poolo anga en, fu a bun di miti en. Taawan de anga tyali, nama go tyali anga en, fu a ogii di miti en.
eng_text: Rejoice with them that do rejoice, and weep with them that weep.

djk_text: U mu booko ede makandii gi useefi. Noiti si iseefi hei moo taawan. Da te sani de fu du, da nama makandii du en sondee, fu go pee basi. Noiti denki enke yu ede e wooko moo bun, ofu koni moo taawan.
eng_text: Be of the same mind one toward another. Mind not high things, but condescend to men of low estate. Be not wise in your own conceits.

djk_text: Te taawan du sani anga yu, da ná puubei fu pai en anga ogii baka. Teke fu libi leti anga taawan, da yu o de sondee kaagi taki, yu libi á bun.
eng_text: Recompense to no man evil for evil. Provide things honest in the sight of all men.

djk_text: Suku fi yu se naamo, fi yu ati sa de switi a taawan.
eng_text: If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men.

djk_text: Mi lobi biibiwan! Te taawan nái wooko leti anga yu, da noiti wooko takuu fasi anga en baka. Fika en gi Masaa Gadu. Bika en Buku sikiifi taki: “Na mi Masaa Gadu de fu pai sama. Da na mi o gi ibiiwan san fiti en.” Ma en Buku sikiifi tu taki:
eng_text: Dearly beloved, avenge not yourselves, but rather give place unto wrath: for it is written, Vengeance is mine; I will repay, saith the Lord.

djk_text: “Ma efu yu feyanti de anga angii, da gi en nyanyan! Wataa moo en, gi en wataa. Libi switi anga en o meke a sidon denki, fa a abi yeepi fanowdu. Da Masaa Gadu sa fende pasi, fu go kengi en.”
eng_text: Therefore if thine enemy hunger, feed him; if he thirst, give him drink: for in so doing thou shalt heap coals of fire on his head.

djk_text: Ma ogii sa wooko enke basi a yuseefi tapu, te yu e du ogii baka anga taawan di du ogii anga yu. Ma te taawan du ogii anga yu, ma yu e libi switi anga en, da ogii sa fika a yu ondoo futu.
eng_text: Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.

djk_text: We, da ibii kondee abi lanti fu tii sama. Da ná si den enke noti, fu du sani pasa den mofu. Bika a makiti fu den tii sani, anga ala taki gi taawan de komoto a Masaa Gadu. Taa fasi á de fu fende makiti.
eng_text: Let every soul be subject unto the higher powers. For there is no power but of God: the powers that be are ordained of God.

djk_text: Da sama di taanga yesi fu sitee anga mofu di lanti poti, da ai feti anga Masaa Gadu seefi. Da yu o tuka anga lanti, fu fende a sitaafu di poti, fu san i du. Bika den á fika soso ana.
eng_text: Whosoever therefore resisteth the power, resisteth the ordinance of God: and they that resist shall receive to themselves damnation.

djk_text: Bika lanti á poti fu tyai feele gi sama, di e wooko leti. Na den di e wooko takuu fasi abi fu feele. Da te yu á wani feele lanti, da wooko leti. Da den o naki yu a sikoo taki: “Moi so!”
eng_text: For rulers are not a terror to good works, but to the evil. Wilt thou then not be afraid of the power? do that which is good, and thou shalt have praise of the same:

djk_text: Bika lanti á poti, fu du ogii anga sama. Ma na fu luku fa sama e waka. Da na sama pasa den mofu, abi fu waka anga feele. Bika na lanti mu sitaafu sama, meke den ana bigi sai, anga wapu di den e tyai. Na Masaa Gadu wooko den de.
eng_text: For he is the minister of God to thee for good. But if thou do that which is evil, be afraid; for he beareth not the sword in vain: for he is the minister of God, a revenger to execute wrath upon him that doeth evil.

djk_text: Da biibiwan mu waka a lanti ondoo. A ná fu a feele ede taki, den poi sitaafu yu. Ma konsensi seefi e piki yu taki, dati na a leti fasi.
eng_text: Wherefore ye must needs be subject, not only for wrath, but also for conscience sake.

djk_text: Da pai lantimoni na a kondee. Bika na dati e pai lantiman, fu a wooko, di Masaa Gadu poti den gi sama de. Den e wooko hii dei, fu fende a dei beele ya.
eng_text: For for this cause pay ye tribute also: for they are God's ministers, attending continually upon this very thing.

djk_text: Da pai ala san poti fu pai lanti. Gi a lantimoni na a fasi di dati poti. Gi ala taa sowtu moni na a fasi di dati poti. Gi lesipeki na a fasi di de fu dati. Gi gaandi na a fasi di de fu dati.
eng_text: Render therefore to all their dues: tribute to whom tribute is due; custom to whom custom; fear to whom fear; honour to whom honour.

djk_text: Ná oli paiman di de fu gi! Oli namo taki, i mu gi taawan lobi enke fa Masaa Gadu wani. Bika lobi taawan, na dati en weiti wani.
eng_text: Owe no man any thing, but to love one another: for he that loveth another hath fulfilled the law.

djk_text: Bika weiti di a gi Mosesi taki: “Ná waka gi yu uman ofu man. Ná kii taawan. Ná fufuu taawan. Ná abi takuu losutu a taawan sani.” Da ala den weiti de e soi fu lobi taawan. Lobi, na fu du gi taawan, enke san i wani fi iseefi.
eng_text: For this, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not kill, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness, Thou shalt not covet; and if there be any other commandment, it is briefly comprehended in this saying, namely, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

djk_text: Noiti lobi e du ogii anga taawan. Libi sowan fasi, da na fa a hii weiti fu Masaa Gadu e taki dati.
eng_text: Love worketh no ill to his neighbour: therefore love is the fulfilling of the law.

djk_text: Bika fusutan san de fu kon nownow. Seeka fu dati, enke sani e kon miti sama, fu dyombo en puu en a siibi. Kelestesi de, fu kon baka anga ala bun di Masaa Gadu paamisi wi. Dati koosube moo di u be bigin biibi nyunyun.
eng_text: And that, knowing the time, that now it is high time to awake out of sleep: for now is our salvation nearer than when we believed.

djk_text: Bika a takuu ten ya gwe faawe kaba, fu Kelestesi mu kon doo. Enke te neti gwe faawe kaba, fu dei doo. Da kaba libi enke fa neti dunguu moi, fu kibii du ogii. Libi enke fa dei kiin moi, fu si bun di yu e du.
eng_text: The night is far spent, the day is at hand: let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and let us put on the armour of light.

djk_text: Libi enke fa dei kiin moi fu si yu e waka leti. Ná diingi duungu, fu lontu anga takitaki, a kulu. Ná waka gi yu uman ofu man. Ná teke sikin, fu du sani, di de fu kai sen sani. Ná kwali meke toobi. Ná abi takuu losutu a taawan sani.
eng_text: Let us walk honestly, as in the day; not in rioting and drunkenness, not in chambering and wantonness, not in strife and envying.

djk_text: Bika i libi mokisa anga Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi, fu teke a fasi fi en. Da puu denki a fa takuu losutu e tyai sama libisama fasi, enke fa u be gwenti libi switi useefi ati namo.
eng_text: But put ye on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make not provision for the flesh, to fulfil the lusts thereof.

djk_text: Son biibiwan abi a swaki fasi, fu san fiti ofu san á fiti. Ma teli den ete, sondee fu poli anga den. Sitee seefi á mu de a u mindii, fu dati.
eng_text: Him that is weak in the faith receive ye, but not to doubtful disputations.

djk_text: Taawan sa denki kina á de fu nyanyan sani. Ma taawan abi a swaki fasi taki, kina de fu nyan sani enke meti so. Da ai nyan guluntu namo.
eng_text: For one believeth that he may eat all things: another, who is weak, eateth herbs.

djk_text: Ma sama di kina á de gi, mu kaba soso taawan di nái denki enke den. Sama di e denki kina de seefi, mu kaba kaagi den di e denki kina á de. Bika na Masaa Gadu teke denseefi, e kai osu sama fi en.
eng_text: Let not him that eateth despise him that eateth not; and let not him which eateth not judge him that eateth: for God hath received him.

djk_text: Da sama ná abi leti, fu go a wan taawan osu, fu go kuutu a taawan de wookoman? Na a basi di abi den wookoman, e si sowtu wookoman e piisii en. Na soseefi, da wi Masaa taanga, fu meke den taawan waka piisii Masaa Gadu tu.
eng_text: Who art thou that judgest another man's servant? to his own master he standeth or falleth. Yea, he shall be holden up: for God is able to make him stand.

djk_text: Da wan sa denki, dei abi kina fu oli enke weiti. Taawan sa denki, dei ná abi kina fu oli enke weiti. Da meke ibiiwan denki san enseefi e si fiti, fu teke wooko sondee fu go muliki taawan di nái denki enke en.
eng_text: One man esteemeth one day above another: another esteemeth every day alike. Let every man be fully persuaded in his own mind.

djk_text: Bika fu wan sama poti wan dei, fu gi Masaa daa, da ai si dati fu gi Masaa Gadu gaandi. Efu wan taawan poti taki, kina á de fu son meti, da ai si dati fu gi Masaa Gadu gaandi. Efu wan poti taki, kina de, da ai si dati fu gi Masaa Gadu gaandi. Da ibiiwan e gi Masaa Gadu daa anga fi en fasi.
eng_text: He that regardeth the day, regardeth it unto the Lord; and he that regardeth not the day, to the Lord he doth not regard it. He that eateth, eateth to the Lord, for he giveth God thanks; and he that eateth not, to the Lord he eateth not, and giveth God thanks.

djk_text: Bika a libi á de fu wan sama seefi. A dede seefi á de fu wan sama seefi.
eng_text: For none of us liveth to himself, and no man dieth to himself.

djk_text: Libi anga dede na fu tyai gaandi gi wi Masaa. Bika ne en wawan e fiti ala dati poti, gi wi. Da na fu gafa en namo anga a libi, go doo dede seefi.
