eng_text: Do ye not know that they which minister about holy things live of the things of the temple? and they which wait at the alter are partakers with the alter?

djk_text: Na so Masaa fiti poti gi wi di e tyai a Bun Nyunsu. U mu fende solugu a sama di e teke biibi a dati.
eng_text: Even so hath the Lord ordained that they which preach the gospel should live of the gospel.

djk_text: Ma mi nái luku fu u solugu mi. Winsi fa mi abi pasi fu dati seefi. Da fa mi sikiifi ya baka á de fu suku dati tu. A moo betee mi dede! Bika mi á wani poli awan kodo bun nen di mi abi fu gafa.
eng_text: But I have used none of these things: neither have I written these things, that it should be so done unto me: for it were better for me to die, than that any man should make my glorying void.

djk_text: Bika fa mi e gi a Bun Nyunsu ya, ma mi á poi gafa miseefi anga en. Bika na Kelestesi kisi mi poti fu du a wooko ya namo namo. Da heelu fu mi, efu mi á du en!
eng_text: For though I preach the gospel, I have nothing to glory of: for necessity is laid upon me; yea, woe is unto me, if I preach not the gospel!

djk_text: Bika efu mi be e du a wooko ya anga miseefi wani, da mi be o teke paiman fi en. Ma kweti! Na Kelestesi sende mi. Da na mi wooko di mi musu fu du.
eng_text: For if I do this thing willingly, I have a reward: but if against my will, a dispensation of the gospel is committed unto me.

djk_text: Ma luku a paiman fu di mi e tyai a Bun Nyunsu ya. Na di mi e du a wooko ya sondee fu suku san mi abi pasi fu teke. Da dati e gi mi piisii.
eng_text: What is my reward then? Verily that, when I preach the gospel, I may make the gospel of Christ without charge, that I abuse not my power in the gospel.

djk_text: Ma mi á de a dwengi taki, sama na mi basi fu a wooko ya. Ma toku miseefi poti miseefi fu wooko piisii ala sama. Da mi sa wini onmen mi poi meke kon toon biibisama.
eng_text: For though I be free from all men, yet have I made myself servant unto all, that I might gain the more.

djk_text: Da te mi doo Dyusama, da mi e oli miseefi Dyu, fu wini son fu den. Weiti nái wooko a mi tapu. Ma te mi doo sama anga weiti fasi, da mi e oli miseefi weiti fasi tu, fu wini son fu den de.
eng_text: And unto the Jews I became as a Jew, that I might gain the Jews; to them that are under the law, as under the law, that I might gain them that are under the law;

djk_text: Te mi doo taa foluku sondee weiti fasi, da mi e oli miseefi sondee weiti fasi tu, fu wini son fu den. Ma dati nái wani taki, mi e kaba anga a tuutuu weiti fa Kelestesi leli wi libi.
eng_text: To them that are without law, as without law, (being not without law to God, but under the law to Christ,) that I might gain them that are without law.

djk_text: Soseefi, te mi doo biibiwan di swaki libisama fasi ete, da mi nái du sani enke mi sabi moo den. Na so mi e wooko ala fasi gi ala sowtu sama, fu yeepi onmen mi poi wini gi Kelestesi.
eng_text: To the weak became I as weak, that I might gain the weak: I am made all things to all men, that I might by all means save some.

djk_text: Ala a wooko ya na fu a Bun Nyunsu sa go doo ala sama. Da mi anga den makandii sa fende den dyendee seigi di Masaa Gadu paamisi.
eng_text: And this I do for the gospel's sake, that I might be partaker thereof with you.

djk_text: Ma somen sama e tiingi a lo fu sitee lon. Ma na wan kodo namo o toon winiman fu a gaan paiman. Da meke moiti seefi, fu wini a gaan paiman ya.
eng_text: Know ye not that they which run in a race run all, but one receiveth the prize? So run, that ye may obtain.

djk_text: Sama di o go sitee lon e seeka bun, fu wai son sani di ai losutu poti a wanse fosi. Ma na fu wini gowtu ati wei a ede, di á de fu wei tego. Wiseefi mu wai son sani di wi e losutu poti wan se, fu wini a gowtu ati fu wei tego.
eng_text: And every man that striveth for the mastery is temperate in all things. Now they do it to obtain a corruptible crown; but we an incorruptible.

djk_text: Mi ya seefi e meke moiti! Mi nái lon enke mi lasi pasi daai lontu enke mi nái si pe fu lon go wini. Mi nái feti enke kofuman di kofu e kai a soso peesi, fu naki a winta.
eng_text: I therefore so run, not as uncertainly; so fight I, not as one that beateth the air:

djk_text: Kweti! Mi e dwengi losutu fu sikin, fu dati á wooko enke basi a mi tapu. Da a ná o de taki, mi leli somen sama fende Masaa Gadu paamisi, ma miseefi lasi a gaan winiman paiman.
eng_text: But I keep under my body, and bring it into subjection: lest that by any means, when I have preached to others, I myself should be a castaway.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Pakisei wi avo gaansama. U sabi fa ala den be waka makandii komoto a saafu a Egepte Kondee anga Mosesi! Masaa Gadu poti wan woluku a den fesi a tapu, fu kibii den. A piiti a ze a mindii dee wan pasi fu waka abaa.
eng_text: Moreover, brethren, I would not that ye should be ignorant, how that all our fathers were under the cloud, and all passed through the sea;

djk_text: Ne ala den pasa anga a woluku a ini a ze wataa. Na so den dopu toon sama fu Mosesi.
eng_text: And were all baptized unto Moses in the cloud and in the sea;

djk_text: Masaa Gadu solugu ala den anga wan apaiti sowtu nyanyan di ai towe ibii neti komoto a tapu wan foondoo sowtu jeje fasi.
eng_text: And did all eat the same spiritual meat;

djk_text: A poti wan apaiti sowtu siton fu wataa lon wan foondoo sowtu jeje fasi, fu fende diingi. Dati be de Kelestesi seefi di be e waka anga den na ala pe den e go.
eng_text: And did all drink the same spiritual drink: for they drank of that spiritual Rock that followed them: and that Rock was Christ.

djk_text: Ma toku a moo gaanse fu den á tyai denseefi piisii Masaa Gadu. Na dati meke a hii sabana doti be tiingi ala se anga dedewan fu den di kai fika de.
eng_text: But with many of them God was not well pleased: for they were overthrown in the wilderness.

djk_text: A hii toli de meke fu wasikoi wi nownow, fu luku bun! Bika fu sani á mu waka so anga wi, da wi á mu meke takuu losutu tyai wi du ogii enke den.
eng_text: Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things, as they also lusted.

djk_text: Meke wi á dini falisi gadu enke somen fu den. Bika Masaa Gadu Buku sikiifi taki: “A foluku poti enseefi fu nyan diingi fesa gi falisi gadu. Den e opo dansi fanya fanya tu.”
eng_text: Neither be ye idolaters, as were some of them; as it is written, The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.

djk_text: We, meke wi á teke motyo fasi enke son fu den. Ne Masaa Gadu be mu kii twenti a dii dunsu (23.000) fu den a ini wan dei namo.
eng_text: Neither let us commit fornication, as some of them committed, and fell in one day three and twenty thousand.

djk_text: Meke wi á tesi Masaa enke somen fu den. Ne a be mu puu sineki go nyan den kii.
eng_text: Neither let us tempt Christ, as some of them also tempted, and were destroyed of serpents.

djk_text: Meke wi á kaagi a Masaa yesi enke somen fu den. Ne a be sende wan Engel fi en go kii den kaba a soso.
eng_text: Neither murmur ye, as some of them also murmured, and were destroyed of the destroyer.

djk_text: Ala den sani de pasa, fu wasikoi wi san u á mu du. Ne Masaa Gadu meke den sikiifi fika gi wi, na a pisi yuu ten pe goontapu de fu kaba ya!
eng_text: Now all these things happened unto them for ensamples: and they are written for our admonition, upon whom the ends of the world are come.

djk_text: Bika son sama sa denki taki, a taampu taanga a ini biibi. Ma luku bun! Tesi e suku fu towe i puu a Masaa Gadu pasi.
eng_text: Wherefore let him that thinketh he standeth take heed lest he fall.

djk_text: Ma den tesi ya á taanga moo san taa libisama e tyai. Soseefi Masaa Gadu de fitoow fasi fu meke dati á sa bigi pasa u. Ai meke wan pasi tu, fu waka pasa tesi.
eng_text: There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it.

djk_text: Mi lobi biibiwan! Na dati meke, wai a pasi gi falisi gadu!
eng_text: Wherefore, my dearly beloved, flee from idolatry.

djk_text: Mi sikiifi a sani ya fu taki anga u enke sama anga fusutan. Da teke den keli luku efu na tuu.
eng_text: I speak as to wise men; judge ye what I say.

djk_text: Luku fa wi e membee a dede fu Kelestesi. Makandii wi e teke wan kan win diingi gi daa, fu membee en buulu di mokisa wi ala. Wi e teke wan beele nyan gi daa, fu membee en sikin di mokisa wi ala.
eng_text: The cup of blessing which we bless, is it not the communion of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, is it not the communion of the body of Christ?

djk_text: Da fa na wan beele namo wi e booko pisipisi nyan e soi fa wi ala na awan kodo sikin fu Kelestesi. Winsi fa wi ipi seefi, ma ibiiwan na wan pisi fu a sikin.
eng_text: For we being many are one bread, and one body: for we are all partakers of that one bread.

djk_text: Biibiwan! A ini Islayeli Kondee, da Dyusama e kii meti begi Masaa Gadu. Da ala sama di nyan dati mokisa anga Masaa Gadu di abi a apaiti begi tafaa, pe den kii dati.
eng_text: Behold Israel after the flesh: are not they which eat of the sacrifices partakers of the alter?

djk_text: We, mi á wani taki, falisi gadu de wan sani. Meti di kii fu nyan begi falisi gadu seefi á de wan sani tu.
eng_text: What say I then? that the idol is any thing, or that which is offered in sacrifice to idols is any thing?

djk_text: Ma sabi taki, meti di kii fu nyan begi falisi gadu, na wan sani fu dini takuu jeje. Da fa dati á de gi Masaa Gadu, da mi á wani u mokisa useefi anga en.
eng_text: But I say, that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to devils, and not to God: and I would not that ye should have fellowship with devils.

djk_text: Bika wi e diingi awan kodo kan win fu membee Masaa. Da fa u sa mokisa dati fu nyan sani di poti enke paiman gi takuu jeje?
eng_text: Ye cannot drink the cup of the Lord, and the cup of devils: ye cannot be partakers of the Lord's table, and of the table of devils.

djk_text: Bika, da u e dwengi Masaa, fu dyalusu. Ma fa u denki, u si enke u taanga moo Masaa, fu poi kibii gi en sitaafu?
eng_text: Do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? are we stronger than he?

djk_text: Bika mi ya komoto a katibo, fu poi du ala san mi wani. Ma ala san mi wani du á bun fu tyai yeepi gi taawan.
eng_text: All things are lawful for me, but all things are not expedient: all things are lawful for me, but all things edify not.

djk_text: Da meke ibiiwan á suku fu wooko fu yeepi en wawan namo. Ma san yu e du mu poi yeepi wan taawan.
eng_text: Let no man seek his own, but every man another's wealth.

djk_text: Luku fa wenkii lai anga meti fu bai nyan. Da bai nyan seefi sondee fu konsensi piki yu taki, na meti di kii fu nyan begi falisi gadu.
eng_text: Whatsoever is sold in the shambles, that eat, asking no question for conscience sake:

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu Buku sikiifi taki: “Na Masaa Gadu abi goontapu anga ala san fuu en.”
eng_text: For the earth is the Lord's, and the fulness thereof.

djk_text: We, da sama di á de biibisama sa kai yu a tee. Go nyan efu yu wani. Winsi san den puu gi yu, nyan sondee konsensi piki yu taki, na meti di kii fu nyan begi falisi gadu.
eng_text: If any of them that believe not bid you to a feast, and ye be disposed to go; whatsoever is set before you, eat, asking no question for conscience sake.

djk_text: Ma efu wan sama bali piki yu taki: “Na meti di kii fu nyan begi falisi gadu, yu e nyan!” Da ná nyanmi en, fu lesipeki a sama de anga ala en konsensi.
eng_text: But if any man say unto you, This is offered in sacrifice unto idols, eat not for his sake that shewed it, and for conscience sake: for the earth is the Lord's, and the fulness thereof:

djk_text: Mi á wani taki, na di fi yuseefi konsensi fu lesipeki de. Ma na di fu a taawan. Winsi i taki, yu á de a katibo! I sa nyan a sani! Sama konsensi ná abi leti fu kaagi den fu dati.
eng_text: Conscience, I say, not thine own, but of the other: for why is my liberty judged of another man's conscience?

djk_text: I gi Masaa Gadu daa kaba fu nyan a sani. Da sama á mu poi kaagi yu taki, i e nyan wan sani di á bun!
eng_text: For if I by grace be a partaker, why am I evil spoken of for that for which I give thanks?

djk_text: Ma yee ya! Winsi san de fu nyan ofu diingi ofu du seefi, meke a waka fu taawan sa poi gi Masaa Gadu gaandi.
eng_text: Whether therefore ye eat, or drink, or whatsoever ye do, do all to the glory of God.

djk_text: Ma ná du sani fu bangula taawan tyai futu go naki. Winsi na Dyusama ofu taa foluku ofu na a kulu biibiwan fu Masaa Gadu seefi.
eng_text: Give none offence, neither to the Jews, nor to the Gentiles, nor to the church of God:

djk_text: Wooko enke fa mi nái suku fu du wan enkii sani di mu yeepi miseefi namo. Ma na fu yeepi ala taawan, meke Masaa Gadu sa puu denseefi a takuudu anga ogii tu.
eng_text: Even as I please all men in all things, not seeking mine own profit, but the profit of many, that they may be saved.

djk_text: We, da tiiki a fasi fu mi enke fa mi tiiki fu Kelestesi.
eng_text: Be ye followers of me, even as I also am of Christ.

djk_text: Mi e gafa u dise, fa u e membee ala den fasi fu mi de. Soseefi u teke fu waka anga fa mi be leli u.
eng_text: Now I praise you, brethren, that ye remember me in all things, and keep the ordinances, as I delivered them to you.

djk_text: Ma mi wani leli u tu taki, Kelestesi na a ede fu ibii manengee. Masaa Gadu na a ede fu Kelestesi. Ibii manengee na a ede fi en uman.
eng_text: But I would have you know, that the head of every man is Christ; and the head of the woman is the man; and the head of Christ is God.

djk_text: Da manengee á mu wei sani tapu en ede, te ai begi. Soseefi te a de apaiti takiman a den taawan mindii. Bika, da ai gi en ede sen anga dati.
eng_text: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonoureth his head.

djk_text: Ma na uman mu wei sani tapu en ede, te ai begi. Soseefi, te a de apaiti takiman a den taawan mindii. Bika a sa gi en ede sen sondee dati. A poti enseefi enke manengee di de piipii ede sondee sani tapu dati.
eng_text: But every woman that prayeth or prophesieth with her head uncovered dishonoureth her head: for that is even all one as if she were shaven.

djk_text: Bika efu uman á wani wei sani tapu en ede, da meke a go pii en ede fika sondee uwii tu. Ma efu dati na wan sen sani gi wan uman, da meke a tapu en ede de.
eng_text: For if the woman be not covered, let her also be shorn: but if it be a shame for a woman to be shorn or shaven, let her be covered.

djk_text: Bika na manengee á mu wei sani tapu en ede. Da ai soi fa Masaa Gadu meke en, fu soi en dyendee fasi taki, sani á de ne en tapu. Ma a uman meke fu soi dyendee fi en man. Da a mu tapu en ede soi taki, en man de ne en tapu.
eng_text: For a man indeed ought not to cover his head, forasmuch as he is the image and glory of God: but the woman is the glory of the man.

djk_text: Bika a ná wan pisi sikin fu a uman Masaa Gadu be teke meke a man. Ma na wan pisi sikin fu a man a be teke meke a uman.
eng_text: For the man is not of the woman; but the woman of the man.

djk_text: Soseefi a man á be meke fu de enke yeepi fi en uman. Ma na a uman be meke fu de enke yeepi fi en man.
eng_text: Neither was the man created for the woman; but the woman for the man.

djk_text: Na so meke uman mu abi wan sani di tapu en ede, fu soi taki, ai hei en man poti ne en tapu. Da den Engel di lontu wi seefi sa si fa ai tyai enseefi gi en man sowan fasi.
eng_text: For this cause ought the woman to have power on her head because of the angels.

djk_text: Ma enke sama di mokisa libi anga Masaa, da a man fanowdu en uman leti enke fa a uman fanowdu en man.
eng_text: Nevertheless neither is the man without the woman, neither the woman without the man, in the Lord.

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu be teke wan pisi sikin fu a man meke a uman, ma na uman e meke man ya tu. Na so ala sani komoto a Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: For as the woman is of the man, even so is the man also by the woman; but all things of god.

djk_text: Da useefi teke a hii sani ya luku wegi luku efu a bun fu uman á mu wei sani tapu en ede, te ai begi.
eng_text: Judge in yourselves: is it comely that a woman pray unto God uncovered?

djk_text: Goontapu libi seefi e soi wi taki, te wan man kweki langa uwii, da ai tan wan fasi enke sani fu sen.
eng_text: Doth not even nature itself teach you, that, if a man have long hair, it is a shame unto him?

djk_text: Ma uman anga langa uwii e fende gaandi fu dati. Na so a meke fu tyai langa uwii enke a sani di mu tapu en ede.
eng_text: But if a woman have long hair, it is a glory to her: for her hair is given her for a covering.

djk_text: Da sama sa wani sitee anga a toli ya! Ma u mu luku taki, ala taa kulu biibi lontu wi e gi den man gaandi sowan fasi. Den á gwenti du taa fasi.
eng_text: But if any man seem to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither the churches of God.

djk_text: We, mi wani leli u wan sani ya. Bika mi á poi gafa u fa u e du en anda. U e poti nyanyan fu nyan diingi membee Masaa, ma a nái waka fu yeepi taawan. U e du ogii anga taawan de.
eng_text: Now in this that I declare unto you I praise you not, that ye come together not for the better, but for the worse.

djk_text: A fosi sani mi yee dise taki, te u kon makandii so, da onmen sowtu paitei sama e sidon de anga paati fasi. We, mi e si enke fu wan pisi, da ai waka so tuu.
eng_text: For first of all, when ye come together in the church, I hear that there be divisions among you; and I partly believe it.

djk_text: Bika paati fasi mu de a biibiwan mindii. Da u sa si sowtu wan fu u na tuutuu biibiwan.
eng_text: For there must be also heresies among you, that they which are approved may be made manifest among you.

djk_text: We, te u poti nyanyan makandii, fu nyan diingi membee Masaa, da a nái waka enke na Masaa u e nyan diingi fu membee tuutuu.
eng_text: When ye come together therefore into one place, this is not to eat the Lord's supper.

djk_text: Bika ibiiwan e teke san enseefi tyai kon sondee fu paati anga taawan. Da pootiwan e fika anga angii de. Ma taawan fende nyan fuu bee, te diingi duungu seefi!
eng_text: For in eating every one taketh before other his own supper: and one is hungry, and another is drunken.

djk_text: Da fa u peefuu du so? Bika u abi osu fu nyan diingi fuu bee fosi u kon de. U á be abi fu kon du dati a mindii fu Masaa Gadu sama, fu gi pootiwan sen? U wani soi taki, u hei moo den? Fa mi mu taki a sani ya? Mi á poi gafa u!
eng_text: What? have ye not houses to eat and to drink in? or despise ye the church of God, and shame them that have not? What shall I say to you? shall I praise you in this? I praise you not.

djk_text: Bika Masaa seefi be leli mi ya, fa a nyan beele, diingi win membee a dede di a be teke. Meke mi leli u dati baka ya. Luku a neti di Judasi be o konkuu en. Da a be teke wan beele namo wai kon, fu ala den nyan makandii.
eng_text: For I have received of the Lord that which also I delivered unto you, That the Lord Jesus the same night in which he was betrayed took bread:

djk_text: Namo a gi daa, da ai booko a beele pisipisi paati. Da ai taki: “A beele ya na mi sikin fu nyan. Da u e membee fa a teke dede pai a u peesi. Tan nyanmi en naamo seefi, fu membee a wooko di mi du de.”
eng_text: And when he had given thanks, he brake it, and said, Take, eat: this is my body, which is broken for you: this do in remembrance of me.

djk_text: Di den kaba nyan, ne a teke wan kan win poti taki: “A kan win ya na mi buulu fu diingi. Da u e membee fa a lon fu Masaa Gadu meke wan nyun kuudei wooko anga sama fi en. Tan diingi en naamo seefi, fu membee a wooko di mi du de.”
eng_text: After the same manner also he took the cup, when he had supped, saying, This cup is the new testament in my blood: this do ye, as oft as ye drink it, in remembrance of me.

djk_text: We, da ibii leisi u nyan diingi dati, da u e membee fa Masaa meke a nyun kuudei di e soi goontapu a dede fi en, te enke a sa daai kon baka.
eng_text: For as often as ye eat this bread, and drink this cup, ye do shew the Lord's death till he come.

djk_text: Da luku bun fu sama á nyan dati wan fasi di á fiti. Bika, da yu du wan gaan ogii anga a sikin fu Masaa, soseefi a buulu fi en. Da yu o kisi sitaafu.
eng_text: Wherefore whosoever shall eat this bread, and drink this cup of the Lord, unworthily, shall be guilty of the body and blood of the Lord.

djk_text: Ma meke ibiiwan keli enseefi luku fosi a nyan a beele anga diingi fu a kan win ya.
eng_text: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of that bread, and drink of that cup.

djk_text: Bika ibii sama sa nyan diingi. Ma sabi taki, a sa toon wan kaagi gi yu a Masaa Gadu, efu yu nái membee a sikin fu Kelestesi na a fasi di fiti.
eng_text: For he that eateth and drinketh unworthily, eateth and drinketh damnation to himself, not discerning the Lord's body.

djk_text: Na so meke somen biibiwan a u mindii de e siki anga ala swaki so. A tyai dede gi somen de kaba seefi.
eng_text: For this cause many are weak and sickly among you, and many sleep.

djk_text: Ma wegi yuseefi luku fosi i nyan. Da Masaa Gadu á sa abi fu kaagi yu sowan fasi, fu gi sitaafu.
eng_text: For if we would judge ourselves, we should not be judged.

djk_text: Sitaafu di a o gi fu dati seefi na fu dwengi yu poti fa a wani. Da yu á sa fende sitaafu tego makandii anga goontapu sama di á wani teke biibi.
eng_text: But when we are judged, we are chastened of the Lord, that we should not be condemned with the world.

djk_text: We, da biibiwan! Nyan makandii fu membee a dede fu Masaa. Ma tan luku taawan, fu nyan makandii de.
eng_text: Wherefore, my brethren, when ye come together to eat, tarry one for another.

djk_text: Efu na fu angii wan sama wani nyan, da meke a nyan a osu fosi. Da a sa wai gi Masaa Gadu sitaafu, fu a takuu fasi de a den taawan mindii. Kwolon! Mi tapu de fosi. Te mi doo u anda, mi sa leli u den taa taa sani fu a toli ya.
eng_text: And if any man hunger, let him eat at home; that ye come not together unto condemnation. And the rest will I set in order when I come.

djk_text: Biibiwan! U be sende akisi mi, fa fu den apaiti taanga fu a Jeje. We, mi wani u fusutan a sani ya bun.
eng_text: Now concerning spiritual gifts, brethren, I would not have you ignorant.

djk_text: U seefi sabi fa u be tan fosi u be teke biibi. U be gwenti lasi pasi go dini falisi gadu di ná abi libi.
eng_text: Ye know that ye were Gentiles, carried away unto these dumb idols, even as ye were led.

djk_text: Ma kon sabi taki, noiti sama di a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu e tii sa poi kosi ofu fuuku Jesesi. Noiti sama sa poi taki, na Jesesi na a Masaa tu, sondee fu a Apaiti Jeje ya meke a poi.
eng_text: Wherefore I give you to understand, that no man speaking by the Spirit of God calleth Jesus accursed: and that no man can say that Jesus is the Lord, but by the Holy Ghost.

djk_text: Da Masaa Gadu gi u sowtu a sowtu apaiti taanga fu wooko. Ma a Jeje di poti den gi u, na awan seefi Jeje ete.
eng_text: Now there are diversities of gifts, but the same Spirit.

djk_text: A gi somen apaiti sowtu wooko fu du. Ma na a seefi Masaa e gi den.
eng_text: And there are differences of administrations, but the same Lord.

djk_text: A gi somen apaiti taanga fu wooko. Ma na a seefi Masaa Gadu e du sani sowtu a sowtu fasi a ini wi so.
eng_text: And there are diversities of operations, but it is the same God which worketh all in all.

djk_text: Da a Jeje ya e puu kon a kiin sowtu apaiti taanga a gi ibiiwan, fu wooko. Da ibii yuu dati e de fu yeepi taawan.
eng_text: But the manifestation of the Spirit is given to every man to profit withal.

djk_text: Bika ai gi son wan apaiti taanga fu koni fu taki sani wan leti fasi. Ai gi taawan fu sabi taki Masaa Gadu bosikopu.
eng_text: For to one is given by the Spirit the word of wisdom; to another the word of knowledge by the same Spirit;

djk_text: Ai gi taawan fu biibi taanga. Taawan ai gi fu deesi sowtu a sowtu siki. Ma na a seefi jeje e gi den.
eng_text: To another faith by the same Spirit; to another the gifts of healing by the same Spirit;

djk_text: Taawan ai gi fu du foondoo sani. Taawan ai gi fu de apaiti takiman. Taawan fu poi tesi sowtu jeje e wooko. Taawan fu taki sowtu a sowtu tongo taki. Taawan fu fusutan tongo taki.
eng_text: To another the working of miracles; to another prophecy; to another discerning of spirits; to another divers kinds of tongues; to another the interpretation of tongues:

djk_text: Ma na awan kodo seefi Jeje e gi somen apaiti makiti fu wooko so. Da ai paati gi ibiiwan san a wani dati mu du apaiti fasi.
eng_text: But all these worketh that one and the selfsame Spirit, dividing to every man severally as he will.

djk_text: Bika luku fa sama sikin abi sowtu a sowtu pisi. Ma a hii sikin de wan kodo sikin namo. Na so sama fu Masaa Gadu de somen, ma na awan kodo sikin fu Kelestesi namo dati.
eng_text: For as the body is one, and hath many members, and all the members of that one body, being many, are one body: so also is Christ.

djk_text: Bika u de somen sama, da u de somen sowtu fasi. Taawan na Dyu, taawan á de Dyu. Taawan na saafu a katibo, taawan á de saafu a katibo. Ma a seefi Jeje teke peesi a ini ibiiwan fu wi, ne a mokisa wi ala toon wan sikin, di u teke dopu.
eng_text: For by one Spirit are we all baptized into one body, whether we be Jews or Gentiles, whether we be bond or free; and have been all made to drink into one Spirit.

djk_text: Bika wan sama sikin á meke anga wan kodo pisi namo. Ma a de pisi fu pisi.
eng_text: For the body is not one member, but many.

djk_text: Ma futu á poi taki, fa a á de ana, da a á poi teli enke a sikin.
eng_text: If the foot shall say, Because I am not the hand, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?

djk_text: Yesi á poi taki, fa a á de ain, da a á poi teli enke a sikin.
eng_text: And if the ear shall say, Because I am not the eye, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?

djk_text: Bika efu ala a sikin na be ain, da fa a be o poi yee sani? Efu ala a sikin na be yesi, da fa a be o poi sumee sani?
eng_text: If the whole body were an eye, where were the hearing? If the whole were hearing, where were the smelling?

djk_text: We, na Masaa Gadu meke a sikin anga sowtu a sowtu pisi so. Ne a poti ibiiwan a pe fu a sikin a wani.
eng_text: But now hath God set the members every one of them in the body, as it hath pleased him.

djk_text: Bika efu ala a sikin be meke anga wan kodo pisi namo, da fa a be sa de fu kai wan hii sikin?
eng_text: And if they were all one member, where were the body?

djk_text: Ma fa a de, da na somen pisi a sikin abi. Ma na wan kodo sikin namo de ape.
eng_text: But now are they many members, yet but one body.

djk_text: Da ain á poi taki, a ná abi ana fanowdu. Ede seefi á poi taki, a ná abi futu fanowdu.
eng_text: And the eye cannot say unto the hand, I have no need of thee: nor again the head to the feet, I have no need of you.

djk_text: Ma pisi fu a sikin di soi swaki seefi moo de fanowdu gi a sikin.
eng_text: Nay, much more those members of the body, which seem to be more feeble, are necessary:

djk_text: Wi e moo wei koosi gi pisi fu a sikin di u e buuse taki, den á lesipeki fu si. Pisi fu a sikin di e takuu na ain, da wi e moo wei moi sani gi dati.
eng_text: And those members of the body, which we think to be less honourable, upon these we bestow more abundant honour; and our uncomely parts have more abundant comeliness.

djk_text: Ma moi pisi fu a sikin ná abi fanowdu fu wei sani gi so. Bika Masaa Gadu sete a sikin na a fasi taki, den di e soi lagi a sama ain mu moo gi lesipeki.
eng_text: For our comely parts have no need: but God hath tempered the body together, having given more abundant honour to that part which lacked:

djk_text: Na so ala pisi fu a sikin sa fii taki, taawan nái teli bigi moo taawan. Da ibiiwan sa booko ede yeepi a taawan enke fa ai yeepi enseefi.
eng_text: That there should be no schism in the body; but that the members should have the same care one for another.

djk_text: Efu wan pisi e fii pen, da ala taa pisi e fii pen anga en. Efu wan pisi e fende gafa, da ala taa pisi e fii piisii anga en.
eng_text: And whether one member suffer, all the members suffer with it; or one member be honoured, all the members rejoice with it.

djk_text: Da wi na a sikin fu Kelestesi. Ibiiwan na wan pisi fu a sikin ya.
eng_text: Now ye are the body of Christ, and members in particular.

djk_text: Masaa Gadu gi wi somen sowtu apaiti taanga fu wooko. A fosi peesi, fu de apaiti bosikopuman. Bakadati, apaiti takiman. Bakadati, apaiti leliman. Taawan fu du foondoo sani. Taawan fu deesi sowtu a sowtu siki. Taawan fu poi yeepi taawan. Taawan fu tii sani. Taawan fu taki sowtu a sowtu tongo.
eng_text: And God hath set some in the church, first apostles, secondarily prophets, thirdly teachers, after that miracles, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, diversities of tongues.

djk_text: Ma ibiiwan wooko á de fu de apaiti bosikopuman. Ibiiwan wooko á de fu de apaiti takiman. Ibiiwan wooko á de fu de apaiti leliman. Ibiiwan wooko á de fu poi du foondoo sani.
eng_text: Are all apostles? are all prophets? are all teachers? are all workers of miracles?

djk_text: Ibiiwan wooko á de fu poi deesi sowtu a sowtu siki. Ibiiwan wooko á de fu poi taki tongo. Ibiiwan wooko á de fu poi fusutan tongo, fu taigi taawan.
eng_text: Have all the gifts of healing? do all speak with tongues? do all interpret?

djk_text: Ma meke ibiiwan feti fu Masaa Gadu gi en apaiti taanga, fu du wooko di moo de fanowdu. Ma anga ala dati, da luku seefi san na a leti fasi fu wooko anga taawan.
eng_text: But covet earnestly the best gifts: and yet shew I unto you a more excellent way.

djk_text: Bika winsi mi sabi apaiti tongo di sama ofu Engel e taki seefi, ma mi de sondee tuutuu lobi. Da mi wowtu sa gei soso gengen anga boko beenki, fu bali muliki sama yesi.
eng_text: Though I speak with the tongues of men and of angels, and have not charity, I am become as sounding brass, or a tinkling cymbal.

djk_text: A ná abi toobi, efu mi na wan apaiti takiman. Efu Masaa Gadu soi mi ala kibii toli fi en. Efu mi sabi ala san de fu sabi. Efu mi biibi bigi fu toto gaan mongo puu a pasi. Ma sondee tuutuu lobi, da mi na wan soso sani.
eng_text: And though I have the gift of prophecy, and understand all mysteries, and all knowledge; and though I have all faith, so that I could remove mountains, and have not charity, I am nothing.

djk_text: Efu mi e paati ala san mi abi fu soso seefi. Efu mi towe mi sikin boon a faya gi taawan seefi. Ma sondee tuutuu lobi, da mi na wan soso sani.
eng_text: And though I bestow all my goods to feed the poor, and though I give my body to be burned, and have not charity, it profiteth me nothing.

djk_text: Bika tuutuu lobi e gi langa pasensi fasi. Ai gi switi fasi. Ai tapu dyalusu, ai tapu suku gafanen, ai tapu hei membee.
eng_text: Charity suffereth long, and is kind; charity envieth not; charity vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up,

djk_text: Tuutuu lobi e kaba saanti taawan. Ai tapu suku wini fi i wawan namo. Ai tapu gaw atiboon fasi ofu oli taawan na ati.
eng_text: Doth not behave itself unseemly, seeketh not her own, is not easily provoked, thinketh no evil;

djk_text: Te sani nái waka leti, da tuutuu lobi e wai piisii poti a wanse. Ma ai gi piisii te sani e go tuutuu, enke fa sani mu waka.
eng_text: Rejoiceth not in iniquity, but rejoiceth in the truth;

djk_text: A ini ala sani, da tuutuu lobi e kibii taawan. Ai biibi naamo. Ai luku naamo a san de fende. Ai fudaagi naamo tu.
eng_text: Beareth all things, believeth all things, hopeth all things, endureth all things.

djk_text: Tuutuu lobi noiti e kaba. Ma fu de apaiti takiman sa kaba wan dei. Sowtu a sowtu tongo taki seefi sa kaba tu. Apaiti sabi fu Masaa Gadu bosikopu seefi tu.
eng_text: Charity never faileth: but whether there be prophecies, they shall fail; whether there be tongues, they shall cease; whether there be knowledge, it shall vanish away.

djk_text: Bika na nownow u á kaba sabi ala san de fu sabi. Bosikopu fu apaiti takiman seefi nái kaba soi kiinkiin san de fu kon bakaten seefi.
eng_text: For we know in part, and we prophesy in part.

djk_text: Ma a ten o doo di ala san Masaa Gadu meke fu tan tego sa soi denseefi kiinkiin enke fa den de seefi. Da u sa kaba denki den sani wan fasi di á kaba doo peesi.
eng_text: But when that which is perfect is come, then that which is in part shall be done away.

djk_text: Bika pikinengee ten fu wan sama, da ai taki sani pikinengee fasi. Ai denki sani pikinengee fasi. Ma te a toon manengee, da ala a pikinengee fasi e kon kaba.
eng_text: When I was a child, I spake as a child, I understood as a child, I thought as a child: but when I became a man, I put away childish things.

djk_text: Da goontapu ya, da na wan difii fasi enke bwuingi kai a sipikii fesi, na so wi e si san Masaa Gadu fiti poti fu kon. Da sani nái kaba de kiinkiin a den peesi. U nái kaba si sani enke fa den de seefi. Ma bakaten, da ala sani o de fesi a fesi. Da fa Masaa Gadu e si mi tuutuu, na so mi o si ala sani.
eng_text: For now we see through a glass, darkly; but then face to face: now I know in part; but then shall I know even as also I am known.

djk_text: Da luku ya! Dii sani fika gi wi fu du nownow. Fu biibi. Soseefi luku fu fende Masaa Gadu paamisi anga fu lobi tuutuu. Ma a moo gaanwan fu den dii dati na fu lobi tuutuu.
eng_text: And now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.

djk_text: We, da feti fu wooko anga tuutuu lobi. Ma suku den apaiti taanga di a Jeje e gi tu. Moomoo fu de wan apaiti takiman.
eng_text: Follow after charity, and desire spiritual gifts, but rather that ye may prophesy.

djk_text: Bika sama di e taki a wan tongo di a Apaiti Jeje gi en, nái taki anga libisama. Ma anga Masaa Gadu wawan ai taki. Bika taa sama nái fusutan san ai taki. Na a Apaiti Jeje gi en kibii toli fu taki.
eng_text: For he that speaketh in an unknown tongue speaketh not unto men, but unto God: for no man understandeth him; howbeit in the spirit he speaketh mysteries.

djk_text: Ma a apaiti takiman dati e taki sani di taawan e fusutan. Da ai yeepi den, fu kon moo taanga. Ai bali den puu a sani di á bun. Soseefi ai gi taanga sikin anga koo ati na a biibi.
eng_text: But he that prophesieth speaketh unto men to edification, and exhortation, and comfort.

djk_text: Ma a sama di e taki a wan taa tongo di a Apaiti Jeje e gi en, da ne en wawan di e taki namo e kon taanga. Ma a apaiti takiman, e yeepi a hii kulu biibiwan fu den kon taanga tu.
eng_text: He that speaketh in an unknown tongue edifieth himself; but he that prophesieth edifieth the church.

djk_text: We, mi be sa wani fu u ala fiya be fende wan taa tongo na a Apaiti Jeje fu taki. Ma a be sa moo bun fu u be de wan apaiti takiman. Bika wan apaiti takiman e moo tyai yeepi gi taa sama. Boiti efu wan sama de ape anga apaiti taanga, fu puu den tongo taki gi taawan.
eng_text: I would that ye all spake with tongues, but rather that ye prophesied: for greater is he that prophesieth than he that speaketh with tongues, except he interpret, that the church may receive edifying.

djk_text: Bika biibiwan! Efu mi kon a u kon e taki taa tongo taki, sondee fu u sabi san mi e taki, da on yeepi seefi mi be sa tyai kon gi u anga dati? A moo bun mi kon taigi u wan sani di Masaa Gadu puu kon a kiin gi mi. Efu ná so, mi kon soi u wan sani fi en di u á be sabi ete. Soseefi, fu mi leli u, taigi u san mi sabi.
eng_text: Now, brethren, if I come unto you speaking with tongues, what shall I profit you, except I shall speak to you either by revelation, or by knowledge, or by prophesying, or by doctrine?

djk_text: Sani enke foiti ofu gitali di den e pee poku ná abi tongo fu taki. Ma i sa sabi sowtu singi den e pee a den. Bika gitali anga foiti nái piki a seefi fasi. Ma efu yu sabi pee den kiin, da taawan e sabi a singi di yu e pee.
eng_text: And even things without life giving sound, whether pipe or harp, except they give a distinction in the sounds, how shall it be known what is piped or harped?

djk_text: Soseefi tu, efu a tutu á piki kiin, da den suudati ná o sabi taki, den mu seeka fu opo go a feti.
eng_text: For if the trumpet give an uncertain sound, who shall prepare himself to the battle?

djk_text: Na so a sa waka anga u tu, efu u e taki tongo di sama nái fusutan. A de leti enke yu e taki anga winta.
eng_text: So likewise ye, except ye utter by the tongue words easy to be understood, how shall it be known what is spoken? for ye shall speak into the air.

djk_text: Bika goontapu lai anga sowtu a sowtu tongo. Ma ibiiwan de fu sama di sabi dati sa fusutan.
eng_text: There are, it may be, so many kinds of voices in the world, and none of them is without signification.

djk_text: Ma efu mi anga wan sama de, ne mi á sabi a tongo fi en, da te a o taki, da mi ná o fusutan san ai taki. Da a de taki, mi nái fusutan a sama di e taki. Ma soseefi tu, a sama di e taki nái fusutan mi tu.
eng_text: Therefore if I know not the meaning of the voice, I shall be unto him that speaketh a barbarian, and he that speaketh shall be a barbarian unto me.

djk_text: Na so meke a bun fu suku den apaiti taanga di a Jeje e gi. Ma suku moomoo den apaiti taanga di sa yeepi den sama fu Masaa Gadu, fu den sa taampu moo taanga.
eng_text: Even so ye, forasmuch as ye are zealous of spiritual gifts, seek that ye may excel to the edifying of the church.

djk_text: A dati meke efu wan sama e taki a wan tongo di sama nái fusutan, da a mu begi Masaa Gadu, fu Masaa Gadu gi en koni, fu a sa puu a tongo taki de kon a kiin gi sama, fu den fusutan.
eng_text: Wherefore let him that speaketh in an unknown tongue pray that he may interpret.

djk_text: Bika efu mi e begi a wan tongo di sama nái fusutan, da mi jeje e begi Masaa Gadu tuu, ma mi seefi nái fusutan.
eng_text: For if I pray in an unknown tongue, my spirit prayeth, but my understanding is unfruitful.

djk_text: Da fa a mu de seefi? Mi o begi anga mi jeje, ma mi o begi anga mi fusutan tu. Mi o singi anga mi jeje, ma mi o singi fu sama sa fusutan mi tu.
eng_text: What is it then? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also: I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.

djk_text: Bika efu yu gi Masaa Gadu daa anga yu jeje namo, da fa den taawan di de ape o de wan anga yu, fu bali: “Amen, na so a de!” Bika a á sabi san yu e taki.
eng_text: Else when thou shalt bless with the spirit, how shall he that occupieth the room of the unlearned say Amen at thy giving of thanks, seeing he understandeth not what thou sayest?

djk_text: Bika a yu gi daa bun, ma toku seefi a á tyai yeepi gi den taawan di nái fusutan, fu den kon taampu moo taanga na a biibi.
eng_text: For thou verily givest thanks well, but the other is not edified.

djk_text: We, mi e gi Masaa Gadu daa, fu di mi sa taki taa tongo di sama nái fusutan moo u ala de.
eng_text: I thank my God, I speak with tongues more than ye all:

djk_text: Ma te mi de a biibiwan mindii, da a moo betee, fu mi taki feifi wowtu namo di sama sa fusutan, fu den leli sani. Moo enke mi taki dunsu dunsu wowtu a wan tongo di ná wan sama poi fusutan.
eng_text: Yet in the church I had rather speak five words with my understanding, that by my voice I might teach others also, than ten thousand words in an unknown tongue.

djk_text: Biibiwan! U kaba anga pikinengee fasi. Ma na a se fu sabi du ogii, da u mu de enke pikinengee. Ma na se fu bunbun fusutan, da u mu de enke gaansama.
eng_text: Brethren, be not children in understanding: howbeit in malice be ye children, but in understanding be men.

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu Buku sikiifi a fesi taki: “Mi Masaa Gadu ya, o sende taa kondee sama kon taki anga den sama ya. Soseefi mi o sende sama kon di o taki anga den a taa tongo tu. Ma toku, den ná o teke mi taki fu biibi.”
eng_text: In the law it is written, With men of other tongues and other lips will I speak unto this people; and yet for all that will they not hear me, saith the Lord.

djk_text: U sa si de fa taki tongo taki á de wan foondoo maiki gi sama di e biibi. Ma a de gi den di nái biibi. Na apaiti takiman de gi den di e biibi. Ma a ná gi sama di nái biibi.
eng_text: Wherefore tongues are for a sign, not to them that believe, but to them that believe not: but prophesying serveth not for them that believe not, but for them which believe.

djk_text: Bika meke sama di nái biibi anga swaki biibiwan seefi kon doo a ini a miti makandii fu u enke a kulu fu Masaa Gadu sama de, da u ala e taki tongo taki, da u sa si! Den o denki, na buuya taki, u e taki.
eng_text: If therefore the whole church be come together into one place, and all speak with tongues, and there come in those that are unlearned, or unbelievers, will they not say that ye are mad?

djk_text: Ma meke u ala wooko enke apaiti takiman de, da u sa si! A taki de o kai doo dipi fu den ati, meke den membee ogii fu denseefi.
eng_text: But if all prophesy, and there come in one that believeth not, or one unlearned, he is convinced of all, he is judged of all:

djk_text: Da a kibii pisi fu den ati o kon a doo, fu denseefi si. Da den o kai anga kini begi Masaa Gadu. Soseefi den o si taki, Masaa Gadu de a u mindii de tuu.
eng_text: And thus are the secrets of his heart made manifest; and so falling down on his face he will worship God, and report that God is in you of a truth.

djk_text: We, biibiwan! Fa sani mu waka te u kon makandii? U bali singi towe. Teke Masaa Gadu sani leli. Taki san Masaa tyai kon a kiin gi yu de. Taki tongo taki. Puu dati taigi taawan. Ma ala sani mu waka fu yeepi u ala.
eng_text: How is it then, brethren? when ye come together, everyone of you hath a psalm, hath a doctrine, hath a tongue, hath a revelation, hath an interpretation. Let all things be done unto edifying.

djk_text: Da meke tu, te dii sama namo bali tongo taki. Ma den á mu taki dyabaadya. Da taawan mu de ape anga apaiti makiti fu fusutan tongo taki taigi taawan.
eng_text: If any man speak in an unknown tongue, let it be by two, or at the most by three, and that by course; and let one interpret.

djk_text: Ma efu ná wan sama abi apaiti makiti fu fusutan tongo taki taigi taawan, da u á mu taki taanga fu taawan yee. Ma taki saafi fi yu anga Masaa Gadu wawan.
eng_text: But if there be no interpreter, let him keep silence in the church; and let him speak to himself, and to God.

djk_text: Meke tu ofu dii apaiti takiman namo taki. Da meke taawan keli luku efu na Masaa Gadu bosikopu tuu.
eng_text: Let the prophets speak two or three, and let the other judge.

djk_text: Ma efu wan sama e aliki, ne Masaa tyai sani kon a kiin gi en na a seefi yuu de, da meke di be e taki tapu mofu fosi.
eng_text: If any thing be revealed to another that sitteth by, let the first hold his peace.

djk_text: Meke den apaiti takiman á taki dyabaadya. Ma du en wan fu wan a taawan baka. Da taawan sa fende wan sani leli de. Taawan sa fende wan sani fu opo waka go doo anga a biibi.
eng_text: For ye may all prophesy one by one, that all may learn, and all may be comforted.

djk_text: Bika a Jeje di e gi makiti fu de apaiti takiman nái subi yu fu a taki mu komoto sondee yuseefi wani.
eng_text: And the spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets.

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu á de wan buuya Gadu. Ma sani fi en e waka switi fasi. Luku ibii taa peesi pe Masaa Gadu sama e kon makandii. Meke sani waka a u de so tu.
eng_text: For God is not the author of confusion, but of peace, as in all churches of the saints.

djk_text: Uman á mu sete takitaki de, ma a mu saka enseefi anga ala tan pii de. Na so Masaa Gadu weiti taki, fu dati.
eng_text: Let your women keep silence in the churches: for it is not permitted unto them to speak; but they are commanded to be under obedience, as also saith the law.

djk_text: Efu a uman wani sabi wan sani, da meke a akisi en man dati a osu. Bika na wan takuu sani fu uman e takitaki a ini a kon makandii fu Masaa Gadu sama.
eng_text: And if they will learn any thing, let them ask their husbands at home: for it is a shame for women to speak in the church.

djk_text: U aliki mi! Na sama tyai Masaa Gadu bosikopu kon gi u de. A ná u bigin a wooko fu paati dati. Soseefi, a ná u wawan namo a bosikopu ya doo tu.
eng_text: What? came the word of God out from you? or came it unto you only?

djk_text: Da sama sa denki taki, en na apaiti takiman a den taawan mindii ofu Masaa Gadu gi en apaiti taanga fu wooko. Ma sabi taki, ala san mi sikiifi ya, na Masaa Gadu seefi soi mi, fu sikiifi den poti so gi u, fu teke wooko.
eng_text: If any man think himself to be a prophet, or spiritual, let him acknowledge that the things that I write unto you are the commandments of the Lord.

djk_text: Da efu wan sama poti den taki fu mi a wanse, da a á fiti fu taa sama teke dati taki tu.
eng_text: But if any man be ignorant, let him be ignorant.

djk_text: We, da biibiwan! Feti fu wooko enke apaiti takiman, ma ná tapu anga a taki fu tongo taki.
eng_text: Wherefore, brethren, covet to prophesy, and forbid not to speak with tongues.

djk_text: Ma meke ala sani waka wan fasi di fiti sondee buuya fasi.
eng_text: Let all things be done decently and in order.

djk_text: We, biibiwan! Mi o membee u baka san na a Bun Nyunsu di mi be gi u, te u be teke biibi. U teke dati kaba enke u fasi fu libi seefi.
eng_text: Moreover, brethren, I declare unto you the gospel which I preached unto you, which also ye have received, and wherein ye stand;

djk_text: Tan biibi dati fu kaba koti paati anga takuudu anga ogii, fu fende san Masaa Gadu paamisi. Ma efu u fika a biibi ya, da u sa lasi ala dati. Da na fu soso u be teke a biibi.
eng_text: By which also ye are saved, if ye keep in memory what I preached unto you, unless ye have believed in vain.

djk_text: Mi be taigi u somen sani fu a biibi. Ma a hii mama fu a Bun Nyunsu ya taki, Kelestesi kon teke dede pai a u peesi tuu. Da u sa fende paadon fu u takuudu anga ogii. Masaa Gadu Buku be sikiifi fu dati a fesi taki, sani o waka so.
eng_text: For I delivered unto you first of all that which I also received, how that Christ died for our sins according to the scriptures;

djk_text: Namo Kelestesi beli a ini wan geebi. Ma baka dii dei, ne Masaa Gadu weki en kon a libi ya baka tuu. Na so Masaa Gadu Buku sikiifi taki, sani o waka so.
eng_text: And that he was buried, and that he rose again the third day according to the scriptures:

djk_text: Namo Kelestesi soi enseefi libilibi a Kefasi enke wan fu den twalufu bakaman fi en. Bakadati, a soi enseefi na ala den twalufu makandii.
eng_text: And that he was seen of Cephas, then of the twelve:

djk_text: Bakadati, a soi enseefi libilibi a moo enke feifi ondoo taa biibiwan makandii a wan peesi. Somen fu den dati dede kaba, ma son fu den de leti a libi ya ete.
eng_text: After that, he was seen of above five hundred brethren at once; of whom the greater part remain unto this present, but some are fallen asleep.

djk_text: Bakadati, ne a soi enseefi libilibi a Jakowbesi enke wan fu den twalufu bakaman. Bakadati, ne a soi enseefi libilibi na ala den twalufu bakaman makandii.
eng_text: After that, he was seen of James; then of all the apostles.

djk_text: Te fu kaba, ne a soi enseefi libilibi a mi Pawlesi ya tu. Namo mi teke biibi wanboo wanboo enke te pikin yuu á be kisi fu meke.
eng_text: And last of all he was seen of me also, as of one born out of due time.

djk_text: Bika mi na wan apaiti bosikopuman di á waiti fu teli enke apaiti bosikopuman fi en. Bika mi be lon du gaan ogii anga a kulu sama fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: For I am the least of the apostles, that am not meet to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Gadu teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku mi. Ne mi de san mi de tide ya. Ma dati á waka fu soso. Bika somen sama toon biibisama, di mi tyotyo wooko moo ala taa apaiti bosikopuman fi en. A ná anga taanga fu miseefi libisama fasi. Ma anga gaan bun ati fasi namo di ai teke, fu wooko a ini mi anga en taanga.
eng_text: But by the grace of God I am what I am: and his grace which was bestowed upon me was not in vain; but I laboured more abundantly than they all: yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.

djk_text: Ma a ná abi toobi, efu na wan fu den taa apaiti bosikopuman gi u anda en bosikopu. Na a seefi bosikopu wi e tyai, di u teke biibi de.
eng_text: Therefore whether it were I or they, so we preach, and so ye believed.

djk_text: We, wi dati e tyai a bosikopu fa Kelestesi weki kon a libi ya baka. Da fa sama sa sitee anda taki, dede á poi weki kon a libi baka?
eng_text: Now if Christ be preached that he rose from the dead, how say some among you that there is no resurrection of the dead?

djk_text: Bika efu a dede á poi weki baka, da Kelestesi seefi á weki kon a libi baka!
eng_text: But if there be no resurrection of the dead, then is Christ not risen:

djk_text: Da efu Kelestesi á weki kon a libi baka, da wi ya e paati wan wisiwasi bosikopu. Da na fu soso u teke biibi anda tu.
eng_text: And if Christ be not risen, then is our preaching vain, and your faith is also vain.

djk_text: Da wi na leiman di e kotoigi falisi sani fu Masaa Gadu. Bika u taki, a weki Kelestesi kon a libi baka. Ma kweti! A be sa de wan lei sani, efu Masaa Gadu á be makiti sai fu weki dede baka. Da a á be o poi weki Kelestesi baka.
eng_text: Yea, and we are found false witnesses of God; because we have testified of God that he raised up Christ: whom he raised not up, if so be that the dead rise not.

djk_text: We, efu Masaa Gadu á makiti sai fu weki dede, da Kelestesi dede nownow ete.
eng_text: For if the dead rise not, then is not Christ raised:

djk_text: Da efu Kelestesi dede nownow ete, da wini á de fu fende a wi bosikopu di u anda teke biibi. Soseefi, da u á poi komoto a takuudu anga ogii tu.
eng_text: And if Christ be not raised, your faith is vain; ye are yet in your sins.

djk_text: Da biibisama di dede kaba, noiti moo o weki baka. Den lasi fu tego.
eng_text: Then they also which are fallen asleep in Christ are perished.

djk_text: Da fu a tyotyo di wi e teke a goontapu fu a biibi a ini ala san u e luku fu fende a Kelestesi ya. Ma fu sani fu dati á de fu kon moo, baka dede, da sama mu tyali gi wi enke den moo ogii ede sama di de.
eng_text: If in this life only we have hope in Christ, we are of all men most miserable.

djk_text: Ma a hii sani na tuutuu Kelestesi weki kon a libi ya baka. En fosi weki enke sama fu Masaa Gadu di noiti moo sa dede baka. Da sabi taki, ala taawan fu Masaa Gadu di dede musu weki so tu.
eng_text: But now is Christ risen from the dead, and become the firstfruits of them that slept.

djk_text: Bika wan kodo man namo be tyai dede kon a goontapu. Na so wan kodo man namo tyai libi kon baka.
eng_text: For since by man came death, by man came also the resurrection of the dead.

djk_text: Bika Adan enke fosi sowtu sama be wooko takuu. Ne a hii paansu sama di waka ne en baka fende dede enke paiman. Na so a Kelestesi wooko bun. Ne a hii paansu sama di waka ne en baka seefi fende libi tu.
eng_text: For as in Adam all die, even so in Christ shall all be made alive.

djk_text: Ma ibiiwan abi en yuu di Masaa Gadu poti gi en. Kelestesi fosi weki baka. Da a hii kulu sama fu Kelestesi, te a o kon baka.
eng_text: But every man in his own order: Christ the firstfruits; afterward they that are Christ's at his coming.

djk_text: Da na a kaba fu goontapu. Da Kelestesi o fika na ala sani tapu. Bika a o booko ala a makiti anga taanga fu goontapu puu. Da a sa sidon enke kownu. Bakadati, da a o langa a hii tii fu sani go a ini ana fi en Tata, Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Then cometh the end, when he shall have delivered up the kingdom to God, even the Father; when he shall have put down all rule and all authority and power.

djk_text: Bika a mu de kownu fu tii sani doo a ten di a sa kaba booko makiti fu ala feyanti fi en poti ne en ondoo futu.
eng_text: For he must reign, till he hath put all enemies under his feet.

djk_text: A mama feyanti di a mu booko puu ete seefi, dati na dede seefi.
eng_text: The last enemy that shall be destroyed is death.

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu Buku sikiifi taki, a poti Kelestesi na ala sani tapu. Ma dati á wani taki, Masaa Gadu seefi. Bika na Masaa Gadu gi en a hii bigi ya.
eng_text: For he hath put all things under his feet. But when he saith, all things are put under him, it is manifest that he is excepted, which did put all things under him.

djk_text: Da te Kelestesi kaba anga fi en se wooko taki, ala sani kon de ne en ondoo futu. Da a Manpikin fu Masaa Gadu ya o saka enseefi poti a ondoo fu Masaa Gadu, di be meke ala sani kon de na a Manpikin fi en ya ondoo futu. Da Masaa Gadu sa de a moo heiwan fu ala sani.
eng_text: And when all things shall be subdued unto him, then shall the Son also himself be subject unto him that put all things under him, that God may be all in all.

djk_text: We, efu dede nái weki baka, da saide son sama e biibi de taki, den sa teke dopu tyai yeepi gi sama fu den di dede kaba? Bika dati na biibi taki, sani de baka dede ete.
eng_text: Else what shall they do which are baptized for the dead, if the dead rise not at all? why are they then baptized for the dead?

djk_text: Saide meke wi enke apaiti bosikopuman e du a wooko ya, ma a sa tyai dede gi wi seefi?
eng_text: And why stand we in jeopardy every hour?

djk_text: Biibiwan! Mi ya dati, ogii lontu mi fu tyai dede gi mi seefi. Ma toku, mi de anga piisii a ini. Mi sa gafa a manii fu mi ya, fu di a tyai yeepi, meke u anda kon de sama fu wi Masaa, Kelestesi Jesesi seefi.
eng_text: I protest by your rejoicing which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.

djk_text: Bika u si fa pikinmoo sama meke takuu meti kii mi a Efese Foto. Da na bun fu goontapu mi e suku, fu tyai miseefi go so faawe? Bika fu Masaa Gadu ná o weki sama baka, “Da meke u nyan diingi piisii. Tamaa dede sa doo, fu ala sani kaba.”
eng_text: If after the manner of men I have fought with beasts at Ephesus, what advantageth it me, if the dead rise not? let us eat and drink; for to morrow we die.

djk_text: Ma ná meke sama koli yu! Ná mosoo anga poli sama. Bika winsi i be taampu bun, ma den o poli yuseefi tu.
eng_text: Be not deceived: evil communications corrupt good manners.

djk_text: Da poti ede leti fu si sani. Kaba anga takuudu anga ogii. Bika sama de leti a u mindii de di toku nái fusutan Masaa Gadu. Mi taki so, fu gi u sen!
eng_text: Awake to righteousness, and sin not; for some have not the knowledge of God: I speak this to your shame.

djk_text: Son sama o sitee de taki, dede fu weki baka, da fa den sikin o tan?
eng_text: But some man will say, How are the dead raised up? and with what body do they come?

djk_text: We, na wan lawlaw sani a sama de akisi de. Bika useefi e paandi sii anda. Da a nái loto poli a ondoo doti fosi, da a sutu ede kon a tapu, fu toon wan sani, no?
eng_text: Thou fool, that which thou sowest is not quickened, except it die:

djk_text: Soseefi u nái paandi a hii gaan bon fu sani enke kalu so. Ma na wan sii namo. Da fa a waka wan hii gaan kalu bon e goo kon komoto na a sii de?
eng_text: And that which thou sowest, thou sowest not that body that shall be, but bare grain, it may chance of wheat, or of some other grain:

djk_text: We, na Masaa Gadu e gi ibii sii wan sowtu bon di mu goo kon komoto de. Da ai goo enke fa a fiti poti gi en. Da ibii bon sikin abi en fasi.
eng_text: But God giveth it a body as it hath pleased him, and to every seed his own body.

djk_text: Soseefi ala sikin kengi anga denseefi. Libisama sikin anga meti sikin. Foo sikin anga fisi. Ibiiwan kengi.
eng_text: All flesh is not the same flesh: but there is one kind of flesh of men, another flesh of beasts, another of fishes, and another of birds.

djk_text: Masaa Gadu meke sani a tapu anda anga goontapu ya tu. Da den di fu tapu sikin e beenki kengi anga di fu goontapu ya.
eng_text: There are also celestial bodies, and bodies terrestrial: but the glory of the celestial is one, and the glory of the terrestrial is another.

djk_text: A san a tapu anda e beenki en fasi. A mun e beenki en fasi. Den sitali e beenki den fasi. Ma ibii sitali baka e beenki kengi anga a taawan.
eng_text: There is one glory of the sun, and another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars: for one star differeth from another star in glory.

djk_text: Na so di Masaa Gadu o weki dede baka. Da sikin di dede ya e beli loto poli, ma te a o weki baka, da a o toon sikin di noiti moo sa poi loto poli.
eng_text: So also is the resurrection of the dead. It is sown in corruption; it is raised in incorruption:

djk_text: Sikin fu tyai go beli e tan ogii sondee waiti fasi. Ma te a o weki baka, da a o toon dyendee sani. Sikin fu tyai go beli e swaki sondee kaakiti. Ma te a o weki baka, da a o toon taanga kaakiti sikin.
eng_text: It is sown in dishonour; it is raised in glory: it is sown in weakness; it is raised in power:

djk_text: Sikin fu tyai go beli de libisama fasi a goontapu. Ma a nyun sikin de fu libi jeje fasi a tapu anda. Da fa i si u fende sikin fu libi ya, na so u o fende a sikin fu libi a tapu anda tu.
eng_text: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body, and there is a spiritual body.

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu Buku sikiifi fu dati taki: “A fosi sowtu sama na Adan, di Masaa Gadu meke goontapu fasi ya.” Ma a kiiboi sowtu Sama na Kelestesi di de Masaa Gadu Kondee fasi, fu tyai a sowtu libi de gi taawan.
eng_text: And so it is written, The first man Adam was made a living soul; the last Adam was made a quickening spirit.

djk_text: Ma a fosi sowtu sikin fu sama á gei a jeje sowtu sikin fu tapu anda. Bika fa sikin di meke goontapu fasi fosi kon, da a jeje sowtu sikin fu Masaa Gadu Kondee musu kon tu.
eng_text: Howbeit that was not first which is spiritual, but that which is natural; and afterward that which is spiritual.

djk_text: A fosi sowtu sikin meke komoto a doti fu goontapu ya. Ma a lasiti sowtu sikin komoto a Masaa Gadu Kondee a tapu.
eng_text: The first man is of the earth, earthy: the second man is the Lord from heaven.

djk_text: Namo ibii paansu sama fu Adan enke fosi sowtu Sama fende a sowtu sikin fi en. Na so ibii paansu sama fu Kelestesi enke a kiiboi sowtu sama seefi o fende a sowtu sikin fi en tu.
eng_text: As is the earthy, such are they also that are earthy: and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.

djk_text: We, wi de anga a sowtu sikin fu tan a goontapu ya. Ma bakaten, da wi o de anga a sowtu sikin fu tan a Masaa Gadu Kondee a tapu.
eng_text: And as we have borne the image of the earthy, we shall also bear the image of the heavenly.

djk_text: We, biibiwan! Mi wani soi anga ala dati taki, sikin buba anga buulu, na fu loto poli. Noiti dati sa poi libi tego na a peesi pe noiti moo sani sa poi dede loto poli. Da a ná o poi fende a bun di de a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Now this I say, brethren, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God; neither doth corruption inherit incorruption.

djk_text: Luku ya! Masaa Gadu taigi mi wan bosikopu di noiti a be soi sama wanten. Da a be de wan kibii toli. A taki, somen fu wi ná o dede seefi, fosi wi ala faandi teke a nyun sowtu sikin.
eng_text: Behold, I shew you a mystery; We shall not all sleep, but we shall all be changed,

djk_text: Di a kaba yuu o doo, da wan Engel o boo wan tutu taki, ala sani kaba. Da fosi i pingi ain opo, da den dede biibiwan o weki anga wan hii nyun sowtu sikin. Da ala biibiwan di be de a libi ete seefi o faandi so tu.
eng_text: In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trump: for the trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and we shall be changed.

djk_text: Bika a sowtu sikin di poi dede mu faandi toon wan di noiti moo poi dede. Soseefi a sikin di poi loto poli mu faandi toon wan di noiti moo poi loto poli.
eng_text: For this corruptible must put on incorruption, and this mortal must put on immortality.

djk_text: Na so u sikin o faandi fu noiti moo poi dede loto poli. Da sani waka de enke fa Masaa Gadu Buku taki: “Dede komoto a pasi, fu tego. Na so gaan wini kon.”
eng_text: So when this corruptible shall have put on incorruption, and this mortal shall have put on immortality, then shall be brought to pass the saying that is written, Death is swallowed up in victory.

djk_text: Da gaan piisii bali o piki taki: “Dede! Yu á poi de winiman moo! Bika i fika sondee tifi, fu feele.”
eng_text: O death, where is thy sting? O grave, where is thy victory?

djk_text: Tuutuu! Dede abi tifi fu feele taki, u mu go kisi sitaafu fu wi takuudu anga ogii. Bika u á poi wooko anga weiti fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: The sting of death is sin; and the strength of sin is the law.

djk_text: Ma gaantangi fu Masaa Gadu! A sende wi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi kon teke dede pai fu wi takuudu anga ogii, meke u sa fende libi. Na so gaan wini kon gi wi.
eng_text: But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

djk_text: We, da lobi biibiwan! Da taampu taanga doo anga a biibi. Meke wan enkii sani á poi seke u puu a den sani fu Masaa Gadu! Ma wooko gi Masaa Gadu pasa peesi enke wookoman di á lesi. Sabi taki, dati noiti o de fu soso.
eng_text: Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.

djk_text: We, biibiwan! Mi o taki fu a moni di u e piki fu solugu pootiwan a Jelusalem Foto. Mi taigi biibiwan na a pisiwataa fu Galasiya kaba, fa dati mu waka. Useefi teke fu wooko so tu.
eng_text: Now concerning the collection for the saints, as I have given order to the churches of Galatia, even so do ye.

djk_text: A fosi dei fu a wiki, da poti pikinso moni di i fende fu a wiki go a wanse. Kibii dati sondee fu wooko anga en. Da te mi o doo de, da u ná abi fu fanya fanya suku moni, fu sende gi den sama fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Upon the first day of the week let every one of you lay by him in store, as God hath prospered him, that there be no gatherings when I come.

djk_text: Soseefi, suku wantu fitoow manengee a u mindii de. Da mi o kon naki sitampu poti den a wooko, fu biibiwan a Jelusalem Foto sa sabi taki, na den dati mi sende anga sani di u piki makandii, fu tyai yeepi gi den.
eng_text: And when I come, whomsoever ye shall approve by your letters, them will I send to bring your liberality unto Jerusalem.

djk_text: Soseefi, efu a mu de taki, mi seefi mu go anda, da den sa waka makandii anga mi go anda.
eng_text: And if it be meet that I go also, they shall go with me.

djk_text: Ma fosi mi doo u de, da a waka fu mi o lolo a somen peesi a ini a hii pisiwataa fu Masadoniya, fu go luku den sama anda fosi.
eng_text: Now I will come unto you, when I shall pass through Macedonia: for I do pass through Macedonia.

djk_text: Da te mi o doo u de, da mi sa tan wan hii pisiten anga u. Kande mi pasa a hii koo pisi fu a yali a u mindii de seefi. Da u sa poi yeepi mi seeka sani wanten, fu go moo faawe a pe mi o denki fu go bakadati.
eng_text: And it may be that I will abide, yea, and winter with you, that ye may bring me on my journey whithersoever I go.

djk_text: We, efu mi mu kon luku u de nownow, da mi ná o poi tan langa anga u. Bika na waka tapu mi o pasa u, fu wan satu pisi ten namo. Ma mi á wani so. Bika mi wani tan langa a u de, efu Masaa Gadu wani en so.
eng_text: For I will not see you now by the way; but I trust to tarry a while with you, if the Lord permit.

djk_text: Ma fa a de, da mi de a Efese Foto ya fosi, te enke Penkisite Fesa sa kai pasa.
eng_text: But I will tarry at Ephesus until Pentecost.

djk_text: Bika doo opo bigi gi mi a Efese Foto ya, fu tyai Masaa Gadu bosikopu paati. Ma fa pasi opo bigi gi mi, na so tyaipi sama taampu sete, fu tapu mi anga a wooko ya.
eng_text: For a great door and effectual is opened unto me, and there are many adversaries.

djk_text: We, Timotiyesi de a waka tapu nownow. Efu a doo u de, da u á mu libi wan fasi anga en. Ma solugu taki, a fii switi a u mindii. Bika na fa mi ya e wooko gi Masaa Gadu, na so enseefi tu.
eng_text: Now if Timotheus come, see that he may be with you without fear: for he worketh the work of the Lord, as I also do.

djk_text: Da sama á mu wooko ape anga en enke a nái de wan sani. Ma meke a komoto de baka anga wan switi ati. Bika mi de ya e luku en anga den taa biibi baala di e waka anga en, fu daai kon mi ya.
eng_text: Let no man therefore despise him: but conduct him forth in peace, that he may come unto me: for I look for him with the brethren.

djk_text: Ma on ten Apolos o kon luku u anda, mi á sabi. Na moo onmen leisi mi sende en kaba, fu du dati makandii anga den taa baala di e waka anga en. Ma ai fende naamo taki, a nái kon ete. We, fa i si a o fende a okasi fu kon anda bakaten, da a o kon.
eng_text: As touching our brother Apollos, I greatly desired him to come unto you with the brethren: but his will was not at all to come at this time; but he will come when he shall have convenient time.

djk_text: We, mi e wasikoi ete wan leisi taki, luku bun! Taampu taanga doo anga a biibi. Meke wan enkii sani á poi seke u. Noiti feele wan enkii sani tu.
eng_text: Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong.

djk_text: Membee naamo taki, meke ala san i teke fu du waka anga lobi.
eng_text: Let all your things be done with charity.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Ete wan sani mi wani sende u! U sabi Stefanasi anga den sama fi en osu taki, na den fosi teke biibi na a hii pisiwataa fu Akasi anda. Ne den poti den hii libi yeepi sama di Masaa Gadu poti apaiti fasi anda.
eng_text: I beseech you, brethren, (ye know the house of Stephanas, that it is the firstfruits of Achaia, and that they have addicted themselves to the ministry of the saints,)

djk_text: We, da teke den sowtu man de taki, den fiti fu teli enke edeman a u tapu. Soseefi teli ala taawan di e wooko makandii anga den tu.
eng_text: That ye submit yourselves unto such, and to every one that helpeth with us, and laboureth.

djk_text: Piisii moo mi ya di Stefanasi anga Footunatesi anga Akaikosi kon luku mi ya! Mi piisii anga den fu u anda peesi, di u á de ya kaba.
eng_text: I am glad of the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus: for that which was lacking on your part they have supplied.

djk_text: Bika den gi mi nyun kankan wan jeje fasi enke fa den e gi u anda tu. Da teli man enke den disi fu bigi!
eng_text: For they have refreshed my spirit and yours: therefore acknowledge ye them that are such.

djk_text: We, ala kulu biibiwan fu Masaa Gadu a den peesi lontu a hii pisi fu Asiya dise sende bigi odi gi u. Akwila anga en uman Pelesela anga biibiwan di e miti makandii a den osu seefi. Den ala na sama di e waka a Masaa baka makandii anga u anda.
eng_text: The churches of Asia salute you. Aquila and Priscilla salute you much in the Lord, with the church that is in their house.

djk_text: Ala Masaa Gadu sama dise e bali u anda odi. Bali ala biibiwan anda wan switi odi a ini a nen fu Masaa gi wi.
eng_text: All the brethren greet you. Greet ye one another with an holy kiss.

djk_text: We, a pisi biifi di e kon ya, na miseefi o teke a sikiifi tiki oli sikiifi taki, mi Pawlesi e sende bigi odi gi u anda tu.
eng_text: The salutation of me Paul with mine own hand.

djk_text: U yee ya! Sama di á lobi Masaa Gadu mu luku bun! Bika a poti wan gaan fuuku a den dati tapu. Mi e begi Masaa gaantangi taki, Masaa! Kon esi esi, baa! Dati na Malanata!
eng_text: If any man love not the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be Anathema Maranatha.

djk_text: Ma u ala anda dati, da Masaa Jesesi taampu anga u ala, fu teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku u de.
eng_text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

djk_text: Noti moo enke mi lobi u tuutuu. Bika u ala de fu Kelestesi Jesesi makandii de. Amen, na so a de!
eng_text: My love be with you all in Christ Jesus. Amen.

djk_text: Masaa Gadu poti mi Pawlesi ya toon apaiti bosikopuman fu Masaa Jesesi. Da mi sikiifi a biifi ya gi a hii kulu sama a Kolenti Foto di Masaa Gadu kai kon poti apaiti fasi enke sama fi en seefi. Ma a biifi mu doo kulu biibiwan fu Akasi tu. Mi anga wi lobi biibi baala Timotiyesi e sende odi.
eng_text: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timothy our brother, unto the church of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints which are in all Achaia:

djk_text: Meke u Tata, Masaa Gadu anga Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku u de. Soseefi, meke u ati de switi.
eng_text: Grace be to you and peace from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

djk_text: Bali gafa Masaa Gadu di de Gadu anga Tata fu wi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi. Bika na useefi Tata di abi tyali ati gi u enke pikin fi en. Ai koo wi ati naamo, fu biibi doo.
eng_text: Blessed be God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort;

djk_text: Ibii booko ede, da a taampu de fu koo wi ati. Da wiseefi e poi koo taawan ati baka anga san a du gi wi, te denseefi abi booko ede.
eng_text: Who comforteth us in all our tribulation, that we may be able to comfort them which are in any trouble, by the comfort wherewith we ourselves are comforted of God.

djk_text: Bika a libi fu Kelestesi a goontapu lai booko ede. Da wi enke sama fi en e fende booko ede fi en ede. Ma fi en ede tu meke Masaa Gadu e koo wi ati naamo.
eng_text: For as the sufferings of Christ abound in us, so our consolation also aboundeth by Christ.

djk_text: Da sabi taki, wi ya abi booko ede, ma na fu Masaa Gadu mu koo u anda ati tyai gaan bun gi u. Bika u anda abi booko ede enke wi ya. Da fa ai koo wi dise ati o koo u anda ati tu. Da u sa abi pasensi de.
eng_text: And whether we be afflicted, it is for your consolation and salvation, which is effectual in the enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer: or whether we be comforted, it is for your consolation and salvation.

djk_text: Wi abi a taanga denki ya. Bika u sabi taki, na fu a biibi ede meke u abi booko ede enke wi ya. Da Masaa Gadu o koo u de ati enke fa ai koo wi ya ati tu, fu biibi doo.
eng_text: And our hope of you is stedfast, knowing, that as ye are partakers of the sufferings, so shall ye be also of the consolation.

djk_text: Mi lobi biibiwan! Booko ede di wi ya be abi na a pisiwataa fu Asiya sa soi u anda san na banowtu. A be bigi te, ne u be denki kaba taki, u futu o komoto a goontapu!
eng_text: For we would not, brethren, have you ignorant of our trouble which came to us in Asia, that we were pressed out of measure, above strength, insomuch that we despaired even of life:

djk_text: A be soi enke Masaa Gadu dei be doo fu puu wi ya. Ma kweti! Na fu seefi a be fika wi fu si taki, efu u dede, da ne en wawan yeepi namo fika di poi weki dede baka.
eng_text: But we had the sentence of death in ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God which raiseth the dead:

djk_text: Soseefi a meke u si taki, a fika wi a dede mofu, ma a poi puu wi baka a ini ala dati sondee fu u dede. Da ibii tu fasi u sa poi denki anga fitoow taki, yeepi o komoto ne en namo doo wi.
eng_text: Who delivered us from so great a death, and doth deliver: in whom we trust that he will yet deliver us;

djk_text: Da u tan begi a yeepi ya gi wi dise, fu fende. Da moo sama o si dati, fu bali gafa Masaa Gadu, fa ai teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku wi ala.
eng_text: Ye also helping together by prayer for us, that for the gift bestowed upon us by the means of many persons thanks may be given by many on our behalf.

djk_text: Wi dise e gafa fa a o yeepi wi sowan fasi. Bika wi konsensi e piki wi taki, wi e libi leti anga sama. Moomoo u fu anda. Soseefi na sondee takuu fasi wi e libi, fu piisii en. A ná anga goontapu koni, ma ne en gaan bun ati fasi namo di a teke, fu yeepi wi anga dati.
eng_text: For our rejoicing is this, the testimony of our conscience, that in simplicity and godly sincerity, not with fleshly wisdom, but by the grace of God, we have had our conversation in the world, and more abundantly to you-ward.

djk_text: Da ala san wi e sikiifi sende gi u anda á taanga fu fusutan tu. Wi á kibii sani ya tu di wi á sikiifi. Da a ná wi ya meke u nái kaba fusutan ala dati de. Ma wi abi a taanga denki taki, dati o kengi namo.
eng_text: For we write none other things unto you, than what ye read or acknowledge; and I trust ye shall acknowledge even to the end;

djk_text: U o fusutan ala sani de namo. Da te Masaa Jesesi o kon baka, da u anda o poi poolo gafa fa wi dise be wooko. Wi ya seefi o poi poolo anga u de tu.
eng_text: As also ye have acknowledged us in part, that we are your rejoicing, even as ye also are ours in the day of the Lord Jesus.

djk_text: Mi be sabi kaba taki, mi anga u de bun so. Ne mi be poti kaba fu kon luku u de hii tu leisi seefi, fu moo tyai yeepi gi u.
eng_text: And in this confidence I was minded to come unto you before, that ye might have a second benefit;

djk_text: Te mi o de a pasi, fu gwe a Masadoniya anga te mi o daai komoto anda o de tu leisi mi tapu a u de. Da u sa seeka mi de anga san mi fanowdu na a waka, fu gwe a Judeja pisiwataa.
eng_text: And to pass by you into Macedonia, and to come again out of Macedonia unto you, and of you to be brought on my way toward Judaea.

djk_text: Da meke sama kaba denki de taki, mi paamisi so, ma mi o wooko goontapu fasi enke sama nái teli Masaa Gadu anga tu mofu taki. Den e piki taki, den o du so, da den kengi baka taki, den ná o du so moo.
eng_text: When I therefore was thus minded, did I use lightness? or the things that I purpose, do I purpose according to the flesh, that with me there should be yea yea, and nay nay?

djk_text: Bika ala yuu, da Masaa Gadu e du san a paamisi, meke sama sa fitoow en. Da meke wi seefi á taki, wi o du wan sani, ma wi e kengi baka taki, wi ná o du en moo. Kweti!
eng_text: But as God is true, our word toward you was not yea and nay.

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu Manpikin, Jesesi Kelestesi bosikopu di mi anga Silasi anga Timotiyesi paati doo u de nái waka enke sani fu meke sama pantan. Noiti en taki e kengi anga san a be paamisi kaba.
eng_text: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us, even by me and Silvanus and Timotheus, was not yea and nay, but in him was yea.

djk_text: Luku fa a be paamisi taki, a o sende a Kelestesi kon yeepi libisama. Namo a kon so tuu, meke u sa bali gafa en taki: “Amen !” Na so a de tuu enke fa a be paamisi.
eng_text: For all the promises of God in him are yea, and in him Amen, unto the glory of God by us.

djk_text: Da luku fa ai wooko anga wi ala tu. Ai yeepi wi anga u de makandii, fu taampu taanga a ini a mokisa libi anga Kelestesi. A kandi en apaiti fatu seeka u libi.
eng_text: Now he which stablisheth us with you in Christ, and hath anointed us, is God;

djk_text: Ne a sende en Jeje kon teke peesi a wi ati, enke wan sitampu di a naki a wi, fu soi taki, u na sama fi en. Soseefi enke a maiki fu soi taki, tuutuu u sa fende ala taa sani di de fu kon ete.
eng_text: Who hath also sealed us, and given the earnest of the Spirit in our hearts.

djk_text: Ma mi á kon a Kolenti Foto de ete enke fa mi be paamisi. Bika mi á wani kon taki hati fasi anga u de, fu san u e du de ete. Na dati tuu, mi e taki leti. Masaa Gadu ain de a mi tapu, meke mi á poi lei.
eng_text: Moreover I call God for a record upon my soul, that to spare you I came not as yet unto Corinth.

djk_text: Mi á wani kon anga wan taki de, fu meke u fii de enke wi ya e basi u anga a biibi. Na makandii wi ala mu taampu fu wooko anga a biibi, da piisii sa de a u de. Bika na biibi Kelestesi namo e meke u ala taampu taanga.
eng_text: Not for that we have dominion over your faith, but are helpers of your joy: for by faith ye stand.

djk_text: Na dati puu mi, fu mi á kon luku u de ete. Bika mi á wani kon taki taanga anga u de, fu sani mu waka baka enke a taa leisi, fu tyai buduufu.
eng_text: But I determined this with myself, that I would not come again to you in heaviness.

djk_text: Bika te mi meke u buduufu, da mi seefi e buduufu. Ma fu mi anga u mu buduufu makandii, da sama ná o de fu koi mi de.
eng_text: For if I make you sorry, who is he then that maketh me glad, but the same which is made sorry by me?

djk_text: Na so meke mi sikiifi piki u, pe fu kon taki a ogii di be pasa de. Da a sa seeka fosi mi kon, meke u di mu piisii mi ná o de fu buduufu mi. Mi sabi taki, u o du enke fa mi be soi na a biifi de, fu u sa piisii makandii.
eng_text: And I wrote this same unto you, lest, when I came, I should have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all, that my joy is the joy of you all.

djk_text: Bika na booko ede fu anda meke mi be sikiifi a biifi de, anga wataa ain seefi. Mi á be sikiifi en fu buduufu u, ma na fu be soi fa mi lobi u dipi pasa peesi.
eng_text: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote unto you with many tears; not that ye should be grieved, but that ye might know the love which I have more abundantly unto you.

djk_text: Bika a sama di be du a ogii de be buduufu u de moo mi ya seefi. A buduufu naki ibiiwan pikinso de. Mi taki na pikinso, bika mi á wani sutu faya baka na a toli ya.
eng_text: But if any have caused grief, he hath not grieved me, but in part: that I may not overcharge you all.

djk_text: Bika a sitaafu di gaanse fu u anda be fiti gi dati be sai gi en kaba.
eng_text: Sufficient to such a man is this punishment, which was inflicted of many.

djk_text: Da a doo peesi now fu gi en paadon, fu fende kankan bigin libi leti baka. Efu u á du so, tyali o moo en. Da a sa bigin denki taki, noiti moo paadon sa de gi en.
eng_text: So that contrariwise ye ought rather to forgive him, and comfort him, lest perhaps such a one should be swallowed up with overmuch sorrow.

djk_text: Da mi e begi u taki, u kai u seefi kon makandii baka, da u kai en poti sidon. Da u fiti taki, u seeka a toli fi en baka. U lobi en fu kon a u mindii baka.
eng_text: Wherefore I beseech you that ye would confirm your love toward him.

djk_text: Saide mi be sikiifi a biifi de tu taki, u be mu puu en a u mindii. Mi be wani keli u luku efu u e du ala san mi e akisi u fu du. We, ne u soi dati kaba.
eng_text: For to this end also did I write, that I might know the proof of you, whether ye be obedient in all things.

djk_text: Da mi e akisi u ya baka taki, gi en paadon. Da mi mokisa anga u de, fu dati. Fu mi se, a fende en kaba, fu san a be du anga mi dati. Mi á be teke en bigi kaba lasitan paadon fu gi en. Kelestesi e si fa mi du so, fu u sa si a mi fa fu du tu.
eng_text: To whom ye forgive any thing, I forgive also: for if I forgave any thing, to whom I forgave it, for your sakes forgave I it in the person of Christ;

djk_text: Da didibii á sa poi fende wini a u mindii de. Bika u ala sabi fa ai denki fu sutu faya a sani.
eng_text: Lest Satan should get an advantage of us: for we are not ignorant of his devices.

djk_text: Sabi taki doo be opo bigi gi mi a Towasi Foto pe mi be doo anga a Bun Nyunsu fu Kelestesi. Sama be lobi a toli ya fu teke anga ala piisii.
eng_text: Furthermore, when I came to Troas to preach Christ's gospel, and a door was opened unto me of the Lord,

djk_text: Ma saide mi ati á be kaba sidon de! Bika mi lobi biibi baala Titesi á be kon doo mi ete fu soi fa ai go anga u anda. Da mi be e booko ede fu u ede, meke mi be bali adyosi de pasa go doo Masadoniya.
eng_text: I had no rest in my spirit, because I found not Titus my brother: but taking my leave of them, I went from thence into Macedonia.

djk_text: We, gafa Masaa Gadu, fu di u mokisa libi anga Kelestesi. Ai tyai u lontu enke en gaan fesa pe ai soi goontapu fa a feti wini u teke. Na so wi e doo ala se anga en leli di e soi fa a de seefi, fu paati dati enke switi sumee gi en.
