eng_text: Now thanks be unto God, which always causeth us to triumph in Christ, and maketh manifest the savour of his knowledge by us in every place.

djk_text: Bika ai piisii fu si wi enke a switi fatu fu Kelestesi di a lobi fu tyatya doo en fesi. Ai doo sama o teke dati tu, fu fende libi tego anga sama ná o teke fu fende sitaafu tego.
eng_text: For we are unto God a sweet savour of Christ, in them that are saved, and in them that perish:

djk_text: Bika den di o fende sitaafu tego e teke en enke den sumee tingi dede sani. Ma den di o fende libi tego e teke dati enke den sumee switi sani. A wooko fu Masaa Gadu ya bigi pasa san libisama poi du.
eng_text: To the one we are the savour of death unto death; and to the other the savour of life unto life. And who is sufficient for these things?

djk_text: Bika wi ya nái waka paati dati enke sama di e lontu, fu meke moni. Ma enke wookoman di mokisa libi anga Kelestesi, da wi sabi fa Masaa Gadu ain de a wi tapu, fu si wi e paati en tuutuu bosikopu di a sende wi.
eng_text: For we are not as many, which corrupt the word of God: but as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God speak we in Christ.

djk_text: Kaba denki, wi e gafa useefi ya! Wi nái tyai a wooko ya anga lenti a pampila di sama maiki fu u mu soi taki, na Masaa Gadu bosikopu. U anda seefi u á fanowdu fu gi u a maiki de.
eng_text: Do we begin again to commend ourselves? or need we, as some others, epistles of commendation to you, or letters of commendation from you?

djk_text: Bika na u libi na a maiki fu soi fa na Masaa Gadu bosikopu wi e tyai. Sama sa si fa u anda libi kengi nyun. Na dati taawan mu fende leisi enke na wan pampila di taki, a libi ya maiki a u ati.
eng_text: Ye are our epistle written in our hearts, known and read of all men:

djk_text: U libi na san Kelestesi lenti fu soi enke maiki taki, a bosikopu di wi ya tyai kengi u. Da a á de pampila di sikiifi tiki maiki. Na a Jeje fi en teke u libi di á de siton fu maiki, ma sama sa fende leisi de taki, a libi ya de a u ati.
eng_text: Forasmuch as ye are manifestly declared to be the epistle of Christ ministered by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tables of stone, but in fleshy tables of the heart.

djk_text: Bika di u mokisa libi anga Kelestesi, ne ala dati waka so. U mu taki dati sondee pantan. Bika u sabi taki, na so Masaa Gadu seefi e si a toli ya.
eng_text: And such trust have we through Christ to God-ward:

djk_text: Wi enke libisama á be o poi du a wooko ya. Sani á de fu useefi be sa du te, da a be o doo peesi gi Masaa Gadu. Ne enseefi be abi fu wooko so anga wi.
eng_text: Not that we are sufficient of ourselves to think any thing as of ourselves; but our sufficiency is of God;

djk_text: A teke wi, fu soi a nyun fasi di a poti fu dini en. Dati á de fu leli wooko anga en weiti. Ma na a Jeje fi en kon wooko a wi. En weiti taanga fu oli meke u be fiti fu dede tego. Ma a Jeje gi taanga fu poi teke en taki fende libi tego.
eng_text: Who also hath made us able ministers of the new testament; not of the letter, but of the spirit: for the letter killeth, but the spirit giveth life.

djk_text: Bika a gaandi fasi fu dini en be sikiifi a siton gi Dyusama. Dati á be meke fu tan tego. Ma toku a be waka dyendee fasi kon a den. A be beenki Mosesi hii fesi te den á be poi luku en. Ma a be taanga fu oli, meke sama di e wooko anga dati fiti fu dede tego.
eng_text: But if the ministration of death, written and engraven in stones, was glorious, so that the children of Israel could not stedfastly behold the face of Moses for the glory of his countenance; which glory was to be done away:

djk_text: Ma a nyun fasi fu dini, da ne en Jeje kon gi taanga, fu poi teke en taki, soseefi fende paadon go doo libi tego. Da a wooko ya musu moo waka dyendee fasi kon a sama.
eng_text: How shall not the ministration of the spirit be rather glorious?

djk_text: Bika Mosesi wooko di waka kon dyendee fasi de bosikopu taki, sama á poi oli weiti, meke den fiti fu dede tego. Ma di a sende kon nownow e puu sama a takuudu anga ogii fende libi tego. Da a musu waka moo dyendee fasi kon a sama.
eng_text: For if the ministration of condemnation be glory, much more doth the ministration of righteousness exceed in glory.

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu bosikopu di Mosesi be e leli na a gaandi fasi fu dini en. Da dati be beenki en fesi dyendee fasi, ma a á be meke fu tan tego. Na di a sende kon nownow meke fu tan tego, da a musu moo bigi.
eng_text: For even that which was made glorious had no glory in this respect, by reason of the glory that excelleth.

djk_text: Di a be sende Mosesi fu leli sama dini en dati á be meke fu tan wooko dyendee fasi tego. Ma a be waka kon a sama dyendee fasi. Da di meke fu wooko dyendee fasi tego musu moo waka dyendee fasi kon.
eng_text: For if that which is done away was glorious, much more that which remaineth is glorious.

djk_text: Da u mu tan taki san Masaa Gadu paamisi wi. U mu e denki taanga fasi fu fende san a bosikopu de taki sondee pantan. Bika u sabi taki, dati noiti poi kengi.
eng_text: Seeing then that we have such hope, we use great plainness of speech:

djk_text: Da u ná abi fu du enke fa Mosesi be abi fu du. A be tapu a dyendee fasi fu Masaa Gadu ne en fesi, di á meke fu tan tego de seefi anga koosi. Da taa Dyusama ain á be sa kai ne en.
eng_text: And not as Moses, which put a vail over his face, that the children of Israel could not stedfastly look to the end of that which is abolished:

djk_text: Bika sama be taanga yesi fu fusutan te doo tide ete seefi, den e wooko anga a gaandi kuudei fu dini. Da ai tapu gi den, fu si pe a wani tii den go. Wan sani tapu dati gi den ete. Na biibi Kelestesi e wai a sani de puu.
eng_text: But their minds were blinded: for until this day remaineth the same vail untaken away in the reading of the old testament; which vail is done away in Christ.

djk_text: Ma enke tide, te Dyusama e wooko anga a gaandi fasi fu dini, da wan sani e tapu den fusutan go doo den ati seefi.
eng_text: But even unto this day, when Moses is read, the vail is upon their heart.

djk_text: Ma ibiiwan di daai biibi Masaa Jesesi, da na leti enke san be tapu a dyendee a Mosesi fesi wai komoto, fu meke a dyendee fu Masaa Gadu kon fu si.
eng_text: Nevertheless when it shall turn to the Lord, the vail shall be taken away.

djk_text: Bika wi Masaa seefi anga a Jeje di a sende kon nownow na a wan. Da te dati go a wan sama libi, da ai booko a taanga di weiti be abi fu wooko enke basi ne en tapu.
eng_text: Now the Lord is that Spirit: and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.

djk_text: Da sani á tapu wi enke biibiwan fesi moo, meke u libi sa soi Masaa Gadu dyendee. Bika ai kengi u moo anga moo gei Masaa Jesesi. Na so wi Masaa e wooko anga Jeje fi en di taanga.
eng_text: But we all, with open face beholding as in a glass the glory of the Lord, are changed into the same image from glory to glory, even as by the Spirit of the Lord.

djk_text: Na dati meke wi ya kon toon Masaa Gadu wookoman. Enseefi wooko tyali ati fasi gi u sani di useefi á poi wooko fu fende. Da noiti wi o lasi ati, fu booko saka anga a wooko ya. Kweti!
eng_text: Therefore seeing we have this ministry, as we have received mercy, we faint not;

djk_text: Wi e wooko leti naamo. U ná abi kibii takuu fasi fu gi useefi sen. U nái bendi a bosikopu taa fasi. U nái leli lei sani, ma na Masaa Gadu tuu taki. Da finga á poi soi kai wi falisi leliman. Masaa Gadu seefi ain e si fa wi e wooko leti.
eng_text: But have renounced the hidden things of dishonesty, not walking in craftiness, nor handling the word of God deceitfully; but by manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man's conscience in the sight of God.

djk_text: Bika sama di toku wi bosikopu kibii gi, da na den di á poi si a dyendee fi en, da den de fu go fende sitaafu tego a Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: But if our gospel be hid, it is hid to them that are lost:

djk_text: Didibii e ligei den di á wani teke dati. A tapu den fusutan, meke den á poi si a gaan dyendee fasi fu Kelestesi a ini a Bun Nyunsu, di e soi fa a de enke Masaa Gadu seefi.
eng_text: In whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of them which believe not, lest the light of the glorious gospel of Christ, who is the image of God, should shine unto them.

djk_text: Bika san wi ya e leli sama á de fu gi useefi gaandi. Na Kelestesi wi e soi taawan fu si fa a de Masaa, fu teke en taki. Wi ya na wookoman namo fu di enseefi sende u kon wooko gi u de.
eng_text: For we preach not ourselves, but Christ Jesus the Lord; and ourselves your servants for Jesus' sake.

djk_text: Na Masaa Gadu di bigin fu goontapu be kumandei a dunguu peesi fu kiin, meke dei booko. Ne en abi a bosikopu fu Kelestesi ya di a meke kiin u ati. Bika a soi wi Masaa Gadu dyendee de anga en libi.
eng_text: For God, who commanded the light to shine out of darkness, hath shined in our hearts, to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.

djk_text: A dyendee fi en de na gaan gudu, fu teke poti waiti fasi! Ma na u libi a mu fende waiti sai fu poti dati. Da a wooko enke sama kibii waiti sani fi en a ini soso tokotoko patu. Da a nái de taanga fu wi seefi moo.
eng_text: But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the excellency of the power may be of God, and not of us.

djk_text: Da winsi feyanti fu a biibi e fuka wi ala se, ma den nái poi booko wi saka. Sani wani buuya wi son leisi, ma wi nái feele enke yeepi á de.
eng_text: We are troubled on every side, yet not distressed; we are perplexed, but not in despair;

djk_text: Sama e lon du ogii anga u, ma noiti Masaa Gadu fika wi. Son leisi wi e mesaandi kisi mankei, ma wi á fika fu kii ete.
eng_text: Persecuted, but not forsaken; cast down, but not destroyed;

djk_text: U sabi fa Jesesi fende dede a sama, da dati sa teke u sikin tu. Ma u nái kaba libi so, fu soi taawan fa a de libilibi ete e gi u libisama fasi taanga, fu poi go doo.
eng_text: Always bearing about in the body the dying of the Lord Jesus, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our body.

djk_text: Bika u de ibii yuu koosube fu dede, fu biibi en ede. Bika na Masaa Gadu wani u mu libi so, fu soi taawan fa Jesesi e gi u libisama fasi taanga, fu poi go doo.
eng_text: For we which live are alway delivered unto death for Jesus' sake, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our mortal flesh.

djk_text: Da banowtu e tyai wi doo dede mofu. Ma na fu meke a sowtu libi fu wi ya mu poi waka doo yu de, fu fende libi tego.
eng_text: So then death worketh in us, but life in you.

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu Buku sikiifi taki: “Na biibi fi yu Masaa Gadu, meke mi e taki fi yu yeepi.” Na so wi e biibi nownow, meke wi ya seefi e taki fi en yeepi.
eng_text: We having the same spirit of faith, according as it is written, I believed, and therefore have I spoken; we also believe, and therefore speak;

djk_text: Bika wi sabi fa a weki Masaa Jesesi kon a libi ya baka. Ne wi mokisa weki anga en de fu doo makandii ne en fesi wan dei.
eng_text: Knowing that he which raised up the Lord Jesus shall raise up us also by Jesus, and shall present us with you.

djk_text: Da a hii tyotyo fu wi ya na fu yeepi u anda, fu meke moo sama yee fu biibi, fa ai teke gaan bun ati fasi namo, fu gi paadon. Da moo anga moo sama sa de tu, fu gi en daa, bali gafa gi en gaandi.
eng_text: For all things are for your sakes, that the abundant grace might through the thanksgiving of many redound to the glory of God.

djk_text: Da noiti wi o lasi ati booko saka. Sani sa tyai mankei a u sikin seefi, ma na doose fu sikin namo e wasi gwe. Ma inise e seeka dei fu dei kon taampu moo taanga.
eng_text: For which cause we faint not; but though our outward man perish, yet the inward man is renewed day by day.

djk_text: Bika u nái si a hii tyotyo fu wi ya bigi. Na fu wan satu pisiten namo, fu Masaa Gadu seeka gaan dyendee gi u ne en kondee anda, fu piisii tego. A paiman de o wegi a hii tyotyo ya.
eng_text: For our light affliction, which is but for a moment, worketh for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory;

djk_text: Da wai ain komoto na a hii tyotyo fu wan satu pisiten namo ya. Meke u sutu pakisei a den gaan dyendee di u o fende bakaten, ma den á de fu si ya ete. Dati o tan tego.
eng_text: While we look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen: for the things which are seen are temporal; but the things which are not seen are eternal.

djk_text: Bika u sabi fa u sikin de enke masanga a kampu di á meke fu libi tego. Dede e naki en booko, da u komoto gwe a tuutuu osu a kondee seefi. Dati na a nyun sikin di meke a tapu anda fu libi tego. A á de sama ana wooko.
eng_text: For we know that if our earthly house of this tabernacle were dissolved, we have a building of God, an house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.

djk_text: Ma fu de a ini a sikin ya, da u e dyeme. Bika u e angii fu go fende boo na a tuutuu osu a tapu anda. Wi o fende sani anda wei tapu useefi enke nyun sikin fu libi tego.
eng_text: For in this we groan, earnestly desiring to be clothed upon with our house which is from heaven:

djk_text: Bika a nyun sikin a tapu na wi osu fu teke wi anda. Na dati meke u ná o tan anda enke u mankei sani enke sikin fu wei tapu useefi. Kweti!
eng_text: If so be that being clothed we shall not be found naked.

djk_text: Wi sikin ya de enke masanga a kampu di á meke fu libi tego. Wi de a ini e dyeme e kusumi e tyotyo. U nái wani komoto go fika sondee sani fu wei tapu useefi enke sikin. Ma u e wani a nyun sikin, meke wi libisama fasi kengi toon sani fu libi tego.
eng_text: For we that are in this tabernacle do groan, being burdened: not for that we would be unclothed, but clothed upon, that mortality might be swallowed up of life.

djk_text: Na so Masaa Gadu meke wi enke sama fi en, fu luku den bun di de fu kon de. Da en Jeje di a sende kon teke peesi a wi, na a maiki fu soi wi taki, tuutuu u sa fende ala taa sani di de fu kon ete.
eng_text: Now he that hath wrought us for the selfsame thing is God, who also hath given unto us the earnest of the Spirit.

djk_text: Ai gi wi taanga biibi tu taki, Masaa Gadu o du ala dati wan dei namo. Ma solanga u de anga sikin fu goontapu, da u á doo a libi tego anda a wi Masaa ete.
eng_text: Therefore we are always confident, knowing that, whilst we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord:

djk_text: Ma u e libi ya anga fitoow ne en, winsi u á poi si dati anga ain ya ete.
eng_text: (For we walk by faith, not by sight:)

djk_text: Enke fa mi be taki kaba, u nái pantan a Masaa Gadu enke a ná o gi u ala dati. Wi e fende en moo bun tu, fu fika a sikin ya go teke a nyun sikin enke a tuutuu osu fu libi tego anga wi Masaa.
eng_text: We are confident, I say, and willing rather to be absent from the body, and to be present with the Lord.

djk_text: Na so meke wi e feti moo enke ala taa sani, fu libi piisii en anga ala san wi e du anga sikin ya. Te u sa doo a nyun sikin a tapu anda seefi tu.
eng_text: Wherefore we labour, that, whether present or absent, we may be accepted of him.

djk_text: Bika u ala o go doo na a kuutu sutuu fu Kelestesi fesi. Da ibiiwan o fende a paiman di fiti fa a libi anga sikin ya. Den di dini en bun makandii anga den di á dini en bun.
eng_text: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ; that every one may receive the things done in his body, according to that he hath done, whether it be good or bad.

djk_text: We, wi kon sabi ya fa u mu libi lesipeki en. Da u nái sipowtu! Ma wi e suku fu soi taawan a leti denki ya tu. Masaa Gadu e si a leti fasi fu wi ya. Mi denki u anda seefi konsensi e piki u dati tu.
eng_text: Knowing therefore the terror of the Lord, we persuade men; but we are made manifest unto God; and I trust also are made manifest in your consciences.

djk_text: Mi nái taki dati baka fu gafa wiseefi a u anda. Ma na fu gi u kankan, fu sabi soi siteeman fa wi ya de. Da u sa poi piki den. Bika den e gafa anga switi taki soi fa den bigi anga taanga. Doose fu den libi e soi so, ma inise di u nái si dati á de so.
eng_text: For we commend not ourselves again unto you, but give you occasion to glory on our behalf, that ye may have somewhat to answer them which glory in appearance, and not in heart.

djk_text: Den e kaagi wi ya taki, wi e kon taki sani anda enke wi fusutan nái wooko moo. Ma den á sabi fa wi ati de fu dini Masaa Gadu fa a wani. Da anga kiin fusutan wi e taki, fu ala dati mu tyai yeepi gi u de.
eng_text: For whether we be beside ourselves, it is to God: or whether we be sober, it is for your cause.

djk_text: Bika san e toosi wi fu tyai a bosikopu ya na di u kon sabi san Kelestesi du. A lobi ala sama, meke a teke dede taki, u mokisa dede anga en de.
eng_text: For the love of Christ constraineth us; because we thus judge, that if one died for all, then were all dead:

djk_text: A dede di a teke taki, useefi dede de kaba. Da wi di fende a nyun libi ya mu kaba waka piisii useefi ati namo. Ma bigin libi piisii en di teke u peesi dede, ma a weki kon a libi ya baka.
eng_text: And that he died for all, that they which live should not henceforth live unto themselves, but unto him which died for them, and rose again.

djk_text: Da kaba keli fa sama bigi anga wan goontapu fasi. Na a fasi de u be e keli Kelestesi fosi u be toon biibisama. Ma dati á mu de so moo.
eng_text: Wherefore henceforth know we no man after the flesh: yea, though we have known Christ after the flesh, yet now henceforth know we him no more.

djk_text: Bika wi di mokisa libi anga en toon wan hii nyun sowtu sama. A haw fasi fu libi kaba, meke wan hii nyun fasi kon de di kengi anga dati.
eng_text: Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.

djk_text: Na Masaa Gadu ala a yeepi de komoto. A meke Kelestesi dede tyai wi kon de bun gi enseefi, toon mati fi en. Ne a sende wi ya e paati a bosikopu de taki, na so sama e kon de switi anga en, fu toon mati fi en.
eng_text: And all things are of God, who hath reconciled us to himself by Jesus Christ, and hath given to us the ministry of reconciliation;

djk_text: A bosikopu ya e soi fa a sende Kelestesi kon puu feyanti fasi fu sama toon mati fi en. Ai figi takuudu anga ogii puu a kaagi fu sitaafu. Na so a sende wi fu bali ala se fa sama sa toon mati fi en.
eng_text: To wit, that God was in Christ, reconciling the world unto himself, not imputing their trespasses unto them; and hath committed unto us the word of reconciliation.

djk_text: Da wi ya taampu a Kelestesi peesi, fu waka lontu. A leli di wi e gi na Masaa Gadu taki di abi ala kaakiti. We, da wi teke Kelestesi peesi e sende u ya taki, teke fa Masaa Gadu poti fu toon mati fi en, da a ati kon de switi anga en.
eng_text: Now then we are ambassadors for Christ, as though God did beseech you by us: we pray you in Christ's stead, be ye reconciled to God.

djk_text: Bika na Kelestesi di noiti abi takuudu anga ogii, ne Masaa Gadu kengi en poti a u peesi. Da a teke a sitaafu fu wi takuudu anga ogii, meke sama mokisa libi anga en kon de bun gi Masaa Gadu kaba.
eng_text: For he hath made him to be sin for us, who knew no sin; that we might be made the righteousness of God in him.

djk_text: Da wi di e wooko makandii anga Masaa Gadu ya e bali u anda taki, luku bun! A gi u paadon sondee useefi wooko fu fende dati. Ma u á mu wisiwasi a sani ya taki, u komoto go baka a ini takuu libi.
eng_text: We then, as workers together with him, beseech you also that ye receive not the grace of God in vain.

djk_text: Bika wan peesi sikiifi a ini en Buku taki: “Di mi yuu doo fu yeepi, ne mi yee a begi fu u. Na mi yuu di fiti fu sende a Yeepiman.” Da aliki ya! Ne en yuu di fiti doo ya tuu, fu sende a Yeepiman.
eng_text: (For he saith, I have heard thee in a time accepted, and in the day of salvation have I succoured thee: behold, now is the accepted time; behold, now is the day of salvation.)

djk_text: Da wi ya nái du sani fu tapu pasi gi taawan a Masaa Gadu bosikopu di wi e tyai. Bika wi o meke den á teke a biibi.
eng_text: Giving no offence in any thing, that the ministry be not blamed:

djk_text: Ma u e du doo taki seefi, fu soi fa na tuutuu fasi wi e dini Masaa Gadu. Na so u e oli pasensi pasa ala sowtu banowtu anga banda fu sama. Te toko kon fu buuya wi tu. A ini ala sowtu taanga libi seefi.
eng_text: But in all things approving ourselves as the ministers of God, in much patience, in afflictions, in necessities, in distresses,

djk_text: A ini fonfon doo tei fiingi a dunguu osu. Te sama miti a bosu e pii ain gi wi fu kii wi. Soseefi a ini tyotyo wooko pasa neti sondee siibi. Son leisi anga ala angii bee seefi.
eng_text: In stripes, in imprisonments, in tumults, in labours, in watchings, in fastings;

djk_text: Ma wi e tan poti ede ete sondee takuu pakisei. U e fusutan fa fu piisii Masaa Gadu ete. U e teke pasensi libi switi anga taawan ete. Na so u e wooko enke fa a Jeje fi en wani anga fa Masaa Gadu taki fu lobi tuutuu.
eng_text: By pureness, by knowledge, by longsuffering, by kindness, by the Holy Ghost, by love unfeigned,

djk_text: Ala yuu u de fu taki Masaa Gadu tuutuu bosikopu di e wooko kaakiti fasi. Wan se, u e tan libi fa a fiti en. A taase, u e tan leli taawan en bosikopu fu tapu a mofu fu siteeman di e kaagi wi biibi.
eng_text: By the word of truth, by the power of God, by the armour of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,

djk_text: Sama e hei ofu lagi wi, den e gafa ofu kosi wi, u nái luku. Wi di e taki a tuutuu sani, ma son sama e kai wi leiman ete.
eng_text: By honour and dishonour, by evil report and good report: as deceivers, and yet true;

djk_text: Wi taampu a Kelestesi peesi, fu wooko. U anda sabi dati. Ma son sama á wani teke dati. Da ala yuu wi de a dede mofu, ma Masaa Gadu e oli u a libi. U e teke fonfon, ma kii fu wi á poi fende peesi!
eng_text: As unknown, and yet well known; as dying, and, behold, we live; as chastened, and not killed;

djk_text: Buduufu e miti wi, ma piisii fu Masaa Gadu de a wi ete. U de enke pootiman, ma na wi e tyai a bosikopu fu gaan gudu gi sama. Tuutuu! Wi gei sama sondee gudu, ma na wi Masaa Gadu gi ala gudu di enseefi abi!
eng_text: As sorrowful, yet alway rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, and yet possessing all things.

djk_text: Mi lobi biibiwan a Kolenti Foto de! Wi ya á kibii wi fii gi u anda. U puu u hii ati gi u de.
eng_text: O ye Corinthians, our mouth is open unto you, our heart is enlarged.

djk_text: Wi á wooko anga pikin pisi fu u ati namo soi u de lobi. Kweti! Na u anda wooko so anga wi ya.
eng_text: Ye are not straitened in us, but ye are straitened in your own bowels.

djk_text: Ma mi o taki anga u de now enke fa dda e leli en pikin. U opo a dipi fu u ati anda lobi wi ya baka.
eng_text: Now for a recompence in the same, (I speak as unto my children,) be ye also enlarged.

djk_text: U á mu tyai u biibi libi sipowtu fasi a mindii fu sama di libi nái waka biibi fasi. Leti fasi anga kukutu fasi nái go. A biibi fasi anga goontapu fasi kengi enke fa kiin fu debooko kengi anga dunguu neti.
eng_text: Be ye not unequally yoked together with unbelievers: for what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness? and what communion hath light with darkness?

djk_text: Kelestesi anga didibii den e kai Beliyali á poi go! Na so biibiwan seefi kengi anga sama di nái biibi.
eng_text: And what concord hath Christ with Belial? or what part hath he that believeth with an infidel?

djk_text: A kulu biibisama na san a libilibi Masaa Gadu teke enke en osu fu tan. Da en osu nái go anga afokodeei sani. Wan peesi sikiifi a ini en Buku taki: “Mi o teke peesi a mi sama, fu waka a den mindii. Mi o de den Gadu, da den de mi foluku.”
eng_text: And what agreement hath the temple of God with idols? for ye are the temple of the living God; as God hath said, I will dwell in them, and walk in them; and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.

djk_text: Wan taa peesi sikiifi baka taki: “Mi e sende u fu komoto a mindii sama, di nái waka a mi baka. Wai gi ibii takuu fasi fu den. Da mi o teke u fu miseefi.”
eng_text: Wherefore come out from among them, and be ye separate, saith the Lord, and touch not the unclean thing; and I will receive you,

djk_text: “Da mi o de enke lobi Tata gi u, da u de mi umanpikin anga manpikin. Na so mi enke Masaa Gadu, di abi ala makiti e taki.”
eng_text: And will be a Father unto you, and ye shall be my sons and daughters, saith the Lord Almighty.

djk_text: Mi lobi biibiwan! Masaa Gadu paamisi wi den sani de. Da meke dati gi u kankan fu libi apaiti fasi anga u sikin. Towe ala takuu pakisei kiin yu fusutan a ini yu ede. Libi, fu gi Masaa Gadu gaandi. Kenisi anga san nái piisii en.
eng_text: Having therefore these promises, dearly beloved, let us cleanse ourselves from all filthiness of the flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.

djk_text: Mi e begi u taki, gi wi ya u hii ati. Denki fa noiti wi libi kukutu fasi anga u de. Noiti u tyai poli gi u de biibi libi. Noiti u koli u suku wini gi u seefi namo.
eng_text: Receive us; we have wronged no man, we have corrupted no man, we have defrauded no man.

djk_text: Mi nái taki ala dati fu soi enke sama de ape e kaagi wi ya fu den sani de. Ma na fa mi be taki kaba. A ná sipowtu lobi u lobi u de na ati. Dede ofu libi á poi tapu dati.
eng_text: I speak not this to condemn you: for I have said before, that ye are in our hearts to die and live with you.

djk_text: Da mi e opo mi ati taki anga ala gaan fitoow anga u. Mi e gafa u taanga taki, a ná sipowtu koo ati u e gi mi anga u biibi libi de. U e piisii mi pasa ala toko di e miti wi ya seefi.
eng_text: Great is my boldness of speech toward you, great is my glorying of you: I am filled with comfort, I am exceeding joyful in all our tribulation.

djk_text: Bika di wi ya be doo Masadoniya pisiwataa, da tyotyo be meke u ná abi losutu. Sama be tapu wi e meke toko anga a leli fu Masaa Gadu. Den be lontu wi ala se. Da wi ati be fuu anga booko ede fu anda.
eng_text: For, when we were come into Macedonia, our flesh had no rest, but we were troubled on every side; without were fightings, within were fears.

djk_text: Ma gaantangi fu Masaa Gadu di e koo saka fasi sama ati. Bika a be meke Titesi komoto a u anda kon doo wi ya, ne dati koo wi ati ya.
eng_text: Nevertheless God, that comforteth those that are cast down, comforted us by the coming of Titus;

djk_text: Ma a ná dati wawan. Moomoo di a taigi wi ya taki u anda biibi libi tyai bun gi en. Soseefi u e buduufu de anga ala booko ede piiti ati fu mi ede. Tuutuu a hii fasi fu u ape gi mi ya piisii.
eng_text: And not by his coming only, but by the consolation wherewith he was comforted in you, when he told us your earnest desire, your mourning, your fervent mind toward me; so that I rejoiced the more.

djk_text: Ma u be buduufu de fu sani di mi be sikiifi a biifi sende gi u de. Da a ná dati piisii mi ya so. Ma na a yeepi di dati tyai gi u de. Da a bun gi mi taki, mi be sikiifi u so. Mi si taki, a sutu u ati.
eng_text: For though I made you sorry with a letter, I do not repent, though I did repent: for I perceive that the same epistle hath made you sorry, though it were but for a season.

djk_text: Da mi e piisii ya, ma a ná fu di mi be sikiifi sani di buduufu u de! Ma na di a buduufu de, meke u daai libi. Na so a wani u mu buduufu, fu fende bun. Da a kon, fa mi meke u buduufu á tyai ogii gi u.
eng_text: Now I rejoice, not that ye were made sorry, but that ye sorrowed to repentance: for ye were made sorry after a godly manner, that ye might receive damage by us in nothing.

djk_text: Bika buduufu fa Masaa Gadu wani e tyai yeepi, fu meke sama fende bun. Da ala a buduufu de e komoto baka. Ma goontapu buduufu nái meke sama fende bun so. Ma ai tyai paati kon gi sama anga Masaa Gadu tego.
eng_text: For godly sorrow worketh repentance to salvation not to be repented of: but the sorrow of the world worketh death.

djk_text: Buduufu fa Masaa Gadu wani tyai wini a u de. U e feti now tapu sama a ogii. U wani mi sabi fa u e bali den. U ati e boon a sama di á wani yee. U e feele Masaa Gadu sitaafu. U wani takuuduman fende paiman. U e angii fu mi kon si fa u wani teke taki. We, da u á engee go na a takuuse de.
eng_text: For behold this selfsame thing, that ye sorrowed after a godly sort, what carefulness it wrought in you, yea, what clearing of yourselves, yea, what indignation, yea, what fear, yea, what vehement desire, yea, what zeal, yea, what revenge! In all things ye have approved yourselves to be clear in this matter.

djk_text: We, mi á be sikiifi a biifi gi u fu booko ede anga a sama di be du a ogii de. A ná fu be teke se fu sama di a be du a ogii de tu. Ma na fu useefi be sa keli a Masaa Gadu fesi luku, efu u e lesipeki mi taki sai.
eng_text: Wherefore, though I wrote unto you, I did it not for his cause that had done the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered wrong, but that our care for you in the sight of God might appear unto you.

djk_text: Namo fa u wooko de koo wi ya ati. Bika u du san mi be sende u. Moomoo seefi, a piisii wi ya fa u wooko anga Titesi de. Wi si taki, a piisii enseefi. Bika u ala tyai bun gi en biibi libi de.
eng_text: Therefore we were comforted in your comfort: yea, and exceedingly the more joyed we for the joy of Titus, because his spirit was refreshed by you all.

djk_text: We, mi be gafa u gi en fosi a be kon de. Da u á gi mi sen. Sani waka enke fa ala san mi e taigi u de e de tuu. Da fa mi be gafa u gi en soi taki, mi nái taki lei sani.
eng_text: For if I have boasted any thing to him of you, I am not ashamed; but as we spake all things to you in truth, even so our boasting, which I made before Titus, is found a truth.

djk_text: Da a de ya e membee ete fa u teke mi taki wooko de. Fa u puu en bun a boto anga ala teke fu wooko switi anga en tu. Namo ai lesipeki u ya bigi moo fosi a be kon luku u de seefi.
eng_text: And his inward affection is more abundant toward you, whilst he remembereth the obedience of you all, how with fear and trembling ye received him.

djk_text: Mi dati ati saka ya tu. Bika mi e piisii taki, mi sa fitoow u de a sani.
eng_text: I rejoice therefore that I have confidence in you in all things.

djk_text: Mi lobi biibiwan! Luku fa Masaa Gadu teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku Masadoniya biibiwan. Namo, ne den nái sipowtu anga yeepi taawan a sani.
eng_text: Moreover, brethren, we do you to wit of the grace of God bestowed on the churches of Macedonia;

djk_text: A ini a tyotyo fu denseefi de, ma den abi gaan piisii ete. Den pooti de, ma fa den e yeepi taawan anga san den abi de bigi.
eng_text: How that in a great trial of affliction the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded unto the riches of their liberality.

djk_text: Mi sa kotoigi taki, den gi taawan san den poi! Eeye, moo enke san den poi seefi sondee sama dwengi den fu du so. Bika na denseefi ati opo fu du dati.
eng_text: For to their power, I bear record, yea, and beyond their power they were willing of themselves;

djk_text: Den begi wi ya seefi, fu gi den pasi du dati. Bika den wani mokisa tyai nen taki, denseefi yeepi Masaa Gadu sama a nowtu. Den e si dati enke wan gaan sani.
eng_text: Praying us with much intreaty that we would receive the gift, and take upon us the fellowship of the ministering to the saints.

djk_text: Namo, san den gi dyombo u ya seefi, wi á be fuuwakiti so. Ma den á du dati fu sama ain ede. Na Masaa Gadu fosi den piki fu du so, fu piisii en. Bakadati, ne den kon piki wi fu du san wi ya seefi wani, di de san Masaa Gadu wani tu.
eng_text: And this they did, not as we hoped, but first gave their own selves to the Lord, and unto us by the will of God.

djk_text: Da na wi ya be sende Titesi fu kon kaba piki a moni di enseefi be bigin piki de kaba. Da u anda sa fende pasi soi fa useefi wani yeepi taawan sowan fasi.
eng_text: Insomuch that we desired Titus, that as he had begun, so he would also finish in you the same grace also.

djk_text: Bika u libi bun somen sowtu fasi de kaba. U abi gaan biibi. U abi dipi fusutan, fu leli taawan. U sabi san Masaa Gadu wani. U wani yeepi taawan. Wi sabi taki, u anda lobi wi ya ape tu. Gaantangi, da soi bun fasi de go doo, fu yeepi biibiwan a nowtu tu.
eng_text: Therefore, as ye abound in every thing, in faith, and utterance, and knowledge, and in all diligence, and in your love to us, see that ye abound in this grace also.

djk_text: U á mu si enke mi kumandei u fu du dati anga taanga. Ma di mi si biibiwan fu Masadoniya pisiwataa feti yeepi taawan, ne mi wani u anda du so tu. Da u sa soi taki, u seefi lobi taawan enke den tu.
eng_text: I speak not by commandment, but by occasion of the forwardness of others, and to prove the sincerity of your love.

djk_text: Bika u sabi fa wi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku sama. En enke a guduman di abi ala san Masaa Gadu abi, ne a mu fika ala dati a tapu anda kon toon pootiman ya, fu be poi yeepi u. Ne u fende dyendee di Masaa Gadu seeka poti gi sama fi en.
eng_text: For ye know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that, though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that ye through his poverty might be rich.

djk_text: Da luku ya fa mi e denki u anda mu si a hii toli ya. Pakisei a yali di pasa fa u be teke fesi yeepi taawan enke fosiwan. Da na u fosi be angii fu du dati.
eng_text: And herein I give my advice: for this is expedient for you, who have begun before, not only to do, but also to be forward a year ago.

djk_text: Da du a wooko de go doo kaba fi en. Da ibiiwan sa si taki, u be sete dati, ne u poti fu du en go doo kaba. Da meke ibiiwan ape gi san a poi gi.
eng_text: Now therefore perform the doing of it; that as there was a readiness to will, so there may be a performance also out of that which ye have.

djk_text: Soso soi namo taki, i wani gi, da gi san i poi gi, da ai piisii Masaa Gadu kaba. Ma a ná enke sama mu gi sani pasa san a poi.
eng_text: For if there be first a willing mind, it is accepted according to that a man hath, and not according to that he hath not.

djk_text: Wi ya nái sende u de fu poti u seefi a fuka, fu yeepi taawan. Kweti! Ma paati san yu abi na a fasi taki, yu abi ete, ma taawan seefi fende tu.
eng_text: For I mean not that other men be eased, and ye burdened:

djk_text: Nownow, di u abi sani sai, da u mu yeepi taawan. Bika di useefi o de a nowtu, ne den abi sani sai, da den o yeepi u baka. Na so u ala sa abi san u fanowdu.
eng_text: But by an equality, that now at this time your abundance may be a supply for their want, that their abundance also may be a supply for your want: that there may be equality:

djk_text: Dati sikiifi a Masaa Gadu Buku taki: “Moo lati, da sama di be dyunta tyaipi, da den á be abi pasa maiki. Soseefi den di á be dyunta tyaipi moo lati á be abi mendii tu.”
eng_text: As it is written, He that had gathered much had nothing over; and he that had gathered little had no lack.

djk_text: We, a ná sipowtu daa mi e gi Masaa Gadu fu Titesi ede. Bika ai booko ede ya gi u anda enke mi ya seefi.
eng_text: But thanks be to God, which put the same earnest care into the heart of Titus for you.

djk_text: Fa ai kon luku u anda á de taki, na wi ya e sende en so. Ma ne enseefi teke fu du dati. Ai piisii en, da ai wani du dati seefi fosi mi ya denki fu sende en.
eng_text: For indeed he accepted the exhortation; but being more forward, of his own accord he went unto you.

djk_text: Wan taa lobi biibi baala wi o sende anga Titesi kon luku u de. Ai tyai bun nen a kulu biibiwan fu ala se taki, ai tyai a wooko fu a Bun Nyunsu wan leti fasi.
eng_text: And we have sent with him the brother, whose praise is in the gospel throughout all the churches;

djk_text: Moomoo, na biibi kulu sama gi wi en, fu waka lontu anga wi makandii. Da a sa kotoigi fu wi di sama poti enke basi fu solugu a moni fu Masaa Gadu sama. Bika den wani sama si taki, wi e tyai dati doo den tuu. We, wi e du a wooko ya fu gi wi Masaa gaandi anga ala wan angii fu yeepi sama tuutuu.
eng_text: And not that only, but who was also chosen of the churches to travel with us with this grace, which is administered by us to the glory of the same Lord, and declaration of your ready mind:

djk_text: Bika na biibiwan ati opo, fu piki sani sende go yeepi taawan. Da wi á wani sama fende pasi kaagi wi, enke u e puu a ini dati, fu teke fu u seefi.
eng_text: Avoiding this, that no man should blame us in this abundance which is administered by us:

djk_text: Wi wani wooko wan fasi, fu Masaa Gadu keli taki, dati bun. Ma libisama seefi mu poi keli taki, dati bun tu.
eng_text: Providing for honest things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.

djk_text: Wan taa lobi biibi baala wi o sende anga den Titesi kon de. Somen sowtu fasi kaba a wooko soi fa ai dini Masaa Gadu bun. A sabi fa u anda e wooko taanga fu yeepi taawan, meke a moo angii fu kon luku u de.
eng_text: And we have sent with them our brother, whom we have oftentimes proved diligent in many things, but now much more diligent, upon the great confidence which I have in you.

djk_text: Fu Titesi dati u sabi fa a wooko fitoow fasi somen leisi anga mi, fu yeepi u de seefi. Ma u mu oli den tu biibi baala di o kon anga en de seefi bun anga lobi tu. Biibiwan dise si den waiti sende a den peesi, fu lontu anga wi. Den libi tyai gafa gi Kelestesi gaandi kaba.
eng_text: Whether any do inquire of Titus, he is my partner and fellowhelper concerning you: or our brethren be inquired of, they are the messengers of the churches, and the glory of Christ.

djk_text: Da gaantangi wooko lesipeki anga den dii man ya. Soi den lobi, te den kon de. Meke ala den taa kulu biibiwan sa poi si fa u nái gafa u de fu soso naamo ala yuu.
eng_text: Wherefore shew ye to them, and before the churches, the proof of your love, and of our boasting on your behalf.

djk_text: Da a á de fanowdu fu tan sikiifi naamo taki, u mu piki sani fu sende go yeepi a nowtu fu biibiwan, di de apaiti fasi gi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: For as touching the ministering to the saints, it is superfluous for me to write to you:

djk_text: Bika mi sabi fa u abi angii fu yeepi taawan nowtu anda. Mi e gafa u dise so naamo a Masadoniya biibiwan mindii taki, na u fu Akasi pisiwata fosi sete a angii fu du dati senten a yali di pasa de. Da na u meke denseefi teke fu du so tu.
eng_text: For I know the forwardness of your mind, for which I boast of you to them of Macedonia, that Achaia was ready a year ago; and your zeal hath provoked very many.

djk_text: Ma toku, mi e sende den dii lobi biibi baala kon a u de ete, fu yeepi u piki den sani di u mu sende go yeepi den. Meke ala ain sa si fa mi nái gafa u de fu soso. Da seeka san u piki poti de, enke fa mi paati mofu kaba taki, u o du so.
eng_text: Yet have I sent the brethren, lest our boasting of you should be in vain in this behalf; that, as I said, ye may be ready:

djk_text: Bika efu u á seeka dati so, da u o gi mi sen. A o soi enke mi gafa u doo fitoow u fu soso, efu sama komoto a Masadoniya dise kon anga mi anda. Da a o tyai sen gi u de moo mi ya seefi.
eng_text: Lest haply if they of Macedonia come with me, and find you unprepared, we (that we say not, ye) should be ashamed in this same confident boasting.

djk_text: Na so meke, mi si en fanowdu fu sende den dii lobi baala ya a mi fesi. Da den sa kon yeepi u de, fu kaba piki a bun di u o sende seeka poti kaba kaba, enke fa u be paamisi de. U mu piki ala dati sondee dwengi, fu sende yeepi taawan.
eng_text: Therefore I thought it necessary to exhort the brethren, that they would go before unto you, and make up beforehand your bounty, whereof ye had notice before, that the same might be ready, as a matter of bounty, and not as of covetousness.

djk_text: Ma membee a nongo di koti taki, sama paandi pikinso alisi namo, en goon ná o puu tyaipi wini. Bika on moo wan sama tyatya towe, da en goon o moo puu wini gi en bakaten.
eng_text: But this I say, He which soweth sparingly shall reap also sparingly; and he which soweth bountifully shall reap also bountifully.

djk_text: Da ibiiwan mu denki bun san a poi gi, da a poti san en ati wani. Ná gi wan sani di nái kai a yu ati. Meke sama á dwengi yu tu, fu gi san iseefi á wani. Bika san Masaa Gadu lobi na sama di o gi anga en hii ati, wan switi fasi.
eng_text: Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver.

djk_text: Da Masaa Gadu di poi teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku yu, sa gi yu tyaipi sani baka pasa peesi. Da yu sa abi ala san yu abi fanowdu ibii yuu naamo. Soseefi, da i sa poi tan du somen bun go doo gi taawan.
eng_text: And God is able to make all grace abound toward you; that ye, always having all sufficiency in all things, may abound to every good work:

djk_text: Na letiso sikiifi a Masaa Gadu Buku taki: “Sama di tyatya tyaipi yeepi doo pooti taawan, Masaa Gadu noiti wanten moo sa feegete a leti fasi fi en de.”
eng_text: (As it is written, He hath dispersed abroad; he hath given to the poor: his righteousness remaineth for ever.

djk_text: Da a de so taki, na Masaa Gadu e gi sama sani fu paandi naamo, meke nyanyan e goo fu fende nyan. Da a musu poi gi u san u fanowdu naamo, fu poi goo a ini a leti wooko fu yeepi taawan seefi tu.
eng_text: Now he that ministereth seed to the sower both minister bread for your food, and multiply your seed sown, and increase the fruits of your righteousness;)

djk_text: Ala fasi a o gi sani pasa peesi, fu poi tan yeepi taawan. Ma soseefi san u o piki sende anga wi fu tyai go yeepi taawan, o tyai gaan piisii gi den, fu gafa Masaa Gadu fu dati.
eng_text: Being enriched in every thing to all bountifulness, which causeth through us thanksgiving to God.

djk_text: Da sabi taki, boiti fu a yeepi di u o sende gi biibiwan so, ma u o meke den gafa Masaa Gadu pasa peesi tu.
eng_text: For the administration of this service not only supplieth the want of the saints, but is abundant also by many thanksgivings unto God;

djk_text: Fa u yeepi de o meke sama si fa u lobi teke Masaa Gadu taki. Da den o gafa en, fu fa u nái kai useefi biibisama a Kelestesi Bun Nyunsu fu soso. Ma u e du san e piisii en tu taki, u ati opo sondee dwengi paati san u abi anga den, go doo taawan tu.
eng_text: Whiles by the experiment of this ministration they glorify God for your professed subjection unto the gospel of Christ, and for your liberal distribution unto them, and unto all men;

djk_text: Da te den mu begi gi u de, da den o pakisei u anga daa na ati. Bika den e si a gaan bun ati fasi namo di Masaa Gadu teke luku u, fu meke u ati opo fu yeepi taawan.
eng_text: And by their prayer for you, which long after you for the exceeding grace of God in you.

djk_text: We, meke u gi Masaa Gadu daa makandii ya! Bika a du gaan bun gi wi pasa peesi anga a yeepi di a sende kon gi wi.
eng_text: Thanks be unto God for his unspeakable gift.

djk_text: We, mi Pawlesi e kon saka fasi, soseefi piisii fasi u de enke Kelestesi seefi. Ma gaantangi, bali den sama di e kaagi mi fu dati taki, fesi a fesi, da mi gei feeleman di e kaku anga taki. Ma te mi komoto de, da mi abi ati fu sikiifi taanga biifi sende gi u.
eng_text: Now I Paul myself beseech you by the meekness and gentleness of Christ, who in presence am base among you, but being absent am bold toward you:

djk_text: We, mi e begi u de fu solugu taki, te mi kon doo de, mi á fende sama kaasi de. Bika den e libi anga a denki taki, wi ya de goontapu fasi ete.
eng_text: But I beseech you, that I may not be bold when I am present with that confidence, wherewith I think to be bold against some, which think of us as if we walked according to the flesh.

djk_text: Bika ala fa wi de libisama ete enke ibii taa sama. Ma kweti! Wi biibi feti nái sitee goontapu fasi.
eng_text: For though we walk in the flesh, we do not war after the flesh:

djk_text: Wi feti sani á tan enke goontapu feti sani, fu teke feti. Na Masaa Gadu seeka wi anga en taanga makiti, fu poi naki taanga feti peesi fu a feyanti booko seefi.
eng_text: (For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds;)

djk_text: Da siteeman nái poi taampu a wi fesi anga falisi leli. Bika wi e naki ala gaan taki fu den puu a pasi, fu kaba tapu sama fu si doo Masaa Gadu leli. U e kisi a hii falisi denki fu den banda, meke sama fende pasi denki enke fa Kelestesi wani.
eng_text: Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ;

djk_text: U de sete sete, fu kaasi ibii taanga yesi fasi a sama. U sa go doo, te enke sama di wani teke taki seeka doo peesi fa Kelestesi wani.
eng_text: And having in a readiness to revenge all disobedience, when your obedience is fulfilled.

djk_text: U mu luku a sani ya dipi sondee fu si en makiliki fasi di á de tuu. Bika siteeman de di e naki ati anda taki, na den Kelestesi poti fu taki. Ma den mu sabi taki, en anga den á de wan fasi moo wi ya.
eng_text: Do ye look on things after the outward appearance? If any man trust to himself that he is Christ's, let him of himself think this again, that, as he is Christ's, even so are we Christ's.

djk_text: Bika fu mi ya be o gafa pasa peesi seefi fa Masaa Gadu poti mi fu taki, da a á be o de fu booko u saka puu a Kelestesi anda. Ma na fu yeepi u de taampu moo taanga. Meke mi á be o fende sen fu dati.
eng_text: For though I should boast somewhat more of our authority, which the Lord hath given us for edification, and not for your destruction, I should not be ashamed:

djk_text: Ma toku mi ná o gafa so. Bika den biifi di mi sende kon a u de be sa gei sani fu dyombo u.
eng_text: That I may not seem as if I would terrify you by letters.

djk_text: Bika son sama bali de kaba taki, mi e sikiifi pepee sani anga ala taanga taki. Ma te miseefi kon doo de, da mi gei soso sama anga wisiwasi taki.
eng_text: For his letters, say they, are weighty and powerful; but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech contemptible.

djk_text: Ma meke den di e taki dati luku bun san sikiifi a ini biifi di mi sende komoto dise. Da den o si te mi doo de, fa mi o du enke fa mi sikiifi.
eng_text: Let such an one think this, that, such as we are in word by letters when we are absent, such will we be also in deed when we are present.

djk_text: Ma wi ya ná o peefuu go maiki useefi luku anga sama e gafa denseefi de, fa den bigi. U ná o hei kisi den. Bika denseefi poti den fasi fu maiki luku sama moo bigi. Den nái wooko anga Masaa Gadu koni.
eng_text: For we dare not make ourselves of the number, or compare ourselves with some that commend themselves: but they measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves among themselves, are not wise.

djk_text: Bika wi ya noiti o teke useefi gafa a pe Masaa Gadu á poti wi fu wooko. Na pe a sende u go wooko mi ya o gafa fa mi wooko leti gi sama de. U anda na peesi pe mi wooko pasa so.
eng_text: But we will not boast of things without our measure, but according to the measure of the rule which God hath distributed to us, a measure to reach even unto you.

djk_text: Ma mi á be o poi go gafa a pe Masaa Gadu á sende mi go wooko. Da den be o abi leti, efu mi á be wooko pasa u de. Ma koloku, na wi ya fosi doo u de anga a Bun Nyunsu fosi den.
eng_text: For we stretch not ourselves beyond our measure, as though we reached not unto you: for we are come as far as to you also in preaching the gospel of Christ:

djk_text: Da noiti wi e go gafa useefi a pe taawan fosi wooko kaba. Wi ya taanga denki, na fu meke u anda biibi goo moo anga moo. Da dati o moo meke u si de fa na wi ya Masaa Gadu poti fu taki de tuu.
eng_text: Not boasting of things without our measure, that is, of other men's labours; but having hope, when your faith is increased, that we shall be enlarged by you according to our rule abundantly,

djk_text: Da dati o opo pasi meke wi ya sa go doo taa pisiwataa di á kisi a Bun Nyunsu ete. Wi ya nái go sidon e gafa e wooko a pe taa sama fosi wooko kaba taki, u bigi. Kweti!
eng_text: To preach the gospel in the regions beyond you, and not to boast in another man's line of things made ready to our hand.

djk_text: Wan peesi sikiifi ne en Buku taki: “U mu gafa namo fa wi Masaa e du en wooko.”
eng_text: But he that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord.

djk_text: Bika a ná sama di e gafa enseefi sa de waiti fu fende gafa taki, a bigi tuu. Ma na sama di wooko e soi taki, na Masaa Gadu sende en.
eng_text: For not he that commendeth himself is approved, but whom the Lord commendeth.

djk_text: Mi denki taki, u sa tan pasensi doo fu teke san mi e taki enke lawman ya. We, mi e si taki, u pasensi teke den kaba, da mi o taki go doo.
eng_text: Would to God ye could bear with me a little in my folly: and indeed bear with me.

djk_text: Bika mi e booko ede anga u de enke fa Masaa Gadu e du. Mi e dyalusu seefi enke u na mi umanpikin di mi paamisi a man den e kai Kelestesi. Da mi e waki u fu taawan á fende u puu ne en ana.
eng_text: For I am jealous over you with godly jealousy: for I have espoused you to one husband, that I may present you as a chaste virgin to Christ.

djk_text: Mi e feele fu san kande sa miti u de. Luku a koni fasi fa a sineki didibii be fende pasi koli Efa. Kande dati sa miti u de, meke u hii libi á de gi Kelestesi wawan moo.
eng_text: But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty, so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.

djk_text: Bika sama leli u de hii taa sani fu wan Jesesi di e wooko kengi anga Jesesi di mi e leli. Dati na wan jeje di kengi anga di Masaa Gadu sende. Soseefi wan nyunsu di kengi anga di fu Jesesi. Ne u teke ala dati anda.
eng_text: For if he that cometh preacheth another Jesus, whom we have not preached, or if ye receive another spirit, which ye have not received, or another gospel, which ye have not accepted, ye might well bear with him.

djk_text: We, mi á denki taki, mi á bigi doo den di teke denseefi poti gaanbigi Masaa Gadu bosikopuman de.
eng_text: For I suppose I was not a whit behind the very chiefest apostles.

djk_text: Mi ya tongo á gaata enke den, ma mi sabi sani fu Masaa Gadu tuutuu fasi. Mi fasi fu waka e meke u si ala dati a mi.
eng_text: But though I be rude in speech, yet not in knowledge; but we have been throughly made manifest among you in all things.

djk_text: Ma u si enke na ogii taki, mi be saka miseefi du son wooko enke ibii taawan de? We, na fu be soi fa u mu libi fu taampu hei gi Masaa Gadu de. Ne mi gi u Masaa Gadu Bun Nyunsu sondee fu meke u pai mi fu dati.
eng_text: Have I committed an offence in abasing myself that ye might be exalted, because I have preached to you the gospel of God freely?

djk_text: Ma mi be teke moni a taa kulu biibiwan, fu solugu miseefi tuu. Ma na fu be poi kon doo u de anga Masaa Gadu wooko.
eng_text: I robbed other churches, taking wages of them, to do you service.

djk_text: Ma u mindii de, te mi be abi moni fanowdu, da mi á be poti a fuka de gi u. Bika biibiwan be komoto a Masadoniya pisiwataa kon yeepi mi. Den e du dati go doo ete seefi. Da mi á denki bakaten seefi mi o fuka u de so tu.
eng_text: And when I was present with you, and wanted, I was chargeable to no man: for that which was lacking to me the brethren which came from Macedonia supplied: and in all things I have kept myself from being burdensome unto you, and so will I keep myself.

djk_text: Mi nái lei, dati sa tan so tu. Kelestesi e wooko a ini mi sondee fu taki lei. Sama fu Akasi pisiwataa anda noiti o poi tapu mi taki, a gafa fu mi ya á de leti.
eng_text: As the truth of Christ is in me, no man shall stop me of this boasting in the regions of Achaia.

djk_text: Ma a ná enke dati e soi taki, mi á lobi u de. Masaa Gadu e si fa mi lobi u de kisi.
eng_text: Wherefore? because I love you not? God knoweth.

djk_text: Ma mi o tan sondee fu u anda solugu mi anga moni. Bika mi á wani sama teke mi teli anga leti enke mi anga den di e du dati ape na a wan.
eng_text: But what I do, that I will do, that I may cut off occasion from them which desire occasion; that wherein they glory, they may be found even as we.

djk_text: Den dati na falisi bosikopuman! Ma den e si denseefi enke gaan bosikopuman di Kelestesi sende fu taki. Den e koli sama biibi a lei de. Bika den e meke enke gaan bosikopuman tuu.
eng_text: For such are false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into the apostles of Christ.

djk_text: Ma dati nái foondoo mi ya! Bika didibii enke saatan seefi e soi enseefi enke dyendee Engel, di de anga a leti kiin fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.

djk_text: Da dati á mu foondoo u de tu. Bika wookoman fu didibii musu meke enke na Masaa Gadu e sende den leli sama leti fasi. Ma fika den gi Masaa Gadu. A o sitaafu den fiti a takuu wooko de.
eng_text: Therefore it is no great thing if his ministers also be transformed as the ministers of righteousness; whose end shall be according to their works.

djk_text: Ma mi e taki ya baka taki, sama á mu si mi enke lawman de! Fu u wani, da si mi so te mi o gafa miseefi nownow pikinso enke fa den falisi bosikopuman e du de. Mi o soi u de sama a mi.
eng_text: I say again, Let no man think me a fool; if otherwise, yet as a fool receive me, that I may boast myself a little.

djk_text: We, ma Masaa Jesesi á be o gafa enseefi so. Bika fu wooko so e gei lawman.
eng_text: That which I speak, I speak it not after the Lord, but as it were foolishly, in this confidence of boasting.

djk_text: Ma di somen sama de ape e gafa denseefi wan goontapu fasi, da mi o gafa soi miseefi tu.
eng_text: Seeing that many glory after the flesh, I will glory also.

djk_text: U gwenti teke gafaman taki di den e leli u de kaba. Bika u denki taki, u sabi wooko leti.
eng_text: For ye suffer fools gladly, seeing ye yourselves are wise.

djk_text: Ma meke mi taigi u de taki, dati na taki fu sama di wani wooko enke basi a u tapu. Na sama di wani soigi u puu wini gi denseefi namo. Na sama di e teke hei peesi, fu naki taawan a sikin fesi de seefi.
eng_text: For ye suffer, if a man bring you into bondage, if a man devour you, if a man take of you, if a man exalt himself, if a man smite you on the face.

djk_text: Sen e kisi mi ya fu di wi ya á taanga sai enke den. Bika wi ya á poi naki sama a sikin fesi de sowan fasi. Da mi law fu taki mi o gafa miseefi enke den lawman de.
eng_text: I speak as concerning reproach, as though we had been weak. Howbeit whereinsoever any is bold, (I speak foolishly,) I am bold also.

djk_text: Bika den e gafa taki, den de Hebelei sama. Den na paansu fu wi avo Abalaham. Den na Islayeli sama. We, mi seefi tu.
eng_text: Are they Hebrews? so am I. Are they Israelites? so am I. Are they the seed of Abraham? so am I.

djk_text: Den e gafa taki, na den e dini Kelestesi. Mi e taki enke lawman ya. We, mi e dini en moo den! Mi e du en wooko taanga moo den. Den á sooto somen leisi fi en ede enke mi ya. Den á fende fonfon somen leisi fi en ede enke mi. Somen leisi mi pasa a dede mofu seefi.
eng_text: Are they ministers of Christ? (I speak as a fool) I am more; in labours more abundant, in stripes above measure, in prisons more frequent, in deaths oft.

djk_text: Dyulanti wipi mi feifi leisi a diitenti a neigin wipi fu den.
eng_text: Of the Jews five times received I forty stripes save one.

djk_text: Dii leisi sama wipi mi anga a tiki wipi fu den. Wan leisi sama piki siton naki mi fu kii. Dii leisi a waka tapu, sipi sungu fu kii mi a wataa. Wan hii neti wan hii dei mi suwen a ini a gaan ze.
eng_text: Thrice was I beaten with rods, once was I stoned, thrice I suffered shipwreck, a night and a day I have been in the deep;

djk_text: Mi e waka lontu naamo, mi e pasa takuu liba. Mi e pasa gaanbigi abani peesi. Eigi Dyusama e meke toko, taa foluku tu. Mi doo foto ofu mi doo bakabini peesi, na toko. Mi de a sipi, ze e meke toko. A mindii fu falisi biibisama seefi na toko tu.
eng_text: In journeyings often, in perils of waters, in perils of robbers, in perils by mine own countrymen, in perils by the heathen, in perils in the city, in perils in the wilderness, in perils in the sea, in perils among false brethren;

djk_text: Mi e tyotyo wooko pasa son neti sondee siibi. Mi pasa dei sondee nyan anga diingi wataa kaba. Son leisi, koosi fu wei e mankei mi sikin, da mi fika gi gaan koo.
eng_text: In weariness and painfulness, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, in cold and nakedness.

djk_text: Anga ala dati, da ibii dei booko ede fu ala den biibiwan fu mi na ala se de a mi. Nowtu fu den e kai a mi sikin buba fu tyai.
eng_text: Beside those things that are without, that which cometh upon me daily, the care of all the churches.

djk_text: Wan biibiwan nái fii wan sani te, da mi á fii anga en. Wan biibiwan nái du wan ogii te, da dati á kon koti mi ati.
eng_text: Who is weak, and I am not weak? who is offended, and I burn not?

djk_text: Ma toku efu mi mu gafa miseefi, da na fu soi a swaki libisama fasi fu mi di á taanga.
eng_text: If I must needs glory, I will glory of the things which concern mine infirmities.

djk_text: Mi nái lei! Masaa Gadu enke Tata fu wi Masaa Jesesi di fiti fu gafa tego e si.
eng_text: The God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which is blessed for evermore, knoweth that I lie not.

djk_text: Bika luku Damasikosi Foto. A gaaman di e wooko a Kownu Aletasi ondoo de be kumandei suudati fu lulu mi kisi a ibii pasi mofu.
eng_text: In Damascus the governor under Aretas the king kept the city of the Damascenes with a garrison, desirous to apprehend me:

djk_text: Da mi be fende pasi lowe. Ma na tetei biibi baala ape be tei a gaan bakisi kibii mi saka puu a wan fensee fu a gaan hei siton sikotu di meke lontu a foto.
eng_text: And through a window in a basket was I let down by the wall, and escaped his hands.

djk_text: Ma na di mi mu gafa, da meke mi gafa miseefi doo gaan jeje sani di Masaa Gadu meke mi si somen leisi tu. Ma a ná enke den gafa ya o tyai wini gi wan enkii sama.
eng_text: It is not expedient for me doubtless to glory. I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.

djk_text: Ma na di mi sabi wan sama di libi mokisa anga Kelestesi. Tin na fo yali pasa, Masaa Gadu be tyai en go doo en kondee a tapu anda. Mi á kaba fusutan fu na anga ala en libisama fasi anga sikin ofu na jeje fasi sondee sikin. Masaa Gadu wawan sabi.
eng_text: I knew a man in Christ above fourteen years ago, (whether in the body, I cannot tell; or whether out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;) such an one caught up to the third heaven.

djk_text: Mi sabi namo fa sani waka anga a man de. Fu na anga ala en libisama fasi ofu jeje fasi namo, mi á kaba fusutan.
eng_text: And I knew such a man, (whether in the body, or out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;)

djk_text: Ma a subi go doo a dyendee peesi fu Masaa Gadu a tapu anda pe sama fi en e dede komoto ya go. San a miti anga san a yee anda foondoo te, ne fasi á de ya fu poi taki dati. Da a á sabi fa fu soi taawan ala dati.
eng_text: How that he was caught up into paradise, and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.

djk_text: Mi o gafa fa sani waka anga a man de. Ma a ná miseefi mi e gafa so. Bika fu mi mu gafa miseefi, da na fu soi a swaki libisama fasi fu mi di á taanga.
eng_text: Of such an one will I glory: yet of myself I will not glory, but in mine infirmities.

djk_text: Fu mi mu gafa san pasa anga a man de, da toku mi á gafa enke lawman. Bika na tuutuu sani. Ma mi ná o gafa, fu sama poti mi bigi pasa miseefi de. Keli mi luku namo san mi e taki doo san mi e du.
eng_text: For though I would desire to glory, I shall not be a fool; for I will say the truth: but now I forbear, lest any man should think of me above that which he seeth me to be, or that he heareth of me.

djk_text: Masaa Gadu á wani mi abi hei membee fu dati ede taki, a meke mi si somen gaan jeje sani. Ne a fika wan sani enke maka a mi buba e sutu mi seefi. Na so a fika didibii, fu poti en wookoman fu banowtu mi.
eng_text: And lest I should be exalted above measure through the abundance of the revelations, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, the messenger of Satan to buffet me, lest I should be exalted above measure.

djk_text: Mi begi wi Masaa te doo dii leisi seefi, fu puu a banowtu ya a mi buba.
eng_text: For this thing I besought the Lord thrice, that it might depart from me.

djk_text: Ma ai piki mi naamo taki: “San yu fanowdu, na fu mi poi teke mi gaan bun ati fasi namo luku yu. Da yu libi mu de swaki libisama fasi di á taanga. Da te mi e yeepi yu, da dati e soi fa na mi taanga de a yu.”
eng_text: And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.

djk_text: Da dini Kelestesi e piisii mi, winsi mi de swaki libisama fasi di á taanga. Da sama sa kosi mi seefi. Toko sa miti mi. Sama sa lon du ogii anga mi doo soseefi taa nowtu. Bika mi libi mu soi swaki libisama fasi di á taanga. Da te Kelestesi e yeepi mi, da dati e soi fa Masaa Gadu taanga de a mi.
eng_text: Therefore I take pleasure in infirmities, in reproaches, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses for Christ's sake: for when I am weak, then am I strong.

djk_text: We, mi e si taki, mi gafa ya enke den lawman de tu. Ma na u anda dwengi mi so. Bika na u be mu gafa mi. Den man di e poti denseefi gaanbigi bosikopuman de á bigi moo mi. Winsi fa mi á de noti seefi.
eng_text: I am become a fool in glorying; ye have compelled me: for I ought to have been commended of you: for in nothing am I behind the very chiefest apostles, though I be nothing.

djk_text: Ma mi na wan apaiti bosikopuman, di poti fu taki tuu. Bika sani e pasa a ini mi libi a u mindii de, di e soi dati. Maiki de fu si taki, Masaa Gadu de anga mi. Foondoo sani anga wonduu tu. Na so mi tei ati fu oli doo, pasa ala sowtu tesi tu.
eng_text: Truly the signs of an apostle were wrought among you in all patience, in signs, and wonders, and mighty deeds.

djk_text: Luku fa mi e libi bun anga u de, doo ala taa kulu biibiwan tu. Mi á gi u de pasi fu solugu mi anga moni seefi. Ma dati á wani taki, mi á wooko bun anga u. Na di mi á wani poti mi fuka a u sikoo. Da u gi mi paadon, efu u si enke mi fowtu.
eng_text: For what is it wherein ye were inferior to other churches, except it be that I myself was not burdensome to you? forgive me this wrong.

djk_text: Na dii leisi kaba di mi de fu kon luku u de. Ma mi de sondee fu wani poti mi fuka a u sikoo ete. Mi á wani u gudu, ma na u seefi mi wani de a mi se. Bika gaansama nái sidon luku fi en nyoni pikin mu solugu en. Ne en mu solugu a pikin.
eng_text: Behold, the third time I am ready to come to you; and I will not be burdensome to you: for I seek not yours, but you: for the children ought not to lay up for the parents, but the parents for the children.

djk_text: Na so meke na mi teke fu gi u de ala san mi abi. Mi o du ala san mi poi fu yeepi u de. Bika fa mi lobi u anda dipi so, da a á sa moi taki, u lobi fu mi dati de swaki fasi.
eng_text: And I will very gladly spend and be spent for you; though the more abundantly I love you, the less I be loved.

djk_text: Da son sama o bali piki mi de taki: “Eeye Pawlesi! Na so yu á wani poti yu fuka fu sama solugu yu. Ma yu e wooko moo koli fasi sende taawan kon puu moni a sama saka ya.”
eng_text: But be it so, I did not burden you: nevertheless, being crafty, I caught you with guile.

djk_text: Ma mi e piki den dati taki, mi noiti sende sama kon de ete anga bosikopu taki u mu sende moni gi mi dise.
eng_text: Did I make a gain of you by any of them whom I sent unto you?

djk_text: Mi be sende Titesi kon luku u de makandii anga wan taa lobi biibi baala, ma a á be wooko koli fasi de. A á be puu moni a u saka de. Bika mi sabi fa Titesi e wooko na a seefi fasi fa mi e denki sani jeje fasi.
eng_text: I desired Titus, and with him I sent a brother. Did Titus make a gain of you? walked we not in the same spirit? walked we not in the same steps?

djk_text: U luku san mi wani soi u anga a langa taki ya. A ná fu feti taki gi miseefi. Ma na fu Masaa Gadu mu yee fa mi e taki anga u di mokisa libi anga Kelestesi anda. Da ala san mi e du doo taki seefi mu meke u di mi lobi de so dipi biibi kon moo taanga.
eng_text: Again, think ye that we excuse ourselves unto you? we speak before God in Christ: but we do all things, dearly beloved, for your edifying.

djk_text: Bika mi e feele enke mi o kon miti u de enke fa mi á wani u de. Da mi o de fa u á wani mi de tu. Mi feele enke u e kwali de. Dyalusu anga kaakeli boon ati fasi. Sama e suku wini fi enseefi namo. Sama e kosi taawan anga ala konkuu tyai taki. Hei membee fasi anga ala fanya fanya fasi.
eng_text: For I fear, lest, when I come, I shall not find you such as I would, and that I shall be found unto you such as ye would not: lest there be debates, envyings, wraths, strifes, backbitings, whisperings, swellings, tumults:

djk_text: Mi e feele enke mi o kon teke sen de baka a Masaa Gadu fesi. Bika son sama o buduufu mi de, di be mu kaba de kaba anga takuu libi. Den de ape ete enke fa den be de a fesi, sondee fii, fu a takuudu libi di nái waka kiin fasi. Da den á daai libi ete, fu fika sani enke motyo fasi, anga ala taa sowtu fasi di de sen sani.
eng_text: And lest, when I come again, my God will humble me among you, and that I shall bewail many which have sinned already, and have not repented of the uncleanness and fornication and lasciviousness which they have committed.

djk_text: We, na di fu dii leisi mi o kon a u de now. Da Masaa Gadu maiki fu wasikoi sama na dii tu, da ai sitaafu. En Buku seefi sikiifi taki: “Tu go miti dii kotoigi piki wan sani, da a sai lanti fu piki taki, i du a ogii tuu.”
eng_text: This is the third time I am coming to you. In the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.

djk_text: Da du fu tu leisi mi be doo a u de, da mi be wasikoi u de fosi leisi. Mi e sende wasikoi u de komoto a faawe ya anga a biifi ya baka, meke tu. Mi poti fu kon luku u de, fu wasikoi sama de anga takuu libi de ete, meke dii. Da a sa sai fu mi gi sitaafu tu.
eng_text: I told you before, and foretell you, as if I were present, the second time; and being absent now I write to them which heretofore have sinned, and to all other, that, if I come again, I will not spare:

djk_text: Bika u be piki mi de fa mi e taki anga u taki, na Kelestesi seefi tongo u e yee a mi. Namo u sabi de fa a wooko anga en taanga a u mindii de tuu, di nái waka swaki libisama fasi.
eng_text: Since ye seek a proof of Christ speaking in me, which to you-ward is not weak, but is mighty in you.

djk_text: Bika a be dede swaki fasi di á taanga a koloisi. Ma di a weki baka, da anga Masaa Gadu taanga makiti. Da wi di mokisa libi anga en de swaki libisama fasi, ma u de anga Masaa Gadu taanga makiti, fu poi wooko gi en.
eng_text: For though he was crucified through weakness, yet he liveth by the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we shall live with him by the power of God toward you.

djk_text: Ma a bun, fu keli yuseefi luku efu yu abi a biibi libi tuu. Wegi i seefi bun. Da yu o sabi efu Jesesi Kelestesi de ini a yu libi. Bika i sa luku te a kaba, da yu á de fu Kelestesi Jesesi ete seefi.
eng_text: Examine yourselves, whether ye be in the faith; prove your own selves. Know ye not your own selves, how that Jesus Christ is in you, except ye be reprobates?

djk_text: Keli wi ya libi luku tu, fu si taki, wi fiti fu kai apaiti bosikopuman fu Kelestesi di a poti fu taki gi en de.
eng_text: But I trust that ye shall know that we are not reprobates.

djk_text: Mi e begi taki, u de sa komoto a ibii takuudu. Mi nái begi taki, sama mu kai mi apaiti bosikopuman fu Jesesi Kelestesi di a poti fu taki de. Bika winsi sama nái teli mi de so, ma efu u ya libi leti de namo, da a bun gi mi kaba.
eng_text: Now I pray to God that ye do no evil; not that we should appear approved, but that ye should do that which is honest, though we be as reprobates.

djk_text: Bika mi á de fu feti anga san e waka enke fa Masaa Gadu tuutuu leli taki. Na dati mi de fu leli taawan fu du.
eng_text: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.

djk_text: Da ai piisii mi te u taampu taanga fu biibi. Da mi sa wooko anga u a swaki libisama fasi di á taanga. San mi e begi gi u dati na fu u libi sa seeka na a leti fasi gi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: For we are glad, when we are weak, and ye are strong: and this also we wish, even your perfection.

djk_text: Da mi e sikiifi wasikoi u ya, ala fa mi á de anda. Fu te mi doo de, fu mi á sa abi fu sitaafu u de anga a taanga di Masaa Gadu gi mi fu taki. Bika a á poti mi fu toto sama puu ne en pasi, ma na fu yeepi sama taampu taanga.
eng_text: Therefore I write these things being absent, lest being present I should use sharpness, according to the power which the Lord hath given me to edification, and not to destruction.

djk_text: Mi lobi biibiwan! Enke kiiboi sani, da u tan bun! Feti seefi fu komoto a takuudu fu seeka a libi. Gi taawan koo ati. Mokisa denki sani go na a wan se. U ati mu de switi makandii. Masaa Gadu di e gi lobi anga switi ati fu taawan sa taampu gi u.
eng_text: Finally, brethren, farewell. Be perfect, be of good comfort, be of one mind, live in peace; and the God of love and peace shall be with you.

djk_text: Bali ala biibiwan anda wan switi odi a ini a nen fu Masaa gi wi.
eng_text: Greet one another with an holy kiss.

djk_text: Ala biibiwan dise sende odi gi u ala anda.
eng_text: All the saints salute you.

djk_text: Mi e begi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi, fu teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku u de. Fu u ala anda sa si a dipi fasi di Masaa Gadu lobi u. Da meke a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu teke ibiiwan de libi tu, meke u sa wooko switi makandii.
eng_text: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the communion of the Holy Ghost, be with you all. Amen.

djk_text: Mi Pawlesi e sikiifi a biifi ya enke apaiti bosikopuman fu Masaa Jesesi. A ná sama poti mi na a wooko ya, meke sama á de fu gafa fu dati. Na Jesesi Kelestesi anga u Tata, Masaa Gadu, di be weki en kon a libi baka.
eng_text: Paul, an apostle, (not of men, neither by man, but by Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead;)

djk_text: Mi sikiifi a biifi ya makandii anga taa biibi baala di e mokisa wooko anga mi dise. A de gi ala kulu fu biibiwan na a pisiwataa fu Galasiya anda.
eng_text: And all the brethren which are with me, unto the churches of Galatia:

djk_text: Meke u Tata, Masaa Gadu anga Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku u de. Soseefi, meke u ati de switi.
eng_text: Grace be to you and peace from God the Father, and from our Lord Jesus Christ,

djk_text: We, luku fa Masaa Jesesi be poti enseefi teke dede gi wi enke paiman, fu takuudu anga ogii. Ma, soseefi, a puu wi a ini a takuu goontapu fu didibii. Na so u Tata, Masaa Gadu wani.
eng_text: Who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us from this present evil world, according to the will of God and our Father:

djk_text: Da bali gafa Masaa Gadu naamo, gi en gaandi alaten. Amen, na so a de!
eng_text: To whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

djk_text: Ma a foondoo mi, fu a satu pisiten di mi komoto de, ne u e feegete Masaa Gadu kaba. Bika u e diipi komoto ne en di kai u kon toon sama fi enseefi, di a teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku, ne a meke Kelestesi puu wi a takuudu anga ogii. Da fa u sa abaa gwe a taa falisi leli di á de a tuutuu Bun Nyunsu de?
eng_text: I marvel that ye are so soon removed from him that called you into the grace of Christ unto another gospel:

djk_text: A falisi bosikopu de a ná di fu Masaa Gadu tuutuu wan. Mi e taki so, fu wasikoi u a son sama, leti a u mindii de, di wani buuya u. Den e daai a tuutuu Bun Nyunsu fu Kelestesi.
eng_text: Which is not another; but there be some that trouble you, and would pervert the gospel of Christ.

djk_text: Ma sama di e daai a Bun Nyunsu, fu kengi anga a tuutuu wan di wi ya be tyai, da a mu luku bun! Winsi na wi ya seefi, ofu wan Engel be sa du dati. Masaa Gadu o fuuku en fu tego.
eng_text: But though we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you, let him be accursed.

djk_text: Wi be taigi u kaba, senten a fosi leisi di wi be kon de. Mi e taki en baka, fu wasikoi sama di e daai a Bun Nyunsu kengi anga a tuutuu wan, di wi ya be tyai, te u anda be teke biibi moimoi. Luku bun! Masaa Gadu o fuuku en fu tego!
eng_text: As we said before, so say I now again, If any man preach any other gospel unto you than that ye have received, let him be accursed.

djk_text: We, mi nái taki sani fu sama mu gafa mi. Kweti! Bika efu mi suku gafanen a sama, da mi á de wookoman fu Kelestesi moo, di mi e dini. Bika na Masaa Gadu namo mi wani mu gafa mi.
eng_text: For do I now persuade men, or God? or do I seek to please men? for if I yet pleased men, I should not be the servant of Christ.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Meke mi puu kon a kiin taki, a Bun Nyunsu di mi e tyai ya á de wan koni di komoto a libisama.
eng_text: But I certify you, brethren, that the gospel which was preached of me is not after man.

djk_text: Pe mi fende a Bun Nyunsu ya á de taki, na libisama taigi mi en. A ná sama leli mi en tu. Ma na Jesesi Kelestesi seefi puu en kon a kiin gi mi, go doo a wooko di a du seefi.
eng_text: For I neither received it of man, neither was I taught it, but by the revelation of Jesus Christ.

djk_text: Bika u ala sabi fa mi be e libi enke fa ala Dyusama e denki sani. Mi be lon du ogii seefi anga den kulu sama di e waka a Jesesi baka, fu kaba den a soso puu a goontapu.
eng_text: For ye have heard of my conversation in time past in the Jews' religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the church of God, and wasted it:

djk_text: Bika mi be teke Dyusama libi fu bigi! Mi be de a fesi fu somen biya fu mi a Dyu Kondee, a ini a feti fu wooko anga weiti, di avo Dyu gaansama fika gi wi, fa fu dini Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: And profited in the Jews' religion above many my equals in mine own nation, being more exceedingly zealous of the traditions of my fathers.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Gadu be abi taa denki anga mi! Fosi mi be meke seefi, da a be fiti poti kaba, fu teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku mi, fu teke mi toon sama fi enseefi. Ne di a yuu di a wani doo,
eng_text: But when it pleased God, who separated me from my mother's womb, and called me by his grace,

djk_text: ne a tyai mi kon sabi awan kodo Manpikin, Jesesi. Ne enseefi poti mi na a wooko fu soi foluku di á de Dyu, a Bun Nyunsu fi en. Na dati meke mi á go suku koni a sama, ofu meke sama leli mi san fu du.
eng_text: To reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the heathen; immediately I conferred not with flesh and blood:

djk_text: Mi á go a Jelusalem Foto seefi a den apaiti bosikopuman anda, fu leli mi san fu du tu. Den toon apaiti bosikopuman fosi mi tuu, ma toku mi á go a den so. Ma mi teke pasi gwe a wan gaan sabana na Alabiya Kondee pe sama de. Di mi komoto anda baka seefi, ne mi daai go a Damasikosi Foto baka.
eng_text: Neither went I up to Jerusalem to them which were apostles before me; but I went into Arabia, and returned again unto Damascus.

djk_text: Ne na baka dii yali fosi mi go a Jelusalem Foto, ne mi miti Peitilisi de. Ma na tu wiki namo mi tan de.
eng_text: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to see Peter, and abode with him fifteen days.

djk_text: Den taa apaiti bosikopuman seefi mi á be si de, boiti Peitilisi. Nono! Ma wan fu den taawan be de ape tu. Dati na Jakowbesi di fu Masaa Jesesi eigi baala.
eng_text: But other of the apostles saw I none, save James the Lord's brother.

djk_text: Fu tuu! Na Masaa Gadu fesi mi de, da mi á poi lei. Na tuutuu sani mi e sikiifi.
eng_text: Now the things which I write unto you, behold, before God, I lie not.

djk_text: Di mi komoto de, ne mi go lontu na a taa pisiwataa fu Siliya pisiwataa. Soseefi taa pisiwataa fu Silisiya pisiwataa.
eng_text: Afterwards I came into the regions of Syria and Cilicia;

djk_text: A ten de, da den kulu biibiwan fu Kelestesi na a pisiwataa fu Judeja noiti be si mi anga ain wanten.
eng_text: And was unknown by face unto the churches of Judaea which were in Christ:

djk_text: Den be e yee namo fu mi taki: “A man di be e lon du ogii anga wi biibiwan, e sende sama nownow, fu teke a seefi biibi de. We, a sa de taki, na a seefi man di be e tapu sama a dati, fosifosi?”
eng_text: But they had heard only, That he which persecuted us in times past now preacheth the faith which once he destroyed.

djk_text: We, a sani ya be meke den poolo te, ne den e gi Masaa Gadu gaandi, fu mi ede.
eng_text: And they glorified God in me.

djk_text: Namo baka tin na fo yali fosi mi go doo Jelusalem Foto baka. Mi anga Balnabasi. Mi be tyai Titesi anga mi tu.
eng_text: Then fourteen years after I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, and took Titus with me also.

djk_text: Mi á be go de taki, na sama be sende kai mi. Kweti! Na Masaa Gadu be piki mi, fu go a den edeman di sama e teli de, so bigi. Bika mi mu soi den fa mi dati e soi foluku, di á de Dyu, a Bun Nyunsu. Mi go taki fiti anga den, fu buuya á sa komoto a den, fu kon poli a wooko di mi e du, soseefi du pasa kaba.
eng_text: And I went up by revelation, and communicated unto them that gospel which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately to them which were of reputation, lest by any means I should run, or had run, in vain.

djk_text: We, Titesi seefi di e yeepi mi wooko na wan lala Giiki sama. Da den be sa sende en go koti maiki a manpeesi taki, na so namo a sa poi kon toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu. Ma kweti!
eng_text: But neither Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised:

djk_text: Na wan duupu taa sama be pee biibisama, bolo kon kibii luku fa ala sani o waka de. Den be wani si efu sama di mokisa libi anga Kelestesi Jesesi komoto a weiti ondoo. Den wani dwengi u go meke weiti wooko enke basi a u tapu baka.
eng_text: And that because of false brethren unawares brought in, who came in privily to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage:

djk_text: Ma wi á du san den wani. Kweti! Bika wi mu oli a Bun Nyunsu, di de Masaa Gadu bosikopu, na a leti fasi gi u anda, go doo.
eng_text: To whom we gave place by subjection, no, not for an hour; that the truth of the gospel might continue with you.

djk_text: Den apaiti bosikopuman, di sama e teli bigi de, á be suku fu mi daai fa mi e taki Masaa Gadu bosikopu. Di mi e kai den so á wani taki, mi e teli den bigi tumisi, winsi fa den be waka anga Kelestesi Jesesi seefi. Bika a u mindii, da u nái keli taawan bigi moo taawan. Ma fa mi be taki kaba, den á be suku fu mi daai fa mi e taki Masaa Gadu bosikopu.
eng_text: But of these who seemed to be somewhat, (whatsoever they were, it maketh no matter to me: God accepteth no man's person:) for they who seemed to be somewhat in conference added nothing to me:

djk_text: Ma den si a toli hii taa fasi. Den fusutan taki, na Masaa Gadu seefi poti mi, fu soi foluku di á de Dyu, a Bun Nyunsu. A poti Peitilisi tu, ma na fu soi Dyusama a seefi bosikopu ya.
eng_text: But contrariwise, when they saw that the gospel of the uncircumcision was committed unto me, as the gospel of the circumcision was unto Peter;

djk_text: A kai Peitilisi poti en kaakiti toon apaiti bosikopuman, sende go a Dyusama. Na soseefi a kai mi dati poti en kaakiti toon apaiti bosikopuman, sende go a foluku di á de Dyu.
eng_text: (For he that wrought effectually in Peter to the apostleship of the circumcision, the same was mighty in me toward the Gentiles:)

djk_text: Gaan tiiman fu biibiwan enke Jakowbesi, Peitilisi anga Johanisi na dii apaiti bosikopuman di si a hii toli ya.
