Den fusutan fa Masaa Gadu teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku mi, fu poti mi na a wooko ya. Ne den soi taki, den o wooko makandii anga mi anga Balnabasi. Bika den seke wi ana taki, u na fu go a den foluku di á de Dyu, ma den o go a den Dyusama.
eng_text: And when James, Cephas, and John, who seemed to be pillars, perceived the grace that was given unto me, they gave to me and Barnabas the right hands of fellowship; that we should go unto the heathen, and they unto the circumcision.

djk_text: Wan sani namo den begi mi. Mi á mu feegete den mofina biibiwan. Mi mu feti fu yeepi den anga san den abi fanowdu. We, fu tuu, na wan sani di mi feti du ibii yuu, enke fa den be akisi mi de.
eng_text: Only they would that we should remember the poor; the same which I also was forward to do.

djk_text: Ma di Peitilisi be kon na Antiyokiya Foto, da a be meke wan gaan fowtu. Ma mi á kibii en. Mi luku en ne en mindii fesi, soi en sowtu ogii a du.
eng_text: But when Peter was come to Antioch, I withstood him to the face, because he was to be blamed.

djk_text: Bika a be gwenti sidon nyan makandii anga taa foluku biibiwan. Ma a koti mofu wanten di Jakowbesi sende biibi Dyusama kon luku den biibiwan de. A feele san den o taki fi en. Bika den dati koti a maiki a manpeesi, fu toon Masaa Gadu sama di e oli weiti.
eng_text: For before that certain came from James, he did eat with the Gentiles: but when they were come, he withdrew and separated himself, fearing them which were of the circumcision.

djk_text: Namo ala taa biibi Dyu fu ape tiiki ne en baka, ala fa den sabi taki, dati á de wan leti fasi, fu wooko. Balnabasi seefi kai go a ini a ogii ya.
eng_text: And the other Jews dissembled likewise with him; insomuch that Barnabas also was carried away with their dissimulation.

djk_text: Namo mi si taki, den nái tyai denseefi fiti fa a Bun Nyunsu taki. Ne mi kai Peitilisi poti a den taawan fesi taki: “Mi sabi fa yu de wan Dyusama di nái libi moo anga Dyu fasi. Da yu kon de enke foluku di á de Dyu. Da saide yu e fende taki, taa foluku biibiwan mu teke Dyusama fasi?”
eng_text: But when I saw that they walked not uprightly according to the truth of the gospel, I said unto Peter before them all, If thou, being a Jew, livest after the manner of Gentiles, and not as do the Jews, why compellest thou the Gentiles to live as do the Jews?

djk_text: Ne mi taki ete taki: “Libisama fasi, da mi anga yu, Peitilisi, na Dyusama di leli dini Masaa Gadu, na a fasi fu Dyusama anga weiti. Da wi á de taa foluku sama di wi e kai gaan takuuduman, di e booko Masaa Gadu weiti.
eng_text: We who are Jews by nature, and not sinners of the Gentiles,

djk_text: Ma u kon sabi taki, sama á poi wooko anga weiti, fu toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu. Da na biibi di u ya seefi poti a Kelestesi Jesesi namo, meke useefi toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu. Na dati meke wi e taki, sama á poi wooko anga weiti, fu toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: Knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law, but by the faith of Jesus Christ, even we have believed in Jesus Christ, that we might be justified by the faith of Christ, and not by the works of the law: for by the works of the law shall no flesh be justified.

djk_text: Da fa useefi be mu teke biibi a Kelestesi, fu toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu, da dati e soi fa useefi taampu enke fa takuuduman a ini foluku di á de Dyu seefi taampu. A hii toli ya e gei Kelestesi taampu a baka fu takuuduman di e booko weiti! Ma kweti!
eng_text: But if, while we seek to be justified by Christ, we ourselves also are found sinners, is therefore Christ the minister of sin? God forbid.

djk_text: Ma fu daai baka, fu wooko anga weiti taki, da a o poti mi toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu, da na gaan ogii mi du. Bika, da mi komoto na a biibi namo, di poti mi toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: For if I build again the things which I destroyed, I make myself a transgressor.

djk_text: Bika mi ya na dedewan, fu di weiti e soi taki, mi nái teli weiti, da mi mu dede. Ma na ala dati opo pasi gi mi, fu poi fende libi anga Masaa Gadu. Bika mi mokisa dede anga Kelestesi na a koloisi.
eng_text: For I through the law am dead to the law, that I might live unto God.

djk_text: Da now mi e libi. Ma a ná anga miseefi taanga mi e libi moo, ma na Kelestesi e libi a mi ini solanga mi de a goontapu. Da mi abi biibi na awan kodo Manpikin fu Masaa Gadu fu yeepi mi. Bika a lobi mi te, ne a teke dede enke a paiman, fu pai a mi peesi.
eng_text: I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me.

djk_text: We, na gaan bun ati fasi namo di Masaa Gadu teke luku mi so. Ne a du dati gi mi. A meke Kelestesi teke dede pai a mi peesi. Da dati á mu waka fu soso, taki sama e kon toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu, te den wooko anga weiti. Kweti!
eng_text: I do not frustrate the grace of God: for if righteousness come by the law, then Christ is dead in vain.

djk_text: Ma biibiwan fu Galasiya pisiwataa! U nái fusutan sani moo, no? Sama kon fende pasi buuya u de so? Bika mi be puu kon a kiin gi u kaba, fa u fende yeepi. Jesesi Kelestesi poti enseefi gi den, den kii a koloisi enke paiman, fu teke dede pai a wi peesi.
eng_text: O foolish Galatians, who hath bewitched you, that ye should not obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ hath been evidently set forth, crucified among you?

djk_text: We, da u piki mi! Saide meke Masaa Gadu be gi u a Apaiti Jeje fi en? Na di u teke biibi fitoow a Bun Nyunsu fi en di e bali lontu, ofu na di u wooko anga weiti?
eng_text: This only would I learn of you, Received ye the Spirit by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?

djk_text: We, na di u be fende a Apaiti Jeje so, meke u be poi bigin a biibi libi. Da u law de fu denki taki, na useefi mu wooko anga sikin, fu toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Are ye so foolish? having begun in the Spirit, are ye now made perfect by the flesh?

djk_text: We, u be teke somen pina anda fu a biibi ya ede kaba, da mi á denki u sa meke dati pasa fu soso. Kweti!
eng_text: Have ye suffered so many things in vain? if it be yet in vain.

djk_text: We, u aliki ya baka. Saide meke Masaa Gadu e wooko anga a Apaiti Jeje fi en a ini u de, fu du foondoo sani? Na di u teke biibi, fitoow a Bun Nyunsu fi en di e bali lontu, ofu na di u wooko anga weiti?
eng_text: He therefore that ministereth to you the Spirit, and worketh miracles among you, doeth he it by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?

djk_text: Bika saide Masaa Gadu Buku be sikiifi taki: “Na di Abalaham be teke biibi fitoow Masaa Gadu namo, meke a toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu kaba?”
eng_text: Even as Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.

djk_text: We, na fu soi taki, na sama di teke fitoow biibi Masaa Gadu enke Abalaham, e teli enke paansu sama fu Abalaham.
eng_text: Know ye therefore that they which are of faith, the same are the children of Abraham.

djk_text: We, Masaa Gadu Buku be sikiifi fu dati a fesi taki: “Ala taa foluku di á de Dyusama sa teke biibi fitoow mi, da den toon bun sama gi mi Masaa Gadu ya.” We, na a Bun Nyunsu a be gi Abalaham seefi a fesi, di a be taigi en taki: “Mi o teke a paansu sama fi yu, fu tyai seigi go doo ala foluku a goontapu.”
eng_text: And the scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the heathen through faith, preached before the gospel unto Abraham, saying, In thee shall all nations be blessed.

djk_text: We, san u e si tide dei? Ala sama di teke biibi fitoow Masaa Gadu, da na so ai seigi den tuu, enke fa a be seigi Abalaham, di Abalaham be biibi en.
eng_text: So then they which be of faith are blessed with faithful Abraham.

djk_text: Bika sama di e wooko anga Dyuweiti, fu toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu, da den dati fende fuuku, fu di Masaa Gadu be taki, den abi fowtu. Bika sama á de fu wooko anga weiti enke fa a mu de. Bika Masaa Gadu Buku sikiifi taki: “Masaa Gadu fuuku ibii sama taki, den abi fowtu, bika den á poi wooko fini fini anga den weiti fu Mosesi.”
eng_text: For as many as are of the works of the law are under the curse: for it is written, Cursed is every one that continueth not in all things which are written in the book of the law to do them.

djk_text: Da Masaa Gadu nái meke sama toon bun sama gi en seefi, te den wooko anga weiti. Ma na sama di poti fitoow ne en tapu namo, ai du dati gi. Bika en Buku sikiifi taki: “Wan sama sa toon bun sama gi mi Masaa Gadu ya, te a teke biibi fitoow mi ya namo.”
eng_text: But that no man is justified by the law in the sight of God, it is evident: for, The just shall live by faith.

djk_text: Ma te sama e wooko anga weiti, da na feti du sani anga sikin, fu toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu. Da a nái de taki, na teke biibi fitoow Masaa Gadu. Ma Masaa Gadu Buku sikiifi taki: “Na sama di poi wooko fini fini anga weiti sa fende libi fu tego a Masaa Gadu.”
eng_text: And the law is not of faith: but, The man that doeth them shall live in them.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Gadu fuuku ala sama di á poi wooko fini fini anga weiti taki, den mu dede. Wi enke biibiwan á de a ini, winsi fa useefi nái wooko fini fini anga weiti. Bika Kelestesi teke a fuuku a wi peesi. Bika Masaa Gadu Buku sikiifi taki: “Ibii sama di den tei lenge lenge a wan udu ponsu kii, fuuku.”
eng_text: Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us: for it is written, Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree:

djk_text: Na so ibii sama, winsi pe a de, ma a de fu Kelestesi, da a sa fende a seigi, di Masaa Gadu be paamisi Abalaham. Soseefi a sa meke en Apaiti Jeje teke peesi a ini a libi fu a sama di teke biibi fitoow so!
eng_text: That the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Jesus Christ; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.

djk_text: We, biibiwan! Masaa Gadu be kuudei anga Abalaham kaba taki, a o gi en bun di a paamisi en. Da a á poi booko ofu kengi mofu moo. Bika luku te sama a goontapu seefi kuudei naki sitampu a lanti, da den á poi booko, ofu kengi dati moo.
eng_text: Brethren, I speak after the manner of men; Though it be but a man's covenant, yet if it be confirmed, no man disannulleth, or addeth thereto.

djk_text: We, Masaa Gadu be paamisi Abalaham bun anga a paansu sama fi en. Ma luku de! A á be taki: “Den paansu sama fi yu.” Ma a taki: “A paansu sama fi yu.” Dati na wankodo sama namo di de a Kelestesi.
eng_text: Now to Abraham and his seed were the promises made. He saith not, And to seeds, as of many; but as of one, And to thy seed, which is Christ.

djk_text: Dati wani taki, a be kuudei anga Abalaham taki: “Mi musu gi yu bun di mi paamisi yu.” Namo baka fo ondoo diitenti (430) yali, ne a sende weiti kon, fu sama wooko. Ma dati á poi booko a kuudei fi en anga Abalaham. Bika a nái kengi mofu. Bika a kuudei á be de fu Abalaham mu wooko fosi a gi Abalaham bun di a paamisi en.
eng_text: And this I say, that the covenant, that was confirmed before of God in Christ, the law, which was four hundred and thirty years after, cannot disannul, that it should make the promise of none effect.

djk_text: Bika kon u taki, na wooko anga weiti e meke Masaa Gadu gi sama en gaan bun, sama á be o poi taki, na fu di Masaa Gadu paamisi gaan bun namo. We, da kweti! Bika u si fa a be paamisi Abalaham sani namo, ne a du en gi en. Da na gaan bun ati fasi namo a teke luku en de so.
eng_text: For if the inheritance be of the law, it is no more of promise: but God gave it to Abraham by promise.

djk_text: Bika saide a poti weiti fu sama wooko? Na fu soi den sama namo taki, a abi leti fu taki, den fiti sitaafu. Weiti kon fu soi efu yu e wooko bun ofu fowtu. Na so sani mu waka doo a yuu ten pe Awan kon doo, di de a Paansu Sama di Masaa Gadu be paamisi, fu kon du bun. Da luku fa weiti waka kon a goontapu. Masaa Gadu sende en anga Engel poti a Mosesi ana, fu gi den Dyusama.
eng_text: Wherefore then serveth the law? It was added because of transgressions, till the seed should come to whom the promise was made; and it was ordained by angels in the hand of a mediator.

djk_text: Da saide sama mu taampu a mindii fu wan wooko so? Na te moo enke tu sama de fu du wan sani, da sama mu de fu luku, efu ai go leti. Ma a kuudei fi en anga Abalaham á be abi dati fanowdu. Bika ne en wawan be mu du wan sani.
eng_text: Now a mediator is not a mediator of one, but God is one.

djk_text: We, da ai gei fu wooko anga weiti e sitee anga te Masaa Gadu paamisi sama bun! Ma kweti! Bika efu weiti be poi gi sama libi fu tego, da wooko anga den be o meke sama toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Is the law then against the promises of God? God forbid: for if there had been a law given which could have given life, verily righteousness should have been by the law.

djk_text: Ma kweti! Masaa Gadu Buku sikiifi taki, ala sama na takuuduman. Da na biibi Jesesi Kelestesi sa puu sama a takuudu anga ogii. Da a sama sa fende bun di Masaa Gadu paamisi Abalaham anga a paansu biibisama fi en.
eng_text: But the scripture hath concluded all under sin, that the promise by faith of Jesus Christ might be given to them that believe.

djk_text: Ma fosi biibi Masaa Jesesi be kon doo, da weiti be mu kon wooko a u tapu fosi. Bika dati mu soi wi taki, wi á poi komoto a Masaa Gadu sitaafu. A wooko so doo a ten di Masaa Gadu puu kon a kiin, fa wan fasi de fu komoto na a sitaafu fi en, toon bun sama gi en. Dati na fu teke biibi a Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: But before faith came, we were kept under the law, shut up unto the faith which should afterwards be revealed.

djk_text: We, da weiti gei wan wookoman di wan gudu dda abi, fu kweki en nyoni pikin te enke a lepi sai fu komoto na a wookoman de ondoo. Na so u tan a weiti ondoo doo na a yuu ten fu u sa teke biibi a Kelestesi, fu toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Wherefore the law was our schoolmaster to bring us unto Christ, that we might be justified by faith.

djk_text: We, di u sa teke biibi nownow, da weiti á de enke wookoman a u tapu moo, fu soi san fiti anga san fowtu.
eng_text: But after that faith is come, we are no longer under a schoolmaster.

djk_text: Bika di u teke biibi a Kelestesi Jesesi, da u toon pikin fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: For ye are all the children of God by faith in Christ Jesus.

djk_text: Bika wi teke a dopu fu Kelestesi. Dati wani taki, u mokisa libi anga Kelestesi.
eng_text: For as many of you as have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ.

djk_text: Da mokisa libi anga Kelestesi á de taki, Dyusama kengi anga foluku di á de Dyu. Saafu a katibo seefi á kengi anga fiiman. Kengi á de tu fu uman efu man. Bika Masaa Gadu e si wi ala enke sama fu Kelestesi Jesesi, da a kaba.
eng_text: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: for ye are all one in Christ Jesus.

djk_text: Da u di de fu Kelestesi, na a paansu sama fu Abalaham. Na u dati abi fu fende den bun di Masaa Gadu be paamisi Abalaham anga en paansu sama.
eng_text: And if ye be Christ's, then are ye Abraham's seed, and heirs according to the promise.

djk_text: Ma te wan dda gudu, da en gudu na fu toon fi en pikin. Ma te a pikin nyoni, da a dda á poi poti a gudu ne en ana ete. Ma wan dei o doo pe a pikin o de basi fu a gudu namo. Ma nownow, da a pikin anga a saafu fu a dda gei na awan sama di ná abi noti.
eng_text: Now I say, That the heir, as long as he is a child, differeth nothing from a servant, though he be lord of all;

djk_text: A dda e poti wookoman na a pikin tapu seefi, fu leli en waka, anga fu luku en. Soseefi wookoman di abi fusutan fu tii a gudu. Ma te a dei doo pe a dda fii taki, en pikin bigi, da ai poti a gudu ne en ana, fu de basi fi en.
eng_text: But is under tutors and governors until the time appointed of the father.

djk_text: Na so wiseefi be de fosi Masaa Jesesi kon doo. Wi á be doo peesi, meke sowtu a sowtu weiti be e wooko enke basi a u tapu.
eng_text: Even so we, when we were children, were in bondage under the elements of the world:

djk_text: Ma di a yuu fu Masaa Gadu doo, ne a sende en Manpikin kon, meke komoto a mama bee, wan libisama fasi. Namo a saka enseefi meke wan weiti wooko enke gaan basi ne en tapu, enke fa Masaa Gadu wani.
eng_text: But when the fulness of the time was come, God sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,

djk_text: Na so a bai wi puu na a katibo fu weiti, meke a kaba wooko enke gaan basi a u tapu. Da u toon pikin fu Masaa Gadu nownow.
eng_text: To redeem them that were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of sons.

djk_text: We, di u toon pikin fu Masaa Gadu kaba, ne a sende a seefi Apaiti Jeje di de a ini en Manpikin kon a ini wi tu. Da dati gi wi kaakiti, fu bali kai Masaa Gadu taki: “Abba, wi lobi Tata.”
eng_text: And because ye are sons, God hath sent forth the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, Abba, Father.

djk_text: Da u sa dini en, sondee fu den weiti wooko enke gaan basi a u tapu. Bika sama di toon pikin fi en, na fu a gi bun di a abi, fu gi pikin.
eng_text: Wherefore thou art no more a servant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.

djk_text: Ma di u á be leli sabi Masaa Gadu ete, da u be abi falisi sani e dini enke na Gadu. Den be e wooko enke gaan basi a u tapu.
eng_text: Howbeit then, when ye knew not God, ye did service unto them which by nature are no gods.

djk_text: Ma yu kon leli sabi Masaa Gadu now. Fu taki leti, ne en kon sabi yu enke sama fi en. Da a ná sani fu daai go teke a haw goontapu fasi baka, fu meke weiti di á doo peesi wooko a i tapu baka. Bika den á poi meke i kon de bun gi Masaa Gadu. Kweti!
eng_text: But now, after that ye have known God, or rather are known of God, how turn ye again to the weak and beggarly elements, whereunto ye desire again to be in bondage?

djk_text: Ma a tyali de! Bika u bigin baka fu oli a Dyu kina dei. Soseefi ibii fosi dei fu mun anga apaiti taa ten fu yali. Soseefi son yali di de apaiti gi Dyusama.
eng_text: Ye observe days, and months, and times, and years.

djk_text: We, mi sidon anga pakisei fu u ya. Bika a gei na fu soso mi be simpan, du a hii wooko di mi be du a u mindii anda.
eng_text: I am afraid of you, lest I have bestowed upon you labour in vain.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Gaantangi, mi e begi u! U waka enke mi. Komoto na a katibo, pe weiti e wooko enke gaan basi a sama tapu. Bika mi enke Dyu komoto a dati kon tan enke u di á de Dyu de. Da luku fa u be diki mi, tyai a tapu a fosi leisi di mi be kon de. U be libi bun anga mi ala fasi.
eng_text: Brethren, I beseech you, be as I am; for I am as ye are: ye have not injured me at all.

djk_text: Ma u be si taki, na siki be tyai mi kon de, di mi be gi u a Bun Nyunsu.
eng_text: Ye know how through infirmity of the flesh I preached the gospel unto you at the first.

djk_text: Ma fa mi á be kaba de gusontu fasi, da a siki fu mi be musu tan ogii gi u, fu oli mi enke seekitiman. Da u be sa wai fesi gi mi. Ma kweti! U be puu mi a boto anga piisii seefi, te moo so á be de. Winsi na wan Engel seefi be doo de, u á be o libi bun anga en moo so. Bika u be libi anga mi enke mi na Kelestesi Jesesi seefi.
eng_text: And my temptation which was in my flesh ye despised not, nor rejected; but received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.

djk_text: We, da u feegete fa u be taki, u e poolo fu mi ede? U sabi ete fa u be piisii, di mi be gi u a Bun Nyunsu? A be switi gi u te, u ain seefi u be sa diki poti gi mi. Tuutuu!
eng_text: Where is then the blessedness ye spake of? for I bear you record, that, if it had been possible, ye would have plucked out your own eyes, and have given them to me.

djk_text: Ma fa u daai e wooko taa fasi anga mi, enke u toon feyanti so? Na fu di mi e soi u, fa Masaa Gadu bosikopu de tuutuu?
eng_text: Am I therefore become your enemy, because I tell you the truth?

djk_text: We, sama de anda e leli u falisi bosikopu. Den e meke enke den abi u fanowdu. Ma a ná tuu! Bika san den abi a den denki á bun! Den wani u kaba aliki mi anga san mi e leli u. Den wani wini u poti a den se. Da u sa aliki den anga den falisi leli fu den.
eng_text: They zealously affect you, but not well; yea, they would exclude you, that ye might affect them.

djk_text: We, a ná ogii fu sama kon libi soi, fa yu de fanowdu gi en, fu teke en taki. Ma a taki mu de wan bunbun sani, fu yeepi yu. Na sowan fasi mi dati e wooko anga u anda. Ma a ná te mi de a u mindii de namo.
eng_text: But it is good to be zealously affected always in a good thing, and not only when I am present with you.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Te mi pakisei u anda, da mi e fii en dipi a mi ati, enke fa bee e nyan mama, fi en pikin. Da a fii ya sa tan, te enke mi yee taki, u poti yesi e teke den leli fu Kelestesi, fu wooko.
eng_text: My little children, of whom I travail in birth again until Christ be formed in you,

djk_text: We, mi angii ya, fu doo u anda baka, fu taigi u den sani ya fesi fesi. Da mi sa taki wan moo switi mati fasi anga u. Bika na booko mi e booko ede nownow tuutuu, fu u ede.
eng_text: I desire to be present with you now, and to change my voice; for I stand in doubt of you.

djk_text: Bika son fu u wani daai go teke den weiti poti wooko enke gaan basi a u tapu baka. Ma luku wan toli di sikiifi, a ini den seefi weiti buku de.
eng_text: Tell me, ye that desire to be under the law, do ye not hear the law?

djk_text: A sikiifi taki Abalaham be abi tu manpikin. Ibiiwan abi en mma. Wan fu den mma na Abalaham tuutuu uman. Dati á be de saafu a katibo, meke en paansu pikin seefi á de saafu. A taa mma na be saafu a katibo, meke en paansu pikin na be saafu.
eng_text: For it is written, that Abraham had two sons, the one by a bondmaid, the other by a freewoman.

djk_text: A manpikin fu a saafu uman á meke foondoo fasi. Ma di fu a fii uman dati meke foondoo fasi. Bika na san Masaa Gadu be paamisi Abalaham.
eng_text: But he who was of the bondwoman was born after the flesh; but he of the freewoman was by promise.

djk_text: A toli ya dipi! Bika a gei den tu sowtu kuudei di Masaa Gadu meke anga libisama. A fosiwan dati, a meke anga Mosesi a Sinai Mongo. Dati na fu weiti wooko enke gaan basi a sama tapu. Da a gei Aakali enke saafu mma di e meke paansu di de saafu, a katibo.
eng_text: Which things are an allegory: for these are the two covenants; the one from the mount Sinai, which gendereth to bondage, which is Agar.

djk_text: Sinai Mongo pe a kuudei ya meke, dati de na Alabiya Kondee. Da nownow seefi, na ape paansu fu a saafu uman e tan. A peesi de anga Jelusalem Foto fu goontapu ya taampu a seefi fasi anga weiti, fu wooko enke gaan basi a sama tapu. Da den gei Aakali, enke saafu mma di e meke paansu di de saafu a katibo.
eng_text: For this Agar is mount Sinai in Arabia, and answereth to Jerusalem which now is, and is in bondage with her children.

djk_text: Ma Jelusalem Foto fu tapu, gei a mma di á de saafu a katibo. Bika wi di o doo anda na biibisama di komoto na a katibo fu weiti.
eng_text: But Jerusalem which is above is free, which is the mother of us all.

djk_text: Masaa Gadu Buku sikiifi fu dati taki: “Dyombo piisii, yu enke uman di fosi á meke pikin! Bika yu á be sabi bee nyan fu pikin. Ma dyonson yu paansu sama o ipi moo a uman, di fosi be meke pikin anga a man.”
eng_text: For it is written, Rejoice, thou barren that bearest not; break forth and cry, thou that travailest not: for the desolate hath many more children than she which hath an husband.

djk_text: We, biibiwan! Wi na a paansu pikin di Masaa Gadu be meke en Apaiti Jeje paamisi Abalaham, na a fasi fu Isaki.
eng_text: Now we, brethren, as Isaac was, are the children of promise.

djk_text: Ma san Masaa Gadu Buku sikiifi ete? A manpikin di á meke foondoo fasi, lon du ogii anga di a Apaiti Jeje fu Masaa Gadu meke foondoo fasi. Na dati e pasa nownow tu.
eng_text: But as then he that was born after the flesh persecuted him that was born after the Spirit, even so it is now.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Gadu Buku sikiifi taki: “Towe a mma saafu anga en manpikin di a meke! Bika dati á meke fu fende a gudu fu a dda. A gudu de, na fu a manpikin fu a mma di á de saafu.”
eng_text: Nevertheless what saith the scripture? Cast out the bondwoman and her son: for the son of the bondwoman shall not be heir with the son of the freewoman.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Ala san pasa a fositen de mu soi fa wi á de paansu sama fu a mama saafu. Wi na paansu sama fu a fii mama.
eng_text: So then, brethren, we are not children of the bondwoman, but of the free.

djk_text: We, Kelestesi puu wi a katibo fu weiti tuu, meke den á poi wooko enke gaan basi a u tapu moo. Da meke u feti fu tan libi sondee u de saafu a katibo fu den.
eng_text: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.

djk_text: We, mi Pawlesi ya e wasikoi biibisama di sa komoto go koti a maiki a manpeesi taki, na fu toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu. Yu o lasi a hii yeepi di Kelestesi tyai, fu meke i toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Behold, I Paul say unto you, that if ye be circumcised, Christ shall profit you nothing.

djk_text: Wan toon moo, mi e wasikoi! Biibisama di komoto go koti a maiki a manpeesi taki, na fu toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu: “Luku ya!” Bakadati, da i mu wooko anga ala den weiti tu, sondee wan enkii fowtu.
eng_text: For I testify again to every man that is circumcised, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.

djk_text: Da i naki paati anga Kelestesi tu. Bika yu teke fu wooko anga weiti, fu toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu. Da yu daai baka gi fa Masaa Gadu poti nownow, fu teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku sama, fu meke a toon bun sama gi enseefi.
eng_text: Christ is become of no effect unto you, whosoever of you are justified by the law; ye are fallen from grace.

djk_text: Bika wi dati na a Apaiti Jeje fu Masaa Gadu piki u, san fu biibi. A de so taki, na Masaa Gadu seefi e meke u toon bun sama gi enseefi. Da u e luku fu fende dati seefi na a dei di u o doo ne en fesi.
eng_text: For we through the Spirit wait for the hope of righteousness by faith.

djk_text: Bika wi biibiwan mokisa libi anga Kelestesi Jesesi, meke Masaa Gadu nái si kengi fu biibisama di koti maiki a manpeesi, ofu den di á koti maiki. Kweti! Bika na sama di teke biibi, poti fitoow a Kelestesi namo, na dati e poi dini Masaa Gadu, fu lobi taawan.
eng_text: For in Jesus Christ neither circumcision availeth anything, nor uncircumcision; but faith which worketh by love.

djk_text: We, u be e waka bunbun kaba anga a Bun Nyunsu. Ma sama kon daai u ede ape, meke u nái fusutan a tuutuu fasi fi en moo?
eng_text: Ye did run well; who did hinder you that ye should not obey the truth?

djk_text: A ná Masaa Gadu sende a sama de fu kon buuya u, puu na a leti pasi pe a be teke u poti toon sama fi enseefi kaba! Kweti!
eng_text: This persuasion cometh not of him that calleth you.

djk_text: Da u á mu si a falisi leli enke na wan pikin sani. Bika ai wooko enke a nongo di koti taki, wan pikintoin sowda taanga sai, fu faandi a hii bolon.
eng_text: A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.

djk_text: We, mi anga u de, na sama fu Masaa makandii. Da mi sabi taki, u e denki enke mi, fu fa sama e toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu. Ma den di e kon buuya u de, da Masaa Gadu musu sitaafu den, winsi sama a den.
eng_text: I have confidence in you through the Lord, that ye will be none otherwise minded: but he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment, whosoever he be.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Da fa sama sa kon lei gi mi de taki, mi e leli sama fu koti a maiki a manpeesi, fu toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu? Bika, da Dyusama á be o lon du ogii anga mi moo. A be o switi gi den taki, mi e puu sama na a biibi di taki, na Kelestesi dede a koloisi enke paiman, fu meke sama toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: And I, brethren, if I yet preach circumcision, why do I yet suffer persecution? then is the offence of the cross ceased.

djk_text: We, den sama di wani buuya u so, a gei den lobi koti a maiki a manpeesi tumisi! Ma saide na a buba mofu fu a manpeesi namo den e koti, mi á sabi. Bika den be sa koti a hii manpeesi puu wanten.
eng_text: I would they were even cut off which trouble you.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Masaa Gadu kai u kon toon sama fi enseefi, ne a puu u tuutuu na a katibo fu weiti. Ma fu komoto na a katibo libi fu weiti á wani taki, pasi opo fu waka du takuu losutu di fuu wi ati libisama fasi. Kweti! Ma na fu libi seefi soi taawan taki, u lobi den.
eng_text: For, brethren, ye have been called unto liberty; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love serve one another.

djk_text: Bika ala san Masaa Gadu weiti wani, dati e kai a wankodo weiti namo: “Lobi taawan enke fa i lobi iseefi.”
eng_text: For all the law is fulfilled in one word, even in this; Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

djk_text: Ma efu na ogii u e du anga taawan, enke takuu meti fu nyan taawan kii, da u luku bun! Bika u sa kaba anga useefi a soso de. U sa booko a hii kulu biibiwan.
eng_text: But if ye bite and devour one another, take heed that ye be not consumed one of another.

djk_text: San mi wani taigi u na disi: U waka naamo enke fa a Apaiti Jeje wani. Ma noiti waka du takuu losutu di fuu wi ati libisama fasi.
eng_text: This I say then, Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulful the lust of the flesh.

djk_text: Bika takuu losutu fuu wi ati libisama fasi. Da den nái fiti anga san a Apaiti Jeje wani. Soseefi san Masaa Gadu Apaiti Jeje wani nái fiti anga den takuu losutu di fuu wi ati libisama fasi. Den e feti fu anga denseefi, a ini wi. Na so meke sama sa poti fu du wan sani, a á poi du en.
eng_text: For the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh: and these are contrary the one to the other: so that ye cannot do the things that ye would.

djk_text: Ma te wi e du naamo san a Apaiti Jeje wani, da weiti ná abi fu wooko enke basi a u tapu, fu katibo u.
eng_text: But if ye be led of the Spirit, ye are not under the law.

djk_text: Bika takuu losutu di fuu wi ati libisama fasi, e de kiin fu si a wan sama libi: Motyo fasi Poli denki Wakawaka libi
eng_text: Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are these; Adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness,

djk_text: Dini falisi gadu Obiya ofu tofuu fasi, fu fuuku taawan Feyanti fasi Kwali Bigi ain fu sama sani Kaakeli feti anga taawan Meke paitei, fu sitee anga taawan Suku wini fi i wawan namo Go teke kulu, fu dini falisi sani
eng_text: Idolatry, witchcraft, hatred, variance, emulations, wrath, strife, seditions, heresies,

djk_text: Dyalusu fu taawan sani Diingi duungu Teke gaan duungu kulu, waka wooko duunguman fasi, a kondee ganda. Somen taa sowtu takuu losutu de ete seefi. Mi be bali u de kaba taki, sama di e du den sani ya, ná o poi fende a bun di de a ini a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Envyings, murders, drunkenness, revellings, and such like: of the which I tell you before, as I have also told you in time past, that they which do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God.

djk_text: Ma te a Apaiti Jeje fu Masaa Gadu e tii i libi, da na den sani ya sama o si a yu: Yu o lobi taawan Yu o abi tuutuu piisii Yu o abi switi fasi Yu o abi langa pasensi Yu go e du bun gi taawan Yu o abi fitoow fasi.
eng_text: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,

djk_text: Yu o abi saka fasi Yu o go e denki taawan nowtu Yu o poi fu dwengi iseefi oli bun fasi. Weiti á de fu sitaafu sama di e du san a Apaiti Jeje wani so. Kweti!
eng_text: Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.

djk_text: Bika sama di de fu Kelestesi Jesesi e kaba anga takuu losutu di fuu sama ati, libisama fasi. Bika di den sipikii a Kelestesi kii a koloisi enke paiman, da denseefi mokisa dede anga en de. Meke den á de a goontapu ya moo, fu du ogii.
eng_text: And they that are Christ's have crucified the flesh with the affections and lusts.

djk_text: We, efu a Apaiti Jeje gi wi wan hii nyun libi so, da meke u tan waka enke fa a wani.
eng_text: If we live in the Spirit, let us also walk in the Spirit.

djk_text: Ma u á mu meke enke u bigi pasa taawan fu dati. U á mu pee enke u letiopu moo taawan. Soseefi u á mu abi bigi ain a taawan sani.
eng_text: Let us not be desirous of vain glory, provoking one another, envying one another.

djk_text: We, biibiwan di e libi enke fa a Apaiti Jeje wani, kande u kisi wan taa biibiwan di misi waka. Da toku so, teke saafi saka fasi, yeepi en kon taampu baka. Bika tesi sa kon a yuseefi pasi tu.
eng_text: Brethren, if a man be overtaken in a fault, ye which are spiritual, restore such an one in the spirit of meekness; considering thyself, lest thou also be tempted.

djk_text: Da te taawan de a fuka, da teke tyali ati fasi yeepi en. Da u e du san Kelestesi wani de.
eng_text: Bear ye one another's burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.

djk_text: Bika efi i e pee bigi fi i seefi, sondee taki i de wan sani, da na koli yu e koli iseefi!
eng_text: For if a man think himself to be something, when he is nothing, he deceiveth himself.

djk_text: Yu wooko na fu keli i seefi luku, fa yu e wooko anga yu biibi. Da efu yu si taki, yu e waka leti, da i sa poolo anga iseefi. Ma a ná fu go maiki iseefi anga taawan taki, i bun moo den. Kweti!
eng_text: But let every man prove his own work, and then shall he have rejoicing in himself alone, and not in another.

djk_text: Bika ibiiwan sa gi faantiwowtu fi en seefi a Masaa Gadu fesi.
eng_text: For every man shall bear his own burden.

djk_text: We, meke den sama di e teke leli fu wan leliman, di e leli den sani fu Masaa Gadu, solugu en na ala fasi.
eng_text: Let him that is taught in the word communicate unto him that teacheth in all good things.

djk_text: Ma kaba waka na a fasi di iseefi e denki. Yu ná o poi sipowtu anga Masaa Gadu sowan fasi. Bika a ná fu soso nongo koti taki, na san i paandi o goo kon lepi gi iseefi fu nyan.
eng_text: Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.

djk_text: Bika sama di e libi anga takuu losutu di fuu en ati libisama fasi, da Masaa Gadu o kuutu en, fu gi sitaafu tego. Ma sama di libi enke fa a Apaiti Jeje wani, da Masaa Gadu o gi en libi tego makandii anga enseefi.
eng_text: For he that soweth to his flesh shall of the flesh reap corruption; but he that soweth to the Spirit shall of the Spirit reap life everlasting.

djk_text: Da noiti weli fu libi na a fasi di e piisii Masaa Gadu. Bika efu wi á lasi ati, da te en yuu di a wani doo, da a o gi wi bun, fu dati.
eng_text: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.

djk_text: We, da meke u á daai daai ibii yuu, te u fende wan okasi fu du bun gi taawan. Feti yeepi taawan. Moomoo, yeepi taa biibiwan enke useefi di de sama fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: As we have therefore opportunity, let us do good unto all men, especially unto them who are of the household of faith.

djk_text: We, luku ya! Miseefi ana oli a sikiifi tiki now, fu sikiifi a pisi fu a biifi ya. Mi e sikiifi en moo bigi seefi.
eng_text: Ye see how large a letter I have written unto you with mine own hand.

djk_text: Na falisi leliman e leli taki, maiki mu koti a manpeesi, fu toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu. Bika den e suku fu Dyusama oli den bun. Bika den e feele enke Dyusama o lon du ogii anga den, efu den leli sama taki, na di Kelestesi dede a koloisi.
eng_text: As many as desire to make a fair shew in the flesh, they constrain you to be circumcised; only lest they should suffer persecution for the cross of Christ.

djk_text: Bika, denseefi nái libi enke fa den weiti taki. Ma den wani namo, fu fende u koti a maiki a u manpeesi, fu Dyusama sa gafa den.
eng_text: For neither they themselves who are circumcised keep the law; but desire to have you circumcised, that they may glory in your flesh.

djk_text: Ma mi dati noiti o suku a sowtu gafa de! Mi o tan bali a nyunsu, fa wi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi dede a koloisi enke a paiman, fu puu wi a takuudu anga ogii. Da fa den nái teli Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi fu wan sani, na so miseefi nái teli san denseefi e teli fu sani tu. Den ná o poi meke mi toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu. Kweti!
eng_text: But God forbid that I should glory, save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom the world is crucified unto me, and I unto the world.

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu seefi nái teli sama fu bigi, efu a koti a maiki a manpeesi, ofu den á koti a maiki a manpeesi. Ma na sama di e libi a hii nyun sowtu libi namo ai teli.
eng_text: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision availeth anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creature.

djk_text: Da mi e begi Masaa Gadu, fu meke den sama di abi a nyun libi ya ati de switi. Soseefi, meke a teke tyali ati fasi luku den. Na so mi e begi, gi a hii Islayeli foluku fu Masaa Gadu tu.
eng_text: And as many as walk according to this rule, peace be on them, and mercy, and upon the Israel of God.

djk_text: We, mi e bali ala sama di e weli mi ede anda anga a toli di mi sikiifi na a biifi ya. U kaba muliki mi so! Bika fa mi de fu Jesesi, da soo maiki fu dati e soi a mi sikin buba.
eng_text: From henceforth let no man trouble me: for I bear in my body the marks of the Lord Jesus.

djk_text: Da mi e begi wi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi, fu teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku u de. Meke u jeje libi sa taampu moo anga moo taanga de. Amen, na so de!
eng_text: Brethren, the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.

djk_text: Mi Pawlesi e sikiifi a biifi ya gi u biibiwan a Efese Foto. Soseefi sama di Masaa Gadu teke poti apaiti fasi, ne u biibi doo. Bika na Masaa Gadu wani, ne a poti mi toon apaiti bosikopuman fu Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, to the saints which are at Ephesus, and to the faithful in Christ Jesus:

djk_text: Da meke u Tata, Masaa Gadu anga Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku u de. Soseefi, meke u ati de switi.
eng_text: Grace be to you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

djk_text: We, gaantangi fu a Gadu anga Tata fu wi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi! A gi u ala sowtu jeje seigi, fu teke wooko go doo a hii pisi fu tapu anda seefi. Bika u mokisa libi anga Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi.
eng_text: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who hath blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ:

djk_text: Langa ten fosi a be meke goontapu seefi, ne a be fiti poti kaba fu teke u toon sama fi enseefi taki, u sa mokisa libi anga Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi. Da dati sa meke a teke wi poti apaiti fasi. Soseefi u sa poi taampu sondee kaagi ne en fesi.
eng_text: According as he hath chosen us in him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without blame before him in love:

djk_text: Na a gaan lobi fi en meke a sende Jesesi Kelestesi kon teke dede pai a wi peesi, meke u sa toon pikin fi en. Tuutuu, a hii sani ya piisii Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Having predestinated us unto the adoption of children by Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his will,

djk_text: Da meke u bali gafa en, fu a gaan dyendee di a teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku wi. Tuutuu, a wooko switi anga wi. A meke en wankodo lobi Manpikin mokisa libi anga ibiiwan fu wi.
eng_text: To the praise of the glory of his grace, wherein he hath made us accepted in the beloved.

djk_text: A meke en wankodo lobi Manpikin mokisa libi anga ibiiwan fu wi, fu puu wi a takuudu anga ogii. Bika di a teke a dede, ne en buulu lon pai fu wi takuudu anga ogii, meke u fende paadon. Da a nái teli a ten moo di u be taanga yesi fu teke en taki. Tuutuu, a gaan bun ati fasi di a teke luku wi ya, bigi pasa maiki.
eng_text: In whom we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, according to the riches of his grace;

djk_text: Da ai teke gaan bun ati fasi namo e luku wi, moo anga moo ete. Tuutuu, a abi gaan koni fu wooko leti fasi a ini ala san ai du.
eng_text: Wherein he hath abounded toward us in all wisdom and prudence;

djk_text: Na so wan gaan koni fasi a wooko, fu du a hii wooko di a be fiti poti a fesi. Na sani di noiti a fesi sama be sabi wanten, meke a be de wan kibii toli hii fositen. Ne na nownow fosi a poti fu tyai en kon a kiin, di Kelestesi kon. A piisii Masaa Gadu seefi seefi, fu bolotyasi a hii sani ya so.
eng_text: Having made known unto us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he hath purposed in himself:

djk_text: A poti ala a sani de fu pasa, te en yuu doo. Da a de taki, wansi wan sani de a goontapu ofu tapu anda seefi. Kelestesi e wooko enke basi a tapu fu ala san Masaa Gadu meke so.
eng_text: That in the dispensation of the fulness of times he might gather together in one all things in Christ, both which are in heaven, and which are on earth; even in him:

djk_text: Soseefi, da ala san a poti a Kelestesi ana toon fu wiseefi tu. Bika u mokisa libi anga en. Na langa ten a fesi Masaa Gadu be fiti poti so, fosi a be meke goontapu seefi. Namo, ne a wooko so nownow tuu.
eng_text: In whom also we have obtained an inheritance, being predestinated according to the purpose of him who worketh all things after the counsel of his own will:

djk_text: We, da wi enke Dyusama di teke biibi ya be sidon langa ten e luku fu fende san be paamisi fu fa a Kelestesi o kon. Namo a doo a wi mindii, te wooko foondoo fasi tuu. A du ala san be paamisi fi en, fu ibii taa foluku sa luku dati, fu gafa a dyendee sani fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: That we should be to the praise of his glory, who first trusted in Christ.

djk_text: We, da taa foluku sama de! Sabi taki, yuseefi di mokisa libi anga Kelestesi, da san Masaa Gadu be paamisi, e toon fi yu tu. Dati na ala san a poti a Kelestesi ana. Bika yu teke biibi na a tuutuu bosikopu fu Masaa Gadu, di de a Bun Nyunsu di i yee. Namo, ne a gi yu en Apaiti Jeje enke wan sitampu di naki a yu.
eng_text: In whom ye also trusted, after that ye heard the word of truth, the gospel of your salvation: in whom also after that ye believed, ye were sealed with that holy Spirit of promise,

djk_text: A Apaiti Jeje ya na wan maiki fu soi wi taki, u sa fende ala den gaan bun di Masaa Gadu paamisi fu gi den sama fi en. Soseefi a Jeje ya puu wi na a katibo fu ibii sani di be e wooko enke basi a u tapu. Da a foondoo fasi fa Masaa Gadu wooko ya fiti fu bali gafa en.
eng_text: Which is the earnest of our inheritance until the redemption of the purchased possession, unto the praise of his glory.

djk_text: We, mi yee dise fa u taa foluku sama anda teke biibi poti fitoow a wi Masaa Jesesi. Soseefi u kon abi lobi fu ala sama di Masaa Gadu teke poti apaiti fasi de.
eng_text: Wherefore I also, after I heard of your faith in the Lord Jesus, and love unto all the saints,

djk_text: Mi e gi Masaa Gadu daa naamo, fu u ede ala yuu mi e begi. Mi e membee u a ini begi tu.
eng_text: Cease not to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers;

djk_text: We, a Masaa Gadu ya na di fu wi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi. Soseefi a Tata fu wi a tapu di wooko gaan foondoo fasi anga en kaakiti, fu yeepi wi. Mi e begi en, fu a Apaiti Jeje fi en gi u apaiti koni fu wooko leti. Soseefi, fu fusutan enseefi doo san a du gi wi. Da u sa poi waka moo anga moo enke fa a wani.
eng_text: That the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give unto you the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him:

djk_text: Da wi di a kai kon toon fi enseefi ain sa moo kiin. Da u ati o opo fu sabi a foondoo fasi di u mu luku en, fu tyai wi. Soseefi fa san a poti fu gi sama fi en bakaten foondoo tuutuu.
eng_text: The eyes of your understanding being enlightened; that ye may know what is the hope of his calling, and what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,

djk_text: Soseefi, fa a makiti di a abi bigi pasa maiki, fu yeepi sama di teke biibi. A makiti fi en ya bigi!
eng_text: And what is the exceeding greatness of his power to usward who believe, according to the working of his mighty power,

djk_text: Na dati a be teke weki Kelestesi a dede kon a libi ya baka. Soseefi a opo en tyai go poti na a gaan hei peesi ne en se a tapu anda.
eng_text: Which he wrought in Christ, when he raised him from the dead, and set him at his own right hand in the heavenly places,

djk_text: Namo a sidon a Masaa Gadu se anda, a tapu fu ala basi di e tii taawan. Makiti di hei ofu lagi moo taawan. Soseefi taangawan di de a taawan tapu anga ala gaan bigiman di sidon a tapu. Da nen á de fu kai te, da a sa hei doo a nen di a abi fu wooko. Na so a sa tan fu tego seefi.
eng_text: Far above all principality, and power, and might, and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this world, but also in that which is to come:

djk_text: Na Masaa Gadu seefi poti ala sani ne en ondoo so. Ne a opo en poti a tapu fu ala sani. Ne a poti en enke edeman fu a kulu biibiwan fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: And hath put all things under his feet, and gave him to be the head over all things to the church,

djk_text: A kulu sama ya, na a sikin fi en. Da en na a edeman fu dati. Ma ede anga sikin á poi wooko apaiti fu denseefi. Den e seeka denseefi fu de enke fa Masaa Gadu wani. Ma ne en tyai ala sani kon de bun gi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Which is his body, the fulness of him that filleth all in all.

djk_text: We, yu á be e koti anga Masaa Gadu. Da a libi fi en á be de a yu. Da yu be e teli fu dedewan kaba. Bika yu á be e teke en taki. Ma yu be de anga takuudu anga ogii.
eng_text: And you hath he quickened, who were dead in trespasses and sins;

djk_text: U be e waka enke den sama fu a goontapu ya, di á sabi Masaa Gadu e waka. U be e poti useefi a ondoo fu a gaan basi fu takuu jeje di lontu goontapu, e tii sama di á teke biibi, fu meke den e taanga yesi gi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Wherein in time past ye walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit that now worketh in the children of disobedience:

djk_text: Ma wi enke Dyusama be tan so fosi u be teke biibi tu. Wi be de enke sama di e taanga yesi gi Masaa Gadu tu. U be e waka a ini ala sowtu takuu losutu di fuu wi ati libisama fasi. Soseefi ala sowtu takuu pakisei. Na so u be gwenti be e meke Masaa Gadu ati boon, fu sitaafu enke ibii taawan di e du den sani ya ete.
eng_text: Among whom also we all had our conversation in times past in the lusts of our flesh, fulfilling the desires of the flesh and of the mind; and were by nature the children of wrath, even as others.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Gadu abi gaan tyali ati fasi fu wi. Ne i si a teke dati wooko so switi anga wi, bika a lobi wi tuutuu.
eng_text: But God, who is rich in mercy, for his great love wherewith he loved us,

djk_text: Ma wi dati á be e koti anga Masaa Gadu di e gi libi, meke libi á be de gi wi moo. Da na wan sowtu dede u be dede ape kaba. Bika u á be e teke en taki, fu du san ai soi wi. Ma fu di u mokisa libi anga Kelestesi, ne Masaa Gadu gi wi a sowtu libi fi en, baka di a dede weki baka. Tuutuu, na so Masaa Gadu teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku yu de tu. Soseefi, a tyai yeepi meke yu komoto a takuudu anga ogii.
eng_text: Even when we were dead in sins, hath quickened us together with Christ, (by grace ye are saved;)

djk_text: Bika na di u mokisa libi anga Kelestesi Jesesi, meke ala san de fi en toon fu wi tu. Fa a dede weki kon a libi ya baka, da wiseefi dede weki kon a libi ya so te! Fa a opo go sidon a Masaa Gadu se anda, fu wooko anga ala Masaa Gadu makiti, da wiseefi opo go sidon anga en a Masaa Gadu se anda tu.
eng_text: And hath raised us up together, and made us sit together in heavenly places in Christ Jesus:

djk_text: Da winsi on ten fu goontapu, ibiiwan sa si a wi fa Masaa Gadu foondoo bigi pasa maiki. Sama á de fu fusutan fa a bigi so, te u luku fa a du gaan bun gi wi di a sende Kelestesi Jesesi kon.
eng_text: That in the ages to come he might shew the exceeding riches of his grace in his kindness toward us through Christ Jesus.

djk_text: Ma fa mi be taki kaba, da na gaan bun ati fasi a teke luku wi, fu di u biibi namo. Ne a puu wi a takuudu anga ogii. Ma u seefi á wooko fu dati. Kweti! Ne enseefi teke a gaan bun de langa gi u.
eng_text: For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God:

djk_text: Bika a á wani wan enkii sama poi gafa taki, enseefi wooko anga weiti fu toon bun sama gi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Not of works, lest any man should boast.

djk_text: Bika enke fa u libi kon tan nownow, da ne en teke u poti so, fu di u mokisa libi anga Kelestesi Jesesi namo. Ne u tan hii nyun sowtu fasi gi en, fu poi du den bun di a be fiti poti langa ten a fesi fu wi yeepi taawan.
eng_text: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them.

djk_text: Ma pakisei fa Dyusama e si yu, enke taa foluku. Den taki, yu á de fu Masaa Gadu enke den. Soseefi yu á koti maiki a manpeesi enke den. We, ala dati na sani fu du libisama fasi anga sikin namo.
eng_text: Wherefore remember, that ye being in time past Gentiles in the flesh, who are called Uncircumcision by that which is called the Circumcision in the flesh made by hands;

djk_text: Da na a ten di yu be e libi sondee Kelestesi, ne yu á be de foluku fu Masaa Gadu enke den tuu. Yu be de a doose fu Masaa Gadu foluku. Da san a be kuudei anga sama fi en á be de gi yu. Yu á be abi fu luku fu fende sani ne en bakaten tu. Bika yu á be e koti anga Masaa Gadu fu sabi en tu.
eng_text: That at that time ye were without Christ, being aliens from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of promise, having no hope, and without God in the world:

djk_text: Ma nownow, da u mokisa libi anga Kelestesi Jesesi, ne u diipi kon koosube fu Masaa Gadu. Bika Kelestesi dede meke en buulu lon pai fi yu takuudu anga ogii.
eng_text: But now in Christ Jesus ye who sometimes were far off are made nigh by the blood of Christ.

djk_text: Bika na Kelestesi de fu tyai yu enke taa foluku anga wi enke Dyu ati kon de switi makandii. Da u sa kaba si useefi enke feyanti. Da u sa mosoo toon wan famii. Da u ná o buuse useefi moo. Bika wi Dyuweiti na a sani di be kaasi abaa a wi mindii, fu tyai paati. Ma a puu ala dati a wi mindii.
eng_text: For he is our peace, who hath made both one, and hath broken down the middle wall of partition between us;

djk_text: Anga enseefi sikin a pai, fu meke wan hii nyun sowtu sama di mokisa kon makandii fu Dyu anga taa foluku. Bika a puu a hii fasi fu wooko anga Dyuweiti. Da wi ati sa kon de switi makandii fu kaba buuse useefi.
eng_text: Having abolished in his flesh the enmity, even the law of commandments contained in ordinances; for to make in himself of twain one new man, so making peace;

djk_text: Bika a dede fi en na a koloisi, puu den weiti di be e paati wi. Ne a opo pasi meke wi tu sowtu sama ya makandii sa go doo Masaa Gadu enke a wan seefi sowtu sama fi en.
eng_text: And that he might reconcile both unto God in one body by the cross, having slain the enmity thereby:

djk_text: Na so a kon tyai a switi bosikopu gi biibiwan fu taa foluku di be de faawe fu Masaa Gadu. Soseefi gi biibi Dyu di be de koosube fi en kaba.
eng_text: And came and preached peace to you which were afar off, and to them that were nigh.

djk_text: Bika a puu wi ala a takuudu anga ogii, fu poi diipi makandii go doo Masaa Gadu, fu di a Apaiti Jeje fi en de a ini wi ala.
eng_text: For through him we both have access by one Spirit unto the Father.

djk_text: We, da yu enke taa foluku ape á de a doose fu Masaa Gadu foluku moo. Soseefi yu á de enke taa kondee sama gi en moo. Ma si yuseefi now enke sama di a teke poti apaiti fasi, fu poi tan ne en kondee a tapu anda. Yu na tyuku tyuku famii fi en, di de a ini en osu tu.
eng_text: Now therefore ye are no more strangers and foreigners, but fellowcitizens with the saints, and of the household of God;

djk_text: Bika a hii wooko fi en ya fondamenti sete enke ai meke wan osu. Ne a poti apaiti bosikopuman anga apaiti takiman na a wooko fu sete dati. Ma a siton futu fu a hii osu ya seefi na Kelestesi Jesesi.
eng_text: And are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone;

djk_text: Bika ne en mokisa a kulu fu biibiwan toon wan hii taanga osu sama. Da ai meke ai goo bigi naamo toon wan gaan apaiti tanpeesi gi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: In whom all the building fitly framed together groweth unto an holy temple in the Lord:

djk_text: Da yu de seefi de enke Masaa Gadu tanpeesi pe en Apaiti Jeje e tan tu. Na so u mokisa libi anga Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: In whom ye also are builded together for an habitation of God through the Spirit.

djk_text: We, mi wooko fu dini Kelestesi Jesesi, na fu tyai a bosikopu de kon yeepi yu enke taa foluku. Na dati mi e du, meke den kisi mi sooto ya.
eng_text: For this cause I Paul, the prisoner of Jesus Christ for you Gentiles,

djk_text: Ma u sabi anda taki, na gaan bun ati fasi namo di Masaa Gadu teke luku mi, fu poti a wooko ya a mi ana, fu tyai bun gi u de.
eng_text: If ye have heard of the dispensation of the grace of God which is given me to youward:

djk_text: Ne a puu kon a kiin gi mi san a fiti poti fu du gi sama. Na sani di noiti sama be sabi a fesi wanten. Da a be de wan kibii toli. San mi sikiifi pasa de, na wan satu pisi fu a hii toli de.
eng_text: How that by revelation he made known unto me the mystery; (as I wrote afore in few words,

djk_text: Te i leisi en, da i sa si san mi fusutan fu Masaa Gadu, fu fa a fiti poti fu du. Na sani di noiti a fesi sama be sabi wanten. A be de wan kibii toli fu Kelestesi di kon meke ala dati pasa.
eng_text: Whereby, when ye read, ye may understand my knowledge in the mystery of Christ)

djk_text: Bika sama á be sabi a toli de a fesi wanten. Ma nownow, da a meke a Apaiti Jeje fi en e piki den apaiti bosikopuman fu Masaa Jesesi dati. Soseefi biibiwan di de apaiti takiman fu Masaa Jesesi. Bika den na wookoman di a teke poti apaiti fasi fi en enseefi.
eng_text: Which in other ages was not made known unto the sons of men, as it is now revealed unto his holy apostles and prophets by the Spirit;

djk_text: A bosikopu seefi e soi taki, taa foluku seefi sa fende bun di Masaa Gadu be paamisi Dyusama tu. Soseefi a mokisa den anga biibi Dyusama toon a seefi kulu sama, di de a sikin fu Masaa Jesesi. Bika den mokisa libi anga Kelestesi Jesesi di den biibi a Bun Nyunsu.
eng_text: That the Gentiles should be fellowheirs, and of the same body, and partakers of his promise in Christ by the gospel:

djk_text: Da mi na wookoman fu tyai a Bun Nyunsu ya. Na gaan bun ati fasi namo di Masaa Gadu teke luku mi, fu gi mi a wooko ya. Ne a poti taanga gi mi, fu poi du en.
eng_text: Whereof I was made a minister, according to the gift of the grace of God given unto me by the effectual working of his power.

djk_text: Bika mi á be fiti fu fende a wooko ya. I sa kai mi a moo lagiwan di Masaa Gadu teke poti apaiti fasi gi enseefi. Ma toku, a fitoow mi a gaan wooko, fu soi taa foluku sowtu sani ai gi sama di biibi Kelestesi. Den sani ya foondoo pasa maiki.
eng_text: Unto me, who am less than the least of all saints, is this grace given, that I should preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ;

djk_text: Na so a poti mi, fu kiin taawan ain, fu si san a fiti poti fu du. Na sani di noiti a fesi sama be sabi wanten. A be de wan kibii toli. Na Masaa Gadu wawan be sabi dati.
eng_text: And to make all men see what is the fellowship of the mystery, which from the beginning of the world hath been hid in God, who created all things by Jesus Christ:

djk_text: Ma nownow, da a wani goontapu mu si a hii toli ya na a kulu sama fi en. Den sa luku den biibiwan de fu si dati. Basi di e tii taawan anga makiti di hei ofu lagi moo taawan seefi sa si dati. Da den musu piki taki, Masaa Gadu abi gaan leti koni fu wooko anga ala san ai du.
eng_text: To the intent that now unto the principalities and powers in heavenly places might be known by the church the manifold wisdom of God,

djk_text: Bika den o si fa a du san a be fiti poti fu du a fesi anga a kon fu wi Masaa, Kelestesi Jesesi.
eng_text: According to the eternal purpose which he purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord:

djk_text: Da wi mokisa libi anga a Kelestesi Jesesi ya, di u teke biibi fitoow en. Na dati meke u ná abi fu pantan moo fu Masaa Gadu, bika wi doo peesi fu diipi go doo en fesi.
eng_text: In whom we have boldness and access with confidence by the faith of him.

djk_text: Na ala dati meke, u á mu booko saka lasi ati fu di mi sooto ya. Kweti! Bika na fu tyai bun gi u anda meke den kisi mi sooto. Da kaka ede poolo seefi taki, u waiti de fu mi teke sitaafu fu u ede.
eng_text: Wherefore I desire that ye faint not at my tribulations for you, which is your glory.

djk_text: We, da mi e sutu kini gi u Tata, Masaa Gadu a tapu gaandi, fu a hii wooko di a du ya.
eng_text: For this cause I bow my knees unto the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,

djk_text: A de a Tata tuu fu ibii paansu fu libiwan di a meke ya doo tapu anda seefi.
eng_text: Of whom the whole family in heaven and earth is named,

djk_text: A lai foondoo fasi fu wooko. Da mi e begi fu a teke wan fu den foondoo fasi ya wooko, meke en Apaiti Jeje gi u taanga, fu poi du ala san a wani.
eng_text: That he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, to be strengthened with might by his Spirit in the inner man;

djk_text: Soseefi, fu meke ibii yuu u sa wooko anga biibi, fu Kelestesi sa teke peesi a ini u ati de naamo enke osu fi en. Soseefi fu u sa denki doo du sani di e waka anga gaan lobi fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: That Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith; that ye, being rooted and grounded in love,

djk_text: Da makandii anga ibii taawan di a teke poti apaiti fasi u sa poi fusutan a baala anga a langa, a hei anga dipi fu a lobi fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: May be able to comprehend with all saints what is the breadth, and length, and depth, and height;

djk_text: Da yu sa poi fusutan fa Kelestesi lobi yu de wan fasi di bigi pasa wi fusutan. Da na so Masaa Gadu sa teke peesi tii yu hii libi de.
eng_text: And to know the love of Christ, which passeth knowledge, that ye might be filled with all the fulness of God.

djk_text: We, da bali gafa Masaa Gadu! Luku fa a kaakiti fi en e wooko taanga a ini wi libi kaba. Da a poi du moo sani ete pasa san u e denki anga san u e begi seefi.
eng_text: Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us,

djk_text: Da meke a kulu biibiwan fi en gi en gaandi tego. Soseefi gi en gaandi fu di wi mokisa libi anga Kelestesi Jesesi. Amen, na so a de!
eng_text: Unto him be glory in the church by Christ Jesus throughout all ages, world without end. Amen.

djk_text: We, mi de ya a dunguu osu fu di mi e dini Masaa Jesesi. Da mi e sende u dati taki, waka fiti wan biibisama anda, fu di Masaa Gadu kai u kon poti fu libi so.
eng_text: I therefore, the prisoner of the Lord, beseech you that ye walk worthy of the vocation wherewith ye are called,

djk_text: Teke saka fasi anga saafi switi fasi fu taawan. Abi langa pasensi fudaagi taawan. Dati sa soi fa u lobi taawan.
eng_text: With all lowliness and meekness, with longsuffering, forbearing one another in love;

djk_text: Da fa a Apaiti Jeje fu Masaa Gadu de a u ala, meke u de awan seefi sama. Da feti libi fiti anga useefi, meke u ati sa de switi makandii. Da dati sa tei u ala na awan go doo.
eng_text: Endeavouring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.

djk_text: Bika wi ala na a wan seefi sama di de wan sikin namo. Soseefi Masaa Gadu gi ibiiwan a seefi Apaiti Jeje fi en. U abi denseefi paamisi fu Masaa Gadu di u e luku fu fende tu, di a kai u kon toon sama fi enseefi.
eng_text: There is one body, and one Spirit, even as ye are called in one hope of your calling;

djk_text: Soseefi, u abi a seefi Masaa Jesesi di e tii wi ala. U abi a seefi biibi a Masaa Jesesi tu. Soseefi a seefi dopu fi en.
eng_text: One Lord, one faith, one baptism,

djk_text: Wi abi a seefi Masaa Gadu e dini, di de Tata fu wi ala. A de a tapu fu tii ibiiwan, da a teke peesi a ini ibiiwan fu wi. Soseefi ai gi ibiiwan a wooko di a wani a du.
eng_text: One God and Father of all, who is above all, and through all, and in you all.

djk_text: Ma Kelestesi abi somen sowtu wooko, ne a gi ibiiwan en apaiti fasi fu wooko. Na so a teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku ibiiwan, na a fasi fa a wani gi dati gudu di enseefi abi fu gi biibiwan.
eng_text: But unto every one of us is given grace according to the measure of the gift of Christ.

djk_text: Na dati Masaa Gadu Buku be sikiifi a fesi taki: “A opo gwe a tapu anda baka. Ne a tyai sama di a wini teke na a feti gwe anga en. Da ai gi den sama fi en gaanbigi bun di enseefi abi fu gi sama.”
eng_text: Wherefore he saith, When he ascended up on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts unto men.

djk_text: Ma san wani taki: “A opo gwe a tapu anda baka?” Bika, da a musu de taki, a sama de be saka kon doo a moo dipi pisi a goontapu ya fosi, fu teke a wini.
eng_text: (Now that he ascended, what is it but that he also descended first into the lower parts of the earth?

djk_text: We, a sama di saka kon ya, da na a seefi sama de musu opo gwe na a moo hei peesi a tapu anda tu, fu teke peesi enke gaan winiman fu tii ala sani anda.
eng_text: He that descended is the same also that ascended up far above all heavens, that he might fill all things.)

djk_text: We, da a poti apaiti bosikopuman, soseefi apaiti takiman fi en ya. Soseefi apaiti bolotyasiman fi en Bun Nyunsu, soseefi apaiti soluguman fu biibiwan. Soseefi apaiti leliman fu leli taawan.
eng_text: And he gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers;

djk_text: Ala den dati mu tyai biibiwan kon sabi fa fu seeka denseefi, fu poi du a wooko fu Kelestesi. Da a hii kulu sama di de sikin fi enseefi sa poi goo kon taampu taanga a ini a biibi.
eng_text: For the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for the edifying of the body of Christ:

djk_text: Te fu kaba, da wi ala sa abi a seefi fasi fu biibi. Soseefi u sa sabi Masaa Gadu Manpikin, Jesesi Kelestesi wan leti fasi. Da a sa wooko taanga a ini u libi, fu poi abi a sowtu biibi di Kelestesi be abi a Masaa Gadu tu.
eng_text: Till we all come in the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, unto a perfect man, unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ:

djk_text: Da u ná o de enke pikinengee di lawlaw fu koli kisi. Falisi leliman ná o poi kon puu wi na a tuutuu fasi fu biibi. Bika wi ná o de fu seke enke paana di nái sidon a wan peesi. U ná o buuya te den e leli sama falisi sani, di denseefi meke anga koni, fu buuya sama wai puu na a leti pasi.
eng_text: That we henceforth be no more children, tossed to and fro, and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the sleight of men, and cunning craftiness, whereby they lie in wait to deceive;

djk_text: Ma wi dati sa taampu anga a tuutuu leli fu Masaa Gadu. Da u sa goo anga lobi makandii ala fasi enke fa Kelestesi soi wi. Bika a de wi edeman, fu tii wi di de a sikin fi en.
eng_text: But speaking the truth in love, may grow up into him in all things, which is the head, even Christ:

djk_text: Da, te ibii pisi fu a sikin miti enke fa a mu de, da ibii pisi sa poi du a wooko di a mu du, fu yeepi a hii sikin anga a yeepi di a mu tyai, fu meke a tan bun. Da a hii sikin e goo moo taanga. Na so wiseefi sa goo kon lobi makandii, fu taampu moo taanga na a biibi, fu dini Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: From whom the whole body fitly joined together and compacted by that which every joint supplieth, according to the effectual working in the measure of every part, maketh increase of the body unto the edifying of itself in love.

djk_text: Ma mi e teke a nen fu Kelestesi sende u taki, u kaba fu waka enke foluku di á sabi Masaa Gadu. Bika den abi soso lawlaw pakisei fu libi.
eng_text: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that ye henceforth walk not as other Gentiles walk, in the vanity of their mind,

djk_text: Den á wani leli sabi Masaa Gadu. Den daai baka gi en, ne den fusutan dunguu fu sabi sani enke fa a mu de. Namo den wai paati anga a sowtu libi fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Having the understanding darkened, being alienated from the life of God through the ignorance that is in them, because of the blindness of their heart:

djk_text: Bika den ná abi wan doopu sen fu a takuu libi, meke den nái tapu baka gi a waka libi. Ma den teke motyo fasi, naamo seefi.
eng_text: Who being past feeling have given themselves over unto lasciviousness, to work all uncleanness with greediness.

djk_text: Ma u dati sabi a libi di Kelestesi leli wi. Ne u e libi hii taa fasi.
eng_text: But ye have not so learned Christ;

djk_text: Bika fa mi sabi, da sama be soi u anda a bosikopu fi en. Den be leli u waka fiti fa a wani u mokisa libi anga enseefi. Ne u kon sabi a tuutuu fasi di a abi.
eng_text: If so be that ye have heard him, and have been taught by him, as the truth is in Jesus:

djk_text: Ma denki, fosi yu be teke biibi, fa takuu losutu di be fuu yu ati e goo moo anga moo takuu. A be sa tyai yu go fende kaba a soso a Masaa Gadu. Bika a be e koli yu du takuu sani. Ma yu kon leli fu fika a hii haw fasi de.
eng_text: That ye put off concerning the former conversation the old man, which is corrupt according to the deceitful lusts;

djk_text: Namo yu leli teke fu waka wan hii nyun fasi. Dati na wan hii nyun fasi fu denki sani.
eng_text: And be renewed in the spirit of your mind;

djk_text: Yu kon leli fu de wan hii nyun sowtu paansu sama di gei Masaa Gadu seefi. Da libi enke fa Masaa Gadu e leli u leti fasi. Soseefi de a apaiti fasi di a teke yu poti.
eng_text: And that ye put on the new man, which after God is created in righteousness and true holiness.

djk_text: Da kaba teke mofu wooko fu lei, ma taigi taawan tuutuu fasi fa sani de. Bika wi na a wan kulu sama di de a sikin fu Kelestesi.
eng_text: Wherefore putting away lying, speak every man truth with his neighbour: for we are members one of another.

djk_text: Kenisi anga du ogii, winsi atiboon seefi. A ati mu koo gawgaw baka sondee fu fende pasi doo neti.
eng_text: Be ye angry, and sin not: let not the sun go down upon your wrath:

djk_text: Meke didibii á poi fende okasi tyai yu go du sani di á bun.
eng_text: Neither give place to the devil.

djk_text: Efu yu be e fufuu, da kaba anga dati. Go wooko leti fasi fende san i fanowdu, fu solugu iseefi. Da i sa poi yeepi taa mofinawan seefi anga dati.
eng_text: Let him that stole steal no more: but rather let him labour, working with his hands the thing which is good, that he may have to give to him that needeth.

djk_text: Kaba taki wan fasi fu sutu taawan na ati. Ma taki sani di sa yeepi taawan anga a biibi libi. Meke ibii okasi di kon fu taki sani sa poi opo pasi soi taawan, fa Masaa Gadu poi teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku denseefi tu.
eng_text: Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace unto the hearers.

djk_text: Ma kaba anga libi di nái fiti a Apaiti Jeje. Dati sa buduufu en di Masaa Gadu poti a yu enke maiki fu soi taki, yu na apaiti sama fi en. Ne en mu tyai yu doo a dei di Masaa Gadu o kaba losi yu puu a takuudu anga ogii tu.
eng_text: And grieve not the holy Spirit of God, whereby ye are sealed unto the day of redemption.

djk_text: Da kaba buuse taawan anga bita fasi na ati. Kaba meke boon ati subi yu balibali taawan. Kaba teke boon ati libi anga taawan di du sani anga yu seefi. Kaba kwali anga taawan tu. Kaba saanti ofu kosi taawan. Ala dati wani taki, kaba libi anga fasi di nái soi lobi.
eng_text: Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamour, and evil speaking, be put away from you, with all malice:

djk_text: Ma libi switi anga taawan. Teke tyali ati fasi luku taawan. Teke paadon gi taawan enke fa Masaa Gadu du anga yuseefi sondee i be fiti dati. Bika na a wooko fu Kelestesi namo meke a du dati.
eng_text: And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ's sake hath forgiven you.

djk_text: We, u na pikin fu Masaa Gadu di a lobi. Da waka enke fa u sabi enseefi be o waka fu du sani ya.
eng_text: Be ye therefore followers of God, as dear children;

djk_text: Soseefi, waka soi taki, u lobi taawan enke fa Kelestesi seefi lobi u te teke dede gi u. Na so a pai a wi peesi enke sama teke meti boon begi Masaa Gadu paadon, fu takuudu anga ogii. A wooko fi en ya piisii Masaa Gadu, fu teke enke wan sumee switi sani di doo ne en fesi.
eng_text: And walk in love, as Christ also hath loved us, and hath given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweetsmelling savour.

djk_text: Da ná du sani fu sama poi kaagi u anga leti. Kaba anga poli libi. Kaba anga ibii sowtu motyo fasi. Kaba anga fafa ati fu suku sani. Den fasi de á mu de a wi! Bika Masaa Gadu teke wi poti apaiti fasi.
eng_text: But fornication, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not be once named among you, as becometh saints;

djk_text: Da kaba puu poli taki a mofu. Kaba anga taki di nái soi lesipeki. Kaba anga sipowtu anga gaan taki. Den nái fiti biibisama. Ma poti i mofu gi Masaa Gadu daa, fi en yeepi di ai gi somen sowtu fasi.
eng_text: Neither filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not convenient: but rather giving of thanks.

djk_text: Bika sabi taki, sani ná o waka bun gi sama anga motyo fasi. Soseefi sama anga waka libi fu wooko poli fasi anga sikin. Soseefi sama anga fafa ati a moni baka. Bika den libi de gei dini afokodeei sani. Da sama di de a ini den libi de, ná o fende a bun di de a ini a Nyun Tii fu Kelestesi anga Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: For this ye know, that no whoremonger, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, hath any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.

djk_text: Kweti! Meke sama á kon fende pasi koli yu du den sowtu ogii de. Bika sama di taanga yesi du den, da Masaa Gadu o sitaafu en.
eng_text: Let no man deceive you with vain words: for because of these things cometh the wrath of God upon the children of disobedience.

djk_text: We, da koti naamo komoto a pasi gi sama di e du den sowtu ogii de seefi tu.
eng_text: Be not ye therefore partakers with them.

djk_text: Bika a fesi, da u seefi be de a dunguu tu. Ma yu toon sama fi en now, meke sani fi en de a kiin gi yu fu sabi. Da waka enke sama di sani fi en de a kiin gi.
eng_text: For ye were sometimes darkness, but now are ye light in the Lord: walk as children of light:

djk_text: Bika fu libi enke sani fi en de a kiin gi yu fu sabi, da yu mu e du san bun. Soseefi du san leti. Libi tuutuu fasi enke fa Masaa Gadu wani.
eng_text: (For the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth;)

djk_text: We, e keli luku naamo, fu sabi san fu du, fu piisii Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Proving what is acceptable unto the Lord.

djk_text: Ma ná mosoo anga sama di e du san nái tyai yeepi. Bika sani fu Masaa Gadu dunguu gi den fu sabi. Da den e du soso wisiwasi sani. Ma tyai yuseefi meke a sa kon a kiin gi den taki, a libi fu den á bun.
eng_text: And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove them.

djk_text: Bika den kibii sani di den e du na gaan sen sani di á bun fu taki.
eng_text: For it is a shame even to speak of those things which are done of them in secret.

djk_text: Ma te sani de a dunguu gi sama, da faya mu kiin a peesi. Da sani sa poi kon a kiin gi en fu sabi.
eng_text: But all things that are reproved are made manifest by the light: for whatsoever doth make manifest is light.

djk_text: A dati meke den taki: “Sama di e siibi weki! Opo komoto a den dedesama mindii de. Da Kelestesi o leti faya poti gi i.”
eng_text: Wherefore he saith, Awake thou that sleepest, and arise from the dead, and Christ shall give thee light.

djk_text: Ma kenisi seefi anga fa fu libi. Feti teke leti koni fu wooko naamo. Ná libi enke sama di ná abi koni.
eng_text: See then that ye walk circumspectly, not as fools, but as wise,

djk_text: Da te a kai fu du bun, da noiti koti pasi komoto gi dati. Bika goontapu takuu noya. Son sama e waka e du soso ogii naamo a ini.
eng_text: Redeeming the time, because the days are evil.

djk_text: Ma poti ede leti! Da kaba du sani enke lawman di nái denki fosi den du. Ma keli luku naamo fu fusutan san fu du piisii Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Wherefore be ye not unwise, but understanding what the will of the Lord is.

djk_text: Ná diingi te fu duungu! Dati o poli yu libi. Ma meke a Apaiti Jeje fu Masaa Gadu lai yu libi.
eng_text: And be not drunk with wine, wherein is excess; but be filled with the Spirit;

djk_text: Da te u kon miti makandii, da u wooko anga san sikiifi a Psalm, a singi buku, fu soi useefi sani. U singi ibii sowtu singi di e gafa Masaa Gadu. U singi piisii gi Masaa Gadu ibii yuu anga singi di en Apaiti Jeje poti a u ati tu.
eng_text: Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;

djk_text: U gi u Tata, Masaa Gadu a tapu daa ala yuu, fu a wooko di wi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi du gi wi.
eng_text: Giving thanks always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ;

djk_text: We, u mu saka a u seefi ondoo fu Kelestesi. Bika a so a taki fu u libi.
eng_text: Submitting yourselves one to another in the fear of God.

djk_text: Biibi uman! Saka a yu man ondoo. Teke en taki, leti enke fa yu e saka a Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi ondoo e teke en taki.
eng_text: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord.

djk_text: Bika na a man na edeman fi en uman enke fa Kelestesi na a edeman fu a hii kulu sama di de sikin fi enseefi. Ne a puu den a takuudu anga ogii, enke Yeepiman fu den, di meke den toon sama fi enseefi.
eng_text: For the husband is the head of the wife, even as Christ is the head of the church: and he is the saviour of the body.

djk_text: Da a hii kulu sama fi en ya mu saka ne en ondoo e teke en taki. Na so ibii uman mu saka a den man ondoo teke en man taki na ala fasi tu.
eng_text: Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing.

djk_text: Man! U mu lobi u uman tuutuu fasi enke fa Kelestesi lobi a hii kulu sama fi en. Ne a poti enseefi teke dede pai a den peesi seefi, fu puu den a takuudu anga ogii.
eng_text: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it;

djk_text: Na so a meke den toon wan apaiti sowtu sama gi Masaa Gadu. Bika a wowtu fi en wasi den libi kon kiin enke fa wataa e wasi sani kiin.
eng_text: That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word,

djk_text: A wooko fi en ya meke a kulu sama fi en hii libi kiin gi enseefi. Den de sondee wan enkii poli fasi. Finga á poi soi kaagi den anga leti. Na so a teke den poti apaiti fasi sondee fowtu.
eng_text: That he might present it to himself a glorious church, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish.

djk_text: Da na so a man mu lobi en uman tuutuu fasi enke ne enseefi sikin dati. Da te ai wooko bun anga en uman, da anga enseefi ai wooko so.
eng_text: So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies. He that loveth his wife loveth himself.

djk_text: Bika sama á de di e buuse enseefi sikin. Ma ai nyan poti gi en, soseefi ai luku en bun enke fa Kelestesi e luku a hii kulu sama fi en.
eng_text: For no man ever yet hated his own flesh; but nourisheth and cherisheth it, even as the Lord the church:

djk_text: Bika wi na a sikin fi en.
eng_text: For we are members of his body, of his flesh, and of his bones.

djk_text: Masaa Gadu Buku be sikiifi a sani ya a fesi taki: “Na dati meke a man e fika en gaansama osu, fu go teke en uman libi. Da den tu sama de mokisa libi toon wan sikin.”
eng_text: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall be joined unto his wife, and they two shall be one flesh.

djk_text: A sani de e taki fu fa Kelestesi anga a hii kulu sama fi en mokisa libi. Na wan gaan sani di noiti a fesi sama be sabi wanten. Ma a be de wan kibii toli.
eng_text: This is a great mystery: but I speak concerning Christ and the church.

djk_text: Ma soseefi dati e soi fa man mu lobi en uman enke fa a lobi enseefi. Da soseefi uman mu lesipeki en man, fu saka teke en taki.
eng_text: Nevertheless let every one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself; and the wife see that she reverence her husband.

djk_text: We, den pikin mu teke den dda anga den mma taki. Bika a pikin ya toon sama fu Masaa Jesesi, da na so fiti fu a libi.
eng_text: Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu Buku be sikiifi a fesi fu a fosi weiti di waka anga wan paamisi a ini den tin weiti. A weiti de taki: “I mu lesipeki i mma anga i dda.”
eng_text: Honour thy father and mother; (which is the first commandment with promise;)

djk_text: Da ai go doo taki: “Da Masaa Gadu o meke sani waka bun gi yu. Soseefi a o gi yu langa libi a goontapu tu.”
eng_text: That it may be well with thee, and thou mayest live long on the earth.

djk_text: Dada ná dwengi i pikin fu soso tu, fu meke a daai kon buuse yu. Ma leli a pikin fu saka teke taki, fu a sa waka leti. Soi a pikin ala fa fu waka fiti Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.

djk_text: De saafu a katibo! U saka u seefi a den gaan masaa fu u ondoo e teke den taki. Lesipeki den, fu waka kenisi sondee taanga yesi gi en. Wooko gi en anga yu hii ati taki enke na Kelestesi yu e dini sowan fasi.
eng_text: Servants, be obedient to them that are your masters according to the flesh, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as unto Christ;

djk_text: Da yu á mu wooko enke na libisama yu e suku fu piisii, te den ain de a yu tapu namo. Ma wooko enke na Kelestesi yu e dini, meke yu e wooko anga yu hii ati ala yuu. Na so Masaa Gadu wani.
eng_text: Not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but as the servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart;

djk_text: We, da te yu de saafu a katibo, da poti yuseefi wooko anga yu hii ati. Bika fa a de, da a ná fu sama ede meke yu e wooko bun so, ma na Kelestesi yu e dini sowan fasi.
eng_text: With good will doing service, as to the Lord, and not to men:

djk_text: Bika sabi taki, sama di de saafu a katibo ofu sama di de fiiman, Masaa Gadu paamisi fu pai ibiiwan fu bun di a du.
eng_text: Knowing that whatsoever good thing any man doeth, the same shall he receive of the Lord, whether he be bond or free.

djk_text: We, gaan masaa fu saafu! Luku bun fa yu e wooko anga yu saafu. Wooko switi anga den, fu piisii Masaa Gadu. Kaba pii ain dwengi den anga sitaafu. Bika sabi taki, a tuutuu gaan Masaa fu wi ala de a Masaa Gadu Kondee a tapu. Dati nái keli taawan bigi moo taawan. Te a kai fu a kuutu, da ai kuutu ibiiwan anga leti, winsi na saafu ofu na sama di á de a saafu.
eng_text: And, ye masters, do the same things unto them, forbearing threatening: knowing that your Master also is in heaven; neither is there respect of persons with him.

djk_text: We, fosi mi tapu a biifi ya, da mi e sende u fu taampu taanga fitoow Masaa Jesesi. Teke en taanga lai yu libi, fu gi yu makiti fu feti biibi fasi.
eng_text: Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.

djk_text: Da teke feti sani di Masaa Gadu gi wi fu feti biibi fasi. Meke te didibii kon muliki yu anga den somen takuu koni fi en fu koli yu kisi, yu sa poi feti baka.
eng_text: Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
