djk_text: Bika a hii suwa anga feti fu wi, a á de anga libisama sikin anga buulu. Ma anga basi di e tii taawan anga makiti di hei ofu lagi moo taawan anga gaan bigiman di e ligei a dunguu goontapu ya anga ala sowtu takuu jeje di lontu goontapu, te doo a pisi fu tapu anda.
eng_text: For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.

djk_text: Da na dati meke u mu teke den feti sani di Masaa Gadu gi wi, fu kibii useefi. Da te didibii wani du ogii anga wi, da u sa poi taampu sondee fu a towe wi. Na so u mu feti doo kaba fu a feti. Da u taampu kankan enke winiman.
eng_text: Wherefore take unto you the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.

djk_text: Da sete iseefi! Enke suudati banti mindii e go a feti. Dati na te wi sabi a tuutuu leli fu Masaa Gadu. Enke suudati teke insii sani wei kibii boo fu ati. Dati na te u du san bun gi Masaa Gadu doo.
eng_text: Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness;

djk_text: Soseefi sete iseefi enke suudati wei a susu fu waka soi taawan a Bun Nyunsu di e tyai sama ati kon de switi.
eng_text: And your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace;

djk_text: Enke suudati tyai insii sani fu tapu lai. Dati na te u poti fitoow a Masaa Gadu. Da ai tapu faya lansi di didibii e sutu kon taki, ai tyai poli sani kon a yu fusutan, fu du ogii.
eng_text: Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.

djk_text: Da enke suudati wei taanga ati fu kibii en ede peesi. Dati na te u tei ati oli biibi doo. Bika didibii e suku fu koli u kisi anga lei fi en. Ma, da u sa poi piki en anga wowtu fu Masaa Gadu di a Apaiti Jeje poti gi u. Da dati e koti didibii enke saapu fetihow di suudati e tyai fu koti feyanti kii.
eng_text: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God:

djk_text: We, soseefi, da taampu anga begi naamo. Begi ala yuu na a fasi di Masaa Gadu Apaiti Jeje e piki yu. Da luku naamo sowtu yeepi de fu begi gi ala taawan di Masaa Gadu teke poti apaiti fasi. Noiti weli fu begi gi taawan so.
eng_text: Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints;

djk_text: U begi gi mi tu, meke Masaa Gadu yeepi mi, fu mi sa opo mofu soi a tuutuu fasi, di Masaa Gadu fiti poti a Bun Nyunsu. Meke a poti wowtu a ini mi mofu fu taki sondee feele, fu den kon fusutan. Bika na sani di noiti a fesi sama be sabi wanten. A be de wan kibii toli.
eng_text: And for me, that utterance may be given unto me, that I may open my mouth boldly, to make known the mystery of the gospel,

djk_text: Bika mi wooko enke apaiti bosikopuman na fu soi sama dati. Na fu dati meke den kisi mi sooto ya. Da begi fu mi sa fende yeepi, fu wooko sondee feele, fu poi soi ala dati enke fa a mu de.
eng_text: For which I am an ambassador in bonds: that therein I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.

djk_text: We, mi e sende Tikikesi kon luku u anda, fu taigi u fa sani e go anga mi ya. U ala sabi en enke wan lobi biibi baala. A de wan wookoman di e wooko fitoow fasi fu dini Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: But that ye also may know my affairs, and how I do, Tychicus, a beloved brother and faithful minister in the Lord, shall make known to you all things:

djk_text: Na dati meke, mi akisi en, fu kon luku u anda gi mi. Fu tuu, te a kon, da a sa taigi u fa ai go anga u biibiwan dise. Soseefi, a sa puu pantan di u abi anda, fu fa sani e go anga wi dise.
eng_text: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that ye might know our affairs, and that he might comfort your hearts.

djk_text: We, mi e begi u Tata, Masaa Gadu anga Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi, meke u ala di teke biibi anda ati sa de switi. Soseefi fu u ati sa opo lobi useefi makandii.
eng_text: Peace be to the brethren, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

djk_text: Mi e begi Masaa Gadu di poti u fu wi lobi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi tego, fu tan teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku u.
eng_text: Grace be with all them that love our Lord Jesus Christ in sincerity. Amen.

djk_text: Mi Pawlesi anga Timotiyesi na wookoman fu Kelestesi Jesesi di wi e dini. Na wi e sikiifi a biifi ya makandii gi ala sama a Filipi Foto anda di Masaa Gadu poti apaiti fasi de. Dati wani taki, sama di mokisa libi anga Kelestesi Jesesi. Soseefi edeman fu biibiwan anga taa fesiman di taampu a den edeman de baka.
eng_text: Paul and Timotheus, the servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus which are at Philippi, with the bishops and deacons:

djk_text: Da meke u Tata, Masaa Gadu anga Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku u de. Soseefi, meke u ati de switi.
eng_text: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

djk_text: We, ibii yuu mi pakisei u ya, da mi e gi Masaa Gadu daa, fu u ede.
eng_text: I thank my God upon every remembrance of you,

djk_text: Anga ala piisii mi e kai u anda nen naamo, fu begi gi u so.
eng_text: Always in every prayer of mine for you all making request with joy,

djk_text: Bika senten a fosi dei di u toon biibisama, ne u yeepi a wooko ya wanten ala sowtu fasi, fu meke a Bun Nyunsu paati moo anga moo. Te enke tide ete, u e du dati go doo.
eng_text: For your fellowship in the gospel from the first day until now;

djk_text: Ma, soseefi di mi sabi tuutuu taki, na Masaa Gadu sete a bun wooko ya a ini u libi. Da a o tyai dati wan bun fasi go doo a dei, di Kelestesi Jesesi o kon baka seefi.
eng_text: Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ:

djk_text: We, da fa mi e pakisei u anda na wan sani di mi musu fu du. Bika u de a mi ati. Soseefi, u taampu anga mi na a Bun Nyunsu di Masaa Gadu teke gaan bun ati fasi, poti a mi ana, fu paati. We, mi be de a dunguu osu, na so u be yeepi. Doo a kuutu dei pe den be tyai mi go seefi, fu soi fa a Bun Nyunsu na Masaa Gadu tuutuu bosikopu. Soseefi, fa mi e taki en leti fasi, fu sama sa fitoow teke biibi. Da u be gi mi taanga sikin sowan fasi.
eng_text: Even as it is meet for me to think this of you all, because I have you in my heart; inasmuch as both in my bonds, and in the defence and confirmation of the gospel, ye all are partakers of my grace.

djk_text: We, Masaa Gadu de enke mi kotoigi fu piki taki, mi nái lei taki mi e angii fu miti u de! Soseefi mi lobi u enke fa Masaa Jesesi lobi u tu!
eng_text: For God is my record, how greatly I long after you all in the bowels of Jesus Christ.

djk_text: We, fa mi e begi gi u, da luku san mi e begi ya. Meke a lobi di u abi makandii de sa goo, fu fusutan moo anga moo fa Masaa Gadu de seefi. Da u o moo sabi fini fini san fiti anga san fowtu.
eng_text: And this I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and in all judgment;

djk_text: Na sowan fasi u sa poi teke a se fu bun ibii yuu. Soseefi, mi e begi meke u sa de tuutuu letiopu fasi, fu taampu enke fa Masaa Gadu wani. Soseefi, meke u á sa du sani, fu finga sa poi soi kaagi u anga leti doo a gaan kuutu dei fu Kelestesi.
eng_text: That ye may approve things that are excellent; that ye may be sincere and without offence till the day of Christ;

djk_text: Da u hii libi anga manii sa de bun sani gi Masaa Gadu enke fa Jesesi Kelestesi seeka en. A libi de o meke Masaa Gadu fende gafa anga gaandi.
eng_text: Being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are by Jesus Christ, unto the glory and praise of God.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Mi wani u sabi fa banowtu e miti mi ya, ma a á poi tapu a bosikopu di wi e tyai. Ai tyai moo ipi sama kon biibi a Bun Nyunsu ya seefi.
eng_text: But I would ye should understand, brethren, that the things which happened unto me have fallen out rather unto the furtherance of the gospel;

djk_text: Bika ala suudati a kownu paleisi ya doo ala taa sama dise seefi kon sabi saide mi de a dunguu osu. Den si taki, na namo fu di mi e dini a Kelestesi.
eng_text: So that my bonds in Christ are manifest in all the palace, and in all other places;

djk_text: Da ala dati e gi taa biibiwan ya moo deki ati, fu waka taki Masaa Gadu bosikopu, sondee feele. Ai gi den moo fitoow a Masaa Gadu tu. Bika den e si fa ai yeepi mi ya taki, a o yeepi den so tu.
eng_text: And many of the brethren in the Lord, waxing confident by my bonds, are much more bold to speak the word without fear.

djk_text: We, na tuu taki, son biibiwan dise e taki Masaa Gadu bosikopu, fu sama mu poti den bigi moo mi. Bika den e dyalusu, da den e sitee anga mi fu fa Masaa Gadu e wooko anga mi. Ma sowan fu den e taki en kiin ati fasi ya sondee a takuu sowtu fasi de.
eng_text: Some indeed preach Christ even of envy and strife; and some also of good will:

djk_text: Den dati e taki Masaa Gadu bosikopu fu a Kelestesi, bika den lobi mi. Den sabi taki, na Masaa Gadu poti mi fu feti meke sama si taki, en Bun Nyunsu na wan tuu sani, fu teke biibi.
eng_text: The one preach Christ of contention, not sincerely, supposing to add affliction to my bonds:

djk_text: Ma den taawan e dyalusu, da den e sitee anga mi, fu sama mu poti den bigi moo mi. Da den nái wooko wan leti fasi. Bika den wani sokoo a banowtu fu mi ya kon moo taanga gi mi.
eng_text: But the other of love, knowing that I am set for the defence of the gospel.

djk_text: Ma mi ná abi toobi anga den. Den e sitee ofu den lobi mi, ma den e taki a bosikopu ya namo, da ai piisii mi kaba. Na so mi o piisii go doo seefi.
eng_text: What then? notwithstanding, every way, whether in pretence, or in truth, Christ is preached; and I therein do rejoice, yea, and will rejoice.

djk_text: Bika mi sabi taki, a kuutu di mi o go seefi o waka bun gi mi, fu di u taampu a mi baka anga begi. Soseefi a Apaiti Jeje fu Jesesi Kelestesi o teke peesi yeepi mi.
eng_text: For I know that this shall turn to my salvation through your prayer, and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,

djk_text: Bika a angii di mi abi, soseefi san mi e luku fu fende, na fu mi á de feele fasi. Soseefi fu mi á du sani tyai sen gi miseefi. Ma ibii yuu mi mu wooko leti fasi sondee feele wan enkii sama, doo fa mi de ya nownow seefi. Da mi sa tan gi a Kelestesi gaandi fa mi e taki sani doo fa mi e du sani seefi, winsi mi o dede ofu mi o libi.
eng_text: According to my earnest expectation and my hope, that in nothing I shall be ashamed, but that with all boldness, as always, so now also Christ shall be magnified in my body, whether it be by life, or by death.

djk_text: Bika fu mi se, da a libi ya na fu tan gi a Kelestesi gaandi. Da dede dati sa moo bun gi mi baka seefi.
eng_text: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

djk_text: Ma efu mi de a libi ya doo, toku mi sa du moo ipi wooko gi a Kelestesi. Na dati meke, mi á sabi sowtu se fu teke, dede ofu libi.
eng_text: But if I live in the flesh, this is the fruit of my labour: yet what I shall choose I wot not.

djk_text: Tuutuu! Ai taanga gi mi sowtu se fu teke. Mi e angii taanga fu dede gwe a Kelestesi anda. Bika dati moo bun seefi.
eng_text: For I am in a strait betwixt two, having a desire to depart, and to be with Christ; which is far better:

djk_text: Ma fu di u anda abi mi taanga fanowdu de ete, meke a moo de fanowdu seefi fu mi de a libi ya ete.
eng_text: Nevertheless to abide in the flesh is more needful for you.

djk_text: Da na fu dati meke mi abi a taanga denki taki, mi o de a libi go doo, fu yeepi u meke u biibi sa moo kisi futu a doti. Da u sa moo piisii a ini u biibi tu.
eng_text: And having this confidence, I know that I shall abide and continue with you all for your furtherance and joy of faith;

djk_text: Da u o moo poi gafa Kelestesi Jesesi gi sama taki, a oli mi a libi, fu kon doo u anda baka seefi.
eng_text: That your rejoicing may be more abundant in Jesus Christ for me by my coming to you again.

djk_text: We, da san fanowdu u anda nownow, na fu libi enke fa a Kelestesi Bun Nyunsu taki. Da winsi mi doo anda fu kon luku u ofu mi á doo anda moo, ma mi sa yee fa u taampu taanga de. Soseefi u mokisa libi a wan, fu feti makandii soi taki, a Bun Nyunsu na wan tuutuu sani, fu teke biibi.
eng_text: Only let your conversation be as it becometh the gospel of Christ: that whether I come and see you, or else be absent, I may hear of your affairs, that ye stand fast in one spirit, with one mind striving together for the faith of the gospel;

djk_text: Soseefi siteeman á poi meke u pantan na a pasi ya, fu meke u feele sani. Da den o kon si taki, na den o lasi a hii sitee ya. Bika u dati abi Masaa Gadu di taampu gi u, meke u sa wini.
eng_text: And in nothing terrified by your adversaries: which is to them an evident token of perdition, but to you of salvation, and that of God.

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu e teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku u. Ne a poti u toon wookoman gi a Kelestesi, fu dini en. Ma dati á wani taki, fu biibi en namo fa a tyai yeepi. Kweti! Ma na fu teke banowtu fi en ede tu, fu di u e teke en taki.
eng_text: For unto you it is given in the behalf of Christ, not only to believe on him, but also to suffer for his sake;

djk_text: Na so meke u e fende banowtu de enke fa u be si dati be miti mi de. Soseefi u e yee fa ai miti mi ya ete.
eng_text: Having the same conflict which ye saw in me, and now hear to be in me.

djk_text: We, a Kelestesi e gi u taanga di u abi fanowdu. Soseefi lobi fu koo u ati. A seefi Apaiti Jeje di be e tyai en, de fu tyai wi tu. Soseefi u abi tyali ati fasi fu wooko anga taawan.
eng_text: If there be therefore any consolation in Christ, if any comfort of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any bowels and mercies,

djk_text: Da u libi de fu piisii mi ya! U denki sani go na a wan se. U lobi ibiiwan a seefi fasi. U libi switi fasi makandii enke wan. U poti ede makandii suku a seefi sani fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Fulfil ye my joy, that ye be likeminded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind.

djk_text: Noiti suku wini fi i wawan namo. Noiti suku gafanen fi iseefi. Noiti keli iseefi hei moo taawan. Lesipeki taawan moo iseefi.
eng_text: Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves.

djk_text: Teke ain luku san taawan mankei, da booko ede anga a taawan nowtu.
eng_text: Look not every man on his own things, but every man also on the things of others.

djk_text: Denki sani na a fasi fa Kelestesi Jesesi e denki.
eng_text: Let this mind be in you, which was also in Christ Jesus:

djk_text: Luku fa a abi a hii bigi fu Masaa Gadu a tapu anda fosi a saka kon ya. Ma a á teke fu tyai a fasi de waka lontu goontapu suku wini fi enseefi.
eng_text: Who, being in the form of God, thought it not robbery to be equal with God:

djk_text: Kweti! A saka enseefi puu a hii bigi fi en poti a wanse. Ne a teke a saka fasi fu wan wookoman di gei saafu e dini basi. Na so a teke libisama fasi enke ibii taawan ya.
eng_text: But made himself of no reputation, and took upon him the form of a servant, and was made in the likeness of men:

djk_text: Namo enke wan libisama, ne a saka baka fu waka dini Masaa Gadu a tapu. A teke Masaa Gadu taki te doo dede wan lagi fasi a koloisi seefi.
eng_text: And being found in fashion as a man, he humbled himself, and became obedient unto death, even the death of the cross.

djk_text: Na so meke Masaa Gadu hei en pasa ala taawan. Ne a fende makiti fu taampu a fesi fu ala taa sani di nen i sa kai.
eng_text: Wherefore God also hath highly exalted him, and given him a name which is above every name:

djk_text: Na so Masaa Jesesi de basi fu ala sani a tapu anda doo goontapu ya seefi. Soseefi doo a moo lagi peesi a dedekondee seefi. Ibiiwan fu den sani ya abi fu saka gi en.
eng_text: That at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things in earth, and things under the earth;

djk_text: Ibiiwan fu den tongo abi fu piki taki: “Eeye! Jesesi Kelestesi na a moo gaan Masaa di de.” Na sowan fasi Masaa Gadu enke Tata fu wi ala sa fende gaandi.
eng_text: And that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

djk_text: Mi lobi biibiwan! Da teke a fasi fi en de tu. Masaa Gadu tyai yeepi puu u a takuudu anga ogii. Da enke fa u gwenti teke en taki de kaba, da feti naamo libi leti. Moo libi so seefi anga ala lesipeki anga gaan kenisi fi en. Ma a ná te mi de ape namo, ma winsi mi á de ape seefi.
eng_text: Wherefore, my beloved, as ye have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.

djk_text: Bika ne en gi u en taanga fu teke en taki, meke u poi libi so. Da u sa poi du den sani di a fiti poti.
eng_text: For it is God which worketh in you both to will and to do of his good pleasure.

djk_text: Da winsi san de fu du, ná kuutu fu dati. Du en sondee hali go anga hali kon.
eng_text: Do all things without murmurings and disputings:

djk_text: Da finga ná o poi soi kaagi u anga leti. Bika u sa de sondee takuudu fasi a mindii fu a takuu goontapu pe ogii ati sama e waka e libi takuudu fasi ya. U o de a den mindii enke lobi pikin fu Masaa Gadu di bun, fu si enke te neti dunguu, ma sitali a tapu e beenki fu si kiinkiin.
eng_text: That ye may be blameless and harmless, the sons of God, without rebuke, in the midst of a crooked and perverse nation, among whom ye shine as lights in the world;

djk_text: Na so u mu tan, fu tyai a bosikopu fa Masaa Gadu e gi libi tego. Da mi ya seefi o poi gafa u de na a dei di Masaa Jesesi o kon baka. Bika u libi sa soi fa mi á kon wooko de fu soso.
eng_text: Holding forth the word of life; that I may rejoice in the day of Christ, that I have not run in vain, neither laboured in vain.

djk_text: U teke biibi, ne u poti u libi gi Masaa Gadu enke te Dyu begiman e poti bunbun meti boon, fu gi Masaa Gadu daa. Da efu mi teke dede dise tu, da a gei mi buulu di lon na a diingi di mu towe a dati tapu, fu meke a daa doo peesi seefi. A hii sani ya e piisii mi. Bika mi anga u mokisa gi u libi a Masaa Gadu so.
eng_text: Yea, and if I be offered upon the sacrifice and service of your faith, I joy, and rejoice with you all.

djk_text: Da piisii de tu. U poolo, fu di mi anga u mokisa gi Masaa Gadu u hii libi so.
eng_text: For the same cause also do ye joy, and rejoice with me.

djk_text: We, efu Masaa Jesesi wani, da a ná o langa fosi mi sende Timotiyesi kon luku u de. Mi o kisi nyun kaakiti, te a sa daai kon taigi mi ya baka, fa sani e go anga u anda.
eng_text: But I trust in the Lord Jesus to send Timotheus shortly unto you, that I also may be of good comfort, when I know your state.

djk_text: We, mi o sende Timotiyesi kon luku u de, bika mi ná abi taa sama ya boiti en di e fii gi u anda enke mi ya. Fu tuu, ai booko ede ya, fa ai go anga u anda.
eng_text: For I have no man likeminded, who will naturally care for your state.

djk_text: Mi e taigi u a sani ya, fu u sa sabi taki, den taawan ya e suku soso wini fu denseefi namo. Da den nái feti a sani fu Kelestesi Jesesi baka.
eng_text: For all seek their own, not the things which are Jesus Christ's.

djk_text: Ma u sabi Timotiyesi dati, fa ai dini Masaa Gadu tuutuu fitoow fasi. Bika di wi be de a u anda, da u be si dati. Fa a be mokisa wooko anga mi enke wooko manpikin di e yeepi en dda a sani. Na so a be e yeepi mi, meke moo sama kon biibi a Bun Nyunsu.
eng_text: But ye know the proof of him, that, as a son with the father, he hath served with me in the gospel.

djk_text: We, na a Timotiyesi ya mi e denki fu sende kon luku u de. Fa i si mi o kisi fu sabi taki, mi o komoto a dunguu osu ya, da na so mi o sende en wanten.
eng_text: Him therefore I hope to send presently, so soon as I shall see how it will go with me.

djk_text: Mi abi a biibi tu taki, mi o fii komoto a dunguu osu ya. Da te dati pasa, da a ná o langa fosi miseefi sa kon luku u de.
eng_text: But I trust in the Lord that I also myself shall come shortly.

djk_text: We, mi si en fanowdu fu sende wi lobi biibi baala Eipafoditesi kon gi u de baka. U be gi mi en, fu teke u peesi waka yeepi mi wooko. Da a yeepi mi so tuu, te mi be abi en fanowdu. Na wan man di be mokisa wooko anga mi tuutuu. Wi feti makandii sowan fasi enke tu suudati di e tyai wini gi a basi. Na so u wooko soi fa Masaa Gadu bosikopu di wi e taki na a tuutuu wan.
eng_text: Yet I supposed it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, and companion in labour, and fellowsoldier, but your messenger, and he that ministered to my wants.

djk_text: Ma fa u de, da Eipafoditesi e angii fu u anda. Soseefi, a kon sabi taki, u e yee anda taki, ai siki dise. Ne ai fii wan fasi ya.
eng_text: For he longed after you all, and was full of heaviness, because that ye had heard that he had been sick.

djk_text: We, fu tuu, a be siki dise tuutuu enke fa u yee anda. Pikinmoo en boo be koti, ma na tyali ati fasi Masaa Gadu teke luku en, meke a kon bun baka. Da a kon, na miseefi Masaa Gadu yeepi de so. Bika di a kon bun en baka, da a kibii mi fu tyali á kon a mi tapu moo san mi abi ya kaba.
eng_text: For indeed he was sick nigh unto death: but God had mercy on him; and not on him only, but on me also, lest I should have sorrow upon sorrow.

djk_text: We, da gawgaw mi e sende en kon gi u anda baka. Bika mi wani u piisii de, te u sa si en baka. Efu mi yee dise taki, u piisii so, da wan koko sa losi komoto a mi ati.
eng_text: I sent him therefore the more carefully, that, when ye see him again, ye may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.

djk_text: We, da poolo puu en a boto anga piisii de. Na so Masaa Gadu wani. Bika sama enke Eipafoditesi fiti fu gi gaandi.
eng_text: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all gladness; and hold such in reputation:

djk_text: Bika a be poti en libi a dede mofu seefi, fu a wooko fu Kelestesi ede. A yeepi mi wan fasi di u anda seefi á be o poi.
eng_text: Because for the work of Christ he was nigh unto death, not regarding his life, to supply your lack of service toward me.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Moo fala, da u tan piisii doo, fu di u mokisa libi anga Masaa. Soseefi noiti mi o weli fu sikiifi u a seefi toli di mi be wasikoi u kaba, fu meke u á sa fende pasi buuya de. Ma u sa taampu sondee pantan fasi.
eng_text: Finally, my brethren, rejoice in the Lord. To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not grievous, but for you it is safe.

djk_text: Da mi e sikiifi naamo taki, luku bun anga den takuu feyanti! Na sama di muliki enke sukumofu dagu, fu waka du den ogii fu den naamo. Den e leli sama taki, den mu meke den koti den poti a maiki gi den fosi, da den sa toon sama fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Beware of dogs, beware of evil workers, beware of the concision.

djk_text: We, na wi Masaa Gadu e si enke sama di koti a maiki fu toon fi enseefi! Bika en Apaiti Jeje teke peesi a ini wi, meke u poi dini en. Da u e piisii fu san Kelestesi Jesesi du gi wi sondee fu teli san useefi de.
eng_text: For we are the circumcision, which worship God in the spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh.

djk_text: Libisama fasi, da mi ya dati be sa poi fu teli san miseefi de. Mi abi sani fu gafa kai moo son taawan di e teli san denseefi de.
eng_text: Though I might also have confidence in the flesh. If any other man thinketh that he hath whereof he might trust in the flesh, I more:

djk_text: Luku ya! Den koti a maiki a manpeesi gi mi, di mi tapu wan wiki. Da mi na Islayeli sama. Mi meke a ini a lo fu Benyameni. Mi na lala Hebelei sama. Na a fasi fu a Dyuweiti, da mi na be Faliseiman.
eng_text: Circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, an Hebrew of the Hebrews; as touching the law, a Pharisee;

djk_text: Mi be dyadya a ini ala san Masaa Gadu wani mi du. Ne mi lon du ogii anga den di e waka a Kelestesi baka. Fu oli weiti be e meke sama kon de bun gi Masaa Gadu, da mi be o de sondee fowtu.
eng_text: Concerning zeal, persecuting the church; touching the righteousness which is in the law, blameless.

djk_text: Ma ala san mi be sa kai fu teli miseefi kon toon sani fu du gaan ogii anga mi. Bika den sa tapu mi fu poti hii fitoow a Kelestesi namo.
eng_text: But what things were gain to me, those I counted loss for Christ.

djk_text: Moo ogii seefi! Mi teli den sani de enke soso sani, fu mi sa fende a moo gaan waiti sani seefi. Dati na fu kon sabi Kelestesi Jesesi enke mi Masaa. Na fi en ede meke mi fika ala den sani de enke tyobo sani a dyiko, fu fende wini a Kelestesi.
eng_text: Yea doubtless, and I count all things but loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord: for whom I have suffered the loss of all things, and do count them but dung, that I may win Christ,

djk_text: Ne di mi mokisa libi anga Kelestesi so, meke mi nái teli ala fa Dyuweiti e leli mi moo fu meke mi kon de bun gi Masaa Gadu. Ma na mi biibi na a wooko di Kelestesi du namo tyai mi kon de bun kaba.
eng_text: And be found in him, not having mine own righteousness, which is of the law, but that which is through the faith of Christ, the righteousness which is of God by faith:

djk_text: We, da mi o leli sabi Kelestesi, fu mokisa anga a taanga di Masaa Gadu teke weki en kon a libi ya baka. Ma soseefi a pina di a be teke doo fende fa a be teke dede seefi.
eng_text: That I may know him, and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, being made conformable unto his death;

djk_text: Da mi sa luku Masaa Gadu, fu weki miseefi komoto a dede kon a libi baka enke en.
eng_text: If by any means I might attain unto the resurrection of the dead.

djk_text: Ma a ná enke mi doo peesi kaba. A ná enke mi kaba seeka enke fa Masaa Gadu wani mi de seefi. Ma mi e feti seefi fu de enke fa Kelestesi wani mi mu de seefi, di a kisi mi teke toon sama fi en.
eng_text: Not as though I had already attained, either were already perfect: but I follow after, if that I may apprehend that for which also I am apprehended of Christ Jesus.

djk_text: Biibiwan! We, tuutuu! Mi á kaba de fa Kelestesi wani mi mu de seefi. Ma na wan sani di mi poti fu du! Da mi nái sidon, ma mi e waka pasa ala san fika a mi baka, fu luku fesi san de fu du, da mi e du ala dati.
eng_text: Brethren, I count not myself to have apprehended: but this one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before,

djk_text: Na so mi o feti fu fende san mi wani wini enke paiman, fu go teke a Masaa Gadu Kondee a tapu. Bika na fu dati Masaa Gadu kai wi kon mokisa libi anga Kelestesi Jesesi.
eng_text: I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.

djk_text: We, da meke u ala di de fa Masaa Gadu wani, denki sani a fasi de. Fu kande son sama e denki sani taa fasi de, da a fika gi Masaa Gadu, fu meke a kon si a toli ya so.
eng_text: Let us therefore, as many as be perfect, be thus minded: and if in any thing ye be otherwise minded, God shall reveal even this unto you.

djk_text: Ma winsi fa wan sama de seefi, na feti a mu feti go anga fesi doo, fu doo fa Masaa Gadu wani a mu de seefi.
eng_text: Nevertheless, whereto we have already attained, let us walk by the same rule, let us mind the same thing.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Da teke a sowtu fasi fu mi de. Luku sama di e libi enke mi de tu, da teke dati so tu.
eng_text: Brethren, be followers together of me, and mark them which walk so as ye have us for an ensample.

djk_text: Bika taawan de ape e go doo anga a takuu sowtu libi. Dati e soi fa den na feyanti fu a wooko di Kelestesi du na a koloisi, fu puu wi a takuudu anga ogii. Mi be taigi u a sani ya kaba, ma mi e taki en ya baka anga ala gaan tyali seefi.
eng_text: (For many walk, of whom I have told you often, and now tell you even weeping, that they are the enemies of the cross of Christ:

djk_text: Den o fende sitaafu tego. Bika losutu fu den sikin e wooko enke basi a den tapu, enke na dati a Gadu fu dini. Da den nái sen fu a ogii fasi de, ma den e gafa seefi fu dati. Na so den e denki na a fasi fu goontapu di nái teli Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Whose end is destruction, whose God is their belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who mind earthly things.)

djk_text: Bika wi dati na sama fu Masaa Gadu Kondee a tapu, di de u tuutuu tanpeesi. Da wi de ya e luku Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi fu komoto anda kon a wi, enke wi Yeepiman di puu wi a takuudu anga ogii.
eng_text: For our conversation is in heaven; from whence also we look for the Saviour, the Lord Jesus Christ:

djk_text: Da a o faandi wi sikin fu goontapu ya poti hii nyun sowtu fasi fu toon a sowtu dyendee sikin fi en, di meke fu tan a tapu anda. Na so a o wooko anga a gaan makiti fi en, di poi dwengi ala sani poti ne en ondoo.
eng_text: Who shall change our vile body, that it may be fashioned like unto his glorious body, according to the working whereby he is able even to subdue all things unto himself.

djk_text: We, biibiwan! Da u de a mi ati tuutuu, soseefi wan angii de fu kon miti u de baka. Bika u e piisii mi fa u e libi. Mi sa gafa u so. Ma, soseefi, da pakisei naamo san mi be sikiifi gi u kaba. Bika teke libi so o meke u taampu taanga a ini a biibi.
eng_text: Therefore, my brethren dearly beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, so stand fast in the Lord, my dearly beloved.

djk_text: Ediya anga Sintika anda! Gaantangi, u tu uman de mu feti libi makandii enke sisa. Bika u tu na sama fu Masaa.
eng_text: I beseech Euodias, and beseech Syntyche, that they be of the same mind in the Lord.

djk_text: Sisikosi! Yu nen wani taki, wooko makandii. Da yeepi den tu uman de meke den fiti makandii baka. Bika den be yeepi mi wooko tyai sama kon biibi a Bun Nyunsu. Den be wooko makandii anga Kelemensi anga ibii taawan di be mokisa wooko makandii anga mi tu. Da sabi taki, Masaa Gadu sikiifi ala den nen makandii a tapu anda ne en buku fu libi.
eng_text: And I intreat thee also, true yokefellow, help those women which laboured with me in the gospel, with Clement also, and with other my fellowlabourers, whose names are in the book of life.

djk_text: U mu piisii ala yuu, fu di u mokisa libi anga Masaa. Wan toon moo mi e taki, u mu piisii!
eng_text: Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice.

djk_text: Wooko switi anga ibii sowtu sama. A konbaka fu Masaa de koosube.
eng_text: Let your moderation be known unto all men. The Lord is at hand.

djk_text: Da noiti booko ede fu sani de. Ma begi fu dati. Soi san u fanowdu, da wanten de gi daa kaba, fu di u sabi fa a yeepi u anga dati kaba.
eng_text: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.

djk_text: Da Masaa Gadu o meke u ati de switi fasi. Bika u abi fitoow a Kelestesi Jesesi, fu yeepi u. Da dati o meke Masaa Gadu koo u ati wan fasi di useefi á poi fusutan na a ten fu booko ede de.
eng_text: And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Moo fala, da denki namo san de fu kai bun. Denki tuutuu sani. Denki sani di waiti fu soi lesipeki. Denki san de leti a libisama fesi doo Masaa Gadu seefi. Denki san de kiin fasi. Denki san e fiti sama. Denki san de fu gi gaandi.
eng_text: Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things.

djk_text: Wooko anga ala san mi be leli u kaba. U waka doo enke fa u be teke a leli ya. San u be yee a mi, soseefi fa u be si mi e waka. Da Masaa Gadu di e meke sama ati de switi fasi sa de anga u.
eng_text: Those things, which ye have both learned, and received, and heard, and seen in me, do: and the God of peace shall be with you.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Mi e gi Masaa gaantangi dise anga ala piisii. Bika baka langa, ma toku u soi mi ya baka fa u e angii fu yeepi mi a sani dise ete. Mi be sabi taki, u be wani yeepi mi so, ma na a okasi u á be fende de ete.
eng_text: But I rejoiced in the Lord greatly, that now at the last your care of me hath flourished again; wherein ye were also careful, but ye lacked opportunity.

djk_text: Ma ná enke mi sidon ya anga nowtu seefi. Bika mi pasa ala sowtu libi, ne mi leli tifeedi anga san mi abi.
eng_text: Not that I speak in respect of want: for I have learned, in whatsoever state I am, therewith to be content.

djk_text: Da mi de tifeedi sondee san mi fanowdu. Winsi san e miti mi, winsi pe mi de. Mi nyan fuu bee ofu mi de anga angii. Efu sani á sai mi ofu mi abi sani pasa peesi.
eng_text: I know both how to be abased, and I know how to abound: every where and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need.

djk_text: Mi leli tifeedi ala fasi, fu di Kelestesi e gi mi taanga fu poi anga ala sani.
eng_text: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.

djk_text: Ma toku u fiti de fu gafa, fu di u sende sani gi mi so, meke mi abi ala san mi fanowdu a ini mi banowtu ten ya.
eng_text: Notwithstanding ye have well done, that ye did communicate with my affliction.

djk_text: We, biibiwan a Filipi Foto de! U sabi enke fa miseefi sabi ya, fa na u anda namo be sende moni yeepi mi anga san mi be fanowdu di mi be de fu komoto a Masadoniya pisiwataa anda. Bika mi be kaba gi Masaa Gadu bosikopu de.
eng_text: Now ye Philippians know also, that in the beginning of the gospel, when I departed from Macedonia, no church communicated with me as concerning giving and receiving, but ye only.

djk_text: Di mi be de a Tesalonika Foto seefi, u be yeepi mi. Na u wawan namo be e sende sani fu yeepi mi na a nowtu di mi be de, te doo somen leisi seefi.
eng_text: For even in Thessalonica ye sent once and again unto my necessity.

djk_text: A ná enke na a sani di u sende gi mi bigi gi mi so! Nono! Ma na a paiman di Masaa Gadu o dyunta moo anga moo gi u a tapu anda, fu san u du naamo de.
eng_text: Not because I desire a gift: but I desire fruit that may abound to your account.

djk_text: We, meke mi piki u taki, mi be kisi ala den gaan bun di u be sende gi Eipafoditesi tyai den doo a mi. Den be ipi pasa peesi. Masaa Gadu e si dati enke te Dyu kii wan bunbun meti boon gi en daa.
eng_text: But I have all, and abound: I am full, having received of Epaphroditus the things which were sent from you, an odour of a sweet smell, a sacrifice acceptable, wellpleasing to God.

djk_text: We, a Masaa Gadu di mi e dini ya na di abi ala gudu. Da a poi gi u, san u seefi abi fanowdu a wan gaan foondoo fasi di useefi á poti fusutan. Bika u na sama di mokisa libi anga Kelestesi.
eng_text: But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.

djk_text: Da meke u gi u Tata, Masaa Gadu gaandi tego. Amen, na so a de!
eng_text: Now unto God and our Father be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

djk_text: We, da bali odi doo ala sama di Masaa Gadu poti apaiti fasi, fu waka a Kelestesi Jesesi baka de. Biibiwan di e wooko makandii anga mi dise e sende bigi odi gi u.
eng_text: Salute every saint in Christ Jesus. The brethren which are with me greet you.

djk_text: Ala sama di de apaiti fasi gi Masaa Gadu seefi e sende bigi odi. Moomoo, den biibiwan di e wooko na a paleisi, fu a moo gaan kownu a Loma Foto.
eng_text: All the saints salute you, chiefly they that are of Caesar's household.

djk_text: Da a fika fu Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi de anga u ala, fu tan teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku u. Amen, na so a de!
eng_text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

djk_text: Mi Pawlesi ya na Masaa Gadu wani, ne a poti mi apaiti bosikopuman fu Kelestesi Jesesi. Na mi anga u biibi baala Timotiyesi e sikiifi a biifi ya.
eng_text: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timotheus our brother,

djk_text: A de gi u ala, di Masaa Gadu poti wan apaiti fasi a Kolose Foto anda anga biibiwan di poti fitoow doo, fu du san a Kelestesi taki. We, da meke u Tata, Masaa Gadu teke gaan bun ati fasi luku u de. Soseefi, meke u ati de switi.
eng_text: To the saints and faithful brethren in Christ which are at Colosse: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

djk_text: We, ibii leisi wi dise e begi gi u anda, da wi e gi Masaa Gadu, a Tata fu wi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi, daa fu u ede.
eng_text: We give thanks to God and the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,

djk_text: Bika wi e yee dise fa u anda poti taanga biibi a Kelestesi Jesesi. Soseefi, u yee fa u abi gaan lobi de fu ibii sama fu Masaa Gadu tu.
eng_text: Since we heard of your faith in Christ Jesus, and of the love which ye have to all the saints,

djk_text: We, fa u e libi de so, na fu di u poti biibi a Masaa Gadu, da u e luku fu fende bun di a paamisi sama di e teke en taki. Bika den di e du san a wani o fende ala dati a Masaa Gadu Kondee a tapu. U be yee a toli de kaba senten a dei di a tuutuu Bun Nyunsu fu Masaa Jesesi be doo u de.
eng_text: For the hope which is laid up for you in heaven, whereof ye heard before in the word of the truth of the gospel;

djk_text: We, na Masaa Gadu wookoman Eipafalasi kon gi u a bosikopu de. Na a seefi bosikopu di taa wookoman fu Masaa Gadu e paati nownow na ala se. Da moo sama e teke biibi ne en tu. Da den e kon sabi libi fiti Masaa Gadu enke san pasa a u de. Bika senten a dei useefi yee en, ne u kon e fusutan fa Masaa Gadu teke gaan bun ati fasi namo, fu luku u. Wi sabi dise taki, na Eipafalasi be leli u ala dati. We, enseefi na wan bun fitoow wookoman fu Kelestesi makandii anga wi dise, fu tyai yeepi gi u de. Na wan tuutuu lobi baala fu wi ya!
eng_text: Which is come unto you, as it is in all the world; and bringeth forth fruit, as it doth also in you, since the day ye heard of it, and knew the grace of God in truth:

djk_text: Namo Eipafalasi seefi kon taigi wi dise fa a si a Apaiti Jeje teke peesi e tii u de libi. Ne dati meke u kon abi gaan dipi lobi fu ibii taa sama fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Who also declared unto us your love in the Spirit.

djk_text: We, senten a dei di u yee dati, da wi á puu dei ya ete, di wi nái begi gi u. Meke u fusutan sa opo moo anga moo, fu u moo sabi san Masaa Gadu wani. Soseefi fu u sa kisi moo leti koni, fu wooko. Ma soseefi tu, fu u sa si kiin, sowtu kengi lei sani abi anga den tuutuu sani fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: For this cause we also, since the day we heard it, do not cease to pray for you, and to desire that ye might be filled with the knowledge of his will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding;

djk_text: Bika na den fasi de sa meke u waka fiti Masaa. Da u libi sa e piisii Masaa Gadu ala fasi. Dati wani taki, u tan du bun sani gi taawan. U feti moo anga moo, fu sabi Masaa Gadu wan leti fasi tu.
eng_text: That ye might walk worthy of the Lord unto all pleasing, being fruitful in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of God;

djk_text: We, meke moo anga moo dyendee taanga fu Masaa Gadu teke peesi a u libi tu, fu u sa taampu moo taanga. Da sani á sa kon miti u, di sa poi moo u. Winsi san, ma toku u sa poi tei ati fu oli doo. Soseefi, u sa fudaagi ala sani.
eng_text: Strengthened with all might, according to his glorious power, unto all patience and longsuffering with joyfulness;

djk_text: Soseefi, gi Masaa Gadu, a Tata fu wi, daa anga ala piisii. Bika a teke u anda kon poti fu fende ala san a paamisi den sama fi en di a poti apaiti fasi. Den o fende a bun di de a ini a Nyun Tii, a Masaa Gadu Kondee di e beenki gaan dyendee fasi.
eng_text: Giving thanks unto the Father, which hath made us meet to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light:

djk_text: Bika a puu wi na a se fu dunguu a didibii ondoo, ne a tyai u kon poti na a Nyun Tii fu a lobi Manpikin fi en ondoo.
eng_text: Who hath delivered us from the power of darkness, and hath translated us into the kingdom of his dear Son:

djk_text: Bika a meke dati du wan gaan wooko di tyai yeepi gi wi, fu Masaa Gadu sa poi gi wi paadon fu wi takuudu anga ogii.
eng_text: In whom we have redemption through his blood, even the forgiveness of sins:

djk_text: We, ná wan sama di sa si Masaa Gadu anga ain. Ma efi i si a Manpikin fi en, da na Masaa Gadu seefi i si de kaba. Ne na edeman fu ala sani di Masaa Gadu meke a goontapu.
eng_text: Who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of every creature:

djk_text: Bika ne en Masaa Gadu be sende meke ala sani. San ain poi si ya anga san ain á poi si doo a tapu seefi. Dati wani taki, sutuu fu sidon tii peesi anga gaan bigiman di sidon a tapu anga basi di e tii taawan anga makiti di hei ofu lagi moo taawan. Masaa Gadu Manpikin de a tapu fu ala, da den meke fu saka denseefi ne en ondoo gi en gaandi tu.
eng_text: For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible, whether they be thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by him, and for him:

djk_text: A Manpikin ya be de kaba, fosi ala sani be meke. Ne en oli ala sani taampu a den peesi, meke den nái kaba a soso.
eng_text: And he is before all things, and by him all things consist.

djk_text: Ne enseefi na edeman fu Masaa Gadu kulu sama, di ai kai en sikin. Ne en meke den poi toon sama fi en, da ai gi den a libi di Masaa Gadu wani gi sama. Soseefi a de a fesi fu ala san meke taki, en fosi dede weki baka, da ai libi tego. We, da na ala fasi a teke fesi fu ala sani.
eng_text: And he is the head of the body, the church: who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all things he might have the preeminence.

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu seefi fiti poti taki, ne enseefi teke peesi a ini a sikin di a Manpikin ya abi. Da ne en Masaa Gadu seefi de ape.
eng_text: For it pleased the Father that in him should all fulness dwell;

djk_text: Soseefi Masaa Gadu seefi fiti poti, ne a sende en kon teke dede a koloisi, meke en buulu lon. Na so a pai fu sama takuudu anga ogii, fu tyai ala sani kon de bun gi Masaa Gadu baka. Dati wani taki, ala san de a ondoo goontapu ya anga Masaa Gadu Kondee a tapu seefi, kon de mati fasi anga en.
eng_text: And, having made peace through the blood of his cross, by him to reconcile all things unto himself; by him, I say, whether they be things in earth, or things in heaven.

djk_text: Da yu de seefi be de tuutuu faawe fu Masaa Gadu. Bika yu be e libi feyanti fasi anga en. I be de anga takuu pakisei anga ala takuudu.
eng_text: And you, that were sometime alienated and enemies in your mind by wicked works, yet now hath he reconciled

djk_text: Ma nownow, da na hii taa fasi yu kon de. Masaa Gadu meke i toon mati fi en, ne i kon de bun gi enseefi. Bika Kelestesi teke dede a yu peesi. En boo be koti libisama fasi, fu meke yu kon de fa Masaa Gadu wani. Da yu taampu sondee kaagi a Masaa Gadu fesi, fu finga á sa poi soi a yu taki, yu abi fowtu.
eng_text: In the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and unblameable and unreproveable in his sight:

djk_text: Na so! Ma taampu doo anga a biibi sondee pantan ne en bosikopu. Soseefi pasi á mu fende koli i kaba luku fu fende san Masaa Gadu paamisi sama di e teke en taki. U be yee dati kaba na a dei di sama be tyai a Bun Nyunsu kon gi u de. Ala wookoman fu Masaa Gadu di e dini en te doo mi Pawlesi ya seefi e gi dati na ala se fu goontapu.
eng_text: If ye continue in the faith grounded and settled, and be not moved away from the hope of the gospel, which ye have heard, and which was preached to every creature which is under heaven; whereof I Paul am made a minister;

djk_text: We, fu puu bun gi u anda, meke mi e teke sitaafu a dunguu osu ya. Da anga ala piisii. Bika ibii wookoman fu a Kelestesi musu teke pina sowan fasi, fu yeepi tyai a pina di en wookoman mu tyai ete a sikin buba, fu yeepi a hii kulu sama fi en. Da na fa a poti gi mi, na so mi e tyai ya, fu puu bun gi u enke sama fi anda. Bika sama fi en ne enseefi sikin.
eng_text: Who now rejoice in my sufferings for you, and fill up that which is behind of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body's sake, which is the church:

djk_text: We, mi toon wookoman fu den sama fu Masaa Gadu so, bika enseefi gi mi a wooko, fu soi u leti san Masaa Gadu fiti poti fu du gi u de, a ini en wowtu.
eng_text: Whereof I am made a minister, according to the dispensation of God which is given to me for you, to fulfil the word of God;

djk_text: Noiti a fesi a be soi sama a bosikopu ya ete. Da a be de wan kibii toli hii fositen te doo na a ten ya fosi, pe a fiti poti, fu tyai en kon a kiin gi sama fi en.
eng_text: Even the mystery which hath been hid from ages and from generations, but now is made manifest to his saints:

djk_text: Namo a poti dati a sama fi en ana, fu soi den foondoo sani di a fiti poti fu du. A bosikopu ya taki, a Kelestesi e teke peesi a ini yu enke taa foluku seefi. Da yuseefi de fu luku fu fende dyendee sani di Masaa Gadu paamisi en sama a Masaa Gadu Kondee.
eng_text: To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles; which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:

djk_text: We, da na fu a Kelestesi ya namo wi e taigi sama. Soseefi wi e wasikoi den, fu den á taanga yesi gi en. Wi e leli ibiiwan den sani fi en. Winsi sama den de. Wi e wooko anga a leti koni di u abi, fu leli. Da te a dei o doo fu taampu a Masaa Gadu fesi, da sama sa taampu de enke fa Masaa Gadu wani.
eng_text: Whom we preach, warning every man, and teaching every man in all wisdom; that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus:

djk_text: Na dati meke mi e naki sikin e tyotyo wooko so. Mi e feti taanga enke fa mi kan anga ala a kaakiti di Masaa Gadu gi mi, fu du a wooko fi en.
eng_text: Whereunto I also labour, striving according to his working, which worketh in me mightily.

djk_text: We, mi e soi fa mi e wooko taanga, fu u mu sabi fa mi e tyotyo e meke moiti, fu yeepi u de. Soseefi, fu yeepi biibiwan a Laodiseya Foto anga ibii taa biibiwan, di noiti si mi fesi wan dei.
eng_text: For I would that ye knew what great conflict I have for you, and for them at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;

djk_text: Ala dati na fu meke u ala taampu moo taanga a ini a biibi. Da sama á sa poi meke u lasi ati pantan ofu taanga yesi gi a bosikopu fu Masaa Gadu. Soseefi, fu meke u ala sa poi mokisa libi makandii enke wan, fu di u lobi useefi. Da u sa kon fusutan a hiihii bosikopu fu Masaa Gadu, di noiti a fesi a be tyai kon a kiin fosi a ten ya. Dati e taki fu Kelestesi.
eng_text: That their hearts might be comforted, being knit together in love, and unto all riches of the full assurance of understanding, to the acknowledgement of the mystery of God, and of the Father, and of Christ;

djk_text: Bika ne en wawan namo poi gi sama a leti koni fu fusutan sani fu Masaa Gadu, di a wani sama mu sabi.
eng_text: In whom are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.

djk_text: Mi taki a sani ya, fu u á meke sama koli u kisi anga den switi toli toli fu den.
eng_text: And this I say, lest any man should beguile you with enticing words.

djk_text: Bika mi á de a u mindii de libisama fasi. Ma mi hii ati de a u anda. Da jeje fasi mi de ape. Soseefi mi e piisii fu e yee u e libi fiti anga useefi de enke tuutuu biibi famii. Mi e yee tu, fa u tan poti fitoow a Kelestesi sondee pantan.
eng_text: For though I be absent in the flesh, yet am I with you in the spirit, joying and beholding your order, and the stedfastness of your faith in Christ.

djk_text: We, fa u teke fu biibi Kelestesi Jesesi de, da na fu meke a wooko enke gaan Masaa a u tapu. Da tan teke fu waka fiti fa ai taki, fu mokisa libi anga en.
eng_text: As ye have therefore received Christ Jesus the Lord, so walk ye in him:

djk_text: Dati wani taki, tan taampu anga san i be yee fi en a bigin fu a biibi. Meke dati goo sowan fasi kon moo taanga. Da noiti pantan anga a biibi fi en bosikopu di u be teke leli. Da u e gi en daa naamo fu a biibi libi ya.
eng_text: Rooted and built up in him, and stablished in the faith, as ye have been taught, abounding therein with thanksgiving.

djk_text: Da luku bun taki, sama á fende pasi koli u tyai go fasi poti a den ondoo, fu wooko enke basi a u tapu. Bika den o leli u lawlaw denki di libisama seefi abi fu dini Masaa Gadu. Soseefi, fu oli kina anga fasi di sama seefi meke fu libi. Ma den á de fa a Kelestesi poti fu waka.
eng_text: Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Christ.

djk_text: Bika a hii sani seefi taki, Masaa Gadu teke libisama fasi anga sikin buba, saka kon toon wan libisama. A sama de na a Kelestesi.
eng_text: For in him dwelleth all the fulness of the Godhead bodily.

djk_text: A makiti moo ala sowtu basi di e tii taawan anga makiti di hei ofu lagi moo taawan. We, da yu mokisa libi anga en, meke yu doo peesi enke sama di sabi Masaa Gadu, fu libi fiti en.
eng_text: And ye are complete in him, which is the head of all principality and power:

djk_text: Dati wani taki, yu mokisa libi anga Kelestesi. Ne a puu yu na a libi pe losutu fu sikin be e wooko enke basi a yu tapu, fu kon toon sama fi en. Dati na wan sowtu maiki di kengi anga fa Dyusama dati be e koti maiki, fu toon sama fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: In whom also ye are circumcised with the circumcision made without hands, in putting off the body of the sins of the flesh by the circumcision of Christ:

djk_text: Ma yu dati dopu go a ondoo wataa taki, na mokisa dede beli a ondoo doti anga en. Di i opo komoto a ini a wataa na mokisa opo kon a libi ya baka anga en, fu teke wan hii nyun sowtu libi. Bika yu biibi Masaa Gadu makiti fu puu yu a takuudu anga ogii gi libi enke fa a be gi a Kelestesi baka di a be dede.
eng_text: Buried with him in baptism, wherein also ye are risen with him through the faith of the operation of God, who hath raised him from the dead.

djk_text: We, luku fa dati pasa anga yu. Bika fosi i be teke biibi, da yu be e boo, ma yu be e teli fu dedewan. Bika yu á be de sama fu Masaa Gadu di sabi libi fa a wani. Da yu á be e teke en taki. Yu be e waka a ini takuudu anga ogii. Ma toku, ne Masaa Gadu gi yu wan hii nyun sowtu libi mokisa anga a Kelestesi. Soseefi paadon, fu yu takuudu anga ogii.
eng_text: And you, being dead in your sins and the uncircumcision of your flesh, hath he quickened together with him, having forgiven you all trespasses;

djk_text: We, takuudu anga ogii fu wi, da Masaa Gadu weiti e bali wi fu dati. Ai soi wi taki, na taanga yesi gi en, fu fende sitaafu. Da ala dati be e sikiifi a buku e poti de. Ma di a Kelestesi dede, meke a puu a hii buku de fiingi towe. I sa taki, a mokisa en naki kii anga a Kelestesi na a koloisi.
eng_text: Blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross;

djk_text: Na so a booko a hii makiti fu basi di e tii taawan anga makiti di hei ofu lagi moo taawan saka. Den naki gaan sen na ala lanti fesi. Bika den si a gaanbigi fasi di a Kelestesi wini den na a koloisi, te enke hii goontapu doo tapu anda seefi si.
eng_text: And having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a shew of them openly, triumphing over them in it.

djk_text: We, da tapu yesi gi sama di e kaagi u fu kande u nyan son sani ofu diingi son sani. U oli son fesa ofu fesa fu son mun. U nái oli a kina dei fu Dyusama.
eng_text: Let no man therefore judge you in meat, or in drink, or in respect of an holyday, or of the new moon, or of the sabbath days:

djk_text: Bika a tuutuu sani seefi na a Kelestesi. Den taa sani di waka ne en fesi de na fu be leli Dyusama fa en enke tuutuu sani di o kon seefi tan. Ne den waka ne en fesi enke fa kaaka fu sani e kai fosi a sani seefi doo.
eng_text: Which are a shadow of things to come; but the body is of Christ.

djk_text: Da kaba aliki sama di e taki, yu ná o fende Masaa Gadu paamisi. Bika yu nái dini Masaa Gadu enke fa ai denki. Soseefi yu nái waka fa ai leli fu taawan wooko enke basi a yu tapu. Yu nái teke en leli fu begi den Engel tu. A taki, a si jeje sani fu Masaa Gadu enke ai deen, da yu nái teke tu. Bika na hei membee meke a sama de e denki taki, a sabi dini Masaa Gadu moo taawan, enke fa en takuu ati e soi en.
eng_text: Let no man beguile you of your reward in a voluntary humility and worshipping of angels, intruding into those things which he hath not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,

djk_text: Da a leli di dati e gi á de fa a tuutuu bosikopu fu a Kelestesi de. Bika na a taki fu disi namo u mu teke enke edeman fu leli sama fi en, moo anga moo fu sabi Masaa Gadu. Soseefi fu kon fusutan en bosikopu moo anga moo fiti en. Bika na ede e oli sikin tei ala sukuufu miti, fu a sa goo, da ai si san a hii sikin abi fanowdu fu libi.
eng_text: And not holding the Head, from which all the body by joints and bands having nourishment ministered, and knit together, increaseth with the increase of God.

djk_text: Bika u teke biibi mokisa dede anga a Kelestesi, da u ná abi fu teke kina anga fasi oli suku yeepi moo enke sama a goontapu di á sabi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Wherefore if ye be dead with Christ from the rudiments of the world, why, as though living in the world, are ye subject to ordinances,

djk_text: Bika den weiti e soi san mofu á mu tesi seefi. San ana á mu oli seefi. San finga á mu nama seefi.
eng_text: (Touch not; taste not; handle not;

djk_text: Ma ala den sani de na bunbun sani di Masaa Gadu meke fu sama teke wooko. Te i wooko anga den seefi, da den nái de fu si moo, meke a á fanowdu fu tapu sama a den sowtu sani de. Bika na sama seefi meke den weiti de e leli taawan.
eng_text: Which all are to perish with the using;) after the commandments and doctrines of men?

djk_text: Da taawan e si den falisi leliman de enke den abi leti koni. Bika ai soi enke na tuu, fu leli sama meke taawan wooko enke basi a den tapu. Soseefi fu poti sikin teke pina. Ma den sani de nái yeepi, fu meke sama wooko enke basi dwengi losutu fi en sikin. Ma na meke ai meke sama keli enseefi hei moo taawan seefi.
eng_text: Which things have indeed a shew of wisdom in will worship, and humility, and neglecting of the body; not in any honour to the satisfying of the flesh.

djk_text: Ma efu yu mokisa libi anga a Kelestesi tuu, da i mokisa dede weki anga en baka a wan hii nyun sowtu libi. Da poti denki suku san e teli fu gaan sani a Masaa Gadu Kondee. Bika na tapu anda a Kelestesi sidon a Masaa Gadu letise, fu fende gaandi.
eng_text: If ye then be risen with Christ, seek those things which are above, where Christ sitteth on the right hand of God.

djk_text: Da si san ai teli fu gaan sani anda, fu gaan sani ya tu. Ma kaba feti a goontapu sani ya baka.
eng_text: Set your affection on things above, not on things on the earth.

djk_text: Bika yu mokisa dede na a koloisi anga a Kelestesi, meke i kaba anga takuudu anga ogii ya tu. Da goontapu ya seefi á de yu tuutuu tanpeesi. Bika na Masaa Gadu a tapu anda yu mokisa libi makandii anga a Kelestesi.
eng_text: For ye are dead, and your life is hid with Christ in God.

djk_text: Ne en namo poi gi sama a libi fu Masaa Gadu Kondee a tapu di á de fu si a goontapu ya. Ma a dei di a o kon baka, da a o de fu si a yu, fu meke yu mokisa fende gaandi anga en.
eng_text: When Christ, who is our life, shall appear, then shall ye also appear with him in glory.

djk_text: We, da kaba libi enke fa sikin e fii fu du sani, enke sama a goontapu di á sabi Masaa Gadu. Kaba anga waka libi. Kaba anga motyo fasi fu sikin. Kaba anga fafa ati fu sani. Kaba anga takuu losutu. Kaba anga giili ati fu sani, di e teli enke yu teke falisi gadu e dini.
eng_text: Mortify therefore your members which are upon the earth; fornication, uncleanness, inordinate affection, evil concupiscence, and covetousness, which is idolatry:

djk_text: Da Masaa Gadu ati e faya a den sowtu sama de, fu gi den sitaafu.
eng_text: For which things' sake the wrath of God cometh on the children of disobedience:

djk_text: Bika na fosi i be toon biibisama, ne i be de a sowtu sama anga takuudu.
eng_text: In the which ye also walked some time, when ye lived in them.

djk_text: Ma nownow, da kaba den sowtu ogii fasi ya tu. Kaba boon ati fasi. Poi fu dwengi atiboon fasi. Kaba du ogii, meke taawan fii. Kaba taki sani ati taawan. Kaba kosi taawan gi sen.
eng_text: But now ye also put off all these; anger, wrath, malice, blasphemy, filthy communication out of your mouth.

djk_text: Kaba lei. Bika yu komoto a ini a fasi di i be de fosi.
eng_text: Lie not one to another, seeing that ye have put off the old man with his deeds;

djk_text: I teke fu toon wan hii nyun sowtu sama di meke fu goo kon tan enke fa Masaa Gadu seefi de. Soseefi fu kon fusutan fa Masaa Gadu de.
eng_text: And have put on the new man, which is renewed in knowledge after the image of him that created him:

djk_text: We, ibii sama di toon a hii nyun sowtu sama, da na a seefi Kelestesi teke peesi a ibiiwan fu den. Da den nái teli moo taki, disi na Dyu ofu dati á de Dyu. Disi koti maiki a manpeesi toon Dyusama ofu dati á koti. Disi na doose kondee sama ofu dati na bakabusi sama. Disi na saafu a katibo ofu dati na fii sama sondee katibo. Kweti!
eng_text: Where there is neither Greek nor Jew, circumcision nor uncircumcision, Barbarian, Scythian, bond nor free: but Christ is all, and in all.

djk_text: We, Masaa Gadu poti yu wan apaiti fasi toon sama di a lobi tuutuu. Da teke booko ede fu taawan. Wooko switi anga taawan. Noiti si yuseefi hei moo taawan. Ná suku wini fi yu wawan namo. Teke pasensi anga taawan.
eng_text: Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering;

djk_text: Fudaagi taawan. Pakisei fa Masaa Gadu gi yu paadon, da paadon taawan so tu.
eng_text: Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye.

djk_text: A moo gaan sani fu du a ini ala dati na fu wooko anga lobi fu taawan. Bika lobi sa tei u mokisa, fu poi libi makandii.
eng_text: And above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of perfectness.

djk_text: Soseefi, da feti fu de switi makandii doo anga useefi. A Kelestesi gi u a taanga fu dati. Na so Masaa Gadu kai u kon poti enke wan sikin, fu wooko. Da tan sowan fasi e gi Masaa Gadu daa naamo, fu ala san ai du gi u.
eng_text: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.

djk_text: Feti fu sabi Masaa Gadu bosikopu fu a Kelestesi, da tyai yuseefi so. Dati wani taki, teke leti koni wooko fu leli anga wasikoi taawan, fu fusutan. Wooko anga san sikiifi a Psalm singi buku, fu meke singi fu singi. Ibii taa sowtu singi di e gafa Masaa Gadu tu. Singi di Masaa Gadu Jeje poti a u ati tu. Singi ibii yuu anga u hii ati gi Masaa Gadu, fu gi en daa, fi en gaan bun fasi.
eng_text: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.

djk_text: Soseefi winsi san yu e du, winsi san yu e taki, meke a de fu Masaa Jesesi ede. Da gi u Tata, Masaa Gadu daa ibii yuu, fu a wooko di dati du gi u.
eng_text: And whatsoever ye do in word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him.

djk_text: Biibi uman! Saka a yu man ondoo. Teke en taki. Bika na dati fiti uman di e libi gi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi.
eng_text: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as it is fit in the Lord.

djk_text: Man! U mu lobi u uman tuutuu fasi! Da u á mu libi goofu anga a uman.
eng_text: Husbands, love your wives, and be not bitter against them.

djk_text: Biibi pikin mu teke en gaansama taki ala fasi! Bika ai switi gi Masaa fu si sama de fi en tan so.
eng_text: Children, obey your parents in all things: for this is well pleasing unto the Lord.

djk_text: Dada fu pikin á mu du anga a pikin te, fu bita a pikin ati. Bika dati sa meke a pikin lasi ati a ini san de fu du.
eng_text: Fathers, provoke not your children to anger, lest they be discouraged.

djk_text: Biibiwan di de saafu a katibo mu teke taki ala fasi fi en gaan masaa di de libisama fasi ya. A ná te en ain de a yu tapu namo enke na sama ati yu wani switi. Bika wooko anga yu hii ati fu di na wi Masaa ati yu wani switi.
eng_text: Servants, obey in all things your masters according to the flesh; not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but in singleness of heart, fearing God:

djk_text: Da winsi san yu e du, da du en bun enke fa yu poi. A ná sama yu e wooko gi. Ma na wi Masaa seefi.
eng_text: And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;

djk_text: Bika sabi taki, na Masaa Gadu seefi o pai yu fiti fa yu wooko. Na so ibii sama yu wooko enke fa a wani o fende bun di a paamisi fu gi. Da wooko de taki na gi wi Masaa di de a Kelestesi.
eng_text: Knowing that of the Lord ye shall receive the reward of the inheritance: for ye serve the Lord Christ.

djk_text: Ma sabi soseefi taki, efu wan sama tan du ogii, winsi sama a yu, Masaa Gadu o sitaafu yu fiti yu ogii. Denki soseefi taki, Masaa Gadu nái keli sama hei moo sama. Da ai kuutu ibiiwan anga leti fu gi san fiti dati.
eng_text: But he that doeth wrong shall receive for the wrong which he hath done: and there is no respect of persons.

djk_text: We, da meke gaan masaa di de biibisama mu wooko bun anga saafu fu den. Gi den san den fanowdu. Pakisei fa yuseefi abi wan gaan Masaa a tapu, fu teke dati taki tu.
eng_text: Masters, give unto your servants that which is just and equal; knowing that ye also have a Master in heaven.

djk_text: We, tan anga begi naamo. Da de anga ain e waki luku. Da wanten de gi Masaa Gadu seefi daa kaba fi en yeepi.
eng_text: Continue in prayer, and watch in the same with thanksgiving;

djk_text: Moomoo, da begi gi mi, meke pasi sa opo fu taki san Masaa Gadu fiti poti fu du gi sama di a sende fu a Kelestesi. Bika na wan bosikopu di noiti a fesi a be soi sama wanten, meke a be de wan kibii toli hii fositen te doo na a ten ya. Ne a poti dati a mi ana, fu tyai kon a kiin gi sama. Na fu dati ede den kisi mi sooto ya.
eng_text: Withal praying also for us, that God would open unto us a door of utterance, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds:

djk_text: Da begi fu mi sa poi opo den sama ain, fu si fa a hii toli ya de seefi. Meke den sa si tu fa na Masaa Gadu seefi fiti poti fu wooko so. Bika na mi wooko fu tyai a toli ya kon a kiin.
eng_text: That I may make it manifest, as I ought to speak.

djk_text: Waka anga leti koni fu wooko a mindii fu sama di nái biibi. De sete sete, fu gaapu ibii okasi di kon fu taki anga den.
eng_text: Walk in wisdom toward them that are without, redeeming the time.

djk_text: Tyai a taki ya wan piisii fasi fu den sama sa wani aliki. Ala disi sa meke yuseefi leli taki anga sama di wani sabi saide yu abi a biibi di yu abi.
eng_text: Let your speech be alway with grace, seasoned with salt, that ye may know how ye ought to answer every man.

djk_text: We, mi o sende Tikikesi kon luku u de, fu soi fa ala sani didon a mi dise. Na mi lobi baala, soseefi fitoow wookoman na a wooko makandii anga mi ya.
eng_text: All my state shall Tychicus declare unto you, who is a beloved brother, and a faithful minister and fellowservant in the Lord:

djk_text: Na dati meke mi sende en, fu kon luku u anda. Da a sa taigi u fa ala sani didon anga wi dise. A o koo u ati anda tu, fu kaba pantan gi wi dise.
eng_text: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that he might know your estate, and comfort your hearts;

djk_text: Mi o sende makandii anga u paandasi sama anda den e kai Onesimesi. Bika a de wan fitoow wookoman na a wooko makandii anga mi ya. Mi lobi enseefi tuutuu tu. Den tu man ya o kon taigi u anda fa ala sani e waka dise.
eng_text: With Onesimus, a faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They shall make known unto you all things which are done here.

djk_text: Alestakesi bali u anda bigi odi. A de a dunguu osu ya anga mi. Maakusi enke tyuku famii fu Balnabasi seefi e bali odi. Mi be taki kaba, efu a kon luku u anda, da puu en a boto bun, meke a sa fii switi a u mindii de.
eng_text: Aristarchus my fellowprisoner saluteth you, and Marcus, sister's son to Barnabas, (touching whom ye received commandments: if he come unto you, receive him;)

djk_text: Soseefi Yestesi di nen Jesesi tu, sende bigi odi gi u de. Tuu, fu biibi Dyusama di e waka wooko anga mi dise, da na den dii kodo man di mi kai pasa de namo. Wi e paati a leli di e taki fu a Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu. Fu tuu, den gi mi koo ati ya.
eng_text: And Jesus, which is called Justus, who are of the circumcision. These only are my fellowworkers unto the kingdom of God, which have been a comfort unto me.

djk_text: We, odi komoto ya fu Eipafalasi, di seefi e wooko gi Kelestesi Jesesi. U sabi en taki, a de wan paandasi sama fu u anda. A nái tapu begi Masaa Gadu ya anga en hii ati gi u anda, meke u sa taampu anga biibi doo sondee pantan. Soseefi, fu u sa de ala fa Masaa Gadu wani. Da u sa de fa a wani sama mu de seefi, sondee fu poi seke seke.
eng_text: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, saluteth you, always labouring fervently for you in prayers, that ye may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.

djk_text: Bika Eipafalasi e booko ede ya, da ai feti fa a poi, fu yeepi u. Soseefi yeepi biibisama fu Laodiseya Foto anga biibiwan fu Hiyelapolesi Foto tu. Mi sa taki, Eipafalasi tan so tuu, bika na mi seefi ain e si ya fa ai feti so tuu.
eng_text: For I bear him record, that he hath a great zeal for you, and them that are in Laodicea, and them in Hierapolis.

djk_text: We, u sabi dataa Lukasi anda enke wi tuutuu lobi baala. Ai sende bigi odi ya tu. Demasi seefi sende odi gi u.
eng_text: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas, greet you.

djk_text: Mi e sende u anda seefi taki, u gi odi doo den biibiwan fu Laodiseya Foto. U gi odi doo a uman den e kai Nimfa a Laodiseya Foto de. U gi odi go doo ala taa biibiwan di e miti begi makandii na a uman de osu.
eng_text: Salute the brethren which are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the church which is in his house.

djk_text: Moo fala, mi e sende u anda wan sani ete! Leisi a biifi ya a mindii fu ala taa biibiwan a Kolose Foto de, meke den yee. Tyai en go doo biibiwan fu Laodiseya Foto tu, fu fende leisi. Mi be sende wan biifi gi den dati, meke den gi u fu Kolose Foto dati fu leisi tu.
eng_text: And when this epistle is read among you, cause that it be read also in the church of the Laodiceans; and that ye likewise read the epistle from Laodicea.

djk_text: Gaantangi, gi Alikepesi a bosikopu ya taki, meke a du a wooko di Masaa Gadu poti ne en ana, go doo.
eng_text: And say to Archippus, Take heed to the ministry which thou hast received in the Lord, that thou fulfil it.

djk_text: Mi Pawlesi ya seefi teke a sikiifi tiki nownow ya, fu sikiifi bali u bigi odi anda. U á mu feegete taki, mi de a dunguu osu ya! U tan begi gi mi, fu a pisiten di mi de ya. Meke Masaa Gadu teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku u anda.
eng_text: The salutation by the hand of me Paul. Remember my bonds. Grace be with you. Amen.

djk_text: Mi Pawlesi anga Silfanas anga Timotiyesi e sikiifi a biifi ya sende gi a hii kulu Tesalonika biibiwan, di de sama fu u Tata Masaa Gadu anga Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi anda. Meke Masaa Gadu teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku u de. Soseefi, meke u ati de switi.
eng_text: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians which is in God the Father and in the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.

djk_text: We, te wi de makandii e begi, da wi e pakisei u anda. Da wi e gi Masaa Gadu daa fu u anda ede, te ná sipowtu.
eng_text: We give thanks to God always for you all, making mention of you in our prayers;

djk_text: Bika wi sabi fa a biibi libi fu u e puu wini gi taawan. Bika u lobi taawan. Soseefi, u oli biibi doo, fu tan luku wi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi. Fa u de so bun! Bika u sabi libi a u Tata, Masaa Gadu, fesi.
eng_text: Remembering without ceasing your work of faith, and labour of love, and patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, in the sight of God and our Father;

djk_text: We, lobi biibiwan! Wi sabi fu tuu taki, na Masaa Gadu seefi teke u anda toon sama fi enseefi. Bika a lobi u tuutuu.
eng_text: Knowing, brethren beloved, your election of God.

djk_text: Bika u teke a Bun Nyunsu di wi ya e tyai. Ma u á teke dati soso fu a taki fu wi wawan. Ma na Masaa Gadu seefi soi u en taanga anga den foondoo sani di a du. Soseefi en Jeje piki u ati taki, a hii bosikopu fi en na tuu. Soseefi fa wi dise be waka bun anda, meke u be sa si a wi fa fu libi.
eng_text: For our gospel came not unto you in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Ghost, and in much assurance; as ye know what manner of men we were among you for your sake.

djk_text: Na so u kon tiiki Masaa Jesesi anga wi ya anga libi tuutuu. Bika gaan banowtu kon a u tapu anda tu, fu a bosikopu fu Masaa Gadu ede. Ma toku, ne u teke a bosikopu anga ala gaan piisii, di a Apaiti Jeje e gi sama.
eng_text: And ye became followers of us, and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Ghost:

djk_text: Da ibii taa biibiwan fu a pisiwataa fu Masadoniya anda, anga a pisi fu Akasi dise seefi e luku u anda fu si, fa fu tyai denseefi.
eng_text: So that ye were ensamples to all that believe in Macedonia and Achaia.

djk_text: Na so u anda toon sama di e soi taawan, fa Masaa Gadu e tyai yeepi. A ná sama fu a hii pisiwataa fu Masadoniya anda anga a hii pisi fu Akasi dise wawan sabi so. Ma u nen bali na ala taa peesi, fa u poti tuutuu biibi a Masaa Gadu. Da wi ya ná abi fu taki dati moo,
eng_text: For from you sounded out the word of the Lord not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith to God-ward is spread abroad; so that we need not to speak any thing.

djk_text: bika den sama seefi e taki kaba. Den e taki, fa u anda be puu wi ya a boto bun anda. Soseefi, u daai fika a dini fu falisi gadu anda, go dini Masaa Gadu seefi. Ne u toon sama now di e dini a tuutuu Masaa Gadu di e libi tego.
eng_text: For they themselves shew of us what manner of entering in we had unto you, and how ye turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God;

djk_text: Namo, ne u sidon e luku en Manpikin, di a weki puu a dede, fu komoto a Masaa Gadu Kondee a tapu anda kon baka. Na a seefi Jesesi de puu wi a ini fa Masaa Gadu o kuutu libisama anga ala gaan atiboon, fu ogii di den e du.
eng_text: And to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead, even Jesus, which delivered us from the wrath to come.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Fa u sabi, da fa wi dise be waka kon a u anda á komoto fu soso.
eng_text: For yourselves, brethren, know our entrance in unto you, that it was not in vain:

djk_text: Fosi wi be kon anda, da sama be du ogii anga wi a Filipi Foto seefi. Fa u sabi, da den poli wi nen ala sowtu fasi, fu booko wi saka. Ma toku Masaa Gadu be gi wi taanga sikin, fu poi kon doo u anda anga en Bun Nyunsu.
eng_text: But even after that we had suffered before, and were shamefully entreated, as ye know, at Philippi, we were bold in our God to speak unto you the gospel of God with much contention.

djk_text: Da wi be fende kankan fu wooko so, fu di na wan bunbun sani wi tyai kon gi de. Bika a ná wan bosikopu fu koli u anda kisi. Soseefi, a á de wan sani fu fende wini a u anda tapu wan fasi di á fiti.
eng_text: For our exhortation was not of deceit, nor of uncleanness, nor in guile:

djk_text: Kweti! Ma na Masaa Gadu luku wi, te a kaba. Ne a fitoow wi fu sende taki a Bun Nyunsu ya. Da na fa a wani wi e taki en, ma u nái puubei taki en fa libisama wani. Masaa Gadu seefi e keli wi ati luku. Da a sa kotoigi fu dati taki, na tuu.
eng_text: But as we were allowed of God to be put in trust with the gospel, even so we speak; not as pleasing men, but God, which trieth our hearts.

djk_text: Ma u anda seefi sabi taki, noiti wi dise e tyai a bosikopu fu Masaa Gadu enke koliman. Noiti wi e suku fu koli sama kisi poti a wi ondoo. Wi nái wooko tu, fu fende wini a sama tapu wan fasi di á fiti. Masaa Gadu seefi e si, fu kotoigi fu dati taki, na tuu.
eng_text: For neither at any time used we flattering words, as ye know, nor a cloke of covetousness; God is witness:

djk_text: U sabi anda kaba tu taki, wi dise nái suku gafa a sama, fu a wooko di wi e du ya. U anda seefi, wi nái suku gafa, te go taki taa sama. Ma wi ya be sa pee bigiman! Bika wi na apaiti bosikopuman fu Kelestesi.
eng_text: Nor of men sought we glory, neither of you, nor yet of others, when we might have been burdensome, as the apostles of Christ.

djk_text: Ma nono! Pe fu pee bigiman, ne wi wooko switi makandii fasi anga u anda. Wi be solugu u anda enke fa wan mma e luku en pikin di a meke.
eng_text: But we were gentle among you, even as a nurse cherisheth her children:

djk_text: Na lobi wi dise lobi u anda bigi so! Na dati meke wi kon gi u anda a Bun Nyunsu di Masaa Gadu sende wi, fu taki. Ma a ná taki namo, da a kaba. Wi hii libi seefi wi poti fu yeepi u anda, di de a wi ya ati tuutuu.
eng_text: So being affectionately desirous of you, we were willing to have imparted unto you, not the gospel of God only, but also our own souls, because ye were dear unto us.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Bika pakisei baka, di wi be de a u anda. Luku fa wi be wooko taanga dei anga neti fu solugu useefi. Bika wi á be wani de wan ibi a u anda tapu, anga a wooko di Masaa Gadu sende wi, fu taki a Bun Nyunsu.
eng_text: For ye remember, brethren, our labour and travail: for labouring night and day, because we would not be chargeable unto any of you, we preached unto you the gospel of God.

djk_text: Masaa Gadu anga u anda seefi sa kotoigi fu dati taki, na tuu. Bika u sabi fa wi dise hii libi be de fiti Masaa Gadu. Fa wi be wooko leti anga ibiiwan a u mindii anda. Fa wi á be gi sama olo fu kaagi wi anga leti. Na so wi be tyai wiseefi anga a biibi anda.
eng_text: Ye are witnesses, and God also, how holily and justly and unblameably we behaved ourselves among you that believe:

djk_text: Fa u sabi anda, da wi dise be wooko anga ibii biibiwan anda enke fa wan dda e luku en eigi pikin.
eng_text: As ye know how we exhorted and comforted and charged every one of you, as a father doth his children,

djk_text: Wi be e taigi ibii wan anda sani, fu gi u taanga sikin a ini a biibi. Fu meke u á pantan, a gaan banowtu ten. Wi be e feti anga u anda naamo, fu tan libi piisii Masaa Gadu. Bika ne en kai u kon poti a ini a Nyun Tii fi en fu fende a dyendee di enseefi abi.
eng_text: That ye would walk worthy of God, who hath called you unto his kingdom and glory.

djk_text: We, da wi dise e tan gi Masaa Gadu daa, fu fa u anda teke en bosikopu sowan fasi. Bika u teke dati enke na Masaa Gadu seefi mofu taki. Ma u á si en enke na libisama taki. We, tuutuu, na Masaa Gadu bosikopu. Bika u seefi si on taanga a wooko a u ati anda.
eng_text: For this cause also thank we God without ceasing, because, when ye received the word of God which ye heard of us, ye received it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, the word of God, which effectually worketh also in you that believe.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Bika luku fa u anda tiiki den kulu sama fu Masaa Gadu di e biibi Kelestesi Jesesi a Judeja pisiwataa. Bika san be pasa anga den pasa anga u anda seefi tu taki, Dyusama di nái biibi be lon du ogii anga den. Na so sama fu u paandasi anda, di nái biibi du anga u tu.
eng_text: For ye, brethren, became followers of the churches of God which in Judaea are in Christ Jesus: for ye also have suffered like things of your own countrymen, even as they have of the Jews:

djk_text: We, a ná a tide Dyusama bigin wooko so anga sama. Bika pakisei fa den fositen apaiti takiman fu Masaa Gadu. Taade ya, ne den kii Masaa Jesesi tu. Nownow seefi, den e lon du ogii anga wi tu. Den nái wooko bun anga sama. Da dati nái piisii Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Who both killed the Lord Jesus, and their own prophets, and have persecuted us; and they please not God, and are contrary to all men:

djk_text: Bika den e puubei ala sowtu fasi fu tapu wi anga a bosikopu, fu soi taa foluku di á de Dyusama, a yeepi di Masaa Gadu tyai. We, da a ogii fu den go doo wan peesi pe Masaa Gadu ati boon, fu gi den wan gaan sitaafu.
eng_text: Forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they might be saved, to fill up their sins alway: for the wrath is come upon them to the uttermost.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Na wan pisiten kaba, di wi dise be mu komoto wan sowtu fasi a u anda mindii. Ma u á feegete u! Bika winsi wi dise ain nái si u anda moo, ma toku wi ya ati de a u anda ete. Da wan angii de a wi fu miti fesi a fesi baka.
eng_text: But we, brethren, being taken from you for a short time in presence, not in heart, endeavoured the more abundantly to see your face with great desire.

djk_text: Da wi be fiti mofu ya kaba, fu kon luku u anda baka. Mi Pawlesi ya, na moo enke wan leisi mi puubei fu kon kaba. Ma nono! Saatan, a didibii e tapu a pasi gi wi, fu kon.
eng_text: Wherefore we would have come unto you, even I Paul, once and again; but Satan hindered us.

djk_text: Bika na u anda e gi wi ya piisii fu luku a dei fu wi Masaa Jesesi kon. Da u anda o taampu anga wi ne en fesi, meke wi sa poi gafa taki, a wooko di wi be du, puu wini.
eng_text: For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Are not even ye in the presence of our Lord Jesus Christ at his coming?

djk_text: Fu tuu, da na u anda e gi wi dise gaandi anga piisii! Bika na u na a hei anga a piisii fu wi dise.
eng_text: For ye are our glory and joy.

djk_text: Na so meke wi dise á poi tei en moo fu tan luku namo. Ne wi fiti taki, wi dati o fika a baka na Atena Foto.
eng_text: Wherefore when we could no longer forbear, we thought it good to be left at Athens alone;

djk_text: Ma u sabi Timotiyesi di wi ya o sende kon anda. Na wi biibi baala di e wooko makandii anga wi gi Masaa Gadu, fu bali a Bun Nyunsu. A sa kon gi u anda taanga sikin. A sa taigi u fu oli biibi doo.
eng_text: And sent Timotheus, our brother, and minister of God, and our fellowlabourer in the gospel of Christ, to establish you, and to comfort you concerning your faith:

djk_text: Bika wi á wani biibiwan mu fuka anga banowtu te, da dati meke a daai baka gi a biibi. Bika fa u sabi, da fii banowtu fu a biibi, na wan sani di fiti fa Masaa Gadu taki sani mu waka.
eng_text: That no man should be moved by these afflictions: for yourselves know that we are appointed thereunto.

djk_text: Wi dise seefi be taigi u anda kaba, di wi be de anda taki, banowtu o kon a wi ala tapu fu a biibi ede. Na dati e pasa anga wi ala kaba, enke fa u be sabi a fesi.
eng_text: For verily, when we were with you, we told you before that we should suffer tribulation; even as it came to pass, and ye know.

djk_text: Na dati ede meke wi be sende Timotiyesi kon a u anda. Da a be sa luku fa sani e go, efu u oli a biibi anda ete. Bika wi á poi tan langa moo, sondee fu sabi fa ai go anga u biibi libi. Bika wi pakisei, san sa pasa anga u, te a didibii sa kon tesi u. Efu u kai a ini ogii, da na fu soso kaali wi dise be simpan useefi wooko taanga a u mindii anda.
eng_text: For this cause, when I could no longer forbear, I sent to know your faith, lest by some means the tempter have tempted you, and our labour be in vain.

djk_text: Ma now, da Timotiyesi kon doo wi ya baka anga moi nyunsu fu u anda. Bika a taki, u tan biibi go doo. U tan e soi taawan fa u abi lobi fu den a ini u ati. U e pakisei wi dise bunbun ete tu. U abi angii fu si wi dise tu, enke fa wi dise seefi abi.
