eng_text: But now when Timotheus came from you unto us, and brought us good tidings of your faith and charity, and that ye have good remembrance of us always, desiring greatly to see us, as we also to see you:

djk_text: Biibiwan! Da wi dise ati nái weli gi u moo, ma wi kisi tuutuu koo ati anga ala fa ala sowtu banowtu e kon a wi tapu dise.
eng_text: Therefore, brethren, we were comforted over you in all our affliction and distress by your faith:

djk_text: Da wi dise kisi nyun taanga sikin baka. Bika wi sabi taki, u taampu taanga anda a ini Masaa pasi ete.
eng_text: For now we live, if ye stand fast in the Lord.

djk_text: We, wi á sabi fa fu gi Masaa Gadu daa kisi dise. Ma enseefi e si fa wi e gi en daa, fu fa u anda e meke wi e kisi gaan piisii dise.
eng_text: For what thanks can we render to God again for you, for all the joy wherewith we joy for your sakes before our God;

djk_text: Da dei anga neti wi dise e tan begi, meke wi anga u sa miti fesi a fesi baka. Da wi sa yeepi lapu a biibi fu u anda kisi moo futu a doti.
eng_text: Night and day praying exceedingly that we might see your face, and might perfect that which is lacking in your faith?

djk_text: We, da meke wi Tata, Masaa Gadu anga wi Masaa Jesesi opo pasi gi wi, fu doo u anda baka.
eng_text: Now God himself and our Father, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way unto you.

djk_text: Soseefi, meke Masaa e poti moo lobi a u biibiwan anda mindii. Meke u sa abi lobi fu ala taa sama tu, enke fa wi dise abi lobi fu u anda.
eng_text: And the Lord make you to increase and abound in love one toward another, and toward all men, even as we do toward you:

djk_text: Te dati pasa, da a biibi fu u anda sa seeka kisi moo futu a doti. Da te wi Masaa Jesesi o kon doo anga ala den apaiti wan fi en, da ibiiwan anda o de a wi Tata, Masaa Gadu fesi sondee kaagi. Bika a hii libi fu u anda o soi apaiti fasi gi Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: To the end he may stablish your hearts unblameable in holiness before God, even our Father, at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ with all his saints.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Fosi wi tapu a biifi ya, da wi dise wani sende u anda wan sani. Libi fu piisii Masaa Gadu! Bika u na sama fu Masaa Jesesi. Wi sabi taki, u anda e libi enke fa wi dise be leli u anda kaba. Ma toku wi wani u suku fu libi moo betee moo so.
eng_text: Furthermore then we beseech you, brethren, and exhort you by the Lord Jesus, that as ye have received of us how ye ought to walk and to please God, so ye would abound more and more.

djk_text: Bika na Masaa Jesesi seefi poti a leli fi en ya a wi ana, fu sende u anda. Ne u kon sabi fa fu waka anda.
eng_text: For ye know what commandments we gave you by the Lord Jesus.

djk_text: Ma toku, wi wani soi u anda ete, fa Masaa Gadu wani u mu de seefi. A wani u libi de apaiti fasi. Da de sondee fu waka motyo fasi.
eng_text: For this is the will of God, even your sanctification, that ye should abstain from fornication:

djk_text: Ma meke ibiiwan sabi teke wan uman poti a osu. Du dati wan fasi di fiti Masaa Gadu anga ala lesipeki fu libisama tu.
eng_text: That every one of you should know how to possess his vessel in sanctification and honour;

djk_text: Ma u á mu waka enke sama di nái poti Masaa Gadu a teli. Bika na fafa ati den abi fu waka du ala sowtu motyo sani.
eng_text: Not in the lust of concupiscence, even as the Gentiles which know not God:

djk_text: Da wi enke biibiwan á mu du a ogii ya anga taawan. Meke wi á koli taawan, poli san den abi. Bika enke fa wi be soi u kaba taki, Masaa Gadu á lobi so. Da en ati o boon fu dati.
eng_text: That no man go beyond and defraud his brother in any matter: because that the Lord is the avenger of all such, as we also have forewarned you and testified.

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu kai wi kon toon sama fi enseefi. Da wi mu libi apaiti fasi. Ma wi á mu waka poli fasi enke motyo.
eng_text: For God hath not called us unto uncleanness, but unto holiness.

djk_text: Efu wan sama towe a leli ya, da a towe Masaa Gadu seefi di gi wi en Apaiti Jeje, fu leli wi libi. Bika a ná libisama soi wi a leli ya, ma na Masaa Gadu seefi.
eng_text: He therefore that despiseth, despiseth not man, but God, who hath also given unto us his holy Spirit.

djk_text: We, Masaa Gadu seefi be soi u kaba fa fu wooko anga lobi. Da a á de fanowdu fu sikiifi ya moo, fa fu lobi taa biibiwan.
eng_text: But as touching brotherly love ye need not that I write unto you: for ye yourselves are taught of God to love one another.

djk_text: Bika u e libi anda so kaba anga ala taa biibiwan na a hii pisi fu Masadoniya. Biibiwan! Ma toku wi dise e soi u anda ete taki, teke a lobi ya wooko moo bigi moo so.
eng_text: And indeed ye do it toward all the brethren which are in all Macedonia: but we beseech you, brethren, that ye increase more and more;

djk_text: Ibii biibisama mu e feti namo fu libi bun anga taa sama sondee dyugu taki. U á mu e waka e mumui a ini taa sama sani tumisi. Ma ibii sama mu mumui anga en eigi sani e du en wooko enke fa a fiti. Da di u be de a mindii anda, da na so u be soi u anda kaba, fu libi.
eng_text: And that ye study to be quiet, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, as we commanded you;

djk_text: Da biibiwan ná o abi fu sidon taki, na taawan mu solugu den. Soseefi, da sama di nái biibi o luku u, da den taki: “Oho! Luku fa den biibiwan e libi soifili fasi.”
eng_text: That ye may walk honestly toward them that are without, and that ye may have lack of nothing.

djk_text: Biibiwan! We, wi wani meke u sabi fa fu den biibiwan di dede kaba. Da u ná o buduufu anda enke sama di á sabi taki, sani de fu luku ete baka dede.
eng_text: But I would not have you to be ignorant, brethren, concerning them which are asleep, that ye sorrow not, even as others which have no hope.

djk_text: Bika Masaa Jesesi seefi be dede koo pii. Ma Masaa Gadu weki en kon libi baka. Na so wi di e biibi kon sabi taki, biibisama di dede kaba, da Masaa Gadu o weki den kon a libi baka enke Jesesi. Da a o tyai den go libi a Jesesi.
eng_text: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so them also which sleep in Jesus will God bring with him.

djk_text: Yee fa Masaa Jesesi seefi be leli wi fu dati taki, wan dei, Masaa o kon teke den biibiwan puu a goontapu. Ma wi á mu denki taki, a o fika den dede biibiwan fu teke a baka, da a o teke den libiwan fosi. Kweti!
eng_text: For this we say unto you by the word of the Lord, that we which are alive and remain unto the coming of the Lord shall not prevent them which are asleep.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Gadu sa bali a tapu taki, a yuu doo. Da a moo hei Engel fi en seefi tongo o piki a tapu. Da wan gaan tutu o boo a tapu anda. Da Masaa Jesesi o saka komoto a tapu anda. Da den dede wan, di be e biibi a Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi fosi o weki baka.
eng_text: For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God: and the dead in Christ shall rise first:

djk_text: Da wantoon so, Masaa Gadu o tyai wi di de a libi makandii anga den di weki gwe a Masaa a den woluku tapu. Da a miti di wi ala o miti ya, a ná fu paati moo wanten. Wi anga Masaa o libi makandii tego.
eng_text: Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.

djk_text: Da na den wowtu ya u mu e teke taigi taa biibiwan, fu puu buduufu na ati. Meke den sa fende koo ati fu libi.
eng_text: Wherefore comfort one another with these words.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Ma fa fu den sani di o pasa fosi Masaa Jesesi kon teke wi so? Soseefi, on yuu dati o pasa? We, a á de, fu fanowdu fu piki ala dati.
eng_text: But of the times and the seasons, brethren, ye have no need that I write unto you.

djk_text: Bika useefi sabi taki, a o doo wan dei, te fu sama membee. Dati o pasa enke fa fufuuman e kon a neti haa, fosi fu sama poti pakisei.
eng_text: For yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so cometh as a thief in the night.

djk_text: Leti na a yuu di sama o taki: “Goontapu sidon switi, ala sani e waka moi.” Fosi den poti pakisei, da sani kon banowtu den. Da den ná o poi kibii gi a gaan banowtu enke fa bee uman á poi kibii gi a bee ati fu go meke. Ai de fi en moi moi, ma te fu a denki, da a bee musu kon nyanmi en.
eng_text: For when they shall say, Peace and safety; then sudden destruction cometh upon them, as travail upon a woman with child; and they shall not escape.

djk_text: Ma biibiwan! U dati á mu feele! Bika u a ná sama di de a dunguu fu nái si san e pasa. Da Masaa ná o doo a u tapu haa, enke fufuuman.
eng_text: But ye, brethren, are not in darkness, that that day should overtake you as a thief.

djk_text: Bika u ala anda e si sani enke sama a kiin fu dei, fu sabi san e pasa. U a ná sama a dunguu fu neti di nái si fu sabi san e pasa. Kweti!
eng_text: Ye are all the children of light, and the children of the day: we are not of the night, nor of darkness.

djk_text: Da wi á mu libi enke sama e siibi, da a nái si sani. Na sama di á sabi Masaa Gadu tan so. Ma meke wi dati de anga ain, da poti ede bun tu.
eng_text: Therefore let us not sleep, as do others; but let us watch and be sober.

djk_text: Bika son sama e kai a siibi a neti. Son fu den e diingi duungu. Da den nái sabi san e pasa.
eng_text: For they that sleep sleep in the night; and they that be drunken are drunken in the night.

djk_text: Ma wi na sama di e si enke u de a kiin fu dei, fu sabi san e pasa. Da meke wi poti ede bun. Meke wi wooko anga a biibi di wi abi. Meke wi wooko anga lobi tu. Meke wi tan luku a yeepi di Masaa o tyai kon. Den sani ya sa kibii wi enke insii sani di suudati e wei fu kibii den seefi a feti.
eng_text: But let us, who are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for an helmet, the hope of salvation.

djk_text: Bika wi a ná sama di Masaa Gadu ati e boon moo fu gi sitaafu. Ma a tyai yeepi puu wi a takuudu anga a sitaafu ya. Bika wi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi teke dede a wi peesi.
eng_text: For God hath not appointed us to wrath, but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus Christ,

djk_text: Da te a kon baka, da biibiwan di de a libi sa tan libi anga en. Soseefi, biibiwan di dede kaba seefi o weki go libi anga en tu.
eng_text: Who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.

djk_text: We, da tan soi ala taa biibiwan anda so go doo enke fa u gwenti kaba. Da den taawan sa kisi moo taanga sikin na biibi. Soseefi, den futu sa moo taanga a ini a biibi.
eng_text: Wherefore comfort yourselves together, and edify one another, even as also ye do.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Mi wani begi u anda ete wan sani. Lesipeki den edeman di e tii u anda a ini a biibi fu Masaa. Bika den e wooko taanga fu soi u fa fu tyai useefi.
eng_text: And we beseech you, brethren, to know them which labour among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you;

djk_text: Gi den gaandi pasa peesi. Libi meke den si taki u lobi den, fu a wooko di den e du. Meke kwali anga toobi á de a u mindii. Ma u ati mu de switi makandii.
eng_text: And to esteem them very highly in love for their work's sake. And be at peace among yourselves.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Sende lesiman a u mindii de taki, den mu wooko. Suku fu gi sama di e pantan taanga sikin. Yeepi sama di futu swaki a ini a biibi. Pasensi anga ala sowtu sama.
eng_text: Now we exhort you, brethren, warn them that are unruly, comfort the feebleminded, support the weak, be patient toward all men.

djk_text: Kenisi taki, u á suku fu pai taawan ogii fu ogii baka. Ma suku fu wooko bun anga useefi ibii yuu. Wooko so anga ala taa taa sama tu.
eng_text: See that none render evil for evil unto any man; but ever follow that which is good, both among yourselves, and to all men.

djk_text: Piisii ala yuu naamo.
eng_text: Rejoice evermore.

djk_text: Ná weli fu begi, ma begi naamo.
eng_text: Pray without ceasing.

djk_text: Da winsi san, ma tan gi Masaa Gadu daa ete. Bika na so a wani si sama di e waka a Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi baka.
eng_text: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.

djk_text: U á mu tei Masaa Gadu Jeje de. Ma gi en pasi fu wooko faya faya.
eng_text: Quench not the Spirit.

djk_text: Da te apaiti takiman bali wan bosikopu, da u á mu oli dati fu soso sani.
eng_text: Despise not prophesyings.

djk_text: Ma keli luku san komoto a Masaa Gadu, da wooko anga dati.
eng_text: Prove all things; hold fast that which is good.

djk_text: Wai a pasi gi ibii sowtu ogii naamo.
eng_text: Abstain from all appearance of evil.

djk_text: Meke Masaa Gadu di e switi sama meke u libi de apaiti fasi gi en. Meke u hii libi, sikin fasi doo jeje fasi wooko sondee fowtu, te wi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi sa kon baka.
eng_text: And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly; and I pray God your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

djk_text: Masaa Gadu di kai u kon toon sama fi en, de fitoow fasi. Da ai du ala san a paamisi, meke a sa du den sani de gi u.
eng_text: Faithful is he that calleth you, who also will do it.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Wi dise e akisi u anda fu begi gi wi dise tu.
eng_text: Brethren, pray for us.

djk_text: Bali ala biibiwan anda wan switi odi a ini a nen fu Masaa gi wi.
eng_text: Greet all the brethren with an holy kiss.

djk_text: Mi e teke a nen fu Masaa sende u taki: “Leisi a biifi ya gi ala taa biibiwan anda.”
eng_text: I charge you by the Lord that this epistle be read unto all the holy brethren.

djk_text: Meke wi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi tan teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku u anda go doo.
eng_text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.

djk_text: Mi Pawlesi anga Silfanas anga Timotiyesi e sikiifi a biifi ya sende gi a hii kulu Tesalonika biibiwan, di de sama fu u Tata Masaa Gadu anga Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi anda.
eng_text: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:

djk_text: Meke u Tata, Masaa Gadu anga Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku u de. Soseefi, meke u ati de switi.
eng_text: Grace unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Ibii yuu ten, da wi dise e gi Masaa Gadu daa fu anda ede. Dati fiti so. Bika a biibi fu u anda e goo naamo. Soseefi, a lobi fu taa biibiwan anda tu.
eng_text: We are bound to thank God always for you, brethren, as it is meet, because that your faith groweth exceedingly, and the charity of every one of you all toward each other aboundeth;

djk_text: Wi e gafa u fu toko fu dati na ala se a taa kulu biibiwan fu Masaa Gadu mindii. Wi e soi den fa u tei ati fu oli doo. Soseefi fa u tan biibi ete, winsi sama e lon du ogii anga u fu dati.
eng_text: So that we ourselves glory in you in the churches of God for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and tribulations that ye endure:

djk_text: Ma Masaa Gadu e kuutu letiopu fasi. Bika a o kuutu taki, u anda be tuka anga banowtu, fu di u e du san a wani. Da u waiti fu go doo a ini Nyun Tii fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Which is a manifest token of the righteous judgment of God, that ye may be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which ye also suffer:

djk_text: Ma, da a o pai den sama di e pina u ya anga pina baka.
eng_text: Seeing it is a righteous thing with God to recompense tribulation to them that trouble you;

djk_text: Tuutuu! Na so Masaa Gadu o kuutu anga leti. Da u anda anga wi dise di be fende pina o fende paiman. Dati na wan bun switi losutu ten na a yuu di Masaa Jesesi o komoto a Masaa Gadu Kondee a tapu anga ala den makiti Engel fi en.
eng_text: And to you who are troubled rest with us, when the Lord Jesus shall be revealed from heaven with his mighty angels,

djk_text: A hii kon fi en ya o waka anga gaan faya, fu pai den takuu ati sama a paiman di den mu fende. Bika den nái teli Masaa Gadu, ne den á wani teke a Bun Nyunsu fu wi Masaa Jesesi.
eng_text: In flaming fire taking vengeance on them that know not God, and that obey not the gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ:

djk_text: Da Masaa o yaki den puu ne en fesi, fu go tan tego sondee Masaa Gadu di abi ala makiti anga en gaan dyendee fasi. A sitaafu ya o kaba den a soso.
eng_text: Who shall be punished with everlasting destruction from the presence of the Lord, and from the glory of his power;

djk_text: Na so sani o waka na a kon fu wi Masaa Jesesi. Da ibiiwan fu den sama fi en o gi en gaandi anga gafa, fu fa a be tyai den. U anda seefi o de a ini hei en nen so. Bika u be biibi den sani fi en, di wi dise be kon taki anda.
eng_text: When he shall come to be glorified in his saints, and to be admired in all them that believe (because our testimony among you was believed) in that day.

djk_text: We, da wi dise e tan begi Masaa Gadu gi u anda naamo, fu gi u anda kaakiti fu poi du ala bun di u wani du anga a biibi libi. Soseefi, fu poi du bun di u sete e du kaba anga a biibi. Da u libi sa waiti sai fu fende a paiman di a kai wi kon poti fu gi.
eng_text: Wherefore also we pray always for you, that our God would count you worthy of this calling, and fulfil all the good pleasure of his goodness, and the work of faith with power:

djk_text: Na so u o meke wi Masaa Jesesi fende gafanen fu dati. Ma u anda seefi o fende gafa, fu fa Masaa Gadu anga Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku u anda so.
eng_text: That the name of our Lord Jesus Christ may be glorified in you, and ye in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.

djk_text: Ma meke u taki moo fu a kon di wi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi o kon baka, fu piki ala biibiwan tyai go poti ape enseefi de. Ma biibiwan! Gaantangi, wi o begi u anda wan sani fu dati.
eng_text: Now we beseech you, brethren, by the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, and by our gathering together unto him,

djk_text: U á mu gaw fu buuya taki, a dei de pasa kaba. Bika son sama sa kon taki, a Apaiti Jeje soi en so. Son sama sa tyai moi bosikopu kon taki so tu. Son sama sa kon taki, na wi dise sikiifi so a ini wan biifi gi den. Ma toku, u á mu dyombo gaw buuya fu dati.
eng_text: That ye be not soon shaken in mind, or be troubled, neither by spirit, nor by word, nor by letter as from us, as that the day of Christ is at hand.

djk_text: Meke sama á koli u wan enkii fasi fu dati! Bika fu tuu, a yuu ten di tyaipi sama o daai baka gi Masaa Gadu mu doo goontapu fosi. Soseefi, wan gaan didibii sama di nái koti anga weiti fu Masaa Gadu o kon a doo fu si fosi. Ma moo lati, da a didibii sama ya o kaba a soso.
eng_text: Let no man deceive you by any means: for that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first, and that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition;

djk_text: A didibii sama ya na a gaan feyanti fu Masaa Gadu. Bika a o feti anga ala gadu sani di de. A o hei enseefi poti a tapu fu ala san sama e dini fu gadu. Da a o du te go sidon a ini a Mama Keliki fu Masaa Gadu. Da a o puu kon a doo taki, ne en na Masaa Gadu kaba di sama mu dini.
eng_text: Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God, or that is worshipped; so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God, shewing himself that he is God.

djk_text: Fu tuu! Di mi be de anda, da mi be taigi u fu a sani ya kaba. Da a kon, u musu sabi en ete.
eng_text: Remember ye not, that, when I was yet with you, I told you these things?

djk_text: Enke fa u sabi kaba, da na wan sani e tapu a gaan didibii sama ya ete fu kon a doo. Ma te a yuu di Masaa Gadu poti gi en doo, da a sa kon a doo, fu si.
eng_text: And now ye know what withholdeth that he might be revealed in his time.

djk_text: A hii wooko di a o kon du, na fu meke sama wai weiti fu Masaa Gadu poti a wanse. Ai du dati kibii fasi a goontapu ya kaba. Ma enseefi o doo na a wooko tapu, te Masaa Gadu puu a wan di e tapu en fosi.
eng_text: For the mystery of iniquity doth already work: only he who now letteth will let, until he be taken out of the way.

djk_text: Da fa i si dati o pasa, da enseefi kon a doo wanten, fu si. Ma te Masaa Jesesi o kon, da en mofu di a o opo namo o kaba a didibii sama ya a soso. Da a hii makiti fi en sa booko de wanten.
eng_text: And then shall that Wicked be revealed, whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming:

djk_text: Ma fosi Masaa Jesesi kon baka so, da a didibii sama ya o du somen gaan foondoo sani, fu koli sama kisi. A didibii seefi o gi en a makiti, fu du ala sowtu foondoo sani. Ma a o du enke na Masaa Gadu gi en a makiti fu du den sani ya.
eng_text: Even him, whose coming is after the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,

djk_text: Ala den foondoo sani ya o koli sama di de fu kaba a soso, poti a ini ogii. Bika den sama ya á be lobi a tuutuu bosikopu fu Masaa Gadu, fu a be sa puu den a ini takuudu anga ogii.
eng_text: And with all deceivableness of unrighteousness in them that perish; because they received not the love of the truth, that they might be saved.

djk_text: Ne Masaa Gadu fika den a ini gaan buuya, fu biibi lei sani di kon a den pasi. Na so meke den teke biibi na a didibii sama ya.
eng_text: And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion, that they should believe a lie:

djk_text: We, da Masaa Gadu sa kuutu taki, na ibii sama di á wani biibi a tuutuu bosikopu fi en seefi abi a fowtu. Bika den á be wani du san fiti Masaa Gadu. Ma den be lobi soso lawlaw sani.
eng_text: That they all might be damned who believed not the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Ma Masaa Gadu lobi u anda bigi! Da wi dise abi fu e gi en daa naamo, fu u anda ede. Bika a teke u anda enke fosi wan di a puu a takuudu anga ogii. Bika di a meke en Jeje wooko taanga a u de, meke u libi de apaiti fasi. Soseefi, di u teke biibi na a tuutuu bosikopu fi en.
eng_text: But we are bound to give thanks alway to God for you, brethren beloved of the Lord, because God hath from the beginning chosen you to salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth:

djk_text: We, na fu so meke Masaa Gadu be gi wi dise a Bun Nyunsu fu kon kai u anda. Fu u anda seefi sa fende a gaan dyendee di wi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi seefi abi.
eng_text: Whereunto he called you by our gospel, to the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Da oli biibi taanga doo. Noiti tapu fu biibi san wi dise tyai anga mofu anga biifi kon leli u anda.
eng_text: Therefore, brethren, stand fast, and hold the traditions which ye have been taught, whether by word, or our epistle.

djk_text: We, wi Tata, Masaa Gadu anga wi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi meke wi ala kisi taanga fu oli biibi doo tego seefi. Soseefi, fu tan luku fu fende sani di Masaa Gadu paamisi. Na gaan bun ati fasi namo di Masaa teke luku u, meke a paamisi wi ala den sani ya. Bika a lobi wi ala, pasa peesi.
eng_text: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God, even our Father, which hath loved us, and hath given us everlasting consolation and good hope through grace,

djk_text: Da meke a gi u anda taanga sikin. Soseefi, da u mu meke u anda e taki soso bun sani. Soseefi, fu du den bun di u e fii fu du.
eng_text: Comfort your hearts, and stablish you in every good word and work.

djk_text: Da a biifi ya e go doo taki, tan begi gi wi dise naamo. Akisi Masaa Gadu, fu meke a bosikopu fu Masaa sa waka esi esi doo somen sama moo. Meke moo anga moo sama sa gi Masaa Gadu daa. Da den sa gafa en enke u anda tu.
eng_text: Finally, brethren, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may have free course, and be glorified, even as it is with you:

djk_text: Soseefi, da begi fu a puu wi dise na ana fu takuu ati sama di wani du ogii anga wi. Bika a ná ala sama teke a bosikopu di wi e tyai, da a de fitoow fasi.
eng_text: And that we may be delivered from unreasonable and wicked men: for all men have not faith.

djk_text: Ma Masaa dati de fitoow fasi! U sa fitoow en fu meke u taampu taanga doo a ini a biibi ya. Soseefi a o kibii u anda fu didibii.
eng_text: But the Lord is faithful, who shall stablish you, and keep you from evil.

djk_text: Da wi e fitoow dise taki, u anda e du ala san wi dise e sende u. Bika u na sama fu Masaa.
eng_text: And we have confidence in the Lord touching you, that ye both do and will do the things which we command you.

djk_text: Da wi dise e begi meke u anda ati sa opo gi a lobi fu Masaa Gadu. Soseefi, meke u anda tei ati fu oli doo enke fa Kelestesi gi u dati.
eng_text: And the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God, and into the patient waiting for Christ.

djk_text: Biibiwan! Mi o teke a nen fu Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi sende u anda fa fu du anga lesi biibiwan. U á mu mosoo anga den. Bika den nái waka na a fasi fa wi dise be soi u anda.
eng_text: Now we command you, brethren, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye withdraw yourselves from every brother that walketh disorderly, and not after the tradition which he received of us.

djk_text: U sabi fa wi dise be waka a u mindii anda. Wi á be lesi langa futu gi sama fu solugu wi. Ma wi be tyai useefi anga ala wooko, fu sama be sa si a wi, fa fu du tu.
eng_text: For yourselves know how ye ought to follow us: for we behaved not ourselves disorderly among you;

djk_text: Da wi á be meke sama poti u sidon, fu solugu anga nyanyan. Ma u be tyotyo wooko dei anga neti, fu wi á be sa toon ibi a sama tapu.
eng_text: Neither did we eat any man's bread for nought; but wrought with labour and travail night and day, that we might not be chargeable to any of you:

djk_text: Ma wi be abi pasi fu meke sama solugu u de. Ma toku wi á be du so. Bika wi be wani wooko soi u anda, fa useefi mu libi de.
eng_text: Not because we have not power, but to make ourselves an ensample unto you to follow us.

djk_text: Di wi be de anda, da na somen leisi wi be soi u kaba taki, ná masi sikin solugu lesiman di á wani wooko.
eng_text: For even when we were with you, this we commanded you, that if any would not work, neither should he eat.

djk_text: Bika wi yee dise taki, son wan a u mindii anda lesi te, den á wani wooko solugu denseefi. Da den e waka e sutu mofu mumui a ini sama sani naamo.
eng_text: For we hear that there are some which walk among you disorderly, working not at all, but are busybodies.

djk_text: Da wi e teke a nen fu Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi, fu kaasi den biibiwan di e du dati. Da wi e bali den taki, kaba anga a libi de! Go wooko solugu iseefi.
eng_text: Now them that are such we command and exhort by our Lord Jesus Christ, that with quietness they work, and eat their own bread.

djk_text: Ma u taa biibiwan dati á mu weli fu du den bun di wi e soi u, fu du. Kweti!
eng_text: But ye, brethren, be not weary in well doing.

djk_text: Sama di á wani libi enke fa a biifi ya taki, da puu en nen kon a doo. Da u kaba mosoo anga en, fu a sa fii sen fu a libi di ai libi.
eng_text: And if any man obey not our word by this epistle, note that man, and have no company with him, that he may be ashamed.

djk_text: Ma toku, u á mu oli en a feyanti. Ma libi anga en meke ai fii taki, en na wan biibisama di u anda e wasikoi.
eng_text: Yet count him not as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.

djk_text: We, na Masaa e switi sama ati, da meke a switi u anda ati ala fasi, ala yuu. Meke Masaa de anga u naamo.
eng_text: Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace always by all means. The Lord be with you all.

djk_text: A fika fu mi Pawlesi seefi teke a sikiifi tiki fu sikiifi a bigi odi ya gi u anda. Mi du dati enke fa mi gwenti a ibii biifi fu mi. Mi poti mi nen anga odi na a seefi fasi.
eng_text: The salutation of Paul with mine own hand, which is the token in every epistle: so I write.

djk_text: Meke wi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi tan teke gaan bun ati fasi luku u ala go doo.
eng_text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

djk_text: Wi Yeepiman, Masaa Gadu anga Kelestesi Jesesi, di wi e luku, kumandei mi Pawlesi ya, fu de wan apaiti bosikopuman fu Kelestesi Jesesi. Da mi e sikiifi a biifi ya gi yu.
eng_text: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the commandment of God our Saviour, and Lord Jesus Christ, which is our hope;

djk_text: Timotiyesi! Mi e sende en gi yu, di teke a bosikopu di mi e tyai. Da mi e kai yu mi pikin a ini a biibi. Meke u Tata, Masaa Gadu anga wi Masaa, Kelestesi Jesesi teke gaan bun ati fasi namo luku yu. Soseefi teke tyali ati fasi luku yu. Soseefi, meke yu ati de switi.
eng_text: Unto Timothy, my own son in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God our Father and Jesus Christ our Lord.

djk_text: Fosi mi be komoto de gwe a Masadoniya, da mi be taigi yu, fu tan doo a Efese de. Da tan du so ete, ma poti ain luku tu, fu tapu sama di e leli taawan falisi leli di nái fiti du fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: As I besought thee to abide still at Ephesus, when I went into Macedonia, that thou mightest charge some that they teach no other doctrine,

djk_text: Tapu den sama soseefi, fu den á mu poti denki a lawlaw toli. Soseefi haw lolo fositen sama sani. Den sani de e tyai soso sitee anga buuya a sama mindii, pe fu soi fa Masaa Gadu wani den biibi, fu komoto a takuudu anga ogii.
eng_text: Neither give heed to fables and endless genealogies, which minister questions, rather than godly edifying which is in faith: so do.

djk_text: Bika a wooko fu Masaa Gadu, na fu soi sama fu lobi makandii. Soseefi, fu meke sama ati kon de kiin sondee konsensi fonfon. Soseefi, fu sama mu abi tuutuu biibi.
eng_text: Now the end of the commandment is charity out of a pure heart, and of a good conscience, and of faith unfeigned:

djk_text: Ma son sama wai komoto na a pasi ya, ne den e waka e sitee, fu taki wisiwasi taki di á de fanowdu.
eng_text: From which some having swerved have turned aside unto vain jangling;

djk_text: Den e meke enke leliman di mu leli taawan wooko anga Masaa Gadu weiti. Da den gei sama di sabi san den e taki. Ma a ná enke den e fusutan weiti di den e soi taawan seefi.
eng_text: Desiring to be teachers of the law; understanding neither what they say, nor whereof they affirm.

djk_text: Ma wi sabi saide Masaa Gadu meke den weiti fi en. Na bunbun sani a meke gi sama di wani wooko fiti anga den.
eng_text: But we know that the law is good, if a man use it lawfully;

djk_text: Da wi sabi taki, weiti á meke fu kaasi sama di e libi leti fasi. Ma na fu kaasi sama di e booko weiti. Sama di ná abi bisi anga weiti anga Masaa Gadu seefi. Sama di e du poli sani. Sama di ná abi lesipeki fu Masaa Gadu sani. Sama di e sipowtu anga Masaa Gadu. Sama di e kii mma anga dda anga taa sowtu kiiman.
eng_text: Knowing this, that the law is not made for a righteous man, but for the lawless and disobedient, for the ungodly and for sinners, for unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,

djk_text: Soseefi, sama anga motyo fasi. Manengee e makume taa manengee. Sama di e seli taawan enke saafu. Sama di e lei. Sama di e daai mofu fu san de be sweli kaba seefi. Na so weiti meke, fu kaasi den sowtu sama de doo ala taa sani di nái fiti a tuutuu leli fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: For whoremongers, for them that defile themselves with mankind, for menstealers, for liars, for perjured persons, and if there be any other thing that is contrary to sound doctrine;

djk_text: Tuutuu leli na di e fiti a dyendee Bun Nyunsu fu a seigi Masaa Gadu, di a fitoow poti a mi ya ana tu, fu tyai taki.
eng_text: According to the glorious gospel of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.

djk_text: We, mi e gi daa doo wi Masaa, Kelestesi Jesesi, di gi mi taanga, fu tyai a wooko ya. Bika a fitoow mi, poti a ini en wooko.
eng_text: And I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who hath enabled me, for that he counted me faithful, putting me into the ministry;

djk_text: A wooko tyali ati fasi anga mi di fosi fosi be toto futu taki soso ogii fi en. Soseefi lon du ogii anga sama di e biibi en. Bika mi á be de biibisama ete, da mi á be sabi taki, na ogii mi be e du so.
eng_text: Who was before a blasphemer, and a persecutor, and injurious: but I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.

djk_text: We, na gaan bun ati fasi namo, di Masaa teke luku mi. Ne a meke mi kon poti hii fitoow ne en. Soseefi mi kon abi a lobi di ai gi wi di mokisa libi anga Kelestesi Jesesi.
eng_text: And the grace of our Lord was exceeding abundant with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

djk_text: We, na wan tuu taki, Kelestesi Jesesi kon a goontapu, fu puu sama a takuudu anga ogii. Na sani fu teke, sondee fu sitee. Bika fu sama di be e du ogii, da sama á moo mi.
eng_text: This is a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.

djk_text: Ma Masaa Gadu teke mi, fu soi fa ai luku sama gaan tyali ati fasi. Soseefi, fa Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi pasensi fasi bigi, fu wooko anga taawan di o kon biibi moo lati, fu fende libi tego.
eng_text: Howbeit for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first Jesus Christ might shew forth all longsuffering, for a pattern to them which should hereafter believe on him to life everlasting.

djk_text: Da bali baya gi a Masaa Gadu ya! Gi en ala gaandi. Bika en na a Kownu di noiti poi dede. Da ai tii sani tego. Soseefi, a de Masaa Gadu di u á poi si anga ain. En na awan kodo Gadu di de. Amen, na so a de!
eng_text: Now unto the King eternal, immortal, invisible, the only wise God, be honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen.

djk_text: We, Timotiyesi enke mi manpikin a ini a biibi! Mi e fitoow yu, fu du a wooko di mi e sende yu, a ini a biifi ya. Bika Masaa be soi a fesi fa yu o du a wooko ya. A be meke apaiti takiman fi en piki yu dati a fesi. Da dati mu gi yu taanga sikin, fu feti du a wooko ya wan bun fasi.
eng_text: This charge I commit unto thee, son Timothy, according to the prophecies which went before on thee, that thou by them mightest war a good warfare;

djk_text: Wooko anga biibi. Meke yu ati de kiin sondee konsensi fonfon. Bika son sama biibi poli, fu di den á wani aliki fa konsensi e fon den ati, fu sani di á fiti. Ne dati poli den biibi enke te wataa e tyai boto go naki booko.
eng_text: Holding faith, and a good conscience; which some having put away concerning faith have made shipwreck:

djk_text: Na so pasa anga Himeneyesi anga Aleksandi. Ne mi fika den a wanse gi didibii, meke a tii den. Da den sa kon si taki, den mu kaba lei, fu gi Masaa Gadu polinen.
eng_text: Of whom is Hymenaeus and Alexander; whom I have delivered unto Satan, that they may learn not to blaspheme.

djk_text: Fosi mi taki taa sani, da mi wani taigi yu enke biibiwan taki, akisi Masaa Gadu sani naamo gi taawan. Begi naamo gi den. Gi Masaa Gadu daa naamo, fu san ai du gi ala sama.
eng_text: I exhort therefore, that, first of all, supplications, prayers, intercessions, and giving of thanks, be made for all men;

djk_text: Du so gi kownu anga taa bigiman fu kondee, fu u libi sa de switi. Da u sa poi tyai useefi wan leti fasi fiti Masaa Gadu anga ala lesipeki fu libisama.
eng_text: For kings, and for all that are in authority; that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and honesty.

djk_text: Te wi e begi so, da na wan gaan waiti sani gi Masaa Gadu, di de wi Yeepiman. Ai piisii en, fu yee sama e begi so.
eng_text: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Saviour;

djk_text: Bika a wani en yeepi di a tyai, mu doo na ala sama. A wani den sama mu kon sabi a tuutuu leli fi en.
eng_text: Who will have all men to be saved, and to come unto the knowledge of the truth.

djk_text: Bika na awan kodo Gadu ya namo de. Namo a poti wan kodo sama namo a wi anga en mindii enke mindiiman, fu tyai yeepi. A sama de na Kelestesi Jesesi.
eng_text: For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus;

djk_text: Na a Kelestesi Jesesi ya poti enseefi enke paiman, fu pai puu sama a takuudu anga ogii. A wooko di a du de soi fa Masaa Gadu ten doo, fu tyai yeepi gi sama.
eng_text: Who gave himself a ransom for all, to be testified in due time.

djk_text: Da na a Bun Nyunsu ya mi mu tyai taki enke apaiti bosikopuman fu Masaa Jesesi. Masaa Gadu poti mi, fu leli foluku di á de Dyusama, fa fu biibi na a tuutuu fasi di Masaa Gadu wani. Mi nái lei! Na tuutuu sani fu teke, mi e taki ya!
eng_text: Whereunto I am ordained a preacher, and an apostle, (I speak the truth in Christ, and lie not;) a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and verity.

djk_text: Da mi e taki go doo taki, mi wani manengee e begi, na ala peesi pe biibisama kon makandii. Ma na manengee di libi de apaiti fasi, fu poi opo ana a tapu begi. Da den mu de sondee fu oli taawan na ati, soseefi biibi sondee pantan taki, Masaa Gadu e yee den.
eng_text: I will therefore that men pray every where, lifting up holy hands, without wrath and doubting.

djk_text: Da biibi uman ape mu e wei koosi di e soi lesipeki fu den sikin. Den mu abi moi saka fasi. Da den mu wooko anga bunbun fusutan. Ma den mu si beei fu gaan moi uwii, fu lawlaw sani. Soseefi, a wei fu gaan dii gowtu sani ofu gaan dii koosi.
eng_text: In like manner also, that women adorn themselves in modest apparel, with shamefacedness and sobriety; not with broided hair, or gold, or pearls, or costly array;

djk_text: Bika a moi fu den, dati mu de a bun di den e du fiti Masaa Gadu. Da ala sama sa si taki, den tiiki uman di lobi dini Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: But (which becometh women professing godliness) with good works.

djk_text: Da meke den uman ya libi pii anga ala saka fasi, fu teke Masaa Gadu leli.
eng_text: Let the woman learn in silence with all subjection.

djk_text: Mi á wani si uman poti denseefi enke basi, fu leli manengee. Ma meke den libi pii fu den.
eng_text: But I suffer not a woman to teach, nor to usurp authority over the man, but to be in silence.

djk_text: Bika na Adan enke manengee fosi Masaa Gadu be meke, fosi a be meke a uman den e kai Efa.
eng_text: For Adam was first formed, then Eve.

djk_text: Soseefi, da a ná Adan enke manengee, didibii be fende pasi koli, fu poli Masaa Gadu weiti. Ma na a uman didibii be fende pasi koli, poli Masaa Gadu weiti.
eng_text: And Adam was not deceived, but the woman being deceived was in the transgression.

djk_text: Ma toku, Masaa Gadu yeepi de gi uman sama seefi. Winsi a sitaafu de gi den ete, fu meke pikin anga taanga. Ma meke den lobi Masaa Gadu. Meke den tan oli biibi doo. Meke den libi de apaiti fasi. Meke den wooko anga bunbun fusutan. Soseefi moi saka fasi.
eng_text: Notwithstanding she shall be saved in childbearing, if they continue in faith and charity and holiness with sobriety.

djk_text: We, efu wan sama wani toon edeman, fu luku taa biibiwan, da ai suku wan gaan bun wooko. Dati na wan tuutuu taki.
eng_text: This is a true saying, If a man desire the office of a bishop, he desireth a good work.

djk_text: Ma en fasi fu libi mu de bun, fu sama á mu poi fende olo kaagi en anga leti. Da a mu abi wan kodo uman namo. A mu poti en ede bun. A mu e wooko anga bunbun fusutan. A mu abi manii anga lesipeki. En osu doo mu opo gi taawan. A mu poi leli taawan Masaa Gadu leli wan bun fasi.
eng_text: A bishop then must be blameless, the husband of one wife, vigilant, sober, of good behaviour, given to hospitality, apt to teach;

djk_text: Diingi á mu poi peemi en basi. Moni á mu poi peemi en basi tu. A á mu kaakeli. Ma a mu e wooko switi piisii fasi anga taawan.
eng_text: Not given to wine, no striker, not greedy of filthy lucre; but patient, not a brawler, not covetous;

djk_text: A mu sabi tii en osu libi bun. A mu sabi kiya en pikin fu kon komoto bun.
eng_text: One that ruleth well his own house, having his children in subjection with all gravity;

djk_text: Bika efu wan sama á poi tii en osu libi, da fa a sa tii den sama fu Masaa Gadu?
eng_text: (For if a man know not how to rule his own house, how shall he take care of the church of God?)

djk_text: Da a á mu de wan sama di teke biibi nyun nyun tu. Bika, da kande a sa kisi hei membee. Da Masaa Gadu o abi fu kuutu en fu dati, enke fa a kuutu didibii.
eng_text: Not a novice, lest being lifted up with pride he fall into the condemnation of the devil.

djk_text: Da sama di nái biibi mu sabi en enke wan bunbun sama. Ofu so, den o fende olo kaagi en anga leti. Bika a didibii o sete sani gi en, fu meke a tyai nen fu takuudu man.
eng_text: Moreover he must have a good report of them which are without; lest he fall into reproach and the snare of the devil.

djk_text: We, manengee di mu taampu a baka fu den edeman, mu tan na a fasi fu lesipeki. Den mu poi taki leti taki. Diingi á mu poi pee den basi. Da den á mu e suku moni ofu wini wan fasi di á fiti.
eng_text: Likewise must the deacons be grave, not doubletongued, not given to much wine, not greedy of filthy lucre;

djk_text: Den ati mu taampu kiin, sondee konsensi fonfon. Bika na sowan fasi bun, fu oli a tuutuu leli di Masaa Gadu gi wi.
eng_text: Holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.

djk_text: Da wan sama mu waka bun anga a biibi libi fosi, meke sama si dati, da a sa fende a wooko ya.
eng_text: And let these also first be proved; then let them use the office of a deacon, being found blameless.

djk_text: Na so a kulu uman di mu taampu a baka fu den edeman, seefi mu tan na a fasi fu lesipeki. Den á mu e kuutu sama. Den mu poti ede bun. Da sama mu poi fitoow den ala fasi.
eng_text: Even so must their wives be grave, not slanderers, sober, faithful in all things.

djk_text: We, da manengee di mu taampu a baka fu den edeman, mu abi wan kodo uman namo tu. Soseefi, den mu sabi tii den osu libi anga den pikin fu den bun tu.
eng_text: Let the deacons be the husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.

djk_text: Bika ibii sama di sa wooko bun so sa kisi lesipeki. Da den o abi a taanga fu soi taawan a biibi di den abi.
eng_text: For they that have used the office of a deacon well purchase to themselves a good degree, and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.

djk_text: We, Timotiyesi! Da mi e pakisei fu kon luku yu anda esi esi. Ma toku, mi sikiifi a biifi ya, fu soi yu den sani di i mu soi den taa biibiwan de.
eng_text: These things write I unto thee, hoping to come unto thee shortly:

djk_text: Bika efu pasi tapu fu mi kon, da toku i sa sabi soi den biibisama anda fa den mu libi anga den seefi. Bika na den na a famii fu a libilibi Gadu. Da na den mu taampu taanga fu oli a tuutuu leli fu Masaa Gadu. Na den mu luku, fu taa sama á sa daai a leli ya.
eng_text: But if I tarry long, that thou mayest know how thou oughtest to behave thyself in the house of God, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.

djk_text: Bika fu tuu! A tuutuu leli di Masaa Gadu puu kon a kiin gi wi ya bigi. Na dati e soi wi fa fu libi fiti Masaa Gadu. A leli ya taki: “Masaa saka kon soi enseefi libisama fasi. Ne a libi wan letiopu fasi anga a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu. Den Engel seefi si, fu kotoigi fi en. En nen bali na ala sowtu nasi mindii. Da den teke biibi fi en na ala se fu goontapu. A subi go teke a dyendee fasi fu Masaa Gadu Kondee.”
eng_text: And without controversy great is the mystery of godliness: God was manifest in the flesh, justified in the Spirit, seen of angels, preached unto the Gentiles, believed on in the world, received up into glory.

djk_text: Ma toku, da Masaa Gadu Jeje piki wi kiinkiin a fesi, fu sabi, fa bakaten somen sama o kai komoto na a tuutuu biibi ya. Bika den o teke lei leli di takuu jeje gi son sama fu taki. Soseefi, den o leli libi a sama di takuu jeje e tii.
eng_text: Now the Spirit speaketh expressly, that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of devils;

djk_text: Den falisi takiman de e du enke na a tuutuu leli den e tyai. Ma na soso lei den e paati. Ma konsensi á poi piki den moo seefi, fu a fowtu fasi de. Bika den lei te, ne den ati deki pasa peesi.
eng_text: Speaking lies in hypocrisy; having their conscience seared with a hot iron;

djk_text: Da den e tapu taki, sama ná abi pasi fu libi anga uman. Son sani á fiti fu sama nyan. Ma na soso lei! Bika na Masaa Gadu meke den sani ya fu sama nyan. Da biibisama di kon sabi a tuutuu leli fi en seefi sa teke den wooko tu, te den gi en daa fu dati namo. Da a sai kaba.
eng_text: Forbidding to marry, and commanding to abstain from meats, which God hath created to be received with thanksgiving of them which believe and know the truth.

djk_text: Bika ala san Masaa Gadu meke na bunbun sani sondee kina fu nyan. Da efu wi e gi en daa fu den, da u sa wooko anga den.
eng_text: For every creature of God is good, and nothing to be refused, if it be received with thanksgiving:

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu wowtu taki, ala san a meke de bunbun sondee kina fu nyan. Da te wan sama e gi Masaa Gadu daa fu den, da a bun fu wooko anga den kaba.
eng_text: For it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer.

djk_text: Timotiyesi! Leli taawan enke fa mi taki de! Da yu o de wan bun wookoman fu Kelestesi Jesesi. Yu libi sa soi taki, yu teke Masaa Gadu bosikopu lai yu ati, wan leti fasi. Soseefi yu abi a tuutuu leli di wi e biibi.
eng_text: If thou put the brethren in remembrance of these things, thou shalt be a good minister of Jesus Christ, nourished up in the words of faith and of good doctrine, whereunto thou hast attained.

djk_text: Ma wai a pasi gi lawlaw toli, bika den á de fu Masaa Gadu. Da feti seeka yu libi naamo fiti Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: But refuse profane and old wives' fables, and exercise thyself rather unto godliness.

djk_text: Bika feti seeka sikin sa waiti seefi! Ma seeka libi fiti Masaa Gadu moo de fanowdu. Bika dati o meke i fende bun di Masaa Gadu paamisi fu libi a goontapu doo tego seefi.
eng_text: For bodily exercise profiteth little: but godliness is profitable unto all things, having promise of the life that now is, and of that which is to come.

djk_text: Dati na wan tuutuu taki, fu teke sondee sitee.
eng_text: This is a faithful saying and worthy of all acceptation.

djk_text: Na a hii sani de meke wi e tei ati tyotyo du a taanga wooko ya. Bika wi poti fitoow na a libilibi Masaa Gadu, a Yeepiman fu ala sama, ma moomoo fu den sama di teke biibi.
eng_text: For therefore we both labour and suffer reproach, because we trust in the living God, who is the Saviour of all men, specially of those that believe.

djk_text: Timotiyesi! Na den sani ya i mu e bali taanga a taawan yesi, fu den teke leli.
eng_text: These things command and teach.

djk_text: Ma noiti meke sama si yu wan fasi, fu di i yonkuu. Ma meke sama sa poi si a yu, fa fu tyai denseefi. Meke den si fa yu e waka leti, fu teke dati. Fa yu e taki leti, fu teke dati. Fa yu lobi taawan, fu teke dati. Fa yu e biibi, fu teke dati. Fa yu abi wan kiin libi, fu teke dati.
eng_text: Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.

djk_text: Mi o kon a yu anda. Ma tan leisi Masaa Gadu Buku gi den taawan. Tan leli den a tuutuu leli. Tan soi den fa fu tyai denseefi naamo.
eng_text: Till I come, give attendance to reading, to exhortation, to doctrine.

djk_text: Noiti feegete fa Masaa Gadu be gi yu a apaiti taanga, fu tii a wooko ya. Edeman fu biibiwan be poti ana a i tapu, begi gi yu. Ne wanten de Masaa Gadu be piki apaiti takiman, fu taki, fu a apaiti taanga di a gi yu. Da wooko anga dati seefi.
eng_text: Neglect not the gift that is in thee, which was given thee by prophecy, with the laying on of the hands of the presbytery.

djk_text: Poti ede bun, fu du a wooko. Da ala sama o si fa yu e taampu moo anga moo taanga naamo, fu tii taa biibiwan.
eng_text: Meditate upon these things; give thyself wholly to them; that thy profiting may appear to all.

djk_text: Kenisi fa yu e tyai iseefi. Sabi fa yu e tyai a leli. Oli so doo, fu tan na a pasi, fu waka go kai a Masaa Gadu Kondee. Da sama di e teke yu taki o waka so tu.
eng_text: Take heed unto thyself, and unto the doctrine; continue in them: for in doing this thou shalt both save thyself, and them that hear thee.

djk_text: Timotiyesi! Da noiti taki saanti fasi anga sama di misi futu. Ma taki lesipeki fasi anga wan dda, enke fa i be o taki anga i eigi dda. Taki anga yonkuman enke fa i be o taki anga i eigi baala.
eng_text: Rebuke not an elder, but intreat him as a father; and the younger men as brethren;

djk_text: Taki lesipeki fasi anga wan mma, enke fa i be o taki anga i eigi mma. Taki anga pikin uman enke fa i be o taki anga i eigi sisa. Libi kiin anga pikin uman sondee koonkoon pakisei.
eng_text: The elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, with all purity.

djk_text: Luku fini fini sowtu biibi uman de, di man dede fika a ganda. Ne den fika tuutuu sondee sama fu solugu den. Da na den dati u biibisama de mu poti solugu.
eng_text: Honour widows that are widows indeed.

djk_text: Ma efu sowan mma abi gaangaan pikin kaba ofu gaan pikin pikin di teke biibi, da fika en gi den. Meke den pikin solugu a mma, fu den biibi sa soi. Soseefi, na wan bun den e du a mma baka, fu di a be kiya den. Masaa Gadu seefi wani si pikin e libi anga en gaansama so.
eng_text: But if any widow have children or nephews, let them learn first to shew piety at home, and to requite their parents: for that is good and acceptable before God.

djk_text: Bika son mma man dede kaba, ne a fika tuutuu sondee wan enkii taa sama. Da na Masaa Gadu namo de gi en, fu poti fitoow. Da ai tan begi dei anga neti, fu suku a yeepi fi en.
eng_text: Now she that is a widow indeed, and desolate, trusteth in God, and continueth in supplications and prayers night and day.

djk_text: Ma mma di teke fanya fanya libi, dati kaba a soso kaba, anga ala di den e boo ete. Bika den á taampu a Masaa Gadu pasi.
eng_text: But she that liveth in pleasure is dead while she liveth.

djk_text: Timotiyesi! Leli den uman di man dede fika a ganda anga den famii fu den, fu libi so. Da sama ná o poi fende olo kaagi den anga leti.
eng_text: And these things give in charge, that they may be blameless.

djk_text: Biibisama di nái solugu famii te go taki, sama a ini en osu baka, da ai gi a biibi libi ogii nen. Da a ogii moo sama di nái biibi.
eng_text: But if any provide not for his own, and specially for those of his own house, he hath denied the faith, and is worse than an infidel.

djk_text: Ma luku sowtu mma de leti, fu teke poti solugu. A mu de wan mma di pasa sigisitenti yali kaba. Da a be libi anga a wan man fi en namo.
eng_text: Let not a widow be taken into the number under threescore years old, having been the wife of one man,

djk_text: Sama mu poi kotoigi fi en fa a de wan bun mma. Da ai libi switi piisii fasi anga taawan. A kiya ala en pikin kon komoto sama. En osu doo opo gi taawan. Ai solugu sama fu Masaa Gadu anga ala saka fasi. Ai yeepi taawan di de a fuka. Fu taki leti, ala fasi ai poti enseefi du soso bun sani.
eng_text: Well reported of for good works; if she have brought up children, if she have lodged strangers, if she have washed the saints' feet, if she have relieved the afflicted, if she have diligently followed every good work.

djk_text: Ma efu wan mma á doo sigisitenti yali ete, da ná teke en poti fu solugu. Bika di den o wani man baka, da den o go libi anga man baka.
eng_text: But the younger widows refuse: for when they have begun to wax wanton against Christ, they will marry;

djk_text: Da na wan gaan ogii den du a lanti fesi. Bika den booko a hii kuudei di den be meke, fu tan sondee man, fu dini Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi wawan.
eng_text: Having damnation, because they have cast off their first faith.

djk_text: Soseefi, efu u poti den fu solugu, da dati o meke den sidon lesi, langa futu sondee wooko. Da den o bigin waka a futu go a sama osu. Ma a ná dati wawan. Den o waka tyai sama taki. Den o sutu mofu a ini sama sani, fu taki sani di á de den fanowdu.
eng_text: And withal they learn to be idle, wandering about from house to house; and not only idle, but tattlers also and busybodies, speaking things which they ought not.

djk_text: Da mi wani si den sowtu moo yonkuu mma ya teke wan man libi baka, fu meke pikin. Da den sa toon bunbun uman a osu. Da wi feyanti ná o poi fende olo kaagi wi anga leti.
eng_text: I will therefore that the younger women marry, bear children, guide the house, give none occasion to the adversary to speak reproachfully.

djk_text: Timotiyesi! Na so yu mu leli den mma ya! Bika somen fu den daai baka gi a biibi, ne den teke a pasi fu a didibii.
eng_text: For some are already turned aside after Satan.

djk_text: We, meke moo yonkuu biibi uman seefi luku sowtu uman de a ini en famii, di man dede fika a ganda. Da meke a solugu a mma de sondee fu fika a fuka de gi a kulu fu biibisama. Bika na mma di fika tuutuu sondee wan enkii taa sama, na den dati u mu teke poti fu solugu.
eng_text: If any man or woman that believeth have widows, let them relieve them, and let not the church be charged; that it may relieve them that are widows indeed.

djk_text: Timotiyesi! Ibii edeman di e tii biibiwan bun, mu kisi moo gaan paiman. Moomoo, den di e moo wooko taanga baka, fu bali Masaa Gadu bosikopu, soseefi fu leli sama tyai denseefi.
eng_text: Let the elders that rule well be counted worthy of double honour, especially they who labour in the word and doctrine.

djk_text: A ná fu soso Masaa Gadu Buku sikiifi taki: “Te kaw e masi alisi, yu á mu tei en mofu.” Bika, soseefi, a sikiifi taki: “Pe yu e wooko, na ape i mu nyan.”
eng_text: For the scripture saith, Thou shalt not muzzle the ox that treadeth out the corn. And, The labourer is worthy of his reward.

djk_text: Te sama kon kaagi wan edeman de, da luku fosi onmen sama tyai a kaagi ya kon. Efu na wan kodo sama, da yu á mu teke a taki de fu taki. Ma efu na moo enke wan sama, da i sa teke en, fu taki.
eng_text: Against an elder receive not an accusation, but before two or three witnesses.

djk_text: Da efu a du wan ogii tuu, da kai en bali na ala taa biibiwan. Da ala taawan o feele fu waka enke en.
eng_text: Them that sin rebuke before all, that others also may fear.

djk_text: Timotiyesi! Masaa Gadu e si fa mi e soi yu. Kelestesi Jesesi anga ala den Engel tu. Fosi wan takitaki, da yu á mu denki a fesi taki, na disi anga dati fowtu. Yu á mu teke wan sama se, fosi a taki kaba taki.
eng_text: I charge thee before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the elect angels, that thou observe these things without preferring one before another, doing nothing by partiality.

djk_text: Timotiyesi! Da noiti gaw fu poti ana a sama tapu, fu begi gi den toon edeman, fu tii biibiwan. Luku fosi fa ai tyai enseefi a Masaa Gadu pasi. Bika efu a nái waka bun, da a o gei enke yuseefi de a ini ogii di ai du. Dati á mu pasa! Bika yu libi mu kiin sondee takuudu.
eng_text: Lay hands suddenly on no man, neither be partaker of other men's sins: keep thyself pure.

djk_text: Timotiyesi! We, ná diingi soso wataa gi a swaki di i lobi fii anga a bee ati fi yu. Bika a diingi fu pikinso win bun gi den sowtu endii de.
eng_text: Drink no longer water, but use a little wine for thy stomach's sake and thine often infirmities.

djk_text: Timotiyesi! Son sama e du ogii gaangaan na ala sama fesi, fu si nownow kaba, fa Masaa Gadu o sitaafu den. Ma son sama e du ogii bakabaka, meke sama nái si. Ma bakaten na a kuutu dei fu Masaa Gadu, da ala dati o kon a kiin, fu gi sitaafu.
eng_text: Some men's sins are open beforehand, going before to judgment; and some men they follow after.

djk_text: Soseefi, son sama e du bun gaangaan na ala sama fesi. Ma son fu den e du bun bakabaka, meke sama nái si. Ma dati ná o tan kibii gi Masaa Gadu tu, fu pai den.
eng_text: Likewise also the good works of some are manifest beforehand; and they that are otherwise cannot be hid.

djk_text: We, biibisama di de saafu a katibo! Lesipeki yu basi, meke yu libi á sa gi Masaa Gadu ogii nen. Soseefi, da sama ná o poi fende olo kaagi a leli fu wi anga leti.
eng_text: Let as many servants as are under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honour, that the name of God and his doctrine be not blasphemed.

djk_text: Efu na biibi basi, toku yu mu lesipeki en. Ná pakisei taki, na biibi basi, da yu oli en wan fasi. Kweti! Wooko moo bun gi en seefi. Bika a basi di o fende a bun fu dati, na wan lobi biibiwan fi yu, di e feti fu du bun. Timotiyesi! Soi taa biibiwan taanga san mi o taki ya.
eng_text: And they that have believing masters, let them not despise them, because they are brethren; but rather do them service, because they are faithful and beloved, partakers of the benefit. These things teach and exhort.

djk_text: Sama di e tyai wan taa sowtu leli nái wooko anga a bunbun leli di wi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi gi wi. Soseefi, dati nái fiti a leli di e soi fa fu libi fiti Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: If any man teach otherwise, and consent not to wholesome words, even the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness;

djk_text: Ma na bigi membee e subi den dati. A ná enke den sabi sani seefi. Ma den lobi sitee taki. Da den e dyalusu. Efu sama taki wan sani, den e dyombo piki taki: “A ná tuu!” Den e waka poli taawan nen. Den e si ibii taa sama enke soso takuuduman, di á de fu fitoow.
eng_text: He is proud, knowing nothing, but doting about questions and strifes of words, whereof cometh envy, strife, railings, evil surmisings,

djk_text: Den e waka e suku taawan mofu. A hii fusutan fu den poli te, ne den á poi denki bunbun sani. Den lasi a pasi fu a tuutuu bosikopu. Ne den kon e si a biibi libi enke sani fu suku wini fu denseefi namo.
eng_text: Perverse disputings of men of corrupt minds, and destitute of the truth, supposing that gain is godliness: from such withdraw thyself.

djk_text: We, libi fiti Masaa Gadu, da tifeedi anga san yu abi. Da yu na wan tuutuu gudu sama kaba.
eng_text: But godliness with contentment is great gain.

djk_text: Bika na piipii u kon a goontapu. Da na piipii wi o gwe ya baka.
eng_text: For we brought nothing into this world, and it is certain we can carry nothing out.

djk_text: Da efu u abi tanpeesi, nyanyan anga koosi fu libi, da de tifeedi.
eng_text: And having food and raiment let us be therewith content.

djk_text: Bika feti fu toon guduman sa tyai tesi kon a yu pasi. Da yu o waka wan fasi di á fiti. Bika yu o fasi a ini ala sowtu ogii, di yu poli denki e losutu. Na dati e tyai sama go kaba a soso.
eng_text: But they that will be rich fall into temptation and a snare, and into many foolish and hurtful lusts, which drown men in destruction and perdition.

djk_text: Bika a mama fu ogii, na feti a moni baka. Dati puu somen sama na a pasi fu a biibi kaba. A tyai booko sikin anga gaan buduufu gi somen sama kaba.
eng_text: For the love of money is the root of all evil: which while some coveted after, they have erred from the faith, and pierced themselves through with many sorrows.

djk_text: Timotiyesi! Ma yu na sama fu Masaa Gadu! Da kibii iseefi fu takuu sowtu libi. Da feti seefi, fu libi wan letiopu libi. Feti libi fiti Masaa Gadu. Feti teke wan fitoow fasi fu biibi. Feti lobi taawan. Tei ati fu oli doo te banowtu ten doo. Feti wooko switi piisii fasi ete, winsi sama e sitee anga yu.
eng_text: But thou, O man of God, flee these things; and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, meekness.

djk_text: Luku fa sama e sitee lon taanga, fu de winiman. Feti letiso, fu de wan bun biibisama, di sa wini a gaan winiman paiman. Dati na libi tego anga Masaa Gadu. Na fu dati meke Masaa Gadu kai yu kon toon sama fi enseefi. Ne i be taigi somen sama, fa yu e biibi fu teke Masaa Jesesi taki.
eng_text: Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, whereunto thou art also called, and hast professed a good profession before many witnesses.

djk_text: Timotiyesi! Mi o sende i wan sani ya! Da Masaa Gadu di e gi ala sama libi, e si! Kelestesi Jesesi seefi di be taampu a Gaaman Pontiyesi Pilatesi fesi, fu kotoigi fi enseefi.
eng_text: I give thee charge in the sight of God, who quickeneth all things, and before Christ Jesus, who before Pontius Pilate witnessed a good confession;

djk_text: Yee ya! Tyai a wooko di Masaa Gadu gi yu, wan bun fasi. Meke sama á poi fende olo kaagi yu anga leti. Tan wooko so, te enke wi Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi kon baka.
eng_text: That thou keep this commandment without spot, unrebukeable, until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ:

djk_text: Bika di Masaa Gadu yuu o doo, da a o meke Masaa Jesesi kon baka. A seigi Masaa Gadu ya abi ala makiti. En na a Kownu fu kownu anga Masaa fu masaa.
eng_text: Which in his times he shall shew, who is the blessed and only Potentate, the King of kings, and Lord of lords;

djk_text: Na a Gadu ya wawan namo dede á poi kii. Ai tan a wan peesi di e beenki te, sama á poi doo de. Soseefi, sama ain á poi si en. Da sama á de di si en wanten. Ne en ala sama mu gi gaandi. Soseefi, den mu taki, a abi ala makiti tego! Amen, na so a de!
eng_text: Who only hath immortality, dwelling in the light which no man can approach unto; whom no man hath seen, nor can see: to whom be honour and power everlasting. Amen.

djk_text: Timotiyesi! We, son biibisama de di abi gudu a goontapu ya. Leli den dati, fu den á meke bigi fu di den gudu. Den á mu luku a gudu enke sani fu poti fitoow. Bika na fu wooko wan pisiten namo. Ma meke fitoow Masaa Gadu di gi den tyaipi sani so, fu meke den libi switi.
eng_text: Charge them that are rich in this world, that they be not highminded, nor trust in uncertain riches, but in the living God, who giveth us richly all things to enjoy;

djk_text: Da meke den du bun anga den sani ya. Da den sa teli dati enke a tuutuu gudu di den abi. Da den á mu giili fu gi sama sani. Ma meke den lobi gi taawan san den abi fanowdu.
eng_text: That they do good, that they be rich in good works, ready to distribute, willing to communicate;

djk_text: Da Masaa Gadu o dyunta tuutuu gudu di nái poli, fu gi den bakaten na a libi tego a Masaa Gadu Kondee. Na dati den mu feti fu fende.
eng_text: Laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold on eternal life.

djk_text: Timotiyesi! Gaantangi, solugu a hii wooko di Masaa Gadu fitoow yu. Ma wai a pasi gi taki di nái fiti Masaa Gadu anga ala taa wisiwasi taki. Bika son sama e si den taki de enke gaan koni taki.
eng_text: O Timothy, keep that which is committed to thy trust, avoiding profane and vain babblings, and oppositions of science falsely so called:

djk_text: Ne dati tyai buuya gi den. Bika a meke den wai komoto na a pasi fu a tuutuu biibi a Masaa Gadu bosikopu. Timotiyesi! Meke Masaa Gadu tan luku u ala anda bun ati fasi namo.
eng_text: Which some professing have erred concerning the faith. Grace be with thee. Amen.

djk_text: Na mi, Pawlesi e meke a biifi ya sende gi yu Timotiyesi, enke mi tuutuu lobi manpikin. Enke fa i sabi, da mi na wan apaiti bosikopuman fu Kelestesi Jesesi. Na Masaa Gadu seefi fende en fu bun, ne a kai mi kon poti na a wooko ya, fu mi mu waka taigi sama a libi di Masaa Gadu paamisi fu gi wi a Kelestesi Jesesi. Timotiyesi, da meke wi Tata, Masaa Gadu anga wi Masaa, Kelestesi Jesesi teke gaan bun ati fasi anga tyali ati fasi luku yu. Soseefi meke yu ati de switi.
eng_text: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, according to the promise of life which is in Christ Jesus,

djk_text: Mi e gi Masaa Gadu, di mi e dini anga wan tuutuu letiopu ati enke den avo gaansama fu mi, gaantangi fu yu ede. Mi nái tapu kai yu nen, fu e begi gi yu. Ma mi e tan begi dei anga neti gi yu naamo.
eng_text: I thank God, whom I serve from my forefathers with pure conscience, that without ceasing I have remembrance of thee in my prayers night and day;

djk_text: Son yuu mi e pakisei fa yu ain be lon wataa di u be mu naki paati. Da mi e angii fu miti anga yu baka, te ná sipowtu. Da dati sa meke mi ati fuu anga piisii te doo.
eng_text: Greatly desiring to see thee, being mindful of thy tears, that I may be filled with joy;

djk_text: Ma te mi e denki yu Timotiyesi, da mi e denki fa yuseefi e biibi Gadu tu. I tiiki a fasi fa yu gaan mama Luwisa, anga i mma Enike, be e biibi Gadu a fesi tu. Da mi sabi taki yu abi a taanga sowtu biibi enke den.
eng_text: When I call to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in thee, which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and I am persuaded that in thee also.

djk_text: Da fu dati ede meke, mi wani i membee wan sani ete. Membee a dei di mi be poti ana a yu tapu begi gi yu, fa Masaa Gadu be gi yu wan apaiti taanga, fi i wooko gi en. We, i mu wooko faya faya anga dati.
eng_text: Wherefore I put thee in remembrance that thou stir up the gift of God, which is in thee by the putting on of my hands.

djk_text: Bika a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu di a gi wi ya, a ná wan Jeje fu meke u de feele fasi. Ma na fu gi wi kaakiti, meke u sa du san Masaa Gadu wani. Soseefi ai meke u lobi taa sama. Soseefi ai yeepi wi, fu wooko anga bunbun fusutan.
eng_text: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.

djk_text: We, di a gi wi en Jeje so kaba, da yu á mu meke sen kisi yu, kweti kweti fu paati a bosikopu fu wi Masaa. Soseefi, da sen á mu kisi yu seefi fu mi, fu di mi de a dunguu osu ya fu wi Masaa ede. Ma yu mu e soi sama a Bun Nyunsu naamo, winsi banowtu o kon a yu tapu enke mi, fu dati. Bika Masaa Gadu seefi gi wi a kaakiti fu du a wooko ya.
eng_text: Be not thou therefore ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner: but be thou partaker of the afflictions of the gospel according to the power of God;

djk_text: Bika Masaa Gadu kai wi puu a takuudu anga ogii. Ne a teke wi poti toon sama di libi de apaiti fasi gi Masaa Gadu. Ma a ná enke na bun useefi be bun so. Nono! Ma na a gaan bun ati fasi fi en, anga fu di a be fiti poti langa ten a fesi kaba taki, a o du so. Na fu dati ede. Bika fosi a be meke goontapu, da a be fiti poti kaba taki, a be o sende Jesesi Kelestesi kon puu wi a takuudu anga ogii.
eng_text: Who hath saved us, and called us with an holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given us in Christ Jesus before the world began,

djk_text: Ma now, da a gaan bun ati fasi fi en kon a kiin. Bika u si taki a Yeepiman fu wi, Kelestesi Jesesi kon tuu. Da di a kon, da a booko a kaakiti fu dede te doo. Na so a meke u kon sabi taki wan nyunyun libi anga wan nyunyun sikin, di dede á poi kii moo de tu. Da na so a Bun Nyunsu fu Masaa Gadu e soi wi.
eng_text: But is now made manifest by the appearing of our Saviour Jesus Christ, who hath abolished death, and hath brought life and immortality to light through the gospel:

djk_text: We, Masaa poti mi fu bali a Bun Nyunsu ya na ala se. Soseefi a poti mi enke apaiti bosikopuman anga wan sama di mu leli sama fini fini fa fu libi enke fa Kelestesi Jesesi wani.
eng_text: Whereunto I am appointed a preacher, and an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.

djk_text: Da na fu di mi e du a wooko ya, meke mi e kisi gaan banowtu so. Ma mi nái sen fu dati fu lasi ati booko saka. Bika mi sabi tuutuu a sama tapu mi poti mi fitoow. Bika Masaa pe mi poti mi fitoow abi tuutuu kaakiti fu kibii a Bun Nyunsu fi en di a poti a mi ana doo te na a dei di a o kuutu ala sama.
eng_text: For the which cause I also suffer these things: nevertheless I am not ashamed: for I know whom I have believed, and am persuaded that he is able to keep that which I have committed unto him against that day.

djk_text: Soo, we Timotiyesi, den sani di mi be leli yu na tuutuu leli. Da teke den poti luku fa fi i leli den sama a wan bun fasi. Tan poti fitoow a Kelestesi Jesesi go doo. Soseefi lobi sama anga a lobi di wi e fende a Kelestesi Jesesi.
eng_text: Hold fast the form of sound words, which thou hast heard of me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

djk_text: Ma yu mu koni anga a Bun Nyunsu di Masaa Gadu poti a yu ana de, fu sama á kon daai en. I mu meke a Jeje fu Masaa Gadu di e tan a ini wi yeepi yu fu kibii en, fu a á poli kaba a soso.
eng_text: That good thing which was committed unto thee keep by the Holy Ghost which dwelleth in us.

djk_text: We, Timotiyesi, iseefi sabi taki ala den biibisama fu Asiya pisiwataa daai baka gi mi. Fikeles anga Hemokeines seefi fika mi wawan tu.
eng_text: This thou knowest, that all they which are in Asia be turned away from me; of whom are Phygellus and Hermogenes.

djk_text: Ma mi e begi gi Onesifoles fu Masaa abi tyali ati fi en anga den sama fi en osu. Bika sen á kisi en fu a kon luku mi a dunguu osu ya. Da a meke mi fii piisii anga dati.
eng_text: The Lord give mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus; for he oft refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain:

djk_text: Ma pe fu a sen gi mi, ne fa i si a doo Loma Foto, ne a lon suku mi wanten na ala peesi. Na so a suku te a fende mi a pe mi de a dunguu osu.
eng_text: But, when he was in Rome, he sought me out very diligently, and found me.

djk_text: Ma iseefi sabi den somen bun di a man ya du gi mi a Efese Foto. Mi ná abi fu taigi yu moo fa a be yeepi mi kisi. Da meke Masaa yeepi en baka na a gaan kuutu dei a Masaa fesi. Meke a abi tyali ati fi en.
eng_text: The Lord grant unto him that he may find mercy of the Lord in that day: and in how many things he ministered unto me at Ephesus, thou knowest very well.

djk_text: We, mi manpikin Timotiyesi! I mu gi Jesesi Kelestesi pasi fu a teke en bun ati fasi wooko a ini yu. Meke i fende taanga anga kaakiti fu oli taanga go doo a ini a wooko.
eng_text: Thou therefore, my son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.

djk_text: Leli taawan a hii tuutuu leli di mi be leli yu. Da yu mu teke a leli ya gi bunbun sama di i sa fitoow di abi koni sai fu leli taawan bunbun baka. Bika tyaipi taa sama seefi fende taki na a tuutuu leli fu Masaa Gadu mi gi yu.
eng_text: And the things that thou hast heard of me among many witnesses, the same commit thou to faithful men, who shall be able to teach others also.

djk_text: I mu de kaba kaba fu tei ati teke banowtu fu Masaa Jesesi Kelestesi ede, leti enke fa wan bunbun suudati de kaba kaba fu teke banowtu fi en kondee ede a ini wan feti.
eng_text: Thou therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.

djk_text: Bika te suudati de a feti tapu, da den nái wooko moo enke wan kuwownu sama. Nono! Den e wooko fu a komandanti fu den mu piisii anga den na a fasi fa den e wooko.
eng_text: No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier.

djk_text: Da soseefi tu, te sama de a sitee lon e lon fu wini wan sani, da efu a á lon a lon na a fasi di a mu lon, da a ná o fende a paiman di wan winiman e fende.
eng_text: And if a man also strive for masteries, yet is he not crowned, except he strive lawfully.

djk_text: Da na soseefi wan sama di e wooko taanga paandi en goon tu. A fiti fu en fosi fende a nyanyan fu a goon nyan.
eng_text: The husbandman that laboureth must be first partaker of the fruits.

djk_text: Timotiyesi, pakisei den sani di mi e taki ya bun. Bika Masaa Gadu o yeepi yu fi i fusutan ala fa den de anga fa i mu du a wooko fi i.
eng_text: Consider what I say; and the Lord give thee understanding in all things.

djk_text: Ma Timotiyesi, yu á mu feegete taki, Jesesi Kelestesi be dede koti boo pii, ma Masaa Gadu weki en puu a dede kon a libi ya baka. A be meke enke bakaten pikin fu Kownu Dafeti paansu tuu. Disi na a Bun Nyunsu fu mi, di mi e waka e bali na ala pe mi go.
eng_text: Remember that Jesus Christ of the seed of David was raised from the dead according to my gospel:

djk_text: Da na fu a Bun Nyunsu ya ede meke i si banowtu e kon a mi tapu so. Den kisi mi bui poti a dunguu osu enke wan sama di du ogii. Bika na mi den kisi bui, ma a wowtu fu Masaa Gadu ná wan sama di poi bui en.
eng_text: Wherein I suffer trouble, as an evil doer, even unto bonds; but the word of God is not bound.

djk_text: Na fu dati ede meke mi e tei ati e teke ala den banowtu di e kon a mi tapu ya anga pasensi. Bika mi e pakisei den sama di Masaa Gadu teke toon fi en seefi. Kelestesi Jesesi o tyai yeepi gi den puu den a ini a libi fu takuudu. Da Kelestesi Jesesi o gi den a libi fu tego na a gaan dyendee peesi pe Masaa Gadu seefi e tan.
eng_text: Therefore I endure all things for the elect's sakes, that they may also obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.

djk_text: Da Timotiyesi, den sani di mi o taigi yu ya now, na tuutuu sani fu teke: Bika efu wi anga Kelestesi Jesesi dede makandii, da wi anga en o libi makandii tu.
eng_text: It is a faithful saying: For if we be dead with him, we shall also live with him:

djk_text: Da efu wi tei ati oli doo, da wi anga en o tii ala sani makandii a bakaten. Da efu wi piki taki, wi á sabi en, da en seefi o piki a fesi fi en Tata tu taki a á sabi wi.
eng_text: If we suffer, we shall also reign with him: if we deny him, he also will deny us:

djk_text: Awinsi wi á de fu fitoow seefi, ma en dati naamo abi fitoow fasi. Bika a á poi daai enseefi poti taa fasi.
eng_text: If we believe not, yet he abideth faithful: he cannot deny himself.

djk_text: We, Timotiyesi, i mu tan membee den taa sama di e gi leli anda taki, den á mu de ape e taki soso taki e ali go e ali kon. Bika den sowtu taki de, nái tyai yeepi gi sama, kweti kweti. Ma na poli den e poli den sama di e yee den kaba anga den a soso.
eng_text: Of these things put them in remembrance, charging them before the Lord that they strive not about words to no profit, but to the subverting of the hearers.

djk_text: Da Timotiyesi, yu mu feti fu Masaa Gadu sa abi piisii anga yu. Wooko leti fu sen á kisi yu bakaten taki yu á wooko bun. I mu leli den sama a tuutuu bosikopu fu Masaa Gadu enke fa a fiti.
eng_text: Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.

djk_text: Ma yu á mu poti mofu a ini den soso taki de, kweti kweti. Bika den soso taki de á fiti Masaa Gadu. Bika moo anga moo den sama di e taki den soso taki de e diipi komoto a Masaa Gadu pasi.
eng_text: But shun profane and vain babblings: for they will increase unto more ungodliness.

djk_text: Soseefi, da a falisi leli fu den sa poli wan sama hii libi enke fa soo sa booko poli wan sama hii sikin. Da na a wooko ya, Himeneyesi anga Feleites e waka e du.
eng_text: And their word will eat as doth a canker: of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus;

djk_text: Den komoto fika a tuutuu leli fu Masaa Gadu go e leli sama taki a weki baka a dede pasa kaba. Da anga sowtu leli de, den e fuduwali son sama te, den á sabi fa fu biibi moo.
eng_text: Who concerning the truth have erred, saying that the resurrection is past already; and overthrow the faith of some.

djk_text: Ma toku, dati á poi poli a tuutuu leli fu Masaa Gadu, kweti kweti. Bika a leli ya taki, Masaa Gadu sabi den sama fi en. Da sama di wani de fu Masaa mu daai baka fika ogii.
eng_text: Nevertheless the foundation of God standeth sure, having this seal, The Lord knoweth them that are his. And, Let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity.

djk_text: Ma luku wan gaan osu te a kaba. Somen sowtu a sowtu sani de a ini fu teke wooko. Gowtu sani de ape. Solufu sani anga udu sani seefi de ape tu. Ma soseefi sani di den meke anga tokotoko de ape tu. Son fu den sani ya na fu teke du wan lagi wooko. Taawan baka na fu teke du wan hei wooko. Na a sowtu fasi ya, biibisama de gi Masaa Gadu fu teke wooko tu.
eng_text: But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth; and some to honour, and some to dishonour.

djk_text: Da wan sama, efi i fika den ogii sani di u taki a fesi de, ne i kon e libi enke fa Masaa Gadu wani, da i de enke wan fu den moo waiti sani fu wan osu di den sa teke du wan gaan wooko. Bika a de apaiti fasi gi a Masaa, da ala yuu na yuu fu a Masaa teke en du wan bunbun wooko.
eng_text: If a man therefore purge himself from these, he shall be a vessel unto honour, sanctified, and meet for the master's use, and prepared unto every good work.

djk_text: We, Timotiyesi, lon wai a pasi gi den takuu losutu di e kon a yonkuu sama pasi. Ma feti fi i libi wan letiopu libi a Masaa Gadu fesi. I mu e biibi Masaa Gadu. I mu lobi Masaa Gadu anga libisama. Wooko switi makandii anga ibii taa sama.
eng_text: Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.

djk_text: Ná mosoo iseefi anga den sama di e sitee gaan sitee e taki soso wisiwasi toli di ná abi wini. Bika iseefi sabi, da na soso kwali, feti anga toobi den sowtu sani de e tyai kon.
eng_text: But foolish and unlearned questions avoid, knowing that they do gender strifes.

djk_text: Ma wan wookoman fu Masaa Gadu á mu lobi e sitee e meke gaan toobi. Ma a mu abi switi fasi anga ala sama. A mu sabi fa fu leli taawan. Da soseefi a mu wooko anga ala pasensi tu.
eng_text: And the servant of the Lord must not strive; but be gentle unto all men, apt to teach, patient,

djk_text: Da a mu kaasi den sama di e tyai falisi leli anga ala saafi saka fasi. Bika yu á poi sabi. Kande Masaa Gadu seefi sa opo den ain fu meke den daai libi, fu kon fusutan a tuutuu leli fu Masaa Gadu, enke fa a mu de.
eng_text: In meekness instructing those that oppose themselves; if God peradventure will give them repentance to the acknowledging of the truth;

djk_text: Da na so den sa kisi fusutan fu lon komoto a ini a kisi di didibii be kisi den poti fu du san a wani anga den.
eng_text: And that they may recover themselves out of the snare of the devil, who are taken captive by him at his will.

djk_text: Ma Timotiyesi, yu mu sabi taki gaan taanga ten o kon a goontapu a den kiiboi dei fosi Masaa daai kon baka.
eng_text: This know also, that in the last days perilous times shall come.

djk_text: Bika ibii sama o lobi fu feti soso fi en seefi namo. Den o abi tumisi taanga lobi fu moni moo ala taa sani. Den o abi bigi membee fu opo denseefi poti enke den dyendee moo taa sama. Den o go e taki soso takuu anga ogii fu saanti Masaa Gadu anga libisama. Da den o abi taanga yesi te, den ná o saka denseefi a den gaansama ondoo. Den ná o pakisei fu gi Masaa Gadu daa fu san ai du gi den. Te go taki libisama. Den ná o go e lesipeki ná wan sani fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: For men shall be lovers of their own selves, covetous, boasters, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,

djk_text: Den o libi sondee lobi fu taawan. Den o si enke na den wawan abi leti naamo. Soseefi den o meke lei e poli taawan nen. Da den ná o poi dwengi denseefi oli bun fasi. Den o go e waka e libi fanya fanya enke meti. Da a sani di den e kai bun, na wan sani di den ná o lobi, kweti kweti.
eng_text: Without natural affection, trucebreakers, false accusers, incontinent, fierce, despisers of those that are good,

djk_text: Da ná wan sama di o go e fitoow den moo seefi, bika den o go e konkuu taawan. Den o go e wooko goofu anga taawan. Ma soseefi tu, den o go e fii den seefi moo hei moo ala taa sama. Den o lobi nyan diingi meke piisii moo enke lobi fu Masaa Gadu.
eng_text: Traitors, heady, highminded, lovers of pleasures more than lovers of God;

djk_text: Ma toku, da den sama ya o kai den seefi tuutuu biibisama. Ma a hii du anga libi fu den o soi taki, den ná opo den ati fu libi enke fa Masaa Gadu wani. Timotiyesi! Yu á mu mosoo iseefi anga den sowtu sama de, kweti kweti!
eng_text: Having a form of godliness, but denying the power thereof: from such turn away.

djk_text: Bika den sowtu sama ya e waka e naki sama politiki enke den na bunbun sama fi i kai den kon a osu. Da te den kon a osu kaba, da den e suku fu kisi den poli libi uman di de ape poti fu biibi den. Bika den uman ya be gwenti libi a poli libi di den ati be e opo den kaba. Da fu di den e feti fu puu a tyali di fika a den ati fu a libi ya, meke den teke san den leiman ya e leli den. Ma den á de fu teke a tuutuu leli fu Masaa.
